headline: Maaniya vilaiyil vaikkol vivasaayigal korikkai
text:
Mettupalayam: ‘vaikkol theevanathai maaniya vilaiyil vazhanga nadavadikkai edukka vendum’ ena, uzhavar amaippu vivasaayigal korikkai viduthullanar.
Mettupalayam thaalugaavil vivasaayathukku aduthavadiyaaga, vivasaayigal karavai maadugal valarppu merkondu varugindranar. Maadugalukku thevaiyaana pasundheevanathai, thangal vayalil payir seythu varugindranar. Tharpodhu mazhai peyyaadhadhaal theevanap pullukku podhiya thanneer illaamal kaayndhu varugiradhu. Adhanaal, Trichy, thanjjaiyil irundhu vaikkolai vilai koduthu vaangi karavai maadugalukku vazhangugindranar. Tharpodhu vaikkol kattin vilai uyarndhulladhu.
Kaaramadaiyai adutha muthukkallooril ulla kurinjji uzhavar mandra seyalaalar thevaraaj matrum uruppinargal kooriyadhaavadhu:
vivasaayigal ovvoruvarum irandu karavai maadugalukkum mel valarkkindranar. Indha maadugalukku thevaiyaana pasundheevana payirgalai, thangal nilathil vivasaayigal valarthu varugindranar. Karavai maadugalukku pasundheevanam adhigam koduthaal, paal adhigam kidaikkum. Naangu maadhangalaaga mazhai peyyaadhadhaal, kinarugalil thanneer kuraindhulladhu. Podhiya thanneer illaadhadhaal, theevanappayirgal vaadi varugindrana. Karavai maadugalukku vaikkol vaangi, theevanamaaga vazhangi varugirom.
Naangu maadhangalukku mun, oru vaikkol kattin vilai, 250 roobaayaaga irundhadhu. Adhigamaana vivasaayigal vaangi varuvadhaal oru kattin vilai, 350 roobaayaaga vilai uyarthi ullanar. Punnaakku, paruthith kottai, theevanam aagiyavatrin vilaiyai uyarthi ullanar. Idhanaal selavugal adhigarithulladhu. Adhanaal kootturavu sangathirku paal ootrum vivasaayigalukku, maaniya vilaiyil vaikkol vazhanga, arasu nadavadikkai edukka vendum.
Ivvaaru, avargal koorinar.

headline: Krishnagiriyil velaan oozhiyar adithukkolai
text:
Krishnagiri: Krishnagiri adutha aar.poosaarippatti TASMAC kadai aruge erpatta thagaraaril, thaniyaar velaan niruvana oozhiyarai kallaal thaakki kondravarai Police kaidhu seythanar.
Neelagiri maavattam, ootti nanjjanaadu pagudhiyai serndhavar arungumaar, 33. Krishnagiriyil thaniyaar velaan niruvanathil panivurindhullaar. Ivar, netriravu than nanbargalaana oothangarai adutha vengadadhaambattiyai serndha theevanraaj, 32, inbasegar, madhan matrum paaradhiraajaa aagiyorudan aar.poosaarippatti TASMAC aruge ulla kadai aruge amarndhu madhu arundhi irugagiraar.
Kaali paattilai koduthu, 10 roobai vaanga sendravodhu kadaiyil irundha kaarthik, 24 avaradhu thandhai kovindharaaj, 48, aagiyor serndhu arungumaarai thaakkiyullanar. Kovam theeraadha kaarthik TASMAC kadaiyil irundhu, 50 meter sendra arungumaarai kallaal thaakki kondraar.
Andha sisidivi kaatchigal veliyaagi paravarappai erpaduthi ullana. Indha TASMAC kadai aruge kadandha sila aandugalukku mun madhuvodhai thagaraaril oruvar kolai seyyappatta nilaiyil, meendum oruvar kolai seyyappatta sambavam paravarappai erpaduthi ulladhu.

headline: India vallarasaaga uruvedukkum; urudhiyaaga solgiraar Russia thoodhar
text:
Pudhudilli: 'India vallarasaaga uruveduppadhum, China-vin selvaakku adhigarippadhum maatra mudiyaadha pokku” ena, India-vukkaana Russia thoodhar tenis alivov therivithullaar.
Tilliyil thaniyaar seythi channel nadathiya oodaga maanaattil India-vukkaana Russia thoodhar tenis alivov pangetraar.
Nigazhchiyil avar pesiyadhaavadhu:
India vallarasaaga maaruvadhum, China-vin selvaakku adhigarippadhumaaga ulladhu. Indha maatrathai thadukka mudiyaadhu. India matrum piriks naadugalin valarchikku America taalarai mattume saarndhirukka mudiyaadhu. Maatru vazhigal namakku thevai.
Taalarukku maatraaga veru naanayathai kondu varuvadhu kurithu mattum naangal pesavillai. Parivarthanaigal, varthagam, othuzhaippu matrum nidhi nadavadikkaigalukkaana maatru vazhigal kurithu piriks amaippil vivaadhithom.
India - Russia idaiyeyaana parivarthanaigalil 96 sadhaveedham thesiya naanayangalai payanbaduthiye nadaiverugindrana.
Russia meedhu erkanave 30 aayirathukkum merpatta thadaigal vidhikkappattullana. Enave, melum oru thadai vidhippadho alladhu neekkuvadho engalukku poruttalla. Idhu amerikkaavukkum theriyum. Indhath thadaigal endha vagaiyilum Russia-vin nokkathai maatraadhu.
India-vil irundhu maambazhangal, javuligal, thozhildhurai uvagaranangal matrum palveru vagaiyaana porutkalin etrumadhiyai adhigarippadhu kurithu naangal kavanam seluthi varugirom.
India -- Russia idaiyilaana uravu 80 aandugalaaga palveru thuraigalai ulladakkiya, needitha uravaaga irundhu varugiradhu. India-vin mukkiyamaana paadhugaappu koottaaliyaagavum Russia thodarndhu irukkum.
Ivvaaru avar pesinaar.

headline: Rail ticket; station-il kuzhappam
text:
Tiruppur: Tiruppur railway station-il, online matrum offline ena iru muraigalil ticket perum vasadhi irundhum, thelivaana arivippu illaadhadhaal payanigal kuzhappam adaigindranar.
Railway station-il idhuvarai 'kavundaril' panam seluthi ticket perum nadaimurai irundhu vandha nilaiyil, tharpodhu pudhiya vidhimurai amalbaduthappattulladhu. Adhanbadi, digital panapparivarthanai vaayilaaga mattume ticket vaanga mudiyum. Panam seluthi ticket pera virumbum payanigal, 'vending meshinil' vaangi kollalaam ena therivikkappattulladhu.
Netru aalappuzhaa - thanbaath rayilil payanikka, 200kkum merpatta vadamaanila payanigal ticket pera neenda varisaiyil kaathirundhanar. Panam seluthi ticket petra pin rayilil payanathai thodarndhanar.
Arivippu avasiyam
ticket kavundaril neenda neram varisaiyil kaathirundhu, kavundarai nerungiya pin digital parivarthanaiyil mattume etrukkollappadum endru solvadhaal, payanigal emaatram adaigindranar. Adhevol, vending meshinil, digital parivarthanaiyai murai erpadhillai ena payanigal therivikkindranar.
Enave, ticket peruvadharkaana iru veru nadaimuraigal kurithu payanigalukku thelivaana vizhippunarvu erpadutha vendum. Endha kavundaril digital panapparivarthanai, endha idathil panam seluthi ticket petruk kollalaam enbadhai thelivuvaduthum vagaiyil arivippu palagaigal vaikka vendum.

headline: Meendum poraattathirku thayaaraagum CJP.. 48 manineram kedu vidhippu.. Echarikkai vidukka kaaranam enna?
text:
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaar 48 mani nerathukkul thanadhu padhaviyai raajinaamaa seyya vendum... Illaiyendraal, meendum naadu muzhuvadhum poraattam nadathappadum ena Cockroach Janta Party-yin niruvanar avijeeth theepge echarikkai viduthiruppadhu pesuvorulaaga maariyulladhu. Vaakkaalar pattiyalil thagudhiyatravargal, irandhavargal, idam maariyavargal matrum irattaip padhivugal ullittavatraik kandarindhu pattiyalaith thiruthuvadharkaaga Special Intensive Revision enappadum SIR nadavadikkaiyai therdhal aanaiyam merkondu varugiradhu. Aanaal, indha nadavadikkaiyaal thagudhiyaana vaakkaalargalin peyargalum neekkappadakkoodum endrum, SIR nadaimuraiyil podhiya velippadaithanmai illai endrum edhirkkatchigal thodarndhu kutrachaattugalai munvaithu varugindrana.
Indha nilaiyil, therdhal aanaiyathil ulla moondru therdhal aanaiyargalil sukbeer sing sandhu matrum vivek joshi aagiya iruvarum, kadandha 10 maadhangalil palveru mudivugal thodarbaaga kuraindhadhu 14 murai aatchevanai therivithadhaaga veliyaana thagaval naadu muzhuvadhum perum vivaadhathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Idhan kaaranamaaga, palveru arasiyal katchigalum thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar padhavi vilaga vendum endrum, SIR nadaimuraikkup piragu therdhal nadathappatta maanilangalil marudherdhal nadatha vendum endrum korikkai vaithu varugindrana.
Indha nilaiyil, telliyil indru seythiyaalargalais sandhitha CJP niruvanar avijeeth theepge, thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaar udanadiyaaga padhavi vilaga vendum endru valiyuruthiyullaar. Adhumattumindri, njaanesh kumaar 48 mani nerathukkul raajinaamaa seyyaavittaal, telliyil mattumindri naadu muzhuvadhum poraattam nadathappadum endrum avar echarikkai viduthullaar.
Indhap poraattam erkenave nadaivetra jandhar mandhar poraattathaip pondradhaaga irukkum endrum CJP tharappil therivikkappattulladhu. Therdhal aanaiyathin seyalbaadugal kurithu kadumaiyaana kutrachaattugalaiyum avijeeth theepge munvaithullaar. Njaanesh kumaar thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyaraagap poruppetra piragu, yaar vaakkalikkalaam, yaar vaakkalikkakkoodaadhu enbadhai arasu theermaanikkum nilai erpattulladhaaga avar kutramsaattiyullaar. Melum, idhu jananaayagathukku migapperiya achuruthal endrum avar therivithullaar.
Innilaiyil, SIR vivagaaram matrum therdhal aanaiyathin seyalbaadugal thodarbaaga erkenave arasiyal katchigal kelvigalai ezhuppi varum nilaiyil, tharpodhu CJP-yum thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar raajinaamaa seyya vendum ena 48 mani nera kedu vidhithiruppadhu kavanam petrulladhu.

headline: Vavijay pirasaara vaaganathin Hard disk azhippu endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Vavijay pirasaara vaaganathin haart tisk azhikkappattadhaaga oru news card

thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “vavijay pirachaara vaaganathin Hard disk azhippu. Karoor kootta nerisal sambavangal thodarbaaga TVK thalaivarin pirachaara vaaganathin sisidivi kemaraa padhivugal adangiya haart tisk panaiyoor TVK aluvalaga valaagathil erikkappattadhaaga thagaval” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
TVK thalaivarum nadigarumaana vavijay karooril merkonda pirasaarathin sisidivi kaatchigal adangiya haart tisk ullitta aadhaarangal azhikkappattadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Chennai Uyarneedhimandram amaitha sirappu pulanaayvuk kuzhu thangal vasamirundha aadhaarangalai siviai-yidam oppadaitha nilaiyil thangalidamirundha aavanangalai azhithadhaaga seythi veliyaagi irundha nilaiyil indha news card samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha news card-ai paarkka thandhi TV veliyitta news card pola irundhaalum, adhan thamizh ezhuthuru (Font) vazhakkamaaga thandhi TV veliyidum news card pola illaamal irundhadhu. Melum, vavijay aluvalagathil aadhaarangal azhikkappattadhaaga endha seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil thandhi TV ippadi oru news card-ai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarthom. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha news kaardum illai. Enave, indha news card-ai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Kaalai unavu migavum avasiyamaanadhaa? Muzhuvadhumaaga erka marukkum nivunargal!!
text:
Kaalai unavu migavum mukkiyamaanadhu ena podhuvaana karuthu nilavi varum nilaiyil, oottachathu nivunargal adhanai muzhuvadhumaaga erka marukkindranar. Kurippitta nerathil kaalai unavu unnuvadhai vida, ottumotha unnum murai, unavin tharam, udal seyalbaadu, thookkam, vayadhu, udalnalap pirachinaigal matrum vaazhkkai murai aagiyavai, oruvaradhu aarokkiyathil migapperiya thaakkathai erpaduthuvadhaaga avargal koorugindranar.
Udal nala paadhippillaadhorukku kaalai unavaith thavirppadhu thaanaagave udalaip paadhikkaadhu enavum, aanaal palarukku adhu kuraindha aatral, thalaivali, sorvu aagiyavatrai erpaduthumena kurippidugindranar. Naalin pirpagudhiyil adhigappadiyaana unavu utkolla vendiya soozhalai uruvaakkum enavum echarikkindranar.
Adhevelaiyil, kuzhandhaigal, padhin paruthuvathinar, karppinigal, mudhiyorukku, kaalai unavu nilaiyaana aatralai vazhangum enavum, avargaladhu thasais seyalbaattai adhigarikkum enavum, oottachathu nivunargal koorugindranar. Kaalai unavu samacheeraanadhaaga irukka vendumena koorum avargal, vejidavul uppumaa, saambaarudan itli, thosai aagiyavai nalla thervu enavum parindhuraikkindranar.

headline: Koottanikkaaga mandi poda thayaar endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘koottanikkaaga mandi poda thayaar,’’ endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ mandi poda thayaar. Mandi pottaavadhu kaangirasai pogavidaamal thaduppen mudhalvar urudhi mozhi ’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Pudhiya thalaimurai logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda news card unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, ‘’idhu poliyaana news card,’’ endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, san news aasiriyar kuzhuvai thodarbugondu kettavodhu, ‘’engaladhu peyaril pagirappadum vadhandhi idhu,’’ endru therivithanar.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Merku vangathil SIR vendaam endru vangadhesa kudiyerigal poraattam seythanaraa?
text:
Vaakkaalar pattiyal sirapputh theevirath thirutham seyyum panikku edhiraaga merku vangathil vangadhesam matrum rohingiyaa sattavirodha kudiyerigal poraattam nadathiyadhaaga oru video

islaamiya aangalum, pengalum kaiyil kattai, thudaippathudan peraniyaaga sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “merku vangathil SIR enum vaakkaalar theevira thirutha pani vendaam ena kilambum satta virodhamaaga merkuvangathil kudiyirukkum vangadhesam matrum rohingiyaa islaamiyargal..!!
Theevira thirutha pani merkondaal satta virodhamaaga thangiya ivargalin ottu urimai parikkappadum enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu. Indha Congress, mamdhaa,thimuga aatchiyaalargalaal India-vil ippodhu enga kondu vandhu niruthi irukkaanunga endru Thamizhaga makkal paarthuth therindhu kollungal..
Ungal vari panam ellaam indha vandherigal anuppavithu kondu indhiyaavai naasam seyya kilambittaanga” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaaril sirappu vaakkaalar pattiyal thirutham moolam BJP edhirppu vaakkaalargal peyargal neekkappattu, poli vaakkaalargal inaikkappattadhaagavum sarchai ezhundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu, merku vangam ullitta maanilangalil vaakkaalar pattiyal sirapputh theevirath thirutham seyyum pani merkollappadum endru therdhal aanaiyam arivithadhu.
Idhan kaaranamaaga merku vangathil sattavirodhamaaga kudiyeri vasikkum rohingiyaa, vangadhesa islaamiyargal poraattangal nadathi varuvadhaaga oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu kadandha sepdambar maadham 15m thedhi indha video veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Merku vangathil vaakkaalar pattiyal sirapputh theevirath thirutham seyyum paniyai indhiyath therdhal aanaiyam 2025 akdovar irudhiyildhaan arivithadhu. Aanaal adharku oru maadhathirku munbaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhaal sandhegam erpattadhu. Namakkuk kidaitha padhivugalil indha video engu edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Indraiya poraattathin kaatchi endru mattum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Video-vai padhivittavarin vivarak kurippai paartha podhu, avar vangadhesathais saarndhavar enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Vangadhesathil erkanave pala poraattangal nadandhu varuvadhaal, indha video vangadhesathais saarndhadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu. Idhai urudhiseyyath thodarndhu thedinom.
India-vil thadai seyyappattulla tikdaak samooga oodagathil palarum indha video-vai padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, avatrai nammaal thirandhu paarkka mudivillai. Adhe nerathil, nammudaiya fekt kirasando malaiyaalathil idhu thodarbaaga fekt sek katturai veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Adhil indha video vangadhesam faridhaappooril edukkappattadhu endrum shek aseenaavin avaami leek katchiyai aadharikkum vagaiyil indha perani nadathappattadhu endrum kurippittirundhanar. Kurippitta andha naalil vangadhesathil avaami leekkukku aadharavaaga poraattangal nadathappattadhaaga vangadhesa oodagangalil veliyaana seythigal namakku kidaithana.
Esaiaar enappadum sirapputh theevira vaakkaalar pattiyal thirutham merku vangathil seyyappadum endru therdhal aanaiyam akdovar irudhiyil arivithadhu. Aanaal, indha video 2025 sepdambar 15m thedhi samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Enave, sirappu thirutham thodarbaana arivippukku ondrarai maadhangalukku munbu indha video veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idhu sirapputh thiruthathai edhirthu nadathappatta perani endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Meendum ulukkiya Bharathidhasan! Pongi ezhundha mu.ka.staalin.. Paravarappu pinnani enna?
text:
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
Thamizhaga arasin saarbil Ambedkar ayalaga uyargalvi endra thittam seyalbaduthappattu varugiradhu. Indha thittathin keezh, Thamizhagathil ulla aadhidhiraavidar, pazhangudiyinar matrum kurippitta samoogathai serndha ezhai eliya maanavargal, velinaadugalukku sendru uyargalvi payila, udhavith thogai vazhangappadugiradhu. Indha thittathin keezh, malesiyaavil ulla thesiya palgalaigazhagathil aaraaychi padippu padithu varum maanavar thaan Bharathidhasan kadandha aagastu maadham video ondrai veliyittirundha ivar, thanakkaana kalvi udhavith thogai innum kidaikkavillai endru kanneer malga kooriyirundhaar.
Idhudhodarbaaga, sattapperavaiyil kelvi ezhuppappattirundha nilaiyil, amaichar vanni arasu vilakkam alithirundhaar. Indha nilaiyil, maanavar Bharathidhasan meendum veliyittulla video-vil, ennai kallooriyil irundhu neekka pogiraargal. Innum enakkaana kalvi udhavith thogai varavillai. Akdovar mudhal vaarathil, ennudaiya aaraaychi kattooraiyai samarbikka azhaippu vidukkappattulladhu. Aanaal, ippodhu ennaal angum poga mudiyaadha soozhal ulladhu” endru koorinaar.
Melum, arasu thanadhu ottumotha adhigaarathaiyum payanbaduthi, ennai odukka muyatsikkiraargal. Kalvi udhavith thogaiyai aaraaychikkaaga thaan payanbaduthinaayaa? Ena ennidam kelvi ketkiraargal. Naan anaithu aadhaarathaiyum koduthuvitten. Neengal ivvaaru kelvi ketbadhaal, enmeedhaana peraasiriyargalin nambikkai udaindhuvittadhu endrum, migundha varuthathudan pesiyullaar. Maanavar paaradhidhaasanin indha video-vai pagirndhulla DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin, TVK arasukku kadum kandanangalai padhivu seythullaar.
“arasu saarbil urudhi alikkappatta urimaiyai thaan maanavar Bharathidhasan ketkiraar. Avar ketbadhu udhavi kidaiyaadhu. Aatchi maatram erpattadhaal, oru maanavarin pala aandu uyargalvi kanavu paazhaaga koodaadhu. Maanavar paaradhidhaasanukku thevaippadum nidhiyai vazhanga mudiyaadhu endraal, adhanai mudhalamaichar velippadaiyaaga arivithuvidungal. Thimugavum, thamizhnaattu makkalum andha maanavarukkaana kalvik kattanathai katti padikka vaikkirom” endru kooriyullaar. Melum, rogith vemulaavukku nadandhadhu pola thanakkum nadakkiradhu endru andha maanavar kooriyadhai merkol kaatti pesiya M.K. Stalin, engalukku edhirgatchiyaagave irundhaal, ippadi oru avappeyarai TVK arasu sumakka vendaam endrum, thanadhu padhivil kurippittullaar.

headline: “peetchaa telivari seytha nanbanaik kevalappaduthiya thozhi” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peetchaa telivari seytha ilainjaraip paartha avaradhu pallikkooda thozhi kevalappaduthiyadhaaga oru video

ilainjar oruvar peetchaa telivari seyyum irusakkara vaaganathil varugiraar. Avarudan pen oruvar pesuvadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “endha sandharppathilum matravaraik kevalappadutha vendaam
oru peetchaa telivari paiyan thanadhu pallith thozhiyai veedhiyil sandhikkiraan.’nee palliyil elloraiyum ookkuvithaay… ippodhu peetchaa telivari seygiraayaa?’ engiraal. Aan kuzhandhaigalin vaazhkkai elidhaanadhalla. Sila nerangalil poruppugal vayadhukku munbe varum. Kanavugal pudhaindhuvidum. Suyamariyaadhai sodhikkappadum. Peetchaa telivari seyvadhu vetkakkedaanadhalla. Eppodhum oruvarin vaazhkkaigagaana poraattathai keli seyyaamal iruppom…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thannudan pallikkoodathil paditha thozhan oruvan valarndhu ilainjanaana piragu peetchaa telivari seyvadhai kanda pen oruvar avarai asingappaduthum vagaiyil pesiyadhaaga video Facebook-il pagirappattu varugiradhu. Video-vai paarkkum podhu sgiripdat video pola ulladhu. Idhai palarum unmaiyaana sambavam endru karudhi padhivittu varuvadhaal idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha padhivai mudhalil aayvu seythavodhu, idhu naadagam enbadhu pola kurippittu ri_shika3317 endra instaagiraam pakkathil video padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Indha video samooga oodagangalil vairalaana nilaiyil, indha video tharpodhu neekkappattulladhu. Adhe nerathil indha video unmaiyillai, pozhudhuvokkukkaaga edukkappatta naadaga video endru kurippittu indha veediyovudan thodarbudaiya pen veliyittirundha padhivu mattume irundhadhu. Andha instaagiraam pakkathil andha ilainjarin veru sila veediyokkalaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Adhe nerathil singhtarun000 endra matroru instaagiraam pakkathilum indha video padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhil, indha video-vil idambetra navar naandhaan. Video-vukku alitha varaverpukku nandri endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha pakkathil indha video thodarbaaga avar veliyittirundha vilakka padhivum irundhadhu. Avaradhu Facebook, YouTube pakkangalukkaana inaippaiyum avar koduthirundhaar.
Avaradhu Facebook pakkathilum andha vilakka video irundhadhu. Adhil, “naan yaaraiyum punbadutha virumbavillai. Indha video-vil naan nadithen” endru kooriyullaar. Keli kindal, avamaanathukku aalaana navar endru koorappatta ilainjare indha video unmaiyaanadhu illai. Adhil nadithen endru vilakkam alithuvittaar. Idhan adippadaiyil peetchaa telivari seytha navarai kevalappaduthiya thozhi endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘islaamai ozhikka pudhiya sattangalai iyatriya Japan’ endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Islaathai thangal naattilirundhu mutrilumaaga ozhikka Japan pudhiya sattangalai iyatriyadhu endru oru video

Japan naadaalumandra uruppinargal utsaaga kural ezhuppi theermaanam niraivetruvadhu pondru video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “islaathai thangal naattilirundhu mutrilumaaga ozhikka Japan pudhiya sattangalai iyatriyulladhu 🇯🇵 halaal padugolai, thozhugaikkaana azhaippugal, podhu piraarthanai matrum periya masoodhigal anaithum thadai seyyappattullana 🚫 islaam merkathiya naadugalukkus seythadhai Japan paarthirukkiradhu, thaamadhamaagividum munbe vendaam endru vizhithukkonda Japan ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Islaam madhathai mutrilumaaga thadai seyvadhu pondru Japan naadaalumandrathil sattangal niraivetrappattadhaaga video-vai palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, video-vai paarkkum podhu sattam iyatrappatta podhu edukkappattadhu pola illai. Video-vil idam petra pen uruppinaraip paarkka Japan piradhamar sane thakkaichi (Sanae Takaichi) pola irundhadhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, adhu Japan naadaalumandrathaik kalaippadhu thodarbaana theermaanam niraivetrappatta video endru therindhadhu. Janavari 23m thedhi indha video-vai oodagangal veliyittirundhana. Japan naadaalumandram kalaikkappattadhaith thodarndhu angu therdhal nadathappattu, meendum sane thakkaichi perumbaanmai idangalil vetri petru aatchiyaith thakka vaithukkondadhaagas seythigal namakkuk kidaithana.
Sari, idharku munbu islaam madhathirku edhiraana sattam Japan naadaalumandrathil niraivetrappattadhaa endru ariya koogulil sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru sattamum niraivetrappattadhaaga seythigalil kurippidappadavillai. Japan arasiyalamaippu sattathil islaam madhathaith thadai seythullaargalaa endru ariya annaattu arasiyalamaippu sattathai paarvaiyittom. Aardigil 20 madha sudhandhiram patrik kurippidugiradhu.
Adhil, madhas sudhandhiram anaivarukkum urudhi seyyappadugiradhu. Endha oru madha amaippum arasidamirundhu sirappu urimaigalaip perak koodaadhu. Endha arasiyal adhigaarathaiyum payanbaduthak koodaadhu. Yaaraiyum endha oru madha nigazhvilum kattaayappaduthip pangerka vaikkak koodaadhu. Arasum adhan amaippugalum madhak kalvi matrum madha seyalbaadugalil eeduvadaamal vilagi irukka vendum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam islaam madhathirku mattum thadai, kattuppaadu vidhikkappattadhu endru koorappadum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu islaam madhathirku palveru kattuppaadu, thadai sattam endrellaam samooga oodagangalil thodarndhu pala aandugalaagave vadhandhi parappappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Indha vadhandhigal thodarbaaga reuters.com fekt sek katturai veliyittiruppadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal adhu sila aandugalukku munbu veliyaana padhivu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovo 2026 janavari maadham Japan naadaalumandram kalaikkappattavodhu edukkappattadhaagum.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: DMK ilainjarani maanaattil mudhalvar M.K. Stalin meedhu seruppu veesappattadhaa?
text:
Virudhunagar DMK ilainjarani maanaattil pangetra mu.ka.staalinai nokki seruppu veesappattadhu endru oru pugaippadam

Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin nadandhu varumbodhu avarai nokki seruppu veesappattadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha pugaippadathil, “mudhalvarin kavanathai eerkka koottathil seruppu veesappattulladhu! Thodarndhu vivaadhippom” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “mudhalvar meedhu seruppu veesiyadhu yaar ?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pipravari 7, 2026 andru virudhunagar maavattam kalgurichi endra idathil DMK ilainjarani maanaadu nadandhadhu. Indha maanaattil pangerka vandha mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinai nokki yaaro seruppai veesiyadhaaga pugaippadathudan silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Unmaiyil appadi oru sambavam nadandhadhaaga seythi edhum illai.
Unmaiyil appadi nadandhirundhaal pudhiya thalaimurai, thandhi TV ena ellaa oodagangalilum periya alavil seythiyaagi irukkum. Kuraindha patcham adhimuga-vin news je-vilaavadhu vandhirukkum. Aanaal edhilum appadi oru seythi veliyaagavillai. Enave, indha pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhaaga irukkalaam endru aayvu seythom.
DMK ilainjarani maanaattuk kaatchigalai oodagangal neradi olivarappu seythana. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil san news logo irundhadhaal andha oodagathil veliyaana video-vai thedi eduthom. Video-vin 3.50vadhu nimidathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla kaatchi varugiradhu. Mu.ka.staalinukku valadhu pakkathil thondar oruvar kodi alladhu saalvai pondru ondraik koduppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Andha nerathil adharku munbaagavo, adharku pinbaagavo seruppu edhuvum andha video-vil veesappadavillai.
San TV DMK aadharavu oodagam enbadhaal matra oodagangalil veliyaana veediyokkalaiyum paarthom. Kurippitta andha idathil mattumindri veru endha oru idathilum seruppu veesappattadhu pondru illai. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam poliyaanadhu, edit seyyappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Thi.mu.ka-vin karuppu – sivappu nira kudaiyudan pirasaaram seythaaraa vavijay?
text:
TVK thalaivar vavijay DMK karuppu – sivappu ena DMK kodiyin nirathil kudai pidithu pirasaaram seythaar endru oru pugaippadam

TVK thalaivar vavijay karuppu sivappu nira kudaiyudan therdhal pirasaaram seythadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha padathin meedhu, “evano namma paiyan thaan kudaiyai koduthu irukkaan” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum share seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Therdhal pirasaarathin podhu edhir tharappin sinnam, kodigalai endha vagaiyilum yaarum payanbadutha maattaargal. Nadigar vavijay thi.mu.ka-vin kodiyai ninaivoottum karuppu – sivappu nirathilaana kudaiyai payanbaduthi pirasaaram seythaar endru palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadamaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, thavegavin kodiyin nirathil kudai iruppadhu pondru pugaippadangal, video-kkal namakku kidaithana. Appodhu TVK thondar oruvar vavijaykku TVK kodiyin nirathil kudaiyai vazhanginaar pala padhivugal namakku kidaithana.
Thondar alitha kudaiyudan thiruvallooril rodu sho seytha vavijay endru kurippittu pala seythigalum veediyokkalum, pugaippadangalum namakku kidaithana. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Utharap piradhesathai 4 maanilangalaaga pirikka thittam? Amaichar pechaal meendum ezhundha vivaadham!
text:
Utharap piradhesathai naangu maanilangalaagap pirikkum vivagaaram meendum pesuvorulaaga maariyulladhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga pesiya ammaanila amaichar om piragaash raajbaar, edhirgaalathil utharap piradhesam naangu pagudhigalaagap pirikkappadum ena therivithullaar.
Saadhivaari kanakkeduppukkup piragu indha nadavadikkai merkollappadum endrum, piradhamar Modi idhugurithu urudhiyalithulladhaagavum avar kooriyullaar. Poorvaanjjal, mathiyaanjjal, pundhelgant matrum harith piradhesam ena naangu maanilangalaagap pirikkalaam ena raajbaar kurippittullaar.
Munnadhaaga, 2011aam aandu maayaavadhi thalaimaiyilaana arasu, utharap piradhesathai naangu maanilangalaagap pirikka sattapperavaiyil theermaanam niraivetriyadhu. Aanaal, arasiyal kaaranangalaal andhath thittam nadaimuraikku varavillai. 2027aam aandil utharap piradhesathil sattamandrath therdhal nadakkum soozhalil, amaichar raajbaarin indhak karuthu utharap piradhesa arasiyalil meendum vivaadhathai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Narasingavurathil mindhadai makkal kadum avadhi
text:
Aathoor: narasingavuram, appamasamuthiram, pudhu udaiyambatti, pazhaiya udaiyambatti, selliyambaalaiyam, thillai nagar ullitta pagudhigalil netru iravu, 7:40 manikku mindhadai erpattadhu. Neenda neramaaga minsaara viniyogam illaadhadhaal, saalai, therukkal irulil moozhgina. Thavira viyaazhandhorum koodum nara-singavuram vaarachandhaiyil, 'taars' lait velichathil kaaygari virka vendiya nilaikku viyaavaarigal thallappattanar. Iravu, 9:00 manikku melum, min viniyogam illaadhadhaal, makkal perum avadhikkullaaginar.
Idhugurithu minvaariya aluvalargal koorugaiyil, 'tiraans-paarmar pagudhiyil, 'piyoos' nirkavillai. Maatri inaippu koduthum min viniyogam vazhanga mudiyavillai. Seeramaippu pani merkollappattu varugiradhu' endranar.

headline: Oyilaattam arangetram: podhumakkal utsaagam
text:
Avinaasi:thirumuruganboondi nagaraatchi, raakkiyavaalaiyathil ulla vadakku kaamaatchi amman kovil maidhaanathil sangamam kalaikkuzhuvin saarbil 18-vadhu valli kummi, 16-vadhu kambathaattam matrum 115-vadhu oyilaatta arangetra vizhaa nadaivetradhu.
Sangamam kalaikkuzhu orunginaippaalar thalaimai aasiriyar kanagaraaj thalaimai vagithaar. Valli kummi aasiriyar pudhuppaalaiyam sellappa kavundar, thunai payitsiyaalargal thamizharasan aarumugam, tharun paavu visvanaadhan aagiyor pangetru paadalgalai paadinar. Kadandha oru maadhamaaga valli kummi matrum oyilaatta kalainjargalukku payitsi alikkappattadhu. Arangetra vizhaavil 75-kkum merpatta pengal ullitta kalainjargal pangetru valli kummi, oyilaattam matrum kambathaattam nigazhchigalai nadathinar. Thamizhargalin paarambariya kalaigalai velippaduthum vagaiyil nadaivetra innigazhchiyai, perundhiralaana podhumakkal kandugalithanar.

headline: Japan | 80 % mattume vayitrai nirappum unavup pazhakkam., 100 vayadhai kadappavargalil adhigam pengal!
text:
Japan-il nooru vayadhaik kadandha mudhiyavargalin ennikkai 2025 sepdambar nilavarappadi 99,763 aaga uyarndhu pudhiya uchathai ettiyulladhu. Kadandha 55 aandugalaagath thodarndhu adhigarithu varum indha ennikkaiyil, 88 sadhaveedham per pengal enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu. Jappaaniyargalin indha neenda aayulukkup pinnaal avargalin kattukkoppaana vaazhkkai muraiyum, samoogak kattamaippum mukkiyap pangu vagikkindrana.
Vayaru 80 vizhukkaadu niraindhavudan unbadhai niruthum pazhakkam matrum oottachathumikka paarambariya unavugal avargalin aarokkiyathai membaduthugindrana. Thittamidappatta udarpayitsigalaaga mattum illaamal, andraada veettu velaigal, nadaippayitsi matrum mudhumaiyilum thangalukkup pidithamaana panigalil eeduvaduvadhan moolam thodarchiyaana udal iyakkathai penugindranar. Idhu jappaaniyargalai surusuruppaagavum aarokkiyamaagavum vaithirukkiradhu.
Japan-il adhiga ennikkaiyilaana pengal neenda kaalam vaazhvadharku avargalin uyiriyal reedhiyaana haarmon paadhugaappum, noy varaamal thaduppadharkaana maruthuvap parisodhanaigalai mungoottiye seythugollum vizhippunarvum kaaranangalaagak koorappadugindrana. Samooga reedhiyaagap paarthaal, jappaaniyap pengal mudhumaiyilum thangalukkul valuvaana samoogath thodarbugalaip penugindranar. ' nanbargaludan thinasari uraiyaaduvadhu avargalaith thanimaiyilirundhum, mana azhuthathilirundhum kaakkiradhu.
Arasu vazhangum tharamaana podhu maruthuvak kaappeettin udhaviyudan noyth thaduppus sugaadhaara nadavadikkaigal moolam noygal aarambakkattathileye kandariyappattus sariseyyappadugindrana. Indhath thadaiyatra maruthuvas sevai matrum aarokkiyamaana pazhakkavazhakkangal jappaanai ulagileye neenda aayilgonda makkal adhigam vaazhum naadaaga aakkiyullana.

headline: 35 aandugalil illaadha varatchi.. Aavathil poomiyin nanneer.. Ulaga aarugal kurithu WMO adhirchi arikkai!
text:
Kadandha 35 aandugalil illaadha alavukku ulagin aarugalil neervarathu migak theeviramaagak kuraindhulladhaaga, aikkiya naadugalin ulaga vaanilai amaippu (WMO) veliyittulla arikkaiyil theriya vandhulladhu. Panippaaraigal urugi kadal neermattam uyarndhu varuvadhodu, nilathadi neermattamum vegamaagak kuraindhu varugiradhu. Idhanaal aasiyaa matrum aappirikka naadugalil kudineer paadhugaappukku kadum achuruthal erpattulladhu.
Ulaga vaanilai amaippu (WMO) veliyittulla 'maanila ulagalaaviya neer valangal 2025' (State of Global Water Resources 2025) arikkai, ulagalavil neer suzhatsiyil erpattulla avaayagaramaana seergulaivai virivaaga vilakkugiradhu. 2025-aam aandu ulaga aarugalil neervarathu kadandha 35 aandugalil illaadha alavukku migak kuraivaagap padhivaagiyulladhaaga avvamaippu echarithulladhu. Idhudhodarbaaga adhu veliyittulla arikkaiyil, kadandha 7 aandugalaagave iyalbaana neervarathu konda aarugalin ennikkai ulagalavil migak kuraindha alavileye (34% - 38%) ulladhu endrum, nilathadi neer, erigal, aarugal matrum panippaaraigal ulladakkiya poomiyin nanneer iruppu kadandha 10 aandugalaagath thodarchiyaagak kuraindhu varugiradhu endrum kadandha 35 aandugalil illaadha alavukku ulagin aarugalil neervarathu migak theeviramaagak kuraindhulladhaagavum adhu therivithulladhu.
Melum, 2025-aam aandu thodarndhu 4-aavadhu aandaaga ulagin anaithup pagudhigalilum panippaaraigal perumalavil urugis surungiyullana enavum ulagalavil kangaanikkappadum kinarugalil moondril irandu pangu kinarugalil nilathadi neermattam iyalbaana alavai vidak kadumaiyaagas sarindhulladhu enavum adhu therivithulladhu.
Melum, puvi veppamayamaadhal matrum el nino (El Niño) pondra paruvanilai nigazhvugalaal ulagalavil mazhaippozhivu seeratradhaaga maariyulladhu. Idhanaal theevira varatchip pagudhigal adhigarithu nadhigalin neervarathu vatri varugiradhu. Imayamalai, aalps matrum aandis malaithodargalil ulla panippaaraigal adhivegamaaga urugi varuvadhaal, kodaigaalathil nadhigalukkuk kidaikkum neer aadhaaram kanisamaagak kuraindhu varugiradhu. Thodar varatchi matrum adhigappadiyaana neer urinjjal kaaranamaagak kangaanikkappadum perumbaalaana nilathadi neernilaigalil neermattam veguvaagas sarindhulladhu ena vilakkiyulladhu.
Melum, ulaga vaanilai amaippu (WMO) suttikkaattiyullavadi, aasiyaa matrum aappirikka kandangalil nilavum kadumaiyaana kudineerp patraakkurai kodikkanakkaana makkalin sugaadhaarathaiyum, piraandhiya amaidhiyaiyum kelvikkuriyaakkiyulladhu. Ulagalavil neer saarndha peridargalaal erpadum uyirizhappugalil 80%-kkum adhigamaanavai indha iru kandangalileye nigazhgindrana. Kadandha aindhu aandugalil padhivaana neer saarndha iyarkai peridargalil 50%-kkum adhigamaanavai matrum adhanaal erpatta uyirizhappugalil 80%-kkum adhigamaanavai aasiyaa matrum aappirikka kandangalileye nigazhndhullana. Thooymaiyaana kudineer kidaikkaadhadhaal vayitruppokku, kaalaraa pondra noygal paravi aappirikka matrum aasiyap pagudhigalil kuzhandhaigal adhigalavil paadhikkappadugindranar.

headline: Ulle... Veliye... : maanagaraatchikkul pasaiyaay ottiyulla oppandhangal :mandala, vaardu aluvalagangalil allaadum nirandharam
text:
Ulle... Veliye... : maanagaraatchikkul pasaiyaay ottiyulla 'oppandhangal' :mandala, vaardu aluvalagangalil allaadum 'nirandharam'
Madurai: Madurai maanagaraatchi mandala, vaardugalil paniyaatrum nirandharap paniyaalargal pala aandugalaaga idamaatram kettum piradhaana aluvalathirkul nuzhaiya mudiyavillai. Idhan pinnaniyil ulla sila aluvalargalin 'arasiyalai' kamishanar kavurav kumaar kandarindhu nadavadikkai edukka vendum ena edhirbaarkkindranar.
Maanagaraatchi piradhaana aluvalagathil palveru pirivugalilum, mandalangal, vaardugal aluvalagangalilum nirandhara, tharkaaligam ena 700kkum merpatta paniyaalargal ullanar. Piradhaana aluvalagathin perumbaalaana pirivugalil oppandha paniyaalargale adhigam ullanar. Aavees asistenttugal (o.e.,kkal) utbada nirandhara paniyaalargal perumbaalum mandala, vaardugalil pala aandugalaaga paniyaatrugindranar. Piradhaana aluvalagathirku idamaatram kettum kidaippadhillai. Idhan pinnaniyil sila aluvalargalin 'arasiyal' ulladhu ena kutramsaattu ezhundhulladhu.
Avargal kooriyadhaavadhu: ovvoru pirivilum o.e.,kkal pani mukkiyamaanadhu. 40kkum merpatta nirandhara o.e.,kkal irundhum perumbaalum mandala, vaardu aluvalagangalil thaan paniyil ullanar. Mukkiya pirivugalil oppandha adippadaiyilaana o.e.,kkale ullanar. Sila pirivugalil 10 aandugalaaga kooda irukkindranar.
Pirivu poruppaalargal solvadhai avargal thattaamal ketbadhaal engalai pondra regular o.e.,kkalai piradhaana valaagathirkul viduvadhillai. Naangal irundhaal kelvi ketbom. Adhu avargalukku siramangalai' erpaduthum. Adhanaal engalai nuzhaiya vidaamal 'arasiyal' seygiraargal. Idharku kamishanar kavuravgumaar mutruppulli vaikka vendum endranar.

headline: PF thogaiyil adhiradi maatram.. Roo.25,000 varai sambalam vaanguvavargalukku kut news!
text:
Thozhilaalar varungaala vaippu nidhi amaippin (EPFO) kattaayap pidithathirkaana maadha oodhiya ucha varambai ₹15,000-lirundhu ₹25,000 aaga uyartha mathiya amaicharavai oppudhal alithulladhu. 2014-kkup piragu merkollappattulla indha maatrathin moolam sumaar 51 latcham oozhiyargal pudhidhaagas samoogap paadhugaappu valaiyathirkul konduvarappadugindranar
arasu matrum thaniyaar niruvanangalil panivuriyum oozhiyargalin oyvukkaalathirkaaga EPFO ennum thittam nadaimuraiyil ulladhu. Oozhiyargalin sambalathil irundhu oru pagudhi piditham seyyappadum. Adhevola niruvanangalum thangaladhu pangalippai vazhanguvar. Idharku vattiyum kodukkappattu varugiradhu enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu. Innilaiyil, EPFO amaippai vangi seyalmuraiyaip pol maatriyamaikka mathiya arasu thittamittulladhu. Vangi seyalbaadugal aanlainil evvaaru nadathappadugiradho adhevola, edhirgaalathil EPFO thodarbaana anaithup panigalum aanlainil seyyappadum ena thagavalgal therivikkindrana.
Indha nilaiyil, thozhilaalar varungaala vaippu nidhi amaippin (EPFO) kattaayap pidithathirkaana maadha oodhiya ucha varambai ₹15,000-lirundhu ₹25,000 aaga uyartha mathiya amaicharavai oppudhal alithulladhu.
Idhuvarai maadham 15aayiram roobai varai oodhiyam petravargal piep thittathil kattaayamaaga serkkappatta nilaiyil, adharku mel peruvavargal seruvadhu avaravar viruppamaaga irundhadhu. Annilai maari 25 aayiram roobai varai vaanguvavargal ini kattaayamaaga piep thittathil serkkappaduvar. Idhanmoolam koodudhalaaga 51 latchathirkum adhigamaana oozhiyargal kattaaya samoogap paadhugaappu matrum oyvoodhiya valaiyamaippirkul konduvarappaduvaargal. 12 aandugalukku pinbu indha ucha varambu uyarthappaduvadhu kurippidathakkadhu. Kadandha sila aandugalaaga erpattulla oodhiya uyarvu, varumaanam adhigarippu matrum muraiyaana velaivaayppugalin virivaakkam aagiyavatraik karuthilgondu indha mudivu edukkappattulladhu.
Ithitta virivaakkathirkaaga mathiya arasu aandudhorum sumaar ₹11,339 kodi varai koodudhal nidhiyais selavidavulladhu. Maruvuram, ₹15,000-kku mel oodhiyam petru idhuvarai PF piditham seyyappadaadha oozhiyargalukku, ini 12% PF piditham seyyappadum enbadhaal kaiyil kidaikkum nigaras sambalam satru kuraiyakkoodum. Eninum, oozhiyargalin oyvugaalas semipputh thogaiyum oyvoodhiyath thagudhiyum kanisamaaga adhigarikkum. Melum, niruvanangal thangalin pangalipputh thogaiyaiyum uyartha vendiyirukkum enbadhaal nirvaagathirkaana samoogap paadhugaappus selavinangal adhigarikkum.

headline: Madurai: 11 aam vaguppu palli maanavan uyirizhappu; kolai vazhakkaaga padhivuseyyak kori aarppaattam!
text:
Maduraiyil 11 aam vaguppu palli maanavan marmamaana vagaiyil uyirizhandha vazhakkai kolai vazhakkaaga padhivuseyyak kori, thamizhchelvan needhikkaana koottiyakkam saarbil kandana aarppaattam nadaippetradhu.
Madurai maavattam, aanaiyoor koodalbudhoor vaanavil theru pagudhiyais serndha thamizhselvan endra palli maanavarin sadalam mutbudhar kuttaiyil irundhu thingalgizhamai meetkappattadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga sandhega maranam endra pirivin keezh udal kaavaldhuraiyinar vazhakku padhivu seythu visaaranai nadathi varugindranar.
Innilaiyil palli maanavan thamizhchelvan maranathai kolai vazhakkaaga maatrida koriyum, visaaranai adhigaariyai udanadiyaaga maatra vendum, visaaranaiyai thuridhappaduthi kutravaaligalai udanadiyaaga kaidhuseyya vendum enak koriyum `thamizhchelvan needhikkaana koottiyakkam' saarbil Madurai maavatta aatchiyar aluvalagam aruge kandana aarppaattam nadaivetradhu.
Indha aarppaattathinbodhu kaavaldhuraiyaik kandithum, kutravaaligalaik kaidhuseyya koriyum padhaagaigalai endhiyavaaru muzhakkangalai ezhuppinar.
Idhu kurithup pesiya thamizhselvanin vazhakkarinjar, “thamizhselvan maranathai kolai vazhakkaagap padhivuseyya vendum. Palli maanavan thamizhchelvan kolaiseyyappatta vivagaarathil maanavi oruvarin thandhai meedhu sandhegam ulladhu. Aanaal avaridam kaavaldhuraiyinar visaaranai nadatha maruthu varugindranar.
Aanavap padugolai endra adippadaiyil vazhakku padhivu seythu visaaranai nadathappada vendum. Maanavanai mirattiya mettu theru pagudhiyais serndha ilainjargalai kaidhuseythu visaaranai nadatha vendum.
Melum maanavanin udalai maru udarkooraayvu seyya vendum kutravaaligalai kaidhuseyyum varai udalai vaanga maattom” endraar.
Maanavanin thaayaar yogalatchumi pesumbodhu, “ enadhu maganudan sendra navargal kuritha sisidivi kaatchigal adippadaiyil mattume kaavaldhuraiyinar visaaranai nadathi varugiraargal. Matra endha visaaranaiyum nadathappadavillai. Enadhu maganai mirattiya mettu theru pagudhiyais serndhavargal kurithu endha visaaranai nadathappadavillai. Enave enadhu magan kolai vazhakkil unmai kutravaaligalai kaidhuseyya vendum” enath therivithaar

headline: 2 pavun, roo.10,000 thirudiyavar sikkinaar
text:

Kadandha aaga., 22l, ivaradhu veettin poottai udaitha marma navar, peerovil irundha, 2 pavun sangili, 10,000 roovaayai thirudichendraar. headline: Chennaiyin 2-vadhu vimaana nilaiyath thittam.. Pariseelanaiyil seyyoor, maanelloor.?
text:
Chennaiyin 2aavadhu vimaana nilaiyathai Chengalpattu maavattam seyyoor alladhu Tiruvallur maavattam Gummidipoondi aruge ulla maanelloor pagudhiyil amaikka Thamizhaga arasu pariseelanai seythu varuvadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Parandhoor vimaana nilaiya thittam rathaanadhai aduthu maanila porulaadhaara valarchikku etra vagaiyil pudhiya vimaana nilaiyathai amaikka idathaith thervu seyyum paniyil Thamizhaga arasu eeduvattulladhu.
Adharkaaga Chengalpattu maavattam seyyoor matrum Tiruvallur maavattam maanelloor aagiya 2 idangal pariseelanaiyil ulladhaagath therigiradhu. Idhil, seyyoor pagudhi pudhucheri vimaana nilaiyathilirundhu sumaar 40 kilo meter tholaivilum, meenambaakkathil irundhu sumaar 120 kilo meter tholaivilum amaindhulladhu. Adhevol aandhira maanila ellaiyai ottiya pagudhiyil ulla maanelloor sennaiyilirundhu sumaar 50 kilo meter tholaivilum, sreeharigottaavilirundhu sumaar 35 kilo meter tholaivilum ulladhu.
Maanelloor pagudhi sreeharigottaa raakket evudhalathukku miga arugil iruppadhaal, vaanvazhi thodarbaana sila savaalgalum ullana. Iruppinum maanellooril sipgaat amaikka erkanave nilam kaiyagappaduthappattulladhaal vimaana nilaiya thevaikkaaga pudhidhaaga nilam kaiyagappadutha thevaiyillai enak koorappadugiradhu.

headline: Velaan thuraiyil othuzhaippai membadutha moondru naadugaludan India pechu
text:
Pudhudilli: velaan thuraiyil othuzhaippai virivuvaduthum vagaiyil, malesiyaa, thimor- leste matrum miyaanmar aagiya naadugaludan mathiya arasu thanithaniyaaga irudharappu pechu nadathiyulladhu.
Tilliyil nadaivetra 9vadhu aasiyaan - India velaanmai matrum vanathurai amaichargal koottathin idaiye, mathiya velaan amaichar sivaraaj sing savugaan, moondru naadugalin velaan amaichargalai sandhithu pesinaar.
Malesiya velaanmai matrum unavu paadhugaappu thurai amaichar mugamadhu pin saavuvudan nadandha pechil, velaan aaraaychi, thozhilnutbam matrum pudhiya kanduvidippugalil inaindhu seyalbaduvadhu kurithu vivaadhikkappattadhu. Idharkaaga iru naadugalum purindhunarvu oppandham merkolla thittamittullana.
Thimor--leste naattin velaanmai, kaalnadai, meenvalam matrum vanathurai amaichar maargos taa kuroos, velaan savaalgalai edhirgondu unavu paadhugaappai urudhi seyya indhiyaavudan valuvaana niruvana reedhiyilaana othuzhaippu thevai ena valiyuruthinaar.
India-vin sirandha velaan nadaimuraigalai pagirndhu kolla thayaaraaga iruppadhaagavum appodhu therivikkappattadhu.
Miyaanmar velaanmai, kaalnadai matrum paasanathurai amaichar min naang udanaana pechil, velaanmai matrum adhu saarndha thuraigalil othuzhaippai valuppaduthuvadharkaana irudharappu purindhunarvu oppandham irudhi kattathil iruppadhaaga iru tharappilum therivikkappattadhu.

headline: India ulbada 5 naadugal meedhu 100 sadhaveedham vari; kaiyezhuthittaar adhivar Trump
text:
Vaashingdan: India ulbada 5 naadugal meedhu 100 sadhaveedha vari vidhikka vazhivagai seyyum sattathil America adhivar Trump kaiyezhuthittaar.
Russia - Ukraine por thuvangiyadhaal ulagalavil kachaa enneykku thattuppaadu erpattadhu. Thodarndhu, Russia thalluvadi vilaiyil kachaa enneyai vazhangi varugiradhu.
Idhanaal, India thodarndhu rashyaavidam irundhu adhigalavil kachaa enney vaangi varugiradhu. Russia-vukku porulaadhaara nerukkadi erpaduthum vagaiyil, annaattin erisakdhi thuraiyai kurivaithu America palveru nadavadikkaigalai merkondu varugiradhu.
Andha vagaiyil, India ulbada 5 naadugal meedhu 100 sadhaveedha vari vidhikka America adhivar tirambukku adhigaaram alikkum masodhaa, America piradhinidhigal savaiyil 262-159 endra ottu vithiyaasathil niraivetrappattadhu.
Indha masodhaa ondru, Russia meedhu neradi thadai vidhippadhu. Matrondru, rashyaavudan thodarndhu varthagam seythu adhan porulaadhaarathukku udhavuvadhan vaayilaaga, Ukraine porukku maraimugamaaga nidhiyudhavi seyyum naadugalai thandippadhu aagiyavatrukku kondu varappattulladhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil, rashyaavidam irundhu adhigalavil kachaa enney matrum iyarkai erivaayuvai vaangum ulagin mudhal aindhu naadugalin etrumadhi porutkalukku, 100 sadhaveedham sunga vari vidhikka immasodhaa adhigaaram alikkiradhu.
Indha masodhaavukku amerikkap piradhinidhigal savai oppudhal alitha nilaiyil, tharpodhu Trump kaiyezhuthittullaar. Idhanaal adutha 30 naatkalil India ulbada 5 naadugal meedhu 100 sadhaveedha vari amalukku varum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.

headline: “panjjaap vella paadhippil makkalukku udhaviya aareses” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Panjjaap vellathil paadhikkappattulla makkalukku aar.es.es thondargaldhaan udhavi seythu varugiraargal endru oru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu.

Mazhai neer thengiyulla idathil ullavargalukku aar.es.es thondargal unavu vazhangum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhudhaan aar.es.es 🚩
poraadiya endha vivasaayigalaavadhu panjjaap mazhai vellathil udhavi seythu paarthadhundaa? Aanaal sanga svayam sevagargal kalathil nirkiraargal ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Panjjaavil kana mazhai kaaranamaaga vella paadhippu erpattulladhu. Avargalukku aar.es.es thondargal mattume udhavi seyvadhu pondru oru video padhivu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Vazhakkamaaga pazhaiya video, pugaippadangalai eduthu aar.es.es thondargal udhavi seythaargal endru samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappuvadhu vazhakkam enbadhaal indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu moondru, naangu maadhangalaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aagast 5, 2025 andru peegaaril vella paadhippu pagudhigalil aar.es.es thondargal nivaarana udhavigalai seythu varugindranar endru kurippittu padhividappattirundhadhu.
Joolai 29, 2025 andru idhe video-vai raajasdhaanil vella paadhippu pagudhigalil aar.es.es thondargal unavu vazhangi udhavi seythanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Innum odisaa ullitta veru pagudhigalaik kurippittum veru sila padhivugalum namakku kidaithana. Raajasdhaan endru kurippittu veliyaana padhivil mattum idhu raamganjs mandi endra idathil seyyappatta nivaarana udhavi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha pagudhiyil joolai irudhiyil mazhai vella paadhippu erpattadhaa endru thediyavodhu, vella paadhippu erpattadhaagavum aar.es.es thondargal udhavi seythaargal endrum pala seythigal namakku kidaithana.
Panjjaap vellam aagast irudhiyil erpattadhu. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai 2025 joolaiyilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video panjjaavil vellathaal paadhikkappatta makkalukku aar.es.es thondargal unavu vazhangi udhavi seythaargal endru paravum video thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Keezhe vizhundha rajinigaanth endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’kaal thadukki, keezhe vizhundha rajinigaanth,’’ endru koori,

idhil, rajinigaanth pondra thotram konda oruvar, veettuth thottathil nadandhusellumbodhu thadukki vizhuvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
‘Be Careful Rajinikanth Sir..’ endra thalaippil, vavijay rasigargal mudhalil X valaidhalathil kurippitta veediyaavai share seythanar. Aanaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, tharpodhu share, comment seyya thodangiyullanar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil, naam idhuvatri rajinigaanth aluvalagathai thodarbugondu, vilakkam kettom. Appodhu, ‘’kurippitta sisidivi kaatchi, rajinigaanth veettil edukkappattadhalla. Adhil irukkum navarum rajinigaanth kidaiyaadhu. Yaaro oruvarin video-vai vendumendre rajinigaanth peyaril share seythu, samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithanar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, kuritha video eppodhu, enge edukkappattadhu endra vivaram thedinom. Idhanbadi, karnaadagaavais serndha Rajaram Tallur enbavar, thanadhu veettil thadukki vizhundhadhu patri nagaichuvaiyaaga, Facebook-il pagira, adhanaiye tharpodhu rajinigaanth endru koori, palarum tirent seyya thodangiyullanar.
Indha video-vil iruppavar rajinigaanth endru tharpodhu tirent seyyappattu varum soozhalil, udanadiyaaga, idhuvatri Rajaram Tallur vilakkam alithu, avaradhu Facebook pakkathil padhivu ondrai veliyittullaar.
Enave, karnaadagaavais serndha oruvaradhu video-vai eduthu, rajinigaanth thadukki vizhundhaar, endru kurippittu, samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video thagaval, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

text:

headline: Mahaa.,vil adhigaalai vivathaal vivareedham; laari meedhu car modhiyadhil 8 per pali
text:
Mumbai: mahaaraashdiraavil laari meedhu esyoovi car modhi erpatta vivathil 3 kuzhandhaigal utbada 8 per uyirizhandhanar.
Mahaaraashdiraavin pandaaraa maavattathil indru (sep 11) adhigaalaiyil, oru laari matrum esyoovi car modhi vivathukkullaanadhu. Thagaval arindhu sambava idathirku Police viraindhanar. Ulloor makkal udhaviyudan meetbu paniyil eeduvattanar.
Indha vivathil moondru kuzhandhaigal utbada ettu per uyirizhandhanar. Ivargalai udalai meettu piredha parisodhanaikkaaga Police maruthuvamanaikku anuppi vaithanar. Indha vivathukkaana kaaranam kurithu Police visaarikkindranar.
Echarikkai avasiyam!

Vaaganam ottuvavar, thookka kalakkathil satru asandhaalum perum vivathu nadai perum. Indha vivathu iravu 8 manikku mel payanam seyvadhai thavirkka vendum enbadhai unarthugiradhu.

text:

Idhanudan por vimaanam ondru kundu veesuvadhu pondrum, adharku peerangi ondru padhiladi tharuvadhu pondrum kaatchigal konda oru video inaikkappattulladhu.
Idhevondru, ‘’neradik kaatchigal ,,indhiya ellaikkul nuzhaiyavirundha paagisdhaanin avaaks por vimaanathai veri kondu thaakki suttu veezhthiya India 🔥🔥🔥,’’ endru thalaippittum idhe video-vai silar pagirndhu varugindranar.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha veediyovukkum, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, idhu unmaiyaana video kidaiyaadhu. Video kem ondrin padhivu seyyappatta kaatchi. Idhil, kemiraa irukkum idam nokki kundu veesappaduvadhu pondrum, kemiraavukku endha paadhippum illaamal, siru nadukkam kooda illaamal, thodarndhu, kaatchigalai padhivu seyvadhu pondrum kaatchi idambetrulladhu. Idhu yadhaartha porkkalathil saathiyamatra seyal. Kemiraavai nokki kunduveesappattaal, adhanai padambidikkum navar kandippaaga alari oduvaar alladhu achathil kookkural ezhuppuvaar. Thavira, kemiraa, nilaidhadumaari keezhe vizhavum neridum. Idhu edhuvume indri iyandhirathanamaaga, naam aayvu seyyum video-vil kaatchigal idambetrullana.
Idhan adippadaiyil, naam thodarndhu thagaval thediyavodhu, idhu aanlainil ArmA 3 endra peyaril karpanaiyaaga por seyvadhu pondru, vilaiyaadappadum video kem endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhuvondru eraalamaana por karpanai video-kkal aanlainil kaanak kidaikkindrana.
Indha video kem vadivamaithu, veliyittu varuvadhu Bohemia Interactive endra niruvanamaagum. Idhu sek kudiyarasu naattais serndhadhu. Indha niruvanam, ARMA seeris muraiyil, ARMA 1, ARMA 2, ARMA 3 endra video kemgalai vadivamaithu veliyittu varugiradhu. Indha kaatchigalil ondrudhaan, naam mele kanda veediyovum. Namadhu Fact Crescendo Assamese pirivu idhuvatri fektchek veliyittulladhu.
Melum, Israel – Palestine modhal thodarbaaga, idhevondru oru video-vai samooga valaidhalangalil paraviyadhum, naam adhuvatri fektchek seythadhum inge kurippidathakkadhu.
Enave, video kem kaatchiyai eduthu, India – Pakistan porkkaatchi endru, thavaraana thagaval parappugiraargal, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Merku vangam idaitherdhal | mamdhaa Con.-kku aadharavu.. Aanaal thideer tvist!
text:
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
merku vangathil nadaivetra sattamandrath therdhalil thirinaamul Congress kottai thagarkkappattu, BJP mudhalmuraiyaaga aatchiyaip pidithadhu. Therdhalil perum tholviyutra thirinaamul Congress katchikkul utkatchip poosal nilaviyadhaal katchi udaindhadhu. Adhumattumillaamal thirinaamul Congress katchiyilirundhu neekkappatta ridhaapradhaa, 58 em.el.ekkal aadharavudan edhirkkatchith thalaivaraanaar. Idhu, mamdhaavukku periya pinnadaivai erpaduthiyadhu.
Innilaiyil merku vangathin mukkiya arasiyal kalamaana nandhigiraamil akdovar 6, 2026 andru idaitherdhal nadaivera irukkiradhu. Nandhigiraamil aduthaduthu nigazhndha paravarappaana sambavangal kavanathai eerkkum vagaiyil amaindhulladhu. Mamdhaa paanarji aniyin vetbaalar sanjjidhaa piradhaan te thideerena thanadhu vetbumanuvaith thirumbap petraar. Idhaith thodarndhu, Congress vetbaalar milan piradhaanukku mamdhaa paanarji thanadhu aadharavai arivithaar. Sila mani nerangalileye milan piradhaan 2007aam aandu vazhakkil kaidhu seyyappattiruppadhu merku vanga arasiyalil paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Nandhigiraam idaitherdhalil mamdhaa aniyin thirinaamool kaangirasin sanjjidhaa piradhaan te thanadhu vetbumanuvaith thirumbap petradhaaga arivithaar. Vetbumanuvaith thirumbap petradharkaana kaaranathai avar pagirangamaaga therivikkavillai. Aanaal, adharku munbu avar merku vanga mudhalvar suvendhu adhigaariyais sandhithirundhaar.
Avar, vetbu manuvaith thirumbap petradhaith thodarndhu mamdhaa paanarji, nandhigiraamil Congress vetbaalar milan piradhaanukku thanadhu katchi aadharavalikkum ena arivithaar. Congress thangalin sagodharak katchi endrum, edhirgaalathil I-N-D-I-A koottaniyai valuppaduthum vagaiyil indha mudivu edukkappattadhaagavum mamdhaa therivithaar.
Aanaal, indha arivippukkup piragu adutha sila mani nerangalileye Congress vetbaalar milan piradhaan merku vanga Police-araal kaidhu seyyappattaar. 2007aam aandu nandhigiraam nilam kaiyagappaduthum poraattathudan thodarbudaiya pazhaiya kolai vazhakkil kaidhu seyyappattadhaagak koorappattadhu. Niluvaiyil irundha vaarant adippadaiyil kaidhu seyyappattadhaagavum Police tharappu therivithulladhu.
Indha kaidhu, therdhalil avar pottiyiduvadharku thaanaagave thagudhi neekkam seyyaadhu endraalum, avaradhu pirasaarathai paadhikkakkoodum endrum koorappadugiradhu. Indha kaidhu thodarbaaga Congress kadum kelvigalai ezhuppiyulladhu. Ithanai aandugalaaga nadavadikkai edukkaamal, vetbumanu thaakkal seytha piragu en kaidhu nadavadikkai edukkappattadhu ena akkatchi kelvi ezhuppiyulladhu. Adhenerathil, indha kaidhu thodarbaana nerathai mamdhaa paanarjiyum kelvi ezhuppiyullaar. BJP indhak kutrachaattugalai niraagarithu, mamdhaa thanadhu vetbaalar vetri pera maattaar ena therindhadhaal, vetbumanuvai vaavas peras seythadhaaga kutramsaattiyulladhu.
2007aam aandu nilam kaiyagappaduthum poraattangalaal thesiya alavil mukkiyathuvam petra nandhigiraam, 2021aam aandu mamdhaa paanarji–suvendhu adhigaari neradi modhalaalum paravarappai erpaduthiyadhu. Tharpodhu meendum angu nadaiveravulla idaitherdhal, merku vanga arasiyalil mukkiya kavanathaip petrulladhu.
Idharkidaiye thirinaamul Congress katchiyin peyar matrum sinnam thodarbaana ulgatchi modhalum pudhiya thiruppathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Therdhal aanaiyam mamdhaa anikku mamdhaa aal India thirinaamul Congress endra peyaraiyum kaalbandhu veerar sinnathaiyum vazhangiyulladhu. Adhirupdhi anikku temaakradik thirinaamul Congress endra peyarum envelope sinnamum odhukkappattullana.

headline: Russia porulaadhaara thadais sattathil kaiyezhuthittaar America adhivar India, China meedhu 100% vari vidhikkappadum
text:
Vaashingdan, sep. 20–
Russia-vukku edhiraana adhiradi porulaadhaarath thadai masodhaavil America adhivar tonaaldu Trump kaiyezhuthittullaar. Idhan moolam, India, China meedhu, 100 sadhaveedha vari vidhikka mudiyum.
Kizhakku airoppiya naadaana Ukraine meedhaana porai niruthumaaru Russia-vukku thodarndhu America azhutham koduthu varugiradhu. Aanaal Russia adhanai alatchiyappaduthuvadhaal, nidhi reedhiyaana nerukkadiyai erpaduthi, porukkuth thevaiyaana porulaadhaara aadhaarangalai mudakkuvadharkaaga America pudhiya thadai sattam ondrai konduvandhulladhu.
Ukraine porukku aadharavalikkum Russia-vin nidhi aadhaarangalai mudakkuvadhe indhas sattathin mukkiya nokkamaagum.
Indha masodhaa America piradhinidhigal savaiyil 262 : 159 endra perumbaanmaiyudan sameevathil niraivetrappattadhu. Adhivar Trump netru kaiyezhuthittu oppudhal vazhangiyullaar.
Indha sattathil Russia adhigaarigal, vangigal, erisakdhi nalangal matrum raanuva nadavadikkaigalukku aadharavu tharum velinaattu niruvanangal ilakkaaga kurippidappattu ullana.
Idhan vaayilaaga Russia porutkal meedhu 500 sadhaveedham varai vari vidhikkavum, Russia enney-, erivaayu vaangum naadugalin porutkal meedhu 100 sadhaveedham varai vari vidhikkavum Trump adhigaaram petrullaar.
Aarambathil varaivu masodhaavil India, China utbada, 10 naadugalin peyargal neradiyaaga idam petrirundhaalum, irudhis sattathil avatrin peyargal neradiyaaga serkkappadavillai.
Rashyaavidam irundhu kachaa enney vaangum naadugalin pattiyalil munnaniyil iruppadhaal, Trump thanadhu adhigaarathaip payanbaduthi, nam naadu meedhu 100 sadhaveedham varai vari vidhikka vaayppulladhu.

headline: Russia-vil sooduviditha therdhal.. Katchigalukkuth thadai.. Putin aadhikkam thodarumaa?
text:
Ukraine meedhaana por thodangappattadharkup piragu, Russia-vil naadaalumandrath therdhal moondru naatkal vaakkuppadhivudan thodangiyulladhu. Russia naadaalumandrath therdhalil adhivar vilaadimir pudin aadharavu petra aalum 'yunaidet Russia' (United Russia) katchikku vetri vaayppum perumbaanmai aadharavum adhigamaaga iruppadhaagak karuthukkanippu mudivugal therivikkindrana.
Netto naadugalil inaiyakkoodaadhu enbadharkaaga Ukraine meedhu Russia, kadandha 2022aam aandu pipravari 24aam por thoduthadhu. Adhu 4 aandugalaik kadandhum indruvarai nadaivetru varugiradhu. Russia-vin muzhu alavilaana padaiyeduppirku edhiraaga ukrainum padhil thaakkudhal nadathi varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, Ukraine meedhaana por thodangappattadharkup piragu, Russia-vil naadaalumandrath therdhal moondru naatkal vaakkuppadhivudan thodangiyulladhu. Russia-vil naadaalumandrathin keezh avaiyaana 'stet toomaa' (State Duma) uruppinargalaith therndheduppadharkaana mudhal naadaalumandrath therdhal moondru naatkal vaakkuppadhivudan thodangiyulladhu. Kadandha sepdambar 18 thodangiya indhath therdhal naalaiyudan (sep.20) mudivadaiyap pogiradhu.
Russia-vin mothamulla 450 naadaalumandrath thogudhigalil 225 idangal therdhal moolamaagavum, meedhamulla 225 idangal neradith thogudhi (Single-member Constituencies) muraiyilum therndhedukkappadugindrana.
Porai pagirangamaaga edhirtha 'yaaplogo' (Yabloko) katchi indhath therdhalil pottiyidath thadai seyyappattulladhu. Adhevol, mukkiya edhirkkatchith thalaivargalum pottiyida mudiyaamal thagudhineekkam seyyappattullanar. Adhenerathil, vaakkuppadhivu sadhaveedhathai uyarthum nokkil pala piraandhiyangalil online minnanu vaakkuppadhivu muraiyum arimugappaduthappattulladhu. Indhath therdhalil, kiremlin aadharavuk katchigal ondrinaindhu 2001-il uruvaakkappatta Russia-vin aalum katchi 'yunaidet Russia' (United Russia), adhivar vilaadimir pudhinai aadharithu varuvadhudan, andru mudhal naadaalumandrathil aadhikkam seluthi varugiradhu.
Karuthukkanippugalinbadi, 37% mudhal 47% varaiyilaana vaakkugalaip petru akkatchi munnilaiyil ulladhu. Idhu katchikkuth thevaiyaana 300-kkum merpatta idangalaip petruth thandhu, sirappup perumbaanmaiyaith (Supermajority) thakkavaikka udhavum. Irandaam matrum moondraam idangalil ulla kamyoonist matrum LDPR katchigal peyaralavil edhirkkatchigalaaga irundhaalum, Ukraine por matrum arasin mukkiyak kolgaigalil adhivar pudinukku muzhu aadharavu alippavaigalaagave ullana.

headline: Pagavath keedhaiyai vaasikkum pudhin endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Vimaanathil pagavath keedhaiyai vaasikkum Russia adhivar Putin endru oru pugaippadam

Indhiya piradhamar narendhira Modi parisaaga vazhangiya Russia mozhiveyarppu pagavathgeedhai puthagathai Russia adhivar Putin vaasippadhu pondra pugaippadam ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil. “piradhamar modiyaal vazhangappatta anbaana parisaana ‘sreemath pagavath keedhai’ noolai, adhivar Putin vaasithukkondirukkum kaatchi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
India vandhirundha Russia adhivar vilaadimir pudhinukku Indhiya piradhamar narendhira Modi pagavath keedhai puthagathai parisaaga vazhanginaar. Indhiyaavilirundhu thirumbis sellum podhu andha puthagathai padithavadi Putin sendradhu pondru pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru pugaippadathai Russia adhivar alladhu Russia arasu tharappilirundhu veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Russia adhivar thodarbaana anaithu veliyeedugalum kramlin maaligai inaiyathalathil veliyaagum. Adhil pudhinin Indhiya payanam, Modi, thiravuvadhi murmu udanaana sandhippu ena pala thagaval irundhana. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha pugaippadamum adhil illai. Appadi irukka ivargalukku mattum pirathiyegamaaga pugaippadam kidaikka vaayppillai.
Russia matrum andha naattu adhivar indha pugaippadathai veliyidavillai endraal idhu unmaiyaaga irukka vaayppillai. Idhu poliyaanadhaaga alladhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathil aayvu seythom. Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittirundhanar. Arasu tharappil, uriya angeegarikkappatta amaippu alladhu piramugargal tharappilirundhu indha pugaippadam veliyaagave, pagirappadavo illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Padathai utru paarkkum podhu puthagathai pidithirukkum pudhinukku irandu peruviral iruppadhu pondru therindhadhu. Podhuvaaga pugaippadangalai eai moolam uruvaakkum podhu idhu pondra uruva kuraivaadugal erpaduvadhu vazhakkamaanadhu. Enave, idhuvum eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla eai pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum inaiyadhalangalil indha pugaippadangalaip padhivetrith thedinom. Avaiyum idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana. Nammudaiya fekt kirasando malaiyaalathilum indha pugaippadam thodarbaaga katturai veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhilum, idhu eai moolam uruvaakkbattadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappattirundhadhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil idam petra pugaippadam thavaraanadhu, eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Theru naaygalukku unavalippadhu urimai endru ucha Needhimandram kooriyadhaa?
text:

therunaaygalukku unavalippadhu nam urimaiyum kadamaiyum podhumakkal unavoottum urimaiyai ucha Needhimandram urudhi seythulladhu. Unavoottuvadhaith thondharavu seythaal udane 100 azhaithu pugaar seyyalaam; kaavaldhurai kadumaiyaana nadavadikkai edukkum.

headline: Pi.ep. Ucha varambu adhigarippu: thozhilaalarukku payan kidaikkum!
text:
Tiruppur: niruvanangalil paniyaatrum oozhiyargalin sambalathil irundhu piditham seyyappadum varungaala vaippu nidhi (pi.ep.)kkaana oodhiya ucha varambai roo.15 aayirathil irundhu roo.25 aayiramaaga uyartha mathiya arasu mudivu seythulladhu. Idhan moolam thiruppooril thozhilaalargal adhigam payanbera vaayppulladhaaga pi.ep. Adhigaarigal therivithullanar.
Oozhiyargalin sambalathil irundhu oru pangum, niruvanathin saarbil oru pangum ovvoru maadhamum pi.ep. Kanakkil seluthappadugiradhu. Indha semippu paniyaalargalin oyvukkaalathil udhaviyaaga irukkum.
Kadandha 2014-m aandu mudhal pi.ep. Uruppinaraaga kattaayam seruvadharkaana maadha sambala ucha varambu roo.15 aayiramaaga irundhu vandhadhu. Tharpodhu indha varambai roo.25 aayiramaaga uyartha mathiya amaicharavai sep. 16-m thedhi oppudhal alithulladhu. Indha maatram sep. 17 mudhal amalukku vandhadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Idhanaal, roo.15 aayiram mudhal roo.25 aayiram varai maadha sambalam perum pudhiya paniyaalargalum kattaaya pi.ep. Paadhugaappukkul varuvaargal. Naadu muzhuvadhum 51 latchathukkum merpatta koodudhal paniyaalargal idhanaal payanberuvaargal ena therivikkappattulladhu.
Tiruppur maavattam javuli matrum aayatha aadaith thozhilil adhigalavil thozhilaalargalai kondulladhaal, pi.ep. Ucha varambu uyarvu ippagudhiyil mukkiyathuvam petrulladhu.
Thozhilaalargalukku enna payan?
Roo.15 aayiram mudhal roo.25 aayiram varai sambalam perum thozhilaalargal kattaaya pi.ep. Varambukkul varuvadhaal, avargalukku pi.ep. Semippu, oyvoodhiyam matrum aayul kaappeedu ullitta samoogap paadhugaappu palangal kidaikkum vaayppu erpadum.
Adhenerathil, pudhiya ucha varambu kaaranamaaga sila oozhiyargalin sambalathil irundhu piditham seyyappadum pi.ep. Pangalippu adhigarikkalaam. Idhanaal maadhandhorum kaiyil kidaikkum sambalam satru kuraiyalaam. Aanaal, pi.ep. Kanakkil semikkappadum thogai adhigarikkum.
Melum, oozhiyargalin pi.ep. Pangalippukku erpa niruvanangalukkum koodudhal selavu erpadum. Thozhilaalargal adhigam ulla thiruppooril pi.ep. Ucha varambu uyarvu thozhilaalargal matrum niruvanangal mathiyil edhirbaarppai erpaduthiyulladhu.
 Pi.ep. Aluvalaga thagavalbadi, tharpodhu 11,782 niruvanangalil 5.04 latcham per pi.ep. Pangalippu seythu varugindranar. Melum, 82 aayiram oyvoodhiyadhaarargal oyvoodhiyap palangalai petru varugindranar.

headline: Lanjjam vaangiya Police endru pagirappadum video Tamil Naattil edukkappattadhaa?
text:

investigation_details:
Merkanda video unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu karnaadagaa maanilathil nigazhndha sambavam endrum, idharkum thamizhnaattirkum endha thodarbum illai endrum theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, sila naatkal munbaaga, karnaadagaa maanilam, paagalgot maavattathil ulla paadhaami kaavalnilaiyathais serndha Police 6 per, kaaval paniyil eeduvattirundhanar. Appodhu, ulloor saamiyaar sithangolaat madaadhivadhi sivagumaar suvaamiji enbavar avvazhiye kaaril vandhaar. Avaridam Police aasi pera virumbinar. Enave, kaarai niruthiya suvaamiji, Police 6 perukkum aasi vazhangiyadhodu, siridhu panam anbalippaagak koduthu, adhanai selavidaamal, pathiramaaga vaithuk kollumbadi arivurai seythaar.
Indha kaatchiyai silar video eduthu, samooga valaidhalangalil pagirndhu, panathirkaaga saamiyaar kaalil vizhundha Police endru kurippittu, vimarsikka thodanginar. Indha video viral-aaga paraviyadhai thodarndhu, sambandhappatta Police 6 perum paniyida maatram seyyappattanar.
