headline: Eestar kunduvedippu kutravaaligal 15 perukku thalaa 200 aandugal sirai thandanai
text:
Kozhumbu: ilangaiyai ulukkiya eestar thodar tharkolaip padai thaakkudhal vazhakkil, 15 perai kutravaaligalaaga arivitha kozhumbu uyar Needhimandram, avargal anaivarukkum thalaa 200 aandugal sirai thandanai vidhithadhu.
Nam andai naadaana ilangaiyil, 2019, epralil, eestar njaayirandru, moondru sarchugal matrum moondru sogusu vidudhigalil, onbadhu per konda kumbalaal, tharkolaippadai thaakkudhalgal nadathappattana. Indhath thaakkudhalil, 11 indhiyargal utbada 270 per uyirizhandhanar; 500-kkum merpattor padugaayamadaindhanar.
Indhath thaakkudhalil eeduvatta ai.es., payangaravaadha amaippudan thodarbudaiya neshanal thavuheeth jamaath amaippais serndha, 25 per meedhu kutram saattappattadhu. Idhil oruvar siraiyil irundhavodhu uyirizhandhaar. Meedhamullor meedhaana vazhakkil, kozhumbu uyar needhimandrathin, moondru per adangiya amarvu theerppalithadhu. 15 per kutravaaligalaaga arivikkappattanar; onbadhu per viduvikkappattanar.
Kutravaaligal 15 perukkum, thalaa 200 aandugal sirai thandanai vidhikkappattadhu. Melum, avargal anaivarin sothukkalai parimudhal seyyavum uyar Needhimandram utharavittadhu.

headline: Naakbooril thozhugai mudithu veliye vandhavargal meedhu Police thaakkudhal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Naakbooril masoodhiyil thozhugai mudithuvittu veliye vandha maanavargal meedhu Police thadiyadi nadathinar endru oru video

irandu islaamiya ilainjargalai Police thaakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thingalgizhamai naakbooril masoodhiyilirundhu thozhugai mudindhu veliye vandha maanavargal meedhu poleesaar thadiyadi nadathinar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Magaaraashdiraa maanilam avurangaavaath aruge kuldhaavaath endra siriya ooril ulla thargaa valaagathil mugalaaya perarasar avurangaseeppin kallarai ulladhu. Avar 1707m aandu irandhuvittaar. Avaradhu kallaraiyai agatra vendum endru 300 aandugal kazhithu ippodhu theevira indhuthuvaa valadhusaarigal poraattam nadathi varugindranar. Idhaiyotti magaaraashdiraa maanilam naakbooril kalavaram vedithadhu.
Indha nilaiyil, naakbooril ulla oru masoodhiyil thozhugai nadathivittu vandha islaamiya maanavargalai Police thaakkiyadhaaga video ondrai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vai paartha podhu irusakkara vaaganathin padhivu en satru mangalaagath therindhadhu. Adhil mathiya piradhesam enbadhai kurikkum vagaiyil MP endru irundhadhu. Iruppinum adhu MPaa alladhu MH-aa enbadhaith thulliyamaaga kandariya mudiyavillai.
Enave, indha video pazhaiya video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2022m aandu epralil indha video-vai silar instaagiraam ullitta samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video ippodhu nadandha naakboor kalavarathudan thodarbudaiyadhu illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu, 2022m aandu mathiya piradhesathin kargon (Khargone) endra idathil veditha vanmuraiyaith thodarndhu islaamiyargal meedhu Police nadathiya thaakkudhal endru kurippittu silar padhivittirundhanar. Thodarndhu thediya podhu, 2022m aandu epral 10m thedhi kargonil raamanavami oorvalathaith thodarndhu iru samoogathinarukku idaiye kalavaram vedithadhu endru seythigal kidaithana. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video naakboorais saarndhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Peegaar therdhalukkaaga kadathappadum madhu paattil endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhal arivikkappattulla soozhalil, rayilil peegaarukku madhu paattilgal kadathappadugindrana endru oru video

rail pettiyin e.si varum pagudhikkul irundhu madhuvaana paattilgalai edukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil, “esi pettiyil kulirchi kuraivaaga iruppadhaaga payanigal pugaar alithadhai thodarndhu esi varum paadhaiyai railway oozhiyar parisodhanai seythavodhu, ulle irundhu eraalamaana madhu paattilgal kaippatrappattana. Peegaarukku indha madhu paattilgal kadathappattadhu theriyavandhadhu” enbadhu pondru aangilathil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “esi sariyaaga velai seyyavillai endru tekneesiyan ovan seythavodhu ulle madhu paattilgal kadathal adaithuk kondiruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. “therdhal kummaalathukkaaga ” sangi naaygal rayilil madhu paattilgal kadathis selgiraargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhal irandu kattamaaga nadathappadum endru therdhal aanaiyam arivithulladhu. Indha nilaiyil therdhal kummaalathukkaaga sangigal madhu paattilai kadathis sendranar endru oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Sila maadhangalukku munbu rail pettiyil esi kaatru varum vazhiyil madhu paattilgal padhukki vaikkappattirundhadhaaga seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Andha seythiyai therdhal thedhi arivikkappatta piragu nadandhadhu pondru pagirndhirukkiraargalaa endra sandhegathil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2025 aagast maadham (irandu maadhangalukku munbu) indha veediyovudan seythi veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Naam sandhegappattadhuvola kadandha aagast maadham veliyaana video-vai ippodhu nadandhadhu pondru thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
2025 aagast 14, 15 thedhigalil indha madhu paattil kadathal thodarbaana seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, utharappiradhesathin thalainagar laknovilirundhu peegaar maanilathil ulla paravuni (Barauni) endra oorukku sendra rayilil esi pettiyil thatbaveppanilai kulirchiyaaga illai endru rayilvekku pugaar sendradhu. Idhaith thodarndhu e.si tekneeshiyan andha pettikku sendru e.si kaatru varavillai endru pugaar ezhundha pagudhikku sendru aayvu seythaar.
E.si varum paadhaiyilirundha moodiyaith thirandhavodhu ulle eraalamaana madhu paattilgal irundhadhai avar kandarindhaar. Idhu thodarbaaga railway poleesil pugaar seyyappattadhu. Madhu paattilgalaip padhukkik kadathi vandha rail petti attandar anish kumaar kaidhu seyyappattaar. Peegaaril madhu virpanaikkuth thadai vidhikkappattadhilirundhu rayilil madhu paattilgalaik kadathis sendru irandu madangu laavathil avar vitru vandhadhu visaaranaiyil theriyavandhadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Kadathappattavar BJP aadharavaalar endro, peegaar sattamandra therdhal thedhi arivikkappattadhaith thodarndha vaakkaalargalaik kavarvadharkaaga ivar kadathis sendraar endro endha seythiyum illai. Peegaar therdhal thedhi arivikkappaduvadharku irandu maadhangalukku munbaaga nadandha sambavathin video-vai thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “therdhalil thotraal enadhu sothugalai makkalukku vazhanguven” endru M.K. Stalin savaal!
text:
Therdhalil tholviyadaindhaal thannudaiya 3000 kodi roobai sothai makkalukku vazhanguven endru Stalin arivippu endru

san news veliyittadhu pondru mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin pugaippadathudan koodiya news card threads.com-l padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “staalin savaal. Naan therdhalil thotraal, ennudaiya 3000 kodi roobai sothai makkalukku ilavasamaaga vazhanguven – MK Stalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Therdhalil tholviyadaindhaal thannudaiya 3000 kodi roobai sothai makkalukku vazhanguven endru Stalin kooriyadhu pondru oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Therdhal vetbu manu thaakkalin podhu M.K. Stalin thannudaiya sothu madhippu roo.6.62 kodi endru therivithirundhaar. Adhanaal, roo.3000 kodiyai makkalukku vazhangugiren endru kooriyirukka vaayppillai.
News kaardin thamizh faandai paarkkum podhe editting kooda sariyaaga theriyaadha navar idhai poliyaaga uruvaakkiyiruppadhu thelivaagath therigiradhu. Idhaiyum palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Therdhal vaakkuppadhivu andru Stalin vaakkalitha pugaippadathai vaitha indha padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Enave, indha san news veliyittirundha news card-ai edit seythu idhai poliyaaga uruvaakkiyirukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil san news tivi-yin samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru news card-ai 23 epral 2026 andru veliyittiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Aanaal adhil. “vaakkalithaar. Chennai: thenaambettai SIET kallooriyil thanadhu kudumbathudan sendru vaakkalithaar mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalin” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraaga padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla indha news card-ai san news digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kidukkippidi podum WhatsApp.. Ini neenga Use panna mudiyaadhaa? Adhiradiyaaga vandha pudhu rools?
text:
Indhiya payanargalidam pirandha thedhiyai ketkum WhatsApp sgireenshaatkal samooga valaidhalangalil viral-aagi, idhu varavirukkum Indhiya arasu vidhimuraigaludan thodarbudaiyadhaa endra kelviyai ezhuppiyulladhu. Aanaal WhatsApp alladhu Indhiya arasu endha pudhiya vayadhu sarivaarppu kolgaiyaiyum arivikkavillai. Idhu sodhanai muyatsiyaa, vazhakkamaana kanakku pudhuppippaa enbadhu thelivaagavillai.
Samooga valaidhalangalil paravi varum sgireenshaatkalil, sila payanargalidam pirandha thedhiyai ullidumaaru WhatsApp ketbadhaagavum, idhu 'varavirukkum Indhiya arasu vidhimuraigal' thodarbaanadhu ena kurippidappattulladhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Indha sgireenshaatkalai mudhalil X thalathil pagirndha avishek yaadhav, idhan moolam pudhiya vivaadhathai erpaduthinaar. Innilaiyil, India mesejing matrum samooga valaidhalangalil ilam payanargalukkaana paadhugaappu nadavadikkaigalai kadumaiyaakkap pogiradhaa endra kelvigal ezhundhullana.
Aanaal, WhatsApp alladhu Indhiya arasu idhuvarai vayadhu sarivaarppu thodarbaana pudhiya kolgai edhaiyum arivikkavillai. Enave, indha arivippu oru varaiyarukkappatta sodhanaiyaa, vazhakkamaana kanakku pudhuppippaa alladhu pudhiya vidhimuraigaludan thodarbudaiyadhaa enbadhu thelivaagavillai.
WhatsApp erkanave sila soozhalgalil payanargalin vayadhu thodarbaana thagavalgalai segarithu varugiradhu. Padhivu seyyum podhu alladhu sila sevaigalai payanbaduthum podhu vayadhai urudhippaduthumaaru payanargalidam ketkappadalaam ena niruvanam therivithulladhu. Indha thagavalgal satta vidhigalai pinbatravum, vayadhukku etra sevaigalai vazhangavum udhavugindrana.
Melum, vayadhu thagavalgal paadhugaappu nadavadikkaigal, sevai vidhimuraigalai amalbaduthudhal matrum sila mettaa eai sevaigalukkaana anugalai nirnayippadhilum payanbaduthappadalaam.
Idharkidaiyil, aasdhireliyaa matrum ingilaandhu pondra naadugal kuzhandhaigalin online paadhugaappukkaaga vayadhu sarivaarppu vidhigalai valuppaduthiyullana. Indhiyaavum edhirgaalathil idhuvondra nadavadikkaigalai eduthaal, WhatsApp mattumindri teligiraam, siknal, instaagiraam ullitta pala thalangalum paadhikkappadalaam.
Tharpodhu, indha arivippu thodarbaaga adhigaarappoorva urudhippaduthal edhuvum illai. Enave, samooga valaidhalangalil veliyaagum thagavalgalai urudhiyaana pudhiya vidhimurai ena karudha mudiyaadhu.

headline: Jeffrey Epstein Israel-il uyirudan irukkiraar endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
America-vin kuzhandhai paaliyal kutravaaliyaana Jeffrey Epstein Israel-il uyirudan vasithu varugiraar endru oru pugaippadam

America-vin kuzhandhai paaliyal kutravaaliyaana irandhu pona Jeffrey Epstein nadandhu selvadhu pol oru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “enakku_appave_sandhegam_irundhadhu…. #marana_viyavaari ..!! “#jepri_epsteen” #uyirudan isrelin “tel aviv” therukkalil sutrith thirigiraan, melum Israel 2019 mudhal avaradhu maranathai poliyaaga sitharithadhu enbadhu urudhippaduthappattu ulladhu. Sinimaavaiye minjjum vagaiyil nadakkum sambavangal.adhirchi alikkiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
America paaliyal kutravaaliyum manidha kadathalgalil eeduvattavarumaana Jeffrey Epstein thodarbaana koppugal veliyaaga adhirchiyai erpaduthina. Indha Jeffrey Epstein America siraiyil irandhuvittadhaaga arivikkappattirundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil, avar uyirudan Israel naattil vasithu varuvadhaaga oru pugaippadathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Jeffrey Epstein 2019m aandu aagast 10m thedhi sirai araiyil irandhu kidandhadhaaga seythigal therivikkindrana. Avar irandha udan adhu thodarbaaga America-vin ep.pi.ai visaaranai nadathiyadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Andha nerathil Epstein udalai pugaippadangal eduthullanar. Andha pugaippadangalai ellaam America veliyittirundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil, avar uyirudan irukkiraar endru pugaippadam paravuvadhaip paarkkum podhu, adhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam alladhu pazhaiya pugaippadamaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha pugaippadathai mudhan mudhalaaga reddit.com thalathil oruvar padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Avar eai payanbaduthi pugaippadangalai uruvaakki thodarndhu reddit.com thalathil padhivittu vandhiruppadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Kaandhiyadigal kaiyil iyandhirath thuppaakkiyudan iruppadhu pol, paadivildar pola iyesu iruppadhu pol ena eraalamaana eai pugaippadangalai avar padhivittirundhaar.
Melum, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda andha pugaippadathai jemini eai moolam uruvaakkiyadhaagavum andha padhivaalar kurippittirundhaar. Adhu thavari veru pala Jeffrey Epstein thodarbaana pugaippadangalaiyum avar eai moolam uruvaakki padhivittirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Andha reddit.com padhivar vauyittirundha pugaippadathil keezhe jemini eai logo irundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Indha pugaippadathai uruvaakkiyavare idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru koorivittaalum, adhai urudhi seythugolla thodarndhu aayvu seythom. Pugaippadathai eai-aal uruvaakkappattadhaa endru kandariya udhavum thehive.ai ullitta sila inaiyadhalangalil padhivetrith thedinom. Avai anaithume idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhudhaan enbadhai urudhi seythana. Idhan moolam indha pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vavijay matrum thirishaa ondraaga siesge kirikket mets paarthanaraa?
text:
‘vavijay matrum thirishaa ondraaga siesge kirikket mets paarthanar’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ padhaviyetra aindhe naatkalil 24 kolaigal
vavijay than thozhiyodu siesge kirikket mets paarthu magizhum tharanum
mets paakka ponadhula thappu illa
thamizhnaattu sattaozhungaiyum paarunga vavijay
arasiyal sinimaa shootting mudichittu veettukku poradhu illa 24 mani neram kalathil iruppadhu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta video, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Indha video-vil DE (Dileep’s Edit) endra vaattarmaark idambetrulladhu. Adhan adippadaiyil, thagaval thediyavodhu dileeps_edit endra instaagiraam pakkathil idhe video mudhalil pagirappattulladhaik kandom. Idharku, ‘’Cheering for CSK 💛💛💛Vijay Thalapathy and Trisha in the stadium Made using @oiioii_ai ,’’ endru thalaippittullanar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, oiioii_ai endra animated AI agent udhaviyudan indha video thayaarikkappattulladhu, endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal aadhaaram idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video AI moolamaaga thayaarikkappattadhu; unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ”paaradhidhaasan udhavith thogai viduvippu; DMK arasiyal seygiradhu” - amaichar vanni arasu
text:
Thamizhaga arasin uyargalvi udhavithogai thittathin moolam malesiyaavil ulla palgalaikkazhagam ondril aaraaychi maanavaraagap payindru varugiraar Bharathidhasan . Kadandha aagast maadham, thanakkaana kalvi udhavithogai innum kidaikkavillai enak koori avar video ondrai veliyittirundhaar. Indha vivagaaram sattapperavai varaiyilum edhirolithirundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil, samooganeedhi matrum siruvaanmaiyinar nalathurai amaichar vanniyarasu, maanavargalukkaana nidhi vazhangappattu varuvadhaaga vilakkam alithirundhaar. Aanaal, adharkup piragum thanakku uriya nidhi kidaikkavillai ena Bharathidhasan thodarndhu therivithu vandhaar.
Indhanilaiyil, sameevathil video ondrai veliyittirundha Bharathidhasan, thanakku Thamizhaga arasidam irundhu kidaikka vendiya nidhi kidaikkaadha nilaiyil, thannai palgalaikkazhagathidam irundhu neekkum nilai erpattiruppadhaaga kanneer malga therivithirundhaar. Indha video, perum paravarappai erpaduthiyirundha nilaiyil, avarukku uriya nidhi alikka vendum enavum palveru arasiyal katchith thalaivargalum arivuruthiyirundhanar. Eninum, avarin mudhalaamaandukkaana nidhi odhukkappattu vittadhaagavum, adharkaana selavinap pattiyalai avar samarppikkaadha nilaiyil, udhavithogai niruthi vaikkappattiruppadhaagavum Thamizhaga arasu saarbil vilakkamalikkappattirundhadhu.
Thodarndhu, indha vivagaaram kurithup pesiyirundha DMK thalaivar Stalin, paaradhidhaasanukku nidhi odhukka mudiyumaa? Mudiyaadhaa? Enbadhai therivithuvida vendum enavum illaadhavatchathil DMK udhavum enavum therivithirundhaar. Eninum, samooga needhithurai amaichar vanni arasu, Bharathidhasan muraiyaaga pilgalai anuppaavittaalum avaradhu padippu thadaivada koodaadhu enbadharkaaga avarukku nidhi viduvikkappadum ena amaichar vanniyarasu urudhiyalithirundhaar.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, tharpodhu 2-m aandukkaana muzhumaiyaana nidhi tharpodhu viduvikkappattirukkiradhu.
Idhaithodarndhu, indru seythiyaalargalais sandhithup pesiyirukkum amaichar vanni arasu, ”paaradhidhaasan vivagaarathil DMK engal meedhu kutram saattugiradhu. Naangal arasiyal seyyavillai; DMK thaan arasiyal seygiradhu. Bharathidhasan kudumbathai ulavuthurai Police moolam mirattiyadhaaga kooruvadhu thittamitta avadhooru. Thambi Bharathidhasan enadhu thambi pondravar. Avaradhu paadhugaappukkum, padippukkum naangal utharavaadham alikkirom. Sattathirku purambaaga yaarum sellakkoodaadhu pil vazhangaadhadhu thurai reedhiyaana nadaimurai. Kadandha kaalathilum idhe nadaimuraidhaan pinbatrappattadhu. Pil varaavittaalum kalvi nalanai karudhi muzhu thogaiyum anuppi vaikkappattulladhu” enath therivithullaar.

headline: Paaliyal thollai... Athumeeriya thandhai; singappen padaiyidam pugaaralitha maanavi - paayndhadhu pokso!
text:
Meendum thandhaiyaal paaliyal seendalukku ullaaga, paadhikkappatta 10-m vaguppu maanavi indru thairiyamaagas ’singappen’ adhiradip padaiyinarukkuth tholaivesi vaayilaagath thodarbu kondu, than thandhai thanakkus seythu vandha paaliyal athumeeralgal kurithup pugaaralithaar.
Nellai, tavun aruge ulla kunnathoor pagudhiyais serndhavar, 52 vayadhaana pilambing thozhilaali. Ivarukku 3 magalgal ullanar. Idhil 3-vadhu magal, Nellai tavunil ulla oru palliyil 10-m vaguppu padithu varugiraar. Indha nilaiyil, madhuppazhakkathirku adimaiyaana andha maanaviyin thandhai, veettil yaarum illaadha nerangalil andha maanavikku thodarndhu paaliyal thollai koduthu vandhullaar. `idhu kurithuth thaay, sagodhari, thaathaa, paatti ena veettil ullavargal yaaridamum koorak koodaadhu. Appadik koorinaal kondru viduven' endru maanaviyai achuruthi miratti vandhullaar.
Uyirukkup payandha andha maanavi, veettil yaaridamum sollaamal irundhu vandhullar. Indha nilaiyil andha maanavi payilum pallikku sameevathil Thamizhaga arasin 'singappen' adhiradip padaiyinar neril sendru, paaliyal seendal matrum athumeeralgal kurithu vizhippunarvu erpaduthiyadhudan maanavigalukku thairiyam ootti, ``paaliyal thollaikku utbaduthappattaalo alladhu pira maanavigal paaliyal thollaikku aalaanaalo yaarukkum payappadaamal thunichalaaga pugaar alikka vendum. Pugaar alikkum maanaviyin peyar ragasiyam kaakkappadum.
Pugaar alithavargal kuritha vivaram velivaraamaleye, paaliyal thollai koduthavar meedhu kadum nadavadikkai edukkappadum" enak kooriyullanar. Athudan, avasara kaalangalil thodarbu kolla vendiya udhavi engalaiyum maanavigalukkuk koduthus sendrullanar. Indha nilaiyil, meendum thandhaiyaal paaliyal seendalukku ullaaga, paadhikkappatta 10-m vaguppu maanavi indru thairiyamaagas ’singappen’ adhiradip padaiyinarukkuth tholaivesi vaayilaagath thodarbu kondu, than thandhai thanakkus seythu vandha paaliyal athumeeralgal kurithup pugaaralithaar.
Andhap pugaarin adippadaiyil kunnathoor pagudhikku viraindhu vandha singappen padaiyinar, magalukkup paaliyal thollai kodutha thandhaiyaip pidithu Nellai anaithu magalir kaaval nilaiyathil oppadaithanar. Angu avar meedhu pokso sattathin keezh vazhakkuppadhivu seytha poleesaar, avaraik kaidhuseythu siraiyil adaithanar.

headline: Peegaaril raagul kaandhi nadaivayanathirku vandha koottam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaaril edhirkkatchith thalaivar raagal kaandhi nadathum vaakkaalar adhigaara nadaippayanam endru kurippittu oru video Facebook-il pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru aayvu seythom.

Migapperiya koottathin video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “edhirkkatchi thalaivar raagul kaandhi peegaaril nadathum “vaakkaalar adhigaara nadaivayanam” migapperiya maatrangalai konduvarum! – laalu pirasaath” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Matroru padhivil, “indha koottathai paarthu Modi-kku viyarthu irukkumo illaiyo modikkaaga thiruttu velai paartha thalaimaith therdhal adhigaari thiyaanesh kumaarukku viyarthu irukkum..🤣😂
#vaakkaalar_urimai_yaathirai #peegaar #vaakkudhiruttuaanaiyam #raagul” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar vaakkaalar pattiyalilirundhu latchakkanakkaanorai neekkiyadhai vaithu edhirkkatchith thalaivar raagul kaandhi poraattam, sutrup payanam merkondu varugiraar. Indha soozhalil raagul kaandhiyin payanathirku migapperiya alavil makkalin aadharavu ulladhu endru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vil raagul kaandhiyai kaanavillai. Avar nadaivayanam merkollum kaatchi illai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga sandhegam ezhave, aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Raagul kaandhi nadaivayanam thodangiya aagast 17m thedhikkup piragu aayirakkanakkaanavargal indha video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu moondru maadhangalukku munbaagave indha video silar samooga oodagangalil veliyittirundhadhaik kandarindhom.
Yaathirai 2025 aagastu 17l thodangiyadhu. Aanaal, 2025m aandu joon irudhiyil indha video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Adhil magaaraashdiraavil edukkappattadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video raagul kaandhiyin yaathiraiyin podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
2025 joon maadham 28m thedhi instaagiraamil indha video padhividappattirundhadhu. Maraathiyilirundha andha padhivai mozhimaatram seythu paarthom. Adhil, “petkaan hindhugesari maidhaanam, latchakkanakkaana idhayangal” enbadhu pola kurippidappattirundhadhu. Petkaan hindhugesari maidhaanam endru koogulil taip seythu thedinom. Appadi oru idam magaaraashdiraavil iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu sila padhivugalil kaalai pandhayam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil sila adippadai kee vaarthaigalaik koogulil taip seythu thedinom. Appodhu joon maadham petkaan hindhugesari maidhaanathil kaalai pandhayam nadandhadhaaga seythiyudan koodiya video-kkal namakkuk kidaithana.
Koogul mep-l petkaan hindhugesari maidhaanam endru thediyavodhu andha idathin street viyoo namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil silar veliyittirundha pugaippadangalaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Andha pugaippadamum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil koodiyirundha koottathin kaatchiyum ondru pola iruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha video peegaaril raagul kaandhi merkondulla yaathiraiyin podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Iraivan uruvaakkiya arpudha padaippu; viral-aagum video-vil irukkum paravaigal unmaiyaanavaiyaa?
text: Iraivan uruvaakkiya arpudha padaippu endru kurippittu viral-aagum azhagiya paravaigal.
investigation_details:
Viral-aagum video-vil irukkum paravaigal Ai thozhitnutbathai payanbaduthi uruvaakkappattadhaagum.
“indha arpudhamaana padaippai uruvaakkiya iraivanukku, nandri idhai kaanoliyaagap padhivu seytha andha manidharukkum nenjjam niraindha vaazhthugal” endru kurippittu video ondru samooga valaithalangalil paravi varugindradhu. Adhil thalaiyil kudai pondra amaippai udaiya jodi paravaigal manjjal matrum karuppu nirathil kaanappattadhu.

headline: `selvapperundhagai' vaitha vimarsanam - piraveen sakkaravarthi sonna padhil!
text:

headline: Japan-il nadakkum aasiya vilaiyaattu; idhuvarai India vendra padhakkam 15
text:
Tokkiyo: Japan-il nadandhu varum aasiya vilaiyaattu pottiyil Indhiya veerargal idhuvarai 15 padhakkangalai (1 thangam, 6 velli, 8 vengalam) vendrullanar.
Jappaanin aychi - nagoyaavil, aasiya vilaiyaattu 20vadhu seesan nadakkiradhu. Indru (sep 24) pengalukkaana 60 kilo saandaa irudhippottiyil China veeraanganaiyidam poraadi Indhiya veeraanganai roshivinaa thevi tholvi adaindhaar. Aanaalum avar irandaadhu idathai pidithu vellippadhakkathai thanvasappaduthinaar.
Irudhiyaaga thangappadhakkam kidaikkaamal ponaamalum aasiya vilaiyaattuppottigalil thodarndhu 3vadhu muraiyaaga padhakkam vendra perumaiyai roshivinaa thevi petrullaar. Manippoor maanilam pishnuvoor maavadathai serndha roshivinaa thevi 2023l naattin uyariya arjoonaa virudhai vilaiyaattil palveru saadhanaigalai nigazhthi petraar enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Murshidhaavaath kalavaram: si.e.e poraatta pugaippadangalaip payanbaduthiya merku vanga BJP | BJP WB Uses CAA Protest Photos with false claims in Murshidabad Riots
text:
Murshidhaavaath kalavaram: si.e.e poraatta pugaippadangalaip payanbaduthiya merku vanga BJP
onbadhu pugaippadangalil ettu pugaippadangal 2019aam aandu si.e.e edhirppup poraattangalilirundhu edukkappattavai endru poom kandarindhulladhu.
Merku vanga paaradhiya janadhaa katchiyin adhigaarappoorva X kanakkil, ammaanilathil nadaiverum indhu pandigaigalilbodhu vaguppuvaadha kalavarangalaik kaattuvadhaaga sila pugaippadangal pagirappattana. Aanaal, idhu vaguppuvaadha kalavarangalukku thodarbillaadha ettu pazhaiya pugaippadangalai oru padathoguppaaga pagirappattulladhu.
Indha maadha thodakkathil, merku vanga maanilathil murshidhaavaathil nadandha vaguppuvaadha vanmuraiyil moondru per uyirizhandhanar. Melum palar kaayamadaindhanar. Oodagacheythiyinbadi, maanila kaavaldhuraiyinar indha amaidhiyinmaikkaaga kuraindhadhu 200 perai kaidhu seythullanar. Ippagudhiyil innum padhattamaana soozhnilai irundhaalum, merku vanga mudhalvar mamdhaa paanarji thalaimaiyilaana agila Indhiya thirinaamul Congress arasum paajagavum, maanilathin thodar vanmuraikku kaaranam ena oruvarai oruvar kutranjjaattikkondu irukkindranar.
Indhu pandigaigalin podhu islaamiyargal vaguppuvaadha kalavarangalai erpaduthiyadhaagak kaattum nokkil,merku vanga paajaga-vin adhigaarappoorva kanakku oru vaguppuvaadha padhivaip pagirndhulladhai poom kandarindhulladhu. Onbadhu padangal konda indhap padhivil, vaaganangal eridhal, kal veechu matrum vanmurai aagiyavai kaattappattulladhu.
Idhu vaguppuvaadhathaith thoondum padhivu endra sattappoorvamaana manuvukku padhilalikkum vidhamaaga, X samoogavalaidhalam @BJP4Bengal endra kanakkai , India-vil niruthi vaikkappattulladhu.
Aangila kootril, "pandigai enbadhellaam paarppadhillai - porutkalai erikka avargalukku oru kaaranam thevai," endru kurippidappattulladhu.
Padhivaip paarkka inge matrum kaappagappaduthappatta padhivaip paarkka inge kilik seyyavum.
Adhe padathoguppu, adhe thavaraana kootrudan Facebook-il vairalaagiyulladhu.

headline: Arasu oozhiyargalukku naalaiye indha maadha sambalam vazhangappadum; Thamizhaga arasu
text:
Chennai: vangigal velainirutham kaaranamaaga, arasu oozhiyargalukku mungoottiye indha maadha sambalam vazhangappadum endru Thamizhaga arasu arivithulladhu.
5 naal velai nadaimurai ulbada palveru korikkaigalai valiyuruthi anaithu vangi oozhiyar sangangal koottamaippu saarbil varum 28m thedhi mudhal 30m thedhi varai vangi adhigaarigal matrum oozhiyargal velainiruthathai arivithullanar. Melum, 26 matrum 27m thedhigal sani matrum njaayitrukkizhamai varuvadhaal, thodarndhu 5 naatkal vangis sevaigal paadhikkappadum nilai uruvaagiyulladhu.
Indha nilaiyil, vangigal velainirutham kaaranamaaga, arasu oozhiyargal paadhikkappadaamal irukka mungoottiye indha maadha sambalam vazhangappadum endru Thamizhaga arasu arivithulladhu. Adhaavadhu, naalai (sep.,25) arasu oozhiyargalukku sambalam vazhanguvadhaaga Thamizhaga arasu arasaanai veliyittulladhu.
Erkanave, mathiya arasu oozhiyargal matrum penshandhaarargalukkaana thogaiyai naalai viduvikkakkori mathiya nidhiyamaichagam utharavai pirappithulladhu.

headline: Sep.28l mudhalvar Madurai varugaiyaa
text:
Usilambatti: sep. 19- -: Thamizhaga arasin thaaymaaman thanga modhira thittathai sep. 28l mudhalvar vavijay thuvakki vaikkiraar. Annigazhchi usilambattiyil nadakkalaam ena thagaval paravugiradhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga Collector nishaanth kirushnaa, arasin thesiya sugaadhaara iyakkath thitta iyakkunar aneeshsegar aagiyor usilambatti arasu maavatta thalaimai maruthuvamanaiyil aayvu merkondanar.
Netru ti.ai.ji., avinavgumaar, es.pi., thevanaadhan matrum Police maruthuvamanaiyil paarvaiyittavin, vizhaa nadatha idam thervu seyyum vagaiyil arasu melnilaippalli maidhaanam, pasumbon muthuraamalingath thevar kalloori maidhaanam pagudhigalil aayvu seythanar.

headline: Indhiyargalukku edhiraaga inaveri vilambaram; Trump arasu seyalaal sarchai
text:
Vaashingdan: America-vil adhivar tonaaldu Trump nirvaagam, sattavirodha pulambeyarndhavargalukku edhiraaga veliyittulla vilambaram ondru kadum sarchaiyaiyum, inaveri kutrachaattugalaiyum erpaduthiyulladhu.
America-vil adhivar Trump padhaviyetradhil irundhu, kudiyetra vidhigalai kadumaiyaakki, sattavirodha kudiyerigalai veliyetrum nadavadikkaiyai theevirappaduthi varugiraar. Innilaiyil, America ulnaattu paadhugaapputhurai, sattavirodhamaaga kudiyiruppavargalukku edhiraaga, piravala haalivut padamaana 'tiraansbaarmars' thiraippada paaniyil vilambaram ondrai uruvaakkiyulladhu.
Adhil, padathin mukkiya kadhaavaathiramaana aapdimas piraim endra iyandhira manidhan, America sinnathudan ulladhu. Thaadi vaithu indhiyar pondra thotrathaiyudaiya oruvarai adhu edhirgolvadhu pol sitharikkappattulladhu.
Melum, 'America amerikkargalukke; engal saalaigalil varaamal vilagi nillungal; ungalukku vandi ottak kooda theriyaadhu mistar sing' endra vaasagamum adhil idambetrulladhu.
America-vil migap periya tirakkugalai iyakkum tiraivargalil, indhiyaavais serndha seekkiyargale perumbaanmaiyinaraaga ullanar. Avargalai veliyetruvadhil Trump nirvaagam theeviramaaga eeduvattulladhu.
Innilaiyil, seekkiya samoogathinar matrum indhiyargalukku edhiraaga inaveriyai thoondum vagaiyil, indha vilambaram ulladhaaga kadum sarchai ezhundhulladhu. Idharku America-vil ulla Indhiya, hindhu matrum seekkiya amaippugal edhirppu therivithullana.

headline: Roo.1 kodi kadan tharuvadhaaga mosadi 5 per kaidhu
text:
Tirunelveli: roo.1 kodi kadan petruth tharuvadhaagakkoori, panam iruppadhu pol kattukkattaaga roo.500 nottugalai adukki vaithu mosadi muyatsiyil eeduvatta 5 perai Police kaidhu seythu, roo.3.68 latchathai parimudhal seythanar.
Sennaiyais serndha jeyachandhiran 47, roo.1 kodi kadan thevai ena sennaiyais serndha mugammadhu akdhar, 26, enbavarai anuginaar. Avar roo.1 latcham kamishan petrukkondu kadan petruth tharuvadhaaga koori, Tirunelveli maavattam agasdhiyarbattiyil vasikkum vengadesh, 29, veettirku azhaithus sendraar.
Therku paappaangulam vengadesh, riyal estet, vattikku panam kodukkum thozhil seythu varuvadhaagavum, kodikkanakkil kadan vazhanguvadhaagavum koori thozhil nadathi vandhaar.
Vengadesh aluvalagathil panam iruppadhu pol kattukkattaaga kaanbithu, jeyachandhiranidam kadan pathiram, 7 vangi kaasolaigalil kaiyezhuthu petranar. Latchakkanakkil kamishan thogai petravargal, kadan thogaiyai vazhangaamal izhuthadithanar.
Jeyachandhiran Chennai ti.ji.pi., aluvalagathil pugaar alithaar. Tirunelveli ti.ai.ji., thirunaavukkarasu, es.pi., vishvesh paalasuppiramaniya saasdhiri utharavinbadi thanippadai Police vengadesh veettil sodhanai nadathinar. Aluvalaga maadiyil kattukkattaaga panam iruppadhu pola roo.500 nottugal adangiya kattugalil melburathil mattum unmaiyaana roo.500 thaalgal irundhana. Adhan keezh vellaithaalgal iruppadhu sodhanaiyil theriyavandhadhu. Idhudhavira maadhiri nottugalum irundhana. Ivvaaru roo.3.68 latcham parimudhal seyyappattadhu.
Vikkiramasingavuram vengadesh, koottaaligalaana raajesh 30, sivasuppiramaniyan 35, kadhirvel paandi 27, mugammadhu akdhar aagiya 5 perai kaidhu seythanar.
Vengadesh meedhu erkanave idhuvondra kutrachaattugal ullana. Avar veru yaaraiyum idhevol emaatriyullaaraa ena Police visaaranai nadathi varugindranar.

headline: Velimaanila vaakkaalargal patri es.pi. Velumani karuthu koorinaaraa?
text:

headline: Marusuzhatsi javulikkaana kolmudhal ookkuvikka mathiya kuzhu oppandham
text:
Tiruppur: arasu i - -maarkket (jem) thalamum mathiya javulithurai amaichagathin adhigaarappoorva amaippaana javuli kuzhuvum inaindhu, marusuzhatsi seyyappatta matrum membaduthappatta javuligalin kolmudhalai ookkuvikkum vagaiyil pudhiya oppandham seythullana.
Javuli kazhivu, kazhivu porutkal matrum payanbaduthappatta aadaigalil irundhu thayaarikkappadum marusuzhatsi matrum madhippu koottappatta porutkalin urpathiyai ookkuvikka arasu nadavadikkai eduthu varugiradhu. Idharkaaga paadhugaappaana sandhaippaduthudhal soozhalum uruvaakkappattulladhu.
Idhugurithu, marusuzhatsi javuli koottamaippu thalaivar jeyavaal kooriyadhaavadhu:
tharpodhu seyyappattulla pudhiya oppandham, marusuzhatsi javuli urpathi matrum kolmudhalai membadutha udhavum. Marusuzhatsi javuli porutkalai etrumadhi seyya velinaadugalil tharachaandrugal avasiyamaaga ullana.
Idharkaaga orunginaindha tharachaandru perum nadaimuraiyai elidhaakkuvadhudan, adharkaana selavugalukku maaniyam vazhangavum nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.
Palangal em.es.em.i., matrum ulloor thozhil niruvanangalin vasadhikkaaga, maadhiri virpanai maiyam amaikkappadum pengal thalaimaiyilaana thozhil, vaniga niruvanangalai ookkuvikka sirappu kavanam seluthappadum.

headline: “aatchi amaikkiradhu adhimuga” endru sienen veliyittadhaaga paravum karuthukkanippu poliyaa?
text:
Thamizhagathil ADMK 130 mudhal 140 thogudhigalai vellum endru sienen oodagam kooriyadhaaga poliyaana seythiyai ADMK parappiyadhaaga oru padhivu

“a.thi.mu.ka parappiya poy seythi!” endru kurippittu kalainjar seythigal news card veliyittulladhu. Melum adhil, “thamizhnaattil 130-140 thogudhi varai ADMK vendru aatchiyaik kaippatrum endru CNN seythi niruvanam karuthukkanippu velittulladhaaga paravum seythi poliyaanadhu. Paravi varum andha seythi Gemini AI moolam uruvaakkappattadhu. Idhu pondra endha oru karuthuk kanippaiyum CNN News 18 oodagam veliyidavillai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sienen karuthukkanippu edhaiyum veliyidavillai endru fekt sek niruvanam ondru veliyittirundha seythi adippadaiyil kalainjar seythigal news card veliyittulladhu. Therdhal nerangalil oodagangal karuthuk kanippai veliyidum. Aanaal, endha oru karuthuk kanippaiyum andha kurippitta niruvanam veliyidavillai endru kurippittirundhadhu sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu. Enave, idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Sienen news 18 YouTube pakkathil idhu thodarbaaga thedip paarthom. Appodhu epral 6, 2026 andru karuthuk kanippu ondrai andha seythi niruvanam veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Video-vin 3.48vadhu nimidathil thi.mu.ka-vukku 90 mudhal 100m adhimuga-vukku 130 mudhal 140 thogudhigal varaiyilum kidaikkalaam endru karuthuk kanippu veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Thodarndhu andha video-vin 4.10vadhu nimidathil veru oru niruvanam edutha karuthuk kanippil thi.mu.ka-vukku 44 sadhavigidha vaakkugaludan 159 mudhal 165 thogudhigal varai kidaikkum endrum kurippittirundhanar. Melum adhimuga-vukku 64 mudhal 70 thogudhigal varai kidaikkalaam endrum kurippittirundhanar.
Thodarndha thediya podhu news 18 aangilathil seythi veliyaagi irundhadhaiyum kandarindhom. Adhil si-ottar niruvanam nadathiya karuthuk kanippu padi thi.mu.ka-vukku 41 sadhavigidha vaakkugal kidaikkum endrum, ottar vaip moolam sienen – news 18n niruvanam nadathiya vot tiraakkar oppeeniyan pol padi, adhimuga-vukku 130 mudhal 140 thogudhigal varai kidaikkum endrum kurippittirundhanar. Idhan moolam sienen news 18 karuthuk kanippai nadathavillai endru veliyaana thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Indhiyaavukkul nuzhaindha China raanuvam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Indhiyaavukkul 60 km tholaivukku nuzhaindhu nilapparappai China raanuvam kaippatriyadhaaga oru video

pachai nira kodiyudan raanuva veerargal anivaguthus sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “seena raanuvam idhuvaraikkum arunaachala piradhesathil 60 kilo meter kaippatriyulladhaaga seythigal therivikkindrana India udanadiyaaga aakshanil iranga vendum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiyaavukkum – seenaavukkum ellaip pirasnai needithu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil China raanuvam indhiyaavukkul 60 km thoorathukku nuzhaindhu Indhiya pagudhiyai kaippatrivittadhaaga samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idharku aadhaaramaaga China raanuvam indhiyaavukkul nuzhaindhuvittadhaaga video-vai pagirndhu varugindranar.
Indhiyaavukkul nuzhaindhuvittadhaaga China raanuvam arivikka vendum alladhu izhandhuvittadhaaga Indhiya raanuvam arivikka vendum. Appadi nuzhaindhirundhaal andha video-vai China raanuvathaal mattume veliyida mudiyum. Enave, indha video thavaraanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video-vin kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indhiyaavukkul China ooduruval endru palarum indha video-vai padhivittirundhanar. Thodarndhu thediya podhu thaay mozhiyil indha video-vai palarum padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil siyaamis raanuvam migap periya padaiyudan varugai thandhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Siyaam enbadhu thaaylaandhin pazhaiya peyar.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu indha video-vai thaaylaandhin raanuvam thodarbaana Facebook pakkam ondru joon 16, 2026 andru padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Andha video-vil iruppadhu pondru pachai nira kodiyudan raanuva veerargal anivaguthus sellum veru pala veediyokkalum adhil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam thaaylaandhu raanuva anivaguppu video-vai eduthu indhiyaavukkul nuzhaindha China raanuvam endru thavaraaga veliyittiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indhiyaavukkul China raanuvam nuzhaindhadhu endru paravum thagaval thodarbaaga Indhiya arasu vilakkam alithulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu Indhiya arasin piaivi fekt sek amaippu indha thagaval thavaraanadhu verum vadhandhi endru kurippittu veliyittirundha padhivu kidaithadhu. Idhan moolam indha thagaval matrum video irandume thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Iran en jordaanai kurivaikkiradhu? Pinnani enna?
text:
Amerikkaa–eeraan idaiyilaana modhal theeviramadaindhu varum nilaiyil, jordaanil ulla America raanuvath thalathai nokki Iran paalistik evuganaith thaakkudhalai nadathiyulladhu. Jordaan raanuvam veliyitta thagavalinbadi, kadandha 8aam thedhi iravu mudhal 9aam thedhi kaalai varai motham 20 evuganaigal evappatta nilaiyil, avatril 18 evuganaigal idaimarithu azhikkappattana. Meedhamirundha irandu evuganaigal makkal nadamaattam illaadha thirandhavelip pagudhigalil vizhundhadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Indhath thaakkudhalil uyirizhappugal edhuvum erpadavillai.
Jordaanin Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, podhuvaaga Al-Azraq Air Base endru azhaikkappadum vimaanappadaith thalame Iran-in thaakkudhalukku ilakkaagiyulladhu. America matrum Iran modhalil ithalam thodarndhu kurivaikkappattu varugiradhu. Idhuvaraiyil tharpodhaiya nilavarappadi al-asraak meedhu Iran 10 murai thaakkudhalgalai nadathiyulladhu. Iran en adhaith thaakkuvadhai ilakkaagak kondulladhu enbadhu kurithu inge paarkkalaam.
Al-Azraq Air Base thalathil America raanuvap padaigal matrum vimaanangal seyalbattu varugindrana. Iran-in Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), al-asraak thalathil irundha F-35, F-16 matrum F-15 por vimaanangalukkaana paraamarippu, thayaarippu matrum nilainiruthum pagudhigalaiyum, vimaanangalaip paadhugaakkum hengargalaiyum kurivaithadhaaga therivithulladhu.
Eninum, indhath thaakkudhalil America raanuvas sothugalukku erpatta sedham kurithu America urudhiyaana thagavalai veliyidavillai. America adhigaari oruvar, orunginaindha vaan matrum evuganaith thaduppu amaippugalaal Iran-in thaakkudhalgalai thaduthu niruthiyadhaaga therivithullaar.
Al-asraak vimaanappadaith thalam irandu neenda oduvaadhaigalaik konda migapperiya raanuvath thalamaagum. Amerikkaavaip poruthavarai, idhu mukkiyamaana thalavaada matrum vimaana nadavadikkai maiyamaaga karudhappadugiradhu.
Amerikkaa–jordaan idaiyilaana 2021 paadhugaappu oppandhathinbadi, jordaanil ulla 12 raanuvath thalangalai amerikkap padaigalum oppandhap paniyaalargalum payanbadutha anumadhi vazhangappattulladhu.
America-vin C-17 pokkuvarathu vimaanangal matrum sumaar 60 por vimaanangalukkaana mukkiya thalavaada maiyamaaga al-asraak maariyadhaaga paadhugaappu nivunargal therivithullanar. Melum, siriyaa matrum Iraq pagudhigalil ulavu, kangaanippu matrum ilakku adaiyaalam kaanum nadavadikkaigalukkum jordaanin vimaanappadaith thalangal mukkiyathuvam vaayndhavai.
Idhanaal, eeraanilirundhu adhiga tholaivil irundhavadiye America thanadhu vimaana matrum raanuva nadavadikkaigalai merkollakkoodiya mukkiyamaana thalamaaga jordaan vilangugiradhu. Valaigudaa naadugalaik kaattilum jordaan eeraanilirundhu tholaivil iruppadhaal, eeraaniya evuganaigal matrum trongalukku edhiraana oru mukkiyamaana paadhugaappu idamaagavum paarkkappadugiradhu.
Idhan kaaranamaagave, America-vin piraandhiya raanuva nadavadikkaigalil mukkiyap pangu vagikkum al-asraak thalam, tharpodhu Iran-in thaakkudhalgalukku mukkiya ilakkaaga maariyulladhu. Melum oman valaigudaa matrum kaark theevu aruge amerikkap padaigal Iran-in 5 enney taangar kappalgalais suttu moozhgadithana. Idharkup padhiladiyaaga, indha murai amerikkaavaith thandikkum nokkil Iran ithalathin meedhu evuganaith thaakkudhalai nadathiyulladhu.
America-vin vaanvazhi valimaiyai mudakkudhal:
ithalathil niruthappattulla America-vin adhinaveena por vimaanangalin thangumidangal, paraamarippu maiyangal matrum ulgattamaippugalai azhippadhan moolam America-vin por uthiyais sidhaikka Iran muyatsikkiradhu. Mathiya kizhakku modhalgalil Iran evum evuganaigalai Israel matrum America thalangalai adaiyavidaamal jordaan thanadhu vaan paadhugaappu amaippugal moolam suttu veezhthi varugiradhu. Idhanaal jordaanil ulla amerikkath thalangalai Iran thanadhu neradi ilakkaaga maatriyulladhu.

headline: Kaaval thuraiyinarai thaakkiya karappaan poochi janadhaa katchiyinar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kaaval thuraiyinar meedhu karappaan poochigal thaakkudhal nadathiya kaatchi endru oru video

thaduppugaludan irukkum kaaval thuraiyinar meedhu ilainjargal silar thaakkudhal nadatha muyalum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indhiya kaaval padai meedhu karappaan poochigal thaakkudhal nadathiya kaatchigal….
Mathiya arasu kadum nadavadikkai eduthu ivargalai odukka vendum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Telliyil poraattam nadathiya kaakros janadhaa katchiyinar poleesaarai thaakkiyadhaaga video ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vai muzhumaiyaagap paartha podhu, andha ilainjargal indhiyargal pola illai. Melum kaavalargal vaithirundha thaduppin meedhu Polisi endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indhiyak kaaval thuraiyil Police endre ezhudhappattirukkum. Enave, idhu veru naattais saarndha video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video 2025m aandu aagast maadhame samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil indha sambavam indhoneshiyaavil nadandhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Kaakros janadhaa paartti poraattam 2026l nadandhadhu. Adharku munbaagave video veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idharkum India-vil nadandha kaakros janadhaa paartti poraattathukkum thodarbillai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indha sambavam thodarbaaga thodarndhu thediya podhu, 2025m aandu aagast maadham indhoneshiyaavil maanavargal nadathiya poraattathin podhu Police nadathiya thaakkudhalil 21 vayadhu ilainjar uyirizhandhaar. Adhaith thodarndhu maanavargal poraattam vedithadhu. Kaaval thuraiyinar meedhu maanavargal thaakkudhal nadathinar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indhoneshiyaa poleesil Polisi endru kurippidappadumaa endru ariya aayvaith thodarndhom. Polisi endru avargal thaduppugal vaithirukkum pala pugaippadangal namakku kidaithana. Idhanudan poraattam nadandha idathin koogul street viyoo kaatchiyaiyum thedi eduthom. Ivai ellaam indha video India-vil kaaval thuraiyinar meedhu karappaan poochi janadhaa katchi aadharavaalargal thaakkudhal nadathiya podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seythana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mosaat kattidam thaakkappattadhu endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Isrelin ulavu amaippaana mosaat-n thalaimai aluvalagam thaakkappattadhu pondru oru pugaippadam

kattidam ondru vedigundu thaakkudhalil sedhamadaindhirukkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Kattidathin meedhu mosaat (Mosad) endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ulagin nambar on ulavu amaippaana, sangigal kondaadiya “mosaat” thalaimaiyagam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran meedhu Israel thaakkudhal nadathiyadharkup padhiladiyaaga Israel meedhu Iran evuganaith thaakkudhalai nadathiyadhu. Idhil isrelin raanuva thalaimaiyagam, vimaanappadaith thalangal ullitta idangal meedhu Iran evuganaith thaakkudhalai nadathiyadhu. Idhil Israel raanuva kattidam sedhamadaindhadhu endru koorappadugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil isrelin mosaat aluvalagam thaakkappattadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil pugaippadangalaip pagirndhu varugindranar.
Mosaat enbadhai aangilathil MOSSAD endru ezhudhuvaargal. Aanaal naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathil oru es illaamal Mosad endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Enave, indha pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhaaga irukkaadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom. Mudhalil Mosad alladhu Mossad edhu sari enbadhai urudhi seythugolla adhan inaiyadhalathaip paarthom. Adhil Mossad endre irundhadhu. Avvalavu periya ulavu amaippu ezhuthuppizhaiyudan ezhudhiyirukka vaayppillai enbadhaal indha pugaippadam thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Mosaat thalaimai aluvalagam thagarkkappattadhaaga seythi edhum ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal, namakku appadi endha seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Sila maadhangalukku munbu levanaanin hisbullaa amaippu mosaat meedhu thaakkudhal nadatha muyatsi seytha seythi mattume kidaithadhu.
Mosaat thalaimai aluvalaga kattidathin pugaippadathudan naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam othuppogiradhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Mosaat aluvalagathin pugaippadam namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Migavum paadhugaappaaga andha pagudhi iruppadhaal mosaat aluvalaga pugaippadam kooda seythi oodagangalil veliyaagavillai. Adhan koogul mep pugaippadathai mattume vaithu oodagangal seythi veliyittu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Silar samooga oodagangalil ragasiyamaaga edukkappattadhu endru mosaat thalaimai aluvalagathin pugaippadangalai pagirndhirundhanar. Koogul mep pugaippadathudan avai othuppoyina. Aanaal, andha pugaippadathirkum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathirkum thodarbillai. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: TVK aatchiyil sirappu pasgal iyakkappadaamal makkal avadhi endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
TVK aatchi amaindhulla nilaiyil sirappu perundhugal iyakkappadaamal podhu makkal avadhiyutradhaaga, mudhalvar vavijaykku edhiraaga pen oruvar aathirathil pesiyadhaaga oru video

kumudham idhazh oodagam veliyitta video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “sirappu perundhu enga..? Aathirathil pesiya pen” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha video-vil thiruvannaamalaikku vandha pen sirappu perundhugal iyakkappadavillai endru kovamaaga pesiya kaatchigal irundhana. Nilaith thagavalil, “sirappu perundhu enga !!! Actor Vijay” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu mudhalvaraaga vavijay poruppetrulla nilaiyil, sirappup perundhugal iyakkappadaamal makkal avadhiyuruvadhaaga video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aatchiyin aarambathileye ippadi oru nilai endru samooga oodagangalil palarum indha video-vai padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, indha video vavijay mudhalvaraaga poruppetra pinnar alladhu avaradhu katchi thanipperum katchiyaaga vetri petra piragu edukkappattadhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Idhai kumudham oodagam veliyittirundhadhaal adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalukkus sendru paarthom. Vavijay mudhalvaraagap poruppetra me 10m thedhikkup piragu indha video-vai kumudham veliyidavillai enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Enave, satru pinnokkith thedip paarthom. Appodhu me 2m thedhi indha video-vai kumudham veliyittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhalil padhivaana vaakkugal ennappaduvadharku irandu naatkalukku munbaagave indha video veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idharkum TVK arasukkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
DMK kaavandhu arasaagath thodarndha kaalathil nadandha sambavathin video-vai TVK aatchi amaindha soozhalil makkal paadhippu enbadhu polath thavaraagap padhivittiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thoothukudiyil kappal kattum thalam: urudhi seythadhu es.ti. Hoondaay
text:
Chennai: Thoothukudi maavattathil kappal kattum thalam amaippadhai Thamizhaga amaichar keerthanaa thalaimaiyilaana kuzhuvidam nadathiya pechil, es.ti.hoondaay niruvanam urudhi seythulladhu. Virivaana thozhilnutba thitta arikkai thayaarikkum nilaikku ithittam munneriyulladhu.
Thoothukudi maavattathil va.u.si., thuraimugam arugil, 18,000 kodi roobai mudhaleettil kappal kattum thalam amaikka Thamizhaga arasudan, then koriyaa naattai serndha hes.ti.hoondaay niruvanam, 2025l purindhunarvu oppandham seythadhu. Anniruvanathin es.ti., ke.es.o.i., kappal kattumaanam matrum kadalsaar thuraiyil eeduvattu varugiradhu. Inniruvanam, Thoothukudiyil kappal kattum thalam amaikka ulladhu.
Thamizhagathil, indhaandu epralil nadandha sattasavai therdhalil aatchi maatram erpatta nilaiyil, an niruvanathin mudhaleettai eerkkum muyatsiyil aandhira arasu eeduvattadhu. Es.ti., hoondaayin mudhaleettai thakka vaikka Thamizhaga adhigaarigal thodarndhu pechu nadathinar.
Es.ti., ke.es.o.i.,niruvanathin sanjun haang thalaimaiyi laana mootha kuzhu, kadandha 1m thedhi mudhal, oru vaaram Thoothukudiyil mugaamittu idangalai paarvaiyittu aayvu seythadhu.
Akkuzhu, Chennai thalaimai seyalagathil thozhil thurai amaichar keerthanaa, seyalar vijayagumaar ullittorudan netru mundhinam pechu nadathi yadhu. Appodhu, Thamizhagathil thittathai munneduthu selvadhaaga, urudhi alikkappattulladhu.

headline: Thaniyaar palligalidam mosadi seythadhaaga vazhakku.. Anbil magesidam 8 manineram visaaranai!
text:
Thaniyaar palligalil 100 kodi roobai mosadi seythadhaaga koorappadum vazhakkil, munnaal pallikkalvith thurai amaichar anbil mages Chennai mathiya kutrappirivu aluvalagathil neril aajaraanaar. Avaridam 7-8 manineram kaavaldhuraiyinar visaaranai nadathinar.
Thaniyaar palligalidam 100 kodi roobai mosadi seythadhaaga thodarappatta vazhakku visaaranaikkaaga, munnaal amaichar anbil mages neril aajaraanaar. Pallikkalvith thurai munnaal amaichar anbil magesukku thodarbudaiya idangalil kadandha 16aam thedhi mathiya kutrappirivu poleesaar sodhanai merkondanar. Appodhu, 118 aavanangal matrum digital aavanangal parimudhal seyyappattadhaaga therivikkappattirundhadhu. Adhandhodarchiyaaga anbil magesukku samman anuppappattirundha nilaiyil, Chennai mathiya kutrappirivu aluvalagathil avar visaaranaikku aajaraanaar.
Visaaranaikku aajaraana anbil mages idam Chennai kaavaldhuraiyinar 7 manineram visaaranai nadathinar. Visaaranaikku piragu seythiyaalargalidam pesiya anbil mages, “kaaval thurai samman anuppiyadhan peril visaaranaikku aajaraanen. Ennidam 8 mani neram visaaranai nadaivetradhu. Kaaval thuraiyinar ennidam ezhuppiya 295 kelvigalil 246 kelvigalukku padhil alithen. 246 kelvigalukkum porumaiyaaga padhilalithen. Adhanai muzhumaiyaaga Print Out eduthu koduthu padithup paarkka sonnaargal, padikkumbodhum sila idathil Spelling mistake irundhadhai suttikkaattinen. Idhanai thiruthikkondu ennidam kaiyoppam petrukkondanar. Adutha vaaram azhaikkumbodhu padhilalikka kaathirukkiren” ena koorinaar.

headline: Sattapperavaiyil pagavath keedhai patri pesiya podhu kurukkeedu seytha savaanaayagar endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Sattapperavaiyil paa.ma.ka-vin saumiyaa anbumani pagavath keedhai patri pesiyadhaagavum adhai savaanaayagar thaduthu niruthiyadhaagavum oru padhivu

sattapperavaiyil PMK em.el.e saumiyaa anbumani pesum video-vin siru pagudhi Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Avar, “avar perusaa eduthukkittadhum illai. Avaraip poruthavaraikkum keedhaiyila sonna maadhiri kadamaiyai sey palanai edhirbaarkkaadhe endra oru vishayathildhaan avar payanichittu irukkaaru. Ippadippatta” endru pesum podhu savaanaayagar mani adikkiraar. Adharku saumiyaa anbumani, “ellorukkum avargal katchith thalaivaraip patri” endru pechaith thodargiraar. Adharku savaanaayagar “ungalukku kurukkeedu illaamal 20 nimidangalukku pesa azhaithirukkiren” engiraar. Adharku saumiyaa anbumani nandri thalaivare engiraar.
Nilaith thagavalil, “sattasavaiyil mudhal muraiyaaga pagavath keedhai patri pesiya akkaa thirumadhi saumiyaa anbumani avargal 🔥🔥🔥 unmaiyil mariyavilsan paivil padithavan anbu mozhi amaidhi mozhi irakkathin mozhi endru pesum podhu kooda savaanaayagar idai nirutham seyyavillai… akkaa thirumadhi saumiyaa anbumani avargal pagavath keedhai patri pesiya podhu kurukkeedu…
en savaanaayagaraaga padhaviyetra podhu kooda savaanaayagar thiru jesidi piravaagar avargal paivil varigalai merkol kaatti pesinaar… avar pesinaal kurippaaga kirithava jeva paadal endraal oge… aanaal indhu samayam saarndha vishayangal endraal kurukkeedu… idhu enna maadhiri mananilai savaanaayagar endraal nadunilaiyaaga thaane irukka vendum enbadhu maravu… aanaal akkaa thirumadhi saumiyaa anbumani avargalai unmaiyil manam niraindhu vaazhthugiren…❤️
pagavath keedhai sattasavaiyil pesave oru Guts vendum 💥💥💥 avaradhu tharpodhaiya seyalbaadugal kooda arumaiyaaga ulladhu 👌👌👌neengal kalakkunga akkaa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga sattapperavaiyil pagavathgeedhai patri PMK em.el.e saumiyaa anbumani pesiyadhaagavum udane savaanaayagar kurukkeedu seythadhaagavum oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirndhu varugindranar. Keedhai patri pesiyadhaal savaanaayagar padharivittaar endrum, keedhai endraal en kasakkiradhu endrellaam kurippittu palarum indha video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video muzhumaiyaaga illai. Adhilum kooda avaraip poruthavarai keedhaiyil sonnadhu pol kadamaiyai sey palanai edhirbaarkkaadhe enbadhan adippadaiyil payanikkiraar endru saumiyaa anbumani kooruvadhai ketka mudigiradhu. Thanadhu kanavarum PMK thalaivarumaana anbumaniyaip patri avar pesiyirukkalaam endra sandhegam ezhugiradhu. Pagavathgeedhaiyai patri pesiyadhu pola theriyavillai. Pagavathgeedhaiyin oru variyai merkol kaatti pesuvadhu polave ulladhu. Enave, andha video-vai thedinom.
Andha video-vil pudhiya thalaimurai logo irundhadhaal, andha oodagathin YouTube pakkathil andha video-vai thedi eduthom. Andha video-vin 17vadhu nimidathirku piragu andha pagudhi varugiradhu. Anbumani mathiya sugaadhaarath thurai amaicharaaga irundha podhu seytha saadhanaigalai saumiyaa anbumani kurippittu pesugiraar. Sarvadhesa alavil America adhivar, ingilaandhu piradhamar, Japan piradhamar, ainaa thalaivar ullittor vaangiya virudhugalai ellaam anbumani vaangiyullaar. Avaradhu saadhanaigalai sarvadhesa alavil paaraattaip petrana. Aanaal, ingu yaarum avaradhu sarveesai kandugollavillai” endru thannudaiya kanavaraip patri pesivittu, keedhai variyai merkolgaattip pesuvadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Pudhiya thalaimurai video mattumindri, Tamil Nadu sattapperavai neradi olivarappu veediyovaiyum thedi eduthu paarthom. Adhil 1 mani neram 37vadhu nimidathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pagudhi vandhadhu. Thannudaiya kanavar patri avar niraiya pesivitta nilaiyil, avaradhu pechai niruthikkollumbadi savaanaayagar koorinaar. 20 nimidangal kurukkeedu illaamal pesa anumadhi alithullen. Enave, nandri solli mudithuvidungal endrudhaan koorinaar. Adharku saumiyaa anbumaniyum “nandri solli mudithuvidugiren. Ellorukkum avargal thalaivargalaip patri naalu nalla vaarthaigal solla” endru thodargiraar. Adharku savaanaayagar “niraiya solliyirukkeenga” engiraar. Adhaith thodarndhu melum oru vishayathaip patri pesivittu nandri koori thannudaiya uraiyai saumiyaa anbumani mudikkiraar.
Video-vai muzhumaiyaaga paarkkum podhu saumiyaa anbumani thannudaiya kanavarum PMK thalaivarumaana anbumani raamadhaas patri mattume pesiyadhai ariya mudigiradhu. Pagavathgeedhaiyin oru variyai merkolgaatti, adhuvum thannudaiya kanavar eppadi seyalbadugiraar enbadharkaaga merkolgaatti pesiyadhai eduthu, 20 nimidangal avar thadaiyindri pesiyarkaaga avaradhu pechai mudikkumbadi savaanaayagar kooriyadhai maatri, pagavathgeedhaiyai patri pesum podhu savaanaayagar thaduthadhaaga thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Kaanaamal pogum mudhiyor adhigarippu: kavanamaaga irukkanum veettaar
text:
Kovai: vayadhu mudhirvu, mananala paadhippu, kudumba pirasnai, kaadhal vivagaaram ullitta pala kaaranangalaal veettai vittu veliyerum navargal kaanaamal pogum sambavangal, Kovai maanagaril thodargindrana. Kaanaamal ponavargal pattiyalil adhigam iruppadhu mudhiyor ena Police tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.
Maanagara Police ellaikkutbatta pagudhigalil, ettu maadhangalil kaanaamal ponadhaaga 413 per kurithu pugaargal padhivaagiyullana. Idhil, 129 aangal, 177 pengal, 25 siruvargal, 82 sirumigal.
Kaanaamal ponavargalai kanduvidikka thanippadaigal amaikkappadugindrana. Police thedi idhuvarai 78 aangal, 128 pengal, 20 siruvargal, 71 sirumigal ena motham 297 per meetkappattu, uravinargalidam oppadaikkappattullanar.
Kaanaamal povadharku ovvoruvarukkum vevveru kaaranangal ullana. Kudumba pirasnai, mana ulaichal, kaadhal vivagaaram ullitta kaaranangaludan, vayadhu mudhirvu kaaranamaaga erpadum maradhiyum mukkiya kaaranamaaga ulladhu.
Kurippaaga, sila mudhiyor veettai vittu veliye sendra piragu, thaangal engu selgirom, endha pagudhiyil vasikkirom, veettukkuth thirumbum vazhi edhu enbadhaiye marandhu vidugindranar.
Idhanaal, vazhi theriyaamal pala pagudhigalukku sendru thavikkum nilai erpadugiradhu. Silar vegudhooram sendra piragu meetkappadugindranar.
Adaiyaalam matrum mugavari theriyaadhadhaal, avargalai kudumbathinaridam oppadaippadhilum siramam erpaduvadhaal, veliyil sellum mudhiyor vishayathil veettaar kavanamaaga irukka vendum engindranar Police

text:

headline: Chennai-yil ulaga thiran maiyam; Thamizhaga arasudan vaalgireens oppandham
text:
Chennai-yil ulaga thiran maiyam; Thamizhaga arasudan 'vaalgireens' oppandham
Chennai: Chennai tharamaniyil, ulagalaaviya thiran maiyam amaippadharkaaga, Thamizhaga thozhil thuraiyudan 'vaalgireens' niruvanam purindhunarvu oppandham seythulladhu. Mudhalvar vavijay munnilaiyil oppandham netru thalaimai seyalagathil kaiyezhuthaanadhu.
Amerikkaavai thalaimaiyidamaaga kondu iyangum vaalgireens niruvanam, marundhaga sevaigal, sugaadhaara paraamarippu matrum nugarvor sugaadhaara porutkal thuraigalil eeduvattu varugiradhu. Inniruvanam thanadhu mudhal ulagalaaviya thiran maiyathai, Thamizhagathil amaikka mun vandhulladhu.
Thozhilnutbam matrum vaniga sevaigalai maiyamaaga kondu Chennai tharamaniyil ulla ti.el.ep., valaagathil indha maiyam amaiyavulladhu. Idhan vaayilaaga 200 perukku velaivaayppugal kidaikkum.
Purindhunarvu oppandham kaiyezhuthaana podhu, thozhildhurai amaichar keerthanaa, thalaimai seyalar saaygumaar, thozhildhurai seyalar vijayagumaar, 'vazhigaatti' niruvana melaanmai iyakkunar theevak jekkap, vaalgireens ulagalaaviya thiran maiya thalaivar umaavadhi visvanaadhan ullittor pangetranar.
Chennai-yil sarva thesa thiran maiyangal adhigarithu varugindrana. O.em.aar., tharamaniyil idharkena ti.el.ep., tavundavn kattadam ulladhu.
Chennai ti.el.ep., tavundavnil ulla mukkiya niruvanangalin ulagalaaviya thiran maiyangal sitti pengk paarkles amerikkan eksbiras ke.el.e., kaarppareshan

headline: Kaanjjivuram: kuppaik kidangaaga maariya panjjuppettai saalai; kandugollaadha maanagaraatchi
text:
Panjjuppettai makkal mattum indri, sutru vattaara makkalum vaaganangalil pogumbodhu kuppaiyai veesivittu selgindranar ena angulla makkal koorinar.
Kaanjjivuram maavattam, kaanjjivuram maanagaraatchikku utbatta panjjuppettai saalai eppodhum paravarappaaga irukkum.
Achaalaiyin aruge kuppaigal adhigam veesappattu avvidam kuppaik kidangaip pol kaatchiyalikkiradhu.
Irandu alladhu moondru varudangalukku munbu suthamaaga irundha idam tharpodhu kuppai medaagave maarivittadhu.
Avvazhiye sellum makkal eppodhum mookkai moodikkondu sendra nilaiyileye nadandhu selgindranar.
Akkuppaik kidangin arugileye kovil, sirappuk paraamarippu min nilaiyam, thunai min nilaiyam, theeyanaippu nilaiyam, sugaadhaara maiyam ullana.
Avvaluvalaga oozhiyargal, avvaluvalagathirkus sellum makkal, avvazhiye sellum oor makkal ena anaivarum kadakka mudiyaamal avvidathai mookkai moodikkondu kadandhu selgiraargal.
Karikkadaigalil meerndhu pogum kazhivugalum ingu kottappadugindrana. Panjjuppettai makkal mattum indri, sutru vattaara makkalum vaaganangalil pogumbodhu kuppaiyai veesivittu selgindranar ena angulla makkal koorinar.
Idhu mattum indri mazhaikkaalangalil mazhaineerudan akkuppaigalum saalaiyil midhandhu paravi kidakkum. Avvidathaik kadakkave kadinamaaga irukkum enavum angulla makkal kavalai therivikkindranar.
Idhaip patri angulla sugaadhaara maiyathil, ''avvidathais sutham seyya maattaargalaa?'' endru kettavodhu adharku avargal, ''maadham orumurai TPC(Municipality Workers) sugaadhaarath thooymai paniyaalargal vandhu sutham seythuvittu selvaargal. Irundhaalum maruvadiyum kuppaigal adhigam veesappattu kuppaik kidangaaga maarividum. Idhanaal kosuthollai matrum noy thotrugal vara vaayppulladhu'' ena koorinaargal.
Idhugurithu appagudhi kavunsiliridam kettavodhu, idhaith thadukka oru madhil suvar kattap povadhaagak koorinaar.
Avvidam paarppadharkus sugaadhaaraminmaiyin uchamaagap piradhivalikkiradhu. Angu veesum thurnaatramum, kuppaigalai erikkumbodhu varum pugaiyaal makkal avadhippadugindranar. Enave maavatta aatchiyar ippirasnaiyais sariseyya vendum enbadhu makkalin korikkaiyaaga ulladhu.

headline: TASMAC kadaiyai thirakka vidaamal pengal mutrugai
text:
Thiruchi:thuraiyoor aruge, TASMAC kadaiyai thirakka vidaamal, nootrukkum merpatta pengal, mutrugai poraattam nadathinar.
Trichy maavattam, narasingavurathil TASMAC madhukkadai seyalbattu varugiradhu. Indha kadai, kudiyiruppugalukku arugil ulladhaal, appagudhiyil ulla pengal, palli, kalloori maanava - maanaviyar, madhu kudipporaal kadum avadhippattu varugindranar. Sila nerangalil, kudippavargal podhaiyil, appagudhiyil ulla veettu vaasalil paduthu vidugindranar. Idhanaal, TASMAC kadai pagudhiyil ulla, 50kkum merpatta kudumbathinar thinamum avasdhaigalai sandhithu varugindranar.
Andha kadaiyai agatra palamurai korikkai viduthum, evvidha nadavadikkaiyum illai. Innilaiyil, netru madhiyam, TASMAC kadaiyai mutrugaiyitta, nootrukkum merpatta pengal, kadaiyai thirakka vidaamal poraattathil eeduvattanar. Sambava idathukku vandha Police matrum varuvaaythurai adhigaarigal pechu nadathinar. Appodhu, madhukkadaiyai agatra vendum enbadhil pidivaadhamaaga irundhadhaal, thuraiyoor thaasildhaar aluvalagathil, moondru naatkalukkul pechu nadathappadum, oru maadhathil kadaiyai agatra nadavadikkai edukkappadum ena, urudhi alithanar. Idhaiyaduthu maalai, 3:00 manikku poraattam kaividappattadhu.

headline: Anbe Sivam - 3 | maranathil ida odhukkeedu kettavar| anbe sivam | thavathiru ponnambala adigalaar!
text:
Moovendhargal parambu malaiyai mutrugaiyittu por nadathiyavodhugooda, andha iyarkai valathin kaaranamaaga angirundha makkal unavup panjjathaal paadhikkappadaamal thodarndhu veerathudan poraada mudindhadhu. Adhanaal paariyai vella mudiyaamal moovendhargal thavithanar.
Indraikkellaam ellaavatrukkum oru thinam vandhuvittadhu. Annaiyar thinam, thandhaiyar thinam, kaadhalar thinam, nanbargal thinam endru palveru thinangalaik kondaadugirom. Kaalam muzhuvadhum nilaithirukka vendiya uravaana natbaikkooda, ore naalil mudindhuvogum ondraippola oru thinamaagak kondaadugirom.
Natbu enbadhu ulagam thondriya naalileye thondriya uravu. Nanbargal illaamal yaaraalum vaazha mudiyaadhu. ‘un nanbanais sol, nee yaar endru naan solgiren’ endru sollum alavukku oruvarin kunathaiyum iyalbaiyum avaradhu nanbargalaip paarthe theermaanikkirom. Nanban nallavanaa, kettavanaa enbadhaikkooda avanudaiya nanbanaip paarthus sollividalaam endra nilaippaadu ulladhu.
Aanaal, ilakkiyathaip paarthaal kaalavellathaal azhikka mudiyaadha pala natbugal varalaatril endrum pesappadugindrana. Avatril kavilarum paariyum kondirundha natbu thanithuvamaanadhu.
Thiruvannaamalai koyilukkus sellumbodhu thirukkovilooraik kadandhu selvom. Angu thenbennai aatrukkul oru siriya paarai iruppadhaip paarkkalaam. Adhudhaan kavilar kundru. Kavilar thanadhu vaazhkkaiyai mudithukkonda idam enbadhaal andhap paarai, 'kavilar kundru' endru azhaikkappadugiradhu.
Kavilar yaar? Avar oru pulavar. Parambu malaiyai aanda paari endra mannanin avaiyil irundhavar. Kadaiyezhu vallalgalil thanipperum vallalaagap potrappattavar paari. Vaadiya mullaikkodi padarvadharkuth thaangugol illaamal thavippadhaik kanda paari, adharkaagath thanadhu theraiye vittus sendravar. Oru kodikkaagath thanadhu theraiye kodutha andhak kodai ullam, uyirinangalin meedhu avar kondirundha irakkathaiyum velippaduthugiradhu.
Parambu malaiyum iyarkai valam niraindhadhaaga irundhadhu. Uzhavar uzhaamal, iyarkaiyaagave then, thinai, vallikkizhangu, moongil arisi, palaa pondravai kidaikkum valamaana nilamaaga adhu vilangiyadhu. Moovendhargal parambu malaiyai mutrugaiyittu por nadathiyavodhugooda, andha iyarkai valathin kaaranamaaga angirundha makkal unavup panjjathaal paadhikkappadaamal thodarndhu veerathudan poraada mudindhadhu. Adhanaal paariyai vella mudiyaamal moovendhargal thavithanar.
Paariyum kavilarum kondirundha natbu porul koduthu vaangiya natbu alla. Paari kavilarukku endhap porulaiyum kodukkavillai; kavilarum paariyidam endhap porulaiyum ketkavillai. Aanaal, paariyin vaazhkkai mudindhavodhu andha natbin unmaiyaana magathuvam velippattadhu.
Paari irandhavodhu avarin iru magalgalaana angavai, sangavai iruvarum aadharavatravargal aayinar. Avargalaith thirumanam seythu kolla yaarum munvaravillai. Thandhaiyai izhandha thuyarathodu avargal varumaiyin kodumaiyaiyum edhirgolla vendiya nilai erpattadhu. Munbu anniya naattuk kudhiraigalin anivaguppaik kanda andhap pillaigal, ippodhu uppu moottaigalais sumakkum kazhudhaigalaiye paarkkum nilaikku vandhuvittadhaagak koori varundhinar.
Andha nerathil paarikku irundha ore uravu kavilardhaan. Paari irandhuvittaan; ini veru oru mannanaip pugazhndhu paadi thanadhu vaazhkkaiyai nagarthik kollalaam endru kavilar ninaikkavillai. Maaraaga, paari irundhirundhaal seyya vendiya kadamaiyaith thaane niraivetra vendum endru karudhinaar.
Angavai, sangavai iruvarukkum thirumanam seythu vaippadharkaagak kavilar oor ooraagas sendraar. Periya arasargalais sandhithu, paariyin magalgalaith thirumanam seythu kollumaaru kettukkondaar. Palarum thayangiya nilaiyil, irudhiyil poruthamaana idathil andha iru pengalukkum thirumanam seythu vaithaar.
Idhanmoolam paari seyya vendiya kadamaiyai, paari illaadha nilaiyil avanudaiya arumai nanban kavilar niraivetrinaar.
Natbu endraal enna? Theneerk kadaiyil kooduvadhu natbaa? Maalai nerathil madhimayangum madhukkadai natbaa? Ivai natbin unmaiyaana ilakkanam alla. Nanban illaadha idathil, avanudaiya vaazhkkaiyil avan seyya vendiya kadamaiyai yaar seygiraaro, avardhaan unmaiyaana nanban. Andha natbin ilakkanathil kavilar uyarndhu nirkiraar.
Angavai, sangavai iruvarukkum thirumanam seythu vaitha piragu, thanadhu kadamai mudindhuvittadhaaga kavilar karudhinaar. Nanbanaip poys sera mudiveduthaar.
Adharkaaga avar therndhedutha idamdhaan thenbennai aatrangaraiyil irundha andhak kundru. Andhak kundrin meedhu amarndhu thanimaiyil thavamirundhu, unnaanonbirundhu thanadhu uyiraith thurandhaar kavilar. Nanbanukkaagavum natbukkaagavum uyiraiye thurandha andha natbu indrum nammaik kangalanga vaikkiradhu.
Indru nanbargal thinathil naam kai kulukkikkolgirom. Aanaal, andhak kaigulukkalukkul oruvarai eppadi veezhthalaam, eppadi azhikkalaam endra ennamum irukkiradhu. Indraiya nanbargal ulagam iruveru ulagamaaga maariyirukkiradhu. Adharku maaraaga, kavilarum paariyum kondirundha natbu thanithuvamaanadhu; magathuvamaanadhu.
Ithagaiya natbin thodarchiyaaga ilakkiyathil innoru magathaana natbaiyum paarkkirom. Adhu kopperunjjozhanum pisiraandhaiyaarum kondirundha natbu.
Indraikku padhavi uyarvukkum, panith thevaigalukkum ida odhukkeedu ketkirom. Aanaal, oruvan irappadharkaagave ida odhukkeedu ketkiraan endraal adhu eppadippatta natbaaga irukkum? Kopperunjjozhan, thaan uyiraith thurakkap pogum idathil thanadhu valappakkathil thanadhu nanbanaana pisiraandhaiyaarukkaaga idathai odhukki vaithaan.
Adhu thiraippadam paarppadharkaana idam alla; vaazhkkaiyai mudippadharkaana idam. Kopperunjjozhan unnaanonbirundhu uyiraith thurakkath thayaaraanavodhu, avarudan amarndhu uyirai viduvadharkaagap palarum vandhanar. Aanaal, than arugil yaarum amarakkoodaadhu endru kopperunjjozhan koorinaan. Enenil, andha idathukkuth than nanban pisiraandhaiyaar varuvaar endru avan nambinaan.
Avarai kopperunjjozhan paarthirukkiraaraa? Pazhagiyirukkiraaraa? Illai. Oruvaraiyoruvar neril paarthadhugooda illai. Pazhagaadha, paarkkaadha andha nanbar, thannudaiya valappakkathil vandhu amarndhu thannodu uyir thurappaar endra nambikkai kopperunjjozhanukku irundhadhu.
Adhaithaan thirukkuralum, “unarchi pazhagudhal vendaa; unarchidhaan natbaam” endru eduthuraikkiradhu. Natbukku eppodhum neril pazhagiyirukka vendum endra avasiyamillai. Unmaiyaana anbum unarvum irundhaal adhuve natbaagiradhu.
Ippadippatta nanbargalai naam ethanai perai nam vaazhkkaiyil paarkkap pogirom? Unmaiyaana nanbargal kidaithaal nam vaazhvu magathaana vetriyaip perum. Athagaiya unmaiyaana natbaiyum anbaiyum patris sindhikka vaikkum thalathildhaan ‘anbe sivam’ endra sindhanaiyum nammai azhaithus selgiradhu.!

headline: Pahalgaam: oru pazhaiya pugaippadathai payangaravaadhiyin 'pirathyega' kaatchi ena thavaraaga seythi veliyitta oodagangal | Media Outlets Misreport Old Image As 'Exclusive' Visual of Attacker
text:
Pahalgaam: oru pazhaiya pugaippadathai payangaravaadhiyin 'pirathyega' kaatchi ena thavaraaga seythi veliyitta oodagangal
indhap pugaippadam kadandha 2021aam aandu mudhal Facebook-il irukkum oru kaanoliyilirundhu edukkappattadhaaga poom kandarindhulladhu.
Pahalgaam thaakkudhalil eeduvatta payangaravaadhi, thanadhu thaakkudhal thuppaakkiyudan irukkum kaatchi ena oru pazhaiya pugaippadathai seythiyaaga piravala oodagangal veliyittullana.
Indha thavaraana seythi, news thamizh 24x7, thinamalar, onindhiyaa thamizh aagiya oodagangalil veliyidappattulladhu. Thaakkudhalil eeduvatta payangaravaadhiyin pirathyega ’mudhal padam’ endru koori oodaga seythi arikkaigalil pazhaiya pugaippadathai veliyittadhu.
Indha pugaippadathai poom sarivaarthu. Appodhu, idhu 2021aam aandu akdovar mudhal Facebook-il irukkum oru veediyovilirundhu edukkappatta sgireenshaat enbadhaik kandarindhadhu. Melum, kurippidappatta endha oodaga arikkaigalilum, sameevathiya pahalgaam thaakkudhalil eeduvatta oru payangaravaadhiyin pugaippadathaik kaattugiradhu enbadhai arasu tharappil irundhu urudhippaduthappatta thagavalgal illai.
India-vil podhumakkal meedhu nadathappatta migak kodooramaana thaakkudhalgalil ondraana jammu & kaashmeerin pahalgaamil ulla paisaran pulveligalil payangaravaadhigal thuppaakkis soodu nadathinar. Idhil 26 sutrulaap payanigalum oru ulloorvaasiyum kollappattanar. Indha thaakkudhalil uyir thappiyavargalum, uyir izhandhavargalin kudumbathinarum, adaiyaalam matrum peyargalaik ketta piragu, payangaravaadhigal islaamiyar allaadhavargalai kurivaithadhaagak kutram saattiyullanar. Mudharkatta visaaranaiyil paagisdhaanais serndha moondru per utbada aindhu payangaravaadhigal idhil eeduvattullanar enbadhu theriyavandhulladhu. Sindhu nadhi oppandhathai niruthi vaippadhu utbada, paagisdhaanukku edhiraaga Indhiya arasaangam theevira arasu nadavadikkaigalai eduthulladhu.
Innilaiyil, news thamizh 24x7 seythiyin YouTube senalil, pahaldhaam thaakkudhalil eeduppatta theeviravaadhiyin mudhal pugaippadam veliyaanadhu endru seythi veliyittulladhu.
Indha pugaippadathil, oodhaa nira kurdhaa matrum paijaamaa anindha oru navar thuppaakkiyudan irukkiraar. Idhu sambava idathil odumbodhu kemaraavil padhivaagiyiruppadhu pondru thondrugiradhu.
