headline: TVK aatchikku vandhaal meendum laattari virpanai thuvakkappadum endru vavijay arivithaaraa?
text:
‘‘TVK aatchikku vandhaal meendum laattari virpanai thuvakkappadum,’’ endru vavijay arivithadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ TVK aatchikku vandhaal aadhav arjoonaa moolam laattari virpanai meendum thuvakkappadum- vavijay’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, TVK thalaimaik kazhagam matrum aadhav arjoonaa tharappil kettavodhu, ‘’idhuvondra endha arivippaiyum TVK thalaivar vavijay veliyidavillai. Melum, sameevathil thandhi TV-yil veliyaana seythi ondrai edit seythu, ivvaaru aadhav peyaril vadhandhi parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithanar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, thandhi tiviyin digital pirivu nirvaagiyidam kettavodhu, naangal aadhav arjoonaa patri veliyitta seythi verondru. Adhanai edit seythu, ivvaaru parappugindranar,’’ endru therivithaar.
Unmaiyaana seythiyin lingk idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda seythi, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Amaichargalin seyalbaadugalai piradhamar Modi aayvu.. 2 naal aalosanaik koottam!
text:
Merku aasiyap por ullitta sarvadhesa savaalgal, ulnaattu porulaadhaara azhuthangal, samaiyal enney vilai uyarvu pondra soozhalil, mathiya arasin seyalbaadugal matrum edhirgaalath thittangalai piradhamar Modi thalaimaiyilaana iru naal ‘sindhan sivir’ aalosanaik koottam aayvu seygiradhu.
Merku aasiyap por ullitta palveru savaalgalukku mathiyil, mathiya arasin seyalbaadugal matrum edhirgaalath thittangal kurithu piradhamar Modi thalaimaiyil irandu naal aalosanaik koottam nadaivera ulladhu.
Indru matrum naalai piradhamarin pudhiya aluvalagamaana ‘sevaa theerth’thil nadaiverum koottathil mathiya amaichargal pangerka ullanar.
‘sindhan sivir’ ena azhaikkappadum indhak koottathil arasuth thittangalin munnetram, kolgai amalaakkam, amaichagangalukku idaiyeyaana orunginaippu matrum podhumakkalukkaana sevai viniyogam kurithu madhippaayvu seyyappada ulladhu. Ovvoru amaichagathin seyalbaadugal, ettappatta ilakkugal matrum aduthagatta seerdhiruthangal kurithu arikkaigal samarppikkappada ullana.

headline: Merinaa kadarkaraiyil vimaananilaiyam kattalaam endru vavijay koorinaaraa?
text:
Chennai merinaa kadarkaraiyil vimaananilaiyam kattalaam endru nadigar vavijay kooriyadhaaga oru news card

nadigarum TVK thalaivarumaana vavijay pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhil. “mereenaavil idamirukke? Vimaana nilaiyam katta parandhooredhaan venumaa? Parandhu virindha mereenaa kadarkaraiyil kattalaame? Enge enna vivasaayamaa nadakkiradhu? Makkalukkum poyvara vasadhiyaaga irukkume? – TVK thalaivar vavijay” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “aahaa, ippadi oru arivaalidhaan thamizhnaattu mudhalamaicharaaga irukkanumvimaana nilaiyam amaippadhu mathiya arasu enbadhu kooda theriyaadha sinimaa nadigar 😂😃😁
vimaana nilaiyam , irayil nilaiyam , anumin nilaiyam , raanuva thalangal , kappal thuraimugam idhulaam maanila arasaal amaikka mudiyaadhu enbadhai yaaraavadhu indha sinimaa nadigaridam sollunga” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Parandhooril pudhiya vimaana nilaiyam amaippadharku padhil Chennai merinaa kadarkaraiyil amaikkalaam endru TVK thalaivar vavijay kooriyadhaaga oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, vavijay appadi pesiyadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Vavijay pesiyadhai ellaa oodagangalum veliyittirundhana. Adhai muzhuvadhumaaga ketta podhu avar appadi kooravillai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Indha news kaardum unmaiyaanadhu pola theriyavillai. Adhan thamizh faant vazhakkamaaga pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidum news card-il ulladhu pola illai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam enbadhu thelivaanadhu. Idhai urudhiseythugolla aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathai paarthom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pola oru news card irundhadhu. Aanaal adhil, “pechukke idamillai. TVK thalaimaiyil amaiyum koottani DMK, BJP-virku edhiraanadhaagathaan eppodhum irukkum. Adhil samarasam endra pechukke idamillai – TVK thalaivar vavijay” irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai thiruthi, thavaraana thagaval serthu veliyittiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarum namakku ippadi oru poliyaana news card samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu endru therivithaar. Samooga oodagangalil paravum poliyaana news card-ai “FAKE” endru muthiraiguthi indha seythiyai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai endru kurippittu anuppinaar. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda “mereenaavil idamirukke” endru paravum nadigar vavijay thodarbaana news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Poondu milagu kuzhambu vitra pengal patri avadhooru; instaavil izhivaaga pesiyavarukku Police valai
text:
Chennai: pengal kurithu avadhooru video veliyitta instaagiraam unavu vimarsagarai Police thedi varugindranar.
Instaagiraamil unavup porutkal patri vimarsanam seybavar manigandan. Unavup porutkalin tharam, adhan vilai, neenda kaalam unavai paadhugaappadharkaaga serkkappadum uppu aagiyavai patri avar kadumaiyaana kelvigalai ezhuppi video veliyittu irundhaar. Idhanaal, aanlainil milagu, poondu kuzhambu vitra pen oruvarukkum avarukkum modhal erpattadhu.
Indha modhalin podhu, pengalin kanniyathai avamadhikkum vagaiyil manigandan tharakkuraivaagap pesiyadhaaga kutram saattappattulladhu. Paadhikkappatta pengal poleesil pugaar alithanar.
Chennai kamishanar aavees matrum kadaloor poleesil pugaar alikkappattadhu. Thagaval arindha manigandan thalaimaraivaagi ullaar. Avarai Police thanippadai amaithu theeviramaaga thedi varugindranar.

headline: Kallidaikkurichi thozhiladhivarai vettik kondra marma kumbal
text:
Tirunelveli: Tirunelveli maavattam kallidaikkurichiyil magalai too - veelaril azhaithu vandhavarai, pindhodarndhu vandha marma kumbal arivaalaal vettik kolai seythadhu.
Kallidaikkurichiyais serndhavar kannan 52, ambaasamuthirathil thirumana mandavam nadathi vandhaar.
Tiyooshan sendrirundha magalai netru iravu 8:30 maniyalavil too - veelaril azhaithuk kondu kallidaikkurichi kuthukkal theru pagudhiyil sendraar.
Appodhu pinburamaaga vandha marma kumbal ondru kannanai arivaalaal vettivittu thappiyodiyadhu.
Idhil, padugaayamadaindha kannan sambava idathileye uyirizhandhaar. Kolaikkaana kaaranam kurithu kallidaikkurichi Police visaarithu varugindranar.
Thagavalarindha maavatta es.pi., vishvesh saasdhiri sambava idathil visaaranai merkondaar.

headline: Nam naattin anu aayudha kaiyiruppu 190!: America vinjnjaanigal koottamaippu madhippeedu
text:
Pudhudilli: nam raanuvathidam 190 anu aayudhangal irukkalaam ena America vinjnjaanigal koottamaippu madhippittulladhu. Anu aayudhangalai thodarndhu adhigarithu varuvadhudan, adhanai naveenappaduthum panigalilum nam naadu eeduvattu varuvadhaaga andha koottamaippu veliyitta arikkaiyil suttikkaattappattulladhu.
Vadakke China, merke Pakistan ena nam naattukku iru naadugalum thodarndhu achuruthalaaga irundhu varugindrana. Edhirigalin achuruthalai samaalikkum vagaiyil nam raanuvathin palathai mathiya arasu thodarndhu adhigarithu varugiradhu.
Kurippaaga adhinaveena raanuva thalavaadangal, digital por karuvigal, raanuvam saarndha thozhilnutbangalai America, piraans, Israel pondra naadugalidam irundhu naam vaangi varugirom.
Innilaiyil, ame rikka vinjnjaanigal kootta maippu, nam naadu anu aayudhangalai perukki varuvadhaaga madhippittu arikkai veliyittuulladhu.
Palveru naadugalidam irundhu perappatta thagavalgal, seyarkaikkol padangal, podhu thagavalgalai adippadaiyaaga kondu nam naattin anu aayudhangal kuritha madhippeedu veliyidappattulladhu.
Onbadhu amaippu
adhil koorappattiruppadhaavadhu:
anu aayudhangalai evakkoodiya padai amaippu matrum thiran thodarbaana podhu thagavalgalin adippadaiyil, India-vil tharpodhu 190 anu aayudhangal irukkalaam.
Adhil 178 anu kundugal, evuganaigalil poruthappadaamal mathiya aayudha semippu kalanjjiyathin kaiyiruppil vaikkappattirukkalaam.
Tharpodhu, indhiyaavidam anu aayudhangalai endhi sellum thiran padaitha onbadhu amaippugal seyalbaattil irukkindrana.
Idhil vaanvazhiyaaga thaakkudhal nadathuvadharku edhuvaaga iru amaippugal, tharai vazhiyaaga thaakkudhal nadathuvadharku edhuvaaga aaru evuganai amaippugalum adangum. Thavira, melum iru pudhiya amaippugal varungaalathil payanbaattirku varavullana.
Tharpodhu seyalbaattil ulla evudhiran amaippugal moolam 160kkum merpatta anu aayudhangalai sumandhu sendru edhirigalin ilakkugalai thaakka mudiyum.
Idhu thavira, pudhidhaaga padaiyil inaikkappadum evuganaigalukkaaga, anu aayudhangal koodudhalaaga urpathi seyyappattu varugindrana.
Kadal vazhiyaaga varum anu aayudha achuruthalgalai samaalippadharkaana thiranum indhiyaavidam virivadaindhu varugiradhu.
Ulnaattileye thayaarikkappatta moondraavadhu anuaayudha neermoozhgi kappalaana ai.en.es., aridhaman kadandha epralil, kadarpadaiyil serkkappattiruppadhu, India-vin palathai adhigarikka vaithulladhu.
Naangaavadhu neermoozhgi kappal 2027l padaiyil serkkappadalaam ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Andha vagaiyil pudhiya evuganaigal, neermoozhgi kappalgal seyalbaattukku varumbodhu India-vin ottumotha anu aayudha kaiyiruppum avarimidhamaaga adhigarikkalaam.
Anu aatral moolapporutkalukkaana sarvadhesa kuzhuvin kanakkeettinbadi, 2026 thodakkathil India 730 kilo puloodoniyam urpathi seythu irukkiradhu. Idhil, 170 kilo varai koodudhalaagavo, kuraivaa kavo irukkalaam.
Oru anugundu thayaarikka saraasariyaaga naangu kilo puloodoniyam thevaippadum. Andha kotbaattin adippadaiyil, indhiyaavidam ulla puloodoniyam moolam 140 mudhal 225 anugundugal varai thayaarikka mudiyum.
India-vin anu aayudha kaiyiruppu, paagisdhaanai vida adhigam endraalum, China, Russia matrum amerikkaavai vida kanisamaana alavukku kuraivaagave irukkiradhu.
Indha aandin thodakkathil, onbadhu anu aayudha naadugalidam 12,187 anugundugal irukkalaam ena theriyavandhulladhu. Idhil 9,754 anugundugal raanuva kaiyiruppil irukkindrana.
Thaduppu thiran
India-vin anu aayudha kolgai, paagisdhaanai maiyappaduthiye amaindhu irukkiradhu. Anu aayudha naveenamayamaakkal thittamum adhai nokkiye vadivamaikkappadugiradhu.
Eninum, neenda thoora evuganaigal, anusakdhi neermoozhgi kappalgalin thiranai perukki varuvadhan moolam, seenaavaiyum edhirgollum alavukku, India-vin anu aayudha thaduppu thiran valuvadaindhulladhu.
Ivvaaru adhil therivikkappattulladhu.
America vinjnjaanigal koottamaippu veliyitta 190 anu aayudhangal endra madhippeedu nam arasin adhigaarappoorva pullivivaram alla. Thulliyamaana anu aayudha kaiyiruppu theriyavillai ena andha arikkaiyil suttikkaattappattulladhu.

headline: Merinaavil penaa silai vaikka mudiyaamal thindaadum DMK endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:
‘‘merinaavil penaa silai vaikka mudiyaamal thindaadum DMK,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ merinaavil vaikka irundha penaa silai
aatchi maatradhaal idam thedum DMK 🤣,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu mundhaiya DMK aatchiyil 2023m aandu edukkappatta video, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Karunaanidhi nootraandu vizhaavai otti, kanniyaagumari thodangi, Tamil Nadu muzhukka, payanam merkolvadharkaaga, muthamizh ther endra peyaril penaavadivil oordhi ondru vadivamaikkappattadhu. Indha oordhi 2023 navambar maadhathil Tamil Nadu muzhuvadhum payanam merkondu, irudhiyaaga tisambar 4m thedhi Chennai sendru serndhadhu.
Indha muthamizh ther oordhiyin thodakka naalandru edukkappatta veediyovaiye tharpodhu thavaraana thagaval serthu parappugiraargal.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda veediyovukkum, penaa silaikkum endha sambandhamum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Irivurathil kudineer kettu makkal mariyal
text:
Sathiyamangalam;thaalavaadimalaiyil ulla thaalavaadi panjjaayathukku utbatta irivuram malai kiraamathil, 300-kkum
 merpatta kudumbathinar vasikkindranar. Ivargalukku kadandha sila 
maadhangalaagave kudineer viniyogam muraiyaaga seyyappadavillai.
Idhanaal
 arugil ulla thottangalukku sendru kudineer kondu vara nerittadhu. 
Thottangalilum thanneer kuraivaaga ponadhaal thattuppaadu erpattu 
avadhikku aalaaginar. Panj., nirvaagathidam palamurai therivithum 
nadavadikkai edukkappadaadha nilaiyil, irivuram-thaalavaadi saalaiyil, 
50kkum merpatta aangal, pengal netru saalai mariyal poraattathil 
eeduvattanar. Idhanaal pokkuvarathu paadhikkappattadhu.
Adhigaarigal,
 varuvaay thuraiyinar matrum Police makkaludan pechuvaarthai 
nadathinar. Pazhudhadaindha aazhdhulai kinatru mottaar sari seyyappattu 
kudineer vazhangappadum endru urudhi kooriyadhaal, mariyal poraattathai 
kaivittu sendranar. Idhanaal, 2 mani neram pokkuvarathu paadhikkappattadhu.

headline: ‘palli, kalloorigal vendaam; koyil kattungal’ endru Edappadi Palaniswami koorinaaraa?
text:
‘’indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai koyilgaldhaan katta vendum; palli, kalloorigalai alla,’’ endru Edappadi Palaniswami kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’koyil illaa ooril.. Koyil illaa ooril kudiyirukka vendaamendru periyavargal solvaargal. Palli, kalloori kooda illaamal irukkalaam. Kalviyai vida pakdhidhaan mukkiyam. Indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai koyilgaldhaan katta vendum. Palli, kalloorigalai alla. Edappadi Palaniswami velippadaiyaana pechu.’’ , endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
News thamizh 24×7 oodagathin logo idambetrulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami patri pagirappadum merkanda news card-ai, News Tamil 24×7 oodagam veliyittadhaa, endru aayvu seythom. Mudhalil, avargaladhu samooga valaidhala pakkangalukkus sendru paarthom. Idhuvondra endha news kaardum kaanappadavillai.
Aduthappadiyaaga, avargaladhu aasiriyar kuzhuvai thodarbu kondu kettavodhu, ‘’engaladhu peyaril pagirappadum poliyaana news card idhu’’, endru urudhi seythanar.
Idhaithodarndhu, ADMK ai.ti. Pirivai thodarbu kondu kettom. Avargalum, ‘’idhu poliyaana news card vendumendre DMK aadharavaalargal idhuvondra vadhandhiyai parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithanar.
Idhu mattumindri, Tamil Nadu muzhukka sutrup payanam merkondu varum Edappadi Palaniswami, edhenum sarchaikkuriya vagaiyil pesiyullaaraa, endru vivaram thedinom. Appodhu, arasaanga panathai eduthu, kalvi valarchip panigalukkus selavidaamal, aranilaiyathuraikku podhumakkal tharum nidhiyai eduthu, DMK arasu selavidugiradhu, endru avar pesiyadhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram…
Vikatan l Dinamani l Thanthi TV
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Jey sreeraam endru koshamida varpuruthappatta islaamiyap pen endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Islaamiya pen oruvarai jey sreeraam endru koshamida varpuruthi indhuthuva aadharavaalargal thaakkinaargal endru oru video

islaamiya pennai aan oruvar thaakkuvadhu polavum, avarai matravargal thaduppadhu polavum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha navar jey sreeraam kooru endru sollith thaakkuvadhu pol ulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indhuthuvaa madhaveri kundargalaal oru ilam sirumiyaith thaakki, ‘jey siri raam’ endru koshamida varpuruthith thaakkappadugiraar.
Idhai eppadip poruthukkolla mudiyum? Aanaalum endha nadavadikkaiyum illai, oodagangalil endha seythiyum varavillai, endha arasiyalvaadhiyidamirundhum oru tveet kooda varavillai.
Ini indha naattil muslim sirumigal, idhuvondra (kundargalaal)kumbalgalaal nadu veedhiyil endhavidha pinvilaivugalum indri thaduthu niruthappattuth thaakkappaduvaargalaa? Needhi enge?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhuthuvaa madha veri konda kundargal ilam islaamiya sirumiyaith thaakkugiraargal endru video ondru samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Endha idam endru adhil kurippidappadavillai. Sila padhivugalil merku vangathil BJP aatchi amaindha piragu indha sambavam nadandhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai vangadhesa oodagam ondru thannudaiya Facebook pakkathil 2025m aandu sepdambar 16m thedhi padhivittirundhadhu. Adhil, “ilam pen oruvar panam thirudum podhu kaiyum kalavumaaga sikkinaar.
Andha pennin peyar anigaa. Aayatha aadai urpathi thozhitsaalaiyil velai seythu varugiraar. Mirboor kalloori sandhai (Mirpur College Market) pagudhi kadai ondril avar panathaith thirudumbodhu sikkinaar. Sambalam podhumaanadhaaga illaadhadhaal ippadi avar thirudivittadhaaga avaradhu uravinargal koorinar” endru irundhadhu.
Andha video-vil andha pennai jey sreeraam koorumbadi yaarum varpuruthith thaakkavillai. Panam thirudu thodarbaagave avarai thaakkiyadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam vangadhesathil nadandha thiruttu sambavam ondrin video-vai edit seythu, aadiyovai maatri thavaraaga madhaveruppai thoondum vagaiyil padhivittiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarathin adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu audio edit seyyappattadhu, thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Modiyai kelvi ketta aisvaryaa raay endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’modiyai kelvi ketta aisvaryaa raay,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ Pakistan idam aaru  vimaanangalai izhandhom?
Naangu rafel veezhndhadhu eppadi?
Es 400 system irandai eppadi veezhthinaargal?
300 raanuva veerargalai eppadi pali kodutheergal?
Kaashmeer  &  raajasdhaan ellai pagudhigalai Pakistan eppadi vizhungiyadhu?
Nalla kelvigal padhil mattum varaadhu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Idhanudan Modi-kku munbaaga aisvaryaa raay pesuvadhu pondra kaatchigal idambetrullana.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta video endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha navambar 19, 2026 andru aandhirap piradhesathin puttavarthiyil sathya saay paavaavin pirandhanaal nootraandu vizhaa nadaivetradhu. Idhil, piradhamar Modi matrum sachin tendulgar, nadigai aisvaryaa raay aagiyor sirappu virundhinargalaaga pangetranar.
Indha nigazhchiyil piradhamar Modi-yin kaalgalai thottu aisvaryaa raay vananginaar. Adhanbinnar uraiyaatriya aisvaryaa raay, “There is only one caste, the caste of humanity. There is only one religion, the religion of love. There is only one language, the language of the heart, and there is only one God, and he is omnipresent” endru therivithaar.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
Live Mint l NDTV l CNN-News18 l The Hindu
idhanmoolamaaga, aisvaryaa raay kuralai mattum edit seythu, avar pesaadha karuthai serthu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video edit seyyappatta ondru, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘saari vendaam… saari kelu’ endru muranaaga vavijay padhaagai vaithirundhaaraa?
text:
Saari vendaam needhi vendum, saari kel endru TVK thalaivar vavijay padhaagai vaithirundhaar endru oru pugaippadam

nadigar vavijay padhaagai ondrai vaithirukkum pugaippadam X thalathil padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, ” Sorry vendaam. Needhi vendum. Sorry kelu” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu.
investigation_details:
Sivagangai maavattam thiruvuvanathil ajithgumaar enbavar kadandha joon maadham Police thaakkiyadhil maranam adaindhaar. Indha maranathirku needhi kettu TVK saarbil Chennai-yil aarppaattam nadandhadhu. Akkatchiyin thalaivarum nadigarumaana vavijay idhil pangetraar. Poraattathin podhu needhi kettu nadigar vavijay vaithirundha penaril saari vendaam endrum saari kelu endrum muranbaadaaga ezhudhappattirundhadhu pondra pugaippadathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Poraattathin pugaippadangal, video-kkal seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi ulladhu. Avatraip paarthom. Adhil appadi endha oru kaatchiyum illai. Avar vaithirundha padhaagaiyil, “Sorry vendaam, needhi vendum!” endru mattum ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthu pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil veliyaana padhivugalaith thavirthu TVK adhigaarappoorva thalangal, samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyaana padhivugalaip paarthom. TVK adhigaarappoorva X thala pakkathil poraattathin pugaippadangal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil vavijay kaiyil padhaagai vaithirukkum kaatchiyum idam petrirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Nellai: kulavanigarburam kirushna jeyandhi vizhaa! Raadhai - kirushnaa alangaaram! Vazhukku maram eriya ilainjargal!
text: Nellai kulavanigarburam kogulam sree muppidaadhi amman, navamohana kirushnan thirukkoyil 53-vadhu aandu kirushna jeyandhi vizhaa vimarisaiyaaga nadaivetradhu. Vizhaavil ilainjargalukkaana vazhukku maram erum potti, raadhai-kirushnaa vedamitta siruvar-sirumigal alangaaram, uriyadi vizhaa aagiyavai nadaivetradhu.

headline: Khamenei kollappattadhai kondaadum Iran makkal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran-in uyariya thalaivaraaga irundha Ayatollah ali Khamenei kollappattadhai Iran-il ullavargale kondaadum podhu ingullavargal edharku poraada vendum endru kettu oru video

palarum saalaiyil nadanamaadik kondaaduvadhu pondru video ondru threads.com samooga oodagathil pagirappattulladhu. Adhil, “ingu iruppavan edhukkudaa poraadureenga andha makkalai sandhoshamaa thaan irukkaanga. Iran sarvaadhigaari kollappattadharku Iran makkal kondaattam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran-in uyariya thalaivaraaga 30 aandugalukkum melaagap paniyaatriya Ayatollah ali Khamenei America – Israel koottuth thaakkudhalil kollappattaar. Kameniyin kolaikku India-vil soniyaa kaandhi ullitta thalaivargal kandanam therivithirundha nilaiyil pala islaamiya amaippugal poraattam nadathina.
Indha nilaiyil, eeraaniyargale kondaadugiraargal, neengal en poraadugindreergal endru kettu eeraaniyargal kondaadiyadhaaga video ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Ivargal kaigalil ulla kodiyaip paarkkum podhu Iran thesiyak kodi pola illai. Indha video-vil ullavargalin kaigalil ulla kodigalil singam kaiyil vaal vaithirukkiradhu. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video-vai aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu eeraaniyargal kondaattathil eeduvattanar endru kurippittu indha video-vai palarum padhivittirundhanar. Aanaal, indha kondaattam engu nadandhadhu endru andha padhivugalil kurippidappadavillai. Neenda thedalukkup piragu oru sila padhivugalil idhu jermani thalainagar perlinil nadandhadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil koogulil sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Appodhu Khamenei kollappattadhaip pazhaiya Iran naattil irundhu veliyeri jermanil kudiyirukkum makkal kondaadinaargal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Melum ivargal kaiyilirundhadhu Iran puratchikku munbu thesiya kodiyaaga irundha kodi endrum sila padhivugalil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Pazhaiya kodiyaith thedip paarthavodhu adhu unmaidhaan enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Indha kondaattam jermaniyil nadandhadhudhaanaa enbadhai urudhiseythugolla aayvu seythom. Appodhu sarvadhesa seythi niruvanamaana Reuters-n samooga oodaga pakkangalil indha kondaattathin neradi olivarappu veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil indha kondaattam jerman thalainagar perlinil ulla Brandenburg Gate pagudhiyil nadandhadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Namakku kidaitha sila thelivaana veediyokkalil saalaiyin amaippu, iru pakkangalilum irundha kadaigalin peyargalai ellaam kurithukkondu Brandenburg Gate pagudhiyil appadi edhum kadaigal ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu indha kondaattam nadandha idathai nammaal kanduvidikka mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha kondaattam Iran-il nadakkavillai, jermaniyil nadandhadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Ivargal eeraanai poorveegamaagak konda makkalaaga irundhaalum puratchikku piragu aatchikku vandha Ayatollah ali Khamenei edhirppaalargal enbadhu thelivaaga purindhugolla mudigiradhu. America-vil ulla seekkiyargal Indhiya thalaivargalukku edhiraaga poraattangalai nadathi varugindranar. Ippadi, America-vil ulla Indhiya vamsaavazhiyinar Indhiya thalaivarukku edhiraaga poraadinaal adhai ottumotha Indhiya makkalin viruppam endru eppadi koora mudiyaadho adhu polathaan idhuvum.
1979m aandu erpatta eeraaniya puratchiyai ivargal erkavillai enbadhai ivargal vaithulla kodiyin moolam arindhugolla mudigiradhu. Ivargal jermaniyil kondaadiyadhai Iran-il eeraaniyargal kondaadiyadhu pondru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu, thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thamizhagathil adutha 5 naatkalukku mazhai! - vaanilai maiyam
text:

headline: Thanjavur maavattam, thaaraasuram sakkaraayi amman koyil: sugappirasavam arulum ambigai!
text:
Pirasavathinaalo alladhu thurmaranamaagavo irappu nigazhaamal, vaazhkkaiyai nallavadiyaay anuvavithu neendagaalam vaazhumbadiyaana amaippaith tharum vidham - avagaala miruthyu payam erpadaadhiruppadharkaaga arulvadhu aaraavadhu sakkaram piradhishdai aanadhaam.
Kumba konam-thanjjaavoor mukkiya saalaiyil kumbagonathukku arugil ulladhu thaaraasuram. Ingulla airaavadhesvarar koyilukku aruge amaindhulladhu sakkaraayi koyil.
Indha aalayathin sirappugal anegam. Ingu vazhivattaal karppinigalukkus sugappirasavam nigazhumaam. Vaarungal indha arpudhamaana amman aalayathin thalavaralaatraip paarppom.
12-m nootraandil 2-m raajaraajar aatchikkaalathil ottak kootharaal adhiveeryamaana aaru sakkarangal piradhishdai seyyappattu, adharku mel ithala ammanai piradhishdai seythaargal engiradhu thalavaanam.
Thirumanam, pillaipperu, udhirappokku nivarthi, udarpalam, manovalam aagiya aindhinaiyum pennukku aruluvadharkaaga aindhu yandhirangalaam. Aaraavadhu yandhiram satru viseshamaanadhu.
Pirasavathinaalo alladhu thurmaranamaagavo irappu nigazhaamal, vaazhkkaiyai nallavadiyaay anuvavithu neendagaalam vaazhumbadiyaana amaippaith tharum vidham - avagaala miruthyu payam erpadaadhiruppadharkaaga arulvadhu aaraavadhu sakkaram piradhishdai aanadhaam.
Karppinigalin achathinaip pokkidum indha annaiyin tharisanam. Sannidhikkuk kaavalaaga valadhuvurathil pachaikkaaliyum, idadhuvurathil pavazhak kaaliyum nirkiraargal.
Mallaandha nilaiyil pirasavathirkuth thayaaraaga ulla pendhaan karuvaraith theyvam. Satrerakkuraiya irandarai adi uyaramum naangarai adi neelamum udaiya kat palagaiyil pudaippuru pondru amaindhulla kal thirumeni ammanudaiyadhu.
Thalaiyatra udaludan irandu karangalum tholukku mele uyarthiya nilai. Neradiyaagath tharisikka iyalaadhavadi sutrilum pudavai thirai alangaarathaal maraithirukkiraargal. Thiraikku mel aavaranangalum poocharangalum saarthiya nilaiyil naam tharisikkalaam.
Avishegaadhigalaiyum muzhu vasdhirathinais sutrappatta nilaiyildhaan seygiraargal. Keezhe athi marathinaal aana sirasu ondru ulladhu. Adharkum visesha archanaigal nigazhgindrana.
Indhak koyilil vaigaasi maadham amaavaasai andru kaappu katti pathu naalgal utsavam nigazhthappadugiradhu. Andhath tharunathil mattume, andha sirasinai moolathiruvirku kazhuthil vaithu alangaritha nilaiyil sakkaraayi kaatchi tharuvaalaam. Enaiya naatkalil sirasu illaamal iruppadhaal evarum kaana iyalaadhavadi maraithe vaithu irukkiraargal.
Vaigaasi utsavathinbodhu indhas sakkaraayi ammanudan, arugilulla koyilgalilirundhu thaaraalamman, ponniyamman, mokshaalamman aagiya moondru pen theyvangal ulaa varuvadhum vegu vimarisaiyaaga nigazhum engiraargal.
Koyilin magaa mandavathil iruvurangalilum aiyanaar, vinaayagar, naagar, veeran, pairavar aagiyorai nilaippaduthi irukkiraargal. Aruge kallaal aana paadhap padimam ondru ulladhu. Sirathinaik koytha kirushnarin thiruppaadhangalaam avai.
Melum indhak koyilil moondru mugangal udaiya magaalatchumi, thavvai aagiyorudan maariyamman thiruvum ulladhu. Karppinigalukku maruthuvachiyaaga vandhu kaappaval enbadhaal `maruthuva maari' enbadhu thiruppeyar.
Sakkaraayikkuk kaavalaaga ulla veeran, sakkaraayi koyilukku veliye valappurathil tham sakdhiyarodu nilaithullaar. Ivarukku mattum thiruvizhaa nerathil visesha padaiyal undu. Athagu asaivap padaiyal nigazhum nerathil, koyil moolasdhaanathuk kadhavugalai moodi nadaisaatri viduvadhu maravaagak kadaippidikkappadugiradhu.
Thirukkoyilin arugilulla thirukkulathirku `sakkaraayi kulam' endru peyar. Theviyin aruvatta siram ikkulathildhaan veezhndhulladhu enbadhu nambikkai.
Thirumanam aana pengalum, karppinigalum koyil valaagathilulla veppamarathil thottil katti piraarthanai seygiraargal.
Perumbaalum karppinigal sugappirasavathirkaaga valaiyal katti vendudhal seyvadhudhaan ingu adhigam. Ivvaaru piraarthanai seybavarukku karuchidhaivo, kuraippirasavamo erpaduvadhu kidaiyaadhu enbadhu urudhi.
Ammanin arulaal pirasavam nallavadiye nadandhu kuzhandhai pirandhaviragu, kuzhandhaiyudan vandhu ival sannidhiyil kuzhandhaiyaik kidathi nerthik kadanaith aatruvadhu avasiyam.
Adhevol ammanukkup paalavishegam seythu, pudhu sivappup pudavai matrum poocharangaludan, elumichai maalai saatri, sivappu aralippookkalaal archithu vazhivaadu seyvadhu vazhakkamaaga irukkiradhu.
Sakkaraayi ammanukku maavilakku etri, sarkkaraip pongalaip padaithu viniyogam seythaal, sakkaraayi manangulirndhu magavinai aasirvadhippaal engiraargal. Thavira karuppaik kolaaru kal,soodhagak kattigal, menovaas pondra paadhippugalaal avadhip paduvavargalum ivvannaikku kungumaarchanai seythu vazhivada, kaimel palan kidaippadhu kangoodu.

headline: Soniyaa kaandhiyai nalam visaaritha Modi endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘soniyaa kaandhiyai nalam visaaritha Modi,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ edhiriyaa irundhaalum, oru ettu etti poy paarthuttu vandhiranum,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Wasitai, Hive Moderation, Sight Engine Tool pondra inaiyadhalangal udhaviyudan merkanda pugaippadathai paguppaayvu seythu, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Aduthappadiyaaga, idhuvondru soniyaa kaandhi matrum Modi sandhithuk kondadhaaga, edhuvum seythi veliyaagiyulladhaa endru paarthom. Avvaaru endha seythiyum kaanappadavillai.
Thodarndhu, naam aayvu seyyum pugaippadathil idambetrulla vaattar maark adippadaiyil vivaram thedinom. Appodhu, Mahi Hemram endra Facebook pakkathil idhuvondra padangal thodarchiyaaga, pagirappattu varuvadhaik kandom.
Kurippitta navaridam naam Facebook mesenjjar moolamaaga, thodarbugondom. Avar ‘’kuritha pugaippadam pozhudhuvokku nokkil Google AI udhaviyudan thayaarikkappattadhu. Arasiyal sarchai erpattadhaal, andha padathai Facebook pakkathil irundhu agatrivitten,’’ endru koorinaar.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Silk smidhaavudan amarndhirukkum Seeman endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’silk smidhaavudan amarndhirukkum Seeman,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ nadigai silk smidhaavudan amarndhiruppavar yaar endru therindhaal comment seyyungal🤔🤔🤔,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu oru edit seyyappatta pugaippadam endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, indha padathil AV Bhaskar endra vaattarmaark ulladhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil thagaval thediyavodhu, AV Bhaskar endra pugaippadak kalainjar kadandha 1983m aandu kumudham oodagathirkaaga, nadigai silk smidhaa matrum kamalhaasan thandhai sreenivaasan aagiyorai padam eduthullaar.
Indha padangalai sila kaaranangalukkaaga, appodhu veliyidavillai endrum, tharpodhu ivatrai pagirvadhaagak koori 2015m aandu, AV Bhaskar Facebook-il padhivu ondrai veliyittullaar.
Melum, kumudham oodagathil veliyiduvadharkaaga, veroru padam eduthadhaagavum, AB Bhaskar Facebook-il kurippittullaar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, silk smidhaavin pazhaiya pugaippadam ondrai eduthu, yaaro oruvar samooga valaidhalangalil pagira, adhanai matravargal vendumendre edit seythu, Seeman peyaril vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru namakku, thelivaagiradhu.
Unmaiyaana pugaippadathaiyum, edit seytha pugaippadathaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Idhudhodarbaaga, naam thamizhar katchi tharappilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pudhu thalaimai seyalagathirku ulloor makkal edhirppai... � samaalikkumaa arasu?:amaichar, adhigaarigal kuzhu amaithu pechu nadatha mudivu
text:
Chennai: Thamizhaga arasin pudhiya thalaimai seyalagam kattum thittathirkaaga, pattinappaakkathil thervu seyyappattulla nilangalin vagaippaadu maatram kurithu, podhumakkal, 21 naatkalukkul karuthu therivikkalaam ena, Chennai perunagara valarchi kuzhumamaana si.em.ti.e., arivithulladhu. Adheneram, indha thittathirku, pattinappaakkam meenava makkal edhirppu therivippadhaal, amaichargal, adhigaarigal konda kuzhu amaithu, avargalidam pechu nadathi samaadhaanam seyya, Thamizhaga arasu mudivu seythulladhu.
Chennai punidha jaarj kottai valaagathil, Thamizhaga arasin sattasavai, thalaimai seyalagam seyalbattu varugiradhu. Ida nerukkadi ulladhaal, 1,200 kodi roobai selavil, pudhiya thalaimai seyalaga valaagathai, pattinappaakkathil katta, TVK, arasu mudivu seythulladhu.
Idharkaaga, pattinappaakkam loop saalaiyil veettu vasadhivaariyam, Chennai maanagaraatchi, varuvaaythurai aagiyavatrirku sondhamaana, 25.5 ekkar nilam thervu seyyappattu ulladhu.
Pudhiya thalaimai seyalagathai, ondrarai aandugalil katti mudikka mudhalvar vavijay virumbugiraar. Adharkerpa panigalai viraivuppaduthumbadi, adhigaarigalukku avar utharavittullaar.
Vagai maatram
kattumaana panikku podhuppanithurai vaayilaaga, virivaana thitta madhippeedu thayaar seyyappada ulladhu. Kattada vadivamaippu panigal, thaniyaar niruvanathidam oppadaikkappada ullana.
Idharkaaga, Chennai pattinappaakkathil veettuvasadhi vaariyathukku sondhamaana nilathai, pudhiya thalaimai seyalaga thittathukku payanbadutha mudivu seyyappattu ulladhu.
Veettuvasadhi vaariyathidam irundhu nilathai peruvadhu thodarbaagavum, virivaana thitta arikkai thayaarippu pondra panigalukku kuzhu amaikkavum, arasaanai veliyidappattu ulladhu.
Innilaiyil, pattinappaakkathil thervu seyyappatta nilangalin vagaippaattai maatram seyya vendum ena, Chennai perunagar valarchi kuzhumamaana si.em.ti.e., vidam, veettuvasadhi vaariyam vinnappithadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil, nila vagaippaadu maatram seyvadharkaaga, podhu makkalidam karuthu ketkum panigalai, si.em.ti.e., thodangiyulladhu.
21 naal avagaasam idhugurithu, si.em.ti.e., netru veliyittulla arivippu:
Chennai pattinappaakkathil, moondru kurippitta 'sarve' engalukku utbatta, 21.37 ekkar nilam tharpodhu, oru pagudhi aadhaara kudiyiruppu, oru pagudhi niruvana payanbaadu, oru pagudhi thirandhaveli matrum pozhudhuvokku vagaippaattil ulladhu.
Idhai vaniga nokkathil, vaniga valaagam endra nila vagaippaattukku maatra, veettuvasadhi vaariyathidam irundhu korikkai vandhulladhu.
Idhugurithu, muzhumaiyaana varaivadangal, ezhumbooril ulla si.em.ti.e., aluvalaga kalandhaalosanai maiyathil, podhumakkal paarvaikku vaikkappattu ullana.
Sambandhappatta pagudhi makkal, aluvalaga naatkalil maalai, 3:00 mani mudhal, 5:00 mani varai, indha vivarangalai paarvaiyidalaam.
Ivvaaru adhil koorappattulladhu.
Meenavargal edhirppu
pattinappaakkathil pudhiya thalaimaiseyalagam katta, sila meenava amaippugal edhirppu therivithu varugindrana. Pokku varathu nerukkadi erpadum ena, palveru arasiyal katchigalum edhirppu therivithu varugindrana.
Edhirgatchigal edhirppai TVK, thalaimai oru poruttaaga eduthukkollavillai. Aanaal, meenava samudhaaya makkal aadharavudan, paniyai mudikka vendum enbadhil, mudhalvar vavijay urudhiyaaga ullaar.
Pudhiya thalaimai seyalagam amaivadhaal, appagudhiyil ulla meenavargalin vaazhvaadhaaram membadum, maraimuga velaivaayppugal adhigarikkum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Enave, idhuguritha unmai nilaiyai, meenava samudhaaya thalaivargalukku eduthukkoora arasu thittamittulladhu.
Idharkaaga, pudhiya thalaimai seyalam amaiyavulla mayilaappoor thogudhi TVK, - em.el.e.,vum, unavuthurai amaicharumaana vengada ramanan, meenvalathurai amaichar sreenaath aagiyor thalaimaiyil, palveru thurai adhigaarigal adangiya kuzhu amaikka, arasu mudivu seythulladhu.
Ikkuzhuvinar, pattinappaakkam sendru, palveru meenava amaippugalai thanithaniyaaga sandhithu pesa ullanar. Avargalin korikkaigalai kettariya ullanar.
Arasin indha muyatsikku endha alavu palan kidaikkum enbadhu pogappogathaan theriyum.

headline: Rashyaavai thaakkiya sunaami endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Rashyaavai sunaami thaakkiyadhaaga oru video

kadarkarai ondrai sunaami pondru periya alai thaakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “rashyaa sunaami” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
2025 joon 30m thedhi Russia-vil miga payangaramaana nilanadukkam erpattadhu. Idhaith thodarndhu Russia, Japan ullitta pala naadugalukku sunaami echarikkai vidukkappattadhu. Russia kizhakkup pagudhi kadarkaraiyil sunaami thaakkiyadhaaga seythigal vandhugonde irukkindrana.
Indha soozhalil, Russia sunaami endru palaveediyokkal samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Appadi samooga oodagangalil paravi varum oru veediyokkalai aayvu seythu varugirom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video thavaraanadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Indha video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, thurukkiyil erpatta sunaami endru idhe video-vai sila aandugalukku munbu samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adharkum munbaaga thennaappirikkaavin tarban kadarkaraiyai raatchadha alai thaakkiyadhaaga niyooyaark taims ullitta oodagangalil indha video kaatchiyudan seythi veliyaagi irundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Idhil edhu unmai endru thodarndhu thediya podhu, tarban kadarkaraiyil raatchadha alai 2017m thaakkiyadhaaga seythigal kidaithana. Enave, thurukkiyil sunaami endru paravum video thagavalum thavaraanadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Thurukkiyil sunaami thaakkiyadhaaga 2023m aandil idhe video-vai padhivittirundhanar. Aanaal, tarban kadarkaraiyil raatchadha alai erpattadhaaga 2017m aandu seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Eeppi (AFP) seythi niruvanam kooda idhu thodarbaaga 2023m aandil fekt sek katturai veliyittirundhadhum theriyavandhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu, 2017m aandu maars 13m thedhi naam aayvukku eduthukkonda adhe video-vai oruvar YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Adhil, 2017 maars 12m thedhi tarban kadarkaraiyai migapperiya alai thaakkiyadhu endru kurippittirundhaar. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video 2025 joolai 30m thedhi rashyaavai sunaami thaakkiya kaatchi illai enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: 69 vinaayagar silai karaippu
text:
Idaippaadi: vinaayagar sadhurthi mudindhu, 5m naalaana netru sangagiri, idaippaadi thaalugaakkalil vaikkap-pattirundha, 30 silaigal, kalvadangam kaaviri aatril karaikkappattana. Kadandha, 5 naatkalaaga, 3 adikku uyaramaana, 1,316 silaigal karaikkappat-tullana.
Adhevol poolaambattiyil ulla poolaambatti kaaviri aaru, kuppanoor, koodakkal pagudhigalil ulla kaaviri aatril, 5 naatkalil, 575 silaigal karaikkappattana. Adhevol keng-ka valli aruge thammambattiyil, indhu mun-nani saarbil vinaayagar sadhurthikku, 39 silaigal piradhishdai seythu vazhivattanar. Netru thammambatti bus staandil irundhu oorvalamaaga, sendhaarappatti erikku sendru silaigalai karaithanar.

headline: Paajaga.,vudan meendum koottani vaippadhu tharkolaikku samam endru semmalai koorinaaraa?
text:
‘’paajaga.,vudan meendum koottani vaippadhu tharkolaikku samam,’’ endru ADMK munnaal amaichar semmalai kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’Edappadi Palaniswami maruvariseelanai seyya vendum
ADMK BJP-yudan meendum koottani enbadhu tha*kolaikku samam, enave podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami idhanai maruvariseelanai seyya vendum; illaiyel ADMK-vai kadavuldhaan kaappaatra vendum- ADMK munnaal amaichar semmalai,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Thandhi TV logo idambetrulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sameevathil Delhi sendra ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami, BJP mootha thalaivarum, mathiya uldhurai amaicharumaana amith shaavai neril sandhithup pesinaar. Idhanaal, varum Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhalil ADMK matrum BJP idaiye koottani erpada vaayppulladhaagap palarum karuthu therivithu varugindranar.
Ithagaiya soozhalil, Edappadi pazhanisaamikku edhiraaga munnaal amaichar semmalai karuthu veliyittadhu pondru kurippittu, merkanda vagaiyil, thandhi TV logovudan koodiya news card ondrai samooga valaidhalangalil pagirvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
Idhil ulladhu pondru, semmalai karuthu therivithaaraa endru, selathil ulla avaradhu aluvalagathai thodarbu kondu vilakkam kettom. ‘ivvaaru semmalai edhuvum sameeva naatkalil karuthu koorave illai’, endru avargal vilakkam alithanar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, thandhi TV digital pirivu nirvaagiyidam idhuvatri vilakkam kettom. Avarum, ‘’idhuvondra news card edhuvum naangal veliyidavillai. Yaaro vishamathanamaaga engaladhu logovai payanbaduthi, ivvaaru vadhandhi parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithaar.
Ivatrin adippadaiyil, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyaanadhu endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

text:

Ivar thaan ezhaiyin kanneerai thudaikka pogiraar 🙄
#tharkurigal_maanaadu’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadam patriya thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha pugaippadathirkum, sameevathil nadaivetra TVK, Madurai maanaattirkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, vavijay thalaimaiyil, TVK, Maduraiyil maanaadu nadathiyadhu aagast 25, 2025 andru. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda sogusu vaaganathin pugaippadam kadandha 2012m aandu mudhale samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappadum ondraaga ulladhu.
Kadandha 2012m aandu keralaavai serndha nadigar Prithviraj Sukumaran indha sogusu vaaganathai vaangiyadhaagak koori, Ojes Automobiles Facebook-il erkanave padhivu veliyittulladhu.
Idhanmoolamaaga, keravan thayaarippukku peyar petra Ojes Automobiles vadivamaitha sogusu vaaganathai Prithviraj vaangiyulladhu, thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
irudhiyaaga, Prithviraj thanadhu adhigaarappoorva Facebook pakkathil 2012m aandu veliyitta padhivai inge inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadathirkum, TVK Madurai maanaattirkum endha thodarbum illai endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mudhiyavarai kaaril kadathi seyin, modhiram parippu
text:
Tirunelveli: thengaasi maavattam Kadayanallur meyin pajaarais serndhavar sandhaanagirushnan 76. Ivar panjju methai viyaavaaram seythu varugiraar.
Netru mundhinam madhiyam 3:30 maniyalavil kadaiyil irundha avarai marmanavargal kaaril kadathichendranar. Kaaril vaithu avaradhu kazhuthil irundha 15 kiraam thangacheyin, kaiyil anindhirundha 8 kiraam modhirathai parithu kondanar. Pin Kadayanallur pudhiya bus staant aruge avarai irakkivittu kaaril thappis sendranar.
Idhugurithu sandhaanagirushnan Kadayanallur poleesil pugaar alithaar. Police appagudhiyil ulla kangaanippu kemaraa kaatchigalai aayvu seythu, kaarin padhivu ennai adippadaiyaaga kondu andha navargalai thedi varugindranar.
Visaaranaiyil kaaril payanbaduthiyadhu poli padhiven ena theriya vandhadhu. Idhugurithu Police thodarndhu visaarikkindranar.

headline: Thavaraana seythi veliyittadharkaaga varutham therivitha Polimer TV endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Trichy pen tharkolai vivagaaram thodarbaaga thavaraana seythiyai veliyittadharku varutham ketkirom endru Polimer TV news card veliyittadhu pondru oru padhivu

Polimer TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “thavaraana seythiyai veliyittadharku varutham! Trichy manachanallooril kudumbath thagaraaril pen oruvar thookkittu tharkolai seythu konda sambavathil oru katchiyai thodarbu paduthi thavaraana seythi veliyittadharku varutham therivithukkolgirom” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Trichy maavattam manachanallooril therdhalil parisup porutkal tharaadhadhaik kanditha pennai DMK nirvaagigal thaakkiyadhaagavum adhanaal andha pen tharkolai seythu kondadhaagavum seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga DMK nirvaagigalai Police kaidhu seythullanar. Indha nilaiyil, indha seythi thavaraanadhu endru Polimer TV varutham therivithulladhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
DMK nirvaagigal indha vivagaarathil kaidhu seyyappattulladhaaga seythigal veliyaagi ullanilaiyil, indha seythi thavaraanadhu endru Polimer TV kooriyiruppadhaaga paravum news card poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom. Ippadi oru news card-ai Polimer TV veliyittulladhaa endru adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarthom. Adhil appadi edhuvum veliyaagavillai.
Enave, indha news card-ai Polimer TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Melum, idhu thodarbaaga X thalathil padhivu veliyittu adhai namakku anuppinaar. Adhil, “paalimar seythigal veliyittadhaaga samooga valaidhalathil paravi varum indha card poliyaanadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga Polimer seythigal maruppu edhuvum therivikkavillai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Aasiya koppai magalir kirikket; Indhiya ani 149 ran kuvippu
text:
Thuvaay: vangadhesathirku edhiraana aasiya koppai magalir kirikket pottiyin araiyirudhiyil Indhiya ani 20 ovar mudivil, 6 vikket izhappirku 149 ran kuvithulladhu.
Thuvaayil nadandhu varum aasiya koppai magalir kirikket thodar irudhigattathai ettiyulladhu. Leek sutrugalin mudivil India, ilangai, vangadhesam matrum Pakistan anigal araiyirudhikku thagudhi petrullana.
Indha nilaiyil, thuvaayil indru nadaivetra mudhal araiyirudhi pottiyil India - vangadhesa anigal modhi varugindrana. Indhap pottiyil taas vendra vangadhesa ani mudhalil pavulingai thervu seythadhu. Adhanbadi, Indhiya anikku vazhakkam pola, shavaali varmaa, smiridhi mandhanaa thuvakka veeraanganaigalaaga kalamiranginar.
Aniyin sgor 9ai ettiya podhu, smiridhi mandhanaa verum 2 rannil avuttaagi adhirchi koduthaar. Adhanbiragu, piradhigaa raaval 20 rannil avuttaanaar. Marumunaiyil adhiradiyaaga aadiya shavaali varmaa indhappottiyilum araisadham adithaar. 40 pandhil 64 ran kuvithu avuttaanaar. Thodarndhu, richaa kosh (24), theepdhi sharmaa (13) aagiyor oralavukku pangalippai koduthanar.
Irudhiyil 20 ovar mudivil Indhiya ani 6 vikket izhappirku 149 ran kuvithulladhu. Kepdan harmanpreeth kavur 24 ran kuvithu kadaisi varai aattamizhakkaamal irundhaar.
Vangadhesa ani tharappil suldhaanaa 2 vikkettum, maruvaa akdhar, nahidhaa akdhar, revaayaa kaan aagiyor thalaa oru vikkettaiyum kaippatrinar.

headline: Pilippainsil piramaanda sogusu kappalil payangara thee; 5 per pali... 80kkum merpattor maayam
text:
Manilaa: pilippainsil payanigal sogusu kappalil erpatta payangara theeyil sikki 5 per paliyaaginar. Melum, 80kkum merpattor maayamaagiyullanar. Avargalai thedum pani nadandhu varugiradhu.
Thalainagar manilaavilirundhu sutrulaath thalamaana palaavanin koron pagudhikkus sendra 'emvi joon aastar' endra piramaanda sogusu kappalil 117 payanigal, 17 oozhiyargal ena motham 134 per sendru kondirundhanar. Nadukkadalil sendru kondirundha podhu, kappalil thideerena theevivathu erpattulladhu. Idhu kappalin matra pagudhigalukkum paraviyadhu.
Kolundhu vittu erindha indhath theevivathil 5 per uyirizhandhanar. Palar theeyil irundhu uyiraik kaappaatrik kolla kadalil kudhithullanar. Avargalil orusilar meetkappatta nilaiyil, 80kkum merpattor thanneeril maayamaagiyullanar. Avargalai thedum paniyil pilippains kadarpadaiyinar thedi varugindranar.
Idhanidaiye, kappalil vaaganangal niruthi vaikkappattirundha keezhthalap pagudhiyil irundhu payangara vedichatham kettadhaaga uyir thappiya oruvar therivithullaar. Iruppinum, kappalil erpatta theevivathu kuritha thulliyamaana kaaranam patri visaarikkappattu varugiradhu.

headline: Irandu thanithani uruppugalaa manidha moolai? Veliyaana aayvu!!
text:
Manidha moolai ore uruppaagak karudhappattuvandha nilaikku maaraaga, adhu iru thanithani narambu mandalangalin inaippaaga uruvaagiyirukkalaam endru America-vin staanbort palgalaikkazhaga aayvaalargal kandarindhullanar. Idhu kurithup paarkkalaam.
Idhuvarai nadathappatta aayvugalinbadi, moolai muzhuvadhum ore vagai mudhanmais sellil irundhu uruvaavadhaagave nambappattadhu. Aanaal, karu valarchiyinbodhe moolaiyin munbagudhi matrum pin pagudhi aagiya irandum mutrilum vevveru selgalil irundhu iru inaiyaana paadhaigalil valargindrana enbadhai aaraaychiyaalargal kanduvidithullanar.
Idhan moolam, manidhanin uyar sindhanai matrum mozhith thiranaik kattuppaduthum munbagudhiyum, suvaasam matrum idhayath thudippaik kattuppaduthum pinbagudhiyum iru veruvatta narambu mandalangalaagave seyalbadugindrana enbadhu urudhiyaagiyulladhu. Munbu, pinbagudhi selgalai aayvagangalil uruvaakka mudiyaamal irundhadhaal thasainaar sidhaivu noy pondra moolaith thandu thodarbaana theevira noygalukkuth theervu kaanbadhil perum savaalgal irundhana. Tharpodhaiya kanduvidippin moolam, moolaiyin pinbagudhi narambugalai aayvagathil thaniyaaga valarthu, idhuvondra kodoora noygalukkaana pudhiya sigichaigalaik kandariya vazhivagai erpattulladhu.

headline:

text:

Seythiyaalar: thurgaa thevi sa
mudhal muraiyaaga, veettin koorai mel minsaaram urpathi seyyum solaar penalgalai amaippavargalukku roo.22,000 varai nidhiyudhavi vazhangum thittathai Thamizhaga arasu sepdambar 21 andru thodangi vaithulladhu. 3KW minsaaram urpathi seyvadharkaana solaar penalgalukku mathiya arasu maaniyamaaga roo. 78,000 vazhangugiradhu; idhanudan maanila arasu maaniyam roo. 22,000 vazhangappattu, sumaar 1 latcham varai indha maaniyam kidaikkum enak koorappattulladhu.
Kaalanilai maatram pondra pala kaaranangalaal kaatraalai minsaara urpathiyil migap periya veezhchi erpattulladhu. Idhanaal, palveru minvettup pirasnaigal Thamizhagathil erpattirukkindrana. Idhaith thodarndhu, Tamil Nadu arasu velichandhaigalil irundhu koodudhal vilai koduthu minsaarathai vaangi varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, veedugalin koorai mel minsaaram urpathi seyvadharkum, min kattanathaik kuraippadharkum, sooriya veppathil irundhu minsaaram urpathi seyyum solaar penalgalai amaithida roo. 22,000 varai maaniyam vazhangum thittathaith Thamizhaga arasu thodangiyulladhu.
Erkenave mathiya arasin piradhama mandhiri soorya kar thittathin moolam, 3KW varaiyilaana minsaaram urpathi seyyum solaar penal amaikka roo.78,000 nidhiyudhavi kidaikkum. Idhanudan tharpodhaiya maanila arasin maaniyathaiyum serthukkondaal, veettin koorai mel solaar penal amaippavargal oru latcham roobai varai nidhiyudhavi pera mudiyum.
Idharkaaga roo. 50 kodi odhukkeedu seythulladhaaga Thamizhaga minsaarathurai amaichar aar.nirmalgumaar sattamandrathil arivithirundhaar. Erisakdhith thuraiyaal veliyidappatta arasaanaiyil, mathiya arasin thittam varum maars 2027-il mudivadaivadharkul 1 latcham payanaalargalais serkkum vagaiyil ithittam seyalbadum enak kurippidappattulladhu. Tamil Nadu erisakdhi kazhagathin indha munmozhivukku maanila arasu oppudhal alithadhu.
TNGECL, mathiya arasu inaiyadhalathilirundhu vinnappadhaarargalin tharavugalaip petru, sevai seyalbaattirku vandhavin, vinnappadhaarargalin vangik kanakkirku neradiyaaga maanila arasin maaniyam seluthappadum ena arivithulladhu.
1KW minsaaram urpathi seyvadharkaana solaar penalgalukku maaniyamaaga mathiya arasu roo. 30,000 vazhangugiradhu, athudan tharpodhu maanila arasu roo. 5,000 maaniyam vazhangugiradhu. 2KW minsaaram urpathi seyyum solaar penal amaikka mathiya arasin nidhi roo. 60,000-udan maanila arasu roo. 10,000 maaniyam vazhangugiradhu. 3KW minsaaram urpathi seyvadharkaana solaar penalgalukku mathiya arasu maaniyamaaga roo. 78,000 vazhangugiradhu; idhanudan maanila arasu maaniyam roo. 22,000 vazhangappattu, sumaar 1 latcham varai indha maaniyam kidaikkum enak koorappattulladhu.
Vinnappadhaarargal mathiya arasin pmsuryaghar.gov.in endra inaiyathalam vaayilaagath thangalin vivarangalai ullittu solaar penal amaippadharkaana maanila arasin maaniyathirku padhivu seythugollalaam. Pinnar arasu adhigaarigalaal vinnappam pariseelikkappattu angeegarikkappadum. Aduthu pinbatra vendiya vazhimuraigalai avargale eduthuraippaargal endru therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: Aaravalli malaiyaik kaakka poraattathil eeduvatta makkal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:

Mothathil Indhiya kudimakkal evanume sandhoshamaaga illai sangigalaith thavira” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Aaravalli malaith thodar thodarbaaga mathiya arasin parindhuraigalai etru ucha Needhimandram maruvaraiyarai vazhangiyadhu. Idhaith thodarndhu vada India-vil poraattangal vedithana. Appadi aaravalli malaith thodar paadhugaappukkaaga makkal poraattathil eeduvattadhaaga oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Sila vaarangalukku munbu peegaar therdhal thodarbaaga idhe video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Peegaaril BJP vetrikku edhiraaga makkal poraattathil eeduvattadhaaga indha video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Adhu thavaraanadhu endru appodhu nammudaiya fekt kirasando thamizhil katturai veliyittirundhom. Tharpodhu, aaravalli malai paadhugaappukkaaga adhe video-vai silar padhivittullanar. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga viraivu aayvu seythom.
Indha perani kujaraath maanilam nethraang (Netrang) endra ooril 2025 navambaril nadandhadhu. Kujaraathin aam aathmi katchi em.el.e-vaana saidhar vaasvaa (Chaitar Vasava) appodhu aadhivaasi inath thalaivaraana maraindha pirsaa mundaavin 150vadhu aandu vizhaavaik kondaadiyavodhu adhil kalandhugonda aayirakkanakkaana aadhivaasi ina makkal endrum seythigal namakkuk kidaithana.
Appodhe nethraang endra oorin koogul street viyoo kaatchiyum, video-vil idam petra pagudhigalin thotramum ondraaga iruppadhai urudhi seythirundhom. Melum, video-vil pirsaa mundaavin oviyathudan koodiya penargal idam petrirundhadhaiyum aadhaaramaagak kaattiyirundhom.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda indha video-vil Super Zankar endru oru vaaganathil ezhudhiyiruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil thediya podhu, navambar 15, 2025 andru kujaraath maanilam nethraang endra ooril pirsaa mundaavin jeyandhi vizhaa kondaadappatta podhu Super Zankar isaik kuzhuvin isai nigazhchi nadathappattadhaagap pala video-kkal namakkuk kidaithana.
Adhil idam petra idangalum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil ulla idamum ondraaga iruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha video aaravalli malaithodaraip paadhugaakka makkal poraattathil eeduvattavodhu edukkappatta video idhu illai enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Arasiyal arivu illaadhavar raagul; therdhal aanaiyam kuritha vimarsanathirku paaja padhiladi
text:
Pudhudilli: therdhal aanaiyam kurithu kadum vimarsanangalai munvaitha Congress embiyum, lok savaa edhirkkatchi thalaivarumaana raagulukku arasiyal arivu illai endru paaja seythi thodarbaalar sudhaansu thirivedhi padhiladi koduthullaar.
Indru maalai seythiyaalargalai sandhitha raagul, therdhal aanaiyathin meedhu adukkadukkaana kutrachaattugalai munvaithadhudan, thalaimai therdhal adhigaari njaanesh kumaar padhavi vilaga vendum endru valiyuruthinaar. Avaradhu indhak kutrachaattukku paaja seythith thodarbaalar sudhaansu thirivedhi padhiladi koduthullaar.
Avar kooriyadhaavadhu; : Congress katchiyaal thanadhu sondha palathil endhavoru therdhalilum vetri pera mudiyavillai. Vayanaattil piriyangaa muslim leekkin aadharavodudhaan vetri petraar. 1977m aandu mudhal merku vangathil kaangirasaal aatchiyaip pidikka mudiyavillai. 1990l irundhu peehaar aatchik kattilil Congress amarndhadhillai. Adhevola, utharaviradhesam, odisaa maanilangalilum sumaar 30 aandugalaaga kaangirasookku vetriye illai.
Raagulukku arasiyal arivu enbadhe illai. Esaiaar nadaimuraiyil ulla kularuvadigal kurithu veliyaagi varum arikkaiyil therdhal aanaiyargalin arivippu patri endhak karuthukkalum idamberavillai. Appadiyirukkaiyil adhanai eppadi namba mudiyum, ivvaaru kelvi ezhuppinaar.

headline: Aathoor aruge kodooram.. Kudumba thagaraaril manaivi meedhu aasit veesiya kanavan!
text:
Salem maavattam Aathoor aruge aanaikkal medu pagudhiyais serndha aarumugam, kudumba thagaraaril aathiram adaindhu thanadhu manaivi muthammaalin meedhu aasit ootri kodooram seythullaar. 60 vayadhaana muthammaal padugaayam adaindhu Aathoor arasu maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattullaar.
Salem maavattam Aathoor aruge aanaikkal medu pagudhiyais serndhavar aarumugam avaradhu manaivi muthammaal (60). Aarumugam sego aalaiyil koolithozhilaaliyaaga paniyaatri varugiraar.
Innilaiyil kanavan manaivi idaiye thagaraaru erpattadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Idhil aathiram adaindha aarumugam muthammaal meedhu aaseet ootri ullaar. Idhil padugaayam adaindha muthammaal Aathoor arasu maruthuvamanaiyil sigichaikkaaga anumadhikkappattullaar. Idhugurithu Aathoor nagara Police visaaranai merkondu varugindranar.

headline: TMC sinnam, peyar mudakkam.. Mamdhaavukku melum oru adi? Therdhal aanaiyam mukkiya arivippu!!
text:
Merkuvanga sattapperavaith therdhal tholviyaith thodarndhu utkatchi modhalgalaal thirinaamul Congress katchi 2 pirivugalaaga pilavuvattirukkum nilaiyil netraiya thinam, akkatchiyin peyaraiyum, adhan adhigaarappoorva 'pookkal matrum pul' (Flowers and Grass) sinnathaiyum mudakki therdhal aanaiyam idaikkaala utharavu pirappithirundhadhu.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, mamdhaa paanarji matrum ridhapradhaa paanarji thalaimaiyilaana iru pirivugalukkum thanithani katchip peyar matrum sinnangalai odhukki therdhal aanaiyam tharpodhu utharavittulladhu. Ammaanilathil, adutha maadham 2 thogudhigalukkaana idaitherdhal nadakkavirukkum nilaiyil, therdhal aanaiyathin indha nadavadikkai thesiya alavil kavanam petrulladhu.
294 thogudhigalaik konda merkuvanga sattapperavaith therdhal 2 kattangalaaga kadandha epral maadham nadaivetradhu. Mamdhaa paanarji thalaimaiyilaana thirinaamul Congress thodarchiyaaga, 4 vadhu muraiyaaga vendru aatchiyamaikkumaa? Endru edhirbaarppu nilaviya nilaiyil thaan, 208 thogudhigalil vendru merkuvangathil mudhanmuraiyaaga aatchiyaip pidithulladhu BJP akkatchiyin suvendhu adhigaari mudhalamaicharaaga poruppetrirukkiraar.
Adhesamayam, mamdhaa thalaimaiyilaana thirinaamul Congress 80 idangalai mattume vendru edhirkkatchiyaanadhu. Aanaal, sattamandrath therdhal tholvikkup piragu, akkatchiyil erpatta utkatchip poosal kaaranamaaga mamdhaa paanarji tharappu matrum edhirkkatchith thalaivar ridhaapradhaa paanarji tharappu ena iru pirivaaga thirinaamul Congress seyalbattu varugiradhu. Idhil, mamdhaa tharappirku verum 15 em.el.e-kkalin aadharavu mattume iruppadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Melum, akkatchiyin 20 makkalavai uruppinargalum en.ti.e. Koottanikku maatruk katchikku sendradhudan, en.ti.e koottani aadharavalippadhaaga therivithirukkindranar.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, 3 murai mudhalvaraaga irundha mamdhaa ”katchiyai naan meendum aarambathil irundhu pudhidhaagak katti ezhuppuven" ena therivithirukkiraar. Eninum, ridhapradhaa paanarji tharappu, ”thangalukke katchiyin sinnam matrum peyar vendum” ena therdhal aanaiyathil urimai koriyirukkiradhu. Idhaithodarndhu, therdhal aanaiyam netru veliyittirundha oru arikkaiyil, therdhal sinnangal (odhukkeedu matrum pangeedu) aanai, 1968'-n pathi 15-n keezh, iru pirivinarum thirinaamul Congress peyar matrum sinnathaip payanbadutha thadai vidhithadhu. Melum, indha vazhakkil irudhi theerppu varum varai 2anigalum tharkaaliga sinnam matrum peyarai payanbaduthum padi therdhal aanaiyam therivithirundhadhu.
Melum, iru anigalum thangalukku viruppamaana peyargalaiyum, therdhal aanaiyam arivithulla suyechai sinnangalin pattiyalil irundhu thalaa sinnangalaiyum thervu seythu sepdambar 18-m thedhi, adhaavadhu indru kaalai 11 manikkul samarppikka vendum enavum utharavidappattirundhadhu. Idhaithodarndhu, thaangale unmaiyaana thirinamool katchi enbadhil urudhiyaaga irukkum mamdhaa paanarji thalaimaiyilaana kuzhu, "kadumaiyaana edhirppaip padhivu seythavaare" thanadhu maatrup peyar matrum sinna viruppangalai aanaiyathidam samarppithadhu. Matroru aniyum, thangaladhu viruppangalai therdhal aanaiyathidam arivithirundhadhu.
Indhanilaiyil thaan, mamdhaa thalaimaiyilaana pirivukku "kaalbandhu " sinnam odhukkappattulladhu. Melum, andha ani "mamdhaa agila Indhiya thirinaamul Congress" engira peyarai payanbaduthalaam ena therdhal aanaiyam therivithirukkiradhu. Adhevola, ridhaapradhaa tharappukku, ‘jananaayaga thirinaamul Congress’ endra peyarum anjjal urai" sinnamum odhukkeedu seyyappattullana. Merku vaanga maanilathil varum, akdovar 6-aam thedhi nandhigiraam matrum rejinagar sattamandra thogudhigalil idaitherdhal nadaiveravulla nilaiyil, therdhal aanaiyam indha tharkaaliga mudivai eduthirukkiradhu. Adhesamayam, utkatchi vivagaaram kuritha irudhith theerppai therdhal aanaiyam vazhangum varai indha erpaadu amalil irukkum enavum therivikkappattirukkiradhu.
Eninum, therdhal aanaiyathin indha mudivukku arasiyal katchith thalaivargal kadum kandanangalai therivithu varugindranar. Kurippaaga, indha vivagaaram kurithup pesiyulla makkalavai edhirkkatchith thalaivar raagulgaandhi, "mudhalil sivasenaa, piragu thesiyavaadha Congress, ippodhu thirinaamul Congress ovvoru muraiyum, ore paaniyil paajagavum therdhal aanaiyamum ondru serndhu, oru katchiyaip pilavuvaduthugindrana; pinnar adhan therdhal sinnathaip parithuk kolgindrana” ena vimarsithirukkiraar.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, thirinaamul Congress katchiyin peyar matrum sinnathai therdhal aanaiyam mudakkiyiruppadhu thesiya alavil kavanam petrulladhu.

headline: Riyaath vimaana nilaiyam aruge karumbugaiyudan theeppizhambugal: havudhi thaakkudhal ena payanigal acham
text:
Riyaath: riyaath sarvadhesa vimaana nilaiyam arugil karum pugaimandalathudan theeppizhambugal kaanappattadhaal payanigal acham adaindhanar. Idhu havudhi kilarchi padaiyin thaakkudhalaaga irukkalaam endru neril kandavargal koori ullanar.
Savudhi areviyaavukkum, emanin kilarchippadaikkum idaiye por innamum oyavillai. Punidha mekkaa nagarai kurivaithu, havudhi kilarchippadai netru thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu. Indha tron thaakkudhalai savudhi areviyaa muriyadithadhu.
Irudharappu modhal edhiroliyaaga, mathiya kizhakkil thodarndhu padhatram adhigarithu varugiradhu. In nilaiyil, savudhi areviyaavin thalainagar riyaathil ulla sarvadhesa vimaana nilaiyam aruge oru kurippitta pagudhiyil irundhu karumbugaiyum, theeppizhambum ezhuvadhai angullor kandanar.
Pala adi uyarathirku vaan nokki ezhundha karumbugaiyai kanda palarum, idhu havudhi kilarchippadaiyin thaakkudhalaaga irukkalaam endru sandhegam therivithanar. Indha kaatchigal adangiya video ondru samooga valai thalangalil vegamaaga paravi varugiradhu. Sarvadhesa oodagangalilum indha video kaatchigal veliyidappattu ullana.
Karumbugai mandalam, theeppizhambugal kaaranamaaga, vaanvazhippaadhaiyil vimaanangal varugai matrum purappaadil thaamadham nilavuvadhaaga pilait raadaar 24 inaiyadhala tharavugalil kurippidappattu ulladhu. Riyaath vimaana nilaiyam aruge ezhundha karumbugai mandalam, theeppizhambugal matrum vimaana pokkuvarathu paadhippu kurithu savudhi areviyaa arasu endha thagavalaiyum veliyidavillai.
Munnadhaaga, havudhi kilarchippadaiyin thaakkudhalgal adhigarithulla nilaiyil, thalainagar riyaathai sutri erpadakkoodum aavathugal kurithu savudhi areviyaa netriravu muzhuvadhum echarikkai arivippugalai veliyittuk konde irundhadhu, kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Trichy kaaviriyaatril kulitha ai.ti.ai., maanavar maayam
text:
Trichy: Trichy aruge kaaviri aatrin thaduppanaiyil kulikkumbodhu maayamaana ai.ti.ai., maanavarai theeyanaippu padaiyinar thedi varugindranar.
Trichy kallukkuzhiyais serndha auto tiraivar sureshgumaar. Ivaradhu magan paarthasaaradhi, 17. Ivar, thiruverumbooril ulla ai.ti.ai.,yil mudhalaandu padithu vandhaar. Netru madhiyam, 3 maniyalavil, thanadhu nanbargal naangu perudan serndhu, kambarasambettai kaaviri aatrin thaduppanaiyil paarthasaaradhi kulikka sendraar.
Kaaviriyil thanneer adhigam varuvadhaal, izhuvaiyum adhigam ulladhu. Idhai ariyaamal paarthasaaradhi aazhamaana pagudhiyil sendru kulithavodhu maayamaanaar. Avarudan sendra, naangu nanbargalum koochalida, angirundhavargal udanadiyaaga jeeyavuram poleesaarukkum, theeyanaippudhuraiyinarukkum thagaval therivithanar. Adhanberil sambava idathukku vandha theeyanaipputhuraiyinar, aatril moozhgiya maanavarai thedi varugindranar.

headline: Chennai | pagalil lepdaap.. Iravil raakket : ilainjargalin pudhiya pitnas tirent!!
text:
Chennai ullitta metro nagarangalil velai mudindhaviragu, iravu nerathil petmindan vilaiyaadum ilainjargalin ennikkai adhigarithuvarugiradhu. Kurippaaga ai.ti. Oozhiyargal, thaniyaar niruvana oozhiyargal, kalloori maanavargal iravunera slaatkalai thervu seythu vilaiyaadivarugindranar. Pagal nerathil velaippalu adhigamaaga iruppadhaal, iravil12 mani varai vilaiyaaduvadhai palar vazhakkamaaga vaithullanar.
Sila ulvilaiyaattu arangugal nalliravu varai petmindan vilaiyaaduvadharkaana vasadhigalai vazhanguvadhaal, nanbargal kuzhuvaaga serndhu 2 mani nerathirku Court puk seythu vilaiyaaduvadhu vazhakkamaaga ulladhu. Aluvalagathil neenda neram amarndhu paniyaatruvavargalukku, velaikkuppiragu udal iyakkam kidaippadhu mukkiyamaanadhaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Ivvaarum, iravugal uranguvadharkaanadhu mattumalla, thangalai reesaarj seythugolvadharkumaanadhumdhaan, enbadhai niroovikkiraargal Chennai vaazh ilainjargal.

headline: Kadaloor| 3 vayadhu sirumikku paaliyal thollai.. Maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhi!
text:
Kadalooril 3 vayadhu sirumi meedhu paaliyal thollai nadandhadhu thodarbaaga mudhunagar Police Pocso sattathin keezh vazhakkuppadhivu seythu theevira visaaranai nadathi varugindranar. Mudhalgatta visaaranaiyil 17 vayadhu siruvan sambandhappattadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu.
Kadalooril 3 vayadhu sirumikku nadandha kodoora sambavam perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Paadhikkappatta sirumiyin thaay pajji kadai nadathi varuvadhaal thinamum kaalaiyil kuzhandhaiyai paalvaadikku anuppivittu kadaikku sendru viduvadhu vazhakkam. Adhan piragu kuzhandhai veettin aruge ulla oruvaradhu veettil iruppadhu vazhakkam ena koorappadugiradhu. Innilaiyildhaan indha paaliyal kodoora sambavam arangeriyulladhu.
Paadhikkappatta sirumi tharpodhu kadaloor arasu maruthuvamanaiyil sigichai petru varugiraar. Sirumiyai paarkka vendum ena uravinargal koottamaaga maruthuvamanaikkul nuzhaiya muyandravodhu, koottamaaga varakkoodaadhu ena kaavaldhuraiyinar thaduthadhaal kadum vaakkuvaadham erpattadhu.
Maruthuvamanaiyil noyaaligal iruppadhaal koottamaaga yaarum nuzhaiyakkoodaadhu, ratha sondhangalil pengalaaga irundhaal mattum ulle sendru paarkkalaam ena kaavaldhurai therivithadhu. Idhanaal nalliravil kadaloor arasu maruthuvamanaiyil perum paravarappu erpattadhu. Neenda nera vaakkuvaadhathirku piragu uravinargal kalaindhu sendranar.
Ichambavam kurithu mudhunagar Police Pocso vazhakkuppadhivu seythu theevira visaaranai merkondu varugindranar. Mudhalgatta visaaranaiyil 17 vayadhu siruvan icheyalil eeduvattadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulla nilaiyil, sambandhappatta navarai pidithu Police visaaranai nadathi varugindranar.

headline: DMK vandhadhaal Thamizhaga makkal piraamanargal kaalil vizhuvadhai niruthivittanar endru kurumoorthi koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘DMK vandhadhaal Thamizhaga makkal piraamanargal kaalil vizhuvadhai niruthivittanar,’’ endru thuklak aasiriyar kurumoorthi kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ azhindhuvona piraamanargal mariyaadhai
DMK aatchikku varuvadharku mun piraamanargal meedhu anaivarum mariyaadhai vaithu irundhaargal. Aanaal 1967-l DMK aatchikku vandhavin piraamanargal kaalil vizhundhu vanangum indhu madhathin punidhap panbaadu azhikkappattu vittadhu. Idhanaaleye naan RSS iyakkathil serndhen”- thuklak kurumoorthi,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu poyyaana thagaval endru, thuklak aasiriyar kurumoorthi erkanave maruppu therivithulladhaik kandom.
Enave naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Jandhar mandhar poraattathil pangetra maanavi maranam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘jandhar mandhar poraattathil pangetra maanavi maranam’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’jandhar mandhar kalathil uyir neetha maanavikku aazhndha irangalgal,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan ilamben oruvarin pugaippadamum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu AI moolamaaga thayaarikkappatta postar endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhevondru, Delhi Police saarbaaga, maruppu therivikkappattulladhu. Adhanaiyum aadhaarathirkaaga inge inaithullom.
Idhanbadi, kadandha joolai 20 andru jandhar mandhar poraattathil kalandhugonda Sakshi endra ilamben, Police thadiyadi nadathiyavodhu, koottathil sikki, kaayamadaindhadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Udane, avar Ram Manohar Lohla Hospital kondu sellappattu, angu avasara sigichaip pirivil serkkappattaar. Tharpodhu varai avar sigichaiyildhaan ullaar. Aanaal, avar uyirizhandhuvittadhaaga, AI moolamaaga oru pugaippadathai vendumendre thayaarithu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
Indian Express l Hindustan Times l The Wire
irudhiyaaga, naam aayvu seyyum postar AI moolamaaga thayaarikkappatta ondrudhaan enbadhai Sightengine, Hive Detect pondra inaiyadhalangal udhaviyudan sarivaarthu, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Seenaavil modiyai varavetru tron sho nadathappattadhaa?
text:
Seenaavil indhiyap piradhamar narendhira modiyai varaverkum vagaiyil tron sho nadathappattadhaaga oru pugaippadam

China sendra piradhamar narendhira modiyai varaverkum vagaiyil vaanathil lesar alladhu tron moolam oli-oli kaatchi nadathappattadhaaga oru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “seenaavil piradhamar narendhira Modi-kku amoga varaverpu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sila aandugalukku munbu ladaakkil kalvaan pallathaakkil Indhiya – China padaigalukku idaiye modhal erpattadhu. Idhil Indhiya veerargal 20 per uyirizhandhanar. Idhaith thodarndhu seenaavukku edhiraana nadavadikkaigalai Indhiya arasu eduthadhu. Tharpodhu indhiyaavukkum amerikkaavukkum varthagam thodarbaana pirasnai ezhundhulla soozhalil piradhamar narendhira Modi-yin China payanam mukkiyathuvam vaayndhadhaagap paarkkappattadhu.
Seenaavil indhiyap piradhamar narendhira Modi-kku sirappaana varaverpu alikkappattadhu. Idhai vaithu BJP aadharavaalargal palveru padhivugalai samooga oodagangalil veliyittu varugindranar. Andha vagaiyil lesar sho nadathappattadhu pondru oru pugaippadam samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Aanaal, appadi oru seythi veliyaagavillai. Modi-yin China payanam thodarbaaga ANI seythi niruvanam thodarndhu padhivugalai veliyittu vandhadhu. Adhil kooda naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu illai. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra aanaal Modi-yin padam illaadha padam ondru 2025 epral 20m thedhi seythi oodagam ondril veliyaagi iruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, China-vin songingil (Chongqing) tron moolam oli – oli kaatchi nadathappattadhu. Andha ooril ovvoru sanik kizhamaigalilum matrum vidumurai naatkalilum indha tron oli – oli kaatchi 15 nimidangalukku nadathappaduvadhu vazhakkamaana ondru endrum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha tron oli- oli nigazhchiyin video kaatchigalum kooda namakkuk kidaithana. Aanaal, piradhamar narendhira modiyai varaverkum vagaiyil andha idathil oli-oli kaatchi nadathappattadhaaga endha oru seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Piradhamar narendhira modiyudan payanitha ANI seythi niruvanam kooda appadi oru seythiyai veliyidavillai.
Modiyai varaverkum vagaiyil seenaavil tron oli-oli kaatchiyai nadathiyirundhaal Modi-yin padathai mattum thaniyaaga vaithu seythirukkalaam. Aanaal, erkanave ulla oru kaatchiyil koodudhalaaga Modi-yin padathai vaithullanar. Paarkkum podhe idhu koodudhalaaga edit seythu vaithiruppadhu therigiradhu. Idhe pondru modiyai vimarsikkum vagaiyil oli-oli kaatchi nadathappattadhaagak Congress ullitta katchigalais saarndhavargalum pugaippadathai edit seythu veliyittirundhadhaiyum nammudaiya thedalil kaana mudindhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Satham potta oozhiyargal.. Thattik ketta isaikkalainjar.. Telliyil nerndha sogam!
text:
Telliyil manippoorais serndha piravala kittaar isaik kalainjar saangdhaam vikram sing adithuk kollappatta sambavam perum paravarappaiyum adhirchiyaiyum erpaduthiyulladhu. Avar veettaruge irundha unavaga oozhiyargal urakkas sathamittu idaiyooru seythadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Idhanaal pirasnai mutriyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Manippoorais serndhavar saangdhaam vikram sing. Piravala kittaar isaikkalainjarum isai aasiriyarumaana ivar, thengizhakku telliyin kilokri pagudhiyil vasithu vandhaar. Indha nilaiyil kadandha sepdambar 6aam thedhi vikram sing veettin aruge irundha unavaga oozhiyargal silar urakkas sathamittu idaiyooru seythadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Idhai vikram sing thattik kettullaar. Idhanaal erpatta vaay thagaraaru mutrave, 8 per konda kumbal avaraith thurathis sendru, avaradhu kudiyiruppu valaagathin 3-vadhu thalathil vaithu saramaariyaagath thaakkiyulladhu.
Idhil padugaayamadaindha avarai, avaradhu magan maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhitha nilaiyil, netru adhigaalai sigichaip palanindri uyirizhandhaar. Ichambavam thodarbaaga sisidivi kaatchigalin adippadaiyil vazhakkup padhivu seytha Delhi kaavaldhurai, 7 peraik kaidhu seythulladhudan, oru siruvanaiyum pidithullanar. Ikkolais sambavathirku manippoor munnaal mudhalvar matrum vadagizhakku maanila amaippugal kadum kandanam therivithullanar. Melum poraattamum nadathiyullana. Indhas sambavam telliyil paravarappaiyum adhirchiyaiyum erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Kadal pola kaatchiyalikkum mumbai vimaananilaiyam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kanamazhai kaaranamaaga mumbai vimaana nilaiyathil thanneer thengiyiruppadhaaga oru video

vimaana nilaiyathil thanneer thengi nirkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “mumbaiyil peytha kanamazhai kaaranamaaga mumbai vimaana nilaiyam kadalaagavum, angu niruthappattulla vimaanangal kappalaagavum maari irukkiradhu. Kanamazhai kaaranamaaga sumaar 250 vimaanangal thaamadhamaaga iyakkappaduvadhodu, vimaana nilaiyathin ran ve muzhukka mazhaineer thengi nirkiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sila varudangalukku munbu Chennai-yil kana mazhai peytha podhu Chennai vimaana nilaiyathil kadal pondru thanneer thengi irundhadhu. Appodhu veliyaana video polave indha veediyovum irundhadhu. Erkanave paartha video pola irundhadhaal, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Koogulil Chennai vimaana nilaiyam, mazhai neer ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Appodhu 2023 tisambar 4m thedhi indha video-vai oodagangal palavum veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, mikjaam puyal kaaranamaaga Chennai vimaananilaiyathin oduvaadhaiyil mazhai neer thengiyadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhe video-vai PTI seythi niruvanam matrum aangila oodagangalum 2023m aandu veliyittirundhana. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video mumbai vimaana nilaiyam illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
