headline: Pudhinukku Trump seytha 'Phone Call' mudivukku varugiradhaa Ukraine por?
text:
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
America adhivar tonaalt trambum, Russia adhivar vilaadimir pudhinum sepdambar 8m thedhi sumaar oru mani neram tholaivesiyil uraiyaadinar. Idhil Ukraine por, amerikkaa–rashyaa uravu, varthagam, porulaadhaara othuzhaippu matrum por kaidhigal kurithu pesappattadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Indha uraiyaadalukku sila naatkalukku munbu, America sirappu thoodhargal steev vitkaap (Steve Witkoff) matrum jaaret kushnar (Jared Kushner) maasgo matrum keev nagarangalukku sendrirundhanar. Ukraine porai mudivukku kondu varuvadharkaana pechuvaarthaigalai meendum thodangum muyatsiyaaga indhap payanam amaindhadhaaga therivikkappadugiradhu.
Udanadi munnetram erpadavillai endraalum, andha pechuvaarthaigal saadhagamaaga irundhadhaaga trambum pudhinum karudhiyadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Adhu mattumallaamal, airoppiya naadugalukku edhiraaga endhavidhamaana thaakkudhal thittamum Russia tharappil illai endru Putin therivithadhaaga sollappadugiradhu.
Ukraine porai viraivil mudivukku kondu vara vendum enbadhe thanadhu viruppam endru Trump therivithadhaagavum thanadhu adhivar padhavikkaalathileye idharku theervu kaana avar virumbuvadhaagavum thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Por mudindhaal amerikkaa–rashyaa uravai membaduthuvadhudan, iru naadugalukkum idaiyilaana varthagam matrum porulaadhaara uravugalai meendum valuppadutha mudiyum endru Trump karudhuvadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Eninum, pudhiya varthaga oppandham thodarbaaga endha arivippum veliyaagavillai.
Iruppinum, rashyaa–ukrain idaiyilaana por kaidhigal parimaatrathai thodarndhu merkolla iru thalaivargalum aadharavu therivithadhaaga therigiradhu.
Idharkidaiyil, Russia, Ukraine, America idaiyilaana adutha mutharappu pechuvaarthaikkaana thedhi innum urudhi seyyappadavillai. Thurukki, aikkiya aravu ameeragam alladhu suvitcharlaandhil adutha sandhippu nadaivera vaayppulladhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana.

headline: India meedhu koodudhal vari; amerikkaavidam adhirupdhiyai therivitha jeysangar
text:
Niyooyaark: Russia matrum Iran naadugalidam irundhu kachaa enney vaangum India ullitta naadugal meedhu koodudhal vari vidhikkum mudivu kavalai alippadhaaga America veliyuravuthurai amaichar maargo rooviyovidam mathiya veliyuravuthurai amaichar jeysangar therivithullaar.
Ainaa savaik koottathil pangerpadharkaaga niyooyaark sendrulla avar, America veliyuravuthurai amaichar maargo rooviyovai sandhithu pesinaar. Indha sandhippin podhu, India-vin adhipdhiyai avar padhivu seythaar.
Russia matrum Iran meedhaana thadais sattathinaal Indhiya nalangalukku erpadum paadhippugal matrum kavalaigalai avar eduthuraithullaar.
Idhu thodarbaaga amaichar jeysangar veliyitta X thalappadhivil; America veliyuravuthurai amaichar maargo rooviyovudanaana sandhippu migavum sirappaaga irundhadhu. Indhas sandhippin podhu, Russia matrum Iran meedhaana thadais sattam thodarbaaga India-vin nalangal matrum kavalaigal kurithu eduthuraithen. Melum, valaigudaa matrum Ukraine nilavarangal kurithum vivaadham nadathinom, ivvaaru kurippittullaar.
Russia matrum eeraanidamirundhu thodarndhu kachaa enney vaangum naadugalukku edhiraaga varthagath thadaigal matrum koodudhal varigalai vidhippadhu thodarbaana sattathai kondu vara America adhivar Trump thodarndhu muyatsi eduthu varugiraar. Indha soozhalil, indha sandhippu nadandhulladhu. Kadandha 2022m aandu mudhal rashyaavilirundhu kachaa enney vaangum mudhanmai naadugalil ondraaga India iruppadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Kappalai moozhgaditha America 3 per pali.. Enna nadandhadhu?
text:
Seythiyaalar : M. Meeraa
kareeviyan kadal pagudhiyil podhaipporul kadathalil eeduvattadhaaga America kutramsaattiya kappal meedhu America kadarpadai thaakkudhal nadathiyulladhu. Indhath thaakkudhalil kappal kadalil moozhgiyadhudan, adhil irundha 3 per uyirizhandhadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. America adhigaarigalin kootruppadi, sandhegathirkidamaana vagaiyil payanitha andhak kappal podhaipporul kadathal nadavadikkaiyil eeduvattirundhadhaaga ulavuthagaval kidaithulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil kappalai kurivaithu thaakkudhal nadathappattadhaaga America therivithulladhu.
Thaakkudhalukkup pinnar kappal kadumaiyaagas sedhamadaindhu kadalil moozhgiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Kappalil evvalavu podhaipporul irundhadhu, adhu engirundhu engu kondu sellappattadhu enbadhu ullitta vivarangal udanadiyaaga muzhumaiyaaga veliyidappadavillai.
Melum, kappalil irundha 3 perum thappippadharkaana vaayppaip petraargalaa, avargalai meetka muyatsigal merkollappattanavaa enbadhu kurithum palveru kelvigal ezhundhullana. Uyirizhandhavargalin adaiyaalam matrum avargalin thesiyathuvam kuritha thagavalgalum udanadiyaaga thelivuvaduthappadavillai.
America-vin indha nadavadikkaikku manidha urimai amaippugal kadum kandanam therivithullana. Podhaipporul kadathalil eeduvattadhaaga sandhegikkappadum navargalai kaidhu seythu, avargalai sattathin mun niruthuvadharkup padhilaaga raanuvath thaakkudhal moolam kolvadhu sarvadhesa satta vidhigalai meerum nadavadikkaiyaaga irukkalaam ena vimarsanangal ezhundhullana. Kurippaaga, oru kappalil iruppavargal udanadi uyirukku achuruthalai erpaduthugiraargal enbadharkaana thelivaana aadhaaram illaadha nilaiyil, avargalaik kurivaithu uyirkkolli thaakkudhal nadathuvadhu sarvadhesa manidha urimai sattathin adippadaiyil theeviramaana kelvigalai ezhuppuvadhaaga manidha urimai amaippugal suttikkaattiyullana.
Idhanaal, podhaipporul kadathalaith thaduppadharkaaga America merkondadhaagak koorum indha nadavadikkai tharpodhu paadhugaappu nadavadikkaiyaa alladhu sarvadhesa sattathai meeriya raanuva nadavadikkaiyaa endra vivaadhathai uruvaakkiyulladhu. Kareeviyan kadal pagudhiyil podhaipporul kadathalai thadukkum nadavadikkaigal thodarndhu varum nilaiyil, indhak kappal thaakkudhal sarvadhesa alavil melum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Trichy auto mekkaanik kolai; madhu podhaiyil thambiye annanaik kolai seytha kodooram
text:
Thalaikkeriya madhu podhaiyil sondha annanaiye thambi kolai seythulla sambavam adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Trichy maanagaram, thennoor vellaala theruvais serndhavar muhammadhu paarook (vayadhu: 32). Ivar, auto mekkaanikkaagap paniyaatri varugiraar. Ivarukku asaar (vayadhu: 28) engira sagodharar ullaar. Avar, meen kadaiyil paniyaatri varugiraar.
Indha nilaiyil, netru maalai paarook, asaar iruvarum veettil irundhullanar. Avargalin thaay nishaa veettu velaikkus sendruvittu veedu thirumbi ullaar. Appodhu, veettil paaruk kazhuthu arukkappatta nilaiyil uyirizhandhu kidandhullaar.
Adhaip paarthu avar kadhari azhudhaar. Avarin azhugais satham kettu vandha akkam pakkathinar idhu kurithu poleesaarukkum thagaval therivithanar. Andhath thagaval adippadaiyil, thillai nagar kaaval nilaiya poleesaar sambava idathirku vandhu visaaranai merkondanar.
Adhodu, Trichy maanagara kaaval thurai thunai aanaiyar aravinth panaavath, thillai nagar udhavi aanaiyar vijayagumaar aagiyorum sambava idathirku vandhu neril visaaranai merkondanar.
Poleesaar nadathiya mudhalgatta visaaranaiyil annan, thambi iruvarukkum podhaip pazhakkam irundhulladhu. Kurippaaga, asaar kanjjaa matrum madhu pazhakkathirku adimaiyaanavar enas koorappadugiradhu. Madhu podhaiyil iruvarum adikkadi sandai poduvaargal enavum, iruvarum madhu podhaiyil irundha nilaiyil iruvarukkum idaiye sandai nadandhulladhu enavum adhil, asaar veettil irundha kathiyaal paarukkin kazhuthai aruthu kolai seythirukkalaam enap poleesaar visaaranaiyil theriyavandhulladhu.
Adhanaithodarndhu, asaaraip pidithu poleesaar visaaranai merkondu varugindranar. Indhas sambavam thiruchiyil paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu.

investigation_details:
Sameevathil China sendra Indhiya piradhamar Modi-kku utsaaga varaverpu alikkappattadhu endrum, adharku mun piradhamaraaga irundha manmogan sing oru pommai pola nadathappattaar endrum koori BJP aadharavaalargal merkanda video-vai parappugindranar.

Andha kaalagattathil manmogan sing Indhiya piradhamar padhaviyil kidaiyaadhu. Adharku mun, 2014m aandu nadaivetra podhuth therdhalil Congress katchi thotru, BJP aatchi amaindhu, narendhira Modi piradhamar padhavikku vandhuvittaar. Enave, idhu thavaraana thagaval.
Aduthappadiyaaga, manmogan sing matrum soniyaa kaandhi aagiyorai sandhithup pesum navargalil China adhivar endru yaarum illai. Adhu China naadaalumandra kuzhu mattume. Andha kuzhuvin thalaivar peyar Zhang Dejiang (Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress of China).
Melum, Zhang Dejiang thalaimaiyilaana kuzhu 2015m aandu India vandhavodhu, manmogan sing, soniyaa kaandhi aagiyorai mattum sandhikkavillai. Piradhamar modiyaiyum sandhithup pesinar enbadhu inge kurippidathakkadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, The Chinese Embassy in India veliyitta seythikkurippu idho…
irudhiyaaga, kadandha 2013m aandu mudhal indha fektchek katturai veliyaagum indraiya naal (03.09.2025) varaiyilum China adhivar padhaviyil Xi Jinping mattume ullaar. Veru yaarum padhavikku varavillai.
Enave, munnukkup pin muranaana thagavalgaludan pazhaiya video ondraiyum serthu, samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “senaap nadhiyaith thirandhu paagisdhaanukku marana payathai kaattiya modi” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:

thideerendru varum kaattaatru vellathil laarigal, poklain ullitta vaaganangal adithus sellappadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pahalgaam thaakkudhalukku padhiladiyaaga himaachala piradhesa maanilathil uruvaagi jammu – kaashmeer vazhiyaaga Pakistan-il paayum senaap nadhi anaiyilirundhu veliyerum neerai India thaduthu niruthiyadhu. Idhanaal Pakistan-il senaap nadhi varandadhu. Moodappatta anaiyilirundhu senaap nadhiyil thideerendru thanneer thirandhuvittu paagisdhaanukku migapperiya sedhathaip piradhamar narendhira erpaduthivittaar endru video ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha video unmaidhaanaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai 2025 epral 12m thedhiyilirundhu aapgaanisdhaanais saarndha palarum thangal X thala pakkathil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, shaahar-i-posork (Shahr-e-Bozorg) nagaril erpatta thideer vellathil aatril surangam amaithu manal, karkalaik kadathi vandha vaaganangal adithus sellappattana” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Pahalgaam thaakkudhal epral 22, 2025 andru nadandhadhu. Adhan piragudhaan anaiyilirundhu thanneer veliyeraamal thaduppadhu ullitta nadavadikkaigal edukkappattana. Thaakkudhal sambavam nadaiveruvadharku 10 naatkalukku munnadhaagave indha video-vai palarum X thalathil padhivittullanar. Aapgaanisdhaanil erpatta thideer vellam endru adhil kurippittirundhanar.
Senaap nadhiyil neer niruthappattadhaaga me 5m thedhidhaan seythi veliyaanadhu. Melum, thanneer thirakkappattadhaaga endha oru seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Senaap nadhiyil thanneer niruthappaduvadharkuk kittathatta 25 naatkalukku munbe indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhai nammudaiya aayvu urudhi seygiradhu. Ivai ellaam, Modi edutha nadavadikkaiyaal paagisdhaanin senaap nadhiyil vellam erpattadhu endru paravum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Indhiyaavai kurivaikkum el nino! Veliyaana adhirchi arikkai! Varappogum aavathugalin list idho!
text:
El nino thaakkathaal India adhigam aavathukkullaagum naadaaga WHO madhippittulladhu..
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
pasivik perungadal pagudhiyil kadal neerin veppanilaiyil erpadum maatrame el nino enappadugiradhu. Idhan thaakkam pasivik kadal pagudhiyudan mattum nindruviduvadhillai. Ulagin palveru pagudhigalil veppanilai, mazhaippozhivu ullitta vaanilaiyilum maatrangalai erpaduthakkoodum.
Ulaga sugaadhaara amaippu veliyittulla madhippeettinbadi, India adhiga sugaadhaara aavathai edhirgollakkoodiya naadugalil ondraaga kurippidappattulladhu. Kurippaaga aagast mudhal akdovar varaiyilaana kaalagattathil therkaasiyaavin sila pagudhigalil vazhakkathaivida adhiga veppamum, kuraivaana mazhaippozhivum padhivaaga vaayppulladhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Veppanilai adhigarikkum nilaiyil, podhumakkalukku udal sorvu, adhigappadiyaana viyarvai, neerizhappu matrum veppap pakkavaadham pondra udalnalap pirachinaigal erpadalaam. Kurippaaga neenda neram veyilil velai seybavargal, mudhiyavargal matrum kuzhandhaigal adhiga kavanathudan irukka vendiya soozhal uruvaagalaam.
Erkanave idhaya noy, suvaasap pirachinai alladhu siruneeraga noy ullitta paadhippugal ullavargalukku adhiga veppam koodudhal siramathai erpaduthakkoodum. Enave, veppam adhigamaaga irukkum nerangalil veliyil selvadhaith thavirppadhum, podhumaana alavu thanneer kudippadhum mukkiyam.
Adhevol, mazhaippozhivu matrum veppanilaiyil erpadum maatrangal kosukkal moolam paravum noygalin paadhippaiyum adhigarikkalaam. Kurippaaga tengu matrum maleriyaa pondra noygalin paadhippu sila pagudhigalil adhigarikkum avaayam iruppadhaaga WHO madhippeettil kurippidappattulladhu. Telliyil indha aandu tengu matrum maleriyaa paadhippugal adhigarithulladhaagavum therivikkappattulladhu.
Eninum, India-vil tengu paadhippu adhigarippadharku el nino mattume kaaranam endru koora mudiyaadhu. Mazhaippozhivu, veppanilai, kosukkalin perukkam, thengi nirkum neer matrum sutruppuras sugaadhaaram ullitta palveru kaaranigal noy paravalai adhigarikkak koodum.
Idharkidaiyil, sila pagudhigalil edhirbaaraadha kanamazhai alladhu vellam erpattaal kudineer matrum sugaadhaara vasadhigal paadhikkappadalaam. Idhanaal kudineer moolam paravum sila thotru noygal erpadum avaayamum adhigarikkakkoodum. Melum, vaanilai maatrangal unavu urpathiyil paadhippu matrum kudineer patraakkurai pondravatrai erpadutha vaayppulladhaaga echarikkappattulladhu.
Innilaiyil, el ninovaal erpadakkoodiya vaanilai maatrangalai thodarndhu kangaanippadhudan, adharkerpa sugaadhaarath thuraiyinar mungoottiye thayaaraaga irukka vendum ena WHO valiyuruthiyulladhu. Podhumakkalum adhiga veppam, neerizhappu matrum kosukkal moolam paravum noygalil irundhu thangalai paadhugaathukkolla thevaiyaana munnecharikkai nadavadikkaigalai merkolla vendum ena arivuruthappattulladhu.
Vaanilai maatram enbadhu verum veppam alladhu mazhaippozhivil erpadum maatram mattumalla; adhu neradiyaaga makkalin udalnalathilum thaakkathai erpaduthakkoodum enbadhaal, varum maadhangalil koodudhal kavanathudan iruppadhu avasiyam ena kettukkollappadugiradhu.

headline: Es - 1 pi visaa kurithu adhivar Trump mukkiya arivippu; 60 naal salugai kaalam rathu
text:
'es - 1 pi' visaa kurithu adhivar Trump mukkiya arivippu; 60 naal salugai kaalam rathu
vaashingdan: es1 pi visaa vaithiruppavargal velai izhandha piragu, America-vil thanguvadharkaana 60 naal salugaik kaalathai mutrilumaaga rathu seyya adhivar Trump nirvaagam munmozhindhulladhu.
America adhivaraaga irandaavadhu muraiyaaga padhaviyetra tonaaldu Trump, annaattavargalukku mukkiyathuvam alikkum nokkil, 'es - 1 pi' visaa nadaimuraigalil kadumai kaattinaar. Andha visaa peruvadharkaana vinnappak kattanathaiyum pala madangu uyarthinaar. Idhaiyaduthu, 'es - 1 pi' visaavukkaana vinnappangalin ennikkai kuraindhu varugiradhu. Aanaal palveru maatrangalai adhivar Trump merkondu varugiraar.
Andhavagaiyil, es1 pi visaa vaithiruppavargal velai izhandha piragu, America-vil thanguvadharkaana 60 naal salugaik kaalathai mutrilumaaga rathu seyya adhivar Trump nirvaagam munmozhindhulladhu. America ulnaattup paadhugaapputh thurai idharkaana pudhiya vidhimuraigalai arivippaaga veliyittu irukkiradhu; es1 pi visaa matrum sila tharkaaliga visaakkalaik konda velinaattu oozhiyargal thangal velai izhandha adutha naale amerikkaavai vittu veliyera vendum alladhu sattappoorvamaagath thanguvadharkaana maatru vazhigalai udanadiyaagas seyya vendum.
Velai vaayppugal America kudimakkalukke kidaikka vendum endra nokkathilum, sattappoorva kudiyetrangalai muraippaduthavume indha nadavadikkai edukkappaduvadhaaga Trump nirvaagam therivithulladhu. 2017m aandu mudhal nadaimuraiyil irundha indha 60 naal salugai kaalam, velaiyai izhandhaal oozhiyargal pudhiya velai theda udhaviyaaga irundhadhu; indha pudhiya maatram innum sattamaaga arivikkappadavillai. Indha arivippu kurithu 60 naatkal makkalin karuthukkal ketkappadum; adhan pirage irudhi mudivu edukkappadum.
Es1 pi indha visaavaal adhigam indhiyargal payanadaindhu varugindranar. Aandudhorum vazhangappadum indha visaakkalil kadandhaandu 70 sadhaveedham visaakkalai Indhiya vallunargal petradhu kurippidathakkadhu. Tharpodhu adhivar Trump nirvaagam arivithulla indha maatram nadaimuraikku vandhaal America thozhilnutbam matrum sevaith thurai muzhuvadhum panivuriyum Indhiya thozhilnutba vallunargal kadumaiyaaga paadhikkappaduvar ena vattaarangal therivikkindrana.

headline: Kaattu yaanaiyudan erpatta modhal; Mettupalayam ’paaguvali’ yaanai kaayam!
text:
Mettupalayam, sirumugai pagudhigalil ‘paaguvali’ ena azhaikkappadum otrai aan kaattu yaanai piravalamaaga irundhu varugiradhu. Aajaanuvaaguvaana udal matrum neenda thandham kaaranamaaga paaguvali endra peyar petrulladhu.
Kovai maavattam, Mettupalayam matrum sirumugai pagudhigalil ‘paaguvali’ ena azhaikkappadum otrai aan kaattu yaanai piravalamaaga irundhu varugiradhu. Aajaanuvaaguvaana udal, neenda thandham kaaranamaaga paaguvali endra peyar petrulladhu. Indha yaanai naaldhorum mettuppaalaiyam- ootti saalaiyai kadandhu vivasaaya thottangalukkul pugundhu varuvadhaal, payir sedham erpattaalum, manidhargal yaaraiyum thaakkiyadhillai. Perum rasigar pattaalathaik kondulla indha yaanai Mettupalayam saalaiyaik kadandhu selvadhai paarppadharkaagave koottam kooduvadhu vazhakkam.
Indha nilaiyil vanappagudhikkul matroru kaattu yaanaiyudan erpatta modhalil paaguvali yaanaiyin idadhu pinburathil kaayam erpattulladhu. Idhanai kavanitha vanathuraiyinar andha yaanaikku sigichai alikka muyatsi merkondu varugindranar. Vanak kaalnadai maruthuvargal matrum vanap paniyaalargal andha yaanaiyai thodarndhu kangaanithu varugindranar. Adhan kaayathirku marundhugal neradiyaaga selutha iyalaadhadhaal, marundhugal kalandha kaliyai urundaigalaagas seythu yaanaikku vaithu varugindranar. Andha kali urundaigalai yaanai utkondu varugiradhu.
Idhu kurithu vanathurai adhigaarigal koorugaiyil, “paaguvali yaanaikkum matroru kaattu yaanaikkum vanappagudhikkul erpatta modhalil thandham kuthiyadhaal paaguvali yaanaikku kaayam erpattulladhu. Kaayathin alavu siriyadhaaga irundhaalum vanappaniyaalargal matrum vanak kaalnadai maruthuvargal andha yaanaiyai thodarndhu kangaanithu varugindranar. Thevaippattaal adharku sigichai alikkavum mudivu seythullom” endranar.

headline: Visaaranai endra peyaril thunburuthum Tamil Nadu kaavaldhurai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’visaaranai endra peyaril thunburuthum Tamil Nadu kaavaldhurai’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ visaaranai endra peyaril adithu thunburuthum kaavaldhurai…
mana saatchi illaadha mundangal.
Mirugangal kooda oppida mudiyaadhu eena piravigal
kaavaldhurai enbadharku padhila padhilaaga
kaattumiraandi thurai Thamizhaga arasu azhaikkalaam peyar maatram seyyalaam.
#thimuga #thimugadherdhal #thimugaseythigal #em.ke.staalin’’ ,
endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Idhanudan, ilainjar oruvarai Police silar ondru serndhu katti vaithu, adippadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sila naatkal munbaaga, sivagangai maavattam, madappuram pathragaaliyamman koyilukkus sendra nigidhaa enbavar thanadhu kaaril irundha nagaiyai kaanavillai endru poleesil pugaar seythaar. Idhanberil, andha koyilil kaavalaaliyaaga panivurindha ajithgumaar enbavar, nagai thiruttu sandhegathin peril Police adithu, visaarithadhil uyirizhandhaar.
Idhudhodarbaana adhirchigara video kaatchigal samooga valaidhalangalil paraviyadhaal, perum sarchai ezhundhadhu. Sambandhappatta Police meedhu udanadiyaaga thurai saarndha nadavadikkai edukkappattadhu. Eninum, idhuvatri arasiyal katchigal thodangi podhumakkal varai indralavum kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu varugindranar.
Idhan thodarchiyaaga, samooga valaidhalangalil kadandha sila naatkalaaga, Tamil Nadu poleesaarin attoozhiyam endru koori edhenum oru video-vai tirending seyyum vazhakkam adhigarithulladhu.
Ithagaiya soozhalildhaan, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda veediyovum samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappadugiradhu. Aanaal, indha veediyovukkum, Tamil Nadu poleesaarukkum endha thodarbum illai. Idhu utharap piradhesa maanilathil nigazhndha sambavam.
Idhanbadi, utharap piradhesathil ulla Jaunpur maavattathirkutbatta Mungra Badshahpur kaaval nilaiyathil SHO padhaviyil panivuriyum SHO Vinod Mishra enbavardhaan ivvaaru ilainjarai kodooramaaga thaakkiya navar. Idhanberil, sambandhappatta Police sasbent seyyappattullanar. Idhuvatri naam kurippitta kaaval nilaiyathil pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Palveru oodagangalilum idhuvatri seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
Times Of India l Free Press Journal l Dainik Bhaskar l ETV Bharat
enave, utharap piradhesathil nigazhndha oru sambavam thodarbaana video-vai eduthu, Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru kurippittu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Paagisdhaanukku udhaviya ellai paadhugaappup padai veerar kaidhu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Paagisdhaanukku udhaviya ellai paadhugaappup padai veerar roo.46 latcha roovaayudan sikkinaar endru oru video

kot soot anindha silarai Police kaidhu seythu avargalai visaaranai seyyum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indhiyaavin karuppu aadu
ivar oru ellai paadhugaappup padai veerar keralaavukku rayilil thanadhu oorukku pogum podhu 46 latcham roovaayudan pidivattaar. Avaradhu veettil sodhanai seythadhil roobai 962 kodi sikki irukkiradhu. Namadhu paaradha naattai kaattik kodukka paagisdhaanidam irundhu petra kaikkooli. Ivardhaan karuppuaadu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Paagisdhaanukku ulavu paartha ellai paadhugaappup padai veerar roo.46 latchathudan sikkinaar endrum avaradhu veettil nadathappatta sodhanaiyil roo.962 kodi sikkiyadhu endrum oru padhivai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Pakistan meedhu India aavareshan sindhoor thaakkudhalai nadathi mudithulla soozhalil paagisdhaanukku keralaavais saarndha ellai paadhugaappup padai veerar udhavi seythadhu pondru palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Appadi oru sambavam sameevathil nadandhadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Roo.962 kodi sikkiyirundhaal adhu migapperiya seythiyaagi irukkum. Kaidhu seyyappattavarai ippadi saadhaaranamaaga utkaara vaithu visaarithirukka maattaargal. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video ettu aandu pazhamaiyaanadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. 2018m janavari maadham indha video-vai YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, “kaanboorais saarndha kattumaana thozhilil eeduvattu vandha aananth kaathriyidam irundhu 96.40 kodi parimudhal seyyappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Adhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thediya podhu pana madhippizhappu nadavadikkaikkup piragu, pazhaiya sellaadha roobai 96 kodiyai vaithirundhadhaagak kaidhu seyyappatta 16 per siraiyil adaikkappattanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Kaanboor pildaridam irundhu mattum avvalavu sellaadha nottukkal kaippatrappattadhaaga andha seythiyil illai. 16 peridamirundhu kaippatrappatta panam endre adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam ivar paagisdhaanukku ulavu paarthu kaidhu seyyappatta navar illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Aduthadhaaga keralaavais serndha ellai paadhugaappup padai (piesep) veerar kaidhu seyyappattadhu thodarbaaga seythi edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu 2018m aandu janavari 31m thedhi veliyaana seythi ondru kidaithadhu. Adhil, rayilil payanam seythu kondirundha piesep veerar kaidhu seyyappattaar. Avaridam irundhu roo.45 latcham kaippatrappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Ivar merku vangathil India – vangadhesa ellaiyil paniyaatri vandhavar endrum, kadathalgaarargalukku udhavi seythu muraigedaaga panam sambaadhithaar endrum seythiyil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Avar veettil 962 kodi roobai sikkiyadhaaga ellaam endha seythiyum illai. YouTube-il indha seythi adippadaiyil thediya podhu piesep veerar kaidhu endru idhe video-vai silar pagirndhirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, ANI ullitta seythi niruvanangal edutha video-vil indha navargal ellaam pana madhippizhappu seyyappatta roobai nottukkalai vaithirundhadhaal kaidhu seyyappattavargal endru kurippittirundhadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Chennai thavirthu matra maavattangalil suzhatsi muraiyil oru mani neram min thadai
text:
Chennai: Thamizhagathil eppodhum illaadha vagaiyil sepdambaril thinasari min thevai, 21,000 megaavaattaaga ulladhu. Idhai poorthi seyya, min vaariyathirku nerukkadi erpattulladhaal, pala idangalil thinamum oru mani neram, mun arivippindri min thadai seyyappaduvadhaaga pugaar ezhundhulladhu.
Thamizhagathin min thevai indha aandu ep., 28m thedhi, 21 aayirathu 211 megaavaattaaga, idhuvarai illaadha alavaaga adhigarithadhu. Vazhakkamaaga joolaiyil irundhu veyil kuraiyum.
Aanaal, indha aandu eppodhum illaadha vagaiyil veyil kadumaiyaaga thodarvadhaal, mudhal muraiyaaga joolai 14l min thevai, 21 aayirathu 724 megaavaattaaga pudhiya uchathai ettiyadhu.
Thodarndhu thinamum maalaiyil, min thevai saraasariyaaga 20 aayiram megaavaattaaga irundhu vandha nilaiyil, immaadhathil 21 aayiram megaavaattaaga ulladhu.
Idhai poorthi seyya, min vaariyathirku nerukkadi erpattulladhu. In nilaiyil, Chennai puranagar utbada, pala idangalil adikkadi min thadai seyyappaduvadhaaga pugaargal ezhundhullana.
Ivai kurithu, min vaariyathin minnagam nugarvor sevai maiya paniyaalargalil silar koorugaiyil, 'sennaiyai sutriyulla maavattangal utbada pala maavattangalil, iravil oru mani nerathirku mel min thadai erpaduvadhaaga thodarndhu pugaargal varugindrana' endranar.
Ivai kurithu, min vaariya adhigaari oruvar kooriyadhaavadhu:
vazhakkamaaga kodaikkaalathudan oppidum podhu, sepdambaril min thevai 2,500 - 3,000 megaavaat kuraiyum; indha aandu kuraiyavillai. Min vaariyamum nidhi nerukkadiyil ulladhaal, velichandhaiyil adhiga vilaikku minsaaram vaanguvadhai, adhigaarigal thavirthu varugindranar.
Chennai thavirthu, matra maavattangalil thinamum, oru mani neram suzhatsi muraiyil min thadai seyyappaduvadhaaga theriya vandhulladhu.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Ulagileye adhiga thangam vaithulla ‘thonduraa’ naattu mannar endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Ulagileye adhiga thangam vaithullavarum, ulaga thanga maarkkettai nirvagikkum kuzhuvil ullavarumaana thonduraa naattu mannar endru oru pugaippadathudan koodiya padhivu

thangak kattigal niraindha araiyil oruvar thanga aavaranangal anindhu nirpadhu pondru eai pugaippadam threads.com samooga oodagathil padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ulagileye adhiga thangathai than vasam vaithullavarum, ulaga thanga maarkkettil adhan vilaiyai theermaanikkum kuzhuvin thalaimaip poruppil irukkum then merku aappirikkaavin arugilulla “thonduraa” naattin maamannar “mavoongaa ufum uttung voodaa”…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ulagathileye adhiga alavu thangathai vaithulla naadu thonduraa endru kurippittup padhividappattulladhu. Ippadi oru naadu iruppadhai idhuvarai kelvippattadhu illai. Adhuvum thangathai adhiga alavil vaithulla naadu endraal kandippaaga edhaavadhu seythiyilaavadhu vandhirukkum. Aanaal, idhuvarai appadip padithadhu illai. Naiyaandikku veliyitta padhivaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha padhivai aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediyavodhu namakku endha mudivum kidaikkavillai. Ippadi oru navar unmaiyil irundhirundhaal nichayam sarvadhesa oodagangalil avaraip patri seythi veliyaagi irundhirukkum. Aanaal, namakku appadi edhuvum illai. Sari then merku aaprikkaavil ‘thonduraa” endru naadu edhum ulladhaa endrum thedip paarthom. Appadi endha oru naadum illai enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Aikkiya naadugalin uruppu naadugal pattiyalil appadi oru naattin peyare illai enbadhaiyum urudhi seythugondom.
Aduthadhaaga indha padhivu thodarbaaga samooga oodagangalil thedinom. Appodhu tholaikkaatchigalil kaamedi nigazhchigal seybavarum, naiyaandiyaaga padhivugalai veliyittuvarum vengadesh aarumugam indha padhivai veliyittirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Thannudaiya padathaiyum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padathaiyum serthu eai moolam uruvaakki avar adhai veliyittirundhaar.
Adhil, “ulagileye adhiga thangathai than vasam vaithullavarum, ulaga thanga maarkkettil adhan vilaiyai theermaanikkum kuzhuvin thalaimaip poruppil irukkum then merku aappirikkaavin arugilulla “thonduraa” naattin maamannar “mavoongaa ufum uttung voodaa” avargaladhu azhaippin peyaril avaradhu thanga karuvoolathirke sendru sandhithu (ingu idhuvarai tirambukku kooda anumadhi tharavillai) thangam vilaiyetra pirachanaikku theervu kaana valiyuruthi irukkiren. Pipravari 31 andru maamannaridam irundhu arivippu varum. Thangam kiraamukku 8 aayiram kuraiyum. Velli karugum.. Tisgi : naan anindhirukkum nagaigal mannar enakkalitha parisaagum” endru kurippittirundhaar.
Muzhukka muzhukka naiyaandi, nagaichuvaikkaaga avar uruvaakkiya andha padhivil, illaadha pipravari 31m thedhi endrellaam kurippittirundhadhai neekkivittu, unmaiyaana seythi pola samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Vengadesh aarumugathin padhivugal samooga oodagangalil avvappodhu viral aavadhu vaadikkaiyaana ondru. Avar nagaichuvaikkaaga veliyidum padhivai, nagaichuvai enbadhai ariya udhavum pagudhigalai neekkivittu samooga oodagangalil unmaiyaana seythi pola palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Koronaa kaalathil koronaa patri kimu 400m nootraandileye pogar sithar ezhudhiya paadal endru ondraip padhivittirundhaar. Appodhe adhu patri nammudaiya fekt kirasandovil katturai veliyittirundhom. Saneesvara pagavaan kovilukku mel seyarkaikkolgal seyalbadaadhu endru veliyaana vadhandhiyai adippadaiyaaga vaithu Madurai meenaatchiyamman kovil patri ivar veliyittirundha padhivum viral aanadhu.
Thangam vilai thodarbaaga nagaichuvaikkaaga vengadesh aarumugam enbavar veliyittirundha padhivai, edit seythu unmaiyaana nigazhvu pola thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kiraapt kaagidham vilai kidugidu ; attaippetti urpathi paadhippu
text:
Kiraapt kaagidham vilai 'kidugidu' ; attaippetti urpathi paadhippu
Tiruppur: kiraapt kaagidha vilai thodarndhu uyarvadhudan, thattuppaadum erpattulladhaal Kovai, Tiruppur, Erode, naamakkal, karoor, thindukkal maavattangalais serndha attai petti urpathi niruvanangal nerukkadikku aalaagiyullana.
Idhugurithu thennindhiya attai petti urpathiyaalargal sanga, Kovai mandala thalaivar thandavaani kooriyadhaavadhu:
kazhivu kaagidhathukku thattuppaadu erpattulladhaaga koori, sathiyamangalam, madathukku lam, sivagaasi, osoor pagudhigalil ulla kaagidha aalaigal kiraapt kaagidham vilai yai uyarthi varugindrana. Oru tan 31,000 roobaayaaga irundha pesik kiraapt kaagidham vilai, ore maadhathil 36,000 roobaayaaga uyarndhulladhu. Veru sila ragangalin vilaiyum adhigarithulladhu.
Kadandha kaalangalil kaagidham vaangu vadharkaana thogaiyai selutha 15 - 30 naal varai avagaasam vazhangappattadhu. Tharpodhu udanadiyaaga panam selutha solgiraargal.
Idhanaal urpathi selavu uyarvu, moolapporul thattuppaadu, thittamittavadi attai petti thayaarippadhil sikkal, nidhi nerukkadi ena urpathi niruvanangal palveru pirasnaigalai sandhithu varugindrana.
Kiraapt kaa ki tham vilai uyarvaal attai petti thayaarippu selavu 20 mudhal 30 sadhaveedham varai adhigarithulladhu. Enave, attai pettikkaana vi laiyaiyum uyartha vendiya kattaayam erpattulladhu.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Mu.ka.staalinukku pandri silai vazhangappattadhaa?
text:
‘’mu.ka.staalinukku pandri silaiyai parisaaga vazhangum thelungargal’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ mu ka staalinukku thelungargal pandri silai vazhangugiraargal , en theriyumaa namadhu vijayanagara pandri kodiya aatchiyai thiraavida maadal endru urutti needhaanayyaa aalugindreergal
thamizhanai emaatri aalvadhil neengal thiramaisaali endru paaraatti pandri silaiyai vazhangi irukkindranar,” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
San news logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idhu oru edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, san news veliyitta unmaiyaana news card verondraaga ulladhu. Idhanai eduthu, vendumendre edit seythu, M.K. Stalin peyaril vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru thelivaagiradhu.
Unmaiyaana news kaardaiyum, naam aayvu seyyum pugaippadathaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Irudhiyaaga, san news digital pirivu nirvaagiyidamum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam, edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Amaichar keerthanaavukku enna aachu? Landan sellaadhadharku idhudhaan kaaranamaa? MLA kanimozhi vilakkam!
text:
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
mudhalamaichar josap vavijay, landan sendrirundha nilaiyil thozhil mudhaleedugalai eerppadharkaana appayanathil thozhildhurai amaichar keerthanaa, mudhalamaichar vijayudan landan sellaadhadhu en endra kelvigal ezhundha nilaiyil, avaradhu udalnilai kurithu TVK em.el.e. Kanimozhi sandhosh veliyittulla thagavalgal tharpodhu kavanam petrullana. Thozhil mudhaleedugalai eerppadharkaaga mudhalamaichar vavijay anmaiyil landan sendrirundhaar. Indhap payanam palveru vivaadhangalukku vazhivagutha nilaiyil, thozhildhurai amaichar keerthanaa udan sellaadhadhu kurithum kelvigal ezhundhana. Kurippaaga, thozhildhurai amaichar, thozhildhurai seyalaalar illaamal mudhalamaichar eppadi thozhil mudhaleettu payanathai merkondaar ena edhirkkatchigal utbada palveru tharappinarum kelvi ezhuppinar.
Idhudhodarbaaga vilakkamalitha amaichar aadhav arjunaa, ’’amaichar keerthanaa udalnilai sariyillaadha kaaranathaal mudhalamaicharudan landan payanam merkollavillai’’ ena therivithaar. Idhaiyaduthu, avaradhu udalnilai kurithu palveru kelvigalum, samooga valaidhalangalil vimarsanangalum ezhundhana. Indha nilaiyil, keerthanaavin udalnilai thodarbaaga TVK kavundambaalaiyam em.el.e. Kanimozhi sandhosh thanadhu samooga valaidhalap padhivil virivaana vilakkam alithullaar.
Adhil, keerthanaavai kazhuthelumbu aruvaichigichaikkup piragu maruthuvamanaiyil sandhithadhaagavum, maruthuvargal 20 naatkal oyvedukka arivuruthiyirundha nilaiyil, maanilathin meedhaana arppanippu kaaranamaaga naangu naatkalileye avar meendum panikkuth thirumbiyadhaagavum kanimozhi sandhosh kurippittullaar. Maruthuvamanaiyil sigichai petru vandhavodhum mudhalamaicharin landan payanathukkaana erpaadugalai keerthanaa orunginaithadhaagavum, ovvoru erpaadum sariyaana nerathil nadaiverugiradhaa enbadhileye avar kavanam seluthiyadhaagavum kanimozhi therivithullaar. Keerthanaavin udalnilai sariyillai, avar naangu naatkal oyvu edukka vendiyirundhadhaaga amaichar aadhav arjunaa therivithadhaith thodarndhu, avaradhu udalnilai kurithu silar maadhavidaayudan thodarbuvaduthi vimarsanangalai munvaithadhaagavum kanimozhi sandhosh thanadhu padhivil kurippittullaar.
Oru pennin udalnalap pirasnaiyai kurippitta oru kaaranathukkul mattum surukkip paarppadhu sariyalla endrum, pengalin thanippatta udalnilai kurithu thevaiyatra kelvigal ezhuppappaduvadhaith thavirkka vendum endrum avar therivithullaar. Melum, keerthanaavin udalnilai kuritha thanippatta thagavalai veliyittadharkaaga avaridam mannippu koruvadhaagavum kanimozhi sandhosh therivithullaar. Indha vivarangalai keerthanaa thanippattadhaaga vaithirukka virumbiyadhai thaan arindhirundhaalum, pengal edhirgollum idhuvondra vimarsanangalukku padhilalikka vendiya soozhal erpattadhaal indha thagavalai veliyittadhaagavum avar vilakkamalithullaar.

headline: Podhu idathil koochamindri nadanamaadum mudhalamaichar vavijay endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘podhu idathil koochame illaamal nadanamaadum mudhalamaichar vavijay,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ rasiga kunjjigal ketta udan taans aadum ivan thaan thamizh naattin mudhalamaichar idhu thaan thamizh naattin thalaividhi.
Thamizh naattin en endha maanilathin mudhalamaicharum ippadi oru kevalathai seythadhillai, seyyavum maattaargal,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu karnaadagaa maanilam uduppiyil ulla kirushnar koyilil nadaivetra jenmaashdami (kogulaashdami) kondaattathinbodhu edukkappatta video endru theriyavandhadhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
idhanbadi, vavijay pondru thotramalikkum navar mekkap anindhu, nadanamaadum kaatchiyai eduthu, unmaiyaana vavijay nadanam endru koori, thavaraana thagaval parappuvadhaaga, thelivaagiradhu.
Deccan Herald Link l Times Of India
adhesamayam, Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar padhaviyetra piragu karnaadagaavil ulla kollur moogaambigai koyilukku vavijay neril sendru, tharisanam seythaar. Aanaal, adharkum, naam aayvu seyyum veediyovukkum endha thodarbum illai.
Enave, vavijay pondru thotramalikkum navar nadanamaadum video-vai eduthu, unmaiyaana vavijay nadanam endru kurippittu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thiruppadhi sellum pakdhargalukku paadhugaappu.. Roo.2 - 10 latcham varai kaappeedu.. TTD arivippu!
text:
Naattileye mudhalmuraiyaaga, thiruppadhi thirumalai thevasdhaanam (TTD), thiruppadhikku varum anaithu pakdhargalukkum aayul matrum vivathu kaappeedu vazhangum varalaatrus sirappumikka mudivai arivithulladhu. Adhanbadi, iyarkai maranam adaindhaal roo. 2 latchamum vivathil maranam adaindhaal roo.10 latchamum vazhangappadum ena 
arivikkappattulladhu.
Ulaga pugazhbetra aandhira maanilam thiruppadhi ezhumalaiyaan koyilukku naaldhorum eraalamaana pakdhargal padaiyeduthu varugindranar. Appadi varum pakdhargalin vasadhikkaaga thevasdhaana nirvaagam thangum idam, unavu ena pala vasadhigalai seythu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, naattileye mudhal muraiyaaga thiruppadhi ezhumalaiyaan koyilukku varum anaithu pakdhargalukkum kaappeedu sevai alikka mudivu seyyappattulladhu. Adhanbadi, thirumalaiyil saami tharisanam seyya varum pakdhargal edhirbaaraadhavidhamaaga iyarkai eythinaal, avargalin kudumbathirku roo.2 latchamum, thirumalai alladhu aliviri malaippaadhaigalil erpadum vivathugalaal uyirizhakkum pakdhargalin kudumbathirku roo.10 latchamum vazhangappadum ena thevasdhaanam arivithulladhu.
El.ai.siyudan inaindhu ithittam seyalbaduthappadum nilaiyil, ikkaappeettuth thittathirku pakdhargal endhak kattanamum selutha vendiyadhillai enavum, idharkaana pireemiyam thogaiyai thevasdhaana nirvaagame muzhumaiyaaga erkum enavum therivikkappattulladhu. Adhevol, paniyinbodhu vivathil uyirizhakkum TTD oozhiyargalukkaana kaappeettuth thogaiyum roo.10 latchamaaga uyarthappattulladhu. Pakdhargalin paadhugaappu matrum nidhip paadhugaappai urudhiseyya thiruppadhi thirumalai thevasdhaanam eduthulla indha nadavadikkai perum varaverpaip petrulladhu.

headline: Thervil ‘saatjividi’ seyali payanbaduthi pidivatta ai.ai.ti., maanavar tharkolai
text:
Mumbai: mahaaraashdiraavin mumbai ai.ai.ti.,yil, thervin podhu movail ponil ‘saatjividi’ enappadum seyarkai nunnarivu seyaliyil thervu vinaathaalai padhivetri padhil ezhudha muyandru pidivatta irandaam aandu pi.tek., maanavar vidudhi araiyil tharkolai seythu kondaar.
Mumbai pavaayil mathiya arasin uyar kalvi niruvanamaana ai.ai.ti., enappadum Indhiya thozhilnutbak kazhagam seyalbadugiradhu. Ingu vidudhi araiyil netru mundhinam pi.tek., irandaam aandu maanavar tharkolai seythu kondaar.
Indha sambavathai thodarndhu, ai.ai.ti., valaagathil maanavargal silar thirandu poraattathil eeduvattanar. Angu poleesaar kuvikkappattanar.
Maanavar tharkolai kurithu ai.ai.ti., nirvaagam tharappil kooriyadhaavadhu:
tharkolai seythu konda pi.tek., irandaam aandu maanavar thervinbodhu movail ponai payanbaduthi ullaar. Adhai peraasiriyar kanduvidithaar. Thervu vinaathaalai ‘saatjividi’ seyalil padhivetri vidaigalai thediyullaar.
Eninum, andha maanavar meedhu endha ozhungu nadavadikkaiyum thodangappadavillai. Avarai azhaithu peraasiriyarum, thurai thalaivarum arivurai mattume vazhanginar. Avaradhu kalvi edhirgaalathai paadhikkum alavukku endha nadavadikkaiyum edukkavillai.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: Singappen sirappu adhiradippadaiyin 100 naal niraivu; 4,231 pugaargal meedhu nadavadikkai
text:
Chennai: mudhalvar vavijayyin mukkiya thittangalil ondraana singappen sirappu adhiradippadai thuvangi, 100 naal niraivadaindha nilaiyil, idhuvaraiyil 4,231 pugaargal meedhu nadavadikkai edukkappattulladhaaga Thamizhaga Police therivithulladhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga veliyidappatta arikkai; pengal matrum kuzhandhaigalin paadhugaappai valuppaduthum nokkil thodangappatta singappen sirappu adhiradippadai mudhal 100 naatkalil sirappaaga seyalbattulladhu.
• 4,231 pugaargalukku sambava idathirke sendru nadavadikkai edukkappattulladhu• 58 pengal, 94 kuzhandhaigal kanduvidikkappattu meetkappattullanar. • 111 paadhippukkullaagum navargal meetkappattullanar.• 54 kuzhandhai thirumanangal thaduthu niruthappattulladhu. • 636 palli idainirutha maanavargal meendum palliyil sera udhavi seythulladhu. * 334 kutra vazhakkugal padhivu seyya mukkiyap pangalippai aatriyulladhu.* kalvi niruvanangalil 14,231 vizhippunarvu nigazhchigal nadathappattana.* pira podhu idangalil 34,632 vizhippunarvu nigazhchigal nadathappattana.* pulambeyar thozhilaalargalidaiye 2,236 vizhippunarvu nigazhchigal nadathappattana.* maanilam muzhuvadhum 15,77,460 paadhippukkullaagum idangal thodarndhu kangaanikkappattu varugiradhu. * 70 kalappirivugal rondhup paniyil eeduvaduthappattullana.* pengalukku udhava 1091 singappen udhavi en 24 mani neramum seyalbadugiradhu.
Singappen sirappu adhiradippadaiyin thodarchiyaana vizhippunarvu nadavadikkaigalin moolam pengal matrum kuzhandhaigalukku thayakkamindri udhaviyai naadavum, kutrangalukku edhiraaga pugaaralikkavum edhuvaana soozhnilai uruvaagiyulladhu, ivvaaru therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: Maas kileening: maavattathil kaaychal paravuvadhai thavirkka mugaamgal: haat sbaat kandarindhu nadavadikkai edukka utharavu
text:
Maas kileening: maavattathil kaaychal paravuvadhai thavirkka mugaamgal: 'haat sbaat' kandarindhu nadavadikkai edukka utharavu
Madurai: sameeva naatkalaaga maanila alavil kaaychal paadhippu adhigarithu varugiradhu. Idhil tengu kaaychalum kurippidathakka alavil ulladhaal munnerpaattu nadavadikkaiyai arasu mudukki vittulladhu. Madurai maavattathil kaaychal paadhippugalai udanukkudan kandarindhu nadavadikkai edukka
Collector nishaanth kirushnaa ullaatchi mandrangalukku utharavittullaar.
Idhaiyaduthu ooraatchi ondriyangal, perooraatchi, nagaraatchigal vizhippunarvu matrum seyalbaadugalil theeviram kaatti varugindrana. Paruvamazhai thuvangum munbe thooymaip paniyai mudukki vittullanar. Enave anaithu ondriya adhigaarigalum 'maas kileening' nadavadikkaiyil theeviram kaatti varugindranar.
Thanneer thengum idangalai kandarivadhu, veedugalin aruge tayar, thengaay odu, kaali tappaakkal ena mazhaineer thengum porutkalai appurappaduthi varugindranar. Thooymaip paniyaalargal veeduveedaaga sendru
thengiya thanneer, thottigalil kosuppuzhukkal (laarvaa) ullanavaa ena aayvu nadathi varugindranar.
Nooru veedugalil aindhil 'laarvaa'kkal irundhaalo, kaaychal paadhippu irundhaalo appagudhiyai 'haat sbaat' ena arivithu angu sirappu kavanam kodukkindranar. Thinamum sendru adhai kuraikkum nadavadikkaiyai merkolla utharavittullanar. Podhu kudineer thottigalil thinamum kulorinesan seythu varugindranar.
Viyaazhandhorum mugaamgal
kiraama panjjaayathu udhavi iyakkunar (therku) suresh kooriyadhaavadhu: vasippidangalai thooymaiyaaga vaithirukka Collector utharavittullaar. Enave viyaazhandhorum sirappu mugaamgal nadakkindrana.
Mudhal vaaram veedugal aruge tayar, sirattai, kaali tappaakkalai appurappaduthuvadhu, 2vadhu vaaram palli, anganvaadi pagudhigal, 3 vadhu vaaram maruthuvamanaigal, aaramba sugaadhaara nilaiyangal, 4vadhu vaaram arasu aluvalagangalil thooymaip pani nadaiverum. Indha vaaram koodudhal nadavadikkaiyaaga palli, kalloori vidudhigalil ippaniyai merkolla utharavittullanar.
Thooymaip panikkaaga ondriya alavil 'tengu masdhoor' enum thooymaip paniyaalargal 30 mudhal 40 per varai maavatta alavil 500 kkum merpattor idhil eeduvaduvar. Kosukkal parava vaayppindri thooymaiyaaga vaithirundhaal paadhippai thavirthu vidalaam, endraar.

headline: Adhigaarigalukkaaga kaathirundha maatruthiranaaligal kumural
text:
Kovai: nadappu aandukkaana petrol scooter vazhanguvadharkaana nermugath thervu, maavatta maatruthiranaaligal nala aluvalagathil netru nadandhadhu. Azhaippaanai kodukkappatta 120 peril, 100- per pangetranar.
Kaalai 10.30 manikku nermuga thervu nadakkum ena koorappattirundhadhaal, kaalai 9 manikke palveru pagudhigalilirundhu vandha maatruthiranaaligala kaathirundhanar.
Aanaal, nermugath thervukku vattaara pokkuvarathu thuraiyai serndha pirek insbekdar varuvadhil thaamadham erpattadhu.
Idhanaal, kurippitta nerathil thervu thuvangavillai.  Pagal 12.30 manikku mel nermugath thervu thuvangiyadhu. Idhanaal, pala mani neram kaathirundha maatruthiranaaligal adhirupdhi adaindhanar.
Maatruthiranaaligal koorugaiyil, ‘passil payanippadhil siramam ulladhaal, auto, car ullitta vaaganangalil adhiga selavu seythu vandhom. Aanaal, uriya nerathil nermugath thervu thuvangavillai. Saappidakkooda veliye sella mudiyaamal, pala mani neram ingeye kaathirukkirom. Adhigaarigalin oppudhalukku pirage mugaam thedhi irudhi seyyappadum. Appadi irukkaiyil, adhigaarigal kaaladhaamadhamaaga vandhaal eppadi?’ endranar.
Adhigaarigalidam kettavodhu, vattaara pokkuvarathuth thurai aluvalargal veru paniyil irundhadhaal, nermugath thervukku varuvadhil thaamadham erpattadhaaga therivithanar.

headline: Payangaravaadhathaal paadhikkappattom; America-vil Iran adhivar masooth peshesgiyaan pechu
text:
Niyooyaark: 'naangalaaga sendru yaaraiyum thaakkavillai. Aanaal, engal meedhu America matrum Israel nadathiya payangaravaadhath thaakkudhalgalaal paadhikkappattullom,' ena, America-vil nadakkum ai.naa., podhu savai koottathil Iran adhivar masooth peshesgiyaan pesinaar.
Merkaasiya naadaana Iran meedhu Israel matrum America thodangiya por, aaru maadhangalaik kadandhum thodargiradhu. Pala sutru pechu nadandhum por nirutham erpadavillai.
Innilaiyil, America-vin niyooyaarkkil nadakkum ai.naa., podhu savaiyin koottathil, Iran adhivar masooth peshesgiyaan pesinaar. Appodhu maraindha Iran uchath thalaivar Ayatollah ali kameniyin padathai avar kaiyil vaithirundhaar. Avar pesiyadhaavadhu:
naangal engalai tharkaathuk kondu varugirom. Naangal payangaravaadhigal alla. Engal naattin meedhu nadathappatta kozhaithanamaana thaakkudhalgalaal appaavi makkalai izhandhullom. Pallik kuzhandhaigal meedhu thaakkudhalgal nadathappattulladhu. Muzhu palathudan andhath thaakkudhalgalai naangal edhirgondu varugirom.
Engal meedhu amerikkaavum, isrelum thaakkudhal nadathugindrana. Adharkaaga naangal panindhu poga mudiyaadhu. Engalai panindhu pogumbadi koorum America adhivar tonaaldu Trump matrum matravargalukku naangal ondrai sollik kolla virumbugirom.
Amaidhiyaana muraiyilaana pechukku naangal eppodhume thayaaraaga irundhullom. Aanaal, mirattalgal moolam, athumeeralgal moolam, kattaayappaduthi engalai paniya vaikka mudiyum endru edhirbaarkkaadheergal.
Ivvaaru avar pesinaar.

headline: Misaa sattam.. Nerukkadi nilai kurithu neengal arindhugolla vendiyavai! Arasiyal pinnani vivaram!
text:
1960kalin irudhi, 1970kalin thodakkathil indhiraa kaandhi edhirgonda katchi ulnerukkadi, sarvadhesa azhutham, ulnaattu poraattangal anaithum serndhu 1975 avasaranilaikku vazhivaguthana. Maintenance of Internal Security Act enum misaa sattam moolam Needhimandram, pidiyaanai indri aayirakkanakkaana edhirppaalargal siraiyil adaikkappattanar. 1977 therdhalukkup pin janadhaa arasu misaavai rathu seythadhu.
Tamil Nadu sattamandra koottath thodaril pesuvorulaana misaa sattam kurithu therindhugollum aarvam adhigarithulla nilaiyil andhas sattathin pinnani kurithu virivaagap paarkkalaam.
Misaa sattathaip patrith therindhugolla vendum endraal naam nerukkadi nilaiyaip patrith therindhugolla vendum,. Nerukkadi nilaiyaith therindhugolla vendum endraal andha kaalagattathin soozhalaith therindhugolla vendum. 1964-il neruvin maraivu matrum 1966- il saasdhiriyin thideer maraivu aagiya soozhalgalukku idaiye indhiraa kaandhi piradhamaraagap porupperkiraar . Indhiraa kaandhiyin thanithuvamaana arasiyal pokku, Congress katchiyin mootha thalaivargalidaiye perum adhirupdhiyai erpaduthi katchikkul panipporai uruvaakkiyadhu.
1967 therdhalil mudhanmuraiyaaga Tamil Nadu utbada 8 maanilangalil Congress aatchiyaip parigoduthadhu. Congress katchi irandaagap pilavutra nilaiyilum, 1971 therdhalil indhiraa kaandhi maaverum vetri petru meendum piradhamaraanaar. Iruppinum katchi iru pirivugalaagas seyalbattu vandhadhum, edhiraniyil kaamaraajar, neelam sanjjeeva retti ullitta periya thalaivargal irundhadhum indhiraavukkuk Congress tharappilirundhu perum nerukkadiyaik koduthukkonde irundhana.
Ithagaiya ularasiyal soozhalukku idaiye, paagisdhaanudan por moondadhu. Vangadhesa vidudhalaip poril India-vin thalaiyeedu kaaranamaaga paagisdhaanaip pilandhu ‘vangadhesam’ endra pudhiya naadu uruvaanadhu. Idhu indhiraavin mukkiya raajadhandhira saadhanaiyaagak karudhappattaalum, avar kadumaiyaana sarvadhesa achuruthalgalaiyum edhirgolla vendiyirundhadhu.
America matrum soviyath yooniyan idaiyilaana panippor uchathilirundha akkaalathil, veliyuravuk kolgaiyil sudhandhiramaagas seyalbada ninaitha indhiraavai America, China, Pakistan aagiya naadugal achuruthalaagap paarthana. America adhivar richart niksan thannais sandhikka vandha indhiraavaik kaathirukka vaithu avamadhitha sambavamum nigazhndhadhu. Idhanodu, ulnaattu alavilum indhiraa kaandhikku edhiraaga eraalamaana poraattangal vedithana.
Aaga, katchi arasiyal, ulnaattu arasiyal, sarvadhesa arasiyal aagiya moondrilum ore nerathil kadumaiyaana nerukkadigalai indhiraa kaandhi edhirgondaar . Ichoozhalildhaan, 1971 therdhalil indhiraa kaandhi arasu adhigaariyaith thanadhu pirasaarathirkup payanbaduthi vidhigalaiyum sattathaiyum meeriyadhaagath vazhakku thodarappattadhu. Avaradhu therdhal vetri sellaadhu ena 1975 joon 12 andru alagaavaath uyar Needhimandram theerppalithadhu. Idhanaal thannai arasiyalilirundhe ozhithukkattum muyatsigal nadappadhaagak karudhiya indhiraa kaandhi, thanakku erpatta thanippatta arasiyal nerukkadiyai naattin thesiya nerukkadiyaaga maatrinaar.
1975 joon 25il pirappikkappatta nerukkadi nilai' arasukku edhiraaga sindhikkakkooda mudiyaadha adakkumurais soozhalai uruvaakkiyadhu . Adharku vazhivagutha mukkiyamaana sattangalil ondrudhaan 'misaa' . . Maintenance of Internal Security Act enbadhan surukkame ‘misaa’ (MISA) enbadhaagum. Thamizhil idhanai "Indhiya ulnaattup paadhugaappup paraamarippus sattam" endru kurippiduvar.
Ichattam kaavaldhuraikkum arasukkum alappariya adhigaarangalai vazhangiyadhu paadhugaappuk kaaranangalaik koori needhimandra visaaranai alladhu pidiyaanai indriye, oruvaraik kaidhu seythu siraiyil adaikka idhu vazhivagai seythadhu. 1950il iyatrappattu 1969il kaalaavadhiyaana thaduppuk kaaval sattathin neetchiyaagave misaa sattam iyatrappattadhu. Jeyappiragaash naaraayanan, adal pihaari vaajbaay, el.ke. Athvaani, lalluvirasaath yaadhav matrum Thamizhagathil M.K. Stalin, murasoli maaran, vaigo ullitta palar misaa sattathin keezh siraiyiladaikkappattanar. Andraiya DMK naadaalumandra uruppinar sittivaavu, siraiyil kadumaiyaagath thaakkappattadhaal 1977il uyirizhandhaar.
Nerukkadi nilai vilakkikkollappatta piragu 1977il nadaivetra podhuth therdhalil vendru aatchiyamaitha janadhaa katchi arasu, 1978 joolaiyil misaa sattathai muzhumaiyaaga rathu seythadhu. Indhiya jananaayaga varalaatril nerukkadi nilaiyum misaa sattamum, kudimakkalin adippadai urimaigalaip parithus sarvaadhigaarathin kora mugathai velippaduthiya oru karuppu athiyaayamaaga indralavum ninaivugoorappadugindrana.

headline: “eeraan thaakkudhalukku poomiyai savithu thaakkum isreliyargal” ena paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran thaakkudhalil Israel azhikkappattu varuvadhaal kovam konda Israel yoodhargal poomiyai mandhirangal jevithu adithu varuvadhaaga oru video

yoodhargal marathin kilaigal, ilaigalai tharaiyil ongi adithu vazhivaadu seyyum video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “poomiyai adikkum isreliyargal…!! Israel eeraanaal palamaaga azhikkappattuk kondulladhu..!! Thamadhu poomip pandhaanadhu isrelukku thurogam izhaikkiradhaam..!! Enave yoodhargal mandhirangal jevithu poomiyai kandikkiraargalaam..!! Telaviv mukkaalvaasi azhindhu vittadhu..!! Aravulagam anaithaiyum thanadhu kattuppaattukkul konduvarum yoodha muyatsi muriyadikkappattulladhu…!! Anaithaiyum izhandhadhaal oru vidha mana noykku adhiga isreliyar aalaagiyullanar..!!
Moodathanathai mothamaaga kuthagai eduthavargal yoodhargal. Aanaal thaangaldhaan ulaga magaa arivaali endru koorik kolvaargal nam oor piraamanargalaip pola.. Maru puram America ainaadhivadhi ulagil ulla piravalyamaana nootrukkanakkaana paadhargalai kooppittu thaan Iran poril vetri pera vendum endru jevikkiraar.
Kalla thoniyila velinaadu thappi odi America isrelukku muttu kodukkum eezha thamizhargale innumaa kanavu kaanuringal Iran poril America Israel vetri perum endru?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Israel meedhu Iran padhiladi thaakkudhal nadathi varum nilaiyil, Iran-in thaakkudhalai edhirgolla mudiyaadha isreliyargal indha paadhippu kaaranam poomi thaan endru kutramsaatti poomiyai thitti, mandhirangal jevithu, ilaigalaal adithu varugiraargal endru oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Indha poomiye isrelukku edhiraaga thurogam seythuvittadhu endru isreliyargal karudhi indha seyalai seythulladhaaga padhividappattulladhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video thelivillaamal ulladhu. Video-vil ullavargal mugathil maask anindhullanar. Enave, idhu koronaa kaalathil edukkappatta video-vaaga irukkalaam. Video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Aanaal, indha video eppodhu engu edukkappattadhu endru nammaal kandariya mudiyavillai.
Adhe nerathil yoodhargal paarambariyamaaga kondaadi varum sukkot (Sukkot) endra vizhaavin kadaisi naalaana hoshanaa rappaavin (Hoshana Rabba) podhu paavathaip pokkum vagaiyil villo (willow) endra marakkilai aindhai eduthu ippadi tharaiyil adippadhu vazhakkam endru video-kkal, seythigal namakkuk kidaithana.
Indha vizhaavai en kondaadugiraargal enbadharku thelivaana kaaranangal illai endru sila katturaigal koorugindrana. Iruppinum paarambariyamaaga idhu kondaadappattu varuvadhaal indrum adhaith thodarndhu seythu varuvadhaaga yoodha madhagurukkal therivithullanar. Idhu oru kaalathil mazhai peyyum sadangudan thodarbudaiyadhaaga irundhirukkalaam. Jerusalemil irundha yoodhargalin aalayam azhikkappattadhai ninaivugoora idhais seythirukkalaam endru silar koorugindranar. Paavam seythavargal thangalai sariseyya idhu thoonduvadhaaga matroru karuthum ulladhu.
Indha vizhaavai ovvoru aandum indha vizhaa akdovar (sila nerangalil sepdambar) maadhathil varum endrum, idhai ulagam muzhuvadhum ulla yoodhargal kondaadi varuvadhaagavum seythigal namakku kidaithana. Idhan moolam yoodhargal kaalagaalamaaga kondaadi varum avargaladhu pandigai naalai, Iran thaakkudhal kaaranamaaga poomiyai savithu, adhai marak kilaigalaal thaakkiya yoodhargal endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Laakap maranam thodarbaaga Stalin nadavadikkai eduthullaar endru Seeman paaraattinaaraa?
text:
Stalin aatchiyilaavadhu laakap maranathirku nadavadikkai edukkappattulladhu endru naam thamizhar katchiyin orunginaippaalar Seeman kooriyadhaaga oru news card

Seeman pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “staalin nadavadikkai eduthullaar. Endha aatchi vandhaalum laakkap maranam nadandhu kondudhaan irukkiradhu. Ayyaa Stalin aatchiyilaavadhu udanadiyaaga nadavadikkai eduthullanar. Ayyaa Edappadi aatchiyil nadandha laakkap maranam innum visaaranaiyil thaan ulladhu – NTK orunginaippaalar seemaan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sivagangai maavattam thiruppuvanathil kaavalaali oruvar Police sigichaiyil uyirizhandhadhu adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Indha sambavam thodarbaaga Police meedhu kolai vazhakku padhivu seyyappattulladhu. Vazhakkai si.pi.ai-kku maatri mudhalamaichar utharavittullaar. Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu arasu edutha nadavadikkaiyai naam thamizhar katchiyin orunginaippaalar Seeman varavetradhu pondru oru news card samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Joon 30, 2025 andru thaan “appaavin aatchiyil kollappadum appaavigal! Naangu aandugaala theeya thiraavida maadal aatchi; nadaiverum kaavaldhurai visaaranai padugolaigale saatchi!” endru Seeman arikkai veliyittirundhaar. Adharkullaaga Tamil Nadu arasaip paaraatti avar petti alithirukka vaayppillai enbadhaal indha news card thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha news card paarkka achu asalaaga pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pola ulladhu. Aanaalum ‘laakap’ enbadhai ‘laakkap’ endru pizhaiyaaga ezhudhiyirundhanar. Enave, idhai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittirukka vaayppillai. Aadhaarangal adippadaiyil idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvaith thodarndhom.
Pudhiya thalaimurai Facebook matrum adhan inaiyathalathil ippadi edhenum news card veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru news kaardum illai. Adhe pondru Seeman appadi petti alithadhaaga endha seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Enave, indha news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Idhan moolam indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: UPI parivarthanaigalukku kattanam nirnayam.. Mathiya arasu pudhiya arivippu! Vivaram therinjjikkonga
text:
Mathiya arasu veliyitta pudhiya arivippin padi, thaninavargalukkidaiyeyaana yuviai digital parivarthanaigalukku endhak kattanamum illai. Aanaal railway, tholaithodarbu, kaappeedu, erivorul pondra kurippitta vaniga thuraigalil roo.2000-kku merpatta yuviai parivarthanaigalukku roo.5 kattanam matrum 0.4% varthaga kattanam, adhigavatcham roo.300 varai nirnayam seyyappattulladhu.
Nodippozhudhil digital muraiyil parivarthanai nadappadhaal saamaaniyaargal, viyaavaarigal ena anaithu tharappinar idaiye yuviai parivarthanai mukkiyap pangaatrugiradhu. Yuviai payanbaadu naalukkunaal adhigarithu varum nilaiyil adharkaana sarvar paraamarippu selavugal, adhigarithu varum parivarthanai alavugal aagiyavatrai kaiyaala vangigalukkum, kattana sevai niruvanangalukkum perum selavaagiradhu. Idhanaal, yuviai parivarthanaigalukku emdiaar kattanathai meendum konduvara vendum ena ithuraiyai serndha niruvanangal thodarndhu korikkai viduthu vandhana.
Indha nilaiyil, roo.2000-kkum merpatta yuviai vaniga panap parivarthanaigalukku, koodudhal kattanam vidhikkappadalaam enath thagavalgal veliyaagina. Idhanaal podhumakkal mathiyil adhirchi erpattadhu.
Ithagaiya soozhalildhaan, 2 aayiram roobai varaiyilaana yuviai panapparivarthanaigal matrum roove tevit kaardugalukku vangigalo, sevai niruvanangalo endhavidhak kattanamum vasoolikkakkoodaadhu endru mathiya nidhiyamaichagam arasaanai veliyittadhaaga thagaval veliyaanadhu. Aanaal tharpodhu 2000 roovaaykku melaana vaniga parivarthanaigalukku kattanam nirnayam seyyappattiruppadhaaga arivippu veliyaagi ulladhu.
Veliyaagiyirukkum arivippin padi, “thaninavargalukku idaiyeyaana digital parivarthanaigalukku kattanam kidaiyaadhu. Adhevelaiyil railway, tholaithodarbu sevaigal, kaappeedu, erivorul pondra kurippitta vaniga pirivugalil roo.2,000-kku merpatta UPI parivarthanaikku roo.5 kattanam nirnayam seyyappattulladhu. Mukkiyamaaga roo.2,000-kku merpatta varthaga UPI parivarthanaigalukku 0.4% kattanam vidhikkappadum endrum, oru parivarthanaikkaana adhigavatcha varthaga kattanamaaga roo.300-aaga nirnayam seyyappadum ena arivikkappattulladhu.

headline:
Mudivukku varum Iran - America modhal?
Trump sonna paravarappu thagaval..
Kaaranam enna?
text:
Mudivukku varum Iran - America modhal? Trump sonna paravarappu thagaval.. Kaaranam enna?
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar. Ra
Iran anu aayudha thayaarippil eeduvaduvadhaagak koori, amerikkaavum isrelum kadandha ezhu maadhathirkum melaaga Iran meedhu thodarndhu thaakkudhal nadathi varugindrana. Eeraanaiye America azhithuvidum enap pechugal adivattu vandha nilaiyil, pala maadhangalaaga eeraanum thodarndhu padhil thaakkudhal nadathi varugiradhu. Indhap porp padhatrathirku mathiyil, Iran thanadhu kattuppaattil irundha haarmus neerinaiyai moodiyadhu. Idhan kaaranamaaga sarvadhesa alavil enney varthagam peridhum paadhikkappattu, kachaa enney vilai kidugiduvena uyarndhadhu.
Idhanaal ulaga naadugal anaithum indhap por eppodhu mudivadaiyum ena edhirbaarthuk kondirukkindrana. Amerikkaavukkum eeraanukkum idaiyilaana modhal theeviramadaindhulla nilaiyil, viraivil por mudivadaiya ulladhaaga America adhivar Trump pesiyirukkiraar. America-vil idaikkaala naadaalumandrath therdhal nadaivera ulla nilaiyil, kudiyarasuk katchiyin pirasaarathirkaagas selvadharku munbu seythiyaalargalai Trump sandhithaar. Appodhu, kachaa enney matrum pira porutkalin vilai eppodhu kuraiyum enak kelvi ezhuppappattadhu.
Idharkup padhilalitha Trump, therdhal mudindha udaneye enney vilai kadumaiyaaga veezhchiyadaiyap povadhaagavum, therdhalukkup piragu por udanadiyaaga mudivukku varum ena thaan ninaippadhaagavum therivithaar. Melum, eeraanaal inimel indhap poraith thaakkuppidikka mudiyaadhu endrum Trump pesi iruppadhu meendum sarvadhesa alavil kavanam petrulladhu. America-vil navambar 3aam thedhi nadaivera ulla naadaalumandra idaikkaalath therdhal migavum mukkiyamaanadhaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Enenil, America adhivarukku palveru nadavadikkaigalai merkolla Congress-in oppudhal matrum sattamandra aadharavu thevaippadum soozhalgal ullana.
Tharpodhu trambin aadharavu katchiyaana kudiyarasuk katchiye Congress-il perumbaanmaiyaip petrulladhaal, Trump nirvaagam thanadhu kolgaigal matrum satta munmozhivugalai munneduthus sella saadhagamaana soozhal ulladhu. Aanaal, indha idaikkaalath therdhalil kudiyarasuk katchi thanadhu perumbaanmaiyai izhandhaalo jananaayagak katchi perumbaanmaiyaip petraalo, trambin nirvaagathirku arasiyal reedhiyaaga palveru sikkalgal erpada vaayppulladhu enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Kumbagonam: DMK piramugarukkus sondhamaana laatjil paaliyal thozhil; 10 pengal meetbu; 3 per kaidhu
text:
Kumbagonam: DMK piramugarukkus sondhamaana laatjil paaliyal thozhil; 10 pengal meetbu; 3 per kaidhu
kumbagonathil poleesaar nadathiya sodhanaiyil DMK piramugarukkus sondhamaana laatj ullitta irandu idangalil paaliyal thozhil nadandhadhu kanduvidikkappattadhu. Idhil eeduvaduthappatta 10 pengal meetkappattullanar.
Thanjavur maavattam, kumbagonathil ulla laadaj, sbaa ullitta idangalil, adhigappadiyaaga paaliyal thozhil nadappadhaaga, es.pi sundharavadhanathirkup pugaargal sendrullana.
Idhu thodarbaaga, kumbagonam merku matrum anaithu magalir Police ullittor palveru idangalil sodhanai nadathinar. Thanjavur vadakku maavatta thimuga-vil poriyaalar ani amaippaalaraaga ullavar raajaaraguvadhi.
Naagesvaran koyil therku veedhiyil, ivarukkus sondhamaana, paiv staar laatjil poleesaar sodhanaiyil eeduvattanar. Idhil angu paaliyal nadappadhu kandu adhirchiyadaindhanar.
Angu paaliyal thozhilil eeduvaduthappatta aaru pengalai poleesaar meettanar. Idhe pol, saarangavaani therku veedhiyil ulla kalars endra azhagu nilaiyathil nadathiya sodhanaiyil paaliyal thozhil nadandhulladhu theriyavandhulladhu.
Paaliyal thozhilil eeduvaduthappatta vadamaanilap pengal ullitta naangu pengalai poleesaar meettanar. Idhugurithu, merku Police vazhakkuppadhivu seythu, meetkappatta pengalai thiruchiyil ulla pengal kaappagathil oppadaithanar.
Melum, laatj paniyaalargalaana anaikkarai pagudhiyais sondha manigandan (34), kumbagonathais sondha magesh(50) matrum kalars azhagu nilaiya menejaraana jaargant maanilathais sondha sottaal thaakkoor (36) aagiya moovaraiyum poleesaar kaidhu seythanar. Athudan thalaimaraivaaga ulla moondru perai valaiveesi thedi varugindranar.
Poleesaar sodhanaiyaith theevirappadutha vendum enavum samooga aarvalargal korikkai vaithullanar.

headline: Utharap piradhesathil lanjjam tharaadha noyaaliyai keezhe thallivitta aambulans tiraivar endra thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’utharap piradhesathil lanjjam tharaadha noyaaliyai keezhe thallivitta 108 aambulans tiraivar,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ BJP aatchi seyyum uthira piradhesa maanilam kondaa maavattathil paadhikkappatta navarai arasu aambulans veliye thonga vittu sendradhu. Siridhu thooram sendradhum noyaali nadurottil padukkai strecharudan vizhundhuvittaar. Adhaiyum kandu kollaamal aambulans sambava idathil irundhu parandhadhu. Keezhe vizhundha noyaali koorugaiyil. Arasu aambulanskku 500 roobai thaan thara vendum endrum aanaal aambulans ottunar 1000 roobai kettadhaagavum, idhanaal noyaaliyin uravinarukkum aambulans tiraivarukkum thagaraaru erpattadhaaga koorinaar.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil, naam idhudhodarbaaga oodagangalil erkanave velivandha seythigalai paarvaiyittom.
Idhanbadi, utharap piradhesa maanilam Gonda maavattathil ulla Balpur Jat endra kiraamathais serndha Hriday Lal enbavar adithuk kollappattadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Idhan meedhu needhi kettu, avaradhu uravinargal, irandha navarin sadalathai aambulansil irundhu, thallivittu, Lucknow – Gonda idaiyilaana thesiya nedunjjaalaiyil mariyal poraattam seyya muyatsithanar. Udanadiyaaga, Gonda Dehat Kotwali kaaval nilaiya Police andha idathirku sendru nilaimaiyai kattukkul konduvandhanar. Indha video-vai eduthu, aambulans tiraivar lanjjam kettu, noyaaliyai keezhe thallivittadhaagak koori, vendumendre samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Idhudhodarbaaga, naam sambandhappatta Police-aridam pesi urudhippaduthiyullom. Koodudhal seythi aadhaam idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video patriya thagaval, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “ini thimuga-vudan koottani illai” endru paarivendhar kooriyadhaagap paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Ariyaadha vayadhil thaan seytha thavatrai viral aakkiya DMK-yudan ini endha oru kaalathilum koottani kidaiyaadhu endru paarivendhar arivithadhaaga oru news card

aijege katchith thalaivar paarivendhar enappadum pachamuthuvin pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “ini DMK-yudan koottani kidaiyaadhu! Ariyaadha vayadhil naan seytha thavaru adhai DMK thaan peridhaakkiyadhu. En andharanga padathai veliyittu adhai viral aakkiya DMK-yudan ini oru kaalathilum koottani kidaiyaadhu – paarivendhar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Es.aar.em kalvi kuzhumangalaith thodangiyavarum aijege endra katchiyin thalaivaraaga iruppavarumaana paarivendhar engira pachamuthuvudaiyadhu endru thanippatta andharanga video ondru sila aandugalukku munbu inaiyathil veliyaanadhu. Idhai adippadaiyaaga vaithu ippodhu news card ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal thedhi arivikkappattulla nilaiyil BJP – ADMK koottaniyil pachamuthuvin katchi ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil DMK-yudan ini endhak kaalathilum koottani illai endru avar kooriyadhaaga palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Adharku avar sonna kaaranam enbadhu thanippatta muraiyil pachamuthuvin mariyaadhaiyaik kuraikkum vagaiyil vishamathanamaaga serthup padhivittadhu pol ulladhu. Melum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card pudhiya thalaimurai vazhakkamaaga veliyidum news card pol illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Paarivendhar pachamuthu ippadi oru arivippai veliyittullaaraa, adhu thodarbaaga seythi veliyaagi ulladhaa endru koogulil thedip paarthom. Appadi endha oru seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Pudhiya thalaimurai samooga oodaga pakkangalilum idhu pondru endha oru news kaardum kaanappadavillai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.

headline: 2021 sattamandra therdhalil kanimozhi alitha vaakkurudhi endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:

investigation_details:

headline: Kanganaa ranaavath thaakkappattadhaaga paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Pen 2 padathai vimarsitha BJP em.pi kanganaa ranaavathai pengal thaakkiyadhaaga oru video

kaaril irundhu irangiya pen oruvarai eraalamaana pengal serndhu thaakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “‘(pen 2)’ padam kurithu kanganaa ranaavath therivitha karuthaith thodarndhu sarchai vedithadhu; avar kaaril irundhu irangiyavodhu, pengal avarais soozhndhugondu araindhadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. ⚠️ Disclaimer indha padhivu samooga valaidhalangalil paravi varum video adippadaiyil pagirappadugiradhu.
Idhan unmaith thanmai matrum thulliyam adhigaarappoorvamaaga urudhippaduthappadavillai. Indha padhivu yaaraiyum aadharikkum alladhu edhirkkum nokkathil alla. Thagaval matrum vizhippunarvu nokkathirkaaga mattume pagirappadugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
BJP em.pi-yum nadigaiyumaana kanganaa ranaavathai pengal thaakkiyadhaaga video ondru samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil indha video unmaiyaa poyyaa endru theriyavillai endru Disclaimer-udan padhivittirundhanar. Indha video padhivil ulla thagaval unmaidhaanaa endru arindhugolla aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2026 joolai irudhiyil indha video-vai vanga mozhi oodagangal palavum veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil thirinaamul Congress nirvaagiyin magal meedhu BJP magalir aniyinar thaakkudhal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha veediyokkalai paarthom. Kaaril amarndhirundha, irangiya pennai paarkka BJP em.pi kanganaa pola illai.
En andha penmani thaakkappattaar endru ariya thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu merku vanga sattamandra therdhal mudivugal vandhavodhu indha penmaniyum avaradhu thandhaiyum BJP nirvaagiyaith thaakkiyadhaaga kutramsaattappattulladhu. Andha sambavathirkup piragu avargal thalaimaraivaagivittanar. Needhimandra utharavu adippadaiyil kaaval nilaiyathukku vandha andha pennai BJP magalir aniyinar thaakkinar endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhan moolam BJP em.pi kanganaa ranaavath thaakkappattadhaagap paravum video seythi thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Shek haseenaavaith thodarndhu magal.. WHO padhaviyil irundhu raajinaamaa.. Pinnaniyil vangadhesa arasiyal?
text:
Vangadhesa munnaal piradhamar shek haseenaavin magalaana saayimaa vaasath , ulaga sugaadhaara amaippin (WHO) thengizhakku aasiyap piraandhiyath thalaivar padhaviyilirundhu raajinaamaa seythullaar. Adhenerathil saayimaavin raajinaamaavaith thodarndhu, thengizhakku aasiyap piraandhiyathirkaana tharkaaligap poruppaalarai niyamikkavum, pudhiya thalaivaraith therndheduppadharkaana nadaimuraigalai merkollavum ulaga sugaadhaara amaippu aayathamaagi varugiradhu.
Vangadhesa munnaal piradhamar shek haseenaavin magalaana saayimaa vaasath, kadandha 2023-aam aandu navambaril nadaivetra therdhalil vetrivetru, 2024 pipravari maadham WHO thengizhakku aasiyap piraandhiya iyakkunaraagap poruppetraar. Idharkidaiye, vangadhesathil, 2024aam aandu arasukku edhiraaga maanavargal nadathiya poraattathinbodhu, appodhaiya piradhamaraaga irundha shek haseenaa India-vil thanjjamadaindhaar. Idhaiyaduthu avaradhu aatchi mudivukku vandhadhu. Appodhu, vangadhesathil mugamadhu yoonus thalaimaiyilaana idaikkaala arasu amaikkappattadhu. Avvarasu, poraattam thodarbaaga haseenaa matrum avaradhu kudumbathinar meedhu pala kutrachaattugalum satta nadavadikkaigalum thodangina. Idhan vilaivaaga, sarvadhesa amaippaana WHO-vil saayimaa vaasath thanadhu poruppil thodarvadharkup pala tharappilirundhum azhuthangal adhigarithana.
Pinnar nadaivetra podhuth therdhalil, pin.en.pi. Koottani amoga vetrivetru ariyanaiyaip pidithadhu. Akkatchiyin thalaivar thaarik rahmaan pudhiya piradhamaraagap padhaviyetruk kondaar.
Indha nilaiyildhaan, saayimaa vaasath , ulaga sugaadhaara amaippin thengizhakku aasiyap piraandhiyath thalaivar padhaviyilirundhu raajinaamaa seythullaar. Munnadhaaga, ulaga sugaadhaara amaippu kadandha aandu avarai, irudhiyil oodhiyamillaa nirvaaga viduppil anuppiyadhu. Haseenaavirkup padhilaaga amaindha idaikkaala arasaangathin keezh, vangadhesathin oozhal edhirppu aanaiyam andha aandu maars maadham avar meedhu mosadi matrum poli aavanam thayaarithadhaagak kutrachaattugalaip padhivu seythadhaith thodarndhu, avar mudhanmudhalil 2025-aam aandu joolai maadham viduppil anuppappattaar.
Eninum, avar indhak kutrachaattugalai maruthirundhaar. Adhenerathil saayimaavin raajinaamaavaith thodarndhu, thengizhakku aasiyap piraandhiyathirkaana tharkaaligap poruppaalarai niyamikkavum, pudhiya thalaivaraith therndheduppadharkaana nadaimuraigalai merkollavum ulaga sugaadhaara amaippu aayathamaagi varugiradhu. Ulaga sugaadhaara amaippu janavariyil pudhiya therdhalgalai nadatha iruppadhaagath thagaval veliyaagi ulladhu.

headline: Mudhalamaichar vetbaalarai BJP thalaimaidhaan mudivu seyyum endru el.murugan koorinaaraa?
text:
ADMK – BJP koottaniyil mudhalamaichar vetbaalarai BJP thalaimaidhaan mudivu seyyum endru el.murugan kooriyadhaaga oru news card

Polimer news veliyitta news card-ai vaithu samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Adhil, “mudhalamaichar vetbaalar – el.murugan karuthu. ADMK – BJP koottaniyil mudhalamaichar vetbaalarai BJP thalaimaidhaan mudivu seyyum – BJP Thamizhaga thalaivar, el.murugan” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kadandha naadaalumandrath therdhalil ADMK koottaniyilirundhu vilagi BJP thani koottani amaithup pottiyittadhu. Adhaith thodarndhu iru katchith thalaivargalum kaarasaaramaana karuthukkalai veliyittanar. Paajaga-vudan eppodhum koottani illai endru ADMK arivithirundhadhu. Tharpodhu meendum ADMK – BJP koottani erpattulladhu. Indha soozhalil pazhaiya thagavalai ellaam pudhidhu pola palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-il thedhi sariyaagath theriyavillai. Aanaal, BJP Thamizhaga thalaivar el murugan endru thelivaaga ulladhu. Idhan moolam idhu pazhaiya news card enbadhu therigiradhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom.
Indha thagavalai appadiye koogulil padhivittu thedinom. Appodhu, 2020m aandu Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivaraaga appodhirundha el.murugan indha karuthaik kooriyirundhadhu unmaidhaan enbadhu thelivaanadhu. Aanaal indha karuthu ippodhaiya arasiyal soozhalukkup porundhaadhu. Enenil, Edappadi Palaniswami thalaimaiyildhaan koottani endru amithshaave arivithuvittaar. Enave, pazhaiya seythiyai pudhidhu pol parappi koottanik katchith thondargal mathiyil adhirupdhiyai erpaduthum vagaiyil padhividappattiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card unmaidhaan. Aanaal pudhidhu illai. 2020m aandu veliyaana news card idhu. Pazhaiya news card enbadhai maraithu pudhidhaaga arivippu veliyittadhu pol vadhandhi parappiyullanar. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Paak raanuva veerargalai azhitha paloos padaiyinar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Pakistan raanuvathaith thani palusisdhaan kettup poraadum paloos theeviravaadhigal thaakki azhithaargal endru oru video

raanuva vaaganangal anivaguthu varum podhu, avatrai ottu mothamaaga thaakki azhippadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kaalailaye kannivedi vachu, paak iraanuva veerargala mothamaa thookkirukkaanunga paloos aarmi. Paloos ellaikkulla vandhaale adippomnu echarikkai vera koduthirundhaanunga paloos🤣” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Paagisdhaanilirundhu thani palusisdhaan vendum endru palusisdhaan pagudhiyil makkal pala aandugalaaga poraadi varugindranar. Sameeva kaalangalil poraattam theeviramadaindhu Pakistan raanuvathirkuth thalaivaliyai erpaduthi varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, palusisdhaan pagudhikkul sendru kondirundha Pakistan raanuvathai paloos raanuvam mothamaagath thaakki azhithadhu endru video-vai palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vil aravu mozhiyil ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Paarkka mathiya kizhakku pagudhiyil nadaiverum modhal sambavathin video pola ulladhu. Enave, idhu unmaiyil Pakistan-il nadandhadhudhaanaa alladhu veru video-vai eduthu Pakistan-il nadandhadhu endru padhivittullaargalaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu eman naattil poraadi varum havudhi kilarchiyaalargal isrelukku edhiraaga America – pirittan padaigalidam irundhu kaippatriya vaaganangalaith thagarthup porp payitsiyil eeduvattanar enbadhu pondru 2024m aandu maars 18m thedhi X thalathil veliyaana padhivu ondru namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil video migavum thelivaaga irundhadhu. Adhil indha video 2024 maars 10m thedhi edukkappattadhaagak kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu epral 21, 2024l YouTube-il veliyaana video ondril naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil idam petra kaatchigal irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, havudhi kilarchiyaalargal raanuva othigaiyil eeduvattadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Video-vil 3.07vadhu nimidathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda kaatchi vandhadhu. Adhilum havudhi padaiyinar raanuva payitsi merkondanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video paagisdhaanais saarndhadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Thozhilaalar sangathinar aarppaattam
text:
Udumalai: palveru korikkaigalai valiyuruthi, thozhilaalar udhavi aayvaalar aluvalagam mun, udumalai thaalugaa podhuthozhilaalar sangathinar aarppaattam seythanar.
Aarppaattathukku sangathin thaalugaa thalaivar ranganaadhan thalaimai vagithaar. Si.ai.ti.yu., maavattacheyalaalar rangaraaj, thunaicheyalaalar jegadheesan, agila Indhiya vivasaaya thozhilaalar sanga maavattacheyalaalar kanagaraaj aarppaattathil, thozhilaalargalukkaana nala vaariya udhavithogai vazhangaamal, visaaranai endra peyaril alaikkazhikkum muraiyai thozhilaalar nalathuraiyinar kaivida vendum. Nalavaariya udhavithogai matrum nivaaranathai udanadiyaaga vazhanga vendum ullitta palveru korikkaigal valiyuruthappattadhu.
