headline: 'rashyaavidam vaanguvadhai nirutha mudiyaadhu..' India-vukku sikkal? Nirmalaa seedhaaraaman sonna kaaranam!
text:
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
rashyaa-ukrain por thodangiya piragu, Russia enney varthagam meedhu merkathiya naadugal palveru kattuppaadugalai vidhithana. Idhan kaaranamaaga, Russia thangal naattil urpathi seyyappadum enneyyai India ullitta naadugalukku adhigalavil virpanai seythu varugiradhu. Indhiyaavum thodarndhu rashyaavidam irundhu kanisamaana alavil kachaa enneyyai vaangi varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, Russia enneyyai vaangum naadugal meedhu America-vin azhuthamum adhigarithu varugiradhu. Russia enney matrum erivaayuvai thodarndhu vaangum naadugal meedhu 100 vizhukkaadu vari vidhikka America adhivarukku adhigaaram vazhangum sattamum America-vil niraivetrappattulladhu. Idhanaal, India meedhum koodudhal azhutham erpadakkoodiya soozhal uruvaagiyulladhu.
Rashyaavidam irundhu enney vaanguvadhai India ullitta naadugal nirutha vendum endru Ukraine adhivar vilaadimirmir jelensgiyum thodarndhu valiyuruthi varugiraar. Russia-vin enney varuvaay kuraindhaal, Ukraine porukkaana Russia-vin selavilum thaakkam erpadum enbadhu avaradhu karuthaaga ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil, Russia enney vaanguvadhai India thideerena niruthivittu, veru naadugalidam irundhu enney vaanga mudiyumaa endra kelvi ezhundhulladhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga padhilalitha mathiya nidhiyamaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman, India rashyaavidam irundhu enney vaanguvadhai niruthinaal, udanadiyaaga veru naadugalidam irundhu thevaiyaana alavu enneyai vaanguvadhu siramamaaga irukkum endru therivithullaar. Ulagalavil kidaikkum enneyyin alavu erkenave kuraivaaga irukkum nilaiyil, India pondra migapperiya naadu ore nerathil sandhaiyil irundhu adhiga alavil enneyyai vaangath thodanginaal, enney vilai melum adhigarikka vaayppu iruppadhaagavum avar kooriyullaar.
Adhumattumallaamal, India-vin suthigarippu nilaiyangalilum sila kattuppaadugal iruppadhaaga nirmalaa seedhaaraaman therivithullaar. Adhaavadhu, ulagil kidaikkum anaithu vagaiyaana kachaa enneyyaiyum India-vil ulla anaithu suthigarippu nilaiyangalaalum ore maadhiriyaaga suthigarikka mudiyaadhu. Enneyyin adarthi ullitta palveru kaaranigalaip poruthe adhais suthigarikka mudiyumaa enbadhu theermaanikkappadugiradhu.
Idhanaal, Russia enneykkup padhilaaga veru naattil irundhu enney vaanga vendum endraal, andha enney India-vin suthigarippu nilaiyangalukku etradhaa enbadhaiyum paarkka vendiya nilai ulladhu. Melum, India-vin 140 kodi makkalin andraada thevaikkaana erisakdhiyai urudhi seyvadhe arasin mukkiyap poruppu endrum nirmalaa seedhaaraaman therivithullaar. Indhiyaavaip poruthavarai, rashyaavidam irundhu enney vaanguvadhu enbadhu vilai mattumallaamal, naattin erisakdhi thevaiyai poorthi seyvadhu, enney kidaikkum alavu matrum Indhiya suthigarippu nilaiyangalukku adhu porundhumaa enbadhu ullitta palveru kaaranigalai adippadaiyaagak kondadhaaga nidhiyamaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman pesiyiruppadhu tharpodhu kavanam petrulladhu.

headline: Anaithu saadhi saandridhazhgalaiyum rathu seyya vendum endru piremaladhaa koorinaaraa?
text:
Essi, esti ullitta anaithu jaadhikkum ida odhukkeettai rathu seythu, saadhi saandridhazhgalai rathu seyya vendum endru piremaladhaa vijayagaanth kooriyadhaaga oru news card

san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “SC,ST ulbada endha jaadhikkum ida odhukkeedu avasiyamillai. Indhiya makkal anaivarum theyvathin kuzhandhaigal ena karudhuvadhaal thaniyaaga saadhivaari kanakkeduppu thevaiyillai. Udane anaithu saadhi saandridhazhgalum rathu seyya vendum. Salugaigal anaithum thirumbap pera vendum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ida odhukkeedu avasiyamillai, saadhis saandrugalai rathu seyya vendum endru themudhiga podhus seyalaalar piremaladhaa kooriyadhaaga oru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Aanaal, unmaiyil san TV veliyitta news card-ai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthadhu pondru ulladhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Piremaladhaa vijayagaanth ida odhukkeedu, saadhivaari kanakkeduppu thodarbaaga edhenum karuthu therivithullaaraa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu saadhivaariyaana kanakkeduppu thodarbaaga petti alithiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhil saadhivaari kanakkeduppu thevaiyillai endru koorinaar. Saadhi saandridhazh, ida odhukkeedu thevaiyillai endrellaam avar kooravillai. Enave, indha thagaval paadhi unmai, paadhi thavaraanadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Aduthadhaaga san news indha news card-ai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathil veliyaana news kaardugalai paarvaiyittom. Sepdambar 6, 2025 andru naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card ondru veliyaagi irundhadhu. Aanaal adhil”avasiyamillai, Indhiya makkal anaivarum theyvathin kuzhandhaigal ena karudhuvadhaal thaniyaaga saadhivaari kanakkeduppu thevaiyillai. Sengottaiyanin pechu ADMK-vin utkatchi vivagaaram enbadhaal karuthu koora mudiyaadhu piremaladhaa” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthiruppadhu therigiradhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga san TV digital poruppaalarin WhatsApp ennukku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil unmaiyudan thavaraana thagavalai serthu vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: “indhiyargale thirumbi ungal naattukku sellungal” endru isreliyar mirattinaaraa?
text:
Indhiyargale ungal naattukkuth thirumbip pongal endru isreliyargal kathuvadhaaga oru video

aan oruvar pen oruvarai miratti avaradhu mugathil thanneerai ootrum video fesbakkil padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, ” #indhiyargale thirumbi unga naattukku ponga endru isreliyargal kovamaaga kathugiraargal… idhu theriyaama inga irukkum sangigal #isreliyargalukku sombadikkiraanga ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Isrelukku BJP, aar.es.es aadharavaalargal aadharavu therivithu varum nilaiyil, Israel-il indhiyargalukku edhiraana mananilai ulladhu enbadhu pondru padhivu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Indhiya pennai, veliyerumbadi isreliyar mirattiyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video thelivaaga illai… “ko tu indhiyaa” endru andha yoodhar kooruvadhu pola ulladhu. Aanaal andha pennai paarkkum podhu indhiyar polavum illai. Yashvaa alladhu yaashvaa endru solvadhu polak ketkiradhu. Adharku andha aan idhu Israel endru mirattuvadhum ketkiradhu. Ivai ellaam sandhegathai erpaduthave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadamaaga maatri rivars imej thedal thalangalil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, yandex.com thedal thalathil namakku oru padhivu kidaithadhu. Adhil, “angel disguised preaching the gospel but got rejected” endru irundhadhu. Adhaavadhu “thevadhoodhan natseythiyai arivithavodhu adhu niraagarikkappattadhu” endru irundhadhu. Adhaippadiye koogulil taip seythu thediya podhu instaagiraam padhivu ondru namakkuk kidaithadhu.
2025 maars 6m thedhi veliyidappattirundha andha padhivil Israel-il natseythi (kirisdhavam) arivikkappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thelivaana muzhumaiyaana andha video-vai paarkkum podhu andha pen yaashvaa endrum jeesas kiraist (Jesus Christ) endrum kooruvadhaik ketka mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam Israel-il iyesu patri podhanaiyil andha pen eeduvatta podhu yoodhargal edhirppu therivithiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Andha instaagiraam pakkathil adhe pen Israel-il iyesu patri podhanai seytha podhu isreliyargalaal thaakkappatta veru veediyokkalum irundhadhu. Avatril ellaam kirisdhava madha podhagar endre kurippidappattirundhadhu. Endha naattais saarndhavar endru adhil kurippidappadavillai. Kurippaaga avar indhiyar endru endha padhivilum kurippidappadavillai. Ivai ellaam andha pen indhiyar enbadhaal viradappadavillai, iyesuvai arivithadhaal virattappattaar enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Video-vil, andha yoodhar “indhiyaavukku sel idhu Israel, yoodhargaludaiyadhu” endru koorugiraar. Aanaal, andha pen indhiyar enbadharku endha aadhaaramum namakku kidaikkavillai. Melum, indhiyar enbadhaal indhiyargal anaivarum isrelai vittu veliye poga vendum endru avar kooravillai. Yoodhargal mathiyil kirisdhavam patri andha pen pirasaaram seythadhaaleye veliyerumbadi koorugiraar. Adhai ottumothamaaga indhiyargalai izhivu seythadhu pondru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Israel-il yoodhargal mathiyil iyesu patri podhanai seytha pennai, yoodhar oruvar thadutha kaatchiyai indhiyarai virattiya yoodhar endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nedhaajiyin uruvam poritha 500 roobai thaal kudiyarasu thina vizhaavil veliyidappattadhaa?
text:
‘‘nedhaajiyin uruvam poritha 500 roobai thaal kudiyarasu thina vizhaavil veliyidappattadhu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ nedhaajiyin uruvam poritha 500 roobai thaalgalai kudiyarasu thina vizhaavil veliyittanar |ippadhaan muzhu sudhandhiram adaindhadhu pola ulladhu’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu. Aam, ivvaaru nedhaajiyin uruvam poritha 500 roobai thaal edhuvum kudiyarasu thina vizhaavil veliyidappattadhaaga, endha seythiyum oodagangalil idamberavillai.
Aduthappadiyaaga, kurippitta pugaippadathil thamizh sinimaa fens channel / Tamil Cinema Fans Channel endra logo ulladhaik kandom.
Idhan adippadaiyil aayvu seythavodhu, Tamil Cinema Fans Channel endra peyaril iyangum instaagiraam pakkathil mudhanmudhalaaga, merkanda pugaippadam padhivu seyyappattadhaaga, theriyavandhadhu. Adhileye, indha pugaippadam AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhu, endru thelivaagak kurippittullanar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhalla, enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, hivemoderation, wasitai aagiya inaiyadhalangal moolam merkanda pugaippadathai paguppaayvu seythom. Idhu AI udhaviyudan thayaarikkappattadhudhaan, endru urudhi seyyappattadhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mamdhaa katchiyin sinnam mudakkam therdhal kamishanukku Court kelvi
text:
Mamdhaa katchiyin sinnam mudakkam therdhal kamishanukku Court kelvi
–sirappu niruvar–
thirinamul Congress katchiyin sinnam matrum peyar yaarukku sondham enbadhai theermaanikka evvalavu kaala avagaasam thevaippadum enbadhai vilakkumbadi therdhal kamishanukku ucha Needhimandram utharavittulladhu.
Merku vangathil nadandhu mudindha sattasavai therdhalil, mamdhaa paanarjiyin thirinamul Congress katchi padudholvi adaindhadhu. Idhanaal, ammaanilathil akkatchiyin, 15 aandugaala aatchi mudivukku vandhadhu. Mudhalvaraaga suvendhu adhigaari padhaviyetradhan moolam, angu mudhal muraiyaaga paa.ja., aatchi amaindhadhu.
Indha arasiyal maatram kaaranamaaga mamdhaa paanarjiyin thirinamul kaang., katchikkul utkatchi poosal uchathai ettiyadhu. Katchiyin em.el.e.,kkal, 60 per, ridhaviradhaa paanarji thalaimaiyilum, em.pi.,kkal, 20 per, kagoli kosh thasdhidhaar thalaimaiyilum porgodi uyarthi thani aniyaaga seyalbattu varugindranar.
Thirinamul kaangirasukkul erpatta indha pilavu kaaranamaaga, katchiyin peyar matrum sinnathai therdhal kamishan mudakkiyadhu. Melum mamdhaa matrum adhirupdhi em.el.e., tharappukku vevveru peyar matrum sinnathaiyum odhukkiyulladhu.
Idhanai edhirthu mamdhaa paanarji tharappil, ucha needhimandrathil manu thaakkal seyyappattadhu. Immanu thalaimai needhivadhi sooryagaanth matrum needhivadhigal jaaymaalyaa paksi, vi.moganaa amarvil netru visaaranaikku vandhadhu.
Appodhu mamdhaa tharappil aajaraana mootha vazhakkarinjar kavil sivil, ‘‘merku vangathil varum ak.,6 idaitherdhal nadakkum samayathil, thirinamul kaang., katchiyin sinnam, peyar irandaiyum therdhal kamishan mudakki iruppadhu muraiyatra seyal. Idhanaal, muraiyaana nivaaranam pera mudiyaadha soozhal erpattulladhu. Eninum idaitherdhalukku udanadi thadai vidhikka vendum ena koravillai,’’ ena vaadhittaar.
Idhaith thodarndhu needhivadhigal pirappitha utharavu:
ivvazhakkil, therdhal kamishan tharappil uriya aadhaarangalai samarppikka kaala avagaasam vazhangugirom. Adhe samayam, katchiyin peyar matrum sinnam patri irudhi mudivu edukka evvalavu kaalam aagum enbadhai therdhal kamishan thelivaaga therivikka vendum.
Ivvaaru needhivadhigal utharavittanar.

headline: Rayilgalil 11 kilo kanjjaa 13 kilo pugaiyilai parimudhal
text:
Salem: jeyppoor - Kovai eksbiras rail netru, Salem nokki vandhu kondirundhadhu. Appodhu thanippadai Police sodhanai merkondanar.
Podhu pettiyil ketbaaratra nilaiyil kidandha paiyai sodhanai seythavodhu, 8.4 kilo kanjjaa, 11.5 kilo pugai-yilai pest irundhadhaal, parimudhal seythanar.adhevol paatnaa - ernaagulam eksbiras rail podhu pettiyil, ketbaaratra nilaiyil kidandha paiyil, 2 kilo pugaiyilai, 1 kilo kanjjaa saaklet irundhadhaal parimudhal seythanar. Thodarndhu Salem railway Police-aridam oppadaith-thanar. Avargal, rayilil kadathi vandhavargal kurithu visaarikkin-ranar.
Merku vangathavar kaidhu
shaalimaar - thiruvanandhavuram eksbiras rayilil netru, thanip-padai Police sodhanai nadathinar. Munbadhivatra pettiyil, oruvar thalaikku adiyil paiyai vaithu thoongikkondi-rundhaar. Avarai ezhuppi, paiyai sodhanai seythavodhu, 2 kilo kanjjaa irundhadhu. Visaaranaiyil merku vangathai serndha kirushna padaagant, 31, enbadhum, kanjjaa kadathi van-thadhum therindhadhu. Avarai kaidhu seytha Police, Salem railway Police-aridam oppadaithanar.
Kanjjaa vitra 3 per kaidhu
Salem, ammaavettai Police, naamamalai adivaarathil netru rondhu paniyil eeduvattanar. Angu, 'palsar' paikkil sandhegathukku idamaaga, 2 per nindrirundhanar. Avargalai pidithu sodhanai seythavodhu, pilaastik kavaril, 2.5 kilo kanjjaa vaithirundhadhu therindhadhu. Visaaranaiyil, ponnammaa-pettai, majith theruvai serndha ravudi raguvadhi, 34, ariyaaga-vundambatti, Palaniswami nagar joyal, 23, ena therindhadhu. Iruvaraiyum kaidhu seytha Police, kanjjaa, paikkai parimudhal seythanar.
Adhevol annadhaanappatti Police netru mundhinam, seelanaayakkanbattiyil rondhu paniyil eeduvattanar. Polee-saarai paarthadhum, 2 per thappa muyandranar. Oruvarai pidithu visaarithadhil, mayilaadudhurai maavattam tharangambaadi, memaathoor, thopputheruvai serndha saranraaj, 29, ena therindhadhu. Avarai sodhanai seythadhil, 3 kilo kanjjaa vaitha-rundhaar. Avarai kaidhu seytha Police, kanjjaavai parimudhal seythu, thappi odiyavar kurithu visaarikkindranar.

headline: Ambaasamuthirathil kanamazhai; nel moodaigal nanaindhu sedham
text:
Tirunelveli: Tirunelveli maavattam ambaasamuthiram sutriyulla pagudhigalil peytha thideer kanamazhaiyaal aruvadai seythu virpanaikkaaga vaikkappattirundha nel moodaigal nanaindhu sedha madaindhana.
Ambaasamuthirathais aduthulla ayan singambatti, jameen singambatti, vairaavigulam, therku paappaangulam ullitta pagudhigalil vivasaayigal nel aruvadai seythu varugindranar. Aruvadai seytha nelmanigalai veedugalin munbum, saalaiyorangalilum kuvithu vaithirundhanar.
Netru mundhinam maalai peytha thideer kanamazhaiyaal avai nanaindhana. Adhevol nel kolmudhal nilaiyangalil virpanaikkaaga kuvithu vaikkap pattirundha aayirakkanakkaana nel moodaigalum mazhaiyil nanaindhana.
Thodarndhu mazhai peythaal nelmanigal mulaithu melum sedhamadaiyum avaayam ulladhaal, vivasaayigal kavalai adaindhullanar.
Enave, nel kolmudhal nilaiyangalai viraivaaga thirandhu nel kolmudhal seyya vendum ena vivasaayigal korikkai viduthullanar.

headline: Regaa kupdhaa aatchiyil yamunaiyil pengal shaambu kuliyal seythanar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Yamunai aatril shaambuvai kalandhuvittadhan moolam aravinth kejrivaalai vida sirandha mudhalamaichar regaa kupdhaa endru arasiyal naiyaandiyaaga oru video

aatril kalandhu varum nuraiyil pengal thalaikku kulikkum veediyo Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kejrivaalai vida Delhi mudhalvar regaa kupdhaa paravaayillai, yamunaa jiyai sutham seyya ilavasa shaambu kalandhu vittullaar😜” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Telliyil kaatru, yamunai aatru neer maasu migapperiya pirasnaiyaaga ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil vada indhiyargal kondaadum sath poojaikkaaga yamunaiyil suthigarikkappatta neeraik kondu kulam ondrai Delhi arasu uruvaakkiyadhu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Indha soozhalil Delhi BJP mudhalamaichar regaa kupdhaa aatchiyil yamunai aatril varum nuzhai kazhivugalai shaambu pola payanbaduthik kulitha pengal endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha video-vai kadandha aande paartha ninaivu irundhadhaal, indha padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2024m aandu navambar mudhal vaarathil indha video seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Telliyil paayum yamunai aatril maasu alavukku adhigamaaga iruppadhaal yamunai aatril neeraadi sath poojai kondaada Delhi uyar Needhimandram thadai vidhithirundhadhu. Adhaiyum meeri pengal palarum yamunai aatril neeraadinar. Yamunaiyil vandha kazhivu nuraiyai shaambu pola payanbaduthi neeraadiya pengal endru andha padhivugalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Regaa kupdhaa 2025m aandu nadandha Delhi sattamandra therdhalil vetri petru mudhalamaicharaanaar. 2025m aandu pipravari 20m thedhidhaan mudhalamaicharaaga regaa kupdhaa poruppetraar. Aanaal naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai adharku naangu maadhangalukku munbe seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi ulladhu. Indha aandu pipravari varai aam aathmi katchidhaan telliyil aatchip poruppilirundhadhu. 2024m aandu sepdambar maadham aravinth kejrivaal mudhalvar poruppilirundhu vilaginaar. Adhaith thodarndhu aam aathmi katchiyin adhishi mudhalvaraaga poruppetraar. Video veliyaana 2024 navambar kaalagattathil aam aathmi katchidhaan telliyil aalungatchiyaaga irundhulladhu.
Regaa kupdhaa poruppetra piragu yamunaiyil thanneer suthamaagivittadhu endru kooravillai. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video regaa kupdhaa mudhalamaicharaaga poruppetra piragu padhivu seyyappattadhu illai enbadhu mattum thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Aam aathmi aatchik kaalathil 2024m aandu edukkappatta video-vai 2025l BJP aatchikkup piragu edukkappattadhu pondru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirappattiruppadhu thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Utharappiradhesathil idikkappadum kirisdhava thevaalayam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Utharappiradhesathil kirisdhava thevaalayam ondru idikkappadum kaatchi endru video ondru

kirisdhava aalayam ondrin mel vaikkappattirundha siluvaigalai oruvar udaikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Keezhe koodiyirundha makkal jeysreeraam endru kosham ezhuppugindranar. Video-vin meedhu “thevaalangal thaakkavadugiradhaa? Utharappiradhesathil kirisdhavargalukku edhirppu” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merku vangathil sila vaarangalukku munbu kattappattu varum kirisdhava aalayathai silar thaakkiyadhaaga seythi veliyaanadhu. Andha aalayathin meedhu vaikkappattirundha siluvaiyai oruvar udaikkum kaatchi appodhu samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattadhu. Andha video-vai eduthu utharappiradhesathil nadandhadhaaga silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Enave, indha video utharappiradhesathais saarndhadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seyvadharkaana aayvai merkondom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu merku vanga maanilam kolgathaa puranagarp pagudhiyaana therku 24 pargaanaa maavattam sonarbooril 2026 joolai 5m thedhi pirpagal 3 mani alavil indha sambavam nadandhadhaaga seythigal namakku kidaithana.
Andha pagudhiyil migas siriya alavil vasithu varum vanga mozhi pesum kirisdhavargal indha aalayathai kattiyadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, indha idathil kirisdhava aalayam kattakkoodaadhu endru koori silar siluvaigalai udaithu vanmuraiyil eeduvattadhaaga seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Melum indha sambavam thodarbaaga mudhal thagaval arikkai padhivu seyyappattu moondru ilainjargalai Police kaidhu seythu visaaranai seythu varuvadhaagavum tharpodhu angu amaidhi nilavuvadhaagavum seythigal kidaithana.
Indhiyan eksbiras sambava idathirku neril sendru andha pagudhi makkal, aalayathai katti varum kirisdhavargal ena anaithu tharappinarin pettiyaiyum eduthu YouTube-il veliyittirundhadhu. Avargal indha sambavam merku vangathil nadandhadhu enbadhai urudhi seythanar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivaanadhu paadhi unmai, paadhi thavaraana thagaval kondadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Annamalaiyudan pugaippadam eduthuk konda nigidhaa endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’Annamalaiyudan pugaippadam eduthuk konda nigidhaa’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ nigidhaa BJP udan nerungiya thodarbil iruppavar endru aadhaarangaludan seythigal varathodangivittana… ini nadunilaiyaalargal !! Ajeethgumaar padugolai kurithu pesuvadhai vegamaaga niruthuvaargal…,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan, nigidhaa matrum Annamalaiyudan pen oruvar nirpadhu pondra pugaippadam aagiya irandu pugaippadangalaiyum ondru serthu pagirndhullanar.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha thagavalai mudhalil DMK aadharavu pathirigaiyaalar sendhilvel samooga valaidhalangalil parappiyadhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Ivvaaru sendhilvel vadhandhi parappiyadharku kandanam therivithu, BJP nirvaagigal palarum X valaidhalathil padhivu veliyittirundhadhaiyum kandom.
Idhaiyaduthu, sendhilvel kurippitta padhivil irundha pugaippadathai, edit seythu, veroru pugaippadathai serthu, thanadhu padhivai apdet seythugondaar.
Sendhilvel apdet seytha padhivin sgirinshaattai meendum orumurai keezhe inaithullom.
Idharkidaiye BJP ai.ti.pirivu nirvaagi SG Suryah tharappilum vilakkam tharappattirundhadhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, thanadhu pugaippadathai thavaraagap payanbaduthi, DMK aadharavaalargal samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappuvadhaagak kutramsaatti, BJP Tiruvallur kizhakku maavatta seyalaalar raajini enbavar, poleesil pugaar seythullaar.
Uruva otrumaiyai adippadaiyaaga vaithu, vithiyaasam theriyaamal ivvaaru DMK aadharavu pathirigaiyaalar sendhilvel mudhalil vadhandhi parappiyullaar. Avarai pinbatri DMK aadharavaalargal palarum samooga valaidhalangalil indha vadhandhiyai parappugiraargal. Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram keezhe inaikkappattulaladhu.
Polimer News l Puthiyathalaimurai l Hindu Tamil
melum, raajini avaradhu Facebook pakkathil vilakkam ondraiyum alithullaar. Adhan lingk keezhe tharappattulladhu.
Idhudhavira, Annamalaiyudan raajini eduthuk konda pugaippadathai, avaradhu samooga valaidhala pakkathil kadandha joon 4, 2025 andru pagirndhullaar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, BJP Tiruvallur maavatta nirvaagi raajini enbavarin pugaippadathai eduthu, madappuram pathragaaliyamman koyil kaavalaali ajithgumaar Police visaaranaiyil uyirizhandha vivagaarathil thodarbudaiya nigidhaavudan serthu vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam patriya thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ADMK-vil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga Jayakumar arivithaaraa?
text:
A.D.M.K-vil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga A.D.M.K-vaich saarndha munnaal amaichar Jayakumar arivithadhaaga oru news card

Polimer Seithigal veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, "Vilagal. BJP-yudan ADMK koottani serndhadhaal katchiyil irundhu naan vilagugiren. Puratchi Thalaivar, Puratchi Thalaiviyin vazhiyil en arasiyal payanam thodarum – ADMK munnaal amaichar Jayakumar" endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
BJP-yudan koottani illai endru A.D.M.K thalaivargal koori vandhanar. BJP-yaal dhaan thottren endru koori paraparappai erpaduthiyirundhaar munnaal amaichar Jayakumar. Tharpodhu, meendum A.D.M.K – BJP koottani uruvaagi ulladhu. Indha soozhalil katchiyil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga Jayakumar kooriyadhaaga news card samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagarappattu varugiradhu.
Paarkka Polimer Seithigal veliyitta news card pola ulladhu. Aanaal, Jayakumar enbadhai Jayagumar endrum, munnaal enbadhai 'munnaal' ena ezhuthuppizhaiyudanum news card-il kurippidappattirundhadhu. ADMK-vil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga Jayakumar arivithadhaaga endha seithiyum illai. Avarudaiya samooga oodaga pakkangalilum kooda appadi endha oru thagavalum illai. Idhanaal, indha news card poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endru aaivu seidhom.
Mudhaliil Polimer Seithiyin samooga oodaga pakkangalil ippadi edhenum news card veliyaagi ulladhaa endru paartthom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru news card-um veliyaagavillai. Enave, Polimer Seithigal digital poruppaalarkku indha news card-ai WhatsApp-il anuppi vaitthom. Andha news card poliyaanadhu endru avar urudhi seidhaar.
A.D.M.K-vil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga munnaal amaichar Jayakumar endha oru arivippaiyum veliyidavillai. Naam aayvukku edutthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru Polimer TV tharappil urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adipadaiyil naam aayvukku edutthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 'Black ticket vitru sambaadhithavan naan' endru Vijay koorinaara?
text:
''Sondha rasigankitteye black ticket vithu surandi sambaaricha enakku evlo irukkum,'' endru Nagai prachaarathil Vijay pesiyadhaaga,

Idhil, ''Sondha rasigankitteye black ticket vithu surandi sambaaricha enakku evlo irukkum,'' endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhudan Vijay pesuvadhu pondra video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seivadhai kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiya endru naam aaivu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu audio edit seiyyappatta video, endru theriyavandhadhu. Idhubatri TVK thalaimai kazhaga aluvalagathai thodarbugondu kettapodhu, ''Engal kazhaga thalaivar Vijay patri edhirkkatchiyinar vendumentre arasiyal ulNokkathudan idhupondru edit seidhu, samooga valaithalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal,'' endru therivithanar.
Idhepondru, TVK podhuch seyalalar N. Anand aluvalagathilum pesi, kuritha pugaippadam unmaiyanadhalla, endru urudhiseidhullom.
Aduthappadiyaaga, thodarnthu, unmaiyana video kaatchiyai paarvaiyittom. Adhil, ''Kudumbathai vaithu kollai adikkintra ungalukke ivvalavu irundhaal, sondhamaaga uzhaithu sambaadhitha enakku evvalavu irukkum,'' endrudhaan Vijay pesiyullaar.
Koodudhal seithi aadhaaram idho…
Idhanpadi, 'Sondhamaaga uzhaithu sambaadhitha enakku evvalavu irukkum' endru Vijay pesiyadhai edit seidhu, 'Sondha rasigankitteye black ticket vithu surandi sambaaricha enakku evlo irukkum,' endru avar sonnadhaaga, arasiyal ulnokkathudan vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Enave, naam aaivukku eduthukkonda videovin audio edit seiyyappattulladhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin padhavi vilaga vendum endru A. Raja karuthu koorinaara?
text:
''Mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin padhavi vilaga vendum'', endru A. Raja karuthu kooriyadhaaga,

Andha videovil, ''Naan kutram saattugiren, ungaladhu statement ularal ullittavatrai kondu koorugiren. Neengal mudhalvaraaga iruppadharku endha thaarmeega adippadai thagudhiyum kidaiyaadhu,'' endru A. investigation_details:
Sameebathil, Sivagangai maavattam, Thirupuvanam aruge ulla Madappuram Badrakaliamman koilil kaavalaaliyaaga panipurindha Ajithkumar enbavar, nagai thiruttu pugaarin peril, police visaarikkumbodhu, uyirizhandhadhaagap pugaar ezhundhadhu.
The New Indian Express l Frontline Magazine l The Hindu
Indha vivagaaram Tamil Nadu arasiyal vattarathil perum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Thavira, podhumakkal tharappilum police meedhu adhirupthi nilavugiradhu. DMK arasai kutramsaatti, palavidhaamana kaarasaaramana vimarsanangal, samooga valaithalangalilum, oodaga vivaadhangalilum munvaikkappadugiradhu.
The News Minute l Times Of India l India Today
Iththagaiya soozhalil, DMK mootha thalaivargalil oruvaraana A. Raja, mudhalamaichar padhaviyil irundhu M.K. Stalin padhavi vilagak kooriyadhaagak kurippittu, silar oru videovai samooga valaithalangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
Aanaal, indha video tharpodhu veliyaanadhalla; idhu kadandha 2020m aandu Sathankulam kaaval nilayathil nigazhndha Jayaraj – Benniks lockup maranam thodarbaga A. Raja Behindwoods Air oodagathirkku alitha petti. Appodhu, Edappadi Palaniswami thalaimaiyilaana AIADMK arasu aatchiyil irundhadhu. Enave, Edappadi Palaniswami padhavi vilaga vendum endru valiyuruthi, A. Raja andha pettiyil karuthu kooriyirundhaar. Idhanai eduthu, tharpodhaiya arasiyal soozhaludan thodarbu-paduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru thelivaagiradhu.
Muzhu video link keezhe tharappattulladhu.
Idhuthodarbaga, A. Raja aluvalagathilum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom. Enave, naam aaivukku eduthukkonda videovukkum, tharpodhaiya Thamizhaga arasiyal soozhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Veeramani vazhakku: 'Yaaraiyum kaappaatra endha uththaravum Kazhaga aatchiyil pirappikkappadavillai' - Stalin
text:
Veeramani POCSO vazhakkil udandhaiyaaga irundhavargal yaaraaga irundhaalum avargal thandikkappada vendum ena Stalin therivithirukkiraar.
Veeramani POCSO vazhakkil avarukku udandhaiyaaga irundhavargal, avarai kaappaatra muyandravargal evaraayinum, eththagaiya poruppil irundhavargal aayinum thappikka koodaadhu ena DMK thalaivar Stalin therivithirukkiraar. Idhu thodarbaga avar than X pakkathil, ``Sirumigalukku edhiraana manidhathanmaiyatra izhivaana seyalkalil eedupatta kutrachaattugalin adippadaiyil Gem Veeramani kaidhu seiyyappattullaar. Idhil Veeramaniyum, avarukku udandhaiyaaga irundhavargal, avarai kaappaatra muyandravargal evaraayinum, eththagaiya poruppil irundhavargal aayinum thappikka koodaadhu. Anaivarum sattathin mun niruthappattu, adhiga-batcha thandanaiyai petru thara vendum. Idhudhaan Dravida Munnetra Kazhagathin nilaippaadu.
Indha vazhakkin mudivu, ini iththagaiya kutra-seyalkalil eedupadum enname evarukkum varaadha vagaiyil amaiya vendum enbadhudhaan or arasiyal iyakkathin thalaivanaagavum, oru kudumba-thalaivanaagavum, manasaatchi ulla manidhanaagavum enadhu viruppam. Aanaal, indha vazhakkil thevaiye illaamal, kurugiya arasiyal nokkathudan DMKazhagathin meedhu poiyaaga avadhoorugalai parappi, oru koottam kulirkaainthu varuvadhu migavum aruveruppaana seyalaagum. Veeramani vazhakkil yaaraiyum kaappaatra endha uththaravum Kazhaga aatchiyil pirappikkappadavillai.
Pengal, sirumigalukku edhiraana kutra vazhakkugalil paarabatchamindri kutravaaligal kaidhu seiyyappattu, kutrapathirigaiyum thaakkal seiyyappattu, thandanai petru tharappattadhu. Ivai anaithum podhuveliyil irukkum, marukka mudiyaadha unmaigal aagum. Evaraiyum kaappaatra vendiya thevai Kazhaga aatchikku illai. Tharpodhaiya TVK aatchiyil nadappadhupola, sattamandra uruppinargal, maavatta seyalaalargal ullitta katchi nirvagigal meedhu anaithu pathirikaigalin munbum baadhikkappatta pengal paaliyal kutrachaattugalai munvaitha pinnarum, nadavadikkai edukkaamal, samarasam pesi vazhakai mudithu vaikkum izhiseyalgal Kazhaga aatchiyil nadaiperavillai.
Enave, sirumigalukku erpatta thuyarathai idaitherdhalukkaana karuviyaaga payanpaduthum izhivaana seyalaiyum, mutrilum poiyaana avadhoorugalai oodagangal moolamaaga parappuvadhaiyum aalumkatchiyinar niruthi kolla vendum. Baadhikkappatta sirumigalukku needhi petru tharuvadhu mattume nam anaivarin nokkamaagavum irukka vendum endru kettu kolgiren."

headline: ''Naan angirundhen'' America meedhaana 9/11 thaakkudhal.. Trump kooriyadhu unmaiya?
text:
Americavin irattai koburangal meedhu vimaanangalai modhi nadathappatta thaakkudhal ullitta Nine Eleven (9/11) bayangaravaadha thaakkudhalgal nadandhu, varum September 11-m thedhiyudan 25 aandugal niraivadaiyavullana. Indhanilaiyil thaan, netraiya dhinam Washington-il ulla Vellai Maaligaiyil 9/11 thaakkudhalin ninaivu dhina nigazhchi nadaippetradhu.
Annigazhvil kalandhu kondu pesiya adhibar Trump, 2001-m aandu thaakkudhal nadandha pinnar thanadhu kattumaana paniyalaargal anaivaraiyum azhaithukondu Ground Zero pagudhikku chendradhaaga therivithaar. Thodarnthu, arugil irundha oru kattadam idindhu vizhum nilaiyil irundhadhaagavum, andha nerathil irandu theeyanaippu veerargal thanadhu kaigalai pidithu angirundhu thookki thannai kaappaatriyadhaaga kooriyadhudan avargal migavum valimaiyana enavum paaraattiyirundhaar.
Trump-in indha pechu perum parabarappai erpaduthihirundha nilaiyil thaan, orupakkam ivar pesiyadhu unmaiya? endra kelviyum ezhundhu vandhadhu. Indhasoozhalil thaan, Trump-in indha kootrukku aadhaarangal edhuvum kidaikkavillai ena America oodagamaana CNN seithi veliyittulladhu. Idhugurithu, Fact Check seidha CNN, 9/11 thaakkudhal nadaippetra naalil Trump World Trade Center aruge illai. Avar Midtown Manhattan pagudhiyil ulla Trump Tower-il irundhaar enavum adhu Ground Zero-vil irundhu pala mile tholaivil ulladhu enavum therivithirukkiradhu.
Adhepole, Trump kurippitta kattadathirku, 9/11 thaakkudhalukku piragu avar chendradhaagavum, angirundhu theeyanaippu veerargal avarai avasaramaaga veliyeetriyadhaagavum urudhippaduthum podhuvaana aadhaarangal edhuvum illai CNN suttikkaattugiradhu. Melum, Ground Zero-vil meetpu panigalil thanadhu oozhiyargal periya alavil eedupattadhaaga Trump kadandha kaalangalil kooriyirundhaalum, adharkum podhumaana aadhaaram illai enavum therivithulladhu.
Adhenerathil, Trump kooriya sambavathil sila unmaiyaana koorugal irukka vaaippulladhaagavum, aanaal avatrai urudhippaduthum aadhaaragalai Vellai Maaligai vazhangavillai endrum CNN kurippittulladhu. Idhanaal, 9/11 thaakkudhal thodarbaga Trump kooriyulla indha pudhiya kadhai unmaiya? endra kelvi meendum ezhundhulladhu.
Munnadhaaga, Americavil kadandha 2001-m aandu September 11-m thedhi, Al-Qaeda bayangaravaadhigal naangu payanigal vimaanangalai kadathiyadhudan, adhai payanpaduthi World Trade Center, Pentagon aagiya idangalil thaakkudhal nadathiyirundhanar. Indha thaakkudhalgalil, 2,977 per varai kollappattirundhanar. Idhuve, Nine Eleven (9/11) thaakkudhal enappadugiradhu.

headline: Thalaimaiyileye modhal.. sarchaiyil sikkiya Therdhal Aanaiyam.. enna nadandhadhu?
text:
Thalaimaiyileye modhal.. sarchaiyil sikkiya Therdhal Aanaiyam.. enna nadandhadhu?
Seidhiyaalar - Rajkumar.R
Kadandha 10 maadhagalil therdhal aanaiyargal Sukhbir Singh Sandhu matrum Vivek Joshi aagiyor, Therdhal Aanaiyathin sila mudivugal thodarbaga kurainthadhu 14 murai ezhuthuppoorvamaaga edhirppu therivithadhaaga 'The Indian Express' seithi veliyittulladhu. Kurippaaga, vaakkalar pattiyazhil pudhiya peyargalai serppadhu, erkanave ulla peyargalai neekkuvadhu, vaakkalar pattiyal thodarbana computer system ullitta palveru vishayangazhil avargal kelvigalai ezhuppiyadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Idhil mukkiyamaaga pesappaduvadhu, vaakkalar pattiyal thodarbana 'ECINet' endra computer system. Indha amaippin moolam vaakkalar pattiyal thodarbana panigal evvaaru merkollappadugindrana enbadhu kurithu irandu therdhal aanaiyargalum sila kelvigalai ezhuppiyadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. Adhepole, pudhiya vaakkalargalai serppadharkaana vinnappathil seiyyappatta maatrangal, vaakkalar peyargalai neekkuvadhu thodarbana nadaimuraigal ullitta sila mudivugalilum avargal edhirppu therivithadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Idhanaal, Therdhal Aanaiyathil irukkum moondru uruppinargalil irandu per thodarnthu sila mudivugalukku edhirppu therivithiruppadhu tharpodhu pesuporulaagiyulladhu. Kurippaaga, Therdhal Aanaiyathin mukkiya mudivugal matrum avai evvaaru edukkappaadugindrana enbadhu thodarbangavum kelvigal ezhundhullana. Innilaiyil, irandu therdhal aanaiyargal edhirppu therivithadhaaga koorappadum sila mudivugal thodarnthu seyalpaduthappattadhaaga veliyaagiyulla thagavalum vivaadhathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Indha vivagaaram thodarbaga Therdhal Aanaiyam indru vilakkam alithulladhu. Therdhal Aanaiyathil oru mudivu edukappaduvadharku munbu, uruppinargal thangaladhu karuthugal, kelvigal matrum maatru-karuthugalai therivippadhu vazhakkamaana nadaimurai-dhaan endru Therdhal Aanaiyam therivithulladhu.
Melum, idhupondra karuthu verupaadugal irundhaalum, irudhiyaaga edukappadum mukkiya mudivugal satta vidhimuraigalai pinpatriye edukappaduvadhaagavum Therdhal Aanaiyam vilakkam alithulladhu. Adhaavadhu, oru pakkam irandu therdhal aanaiyargal palveru vishayangazhil ezhuthuppoorvamaaga edhirppu therivithadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. Marupakkam, idhupondra karuthu verupaadugal Therdhal Aanaiyathin vazhakkamaana aalosanai nadaimuraiyin oru pagudhiye endru Therdhal Aanaiyam vilakkam alithulladhu.

headline: Japan kadarkaraiyil erpatta nilanadukkam endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Japan kadarkaraiyil erpatta 7.6 Richter alavilaana nilanadukkathin kaatchi endru oru video

Nilanadukkam kaaranamaaga kattidangal kulungum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Japan kadarkaraiyil 7.6 Richter adhirchi – tsunami echarikkai veliyaanadhu!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.

Netru erpatta nilanadukkam endru kurippittum palarum indha videovai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Japan-in Aomori kadarkaraiyilirundhu 80 km tholaivil, Pacific perungadalil December 8, 2025 andru nilanadukkam erpatradhu. Japan nerappadi iravu 11.15-kku indha nilanadukkam erpattadhaaga seidhigal therivikkindrana. Indha nilaiyil, pagal nerathil nilanadukkam erpattadhu pondru oru videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu sandhegathai erpaduthave idhu thodarbaga aayvu seidhom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivertrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2024-m aandu Japan-il erpatta nilanadukkam endru kurippittu idhe videovai palarum 2024-m aandil padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video 2024-m aandu Japan-il erpatta nilanadukkathin bodhu padhivaana kaatchiyaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu. Adhe nerathil engu, eppodhu padhivaanadhu endra thulliyamaana vivaram namakku kidaikkavillai.
2024-m aandileye indha video samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhan moolam, 2025 December 8-m thedhi erpatta nilanadukkathin video idhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pani paadhugaappu sattam kettu aasiriyargal aarppaattam
text:
Tiruppur: Palligalil paniyaatrum thalaimai-aasiriyargal matrum aasiriyargalin pani paadhugaappai urudhi seyya valiyuruthiyum, adharkaaga 'Pani Paadhugaappu Sattam' iyatra koriyum Tiruppur maavatta Collector aluvalagam mun kavana eerppu aarppaattam nadaippetradhu.
Tamil Nadu Melnilaipalli Thalaimai Aasiriyar Kazhagam matrum Anaithu Aasiriyargal Kootamaippu (Tiruppur maavattam) saarbil nadaippetra aarppaattathukku, Tiruppur maavatta seyalaalar Ponnusamy varavetrar. Tamil Nadu Melnilaipalli Thalaimai Aasiriyar Kazhaga Tiruppur maavatta thalaivar Palanisamy thalaimai vagithaar.
Anaithu Aasiriyargal Kootamaippu maanila orunginaipaalar Thiagarajan, neradi niyamanam petra mudhukalai aasiriyargal sanga maanila thunai thalaivar Jayareegan, Tamil Nadu Vidiyal Aasiriyar Munnetra Sanga maanila thalaivar Sundaramoorthy, Thesiya Aasiriyar Sanga kotta seyalaalar Gopalakrishnan, Tamil Nadu Pattadhaari Aasiriyar Kazhagathai serndha Sakthivel Raja munnilai vagithanar.
Aarppaattathil, Tamil Nadu Melnilaipalli Thalaimai Aasiriyar Kazhagam, Neradi Niyamana Mudhukalai Aasiriyargal Sangam, Tamil Nadu Pattadhaari Aasiriyar Kazhagam, Anaithu Aasiriyargal Kootamaippu, Tamil Nadu Vidiyal Aasiriyar Munnetra Sangam, Thesiya Aasiriyar Sangam ullitta thozhamai sangangalin maanila matrum maavatta nirvagigal pesinar. Udumalai maavatta orunginaipaalar Mariappan nandri koorinaar. Idhil Tiruppur maavattathai serndha thalaimai-aasiriyargal matrum aasiriyargal pangeptranar.

headline: Bihar-il thotradhaal kadharum Congress poruppaalar endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:

headline: Tamil Naattil NDA koottani aatchi amaindhaal magalir ilavasa bus rathu seiyyappadum endru Modi koorinaara?
text:
Tamil Naattil Dhesiya Jananaayaga Koottani (NDA) aatchi amaithaal magalirkkaana ilavasa perundhu payanam rathu seiyyappadum endru Pradhamar Narendra Modi kooriyadhu pondru oru padhivu

Pradhamar Modi kurippitta sila TV oodagathinaridam pesiya video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “Tamil Naattil NDA koottani aatchi amaindhaal magalirkkaana ilavasa perundhu payanam rathu seiyyappadum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Tamilnaattil NDA koottani aatchi amaindhaal magalirkaana ilavasa payanam rathu seyyapadumaam Modi petti” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pengalukku kattanamilla perundhu sevai thittathai maanila arasugal arivippadhan moolam valarchi baadhikkappadugiradhu endru Narendra Modi pesum videovudan Facebook-il palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, sameebathil appadi endha oru pettiyaiyum Modi alithadhaaga seithi illai. Aangalukkum kattanamilla bus sevai endru AIADMK podhuch seyalalar Edappadi Palaniswami arivithulla soozhalil, pengalukku erkanave ulla kattanamilla bus sevai niruthappadum endru Modi kooriyadhaaga palarum padhivittu varave idhu thodarbaga aayvu seidhom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaga maatrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2024-m aandu India Today kuzhumathin aasiriyargalukku Pradhamar Narendra Modi alitha petti adhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. 2024-m aandil Modi pesiyadhai 2026-il Tamil Naattil NDA koottani aatchikku vandhaal magalir kattanamilla perundhu sevai niruthappadum endru Modiye kooriyadhaaga parappi varuvadhu therindhadhu. Sari andha pettiyil Modi enna pesinaar endru paarthom.
Modiyin pettiyai English subtitles-udan India Today thannudaiya YouTube pakkathil 2024 May 16-m thedhi veliyittirundhadhu. Andha pettiyin 1 mani neram 21-vadhu nimidathil arasiyal katchigal pengalai kavarvadharkaaga ilavasangalai arivikkindrana-ve endru seidhiyaalar kelvi ezhuppugiraar. Adharku Modi, “Idhu pengal prachanai illai. Idhu arasiyal katchigal therdhalil vetri pera vendum enbadharkaaga treasury-ai kaali seigindrana. Idhu miga mukkiyamaana prachanai. Enakku panathai thaaraalamaaga selavazhikka urimai ulladha? Adhigaaram alippadharkaana thittangalai uruvaakkum urimai enakku ulladhu. Aanaal therdhalil vetri peruvadharkaaga adhai kaali seiven endru irukkiraargal. Naam idhai patri chinthikka vendum.
Ippodhu enna nadakkiradhu endru paarungal. Neengal nagarangalil Metro sevaiyai thodangugindreergal. Andha nagarathirku therdhal varugiradhu. Therdhalil vetri pera bus-il pengalukku ilavasa payanam endru arivikkindreergal. Idhan moolam Metro sevaiyin 50 sathaveedha payanigalai neengal izhandhuvidugindreergal. Idhanaal Metro sirappaaga seyalpada mudiyaadhu. Edhirkaalathil Metro kattappaduma illaiya? Idhudhaan kavalai. Yaarum indha vazhiyil chinthippadhu illai. Naam arasiyalukkul vivaadhangal seyyalaam. Naan adhai seyya virumbavillai. Naan thittavattamaagap pesa virumbugiren.
Idhanaal enna aagiradhu… Neengal ilavasa bus thittathai arivippadhan moolam pokkuvarathil prachanaiyai uruvaakkugindreergal, sutrusoozhalukku paadhippai erpaduthugindreergal. Neenga inge oru Metro-vaiyum kondu vandheergal. Eppadi adhu munnetram adaiyum? Naadu eppadi munnera mudiyum” endraar.
Endha idathilum Dhesiya Jananaayaga Koottani aatchikku vandhaal sila maanilangalil kurippaaga Tamil Naattil seyalaakkathil ulla magalir ilavasa payanath thittam rathu seiyyappadum endru kooravillai. Delhi-yil 2019-m aandil pengalukku ilavasa bus thittam arivikkappattadhu. Tharpodhu Delhi-yil BJP aatchiyil ulladhu. Angu kooda andha thittam rathu seiyyappadavillai.
Pradhamarin indha petti 2024 naadaalumandra therdhal nerathil veliyaagi irundhadhu. Appodhudhaan Andhra Pradesh sattamandra therdhalum nadandhadhu. Andha therdhalil Telugu Desam – BJP koottani vetri petru aatchiyum amaithadhu. 2025-m aandu August-il angeyum 'Sree Shakthi' endra peyaril pengal ilavasa payanath thittam arimugam seiyyappattadhu.
Pengalukku arasu perundhugazhil kattanamilla payana sevai vazhanguvadhan moolam arasukku, Metro thittangalukku paadhippu erpadugiradhu, naattin munnetram baadhikkappadugiradhu endru Pradhamar Modi pesiyirundhaar. Endha idathilum andha thittathai rathu seiven endru avar kooravillai. Melum, Delhi-yil BJP aatchikku vandha piragum andha thittam thodargiradhu. Andhra Pradesh-il BJP – Telugu Desam koottani arasu ammaanilathil indha thittathai pudhiyaaga thodangiyulladhu.
Enave, Tamil Naattil NDA koottani aatchikku vandhaal pengal kattanamilla payanath thittam rathu seiyyappadum endru Modi kooriyadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nepal Gen Z poraattathil masoothi erikkappattadha?
text:
Nepal-il nadandha Gen Z poraattathin bodhu masoothi ondru erikkappattadhu endru oru video

Kattidam ondru theepatri eriyum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Nepal-il #genz kutti kunjaans nadathiya poraattathil masoothigalai thee vaithu koluthittaanga 🙄🙄🙄🙄” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Nepal-il Gen Z poraattam vedithu aatchi maatram erpattu kittathatta amaidhi thirumbivittadhu. Indha nilaiyil poraattakaarargalaal masoothi ondru thee vaithu erikkappattadhaaga silar ippodhu padhivittu varugindranar. Indha thagaval unmaiya endru ariya aayvu seidhom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivertrith thedinom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda adhe videovai sameeba naatkalaga masoothi erikkappattadhaaga koori palarum pagirndhu varuvadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhe nerathil oru maadhathukku munbaaga indha kattidam erikkappattadhu thodarbana veru sila videokkal veliyaagi irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Andha padhivugalil Birgunj endra oorin mayor-in veettai Gen Z poraattakaarargal thee vaithu erithanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha videovil veettin mugappil Swastik chinnam irundhadhu. Adhe chinnam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovilum kaana mudindhadhu. Melum, veettukku aruge irundha saalai, veettin madhil suvar, gate ellaam irandu videokkalilum ondraagave irundhadhu. Idhan moolam idhu masoothi illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Veettin munpuram pachai nirathil sedigalukku kattappadum thuniyai katti vaithullanar. Idhai vaithu andha kattidam masoothiyaaga irukkum endru mudivukku vandhu vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Gen Z poraattathin bodhu Birgunj mayor-in veettaip poraattakaarargal thee vaithu eritha videovai, masoothi meedhu thaakkudhal nadathappattadhaagath thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhi seiyyappattulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: BRICS maanaattil pangerka Delhi varugai; Russia adhibar Putin-ukku urchaaga varaverpu
text:
Pudhudhilli: BRICS maanaattil pangerka Russia adhibar Putin Delhi vandhaar. Indru madhiyam 3 maniyalavil, Pradhamar Modiyai sandhithu mukkiya pechu nadathugiraar.
Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa ullitta naadugal uruppinargalaaga ulla BRICS amaippin maanaadu naalai (Sep 12) matrum naalai marunaal (Sep 13) Delhiyil Bharat Mandapathil nadakkiradhu. Indha maanaattil China, Russia, South Africa, Iran adhibargal pangerkindranar; anaithu erpaadugalum Delhiyil seiyyappattu ulladhudan, paadhugaappu balappaduthappattu ulladhu.
Innilaiyil maanaattil pangerka Russia adhibar Putin Delhi vandhaar. Vimaana nilayathil avarai mathiya inai amaichar V.K. Singh varavetrar. Indha pugaippadathai samooga valaithalathil pagirndhu mathiya veliyuravuthurai amaichagathin seithi thodarbaalar Randhir Jaiswal kooriyiruppadhaavadhu:
18-vadhu BRICS uchi maanaattil pangerka Delhi vandhulla Russia adhibar Putin-ai anbudan varaverkirom. Indhiavum Russiyavum neenda kaala uravugalai kondullana. Ivvaaru Randhir Jaiswal kooriyullaar. Indru madhiyam 3 maniyalavil, Pradhamar Modiyai sandhithu mukkiya pechu nadathugiraar.

headline: V.S. Babu kavalaikkidam ena paravum poliyaana news card!
text:

Kolathur thogudhi MLA V.S. Babu udalnilai thodarbaga Thanthi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, ““V.S. Babu udalnilai kavalaikkidamaaga ulladhu” | Kolathur MLA V.S. Babu-vukku moochuthinaral kaaranamaaga kadandha 9-m thedhi maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattu seyarkai swaasa karuvi poruthappatta nilaiyil avaradhu udalnilai ulladhaaga maruthuvamanai meendum vilakkam” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kolathur sattamandra thogudhiyil munnaal mudhalamaicharum DMK thalaivarumaana M.K. Stalin-ai veezhthi vetri pettravar TVK-vin V.S. Babu. Udalnilai baadhikkappattu avar thaniyaar maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattullaar. Angu avarukku theevira sikichai alikkappattu varuvadhaagavum, udalnilai seeraaga ulladhu endrum maruthuvamanai tharappilirundhu arikkai veliyidappattu varugiradhu.
Indha nilaiyil V.S. Babu udalnilai kavalaikkidam endru Thanthi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Kaalai varai seeraaga irundha avaradhu udalnilai thideerendru kavalaikkidamaaga maarivittadhaa endra achathudan andha news card-ai paarthom. News card-ai padithup paarkkumbodhu vaakkiyathil nerudal irundhadhu. “Swaasa karuvi poruthappatta nilaiyil avaradhu udalnilai ulladhaaga” adhil irundhadhu. Enave, idhu edit seiyyappattadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil Thanthi TV-yin Facebook pakkathai paarvaiyittom.
Appodhu V.S. Babu pugaippadathudan naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card-ai Thanthi TV veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Aanaal adhil avaradhu udalnilai seeraaga ulladhu endru irundhadhu. Andha news card-il, ““V.S. Babu udalnilai seeraaga ulladhu” | Kolathur MLA V.S. Babu-vukku moochuthinaral kaaranamaaga kadandha 9-m thedhi maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattu seyarkai swaasa karuvi poruthappatta nilaiyil avaradhu udalnilai seeraaga ulladhaaga maruthuvamanai meendum vilakkam” endru irundhadhu. Idhai edit seidhu, udalnilai kavalaikkidamaaga ulladhu endru thavaraaga maatri samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Idhai urudhi seyya naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai Thanthi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seidhaar. Melum Thanthi TV veliyittirundha unmaiyaana news card-aiyum namakku anuppinaar. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Lanjam vaangiya police-ai kaidhu seidha CBI endru paravum seithi Tamil Naattil nadandhadhaa?
text:
Dravida aatchiyil pugaiyilai porutkalai padhakkiyavaridam lanjam vaangiya kaavalthurai adhigaariyai CBI adhigaarigal kaidhu seidhaargal endru oru seithi

Polimer TV veliyitta seithiyai appadiye Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilai thagavalil, “Sandhi sirikkudhu #DravidaModel #DMK aatchiyai …
Pugaiyilai porutkalai padhakkiyavaridam lanjam .. kaavalthurai thunai udhavi aayvaalar kaiyum kalavumaaga kaidhu… seerudaiyudan saalaiyil azhaithu chendra C.B.I. adhigaarigal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Lanjam vaangiya Dravida Model police endru kurippittu indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Videovai paarkkumbodhu Thirunallaaru kaaval nilayam endru varugiradhu. Thirunallaaru enbadhu Puducherry maanilam Karaikkalil amaindhulladhu. Enave, Puducherry seithiyai Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru padhivittullaargal enbadhu therigiradhu. Idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seidhom.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla videovai paarthom. Adhil, Puducherry maanilam Karaikkalil ulla Thirunallaaru kaaval nilayathil sirappu udhavi aayvaalaraaga paniyaatriya Pakkirisamy enbavar pugaiyilai porutkalai padhakkiyadhaagak kaidhu seiyyappattu bail-il veliye vandha Manikandanidam lanjam kettu thondharavu seidhu vandhullaar. Idhaiyaduthu Manikandan Chennaiyil ulla CBI aluvalagathil pugaar seidhaar. Adhaith thodarnthu CBI adhigaarigalin arivuruthal padi sirappu udhavi aayvaalaridam lanjap panathai koduthullaar. Appodhu avarai kaiyum kalavumaaga CBI adhigaarigal kaidhu seidhanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Seithiyin endha idathilum indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu endro, kaidhu seiyyappatta kaavalar Tamil Nadu kaavalthurai serndhavar endro kurippidappadavillai. Seithiyai veliyitta Polimer TV-yin samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarthom. Adhil, indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu enbadhai seithiyin ulle kurippittirundhaargale thavira, samooga oodaga padhivilo, videovin meedho Puducherry endro, Karaikkal endro alladhu Thirunallaaru endro kooda kurippidappadavillai. Vadhandhiyai parappugiravargalukku idhu saadhagamaaga amaindhuvittadhu. Seithiyai muzhumaiyaaga paarthirundhaal kooda indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadakkavillai enbadhu thelivaagiyirukkum.
Puducherry-il DMK aatchiyil illai. Angu N.R. Congress – BJP koottani aatchiyil ulladhu. Enave, DMK aatchiyil lanjam vaangiya police-ai CBI kaidhu seidhadhu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Gujarat Aam Aadmi nirvagi veettil sikkiya panam endru paravum video unmaiya?

Oozhalai thudaikka thudaippathudan veliye vandhavargal notegalai maatrugiraargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Aam Aadmi Party Delhi aatchiyil irundhadhu, tharpodhu Punjab-il aatchi seidhu varugiradhu. Aanaal, thodarbe illaadha Gujarat-il akkatchi nirvagi veettil kattukkattaga panam edukkappaattadhaagach silar padhivittu varugindranar. Gujarat-il BJP thaan aatchiyil ulladhu. Appadi irukka indha thagaval unmaiya endru ariya aayvu seidhom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadamaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivertrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2022-m aandu West Bengal-il oru thozhiladhibar illathil Amalaakkathuraiyinar sodhanai seidhadhaagak kurippittu indha videovai palarum padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Kittathatta 50 crore rupees kaippatrapattadhaaga andha padhivil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil Google-il thodarnthu thedinom. Appodhu indha seithiyai News18 kadandha 2022-m aandu September maadham padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Melum, Amalaakkathurai sodhanai thodarbaga palveru seidhigalum namakkuk kidaithana.
Mobile game application thodarbana muraikedu thodarbaga Amalaakkathurai kadandha 2022-m aandu September maadham 10-m thedhi Kolkata-vil 6 idangalil sodhanai seidhadhaagavum 17.32 crore rupees kaippatrapattadhaagavum Amalaakkathurai thannudaiya X thala pakkathil padhivittirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam Gujarat-il Aam Aadmi Party nirvagi veettilirundhu kattukkattaga panathai Amalaakkathurai kaippatriyadhu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seigindrana.

headline: Adhigalai varai nadandha visarjanam
text:
Tiruppur: Tiruppuril Vinayagar silai visarjana oorvalam netru mundhinam iravu nadaippetradhu. Idhil kondu varappatta silaigal, Samalapuram kulathil adhigalai 3:00 mani varai visarjanam seiyyappattana.
Maalai 5:00 mudhal 6:00 mani varai palveru pagudhigalil prathishtai seiyyappatta Vinayagar silaigal oorvalamaaga kondu varappattana. Alangadu pagudhiyil iravu 9:30 manikku thodangiya podhukkoottam, 10:30 manikku niraivadaindhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu Vinayagar silaigal Samalapuram kulathukku kondu sellappattana. Iravu 11:45 manikku silaigal kulathai vandhadaindhana.
Silaigalai paadhugaappaaga karaippadharkaaga Samalapuram kulathil 7 padaguthalangal amaikkappattirundhana. Melum, silaigalai karaikkum panikkaaga neechal payirchi petra 15 per thayaar nilaiyil irundhanar.
Avargal silaigalai paadhugaappaaga kondu chendru karaikkum paniyil eedupattanar. Visarjana nigazhvil, anaithu Vinayagar silaigalum adhigalai 3:00 maniyalavil muzhumaiyaaga karaikkappattana .

headline: Karnatakavil nadandha sambavathai Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pol sitharikkum Thanthi TV news card!
text:
Karnatakavil helmet aniyaamal bike-il chendra thambadhiyai police pidithu izhuthadhil kuzhandhai uyirizhandhadhu. Indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu polavum, idharku poruppetru M.K. Stalin padhavi vilaga vendum endrum silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Thanthi TV veliyitta news card-ai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “Police-aarin athumeeriya seyalaal kuzhandhai bali. Helmet aniyaamal bike-il chendra thambadhiyai pidithu izhutha police. Bike-il irundha moondru vayadhu kuzhandhai keezhe vizhundhu baliyaana sogam. Kuzhandhaiyin pettroor saalaiyil amarndhu poraattam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilai thagavalil, “Helmet aniyaamal bike-il chendra thambadhiyaip pidithu izhutha police bike-il irundha moondru vayadhu kuzhandhai keezhe vizhundhu baliyaana sogam, kuzhandhaiyin pettroor saalaiyil amarndhu poraattam #Paadhugaappilla_DMKModel #Resign_Stalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karnatakavil helmet aniyaamal chendra thambadhiyai police thaduthu nirutha muyandra podhu erpatta vibathil moondru vayadhu kuzhandhai uyirizhandhadhu. Idhu thodarbaga Thanthi TV-yil news card, seithi veliyittirundhanar. Aanaal, andha news card-ai mattum eduthu, Tamil Naattil indha sambavam nadandhadhu pola silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
News card-ileye Karnataka endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Paarthadhum Karnataka endru kurippidappattirundhadhai kandupidikka mudiyaadha vagaiyil adhu irundhadhu. Aanaalum, avargal Karnataka endru kurippitte news card-ai veliyittullanar. Aanaal, vadhandhi parappiye theera vendum endra nokkil silar indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru padhivittullanar.
Mudhalil Thanthi TV veliyitta news card-ai adhan Facebook pakkathilirundhu eduthom. Seithiyil hashtag-il English-il Karnataka endru kurippittirundhanar. Idhanaal indha news card-ukku comment seidha silar kooda Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru Tamil Nadu kaavalthuraiyai vimarsithup padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Idhu thodarbaga veliyaana seithiyai thedi eduthom. Adhil, Karnataka maanilam Mandya maavattam Maddur taluk Koravanahalli kiraamathai serndha Ashok – Vani aagiyorin magal Hrutheeksha-vai naai kadithadhaal avasaramaaga maruthuvamanaikku kondu chendrullanar. Appodhu traffic police helmet aniyaadhavargalaip pidithu abaraadham vidhithuk kondirundhanar. Ashok helmet aniyaadhadhaal avarai pidikka muyarchi seidha podhu bike thadumaari keezhe vizhundhulladhu. Idhil, sirumi uyirizhandhadhaaga” kurippidappattirundhadhu.
News card-ileye Karnataka enbadhu kurippidappattulladhu. Indha sambavam thodarbaga Karnatakavilirundhu veliyaana seidhigalum indha sambavam Karnataka maanilam Mandya-vil nadandhadhu endru kurippittullana. Aanaal, vadhandhi parappa vendum, Tamil Nadu arasukku edhiraana karuthai parappa vendum endra nokkil indha sambavam DMK aatchiyil nadandhadhu endrum M.K. Stalin mudhalamaichar padhaviyilirundhu vilaga vendum endrum vadhandhi parappi vandhullanar enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Tamil Naattil minsara kattanam meendum uyarthappattadha?
text:
''Tamil Naattil meendum minsara kattanam uyarvu'' endru koori,

Idhudan minsara kattana uyarvu endru kurippittu, oru attavanaiyum inaikkappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seidhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiya endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2022-m aandu veliyidappatta seithi endru theriyavandhadhu.
Kadandha 2022-m aandu The Hindu Tamil oodagathil kurippitta seithi veliyidappattirundhadhu. Adhanaiye tharpodhu marupagirvu seidhu, samooga valaithalangalil thevaiyatra vadhandhiyai silar parappugindranar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, indha vadhandhikku, Tamil Nadu arasu tharappilum thagundha vilakkam alikkappattulladhu.
Koodudhalaaga, Tamil Nadu pokkuvarathu matrum minsaarath thurai amaichar S.S. Sivasankar, tharpodhaikku endha min kattana uyarvum arivikkappadavillai, endru kurippittu, seithiyarikkai ondrai veliyittirundhaar. Adhanaiyum keezhe aadhaarathirkaaga inaithullom.
Enave, minkattanam pudhiyaadhaaga uyarthappattulladhaagap paravum thagavalil unmaiyillai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Edappadi Palaniswami prachaara vaaganathil Modi pugaippadam vaikkappattirundhadhaa?
text:
Edappadi Palaniswamiyin prachaara vaaganathil Jayalalithavin pugaippadathirkku badhil Pradhamar Narendra Modiyin pugaippadam vaikkappattirundhadhaaga oru pugaippadam

AIADMK podhuch seyalalar Edappadi Palaniswamiyin prachaara vaaganathin mun pakkathil Narendra Modiyin pugaippadam vaikkappattirukkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Muzhu BJP-yaa maariya AIADMK katchi ~ prachaara vaaganathil Jayalalitha padathirkku badhil Modi padam .
~Periya Modi padathirkku pakkathil kuttiyaa chinnadhaa ooramaa Jayalalitha MGR padam iruppadhu pola therigiradhu aanaal kannukku theriyavillai 🙄 MGR viswaasigal AIADMK-virku vote poduvadhu oru pakkam Jayalalitha viswaasigal inimelum AIADMK-virku vote poda vendumaa chinthiyungal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil AIADMK, BJP-udan koottani amaithu sattamandra therdhalai edhirkolgindradhu. BJP-udan koottani kidaiyaadhu endru arivithuvittu meendum akkatchiyudan koottani amaitha AIADMK-vai palarum vimarsithu varugindranar. Katchiyin kolgai, kotpaadu ellaavatraiyum BJP-kkaaga vittukoduthu varuvadhaaga matra katchigal kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu varugindrana. Andha vagaiyil katchiyin thalaiviyaaga irundha Jayalalithavin pugaippadathai prachaara vaaganathil payanpaduthuvadharku badhil Pradhamar Narendra Modiyin padathai Edappadi Palaniswami vaithullaar endru pugaippadathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
March 25-m thedhi Edappadi Palaniswami Mylapore-il therdhal prachaarathai thodanginaar. Avaradhu prachaara vaaganathin mugappu pagudhiyil Jayalalithavin pugaippadamdhaan irundhadhu. Aanaal, Modiyin pugaippadam iruppadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar. Idhu edit seiyyappatta pugaippadamaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seidhom.
Mylapore-il Edappadi Palaniswami prachaaram thodangiya video kaatchigalai AIADMK-vin adhigaarappoorva YouTube pakkathilirundhu eduthu paarthom. Edappadi Palaniswamiyin Facebook pakkathil indha prachaara nigazhvu neradi oliparappum seiyyappattirundhadhu. Adhil, Jayalalithavin pugaippadamdhaan irundhadhu. Adhu thaanaagave matra thalaivargalin pugaippadangalai maatrum LED screen pola illai. Jayalalithavin pugaippadathai print seidhu vaithadhu pola irundhadhu.
Andha videovil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathilirundha idathirku Palaniswami vandha kaatchiyai kandom. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippada kaatchi AIADMK YouTube pakkathil veliyaagi irundha prachaara videovil sariyaaga 1 mani neram 7 nimidam aindhaavadhu vinaadiyil varuvadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Adhu mattumindri, videovin endha idathilum prachaara vaaganathin mugappu pagudhiyil Modiyin pugaippadam idampetravillai. Seithi oodagangazhilum kooda indha idathilirundhu edukkappatta pugaippadathudan seithi veliyittirundhanar. Ellaavatrilum Jayalalithavin pugaippadam mattume irundhadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam edit seiyyappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: 'Mudhalmurai aridhaana sambavam..' China-vil Robo kaidhu..? Moodhaattiyidam seidha seyal!
text:
China-vil 70 vayadhu moodhaattiyai achuruthiya robot-ai kaavalthuraiyinar kaidhu seidha sambavam ulagalavil parabarappai erpaduthiyulladhu. Podhumakkalukku idaiyooru vilaivikkum vagaiyil robot-galai kaiyaala koodaadhu ena urimaiyaalarukku echarikkai vidukkappattulladhu.
Seidhiyaalar - Vignesh
Robot-gal payanpaadu tharpodhu paravalaaga adhigarithu varum soozhalil, adhu thodarbana aabathugalum adhigarithu varugiradhu. Palveru naadugalil robot-galin payanpaadu vegamaaga valarndhu varugiradhu. Kurippaaga China, Japan pondra naadugalil robot-galai payanpaduthuvadhu adhagarithulladhu.
Mukkiyamaaga, robot-galai makkal mathiyil nadamaada vittu adhanai pazhaga vaippadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Annaadugalin raanuva pondra mukkiya thuraigalilum robot-galin payanpaadu adhigarithu varugiradhu. Idhu thodarbana kaatchigalum viral-aanadhu kurippidathakkadhu.
Achurutthum seyal.. robot kaidhu!
Indha nilaiyil thaan, China-vin Macau maagaanathil 70 vayadhu moodhaatti oruvarai achuruthiyadhaagak koorappadum robot-ai, annaattu kaavalthuraiyinar angirundhu azhaithu chendra sambavam ulagalavil kavanam petrulladhu.
Thideerena moodhaatti achamadaindhu sathamittadhai aduthu, sambava idathirku vandha kaavalthuraiyinar andha robot-in tholil kai vaithu, oru kutravaaliyai azhaithu chelvadhupola angirundhu kootti chendranar.
Andha robot oru kalvi niruvanathirkku sondhamaanadhu enbadhu visaaranaiyil theriyavandhadhu. Podhumakkalukku idaiyooru vilaivikkum vagaiyil robot-galai kaiyaala koodaadhu ena adhan urimaiyaalarukku kaavalthurai echarikkai viduthulladhu.
Indhach sambavam thodarbana video tharpodhu samooga valaithalangalil "robot kaidhu seiyyappattadhu" endra peyaril viral-aagi varugiradhu
Idhu vilaiyaattaagath thondrinaalum kooda robot-galaal endhalavukkuk kuzhappam erpadalaam enbadhaiye idhu unarthugiradhu. Podhu idangalil muraiyaana kankaanippu illaamal robot-galai anumadhikka koodaadhu ena netizens valiyuruthi varugindranar. Edhaavadhu emergency endraal ore nodiyil robot-ai off seiyyakkoodiya switches vendum endrum adhupondra switch irukkum robot-galai mattume podhuveliyil anumadhikka vendum endrum padhivittu varugiraargal.

headline: Naaigal kadithu 20 aadugal bali
text:
Sulur: Sulur aruge naaigal kadithu, 20 aadugal baliyaagina.
Sulur adutha Pattanathai serndha Palanisamy, Nagamanaickenpalayam-il, aadu valarthu varugiraar. Netru kaalai paarthapodhu, pattiyil irundha, 20 aadugal kaayangazhudan irandhu kidandhana. Vanathurai oozhiyargal aayvu seidhadhil, naaigal kadithadhaal, aadugal irandhadhu therindhadhu. Siruthaiyo alladhu matra vilangugal vandhu chendra adaiyaalangal edhuvum illai enbadhum theriyavandhadhu.
Palanisamy-kku, uriya nivaranam vazhanga adhigaarigal nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Adhe nerathil theru naaigalai kattuppaduthum nadavadikkaiyai ooraatchi nirvagam edukka vendum ena, ippagudhiyinar korikkai viduthullanar.

headline: Vivasayigal poraattam 20 naatkal othivaaippu
text:
Trichy: Muzhumaiyaaga payirkkadan thallupadi kori, Trichiyil, vivasaaya sangangal nadathiya kaathiruppu poraattam, tharkaaligamaaga, 20 naatkalukku othivaikkappattulladhu.
Payir kadangalai muzhumaiyaaga thallupadi seyya valiyuruthi, Trichy, Samayapurathil, palveru vivasaaya sangathinar, Sep 15 mudhal thodar kaathiruppu poraattam thodanginar.
Vivasayigaludan, velaan thurai amaichar Vinoth, kootturavu thurai amaichar Gandhiraj, aranilayathurai amaichar Ramesh aagiyor pechu nadathinar. Chennaiyil vivasaaya sanga pradhinidhigaludan, amaichargal, adhigaarigal pechu nadathinar. Thodarnthu, netrum pechu nadandhadhu.
Adhil, 'Idaitherdhal nadaimurai amalil iruppadhaal, arasu pudhiya arivippugalai veliyida mudiyaadha soozhalil ulladhu. Vivasayigalin korikkaiyai niraivetra avagaasam vendum' ena, amaichargal kettu kondanar.
Idhai etru, 20 naatkal poraattathai tharkaaligamaaga othivaippadhaaga, vivasaaya sangangalin pradhinidhigal arivithullanar. 'Korikkaiyai niraivetraavittaal, Oct 22-m thedhi mudhal, saagum varai unnaaviradha poraattam nadaiperum' ena, arivithullanar.
Idharkidaiye, poraattathil pangerka vandha, Karur maavattam, Vangal Muniappanur-ai serndha vivasaayi Kandhasamy, 59, netru, moochuthinaral erpattu, maruthuvamanaiyil uyirizhandhaar.
