headline: Thamizhagathil mudhiyor makkal thogai adhikarippu.. Reserve Bank echarikkai!
text:
Reserve Bank (RBI) veliyittulla "Maanila Nidhigal: 2025-26-aam aandin nidhinilai arikkaigal kuritha aayvu" endra arikkaiyin padi, Tamil Nadu, Kerala ullitta maanilangal, makkalthogai urumaatram saarndha perum sikkal ondrai edhirkondullana. Makkalthogai kattuppaattu thittangalai sila pathaandugalukku munbe vetrigaramaaga amalpaduthi adhan moolam samooga-valarchi kuriyidugalil munnilai vagithu varum indha maanilangalil ippodhu mudhiyor ennikkai munnepodhum illaadha alavu adhagarithu varugiradhu.
2026-aam aandil, Kerala-vin motha makkalthogaiyil 18.7 vizhukkaadum, Tamil Naattil 15.8 vizhukkaadum 60 vayadhirku merpatta mudhiyorgalaaga iruppaargal enak kanikkappattulladhu. 2036-aam aandirkul, pirarai saarndhu vaazhum mudhiyorgalin vigidham Kerala-vil 38.3 vizhukkaadagavum Tamil Naattil 32.7 vizhukkaadagavum uyarum. Adhaavadhu, adutha pathaandugalil naattil adhiga mudhiyorai konda maanilangalil Tamil Nadu irandaam idam vagikkum. Tamil Naattil saraasariyaaga moondril oruvar 60 vayadhai kadandha mudhiyavaraaga iruppaar. Idhanaal indha maanilangalin nidhi sumai adhigarikkum endru poruladhaara nibunargal koorugindranar.
Mudhiyorgalin ennikkai uyarvadhaal oivoodhiyam, sugaadhaaram matrum samooga paadhugaappu aagiyavatrukaana arasarasin selavinangal kanisamaaga adhigarikkum. Uzhaikkum vayadhinarin ennikkai kuraivadhaal, nugarvu matrum varumaana valarchi kuraindhu, maanilathin vari varuvaai eettum thiran baadhikkappadalaam ena echarikkappattulladhu. Indhach chavaalai edhirkolla, pengalin pani pangerpu vigidhathai adhagarithal, mudhiyorgalukkaana thiran membaadu matrum thozhilnutpathai payanpaduthi urpathith thiranai uyarthudhal pondra aakkapoorvamaana seerthirutthangal avasiyam ena Reserve Bank parindhuraithulladhu.

headline: TVK aatchi irukkumaa ena paarppom; EPS sandhegam
text:
Salem: Pala katchikku poyittu vandha amaichar Aadhav, kadaisi varaikkum TVK-vil irupparaa endru paarkkalaam, ena AIADMK podhuchcheyalaalar EPS therivithullaar.
Salem-il katchi koottathil pangeptra EPS-idam, 'AIADMK-vum, TVK-vum ondru thaan' endru amaichar Aadhav kooriyadhu patri seidhiyaalargal kelvi ezhuppinar.
Adharku avar badhilalithadhaavadhu; Avar (amaichar Aadhav) sariyillai endru ninaikkiren. AIADMK veru, TVK veru. AIADMK ponvizha kanda katchi. TVK aatchiyil irukkumaa? Irukkaadhaa? Enbadhai poga poga paarthuk kollalaam. Yaar yaaro solluvaanga, adhai ellaam neengal ketkalaamaa? Vedanthangal paravai maadhiri angu poyirukkiraar. Pala katchikku poyittu vandhavar. Kadaisi varaikkum TVK-vil iruppaaraa endru paarkkalaam.
TVK thalaivar Vijay oru thogudhikku iru idangalil prachaaram seivadhu andhak katchiyin nilaippaadu. Indha iru thogudhigalum AIADMK vetri petra thogudhi. AIADMK-vin kottai. Iru thogudhigalilum AIADMK nichayam vetri perum, ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: DMK aatchiyil saalaiyai seeramaikka kori thuni thuvaikkum poraattam nadathappattadhaa?
text:
Thiranatra DMK aatchiyil saalaiyai seeramaikka noodhana muraiyil poraattam nadandhadhu endru oru video

Saalaiyil theangi nindra thanneeril oruvar thuni thuvaithu nadathiya poraattathin videovai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilai thagavalil, “Thiranatra DMK arasu pradhaana saalaiyai seeramaikka vendi noodhana poraattam! 😃🔥👍
#DMK_Naattirkkum_Veettirkum_Kedu #ThiruttuDMK #ByeByeStalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
DMK aatchiyil saalaiyai seeramaikkak kori oruvar saalaiyil theangiya neeril thuni thuvaithu poraattam nadathiyadhaaga silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, Tamil Naattil endha idathil indha video edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai.
Videovil Arasinar Madhiya Achagam endru oru arasu aluvalagathin kattidam therigiradhu. Satru uttru paarkkumbodhu “Puducherry Arasu” endru therigiradhu. Arasu aluvalagam amaindhulla idathin muzhu mugavariyum adhil thelivaaga illai. Aanaal, Puducherry-il andha kattidam iruppadhu mattum thelivaanadhu.
Google Maps-il Puducherry Arasu Arasinar Madhiya Achagam endru type seidhu thedinom. Appodhu Puducherry maanilam Thattanchavady endra idathil andha aluvalagam iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhan Street View paarthapodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovil idampetra kaatchiyum, Thattanchavady-il amaindhulla Arasinar Madhiya Achaga kattidathin mugappu pagudhiyum ondraaga irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil Google, Facebook ullitta ellaa seithi, samooga oodaga thalangalilum “Thattanchavady, saalai, poraattam” ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalai payanpaduthith thedinom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovudan Puducherry oodagangazhil veliyaana seidhigal namakkuk kidaithana. Adhil, “Thattanchavady pagudhiyil saalaigal gundum kuzhiyumaaga mazhai neer theangiyulladhaal Suththam Sundararajan thuni thuvaithu noodhana poraattathil eedupattullaar.!!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video Tamil Naattaich saarndhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Tamil Naattin saalaigal ellaam nandraaga ulladhaa endru aayvu seyyavillai, indha video Tamil Naattaich saarndhadhaa illaiyaa endru mattume aayvu seidhullom. Nammudaiya aayvil indha video Puducherry-ai saarndhadhu enbadhu urudhi seiyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Greenland paadhugaappu ini America vasam: Denmark-udan varalaatru oppandham nadandhadhaaga Trump arivippu!
text:
Washington: Greenland theevin muzhu paadhugaappu kattuppaattaiyum America thanadhu vasamaakkiyulladhu enavum, idhugurithu Denmark matrum Greenland nirvagathudan 'aayutkaala oppandham' kaiyezhuthaagiyulladhaagavum America adhibar Donald Trump adhiradiyaaga arivithullaar.
Samooga valaithalap pakkathil adhibar Trump padhivittulladhaavadhu: America matrum Greenland-in paadhugaappai urudhi seyyum vagaiyil, iru tharappu pradhinidhigaludan pesi miga mukkiyamaana udanbaattai ettiyullom. Indha varalaatru sirappumikka oppandhathinpadi, Greenland-in ottumotha paadhugaappaiyum America nirandharamaaga gavanithuk kollum. Idharkaaga America arasukku oru paisa kooda selavu kidaiyaadhu.
Edhirigalukku idamillai:
Inimeal Americavin neradi ezhuthuppoorva anumadhiyindri, endha oru edhiri naadum Greenland-il raanuva thalam amaikkavo, padaigalai niruthavo alladhu angulla mukkiya thuraigalil mudhaleedu seyyavo kanavilum ninaikka mudiyaadhu. Indha oppandhathirku kaalakkedu edhuvum kidaiyaadhu; idhu oru nirandhara oppandham. Idhanpadi, Greenland-in poruthamaana pagudhigalil Americavin brammaandamaana raanuva thalangalai amaikkum panigal udanadiyaaga thuvangappadum.
Koottu valarchi:
Raanuva kattumaanap panigalil Greenland makkalum inaithuk kollappaduvar. America, Denmark, Greenland aagiya moondru tharappirkum, matrum namadhu natpu naadugalukkum idhu migapperiva raajathanthira vetri. Ivvaaru Trump perumidhathudan therivithullaar. Trump-in indha adhiradi arivippu, sarvadhesa arangilum paadhugaapputh thuraiyilum perum parabarappai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Oppandhathin mukkiya amsangal:
Nirandhara raanuva anumadhi: Arctic pagudhiyil America padaigalin thalam, por vimaanangal parappadharkaana urimai matrum raanuva nilaigalai virivupaduthuvadharkaana muzhu anumadhi Americavukku vazhangappattulladhu.
Edhiri naadugalukku 'No Entry': Americavin mukkiya edhirigalaana China matrum Russia pondra NATO allaadha naadugal Greenland-il raanuva thalam amaippadho alladhu padaigalai nilainiruthuvadho mutrilum thadai seiyyappattulladhu.
Mudhaleedugalukku America anumadhi kattaayam: Greenland-il mukkiya ul-kattamaippu matrum mukkiyamaana thuraigalil anniya naadugal merkollum mudhaleedugalukku Americavin oppudhal avasiyam.
Selavillaa paadhugaappu: Indha virivaana paadhugaappu erpaadugalaal America vari seluthuvorukku evvidha koodudhal nidhi sumaiyum erpadaadhu ena America veliyuravuthurai therivithulladhu.

headline: Therdhal Aanaiyathirku edhiraaga Bihar-il puratchi vedithadhaa?
text:
Bihar-il BJP, Therdhal Aanaiyathirku edhiraaga makkal puratchi vedithadhu endru oru video

Arasu aluvalagathai eraalamaana makkal muttrugeiyittu thaakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Bihar-il vedithadhu makkal puratchi nandri Indhiya therdhal aanaiyathirku edhiraaga…. Nitish Kumar thappi ottam… podhaadhu podhaadhu idhu naadu muzhuvadhum parava vendum. Poraattakaarargalukku vaazhthukkal…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Bihar sattamandra therdhalil BJP koottani vetri petradhai makkal edhirppadhu pondru thodarnthu samooga oodagangalil padhivugal pagirappattu varugindrana. Andha vagaiyil makkal puratchi vedithadhaagavum, Bihar mudhalamaichar Nitish Kumar thappi odinaar endrum silar videovai padhivittu varugindranar.
Sila maadhagalukku munbu Nepal-il Gen Z puratchi erpatradhu. Appodhu veliyaana videovai Bihar-il nadandhadhu pondru veliyittullanar. Indha video kaatchiyil idam petra sila pagudhigalai vaithu munbu idhe pondru vadhandhi parappappattadhu. Idhu Nepal video endru kadandha September-ileye katturai veliyittirundhom.
Melum, kattidathin meedhu parakkum kodiyai paarkkum bodhe adhu Nepal naattin kodi enbadhai ariya mudigiradhu. Kattidathin mozhi peyarppum kooda adhu Maavatta Nirvaaga Aluvalagam, Chitwan (District Administration Office, Chitwan) endru theriyavarugiradhu. Chitwan enbadhu Nepal naattil ulla nagaramaagum. Kattidathil ezhudhappattiruppadhum Nepali mozhi endru Google Translate koorugiradhu.
Erkanave nammudaiya katturaiyil andha kattidam Nepal-il ulladhu enbadhai Google Map udhaviyudan urudhi seidhirundhom. Melum Nepal puratchiyin bodhu Chitwan maavatta nirvaaga aluvalagam thaakkappaduvadhu thodarbaga appodhu veliyaana samooga oodaga padhivugalaiyum aadhaarangalaaga alithirundhom. Indha pazhaiya videovai eduthu, Bihar-il makkal puratchi vedithadhu endru thavaraaga, vishamathanamaaga padhivugalai samooga oodagangalil veliyittiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Trichiyil pudhidhaagak kattiya melnilai neer-thekkath thotti idindhu vizhundhadhaa?
text:
Gujarat-il sameebathil Rs. 21 crore selavil kattappatta thanneer thekkath thottiyil mudhan muraiyaaga thanneer nirappum bodhu idindhu vizhundha sambavathai Tamil Naattil nadandhadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappi varugindranar.

Thanneer thotti norungi vizhundhadhu thodarbaga Dinakaran naalidhazh veliyitta reels video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Trichy Rs. 21 crore selavil kattappatta thanneer thekkath thotti, mudhal muraiyaaga thanneer nirappum bodhu idindhu vizhundhadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sameebathil BJP aatchi seyyum Gujarat maanilam Surat-il sameebathil pudhidhaaga kattappatta mel nilai neer-thekkath thottiyil thanneer nirappi sodhanai seidha bodhu andha thotti udaindhu vizhundhu adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Idhu thodarbana seithi, video seithi, samooga oodagangazhil viral aanadhu.
Indha nilaiyil indha sambavam Tamil Naattil Trichiyil nadandhadhu pondru silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Adhuvum DMK aadharavu Dinakaran naalidhazhe indha seithiyai veliyittadhu pondru parappi varugindranar. Indha seithiyai Dinakaran veliyittadhaa endru aayvu seidhom.
Dinakaran veliyitta reels video padhivugalai adhan Facebook pakkathil paarvaiyittom. 2026 January 21-m thedhi indha videovai andha oodagam veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil, “Gujarat: Rs. 21 crore selavil kattappatta thanneer thekkath thotti, mudhal muraiyaaga thanneer nirappum bodhu idindhu vizhundhadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhil Gujarat endra vaarthaiyai mattum edit seidhu maatri, Trichy endru serthu thavaraaga vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Velaan urpathiyai ookkuvikka pudhiya vazhikaattum amaippu
text:
Chennai: Thamizhaga vivasayigalukku udhavavum, avargalin vivasaaya porutkalukku pudhiya sandhaigalai erpaduthi tharavum Thamizhaga arasu 'Vazhikaattudhal Tamil Nadu' pondra pudhiya amaippai uruvaakka ulladhaaga Tamil Nadu arasarasin Velaan Sandhaipaduthal matrum Velaan Vaniga Thurai iyakkunar Chandrasekhar Sakhamuri I.A.S., therivithaar.
Avar kooriyadhaavadhu:
C.I.I. matrum Madhiya Semippu Kidangu Kazhagam inaindhu erpaadu seidha 'Orunginaindha semippu matrum madhippu koottal sevai-gal vaayilaaga velaan etrumadhiyai valuppaduthudhal' kuritha aalosanai koottathil pesum bodhu avar kooriyadhaavadhu:
Indha velaan vaniga vazhikaattudhal maiyam, naveena thozhilnutpangal, kadan udhavi, maaniya udhavi, payir kaappedu, mudhaleettu thittamidal matrum virivaana thitta arikkai thayaarithal ullittavai kurithu vivasayigal, velaan thozhil munaivor matrum uzhavar urpathiyaalar niruvanangalukku uriya vazhikaattudhalai vazhangum.
Vivasaayi - urpathiyaalar amaippugalukku podhumaana, malivaana matrum uriya nerathil mooladhanam kidaippadhum, vilainilathin arugeleye sirandha padhappaduthudhal matrum paadhugaappu vasadhigalum velaan madhippu thodargalai valuppaduthi vivasayigalai ulaga sandhaigaludan inaippadharku indriyameayadhavai.
Kaiyaaludhal matrum pokkuvarathin bodhu erpadum izhappugal verum vilaiporul veenaavadhu mattumalla, vivasayigalin mudhaleedu, uzhaippu matrum saagubadikku arppanikkappatta valangalin izhappum aagum. Idhu unavu matrum oottachathu paadhugaappukku paadhippai erpaduthugiradhu.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: 5 muraikku mel panam eduthaal vasoolikkappadum ATM kattanam Rs. 2-il irundhu Rs. 23 aaga uyarthappadugiradhaa?
text:
ATM-il aindhu muraikku mel panam eduthaal vasoolikkappadum kattanam Rs. 2-il irundhu Rs. 23 aaga uyarthappadugiradhu endru oru news card

Egirum ATM kattanam endru Thanthi TV news card ondrai veliyittulladhu. Adhil, “May 1 mudhal ATM-il maadhathil 5 muraikku mel panam eduthaal vasoolikkappadum kattanam Rs. 2-il irundhu Rs. 23 aaga uyarvu – RBI arivippu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ATM machine-il aindhu muraikku mel payanpaduthum bodhu (panam eduthaalo alladhu vangi kanakil evvalavu panam ulladhu, mini statement eduthaalo) kattanam vasoolikkappadum. 20 roobaikku mel vangigal vasoolithu varugindrana. Aanaal, 2 roobai mattum idhuvarai vasoolikkappattu vandhadhu pola Thanthi TV seithi veliyittulladhu.
English oodagangazhil aindhu muraikku mel payanpaduthappadum ATM seyalpaadugalukku adhiga-batchamaaga Rs. 23 varai vasoolikka Reserve Bank anumadhi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, evvalavu roobayilirundhu evvalavu uyartha Reserve Bank anumadhi alithulladhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Enave, Reserve Bank veliyitta seithi kurippait thedi eduthom.
Adhil, “Vaadikkaiyaalargal thangal sondha vangi ATM-galilirundhu ovvoru maadhamum aindhu ilavasa parivarthanaigalukku (nidhi matrum nidhi allaadha parivarthanaigal ulpada) thagudhiyudaiyavargal. Avargal pira vangi ATM-galilirundhu ilavasa parivarthanaigalukkum (nidhi matrum nidhi allaadha parivarthanaigal ulpada) thagudhiyudaiyavargalaaga ullanar. Idhan padi, perunagara maiyangalil moondru parivarthanaigal matrum perunagaram allaadha maiyangalil aindhu parivarthanaigalum ilavasamaaga seidhu kollalaam. Ilavasa parivarthanaigalukku piragu, vaadikkaiyaalarukku oru parivarthanaikku adhiga-batchamaaga ₹23 kattanam vasoolikkappadalaam. Idhu May 01, 2025 mudhal amalukku varum” endru irundhadhu.
Arasuthurai matrum thaniyaar vangigalil aindhu ilavasa parivarthanaigalukku piragu evvalavu kattanam vasoolikkappadugiradhu endru paarthom. Thaniyaar vangiyaana ICICI vangiyil panam eduthal sevaikku Rs. 21-um idhara panam saaraadha sevaigalukku Rs. 8.50-um panap parivarthanaikku erpa GST-yum vasoolikkappadugiradhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Podhuthurai vangiyaana SBI vangiyil, panam edukka SBI vangi ATM-ai payanpaduthinaal GST-yudan Rs. 10-um, idhara vangi ATM endraal GST-yudan Rs. 20-um, panam saaraa sevai endraal SBI vangi ATM enil ilavasam endrum idhara vangi ATM endraal GST-yudan 8 roobaiyum vasoolikkappadugiradhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Matra vangigalilum Rs. 20, Rs. 21 vasoolikkappaduvadhaaga thagaval kidaithadhu.
Idhan moolam endha vangiyilum Rs. 2 vasoolikkappadavillai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Tharpodhu RBI parindhurai adippadaiyil aindhu muraikku merpatta ATM payanpaattukku Rs. 23 vasoolikkappada ulladhu thelivaagiradhu. Pala vangigalil adhiga-batchamaaga Rs. 21 varai vasoolikkappaduvadhaiyum nammudaiya aayvu urudhi seidhulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil Thanthi TV unmaiyudan thavaraana thagavalaiyum serthu veliyittulladhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Eariyil vizhundha 7.5 savaran 'necklace' 2 mani nera thedudhalukku pin meetpu
text:
Pallikaranai: Eariyil vizhundha 7.5 savaran 'necklace' nagaiyai, irandu mani nera thedudhalukku pin kandeduthu, urimaiyaalaridam police oppadaithanar.
Pallikaranaich cherndhavar Kokila, 65. Ivar, Vinayagar Chaturthiyai munnittu, veettil siriya Vinayagar silai vaithu, than 7.5 savaran necklace-ai anivithu poojai seidhullaar.
Poojai mudindhapin, silaiyai veettin aruge theruvil vaikkappattirundha periya Vinayagar silai aruge, netru eduthu vaithu veettirku chendrullaar.
Appodhu, 'necklace' nyaabagam vandhadhum, padhariyadithu angu chendru paarthullaar. Appodhu, Vinayagar silaigal visarjanathirku eduthu sellappattirundhana. Thagaval arindha Pallikaranai police, periya Vinayagar silai vaithirundha Balaraman enbavaridam visaarithapodhu, siriya silaigalai karaithuvittadhaaga therivithullaar.
Silai karaikkappatta idathil, ulloor nabargalin udhaviyudan police thedudhal vettaiyil eedupattanar. Irandu mani nerathirkupin, thanneerukkul moozhkiyirundha Vinayagar silaiyodu serthu, necklace-um meetkappattadhu.
Meetkappatta nagaiyai, Pallikaranai police moodhaatti Kokilavidam oppadaithanar.

headline: Bangladesh theeviravaadha amaippu Karappaanpoochi Janata Katchi poraattathai aadharithadhaa?
text:
Bangladesh-in theeviravaadha matrum Indhiya edhirppu kolgai konda amaippu ondru Indhiavil nadandha Cockroach Janata Party (Karappaanpoochi Janata Katchi) poraattathirku aadharavu therivithadhu endru oru padhivu

Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami endra amaippu veliyitta arikkaiyin screenshot Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. “Indhiavil poraattathil eedupattu varum maanavargalukku” endru thodangum andha kadidhathil poraattathirku aadharavu enbadhu pol kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Bangladesh-in theeviravaadha matrum Indhiya-edhirppuk kolgai konda ‘Jamaat-e-Islami’ amaippu, Indhiavil nadaippetru varum CJP poraattathirku thanadhu aadharavai alithulladhu. NEET edhirppu poraattamnu poraadum Congress Communist Naxalgal ena dhesa thurohigal ambalappaduthappattanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kalvith thurai amaicharaaga irundha Dharmendra Pradhan padhavi vilaga valiyuruthi Cockroach Janata Katchiyinar poraattam nadathinar. Idhait thodarnthu avar thannudaiya padhaviyai resignation seidhaar. Idharkidaiye poraattathil eedupattavargal dhesavirodhigal endru kaatta palveru vadhandhigal parappappattu varugindrana.
Poraattathil eedupattavargalukku Bangladesh theeviravaadha amaippu aadharavu therivithadhaaga oru padhivu samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Yaar vendumaanaalum ippadi oru kadidhathai uruvaakkalaam enbadhaal indha kadidham meedhu sandhegam ezhundhadhu. Enave, indha kadidham thodarbaga aayvu seidhom.
Ippadi oru arivippai andha amaippu veliyittadhaa endru ariya Google-il thedinom. Andha amaippin samooga oodaga pakkangalaik kandarindhom. Adhil logo-ve vidhyaasamaaga irundhadhu. Enave, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda kadidham poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu.
Andha amaippin X thala pakkathai paarvaiyittom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda kadidham poliyanadhu endru kurippittu veliyaana padhivu namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil, “Samooga oodagangalil paravi varum polik kadidhathai Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami kandikkiradhu; theeya prachaarathai udanadiyaaga nirutha vendum enak korikkai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda kadidham thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Japan-il tsunami endru paravum pazhaiya videovaal sarchai…
text:

headline: M.K. Stalin aatchiyil kelvi ketta pennai izhuthu chendra police endra thagaval unmaiya?
text:
''M.K. Stalin aatchiyil kelvi ketta pennai izhuthu chendra police,'' endru koori,

Idhil, ''Grama sabai koottathil kelvi ezhuppiya appaavi pennai thaakki izhuthu chendra kaatchi ....
Oru naayai kallaal eduthu adithaal PETA amaippu odi vandhu kelvi ketkudhu
Stalin aatchila nadakkakkoodiya kodumaigal ellaam endha oodagathilum vara maattengudhu
Inga irukkakkoodiya cinema prabalangalukku kannu theriyala
Samooga poraaligal ellaam veru maanilathirku pulampeyarndhu vittanar
DMK kitta irundhu vaangi thindra koottani katchi allakkaigal ellaam kalyaana naal vaazhthu solradhu varisaiyil poi nikkudhu” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seivadhai kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiya endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video kadandha 2021-m aandu edukkappatta ondru enavum, idharkum tharpodhaiya DMK aatchikkum thodarbillai enavum theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanpadi, 2021-m aandu AIADMK aatchik kaalathil, edhirkkatchi thalaivar M.K. Stalin Tamil Nadu muzhukka, podhumakkal aadharavai thirattum paniyil eedupattaar. Adhan oru pagudhiyaaga, January 02, 2021 andru DMK saarbaaga, Coimbatore-il nadaippetra grama sabai koottathil andraiya AIADMK amaichar Velumani kurithu M.K. Stalin vimarsithu pesiyadhaal, pen oruvar kurukkittu vaakkuvaadham seidhaar. Idhaiyaduthu, avarai police appurappaduthinar. Idhuthodarbana kaatchigal appodhe samooga valaithalangalil paravi, perum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu.

headline: Arivaaludan reels vaalibar kaidhu
text:
Tirunelveli: Tirunelveli Pazhaiyapettaiyil arivaaludan 'reels' video veliyittu podhumakkalidaiye achathai erpaduthiya vaalibarai, police kaidhu seidhanar.
Tirunelveli Town Pazhaiyapettaiyai serndha Isakkiraja 21. Kaiyil neelamaana arivaaludan iruppadhu pondra kaatchigalai Instagram-il 'reels'-aaga veliyittaar. Indha video samooga valaithalangalil paraviyadhu. Thagavalarindha Pettai police, Isakkiraja meedhu vazhakkupadhivu seidhu kaidhu seidhanar.
Avaridam irundhu mobile phone matrum videovil payanpaduthappatta arivaal aagiyavatrain parimudhal seidhanar.
Kaidhu seiyyappatta Isakkiraja meedhu erkanave ganja virpanai vazhakku niluvaiyil ulladhu.

headline: Nehruvin sattai collar-ai piditha pen endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiya?
text:
Pradhamaraaga irundha Nehruvin sattai collar-ai penmani oruvar pidithu kelvi ketpadhu pondru pugaippadam ondru

Munnaal Pradhamar Nehruvin sattai collar-ai oru pen pidithiruppadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, “Indhia vidudhalai petradhum,
Nehru Pradhamar aanaar. Oru koottathil avarai nerungiya oru penmani yaarum edhirpaaraadha vagaiyil thideerena Nehruvin sattai collar-ai pidithu, Indhiavirku sudhandhiram kidaithu vittadhu. Ungalukku Pradhamar padhavi kidaithu vittadhu. Enakku enna kidaikkum endru ketka, koottam velavelathu ponadhu. Anaivarum adhirchi adaindhanar. Aanaal, kobam kollaadha Nehru avaradhu paaniyileye sonna badhil: “Indha naattin Pradhamarin collar-ai pidithu, kelvi ketkum urimaiyum, nambikkaiyum ungalukku kidaithu irukkiradhammaa…. Ungal korikkaiyai sollungal. Nadavadikkai edukkirom!!!”. Ippodhaiya Pradhamarai yaarum nerungak kooda mudiyaadhu. Makkal oru km tholaivil niruthi vaikkappaduvaargal!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sudhandhira Indhiavin mudhal Pradhamar Nehru patri thodarnthu thavaraana thagaval samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhuvarai avarai vimarsithu vadhandhigal parappappattu vandhana. Ippodhu, avaradhu perunthanmaiyai pugazhbadhaagak karudhi avarin peyarukku kalangam erpaduthum vagaiyil padhivu ondrai silar samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar. Avaradhu sattai collar-ai penmani oruvar pidithu kelvi kettadhaagavum Nehru migavum amaidhiyaaga avarukku badhil alithaar endru padhivittu varugindranar.
Unmaiyil ippadi oru sambavam nadandhadhaaga endha oru thagavalum illai. Nehru maraindhu pala aandugal aagivitta nilaiyil thideerendru Nehru patriya pudhiya thagaval matrum pugaippadam samooga oodagangalil viral aagave idhu patri aayvu seidhom. Unmaiyil ippadi oru sambavam nadandhirundhaal adhu patri padhivu seiyyappattirukkum. Aanaal namakku appadi endha oru thagavalum kidaikkavillai. Indha pugaippadhathaik Google Lens thalathil padhivertrith thediyapodhu 2026 August maadhathilirundhudhaan indha pugaippadam pagirappattu vandhiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adharku munbu ippadi oru pugaippadam engum veliyaagi irukkavillai.
Indha pugaippadathai paarkkum bodhu AI moolam uruvaakkappattadhu pol therigiradhu. Enave, AI pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum inaiyathalamaana hivedetect.ai-il padhiverri aayvu seidhom. Andha inaiyathalam indha pugaippadam 99.7 sathaveedham AI moolam uruvaakkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endru therivithadhu.
Andha inaiyathalam mattumindri veru sila AI pugaippadangalaik kandariya udhavum inaiyathalangalilum padhiverri aayvu seidhom. Avaiyum indha pugaippadam muzhukka AI moolam uruvaakkappattadhudhaan endru urudhi seidhana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil Nehruvin sattaiyai pidithu kelvi ketta pen endru paravum pugaippadam poliyanadhu endru urudhi seiyyappadugiradhu.

headline: "Maanavargalai kuri vaithu bodhai maathirai virpanai"- 6,000 maathiraigal parimudhal; rowdy ulpada 4 per kaidhu
text:
Thanjavooril college matrum school maanavargalai kuri vaithu bodhai maathiraigal virpanai seidha pirabala rowdy ulpada naangu ilaignargalai bodhai porul thaduppu pirivu police kaidhu seidhullana.
Thanjavooril, bodhai maathirai virpanai adhigalavil nadaiperuvadhaaga, bodhai porul thaduppu pirivu policukku thagaval kidaithulladhu.
Idhaithodarnthu, bodhai thaduppu pirivu police Keelavaasal pagudhiyil sodhanai seidhanar. Appodhu, Keelavaasal, Vannaarathuraiyai serndha pirabala rowdy Prakash(26) (alias) Maadu Prakashidam adhigalavil bodhai maathiraigal irundhullana. Idhaiyaduthu avarai piditha police visaaranai nadathinar.
Visaaranaiyil avaradhu nanbargalaana Keelavaasal, Chinnaiyapillai theruvai serndha Mohamed Abbas(25), Sunnaambukara theruvai serndha Subash(24), matrum Annapettaiyai serndha Sanjay Sampath(23) aagiyoridam, 6,000 Tapentadol engira bodhai maathiraigal irundhadhu kandupidikappattadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, bodhai porul thaduppu pirivu, Prakash, Abbas, Subash, Sanjay Sampath aagiya naangu peraiyum Kizhakku policil oppadaithanar.
Melum naangu per meedhum Kizhakku kaaval nilaiya police vazhakkupadhivu seidhu kaidhu seidhanar. Avargalidam irundhu 6,000 bodhai maathiraigal, oru car aagiyavai parimudhal seyyappattadhu. Parimudhal seidha bodhai maathiraiyin madhippu sumaar Rs.60,000 engiraargal.
Thodarnthu avargalidam nadathiya visaaranaiyil, Mohamed Abbas, Nagpur-il ulla Sai Trading endra company ondtril irundhu maathiraigalai, online moolam order seidhu, andha maathiraigalai parcel moolam petru, nanbargaludan inaindhu college, school maanavargalai kuri vaithu virpanai seidhadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Idhu kurithu bodhai porul thaduppu police kooriyadhavadhu: Theni maavattam, Uthamapalayam pagudhiyai serndha Satheeshkumar(29), ivaradhu nanbaraana Tiruppur maavattam, Anupparpalayam pagudhiyai serndha Ranjithkumar(24) iruvarum serndhu bodhai maathiraigalai Nagpur niruvanathil vaangiyullanar.
Idhil, Ranjithkumar Thiruvaiyaru pagudhiyil ulla thanadhu uravinar veettil thangikkondu, bodhai maathiraigalai virpanai seyya muyandtrullaar. Idharkaaga Satheeshkumaraiyum varavazhaithu irundhaar. Innilaiyil, kadandha 30th date iruvaridam irundhum aayiram maathiraigalai parimudhal seidhadhudan avargalaiyum kaidhu seidhu Maroor policil oppadaithom.
Thodarnthu avargalidam nadathiya visaaranaiyil, Mohamed Abbas, Prakash aagiyor bodhai maathiraigalai online-il vaangi virpanai seidhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu avargal meedhu nadavadikkai edukkappattulladhu endranar.

headline: Gazavil Hamas-ai varavetra makkal endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Gaza therukkalil Hamas nadathiya vetri anivaguppai Palestine makkal varavetrathaaga oru video

Caargalil thuppaakki endhiya palar anivaguthu vara adhai oru pen varaverpadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Videovil "Gazavin therukkalil makkalin amogha varaverpudan Hamas-in vetri vaahana anivaguppu" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilai thagavalil, "Hamas-in vetri vaahana perani.." endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
investigation_details:
Irandu aandugalaaga nadandhu vandha Hamas - Israel idaiyeyana por mudivukku vandhulladhu. Egypt-il America adhibar Trump thalaimaiyil idharkaana oppandham kaiyezhuthaanadhu. Idhaithodarnthu Israel matrum Hamas amaippinar pidithu vaithirundha pinai kaidhigal vidudhalai seyyappattu varugindranar. Indha nilaiyil Gaza therukkalil Hamas amaippinar vetri anivaguppu nadathiyadhaagavum, avargalai podhu makkal varavetrathaagavum oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu unmaiya endru ariya aaivu seidhu paarthom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu indha aandu January-il irundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Perumbaalana padhivugal Hamas-ai pugazhndhu alladhu vimarsithu veliyidappattathaaga irundhadhu. Indha video eppodhu edukkapattadhu endru avatril kurippidappadavillai.
Thodarnthu thediya podhu Arabic mozhiyil veliyaana X thala padhivugal namakku kidaithana. Adhai mozhimaatram seidhu paarthom. Adhil, "Naangu Israeli pen raanuva veerargalai Hamas oppadaikka sendra podhu Hamas veerargalukku Palestine pen vanakkam seluthinaar" enbadhu pola kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan adipadayil Google-il thedinom. Appodhu 2025 January 25th date veliyaana seithigal namakku kidaithana. Adhaavadhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video mudhal mudhalil samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundha naalil veliyaagi irundha seithigal avai.
Andha seithigalil, "Israel siraiyilrundhu 200 Palestiniya kaidhigal vidudhalai seyyappattadhai thodarnthu, naangu Israeli pen raanuva veerargalai vidudhalai seidha Hamas" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam idhu 2025 October-il merkkollappatta por nirutha oppandhathai thodarnthu Hamas nadathiya vetri anivaguppu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Pazhaiya videovai eduthu, ippodhaiya soozhalukku etrpa thavarana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil videovai veliyittiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adipadayil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaradhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vellai Maaligaikkul oodagangallukku anumadhi maruppu; Trump-in uttharavukku court thadai
text:
Washington: Americavin sila munnani oodaga niruvanangalin pathirikaiyaalargal Vellai Maaligaikkul nuzhaivadharku anumadhi marukkum adhibar Donald Trump nirvagathin uttharavukku needhimandram thadai vidithulladhu.
'CNN, - MS-Now, - Politico' aagiya oodagangal thangalai patri punaikkadhaigalaiyum, poigalaiyum thodarnthu ezhudhuvadhaaga koori, Vellai Maaligaikkul nuzhaivadharku thadai vidithu Trump sameebathil uttharavittaar.
Idhai edhirthu indha niruvanangal vazhakku thodardhana. Idhai visaaritha America maavatta needhipathi, andha thadaiyai udanadiyaaga neekki, meendum anumadhi vazhangumaaru uttharavittullaar.
Adhibar maaligaiyin thadai nadavadikkai arasiyalamaippu sattathirku virodhamaanadhu ena needhipathi than theerppil kurippittaar. Idhanaal Americavil Trump nirvagathirkum oodagangallukkum idaiyeyana modhal pudhiya kattathai ettiyulladhu.

headline: 26 acre.. 2 aayiram kodi... Pudhiya Thalaimai Seyalagam enge? Adhigaarappoorva arivippu veliyeedu!
text:
26 acre.. 2 aayiram kodi... Pudhiya Thalaimai Seyalagam enge? Adhigaarappoorva arivippu veliyeedu!
Seithiyaalar - Karthikeyan
Punitha George Fort dhaan tharppodhu Tamizhagathin tharppodhaiya thalaimai seyalagamaaga seyalpattu varugiradhu. Idhanai maatri pudhiya thalaimai seyalagam amaikka vendum endru munnaal Muthalamaichar Kalaignar Karunanidhi kaalathil irundhey palveru muyarchigal edukkapattana. Kurippaaga, Arasinar Thottathil pudhiya thalaimai seyalagam biramaandamaaga uruvaakkappattirundhadhu.
Aanaal, adhanpiragu aatchi maatram nigazhndhu, Muthalamaicharaaga padhaviyetra Jayalalithaa, andha biramaanda kattadathai, pannokku maruthuvamanaiyaaga maatrirundhaar. Indha nilaiyil, tharppodhu Muthalamaicharaaga padhaviyettrulla Vijay-um, Tamizhagathin thalaimai seyalagathai maatriyamaikka aarvam kaatti varugiraar.
Adhan orupagudhiyaaga, Chennai Pattinappakkathil ulla 25.16 acre nilathil, thalaimai seyalagam amaikka iruppadhaaga, therivikkappattulladhu. Adhaavadhu, Tamil Nadu Arasu-in podhutthurai seyalalar Sundaravalli arasaanai ondrai veliyittullaar. Adhanpadi, pudhiya thalaimai seyalagathirkaana virivaana thitta arikkaiyai podhup panitthurai thayaarikka vendum endru uttharavidappattulladhu.
Melum, kattadak kalai nibunargalai konda aalosanai kuzhu, kattada vadivamaippu, varaipadathai thayaarikkum kuzhu, irudhik kattada vadivamaippu, oppudhalai vazhangum kuzhu aagiya moondru thanithani kuzhukkalai amaikka vendum endrum arasaanaiyil therivikkappattulladhu. Pattinappakkam enappadum Foreshore Estate-il sumaar 25.16 acre-il pudhiya thalaimai seyalagathai kattuvadharku, Tamizhaga Veettu Vasadhi Vaariyamum, Chennai Maanagaraatchiyum anumadhi vazhangiyulladhu.
Varuvaayt thuraikku sondhamaana koodudhal nilangaludan serthu motham 26.5 acre parappalavil amaikkappada ulladhu. Motham 20 latcham sadhuravadi parappalavil kattappada ulla indhak kattadam, 15 adukkugalai kondadhaaga amaikkappada ulladhu. Idhan madhippu oru sadhuravadi 22,000 veedham, motham Rs.2,047 kodiyaaga ulladhu.
Veettu vasadhi vaariyathirku sondhamaana indha pagudhiyil irundhu, Santhome mukkiya saalaiyai elidhil anuga mudiyum. Tharppodhu thervu seyyappattulla veettu vasadhi vaariyathirku sondhamaana indha idam, 1958th aandu kaiyagappaduthappattadhu. Adhanpiragu, sumaar 1963 mudhal 1998 varaiyil sumaar 1,380 arasu oozhiyargalukkaana kudiyiruppugal kattappattana. Ivai tharppodhu sidhilamadaindhadhaal, adhanai idikkum panigal nadandhu varugindrana enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Data illaatha Voice&SMS maadha recharge.. TRAI pirappitha adhiradi uttharavu!
text:
Data thevaiyillaadha, kural azhaippugal matrum kuruncheidhigalai mattum payanpaduthum vaadikkaiyaalargalukkaagak kurugiya kaala recharge thittangalai vazhanga vendum endru tholaithodarbu niruvanangalukku Indhiya Tholaithodarbu Ozhungumurai Aanaiyam (TRAI) uttharavittulladhu.
'Tholaithodarbu Nugarvor Paadhukaappu (13-vadhu thirutham) Vidhigal, 2026'-n keezh September 21, 2026 andru indha pudhiya vazhikaattudhalgal veliyidappattullanar.
Adhanpadi, tholaithodarbu niruvanangal 30 naatkal alladhu adharku kuraivaana kaala validity konda sirappu vouchergalai voice, SMS matrum data sevaigalukkaagak kattaayam vazhanga vendum. Ovvoru maadhamum ore thedhiyil pudhukkikkum vagaiyil kuraindhapatcham oru recharge thittathaiyaavadhu niruvanangal arimugappadutha vendum. Adhaavadhu oru maadhadhil andhath thedhi illai yenil, am maadhadhin irudhi naalil pudhukkappadum.
Data pack-galudan serthu adhiga vilaiyulla recharge thittangalai vaanga iyalaadha kuraindha varumaanam konda vaadikkaiyaalargal matrum feature phone payanargalukku idhu perum nimmadhiyai alikkum. Neenda kaala validity konda oru thittathudan, 30 naatkal alladhu adharkum kuraivaana kaala alavu konda pira STV thittangalaiyum niruvanangal kattaayam vazhanga vendum. April 7, 2026 andru varaivu arikkaiyai veliyittu, June 15 andru podhumakkaludanana kalandhaaikkuk pirage TRAI indha irudhi mudivai eduthulladhu.

headline: 12 aandugalaaga Rs.1.49 lakh vari baakki: Seal vaikka sendra Tahsildarukku palaar
text:
12 aandugalaaga Rs.1.49 lakh vari baakki: 'Seal' vaikka sendra Tahsildarukku 'palaar'
Chennai: Sothu vari matrum kazhivuneer vari baakkiyai selutha kooriya, Kudineer Vaariya sirappu Tahsildar kannathil araindha, kattada urimaiyalalar ulpada iruvarai, police kaidhu seidhanar.
Mannady, Ibrahim saalaiyil Selvakumar, 45, enbavarukku sondhamaana kattadathin tharaithalathil tea kadai matrum thaniyaar aluvalagamum, mudhal matrum irandaavadhu thalathil veedugalum ullana.
Ikkattadathirku, sothuvari matrum kazhivuneer vari kadandha, 12 aandugalaaga seluthaamal, 1.49 lakh niluvaiyil ulladhu. Idhai selutha koori, Kudineer Vaariyam saarbil, kattada urimaiyalalar Selvakumarukku 'notice' anuppappattulladhu.
Selvakumar panam seluthaadhadhaal, kadandha 22nd date Royapuram mandala kudineer matrum kazhivuneer vaariya sirappu Tahsildar Harikaran, 41 matrum melaalar, maanagaraatchi oozhiyargal kattadathin tharaithalathil ulla kadaigalukku 'seal' vaikka sendrullanar.
Idharku edhirppu therivitha, Selvakumar matrum avaradhu aadharavaalar Suresh ulpada naangu per serndhu, Tahsildarudan vaakkuvaadhathil eedupattanar. Thodarnthu Selvakumar, Tahsildar Harikaran kannathil ongi kaiyaal araindhaar. Thodarnthu, thagaadha vaarthaiygalal thitti, kattadathirku 'seal' vaithaal, 'unnai, uyirodu vidamaatten' ena, mirattiyullaar.
Idhu kurithu Vadakku Kadarkarai kaaval nilaiyathil, Hariharan pugaar alithaar. Idhaiyaduthu police paadhukaappudan kadaigalukku 'seal' vaikkappattadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu police, arasu oozhiyarai pani seyya vidaamal thaduthal, mirattal ulpada aaru pirivin keezh vazhakku padhivu seidhu, Selvakumar, Suresh, 37, aagiyorai netru kaidhu seidhanar. Melum moovari, police thedi varugindranar.

headline: America adhibar Trump mejaiyil Periyar silai vaikkappattulladha?
text:
"America adhibar Trump mejaiyil Periyar silai vaikkappattulladhu" endru koori,

Ide pugaipadangalai vaithu, Facebook, X valaithalam palavatrilum padhivugal pagirappadugindrana.
Avatril, "America adhibar Trump mejaiyil Periyar sanghis." endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan maarbalavu Periyar silai, Trump mejaiyil iruppadhu pondra pugaipadam ondrum pagirappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seidhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkkanda thagaval unmaiya endru naam aaivu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu unmaiyaana pugaipadam kidaiyaadhu endrum, edit seyyappattadhu endrum theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, America adhibar Donald Trump, aluvalaga mejaiyil iruppadhu annaattin munnaal adhibar Benjamin Franklin silai; Periyar silai kidaiyaadhu.
Video link keezhe inaikkappattulladhu.
Sila naatkal munbaaga, Florida Gators basketball aniyin veerar Olivier Rioux enbavarai mariyaadhai nimithamaaga, Donald Trump neril sandhithup pesinaar. Appodhu, Olivier-in uyarathai paarthu, Trump satru piramithaar.
Idhuthorbana videovai, Trump-in adhigaarappoorva udhaviyaalar Margo Martin, avaradhu X valaithalathil pagirndhullaar. Adhanaiyum aadhaarathirkaagak keezhe inaithullom.
Enave, Trump mejaiyil vaikkappattulla Benjamin Franklin silaiyai eduthuvittu, adhil Periyar silaiyai serthu, samooga valaithalangalil vendumenre vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: BJP patri vimarsikka vendaam endru M.K. Stalin koorinaara?
text:
"BJP patri vimarsikka vendaam," endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga,

Idhil, "Inimel yaarum BJP patri vimarsanam panna vendaam- Stalin pechu" endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Sun News logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seidhavadhai kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkkanda news card unmaiya endru naam aaivu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu Sun News peyaril paravum vadhandhi, endru theriyavandhadhu. Kurippitta news card-il, 24/May/2025 endru thedhi ulladhu.
Idhan adipadayil thagaval thedinom. Mudhalil Sun News aasiriyar kuzhuvil kettapodhu, "Naangal veliyitta veroru seithiyai eduthu, edit seidhu, thavarana thagaval parappugiraargal," endru therivithanar.
Melum, unmaiyaana seithiyin muzhu video link-ai namakku koduthanar.
Idhil engeyum "BJP patri vimarsanam panna vendaam," endru M.K. Stalin pesave illai.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Jana Naayagan release thaamadham; mottai potta rasigaikku wig vazhangappattadha?
text:
"Jana Naayagan padam thaamadham indri release seyya kettu, mottai potta rasigaikku wig vazhangappattadhu", endru koori,

Idhil, "Jana Naayagan padam nallabadiyaaga release aagavendum endru oru Vijay rasigai mottai adithuk kondaar avarukku katchi saarbaaga wig vazhangappattadhu aanaal adhu karuppaaga illai ena aniya maruthuvittaar..!," endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seidhavadhai kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkkanda thagaval unmaiya endru naam aaivu merkondom. Appodhu, AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta padam, endru theriyavandhadhu. Google Gemini logo idhil idampetrulladhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, unmaiyaana seithiyin link kidaithadhu.
Koodudhal seidhi aadhaaram idho...
Idhanpadi, Chennaiyil Jana Naayagan thiraipadamukku nalla theerppu vara vendum, endru pen rasigai oruvar, kula deiva kovilil mudiyai kaanikkai seluthinaar. Adhubatriya pugaipadam ondrai eduthu, AI udhaviyudan edit seidhu, parappugiraargal.
Aduthappadiyaaga, TVK thalaimai aluvalagathilum pesi, kurippitta pugaipadam unmaiyaanadhalla; AI muraiyil edit seyyappattadhu, enbadhai urudhippaduthiyullom.
Irudhiyaaga, Wasitai inaiyathalam udhaviyudan naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaipadam, AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhu, endru urudhi seidhullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaipadam AI edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Edappadi Palaniswami-yai kindal seidhaara Jayakumar?
text:
"Senchotru kadan theerkka seraadha idam serndhaar" endru Edappadi Palaniswami-yai munnaal amaichar Jayakumar kindal seidhaar endru oru video

AIADMK moottha thalaivarum munnaal amaicharumaana D. Jayakumar alitha pettiyin siru pagudhiyai vaithu padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Adhil, "Tharam thaazhndhu ippadi poivittaar endru thaan... Karnan padathil senchotruk kadan theerkka seraadha idam serndhu vanjathil veezhndhaayadaa Karna endru varuvadhu pola ippodhu adhu pola nadandhuvittadhu" engiraar. Videovil, "Edappadi Palanisamiyai paadal paadi kindal seidha Jayakumar" endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Nilai thagavalil, "Edappadi Palanisamiyai paadal paadi kindal seidha 'Pradhaana Saalai'" endru kurippidappattulladhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
BJP kootaniyal thaan therthalkalil AIADMK tholviyadaindhadhu endru koori vandhavar munnaal amaichar Jayakumar. Tharppodhu meendum AIADMK - BJP kootani uruvaagi ulladhu. Idhai vaithu Jayakumarai vaithu samooga oodagangalil vadhandhigal paravi varugindrana. AIADMK-vil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga Jayakumar arivithadhaaga news card paraviyadhu. Adhu poliyanadhu endru urudhi seidhirundhom.
Indha nilaiyil BJP-il kootani serndhadhan moolam seraadha idam serndhu vanjathil veezhndhuvittaar Edappadi Palaniswami endru Jayakumar kooriyadhaaga videovai padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, andha videovil Edappadi Palanisamiyai Jayakumar vimarsithadhu pondru engum illai. Adhe pondru BJP-vil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga naan eppodhu koorinen endru Jayakumar kooda petti alithullaar. Enave, idhu pazhaiya videovaaga irukkalaam endru aaivu seidhom.
Karnan, senchotruk kadan theerkka, Jayakumar ena sila adipadai vaarthaigalai payanpaduthi Google-il thedinom. Appodhu Jayakumar 2022nd aandu alitha petti ondru kidaithadhu. Adhai paartha podhu, andha pettiyilirundhu indha padhivai uruvaakkiyiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Videovin 1.40th second-il naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla kaatchigal vara thodangiyadhu. Adhil, "Senchotruk kadan theerkka seraadha idam serndhu vanjathil veezhndhaayadaa Karna... vanjagan Dinakarandaa" engiraar. Pettiyai muzhumaiyaaga paartha podhu O. Panneerselvam-ai Jayakumar vimarsithu petti alithirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Jayakumar alitha pettiyai vaithu oodagangalil veliyaana seidhigalum namakkuk kidaithana. O. Panneerselvam matrum TTV Dhinakaran-ai vimarsithu Jayakumar petti alithirundhadhu idhan moolam thelivaanadhu. 2022nd aandu O. Panneerselvam-ai vimarsithu Jayakumar alitha pettiyai edit seidhu, BJP-yudan kootani amaitha Edappadi Palaniswami-yai vimarsithadhaaga thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adipadayil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu edit seyyappattadhu, thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Sirumi mudhal moodhaatti varai.. Ukraine poril 1,004 paaliyal vanmuraigal.. Russia meedhu UN kuttrachaattu!
text:
NATO naadugalil inaiyakkoodaadhu enbadharkaaga Ukraine meedhu Russia por thoduthu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, Ukraine poril merkkollappatta paaliyal vanmuraigal thodarbana arikkai veliyaagi ulladhu. Idhil, 89% paaliyal vanmuraiyai Russia arangerriyadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
NATO naadugalil inaiyakkoodaadhu enbadharkaaga Ukraine meedhu Russia, kadandha 2022nd aandu February 24th por thoduthadhu. Adhu 4 aandugalai kadandhum indruvarai nadaipetru varugiradhu. Russiavin muzhu alavilaana padaiyeduppirku edhiraaga Ukraine-um badhil thaakkudhal nadathi varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, Ukraine poril merkkollappatta paaliyal vanmuraigal thodarbana Aikkiya Naadugal Manidha Urimaigal Aluvalagathin (OHCHR) adhirthi arikkai veliyaagiyulladhu.
February 2022 mudhal July 2026 varai padhivaana 1,004 urudhiseyyappatta sambavangalai adipadayaagak kondu thayaarikkappatta indha arikkaiyil, 89% paaliyal vanmuraiyai Russia arangerriyadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Por kaidhigal matrum pidithu vaikkappatta nabargalai mirattavum, vaakkumoolam peravum paaliyal vanmuraiyai oru thittamitta aayudhamaaga Russia padaigal payanpaduthiyullana ena adhil therivikkappattulladhu. Sirai mugaamgalil adaikkappattulla porkaidhigalaana aangaley ithagaiya paaliyal sithiravadhaigalukkum, pirappuruppugalil minsara adhirchi alikkum kodurangalukkum adhigalavil aalaagiyullanar. Russia aakkramippu pagudhigalil 4 vayadhu sirumi mudhal 82 vayadhu moodhaatti varai koottup paaliyal vanmuraikku aalaakkappattulladhu aavanappaduthappattulladhu.
Koottup paaliyal vanmurai, pazhaiya Soviet kaala 'tapik' tholaipesi karuvigal moolam uruppugalil minsaram paaichudhal matrum udaliyal sidhaivu pondra seyalgalum idhil adangum. UN veliyittulla indha arikkai, ulagil adhirthiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Russia thanadhu aakkramippu pagudhigalukku UN paarvaiyaalargalai anumadhikkaadhadhaal, unmaiyaana baadhippugalin ennikkai idhaividap pala madangu adhigaamaaga irukkakkoodum ena UN manidha urimaigal aanaiyam therivithulladhu. Adhenerathil, Ukrainiya padaigalaal Russian porkaidhigal paaliyal vankodumaikku ullaakkappatta endha sambavangalaiyum thaangal aavanappaduthavillai endru UN manidha urimaigal uyar aanaiyam therivithulladhu.

headline: AI manidhakulathirku aabathu.. Anthropic-il irundhu vilagiya nibunar bageer!
text:
Seithiyaalar - M. Meera
Ulagin munnani seyarkai nunnarivu niruvanangalil ondraana Anthropic niruvanathil moondru aandugal paniyaatriya 27 vayadhu AI aaraaichiyaalar Jacob Coxon, thanadhu padhaviyil irundhu vilagiyiruppadhu thozhilnutpa ulagil parabarappai erpaduthiyulladhu. Avar thanadhu padhavi vilagal kurithu samooga valaithalamaana X-il padhivitta Coxon, OpenAI matrum Anthropic aagiya iru niruvanangalum AI valarchiyil poruppudan seyalpadavillai endru kadumaiyaaga vimarsithullaar.
Thaan, OpenAI matrum Anthropic aagiya iru niruvanangalilum AI modelgalin pretraining thodarbana aaraaichiyil paniyaatriyadhagak kooriyirukkum avar, indha niruvanangal thannaithaney membaduthikkollum 'Superintelligence' nokki vegamaaga nagarndhu varuvadhaagavum, idhanmoolam manidha uyirgalaiye aabathil thalluvadhaagavum therivithullaar.
AI thuraiyil paniyaatrum palar, indha thozhilnutpam indha 10 aandukkul manidhakulathaiye azhikkum saathiyam iruppadhaaga unmaiyaaga nambuvadhaaga Coxon therivithullaar. Veru endha manidha seyarpadum indha alavilaana aabathai erpaduthavillai" endrum Coxon echarithullaar.
Melum, AI thozhilnutpathin thiranai orupodhum kuraithu madhippidakkoodaadhu endrum edhirkaalathil uruvaagakkoodiya super intelligent AI amaippugal cyber thaakkudhalgalai merkkollavum, palveru thuraigalil migap periya maatrangalai migak kurugiya kaalathil erpaduthavum, nija ulagil adhigaaram matrum valangalai peravum mudiyum endrum avar echarithullaar.
OpenAI-yil AI-yin aabathu kuritha puridhal podhumaana alavukku illai endru avar kooriyullaar. Adhevelai, Anthropic niruvanathil indha aabathugal nangu purindhukollappattirundhaalum, "Pottiyil matravargal munnerividakkoodaadhu endra acham, AI-yin aabathu kuritha achathai vida valuvaaga ulladhu" ena avar therivithullaar.
Thaniyaar niruvanangalin ulkattamaippukkul idhupondra migap periya mudivugalai eduppadhu aabathaanadhu endrum, Super Intelligence-ai nokkiya pottiyai etrkkum mun miga uyarndha alavilaana nambikkaiyum paadhukaappu urudhiyum thevai endrum Coxon valiyuruthiyullaar.
AI aaivagangallil paniyaatrum aaraaichiyaalargal, adutha sila aandugalil enna nadakkappogiradhu enbadhai theeviramaaga sindhikka vendum endrum avar kettukkondullaar.
Super intelligent AI uruvaakkum muyarchigalai thodanguvadharku munbu, adhan seyalpaadugal matrum manam kurithu podhumaana puridhal irukkiradha enbadhai kelvi ezhuppa vendum endrum therivithullaar.
Melum, ulagalaaviya AI pottiyai thadukka modelgalin thiranai membaduthuvadharku tharkaālika thadai pondra kadumaiyana nadavadikkaigal thevaippadalaam endrum avar kooriyullaar. Jacob Coxon-in karuthugalukku badhilalitha Anthropic niruvanathin Alignment Science Lead Evan Hubinger, AI manidhakulam muzhuvadhaiyum azhikkum saathiyam iruppadhaaga Anthropic unmaiyaagave nambuvadhaagath therivithullaar. Melum, thanippatta muraiyil, adutha patthu aandugalil idharkaana aabathu 10 percent-ukkum adhigaamaaga irukkalaam endrum avar kooriyullaar.
Tharppodhaiya AI modelgalaal erpadum aabathu kuraivaaga iruppadhaagak kooriya avar, thannaithaney membaduthikkollum Super intelligence uruvaagum saathiyame thannai adhigam kavalaipaduthugiradhu endru therivithullaar.

headline: Congress MP-kkaludan Thuglak Gurumurthy sandhippu endru paravum pugaipadam unmaiya?
text:
Thuglak aasiriyar auditor Gurumurthy-yai Congress MP-kkal K.C. Venugopal, Manickam Tagore ullittor sandhithup pesiyadhu polavum, Manickam Tagore-ai iyakkuvadhey Gurumurthy dhaan endrum oru pugaipadam

Congress MP-kkal K.C. Venugopal, Manickam Tagore aagiyor oruvarudan pesik kondirukkum pugaipadathai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Andha nabar yaar endru sariyaagath theriyavillai. Nilai thagavalil, "Ezhuthu iyakkam Gurumurthy* *RSS thalaimaiyidam* *Hello Manickam Tagore* *Manickam Tagore* *Sollunga esamaan* *Kavanamaa kettukko* *1, Congress DMK kootaniyai, udaikkanum,* *2, adharku, aatchiyil pangu, adhigaarathil pangu kekkanum,* *3, MLA thogudhi 40% kettu vaanganum,* *4, MLA 80 thogudhikkuk kuraiyaamal vaangi vittu,* *5, Congress vetpaalargalukku, ovvoru vetpaalarukkum, thalaa Rs 200 crore alli koduppom,* *Rs 200 ai eppo sambaadhikka poraanga,* *6, Congress vetpaalargal thorka vendum,* *adhu dhaan 80 perukkum, ovvoruvarukkum, thanit thaniyaaga Rs 200 crore koduthaache! Piragu enna?* *7, andha 80 MLA-kalum, BJP - AIADMK endru aagi vidum.* *8, innum 40 MLA-galai, viratti, viratti, miratti, miratti, ore group-aaga, thaavi thaavi, BJP pakkam vandhu viduvaargal eppadi thittam,* *9, sariga esamaan (endraan Manickam Tagore). *10, RSS thalaimaiyidam,* *Manickam Tagore appuram nee dhaan, 'Maanbumigu Thunai Muthalamaichar'" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhaavadhu, Manickam Tagore-ai iyakkuvadhey RSS-il thodarbudaia Gurumurthy dhaan enbadhu polavum adharkaana sandhippu nadandhadhu polavum padhividappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaipadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kootani aatchi illai endru DMK thelivaagak kooriya pinbum, aatchiyil pangu endru koori DMK kootaniyil kuzhappathai nilavach seidhu varubavar Congress katchiyin MP Manickam Tagore. Avar BJP thoondudhalin peyaril ippadi seidhu varuvadhaaga inaiyathil DMK aadharavaalargal kuttranchaatti vandhanar. Adharku aadhaaram kidaithadhu pola, auditor Gurumurthy-yai Manickam sandhithup pesinaar endru artham varum vagaiyil samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Padathil paarkkum moondraavadhu nabarin mugam sariyaagath theriyavillai. Saayalil satru Gurumurthy pola irundhaalum, adhu avar illai enbadhu thelivaagath therigiradhu. Ivar Gurumurthiya illaiya enbadhai urudhi seyya aaivu seidhom. Indha pugaipadathai Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu indha pugaipadathai padhivittavarey Manickam Tagore dhaan endru theriyavandhadhu. Naadaalumanrathil Americavudanana varthaga oppandhathirku edhirppu therivithu Congress podhuch seyalalar Priyanka Gandhi thalaimaiyil poraattam nadandhapodhu endru kurippittu indha pugaipadathai padhivittirundhaar. Aanaal, padathil ullavar yaar endru kurippidavillai.
Poraattam thodarbaga video kidaikkiradha endru thedip paarthom. Congress katchiyin samooga oodaga pakkathil indha poraattathin video veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaipadathil pink nira Nehru coat anindhirundha nabarum poraattathil eedupattirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Avar yaar endru thedinom.
Congress katchiyin adhigaarappoorva inaiyathalathil akkatchiyin MP-kkalin pugaipadangaludan pattiyal veliyittullanar. Adhil thediyapodhu, adhu Kerala maanilam Kasaragod naadaalumanrath thogudhiyin urupinar Congress katchiyai serndha Rajmohan Unnithan enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Thodarnthu thediya podhu naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru X thalathil veliyaana padhivukku Gurumurthye maruppu therivithup padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil avar, "En thalaiyil ippodhu kittathatta 80% mudi illaamal ulladhu. Aanaal (ennudaiyadhaagak kaattappattulla pugaipadathil irukkum) Unnithan pola enakkum orukaalathil ivvalavu mudi irundhadhu. Ivargal yaarum arasiyalil varuvadharku 20 aandugal munbey enakku ithanai mudi irundhadhu. Indha muttaal, ennudaiya poli pugaipadathai kaattumpodhu kooda konjam nalla pugaipadathai kooda thervu seyyavillai" endru kurippittirundhaar.
Idhan moolam pugaipadathil iruppadhu thaan illai Congress MP Rajmohan Unnithan endru kurippittullaar. Indha aadhaarangal moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thirumalaiyil Malayappa Swamikku venpattu kudaigal samarppippu Hindu Dharmartha Samithi saarbil RR.Gopaljee vazhanginaar
text:
Thirumalai: Thirumalai Tirupati Ezhumalayaan kovil Brahmotsavathin mukkiya nigazhvaana Garuda Vaahana sevaiyaiyotti, Tamizhaga bakthargal saarbil 11 azhagiya venpattuth thirukkudaigalai, Hindu Dharmartha Samithi arakattalai arangaavalar RR.Gopaljee, Devasthanathil netru samarppithaar.
Thirumalaiyil aanduthorum nadaiperum Brahmotsavathil, Tamizhagathil irundhu irandu mukkiya mangala porutkal kaanikkaiyaaga vazhangappadugindrana.
Avatril ondru, Srivilliputhur Aandaal kovil maalai; matrondru, Chennaiyil irundhu bakthargalin praarthanaigaludan oorvalamaaga eduthuch sellappadum venpattuth thirukkudaigal.
Andha vagaiyil, Hindu Dharmartha Samithi Trust saarbil, 22nd aandu thirukkudai oorvalam, Chennai Pookkadai pagudhi Chennakesava Perumaal kovilil kadandha 13th date thodangiyadhu.
Karnataka maanilam Thirthahalli Sri Bheemanna Katte madathin peedaadhibathi Sri Raghuvarendra Thirtha Swamigal kodiyasaithu, oorvalathai thodangi vaithaar.
Andru maalai kavanaiyai kadandhu sendra thirukkudaigalukku, Chennai, Thiruvallur maavattangalil latchakkanakkaana bakthargal thirandu, aarathi eduthu vazhipattanar.
Aindhu naal payanathukku pin, netru mundhinam maalai, Tirupatiyai oorvalam sendradaindhadhu. Angu, Thiruchanoor Padmavathi Thaayaar kovilil irandu thirukkudaigal samarppikkappattana.
Thirumalaiyil veedhi ulaa thodarnthu, onbadhu thirukkudaigal netru kaalai Thirumalaikku kondu sellappattana. Avai, maada veedhigalil oorvalamaaga eduthuch sellappattana.
Pin, Hindu Dharmartha Samithi Trust arangaavalar RR.Gopaljee, onbadhu venpattuth thirukkudaigalaiyum devasthana adhigaarigalidam samarppithaar. Malayappa Swamikku pattu vasthirangalum vazhangappattana.
Idhaiyaduthu, nirubargalidam RR.Gopaljee kooriyadhavadhu:
Kadandha 13-il thodangi, palveru pagudhigalai kadandhu vandha thirukkudai oorvalathil, 15 latchathukkum adhigaamaana bakthargal, thangal praarthanaigalai, thirukkudaigal meedhu seluthinar.
Kadandha 17-il, irandu kudaigal Thiruchanoor Padmavathi Thaayaar sannidhiyilum, 18-il onbadhu kudaigal Thirumalaiyilum samarppikkappattana. Bakthargalin praarthanaigalai Malayappa Swami etrukkondu arulpuriyap praarthikkiren.
Ivvuaru avar koorinaar.

headline: ChatGPT-yaal sikkiya maanavar.. IIT-il adhirthi.. Adutha sila maninerathil nadandhadhu enna?
text:
Seithiyaalar - M. Meera
Energy Science and Engineering (Department of Energy Science and Engineering) thuraiyil irandaam aandu padithuvandha Sahil Waghmare endra maanavar, thervinpodhu cell phone-ai payanpaduthiyadhaagavum, thervu vinaathaalai ChatGPT-il padhivettrit adharkaana badhilgalai pera muyandradhaagavum IIT Bombay nirvagam therivithulladhu.
Indha vivagaaram kurithu maanavaridam thervuk kanganippaalar matrum thuraith thalaivar pesiyadhaagavum, avarukku aalosanai vazhangiyadhudan, indha sambavam avaradhu kalvi vaazhkkaiyai baadhikkaadhu ena urudhiyalithadhaagavum nirvagam kooriyulladhu. Melum, maanavar meedhu endha ozhungu nadavadikkaiyum edukkappadavillai endrum therivikkappattulladhu.
Indhach sandhippukku piragu maanavar thanadhu vidhudhi araikku thirumbiyullaar. Pinnar netru maalai avaradhu araiyil avar uyirizhandha nilaiyil kandudukkapattadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Sambavam thodarbaga adhigaarigal visaaranai nadathi varugindranar. Indhach sambavam IIT Bombay valaagathil kurugiya kaalathil padhivaana moondraavadhu maanavar tharkolai sambavam enak koorappadugiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu maanavargal valaagathil poraattathil eedupattu varugiraargal. Maanavargal silar, avar meedhu oru aandu idaineekkam ullitta kadumaiyana nadavadikkai edukkappadalaam ena achuruthiyadhaaga kuttranchaattiyanar. Idaineekkam seyyappattaal vidhudhiyai gaali seyyavendiya nilaiyum, adhan kaaranamaaga padippu kaalam neelum vaaippum irundhadhaaga avargal therivithanar. Eninum, indhak kuttrachaattugal urudhi seyyappadavillai.
Idharkidaiye, maanavargalin poraattathai thodarnthu sambavam thodarbana visaaranai nadaipetru varuvadhaagavum, maanavargalin korikkaigal kurithu nirvagathudan pechuvaarthai nadathappattu varuvadhaagavum kaavalthurai therivithulladhu.

headline: "Thalaimai therthal aanaiyari padhavi neekkam seiga" - DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin
text:
Indian Express veliyitta thagavalinpadi, thalaimath therthal aanaiyar Gyanesh Kumar matra aanaiyargalukku thagaval tharaamal ragasiyamaaga seyalpattadhaaga kuttrachaattu ezhundhulladhu. SIR nadavadikkaiyaal vaakkalar pattiyalil perum kuzhappangal erpattadhaagavum, needhimandra uttharavugalum purakkanikkappattadhaagavum koori, DMK ullitta edhirkatchigal avarai neekki, SIR nadavadikkaigalai nirutha vendum ena korugindrana.
SIR vivagaarathil thalaimai therthal aanaiyar Gyanesh Kumar thannitchaiyaaga seyalpattaar endrum, matra therthal aanaiyargal palabmurai aatshebani therivithapodhum pala visayangalai thaninabar mudivaaga seidhaar endrum thagavalgal veliyaagiyiruppadhu adhirthiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Idharku thesiya katchigal, maanila katchigal ena edhirppu therivithuvarum nilaiyil, DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin thalaimai therthal aanaiyar Gyanesh Kumarai padhaviyilirundhu neekkavendum ena valiyuruthiyullaar.
Idhukurithu X thalathil padhivittirukkum avar, "Thani aavarthanam seidha thalaimath therthal aanaiyar Gyanesh Kumar iniyum padhaviyil needikka koodaadhu: udanadiyaaga avar neekkappada vendum!
Sirapputh theevira thirutham (SIR) endra peyaril vaakkalar pattiyalil irundhu kodikkanakkaana makkalin peyargalai neekkum mudivukku Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam ullitta edhirkatchigal thodarnthu edhirppu therivithu vandom. Ovvoru maanilathilum therthalukku sila maadhangalukku munbu avasara gadhiyil nadathappatta indhap paniyil pala kuzhappangal nadandhana. West Bengal ullitta maanilangal porkkalam aayina.
Innilaiyil, indru Indian Express naaledil adukkadukkaana aadhaarangaludan veliyaagiyulla seidhi, SIR-kku pinbu nadandha anaithuch sattamandrat therthal mudivugalaiyum kelvikkullaakki ulladhu. Thalaimath therthal aanaiyar Thiru Gyanesh Kumar avargal matra therthal aanaiyargal iruvarin oppudhal illaamal thannanthaniyaaga, iragasiyamaaga seyalpattu vandhulladhu ambalam aagiyulladhu. Moondru therthal aanaiyargalil Thiru Sukhbir Singh Sandhu matrum Thiru Vivek Joshi aagiya iruvarukkum, therthal commission-il enna nadakkiradhu enbadhey theriyaamal maraithu vaikkappatta seidhi naadu muzhuvadhum adhirvalaikalai erpaduthi irukkiradhu. Thangalukku theriyaamal mudivugal edukkappaduvadhu kurithu, 10 maadhathil 14 murai avargal aatshebani therivithum avargal purakkanikkappattulladhu therthal aanaiyam meedhaana nambagathanmaiyaiye muttrilumaagach seerkulaithulladhu.
Therthal aanaiyargal moovarum orumitha karuthin adipadayil mudivugalai merkkolla vendum. Adhu saathiyamaagaadha nilaiyil, perumbaanmaiyin adipadayil mudivugal amaiya vendum enbadhudhaan therthal aanaiya vidhi. Aanaal, moovaril iruvarukku thaangal poruppu vagikkum amaippil enna nadakkiradhenbadhey theriyaamal irundhirukkiradhendraal, idhanai saadhaaranamaaga eduthukkollamudiyadhu. Indhiya jananaayagathin meedhu thodukkappatta miga mosamaana thaakkudhal idhu. Sudhandhiramaagavum - velippadaithanmayodum - arasiyal kurukkeedugal illaamalum seyalpada vendiya ucha amaippin meedhu migap perum kalangam padindhulladhu.
"Needhimanrame thalaiyittu vaakkalar pattiyalil serkkach sonna piragum, avargaladhu peyargalai serppadharku edhiraaga melmuraiyeedugal seyyappattullana. Yaar idhanai seidhadhu? Adhukurithu kooda engalukku theriyavillai.
Sattappadi vaakkalar pattiyalil thiruthangalai saribaarthu merkkolla ERO enappadum vaakkalar padhivu aluvalargalukku adhigaaram undu. Aanaal, thagudhiyulla vaakkalargalaaga angeegarikappattavargalin peyargalai vaakkalar pattiyalil avargalaal serkka mudiyavillai.
Adhaich seivadharkaana ERONet valaithalam muttrilumaaga oruvarin kattuppaattil irundhadhu." ena irandu therthal aanaiyargalum therivithullaargal endraal, therthal aanaiyathil endha alavukku arasiyal kurukkeedugal irundhirukkum enbadhu thellat thelivaagiradhu.
Erkkanave, kadandha March maadhadhil thalaimath therthal aanaiyar Gyanesh Kumar avargalai padhavi neekkam seyya Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam ullitta edhirkatchigal notice koduthom. Iniyum avar andhap padhaviyil needikka koodaadhu. Gyanesh Kumar avargalai udanadiyaagap padhavineekkam seyya vendum. SIR nadavadikkaigal niruthappada vendum. Idhuvarai therthal aanaiyathil nadandha anaithum nyaayamaana muraiyil visaarikkappattu idharkup poruppaanavargal thandikkappada vendum enath DMK saarbil valiyuruthugirom.

headline: Manidhargal kattuppaattil AI irukka vendum; Americavil China adhibar pechu
text:
Washington: 'America matrum China idaiyeyana natpu pinni pinaindha ondru. Ulaga vivagaarangalil naam inaindhu seyalpaduvadharku eraalamaana vaaippugal ullana. Iru tharappum nermaiyudan othuzhaippom,' ena, China adhibar Xi Jinping koorinaar.
Moondru naal payanamaaga, nam andai naadaana Chinavin adhibar Xi Jinping, Americavukku sendrullaar. Washington-il avarai America adhibar Donald Trump neril sendru varavetraar.
Idhaith thodarnthu Vellai Maaligaiyil, iru thalaivargalum sandhithu pesinar. Indha sandhippu kurithu China adhibar Xi Jinping kooriyulladhavadhu:
China matrum Americavin ennangal, nokkangal, ondrukkondru pinnip pinaindhavai. Naam inaindhu seyalpaduvadharkaana vaaippugal eraalamaaga ullana. Naam nermaiyudan othuzhaithu inaindhu seyalpaduvom.
Tharppodhu ulagengum pala pirachinaigal, sarchaigal ullana. Nam irandu naadugalum inaindhu seyalpaduvadhaal mattum, indha anaithu pirachinaigalukkum theervu kaana mudiyaadhu. Adhe nerathil, nam othuzhaippu illaamal indhap pirachinaigalukku theervu kaana mudiyaadhu.
AI thozhilnutpam:
AI enappadum seyarkai nunnarivu thozhilnutpathil, nam iru naadugalum munnaniyil ullana. Adhanaal, indhath thuraiyil naam inaindhu seyalpaduvadhu migavum mukkiyamaagum.
Indhath thozhilnutpathai, makkalukku palan alikkak koodiyadhaaga, payanpadutha ugandhadhaaga uruvaakka vendiya poruppum, thiranum nam naadugalukku ulladhu. Manidhargalin kattuppaattil thaan AI thozhilnutpam iruppadhaiyum, adhu makkalin nalanukkaannadhaaga iruppadhaiyum naam urudhi seivom.
Ivvuaru avar pesinaar.

headline: IndiGo vimaani thideerena leave; Mumbai sellum vimaanam 3 mani neram thaamadham
text:
Mumbai: Varanasielirundhu Mumbai nokkich sellavirundha IndiGo vimaanathai iyakkavirundha vimaani thideerena udalnilai sariyillai ena vidumurai eduthadhaal, andha vimaanam 3 mani neram thaamadham aanadhu.
Varanasiel ulla Lal Bahadur Shastri sarvadesa vimaana nilaiyathilirundhu Mumbaikku IndiGo vimaanathai iyakka thittamidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal vimaanam sariyaana nerathil purappadaamal thaamadham aanadhu. Vimaana nilaiyathil payanigal vaakkuvaadhathil eedupattanar. Andha vimaanathai iyakka niyamikkappatta vimaani thideerena udalnilai sariyillai endru vidumurai eduthadhaal indha thaamadham erpattadhu ena vimaana niruvanam therivithulladhu.
Varanasi vimaana nilaiyam IndiGo niruvanathin mukkiya thalamaaga illaadhadhaal, Ahmedabad-il irundhu maatru vimaani varavazhaikkappattaar. Idharkaana koodudhal neram thevaippattadhey indhath thaamadhathirkuk kaaranamaagum; indha vimaanam, maatru erpaadugal seyyappattup pudhiya vimaani vandhavudan pathiramaaga Mumbai nokkip purappattuch sendradhu.
Maatru erpaadugal seyya vendiyirundhadhaal, siridhu thaamadham erpattadhu. Vimaanath thaamadhathin podhu kaathirundha payanigalukku sittrundigal vazhangappattadhu, payanigalin siramathirku varundhugurom ena IndiGo niruvanam tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: Ethiopia erimalai vedippu endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Ethiopiavil Hayli Gubbi endra erimalai vedithadhu endru kurippittu video ondru

Vaan uyarathukku karumpugai ezhum video kaatchi Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, "'Irulil soozhum India' '10,000 aandugalukku pin Ethiopiavil veditha Hayli Gubbi erimalai Indiyavai nokki 100-120 km vegathil erimalaiyin saambal vandhukondirukkiradhu. Iravu 10 manikkul Indiyavai adaiyum erimalai saambalaal vaanam vazhakkathai vida irundu kaanappadum. Indhiya vaanilai aaivu maiyam'" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
10 aayiram aandugalukku piragu Ethiopiavil ulla Hayli Gubbi endra erimalai November 23rd date vedithadhu. Indha erimalaiyilirundhu ezhum thoosu, pugai vada Indiyavin pala pagudhigalukku paravalaam endru seidhi veliyaanadhu. Indha nilaiyil vedithuch sidhariya Hayli Gubbi erimalai endru kurippittu kaanoliyai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindrana. Idhu Ethiopiavil ulla erimalai vedippu videova endru aaivu seidhom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu Indonesiavil erpatta erimalai vedippu endru kurippittu palarum indha videovai samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovin muzhumaiyana kaatchigalai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Adhil andha pagudhi makkalaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Avargal thenkizhakku Aasiya pagudhi makkalai pola irundhanar. Idhanaal, indha video Indonesiavai saarndhadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu.
Melum, November 19th thedhiye indha video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhaavadhu, Ethiopia erimalai vedippukku naangu naatkalukku munbu indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhu. Thodarnthu thediyapodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovudan veliyaana seidhigalum namakkuk kidaithana.
Avatril Indonesiavin kizhakku Java theevugalil ulla Semeru erimalai November 19, 2025 andru vedithadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video Ethiopia erimalai vedippu video illai enbadhai urudhi seidhana.

headline: Indiyavil adhigarikkum mudhiyor makkalthogai... Arasin mega thittangal!
text:
Indiyavil mudhiyor makkalthogai 20 aandugalil irumadangaagum nilaiyil, adhaich samaalikka madhiya arasu palveru thittangalai theevirappaduthiyulladhu. Ayushman Bharat moolam 70 vayadhukku merpattorukku aandukku 5 lakh rupees varai ilavasa maruthuvak kaappeedu vazhangappadugiradhu. 800 kaappagangal, pagal nera paraamarippu maiyangal, 'Jeevan' app, 'Sadayu' dashboard pondra muyarchigal moolam paraamarippu sevaigal orunginaikkappadugindrana.
Indiyavil mudhiyorin makkalthogai miga vegamaaga irattippaagivarum nilaiyil, adhanai samaalikkavum, pudhiya porulaadhaara vaaippaaga maatravum madhiya arasu theevira nadavadikkaigalai merkkonduvarugiradhu. Tharppodhu naattil 16 mudhal 17 crore mudhiyor ulladhaagavum, adutha 20 aandugalil indha ennikkai irumadangaaga uyarum endrum samooga needhi amaichagach seyalalar Sudhansh Pant therivithullaar.
Ayushman Bharat thittathin keezh 70 vayadhu matrum adharku merpatta mudhiyorukku aandukku 5 lakh rupees varai ilavasa maruthuvak kaappeedu vazhangappadugiradhu. Naadu muzhuvadhum 800 kaappagangal iyangivarum nilaiyil, 'pagal nera paraamarippu maiyangalai' uruvaakka arasu thittamittulladhu. Arasin sevaigalai ore idathil pera 'Jeevan' app-um, paraamarippaalargalai elidhil kandariya 'Sadayu' dashboard-um thodangappattullanar.
Sameebathiya aaivarikkaiyinbadi, mudhiyorukkaana veedugal matrum paraamarippuch sandhai 2030-kkul sumaar 96 aayiram crore rupees alavukku biramaanda valarchiyadaiyum ena edhirpaarkkappadugiradhu. Naattil uyarndhuvarum aayutkaalathukku etrpa, tharamaana mudhiyor paraamarippu ulkattamaippugalai udanadiyaaga membadutha vendiyadhu kaalathin kattaayamaaga maariyulladhu.

headline: Houthikku kuri.. Saudiyudan inaindha Pakistan.. Bayathil Iran!
text:
Por nirutham thodarbaga pechuvaarthaiyil eedupattu varum Pakistane, tharppodhu Irankku edhiraagat thirumbiyiruppadhu Middle East-il melum padhatrathai uruvaakki ulladhu. Saudi Arabia meedhu Yemen naattin Houthi kilarchiyaalargal nadathiya missile matrum drone thaakkudhalgalai thodarnthu, Pakistan Houthi amaippirkup palatha echarikkai viduthulladhu.
Middle East-il nadaipetru varum porukku naduvil, Yemen-in Iran aadharavu petra Houthi amaippinar Saudi Arabianin Abha sarvadesa vimaana nilaiyam, King Khalid vaanpadaith thalam matrum Aramco ennai niruvanathin aalaigal meedhu thaakkudhal nadathinar. Ithaakkudhalil ennai suthigarippu aalaigalil thee vibathu erpattadhodu, 73-kkum merpatta podhumakkal kaayamadaindhanar. Melum, Red Sea vazhiyaaga Saudi thuraimugangalukku sellum varthaga kappalgal meedhu thadaigalai vidhippadhaaga Houthigal achurutthinar. Idharku badhiladiyaga Yemen naattil ulla Houthi amaippugal meedhu Saudi Arabia vaanvazhi thaakkudhalai nadathiyadhu. Idharku Houthiyum badhiladi koduthadhu. Saudiyin mukkiya nagarangal meedhu Houthi amaippugal missilegalai eviyadhu.
Indha nilaiyildhaan, Yemen-il nilavum thaakkudhal sambavam Saudi Arabianin ellaikkul paravinaal, Mecca paadhukaappu kootaniyin saarbil Pakistan thaakkudhal nadathum ena Pakistan echarikkai viduthulladhu.
Idhkurithu Pakistan paadhukaappu amaichar Khawaja Asif, "Mecca paadhukaappu kootu oppandhathinpadi, uruppu naadugalil edhenum oru naattin meedhu nadathappadum thaakkudhal, moondru naadugal meedhum nadathappattadhaagave karudhappadum. Houthigal Saudi ellaikkul porai virivupadutha muyandraal, indha oppandhathin paadhukaappup pirivugal udanadiyaagach seyalpaattirku varum" ena echarithullaar. Melum, 'Saudi Arabiavudan varthagathil eedupadum kappalgal alladhu Pakistaniyak kodi porundhiya varthagak kappalgal meedhu Houthigal kaivaithaal, tharkkaappirkaagap padaigalai payanpadutha thayangamaattom' ena Pakistan veliyuravu amaichagam echarithulladhu.
Mecca oppandhathinpadi, Saudi Arabiakku neradip paadhukaappu vazhangumbatchathil, Pakistan thanadhu padaiyai Saudikku aadharavaagak kalam irakkakkoodum enbadhaal Middle East-il melum padhatram adhagarithulladhu. Idhanaal, Iranum achathil uraindhulladhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Kaaranam, Houthi amaippukku Irane aadharavu alithu varugiradhu enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Aavani Amavasai: Devikku varamilagai yaagam
text:
Salem: Aavani Amavasaiyai yotti, ulaga nanmai vendi, kan dhrishti vilaga vendi, Salem, Mannarpalayam pirivu saalaiyil ulla Adhiparasakthi Prathyangira Devi kovilil, vara milagai yaagam netru nadandhadhu.
Adhil eraalamaana bakthargal, kaigalaal milagaigalai yaagathil samarppithu, deviyai vazhipattanar. Tharamangalam, Pappambadi Santhaipettai Maha Maariamman kovilil vaasanai thiraviyangalaal abhishekam seidhanar. Thodarnthu amman idadhu kaiyil Vinayagarai vaithapadi, alangaaram seidhanar. Sirappu alangaarathil irundha ammanukku deepaaradhanai kaattappattadhu.
Sankari, V.N. Palayam Shakthi Maariamman kovilil Shakthi-Maariamman, Vinayagar swamigalukku palveru dhivya porutkalaal alangaaram seyyappattu poojai nadandhadhu. Mecheri Badhrakaliamman, simma vaahana alangaarathil arulbaalithaar.
Salem - Namakkal maavatta ellaiyil ulla Kaalipatti Kandhasamy kovilil, Valli, Deivayanai samedha Kandhasamykku paal, thayir, ilaneer, sandhanam, panchamirtham ullitta porutkalaal abhishekam seyyappattadhu. Moolavar Kandhasamykku raja alangaarathil maha deepaaradhanai kaattappattadhu.
Adhepola Valli, Deivayanai samedha urchavar Kandhasamykku pattu vasthirangalaal sirappu alangaaram seidhu poojai nadathappattadhu. Eraalamaana bakthargal, neenda varisaiyil kaathirundhu dharisanam seidhanar.
Thalaivasal, Aagaloor Vasishta nadhi karaiyil ulla Ambayiramman kovilil moolavarukku paal, panneer, sandhanam ullitta abhisheka poojai nadandhadhu. Pin velli kavasam, pushpa alangaarathil arulbaalithaar.
Adhepola Salem, Uthamasolapuram Karapuranathar, Siddharkovil Siddheswarar, Sukavaneswarar ullitta anaithu Sivalayangall, Attur, Kottai Sambodai Vana Madhurakaliamman, Kadaiveedhi Angalaparameswari, Vinayagapuram Samayapurathu Maariamman ullitta kovilgalil, Amavasai sirappu vazhipaadu nadandhadhu. Eraalamaana bakthargal vazhipattanar.
Rs.1.38 crore-kku kaaikari virpanai:
Amavasaiyai yotti, Salem maavattathil ulla, 13 Uzhavar Sandhaigalil kaaikari virpanai netru amogamaaga nadandhadhu.
Adhil adhiga patchamaaga Dadagapatti Uzhavar Sandhaiyil, 28.95 lakh rupees-kkum, kuraindhapatchamaaga Mecheri Uzhavar Sandhaiyil, 44,000 rupees-kkum virpanai nadandhadhu.
Motham, 296.36 ton kaaikari moolam, 1.38 crore rupees-kku virpanai nadandhadhaaga, velaan virpanait thuraiyinar therivithanar.

Atlee thayaarippil Vijay Sethupathi, Lijomol Jose ullittor nadithulla Baththa thiraipadam October 1st thedhi veliyaaga ulladhu. Idhaiyotti Chennaiyil nadaiperra arimuga vizhaavil padakkuzhuvinar kalandhukondanar. Sameebathil Vijay Sethupathi thoguthu vazhangiya nigazhchiyil avar kooriya karuthugal sarchaiyaana nilaiyil, adhukurithu avar vilakkam alippaar ena edhirpaarkkappattadhu. Aanaal vizhaa medaiyil andha vivagaaram kurithu Vijay Sethupathi edhavadhum pesavillai. Aanaal medaiyai gavannikka vaithadhu Atlee-yin pechudhaan. "Indru naan anindhirukkum indha pant, shirt ellaame en uzhaippaal kidaithadhu endru ninaithaalum, Vijay annan illaiyendraal idharkaana vaaippe kidaithirukkaadhu. Adharkaaga avarukku naan endrum nandrikkadan pattavan" endrum therivithaar.
Adhodu, "Oor vaayai adakka mudiyadhu. Aana oor vaayil vizhundhuttu, adhaiye nambi vaazhndhuttu poradhu muttaalthanam. Oor aayiram pesum. Adhanaal evan enna solraannu ketkaadha. Nee poga vendiya idathukku poykitte iru. Vaazhkkai nee poga vendiya idathukku unnai azhaithuch sellum. Yaar pechaiyum ketkaadha" endrum koorinaar.
Thodarnthu, "Indha social media-la avaru ivara solraaru, ivaru avara solraarunu adhellaam onnum illa. Sollanumnaa nera sollikkalaam. Adutha thalaimurai arasiyalil aarvamaaga irukka ore kaaranam Vijay annadhaan. Mundhaiya thalaimuraiyil sattasabhaiyai naan paarthadhillai. Aana innaikku sattasabhaiyil enna nadakkudhunu 5 vayasu kuzhandhai kooda paarkkudhu. Adharkuk kaaranam Vijay annadhaan. Avar urudhiyaana thalaimuraiyai uruvaakkikkondirukkiraar. Adhil endha maattruk karuthum kidaiyaadhu. Silar 'arasiyal namakkaandhu illai' endru kooruvaargal. Aanaal arasiyal namakkaandhudhaan" enap pesinaar. Idhu thodarbana video tharppodhu samooga valaithalangalil viral aagi varugiradhu.

headline: Nepal-il badagu kavizhndhadhaagap paravum video unmaiya?
text:

Aatril badagu kavizhundhu, adhil payanitha anaivarum aatril kudhithu neendhum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video meedhu "Nepal endrum, enna nadakkiradhu Nepal-il..? Sutrulaavukku sendra Tamizhargal nilai enna..?" endrum Tamizhil ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Nepal - Tibet ellaiyil panippaarai sarivu kaaranamaaga erpatta thideer vellapperukkil aayirakkanakkanor uyirizhandhullanar. Indha vella baadhippu thodarbaga pala adhirthiyoottum videokkal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindrana. Appadi Nepal-il badagu kavizhndhadhaaga oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu thodarbaga aaivu seidhom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu indha sambavam Bihar-il nadandhadhaaga PTI ullitta pala oodagangal veliyittirundha seithigal pala namakku kidaithana. NDTV veliyittirundha seithiyil, "Bihar maanilam Bhagalpur maavattam Raghopur-il Ganga aatril 21 thozhilaalargalai etrich sendra badagu August 26th date (2026nd aandu) kavizhndhadhu. Aatrin neerrottam thideerendru maariyadhaal badagu nilai thadumaari kavizhndhadhu.
Aatrangarai arippai thadukkum paniyil ivargal eedupattuk kondirundhanar. Badagil manal arippai thadukka manal moottaigalai adhiga alavil kondu sendradhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Andha pagudhiyil irandu naatkalukku munbu karaiyil udaippu erpattadhaal adhai sari seyyum paniyil thozhilaalargal eedupattirundhanar. Kavanak kuraivaaga seyalpatta oppandhadhaarar meedhu vazhakku padhivu seyyappadum endru adhigaarigal therivithullanar" endru andha seithiyil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Melum, "indha sambavathin podhu aattrukkul kudhitha 21 thozhilaalargalil 19 per meetkappattanar endrum, irandu perai thedi varuvadhaagavum" adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Tibet - Nepal ellaiyil pani malai sarindhu erpatta vellap perukku kaaranamaaga indha sambavam nadandhadhu endru endha seithiyilum kurippidappadavillai. Idhan moolam indha sambavam Nepal-il nadandhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Idhan adipadayil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
