headline: 10 vagai kan sottu marundhugalai thirumbap perum Sun Pharma! En theriyuma?
text:
Indiyavin munnani marundhu niruvanamaana Sun Pharma, maasupaadu sandhegathin kaaranamaaga Indiyavil virpanai seyyappatta 10 vagai kan sottu marundhugalai munnecharikkai nadavadikkaiyaaga thirumbap perugiradhu.
Seithiyaalar - M. Meera
Indiyavin munnani marundhu thayaarippu niruvanangalil ondraana Sun Pharma, Indiyavil virpanai seyyappattu varum 10 vagaiyaana kan sottu marundhugalin viniyogathai munnecharikkai nadavadikkaiyaaga niruthi, avatrait thirumbap peruvadhaaga arivithulladhu. Marundhugalil maasupaadu erpattirukkalaam endra sandhegathin adipadayil indha nadavadikkai merkkollappattulladhaagath therivikkappattulladhu.
Viniyogaastharargalukku anuppappatta thagavalil, thirumbap perappatta marundhugalin virpanaiyai udanadiyaaga niruthavum, kaiyiruppil ulla marundhugalai niruvanathidam thiruppi anuppavum arivuruthappattulladhu.
Thirumbap perappatta marundhugalil Difluprednate, Brinolar, Brinzotim, Lotepred, Nepa-Lact, Tobra-F ullitta kan sottu marundhugal idampetrullana. Ivai kan aruvai sigitchaikkup pindhaiya sigitchai, glaucoma, kan thottru, ovvaamai matrum kan azharchi pondra baadhippugalukku maruthuvargalaal parindhuraikkappadugindrana.
Idharkidaiye, indha marundhugalai payanpaduthi varum noyaaligal maruthuvar aalosaniindri sigitchaiyai thideerena niruthavo alladhu thodarnthu payanpaduthavo koodaadhu ena arivuruthappattulladhu. Udanadiyaaga kan maruthuvarai anugi, thevaiyaana maatru marundhu kurithu aalosanai pera vendum.
Noyaaligalin paadhukaappe mudhanmai enath therivithulla Sun Pharma, marundhugal meendum kidaikka thevaiyaana nadavadikkaigalai merkkondu varuvadhaaga kooriyulladhu.

headline: Edappadi Palaniswami-yin "Keeladi nilappaadu" endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Keeladi patri AIADMK-vin nilappaadu enna endru Edappadi Palaniswami-yidam kettapodhu "Idhellaam puraanam padithirukka vendum" endru kooriyadhaaga oru video

AIADMK podhuch seyalalar Edappadi Palaniswami alitha pettiyin siru pagudhiyai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, "Nirubar: Keeladiyai pathi AIADMK-voda nilappaadu enna Edappadi: Keeladiyai pathi niraiya padikkanumnga 'Table-ukku adiyila' 'Kaaladiyai' pathi kelunga badhil solren" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
2023nd aandil Ariyam, Dravidam thodarbaga Tamil Nadu aalunar R.N. Ravi pesiyadhu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Katchiyin peyarileye "Dravida" vaithulla Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam podhuch seyalalar Edappadi Palaniswami-yidam idhu thodarbaga kelvi ezhuppappattadhu. Adharku avar "Idhellaam puraanam padikkanum. Naan andha alavukku padichavan illai, indha maadhiriyaana kadhai ellaam padichi sollanumnaa periya aaivu seyya vendum. Indha aaivu seidhaaldhaan idhu unmaiya poiya enbadhu theriyum. Adhukku naan utpattavan illai" endru kooriyirundhaar.
Edappadi Palaniswami-yin indha pettiyai vaithu nirubargal Periyar patri, maanila suyaatchi patri kelvi ezhuppiya podhu endru vadhandhi paraviyirundhadhu. Tharppodhu meendum adhe pettiyai Edappadi Palaniswami-yin Keeladi nilappaadu endru kurippittu palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha videovai 2023nd aandu News 18 Tamil Nadu, Sun News ullitta oodagangal veliyittirundhana. News 18 Tamil Nadu veliyitta videovai paarthom. Adhil thodakkathileye (0.10 second alavil) nirubar, "Aalunarin pechu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Adhaavadhu Tamil Naduvil Ariyamum illai, Dravidamum illai, sudhandhira poraatta thiyagigalai ellaam saadhiya thalaivargalaaga adaiyaalappaduthugiraargal" endru kelviyaik ketkiraar.
Kelviyai mudippadharku munbaagave Edappadi Palaniswami badhil alithaar. Appodhu, "Idhellaam puraanam padikkanum. Naan andha alavukku padichavan illai, indha maadhiriyaana kadhai ellaam padichi sollanumnaa periya aaivu seyya vendum. Indha aaivu seidhaaldhaan idhu unmaiya poiya enbadhu theriyum. Adhukku naan utpattavan illai" engiraar.
Udane nirubar appadi endraal aalunar aaivu seyyavillai engireergalaa endru badhil kelvi ketkiraar. Adharku Edappadi Palaniswami, "Aamaam, adhukku enna panradhu, avarkittadhaan ketkanum. Avarkitta ketka vendiya kelviyai ennidam kettaal enakkenna theriyum? Idhu unmaiya poiya enbadharku idhai aaivu seidhaaldhaan theriyum" engiraar.
Ariyam, Dravidam patri 2023nd aandu nirubar ketta kelvikku Edappadi Palaniswami alitha badhilai, Keeladi aayvukku avar alitha badhilaagath thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adipadayil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

Madhuranthakam thogudhiyin idaittherthalukkaaga TVK-vin mukkiyasthargal andha thogudhiyil mugaamittirukkindranar. Thogudhiyil nadandha paaga mugavargal koottathil pesiya Aadhav Arjuna, Edappadi Palaniswami-yai kadumaiyaaga vimarsithup pesiyirukkiraar.

headline: 27 aayiram adikku sarindha vimaanam.. Marana bayam kaattiya pilot.. Alari koochalitta payanigal!
text:
Seithiyaalar - Karthikeyan
Vimaana vibathugalil sikkinaal aabathu enbadhu migamiga adhigam. Idhanaaldhaan paadhukaappuk kaaranangalai valuppaduthuvadharkaaga vimaana niruvanangal, ticket kattanangalai adhigaamaaga vaithirukkiraargal. Aanaal, appadi irukkumpodhu sila samayangallil perum vibathugal erpattu, podhumakkal kadum baadhippukku aalaagividugiraargal. Sameebathilkooda, Air India-vin vimaanathil erpatta vibathu, naadu muzhuvadhum perum achathai makkal mathiyil erpaduthiyirundhadhu.
Ippadiyaana soozhnilaiyil, matruru vimaana vibathu ondru nadandhu, payanigal palaraiyum nadukkathil aazhthiyirukkiradhu. Adhaavadhu, Delta Airlines niruvanathin Boeing 737-900 ER raga vimaanam, Americavin Los Angeles sarvadesa vimaana nilaiyathil irundhu, Salt Lake City-kku sendru kondirundhadhu.
Vimaanam thanadhu serumidathai adaivadharku satru munbu, vimaanathil irundha kaattrzhuthak kattuppaattu amaippu thideerena pazhudhadaindhuvittadhu. Idhanaal, payanigal moochuvida siramappattadhaagavum, kaadhugalil migak kadumaiyaana vali erpattadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Marana bayathai adaindha payanigal alarith thudithullanar. Pinnar, suvaasak kolarugalai sari seivadharkaaga, vimaanathil thaanangi muraiyil oxygen mugamoodigal vandhullana. Andha mugamoodiyai anindhukonda piragum, vimaana paniyaalargalin arivippugalai thangaladhu kaadhugalaal ketka mudiyavillai endrum koorappadugiradhu.
Irudhiyil, podhumakkal elidhil suvaasikka edhuvaaga, 36 aayiram adi uyarathil parandhukondirundha vimaanam, 27 aayiram adi sarindhu, 10 aayiram adi uyarathil parakka thodangiyadhu. Avasara nilai erpattapodhu Las Vegas nagarukku arugil parandhukondirundha vimaanam, angirundha sarvadesa vimaana nilaiyathil tharanyirakkappattadhu.
Vimaanathil irundha software kolaru sariseyyappatta piragu, adhe vimaanam pinnar Salt Lake City-kku paadhukaappaagap purappattuch sendradhu. Indhach sambavathil adhishtavasamaaga yaarukkum endhap perungaayamum alladhu uyirizhappum erpadavillai endru vimaana niruvanamum adhigaarappoorvamaagath therivithulladhu.

Idhanaal America, Canada pondra naadugalil, mana azhutham, vaazhkkaimurai noigaalal baadhippadaindhavargalukku marundhudan serthu, Nature Prescription-um parindhuraikkappadugiradhu. Aanaal idhu marundhukku maatru alla, thunai maruthuva anugumurai aagum... headline: Vivasaayigal poraattam unavu thara anumadhi maruppu
text:
Trichy: Payirkkadanai muzhumaiyaaga radhu seyyak kori, Trichy aruge poraattam nadathi varum vivasaayigalukku, veli nabargal unavu thara anumadhi marukkappattadhu.
Tamizhagathil, vivasaayigalin payirkkadan-galai, therthal vaakkurudhippadi, muzhumaiyaaga thallupadi seyya vendum ulpada, palveru korikkaigalai valiyuruthi, Sep. 15 mudhal, 40 sangangalai serndha vivasaayigal sangathinar, Samayapuram toll plaza aruge thodar kaathiruppu poraattathil eedupattu varugindranar.
Kadandha, 15-il Tamizhaga amaichargaludan, vivasaaya sanga piradhinidhigal nadathiya pechu tholvi adaindhadhu. Netrum, moondraavadhu naalaaga iravu, pagalaaga kaathiruppu poraattam nadandhadhu. Poraattakkaarargalukku veli nabargal moolam netru unavu kondu varappattadhu.
Aanaal, 'Avatraip poraatta idathil vazhanga anumadhikka mudiyadhu' ena, police thaduthadhaal, vivasaayigalukkum, policukkum vaakkuvaadham erpattadhu.
Adhanpin, varuvaayt thuraiyinar samaadhaanam seidhadhaal, irutharappinarum amaidhiyaanar.
Vivasaaya sangathinar koorugaiyil, 'Arasu pechu nadathi, engal korikkaigalai niraivetttrum varai, kaathiruppu poraattam thodarum' endranar.

headline: Parigaara room-il school uniform, laptop muzhukka aabaasa videokkal; Salem saamiyarin adhirthip pinnani
text:
Parigaaram engira peyaril sirumigal matrum pengalidam paaliyal athumeeralil eedupattu 50-kkum merpatta aabaasa videokkal edutha adhirthich sambavam kurithu poli saamiyar Vijay Raja-vidam magalir kaavalthuraiyinar theevira visaaranai merkkondu varugindranar.
Salem maavattam Vazhapadi-yai serndha 50 vayadhaana Vijayaraja fridge, mixie, grinder pazhudhu paarkkum velai seidhu vandhirukkiraan. Melum, Saneeswara Parigaara Nilaiyam engira peyaril poliyaaga maanthreega maiyam ondraiyum nadathi vandhirukkiraan.
Vinayagar Chaturthi vizhaavai munnittu sirumi oruvar Vinayagar vazhipaattirkaana nangodai kettu maanthreega nilaiyathirkuch sendrirukkiraar. Andhach sirumiyidam thagaadha muraiyil Vijayaraja nadakka muyarchi seidhirukkiraan. Padhariya andhach sirumi angirundhu thappich sendrirukkiraar.
Idhu kurithu thannudaiya saga thozhiyaana matruru sirumiyidam kooriyirukkiraar. Thannidammum andhach saamiyar idhepondru paaliyal athumeeralil eedupada muyarchi seidhadhaaga andhach sirumiyum kooriyirukkiraar. Idhkurithu sirumigal iruvarum petroridam kooriyirukkiraargal. Idhaiyak kettu aathiramadaindha petror matrum appagudhiyai serndha ilaignargal, Vijayarajavin maanthreega parigaara nilaiyathirkuch sendrullanar.
Poottappattirundha nilaiyil, poottai udaithu ulle sendru paarthullanar. School maanavigalin uniform-gal iruppadhaik kandu sandhegamadaindhullanar. Melum, angirundha oru laptop-ai eduthu paarthapodhu, saamiyar Vijayaraja eraalamaana school sirumigal matrum pengalidam aabaasamaaga irukkum 50-irkkum merpatta videokkal iruppadhaik kandu adhirthiyil uraindhullanar.
Udanadiyaaga kaavalthuraiyinarkuth thagaval therivithu, padhungiyirundha Vijayarajavai chutri valaithup pidithu kaidhu seidhullanar. Parigaaram engira peyaril sirumigal matrum pengalidam paaliyal athumeeralil eedupattu 50-irkkum merpatta aabaasa videokkal edutha adhirthi sambavam kurithu poli saamiyar Vijay Rajavidam magalir kaavalthuraiyinar theevira visaaranai merkkondu varugindranar.

headline: 'Tamil Nattirkku avvalavu neer tharamudiyadhu..' Uchanidhimandrathai naada Karnataka mudivu?
text:
Cauvery neer ozhungumuraik kuzhuvin parindhuraiyai adipadayaagak kondu, Cauvery Neer Melaanmai Aanaiyam September 9 mudhal 15 naatkal dhinamum 6,000 cusec neerai Tamil Nattirkku vida Karnatakavai kattaayappaduthiyulladhu. Anaikalil neer iruppu mosamadaindhadhaal, indha uttharavai edhirthu Ucha Needhimandrathil melmuraiyeedu seyyavum, kuzhuvidame seeraaivu manu thaakkal seyyavum Karnataka arasu nadavadikkai eduthu varugiradhu.
Cauvery-ilirundhu Tamil Nattirkuth dhinamum 6,000 cusec neerai thirandhuvida vendum endra uttharavai edhirthu, Ucha Needhimandrathil manu thaakkal seyya Karnataka arasu nadavadikkai eduthu varugiradhu. September 9 mudhal adutha 15 naatkalukkkuth Tamil Nattirkuth dhinamum 6,000 cusec neeraik Karnataka urudhi seyya vendum endra 'Cauvery Neer Ozhungumuraik Kuzhuvin' parindhuraiyai 'Cauvery Neer Melaanmai Aanaiyam' Sevvaaikkizhamai urudhi seidhadhu.
Idhu kurithu ammaannila mudhalvar D.K. Shivakumarudan aalosanai nadathiyullaadhaagavum, sattak kuzhuvin parindhuraippadi Vyaazhakkizhamai Ucha Needhimandrathil melmuraiyeettu manu thaakkal seyya aayathap panigal nadaipetru varuvadhaagavum Karnataka neervalat thurai amaichar N. Cheluvarayaswamy therivithullaar.
Melum, Cauvery neer ozhungumuraik kuzhuvin uttharavai edhirthu akkuzhuvidame seeraaivu manu thaakkal seyyumaaru adhigaarigalukku uttharavidappattulladhu. Karnataka anaikalin neer iruppu migak mosamaana nilaiyil ulladhaal, Tamil Nattirkuth thirandhuvidat thevaiyaana thanneer thangalidam illai endru ammaannila arasu therivithulladhu.

headline: Bihar makkal veedhiyil irangi poraadat thodangivittadhaaga paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga Bihar makkal veedhiyil irangi poraadat thodangivittanar endru irandukkum merpatta videokkalai ondru serthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar.

Oru maidhaanathil aayirakkanakkanor koodiyirukkum video matrum iravil saalaiyil theeppandhathudan aayirakkanakkanor oorvalamaaga sellum videokkalai ondru serthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilai thagavalil, "Theeppori patri vittadhu. Bihar makkal veedhigalil irangi vittanar. Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Kerala ovvoru maanilamaaga irangum" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Bihar-il BJP kootani vetri petradhai thodarnthu angu makkal poraattam nadathi varuvadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Bihar-il veedhiyil irangi poraadum makkal endru moondru videokkalai inaithu ondraaga padhivittullanar. Idhil oru video thodarbaga erkkanave nammudaiya Fact Crescendo Tamizhil katturai veliyittirundhom.
Kadandha August maadham Bihar-il Rahul Gandhi yaathirai merkondaar. Appodhu avaraik kaana koodiya koottam endru andha videovai appodhu palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Aanaal adhu unmaiyil Maharashtravil nadandha oru nigazhchiyin podhu edukkappatta video endru unmai kandariyum aaivu seidhirundhom. Andha katturaiyaik kaana inge click seyyungal. Andha pazhaiya videovai ippodhu Bihar-il veedhiyil irangip poraadum makkal endru thavaraagap padhivittullanar.
Idhanudan serkkappattirundha kaiyil thee pandhangaludan makkal peraniyaagach sellum video thodarbaga aaivu seidhom. Video kaatchigalai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu, andha videovum ippodhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga kural kodungal endru kurippittu indha videovai 2025 August 12th thedhiyilirundhu palarum padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Bihar-il vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga Ilaignar Congress saarbil thee pandham endhi perani nadathappattadhaaga sila padhivugal namakkuk kidaithana.
Matruru theeppandham endhi peraniyaaga sendra video kaatchiyai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Adhu Rajasthan-il edukkappattadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Andha videovai September irudhiyil palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Adhil, Rajasthan-in Jhalawar-il school vibathil kollappatta kuzhandhaigalin kudumbangalukku needhi kori Jaipur-il theeppandham endhi peraniyaaga sendra makkal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha moondru videokkalum Bihar sattamandra therthalukku munbaagave veliyaagi irundhadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Idhan moolam Bihar therthal mudivugalukku edhiraaga alladhu Bihar vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga Bihārigal veedhigalil irangip poraadat thodanginar endru paravum video thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adipadayil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Vijay azhaippu viduthaal aalosithu mudivu endru Communist-gal arivithaargalaa?
text:
Aatchi amaikka azhaithaal aalosithu mudivedukkappadum endru Marxist Communist katchi therivithadhaaga oru seidhi

Vijay azhaithaal aalosithu mudivedukkappadum endru Marxist Communist katchiyin Tamil Nadu maanila seyalalar Shanmugam kooriyadhaaga oru news card samooga oodagangalil viral aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu thodarbaga aaivu seidhom.
investigation_details:
Polimer Seithigal veliyitta seithiyin adipadayil kootani aatchi amaikka azhaippu viduthaal aalosithu mudivu seivom endru Indhiya Communist katchiyin maanila seyalalar Shanmugam kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha seidhiyai Polimer TV veliyittiruppadhu adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyaana padhivugal moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Aanaal indha seidhiyai Marxist Communist katchi maruthulladhu.
M.K. Stalin-ai sandhikka vandha Communist katchith thalaivargal matrum Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi thalaivar Thol. Thirumavalavan ullittor Arivalayathil vaithu seithiyaalargalaich sandhithanar. Appodhu pesiya Marxist Communist katchiyin maanila seyalalar Shanmugam, "Tamil Naduvil AIADMK - BJP kootaniyai veezhtha vendum endra nokkathudan therthalai edhir kondom. Adhil vetriyum petrullom. Idharkaaga DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin-ai sandhithu nandriyait therivithom. Kootani aatchi thodarbaga TVK endha azhaippaiyum vidukkavillai. Kootani aatchi thodarbaga TVK thannudaiya nilappaattai arivikkaadha nilaiyil, engal tharappilirundhu enna karuthu, enna nilappaadu endru ketpadhenbadhey poruthamaanadhaagap padappadavillai" endru koorinaar.
Azhaippu viduthaal enna seiveergal endru nirubargal kelvi ezhuppinar. Adharku Shanmugam, "Idhu yoogathin adipadailaana kelvi. Thanipperum katchi endra adipadayil aatchi amaikka sattappoorva urimai pettravargal avargal. Avargaldhaan thangal nilappaattai therivikka vendum" endru kooriyirundhaar.
Indha nilaiyil Polimer TV-yil kootani aatchi amaikka Vijay azhaippu viduthaal aalosithu mudivu endru Shanmugam kooriyadhaaga seidhiyai veliyittullanar. Polimer veliyittirundha seidhiyai paarthom. Thani petti eduthadhu pondru video veliyittirundhanar. Aanaal, avar enna pesinaar endru adhil audio-vai veliyidavillai. Shanmugam ivvaaru koorinaar endru seithiyaalar oruvar vilakkip pesuvadhu pondru andha video irundhadhu.
Ippadi edhum petti alithullaara, adhu thodarbana seidhi edhum ulladha endru thedip paarthom. Idhu thavarana seidhi endru Shanmugam veliyittirundha X thala padhivu dhaan kidaithadhu. Polimer veliyittirundha seidhiyaiye marupadhivaagap pottu adhil, "Indru Polimer tholaikkaatchiyil veliyaana seidhi muttrilum thavaraanadhu. Andha seithiyil veliyidappatta karuthugal enadhu karuthugal alla. Naan appadippatta endha karuthaiyum endha oodagathirkum vazhangavillai. Enadhu peyarai payanpaduthi thavarana thagaval parappappattulladhu" endru kurippittirundhaar.
Naalai enna vendumaanaalum nadakkalaam. Perumbaanmaiyai niroobikka Communist katchiyin aadharavai Vijay ketkkalaam... Alladhu veru katchiyin aadharavai ketkkalaam. Oruvelai Vijay aadharavu kettaal Communist katchi thannudaiya iyakka nadaimuraippadi vivaadhitthe mudivedukkum soozhal varalaam. Aanaal indraikku appadi oru karuthai CPI-M katchi velippaduthavillai enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Amit Shah-vin kaalaniyai thudaitha Navika endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Madhiya ulthurai amaichar Amit Shah-vin kaalaniyai Times Now Network kuzhuma thalaimai aasiriyar Navika Kumar thudaippadhu pondru oru video

Pirabala aangila tholaikkaatchiyin aasiriyar Navika enbadhu kooda theriyaamal yaaro oru penmani Amit Shah-vin kaalaniyaith thudaithaar endru videovai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilai thagavalil, "Therthal. pirachaarak koottathil kalandhukonda ulthurai amaichar Amit Shah pirachaarathirkaana.! vaahana payanathinpodhu oru pennidam thanadhu
kaalanigalai kaatti thudaikka selgiraar, naattilulla vaakkalargal anaivarum, immaadhiriyaana BJP thalaivargalukku paadam pugattungal indha video naattumakkal anaivarukkum samarppanam" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indiyavin pirabalamaana aangila oodagathin kuzhuma thalaimai aasiriyaraaga iruppavar Navika Kumar. Ivar BJP-ukku aadharavaaga seyalpadak koodiyavar endra karuthu samooga oodagangalil ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil videovil iruppavar Navika Kumar enbadhu kooda theriyaamal pen oruvar Amit Shah-vin kaalaniyaith thudaithuvittaar endru padhivittullanar.
Amit Shah-vin muga baavanai, Navika Kumar-in kai kadigaaram thideerendru valaiyalaaga maaruvadhu, Amit Shah-vin mookku kannaadi thideerendru maraivadhu endru pala kaatchigal idhu AI moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seidhana. Melum ANI seidhi niruvanathin logovum thavaraaga irundhadhu. Unmaiyil Navika Kumar Amit Shah-vin kaalaniyaith thudaithirundhaal adhai oodagam veliyittirukka vaaippillai. Ivai ellaam indha video poliyanadhu enbadhai urudhi seigindrana.
Aadhaarangal adipadayil idhai urudhi seyya, video kaatchiyai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovil ulladhu pondru Amit Shah arugilirundhu Navika Kumar eduthirundha selfie pugaipadam X thalathil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Andha pugaipadathai Navika Kumar veliyittirundhaar. Andha pugaipadathai eduthu AI moolam videovaaga veliyittirukkalaam endru therindhadhu.
Indha video kaatchiyai AI pugaipadangalaik kandariya udhavum inaiyathalathil padhivettrit thedinom. decopy.ai endra inaiyathalathil indha pugaipadathai padhivetri aaivu seidha podhu 100 percent idhu AI pugaipadam endru kooriyadhu. Idharku mugathin baavanai velippaadu, udaigalin nira maatram endru palveru kaaranangalaich suttikkaatti AI kaatchidhaan endru urudhi seidhadhu. Thodarnthu thediya podhu nammudaiya Fact Crescendo Malayalam-ilum kooda indha video thodarbana katturai veliyaagi irundhadhu. Andha katturaiyaik kaana inge click seyyungal. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video poliyanadhu enbadhai urudhi seidhana.

headline: Madurai Muruga bakthargal maanaattil madhu viniyogikkappattadha?
text:
Maduraiyil nadandha Muruga bakthargal maanaattil pangerravargalukku madhu bottle vazhangappattadhaaga oru video

Veettu vaasalil amarndhu oruvar madhu viniyogikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilai thagavalil, "Madurai Murugan maanaattukku varugira bakthargalukku theertham vazhangappadum pirathyega kaatchi.!?" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Maduraiyil Hindu Munnani saarbil June 22nd thedhi Muruga bakthargal maanaadu nadathappattadhu. Indha maanaattil pangerravargalukku madhu viniyogikkappattadhu endru silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha videovai pala maadhangalukku munbe paartha ninaivu irundhadhaal idhu Murugan maanaattil nadandhadhaaga irukka vaaippillai enbadhu therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seyya aaivu seidhom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu 2024 August maadhadhilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, indha sambavam engu, eppodhu nadandhadhu endru endha padhivilum kurippidappadavillai.
Aanaal Murugan maanaadu Maduraiyil June 22, 2025-il nadandhadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovai 2024 August-il mudhalil padhividappattulladhu. Adhaavadhu Murugan maanaadu nadappadharkuk kittathatta 10 maadhangalukku munbu indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi ulladhu. Idhan moolam indha video Madurai Murugan maanaattil eduthadhu illai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adipadayil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Iran-il irundhu naadu thirumbum Pakistan-iyargal endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
"Iran-il irundhu naadu thirumbum Pakistan-iyargal", endru koori,

Idhil, "Iran meedhu Israel thodarnthu vaanvazhi thaakkudhal nadathum nilaiyil angu vasithu vandha Pakistaniyar adhigaamaanore Pakistannukku Taftan vazhiyaaga thirumbi varugindranar aanaal adhaip payanpaduthi Iraniyargal yaarum ulle vandhu vidaamal romba jaakkiradhaiyaa paadhukaakkiradhu pak," endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan Pakistan ellaikkul makkal koottamaaga nuzhaivadhu pondra kaatchigal konda oru videovum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seidhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkkanda thagaval unmaiya, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idharkum tharppodhaiya Iran - Israel modhalukkum endha thodarpum illai endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, kurippitta video kadandha 2023nd aandu mudhale samooga valaithalangalil pagirappadum ondru.
Pakistan makkal, Balochistan-il ulla Taftan vazhiyaaga, Iran sendru, aanmeega yaathirai, varthagam merkkolvadhu vazhakkam. Idhanpodhu, avargalidam Taftan sodhanaich saavadiyil ulla paadhukaappu adhigaarigal lanjam vaanguvadhaagak kuttranchaattappadugiradhu.
Idhuthorbana oru video kadandha 2023nd aandu samooga valaithalangalil pagirappattadhu. Idhe videovai samooga valaithala payanargal, reference matrum fileshot muraiyil avvappodhu marupagirvu seivadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.

headline: Kashmir-il siruvanin kan munne thandhaiyai suttuk kondra theeviravaadhigal endra video unmaiya?
text:

Irandha andha mudhiyavarin sadalam meedhu, avaradhu perakkuzhandhai sogamaaga amarndhirundhadhu. Pinnar andha kuzhandhaiyai paadhukaappup padaiyinar pathiramaaga meettanar.

headline: Indhiya pork kappal meedhu Pakistan kappal modhiyadhaagap paravum video - Ippodhu nadandhadhaa?
text:
Indhiya pork kappal meedhu Pakistan pork kappal modhiya sambavathin video endru oru video

Irandu kappalgal arugaruge sendru urasikkollum video kaatchi Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Videovin meedhu, "Indhiya pork kappal meedhu Pakistan kadarpadai modhal. Pakistan thoodharai azhaithu India kadum edhirppu" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilai thagavalil, "Arabikkadalil Indhiya pork kappal meedhu Pakistan kadarpadaik kappal modhal!" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vada Arabik kadalil vazhakkamaana kanganippup paniyil eedupattirundha Indhiyak kadarpadaiyin pork kappalai nokki Pakistan kadarpadaik kappal ondru adhiga vegathil modhiyadhu. Idhil periya alavil sedham erpadavillai endraalum indha sambavathirku India kandanam therivithirundhadhu.
Indha sambavathirku Pakistan uyar aanaiyathin poruppu adhigaariyai Indhiya veliyuravu amaichagathukku azhaithu vilakkam kettappattadhaaga Indhiya veliyuravu amaichagam tharappil arikkai moolam therivikkappattirundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil, indha sambavathin neradi olipadhivu kaatchi endru oru videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video migavum pazhaiyadhu pola ulladhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaga aaivu seidhom.
Aayvukku eduthukkonda video kaatchigalai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovai 2014nd aandil YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil Pakistan kadarpadaiyin Babur kappalum Indhiyak kadarpadai kappalum endru thalaippidappattirundhadhu. Melum, MV Suez endra varthaga kappalai meetkum paniyin podhu Indhiya matrum Pakistan kadarpadai kappalgalukku idaiye modhal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adipadayil Google-il thediyapodhu, 2011nd aandil Indhiya - Pakistan kappalgalukku idaiye modhal erpattadhaaga seidhigal namakku kidaithana. NDTV idhu thodarbaga 2011-il veliyittirundha seidhiyum namakku kidaithana. Melum, 2011-il erpatta modhal endru kurippittu ithanai aandugalaaga indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video India - Pakistan kadarpadai kappalgalukku idaiye erpatta modhalin podhu edukkappattadhudhaan. Aanaal, idhu 2026-il nigazhndha sambavathin video illai. 2011nd aandu nigazhndha sambavathin videovai 2026-il nadandha sambavam pondru thavaraaga, thavarana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Preity Zinta-vin Rs.18 crore bank kadanai madhiya arasu thallupadi seidhadhaa?
text:
Nadigai Preity Zinta-vin Rs.18 crore kadanai madhiya arasu thallupadi (write-off) seidhadhaagap palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha thagaval unmaiya endru arindhukolla aaivu seidhom.
Pirabala Bollywood nadigaiyum IPL cricket Punjab aniyin urimaiyalalarumaana Preity Zinta thodarbaga sameebathil Kerala Congress X thalathil padhivu veliyittadhu. Adhil, "Nadigai Preity Zinta thannudaiya samooga oodaga pakkathai nirvagikkum poruppai BJP-ukku koduthu, bank kadan Rs.18 crore thallupadi petraar. Andha bank kadandha vaaram nidhi nerukkadiyil sikkiyadhu. Mudhaleettaalargal tharppodhu thangal panathirkaaga veedhigalil nirkiraargal" endru kurippittirundhadhu.
Indha thagaval thavaraanadhu endru nadigai Preity Zinta maruthirundhaar. Congress veliyittirundha padhivukku avar alithirundha badhilil, "Illai, enadhu samooga oodaga kanakkugalai naane iyakkugirom, poli seidhigalai veliyittadharkaaga ungalai paarthu vetkappadugirom! Yaarum enakkaaga edhaiyum alladhu endha kadanaiyum thallupadi seyyavillai.
Oru arasiyal katchi alladhu adhan piradhinidhi enadhu peyar matrum padangalai payanpaduthi thavarana vadhandhigal matrum polich seidhigalai ookkuvippadhaik kandu naan adhirthiyadainthen. Inge oru thagavalai padhivu seyya virumbugirom. 10 aandugalukku munbu kadan vaangappattu muzhumaiyaagath thiruppich seluthappattadhu. Indha thagaval edhirkaalathil thavarana puridhal erpadaamal irukkavum matravargalukkuth thelivupaduthavum udhavum endru nambugirom" endru kooriyirundhaar.
Aanaalum, nadigai Preity Zinta-vin bank kadan thallupadi seyyappattadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha thagaval thodarbaga thodarnthu thedip paarthom. Appodhu Mumbai maanagara kaavalthuraiyin porulaadhaara kutrap pirivu tharappilirundhu vilakkam alikkappattiruppadhaagach seidhigal kidaithana.
Adhil, "Tharppodhu nadandhu varum visaaranaiyil nadigai Preity Zinta-vin peyar idam peravillai. Preity Zinta thodarbaga engalukku idhuvarai endha pugaarum varavillai" endru therivithulladhu. Nadigai Preity Zinta-vin kadan thallupadi seyyappattadhaaga namakku endha seidhiyum kidaikkavillai. Melum kadanai thiruppich seluthivittadhaaga Preity Zinta urudhi seidhullaar. Ivai ellaam nadigai Preity Zinta-vin bank kadanai BJP arasu thallupadi seidhadhu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seigindrana.
New India Co-operative Bank muraikedu:
New India Co-operative Bank-il nadandha muraikedu enna endru ariya adhu thodarbaga veliyaana seidhigalaip paarthom. 2025 February 12th andha bank-il Reserve Bank adhigaarigal aaivu seidhullanar. Appodhu bank kilai ondrin pettagathil kanakkilirundha Rs.112 crore-um matruru kilaiyil Rs.10 crore panam kaanaamal poyiruppadhaik kandarindhanar. Panam 2019nd aandilirundhu 2025nd aandu varaiyilaana kaalathil thirudiyullanar. Indha vivagaaram thodarbaga New India Co-operative Bank-in munnaal podhu melaalaraana Hitesh Mehta enbavarai police kaidhu seidhanar.
Indha irandu kilaigalaiyum Hitesh Mehta nirvagithu vandhullaar. Panathai eduthu Dharmesh Paun enbavaridam oppadaithadhaaga avar oppukondullaar. Idhaith thodarnthu Dharmesh Paun-um kaidhu seyyappattaar. Lucky Baskhar endra thiraipadathil varuvadhu pondru bank-il ulla panathai Reserve Bank vidhigalukku maaraaga veru niruvanangalukku kadanaaga koduthu ragasiyamaaga laabam sambaadhithiruppadhu therigiradhu. Aanaal Reserve Bank nadathiya thideer aaivil idhu velippattulladhu. Bank kadan write-off seyyappattadhaal nidhi nerukkadi erpattadhaaga endha thagavalum illai.
New India Co-operative Bank-in nadandha muraikedu thodarbaga visaaranai nadandhu varum soozhalil nadigai Preity Zinta-vin kadan thallupadi seyyappattadhal dhaan bank-il nidhi nerukkadi erpattulladhu enbadhu pondru thavarana thagavalai samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Enave, namadhu vaasagargal, ithagaiya thavarana seidhi, pugaipadangal, video pondravatrai urudhi seyyaamal matravargalukkup pagira vendaam ena kettuk kolgirom.

headline: Godse-vin silaiyai udaitha vada Indhiyargal endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Gandhiyai suttukkondra Godse-kku silai thevaiya endru sindhikka aarambitha vada Indhiyargal Godse-vin silaiyai agatriyadhaaga oru video

Silai ondrai ilaignargal udaithu keezhe thallum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Videovil, "Gandhiyai suttukkondra Indhiya desa dhrogi Godse-kku silai thevaiya sindhikka aarambitha vadakkans 2 roobai sanghi kadharal aarambam" endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu.
Nilai thagavalil, "Indiyavin mudhal theeviravaadhi paappara paradeisi naayin silai vada Indhiya makkalaal adithu norukkappattadhu.
India muzhuvadhum RSS Hindutva theeviravaadha paappara naaikalai adithu oda vidum naal vegu dhoorathil illai" endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Gandhiyai suttuk kondra Godse-vai sila amaippaich saarndhavargal aadharithu varugindranar. Indha nilaiyil Godse-kku vaikkappattirundha silaiyai vada Indhiyargal adithu norukkiyadhaagach silar padhivittu varugindranar. Videovil ulla silaiyai paarkkum podhu Godse silai polath theriyavillai. Sila maadhangalukku munbu Nepal-il nadandha poraatta video polath therindhadhu enave, indha padhivu thodarbaga aaivu seidhom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaipadangalaaga maatri Google Lens thalathil padhivettrit thedinom. Thodakkathil namakku endha mudivum kidaikkavillai. Veru veru kaatchigalai padhivettrit thediya podhu, News 18 India 2025 September 9th date padhivetram seidha video ondru kidaithadhu. Adhil, Nepal-il Gen Z ilaignar poraattam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, idhu Nepal-il engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidappadavillai.
Thodarnthu thediya podhu, Facebook-il oruvar padhivu namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil, Nepal-il Nepalgunj endra idathil ulla B.P. Koirala-vin silaiyai poraattakkaarargal udaithanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan adipadayil thodarnthu thedinom.
Google Maps-il Nepalgunj endra ooraik kandarindhom. Andha ooril ulla saalai sandhippugalai ellaam paarvaiyittom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovil ulladhu pondru silai matrum arugil kadaigal iruppadhaik kandarindhom. Idhan moolam indha sambavam Nepal-il nadandha ilaignar poraattathin podhu edukkappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Nepal-il nadandha Gen Z poraattathin podhu Nepal-in munnaal Pradhamar B.P. Koirala-vin silaiyai poraattakkaarargal iditha videovai, vada Indiyavil Godse-vin silaiyai iditha makkal endru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhai urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adipadayil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Aasiya Koppai finalukku munneeriyathu India: Veliyeriyathu Bangladesh
text:
Dubai: Asia Cup final-ku Indhiya pengal ani 10vathu muraiya munneriyathu. Araiyiruthiyil 40 ran vithiyasathil Vangadesathai vendrathu.
Aikkiya Arabu Emirates-il (U.A.E.,), pengalkana Asia Cup cricket ('T-20') 10vathu season nadakkirathu. Dubai-il nadantha muthal araiyiruthiyil India, Vangadesa anigal mothina. 'Toss' ventra Vangadesa ani 'fielding' therivu seithathu.
Shafali abaram:
Indhiya anikku Smriti Mandhana (2) ematrinar. Marumunaiyil asathiya Shafali Verma, Sultana veesiya 4vathu over-il varisiyaya 2 sixer parakkavittar. Prathika Rawal (20) oralavu kaikoduthathu. Paruma veesiya 11vathu over-il thodarchiyaga 2 boundary virattiya Shafali, sarvadesa 'T-20' arangil thanathu 20vathu arasa-sathai pathivu seithar. Shafali, 40 panthil 64 ran (3X6, 7X4) eduthu aattamizhanthar.
Pin innaintha captain Harmanpreet Kaur, Richa Ghosh jodi kaikoduthathu. Naanqavathu wicket-ukku 36 ran sertha pothu Richa Ghosh (21) out-aanar. Bahima, Nakhitha panthil thala oru sixer adithar Harmanpreet. Maruba veesiya kadaisi over-il oru boundary, oru sixer adithar Deepti Sharma 13 ran-il aattamizhanthar. Indhiya ani 20 over-il 149/5 ran eduthathu. Harmanpreet (24) out-aakamal irunthar.
Deepti asathal:
Savalana ilakkai virattiya Vangadesa ani 20 over-il, 109/7 ran mattum eduthu tholviyainthathu. Shorna (22), Dilara (21), captain Nigar Sultana (19) aaruthal thanthanar. India sarbil Deepti Sharma 3, Nandhini 2 wicket kaipatrinar.

headline: Soodaan | Thangathukkaaga uyirai panayam vaikkum makkal.. surangathil aduthaduthu maranam!
text:
Seithiyalar - M.Meera
Sudanil needithu varum porukku mathiyil, thangach suranga thozhil naattin mukkiya varumana atharamaga mariyullathu. Ithanal padugappattra suranga panigal thodarndhu uyirizhappugalai erpaduththi varugindrana. Sameebathiya iru suranga vibathugalil mattum sumaru 100 per uyirizhanthullana. Vadakku Sudanil, Egipthu ellaikku arugil ulla Awny suranga paguthiyil kadantha September 20aam thethi surangam idinthu vizhunthu. Ithil kurainthathu 10 per uyirizhanthathagavum, 21 per kayamDhaindhaathagavum suranga thozhilalargal theriviththullana. Idipadugalukkul melum palar sikkirukkalam enak koorappadum nilaiyil, meetpu panigal thodarndhu nadaiperrana.
Itharku sila naatkalukku munbu West Kordofan maanilathil ulla al-Zaraa thangach surangathil erpatta matroru vibathil kurainthathu 82 per uyirizhanthanar. Aduthaduththu erpatta intha vibathugal, Sudanin thangach suranga thuraiyil nilavum padugappattra soozhalai meendum velichaththukku kondu vanthullana.
Sudanin thangaththai kattupaduththuvathu yaar?
AbhbhirighghAvin mukkiya thanga urpathiyalarkalil ontrana Sudan, kadantha aandu sumaru 70 tan thangaththai urpathi seythathaga annattu arasu theriviththullathu. 2024-l 64 tan thangam urpathiyanathagavum, ithu 2022-il pathivana 41.8 tan-naivida 53 sathaveetham athigam enrum therivikkappattullathu. Ithnmoolam sattappoorva yetrumathi varuvayaga sumaru 1.57 billiyan dalar kidaiththullathu. Aanal, thangaththin mukkiya']/huvam athigariththatharku pinnal Sudanin mosamaana porulathara nilaiyum ullathu. 2023 Apralil raanuvaththukkum thunnai raanuvappadiyana Rapid Support Forces (RSF)-kkum idaiye por thodangiyathilirunthu, thozhilgal padhikkappattullana. Vivasayam seerkulainthu, latchakkanakkana makkal idampeyarnthullana.
Inthach soozhalil, thangam palarukku mukkiyaana varumana vaippaga mariyullathu. Athathe nerathil, naattin perumpalanmai thangam arasu vazhiyaga yetrumathi seyyappadamal kadaththal matrum sattavirutha valaiyamaipugal moolam veliyeruvathaga aayvalargal koorugindrana. Sudanin thanga yetrumathiyil Ikiya Arabu Ameerakam mukkiya idam vakikkirathu. Thanga varthagam thodarbaga Sudanukkum UAE-kkum idaiye sarvadesa alavil kurrachaattugalum ezhunthullana; intha kurrachaattai UAE maruththullathu.
Thangach surangangalil perumpalanvaitrai tholaithoora paguthiyil seyalpadum muraisara surangangalaaga iruppathal, naveena tholniltham, pothiya kattamaipup matrum padugappu ubakaranangal illamal thozhilalargal paniyattruvathaga aayvalargal therivikkindrana.
Poralaal Sudanin porulatharam melum seerkazhinthullathu. 2023-kku munbu oru America dolarukku sumaru 570 Sudan paundukal iruntha nilaiyil, 2026 Apralil oru dolarukku 3,500 paundukalukkum athikamagi ullathu. Oonapporulgal, eriporul matrum pokkuvarathu selavugalum kadumaiyaga uyirnthullana.
Ithanal, uyirukku aapaththanaathaga irunthalum thangach suranga pani palarukku thavirkka mudiyatha vazhvatharamaaga mariyullathu. Sudanin porschoolal needikkum nilaiyil, thangaththin meethana intha porulathara saarpu melum pala uyirgalai aapaththil thallakkoodum enra kavalai ezhunthullathu.

headline: “Hamas aadhaaru koshomitta pennai Gaza-vil kudiyeira sonnapothu kathari azhuthar” endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Hamas-ai aadharithu koshomitta pennai Hamas-in thalaiyagam ulla Gaza-vil kudiyeira Israeli police adhikarigal utharavitta pothu kathari azhuthar endru oru video

Penn oruvaridam Israeli kavalathuṟai adhikarigal visaaranai seyyum video Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Avarkal pesuvathu puriyavillai. Nilaith thagavalil, “Israel-il ulla ippen vilaiyaattaga Hamas-ai aadharithu utsahamaga koshom pottar. Athave avarukku perum athirchiyai alithathu.
Appennin iruppidam senra Israel kavalathuṟai athigari ungal ithayathil idam pidithirukkum Hamas-in thalaiyagam Gaza-vil kudiyeri aananthamaga vaazhungal. Angu senru kudiyeravum endru koorinar.
Intha utharavai kettavudan appenn katharuvathaip paarungal.
Namathu naattilum Hamas, Syria, Palestine, Pakistan aagiyavatrai aadharippavarkalaiyum
Sirappu vimaanm erpaadu seythu angu irakkividalaam” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha videovai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathividu varukindrana.
investigation_details:
Israel-il Hamas bayangaravaathigalukku aadharavaga koshomitta pennai Gaza nagarukku anuppiya Israel endru kurippittu video Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Israel-il sogusaga vaalntha antha penn, Gaza-vil vaazha sonnathaik kettu azhuthathagum, athe pol Pakistan-ai aadharithu pathividupavarkalai ellam Pakistan-ukku anuppa vendum endru antha pathivil kurippidappattullathu.
Intha video patri kurippidappattulla thagaval unmaiya endru ariya aayuv seidhom. Intha videovai pudaangalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Naam aayuvukku eduthukkonda pathivil ulla thagavalai vaithu palarum ithai samooga oodakangalil pathividu vanthiruvathaip kaana mudinthathu. Ithu thodaraga seithi ethum ullatha endru thedi paarthom. Aanaal, appadi entha oru seithiyum namakku kidaikkavillai.
Veru veru reverse image thedal thalangalil intha pudaathai pathivittu thediya pothu, Russian mozhiyil veliyana pathivu onru kidaithathu. Athil, bayangaravaatharkku aadharavaana karuthai veliyitta pennai kaithu seitha police endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha pathivil idam pettriruntha sila thagavalkalai payanpaduthi Google-il thedi paarthom. Appothu 2023m aandu November maatham veliyana seithi namakku kidaithathu.
Athil, “Israel kudiyurimai konda Palestinian penn oruvar thannudaiya WhatsApp status-il bayangaravaatha aadharu karuthip pathivathu thodaraga Israeli policaral kaithu seiyappattar. Puthithaga konduvarappatta bayangaravaatha thadappu sattathin keel ivar kaithu seiyappattar” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Avar Gaza paguthikku idappeyarvu seiyappada utharavappattathaga entha oru seithiyum namakku kidaikkavillai.
Antha pennudan Israeli kavalathuṟai adhikarigal pesiyathin mozhipeyarpukal namakku kidaithana. Athil, “Neerkal ungal WhatsApp status-il bayangaravaatharkku aadharavaga, ookkuvikkum vagaiyil pathivu veliyiruntheerkal” endru police athigari koorukirar. Atharkku antha penn, “Illai, illai atharkku vaaippe illai. Naan Israel-ukku vetriyai tharattum endruthan pathiyirunthen. Sathiyama apadiyathaan solliyirunthen” enkirar.
Todarndhu pesiya antha police athigari, “Ungalukkum bayangaravaatha amaippukkum idaiy㖅yana thodarbu patri aayuv seivom” enkirar. Antha penn illai endru katharukirar. Matrppadi Gaza nagarukku naadukadathappaduvathaga avar kooriyathaga entha pathivum illai.
Namudaiya aayuvil, Israel-il Palestine penn oruvar bayangaravaathigalukku aadharavaana karuthai WhatsApp status-aaga vaithatharkaak kaithu seiyappatta videovai eduthu thavaraaga pagirnthiruppathu uruthi seiyappattullathu. Intha aadharangal adippadaiyil naam aayuvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaraanathu endru uruthi seiyappadugirathu.

headline: Fuse carrier thirudiya T.V.K matrum D.M.K saarntha nabargal endru paravum news card unmaiya?
text:
Avadiyil fuse carriers thirudiyadaha kaidhu seyyappatta iruvar D.M.K thundu pottirukkum polavum avarkale TVK thundu pottirukkum polavum irandu news card-kal
Sun News veliyittathu pondru news card Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Irandu per TVK thundu aninthirukkum iruvar kaidhu seyyappattathu pondru seithi irunthathu. Athil, “Iruvar kaidhu. Avadiyil minvaariyathin pinpuram minsara cable pettiyil 14 fuse carriers thirudappatta vazhakkil, Ambathuraye serntha Dinesh Kumar, Vinith Kumar kaidhu. Thiruttukkana kaaranam kurithu police visaaranai” endru kurippidappattirunthathu.
Ihthe news card-ai D.M.K thundu aninthirukkathu pondru edit seithum palarum samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindrana. Intha irandu news card-kal thodarbaha aayvu seithom.
Thagavalin vivaram:
Thamizhnattil TVK aatchikku vanthathilirunthu maanavathin pala paguthikalil minsara vettu paathippu erpatullathaha seithigal varukindrana. Itharku D.M.K aadhaaravalarhal kaaranam enbathu pondru TVK-vinar samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindrana.
Fuse carriers thirudappaduvathey minvettukku kaaranam endru minvaariya tharappil vilakkam alikkappattathu. Itharku balam serkkum vagaiyil Avadiyil minsara fuse carriers-ai thirudiyadaha irandu per kaidhu seyyappattanar. Ivarkal arasiyal pinpalam patri ithuvarai seithi veliyavillai. Aanal ivarkal D.M.K-vai saarnthavarkal endru TVK-vinarum, ivarkal TVK-vai sernthavarkal endru D.M.K-vinarum Sun News veliyitta oru news card-ai samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindrana.
Ithil ethu unmaiyanathu endru ariya aayvu seithom. Ippadi oru news card-ai Sun News veliyittatha endru ariya athin Facebook pakkathai paarthom. Athil iruvar kaidhu seyyappattathu thodarbaha news card-ai veliyittirunthatha kandarinthom. Aanal athil avarkal iruvarum katchi kodi thundu ethaiyum aninthirukkavillai. Aayvukku eduthukkonda irandu news card-kalaiyum Sun News digital poruppalarukku anuppinom. Avarum ivai poliyanavai, edit seyyappattavai endru uruthi seithar.
Ithan moolam D.M.K matrum TVK ena iru tharappinarum Sun News veliyittiruntha news card-ai edit seithu vathanthi parappiyirunthu uruthiyagirathu. Intha aathaarankal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivukal edit seyyappattavai endru uruthi seyyappadukindrana.

investigation_details: Maerkanda news card unmaiya endru naam aayvu maerkondom. Appothu, idhu Pudhiya Thalaimurai peyaril bagirappadum poliyana news card, endru theriyanthadhu. Idharkoduthaga, ADMK I.T., pirivu nirvagi Gowri Shankar marupu therivithu, avaradhu X valaiThala pakkathil pathivu ondrai veliyittullaar. Adhuthappadiyaaga, Pudhiya Thalaimurai digital pirivu nirvagiyidam kaettapothu, ‘’Idhu engaladhu peyaril bagirappadum poliyana news card’’, endru therivithaar. Ivmatrin adippadaiyil, naam aayvukku eduthukonda news card poliyanathu endru, sandhagemindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Unmaiyaana ADMK-ve TVK-dhaan; solgiraar amaichar Aadhav
text:
Sengalpattu: 'Tharpothaiya soolalil unmaiyana ADMK-ve TVK-than. MGR, Jayalalithaa-vin aasi visis chinnathirku thaan irukkirathu,' endru Maduranthagam prasaara kootathil amaichar Aadhav therivithullar. Avar pesiyathu; Amaicharaaga, MLA-vaaga pesuvathai vida, TVK thondanaga pesuvathai santhosamaana vishayam. Sakkasayil pesinaal avai nerimurai endru pesa vidamaatteeranga. Athennamo theriyavillai, ezhunthu nindraale pesa vidamaatteeranga. Adutha murai moochu kooda vida mudiyathu pola. Sakkasayil mothamamaaga 'pack' seithu anuppittoma?. DMK 75 aandu katchi, periya alamaram, murungai maram endru ellam sonnaanga. Sakkasai mudhal naal ivangalukku (DMK) thaan arasiyal theriyum enbathaip pola kelambi vanthaanga. Aanal, kadisi naalil yaarume anga illai. Muthalvarai pesa pesa endru solvargal. Pesinaal, ezhunthu katha aarambithu, veliye kelambiduvaanga. Udhayanidhikku thaguthiyukka? 2026 sakkasai therthalukku munbu TVK kaanamal poyvidum endru sonnaargal. Aanal, sonnavarkal thaan kaanamal poyvittaarkal. Yaar yaarellam thorpom endru sonnavarkal ellam, sakkasaikku ulle sendru vittom. TVK eppadi jeyithathu endru DMK innum aaratchi pannittu irukkaanga. Athil, Stalin therthalukku piragu veliye vara maatteenguraaru. Kalyana veedugalil mattume pesi varukirar. Ethiri yaar endru theriyaamal prasaaram seithu vittom endru Udhayanithi solgiraar. Karunanithi-yin thiramaikku pakkathil varuvathu thaguthi, Stalin maganaga irunthal mattume pothathu. Ethirkkatchi thalaivarukku athu theriyavillai. Neraga vanthu thunai muthalvar, ethirkkatchi thalaivar aanathum nammai ellam kindal panraaram. Panam kodukka maattomGen Z katchi, Reels katchi, Instagram katchi endru nambalai paarthu kevalamaaga pesinarkal. Verum Instagram-ai vaithey ungalai (DMK) mudithu vittar enga mudhalvar. Ithankum engalai thalaivarai pirasaram seiya vidavey illai. Oozhal suthamaaga ozhikkappattathu. Karunanidhi, Stalin aatchiyil nadanthatha? Eduthavudaney MLA aniyoo, amaichar aniyoo, antha kudumbathirkku cutting (lanjam) kodukkanum. Athanpiraqu, amaichar kudumbam, amaichar PA kudumbam, amaichar machan kudumbam endru appadiye varisaiyaaga kodukkanum. Satta sabai therthalaippolave, intha idai therthalilum ottukku panam kodukka maattom. Ottukku panam kodukkum kalasaarathaiye ozhippom.
DMK deposit izhakkum. Kadanthu murai koduthathaippolave, DMK-vinar intha muraiyum ottukku thalaa 5 aayiram koduppaanga. Athai Deepavaliakku thuni vaanga vaithu kollalam. Namma makkal, kadantha murai maathiri kaasai vaangittu TVK-vukku oottu podaanga.
EPS-kku savaal
Peramboor pirasaramai mudithu vittu, Kolathooril 5 nimidam thaan thalaivar Vijay pirasaram seithar. Angu Stalin out. Edappadi thoguthiyil visil chinnathil vaetpalar nindrunthaal, EPS tholviyadayiruppaar. Athanaal, thaan panam koduthu settle seithu vittar. Mudinthaal pathavai raajinaama seithu vittu, EPS meendum pottiyeungal. Naangal visil chinnathil vaetpalarai niruthinaal vetti petru viduvom.
Unmaiyaana ADMK
DMK-vum, ADMK-vum kootani amaikka pechuvaarthai nadathiyullana. Ithai kootani katchigalaana VCK, Communist, Muslim League katchigaley kooriyullana. Oozhal, bayam kaaranamaaga sollaamal kooda Delhi-kku sellukindranr. ADMK mulumaiyaaga thudaitheriyappattullathu. Maduraiyil MGR-aiyum, Annaduraiyaiyum arasiyal thalaivargalaaga Vijay etrukkondaaro, appothu thaan unmaiyaana ADMK-vaaga TVK maariyathu. MGR, Jayalalithaa visuvaasigal, DMK-vai ethirkka Vijay thaan sariyaana thalaivar endru unarnthullana. Unmaiyaana ADMK-vinar oottuppottathaal thaan TVK 35 sathavitha oottugalai petrathu. Ippothu, irattai ilaiyum, visilum onraagi vittathu. DMK-vai ethirthu nindru arasiyal seiyum valimai Vijay-kku mattum irukkirathu. Ippothu irukkum ADMK, Edappadi ADMK endru thaan solla vendum. Irattai ilai mudinthu vittathu. MGR, Jayalalithaa-vin aasi visil chinnathirkku thaan irukkirathu.
Communist-kalukku kelvi
Communist katchiyinarai paarthu kaetkiren, CMDA-vil pona murai Rs.25 DMK-vil vaanginaarkala illaiya? TASMAC-il oozhal nadanthatha illaiya? Amaichargal, mudhalvar vaanginaarkala illaiya? mudhalvar kudumba nithi, katchi nithi vaanginaarkala? Illaiya? Nedunchaalai thuraiyil oozhal nadanthatha illaiya? DMK aatchiyil oozhal seiyavillai endru nenjai nimirthi solla mudiyuma? Ivaaru avar koorinar.

headline: ‘Naepaalam vellathil adiththu varappatta saalakiraama kal’ endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text: ‘‘Naepaalam vellathil adiththu varappatta saalakiraama kal,’’ endru koori, Ithil, ‘’ Naapaala vellathil adiththu varappattu periya salakram. . Ulagilae miga periya salakram ithu thaan..,’’ endru ezhuthappattullathu. Palarum ithanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seyvathaik kaana mudikirathu.
investigation_details: Maerkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu maerkondom. Appothu, ithu kadantha 2026 May maatham edukkappatta video endru theriyavanthathu. Aanaal, Naepaalathil erpatta thidheer vellapperukku setham August 26, 2026 andre nigalthathu. Ithanpadi, Naepaalathil ulla Jomsom – Gharapjhong endra idamulla oor nivaagam saarbaga migaperiya saalakiraama kallil sethakkappatta sakkarathai Sringeri Sharada Peetham pothumakkal vazhipattirku thiranthu vaithathu. Intha thuvakka vizhaavil saaratha madathin thalaimai sangaraachaariyaar kalanthukondaar. Koodutha aathaaram itho… Sringeri Peetham Link 1 l Link 2 Sirungeri saaratha madam samooga valaithalangalil veliyitta videovai eduthu, tharthaiya Naapaala vellapperukku sethathudan thodarbuthi, vathanthi parappukiraargal endru thelivagirkathu. Enavae, naam aayvukku eduthu konda videovukkum, Naepaalam vellathirkum entha thodarbum illai, endru sandhegamindri uruthi seyyappadukirathu.

headline: Indhiya thaakkuthalil paadhikkappatta Pakistan vimaana thalam endru paravum video unmaiya?
text: Indhiya nadathiya thaakkuthalil Pakistan-in vimaana thalam miga kadumaiyaaga sethamadainthathagaavadhum adhanaalthaan Pakistan saranadainthathu endrum oru video vimaana nilaiathil vimaanathin baagangal sitharikkidakkum video Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Nilaith thagavalil, “Pakistan thalaimai raanuva vimaana thalam saranadaintha kaaranam theriyutha?” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha videovai palarum samooga oodagangalil pathividu varugirargal.
investigation_details: Indhiya merkonda Operation Sindoor kaaranam Pakistan-in vimaana thalam miga kadumaiyaaga pathikkappattulla kaatchi endru merkanda video Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Ezharalaana vimaangal sithaintha nilaiyil irupathai, intha videovil kaana mudinthathu. Indhiya nadathiya thaakkuthal kaaranam intha paathippu erpattaatha enbata uruthi seithu kolla aayivu seithenam. Video kaatchiyai Pudaakkalaga maatru Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Appothu intha video 2025 April 1 mathiye yaavadhum Indhiya Operation Sindoor thaakkuthalai thodanguvatharku oru maathathirku munbe YouTube-il pathividappattirunthathai kaana mudinthathu. Athil, R.S.F poraali thaakkuthalukku piragu Khartoum vimaana nilaiyin nilai (STATUS OF KHARTOUM AIRPORT AFTER IT WAS VANDALIZED BY RSF FIGHTERS) endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha vimaana nilaiyam Sudan-in thalainagaril ullathu theriyanthathu. Inthan adippadaiyil thodarnthu thediyapothu veru pala pathivugal namakku kidaithana. Athil, “Sudan-in Khartoum vimaana nilaiyil Sudan raanuwathirku Rapid Support Forces amaippukkum nigalalntha thaakkuthalil migaperiya alavil vimaangal sethamadainthathu” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Indhiyin thaakkuthalil Pakistan-in vimaana padai thalam seerkulaiunthu kaanappadum kaatchi endru paravum video 2025 March maatham iruthiyilirunthu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vanthirupathai uruthi seithellom. Sudan-in vimaana nilaiyil nadantha thaakkuthal ithu enbatha uruthi seyyappattullathu. Intha aadharangal adippadaiyil naam aayivukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaraanathu enbathu uruthi seyyappadugirathu.

headline: Maruthamalayil thideer mazhai
text: Thondamuthur: Thondamuthur matrum Maruthamalai sutruppakuthigalil, netru kaalai muthale veylin thaakkam athigamaga irunthathu. Nilaimaiyil, netru maalai Maruthamalai paguthiyil thideerena 30 nimidangal kanamazhai peythathu. Thondamuthur, Vedapatti, Onappalayam sutruppakuthigalil, 30 nimidangal saaral mazhai peythathu. Pala naatkalaga veylin thaakkathil makkal thavithu vantha nilaimaiyil, thideer mazhaiyaal makkal magizhnthanaar.

headline: Pakistan cricket anikku 2040 aandu varai thadai vizhiththulllathaa?
text: Pakistan cricket anikku 2040m aandu varai ICC thadai vithiththullathu endru oru pathivu. Udhagangal veliyidum news card pola ICC pathirikai seithi, ICC thalaivar Jay Shah mattum Pakistan cricket veerargal pugappadaththudan pathivu Facebook-il veliyidappattullathu. Athil, “Pakistan anikku ICC - 2040 varai thadai vithiththullathu! Pakistan cricket vaariyaththirku, ICC oru aandu thadai vithiththu athigaarappoorvamaaga ariviththullathu. ICC koottaththil 14-2 endru vaakku viyaththiyaththil indha mudivu edukkappattathaka koorappadukirathu. Idhanaal PSL thodarukku thadai, varuvaay pangu kuraippu mattum 2040 varai ICC pottigalai nadaththa anumathu illai ena thaval therivikkirathu” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga udhagangalil pathivittu varugirargal.
investigation_details: 2040m aandu varai Pakistan anikku thadai endru kurippittu vittu, ullae 2040m aandu varai ICC pottigalai nadaththa thadai endru kurippittu pathivittullanaar. Aanal, ippadi oru arivippu edhaiyum ICC enappadum sarvadesa cricket vaariya veliyittathaka entha oru seithiyum illai. Maelum, news card-il ulla pathirikai seithi paarkka unmaiyanathu pola illai. Thaenalae, indha pathivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. ICC inaiya thalaththil pathirikai seithi pakuthikku senru samipaththil veliyana pathirikai seithigalai paarththom. T20 world cup 2026 thodarbaaga February 1m theethi arivikkai veliyiyirunthathu. Athai thavira world cup-in A, B anigal patriyum 19 vayathirku utpattavargalukkaana pottikku thodarbaana seithik kurippukal irunthana. February 1m theethi veliyiyiruntha arivikkaiyil Pakistan thodarbaaga kurippidappattirunthathu. Athilum Pakistan cricket vaariyam sumugamaana mudivai edukkum endru nambuvathaaga ICC kooriyirunthathu. Antha anikku thadai vithippathaaga athil kurippidappatavillai. Pakistan ani vilakkappattathaaga ICC athigaarappoorvamaana samooga udhaga pakkangalil thaval aethum veliyiyullathaa endru paarththom. Athilum appadi entha oru thavialum illai. Thaenalae, indha thaval thavaraanathaaga irukkum enpathu thelivanathu. Naam aayvukku eduththukkonda news card-il idam petriruntha pathirikai seithiyil idam petriruntha muthal irandu variyai appadiye Google-il type seythu thaedinom. Sila samooga udhagangalil antha pathirikai seithi veliyiyirunthathu. Aanal, entha oru athigaarappoorvamaana seithi udhagangalo, ICC-yo ithai veliyidavillai. Thaenalae, ICC-yin pazhaiya pathirikai seithi pugappadaththudan indha pathirikai seithiyai oppitta aayvaith thodarndhom. Circle Of Cricket enra Facebook pakkam ullitta pala samooga udhaga pakkangalil indha arivikkai veliyiyirunthathu. Doordarshanum ICC-yin pathirikai seithiyai veliyiyirunthathu. Doordarshan veliyiyirunthathaal athai aathaaramaaga eduththukkondom. ICC inaiya thalaththil veliyiyiruntha athe thaval Doordarshan veliyiyiruntha pathiviyilum appadiye irunthathu. Aanal, athil ICC thalaivar Jay Shah kaiyeluththu illai. Aanal naam aayvukku eduththukkonda news card-il Jay Shah kaiyeluththu irunthathu. English font-um viyaththiyamaaga irunthathu. Inthan moolam vishamaththanaana thavakai ICC pathirikai seithi vadivil poliyaaga uruvaakkiruvathu inthan moolam uruththiyagirathu. Indha aathaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduththukkonda news card-il ulla thaval thavaraanathu enpathu uruththi seyyappadukirathu.

headline: Vivasayiyai kondru thappiya vivasayi kaidhu
text: Bhavani:Bhavani arugai Kannadipalayam Pothanaayakkanoorai serndha vivasayi Kalanayakkar, 70; ivaradhu bangali Rangasami, 50; iruvarukkum nilam matrum vandhithadam thodarbaga munvirodam irunthathu. Netru mundhinam idthu thodarbaga erpatta vakkuvathil, Kalanayakkarai tractor yetri Rangasami kolai seithar. Ithai thodarndhu thappi odi vittar. Bhavani polisaar thedi vantha nilaiyil, Kadaiyampatti ring road paguthiyil, netru kaidhu seithenar.

headline: Nicholas Maduro viduthalaikaaga poradum Venezuela makkal endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Amerika kaithu seitulla Venezuela athibar Nicolas Madurovai viduvikka valiyuruthi Venezuela makkal periya moha porattamathai nadathiyathaaga video ondru

Venezuela naattuk kodiyudan brammaanda perani nadanthathu pondru video Facebook-il pathivappattullatru. Nilaith thakavalil, “Venezuela athibar Nicolas Madurovin viduthalaikkaaha thalainagar Caracas-in veethigalil ore udalaga ondrinainthulla makkal. Periya medangalil velivaaratha kaatchigal…” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha videovai palarum samooka medangalil pathivittu varukindranaar.
investigation_details:
Venezuela adhiparaga iruntha Nicholas Maduro-vai samipathil America athumeeri kaidhu cheythathu. Intha nilaiyil, avarai viduvikka kori Venezuela nattu makkal periya alavil paerani nadathiyathaaga video Facebook-il pathivupattullathu.
Videovai paarkum pothu makkal kootamaga paerani senrathu pola illai. AI moolam manithargal kootamaga selvathu ponru uruvakkappattathu ponru ullathu. Kodiyil ulla natchathirangalul onru thavaraaga irupathai kaana mudinthathu. Paeraniyil selbavargal kaigalai uyarthi goshidum katchiyil kaigalukku pathil viralgal illatha kai, kaal ponru thotram therigathu. Ivai ellam intha video AI moolam uruvakkappattirukkalam entra sandhegathai erpaduthiyathu.
Video katchigalai padamgalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil pathivaetri thedinom. Intha video patri entha thagavalum namakku kidaikkavillai. Palarum ithai pathivittirunthanrgal. Avartul TikTok cheyaliyil oruvar muthan muthalaga pathivittalathu ponru Google Lens kattiyathu. Nam nattil TikTok cheyalikku thadai ullathal, Ilangai kuzhuvinarin udaviyudan antha TikTok pathivai aayvuseithom. Athil antha video AI moolam uruvakkappattullathu endru kurippidappattullathu endru thagaval kidaithathu.
Intha video mattumrinri innum eralamaana porattam thodarpana videokkal AI moolam uruvakkappattu antha TikTok pakkathil pathivaettam seyyappattullathum theriyanthathu. Intha video-vai AI kandariya udavum inaiyathalangalil pathivaetri thedinom. Athum kooda ithu AI moolam uruvakkappatta video endru kooriyathu.
Thodarnthu thediyapothu, colombiacheck.com entra factcheck inaiyathalathil intha video thodarpu katturai veliyagi iruppathu theriyanthathu. Athil, intha video unmaiyanathu illai endru uruthi cheythinrunthanrgal. Athilum namakku kidaitha TikTok videovai aadharamaga vaithirunthanrgal. Athudan antha videovil Venezuela nattu kodi thavaraaga iruppathai kurippidittirunthanrgal.
Venezuela nattu kodiyil ulla natchathirangal sivappu pakkathai parthathu ponru arai vattam vadivil irukkum. Aanal, intha videovil manjal pakkathai parthathu ponru ullathu. Enavae, intha video poliyanathu endru kurippidittirunthanrgal. Namum antha nattu kodiyudan intha videovil idam pettriruntha kodiyai oppittu parthom. Natchathirangal thavaraaga iruppathu theliyanathu. Intha aadharangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaranathu endru uruthi cheyyappadugirathu.

headline: Sevai paathaiyil irundhu BJP eppodhum vilaagaadhu: Pradhan Mantri Modi pechu
text: Puthudill: "Arasiyalil, namakku evvalavu periya adigaaram kidaithalum, BJP orupothum sevai seyyum paathaiyil irundhu vilaagaadhu," ena, Pradhan Mantri Modi therivithullaar. Pradhan Mantri Modiyin 76vathu piranthaanaal matrum avarathu 25 aandukaala pothu vaazhvai kondaadum vidamaaga BJP sarbil 'Seva Sankalp Yaatra' nadathappadugirathu. Pradhan Mantriyin pirantha idamana Gujarat-in Vadnagar-il thodangi, avarathu Lok Sabha thoguthiyaana Uttar Pradesh-in Varanasi varai indha yaatra payanikkirathu. Ithil, naattin palveru paguthigalai serntha nootrukkanaka ilangargal pangeatrullar. Indha yaathraiyil pangeatra nabargal, Madhya Pradesh-in Dewas maavattathirku netru varugai thanthanar. Appothu, Delhi-yil irundhu video conference moolam Pradhan Mantri Modi avargaludan kalanthuraiyaadinaar. Ithai thodarnthu avargalidaiye Pradhan Mantri Modi pesiyathu: Arasiyal, therthalkal, aatchi ponravai avatrirkuuriya idamai kondu ullana. Aanaal, BJP-yin adithalamum nokkamum desathai katti ezhupvathum, nam naattin valarchiyai uruthi sevvathum thaan. Namakku evvalavu periya arasiyal adigaaram kidaithalum, BJP orupothum sevai seyyum paathaiyil irundhu maarathu. Gujarat muthal Delhi varai BJP-yin nirvagathirkum adhan kolkaigalkum sevai onre vazhiyaattum kolkaigaaga irunthu varugirathu. En vaazhkai, eppothum makkalin aasirvaadangalalum anbinalum vazhinadathappadugirathu. En vaazhvin thaaraga manthiramaaga eppothume pothu sevaiyae irunthu varugirathu. Ivaaru avar pesinaar.

headline: “Laila-Majnuvin original photo” endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiya?
text:
Laila Majnuvin original pugaippadam idhidhan endru oru pugaippadam

Aan, penn ena iruvarin pugaippathai ondra serthu Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Adhil, Laila, Majnu endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Nilaith thagavaldhil, “Ennangada solreenga.?
Idhan Laila Majnu original photo-va.?
Inga ivayinga ezhuthina paatellam vechu ithanai naal naan panni vechuruntha karpanaiyai ellam ore naalil antharasantharaiya norukkitteengada paavigala.!” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha pathivai palarum samuga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindrana.
investigation_details:
Kaalathal azhiyaatha kadhal kathaiyaga Laila – Majnu kadhal kathai ullathu. Ithu 7m nootrandin arabiyappakuthi kadhal kathai endru koorappadugirathu. 7m nootrandil pugaippada karvi ellam kidaiyaathu. Ulagin muthal pugaippadam 1826m aandu edukkappattathaga varalaru koorugirathu. Enave, 7m nootrandil vaazhnthavarin unmaiyana pugaippadam endru paravum thagaval thavaraanathu enbadhu thelivaga theriyirathu.
Intha pugaippadathil ullavargal yaar endru ariya aayvu seythu paarthom. Muthalil Laila endru kurippidappattulla pennin pugaippathai mattum thaniyaga eduthu Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Appothu, antha pennin pugaippathai sila pugaippadangalai virpanai seyyum inaiya thalangal virpanaiyaka vaithirunthathai kaana mudinthathu. Adhil Bedouin endru inathai sertha penn oruvarin pugaippadam, 1898-1914 kaalakkattil edukkappattathu endru kurippidappattirunthathu.
Syria pakuthiyai saarntha Bedouin ina penn endru intha pennin veru sila pugaippadangalaiyum antha pugaippadangalai virpanai seyyum thalangal vaithirunthana. Adhai eduthu, satru edit seythu kadhal kathaiyil varum Lailavin unmaiyana pugaippadam endru thavaraaga samuga oodakangalil pagirnthirupathu thelivanathu.
Aduthaaga Majnu endru kurippidappatta nabarin pugaippathai Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Pugaippadathil Irukkum nabar Qatar-ai saarntha Faraj bin Nasser bin Dalmuk Al-Marri endru kurippittu sila pathivugal namakku kidaithana. Invarin pugaippadam Sheikh Faisal bin Qasim Al Thani arungaatchiyakathil ullathu endru intha pugaippadam flickr.com enra inaiya thala pakkathil 2008m aandu pathivetram seyyappattirunthathu. Invarai ppathi kavidhai ondru paadappattu adhu YouTube-il kooda pathivetram seyyappattirunthathai kandarinthom.
Melum, pazhaiya pugaippadangalai eduthu Laila – Majnu endru silar thavaraaga samuga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindrana endru kurippittu silar veliyittiruntha X thala pathivugalum namakku kidaithana. Adhil, intha pugaippadangalil iruppavargal yaar endrum avargal veliyittirunthana. Ivai ellam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivil ithu Laila – Majnuvin unmaiyana pugaippadam endru kurippittiruntha thagaval thavaraanathu enbadhai uruthi seykindrana.

headline: `Police-aaga aasaippatta enakku uniform value theriyum; oruvitha kobathil!'- andru police-ai aditha Aakash
text:
Army training areayil NCC-yil irunthappa rendu naal training-il irunthirukken. Police uniform-oda value enakku theriyum. Thittamittu edhum nadakkavillai, nadantha sambavathukku manapoorvamaga mannippu kettukolgiren- Aakash
Tanjavooril anmathiyinri vaikkappatta flex maanagaraatchi sarbil agartappattadhi. Ithil VCK-vinar vaitha flex agartappattadhal akkatchiyar maanagaraatchi aluvalagam ethire thideer saalai mariyal poraattam nadathinar. Appothu antha idam kadakka muyantha Aakash entra ilainjarai VCK-vinar thaduthinar. Ithil VCK-vinarukkum, Aakashkkum idaiye vaakku vaatham erpattadhu.
Ithayaduthu angiruntha police-aar Aakash-idam pesiyullanaar. Appothu, `Naan enna thappu seithen ennai pesugireergal?' endruullaar Aakash. Ithil police sirappu sub-inspector Abdulraheem, Aakash-ai arainthu vidugiraar. Pathilukku Aakash-um Abdulraheem-ai adithu vittar.
Kalantha 17m thethi nadantha antha sambavam perum paraparappai erpaduthiya nilaiyil samooga oodakangalil intha kaatchigalum vegamaga paraviyathu. Nilaiyil, Aakash matrum avarkku aadharavaga pesiya Ayyappan iruvaraiyum kaithu seitha police-aar avarkal meethu pothu idathil aabasamaga pesuthal, kaayam erpaduthuthal, kalavarathai kattupaduthum paniyil eedupattulla pothu oozhiyai thaakkuthal, pothu oozhiyar thantha pothuppaniyai seya idaiyooru seithal, mirattuthal, arasu oozhiyar thantha kadamaiyai seyumbothu thaakkuthal, kaayam erpaduthuthal aagiya 7 pirivukalil vazhakku pathivu seithu Pudukottai siraiyil adaithinar.
Perum pesu porulana intha vivakarathil palarum Aakash-kku aadharavana pathivukalai pathivittinar. Adhe nerathil vimarshanamgalum elunthana. Ithayaduthu kaithu seiyappatta marunaale Aakash pinaiyil veliyey vanthaar. Avarkku udal reethiyaga prachanai iruppathal udane pinai perappattadaha solgiraar.
Intha vivaharam ipothum adangaamal munumunukkappadugirathu. Intha sujalil Thanjavoor, Velaar paguthiyil ulla veettil Aakash-ai santhithu pesinom,
``Naan pathaam vaguppil 424 mark eduthen, maths-il 98 markku eduthu school topper-aaga vanthaar. B.Sc Maths padithirukkiren. Raanuva veerar allathu police aaga vendum enbathu thaan en kanavu. Atharkaagave palli, kalloorikalil NCC-yil sernhen.
Kallooriyil padithappothu vibathil sikkiyathil thalaiyil balamaga adippattathu. Atharku pirappu enakku fits varum itharkaaga regularly maathirai eduthu varugiren. Atharku pirappu raanuva veerar aaga vendum enbatha en kanavu posungiyathu. Police-um aagamaudiyavillai. Gym-il trainer aanen. Thanjavooril iruntha SP sir oruvarukku trainer-aaga irunthirukkiren. NCC-yil irunthathal corona lockdown samayathil thannaarvalarkalai orunginathu vizhuppunarvu seithen.
Kaathal thirumanam
Inthasujalil, Islamic maththai serntha pennai kaathalithu thirumanam seithen. Engalukku oru mahal irukkiraal. Kaathal thirumanam seithathal enakku pala prachanaigal irukkuthu. Pattiyalinasai serntha naan saathi reethiyaga pala valigalai anubavithirukkiren. Ithanal en magalukku Islamic entu community certificate vaangiken. Antha kobathil appa ennai kandu kollamal odhu vaithudun pala vagaiyil kudachal koduthu varugiraar.
Ithanal kadan sumai en thalaiyil vizhunthathu. Kudumbathai kaakkavum, kadanai adaikkavum pakalil gym trainer-aagavum, iravil chicken pannaiyilum velai seithen.
Sariya thoongalaina enakku fits vanthidum. Aanaalum panathevai irukkudhen enneramum odinen. Appa vagaiyil engalukku pala prachanaigal irukku. Ammavukku 61 vayathu aaguthu. Ipp varaikum Aadhaar ullaitta entha proof-um kidaiyaathu. Ammavukku Aadhaar edupatharkaaga kidacha nerathil alainjen. Itharkaaga taluka office ponappathaan intha sambavam nadanthathu. Poraattam nadathiyavarkalil silar ennaiyum, en kudumbathaiyum thagaatha vaarthaikalil pesinar. Appaguda naan entha bad words-um use pannala aanaal trigger aakitten. Amaidhipadutha vantha police oruvar eduthadume vandy station-kku vidununnar. Naan enna sir thappu senjen, poraattam nadathiyavarkalai pesamal ennai pesureergal, palar two wheeler-il kadanthu ponaanaal naanuman vanthenu sonnen.
Anaivarukkum en nandrigal!
Atharku pirappu Abdulraheem sir vanthaar. Appathaan etho kobathil antha sambavam nadanthu vittathu. Atharku pirappu station-ukkul nadanthavai ennodu pokattum. Antha soozhalilum en nilaiyai unarndhu Vishnu Prasad SI sir ullaitta police-aar rombave parivu kaatthi paathukappaga irunthanaar. NCC-yil irunthapothu army training areayil rendu naal training-il irunthirukken. Police-aaga aasaippatta enakku police uniform-oda value theriyum. Nadantha sambavathukka mannippu kettukolgiren. Intha vivaharakathil enakku thunai nintra media and samooga oodakangalil, arasal katchiyar anaivarukkum en nandrigal.
18m thethi enakku piranthanaal aanaal sariya iravu 12.05 manikku enakku sirai kadhavu thiranthathu. Nadantha ella valigalai maranthu, kadanthu vaazha vendum. Naan velaikku poi oruvaram aagi vittathu. Chicken company-yil ennai velaiyai vittu eduthu vittaran. Ennai nambi vanthavala kaakka vendum, porulaathaarathirkaaga velaikku sella vendum, enakku maruthu, maathirai vaanga vendum, kaathal thirumana seithatharkana ethirppai samaalippa vendum. Ippadi pala sikkalangalai naan kadakka vendum. Naan senjathukku Abdulraheem sir-kitta manapoorvamaga mannippu kaetten, avaroom eettikkittu sorry sonnaar.
Oru vidha kobathil ella nadanthu mudinthu vittathu!
Enakku kudumbathodu nalla vaazhanum, en magalai aalaakkanum. En meethum, enakku support seitha kaaranathirkaaga Ayyappan meethu pathiyappatta vazhakukalai rathu seiya vendum. Thittamittu edhum nadakkavillai, oru vitha kobathil ella nadanthu mudinthu vittathu. Ini nadappavai nallavaiyaai amaiyanum. En vaazhkai nallapadiya amaiyavum, en kudumbathinarukkaagavum Tamil Nadu Mudalvar Vijay sir ithil thalaiyittu en meethuulla vazhakai rathu seivatharkaaga nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Nadanthaavaitku meendum oru murai mannippu kettukolgiren" endraar.

headline: APPLE-il mudhal madikkakkoodiya iPhone.. pala surprise madakkal indru veliyedu!
text:
Apple puthiya thalaimai seyal athikari John Turnus poruppetrru piragu nadathum muthal “Surprise and Shine” nigalvu inru iravu 10.30kku Apple Park thalaimaiyagathil nadakkirathu. Ithil pala varuda vathanthiukalukku piragu, puthaka vadiva madippu amaippudan, “iPhone Ultra” enra peyaril Apple-in muthal madikkakkudiya iPhone arimugamakkum ena ulagam muluvathum perum ethirpaarppu nilaiyiruthu.
Apple-in puthiya thalaimai seyal athikariyaaga John Turnus poruppetrrpiragu nadathum muthal nigalvu ‘Apple thiruvizha’ pola inru nadakkirathu. Tholilnutpa ulagin kavanathai perithum eirthirukkum intha brammanda nigalvu "Surprise and Shine" enra peyaril inthiya nerappadi inru iravu 10.30 manikku nadaiperugirathu.
California-vil ulla Apple Park thalaimaiyagathil nadaiperum intha nigalvil, muthal madikkakkudiya iPhone modal arimugamakkum ena perithalavil ethirpaarkkirathu. Adhutan iPhone 18 Pro series, puthiya Apple Watch modalgal matrum mempaduthappatta AirPods ponra features-um kavanam peruginrana. Intha nigalvai neralai moolam Apple niruvanathin athikaarappoorva inaiyathalam, Apple TV app matrum Apple niruvanathin athikaarappoorva YouTube channel vazhiyaga payanargal paarkka erpaadugal seyyappattullantha.
Intha aandu nadaiperum Apple veliyettu nigalvai special-agavum, elloraiyum paarkka thoondum onraagavum maatruvatharku mukkiya kaaranam ‘madikkakkudiya iPhone’-aaga irukkalaam.. Itho varugirathu, ippo vanthuvidum enra pala varuda vathanthiukalukku piragu, Apple thanathu muthal madikkakkudiya iPhone-ai inthamurai arimugam seyyum endru paravalaga ethirpaarkkirathu.
Intha modal “iPhone Ultra” endru peyaril veliyidappadum endrum, Samsung-in Galaxy Z Fold thodar-ai ponra puthaka vadiva madippu amaippai kondirukkum endrum koorappadugirathu. Kasintha thagavalinpadi, Apple niruvanam 'Hinge' paguthiyil athika kavanam seluthuvathagavum, ul thiraiyil theriyum madippai kuraiyullathagavum theriyuthu. Ithavaraiyil illatha athika vilai konda iPhone-aaga ithu irukkum endru ethirpaarkkirathu. Ithan vilai 2,500 dollarukkum athikamaga irukkum ena therivikkappattullantha. Ithave Apple-in ithavaraiyilana iPhone-galilae mikavum premium aanathu aagum. Inthiyavil itha vilai thoraiyamaaga 2.6 latcham roobai ena koorappadugirathu.
Athapola foldable iPhone-udan, vazhakkamana premium varisaiyil iPhone 18 Pro matrum iPhone 18 Pro Max modalgalum arimugamakkum ena ethirpaarkkirathu. Intha modalgalil munthai features-ai oppidumpothu periya maattrangal irukkathu endralum, thirai matrum munpakka camera amaippil sila mukkiya maattrangal idampera vaippulla irukkuthu endru theriyuthu. Athaneram Pro modalgalil puthiya A20 Pro chip, mempaduthappatta battery aayul matrum kurippiduthakka camera mempadugal idamperakkoodum ena thagavalkal therivikkinrana.
Athathodarnthu Apple Watch Series 12 matrum oru puthiya Apple Watch Ultra ponra features-um, puthiya AirPods-um arimugamakalaam ena ethirpaarkkirathu.
