headline: BRICS maanattuku varum seena athibar prathamar Modiyai sandhikkiraar
text:
'BRICS' maanattuku varum seena athibar prathamar Modiyai sandhikkiraar
Putudilli: 'BRICS' uchi maanattukkaaka Dilli varum seena athibar Shee Jinping, prathamar Modiyai sep., 12 antru sandhithu irutharappu uravu kurithu pesa ullatha thaval veliyakiyullathu.
Inthiya -- Seena idaiyaana iru tharappu uravil paraspara nambikkai kuraivagave ullathu. 2020l Kalvaan pallathakkil erpatta mothalukku pin, iru naadukalin uravil erpatta pathatram padippadiyaaka kurinthu varukirathu.
Nilaimaiyil, Inthiya thalaimaiyil nadakkum, 'BRICS' maanadu irutharappu uravai adutha kattathukku kondu selvathaana vaaippai erpaduthum ena ethirpaarkkirappadukirathu.
Preesil, Rashya, Inthiya, Seena aakiya naanku naadukaludan, 'BRICS' entra peyaril intha amaippu uruvanathu. 2011l intha amaippil then Aaprikkaa inainthathum, 'BRICS' ena peyar maatruppattathu.
Intha aandukkaana BRICS uchi maanadu, Putudilliyil ulla Paarath Mandapathil naalai matrum naalai matrunal nadakkirathu. Prathamar Modi thalaimaiyil nadakkum maanattil, BRICS uruppu naadukalin thalaivarkal, velinaattu pirathinithikal, antharatthiya amaippukalin thalaivarkal, mukkiya piramukarkal pangetra ullanar.
Seena athibar Jinping Dilli varuvathu netru uruthi seyyappattathu. Ithai thodarndhu, prathamar Modiyai naalaiya thinam Dilliyil avar sandhithu pesa ullatha thaval veliyaki ullathu.

headline: Sothu thagararil thandhaiyai kondra maganuku kaapu
text: Trichy: Sothu thagararil, Ganesan, 70, enbavarai arivalal vetti kondra avarathu magan Mani, 48, enbavarai, police-ar kaidhu seithanar. Trichy mavattam, Thuraiyur, Kottaithoorai sernthavar Ganesan. Manaiviyai izhantha ivaar, thaniye vasikiraar. Ivarukku, Mani, Saravanan, 47, Manohar, 45, ena, moondru magankalum, Revathy, 43, entra magalum ulnar. Anaivarukkum thirumanam aagi, thanithaniye vasikiranar. Ithil, Mani mattum, Ganesan veettaruge, kudumbathudan vasikiraar. Anmaiyil Ganesan than poorveega nilathil siru paguthiyai, 3.50 latcham roopaikku vittulaar. Athil Mani pangu ketka, netru mundhinam nalliravu, iruvarukkum thagararu erpatathu. Ithil, aathiramadaintha Mani, arivalal vettiyathil Ganesan uyirizhanthaar. Thuraiyur police-ar, netru Maniyai kaidhu seithanar.

headline: Godhra rail erippu sambavathin mukiya kutravaali Rafeeq Hussain Bathuk endru paravum pookappadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’Gothra rail erippu sambavathin mukkiya kuttravaali Rafeeq Hussain Badhuk’’ endru koori,

Idhil, ‘’ Ivan Rafeeq Hussain Badhuk,
Godhraavil irandu petrol bambukalin urimaiyalarum oru thulukka iyakka thalaivarumanavan… 23 varudangalkku munbaaga Gujarat Godhra rail nilaiyathellam railai erikka ilavasamaaga petrol kodutha
Indha Jihadi Sabarmati Express railukku petrol ootri thee vaithu piragu 14 aandukalaaga thalaimaraivaaga irundhaan…
Ivanai Gujarat ulavu pirivu police-ar thedik kondirundhanar.
Iruthiyaaga Delhiliyul avarathu maraividathai police-ar kandupidithu
Avanai siraiyil adainthanar… Needhimandrathil kuttravai oppukkonda piragu, avanukku aayul thandanai vithikkappattathu..
Godhraavil Sabarmati Express-il eerpatta thee vibathu thannichaiyanathu endrum, yaaralum vendumendre erikkappadavillai endrum Lalu Yadav utpada DMK, thulukka red light payalgal ,Congress, Communist ellaam kooriyathu ninaivirukkiratha?
Indha unmaigal anaithum needhimandrathil velichathukku vandana… Tamizhaga red light ueedakangal indha seithiyai veliyidavillai. Indha unmai therinthu kollungal nandri vanakkam ” endru ezhuthappattullathu. Idhathudan pugaippadam onrum inaikkappattullathu.
Palarum ithanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaikalangalil share, comment seithu varukirargal.
investigation_details: Merkatta pookappathathil ulla nabar yaar endru thaval thedinom. Appothu, ivar Godhra Train Burning vazhakil, arasu tharappu vazhakarinaraaga aajaragi, vaathaadiya RC Kodekar endru theriya vanthathu. Melum, avarathu pookappathathai thavaraaga payanpaduthi, silar samooga valaiyathalgalil Godhra rail erippu vazhakkin kutravaali Rafeeq Hussain Bathuk endru vathanthi parappukirargal. Ithupatri kadantha 2024m aandu RC Kodekar police pugar alithullar. Kadantha 2024m aandu Godhra rail erippu vazhakkil kutravaaligalukku petrol koduthu uthaviyathaaga kutrasaatappadubavar Rafiq Hussain Bhatuk. Ivar, 19 aandukal thalaimaraivaaga iruntha nilaiyil, 2021m aandu polisaridam sikkinaar. Idhai adutthu, avar meedhana kutrasaattai uruthi seitha neethimandram, kadantha 2022m aandu avanukku aayul thandanai vithithathu. Bussiness Standard l Economic Times l Hindustan Times Ithudarkaga, arasu tharappu sirappu vazhakarinaraar RC Kodekar enbavaridam betti eduthu, ANI oodagam 2022m aandu seithi ontrai veliyittirunthathu. Aanaal, antha seithiyin thalaippu mattum athil inainthirundha pookappadam irandaiyum thavaraaga purinthukonda silar, vazhakarinaraar RC Kodekar pookappathathai eduthu, kurippitta vazhakkil thandanai vithikkappatta kutravaali Bathuk endru vathanthi parappa thodanginar. Idhai adutthu, RC Kodekar police-il pugar seithaar. Athamaaram, 2022m aandu veliyitta seithiyaal erpatta kuzhappam patri, 2024m aandu ANI oodagam vilakkam alithathu. Ithaiya sutruzhul, meendum indha vathanthiyai unmai theriyaamal silar thamizhmozhiyil parappuvathaga, thelivagirathu. Unmaiyaana Rafiq Hussain Bhatuk pookappathathudan, naam aayvukku eduthu konda pookappathathaiyum oppeedu seithu, keezhe inainthullom. Enavae, naam aayvukku eduthu konda pookappathathil iruppavar 'Rafeeq Hussain Bathuk' kidaiyaathu endru sandegamindri uruthi seiyappadugirathu.

headline: Arasu palligal moodal.. kuraintha maanavar varugai.. veliyaana athirchi vivaram!
text: Tamilnaattil 14 aayirathukkum meRbhaDha patta arasu thodakka pallikalil 30kkum kurivaana maanavargalae padithuvaruvathaaga atharchith thagaval vèLiyAghi uLLadhu. Ithukoorithu virivaana seithiyai paarkalaam. Tamilnaattil ulla 14,829 arasu thodakka pallikalil 30kkum kurivaana maanavargalae payinthu varuvathaaga atharchith thagaval vèLiyAghi uLLadhu. Ithil 3,027 pallikalil 10kkum kurivaana maanavargalum 6,662 arasu thodakka pallikalil 20kkum kurivaana maanavargalum padikkirargal. Thiruvannamalai, Krishnagiri, Salem aagiya maavattangalil ulla pallikalilaeyae innilai athigalavil ullathu. India muzhuvum arasu palli maanavar ennikkai sarinthuvarugathu. Pala arasu pallikal moodappaduginrana. Mathiya arasin 'UDISE+' tharavukalinpadi, kadantha moontru aandukalil mattum Tamilaga arasu pallikalil maanavar serkkai 7.39 laksham kurainthullathu. Maanavar serkkai illathathaal Tamilnaattil 246 arasu thodakka pallikal moodappattullanra. Arasu pallikalil anglakkalvi arimugappaduththappattalum thaniyar pallikalai naadum pokku pettroridaiyae athigarithu varuvathaaga koorappadugirathu. Perumpalaana arasu pallikalil mazhalaiyar vaguppugal illathathaal aarambaththil thaniyar palliyil pillaihaail serkkum pettror, angaeyae kalviyai thodarvathaaga nipunargal kooruginrargal. 30kku kurivaana maanavargal padikkum pallikalil or aasiraiyaeyae thalaiyai aasiraiyaagavum seyalpattu anaiththu paadangalaiyum edkka vendiyullathu. Ithanaal intha pallikalil payilum maanavargaludea kalvi baadhikkappaduvathaaga kalviyaalargal kavalai thervippinrargal. Arasuth thodakka pallikalil kurainthu varum maanavar serkkaiyai uyarththavum, thodakka kalviyin tharathai maembaduththavum pothumaana aasiraiyaargalai niyamiththal, mazhalaiyar vaguppugalai virivupaduththuthal mattrum adippadai ulkattamaippugalai valuththuthal aagiya vattrukku munnurimai alikka vendiya avasiyam erpattullathaaga kalviyaalargal kooruginrargal.

headline: Adhimel adhi vaangum America.. Submarine-ai kaipatriya Iran.. Veliyana paraparappu thagaval!
text:
Seithiyalar: M.Meera
Melku Asiyavil America–Iran idaiyeyana mothal theeviramadainthu varum nilaiyil, Iran athibar Masuth Peseshkiyan, akkiramipalarkal mulumaiyaga varunthum nilaiqukku thallappadum varai Iran thanathu ethirppai thodarum endru therivithullar. Atheneratthil, Iran eppothum porai ethirthu vanthathum, makkalin nalanaiyum Melku Asiya piranthiyathin pathukappaiyum karuthil konde porai thavirkka muyalvathagum avar koorullar.
Aanal, nattin meedu nadathappadum thakkalukalil irunthu thangalai tharkathukkolla Iran thodarnthu uruthiyudan seyalpadum endrum therivithullar.
Itharkidaiye Iran meedana porulathara aluththai America athigarithullathu. America karuoolathu thurai, 27 Iraniya viman niruvanangalai thadai seithullathu. Iranin varthaka viman niruvanangal atchiyin nadavadikkalaikku atharavalippathagum, IRGC ayuthangal, upakaranangal matrum aatkalai konduchella thaniyar viman niruvanangalai payanpaduthuvathagum America kurramsattiyullathu.
Intha soolalil Harmus neer معلوماتai sutri puthiya pathatram uruvagiyullathu. Iraniya puratchikara kavalarkal America porkappal meedu ballistic eyvaganikal moolam thakkal nadatha muyalvathai thodarnthu, ainthu Iraniya kacha ennaiykkappalai America padaitkal alithathaga CENTCOM therivithullathu.
Ithanai thodarnthu America ranuvathin mikavum naveenamana alilla neerumoolgi kalan onrai Harmus neerinaiyin nulayavail pakuthiyil kaippatriyullathu Iran kadarpadai therivithullathu.
Islamiyap puratchikara kavalar padaiyana IRGC-yin athigarpoorva udamana ‘Sebas News’ veliyitta thagalinpadi, sikkalana ulavu nadavadikkaiyin moolam ‘Dive-LD’ ena adayalam kanappatta alilla neerumoolgi kalanai Iran kaippatriyathagac koorullathu. Ithodarkana kanoli onraiyum Iran veliyittullathu.
Dive-LD enbathu Americavukkaga uruvakkappatta alkadal alilla neerumoolgi kalan thothilnutpangalil ondrakum. Kadarpadai veerarkalin uyirukku aapathu erpadamal, neenda thoorad kadal pakuthigalai kankanippathu, ulavu thagavalkalai sekarippathu, ethirigalin kappalkal matrum neerumoolgi kappalkalai kankanippathu utlitha panigalukkaga ithuntha alilla amaippugalai America athigalalil payanpaduthi varukirathu.
Dive-LD 10 natkal varai neerukkullaye seyalpadakkootiyathu. Melum, sumaru 6,000 meetar (19,700 adi) aluam varai moolgum vagayil ithu vadivamaikkappattathu. Inthan vilai sumaru 2.5 million America dolarukal enavum koorappadukirathu.
Intha alilla neerumoolgi kalanai kaippatriyathaga Iran kooriyulla nilaiyil, America ranuvamum ithodarkaga arikkai veliyittullathu. Athil, atharku muntheya naal kadal pakuthiyil ayvu nadavadikkaiyil eedupattiruntha neerukkadiyil iyangum alilla drones-galil ondru seyalinanthuvittathu endru America therivithullathu. Aanal antha sathanam Iranal kaippatriyappattatha enbathai America uruthippaduthavillai. Melum, athu palaiya model endrum, mukkiyamana thagavalkalai sekarippum thirano, ragasiya sonar allathu radar karuvigalo athil illai endrum Pentagon therivithullathu.

headline: "Kudumbap padam" endru Vijay - Trisha patri pagarappum pugaippadam unmaiya?
text:
Nadigar Vijay matrum nadigai Trisha inainthu ore kudumbamaga ullanar endru vishamathanathudan oru pugaippadam

Velankanni Maadha suroobathin munbu nadigar Vijay matrum Trisha muzhanthaal padiyittapadi irukkum pugaippadam Facebook-il pathividappattullatil, "Antony pothuvaa maadakooda kudumbathodaathane photo eduppom?" endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha pugaippadathai palarum samooka oodakangalil pathivittu varukindrana.
investigation_details:
Nadigar Vijay matrum avarathu manaivi Sangeetha Velankanni Maadha suroobathirku munbu muzhanthaal padiyittapadi irukkum padam pala aandukalukku munbu veliyanathu. Intha pugaippadathai samooka oodakangalil avarathu rasigargal avappothu pathivittu varukindrana. Antha pugaippadathai AI moolam maatri Sangeethavukku pathil nadigai Trisha padathai vaithu silar samooka oodakangalil pathivittu varukindrana.
Nadigar - nadigaigal ontraga irukkum pugaippadathai samooka oodakangalil pathividuvathu ontrum thavaranathu illai. Aanal, pothuvaaga intha mathiri Velankanni Maadha suroobathin munbu kudumbamaakathaan pugaippadam eduppargal endru oru vishamathanamaana karuthai sethiruppathin moolam, nadigar Vijay - nadigai Trisha ore kudumbamaga irukkindrana enpathu pontra karuthai pathivittullana. Enave, intha pugaippadam thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Padathai paarkum pothe edit seyyappattathu enpathu thelivaga therigirathu. Velankanni Maadha suroobathin mugam thelivaga illai. Seyarkai nunnarivu moolam padathai maatrum pothu mugam sithaivurruullathai kaana mudikirathu. Nadigar Vijay - Sangeetha unmai pugaippadam eppothu veliyanathu enpathai kandariya mudiyavillai. Aanal, pala aandukalaga athu samooka oodakangalil pagarappattu vanthiruvathai kaana mudikirathu. 2014m aandil intha pugaippadam X thalathil veliyai irunthathai kaana mudinthathu.
Vijay - Trisha pugaippadathai AI pugaippadangalai kandariyum thalathil pathivetri aayvu seythom. Avai ellavattarilum ithu seyarkaiyanathu, AI moolam uruvaakkappattathu enre namakku mudivukal kittanathu. Intha aatharangal adippadaiyil nadigar Vijay - Trisha Maadha silai munbu muzhanthaal padiyittirukkum pugaippadam poliyanathu endru uruthi seyyappadugirathu.

headline: Pagutharivai parappuvathakkoori payirkalai pidungukintanarae Kundrakudi Ponnambala Adigal vedhanai
text:
Madurai: 'Silar aanmigathai parappuvathaga kalaigalai payiridukinranar. Silar pagutharivai parappuvathakkooti payirkalai pidungukinranar' ena, Kundrakudi Ponnambala Adigal pesinaar.
Madurai Senthamizh kallooriyil naankam Thamizh sanga 125vathu aandu vizha nadanthathu. Sanga thalaivar Nagenhdra Sethupathi thalai vagithar. Thunai thalaivar Durai Karunanidhi, Thiruvalluvar kazhaga mathippiyal thalaivar Kamalai Vijayarajan munnilai vagithar. Kalloori mudhalvar Shanthidevi varavetrar.
Thanjai kalai munnaal perasiriyar Pazhani Arangasamy thuvakki vaithu pesinaar. Aandu malarai Kundrakudi Ponnambala Adigal veliyida, munnaal needhipathi Sureshkumar petrar.
Ponnambala Adigal pesiyathu: Thamizh varalatrin ucham Maduraiyil irupathai arinthu kolla vendum. Silar aanmigathai valarpathaga, payirkalukku bathil kalaigalai payiridukinranar. Silar pagutharivai parappuvathaga kalaigalukku bathil payirkalai pidungukinranar. Intha muranpatta nilaiyai kalainthaal Thamizh samookam valam perum. Ethanai illakiyam irunthaalum vazhakkarkku vazhikaattuvathaga Thirukkural thigazhgirathu. Naam edhaik katraalum manitha samookathirku payanpada vendum.
Ivaaru pesinaar.
Yathavar kalloori munnaal perasiriyar Ramasamy, Thyagarajar kalloori munnaal mudhalvar Arunagiri, thunai mudhalvar Subbulakshmi, perasiriyar Poongothai utpada palar pesinaar. Sangach seyalalar Mariappa Murali, kalloorich seyalalar Dasaratharaman, Puratchi Pavalar Mandra thalaivar Varatharajan utpada palar pangenrnar.

headline: Paadhikkappattavarkalai Panaiyoorukku azhaiththa Vijay endru paravum news card unmaiya?
text:
Karoor koottam nerisalil uyirizhandhavarkalin kudumbathinarai Panaiyoorukku azhaiththa Vijay endru oru thagaval
Nadigar Vijay pottakkaraththudan News18 Tamilnadu veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il pathiyappattulladhu. Adhil, “Badhikkappattavarkalai Panaiyoorukku azhaiththa Vijay! Karooril pirachaaraththin pothu ērpatta koottam nerisalil uyirizhandha 41 paerin kudumbangalukku thala Rs.20 latcham nithiuthavi matrum nivaranam vazhanganga thavēka thalaivar Vijay Panaiyoorukku azhaiththullathaaga thagaval. Vara iruthikkul avarkalai Panaiyoorukku azhaiththuvara nirvaakigalukku utharavittullathaagath thagaval” endru kurippidappattulladhu.
Nilai thagavalil, “#tahēka_unmaiyana #thondarkalin_kavanathirku ..! #Karooril badhikkappatta makkalē uyirizhandha 41 manitha pirathangalai thookkikkondu udanē Panaiyoorukku sellungal ungal Vijay azhaikkiraar” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindranaar.
investigation_details: Karooril nadantha TVK pirachaara koottamnil erpatta koottam nerisalil sikki 41 paer uyirizhanthanar. Avarkalin kudumbangalai ithuvarai nakarilum TVK thalaivaruman Vijay santhikkavillai. Intha nilaiyil paadhikkappattavarkalin kudumbathinarai Panaiyooril ulla thannudaiya aluvalakathirku Vijay azhaiththathu pondru news card Facebook utlitta samooga oodakangalil pakirappattu varukirathu. Vijay arivippu veliyittathaaga kurippidappadavillai, appadi oru thagaval iruppathu pondru vathanthiyai parappiyullanar. News card paarka News 18 Tamil Nadu veliyitthathu pol irunthalum, font - design satru vithiyaasamaka irunthathu. Enavae, intha news card unmaiya endru ariya aayvu seythom. Intha news card-ai News 18 digital poruppalarukku anuppinom. Avarum ithu poliyanathu enbathai uruthi seythaar. Maelum, ithu thodarbaaga News 18 Facebook pakkathil maruppu veliyittiruppathaaga athan inaippaiyum aliththaar. Athil, “#JUSTIN Karoor koottam nerisalil uyirizhanthorin kudumbangalai Vijay Panaiyoorukku azhaiththathaaga News 18 peyaril Fake Card” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Ivai ellam intha news card poliyanathu enbathai uruthi seythana.

headline: Neerizhivu nooy| adhigamaaga paadhikkappadum pengal.. aanangalai vida 4 madangu adhigappaadhippu!
text: Neerizhivu nooy pengalukku aanangalai vida pala madangu theeviramaakap paadhikkiradhu ena maruthuvargal echcharikkirandrar. (Note: echcharikkirargal) Eestrogen, progesterone hormone maatrangal, maadhavidaay suzharchi, garbakala neerizhivu, P.C.O.D pondra kaaranangal insulin edhirppai adhariththu (adhariththu) type-2 neerizhivu aabaayaththai uyarththukindrana. Idhanaal pengalukku idhaya nooy, mananala prachchanaigal adhigarikkiya nilaiyil, udappayirchi (udatpayirchi), naarpaththu unavu, yedai kattupaadu, sarkarai parisodhanai avasiyam ena nibunargal valiuruththukindrana (valiyuruththukindrana). Neerizhivu enbadhu oru podhuvaana nooyaakak karuththappattalum, adhu aangan matrum pengalin udalil yerpaduththum thaakkangal muttrilum verupattavai ena maruthuva nibunargal suttikkattukindrana. Pengalin udalil estrogen matrum progesterone pondra hormone maatrangal thodarchiyaaga yerpadugindrana. Maadhavidaay suzharchiyin irandaam paadhi, garbakkaalaththil yerpadum indha hormone maatrangal selgalin insulin yerpum thiranak kurainthu, insulin edhirppai adharikkindrana (adhikarikkindrana). Kurippaaga, ilangangalidaiye (ilangalin idaiye / ilangap pengalidaiye) paravalaakak kaanappadum P.C.O.D enappadum neerkkattip prachchanai, type-2 neerizhivu nooy varuvatharkaana aabaayaththai pala madangu uyarththukiradhu. Garbakala neerizhivu, prasavaththirkup piragu sariyaagivittalum, pirkkaalaththil thaay matrum kuzhandhai iruvarkume nirandhara sarkarai nooy varuvatharkaana vaaippai uruvaakkiradhu. Melum estrogen alavu thidirenak kurainthu kozhuppu serkkaikkum raththa sarkarai alavu kattupaadattru uyarvatharkum vazhiyavukkiradhu (vazhiyavugiradhu). Idhu neerizhivu nooyaal paadhikkappatta pengalukku idhaya kolaarugal yerpaduvatharkaana vaaippai aanangalai kaattilum irandu muthal naangu madangu varai adhigarichcheivathaaga idhaya nooy nibunargal echcharikkirargal. Podhiya udappayirchiyinmai matrum thookkaminmai kaaranamaaga yerpadum naalpatta mana azhuththam, cortisol pondra stress hormonesai surakkach seidhu raththa sarkarai alavai uyarththukiradhu. Enave, pengal thangal udal yedaiyai seeraga paramaariththu, naarpaththu niraaindha saravigitha unavu murai, dhinasari udappayirchi matrum thodarchiyaana sarkarai alavu parisodhanai merkolluvadhu avasiyam ena maruthuvargal arivuruththukindrana.

headline: Seeman naditha mudhal thiraippada kaatchi endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Naam Thamizhar Katchiyin thalaimai orunginaippaalar ‘Manithan’ entra Thamizh thiraippadathil muthal muraiyaaga thirudan vedathil nadithar endru oru video

Rajinikanth naditha Manithan thiraippadathil idam petra “Vaanathai parthen” endru thodangum paadal kaatchiyin sila vinaadi paguthi threads.com-l pathividappattullathu. Athil, Naam Thamizhar Katchiyin Seeman pola irukkum nabar koottathil oru nabaridam irunthu thiruduvathu pontru kaatchi irunthathu. Video meethu, “Eppo antha characterla nadichaaro appo irunthu ipo varai athe characterla than irukkar antha characteragavae maarittar. Seeman naditha mudhal paathiram Manithan padathil” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha videovai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindranaar.
investigation_details:
Rajinikanth nadithu 1987am aandu veliyaana Manithan thiraippadathil oru paadal kaatchiyil thirudan vedathil Seeman nadithathaaga videovai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindranaar. Seemanin mugam tharpothu ullathu pola vayathu muthirndha thotrathil ullathu. Padam vantha nerathil Seemanukku 20 – 21 irukkalam. Enave, intha video poliyanathu endru therinthathu. Ithai uruthi seyya aayvu seythom.
Video thelivaga illai. Seemanin mugam varum oru sila vinaadigal mattum AI moolam mugathai maatriyullanaar. Matra ella kaatchigalum unmaiyanathaka ullathu. Enave, ithai AI videovakkalai kandariya udhavum inaiyalatha karuvigalalae thulliyamaka kandariya mudiyavillai. Enave, thiraippadathin videovai YouTube-il thedi eduthom.
2014am aandu intha paadalai oru YouTube channel veliyittirunthathu. Athil 2.57vathu nimidathil antha kurippitta kaatchi vanthathu. Aanaal athil nadithirunthavar Seeman illai. Veru oru nabarin mugathai maatri Seeman mugathai vaithu edit seythu poliyaka videovai uruvakiyirupathu therinthathu.
2014am aandai thodarndhu pala YouTube channel-galum intha paadal videovai pathivetram seythirunthana. HD tharathil veliyagi iruntha videovkal ena ethilum Seemanin thotram illai. Ithanh moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkollathu poliyanathu, edit seyappattathu enpathu uruthiyanathu.

headline: Adhiga carbon umizhvadhu valarndha naadugale: Sutrusundhala maanattil Pradhaar Modi kuttachaattu
text: Puthudilli: “Nam naattin thaninabar carbon umizhvu, ulaga saraasariyil paathiyai vida kuraiyaaga ullathu. Valarntha naadugal Indiayai vida aaru madangu adhigamaaga carbon veliyetrathai erpaduthukinrana. Intha vivaharathil, valarum naadugal meedhu thavaraaga pazhi sumathappadugirathu,” ena, Pradhaar Narendra Modi kavalai therivithullar. 'Sutrusundhal mattum kaal nilai iyakkaviyalin ethirkalam' entra thalaippilana santharasa maanadu Dilliyil netru thodangiyathu. Thesiya pasumai theerpaayam sarbil irandu naatkal nadakkum intha maanattil 17 naadugal pangeluthullana. Intha maanattai Pradhaar Modi thodangi vaithu pesiyavathu: Carbon veliyetrathukana poruppu palaalum, valarum naadugal meedhu thavaraaga sumathappadugirathu. Aanal unmai ennavendraal, indrum kooda Indiayin thaninabar carbon veliyetra alavu ulagalaaviya saraasariyil paathiyalvarkum kuraiyaagave ullathu. Valarntha naadugalin thaninabar carbon veliyetram Indiayai vida aaru madangu adhigamaagave ullathu. Intha unmaiyai ulagalaaviya thalangalil India valuvaga eduthuraithu varugirathu. Sutrusundhalai paathukaappatharkana puthiya tharangaligalai vagukka pira naadugaludan India inainthu seyalpattu varugirathu. Engal valarchi viraivaanathu mattumalla, nilaiyaanadhu kooda. Kalandha 12 aandugalil, sutrusundhal thodarbaana ovvoru thuraiyilum, India asathaarana munnetrathai adainthullathu. Sutrusundhal paathu kaappil mukkiya pangu vagikkum puthuppikkakkatha erisakkuthikku adhigha mukkiyathuvam alikkappadugirathu. France thalainagar Parisil nadantha, 'COP - 21' uchi maanattil alitha vaakuruthipalai nirnayikkappatta kaalakaduvukku munbe niraivetriya ore 'G 20' naadu India thaan. Puthibaadiyamatra eriporul payanpaadu, sooriya aarral thiran, carbon umizhvukku kattupaduthuvathu ena ulagam muzhuthum Indiayin seyalpaadu pesappadugirathu. 12 aandukalukku mun, Indiayin sooriya min urpaththi 2 gigawatt-aga irunthathu. Tharpothu, athu 160 gigawatt-ai kadanthullathu. Pradhaar Mandhiri sooriya veedu ilavasama minsaara thittathin keezh, 50 lathsathukkum merpatta veedugalil merkuraivil sooriya minsaasara thakadigal poruthappattullana. Ithhu, pala naadugalin ulla moththa veedugalin ennikkaiyai vida adhigam. Intha thittathin keezh, oru veettukku 80,000 roopaiyai arasu valangugirathu. Kalandha 12 aandugalil naattin kaatraalai minsaakthi urpatthi thiran moondru madangaga athigarithullathu; neer minsaakthi thiranum uyarndhuthu. Anusaakthi urpathyilum naadu miga veegamaaga seyalpattu varugirathu. Sameepathil, Indiayin muthal hydrogen rail iyakkappattathu. Athuve, ulagin miga neelamaana hydrogen rail. Ithhu thuya erisakkuthi pokkuvarathu thuraiyil oru puthiya sakaabthathin thodarkathai kurikkirathu. 2014-kku mun, Indiayil aandukku 3,000 minsaara vaahanangal mattume virpana seyyappattana. Kalandha aandinil 25 latcham minsaara vaahanangal virpana seyyappattana. Ithhu, sutrusundhalukku migavum payanalthikkinrana. Oru murai mattumae payanpaduttha koodiya plastic-ku Indiayil etharkave thadai vithikkappattathu. Kuraithal, marupayampaadu mattum matrusuzhchi aakiya kotpaadukalin adippadaiyil vatta porulaatharathai mathiya arasu oothuvichu varugirathu-. Indiayil indu thinamum aayirakkanaanakkan thandhukal marusuzhchi seyyappadugirathu. Iyarkai mattum sutrusundhal thodarbaana vishayangalal pala nootrandukalaga ulaga naadugalukku India vazhikaatti varugirathu. Vaaru avar pesinaar.

headline: Pon.Radhakrishnanukku anuthi maruppu endru paravum seithi unmaiya?
text:

investigation_details: Metkandha thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2024m aandu veliyidappatta seidhi, endru theriyavandadhu. Aam, 2024m aandu mei maadham pradhamaar Modi 3 naal payanaaga, Kanniyakumariyil vandhaar. Appodhu, avar thanguvadhaarkaga, erpaadu seyyappatta arasu virundhinar maaligaiyai paarka Pon. Idhanaiye tharpodhu pagirndhu, Modi sameebathil Tamilnadu vandhuchendra nigalvudan thodarbuppaduthi vadhanthi parappukiraargal, endru thelivagiradhu. Melum, Puthiya Thalaimurai digital pirivu nirvaagiyidamum pesi urudhippaduththiyullom. Enave, pazhaya seidhiyai eduthu, arasial ulndookathudan samooga valaithalangalil tharpodhu parappukiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappiradhu.

headline: 45 nimidangalkku mel utkaarugireergala? Ithayathukku aabathu.. athirchi echcharikkai!
text: Thodarndhu 45 nimidangalkku mel ore idamuthil amarndiruppathu ithaya aarokkiyathirku theengu vilaivikkumenna ithayanoy nipunaargal echcharikkindranar. Neenda neram asaiyaamal utkaarnthirukkum pothu kaalgalil ratha ottam mandhamagi, naaladivil ratha azhutham, kozhuppu sathu matrum neerazhivu pondru sikkalgalukku vazhivagukkum ena therivikkindranar. Kaalaiyil gym ya nadaiyarchchi sendraalum, naalil matra nerangalil manikkanakkil utkaarnthirukkum pazhakkam intha theemaigalai muzhumaiyaga pokkuvathillai. Enave, aluvalaga paniyalaargal matrum neenda neram velai seivor ovvoru 45 mudhal 60 nimidangalkku orumurai ezhunthu sila nimidangal nadanthu selvathu, thanneer arunvathu ya siriya udal asaivugalai seivathu ithayathaiyum udal nalathaiyum paathukaakka migavum avasiyam ena echcharikkindranar.

headline: Afghanistan-il 10 idamgalil Pakistan drone thaakkuthal; iru naattu ellaiyil pathatram
text: Kabul: Afghanistan-il 10 idamgalil Pakistan drone thaakkuthal nadathiyullathu. Ithanaal iru naattu ellaiyil pathatramana soozhal nilaviyathu. Afghanistan - Pakistan idaiye neenda naatkalaga ellai prachanaikkuppad pala prachanaigal needikkirana. Afgan-ai aalum Taliban arasu, Pak. arasudan pechu nadathiyum itharku theervu ettappadavillai. Pakistan-ai nokki bayangaravaathigalai Afghanistan aavi viduvathaga Pak. arasu kutramsaatti varukirathu. Itharku ner ethiraga, sarvadesa bayangaravaathigalukalukku Pakistan adaikkalam alippathudan, thangal naattin meedu pazhipoduvathagavum Taliban arasu kuttrachattai munvaithullathu. Iru naattu ellaiyil adikkadi thaakkuthalgal nadanthu vantha nilaiyil, kadantha 21m thethi, Afghanistan-in iru maanagangalil Pakistan raanuvam vaanvazhi thaakkuthalil eedupattathu. Eevuganagalai veesiyum, vimaanappadai vimaanaththilirunthu gundu mazhai pozhinthum Pak. padai thaakkuthal nadathiyathu. Intha thaakkuthalil, appaavi pothumakkal 3 per uyirizhanthathaaga, Afghanistan kutramsattiyathu. Pakistan-ukku pathiladi tharum vagaiyil, Afgan tharapilum thaakkuthal nadanthathaaga seithi veliyaanathu. Nilaiyil, Afghanistan-ai nokki inru (Sep 24) kaalai Pak. dronukal paranthathaal pathatram erpattathu. 10kkum merpatta verupatta idamgalil dronukalai aavi, Pak. thaakkuthalai thodarnthathu. Afghanistan-in raanuva nilaivagalai kurivaiththe intha dronukal aavappattathagaum, makkal vasikkum paguthigalil thaakkuthal nadathavillai enavum Pakistan vilakkam alithullathu.

headline: Pen aliththa pukaar | BJP maanila pothuseyalaalar neekkam.. Nainar Nagenthiran nadavadikkai!!
text: Tamilnadu BJP-yai serntha penn oruvar, katchiyin desiya thalaimai matrum maana nila thalaivargalidam Tamilnadu BJP pothuseyalalar Karuppu Muruganantham meethu kadumaiyaana kuttrachattugalai munvaithu September 12 andru pugar kaditham ondrai anuppinar. Athil, Karuppu Muruganantham thamakku thirumana aasai kaati yematriyathagum, 2026 Tamilnadu jhaDhDhamanRadh dherdhalil Srirangam thoguthiyil pottiida vaaippu tharuvathaga uruthiyalithathagum therivithirunthaar. Melum, udalalavilum manathalalavilum sithiravathai seythathu, virubhbhadhdhiRghu mARAghagh karuvai kalaikka kattaayappaduthathu matrum kolai mirattal viduthathu pondra pala theeviramaana kuttrachattugalai avar munvaithar. Thodarndhu, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) satta pirivugalin keezh avar meethu uriya nadavadikkai edukka vendum endrum, thanakkum thanathu kulanthaigalukkum paathukaappu vazhanggha veNDhuM endrum katchi melidathai valiyuruthinaar. Nilaimaiyil thaan, intha vivaharathai thodarndhu, Tamilnadu BJP maanila thalaivar Nainar Nagendran Karuppu Murugananthappai katchi poruppugalilirunthu neekki athigaarappoorva arivippu ondrai veliyittullaar. Athil, Tamizhaga Bharatiya Janata katchiyin maanila pothuseyalalar M. Muruganantham, katchiyin narpeyarukku kalangam vilaikkum seyarkalil eedupattu vanthathal, avar katchiyin poruppilirunthu udanadiyaga viduvikkappadugirar endru therivikkappattullathu. Nilaimaiyil, intha vivaharam kurithu pesiyulla Karuppu Muruganantham, muttrilum poyyaana kuttrachattugalin adippadaiyil, katchiyin ozhungu nadavadikkai kuzhuvin moolamaga evvitha muraiyaana visaaranaiyum nadathappadamal, ennai udanadiyaga poruppilirunthu viduvithathu miguntha kandanathiriyathu ena therivithirukkirar. Melum, "Intha vivaharam thodarbaga desiyap pothuseyalalar Santhosh avargalidammum, maanila poruppalar Aravind Menon avargalidammum naan yerkenave pesiyullen, ozhungu nadavadikkai kuzhu mulumaiyaga visaritha pirake uriya nadavadikkai edukkappadum endru therivikkappattirunthathu. Anal, avvarana evvitha visaaranaiyinri, seyyarkai nunnarivu (AI) tholnutpathin moolamaga poliyaga uruvakkappatta padangal matrum punayappatta poli pugar manuvai mattume adippadaiyaaga kondu en meethu nadavadikkai eduthirupathai orupothum yetrukkolla mudiyaathu. Melum, ithakkaya poli seithigalaiyum vathanthigalaiyum parappuvor meethu miga kadumaiyaana satta nadavadikkai edukkappadum" ena therivithullaar.

headline: Sasikala-vin kanavar Natarajan pugappadathudan paravum News J. News card unmaiya?
text:
Anna Palkalai Kazhaga maanavi vivahathil Palkalai Kazhaga makkal thodarbu athigaari Natarajan enbavar sikkiyathaaga Sasikala-vin kanavar Natarajan pugappadathudan News J tholaiyakaatchi News card veliyittathaaga palarum

maraintha Natarajan pugappadathudan News J tholaiyakaatchi veliyittathu pondru News card Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Athil, “Velichathukku vantha saarkal sikkuvaarkala? Anna Palkalai. maanavi paaliyal vazhakkil Gnanasekaran-ukku uthaviyathaaga DMK nirvaagi Shanmugam matrum vilambara priyar amaichar peyar adippatta nilaiyil antha pattiyalil puthithaaga inainthuullathu Palkalai. makkal thodarbu athigaari Natarajan. Shanmugam, Gnanasekaran mattumillamal DMK-vil palarudan Natarajan nerukkam enak koorappadum nilaiyil vazhakkil thodarbudaiya unmai saarkal sikkuvaarkala ena makkal ethirpaarppu” endru irunthathu. Intha News card-ai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathividu varukindranaar.
investigation_details:
Sasikala kanavar Natarajan marainthu pala aandukal aagivittathu. Intha nilaiyil avarathu padam vaithu ADMK aatharvu oodakamaan News J-vil News card veliyittathu pondru palarum samooga oodakangalil pathividu varukindranaar. Paarkka unmaiyana News card poleye ullathaal, News J unmaiyil ippadi oru News card-ai veliyittathaara enra sandehatthin adippadaiyil aayvu seidom.
Muthalil Anna Palkalai Kazhagamathil Natarajan enru makkal thodarbu athigaari ullaara enru athan inaiyalathil paarthom. Aanaal appadi yaarum illai. Tharpoothu Kalaiarasan enbavar angu makkal thodarbu athigaariyaaga ullathaaka kurippidappattirunthathu. Enave, intha News card-il ulla thagaval thavaraanathu enbathu theliyathu.
Intha News card-ai News J veliyittathaara enru athan samooga oodaka pakkangalai paarvayittom. Aanaal, athil appadi entha oru News card-um veliyavillai enbathu theriya vanthathu. Melum, samooga oodakangalil paravum News card unmaiyanathu illai enru “FAKE” muthritaiyudan avarkal veliyirunthanar. Inthan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda News card poliyaanathu enbathu uruthiyaanathu.

headline: SIR sarchai! 370 nekkam mudhal Raamar koyil varai.. Gnanesh Kumar-in parabarappu pinnani!
text:
Indiyavin 26vathu thalaimai therdhal ANaiyarAgha poruppetra Gnanesh Kumar kaalathil SIR (Special Intensive Revision) thodarbaaka therdhal aanaayathukkul kadum karuthu verupaadugal ezhunthullana. Puthiya vaakkalar serthal, peyar neekkam, menporul kattupaadu, Form 6 maatrangal kurithu iru aanaayarkal 14 murai ezhuthu moolam ethirpu therivithathaaka thakaval. Anal iruthi mudivugal orumanathaagave edukkappattathaaka aanaayam vilakkam alithullathu.
Seythiyaalar - M.Meera
Indiyavin 26-vathu thalaimai therdhal ANaiyarAgha Gnanesh Kumar kadantha 2025 February 19aam thethi poruppetraar. Avarathu pathavikkaalathil SIR enappadum Special Intensive Revision thodarbaaka therdhal aanaayathukkul karuthu verupaadu erpatathaaka veliyaana thakaval, arasiyal vattarathil puthiya paraparappai erpaduthullathu.
The Indian Express veliyittulla arikkaiyinppadi, therdhal aanaayarkal Sukhbir Singh Sandhu matrum Vivek Joshi, aagiya iruvarum kadantha 10 maathangalil SIR thodarbaana mudivugal kurithu kurainthathu 14 murai ezhuthupoorvamaaka ethirpu therivithathaaka koorappattullathu. Puthiya vaakkalarkalai serppathu, vaakkalar peyarkalai neakkathu, vaakkalar pattiyal menporul matrum melmuraiyeadugal ullitta vivakangalil antha ethirpu irunthathaaka arikkai therivikkirathu.
Kurippaaka, puthiya vaakkalarkal pathivu seyyum Form 6-l SIR thodarbaana kooduthal vivarangal serkkappattatharku iru therdhal aanaayarkalrum ethirpu therivithathaaka, itharku vidhigalil thirutham thevai ena avarkal kurippittathaaka antha arikkai koorugirathu.
Melum, vaakkalar pattiyal thodarbaana thakaval tholnutpa amaippin kattupaadu Delliyil vaithiruppathu, vaakkalar peyarkalai serthal, neakkuthal matrum meendum serthal thodarbaana nadaimuraigal kurithum avarkal kelvi ezhupiyathaaka koorappatturathu. Sila vivakangalil thangalathu kavalangalai mathiya arasin uyarathikaariyaa amaicharavai seyalaridamum therivithathaaka Indian Express seithi therivikkirathu.
Anal, therdhal aanaayam itharku pathalikkaiyil, karuthu verupaadugal aalosanai nadaimuraiyin iyalbaana pakthiyaagum enrum, iruthiyaaka edukkappatta mudivugal anaithum orumanathaagave irunthathaakavum therivithullathu.
Gnanesh Kumar-in pinnani
1988aam aandu Kerala Kedarai serntha IAS athikaariyaana Gnanesh Kumar, mathiya arasil pala mukkiya poruppukalai vakithullathu.
2019 aam aandu Ucha Neethimanram Ayodhya vazhakkil varalaatru sirappumikka theerppai vazhangiya pothu, Ramar kovil kattumanathai merkpaarvaiyida oru thani arakkattalaiyai uruvaakkumaaru mathiya arasukku utharavittal. Antha kaalakkattathil, Gnanesh Kumar mathiya ulthurai amaichakathil kooduthal seyalaraaka (Additional Secretary) paniyaatrikkondirunthaar.
Ucha Neethimanra theerppait thodarhnthu, Ramar kovil arakkattalaiyai uruvaakkuratharkaana panangalai porkaala adippadaiyil kavanippatharkaaka mathiya ulthurai amaichakathil oru pirathiyega pirivu (Desk) uruvaakkappattathu. Intha mukkiyaana pirivin thalaivaraaka Gnanesh Kumar niyaamikkappattaar.
Intha sirappu pirivin thalaivaraaka irunthu, 'Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra' arakkattalaiyai uruvaakkuratharkaana sattappoorva aavangalai thayaarippathu, athan vidhigalai vakuthal matrum athan mulumaiyaana kattamaipai (Draft & Constitution) uruvaakkurathil ivar mukkiya pangaatrianaar.
Itharku munnathaaka, Jammu Kashmir vivakangalai kavanikkum pirivin thalaivaraaka iruntha Gnanesh Kumar, Jammu Kashmir-in 370-vathu sattappirivai neakkum (Abrogation of Article 370) arasin mukkiya nadavadikkaiyin pothu mathiya ulthurai amaichar Amit Shah-in nambikkaiyai petrirunthaar. Athan thodarchiyagave, 2020aam aandil Ramar kovil arakkattalaiyai muraippadi amaikkum poruppum ivaridam oppadaikkappattathu.
India therdhal aanaayathin thakavalinppadi, avar IIT Kanpur-il Civil Engineering, ICFAI-yil Business Finance matrum Harvard palkalaikkalagam sutruchoola porulaathaaram payinthullaar.

headline: “Neeyum naanum onnu” enbathuthaan TVK-vin adippadai emotion endru Vijay koorinaara?
text:
Neeyum naanum onnu, Gandhi porantha mannu, teekadayila ninnu, thinnupaaru pannu enbathuthaan TVK-vin adippadai emotion endru Vijay kooriyathaaga oru news card

TVK thalaivarum nadigarumaana Vijay pottakkathudan Puthiya Thalaimurai veliyittathu pondru news card Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Athil, “Neeyum naanum onnu, Gandhi porantha mannu, teekadayila ninnu, thinnupaaru pannu endru naan cinimayil sonnathuthaan TVK-vin adippadai emotion – Thanjai TVK nirvaahigal santhippu koottathil akkatchi thalaivar Vijay pechu” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha news card-ai palarum samooka oodakangalil pathivittu varukirargal.
investigation_details:
Cinimayil pesiya vasanathai Thanjavooril nadantha nirvaahigal santhippu koottathil Vijay pesiyathu pondru news card onrai palarum samooka oodakangalil pathivittu varukirargal. Vijay unmaiyil appadik koorinaara endru ariya aayvu seitthom.
Thanjavoor sattathil avar pesiya videovai paarthom. Avar appadi ethum kooravillai. Enave, ithu poliyaanathu enbathu uruthiyaanathu. Intha news card-um poliyaanathu enbathai urutheiseithukolla aayvai thodarnthom. Puthiya Thalaimuraiyil March 4, 2026-m thethi veliyana news card-ukalai paarthom.
Athil naam aayvukku eduthukkondathu pondru Vijay pottakkathudan oru news card veliyagi irunthathaik kaana mudinthathu. Anal athil, “Enakkum makkalukkumana uravu iyarkaiyaagave amaintha uravu. Matravarkalukku vendumaanaal ithu Election. Enakkum ennai nesippavarkalukkum ithu Emotion” endru irunthathu. Intha news card-ai edit seithu vathanthi parappiyirupathu thelivaanathu.
Ithai urutheiseithukolla Puthiya Thalaimurai digital poruppalarukku intha news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum ithu poliyaanathu endru uruthi seithar. Melum, sorithu neram kazhithu “Intha seithiyai Puthiya Thalaimurai veliyidavillai” endru kurippittu thangal samooka oodakangal pakkangalil pathivaiyum veliyittanar. Intha aathaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaraanathu endru uruthi seyyappadukirathu.

headline: Madurai theppakulathil Drone show endru paravum video unmaiya?
text: ‘‘Madurai theppakulathil Drone show,’’ endru koori, Ithil ’’ Madurai theppakulam, aagayathil Drone show ! 🙏🙏🔥🔥🔥🔱🔱🔱🔥🔥🔥🙏🙏 ,’’ endru ezhuthappattullathu. Ithantan, aagayathil Drone show nadaiperuvathu pontru video ondrum innaikappattullathu. Palarum ithanai unmai ena nambi, samuga valaiuntukalil share, comment seyvathaik kaana mudikirathu.
investigation_details: Merkanta thaval unmaiya endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appothu, ithu AI muraiyil tharisarikappatta video, endru theriyanthathu. Ithudarkaka, Tamilnadu Hindu aranilaipputhurai amaichakathil pesi, uruthippaduththullom. Aduththappadiyaka, Madurai Meenakshi Amman koyil kumbabhishekam thodarkaka yethenum light show nadanthatha, athupatri udakangalil seithi veliyanthatha endru vivaram thedinom. Aanal, namakkuk kitta aatharam veronraaka irunthathu. Kooduththa seithi aatharam itho… Ithanpadi, laser light show mattume nadathappattathaka, naam aayvu seiyum videovil ullathu pontru drone show ethum nadathappadavillai enpathum namakku thelivaka irukkiraathu. Enave, naam aayvukku eduththukkonda video, AI muraiyil tharisarikappattathu, endru santhakaminri uruthi seiyappadukirathu.

headline: Sarakku vaanguvathil thallumullu vaalibar kazhutharuthu kolai
text:
'Sarakku' vaanguvathil thallumullu vaalibar kazhutharuthu kolai
Trichy: Trichy arugé madhu vaanguvathil erpatta thagaraaril, madhukkadai vaasalil Prakash, 30, entra kooli thozhilaaliyai kazhutharuthu kolai seitavargalai polisaar thédi varugintranaar.
Trichy maavattam, Samayapuram arugé ulla Marudhurai serntha Prakash, netru maalai Samayapuram naalroadu paguthiyil ulla TASMAC kadaiyil madhu vaanga senraar. Appothu angu koottam athigamaaga irunthathu enraal, yaar muthalil madhu vaanguvathu ena, pirachanai erpattullathu.
Appothu, silar sernthu, Prakash-ai thaakkiyullanar. Antha neram, kumbalil iruntha oruvar, kaiyil vaithiruntha aayuthathal Prakash kazhuthai aruthu thappiyodinaar. Prakash, athe idamathil ratha vellathil surundu vizhunthu iranthaar.
Samayapuram polisaar visaarikkintranaar. Kolaikku kaaranam, madhu vaanguvathil erpatta pirachaniya allathu munvirothama entra konathil, appaguthi 'CCTV' camera pathivugalai vaithu polisaar visaarithu varugintranaar.

headline: “Trump-ukku mananala paadhippaa?”.. Ottrai padhivaal kadum kobathil andhai naadugal!!
text:
Kanada, Mexico, Greenland, Iceland ullitta pala naadugalai America-voda innainthu annattu athibar Trump veliyittirukkum pathivu kadum vimarshana'])]glai petru varugirathu. Kadantha naangu naadkalil mattum Trump ithupondru nootrukkanakkana pathivugalai pottirukkum nilaiyil, Trump-in mana aarokkiyam kurithu palarum kavalaippada aarambithirukkinkaranar. Vivaram enna enbathai virivaaga paarkalaam...
Thangalin ellaikku apparpatta naadugal, paguthigalukku padaiyethu sellum mannarkalin kathaiyai kettiruppom. Aanaal, athibaraaga pathviyetranaal thodangi, America makkalaal ‘Mannar’ ena vimarshikkappattu varum athibar Donald, digital porai thoondi vittirukirar. Trump-in seyal pala naadugalai serntha thalaivaraiyum kobamadiya seitirukkirathu. Kadantha njayiru matrum thingatkilamaikalil mattum thanathu Truth Social media pakkathil sumaar 100 pathivugalin veliyittaar America athibar Donald Trump.
AI-yaal uruvaakkappatta padangalai Trump thodarnthu pathivittathu palaraiyum kavalaiyadaiya seitathu. Trump antha pathavukku etra nabar thaana ena silarum, Trump-ukku dementia allathu veru ethavathu theeviramaana moolai noi irukkum endru California maakana senatarum vimarshithu varukindranaar. Nilavu America-vukku thaan sontham enbana ponru pathivugalum athil adangiyirunthathaal thaan Trump-in mana aarokkiyamai patriya vivatham uruvaagiyirunthathu.
Nilaiyil, antha pathivugalil melum onru tharpothu sarchaiyaagi varugirathu. Kanada, Mexico, Greenland, Iceland, Cuba matrum Caribbean theevugalin sila paguthigalai America ena kurippittu annattin kodi intha naadugalin meethu padarnthiruppathai pola Trump pathivittirukkiraar.
International alavil por pathatram, theeviramadaiya koodiya varthaga oppanthangal, pechuvarthaigalukku mathiyil Trump ippadiyaana oru pathivai pottiruppathai sambandappatta naadugal kandithirukkindrana.
Trump-in seyal thodarpaaga kandanathai pathivu seivathaarkaaga America thootharukku azhaippu vithirukkirathu Iceland. Entha voru naattin colony naadaagavo allathu yaaruudaiya paathukappilumo naangal irukka maattom ena Mexico athibar Claudia Kaattam therivithirukkiraar. Appappothu ippadi paraparappukalai kilappi vittu vaaypothi amaithi kaakkum Trump-in seyal, sambandappatta naattai sernthavargalai mattumallamal, sambathai ketpor anaivaraiyum kobamadiya seitirukkirathu.

headline: Kallachaaraya visaaranai arikkai tha.ve.ka., arasu nilaippaadu enna? Anbumani kelvi
text: Chennai: Pa.Ma.K., thalaivar Anbumani arikkai: Kallakkurichi kallachcharaya uyirizhappukal thodarbaha visarana nadathiya Chennai uyar neethimandram oyvuperra neethipathi Gokuldas thalaimaiyilana aaniyam, 2025 Feb., 14l visarana arikkaiyai thaakkal seithathu. 18 mathangalukku pin, tharpooth satta sabaiyil arikkai veliyidappattullathu. Athil, 'Kallach charaya vanigarkaludan athikarikal koottani vaithirunthana; avarkal thunaiyindri, Chennaiyil irunthu Kallakkurichikku kallachcharayam vanthirukka mudiyaathu. Intha koottani thakarkappada vendum. Kadamai thavariya athikarikal meethu nadavadikkai edukkappada vendum' ena koorappattullathu. Antha parinthuraikal meethu Tha.Ve.K., arasu enna nadavadikkai edukka pogaRathu? Ithvaaru athil koorappattullathu.

headline: Purka aninthu vilaiyaadiya Vangathesha magalir kriket aniyinar endru paravum pukaippadam unmaiya?
text:
ICC pengal ulaga koppa kriket pottiyil Vangathesha ani veerargal purka aninthu vilaiyadiyathu pontru oru pukaippadam

Purka aninththa pengal kriket vilaiyadvathu pontru pukaippadam Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. ICC pengal ulaga koppa kriket pottiyil Vangathesham matrum New Zealand mothuvathu pontru keezhe score card ullathu. Nilaith thakavalil, “Bangladeshiyai vida munnerichinnu intha marma nabargal & DMK upiskal urutturathu unmai thaan pola…
Ground-la kosu marunthu adikiravangalukku kooda full-a cover panra uniform koduthurukkanunga…” endru kurippidappattirunthaathu. Intha pukaippattathai palarum samooka oodakangalil pathividu varugindrana.
investigation_details:
Vangathesham munnerivittathu endru entha DMK upis uruttinaarkal endru theriya villai, DMK-vai vaithu palarum ippadi samooka oodakangalil urutti varugindrana. Kurainthapatcham avargal parappiya pukaippadamavathu unmaiya endru paarthom. Aayvu seyyamalaiye ithu poliyaana pukaippadam enbathu theriyanthathu.
Pukaippattathin keezhe oru orathil Gemini AI uruvaakkum AI pukaippadangalil idam perum water mark logo-vai kaana mudikirathu. Ithuve intha pukaippadam poliyaanathu enbathu uruthi seygirathu. Iruppinum ICC veliyitta video-kkal, pukaippadangal adippadaiyil uruthi seyya aayvai thodarnthom.
Vangathesha magalir aniyinar purka aninthu vilaiyadi irunthaal athu thodarbaana seithi veliyagi irukkum. Aanal, namakku appadi entha oru seithiyum kidaikkavillai. ICC veliyiruntha Vangathesham – New Zealand ani pottiyin highlight-ai thedi eduthu paarthom. Athilum entha edathilum Vangathesha aniyinar purka aninthathu pol oru kaatchiyaiyum kaana mudiyavillai.
Aduththaaka AI pukaippadangalai kandariya udhavum inaiyathalathil intha pukaippattathai pathivetti aayvu seitthom. Athilum kooda “Intha pukaippadam AI moolam uruvaakkappattathu. Oru sathavigidam alavukku kooda unmaiyillai” endru theriyanthathu. Ivai ellam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaraanathu, vishamathaanathu endru uruthi seitthullathu.

headline: Sound vitta rowdikal kaidhu
text: Mettur: Mettur, Karumalaikoodudal polisaar, netru mathiyam, Ajay-Nagar, 4 roadil ronthu senranaar. Appothu angu nindriruntha Sellappan theruvai serntha rowdy Prakash, 25 enbavar, 'Ennai kandu matravargal bayapada vendum. Atharku vaha-nangal, pothuchothugalai sethapadutha vendum' ena pesinaar. Polisaar echarithum, angirunthu sellaamal iruntha Prakash-ai, polisaar kaithu seithanaraar. Prakash mithu Karuma-laikoodudal, Poolampatti stations-kalil vazhakkugal ullana. Athaippol Omalur, Amaragundhi kaspa paguthiyai serntha rowdy Thirunavukarasu, 29. Netru kaalai, Amaragundhi Eswaran kovil aruge pesinaar. Avarai, Tholasampatti polisaar kaithu seithanaraar.

headline: Kuzhandhaigalai thunburuthi Vijay piranthanaal kondaadiya TVK-vinar endru paravum video tharpothu edukkapattathaa?
text: Thunburuthi Vijay piranthanaalai kondaadiya TVK-vinar endru oru video. Saagasa nigazhchiyin pothu siruvanin kaiyil theepattrikollum video Facebook-il pathividappattullathee. Nilaith thagavalil, “Ithellam thevaiyaada ungaluku… soru, inippu koduthu kondadungada… piranthanaal paarthu kondadungada.. kuzhandhaigalai thunburuthi kondadum tharkurigal” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha videovai palarum samuga udamangalil pathividu varugindranaar.
investigation_details: Thamizhaga mudhalvar Vijay-yin pirandhanaalai June 22m thethi avarathu katchinar uthsahamaakondaadinar. Indha nigazhchiyae podhu siruvargalai thunburuthiyadhaaga oru videovai palaarum samooga oodangalil pathivu seithu varugindranaar. Indha video eppodhu edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Idhanaal, tharpoothu nadandhadhu pondru artham varum vagaiyil pathivu ullathu. Aanaal, indha videovai sila aandukalukku munbu paarthadhu pondru ninaivu irunthadhaal indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seithom. Indha pathivil kuzhandhaigalai chitharvadhai seithadhaaga kurippidappattirunthadhu. Odotenvai udaikkum stunt saagasa nigazhchiyae ithellaam vazhakkamaana ondruthaan. Kuzhandhaigalai kattayappaduthi, thunburuthi nigazhchi nadathiyadhu pola illai. Enavae indha nigazhchi thodarbaaga thedinom. Nummudaiya thedalil indha sambavam 2024m aandu Vijay pirandhanaal kondaattathin podhu nadandhadhu endru theriya vanthathu. Saagasa nigazhchiyae eedupatta siruvarkku siriya alavil kaayam thendradhaaga seithigal kidaithana. Aanaal, indha sambavam thodarbaaga police vazhakku pathivu seithadhaaga entha seithiyum illai. Andha siruvanin paettaiyai News 18 Tamil Nadu 2024m aandae veliyittirunthadhu. Adhil, “15 ulaga sadhanai seithullen, indha murai spark aagiyathal theepattriyathu, ithu sahajam thaan, vali kuraivaaga ullathu, odu matrum kaigalil petrol ootruvathu vazhakkamaana ondruthaan endru andha siruvan therivithullar” endru irunthathu. Idhanaal ithu pazhaya sambavam enbadhai kurippidaamal thavaana purithalai erpaduthum vagaiyil pathivittirupathu thelivaagirathu. Idhana adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu unmaiyai maraithu veliyidappattathu endru uruthi seiyappadugirathu.

headline: Russia adhibar Putin indhiya dhesiya geedhathukku mariyaadhai aliththaaraa?
text:
Rasiya adhibar Putin indhiya dhesiya geethathukku mariyadhai alithu nindraar endru oru video

Rasiya adhibar nadanthu vara thidarendru indhiya dhesiya geetham paadappadugiradhu. Udane Putin nindru mariyadhai seluthum vagaiyil video ondru Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Videovil, “Nam naattin dhesiya kodikku enna madhippu” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Nilaith thagavalisil, “Nam naattin dhesiya kodikku enna madhippu 🇮🇳 nanbennda 🎉 Rasiya adhibar Vladimir Putin great” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha videovai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varugirargal.
investigation_details:
America adhibar Trump-kku indhiyil migapperiya aadharuthu irunthu vandhadhu. Avar vetripera yaagam, poojai ellam seyyappattathu. Indhiavkku edhiraana nadavadikkaigalil Trump irangave, aadharuthai appadiye Russia pakkam thiruppivittana netizen-gal. Tharpodhu Russia adhibar indhia meedhu adhiga paasathudan iruppathu pondru pathivugal veliyagi varugirathu.  Antha vagaiyil indhiya dhesiya geedhathukku mariyaadhai alikkum vagaiyil Putin nindraar endru oru videovai palarum samuga oodakangalil pathivittu varukirargal. Video mulumaiyaga illai. Putin nadanthu varumbothu thidirenru indhiya dhesiya geedham isaikkiradhu. Adhibar varugirar endral, avar vantha piraguthaan muraippadi dhesiya geedham isaikkappadum. Aanal, avar varuvatharku munbe paadal olikka aarambithuvittathu sandhegathai erpaduthiyathu.
Intha video kaatchiyai padappadangalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. 13-14 aandugalaga intha video samuga oodakangalil pakirappattu vanthiruppathai kaana mudinthadhu. Aanal, indhiya dhesiya geedhathukku pathil Russia dhesiya geedham isaikkappadugiradhu. Audiovai mattum edit seyyiruppathu theriyavanthathu.
Thodarndhu thediyappothu, 2012m aandu veliyaana video onru namakku kidaithathu. Athil aikkiya Russia katchiyin maanadu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. 2011m aandu September 23, 24m thedhigalil antha maanadu nadanthathaga medaikku pinpuram iruntha banner-il kurippidappattirundhadhu. Appothu Putin pradhamaraga irunthaar. Avarai medaikku azhaithappothu, Russia-vin dhesiya geedham isaikkappattadhu. Avar atharku mariyaadhai alikkum vagaiyil nirkirar. Intha videovai edit seidhu indhiya dhesiya geedhathukku mariyaadhai aliththaar endru thavaraaga pakirunthathu thelivagiradhu.
Nammudaiya Fact Crescendo Malayalam-ilum kooda ithu thodarbaana katturai veliyagi ulladhu. Adhai kaana inge click seyyungal.

headline: Mutputharil maanavan sadalam... thodar poraattam... 52 peermaithu vazhakku!
text:
Thamizhselvan maranathil aduthaduthu thirupangal
Maduraiyil maanavar Thamizhselvan marma maranam kurithu, ‘nadanthathu kolai; C.B.C.I.D visarana vendum’ enak kori, poratangal thodarum nilaiyil, maavatta aatchiyar aluvalathai mutrukiyitu poradiya 52 permeethu, 7 pirivukalil police-ar vazhakku pathivuseythirupathu satcheraiyai erpaduthiyirukirathu.
Madurai aanaiyur koodalputhoorai serntha 11-am vaguppu maanavar Thamizhselvan, kadantha 5-am thethi kuttaiylulla mutputharil sadalamaaka meetkapattaar. Santhaka marana vazhakku pathivuseythu kavaluthurai visarithuvarum nilaiyil, ‘maatru samuga pennai kathalithathaal Thamizhselvan kolai seyyappattaar’ enak kutramsaati, kolai vazhakkaka maatrina C.B.C.I.D visaranaikku utharavida vendum ena petrorum, samuga amaippukal poradivarukintanar.
Pennin thalaimutiyai pithithu izhuthu...
Ithu thodarbaaka Thamizhselvan kudumbathin tharappil Madurai uyar neethimandrathil vazhakku podappattirukirathu. Intha soozhalil, 18.09.26 andru maavatta aatchiyar aluvalathai mutrukiyitu poradiyavarkalai kavaluthuraiyinar appurappaduthiyathudan, porattathil edupatta 52 permeethu 7 pirivukalinkeezha vazhakku pathivuseythirupathu puthiya satcheraiyai erpaduthiyirukirathu.
Ithu kurithu pesiya pengal ezhuchi iyakkathai serntha Mahalatchumi, ``maavatta aatchiyar aluvalathathu aruke Thiruvalluvar silai paguthiyil porattam nadatha thittamiduntha nilaiyil, kavaluthuraiyinar vahanangalai niruthi idaiyooru seythaal, aatchiyar aluvalathai nokki perunaiyaaka senrom. A pothu porattathai thadutha kavaluthuraiyinar, pennin thalaimutiyai pithithu izhuthum, aanngalai gundu-kattaka thookkiyum senratan. Ithil oruvarai padikattilirunthu keezhe pottathaal avarukku muthukil palatha kaayam erpadanthathuudan, mernthum silarum kayamadinan. Iruvar, arasu Raasasi maruthuvanaril sikitse perruvarukintanar.
Thamizhselvan irappil sandhegam irupathaal, neethi kettu poradiya engalmeethe kavaluthuraiyinar vazhakku pathivuseythu, neril aajara samman anuppukintanar. Police-ar muraiyaaka visarithirunthal, naangal yen ivvalavu periya poratangalai nadathavendiya nilai erpadirukkum... Thamizhselvan-in maama Mohan manitha urimai vazhakkukalai nadathi varuvathaal, avar meethulla kobathai kavaluthuraiyinar intha vivakathil velipaduthukintanar” enraar.
CCTV aatharathukku muttukkattai!
Ithu kurithu vazhakkaringar Mohan nammidam pesum pothu, “kanavudan erpadutta karuthu verupadu kaaranamaaka en thangai Yogalatchumiyum, Thamizhselvankum ennutanthaan vasithu vanthanar. Manitha urimai vazhakkukalai nadathi varum naan, Thamizhselvan uyirizhupukku thodarbaaka unmai kandariyum kuluvai amaithu visaranai nadathen. Arikkaiyai thunai aanaiyar Ravichanthiraniyal alithen. Aanaal, avar ithai kelvikullaakki, melottamaaka visaranai nadathi varukirar.
Thamizhselvan irantha idathukku arugilulla veettin CCTV pathivukalai antha veettin urimaiyalarukal vazhanguvathaaka kooriyiruntha nilaiyil, naangal senra sila mani nerathu angu senra Q-pirivu police-ar, videokkalai kodukka koodathu ena therivithu ullanan. Ovvoru aatharathai thedum pothum kavaluthuraiyinar nerukkadi kodukkinran. Kurippaaka, idathusaarikalaiyum, antha amaippukalaiyum odukkave ivvaaru seykintanar.
Kavaluthuraiyinaalaal sitharvathaikku ullakka pattavarkalaiye thalaivarkalai etru, pothu velaikalai seithuvarukiram. Athanaal, engalmeethu vazhakku pathivuseythalum, thaakinaalum, sitharvathai seythaalum intha vivakathilirunthu vilagividuvom ena, kavaluthuraiyinar ninaikka vendam. Thamizhselvankku neethi kidaikkum varai oya maattom” enraar.
``Yaaraiyum thaakkavillai... video aatharam irukirathu!’’
Madurai maanagara kaval aanaiyar Rajendranidam vilakkam kettom. ``Porattangalil edupattavarkaludan pechuvarthai nadatha muyalum, avarkal goshangalai ezhuppi maruthathaal appurappaduthavendiya soozhal erpadanthathu. Yaaraiyum thaakkavillai; atharkana video aatharankal ullana. Muthalil avarkal koriyappadi visaranai athikaari maatrinan. Avarkal ithai kolai vazhakku enak koorum nilaiyil, avarkaludaiya unarvukalai purinthukondu, kolaikana aatharankalaiye kavaluthuraiyum thedivarukirathu.
Avarkal thaniyaaka kulu amaithu arikkai alithalum, engalkana vazhikaatuthalinpadiye visaranaiyai nadatha mudiyum. Ithil thanippatta nokkamo, arasial thodarbo illai. Thamizhselvan-in udakkurayvu iruthi arikkai innum irandu naalil vanthuvidum; athan pinpu vazhakku kuritha muzhu vivaramum theriyavarum. Atharkul avarkal neethimandrathil vazhakku thodarnvathudan, kaval aanaiyar, aatchiyar aluvalathalai mutrukiyitu porattam nadathukintanar. Aatharankal kidaithaluthaan vazhakkai mudikka mudiyum” enraar.
Unmaiyai sollapovathu aatharankala… iruthi arikkaiya?

headline: Pen adhigaariyidam seendal GST aayaalar kaidhu
text: Thirumangalam: GST alvalaga pen adhikaariku paaliyaal thollai kodutha, Saurav, 28, entra aayaalarai polisaar netru kaidhu seithanaar. Chennai Mugappair, irandaavathu pradhaana saalaiyil GST alvalagam ullathu. Ingu Aanthira maanilathai serntha, 32 vayathu pen, aayaalaraaga pani purinthu varugiraar. Ivar, Thirumangalam magalir kaaval nilaiyathil, sameepathil oru pukaar alithaar. Aathil, 'thaan pani puriyum alvalagathil, merku vanga maanilathai serntha Saurav, 28, enbavar aayaalaraaga pani purinthu varugiraar. Thannidam avar, irattai aarthathil pesuvathodu, paaliyaal thollai koduthu varugiraar. 'Thannudaiya anumathiyinri samuga valaiyathal pakkangalilirunthu pudaipadangalai thirudi, anaagarigamaaga ezhuthullaar. Avar meesu sattappadi nadavadikai eduka vendum' ena kurippirunthaar. Ithukurippu vazhakku pathivu seitha Thirumangalam polisaar, paaliyaal thollai kodutha aayaalar Sauravai, netru kaidhu seithanaar.

headline: AI manithakulathukku ethiraaga maaraamal irukka sarvadesa vidhigal thevai; UN-il nibunargal valiuruthal
text: New York: 'Seyarkkai nunnarivu enappadum A.I., tholnuzhpanam manitha kulathukku abathu erpaduthatha vagaiyil kattupadatha sarvadesa paathukaappu vidhigalai uruvaakka vendum' ena, munnani A.I., niruvanangalin thalaivargal UN, paathukaappu council-il valiuruthinargal. America-vin New York-il, UN,-vin pothu sabai kootam nadanthu varugirathu. Ithil pangeṟka, 193 uruppu naadungalukkum azhaippu vidukappattu ullathu. Palveru pothu vivakangal kuritha vivathangalum nadanthu varuginrana. Ulagam muzhuvum vegamaaga valarnthu varum A.I., tholnuzhpanamum athil ondru. Intha tholnuzhpanam thavaraaga payanpaduthappattal erpadakkoodiya abathukal kurithum ulaga naadugal kavalai therivithu varuginrana. Nilaamaiyil nadantha UN, paathukaappu council kootathil, 'Anthropic' niruvanathin thalai nirvaaga athikaari Dario Amodei, 'OpenAI' thalai nirvaaga athikaari Sam Altman matrum 'Hugging Face' niruvanathin thalai nirvaaga athikaari Clement Delangue aagiyor pangeṟru A.I., tholnuzhpanathin ethirkaalam kurithu pesinargal. Sam Altman koorugaiyil, “A.I., tholnuzhpanathin kattupadu oru niruvanam allathu oru naattin kaigalil mattum kuvinthu vidakkoodathu. Athisamayam, manithargalin vaazhkkaiyai mempaduthuvatharkum, makkal thangal vaazhkkai kuritha mudivugalil athika athikaaram peruvatharkum A.I., udhavum”, endraar. Anthropic thalai nirvaaga athikaari Dario pesugaiyil, “A.I., tholnuzhpanathai sariyaaga nirvaagikkavillai entraal, athu ottomuttha manitha kulathukke abathahaga maarakkoodum. 'Uyiriyal aayuthangalai uruvaakka A.I., tholnuzhpanathai anumathikkak koodathu. A.I., maathirigalukku ennaenna thiranukal ullaana enbathai sariparkkum muraigal uruvaakkappada vendum. A.I., tholnuzhpanathai sothippatharku pothuvaana sarvadesa tharanangal thevai,” endraar. Aanaal, A.I., tholnuzhpanathin valarchiyai kattupaduthuvatharku ethiraaga America karutthu therivithullathu. 'Puthiya sarvadesa nirvaaga amaippugalai uruvaakkuvatharkaana kaaranamaaga A.I., meethaana kavalaihalai payanpadutha koodathu. Intha tholnuzhpanathin palanugalai America-vin natpu naadugalum pera vendum' ena UN, paathukaappu council-il vellai maaligai ariviyal aalosagar Michael Kratsios therivithaar.

headline: Gem Veeramani vazhakil thideer thiruppam! Police adhikarikalukku summon.. Aen?
text:
Chennai granite thozhiladhibar R. Veermani-ku ethiraana POCSO vazhakil needhibathi kadum kandanam therivithathai aduthu visaaranai theeviramadainthullathu. Video aadhaaram irunthum sirumiyaiyum sambava idathaiyum kandupidikka mudiyalai ena koori vazhakai mudikka muyandra police-ku, meendum mel visaaranai nadathi 4 vaarathil arikkai thaakkal seiyya utharavu pirappikkappattathu.
Seithiyaalar - M.Meera
Chennai-yai serntha granite thozhiladhibar R. Veeramani meethu POCSO vazhakku pathivu seiyyappattirunthathu. Intha vazhakku, 2025-aam aandu kuzhanthaigal nalathuraiyudan thodarudaiya thannaarvalar oruvar police-ariidam alitha pugaarai thodarndhu velichathukku vanthathu. Appothu aadhaaramaaga samarpikkappattathaana video-vil irukkum sirumi yaar endru kandupidikka mudiyavillai endrum koorappattathu. Melum antha video-vil iruppavar Veeramani thaan enbathai sariyaaga adaichalam kaana mudiyavillai enbathal intha vazhakai mudithu vaikkavullom endrum manu thaakkal seiyyappattathu.
Ithanai thodarndhu intha vazhakku kadantha 2026, August 19-aam thethi visaaranai-ku vantha nilaiyil, kaavalthurai-ku needhibathi kadum kandanam therivithar. Video aadhaaram irunthum sambava idathaiyo sirumiyaiyo kandupidikka mudiyavillai ena koori vazhakai mudikka mudiyathu endru vimarshitha needhibathi, meendum virivaana mel visaaranai nadathi 4 vaarathil arikkai thaakkal seiyyavendum endrum utharavittaar.
Ithanai thodarndhu R. Veeramani thodarbaana POCSO vazhakil visaaranai theeviramadainthullathu. Veeramani matrum avarathu thodarbudaiya nabargal saarntha 5 idangalil madhiya kutrappirivu (CCB) police sothanai nadathiyullana. Intha sothanaiyil cellphones, aavanangal matrum palveru minnu aadhaarangal kaippartappattullathaaga police therivithullana.  
Oru pen drive-il irunthathaaka koorappattathaana video thodarbaaga nadantha aarambakatta visaaranai-ku pinnar, antha video-vil iruppavar Veeramani ena adaichalam kaanappattathaaga police therivithirunthanar.
Intha vazhakil kadantha August 29-aam thethi Veeramani, avarathu thodarbudaiya Mahendra Simman matrum Shanthi aagiyaor kaithu seiyyappattanar. Kaithu seiyyappatta moovarum needhimandrathil aajarpaduthappattu needhimandra kaavalukku anuppappattanar.
Itharkidayil, Veeramani-yin niruvanathil sumaar 23 aandukal paniyaatrithathaaka koorappattathaana Ganesan enbavarium police September 22-aam thethi kaithu seithanar. Kutrachattu-ku thodarbudaiya video-vai police-ariidam therivikkaamal vaithirunthathaaka avar meethu kutrachattu munvaikkappattullathu. Avaridam nadathappatta visaaranai-yin adippadaiyilae aduthakattamaga 5 idangalil sothanai nadathappattathu.
Chennai Gopalapuram-il ulla Veeramani-yin aluvalagam matrum T.Nagar-il ulla avarathu illam ullitta idangalil intha sothanaigal nadaiperrathu. Kaippartappatta cellphones, aavanangal matrum minnu sadhanangalai aayndu police thodarndhu visaaranai nadathi varukindrana.
Melum, intha vazhakil mukkiya aadhaarangalai maraivatrko allathu visaaranaiyai thisai thirupuvatrko panamparimaatrangal matrum nilaparivarthanaigal nadaiperrathana enbathaiyum police aayndu varukindrana.
Nilaiyil, intha vazhakai munbu visaaritha vibachaara thaduppu pirivu udhavi aaniyaar Yasmin, kaaval aayvaalarugal Mahesh Kumar, Raja Lakshmi aagiyaor visaaranai-ku aajaraaga Chennai madhiya kutrappirivu police samman anuppiyullaar. Melum vazhakai mudithu vaithathu yaen endrum kelvi elappappattullathu.

headline: Mahadev soothatta seyali vazhakkil mukkiya kuttravaali Abhishek kaithu
text: Puthudilli: Mahadev online suthadatta seyali vazhaghghil mukkhiya kuttravaali Abhishek Kumarai Hyderabad sarvadesa vimana nilaiyathil C.B.I., athigarigal kaithu seithenar. Chhattisgarh-ai serndha Saurabh Chandrakar, Ravi Uppal aakiya iruvarum inainthu, merkasiya nadana United Arab Emirates-ai thalaidaniyaga kondu Mahadev online suthadatta seyaliyai nadathinar. Indha seyali moolam 2019 muthal 80 aayiram kodi roopaiyai mosadiyaga sambadhithathaga kuttramsattappattathu. Idhu thodarbaga Chhattisgarh-in palveru police stations-il thodarappatta 13 vazhukkalai C.B.I.,-kku maatrina nilaiyarasu utharavittathu. Indha vazhakkil thappiyodiya mukkhiya kuttravaaliyana Abhishek Kumar United Arab Emirates-in Dubai-il irunthu Telangana-vin Hyderabad sarvadesa vimana nilaiyathukku vandar. Avarai C.B.I., kaithu seithenathu. Online panthayam matrum suthadatta nadavadikkailai iyakkuvathilum, panthaya kuzhukkalai orunginaippathilum, nithi thirattuvathilum mukkhiya pangaatriyathudan, antha varumanathai kondu Dubai-il asaiya sothukkalai vanguvathilum Abhishek Kumar theevira pangaatriyullathaga C.B.I., kuttramsattiyullathu. Avarai kaithu seitha pin avaridam irunthu kuttramai uruthi paduthum AvaNangghaL parimuthal seyyappattathagavum athigarigal therivithanar.

headline: Laabath thogai vazhanga vendum : Mahaasabai koottathil valiyuruththal
text: Annavur: Thodakka velaan kooturavu sanga magasabai kootathil, urupinargal, palveru korikaigalai therivithanatha. Thamizhaga arasu kooturavu sangangaluku therthal nadatha thayaragi varugirathu. Irandha urupinargalin peyarigalai pattialil irunthu neekuvadhu utpatra panigal thuvangiyullana. Oru paguthiyaga, magasabai kootam netru nadanthathu. Dasampalayam, Varathaiyampalayam, Ambothi, Kezhkathavakarai, Kariyampalayam, Kanuvakkarai agiya sangangalil, kooduthal saar pathivalar Santhamani kootam nadathinar. Kariyagoundanur, Allappalayam, Annavur, Kuppampalayam, Kunnathur, Pa.Puthupalayam agiya oorgalil, kooturavu saarpathivalar Radharani kootathai nadathinar. Kootathil, payir kadanai muzhumaiyaga thallupadi seiya vendum. Sanga urupinargaluku labathogai vazhanggha vendum. Viraivil puthiya kadanigal vazhanggha vendum enbana utpatra palveru korikaigalai urupinargal therivithanatha. Theermanangal niraivetrapattana. Sanga seyalargal, paniyalargal matrum urupinargal pangetranar. Indru, Kuppanur, Alagapagoundanur matrum Akkaraisengappalli thodakka velaan kooturavu kadan sangangalil magasabai kootam nadakirathu. Sangangalin urupinargal pangetrka nirvahigal azhaippu viduthullanar.

headline: Meendum kaathiruppoor pattiyalukku maatrapatta Arun I.P.S - Thamizhaga arasu aanai; vivaram enna?
text: Arun I.P.S kaathiruppoor pattiyalukku maatram seyyappattirukkirar. Chennai maanagara kaaval aanaiyaraaga iruntha Arun I.P.S-sai therthal nerathil, inthiya therthal aaniyam kaathiruppoor pattiyalukku maatrinaan, nadavadikkai merkonthirunthathu. Antha pathavukku A.T.G.P anthasthil irukkum Amalraajai niyaamanam seythu utharavittirunthaar. Sathamana therthal mudinthu, thaveka aatchi amainthathai thodarnthu, I.P.S, I.A.S athikaarigal thodarnthu paniyaida maatram seyyappattanaar. Appothu kaathiruppoor pattiyalil iruntha athikaarigalukkum puthiya poruppukkal vazhangappattana. Athil Arun IPS., Tamilnadu oozhal kankanippu mattum lanja ozhipputhurai (DVAC) iyakkunaraaga niyaaminappattar. Antha poruppai yetru 45 naagale aana nilaiyil, Arun appathavilirunthu thidiren paniyaida maatram seyyappattar. Athai thodarnthu, Vandaloor Tamilnadu kaavaluthurai akadamiy iyakkunaraaga paniyaatri vanthaar. Intha nilaiyil, Arun, I.P.S tharpoathu kaathiruppoor pattiyalukku maatram seyyappattirukkirar. Melum, Chennai payirchi pirivu kaaval thurai thalaamai iyakkunar (DGP) Rajeev Kumar, I.P.S, Vandalooril ulla Tamilnadu kaaval akadamiyin iyakkunar poruppaik kooduthal poruppaaga kavanithu kolvaar ena arivikkappattullathu.

headline: 26 vayadhu ilainyarai miratti Rs. 5 latcham panam parippu.. Bigg Boss prabalam Varshini kaidhu!
text: Vijay TV Bigg Boss natchathiril prabalamana Varshini Venkat, kurumpada muthaliedu seiyumpadi koori 26 vayadhu ilainyarai eamatriyathaaga kuttachaattu elunthullathu. Kindiyil ulla prabalamaana thaniyaar hoteltil thangiruntha 26 vayadhu ilainyar kodutha pukarin adippadaiyil, Kindi police-ar intha vazhakai pathivu seithullana. Vijay tholaikatchiyil Bigg Boss natchathiril prabalamanavar kurumpadam edukkaatharka muthaliedu seiyungal enak koori thannai eamatriyathaaga pukarthaarlar therivithullaar. Panathai kettappoluthu kadantha August 22-aam thethi, pesa alaithu thannai thaakki, irandu cellphone-kal matrum 50 aayiram roopaiyai parithathakaaga, athan pinnaar tholaipaesiyil miratti vangi parivarthanai moolam 5 latcham roopai parithathakaaga avar pukaril kurippittullaar. Meendum 27 latcham roopai kettum mirattuvathakaaga, panam tharaavittal poi vazhakku poduvom ena mirattuvathakaaga pukar alithullaar. Ithu thodarbaaga 3 pirivukalil vazhakku pathivu seithullana. Intha vivaharethil Varshini Venkat, Sanjay utpada 4 per mithu vazhakku pathivu seiyappattulla nilaiyil, Kindi police-ar Varshiniyai kaidhu seithu visarannai merkondu varukirannar. Ivar TVK katchiyai saarnthavar enbathu kurippidathakkathu

headline: Pakistan meedhu India nadathiya thaakkuthal endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Pakistan-il ulla bayangaravaathigal mugam meedhu India nadathiya vaanvazhi thaakkuthal endru oru video.

Oru nagarathin meedhu aevoganai thaakkuthal nadathappadum video Facebook-il pathividappattusllathu. Nilai thagavalil, “Pakistan-il ulla theeviravaathigal mugamil Indian raanuwam thaakkuthal..…” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha video-vai palarum samuga oodagangalil pathividu varugindrana.
investigation_details: Kaashmir Pahalgam suttrula thalathil nadathappatta bayangaravatha thaakkuthalukku bathiladiyaaga Pakistan bayangaravathigal mugam meethu India thaakkuthal nadathiyathu. Itharku Operation Sindoor endru peyridappattathu. Intha nilaiyil thaakkuthal nadathappatta kaatchi endru oru video samooha oodakangalil viralaga pagarappattu varugirathu. Inthiya raanutha tharappil video veliyidappattathaga entha seithiyum illatha nilaiyil, intha pathivu sandehathai erpaduthiyathu. Thaakkuthal Israel meethu 2024m aandu Iran nadathiya thaakkuthalin video enbathu theriyanthathu. New York Post ullitta pala sarvadesa oodakangalilum intha video 2024 October 2m theethi thangal samooha oodaka pakkangalil veliyittu Israel meethu Iran nadathiya thaakkuthal endru kurippittirunthanar. Pakistan bayangaravathigal mugam meethu India 2025 May maatham thaakkuthal nadathiyathu. May maatham 6m theethi iravu thaakkuthal nadathappattatha allathu 7m theethi kaalaiyil thaakkuthal nadathappattatha entra thagaval athigaarappoorvamaaga veliyavillai. Prime Minister Narendra Modi iravu muzhuvum kanvizhithu thaakkuthal vivarangalai kankondu irunthaar endru ANI seithi veliyittullathu. Inthan moolam naam aayvvukku eduthukonda pathivil kurippittathu ponru Pakistan meethu India nadathiya thaakkuthalin kaatchi endru paravum video thavaraanathu enbathu uruthiagirathu.

headline: Londanil Ajith pangetrum car panthayam; thuvakki vaikirar mudhalvar Vijay
text: London: Londanil nadakkum prabala car panthayathai mudhalvar Vijay thuvakki vaikka iruppathaga arivikkappattullathu. Thamizhaga mudhalvaraga Vijay poruppetra piragu, arasu muraippayanamaga mudhalmuraiyagainru velinattukku purappattu selgirar. Indriravu 10 manikku purappadum avar, Dubai sendru, piragu angrunthu vera vimanathil naalai London sendradaiya ullar. Angu mudhaleettalarkalai santhithu, Thamizhagathirku thozhil mudhaleettugalai eerkka ullar. Palveru nigazhvil pangetrum avar, thanathu 6 naal payanathai mudithukkondu 17m theethi meendum Chennai thirumbugarar. Intha nilaiyil, ivvara iruthiyil Londanil nadakkum Silverstone car panthayathil sirappu virunthinaraga mudhalvar Vijay pangetrar. Andraya pottiyai pachai kodiyasaithu mudhalvar Vijay thuvakki vaikka ullathaga Le Mans cup niruvagam athigaroorvamaaga arivithullathu. 'Automobile Club de l'Ouest' endra amaippal nadathappadum intha car panthayamanathu, antharaseeya alavil prabalanathamagum. Ithil, motham 44 anigalai serntha car panthaya veerargal pangetru irukkinraran. Thamizhagathai serntha car panthaya veerarum, nadigarumanana Ajithum intha panthayathil pangetru irukkarar. Thamizhagathil antharaseeya tharathilana motor sports nagaram amaikkappadum endru sadasayil mudhalvar Vijay arivithirunthar. Tharpothu, Londanil nadakkum intha car panthayathai paarviyidum avar, angulla antharaseeya tharathilana ulkattamainppu vasathigalaiyum paarviyidugarar.

headline: “Kiruththava alayaththai idiththa Vijay arasu” enru paravum video thakaval unmaiya?
text:
Kiruththava alayaththai idiththu Tamilnattin Yogi Adityanath aga maarinar Tamilnadu mudhalvar Vijay enru oru video

“Poomparai Maranatha Poorana Suvisesa Sabai” enru peyar konda kiruththava alayam onru idikkappadum video Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Nilaith thakavalil, “Adutha Adityanath Yogiya maarinaara Joseph Vijay” enru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha videovai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathividu varukindrana.
investigation_details:
Tamilnattil Vijay atchiku vanthum kiristhava aalayam idikkappattathu endru video-vai palarum samuga udalgalil pathivittu varukindrannar. Atchiku vanthu 10 naal thaan agirathu. Atharkullaga neethimandru utharavu petru agatruvathu enbathellam saathiyamillai. Enave, kadantha atchikaalathil nadantha sambavathin video-vai pagirnthirukkalaam entra sandeghathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai padangalaga maatrik google lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Appothu indha video-vai malayalam udagam ondru May 7, 2026 andru veliyittirunthathu theriyanthathu. Thelivana antha video-vai paarkum pothu athil antha devaalayam Kerala maanilam Idukki maavattathil ulla Poombaarai entra idathil iruppathaga kurippidappattirunthathu.
Antha malayalam udagam veliyittiruntha seithiyai paarthom. Athil, “2024-m aandu aatrin paathaiyil aakkiramithu kattappatta moondru vazhipaattuthalangal ulpada 56 kattidangalai agatra arasu utharavittathu. Ihtai ethirthu nilaththin urimaaiyaalargal vazhakku thodarnthanar. Ivargal mathu uyar neethimandram matrum ucha neethimandrathal nirakarikkappattathu. Ithai thodarnthu idathai kaali seyyumbi nottis vazhangappattu, kattidangal idikkappattana” endru kurippidappattirunthathu.
Ithan moolam indha nigalvu Tamilnattil nadanthathu illai enbathum, indha kattidam idikkappattatarkum Joseph Vijay arasukkum thodarbu illai enbathu urutiyagirathu. Keralavil nadantha sambavathai Tamilnattil Vijay muthalvaraanathu nadanthathu pol thavaraaga pagirnthirupathu thaguntha aathaarangal adippadaiyil uruthi seyyappadukirathu.

investigation_details: Rajasthan maanilaiyil autovil senra 13 vayathu sirumiyai paaliyal vankodumai seytha sambavam naadu muluvathum athirchiyai eRbhaDhudhdhaiyathu. Intha nilaiyil sirumi oruvar maruthuvamanaiyil sikitshi perum videovai pathivittu, Rajasthan paaliyal vankodumai sambavathai patri vivarithullanaar. Itharin moolam intha sirumithaan antha 13 vayathu sirumi enbathu pagirappattu varugirathu. Enave, intha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchigalai pudaakkalgalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Appothu, ithuvum kootu paaliyal vankodumaitku aalana sirumiyin videovthaan... aanaal intha sirumi Uttar Pradesh-ai saarnthavar enru theriyanthathu. Intha videovai facttious enra Instagram pakkam 2026 July 3m thethi pathivitirunthathu. Athil, “Uttar Pradesh maanilai, Hardoi mavattathil pattiyalina sirumi oruvar paaliyal vankodumai seyyappattaar. Kutravaaliyum adaialam kaanappattaar. Aanaal, pala poraattangalukku pirahathaan muthal thaval arikkaiye pathivu seyyappattathu. Uriya nadavadikkai edukkamal kaaval thurai alatchiyam kaatti varugirathu enru sirumiyin kudumbathinar kutramsaatti varugiranar. Kutravaaligal meethu uriya neerathil uriya nadavadikkai edukka vendum” enru kurippidappattirunthathu. Thodarnthu thediya pothu naam aayvukku eduthukonda videovudan bhaskar.com enra Hindi oodagam veliyittiruntha seithi kidaithathu. Athil, kutramsaattappatta nabarai police kaithu seyvittathaaga kurippidappattirunthathu. Namudaiya theduthalil intha video thodarbaaga Rajasthan police veliyittiruntha fact check pathivum kidaithathu. Athil Rajasthan maanilai Ganganagar mavattathil nadantha sambavam enru kurippittu samuga oodakangalil paravum intha video unmaiyil Uttar Pradesh-ai saarnthathu” enru kurippidappattirunthathu. Ivai ellam naam aayvukku eduthukonda video thavaraana purithalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ullathu enbathu uruthi seithana.

headline: Maridhas, Savukku Shankar kaidhu endru paravum poliyana news card!

nammidam pesiya digital poruppaalar, “puthiya thaimarai endru poliyana peyarai vaithu news card-ai parappiyullana. ithu poliyanthu” entraar. intha aatharangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukonda pathivu thavaranathu endru uruthi seyyappadugirathu.
