headline: “Ennaip padippavidungal.. kanavaich sithaikatheergal!” kanneerudan katharum aaratchi maanavar!
text:
“Ennai padippavidungal.. Kanavai sithaikatheergal!” kanneerodu katharum aaratchi maanavar!
Seithiyalar: Rajkumar.R
“Thayavucheithu ennai padippil kanavam seluthavidungal. Meendum meendum mana ulachaltharkum, manareethiyana thollaigalkum ennai aalakkatheergal. Enathu kalviyaiyum, aaratchiyaiyum thodara amaithiyana soolai valangungal. Ennai padippavidungal” ena meendum aaratchi maanavar Bharathidasan video onrai veliyittullar.
Thamizhaga arasin uyarkalvi uthavithogai thittathin moolam malaysiavil ulla palkalaikkalagam onril aaratchi maanavaraga payinru varugirar Bharathidasan . ghaDhandha AghasDh mAdhaM, thanakkana kalvi uthavithogai innum kidaikkavillai ena koori avar video onrai veliyittunthar. Intha vivaharam sattapperavai varaiyum ethurolithiruntha. Intha nilaiyil, samuga neethi matrum sirupanmaiyar nalathurai amaithiyar Vanniyarasu, maanavarkalukkana nithi valangappattu varuvathaga vilakkam alithirunthar. Aanal, atharku piragum thanakku uriya nithi kidaikkavillai ena Bharathidasan thodarnthu therivithu vanthaar.
Nilaiyil, netru meendum video veliyitta avar, “Thamizhaga arasidamirunthu vara vendiya nithi innum kidaikkavillai. Ithanaal ennai palkalaikkalagathil irunthu neekkum nilai erpattullathu. October muthal vaarathil enudaiya aaratchi katturaiyai samarpikka azhaippu vidukappattullathu. Aanal, tharporu ennaal anguch sella mudiya soolai erpattullathu” ena therivithullathu.
Melum, arasu thanathu ottumothathai athikarathaiyum payanpaduthi thannai odukkka muyarchippathagum, kalvi uthavithogaiyai aaratchikkaathaan payanpaduthinaya ena thannidam kelvi ezhuppappaduvathagum avar kuttamchattullathu. “Ennai padipp vidungal.. Ennaiyum matroru Rohit Vemulava ahividatheergal” ena avar kanneerodu urukkamaga pesiyirunthaar.
Intha video samuga valaiyathalil viralanavathai thodarnthu, Thamizhaga arasial vattarathilum intha vivaharam meendum paraparappai erpatullathu. Itharku sernthu, Thamizhaga arasu sarbil maanavarukku intha aandukkana kalvi kattanam erkanave palkalaikkalagathirkku seluthappattuvattathaga vilakkam alikkappattullathu. Melum, kadantha aandil valangappatta uthavithogaiukkana selavinappattialai arasu kettirunthathagum, maanavar alitha pattial erpuudaiyathaga illathathaal athukurippu vilakkam kekappattathagum arasu tharbil therivikkappattullathu. Aanal, ithuvarai maanavar tharbil uriya vilakkam alikkappadavillai enrum arasu kooriyullathu. Selavinappattial sila kulurpadigal iruppathaga therivithu, maanavar padikkum palkalaikkalagathil avar alitha uthesappattialukku opputhal korappattullathaga, antha opputhal kidaithavudan meethamulla uthavithogai valangappadum enrum Thamizhaga arasu vilakkam alithullathu.
Melum, maanavar unmaikku purambana thakavalkalai parappi varuvathagum arasu tharbil kuttamchattappattullathu.
Nilaiyil, Thamizhaga arasu alitha intha vilakkathirku pathilalikkum vagaiyil Parthasarathy meendum video onrai veliyittullar. Athil, “Meendum meendum samuganeethithuraiyum, avargalin IT Wing-m ennai mana ulachalthirku aalakkuginranar. Ithuvarai naan entha vilakkamum alikkavillai ena Thamizhaga arasu therivithullathu. Aanal, atharkana vilakkathai aatharangaludan kadantha maatham 26-aam thethiye samarpithuvitten” ena Bharathidasan therivithullar.
Melum, thaan intha thittathai thavaraga payanpaduthuvathagum kuttamchattappaduvathagum avar kooriyullar. Velinaadugalil 100-kum merpatta maanavargal intha uthavithogai thittathin keel padithu varuvathaga arasu therivithulla nilaiyil, avargalil eththanai per muthukalaip padippum, eththanai per aaratchi padippum padithu varukinranar enra thakavalai thurai veliyida vendum enrum Bharathidasan korikkai viduthullar.
“Muthukalaip padippum, aaratchi padippum onralla.. Indiyavil JRF uthavithogaiudan aaratchi padippu payilum vaippu enakku kidaithirunthum, athai vittuvittu, ithai oru periya vaippaga karuthi velinaattukku vanthu padithu kondirukkiren” enrum avar therivithullar. Aanal, thannai meendum meendum thannibar thaakkathalukku ullakkathu vedanaiyaiyum mana ulachalthaiyum erpatruvathagum Bharathidasan thanathu pathivil kurippittullar. Nilaiyil, maanavar Bharathidasan matrum samuganeethi thurai ena irutharappil maarupatta vilakkangal veliyagi varum nilaiyil, ithil unmai enna enbathu kurippu palveru kelvikalo ezhuppappattullathu. Ethu unmai, ethu thavaru enra vivaharam oruputhram irunthalum, maanavarin kalvi matrum aaratchi entha vagaiyilum paathikkappadatha vagaiyil Thamizhaga arasu uriya nadavadikkai edukka vendum enra korikkaiyum tharporu valuthu varugirathu.

headline: “Sankaraachaariyaar” enbatharkaana aadharangalai kaattinaara Avimuktheswaraanandhaa?
text:
“thaan oru sangaraachaariyaar enbathaai niroobikka veNDhuM” endru jothirmadathin peedaadhipathi swami avimuktheswaranantha saraswathiukku utharappiradesa arasu utharavittathai thodarnthu moondru sangaraachaariyaargalum saanthitharkaludan photovukku pose koduthathaaga oru photograph

jothirmadathin peedaadhipathi swami avimuktheswaranantha saraswathi sangaraachaariyaar matrum iruvarudan saanthithal ondrai pidithappadi nirkum photograph facebook-il pathividappattulladhu. Nilaith thakavalil, “#uthirappiradesathil irunthu #maattukkari velinaadukalukku athikam yetrumathi seyyappaduvathai suttikkaattiya sangaraachaariyar meethu modikkum, yogi aadithyanatharkum, avarmeethu, sollònna kobam! Kaaval thuraiyai vaithu miratti avarai kangaiyil snanam seyya vidamal thaduthu, avarathu sishyangalai adithu nokkiyathu yogiyin kaaval thurai!
Ithu pothaathenru, sangaraachaariyaarin thangiruntha kudisaiyin vaasalil avar oru sangaraachaariyaar enbathaai niroobikka saanthithalai udane arasidam samarpikka vendumendru arasin aanai ottappattathu! Itho moondru sangaraachaariyargalum, antha saanthithaludan nirkum kaatchi! Modikku inthu mathamo, raamaro mukkiyamillai! Inthu matha veriyai thoondi vittu, selvam serppathey gujarathikalin ilakku! Modi + thaadi+ adhaadi +ambathi” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha photovaippalarum samooga oodakangalil pathivittu varukindranaar.
investigation_details:
Sankara madangalul onrana uttarakand manilathil ulla jyotirmath-thin peedathipatiyana swami avimuktheswaranand saraswati, palveru vivakangalil madhiya arasukku ethiraga karuthu koori varugirar. Ithanal ivarukkum BJP-vukkum idaye mothal irunthu varugirathu. Intha nilaiyil, uttarappradesa manilam, prayagrajil nadaiperuvarum maga melavil amavasaiyaiyotty ghaDhandha njAyiRRughghizhamai punitha neerada vantha avarai kaval turai athikarigal thaduthu niruthiyathu carcha指定的 urupattathu. Melum, avar sankarachariar entra padathai eppadi payanpaduthuvathu endru vilakkam kettu mela niruvagam sarbil avarukku notice valangappattathaga koorappattathu.
Intha nilaiyil, thangal sankarachariargal than endru avimuktheswarananthavudan melum irandu sankarachariargal chantitharkaludan vilakkam alithathaga oru pugaippadam samuga oodakangalil viralaga pagirappattu varugirathu. Uttarappradesa arasin nadavatikkaiyku ethirpu therivithu avimuktheswaranantha unnavirathil eeduppattu varuvataga seithigal veliyagi irunthu. Than sankarachariarthan endru avar entha oru vilakkathaiyum veliyittathaga seithigal illai. Enave, intha pugaippadam thodarPaga ayvu seidhom.
Intha pugaippadathai google lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Appothu intha pugaippadam 2025 januaryyil seithi oodakangalil veliyagi iruppathai kana mudinthathu. Idan moolam intha pugaippadam ippothu nadanthukondu irukkum prachinaiyudan thodarudaiyathu illai enpathu urutiyanathu.
Antha pugaippadam thodarPaga thediya pothu, 2025m andu nadantha maha kumbamelavin pothu munru sankarachariargalum inainthu oru hindu matha manattai nadathinar. Athil hindukalin desiya moliyaga samskrithathai arivippathu, india muluvathum pasu vathaigalai niruthuvathu enpathu utlipada 30 piradananthai veliyittargal endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Hindu matham thodarPana ananaiyai munru sankarachariargalum veliyittathaga antha seithigalil kurippidappattirunthathu. Antha piradananthin pugaippadangalum kooda appothu veliyagi irunthathu.
Ivai ellam thangal sankarachariargal enpatharkana atharathai munru sankarachariargalum veliyittargal endru paravum pugaippadam thavaranathu enpathai uruthi seyntana. Intha atharangal adippadaiyil nam ayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaranathu endru uruthi seyyappadugirathu.

headline: Thirudanidam lollipop neettiya sirumi endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kadaiyil kollaiyaditha thirudanidam thannidamirundha lollipop-ai vazhangiya sirumi endru oru video.

Kadai ontril urimaiyalarum avarkalukku arugil sirumi oruvarum amarnthirukka, kollaiyan vanthu urimaiyai alithu panathai thiruvathu ponru video Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Kollaiyanidam sirumi thannidamirundha lollipop-ai neetta, thigaithupona kollaiyan manam thirunthi panathai koduthuvittu, sirumiyin thalaiyil muthamittuvittu veliyeruvathu ponru videovil idam petrunthathu. Nilaith thagavalil, “Thiruda vantha thirudanidam thannidam ithuthan irukkirathu endru lollipop-ai neettum sirumi antha anpirku adipanitha thirudan” endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha video-vai palarum samuga oodakangalil pathivittu varukintranaar.
investigation_details:
kadaiyil kollaiyadiya vandavanidam sirumi thannidam ithu mattumthan irukkirathu ènRu lollipop-ai neetta,antha sirumiyin seyalal manam thiruthiya thirudan enbathu ponru video facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Intha sambavam engu nadanthathu ènRu kurippidappadavillai. Video katchiyai parthum pothu unmai sambavam pola illai. Kadai urimaiyalarum, sirumiyum kollaiyanai parthu sirthum bayamindri amarnthirupathai kana mudikirathu. Kadai urimaiyalarai thakkum katchigal ellam seyyarkaiyaga ullathu. Enave, scripted video-ai unmai sambavam pola pagirthirukkalam enpathal ithu patri ayvu seitom.
Video katchigalai padappadangalaga matri google lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Palarum intha video-ai kadantha sila natkalaga samuga udakangalil pathivittu vanthirunthathai kana mudinthathu. Nam ayvukku eduthukonda video-il thethi sariyaga theriyavillai. Anal, inaiyatil thediya pothu kidaitha video-il thethi sariyaga therinthathu. Athil, november 12, 2025 ènRu irunthathu. Athanal, ithu palaiya video illai enpathu thelivanathu. Thodarndhu thediya pothu november 16m thethi youtube-il oruvar ithai pathivittirunthathai kana mudinthathu.
Athil, “ithu unmaiyana video illai. Intha video-il idam petravargal unmaiyil nadigargal. Video-il kattappadum ayudham poliyanathu. Verum pozhuthupokkukkaga mattum uruvakkappatta video ithu” ènRu kurippidappattirunthathu. Kamran Team Official entra youtube channel intha video-ai veliyittirunthathu.
Antha youtube channel-il veliyana video-akkalai parthom. Ithe ponru CCTV katchi video ponru pala video-akkalai avargal pathivittirunthanar. Pozhuthupokkukkaga veliyidappatta video, ithu unmaiyanathu illai enrere kurippidappattirunthathu. Inthan mulam nam ayvukku eduthukonda video unmaiyanathu illai enpathu urutiyagirathu.

headline: Thalaimai thernthal comisunarukku ethiraaga meendum padhavi neekka theermaanam kondu vara edhirkkatchigal mudivu
text:
- sirappu nirubar -
thalaiymai thernthal kamisanar gyanesh kumarukku ethiraga, muntravathu muraiyaaga parliamentil meendum pathavi neekka theermanam kondu vara, ‘indy’ kootaniyil ulla edirkatchigal theeviramaga kalamirangiyullana.
S.I.R., enappadum, vaakalar pattiyal sirappu theevira thirutham utpada palveru vivakangalil thalaiymai thernthal kamisanar gyanesh kumarukku, pira thernthal kamisanargalana sukhbir singh sandu, vivek joshi aagiyor ezhuthupoorvamaaga ethirppu therivithaka angila thinasari naalithal ontril seithi veliyanathu.
Puthiya vaakalargalai serthal, peyaragalai neakkuthal, vaakalargal tharvuthalathai anuguvathu, puthiya vaakalargalukkana padiyam 6l seyyappatta maatrangal utliya vivakangal thodarbaaga, kadantha 10 mathangalil, 14 murai ethirppu therivithakathu athil koorappattathu. Intha vivakaram, delhi arasiyal vattarathil kadum athirvalaigalai ezhuppi varugirathu. Thalaiymai thernthal kamisanar gyanesh kumar pathavi vila vendum ena arasiyal katchiyinar valiuruthi varugiranthar.
Nilaiyil, gyanesh kumarukku ethiraga theevira nadavadikaiyil iranga, ‘indy’ kootaniyil ulla edirkatchigal thittamittullana. Intha thodarbaaga, edirkatchigalai serntha mootha M.P.,kkal palar, parli., valaga arangil kooti netru alosana nadathinar. Appothu, thalaiymai thernthal kamisanar gyanesh kumar than arasiyal amaippu pathaviyin kanniyathai muttrilum seerukulaithuvittathu ena palar kuttranjaattinar.
Gyanesh kumarukku ethiraga parli.,yil pathavi neekka theermanathai kondu vara avarkal theermanithullana. Atharkana notice, anaithu edirkatchigalin mulu aatharavudan samarppikkavum thittamittappattullathu. Intha vivakarathil thanithaniyaga allamal, anaithu edirkatchigalum, orunginainthu kootu uthiudan seyalpaduvathu endrum mudivedukkappattullathu ena thakalaraintha vattarangal therivithana.
Intha thodarbaana arivippu virainvil samarppikkappadaam ena ethirpparkappadugirathu. Itharkaka, parli., koottathodar nadakka vendiya avasiyamillai endrum, adutha vaarathukkul ithu samarppikka vaippullatha thagal veliyai ullathu.
Parli.,yil kadantha march 12 matrum apr., 24 aagiya thethigalil, gyanesh kumarukku ethiraga, irandu pathavi neekka noteeskalai, edirkatchigal samarppithirunthana. Thunai janathipathiyum, rajyasaba thalaivarumaana c.p. radhakrishnan matrum loksabha sabanayagar om birla aagiyoor, muthal thadava samarppikkappatta noteesirku, opputhal tharamal nirakathinar. Irandavatha alikkappatta matroru notice meethu entha mudivum edukkappadamal, innum niluvaiyil ullathu.

headline: DMK-vudan adimai maadhiri payanippathu migavum vedhanaiyalikirathu endru Gopannaa koorinaaraa?
text: ''DMK-vudan adimai maadhiri payanippathu migavum vedhanaiyalikirathu,'' endru Gopannaa kooriyathaaga,ithil, '' DMK-vudan adimai maadhiri payanippathu migavum vedhanaiyalikirathu -Congress mootha kalaivar Gopannaa aadhangam'' endru ezhuthappattullathu. Sun News logo ullathaal, palarum ithanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaithalangalil share, comment seyvathaik kaana mudikirathu.
investigation_details: Merkanda news card unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appothu, ''ithu poliyaana news card,'' endru theriyanthathu. Intha news card-ai veliyitta X pakkathil parody account endru thelivaga kurippidappattullathu. Ithan moolamaaga, Sun News peyaril iyangum poliyaana pakkam onru veliyitta card-ai eduthu, unmai pondru parappukiraargal, endru thelivakirathu. Ithotarkaga, Sun News aasiriyar kuzhuvai thodarbugondu kettapothu, ''engalathu peyaril pagirappadum vathanthi ithu,'' endru therivithanaar. Aduthappadiyaaga, unmaiyaana news card-in link kidaithathu. Athil, ''TVK-vudan Congress kootani vaithaal athu tharkolaikku samam. 140 aandu kaala Congress periyakkam, netru peytha mazhaiyil mulaithatha TVK-vudan kootani servathaa? Vedhanaiyaaga irukkirathu -Congress mootha thalaivar Gopannaa aadhangam,'' endruthaan ezhuthappattullathu. Enave, naam aayvukku eduthu konda news card unmaiyaanathalla, endru sandeghamindri uruthi seyyappadukirathu.

headline: Salomon Pappaiya ninaivanjali
text: Madurai: Madurai Senthamizh kallooriyil thamizhringar Salomon Pappaiya ninaivu vizha, naangam thamizhchchanga seyalaalar Mariappamurali thalaiyil nadanthathu. Kalloarich seyalaalar Dasaratharaman munnilai vahithaar. Mudhalvar Shanthidevi varraetraar. Pappaiya peyaril pattimandra ani saarbil arakkattalaiyai Raja thuvakkinaar. Kalloari thunaimudhalvar Subbulakshmi nandri koorinaar. Thanjai thamizh palkalai munnaal thunaivaendar Thirumalai, oyvu peraasiriyargal Srinivasan, Prabhakar, Ramasami, Pappaiyayin magal Vimala, Puratchi Paavalar Mandra thalaivar Varatharajan pangeartranar. Thirunagar: Makkal mandram saarbil ninaivaanjali nigalchchi nadanthathu. Mandra thalaivar Chella thalaimai vaithaar. Fathima kalloori munnaal thunaimudhalvar Visaalaatchi pesinaar. headline: 'Kalaignarudan oppida Udhayanidhiku enna arunghadhai irukirathu?' - Aadhav kelvi!
text:
DMK 10000 rupai koduthalum vella mudiyathu. DMK indha muraiyum oru 5000 rupai kodupargal. Makkal adhaiyum vangi vittu visilukke ottu poduvargal. Deepavaliukku dress edupatharkaga DMK kasu kodukirathu
Madurantakam thoguthi idaitherthalil TVK sarbil potiyidum Maragatham Kumaravelukkaga baga mugavargal kootam nadathappattathu. Adhil pesiya amaichar Aadhav Arjuna DMK-vai kadumaiyaga visarisithu pesiyirunthar.
Aadhav Arjuna pesiyathu, 'TVK eppadi vendrathu ena 75 varuda katchi innamum aaratchi seithu kondirukkirukathu. M.K.Stalin therthalukku piragu veliyeve varavillai. Kalyana veedukalil mattum pesikkondirukkirar. Udhay-ai nankam kalaignar, Che Guevara, chinnavar enkargal. Kalaignar methu aayiram vimarpanam irunthalum, anbarin thiramaikku Udhayanidhi oppavara?
Appadi solvatharku arunthai ventama? M.K.Stalin-in maganaka neraga varakkodathu. Nammai mathiri ulathu mele vara vendrom. Ethiri yarentre theriyamal prasaram seithargalam. Therthalil ethiri yaar endru kooda kandadaiya mudiyatha katchithan DMK.
Verum Instagram-ai vaithe ungalai engal thalaivar mudithu vittar. Thalaivarai ningal muraiyaka prasaram kooda seya vidavillaiye.
DMK-vil MLA, mavatta seyalalar aga vendumenil antha kudumbathukku 12% cutting kodukka vendum. Engaludaiya mavatta seyalalargalum MLA-kalum makkalodu makkalaga irukkirargal.
Thiruvannamalai endrale E.V.Veluvaam...Avar enna periya Gandhiya? Oru ottukku 5000 kodukka vendum. Engalellam kodukkalam enbathuthan ivargalin arasiyal.
Therthalukku munpaga magarum thiyagi Senthil Balajiyai thooki kondadinargal. Ippothu avar kandukolvathe illai.
Idaitherthalil makkalukku kasu kodukkave mattom, eluthi vaithukollungal.
Madurantakathil vetri namakke' endrar.

headline: Maattukottagaiyil oru taiyal meshin... 10 pengalukku velai, Rs.30 latcham turn over!
text:
Kalakkum Kavitha
Kudumbap poruppu, kuzhanthaip paramaripu ena pala savalugalukku naduve sonthamakath thozhil thodanguvathu enbathu pala pengalukkum kanavagave irukkirathu. Kuzhanthaigalin ethirkalathukkagum, suyamariyathaik kappatrik kollavum maattuk kottagaiyil thodangiya oru siriya muyarchiyai, pathukkum merpatta pengalukkana vazhatharamaga mARRaiyirukkiricar, Kovai Karumathampattiyai serntha Kavitha.
"Naan aintham vaguppu varaithan padichiruken. Aarambathula enga veettukku pakkathula iruntha oru zavuli millukku kooli velaikku poyittu irunthaen. Kalaiyil irunthu sayangalam varai कठिनama ulaichalum, masam verum 3,000 rupaiythan kidaikkum. Intha varumanathula anranda kudumbach selavugalai samalikkirathe periya porattamaga irunthuccu. En rendu pen kuzhanthaigalai sayangalam school mudinju veettukku varum pothu kavanikkavo, sappadu kodukkavo yarum irukkamattanga. En kanavarum vivasaya velaigalukkaka adikkadi veliyoorukku poyiduvaru. Kuzhanthaigalin pathukapputhan mukkiyamnu ninaicthu, veli edangalukku velaikku pogama veettula irunthe edavathu kaithozhil seiyanumnu mudivu panninen.
Enakku thaiyal theriyum. Engamma veettula iruntha pazhaya thaiyal meshinai eduthuttu vanthu, athai repair panni payanpaduth thodanginen. Veettukku pinnala iruntha maattuk kottagaiyai suththam seythu, thaiyal meshinai angarye pottuth thaikka thodanginen. Pakkathula iruntha yetrumathi niRuvanathula irunthu koolikku paigal thaichu kodukka vaayppu kidaicuthu. Athula masam 10,000 rupai varai varumanam kidaicuthu..."
- Satru thalainiraintha soozhalil, Corona perun thottu Kavithavin vazhvil migaperiya thiruppumunaiyai erpaduthiyirukkirathu.
"Corona samayathula yetrumathi thozhilgal mudanginathala, companygalil irunthu order varvathu ninnu pocchu. Nerukkadiyaanantha kattathula, thunippai galukkana thevaiyum vizhippunarvum athigarikka thodangucchu. Matra niRuvanangalukku koolikku thaichu kodukkirathukku bathila, namai cotton paigalai utpatti senju virpanai seyalameennu yosichen. Veettukku pakkathulaiye oru chinna thozhirsalaiyai amaicthu, thevaiyana meshinangalai vangippottu sonthama business thodanginen" enkirar. Thozhilin aduththakatta nagaruvukkum, valarvukkum Kavithavin magalgal pangalithirukkirargal.
"Chinna vayasulaiye thaiyal pathina vishayangal en rendu magalgalukkum theriyum. School padikkumppothe naan thaikkira paigalil irukkira chinna kuraipadugalai kooda thulliyama kandupidichu solliroduvanga. Mootha magal Rithanya, computer technology padichittu velaikku poyittu irukkanga. Chinna ponnu Dakshanya, fashion designing mudichittu ennodae serndhu business-ai parthukkiranga.
Magalgal vantha piraguthan thozhilnutpamum business-ukkulla vanthathu. Digital marketing vazhiya online orders edukkurathu, social media pakkangalai kaiyalrathu, mail, message-ukku udanukku udan bathil alikkirathu-nnu ellathaiyum avangale parthukkiranga. Chinna viyabarigal thodangi periya corporate niRuvanangal varai order eduthu, paigal seythu koduthuttu irukkom. Return gift, office paigal, shopping paigal-nu ella vagayana paigalaium thayarikkirom. Paruththi thunigalai mattume payanpaduththi paigal thayarikkirathala sutrusoozhalkku uganthathakavum, neeedukalam uzhaikkakkoodiyathavum irukkum. Ippa enga business-oda turn over varushathukku 30 latcham rupai. Sumar 10 pengal enga niRuvanathula velai parkkuranga. headline: ‘Kolathur tholvi manathalavugal pathithullathu’ endru M.K.Stalin koorinaara?
text:
Kolathur tholvi ennai manathalavula pathithullathu endru Thi.Mu.K thalaivar M.K.Stalin kooriyathaaka oru news card

munnaal muthal amaicharum Thi.Mu.K thalaivarumaana M.K.Stalin pudaippadathudan Puthiya Thalaimurai veliyittathu pondru news card Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Athil, “Kolathur tholvi ennai manathalavula pathithu ullathu. Ithanaal adikkadi sattaiya kizhithu kondu enakku naane sirithu kondu veetta vittu veliye varamudiyamal irukkiren. Stalin, DMK thalaivar” endru irunthathu. Intha news card-ai palarum samooka oodakangalil pathividu varukindranaar.
investigation_details: Kolathur sathimandra thoguthiyil pottiyitta M.K. Stalin tholviyadainthaar. Iruppinum avar sahajamaaga thannudaiya katchi panikalai seithu varukiraar. Intha nilaiyil, avar tholvi kaaranamaaga manathalavaha baathikkappattullen endru kooriyathaaga oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodangalil pathivu seithu varukiraarhal. Adikkadi sattaiyai kilithukonndu, enakku naane sirithukonndirukkiren endru kurippittiruppathellam Stalin-ai asingappaduthum nokkil vendathavarkal veliyitta news card-poleye irukkirathu. Enave, ithu thodarbaaha aayvu seitom. Intha news card-ai Puthiya Thalaimurai veliyitthatha endru ariya athan samooga oodanga pakkangalai paarvayittom. Appothu, ithe maathiriyaana card-ai September 10-m thethi Puthiya Thalaimurai veliyitthirunthathu therinthathu. Aanaal athil, "Yaar ennai kochappaduthinaalum, varalaatru maatra mudiyaathu; athu kaalathukkum appadiyethaan irukkum Misa kurithu mudhalvar Vijay pesiya nilaiyil DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin video veliyittu pechu" endru irunthathu. Intha news card-ai edit seithu thavaraana thagaval serthu veliyitthiruppathu therinthathu. Ithai uruthi seiya, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai Puthiya Thalaimurai digital poruppaalarkku anuppinom. Avarum ithu poliyaanathu endru uruthi seithar. Melum ithu poliyaanathu endru muthruyudan Puthiya Thalaimuraigil pathivu ondrai veliyittuvathaha avar therivithar. Intha moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanathu endru uruthi seyyappadukirathu.

headline: "I.Na oru payanatra amaippu" - Argentina athibar kadum thaakku!!
text: New York-il nadantha Ikiya Naadugal Sabaiyin pothu vivaatha kootathil uraiyaatriyulla Javier Milei, I.Na thanathu adippadai nokkangalil irunthu vilagi 'payanatra amaippaka' maarivittathaga therivithullaar. Ikiya Naadugal Sabaiyin 81 aavathu kootatharin pothu vivaatham America-yin New York nagaril nadaiperuvarugirathu. Varum 28-m thethi kontha kootathodar niraivaaduvulla nilaiyil, palveru ulaga naadugalin thalaivarkalum pirathinithigalum pangeṟru, uraiyaatri varugiranthar. Anthavakaiyil thaan, I.Na vivaatha kootathil pesiya Argentina athibar Javier Milei, kootru paathukaappu mathum manitha urimaikalai uruthi seyya vendiya amaippu, atharku pathilaaga kulappam, vanmurai mathum sarvadesa bayangaram vanmurai needikka vazhiyavuthullathaga I.Na amaippin meethu kadumaiyaana vimarcanam onrai munvaithullaar. Meethum, I.Na oru "payanatra amaippaka" maarivittathagavum, nalla nokkamudaiya athigaarigal entra porvaiyil seyarpadum athigaarathuva amaippai mattume athu aadharipathagavum Milei kadumaiyaaga saadinar. Kurippaga, Argentina-vukkum Britain-ukkum idaiyilana neendakaala Falkland theevukal, athavathu Malvinas theevukal thodarbaana iraiyaanmai prassnaiyayum avar ezhupinaar. Intha vivaharathil, I.Na theermanaangal niraivetrapattum, avatrai seyarpaduvatharkaana nadavadikkigal edukkappadavillai endru Milei kutramsaattiyathudan, "vaarthaigalukkum theermanaangalukkum panjamillai... aanaal, avatrai meerupavarkalukku vilaivukal illai" endrum avar vimarsithar. Meethum, Falkland theevukal vivaharathil Britain meendum pechuvarthaiyai thodanga vendum enavum atheneram, I.Na-vai vimarsiththaalum, sarvadesa amaippukalil Argentina thodarnthu pangeṟpum endrum avar therivithullaar.

headline: Uttarapradesh-il Holi kondattathil vanmurai endru paravum video unmaiya?
text:
Uttarapradesh-il Holi pandigai kondattathil silar bayangara aayuthangalai vaithu thaakkikondathaga oru video

Saalaiyil ilangarkal katta, kathi ulliitta aayuthangalai vaithu vahanangalai thaakki udaikkum video Facebook-il pathividappattullatru. Nilai thagavalil, "Uttarapradesh-il Holi pandigai" endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Intha reels-ai palarum samuga udamakkalil pagirndu varugirargal.
investigation_details:
Vada India-il Holi utsahathudan kondaadappadugirathu. Intha kondattathin pothu aangange virumbathakkatha sambavangal nadanthathaga samuga udamakkalil sila pathivugal pagirappattu varugirargal. Antha vagaiyil, Uttarapradesh-il Holi kondattathin pothu erpatta vanmurai endru oru video samuga udamakkalil pagirappattu varugirathu. Ithu unmaiya endru ariya aayvu seithenom.
Video kaatchiyai padangalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Appothu, intha sambavam Gujarat maaniyam Ahmedabad-il nadanthathu endru sila X thala pathivugal namakku kidaithana. Adhan adippadaiyil Google-il thedinom. Appothu, intha thaakkuthal sambavam thodarbaaga udamakkalil veliyana seithigal namakku kidaithana. Avaiyum intha sambavam Ahmedabad-il nadanthathu endru uruthi seithena.
Unavagam onrait thirappathu thodarbaaga Sigarwar matrum Pawsar endru iru nabarkalukku idaiye mothal irunthu vanthullathu. Sigarwar samippathil siraiyilirunthu veliye vanthullar. Ithai arintha Pawsar tharappinar thaakkuthal nadathiyullarnar. Ithai thodarndu kutravaaligal anaivarum kaidhu seyyappattathaga antha seithigalil kurippidappattirunthathu.
Melum, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda videovudan, kutravaaligalukku sariyaana paadam nadathiya piragu edukkappatta video endru kurippittu Ahmedabad police veliyittiruntha X thala pathivum namakku kidaithathu.
Ivai ellam naam aayvukku eduthu konda video Uttarapradesh-ai saarnthathu illai enbathum, Holi kondattathil erpatta vanmurai illai enbathaiyum uruthi seithena. Intha aatharangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaranathu endru uruthi seyyappadugirathu.

headline: Nepaal peruvellam melum 6 udalgal meetpu
text: Kaathmaanduu: Nepaalathil, peru vellathil paadhikkapatta neermina surangathil irunthu, melum aaru udalgal meetpattanam. Nam andai naadana Nepaalam ulla Chinaavin kattupaattil ulla Tibet ellaiyil, Imayamalai thodaril ulla Laangtaang Lirung sigarathil iruntha panippaaraiyin oru paguthi, Aug., 26-l thidirenathu sarinthu vizhunthu. Ithanaal erpatta peru vellam ulla nilachariyaal, pala graamangal, paalangal, saalaigal adithu sellappattanar. Ithil 1,410-kum merpattaor uyirizhanthanar; 6,145 per maaymaagiyullanar. Kurippaaga, appaguthiyil iruntha neermin thittangalin surangangalkkullae thanneer ulla saetru pugunthathil, nootrukkannana thozhilaalargal ullae sikkinar. Samippathil Indian ulla Nepaalak kuzhuvinar inainthu, Silimae neermin thitta surangappaathaiyil irunthu ainthu udalgalai meettanar. Atharku mun, 'Trisulii 3A' neermin thittathinthu surangattharku, 558 adi thoorathil sikkiyiruntha irandu thozhilaalargalai uyirudan meettanar. Nilaimaiyil, 'Trisulii- 1' neermin thittathinthu suranga paguthiyil, concrete velaikkaaga thayaar seythiruntha irumbu valaikkullae sikkiyiruntha aaru udalgalai Nepaal meetpu padaiyinar netru meettanar.

Ungal kanavar allathu uravinarai inai kadanaliyaka sethathu avarathu varuvaiyaiyum kanpithu kadan vangineergalo?
Ungalathu tharpothaya varumanathai mattum vaithu intha kadanai udane adaikka mudiyathu. Oru sila vazhimuraigal solkiren. Uthayogamaka irukkuma endru paarungal.
Inimele ovvoru aandum ungalukku kidaikkum sambala uyarvu, Deepavali bonus, incentive akiya ottumoththa panathaiyum selavu seyyamal, neradiyaka veettukkadanudaiya asalil varavu vaiyuthu.
Aduthadutha aandugalil ungal sambalam uyarum pothu, tharpothaya E.M.I. thogaiyai varudathirku 5 muthal 10 sathavitham varai konjam konjama uyartha solli vangiyil kelungal.
Aandukoru murai oru thavanai thogaiyai mattum kooduthala selutha muyalungal. Intha chinna chinna vazhimuraigal pinpatrinale, 20 aandu kadanai pala aandukalukku munbe mudithu vida mudiyum.
 Cryptocurrencylil muthalidu seivathu nalla muyarchiya? Beldux, Chain Link sariyana vazhiya?
C.Velmurugan, Soorampativalasu, Erode 
Illai. Abayam athikam. Athu pathukappana 'muthalidu' kidaiyathu. Athu 'ooga vanigam'. Ithil pangangal, thangam, manai pola entha adippadai sothum kidaiyathu. Nam nattil cryptocurrency, roopai pola sattappuravana nanayamaka angikarikkapadavillai. Ithana, muthalidalarkalukku kidaikkum pathukappum migavum kuraippu. Ithil labam vanthal 30 sathavitha variyum, crypto parivarthanaigalukku T.D.S., vidigalum ullana.
Chain Link : Oracle networkil iruppathai crypto santhaiyai poruthavarai itharku unmaiyana tholilnutpa payanpadu ullathu. Blockchain tholilnutpathil palveru payanpadukalukkaka ithu payanpaduthappadugirathu. Aanal, crypto santhai veezhchiyadiyum pothu ithuvum kadumayana sarivai santhikkum.
Beldux : Intha coinil panam poduvathu kandippaka thavirungal. Samipaka tamilnattil pala idangalil ithu MLM muraiyil, 'nichayam labam varum' ena asai katti virkappadugirathu. Nithi santhaiyil ippadi network marketing muraiyil virkappadum enthaoru thittamum uruppanathaka sarthirame illai.
Kashappattu sampathitha panathai pathukappaka valarkka virumbinal, pangusanthai ya allathu mutual fund pakkam sellungal. Potta panam muzhuvathu azhinthalum paravayillai ena athika risk edukka thayaraga irunthal mattum, intha pakkam thalaivaithu padungal.
 En pangangalaiyum atharkana dividendkalaiyum muthalidalar kalvi & pathukappu nithiyathukku anuppi vittathaka oru niruvanam therivithullathu. Appadi anuppuvatharku moondru mathangalukku munnaar, panguthararku notice anuppi vibaram therivikka vendum enbathu vithi. Aanal, intha kurippitta niruvanam athai seyyavillai. Ithai ethirthu enge naan pugar seyyavendum?
R. N. Rajan, Bengaluru 
Neer suttikattiya sattam mattum muthalidalar kalvi & pathukappu nithiyathukkana vidigal muttrilum sariyana vai. Sattappadi neer antha niruvanathukku ethiraka porada mudiyum.
Aanal, konjam nadamurai chikkalkalaiyum kavanathil kollungal. Ungal palaiya mukavariyai sathyana thabalil notice anuppinom endro, allathu vidigalilpadi nalithazhgalil pothu arivippu kodutthu vittatom endro niruvanam elithaka sattathirunthu thappithu vidum. Ithana, ungal neramum panamum thaan veenagum.
Athanal 'notice tharavillai' endru niruvanathudan satta porattam nadathuvathai vida, ungal pangangalai meetpathe ippothaya muthal velai.
Pangangal erkanave arasu nithiyathukku poyvittathal, antha niruvaname ninaithalum athai ungal kanakkirku neradiyaka thiruppi thara mudiyathu. Enave, udanadiyaka 'IEPF-5' pathivathai onlineil poorthi seithu, athil kurippidappadum aavanangalai thayaar seithu, antha niruvanathin IEPF athikaritiyam samarpikkum nadamurayai thodangungal. Athuve ungalukku mana amaithi tharum.
Vasakangale, nithi sambanthappatta ungal kelvikalai, 'E-mail' mattum 'Whatsapp' vayilaka anuppalam.

headline: “Massage seidukonda Modi” endru paravum video unmaiya?
text: Massage seidukonda Modi-yin ragasiya video veliyaanadru endru kurippittu oru video vayadana nabar oruvar mugathil pennmani oruvar massage seiduvidum video Facebook-il pathividappattulladhu. Adhil angilathil “Pradhan mantri Modi-yin video veliyaanadru” endru ezhuthappattirunthathu. Nilaith thagavalil, “Vazhraanya manushan… Ji” endru kurippittirunthathu. Indha videovai palarum samuga oodangalil pathivittu varukindrana.
investigation_details: Pradhaar Modi massage seidhu kondaboadu edukkappatta ragasiya video veliyaanathu endru palarum videovai pathivittu varugindrana. Anal, videovil ulla naparai paarkum poadu Narendra Modi poala theriyaavillai. Vellai thaadi ulla anaivarum Narendra Modi endru kooruvathu poal irunthathu indha pathivu. Enave, ithu thodarbaaga aayvu seidhom. Video kaatchigalai padangalaga maatri Google Lens thalathil pathivetri thedinom. Appoadu, pradeep kaur dhillon endra Instagram ID-yil indha video thodarbaaga veliyaana vilakkamalikkum pathivu ondru namakku kidaithathu. newshourindia endra Instagram pakkam veliyirunthandha videovai reshare seidha pathivu athu. Athil videovil iruppavar Modi illai endrum, pradeep kaur dhillon endra Instagram pakkathil ulla penmaniyin kanavar endrum kurippidappattirunthathu. pradeep kaur dhillon endra antha Instagram pakkathil vellai thaadi vaithu ulla antha naparudan antha penmani irukkum pala pathivigal irunthana. Panjaabi kudumbam ondrin pathivu athu enbathu theriya vanthathu. Antha Instagram pakkathil naam aayvukku eduthukonda video illai. Modi endru kurippittu palarum videovai pagirave, antha pathivai agattiyirukkalam endru therinthathu. Antha agattappatta pathivin screenshot nammudaiya Fact Crescendo Malayalam thalathilirunthu namakku kidaithathu. Adhae nerathil massage maathiri vera oru videovum namakku kidaithathu. March 28m thethi pathividappattiruntha antha pathivil antha vellai thaadi naparin mulu uruvathaiyum thelivaga kaana mudinthathu. Athu antha penmaniyin kanavarthan enbathu ithan moolam thelivanathu. Panjaabi penmani oruvar thannudaiya kanavarkku massage seidha videovai eduthu, Narendra Modi massage seidhu konda video endru thavaraaga pagirnthiruppathu ithan moolam thelivagirathu. Intha aadharangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukonda pathivu thavaranaathu endru uruthi seyyappadugirathu.

headline: “Vada maanila maanavargaludan pottiidum alavukku Thamizhlargalukku arivillai” endru Nainar koorinaara?
text: Vada maanila maanavargaludan pottiidum alavukku Thamizhlargalukku arivillai enbathaal Neet-ai rathu seyya mudiyaathu endru Tamilnaadu BJP thalaivar Nainar Nagendiran kooriyathaaga oru news card Puthiya Thalaimurai veliyittathu pondru news card Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Athil, “Rathu seyya mudiyaathu. Vadamaanila maanavargaludan pottiidum alavarkku Thamizhlargalukku arivillai enbatharkaaga Neet-ai rathu seyyamudiyaathu. Thesiya Janaayaga Kootani aatchikku vanthaal NEET thervu rathu seyyappadumaa endra kelvikku Nainar Nagendiran bathil” endru irunthathu. Intha news card-ai palarum samooga oodakangalil pathividu varugindrana.
investigation_details:
ThamizhnADhDhul NEET thervai rathu seyya mattom enbathuthaan Bharathiya Janatha katchiyin nilaippadaaga ullathu. Itharku Thamizhaga maanavargalukku arivillai enbathalithan rathu seyya mudiyathu ènRu Thamizhnaadu BJP thalaivar Nainar Nagendran kooriyathaaka news card onraai palaarum samooka oodakangalil pathivu seithu varukindaraanar. Entha soozhalilum ippadi oru karuthai entha thalaivarum koora maattar enbathal ithu poliyaaka irukkalaam enbathal ithu patri aayvu seithom.
NEET thervu thodarbaaka Nainar Nagendran samipathil karuthu therivitharaa enru thediya pothu, NEET thervai rathu seyya mudiyathu ènRu avar betti alithiruppathu therinthathu. Athil entha edathilum vada maanavaarkaludan pottiyidum alavukku Thamizhlargalukku arivillai enbathal NEET thervai rathu seyya mudiyathu ènRu kooravillai. Appadi avar kooriyathaaka entha oru oodakathilum seithi veliyagavillai.
Intha news card-ai Puthiya Thalaimurai veliyitharaa enru ariya athin Facebook pakkathai paarvayittom. Athil naam aayvukku eduthukkondathu ponru news card onrai veliyiruppathai kandom. Athil, “NEET thervai rathu seyya mudiyathu ena naangal aarambathil irunthe solli varukirom” enru thaan irunthathu. Ithai edit seithu maatril, thavaraana thagaval sethu samooka oodakangalil pagirnthiruppathu thelivaanathu.
Intha news card poliyaanathu enbathai uruthi seithukolla ithai Puthiya Thalaimurai digital poruppalaarukku anuppinom. Avarum ithu thavaraanathu, edit seyyappattathu enru uruthi seithaar. Intha aathaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaraanathu enru uruthi seyyappadukirathu.

headline: Coimbatore-il thirakkappatta puthiya maempalathil mazhai neer thaekkam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Coimbatore-il puthithaga kattapatta meypalathil mazhai neer thengiyathu endru oru video

Meypalathil yerum paguthiyil mazhai neer thengiyirukkum video Facebook-il pathividappattullathu. Video-vil angilathil Coimbatore, Periyanaickenpalayam palam endru ezhuthappattullathu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “DMK karanga kovil katti thaan kumbidanum ivangala tharkuri solrathatha illa koomuttai solrathatha enakku theriyala Coimbatore-il kattapatta puthiya meypalaiyam pokkuvarathu nerisalai kuraikkutho illaiyo nichayamaga mazhai neer sekarikka uthavukirathu” endru kurippidappattirunthai. Intha video-vai palarum samuga udamangalil pathividu varugirannar.
investigation_details:
Coimbatore-il puthithaga kattappatta mempaalathil mazhai neer theangiyathu endru videovai palaarum pathivittu, Tamilnadu arasai vimarshithu varukindranaar. Coimbatore-il puthithaga thirakkappatta mempaalam endral athu G.D. Naidu mempaalam thaan. Aanaal, videovil Periyanaickenpalayam endru kurippidappattirunthathu. Coimbatore-il kattappatta puthiya paalam endru kurippittiruvathin muulam sameepathil thirakkappatta G.D. Naidu mempaalathai thaan koorugiraargal endru theriyuthathu. Thaanae, ithu thodarbaaga aayvu seythaom.
Muthalil intha video kaatchigalai puthiraangalaaga maatrina Google Lens thalathil pathivaetri thedinaom. Appothu kadantha sila maathangalaaga intha mempaalathil mazhai neer theangiya video samooga oodakangalil pakirappattu vanthiruvathai kaana mudinthathu. Ithu thodarbaana seithigalai paarthom, thesiya nedunchaalaiyil mathiya saalai pokkuvarathu amaichakam saarbil kattappattu sameepathil Prime Minister Narendra Modi-yal thiranthu vaikkappatta Periyanaickenpalayam mempaalathil mazhai neer theangiyathal vaakana ottigal avathiyuttrathaaga koorappattirunthathu.
Intha paalam thodarbaaga thodarndhu thedinaom. Appothu, 2024 March 11-theathi mathiya arasin seithi vilambara pirivaana PIB veliyittiruntha seithi kurippu ondru namakku kidaithathu. Athil, “Nagapattinam, Gudalur-Mysore saalaiyil, Periyanaickenpalayam-Coimbatore puranagara paguthiyil Rs.99 kodi selavil 1.76 km thoorathirku kattappatta mempaalathaiyum Prime Minister thodangi vaithar” endru kurippidappattirunthathu.
Ithin muulam intha paalam puthithaga thirakkappatta GT Naidu mempaalam illai enbathum, Tamizhaga arasu kattiya paalam illai enbathum uruthiyaakirathu. Intha aathaarangal adippadail naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pathivu thavaraanathu endru uruthi seyyappadukirathu.

headline: Mr. Kazhugu: “Aaru perai thorkadipom...” - Edappadi Palaniswami sabatham!
text:
Oruvelai, di.mu.ka kootanikku vara pa.ma.ka sammathithuvittal, mathuranthagam thoguthi pa.ma.ka-vukkuppogalam.
“Ethirkatchith tharappilirunthu kelvi ketka vaippalikkave illai. Veyrum pathilurai matlythanthaan ennaal, ithithaan satramantra nadamuraiya?” ena yaarukko voice note anuppiyapadiyae aluvalakathukkul entry koduttha kazhugaarukku, karuppu kauniy alvavum, mukkanippayasamum kodutthom. Suvaithuvittu, seithigalukkul thaavinaar.
“ `Mathuranthagam, tharapuram thoguthigalukku october 6-m thethi idaith-theyartthal nadaiperum’ ena inthiya theuthal aanaiyam arivitthirukkirathu. Idaitheyartthalil vetri petru than aalumaiyai nirubikkavendiya nerukkadi entha alavukku tha.ve.ka-vukku irukkiratho, athe alavukku sitting thoguthigalai meendum kaipatravendiya nerukkadi a.thi.mu.ka-vukkum irukkirathu. September 6-m thethi nadantha a.thi.mu.ka mavatta seyalaalarkal kootatthil, ‘namma katchiyai serntha aaru peer m.l.a pathivai raajinaama seithu throgam senjuttanga. Avangalai varra idaith-theyartthalil thotkadakkanam. Vijay alai veesinapothai, antha aaru thoguthigalaiyum naamathaan jeyichom. Marupadiyum naamathaan jeyippom. Ithukkaaka sapatham eduthu, nambikkaiyoda vela seivom...’ endru nirvaagigalukkal azhutthamaka karuthu payirthirukkirathu edappadi.”
“Oho...”
“Antha aaru thoguthigalilum kalanilavaram thodarpaaka oru survey-yai edutthirukkirathu edappadi. Athil, ‘tharapuram, mathuranthagatthil mattumae vetrikkaana vaippirukkirathu. Pa.ma.ka kootaniththil thodarnthaal mattumae mathuranthagatthil vetri saathiyam’ endru report alikkapattirukkiratham. Athatthodarnthu, k.p.munusamy, agri krishnamoorthy ena seniors-ai alaiththu aalosanai seithavar, kooduthal kanam seluttha mavatta seyalaalarkalukkum, than makan mithunukkum uttharavitthirukkiraaram.”
“Di.mu.ka-vin thittam enna?”
“Idaitheyartthal arivikkapattirukkum irandumae thanithoguthigal enpathal, ‘vi.ci.ka-vilirunthu di.mu.ka-vil inaintha seyyoor munnaal m.l.a panaiyoor paabuvai mathuranthagatthil nirutthaalaam’ endru aalosanai odikondirukkirathu. Oruvelai, di.mu.ka kootanikku vara pa.ma.ka sammathithuvittal, mathuranthagam thoguthi pa.ma.ka-vukkuppogalam. Atheneram, ‘idaitheyartthalai purakkanniththu, a.thi.mu.ka-vai mattum pottiyaduvittu tha.ve.ka-vait thotkadakkalama?’ endru pechum oru pakkam odigirathu.”
“Hmm... Latcha ozhipputthurai raid-il sikkirukkirarae munnaal amaichar k.n.nehru?”
“Nehrukkuk sonthamaana 10-kum meerpatta idamgalil raid nadatthiyum ethum sikkavillaiyam. Intha raid kurithu moonru naalukkalukku munpae alert kodutthirukkiraarkal sila kaavaluthurai athigaarigal. Ithanaal, periya alavil entha aavnatthaiyum edukka mudiyavillaiyam. Intha nilaiyil, ‘party fund’ vivagatthai vaiththu vazhakku pathivum seyyapattirukkirathu. Aanalaam vazhakkai adutthakattatthukku edutthu selvathil latcha ozhipputthuraikku kadum azhuttham kodukkappadugirathu...”
“Vazhakkamaaka raid-galilum vazhakkugalilum sikkum munnaal amaichar senthil baalaji, ippothu utkatchi charchaikalil sikkirukkirarae!”
“Di.mu.ka-vil, maruceeramaippu panigalai kankaanikka kovai mavattatthukku munnaal m.p., s.r.paarthipan, munnaal mayor reka priyadharshini aakiar niyamikkappattanaar. September 6-m thethi nadantha avasara seyarkuzhu kootatthil, maruceeramaippu nadavadihaigal kurithu avarkal aalositthirukkiraarkal. Appothu, ‘naangal solvathupadithaan katchiyai pirikkanam, nirvaahigalai niyamikkanam’ endru senthil baalajiyin uthaviyaalar shankar, iruvaridamum azhutthamaka sonnaraam. ‘Meendum senthil baalajiyin aatharavaalarkalukkae katchi pathivukalil vazhanguvathu aniyaayam’ ena, kongu di.mu.ka-vinar pongugiraarkal.”
“Atha sari... Puthukottai di.mu.ka-vilum vaartthai por muttriyirukkirathae?”
“Aamaam. Puthukottai therku mavatta seyalaalar ragupathikkum, aranthangi munnaal m.l.a uthayam shanmugatthukkum idaiyae mothal vediththu pothuvelikku vanthuvittathu. Medaiyilaiyae iru tharappum vaartthaikalaal vaaleduiththu veesiyirukkiraarkal. Ithupola prachanaikal than kaathukku varumppothu, ‘sandai vanthal varattum... paarththukkalaam’ endru amaithiyaaha irukkiraaram di.mu.ka thalaivar stalin. Ithaitthaan iru ithazhukkalukku munpaaba neer cover story-aaha veliyitthirunthirey... Athil sollippattapolaevathaan nadakkirathu” endru kazhugaarukku, paneer 65 kodutthom. Suvaithapadiyae seithigalai thodarnthaar.
“September 9-m thethi kootanik katchigalin kootatthai koottiyirukkirathu tha.ve.ka. Muraippadi kootani amaippathu kurithutthaan paesavirukkiraarkal. Kazhantha murai maamallapuratthil nadantha kootatthil, ‘nammudaiya puthiya kootanikku peyar sootta vendam. Thalaivar, oruinginaippaalar, uruppinarhalai niyamikkanam’ endru paesappattapothu, ‘ippothaikku vendam. Aduttha kootatthil mudivedutthu kollalaam’ endru sollivittar vi.ci.ka thalaivar thirumavalavan. Ippothu atharkaana kaalam kaninthirukkirathu.”
“Atha sari...”
“Mudhalvar vijay-ait thalaivaraakkondu uruvaakum antha kootanikku, congress katchiyin maannikkam thaagoor allathu thirumavalavan oruinginaippaalaraaha niyamikkappadalaam. Ma.thi.mu.ka., i.u.e.m.l., vi.ci.ka katchigalai sernthavarkal uruppinarhalaaha idamperavirukkiranar. Oruinginaippaalar poruppu kidaikkaathathil ma.thi.mu.ka pothuch-seyalaalar vaiko upset-aam.”
“Oho... Communists yaar pakkam?”
“Avarkal ‘idathusaarigal munnani’ engira peyaril puthithaaha oru aniyai kattamaikkum muyarchiyil irangiyirukkiraarkal. October 15-m thethi ‘tamilnadu ini idathu pakkam’ endru thalappil thiruchiyil maaperum peranikku aayatthamaahiraarkal. IdaitheyartthalkkuLLe communists-aiyum thangal kootanithil inaitthukollum poruttu, ‘amaicharavaiyil idam vendam ena sollivittirgal. Thunai sabanaayakar pathivai tharugirom. Athai yetrukkondu neengalum engaludan vara vendam’ endru offer kodutthirukkirathu tha.ve.ka thalaimai. Mudhalvar thalaimaiyil uruvaakum intha kootanikku, mathachaarpatra, samooga needi vaasagangal adangiya oru puthiya peyar aalositthirukkirathu.”
“Sari... Puthiya vimaana nilaiyam amaippatthukku maatru idam theervahivittathaa?”
“Gummadipoondukku arugai maaneedoor giraamatthai theervuseythirukkiraarkal. Aanaal, 130 kilometre tholaivil amainthirukkum thirupathi vimaana nilaiyatthai, sarvadesa vimaana nilaiyaamaaha mempadutthum muyarchiyil andra arasu irappathal, maaneedooril puthiya vimaana nilaiyam amaikka mathiya arasu anumathi koduppathu sirkam engiraarkal. Chengalpattu mavattam, seyyooril amaikkalaam entraal, perum paguthi vivasaaya nilaihangalaaha irappathudan, othyoor paravaigal saranalayamum irappathal angaiyum sikkal vara vaippirukkirathu.”
“Hmm...”
“Thalainagarilulla oru thaniyaar kalloorikku sonthamaaha, aayirak-kanakkaana aekar nilangal tamilnagarengum irukkiraarkal. Sirupanmai samoogatthinar nadatthum antha kallooriyin sothukalai, nirvaagatthil iruppavarkalaiyae konjam konjamaaha surandi vittuvittirkaalam. Kazhantha ainthandukalil mattum, kallooori arakkattalaikku sonthamaana 1,000 kodi rooba sothukal muraigedaaha kaimaattappattiruppathaaha pugar ezhunthirukkirathu. Romanirunthu vanthavarkal athu kurithu visaariththu maelidatthukku arikkai thaakkal seithirukkiraarkal. Intha vivagatthil, ‘kazhantha aatchiyil kolochchiya ‘thoongaa nagar’ maanmiguvin kaingaryam eyathum irukkirathaa?’ endru thondat thodangiyirukkirathu tha.ve.ka arasu.”
“Oho... Real estate company ondridam pammugirathaamae tha.ve.ka arasu?”
“Athu ennavo unmaithaan. Aatchi maarinaalum kaatchi maaravillai enpathupola, ottai ezhuthu niruvanatthin aathikkam ippothum thodarkiratham. Antha niruvanatthaal paathikkapattavarkal pugaraliththaal, vazhakku pathivuseyiy marukkirathaamae kaavaluthurai. Pollatchi, salem, thiruchi, thiruvalloor aakiya idamgalil ithupola nadanthirukkirathu. Angairukkum kaavaluthurai uyarathigaarigal, ‘maelidatthula irunthu permission vaarama naangal vazhakku pathivuseyya mudiyaathunga’ endru kai-virikkiraarkal. ‘Antha ottai ezhuthu niruvanatthukkum, annaasalai katchiyin maelidatthu mappillaikkum iruntha thodarpu oorarintha rahasiyam. ‘Makkal panatthai thottavarkal vizha maattom’ endru sooluraikkiraar mudhalvar. Avarin aatchiyil, appadi thottavarkal paathukaappathu, mudhalvarkku nerukkaamaaha irukkum andrahatthai poorvihaamaaha konduvar enpathal, naangal eppadi nadavadikkai eduppathu?’ engiraarkal police athigaarigal...”
“Hmm... Veyru enna viseysha seithigal?”
“Mudhalmaanaiyavarkku nerukkaamaana thurai-muga mavatta amaichar, kazhantha moonru maasamkaalaaha strictly-aakathaan irunthirukkirathu. Thoguthiyin mukkiyappulligal, sanga prathinithigalai santhippaththe marutthu vantha nilaiyil, tharpothu uravuppulli oruvarai prathyekamaaha niyamitthirukkirarae. Yaar, entha vishayatthukkaaka anuginaalum, ‘machankitta paesikonga’ endru sollividugiraaram amaichar.”
“Machan arasiyal aarambitthuvittathaa...”
“Machanum summa illai. Thurai-muga maanagaraatchiyin tender vivagangal, vasool routes ena sakalatthaiyum visaarikka thodangiyirukkiraar. ‘Yaaridamum demand seyyavendam. Atheneram, anbalippukalai marukkavendam’ ena mudivedukkappattirukkirathu. Samipatthil mavatta poruppum tharappattiruppathal, amaicharukku latchimi kadatcham kittivittathaaha solgiraarkal.”
“Maanagaraatchi enpathum ninaivukku varuthu. Eppothuthaan ullaatchi theuthal nadatthavirukkiraarkal?”
“Appadiyoru thittamae tha.ve.ka-vidam illaiyam. Ullaatchi poruppukalai kalaiththuvittu, athigaarigalai vaiththukondu nirvaaham seyyum mudivil irukkiraarae mudhalvar. Idaitheyartthalil makkalin pulse-ai paarththuvittu ullaatchi theutthalai eppothu nadatthalaam enpathu mudivanaum engiraarkal. Atharku munnathaaha, tamilnadu maasila theuthal aanaiyar jyothi nirmalasamiyai antha poruppilirunthu agatra aayatthamaahiraarkal.”
“Hmmmm...”
“Thenmaavattatthil tha.ve.ka konjam weak-aaha iruppatthai unarntha katchi thalaimai, nadaar samooga vaakukalai kurivaiththu, ‘kal irakkatthadaiyaillai enru arivitthuvidalaamama?’ ena aalositthirukkirathu” endru sollivittu kilamba aayatthamaana kazhugaar,
“Immanuel sekaran ninaivaalana september 11 andru, ‘vanni arasukku ethiraaha porattam nadatthuvom’ endru puthiya thamizhagam thalaivar doctor krishnasamy arivitthirupatthai adutthu, samooga veelaithalathil iru tharappum maari maari vaartthai por nadatthivarugiraarkal. Ithanaal, september 11 andru nadaperum anjali nigalvu entha vidha asambaavithamum illaiyammai amaithiyaaha nadanthu mudiya vendam endru pathatatthil irukkaarkal kaavaluthuraithinar” enpathupadi siragalai viritthuvittu,
“Innoru seithiyai kayum. Maduraiyil, koodalnagaril 11-m vaguppu padiyvarum pattiyalina maanavar thamizhchelvan, maatru samoogatthai serntha saka maanaviyudan natpaaha pazhakivanthathu prachanaaniya nilaiyil, september 7-m thethi marmamaana muraiyil sadalamaaha meetkappattirukkirathu. Antha maanavar aanavappadugolai seyyapattiruppathaaha avarin petror kutramsaattugiraarkal” enpathupadi paranthaar.

headline: Kolathur thoguthi TVK MLA V.S. Babu udalnilai munnetram
text:
Chennai: Kolathur thoguthi TVK MLA V.S. Babu udalnilaiyil munnetram erpatullathu; doctorgalin thodar kankanippil ullar ena MGM maruthuvamanai nirvaagam arikkai veliyittullathu.
Kolathur thoguthi TVK MLA-vaaga iruppavar V.S. Babu. Sep 9-m thethi moochuthinaral erpatu udalnilai paathikkapattar. Piragu avar amainthakaraiyil ulla MGM thaniyaar maruthuvamanaiyil serkkappattar. Angu theevira sikitse pirivil sikitse alikkappattu varugirathu.
Nilaiyil indru (Sep 19) maruthuvamanai nirvaagam veliyitta arikkai: TVK MLA V.S. Babu udalnilai seeraga ullathu; palveru maruthuva thuraigalai serntha doctorgal kuzhuvin theevira kankanippil irukkirar.
Tharpothu anbarathu udalnilaiyil munnetram erpatullathu. Avarukku alikkappattu varum sikitsekku avar udalnilai othuzhaippu alikkirathu. Vaaru maruthuvamanai therivithullathu.

headline: Sothukkaaga petrorai thunburuthum pillaihalai sattam paahukaadhu: Ucha Neethimandram kaattam
text: Puthudilli: 'Sothukkaaga petrorai thunburuthum allathu emaatrum pillaihalai sattam orupothevum paahukaadhu' ena, Ucha Neethimandram theriviththullathu. Dilliyai serntha vayana thampathi, thangalukku sonthamana idaththil veedu onrai kattiyirunthaar. Intha veettin muthal maadiyil, than makan matrum marumahalai vaadakaiyindri vasikka avarkal anumatriyirunthaar. Oru kattaththil, veedu thodarbaaha poli aavanangalai uruvaakiya makan, athai sontham kondadinaar. Petrorai veettaivittu thuraththa muyndraar. Veettin meethu urimai kori, maavatta neethimandrattai makan naadinaar. Avarkalukku ethiraaha theerppu vanthathai aduththu, Dilli uyar neethimandrattai avar anuhinaar. Angum, avarin petrorukku aatharavaaha theerppu vanthathu. Intha uttharavai ethirththu Ucha Neethimandraththil makan maelmuraiyeedu seythaar. Intha manu, neethipathikal Satheesh Chandra Sharma matrum N. Koteeswar Singh ahivarkal adangiya amarvu mun visaaranaiykku vanthathu. Appothu neethipathikal pirappiththa uttharavu: Nam naattil petrorukku ena thaniyidam undu. Inthiya samuthayaththilum, Hindu matham ullitta pira mathangalilum thaayukku mikavum uyarndha idam alikkappadukirathu. Thaay - thanthaiyarai thunburuthum allathu emaatrum pillaihalai sattam orupothevum paahukaadhu. Intha vazhakkil sambanthappatta ilaiyarin nadaththai thavaraaha ullathu. Avar than thaayidam senru, avarin anbai unarnthu paathangalai thottu aasi pera vendum ena intha neethimandram virumbukirathu. Manuthaararana ilaiyarin manu thallupadi seyyappadukirathu. Aduththa 60 naatkalukkul veettai kaali seyvathudan, than petrorukku uriya izhappeedaiyum makan vazhanga vendum. Vaaha uttharavil koorappattullathu.

headline: Silambam pottigalukku thiranda maanavarkal thittamidal illaiyena petror athirupthi
text:
silambam potigalukku thiranda manavargal thittamidal illaiyena petror athiruthi
kovai: mavatta alavilana ‘muthalvar koppai’ silambam poti echanari thaniyar kallooriyai netru thuvangiyathu. ithil, 55, 65, 70, 75 kilovukku utpattor pirivugalil iru balarukkum potigal nadakkirana.
kadanthandai vida manavargal ennikkai athigam enbathal potiyai nadathi mudikka naduvargal thinarina.

‘kaalai 7 manikke vanthuvittom. aanaal, 11 manikku piragu thaan ovvoru pirivaga theru seithanar. mathiyam 1:30kku vantha naduvargal silar naalai(inru) manaviyaria potikku alaithu varumaaru therivithanar. pollachi, annooril irunthu vanthu neenda neram kathirunthom. uriya thittamidal inri poti nadathuvathu ellorukkum veen alaichalai tharugirathu’ ena, manaviyarin petror pulambinar.
mavatta vilayattu aluvalar bhuvaneshwari, ‘‘kadanthandu 300–500 manavargal mattume silambam potiyil pangetranar. inthanthu manavargal 1,200kku merpattorum, manaviyar 800kku merpattorum vanthirunthanar. iru tharappinarukkum paathipu varakkoodathu enbatharkaga, manaviyarukkana poti thallivaikkappattathu,’’ enraar.

headline: Naadaalumandrathil modiyai neradiyaaga edhirtha raagul kaandhi endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Modi-yin kangalaip paarthup pesiya raagul kaandhi endru oru pugaippadam

naadaalumandrathil piradhamar narendhira Modi-yin idathirku sendru raagul kaandhi vaakkuvaadham seythadhu pondru oru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhaithaan singam enbaargal, kangalaip paarthup pesuvavar #raagulgaandhi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padathai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Makkalavaikkulle piradhamar modiyudan edhirkkatchith thalaivar raagul kaandhi modhalil eeduvattadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Raagul kaandhiyin indha seyalaithaan singam (veeram mikkavar) endru solvaargal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhu endra arthathil padhivittiruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
Naadaalumandrathin avaikkul tholaikkaatchigalin kemaraakkal anumadhikkappaduvadhu illai. Aanaal, modiyudan raagul kaandhi vaakkuvaadhathil eeduvatta podhu anaithu oodagangalum Modi-yin irukkaikku aruge sendru olippadhivu seythadhu pondru pugaippadam ulladhu. Idhuve indha pugaippadam poli enbadhai urudhi seygiradhu.
Melum, modiyum raagul kaandhiyum ippadi modhikkollave illai. Ore oru murai raagul kaandhi piradhamar narendhira Modi-yin idathirke sendru avarai kattippiditha sambavam thaan nadandhulladhu. Pugaippadathaip paarkkum podhu idhu pudhiya naadaalumandrak kattidathil nadandhadhu pol illai. Pazhaiya makkalavaiyil nadandhadhu pondru kaattiyullanar. Modi-yin mesai vazhakkamaaga avaith thalaivaraip paarthadhu pol illaamal thirumbiyirukkiradhu. Avaradhu mesaiyin oliverukkigal veru pakkam thirumbi ullana. Modi-yin irukkaikku edhireye raagul kaandhiyin irukkai ulladhu pondru ulladhu. Raagul kaandhi aruge irukkum irandu uruppinargalin mugathotram ondraaga irukkiradhu. Ivai ellaam indha pugaippadam eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhaith thelivuvaduthina.
Idhu eai pugaippadamaa enbadhai ariya thehive.ai endra inaiyathalathil indha pugaippadathaip padhivetram seythu paarthom. Adhu 99 sadhavigidham eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhudhaan endru urudhi seythadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pfizer-n peyaril poli marundhu! Roo.5 kodi mosadi pinnani enna?
text:
Pengalooru aruge urimam illaamal marundhugalai maruvek seythu pudhiya levil otti virpanai seytha kumbal meedhu sodhanaiyil roo.5.05 kodi madhippilaana poli marundhugal, iyandhirangal parimudhal seyyappattadhu. Kuraindha vilai marundhugalai uyarndha uyirgaakkum marundhugalaaga maatri vitradhu velichathukku vandhulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
karnaadagaavil poli marundhugal thayaarithu, virpanai seythadhaaga ezhundhulla pugaar podhumakkal mathiyil adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Pengalooru therku maavattam pidadhi aruge aagast 18-aam thedhi nadathappatta sodhanaiyil, urimam illaamal marundhugalai maruvadiyum pek seythu, pudhiya levilgal otti virpanai seythadhu kanduvidikkappattadhu. Sumaar roo.5.05 kodi madhippilaana poli marundhugal, iyandhirangal matrum achidum porutkal parimudhal seyyappattana.
Kuraindha vilaiyil vaangappatta marundhugalai, vilai uyarndha uyirgaakkum marundhugalaaga maruveyarittu virpanai seythadhaaga mudharkatta visaaranaiyil theriyavandhulladhu. Idhaiyaduthu 16 marundhu urimangal rathu seyyappattu, 8 urimangal idaineekkam seyyappattullana. Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940-n keezh vazhakkum padhivu seyyappattulladhu.
Innilaiyil idhu kurithu Pfizer niruvanam veliyitta arikkaiyil noyaaligalin paadhugaappu, thayaarippu tharam matrum podhu sugaadhaarathaip paadhugaappadhil niruvanam thodarndhu kavanam seluthi varuvadhaagak kooriyulladhu.
Indha vivagaaram thangal kavanathirku vandhadhil irundhu kadandha oru maadhamaaga adhigaarigaludan inaindhu paniyaatri varuvadhaaga Pfizer therivithulladhu. Visaaranaikku udhavum vagaiyil palveru nadavadikkaigalai eduthulladhaagavum niruvanam kooriyulladhu.
Kurippaaga, poli marundhugalil thangaladhu unmaiyaana marundhugalin Batch Number-kal nagaledukkappattirundhadhaal, kuzhappathaith thavirkka sambandhappatta sila Pfizer marundhu attaigalai sandhaiyil irundhu agatriyadhaaga niruvanam therivithulladhu. Melum, unmaiyaana marundhugalaiyum poli marundhugalaiyum veruvaduthik kandariya adhigaarigalukku udhaviyadhudan, paadhikkappatta marundhu attaigal thodarbaana thozhilnutba matrum thevaiyaana thagavalgalaiyum vazhangiyadhaaga kooriyulladhu.
