Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, naam pudhiya thalaimurai aasiriyar kuzhuvilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Endometriyosis paadhippu.. Pengalukku neerizhivu avaayam.. Aayvil thagaval!!
text:
Karuppai thisukkal velippurathil valarum endometriyosis paadhippu ulla pengalukku, 'taip 2' neerizhivu noy erpaduvadharkaana vaayppu 46 sadhaveedham adhigam endru America-vil ulla jaarj mesan palgalaikkazhagathin pudhiya aayvil adhirchi thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. 1996 mudhal 2021 varai sumaar 30 latcham pengalidam merkollappatta indha neenda kaala aayvil, indha paadhippaal udalil erpadum naalbatta azhatsi (Chronic inflammation) insulin edhirppai uruvaakki, neerizhivu noykku vazhivaguppadhaagak kandariyappattulladhu.
Kurippaaga, maadhavidaay niruthathukku mundhaiya paruvathil ulla pengalukkum, udal paruman illaadha pengalukkum indha avaayam adhigamaaga ulladhu. Indha noy verum inapperukka aarokkiyathai mattumallaamal, pengalin ottumotha udalnalathaiyum paadhikkakkoodiyadhu enbadhu idhanmoolam thelivaagiradhu. Enave, endometriyosis paadhippu ulla pengalukku aarambathileye neerizhivu parisodhanai seythu munnecharikkai nadavadikkaigalai eduppadhu avasiyam ena maruthuvargal valiyuruthugindranar.

headline: Vijay ‘naay’ endru koori TVK, thondargal penar pidithanaraa?
text:
‘’naagaikku varum engal naaye varuga,’’ endru koori TVK, thondargal penar pidithadhaagak kurippittu,

idhil ulla pugaippadathil, ‘’naagaikku varum engal naaye varuga,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu oru edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu. Idhuvatri TVK, thalaimaik kazhaga aluvalagathai thodarbugondu kettavodhu, ‘’engal kazhagath thalaivar Vijay patri edhirkkatchiyinar vendumendre arasiyal ulnokkathudan idhuvondra edit seytha pugaippadangalai samooga valaidhalangalil parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithanar.
Idhevondru, TVK, podhus seyalaalar en.aananth aluvalagathilum pesi, kuritha pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhalla, endru urudhiseythullom.
Nellai District TVK IT Wing veliyitta X valaidhala padhivil unmaiyaana pugaippadam pagirappattulladhu. Adhil ‘’naagaikku varum engal naalaiya theerppe varuga,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Unmaiyaana pugaippadathaiyum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadathaiyum oppeedu seythu, inge inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, arasiyal ulnokkathudan pagirappadum oru vadhandhi, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: DMK-vai kaappi adikkum adhivar Trump; salugai arivippu kurithu sreedhar vembu karuthu
text:
Chennai: ovvoru kudimaganukkum thalaa, 5,000 taalar vazhangappadum ena adhivar Trump DMK-vai kaappi adithu iruppadhaaga sogo niruvanar sreedhar vembu therivithullaar.
Amerikkaavilum, nammoor paaniyai pinbatri, 'varum navambar maadham nadaivera ulla paarliment therdhalil kudiyarasu katchi vendraal, ovvoru kudimaganukkum thalaa, 5,000 taalar adhaavadhu, 5 latcham roobai vazhangappadum' endru, adhivar tonaaldu Trump arivithullaar.
America-vin makkal thogai, 34.9 kodiyaaga ulladhu. Adhil ottalikka thagudhi petror, 27 kodi per. Tiramppin arivippuvadi, 27 kodi perukkum thalaa 5,000 taalar vazhanginaal, arasukku 129 latcham kodi roobai selavaagum. Idhu arasukku migap periya sumaiyaagum.
Indha arivippu kurithu, sogo niruvanar sreedhar vembu veliyittulla padhivil, ''naangal idhaith Thamizhagathil uruvaakki, India-vin pira pagudhigalukkum parappinom. Adhivar Trump tharpodhu DMK-vai kaappi adithullaar'' ena nagaichuvaiyaaga padhivittullaar.

headline: Pakistan anusakdhi maiyam aruge nadathappatta thaakkudhal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Paagisdhaanin anusakdhi kattalai maiyam aruge India-vin pirammos evuganai vizhundhadhil erpatta paadhippu endru oru video

vimaananilaiyam matrum pala idangalil migap periya alavil raanuva thaakkudhal nadathappattadhan video pagirappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indhiyaavin pirammos evuganai paagisdhaanin NCA thalaimaiyagathirku aduthulla anusakdhi kattalai maiyathirku arugil vizhundhadhu.
Indhath thaakkudhalaal islaamaavaath migavum adhirchiyadaindhu, thalaiyidak kori amerikkaavirku odinar.
Pakistan-il maruthuva avasaranilai, anu kadhirveechu paravi varugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pakistan meedhu India merkonda aavareshan sindhoor thaakkudhalil paagisdhaanin anusakdhi kattalai maiyam paadhikkappattadhaaga video ondraip palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vil aravi mozhiyil thagaval irundhadhu. Video-vai paarkka mathiya kizhakku naadugalil nadakkum thaakkudhal pola ulladhu. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video-vai aayvu seythom.
Video-vil idam petra aravu mozhiyil veliyaana seythiyai koogul tiraanslettar udhaviyudan mozhimaatram seythu paarthom. Adhil, “sanaa sarvadhesa vimaana nilaiyam (Sanaa International Airport) meedhu America – isreliya padaigal nadathiya thaakkudhal” endru irundhadhu. Pakistan-il Israel, America raanuva thaakkudhal edhuvum nadakkavillai. Sanaa sarvadhesa vimaana nilaiyam engu ulladhu endru thediya podhu adhu eman naattil iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video Pakistan-il India nadathiya thaakkudhalin paadhippu video illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, The Straits Times endra oodagam me 7, 2025 andru YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhil, eman vimaananilaiyathin meedhu Israel nadathiya thaakkudhal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha thaakkudhal sambavam thodarbaaga veliyaana pala seythigal, veediyokkalaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Sendhilbaalaaji maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhi endru pazhaiya seythiyai pudhidhu pola parappum vishamigal!
text:
Sameevathil amaichar padhaviyilirundhu vilagiya sendhilbaalaaji nenjjuvali endru koori maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattadhaaga oru news card

Polimer TV veliyitta news card-ai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “aisiyu pirivil sendhil paalaaji anumadhi. Omandhooraar arasu maruthuvamanai aisiyu pirivil munnaal amaichar sendhil paalaaji anumadhi. Sendhil paalaajikku moochu viduvadhil satru pirasnai iruppadhaal maruthuvargal parisodhanai; isiji ullitta parisodhanaigalai maruthuvargal merkondadhaaga thagaval” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Amaichar padhaviyilirundhu sameevathil sendhil paalaaji raajimaanamaa seythaar. Indha nilaiyil avar maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil news card-ai pagirndhu viraivil kaidhu seyyappaduvadhilirundhu thappikka naadagam nadathugiraar enbadhu pondru karuthaip pagirndhu varugindranar.
Aanaal, sendhil paalaaji maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Melum, andha news kaardileye thelivaaga 2024m aandu joolai 21m thedhi veliyidappattadhaagak kurippidappattulladhu. Adhai kavanikkaamal, kavanithaalum avadhooru parappiye aaga vendum endra ennathil indha news card-ai eraalamaanavargal samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varuvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
Indha news card pazhaiyadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya, 2024m aandu joolai 21m thedhi Polimer TV veliyitta news card-ai thedi eduthom. Appodhu oodagangalil veliyaana seythigalaiyum eduthom. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-il ulla thagaval 2024m aandu nadandhadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
2024m aandil sendhil paalaaji maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappatta seythiyai pudhiya seythi pol parappi, vazhakkil irundhu thappikka maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattullaar enbadhu pondru thavaraana thagavalai samooga oodagangalil palarum pagirndhu varuvadhai thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seythullom. Indha thagaval thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Karpazhippu vazhakkil ayothi raamar kovil poosaari kaidhu seyyappattaaraa?
text:
Kadathal matrum karpazhithal vazhakkil raamar kovil poosaari kaidhu endru ayothi raamar pugaippadathudan oru padhivu

ayothi paala raamar vikragam matrum saamiyaar oruvar pugaippadathai inaithu pugaippada padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Adhil, “kadathal matrum karpazhippu vazhakkil raamar kovil poosaari kaidhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “#sendhoor udalil odum onaay sangi engirundhaalum medaikku varavum! Idhuvum indhu pennin kungumathai azhippadhaippola thaane… sangi… ratham irukkaa…. Kodhikkudhaa…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ayothi raamar vikragathin pugaippadathudan saamiyaar oruvarin pugaippadathai inaithu raamar kovil poosaari kaidhu endru palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Pugaippadathil ayothi raamar vikragam iruppadhaal, padhivaip paarkkum podhu ayothi raamar kovil poosaari paaliyal vangodumai vazhakkil sikkiyadhu pondra thotrathai erpaduthugiradhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Karnaadaga maanilathais saarndha raamar kovil ondrin saamiyaar oruvar kaidhu seyyappatta sila thinangalukku munbu seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Andha seythiyai ayothi raamar pugaippadathudan thavaraaga pagirndhirukkalaam enbadhaal aayvu seythom. Indha padhivil ulla saamiyaar pugaippadathaik koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, idhu karnaadaga maanilathil nadandha sambavam thodarbaana saamiyaar enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indha saamiyaar pugaippadathudan endidivi ullitta oodagangalil veliyaana seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Adhil, karnaadaga maanilam pelgaam maavattam megaali (Mekhali) endra kiraamathil ulla raamar kovilin archagaraaga irundha logeshvara magaaraaj enbavar 17 vayadhu sirumiyai kadathis sendru paaliyal vangodumai seythadhaaga kaidhu seyyappattullaar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha sambavathirkum ayothi raamar kovilukkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thodarbaaga samooga oodagangalil thediya podhu neenda thagavaludan palarum indha pugaippadathaip pagirndhirundhanar. Adhil, “karnaadaga maanilam pelgaam maavattathais saarndha raamar kovilin poosaari logeshvara magaraaj enbavar sirumiyai paaliyal vangodumai seythadhaagak kaidhu seyyappattullaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Aanaal, silar andha neenda padhivil idam petra thagavalai maraithu, ayothi raamar vikragathudan “raamar kovil poosaari kaidhu” padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu kuzhappathai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu… idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Karnaadagaa therdhalil thirumaavalavan pottiyittaaraa?
text:
‘‘karnaadagaa therdhalil pottiyitta thirumaavalavan,’’ endru koori,

idhil, 10/05/2001 andru nadaivetra sattamandra therdhalil DMK koottani saarbaaga, Tamil Nadu muzhukka pottiyitta VCK vetbaalargal matrum thogudhi vivaram idambetrulladhu. Mangaloor thogudhiyil thirumaavalavan pottiyiduvadhaagak kurippidappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, karnaadagaavil ulla mangalooril thirumaavalavan pottiyittadhaagak koori samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha mangaloor karnaadagaavil illai enbadhum, idhu Tamil Naattin kadaloor maavattathil ulladhu enbadhum theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha 2001 sattamandrath therdhalil kadaloor maavattam mangaloor thanith thogudhiyil DMK koottani saarbil pottiyitta thirumaavalavan, 2004m aandu DMK koottaniyai vittu vilaginaar. Appodhu avaradhu emele., padhaviyaiyum raajinaamaa seythaar.
Kurippitta mangaloor pagudhiyil DMK matrum VCK saarbaaga indralavum arasiyal nigazhchigal nadaiveruvadhu vazhakkam. Adharkaana sila seythi aadhaarangal idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vetrukkiragavaasigal uyirudan irukkindranavaa? Secret-ai udaitha vinjnjaanigal!
text:
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
vetrukkiragavaasigal iruppadharkaana aadhaaram kidaithuvittadhaa endra kelvi sameevagaalamaaga adhigamaaga ezhuppappadugiradhu. 2025-aam aandu, poomikku veliye uyirgal iruppadharkaana miga valuvaana arigurigal kidaithulladhaaga seythigal veliyaagina. Kurippaaga, K2-18b endra vetrukkiragathil uyirgal irukkalaam endra thagaval kavanam petradhu. Adhevol, sevvaayk kiragathil NASA-vin Perseverance rovar aayvu seytha ‘Cheyava Falls‘ endra paaraiyilum, uyirinangalin seyalbaattudan thodarbudaiyadhaaga irukkakkoodiya sila adaiyaalangal kanduvidikkappattadhaaga NASA therivithadhu.
Aanaal, perumbaalaana vinjnjaanigal idhai eppadip paarkkiraargal? Indhak kelvikkup padhil therindhugolla ulagam muzhuvadhum ulla nootrukkanakkaana vaaniyal matrum vetrukkiraga uyiriyal aaraaychiyaalargalidam aayvu nadathappattadhu.
K2-18b thodarbaana aayvil, verum 6.6% vinjnjaanigal mattume vetrukkiraga uyirgal kanduvidikkappattirukkalaam endru oppukkondanar. Sumaar moondril irandu pangu vinjnjaanigal idhai erkavillai. 28% per endha mudivaiyum therivikkavillai.
Sevvaayin paaraiyil seyyappatta aayvil nambikkai satru adhigamaaga irundhadhu. 15.1% per uyirinangalin thadayangal kanduvidikkappattirukkalaam endru therivithanar. 44.6% per idhai erkavillai. 40.3% per nadunilaiyaaga irundhanar.
Idhilirundhu oru mukkiyamaana vishayam therigiradhu. Vinjnjaanigalin karuthu verumane “aam” alladhu “illai” endru irandaagap pirindhuvidavillai. Aadhaarangal podhumaanadhaaga illai endru palar karudhugindranar.
K2-18b thodarbaana thagavalgal poomiyil irundhu migath tholaivil ulla oru kiragathin valimandalathai aayvu seythadhan adippadaiyil kidaithavai. Aanaal, sevvaay paaraiyai neradiyaaga aayvu seyya mudigiradhu. Adhanaal iru aayvugalukkum idaiye mukkiyamaana veruvaadu ulladhu.
Uyirinangal uruvaakkakkoodiya sila adaiyaalangal, iyarkaiyaana uyiratra seyalmuraigalaalum uruvaagalaam enbadhaiyum vinjnjaanigal suttikkaattugindranar.
Idhanaal, “vetrukkiraga uyirgal kanduvidikkappattuvittana” endru urudhiyaagak koorum nilaikku vinjnjaanigal innum varavillai. Pudhiya aadhaarangal kidaikkum varai, indha vivagaarathil echarikkaiyudan mudivedukka vendum enbadhe perumbaalaana vinjnjaanigalin nilaippaadaaga ulladhu.
Idhanmoolam, ariviyal enbadhu eppodhum 100 sadhaveedham urudhiyaana “aam” alladhu “illai” endra padhilgalaik kondadhu alla enbadhum theriyavarugiradhu. Pudhiya aadhaarangal kidaikkumbodhu vinjnjaanigalin karuthugalum maarakkoodum.

headline: Iran por| America pali ennikkai.. Veliyaana pudhiya thagavalaal paravarappu!
text:
Iran poril America veerargal uyirizhappu ennikkai kurithu The Washington Post veliyitta thagaval perum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Pendagan tharavuthalathil 18 maranangal mattume padhivaagiyulla nilaiyil, kuraindhadhu 22 alladhu 23 veerargal uyirizhandhadhaaga andha seythi koorugiradhu.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
amerikkaa–eeraan poril uyirizhandha America veerargalin ennikkai thodarbaaga The Washington Post veliyitta seythi kadum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Pendagan adhigaarappoorvamaaga veliyittulla ennikkaiyai vida adhigamaana America raanuva veerargal uyirizhandhulladhaaga andha seythi kooriya nilaiyil, America paadhugaapputhurai seyalaalar peet heksath adhai thittavattamaaga maruthullaar.
Washington Post veliyitta thagavalinbadi, Iran porin thodakkam mudhal kuraindhadhu 22 America raanuva veerargal uyirizhandhulladhaaga America paadhugaapputhuraiyin adhigaarigal therivithullanar. Aanaal, pendaganin podhuveli casualty database-l 18 uyirizhappugal mattume idambetrulladhaaga andha seythi kurippittadhu. Melum, oru adhigaari uyirizhappu ennikkai 23 aaga irukkalaam endrum kooriyadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Eninum, indha koodudhal uyirizhappugal anaithum neradiyaaga eeraanudanaana poril erpattavai endru koora mudiyaadhu endru andha adhigaari therivithadhaaga Washington Post seythi koorugiradhu. Mathiya kizhakkil por nadavadikkaigal needithuk kondirundha kaalathil angu paniyaatriya America veerargalin sila maranangalum idhil serkkappattirukkalaam ena therivikkappattulladhu.
Indha seythikku America paadhugaapputhurai seyalaalar peet heksath, X-l kadumaiyaaga padhilalithullaar.
Avar Washington Post seythiyai aruvarukkathakka poy seythi endru vimarsithullaar. Melum, andha seythi niruvanathai Iran arasu oodagangaludan oppittu Iran oodagangalai vida mosamaaga seylbadugiradhu Washington Post endru kadumaiyaaga vimarsithullaar.
Idharkidaiye, uyirizhappu ennikkaiyil erpattadhaaga koorappadum veruvaadu kurithu Washington Post ketta kelvigalukku pendagan padhilalikkavillai ena andha naalidhazh therivithulladhu.
Uyirizhappu ennikkai thodarbaana sarchaiyudan, Iran porukkaaga America selavidum thogaiyum sarchaikku ullaagi varugiradhu.
America Central Command-n pudhiya madhippeettinbadi, sepdambar 3 nilavarappadi porukkaana selavu sumaar 43.6 pilliyan taalaraaga uyarndhulladhu. Aagast 1 varai selavu 38 pilliyan taalaraaga irundhadhaaga Congressional Budget Office therivithirundha nilaiyil, oru maadhathirkul selavu melum adhigarithulladhu.
Idhil aayudhangalukkaana selavu mattum 28.1 pilliyan taalaraaga uyarndhulladhu. Kurippaaga Patriot matrum THAAD pondra evuganaith thaduppu amaippugalukkaana interceptor-kal ullitta vilai uyarndha aayudhangalin payanbaadu selavu adhigarippukku mukkiya kaaranamaaga iruppadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Melum, mathiya kizhakkil ulla America raanuva thalangal meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhalgalaal nootrukkanakkaana kattidangal matrum pira kattamaippugal sedhamadaindhadhaaga America aayvaalar aluvalaga arikkai ondru suttikkaattiyulladhu. Ivvaaru uyirizhappu, aayudhas selavu, raanuvath thalangalukkaana sedham ena Iran porin thaakkam amerikkaavukkul thodarndhu vivaadhamaagi varugiradhu.

headline: Mudivukku varum vallarasugalin modhal: ulaga naadugalukku China kodutha adhirchi! India-vukku sikkalaa?
text:
Seenaa–amerikkaa idaiyeyaana neendagaala modhalai mudivukku kondu vara ji jinbing, Trump sandhippu mukkiya thiruppamaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Iru vallarasugalum koottaaligalaaga seyalbada vendum endra China-vin munvaippu, idhai etra tirambin nilaippaadu ulaga naadugalukku adhirchiyaiyum kuzhappathaiyum erpaduthiyulladhu. Kurippaaga seenaavai edhirgolla amerikkaavai nambiya India-vukku idhu pudhiya thandhira sikkalai uruvaakkugiradhu.
Irandaam ulagapporukku pinnar kamyoonist naadaana soviyath matrum America aagiyavai ulagin vallarasugalaaga uruveduthana. Sumaar 40 aandugal indha iru naadugalukku idaiye thodarndha panippor 1990kalil soviyath ondriyathin veezhchiyodu mudivukku vandhadhu.
Idhanaal ulagin ore vallarasaaga America thigazhndhu vandha nilaiyil, kadandha 10 aandugalil matroru vallarasaaga soviyathin idathil matroru kamyoonisa naadaana China uruvaagiyulladhu. China-vin valarchi America-vukku achuruthalai erpaduthiyulladhaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Adhilum kurippaaga America adhivaraaga Trump poruppetradhum seenaavai kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu vandhaar.
Seenaavukku koodudhal varigalai vidhitha Trump, China niruvanangalukkum palveru kattuppaadugalai vidhithaar. Idharku padhiladiyaaga seenaavum America porulgal meedhu koodudhal varigalai vidhithadhu. Indha soozhalil China adhivar ji jinbing America sendru tiramppai sandhithu pesavulladhaaga adhigaaravoorva arivippu veliyaanadhu. Adhanbadi netru America-vin vaashingdan ti.si-yil adhivar tonaalt tirambais sandhithup pesuvadharkaaga China adhivar ji jinbing America sendrirundhaar. Avarai America adhivar Trump vimaana nilaiyathukke neril sendru varavetraar. 1962-aam aandukkup piragu America adhivar oruvar velinaattuth thalaivarai vimaana nilaiyathirku neradiyaagas sendru varaverpadhu idhuve mudhal murai enbadhaal idhu periya alavil kavanikkappattadhu.
Thodarndhu iruvarum vimaana nilaiyathileye siridhu neram uraiyaatriya nilaiyil, adhu kuritha vivarangalai China arasin seythi niruvanamaana 'sinhuvaa' (Xinhua) veliyittulladhu. Adhil seenaavum amerikkaavum oruvarukkoruvar edhirigalaagavo alladhu pottiyaalargalaagavo (Rivals) illaamal, koottaaligalaagave (Partners) irukka vendum endru ji jinbing trambidam kooriyadhaaga koorappattulladhu. Indha karuthai tiramppum oppukkondulladhaagavum adhil koorappattulladhu. Thodarndhu Trump matrum ji jinbing iruvarum indru sandhithu virivaana pechuvaarthaiyai nadathavullanar. Adhil palveru mudivugalum edukkappadalaam endru koorappadugiradhu.
Idhanidaiya China adhivarin karuthu ulagalavil paravarappai erpaduthiyuladhu. America matrum China idaiye nadandhuvandha modhalil sila naadugal amerikkaavukkum, sila naadugal seenaavukkum aadharavaaga seyalbattu vandhana. Indha soozhalil amerikkaavum seenaavum pagaiyai marandhu koottaaliyaaga maarum vagaiyil arasiyal nadavadikkaigal maaruvadhu ulaga naadugalukku adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Kurippaaga indhiyaavukkum seenaavukkum ellai thagaraaru nilavi varum nilaiyil, China paagisdhaanukkum aadharavu koduthu varugiradhu. Idhanaal India amerikkaavudan nerukkamaaga seyalbattu varum nilaiyil, China-vin aadhikkathai kuraikka amerikkaavaal uruvaakkappatta kuvaat raanuva amaippilum inaindhulladhu. Indha soozhalil seenaavum amerikkaavum nerungi varuvadhu India-vin nalangalukkum paadhippai erpaduthum endra acham uruvaagiyulladhu.

headline: India-vukku nalla vaayppu... Eai thozhilnutbam kurithu pil kets sonna vishayam
text:
Niyooyaark: eai thodarbaaga adutha 12 mudhal 18 maadhangalukkul edukkappadum mudivugal, indhath thozhilnutbathaal yaar payanadaivaargal enbadhaith theermaanippadhil mukkiyap pangu vagikkum endru maikrosaapt inai niruvanar pil kets therivithullaar.
Idhu kurithu avar kooriyadhaavadhu; eai thozhilnutbam enbadhu idhuvarai naam kandiraadha ondru. Idhil ulla aavathu kurithu naan erkanave ezhudhiyullen. Adhanai naam theeviramaaga eduthuk kolla vendum. Eai thozhilnutbam pudhiya nichayamatra thanmaigalaiyum, aavathugalaiyum kondu vandhaalum, adhu migavum payanulladhaagavum amaiyum. Ivatrai naam eppadi payanbaduthugirom enbadhu, naam edukkum mudivugalaip poruthe amaiyum.
Eai thodarbaaga adutha 12 mudhal 18 maadhangalukkul edukkappadum mudivugal, indhath thozhilnutbathaal yaar payanadaivaargal enbadhaith theermaanippadhil mukkiyap pangu vagikkum. Indha thozhilnutbathin palangalai nagarangalukku mattumallaadhu, kiraamangalaiyum kondu serkka India-vukku nalla vaayppu kidaithulladhu. Enenil, India-vin digital podhu ulgattamaippu idharku valuvaana adithalathai vazhangugiradhu.
Eai thozhilnutbam aangilathil mattum illaamal, ulloor mozhigal, paadhugaappu matrum ulnaattuth thiramaigalin adippadaiyil uruvaakkappada vendum. Vivasaayigal thangal sondha mozhiyil kelvigalaik kettup payanberum mahaaraashdiraavin 'MahaVISTAAR' pondra sevaigal vivasaayathil perum maatrangalai erpadutha mudiyum, enak koorinaar.

headline: Teksaas kanamazhai adhirchi kaatchigal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
America-vin teksaas maanilathil kana mazhai peythadhin paadhippu endru oru video thoguppu

mazhai paadhippu thodarbaana pala veediyokkalai thoguthu Facebook-il padhividappattullanar. Adhil, “teksaas maanilathil kanamazhai veliyaana adhirchi kaatchigal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
America-vin teksaas maanilathil erpatta mazhai vella paadhippin video endru oru video thoguppai oodagangal veliyittu varugindrana. Idhil sila veediyokkalai erkanave paartha ninaivu irundhadhaal idhudhodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil kuzhandhaiyai pen oruvar thookkikkondu varum video patri aayvu seythom. Adhai erkanave aayvu seythadhu ninaivil irundhadhaal andha katturaiyaith thedi eduthom. 2025m aandu akdovar maadham jamaikkaa naattil erpatta melisaa puyal thodarbaaga indha video-vai appodhu palarum padhivittirundhanar. Kuzhandhaiyaith thookkikkondu pen oruvar odi varum video 2024m aandil America-vin alavaamaavil edukkappattadhu endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aduthadhaaga, kattidam ondrin koorai kaatril parakkum kaatchiyai aayvu seythom. Adhu America-vin fuloridaavil 2022m aandu nadandhadhu endru theriyavandhadhu. Fuloridaa mottal endru adhil kurippidappattu irundhadhu.
Moondraavadhaaga veettin koorai parakkum kaatchi thodarbaaga thediyavodhu andha video-vai aagast 14m thedhiye silar Facebook-il padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Andha video-kkal viyatnaam mozhiyil padhividappattirundhana. Aanaal, endha idathil eppodhu edukkappattadhu endru urudhiyaaga kandariya mudiyavillai.
Aduthadhaaga thani veedu ondrin koorai parakkum kaatchi thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Appodhu adhu kadandha aagast maadham piraans naattil edukkappattadhu endru veliyaana seythigal namakku kidaithana. Aduthadhaaga petrol pangk ondrin koorai aadum video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Adhu America-vin ilinaaysil (Illinois) edukkappattadhaaga 2022m aandu padhividappattirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Car paarkking pagudhiyil erpatta paadhippu thodarbaana kaatchiyaip patrith thedinom. 2025l jamaikkaavil erpatta mellisaa puyal paadhippu endru kurippittu andha video 2025 akdovar 29m thedhi padhividappattirundhadhaik kandarindhom.
Neela nira penarudan koodiya petrol pangk pola kaatchi alikkum idathil puyal veesum kaatchi thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Andha video 2025m aandu maars 5m thedhi samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhil, piresilin Nova Londrina endra idathil puyal paadhippin kaatchi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Bike paarkking neela nira met koorai parakkum kaatchi haangaangil nadandhadhu endru 2025m aandu padhividappattirundhadhu. Ippadi ellaa veediyokkalum pazhaiya video-kkal enbadhum America mattumindri ulagin palveru pagudhigalil nadandha sambavangalin kaatchigal endrum theriyavandhadhu.
Anaithirkum melaaga, indha thedudhalin podhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video thoguppai sila aandugalaagave samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu vandhiruppadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Idhai eduthu teksaas kana mazhai endru peyarittu thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Iru sakkara vaaganangalukku sungak kattanam vasoolikkappada ulladhaa?
text:
‘’ iru sakkara vaaganangalukku sungak kattanam vasoolikka mathiya arasu mudivu’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ joolai 15 mudhal iru sakkara vaaganangalukku sungak kattanam vasoolikka ondriya BJP arasu mudivu,” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan san news veliyitta video seythi ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idhu oru adippadai aadhaaramatra vadhandhi endru, theriyavandhadhu.
Irusakkara vaaganangalukku sungak kattanam endru munnani oodagangal thodangi, thanippatta samooga valaidhala payanaalargal varai palarum paravarappaaga merkandavaaru, seythi parappugindranar. Palveru mozhigalilum indha seythi paravuvadhaal, udanadiyaaga idhanberil, Indhiya thesiya nedunjjaalai matrum aanaiyam (NHAI) maruppu veliyittulladhu.
Adhanai aadhaarathirkaaga inge inaithullom.
Aduthappadiyaaga, mathiya pokkuvarathuth thurai amaichar nidhin katkari thanadhu Twitter pakkam moolamaaga, adhigaarappoorvamaaga maruppu ondraiyum veliyittullaar. Adhanaiyum keezhe inaithullom.
Idhu mattumindri, mathiya arasukkus sondhamaana PIB Factcheck tharappilum vilakkam alikkappattulladhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
Hindustan Times l ANI News l News On Air
ivatrin moolamaaga, irusakkara vaaganangalukku sungak kattanam idhuvaraiyilum vidhikkappadavillai, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda seythi thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nellai: ilainjar thalai thundithuk kolai; visaaranaiyil pageer; Police kuvippaal padhatram; nadandhadhu enna?
text:
Nellaiyil ilainjar oruvar thalai thundikkappattu kodooramaagak kolai seyyappatta sambavam padhatrathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Ichambavam thodarbaaga 2 per saranadaindha nilaiyil melum silarai poleesaar thedi varugindranar.
Nellai, manimoortheesvaram pagudhiyais serndhavar segar. Peyint adikkum thozhilaaliyaana ivar, kadandha 11 aandugalukku munbu vijayaletchumi endra maatrus samoogathais serndha pennai kaadhal thirumanam seythu kondaar.
Ivargalukku 3 pen kuzhandhaigal ullanar. Netru maalai ooril nanbargaludan pesik kondirundha paasgar, aatril kulikkas selvadhaagak koorivittu thachanalloor paivaas saalai nokki thanadhu paikkil sendrullaar.
Appodhu andha vazhiyaaga paikkil vandha 2 ilainjargal paasgarai vazhimarithu avarai arivaalaal saramaariyaaga vettivittu thalaiyaith thundithullanar. Pinnar, avaradhu thalaiyai eduthuk kondu 150 meter tholaivil paasgar veettukkus sellum vazhiyil ulla vaazhavandha amman koyil sandhippil veesivittu thappiyodiyullanar.
Ichambavam thodarbaaga thachanalloor kaaval nilaiya poleesaar vazhakkuppadhivu seythu visaaranai nadathinar.
Visaaranaiyil, kolai seyyappatta paasgarukkum adhe pagudhiyais serndha silarukkum min kambangalil saadhiya adaiyaalamaana varnangal theettappattadhu thodarbaagavum, adhu thodarbaaga paasgar poleesaarukku thagaval kooriyadhaal azhikkappattadhu thodarbaagavum munvirodham irundhuvandhulladhu theriya vandhadhu.
Idharkidaiyil ikkolais sambavam thodarbaaga manigandan matrum ponraaj aagiya irandu per arivaaludan thachanalloor kaaval nilaiyathil saran adaindhullanar.
Idhanaiyaduthu manimoortheesvaram, kattudaiyaar kudiyiruppup pagudhigalil padhatram nilaviyadhaal paadhugaappirkaaga poleesaar kuvikkappattullanar.
Idhu kurithu poleesaaridam visaarithom, “manimoortheesvaram matrum katturaiyaar kudiyiruppup pagudhigalil adidhadi ullitta asambaavidham nadandhaal poleesukku thagaval koorum inbaarmaraaga paasgar irundhu vandhaaraam.
Munvirodham kaaranamaaga paasgar appagudhiyais serndha oruvarai vettik kolai seyya muyatsithullaar. Idhudhodarbaana vazhakku, Nellai needhimandrathil nadandhu varugiradhu. Melum katturaiyaar kudiyiruppais serndha manigandan, ponraaj aagiyorudan panam kodukkal vaangalil thagaraaru erpattulladhu.
Manigandan, ponraaj aagiyor andhap pagudhiyil kavadi potti nadatha erpaadu seythadhaagavum adhai paasgar thaduthadhaagavum adhanaal avargalukkul melum modhal erpattulladhu. Innum sila sambavangalaiyum kaaranangalaagas solgiraargal appagudhiyinar. Munvirodhame idharku mukkiya kaaranamaaga visaaranaiyil theriya varugiradhu. Saranadaindha 2 peridamum visaaranai nadathi varugirom. Melum silaraith thedi varugirom” endranar.

headline: Raagul kaandhiyai virattiya peegaar makkal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Vaakkuth thiruttu endru poyyaana thagavalai kooriyadhaal raagul kaandhiyai peegaar makkal virattiyadithaargal endru oru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu.

Car ondrai podhu makkal virattiyadikkum video-vai vaithu oruvar pesiya video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha video-vil, raagul kaandhiyai oda oda viratti aditha makkal. Peegaar peraniyil thideer paravarappu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Video-vai veliyittirundha andha navar, “peegaar makkalin vaakkugalai BJP thirudivittadhu endru thavaraana thagavalai alitha raagul kaandhiyai peegaar makkal viratti adithaargal” endru periya vilakkam alithirundhaar.
Nilaithagavalil, “pappu raagul kaandhiyai nambi pona namma thathi mudhalvarukku peegaar makkal kodutha sariyaana saattaiyadi..!” endru kurippittirundhaar. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaaril latchakkanakkaana vaakkaalargalai thideerendru vaakkaalargal pattiyalilirundhu neekkiyadhaaga Congress mootha thalaivar raagul kaandhi kutramsaattiyirundhaar. Idhaith thodarndhu peegaaril perani nadathi varugiraar. Idhil, Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinum pangetraar. Indha nilaiyil, thavaraana thagavalai alithadhaaga koori raagul kaandhiyai peegaar makkal virattiyadithaargal endru oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Raagul kaandhikku peegaaril edhirppu kilambiyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Unmaiyil raagul kaandhikku peegaar makkal edhirppu therivithirundhaal adhu BJP aadharavu oodagangalil migapperiya seythiyaaga veliyaagi irukkum. Aanaal, appadi oru siru thuli seythi kooda namakku kidaikkavillai. Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom.
Appodhu, peegaar thalainagar paatnaavil siruvargal kolai seyyappattadhaaga koori podhu makkal poraattam nadathiyullanar. Appodhu sugaadhaarath thurai amaichar mangal paandevin kaarai viratti thaakkiyadhaaga seythigal namakku kidaithana. Paatnaavil kaaril irandu kuzhandhaigal irandha nilaiyil kandedukkappattadhu makkal mathiyil kondhalippai erpaduthiyadhu. Kolai seythavargalai kanduvidithu thandanai alikka podhu makkal poraattam nadathi varugindranar. Poraattam vanmuraiyaaga maariyadhu. Kaavaldhurai vaaganangalukku thee vaikkappattadhaaga seythigal namakku kidaithana.
Theevira valadhusaari aadharavu oodagamaana rivaplik tivi-yin YouTube pakkathileye kooda indha video-vai padhivittirundhanar. Adhil, “peegaarin selvaakkumikka amaichar mangalbaandevum avaradhu paadhugaavalargalum thangal uyiraik kaappaatrikkollath thappi odinar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Peegaar edhirkkatchith thalaivar thejasvi yaadhav kooda indha video-vai thannudaiya X thala pakkathil veliyittu, peegaar amaicharukku kandanam therivithirundhaar. Ivai ellaam raagul kaandhiyai virattiya peegaar makkal endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Maanila suyaatchi patri pesa puraanam theriya vendum endru Edappadi Palaniswami koorinaaraa?
text:
Maanila suyaatchi patri pesa vendum endraal puraanam padithu, aayvu seythirukka vendum endru Edappadi Palaniswami kooriyadhaaga oru padhivu

Edappadi Palaniswami niruvargalukku petti alitha video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “idhellaam puraanam padikkanum. Naan andha alavukku padichavan illai, indha maadhiriyaana kadhai ellaam padichi sollanumnaa periya aayvu seyya vendum. Indha aayvu seythaaldhaan idhu unmaiyaa poyyaa enbadhu theriyum. Adhukku naan utbattavan illai. Poy avaraithaan ketkanum. Avarkitta ketka vendiya kelviyai enkitta kettaa eppadi theriyum. Arinjargalidam kettaaldhaan adhu sariyaa, thavaraa endru theriyum” engiraar.
Nilaith thagavalil, “maanila suyaatchi theermaanam.. ~ ADMK velinadappu. Maanila suyaatchi kurithu pesonumnaa puraanam padikkonum.aayvu pannonum. Naan andhalavukku padichavan illa namakku andha alavukku arivu illa. Adhaan velinadappu senjjuttom.-thavazhndhappaadiyaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu sattapperavaiyil maanila suyaatchi thodarbaana theermaanathaith Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin kondu vandhaar. Adhu thodarbaaga M.K. Stalin pesik kondirundha podhe, edhirkkatchiyaana ADMK velinadappu seythadhu. Indha soozhalil maanila suyaatchi theermaanam thodarbaaga edhirkkatchith thalaivar Edappadi Palaniswami petti alithadhu pondru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Indha video thiraavidam aariyam thodarbaana kelvikku Edappadi Palaniswami alitha padhil aagum. Indha video-vai vaithu munbu oru murai vadhandhi parappappattadhu. Periyaar patri Seeman pesiyadhu thodarbaaga niruvargal kelvi ezhuppiyadhaagavum adharku ippadi Edappadi Palaniswami padhil kooriyadhaagavum vadhandhi parappappattadhu. Appodhe idhu thodarbaaga fekt kirasando thamizhil katturai veliyittirundhom.
Tharpodhu adhe video-vai vaithu maanila suyaatchi thodarbaana kelvikku Edappadi Palaniswami padhil alithadhu pondru thavaraagap pagirndhullanar. News 18 veliyittirundha unmaiyaana video-vai thedi eduthom. 2023m aandu akdovar 24m thedhi indha video-vai news 18 Tamil Nadu veliyittirundhadhu. “aariyam, thiraavidam irukkiradhaa, illaiyaa ena arinjargaldhaan koora vendum; naan andha alavukku padithavan alla – ADMK podhucheyalaalar Edappadi pazhanisaami” endru thalaippum vaithirundhanar.
Adhu mattumindri veru pala oodagangalum kooda indha pettiyai thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyittirundhana. Ivai ellaam maanila suyaatchi thodarbaaga Edappadi Palaniswami kooriyadhu endru paravum video thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Nirmalaa seedhaaraamanukku padhil ke.ti.raagavanai sandhithen endru Seeman koorinaaraa?
text:
‘’ nirmalaa seedhaaraamanukku padhil ke.ti.raagavanaidhaan sandhithen,’’ endru Seeman kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’naan sandhikkala… Chennai ottalil nirmalaavai sandhikkavillai. Angeye thangiyirundha ke.ti.raagavanaidhaan sandhithen. Sila thozhilnutba sandhegangalukku vilakkam ketkap poyirundhen- Seeman vilakkam,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Pudhiya thalaimurai logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu oru edit seyyappatta news card endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, unmaiyaana news card-il, ’’ nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai naan sandhikkala; sandhichirundhaa thairiyamaa ‘idhukkaagathaan sandhichen’nu solluven. Mathiya amaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai NTK thalaimai orunginaippaalar Seeman sandhithadhaaga thagaval veliyaana nilaiyil, adharku Seeman maruppu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Unmaiyaana news kaardaiyum, edit seyyappatta news kaardaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
irudhiyaaga, pudhiya thalaimurai digital pirivu nirvaagiyidamum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, pudhiya thalaimurai peyaril vendumendre edit seyyappatta news card-ai thayaarithu, arasiyal ulnokkathudan samooga valaidhalangalil parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Irandhavarin paan, aadhaar attaigalai sarandar seyya vendumaa?
text:
Irandhavargalin paan attai, aadhaar attaigalai sarandar seyya vendumaa? Yaaridam sarandar seyya vendum?
Raa.raveendhiran,
Chennai 
irandhavarin paan attaiyai udanadiyaaga sarandar seyya vendum endra sattareedhiyaaga kattaayam illai. Aanaal, adhai thavaraaga payanbaduthuvadhai thavirppadharkaaga, varumaana varithuraiyidam oppadaippadhu nalladhu. Irandhavarudaiya peyaril irukkum vangi kanakkugal, miyoochuval pandugal, sothugal pondravatrai sattappoorva vaarisugalukku maatriya piragum, avarukkaana irudhi varumaana vari kanakkai vaarisugal thaakkal seytha piragum paan card-ai oppadaippadhu nalladhu.
Aadhaar attaiyai rathu seyyavo, neekkavo, adhigaarigalidam sarandar seyyavo 'indhiyath thanithuva adaiyaala aanaiyathil' adhigaarappoorvamaaga endha vazhimuraiyaiyum sollavillai. Adhanaal, adhai sarandar seyya thevaiyillai.
 Thangathil sbaat thangathin vilai enbadhai vaithu eppadi thangathin vilaiyai nirnayikkindranar. Sbaat endra vaarthaiyai en thangathil payanbaduthugiraargal. Appadi endraal enna?
Ke. Vanidhaa, ezhumalai 
panguchandhai matrum kamaaditti sandhaiyil podhuvaaga irandu vagaiyaana vilai undu. Ondru 'sbaat vilai' , matrondru 'munbera varthaga vilai' 'sbaat' endraal, udanadi viniyogathukkaana tharpodhaiya sandhai vilai endru artham. Sarvadhesa thanga sandhaiyil, ippodhu oppandham seythu, vazhakkamaana sbaat settilment kaalathukkul thangathai peruvadharkaana vilaiye 'sbaat vilai'.
Veru sila varthagargal, mudhaleettaalargal irukkiraargal. Avargal 'adutha maadham alladhu adutha varudam idhe thedhiyil indha vilaikku thangam vaangugiren' endru mungoottiye munbera oppandham seyvar. Indha 'edhirgaala oppandha vilaiyilirundhu', 'indraiya sandhai vilaiyai' thelivaaga pirithu kaattuvadharkaagave 'sbaat' endra vaarthai payanbadugiradhu.
Sarvadhesa alavil thangathin vilai podhuvaaga oru traay avunsukku ithanai America taalar endru kurippidappadum. 1 traay avuns enbadhu 31.10 kiraam. Landan sandhaiyin sbaat thanga vilaidhaan ulagalaaviya thanga sandhaiyin mukkiyamaana alavugolgalil ondraaga irukkiradhu. Indha sbaat vilaiyai vaithu namadhu oor nagaikkadai vilaiyai kanakkiduvar.
Taalaril irukkum andraiya sbaat vilaiyai, andraiya taalarukku nigaraana Indhiya roovaayin madhippai kondu perukkuvar. Andha thogaiyai 31.10l vaguthaal, oru kiraam thangathin adippadai roobai vilai kidaikkum. Idharku mel namadhu naattin irakkumadhi vari matrum ses aagiyavatrai serppar.
Kadaisiyaaga, Indhiya vangigal thangathai irakkumadhi seyvadharkaana pokkuvarathu selavu, nagaikkadaigalin pireemiyam laavam matrum 3 sadhaveedha ji.es.ti., aagiyavatrai serthaal, neengal kadaiyil paarkkum indraiya vilai vandhuvidum.
 Nidhi aalosagar, kurippitta miyoochuval pandu thittathil panam podalaam endru sollum aalosanaikku kattanam thara vendaam engiraar. Aanaal, thangal niruvanathin seyali vaayilaaga panam podungal endru solgiraar. Appadi podalaamaa? Avar sollum seyali vaayilaaga panam poduvadharkum enadhu teemet kanakku vazhiyaaga panam poduvadharkum enna vithiyaasam?
Manigandan,
pudhukkottai 
panguchandhaiyilum miyoochuval pandilum ilavasam endru edhuvume kidaiyaadhu. Nidhi aalosagar avarudaiya niruvanathin seyali vazhiyaaga mudhaleedu seyya solvadharku kaaranam, avar 'miyoochuval pant viniyogasdharaaga' iruppaar. Neengal andha seyali vaayilaaga mudhaleedu seyyumbodhu, neengal vaangum thittam 'regular pilaan' endru azhaikkappadum.
Idhil neengal mudhaleedu seyyum thogaiyai adippadaiyaagak kondu, ovvoru varudamum kamishanaaga avarukku miyoochuval pandu niruvanam koduthuvidum. Indha viniyogasdhar kamishan, thittathin selavu vigidhamaana 'eksbens reshiyo'vil piradhivalikkum. Adhanaal thaan avar ungalidam neradiyaaga kattanam ketkavillai.
Ungal timet kanakku vazhiyaaga 'tairakt pilaanil' mudhaleedu seythaal, indha viniyogasdhar kamishan irukkaadhu. Idhanaal, tairakt pilaanin eksbens reshiyo podhuvaaga regular pilaanaivida kuraivaaga irukkum.
Endha miyoochuval pandil eppodhu mudhaleedu seyvadhu, eppodhu maatruvadhu enbadhellaam ungalukku theriyum endraal, tairakt pilaanil mudhaleedu seythu kollalaam. Aalosanai thevai endraal, nidhi aalosagar alladhu viniyogasdhar vaayilaaga regular pilaanukku sellalaam.
 Enakku vayadhu 77. Kolathooril ulla en veettai 'rivars maartkej' seythu tharumbadi podhuthurai vangi ondridam thodarndhu kettu varugiren. Avargal lon vazhangaamal thatti kazhikkiraargal. Kaaranamum solla maatten engiraargal. Enna seyvadhu?
Ee. Kurunaadhan,
Chennai 
namadhu naattil ulla perumbaalaana vangi melaalargalukku 'rivars maartkej' kadan vazhanguvadhil oru thayakkam irukkiradhu. Mudhiyavargal kaalathirku piragu, andha veettai elam vittu panathai vasoolikkumbodhu satta sikkalgal varalaam. Vaarisugal pirasnai seyyalaam. Andha veedu ninaitha vilaikku virpanai aagaamal pogalaam. Idhanaal, indha thittathai vangigal vazhanginaalum, adhan melaalargal adhigam piramot seyvadhillai. Adhanaal thaan, kaaraname sollaamal ungalai alaikkazhikkiraargal.
Vangigalin sattappadiye ponaal kooda, indha kadanai tharamudiyaadhu endru endha vangiyaalum solla mudiyaadhu. Aanaal, adhu oru neenda satta matrum nirvaaga reedhiyilaana poraattam.
Elimaiyaana vazhi solgiren. Ungalukku uvayogamaaga irukkumaa endru paarungal.
Kolathooril ulla pazhaiya veettai vitruvittu, puranagar pagudhiyil oru siriya veettai vaangi kollungal. Meedhamulla perum thogaiyai 'mootha kudimakkal semippu thittathil' mudhaleedu seyyungal.
'rivars maartkej' thittathai vida miga nalla matrum utharavaadhamaana maadhaandhira varumaanam endha thalaivaliyum illaamal ungalukku kidaikkum.

headline: Meendum parappuraikku thayaaraagum Vijay vaaganam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’meendum parappuraikku thayaaraagum Vijay vaaganam,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ meendum parappuraikku thayaaraagum Vijay vaaganam…
vandhuttaan
vandhuttaan..//,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta padam endrum, unmaiyaanadhalla endrum theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, merkanda pugaippadathil TVK pirasaara vaaganathai kirees ootri thudaikkiraargal. Idhil ulla manidhargal endha unarchiyum indri ullanar. Melum, andharathil midhakkindranar. Melum, Vijay erumai maadu mele varuvadhu pondra padamum unmaiyalla..
Aduthappadiyaaga, wasitai matrum hivemoderation aagiya AI sarivaarppu inaiyadhalangalil kurippitta padangalai aayvu seythu, unmaiyaanadhalla, enbadhai urudhi seythom.
Idhevondru naam aayvukku eduthuk konda matroru padamum AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhudhaan. Andha padathin meedhulla vaattar maark, (MADE IN ANIMOTICA) namadhu sandhegathai urudhippaduthugiradhu.
Irudhiyaaga, TVK, thalaimai aluvalagathilum pesi, merkanda padangal unmaiyalla, endru urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda padangal, AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattavai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Meenaatchi amman koyil: 'punidha neerdhelippu, needhivadhi avamadhippu?' - arasu niyamana archagargal sangam
text:
- arasu niyamana archagargal sangam, archagar payitsi petra maanavargal sangam valiyuruthal
'pugazhbetra Madurai meenaatchi amman koyil kudamuzhukku vizhaavil thamizhukku vaayppalikkappattadhaa? Needhivadhi alatchiyappaduthappattaaraa? Enbadhu kurithu Thamizhaga arasu vilakkam alikka vendum' endru archagar payitsi petra maanavargal sangam matrum Tamil Nadu arasu niyamana archagargal sangathinar valiyuruthiyullanar.
Idhugurithu sangathin thalaivar vaa.ranganaadhan veliyittulla arikkaiyil, "Madurai meenaatchi amman koyil kudamuzhukku vizhaavil uyar needhimandra thalaimai needhivadhi kaathirundhavodhu, avaraip patri amaichar oruvar alatchiyamaagak kooriyadhaaga oodagangalil veliyaagiyulla seythi unmaiyenil, adhu needhithuraiyin kanniyathaiyum arasamaippus sattathai urudhi seyyum needhithuraiyin mariyaadhaiyaiyum paadhikkum vagaiyilaanadhu.
Enave, Thamizhaga arasum, sambandhappatta amaicharum idhugurithu udanadiyaagath thelivaana vilakkam alikka vendum.
Melum, kudamuzhukku vizhaavil thamizhukku uriya idam vazhangappattadhaa, thamizhil vazhivaattu nigazhvugal nadathappattanavaa, needhimandra utharavugal muzhumaiyaagas seyalbaduthappattanavaa enbadhaiyum arasu velippadaiyaagath therivikka vendum.
Thamizhil kudamuzhukku nadathak kori, Chennai uyar needhimandrathil utharavu petra sathiyavaamaa ammaiyaar, 'Madurai aadhisaiva sivaachaariyaargal, pillaiyaarbatti pichai kurukkal, thirupparangundram raajaa pattar aagiyor velvichaalaiyil, kudamuzhukkil thamizhukku uriya idam odhukkavillai, idhaik kettadharku kaavaldhurai avamadhithadhaaga' velippadaiyaaga kutram saattiyullaar.
Thandhai periyaar vazhiyil nadappadhaaga sollum indha arasu, kurippaaga aranilaiyathurai amaichar rameshum, amaichar nirmalgumaarum, kudamuzhukku thamizhilum nadaiverum endru solli emaatriyadhu en enbadharku mudhalvar vilakkam alikka vendum.
Vizhaavil vi.vi.ai.pi, vi.ai.pi anumadhis seettugal vazhangappatta vidham, avatrukkaaga vasoolikkappattadhaagak koorappadum thogai, podhumakkalukku vidhikkappatta kattuppaadugal, neenda neram kaathirundha pakdhargalukku erpatta siramangal thodarbaagavum kurippitta navargalukkum, kudumbangalukkum munnurimai vazhangappattadhaaga ezhundhulla kutrachaattu kurithum arasu vilakkam alikka vendum.
Therdhalukku munbaaga TVK arasu, koyil vazhivaattil paaguvaadu irukkaadhu endru sollivittu, indru adharku ner edhiraaga amaichargalum, avargaladhu uravinargalum adhigaarigalum, kudamuzhukku nigazhvai aakkiramithuk kondu, makkalai anumadhikkaamal alaikkazhithu, kudamuzhukku punidha kalasa neer, makkal meedhu sezhikkappadaamal avamariyaadhai seythiruppadhu, kudamuzhukku nokkathaiye seergulaithu vittadhu. Koyil nirvaagathin nokkam pakdhargalin nalanaiyum koyil paadhugaappaiyum, iraivan arulaip perum nambikkaiyaiyum urudhi seyvadhaaga irukka vendum.
Aanaal, kudamuzhukkil payanbaduthappatta punidha neer ena verum thanneerai vaaliyil ootri, kaavaldhuraiyinar pakdhargal meedhu thelithadhu thittamitta emaatrum seyal ena makkal neradiyaaga therivitha video-kkal veliyaagi ullana. Avai unmaiyaa enbadhai arasu udanadiyaagath thelivuvadutha vendum.
Punidha neerukku padhilaaga, veru neer thelikkappattadhu unmaiyaanaal indhu samaya aranilaithurai amaichar ramesh raajinaamaa seyya vendum.
Madurai meenaatchi amman koyil pondra varalaatrus sirappumikka thirukkoyilgalin nirvaagam velippadaithanmaiyudanum, satta vidhigalinbadiyum, arangaavalar kuzhuvin uriya aalosanaiyudanum nadaivera vendum. Arangaavalar kuzhuvai purakkanithu mudivugal edukkappattadhaagak koorappadum kutrachaattum visaarikkappada vendum.
Koyil nirvaagam thodarbaaga palveru tharappinaraal thodarndhu kelvigal ezhuppappattu varum nilaiyil, avatrukku arasiyal vilakkangalai vida aavanangaludan koodiya velippadaiyaana padhilgale thevai. Indhu samaya aranilaithurai amaichar rameshukku edhiraaga BJP indhu munnani ullitta sanga parivaara amaippugal vaayai thirakkaamal ullana.
Thalaimai needhivadhi thodarbaaga veliyaagiyulla sarchaikkuriya sambavam kurithum kudamuzhukku vizhaa erpaadugal ullitta anaithu pugaargal kurithu oyvuvetra needhivadhi thalaimaiyil visaaranaik kuzhu amaikka vendum, sattathin aatchiyum, aalayangalil samathuvamum nilainaattappada vendum" endru therivithullaar.

headline: TVK Vs DMK misaa vivagaarathaik kaiyil edutha IT WINGS.. Jeyithadhu yaar?
text:
Seythiyaalar : raajgumaar.ra
sattamandrathil maaniyak korikkaikkup padhilalitha mudhalvar Vijay, misaa sattathin keezh munnaal mudhalvarum DMK thalaivarumaana Stalin kaidhu seyyappatta vivagaaram kurithu pesiyavodhu, thaadaiyil kaivaithu pesiyadhu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Misaa sattathin keezh mu.ka. Stalin kaidhu seyyappattavodhu, siraiyil kaavaldhuraiyinaraal thaakkappattadhil avaradhu thaadaip pagudhiyil erpatta kaayangalai kurippitte Vijay andha saigaiyai seythadhaaga vimarsanangal ezhundhana. Mudhalvar Vijay-in udalmozhikkum pechukkum arasiyal thalaivargal ullitta palveru tharappinarum kandanam therivithu vandhanar.
Idhaiyaduthu, mudhalvar Vijay tharappil vilakkam alikkappattadhu. Thaam edhechaiyaaga seytha oru seyalai vendumendre seythadhaaga sitharithu varuvadhaagavum therivikkappattadhu. Indha nilaiyil, munnaal mudhalvarum DMK thalaivarumaana mu.ka. Stalin indru video ondrai veliyittu, misaa vivagaaram kurithu pesiyadhudan, vijaykkum sila arivuraigalai vazhangiyirundhaar . Stalin veliyitta indha video-vai vimarsikkum vagaiyil, TVK aidi ving saarbil oru padhivu veliyidappattadhu.
Andhap padhivil, “pala aandugalaagak kattamaikkappatta ‘sirai sendra thiyaagi’ endra poli pimbam udaindhadhil padhatram patrikkondadho? Athanai neelamaagap pesiyum detention copy patri mattum moochuvidavillai. Unmaikku vilambarangalo, vilakkangalo thevaiyillai. Aanaal inge shooting video veliyaagiradhu” ena vimarsithirundhanar.
Idharku padhiladi kodukkum vidhamaaga DMK aidi ving saarbil padhil padhivu veliyidappattadhu. Adhil, “thandhaiyin thayavaal sinimaavil valarndhu, toop vaithu sandai pottavargalukku siraik kottadiyil MISA kaidhigal poleesaarin poots kaalaal midhivattus sindhiya rathathin madhippu eppadith theriyum? Misaa thiyaagam enbadhu panjju methaiyil urulvadhalla; adhu kolgai urudhi maaraamal, siraichaalaiyin irumbuk kambigalukkidaiye ratham sindhiya nijam!” ena padhivittirundhanar.
Melum, indhap padhivudan thodarbudaiya sila pugaippadangalaiyum DMK aidi ving tharappil veliyittullanar. Innilaiyil, misaa vivagaarathai maiyamaaga vaithu TVK matrum DMK aidi vingalukku idaiye samooga valaidhalangalil vaarthaip por theeviramadaindhulladhu. Iru tharappinarum oruvarai oruvar kadumaiyaana vaarthaigalil vimarsithu varum nilaiyil, indha vivagaaram tharpodhu arasiyal vattaarathil perum kavanathaip petrulladhu.

headline: Chennai-yil sirumiyaik kadathiya vada maanila thozhilaali endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Chennai-yil sirumiyaik kadathiya vada maanila thozhilaali endru oru video

sirumi oruvarai ilainjar oruvar kadathis sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “sennai vada maanila thozhilaali vizhithiru thamizhaa. Naalaikku un pillaikkum nadakkum” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
2025 joolai maadham Tiruvallur maavattam Gummidipoondi aruge 10 vayadhu palli sellum sirumiyai ilainjar oruvar thookkis sendradhu adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Appodhe adhu thodarbaana sisidivi kaatchigal veliyaagina. Ippodhu, adhe pondru oru sambavam nadandhadhu pondru video ondrai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittullanar.
Chennai-yil indha sambavam nadandhadhu pondru kurippidappattulladhu. Chennai nagarathil ippadi oru sambavam nadandhadhaaga sameevathil endha oru seythiyum illai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu kadandha joon 2025l indha video-vai oruvar thannudaiya Facebook pakkathil padhivittirundhaar. Andha video-vil kannada seythi oodagam ondrin logovum irundhadhu.
Andha kannada oodagathin samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Indha video seythiyai joon 25, 2025 andru avargal veliyittirundhanar. Aanaal andha padhivil indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru edhaiyum kurippidavillai. Pallikku sellum kuzhandhaigal patri eppodhum vizhippunarvudan echarikkaiyudan irungal endru mattume kurippittirundhanar.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu Tamil Nadu fekt sek veliyitta padhivu namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhilum kooda indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidavillai. Kadandha maars maadham mudhale indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varuvadhaagavum, Tamil Naattil indha sambavam nadakkavillai endru Tamil Nadu kaaval thurai urudhi seythulladhaagavum kurippittirundhanar.
Tamil Nadu kaaval thurai indha video Tamil Naattil edukkappattadhu illai endru urudhi seythiruppadhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthak koodiyadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ke.ti.raagavan kaalil vizhundha Annamalai endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Ke.ti.raagavan kaalil vizhundhu aasi petra Annamalai endru oru pugaippadam

Thamizhaga BJP munnaal thalaivar Annamalai, BJP mootha nirvaagi ke.ti.raagavan kaalil vizhundhu aasi peruvadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “#annaamalai Thamizhaga pijevi thalaivaraaga padhavierkumbodhu…
pijevi thalaivar kedi raagavangaalil vizhundhu vanangugiraar.
Ore maadhathil kedi raagavanai arasiyalil irundhu Annamalai thannudaiya sithu vilaiyaattaal kedi raagavan arasiyal vaazhkkaiyai mudithu vaithu vittaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga BJP thalaivaraaga Annamalai poruppetra podhu ke.ti.raagavanin kaalil vizhundhu aasi petruvittu pinnar avarai orangattinaar endru kurippittu pugaippadam ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Ke.ti.raagavan nirkum nilai, Annamalai tharaiyil vizhundhu vanangum nilaiyaip paarkkum podhu pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu therigiradhu. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, saamiyaar oruvar kaalil Annamalai vizhum pugaippadam ondru namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhai Annamalai thannudaiya Facebook pakkathil 2024 maars 25m thedhi padhivittirundhaar. 2024 naadaalumandrath therdhalin podhu siravai aadheenam kumaraguruvara suvaamigalai sandhithu aasi petravodhu edutha pugaippadam endru Annamalai kurippittirundhaar.
2024m aandu siravai aadheenathai Annamalai sandhithavodhu avar kaalil vizhundhu aasi petra pugaippadathai edit seythu, Thamizhaga BJP thalaivaraaga Annamalai poruppetra podhu ke.ti.raagavan kaalil vizhundhu aasi petraar endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Merku vangaalathin maaldaavil nadandha vanmurai ena pagirappadum vangaala thesa kaanoli | Video From Bangladesh Falsely Shared As Violence In Malda, West Bengal
text:
Merku vangaalathin maaldaavil nadandha vanmurai ena pagirappadum vangaala thesa kaanoli
indha kaanoli 2023aam aandu vangadhesathil ulla silhet maavattathil pi.en.pi nadathiya poraattathin kaanoli endru poom kandarindhulladhu.
Vangaala thesathil nadandha vanmuraip poraattathin kaanoli, India-vil merku vangaalathil ulla maaldaavil kadandha maars 27aam thedhiyandru nadandha vaguppuvaadha vanmuraiyin sameevathiya kaatchigal endra thavaraana kootrudan vairalaanadhu.
Andha kaanoli nadandha sambavam India-vil nadakkavillai endrum, navambar 2023aam thedhi vangaaladhesa thesiyavaadhak katchi (pi.em.pi) angulla silhet maavattathil nadathiya poraattathaik kaattugiradhu endru poom kandarindhulladhu. Indha poraattam pinnar vanmuraiyaaga maariyadhu.
Indha aandu kadandha maars 27aam thedhiyandru merku vangaalathin maaldaavil ulla modhavariyil vaguppuvaadha modhalgal nadandhana. Indha pagudhiyil koodudhal padaigal iruppadhaiyum, inaiya sevaigal niruthappattadhaiyum ulloor seythiyaalargal urudhippaduthiyadhaal, ingu nilaimai padhattamaaga ulladhu.
Indha nilaiyil samooga valaidhalathil, "merku vangaalathin maaldaavil indhukkal meedhaana thaakkudhalgal’ endra thavaraana kootrudan, aambulansai erippadhu utbada, theruvil vaaganangalai silar sedhappaduthum kaanoli pagirappattadhu. Melum, uldhurai amaichar amith shaa nadavadikkai edukka vendum endrum korikkai vidukkappattulladhu.
Indha kaanoli, thamizhilum, “merku vangam maaldaa maavattathil hindhu kadaigal kurivaithu erithu varugindranar...idhu thaan amaidhi maarkkam maa??? Naalai ellorukkum idhe nilai thaan varum…,” endra karuthudan, indha kaanoli pagirappattadhu.

Indha pagudhiyil koodudhal padaigal iruppadhaiyum, inaiya sevaigal niruthappattadhaiyum ulloor seythiyaalargal urudhippaduthiyadhaal, ingu nilaimai padhattamaaga ulladhu.
Indha nilaiyil samooga valaidhalathil, "merku vangaalathin maaldaavil indhukkal meedhaana thaakkudhalgal’ endra thavaraana kootrudan, aambulansai erippadhu utbada, theruvil vaaganangalai silar sedhappaduthum kaanoli pagirappattadhu. Melum, uldhurai amaichar amith shaa nadavadikkai edukka vendum endrum korikkai vidukkappattulladhu.
Indha kaanoli, thamizhilum, “merku vangam maaldaa maavattathil hindhu kadaigal kurivaithu erithu varugindranar...idhu thaan amaidhi maarkkam maa??? Naalai ellorukkum idhe nilai thaan varum…,” endra karuthudan, indha kaanoli pagirappattadhu.

headline: Trichy maavattam, mutharasanalloor kuruvaayoorappan koyil: thirumanath thadai neekkum aayilya naaga poojai!
text:
Vettaikkorumagan vazhivaadu enbadhu 12,008 thengaaygalai oruvare thodarndhu udaikkum vazhivaattu murai. Sivagumaarin azhaippin peril adhais seythuvaikka kuruvaayoor namboodhiri mutharasanalloor vandhaar. Vazhivaadu sirappaaga mudindhadhu.
Trichy sathiram perundhu nilaiyathilirundhu karoor sellum saalaiyil sumaar 7 km thoorathil ulladhu mutharasanalloor railway ket. Adhaith thaandinaal, kadaiveedhi akrahaaram pagudhiyil kuruvaayoorappan koyil amaindhirukkiradhu. Indhak koyil kuritha pala vishayangal suvaarasyamaanavai.
Magaa periyavar orumurai mutharasanalloorukku vijayam seythadhaagavum appodhu avar thangiyirundha idathai migavum punidhamaanadhu endru karudhi thaan vaangiyadhaagavum therivithaar tharpodhu indhak koyil amaindhirukkum idathin urimaiyaalar sivakkumaar.
Indha nilaiyil, 2013-m aandu kanavil kaatchigodutha magaa suvaamigal punnagaiyodu, “indha idathil oru kulathai erpaadu sey. Kshemamaay iruppaay” endru utharavittaar. 2015-m aandu andha muyatsiyil iranginaar sivagumaar. Andha aandu kadum varatchi. Neer kondu serppadhu eppadi endru kavalaippattaar sivagumaar.
Sivakkumaar pala aandugalaaga maadhamdhorum keralaa sendru kuruvaayoorappanaith tharisanam seythu varuvavar. Andha murai kuruvaayoor sendravar, than manakkavalaiyai kuruvaayoorappanidam irakki vaithuvittu, angirundha namboodhiri oruvaridamum pagirndhugondaar.
Adharku andha namboodhiri, ''vettaik`korumagan enum vazhivaadu seythaal thanneer pirasnai varaadhu’’ enak koorinaar.
Vettaikkorumagan vazhivaadu enbadhu 12,008 thengaaygalai oruvare thodarndhu udaikkum vazhivaattu murai. Sivagumaarin azhaippin peril adhais seythuvaikka kuruvaayoor namboodhiri mutharasanalloor vandhaar. Vazhivaadu sirappaaga mudindhadhu. Adharkaana palanum kidaithadhu. Mazhaiveythu kulam nirambiyadhu. Sivagumaar magaaveriyavarin karunaiyai enni magizhndhaar.
Andha vaivathinbodhu namboodhiri `thidambu vikraham’ ondrai sivagumaarukkup parisalithaar. Andha vikrahathai magaaveriyavar padathukku valappakkathil vaithu muraiyaagap poojai seythuvandhaar sivagumaar. Kuruvaayoorappanukkuth thaniyaaga oru sannidhi amaikkalaamaa endra ennamum erpattadhu. Idharkaagap pirasnam paarkka erpaadu seythaar. Pirasnathil pala theva ragasiyangal veliyaagina.
“sreesakdhi sangara nandhavanathil 18 thevadhaigal vaasam seygindrana. Sreeguruvaayoorappanum sreevaramaasaaryarum ippagudhi makkalukku anukkiragam seyya ingu ezhundharuliyullanar. Enave inge aalayam amaithu uvadhevadhaigalukkum sannidhi erpaduthi vazhivaduvadhan moolam indhap pagudhiye suvitchamaagum” endru utharavu vandhadhu.
Sivagumaar udanadiyaaga andha idathil koyil ezhuppa erpaadugalais seythaar. Adhanbadi ange arpudhamaana kuruvaayoorappan thirukkoyil undaanadhu.
Kuruvaayoorukkus sendru andhak kirushnanai tharisanam seytha thirupdhi ingu tharisanam seyvadhan moolam pakdhargalukkuk kidaithuvidugiradhu. Enave thamizhagam mattumalla pala maanilangalilirundhum indha aalayam kurithuk kelvippattu vandhu tharisanam seythu selgiraargal pakdhargal.
Kuruvaayoor koyilil enna poojai muraiyo adhudhaan ingum. Kaalai 6 manikku sannidhi thirakkappadum. Kaalai 6.15 mani varai nirmaalya tharisanam. Kaalai 6.15 suvaamikku avishegam, 6.45 manikku malar nivedham. 7 manikkus sinnadhaaga oru poojai. 9.30 manikku uchikkaala poojai. Adhaiyaduthu 11 manikku sannidhi moodappadum.
Ingu kirushna jayandhi kolaagalamaaga nadaiverum. Adhevola kaarthigai maadhathil ‘kuruvaayoor egaadhasi’yum migavum pirasitham.
Vizhaakkaalangalaana 33 naalgalil suvaami velippiraagaarathil ulaa varuvaar. Ingu aiyappanukkum sannidhi iruppadhaal navambar 15-m thedhi mudhal janavari 15-m thedhi varai mandala kaala poojaiyum vegu vimarsaiyaaga nadaiverum. Janavari 15-m thedhi magarajodhi tharisanamum adhai otti visesha poojaigalum nadaiverum. Aavani maadhathil onam pandigai ingu pathunaal utsavamaagak kondaadappadugiradhu.
Melum ingu vettaikkoruman, karuppanna suvaami, pillaiyaar, pakkathi leye kiraama theviyaaga paraasakdhi aagiyorukkum sannidhi ulladhu. Magaa periyavaa, saayivaavaa pondra magaan kalum inge sannidhi kondarulgiraargal. Enave ingu vandhu vendum pakdhargalin korikkaigal yaavum niraiverugindrana engiraargal.
Ingu thiruvona poojai seyvadhaal kuzhandhaip paakkiyam kidaikkum enbadhu nambikkai. Ingulla naaga theyvangalukku maadhamdhorum aayilya natchathira naalil nadaiverum naaga poojai visesham. Idhil kalandhugondu piraarthanai seythugondaal, sarppa thoshangal theervadhodu thirumanath thadaigalum neengum; noygal vilagum engiraargal palan kanda pakdhargal. Mattumandri kuruvaayoor polave sutru vilakku, thulaavaaram aagiya vazhivaadu kalaiyum indha aalayathil pakdhargal seyyalaam.
Vaayppiruppavargal orumurai mutharasanalloor sendru kuruvaayoorappanai vazhivattu vaarungal. Kuruvarulum thiruvarulum nichayam kidaikkum.

headline: Karukkalaippukkus salugai illai endru Seeman aadhangappattaaraa?
text:
Karukkalaikka kaaranamaana aangalukku patjettil endha salugaiyum illai endru Seeman kooriyadhaaga oru news card

Polimer news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “kavarchi arivippugaludan koodiya vetru arikkai. Patjettil karukkalaikkak kaaranamaana aangalukku endha salugaiyum illai idhellaam oru patjettaa? Naangaandugalil seyyaadhadhai meedhamirukkum oraandil DMK arasu seyyum enbadhai eppadi namba mudiyum ena kelvi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naam thamizhar katchiyin thalaimai orunginaippaalarukkum thiraippada nadigai oruvarukkum munbu thodarbu irundhadhaagak kutrachaattu ulladhu. Indha thodarbu kaaranamaaga andha nadigai pala murai karukkalaippu seythadhaagavum kutrachaattu ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu patjettil karukkalaippukku kaaranamaana aangalukku salugai illai endru Seeman karuthu therivithup pondru news card ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Ippadi oru karuthai Seeman kooriyirukka vaayppillai. Melum, news kaardin thamizh faant vazhakkamaana Polimer news kaardudan othuppogavillai. Enave, indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil Polimer TV veliyitta unmaiyaana news card-ai thedi eduthom. Adhil, “thamizhaga patjet, kavarchi arivippugalai mattume konda vetru arikkai ena Seeman vimarsanam” endru irundhadhu. Idhai edit seythu Seeman kooraadha vishayathais serthiruppadhu thelivaanadhu. Aduthadhaaga Seeman alitha pettiyaiyum thedi eduthom. Adhaiyum muzhuvadhumaaga paarthom. Adhil avar karukkalaippukkus salugai endrellaam kooravillai. Enave, indha thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya, idhai Polimer TV digital poruppaalarukku WhatsApp moolam anuppinom. Avarum “indha news card poliyaanadhu, Polimer seythigal veliyitta news card-ai edit seythullanar. Idhu thavaraanadhu” endraar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Poori radha yaathiraiyin podhu aar.es.es thondargal amaitha manidha piramidu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Odisaa poori jegannaadhar kovil therottathin podhu aar.es.es sevaa paaradhi thondargal amaitha manidha piramidu endru kurippittu video ondru

poori jegannaadhar therottathin podhu pakdhargal manidha piramidu erpaduthiyadhu pondru video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “puri radha yaathiraiyin podhu aar.es.es sevaavaaradhi thondargal amaitha manidha piramit” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Odisaa maanilam piravalamaana poori jegannaadhar kovil therottathin podhu aar.es.es thondargal pirammaanda manidha piramidu amaithadhaaga video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vai paarkkum podhu unmaiyaanadhu pola illai. Kattukkadangaadha koottam seyarkaiyaaga eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu pola irundhadhu. Aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil aar.es.es thondargal indha manidha piramidais seythanar endru kurippittirundhadhaal idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil therottathin podhu aar.es.es thondargalin manidha piramidu nadandhadhaa… adhu thodarbaaga seythi, video edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Namakku appadi endha oru seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Radhayaathiraiyin neradi olivarappaip pala oodagangalum seythirundhana. Thoordharshan YouTube-il seythirundha neradi olivarappaip paarthom. Adhil manidha piramidu edhuvum uruvaakkappadavillai. Ivai ellaam jegannaadhar therottathin podhu aar.es.es thondargal saarbil manidha piramidu erpaduthappattadhaagap paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil bharathfx1 endra instaagiraam aidi irundhadhu. Andha aidi-kku sendru paartha podhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video padhividappattirundhadhaik kandom. Migavum thelivaaga andha video irundhadhu. Video patri sirugurippaiyum veliyittirundhanar. Adhil, “indha reelsl neengal kaanum pugaippadam/veediyo muzhumaiyaaga eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu. Engal nokkam yaaraiyum punbaduthuvadhu alla. Idhu pozhudhuvokku nokkirkaaga uruvaakkappattadhu. Idhil idam petra kaatchigalai neengal neradiyaaga seyya muyala vendaam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha veediyovum eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhudhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga eai pugaippadangalaik kandariya udhavum sila inaiyadhalangalil(hivedetect.ai) indha video-vai padhivetrith thedinom. Avaiyum indha video muzhukka muzhukka eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhudhaan endru urudhi seythana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil, poori jegannaadhar therottathin podhu miga pirammaanda manidha piramidai aar.es.es thondargal uruvaakkinaargal endru paravum video thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Manikku 600 km vegam! Alai alaiyaaga paayum trongal! Ukrainai pandhaadum Russia!
text:
Nettovil inaiya muyandra ukrainukku edhiraaga 2022 mudhal thaakkudhalaith thodarum Russia, ippodhu keraan-5 trongalai alai alaiyaaga evi, Ukraine-in utkattamaippai sedhappaduthi varugiradhu.
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
airoppiya yooniyanin raanuva matrum arasiyal koottamaippu thaan netto endru azhaikkappadugiradhu. America, ingilaandhu, jermani ullitta naadugal angam vagikkum indha amaippil inaiya Ukraine muyatsigal merkondadhu. Idharku edhirppu therivitha Russia, kadandha 2022-aam aandu mudhal thodarchiyaaga thaakkudhal nadathi varugiradhu. Indha thaakkudhalukku, ukrainum thangalaal mudindha padhiladigalai avvappodhu alithu varugiradhu. Irudharappilum idhuvarai 16 aayirathirkum merpattor uyirizhandhulla nilaiyil, 50 aayirathirkum merpattor padugaayam adaindhullanar.
Innilaiyil, indha poril Ukraine meedhu migapperiya thaakkudhalai nadatha, adhinaveena aayudhathai Russia kalamirakkiyulladhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. Adhaavadhu, manikku sumaar 600 kilo meter vegathilum, 6 aayiram meter uyarathilum parakkak koodiya keraan -5 endra adhinaveena trongalai, Russia kalamirakkiyulladhu. Sumaar aayiram kilo meter thoorathil ulla ilakkugalaiyum thulliyamaaga thaakkak koodiya indha trongal, 90 kilo varaiyilaana vedivorutkalai sumandhu sellum thiran kondadhu.
Pazhaiya trongalai pol illaamal, adheedha vegathil kuroos evuganaip pondru seyalbadum indha trongal, e.ai amaippugaludanum, thermal kemaraakkaludanum seyalbaduvadhaal, ilakkai kachidhamaaga thagarkkiradhu. Melum, minnanu thaakkudhalgalai muriyadikkum aandi jaaming amaippugalum poruthappattulladhaal, Ukraine-in vaan pagudhi, migundha aavathil ulladhu.
Ithagaiya valimaiyaana trongalai uruvaakkiyiruppadhodu, idhanai alai alaiyaaga aayirakkanakkil Russia evuvadhaal, Ukraine-in utkattamaippu palatha paadhippu adaigiradhu. Ivai anaithirkum melaaga, keraan -5 trongal oppeettu alavil vilai kuraivaana aayudhamaaga iruppadhaal, adhanai adhiga alavil rashyaavaal eva mudigiradhu. Aanaal, andha adhinaveena trongalai azhikka, vilai uyarndha indarsepdar evuganaigalai Ukraine payanbadutha vendiyulladhu. Idhu porin porulaadhaara vidhigalaiyum, edhirgaalap por thandhirangalaiyum rashyaavirkus saadhagamaaga maatriyulladhu.

headline: Vandhe maadharam sarchai| ’indhu theyvangalai maiyam kondadhaal..’ Uchaneedhimandram sonna mukkiya vishayam!
text:
Vandhe maadharam paaduvadhai sattamaakkiyadhu thodarbaana vazhakkil, paadalin kadaisi naangu pathigal indhu theyvangalai maiyamaagak kondadhaal avatrai kattaayappaduthuvadhu madhachaarbatra thanmaikku muranaanadhu ena ti.em. Kirushnaa manu thaakkal seythullaar.
Seythiyaalar - M.meeraa
vandhe maadharam paadalin aaru pathigalaiyum paaduvadhaik kattaayamaakki adhu thodarbaana sattathin thandanaip pirivugalai serthiruppadharku edhirthuk karnaadaga isaikkalainjar ti.em. Kirushnaavin manu meedhu padhilalikka mathiya arasukku ucha Needhimandram utharavittulladhu. Thalaimai needhivadhi sooryaa kaanth thalaimaiyilaana amarvu, ichattathin thandanai saarndha amsangalai arasiyal amaippin pirivu 25 matrum 26 alikkum madha sudhandhira urimaigalin keezh pariseelikkalaam enak kooriyadhu.
Mukkiyamaaga, madhak kaaranangalaal ippaadalaip paadaadha oruvarukku endhak kutraviyal alladhu thandanai nadavadikkaigalum vidhikkappadak koodaadhu endrum, idharku munmaadhiriyaaga 'pijoy imaanuvel' theerppu muzhumaiyaagap pinbatrappadum endru edhirbaarppadhaagavum ucha Needhimandram therivithulladhu. Vandhe maadharathin kadaisi naangu pathigal indhu theyvangalai maiyamaagak kondulladhaal, avatraik kattaayamaakkuvadhu madhachaarbatra thanmaikku edhiraanadhu ena kirushnaavin manuvil therivikkappattulladhu.
Vandhe maadharam vazhakkil mathiya arasin solisittar jenaral thushaar methaa therivitha 'naksalait' endra karuthukku mootha vazhakkarinjar es. Muralidhar ucha needhimandrathil kadum aatchevam therivithaar. Karnaadaga isaikkalainjar ti.em. Kirushnaa thaakkal seytha manu visaaranaiyin podhu, satta uruvaakkam naksalait mananilaikku erpa amaiya mudiyaadhu ena methaa koorinaar. Idharkuk kadum edhirppu therivitha muralidhar, oru satta adhigaari idhuvondra vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthuvadhu azhagalla" enak koori, avvaarthaiyaith thirumbap pera valiyuruthinaar. Idhanaal needhimandrathil kaarasaara vivaadham erpattadhu.
