Idhe seythiyin matroru padam idho…
aduthappadiyaaga, 2vadhu pugaippadam kadandha 2014m aandu mudhale inaiya thalathil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idharkum, tharpodhaiya DMK aatchikkum endha thodarbum illai.
Irudhiyaaga, vellai car pallathil kidappadhu pondra pugaippadam, 2025m aandu me maadham, Chennai thiruvaanmiyooril nadandha oru sambavam thodarbaanadhu. Aanaal, idharkum, paruva mazhaikkum endha thodarbum illai.
New Indian Express l Times of India
enave, vevveru sambavam thodarbaana pugaippadangalai ondraaga inaithu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mumbai ketve aap India aruge kondhalikkum kadal video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:
Mumbaiyil kanamazhai peythu varum soozhalil, ketve aap India (The Gateway of India) aruge kadal migavum kondhalippaaga ulladhu endru oru video

mumbaiyil ulla ketve aap India-vukku aruge kadal kondhalippaaga irukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “mumbai thaaj ketve arugil kondhalikkum aravi kadal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Mumbaiyil thodarndhu kana mazhai peythu varum soozhalil, mumbaiyil vella paadhippu endru sila video-kkal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Mumbai vimaananilaiyam kadal pola mazhai neer thengi nirpadhaaga oru video samooga oodagangalil paraviyadhu. Adhu 2023m aandu Chennai vimaana nilaiyathil edukkappattadhu endru katturai veliyittirundhom.
Indha soozhalil, mumbai thaaj hottal – ketve aap India aruge kadal kondhalippaaga ulladhu endru palarum video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vai paarkkum podhu adhu mumbai ketve aap India arugil edukkappattadhu enbadhu unmaidhaan. Aanaal, indha video eppodhu edukkappattadhu endru thelivaaga illai. Idhanaal, tharpodhu peythu varum kana mazhai matrum vaanilai kaaranamaaga kadal seetramaaga irukkiradhu endra ennam erpadugiradhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video-vai sameeva naatkalaagap palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu moondru, naangu aandugalukku munbum kooda idhe video-vai silar thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediyavodhu 2021m aandu Tauktae puyal kaaranamaaga mumbai thaaj hottal – ketve aap India pagudhiyil kadal seetrathudan irundhadhaaga seythigal namakku kidaithana. Athudan kadal seetram kaaranamaaga karaiyora pagudhiyil paadhippu erpattadhaaga veliyaana video seythiyum namakku kidaithadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video 2021m aandais saarndhadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Nammudaiya aayvil 2021m aandu mumbai kadarkarai pagudhiyil edukkappatta video-vai 2025l mumbaiyil kadal seetram endru ippodhu nadappadhu pondru thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthak koodiyadhu alladhu eppodhu indha video edukkappattadhu endra thagavalai maraithu veliyidappadap padhivu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thinamum kaadhil ‘iyarplak’ vaithu thoongugireergalaa? Maruthuva nivunargal tharum echarikkaigal!
text:
Thinamum kaadhil iyarplak enappadum sevicherugiyai vaithu thoonguvavaraa neengal? Appadiyendraal indha seythi ungalukkaanadhudhaan. Iravu thoongumbodhu kurattai, vaaganap pokkuvarathu pondra sathangalai thavirkka palarum kaadhil 'iyarplaks' payanbaduthugindranar. Aanaal, idhanai thodarndhu thinamum payanbaduthuvadhu, kaadhil pirachinaigalai erpaduthum engindranar maruthuva nivunargal.
Adhaavadhu, thodarndhu iyarplak payanbaduthuvadhaal, kaadhukkul iyarkaiyaagas surakkum mezhugu veliyeruvadhil thadai erpattu, ulleye thangividum endrum, idhanaal kaadhu adaippu alladhu ketkum thiran mangudhal pondra pirachinaigal erpadum enavum echarikkindranar. Sariyaaga suthappaduthappadaadha iyarplakkai meendum meendum payanbaduthumbodhu, adhil ulla paakdeeriyaa kaadhukkul sendru kaadhu thotrai erpaduthalaam endrum koorugindranar. Adikkadi kaadhu thotrukku ullaaguvavargal, kaadhil arippu alladhu thol noy ullavargal, maruthuvarin aalosanaikkup pirage iyarbilakkai payanbadutha vendum endrum maruthuva nivunargal arivuruthugindranar.

headline: Beast padathin paadal paadum arasup palli maanavargal endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:
‘‘Beast padathin paadal paadum arasup palli maanavargal endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ arasu palligal kalvi nilaiyangalaa alladhu kalaikkoothaadum kambeniyaa? Palli kalvi thurai amaichar thiru raajmogan avargale idhu thaan neenga maanavargalukku kalvi kodukkum murai asingamaaga illai ungalukku arasiyal seyya idam illaiyaa #TVKFails,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan, Vijay naditha Beast padathil idambetrulla paadal ondrai arasup palli maanavargal paaduvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, kurippitta Beast paadalai ezhudhiya sinimaa paadalaasiriyar ku.kaarthik, avaradhu instaagiraam pakkathil indha video-vai kadandha joon 21, 2022 andru pagirndhulladhaik kandom.
Indha video tharpodhu meendum viral seyyappadum nilaiyil, idhuvatri paadalaasiriyar kaarthik vilakkam alithullaar.
Melum, idhu 4 aandugalukku mun edukkappatta pazhaiya video endru, Tamil Nadu pallik kalvithurai amaichar raajmogan vilakkam alithullaar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, pazhaiya video-vai eduthu, vendumendre tharpodhu vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ’engalukku vera vazhiyilla’– kovaiyil karugum vaazhaiyaik kaappaatra thanneerai vilaikku vaangum vivasaayigal!
text:
”aruvadaikku thayaaraa konjjam nallaa irukkura vaazhaigalai kaappaatha veru vazhiyillaama oru tengar thanneerukku roo.5,000 mudhal roo.10,000 varai vilai koduthu vaangi oothi samaalikkirom”
vaanam paartha poomiyil mazhaikkaaga kaathirukkum vivasaayigalukku ovvoru naalum emaatrame minjjugiradhu. Pasumai porthiyirukka vendiya vilainilangal pachaiyathai tholaithuvittu manjjalum pazhuppumaaga paridhavithu nirkindrana. Sila naatkalukku munbu varai kaatril thalaiasaitha payirgal, indru verum sarugugalaaga parakkindrana. Vaadiya payirgalin thaagathai theerkka vazhidheriyaamal vaadiya mugathudan irukkum vivasaayigal pala maadha uzhaippu, veyilil karaiyum panithuliyaaga karaigiradhu. Idhudhaan varatchiyin pidiyil sikkiyulla annoor sutruvattaara kiraamangalin nilai. Idharku ore kaaranam ’el nino’.
Kadum veyil matrum nilathadi neermattam sarivu kaaranamaaga, paasanak kinarugalum, aazhdhulaik kinarugalum aduthaduthu varandu varugindrana. Idhan kaaranamaaga aruvadaikkuth thayaaraaga ulla vaazhaip payirgalaik kaappaatra laarigal moolam koodudhal vilai koduthuth thanneer vaangip paaycha vendiya avala nilaikku thallappattulladhaaga vivasaayigal vedhanai therivikkindranar.
Idhu kurithu annoor pagudhi vivasaayigal kooriyadhaavadhu, “paruvamazhai kaigodukkumnu nambi payirgalai vilaivichom. Aanaa mazhai kaigodukkala. Eppodhaavadhu konjjamaa thoorittu poyiduchu. Adhanaala ennoda porvel, kinaru ellaam thannee illaama vatri poyirukku. Aayiram adikkum mela por pottaalum thannee varuvadhilla. Idhanaala niraiya idangalula karumbu, vaazhai ellaam kaayndhu karugittu irukku. Ippadiyoru mosamaana varatchiyai naanga paarthadhu illa. Idhanaala niraiya vivasaayigalukku nashdamaagittu irukku.
Aruvadaikku thayaaraa konjjam nallaa irukkura vaazhaigalaik kaappaatha veru vazhiyillaama konjjam vasadhi irukkura vivasaayigal tiraakdar, tengar laarigal moolam thannee vaangi oothurom. Oru tengar thanneerukku roo.5,000 mudhal roo.10,000 varai vilai koduthu vaangi samaalichittu irukkom. Ini varum naalgalil mazhai peyyalaana thanneeyum kidaikkaama poyidum. Thodarndhu thanneerai vilai koduthu vaangi oothi vivasaayathai kaappaatha mudiyumaa? Mazhaiyillanaa ottumothamaaga vivasaayathai kaividura nilaikkuth thallappaduvom” ena vedhanaiyudan therivithanar.

headline: 'onnu arivaal vettu; innonnu minvettu; rendukkumdhaan pottiye!' - Stalin vimarsanam
text:
Mudhalvar indraikku enna kot pottaar, vellikkizhamai pattu vetti, netriyil enna kalar pottu vaithaar endru seythi vandhugondirukkiradhu. Mudhalvarum idhai seythaal podhumena ninaikkiraar.
DMK-vin mupperum vizhaa Chennai annaa arivaalayathin kalainjar arangil nadandhirundhadhu. Idhil pesiya DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin mudhalvar vijayyaiyum TVK arasaiyum kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu pesiyirundhaar.
M.K. Stalin pesiyadhaavadhu, 'oru iyakkam 75 aandugal nilaithiruppadhu saadhaarana vishayamalla. 75 aandugal kazhithum adhe kambeerathodu nirpadhum saadhaarana saadhanai kidaiyaadhu. Nadandhu mudindha therdhalil aalungatchikkum namakkum 17 latcham vaakkugaldhaan vithiyaasam, perumbaanmai kooda kidaikkavillai.
Edho periya alai adithadhai pola pesugiraargal. Nammudaiya koottani katchigalaaldhaan aatchiye nadakkiradhu. Andha katchigalaiyum nambaamal kudhirai peram nadathik kondirukkiraargal. Thiraavida maadal aatchiyil kondu vandha thittangalai niruthuvadhum peyarai maatruvadhumdhaan maatramaa? DMK aatchiyil porulaadhaara valarchiyil nambar 1maanilamaaga irundhom. Ippodhu vilaivaasi uyarvil nambar 1 aaga maarikkondirukkirom.
Indha thuklak tharbaarai patri pesak koodaadhu enbadharkaaga amaicharavai mudhal oodagangal varai taivart seygindranar. Mudhalvar indraikku enna kot pottaar, vellikkizhamai pattu vetti, netriyil enna kalar pottu vaithaar endru seythi vandhugondirukkiradhu. Mudhalvarum idhai seythaal podhumena ninaikkiraar.thavega aatchiyil irande irandukku idaiyildhaan pottiye. Ondru minvettu, innondru arivaal vettu' endraar.

headline: Idaitherdhal | thavegavukkup potti.. Kalamirakkappatta ADMK vetbaalargal!
text:
2026 sattamandrath therdhalil koottani amaithup pottiyitta ADMK, verum 47 idangalil mattume vetri petradhaal 3-aam idathirku thallappattadhu. Idhanaal, sila karuthu veruvaadugal erpattu, mukkiya nirvaagigal palar katchiyil irundhu veliyerinar. Kurippaaga, madhuraandhagam, perundhurai, thaaraavuram, ambaasamuthiram, karoor matrum viraalimalai ADMK em.el.e-kkal thangal padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythuvittu akkatchiyil irundhu vilagi thavegavil inaindhanar. Idhaiyaduthu, athogudhigal kaaliyaanadhaaga arivikkappattadhu. Thodarndhu Trichy kizhakkudan serthu 7 thogudhigalukku viraivil, therdhal arivikkappadum ena edhirbaarkkappattadhu. Aanaal, madhuraandhagam matrum thaaraavuram thavirtha matra 5 thogudhigalil therdhal thodarbaana vazhakku niluvaiyil irundha nilaiyil, andha thogudhigalukku idaitherdhal nadatha Needhimandram idaikkaalath thadai vidhithirundhadhu.
Indhachoozhalildhaan, Tamil Naattil thaaraavuram matrum madhuraandhagam thogudhigalukku mattum idaitherdhalai therdhal aanaiyam arivithirukkiradhu. Adhanbadi, indha iru thogudhigalilum akdovar 6aam thedhi idaitherdhal nadaivera irukkiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, angu therdhal kalam sooduvidithulladhu. Therdhalai munnittu, DMK, TVK aagiya katchigal vetbaalargalai niruthiyullana. DMK saarbil, madhuraandhagam (thani) thogudhiyil, vazhakkarinjar ai.parandhaamanum, thaaraavuram (thani) thogudhiyil vazhakkarinjar es. Suganyaavum niruthappattullanar. TVK saarbil, madhuraandhagathil maragadham kumaravelum thaaraavuram thogudhiyil sathiyavaamaavum pottiyidugindranar. Ivargal iruvarum kadandha therdhalil adhe thogudhigalil adhimugavilirundhu vetri petravargalaavar. Adhevol, adhimugavum vetbaalargalai arivithulladhu. Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil kanidhaa sambathum, thaaraavuram thogudhiyil paanumadhiyum vetbaalargalaaga arivikkappattullanar.

headline: Kediem bike thirudiya saaraaya viyaavaari kaidhu
text:
Aathoor;aathoor, mullaivaadiyai serndhavar piravaagar, 32. Thaniyaar nidhi niruvanathil melaalaraaga ullaar. Ivar iluppanathathai serndha thamizhan enbavaradhu, 'kediem - 200 tiyuk' paikkai, payan-paduthi vandhaar. Kadandha, 8l, veedu mun niruthiyi-rundha nilaiyil,
andha bike thiruduvonadhu. Pira-paagar pugaaril, Aathoor tavun Police visaa-rithadhil, Aathoor, arunagirinaadhar theruvai serndha velan, 25, thirudiyadhu therindhadhu. Netru, thennangudivaalaiyam pudhu eriyil irundha avarai, Police kaidhu seythu, paikkai meet-tanar. Melum velan, sentring velaikku sendru varuvadhum, koronaa kaalathil saaraayam vitru kaidhu seyyappattavar enbadhum theriyavandhadhu.

headline: Noolagangal verum thervu maiyangalaa.. Thamizhagap palligalil kattaayamaakkappadumaa naalidhazh vaasippu?
text:
Thamizhagathil oru kodiye iruvadhu latcham maanavargal irukkiraargal... Ketkave perumaiyaaga irukkiradhu allavaa? Aanaal, indhap perum pattaalam indru edhaip padithuk kondirukkiradhu? Arasu oor ooraagap puthagath thiruvizhaa nadathugiradhu... Puthaga thiruvizhaakkalukku nidhiyudhavi seygiradhu. Aanaal, nilaimai enna theriyumaa? Medaip pechaik kettu rasippavargal, puthaga alamaarigalai ettip paarkkakkoodath thayangugiraargal. Idhu arivuth thedal alla... Verum pozhudhuvokkuk koodaaramaaga maari varugiradho endra acham ezhugiradhu. Noolagangal indru amaidhiyaagap padikkum idamaaga illaamal, pottith thervukku thayaaraagum maiyangalaagas surungip poyvittana.
Utharap piradhesamum, raajasdhaanum oru sathamillaadha puratchiyais seythirukkindrana. Palligalil naalidhazh vaasippai kattaayamaakkivittaargal. En idhaith thamizhagam seyyak koodaadhu? Aaraam vaguppileye oru siruvan seythithaal padikka aarambithaal, avan kaigalil ulagam vandhu amarum. Verum paadapputhaga arivu enbadhu thervukkaanadhu; aanaal ulaga arivudhaan oruvanaip peraatral mikka vetriyaalanaakkum. Aasiriyargalum maanavargalum inaindhu, naalidhazh vaasippai oru thavamaaga merkondaal, nam varungaalath thamizhagam arivus samoogamaaga ulagai aalum enbadhil ellalavum sandhegamillai.

headline: Paaksing kalathil ilamveerar moolaichaavu; udal uruppu thaanamaaga vazhangiya petror
text:
'paaksing' kalathil ilamveerar moolaichaavu; udal uruppu thaanamaaga vazhangiya petror
Chennai: palliyil nadandha kuthuchandai pottiyin irudhiyaattathil, thideerena mayangi vizhundhu moolaichaavu adaindha 15 vayadhu ilamveerarin udal uruppugalai, avaradhu petror thaanamaaga vazhanginar.
Ambathoor, teechars kaalani, 2vadhu theruvais serndhavar sandhiravaavu, 44; ai.ti., niruvana oozhiyar. Ivaradhu manaivi reshmi, 41. Thambadhikku oru magalum, maganum ullanar. Avaradhu magan harish, 15; soorappattu, velammaal palli pathaam vaguppu maanavar; kuthuchandai veeraraagavum vilanginaar.
Indha nilaiyil, thiruverkaadu adutha ayanambaakkam pagudhiyil ulla velammaal palliyil, si.pi.es.i., palligalukku idaiyilaana kuthuchandai potti nadandhadhu. Pottiyin thodakkam mudhale asathiya harish, irudhi sutrukku munnerinaar.
Kadandha 12m thedhi irudhippotti nadakka irundha idathil, harish thideerena mayangi vizhundhaar. Palli nirvaagam avarai meettu, arugil ulla thaniyaar maruthuvamanaiyil serthanar. Angu avarai parisodhitha maruthuvargal harishin moolaiyil rathakkasivu ulladhu, udane, aruvai sigichai seyya vendum ena kooriyullanar.
Adhanbadi, aruvai sigichai seytha nilaiyil, netru mundhinam maalai harish moolaichaavu adaindhaar. Pin, iravu 11:00 maniyalavil, sigichai palanindri paridhaavamaaga uyirizhandhaar. Harishin udalai thaanam seyya, avaradhu petror mudivu seythanar.
Idhaiyaduthu, moolai saavu adaindha harishin kan, idhayam, kanaiyam, kitni, kudal ullitta ezhu udal uruppugal thaanamaaga alikkappattadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, avaradhu udal sondha ooraana kerala maanilam kollathirku eduthus sellappattadhu. Indha sambavam appagudhiyil perum sogathai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Thamizhaga mudhalvar vijayyai vimarsitha karnaadaga mudhalvar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Thamizhaga mudhalvar vijayyai karnaadaga mudhalvar ti.sivakkumaar vimarsithaar endru oru video

karnaadaga mudhalamaicharaagap poruppetrulla ti.sivakkumaar alitha pettiyin siru pagudhiyai vaithu video padhivu uruvaakkappattu Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil Vijay mudhirchiyatra arasiyalvaadhi endru ti.sivakkumaar koorugiraar. Nilaith thagavalil, “pakkathu maanila CM, Vijay oru Immatured Fellow, avarukkellaam oru mannum theriyaadhunu kaari thuppuraar..
Ithanaikkum avaru koottanila irukka katchigaaraaru” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattin mudhalamaicharaaga ulla vijayyai karnaadaga maanilathin mudhalamaicharaagap poruppetrulla ti.sivakkumaar vimarsithaar endru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Thangal koottaniyilirundhaalum kooda vijayyai ti.sivakkumaar vimarsithadhaagap padhividappattulladhu.
Aanaal, indha indha petti pudhiyadhu alla. Pazhaiya pettiyai eduthu tharpodhu iruvarum vevveru maanilangalin mudhalamaichargalaagap poruppetra piragu alitha petti pola padhivittullanar. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Ti.sivakkumaar alitha pettiyai samooga oodagangalil thedi eduthom. ANI seythi oodagam indha pettiyai epral 9, 2026 andru veliyittirundhadhu. Adhaavadhu Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal pirasaaram uchathilirundha podhu ti.sivakkumaar indha pettiyai alithirundhaar. Appodhu avar karnaadaga mudhalamaichar illai. Vijayyum Tamil Nadu mudhalamaicharaaga appodhu illai. TVK koottaniyil Congress katchiyum appodhu inaindhirukkavillai.
ANI mattumindri veru pala oodagangalilum kooda epral 9m thedhi indha video veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Anaithu seythi oodagangalilum seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhalil TVK 108 idangalil vetri petra piragudhaan thavega-vukku aadharavu endra arivippai veliyittadhu Congress adhan piragu ti.sivakkumaare kooda Vijay-kku tholaivesi moolam vaazhthu koori pesiyadhaaga kooda seythi veliyaagiyadhu.
Idhan moolam Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar vijayyai karnaadaga mudhalamaichar ti.sivakkumaar vimarsithaar endru paravum video pazhaiyadhu, thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Jem veeramaniyidam panam vaanginom endru DMK munnaal amaichar raguvadhi koorinaaraa?
text:
Jem kiraanait veeramaniyidam mudhal thagaval arikkai padhivu seyyaamal irukka panam vaanginom endru DMK munnaal amaichar raguvadhi kooriyadhaaga oru news card

san news veliyittadhu pondru news card instaagiraamil padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “‘panam vaanginom’ “jem kiraanait veeramani meedhu FIR podaamal irukka panam vaangiyadhu unmai thaan. En idhellaam oru periya vishayamaa? Adikkadi engal DMK aatchiyil nadakkum vishayam thaane?” DMK munnaal amaichar raguvadhi petti” endru irundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “unmaiyai oppukkondanar DMK arasu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Jem kiraanait veeramani meedhu kadandha DMK aatchikkaalathileye paaliyal vangodumai pugaar ezhundhadhu. Appodhe pokso sattathin keezh vazhakku padhivu seyyappattadhu. Aanaal, panam vaangikkondu ep.ai.aar padhivu seyyavillai endru munnaal amaichar oppukkondadhaaga news card samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Raguvadhi pettiyil appadi kooravillai.
Melum, unmaiyil lanjjam vaangiyirundhaalum yaarum adhai velippadaiyaaga koora maattaargal. Enave, indha news card poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil indha news card-ai san news veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathai paarvaiyittom. Adhil, veen pazhi endru naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card-ai san news sepdambar 22, 2026 andru veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Adhil, “‘veen pazhi’ “jem kiraanait veeramanikku edhiraana vazhakkil FIR padhivu seythadhu DMK arasudhaan. Paaliyal vazhakkil DMK meedhu veen pazhi sumathugiradhu TVK arasu” -thimuga munnaal amaichar raguvadhi petti” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu vishamathanamaana thagaval serthup pagirndhiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla san news digital poruppaalarukku naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai anuppi visaarithom. Avarum idhu poliyaana news card enbadhai urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kudiyarasu thunaith thalaivarai pilaastik naarkaaliyil amara vaithu avamariyaadhai seythaaraa amithshaa?
text:
Thaan sogusu kushan sofaavil amarndhugondu, kudiyarasu thunaith thalaivarai pilaastik naarkaaliyil utkaara vaitha mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaa endru oru pugaippadam

amithshaa – o.panneerselvam sandhippin podhu, amithshaa arugil oramaaga tharpodhaiya kudiyarasuth thunaith thalaivar raadhaagirushnan amarndhirukkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “amith shaa utkaarndhu irukkum naarkaaliyai paarungal. Namadhu menmai porundhiya thunai janaadhivadhi amarndhu irukkum naarkaaliyai matrum andha pavyamaana vidhathai paarungal. Pilaastik naarkaali, sovaa pondra arasiyal aattam njaavagam vandhaal naan poruppu alla” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sameevathil munnaal mudhalamaichar o.panneerselvam Delhi sendru BJP mootha thalaivargalai sandhithup pesinaar. Indha nilaiyil indha sandhippin podhu Indhiya kudiyarasu thunaith thalaivar si.pi.raadhaagirushnan pilaastik naarkaaliyil amara vaikkappattu avamariyaadhai seyyappattaar enbadhu pondru pugaippadam ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Aanaal, andha pugaippadathaip paarkka sameevathil edukkappattadhu pola illai. Munbu Tamil Nadu BJP poruppaalaraaga irundha si.pi.ravi, munnaal thalaivar thamizhisai saundhararaajan matrum mootha nirvaagigal palarum andha pugaippadathil iruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Enave, si.pi.raadhaagirushnan kudiyarasu thunaith thalaivaraagath therndhedukkappaduvadharku munbu indha pugaippadam edukkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu. Enave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathaik koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha pugaippadam 2019m aandu seythi oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu BJP-yin inaiyadhalathilum kooda indha nigazhvin pugaippadam veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, “aiadhimuga mootha thalaivar paajaga-vin thesiya thalaivar amith shaavai Maduraiyil 2019 pipravari 22m thedhi sandhithaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha pugaippadam edukkappatta podhu amithshaa India-vin uldhurai amaicharaagavum aagiyirukkavillai, si.pi.raadhaagirushnan India-vin kudiyarasu thunaith thalaivaraagavum aagiyirukkavillai. Appodhu em.pi, aalunaraagak kooda si.pi.raadhaagirushnan illai. 2025m aandu sepdambaril thaan si.pi.raadhaagirushnan kudiyarasuth thunaith thalaivaraaga poruppetraar.
Idhan moolam 2019m aandu edukkappatta pazhaiya pugaippadathai ippodhu si.pi.raadhaagirushnan pilaastik naarkaaliyil utkaara vaikkappattu avamariyaadhai seyyappattaar endru thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhal epral 19l nadakkum endru arivikkappattadhaa?
text:
Tamil Nadu sattamandrathirkaana podhuth therdhal epral 19m thedhi nadaiverum endru therdhal aanaiyam arivithadhaaga oru padhivu

oodagam ondru veliyitta seythiyai sgireenshaat eduthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “thamizhnaattil ep.19l ore kattamaaga therdhal. Joon 4-m thedhi sevvaaykkizhamai andru vaakku ennikkai nadaivera ulladhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “*thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal thedhi arivippu* Tamil Naattil epral 19_l ore kattamaaga therdhal vaakkuppadhivu, vaakku ennikkai joon _4. ::- therdhal aanaiyam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu sattamandrathirku indha aandu therdhal nadaivera ulladhu. Idharkaana arivippu pipravari irudhi alladhu maars maadham mudhal vaarathil therdhal aanaiyam veliyidum endru edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Enenil Madurai eyms maruthuvamanaikku endru kattappattulla kattidangalai piradhamar Modi maars 1m thedhi thirandhu vaikka ulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Tamil Nadu arasin idaikkaala patjet thaakkal aagavillai. Pipravari 17m thedhi thaan thaakkal seyyappada ulladhu. Enave, ivai ellaam mudiyum varai therdhal thedhi arivikkappada vaayppillai.
Tharpodhudhaan therdhal nadathuvadhu thodarbaaga therdhal adhigaarigaludan therdhal aanaiyam aalosanai nadathi varugiradhu. Melum, therdhal thedhi arivikkappadugiradhu endraal munnadhaagave seythiyaalargal sandhippukku azhaippuvidukkappadum. Andha seythiyaalar sandhippildhaan therdhal thedhiyaith thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar arivippaar. Indru (pipravari 7, 2026) appadi endha oru sandhippukkum azhaippu vidukkappadavillai, avasara sandhippu edhuvum nadakkavum illai. Enave, indha sgireenshaat pazhaiya veediyovudaiyadhaaga irukkalaam endru aayvu seythom.
2024 naadaalumandrath therdhal eppodhu nadandhadhu endru thedhiyai ariya aayvu seythom. Tamil Naattil epral 19m thedhi nadandhiruppadhu therindhadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda sgireenshaattil joon 4 sevvaaykkizhamai endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. 2024m aandu joon 4 sevvaaykkizhamaiyaaga irundhadhu. Indha aandu viyaazhakkizhamaiyaaga ulladhu. Enave, idhu pazhaiya seythidhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga indha sgireenshaattai koogul lens thalathil padhivetri thedinom. Idhai san news veliyittiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhai news kaardaaga san news thannudaiya samooga oodaga pakkangalil 2024m aandu maars 16m thedhi veliyittirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Kaamaraajar kaaril ponadhe seemaanudandhaan endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Kaamaraajar kaaril ponadhe seemaanudandhaan endru NTK nirvaagi vennilaa thaayumaanavan kooriyadhaaga oru news card

vigadan veliyittadhu pondru news card ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “kaamaraajar kaaril ponadhe seemaanudandhaan. Sivagangaikku kaamaraajar kaaril poyk kondirundhavodhu, tavusarodu maadu meythuk kondirundha paiyanai paarthudhaan madhiya unavuth thittame aarambithaar. Andha paiyan veru yaarumalla, annan seemaandhaan. Kaamaraajar padathileye indha kaatchi vandhirukkiradhu. – NTK vennilaa thaayumaanavan (vigadan pettiyil)” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naam thamizhar katchi orunginaippaalar seemaanai naiyaandi seythu pala padhivugal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindranar. Appadippatta oru karuthai vigadan oodagame veliyittadhu pondru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Yaaro vishami seemaanai naiyaandi seyyum nokkathil indha padhivai uruvaakkiyirukkalaam endru therigiradhu. Idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai vigadan veliyittadhaa enbadhai urudhi seyya vigadan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil appadi endha oru news kaardum illai. Enave, vigadan digital poruppaalarin WhatsApp ennirku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Siridhu nerathil vigadan samooga oodaga pakkangalil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card meedhu “FAKE” muthiraiyudan, “idhu vigadan veliyitta seythi alla…” endru kurippittup padhivittirundhanar. Ivai ellaam indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
NTK nirvaagi ippadi edhenum kooriyirundhaaraa enbadhai urudhi seythugolla avaradhu samooga oodaga pakkathaip paarthom. Adhil, vigadan veliyitta padhivai reevost seythu, nandri vigadan endru kurippittirundhaar. Idhan moolam indha news card matrum thagaval irandume thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Pahalgaam thaakkudhal: kadarpadai adhigaariyin irudhik kaatchi endra thavaraana kootrudan paravum kaanoli | Pahalgam Attack: Posts Falsely claim Video As Final Footage Of Naval Officer
text:
Pahalgaam thaakkudhal: kadarpadai adhigaariyin irudhik kaatchi endra thavaraana kootrudan paravum kaanoli
viral kaanoliyil nadanamaadum thambadhiyinar, thaakkudhalukku ettu naatkalukku munbu pahalgaamil irundha samooga valaidhala piravalangalaana aashish sehraavathum avaradhu manaiviyum.
Jammu kaashmeerin pahalgaam payangaravaadha thaakkudhalil paridhaavamaaga kollappatta kadarpadai lepdinant vinay narvaalaiyum avaradhu manaiviyaiyum, andhap pagudhikkus sendra oru thambadhiyinarin thodarbillaadha matroru kaanoliyudan thodarbuvaduthi samooga oodagangalil oru kaanoli viral-aagi varugiradhu. Idhu samooga oodaga payanargalaal paravalaagap pagirappattadhu mattumallaamal, pala seythi niruvanangal thavaraana kootrudan seythi veliyittullana.
Vairalaana kaanoliyudan iruppadhu samooga oodaga piravalangalaashish sehraavath matrum avaradhu manaivi yaashigaa sarmaa enbadhai poom kandarindhulladhu.
Indha aandu epral 22aam thedhiyandru, kaashmeerin pahalgaamil ulla paisaran pallathaakku pagudhiyil sutrulaap payanigal matrum ulloorvaasigal meedhu payangaravaadhigal thuppaakkis soodu nadathinar. Idhil 26 per kollappattanar matrum palar kaayamadaindhanar. Paadhikkappattavargalin kudumbangal, thaakkudhal nadathiyavargal indhu aan sutrulaap payanigalai kurivaithu kolaigalais seythadhaagavum, kolaigalais seyvadharku munbu peyargal matrum adaiyaalangalaik kettadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu.
Indha thaakkudhalil uyirizhandhavargalil oruvar hariyaanaavin karnaalais serndha kadarpadai lepdinant vinay narvaal. Avar thanadhu manaivi himaanshiyudan pahalgaamirkus sendru kondirundhaar. Indha thambadhiyinar indha aandu epral 16aam thedhiyandru thirumanam seythu kondanar. Thuyaramaana thaakkudhalukkup piragu, payangaravaadhigal thanadhu kanavarai eppadi suttuk kondraargal enbadhai himaanshi vivarikkum kaanoli vairalaanadhu. Iruppinum, pallathaakkil oru thambadhiyinar nadanamaaduvadhaik kaattum video-vin sgireen shaatkal samooga oodagangalil velivandhana. Avai vinay matrum himaanshiyin endra poyyaana kootrudan pagirappattana. 
X thalathil payanar oruvar, “idhu sinimaa alla nijam..netru pahalgaamil theeviravaadhigalaal kollappatta vinay narvaalum avarudaiya manaivihimaanshiyum thenilavai kondaadiya veediyo..idhu thaan avargalin kadaisi veediyo.” endru pagirndhullaar.
Vairalaana kaanoliyin nambagathanmaiyai sarivaarkka mudiyavillai endru taims nav, pree piras jarnal matrum mint aagiyavai kooriyirundhaalum, nadanamaadum thambadhiyinaraik kaattum kaanoliyin sgireen shaatkalai veliyittu, adhai narvaal matrum avaradhu manaiviyudan thavaraana kootrudan veliyittanar.

headline: DMK 200 thogudhigalukku mel vetri perum endru IBC Tamil karuthuk kanippu veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘‘DMK 200 thogudhigalukku mel vetri perum’’, endru IBC Tamil karuthuk kanippu veliyittadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ IBC thamizh – thuklak idhayaa inaindhu nadathiya megaa karuthu kanippu mudivugal. 200kku mel vetri petru thamizhnaattai meendum thattithookkum DMK,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhuvondru endha karuthuk kanippum veliyidavillai, endru IBC Tamil tharappil maruppu koorappattulladhaik kandom.
Idhanmoolamaaga, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Karoor kootta nerisalil irandhavargalaip paarthu Vijay rasippadhu pondru kaarttoon veliyittadhaa vigadan?
text:
Karoor kootta nerisalil irandhavargalin udalgalaik kandu TVK thalaivarum nadigarumaana Vijay rasippadhu pondru kaarttoon ondrai vigadan veliyittadhaaga palarum

irandhavargalin udalgalai vaithu kelvikkuri uruvaakki, kelvikkurikku mel pirasaara vaaganathil amarndhu Vijay rasippadhu pondru oviyam ondru uruvaakki Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “unmaileye vigadana paaraattiyaaganum.. Vaazhthugal vigadan.. Cartoonist aaseep kaanukku vaazhthugal…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha oviyathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karoor TVK pirasaara koottathil erpatta kootta nerisalil sikki 41 per uyirizhandhanar. Indha vivagaaram thodarbaaga nadigarum TVK thalaivarumaana vijayyai vimarsithu, kootta nerisal uyirizhappai rasithadhu pondru karuthup padathai veliyittadhaagap palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Padathaip paarkka edit seythadhu pol irundhadhaal idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom
mudhalil vigadan veliyitta karuthu padam oviyathai adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalilirundhu eduthom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru illai. Kelvikkuri pola irandhavargalin udalgal adukkappattirukka, Vijay azhuvadhu pondru irundhadhu. Adharku idhudhaan jananaayaganaa endru kelvi ezhuppuvadhu pondru padhivittirundhanar. Indha oviyathai edit seythu Vijay rasippadhu pondru maatriyiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Idhai urudhiseythugolla vigadan digital pirivu poruppaalarukku naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathai WhatsApp moolam anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil uyirizhandhavargalaip paarthu Vijay rasippadhu pondru paravum kaarttoon poliyaanadhu, edit seyyappattadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ’smaartfongal vilai 2 aandugalukkuk kuraiyaadhu..’ idhudhaan kaaranam..?
text:
’smaartfongal vilai 2 aandugalukkuk kuraiyaadhu..’ idhudhaan kaaranam..?
Aidisi aayvu padi, eai tettaa sendargalukkaana memari sippugal thevai veguvaaga adhigarithadhaal smaartfongalukku thevaiyaana sippugal kadumaiyaaga thattuppattullana. Idhan vilaivaaga smaartfongalin vilai innum kuraindhadhu irandu aandugal uyarndha nilaiyileye needikkum ena kanikkappadugiradhu. 2028kkup pirage vilai mella kuraiyum endrum koorappadugiradhu.
Smaartfongal vilai innum 2 aandugalukku adhigamaagave needikka vaayppulladhaaga aidisi (IDC) niruvanathin aayvu therivikkiradhu. Memari sippugal thattuppaattais suttikkaatti ivvaaru koorappattulladhu.
Memari sippugal thattuppaadu 2028ildhaan sariyaagum endrum appodhilirundhu smaartfongal vilai mella kuraiyum endrum therivikkappattulladhu. Smaartfongal vilai uyarvu kaaranamaaga avatrin virpanai indhaandu 16.7% kuraiyum endrum anniruvanathin kanippu koorugiradhu.
Eai tettaa sendargalukkaana memari sippugal thevai panmadangu adhigarithadhaal smaartfongalukkaana sippugal thattuppaadu erpattu avatrin vilai veguvaaga adhigarithulladhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Maanila hentbaal potti: varum 28l veerargal thervu
text:
Maanila hentbaal potti: varum 28l veerargal thervu
pe.naa.paalaiyam: Tamil Nadu hentbaal anikkaana veerargal thervu, Kovai maavattam, narasimmanaayakkanbaalaiyam arasu uyarnilaippalli valaagathil varum 28m thedhi nadakkiradhu.
Nadappu kalvi aandukkaana Indhiya palligalin vilaiyaattu kuzhumam nadathum, maanila alavilaana, 19 vayadhukku utbatta, Tamil Nadu hent paal anikkaana veerargal thervu, narasimmanaayakkanbaalaiyam arasu uyarnilaippalli valaagathil varum 28m thedhi kaalai 7.00 manikku nadakkiradhu. Andhandha maavatta udarkalvi aayvaalargal, thangal maavattathil mandala alavil thervu petra maanavargalai, indha thervu pottigalil kalandhu kolla erpaadu seyya vendum.
Thervu pottiyil pangerka varum maanavargal, Indhiya palligalin vilaiyaattu kuzhumam saarbil alikkappatta thagudhi vinnappam, unmai saandridhazhgal, madhippen pattiyal, pirappu saandridhazh nagal, 10m vaguppu madhippen pattiyal nagal, aadhaar card nagal, petror anumadhi nagal, maanavargalin vangi kanakku paas puthagathin nagal aagiyavatrai kattaayam kondu vara vendum. Vivarangalukku, narasimmanaayakkanbaalaiyam arasu uyarnilaippalli udarkalvi aasiriyar thanakkumaar, 76678 51457 endra ennil thodarbu kollalaam ena arivikkappattulladhu.

headline: Hariyaanaavil kaaril irundhu veesappatta pen endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Hariyaanaavil paaliyal vangodumai seyyappattu pen oruvar kaaril irundhu veesappattaar endru kurippittu video ondru

saalaiyil vegamaaga sendru kondirundha kaaril irundhu pen oruvar saalaiyil vizhum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vin mel, “kurgaan – faridhaavaath saalaiyil 25 vayadhaana pen oruvar paaliyal vangodumai seyyappattu odum kaaril irundhu saalaiyil veesappattaar” endru aangilathil ezhudhappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “paajaga aatchiyil hariyaanaavil pengal paaliyal palaathgaaram seyyappattu kaaril irundhu thookki eriyappattanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
investigation_details:
Hariyaanaavil pen oruvar paaliyal vangodumai seyyappattu odum kaaril irundhu veesappattaar endru video ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum pagirndhum varugindranar. Kadandha 2025 tisambar irudhiyil hariyaanaa maanilam paridhaavaathais serndha pen oruvar paaliyal vangodumai seyyappattadhaaga seythi veliyaagi adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirundhadhu. Sameevathil appadi endha oru seythiyum namakku kidaikkavillai.
Indha video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video-vai 2026 maars irudhiyil silar padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Sbaanish mozhiyilirundha padhivai mozhimaatram seythu paarthavodhu, indha sambavam piresil naattil nadandhadhu endru adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Melum adhil, “maars 28 sanikkizhamai andru iravu magaavaavin vadakke ulla roovaa maado krosovil (Rua Mato Grosso, near Pacoval, north of Macap) odikkondirundha kaaril irundhu ilam pen saalaiyil veesappattaar. Indha vaaganathilirundhavargal patri Police visaaranai nadathi varugindranar. Andha car patriya thagaval therindhaal kaavaldhuraiyai thodarbugollumbadi” kurippittirundhanar. Andha padhivu mattumindri melum eraalamaana padhivugalum namakku kidaithana.
Idhu thodarbaaga thodarndhu thediyavodhu idhu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigal namakku kidaithana. Adhil, “vaaganathil thanadhu kaadhaludan andha pen vaakkuvaadhathil eeduvattullaar. Appodhu kaadhalanai mirattuvadharkaaga kadhavai thirandhu veliye kudhithullaar. Idhai andha pen vaakkumoolamaagavum alithullaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Adhu mattumindri indha sambavam thodarbaaga andha oor seythi oodagathin niruvar Police adhigaariyidam edutha pettiyum namakku kidaithadhu. Ivai ellaam indha sambavam hariyaanaa maanilathil nadandhadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seythana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Iran-il kalamaada kaathirukkum 80 aayiram veerargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran-il America, Israel ullitta naadugalai edhirgollath thayaar nilaiyil kalathil 80 aayiram veerargal endru oru video

arangam ondril aayirak kanakkaana veerargal anivaguthu varum video Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Adhil aangilathil, Iran-in raanuva palam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “eeraanin 80000 veerargal kalathil echarikkaiyudan ullaargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran meedhu America thaakkudhal nadathum endra acham nilavugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil America ullitta naadugalai edhirgolla Iran-il 80 aayiram veerargal kalathil ullaargal endru oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Por padhatram ulla soozhalil porp payitsiyil eeduvadaamal ippadi anivaguppu kangaatchi nadathuvaargalaa endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha aandu thodakkathil saudhi areviyaavil nadandha raanuva anivaguppu endru kurippittu indha video-vai oodagam ondru veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil “saudhi areviya raanuvathin pirammaanda anivaguppu.(saudhi pattathu ilavarasar) mugamadhu pin salmaanidamirundhu anaivarukkumaana aachariyamaana seythi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu idhe pondru eraalamaana video-kkal kidaithana. Adhe idathil nadandha raanuva anivaguppu video-kkal adhu. Andha arangin thotram ellaa veediyokkalilum ondraaga irundhadhu. Anaithilum saudhi areviyaavin raanuva anivaguppu endre kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu nammudaiya fekt kirasando malaiyaalathilum indha video thodarbaaga aayvuk katturai veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, saudhi areviyaavukkup punidha payanam merkolbavargalaik kattuppaduthum paadhugaappup padaiyinarin anivaguppu adhu endru kurippittirundhanar. Andha katturaiyaik kaana inge kilik seyyungal.
Adhe nerathil Iran-il matra naadugalin thaakkudhalai edhirgollum vagaiyil raanuva anivaguppu nadandhadhaaga endha oru seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

Yosithu paarunga. Oru jatjookku ivvalavu vedhanai irundhaa, iyesuva arindha theyvap pillaigal namakku evvalavu vedhanai irukkum,’’
ivvaaru mogan si laasaras pesugiraar.

headline: “paajaga-vin kalavara soozhchiyai kandikkaadha thalaivargal” endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Thirupparangundrathil BJP matrum indhu munnaniyin seyalbaattaik kandikkaadha thalaivargal endru pudhiya thalaimurai news card ondru

Vijay, anbumani, tidivi thinagaran, Edappadi Palaniswami, o.panneerselvam aagiyor pugaippadangaludan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “vaay thirakkaadhavargal! Thirupparangundrathil BJP matrum indhu munnani amaippin kalavara soozhchiyai kandikkaadha arasiyal thalaivargal!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thirupparangundrathil vazhakkamaaga kaarthigai theevam etrum idathirkup padhil, malai uchiyil ulla thargaavukku aruge theevam etra vendum endru indhuthuvaa amaippugal saarbil vazhakku thodarappattadhu. Indha vazhakkai visaaritha Chennai uyarneedhimandra Madurai kilai, korikkai vidukkappatta idathil theevam etra utharavittadhu. Aanaal, idhai edhirthu Tamil Nadu arasu melmuraiyeedu seythulladhu. Idhai kaaranam kaatti vazhakkamaaga theevam etrum idathileye kaarthigai theevam etrappattadhu. Idhanaal BJP, indhu munnani ullitta indhuthuvaa amaippugalukkum poleesaarukkum idaiye thallumullu erpattadhu.
Indha nilaiyil indha sambavam thodarbaaga karuthukkalai veliyidaadha thalaivargal endru Edappadi Palaniswami, o.panneerselvam, anbumani raamadhaas, nadigar Vijay ullitta thalaivargalai kutramsaatti pudhiya thalaimuraiyil seythi veliyittadhu pondru padhivu Facebook-il padhividappattirundhadhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Pudhiya thalaimuraiyil veliyaana padhivugalaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru aanaal thalaivargal padam illaamal padhivu ondru veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, “visaaranai thodakkam. Thirupparangundram vivagaaram thodarbaaga Tamil Nadu arasin melmuraiyeettu manu meedhu uyarneedhimandra kilaiyil visaaranai” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthup pagirndhiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Sila samooga oodaga padhivugalil indha news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittuvittu, pinnar agatrivittadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Enave, pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppi, idhai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittuvittu pinnar neekkiyadhaa endru kettom. Adharku avar, idhai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidave illai. Idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Melum, sila nimidangalil indha news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai. Idhu poliyaana news card endru Facebook-il padhivai veliyittuvittu, adhu thodarbaana thagavalaiyum nammidam therivithaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai news 7 thamizh veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathai paarvaiyittom. Idhe pondru news card-ai veliyittiruppadhu therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla, aayvukku eduthukkonda news 7 thamizh digital poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Avargal tharappil idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythanar. Idharkullaaga avargaludaiya samooga oodaga pakkangalil indha news card poliyaanadhu endru muthiraiyudan padhivu ondraiyum veliyittanar. Adhanai udanadiyaagath thangaladhu thalaivarodu poruthip paarthu, karuthu sonnavaraiye thaakka murpaduvadhu en? Thanakkup piditha karuthai mattume matravargal pesavendum ena ninaippadhu jananaayagam alla. Thanakku edhiraana karuthaiyum pesa anumadhithu, adharku karuthaal padhil solvadhudhaan jananaayagam!” endru Seeman padhivittadhaaga vigadan veliyitta asal niyoosgaardu kidaithadhu.
Indha asal niyoosgaardai viral-aagum niyoosgaardudan oppittu paarthadhil, asal niyoosgaardil idambetrirundha thagaval matrum vaasagangal maatrappattu, Seeman Vijay sedhuvadhiyai mirattiyadhaaga poliyaana thagaval serkkappattiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Idhanaithodarndhu vigadan oodagathin aasiriyar ai.pirittovai thodarbugondu visaarithavodhu, viral-aagum niyoosgaardu edit seyyappatta poliyaana card enbadhai avarum urudhippaduthinaar.
Naadhagavin adhigaarappoorva aidi vingum idhu poyyaana thagaval endru padhivittulladhu.
Pinnani enna?
Pikbaas nigazhchiyil pottiyaalargalidaiye nadaivetra vilaiyaattus soozhalai munvaithu, thalaimaithuvam, poruppunarvu matrum adhigaaram kurithu Vijay sedhuvadhi pesiyirundhaar. Avaradhu karuthu mudhalamaichar Vijay-kku edhiraanadhu enak koori TVK aadharavaalargal samooga valaithalangalil edhirvinaiyaatrinar.
Idhaiyaduthu, Vijay sedhuvadhiyin karuthukku aadharavaaga Seeman arikkai veliyittaar. Adhil, Vijay sedhuvadhi endha arasiyal katchiyaiyum kurippittu pesavillai endrum, avarai thanippatta muraiyil thaakkuvadhai nirutha vendum endrum therivithirundhaar.
Indhas sambavam thodarbaaga vigadan veliyitta asal niyoosgaarde edit seyyappattu, Seeman Vijay sedhuvadhiyai mirattiyadhaagak koorum vagaiyil samooga valaithalangalil parappappattulladhu.
Also Read: ”jaalikkudhaan seythaar veeramani; vendumendre seyyavillai” endru pesinaaraa DMK aar.es.paaradhi?
Conclusion
Vijay sedhuvadhiyai Seeman mirattiyadhaaga paravum thagaval mutrilum thavaraanadhaagum. Vigadan veliyitta asal niyoosgaardai edit seythu, uruvaakkappatta poliyaana niyoosgaardai vaithu indha thagaval parappappadugindradhu.
Indha unmaiyaanadhu kidaitha aadhaarangalin vaayilaaga thelivaagiyulladhu. Aagave vaasagargal yaarum ithagavalai namba vendaam endru niyoossekkar thamizh saarbil kettuk kolgindrom.

headline: Peegaaril paajaga-vukku aadharavaagap pirasaaram seytha islaamiyargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaaril 10 jamaathais saarndhavargal paajaga-vukku aadharavaagap pirasaaram seythaargal endru oru video

islaamiyargal BJP kodiyudan peraniyaagas sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peegaaril 10 jamaathais serndha 1000 islaamiyar mattum kalandhu kondu #pijevikkaaga seytha pirachaaram thaan idhu. Pijeviullavandhudumnunu Tamil Naattil mattumdhaan #thiraavida katchigalum #periyaaristtugalum pijevikku edhiraana #sithaandhathai uruvaakki #islaamiya sagodharargalai #moolai salavai seythu #pijevikku edhiraana sindhanaiyai uruvaakkugiradhu.. #kaathirungaldhamizhagathil #thiraavidathai karuvaruppom” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhal pirasaarathil paajaga-vukku aadharavaaga islaamiyargal pirasaaram seythaargal endru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Annaa peyaril ulla thiraavida katchiyudan koottani vaithukkonde thiraavidathaik karuvaruppom endru veruppu pirasaarathai parappiyullanar. Indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video 2024m aandu therdhal naadaalumandrath therdhal nerathil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, thirivuraavil BJP saarbil pottiyidum piplaap kumaarukku aadharavaaga islaamiyargalum pirasaaram merkondanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thediya podhu thirivuraa merku naadaalumandrath thogudhiyil munnaal mudhalamaichar piplaap kumaar thev BJP saarbil pottiyittaar. Avarukku aadharavaaga islaamiyargal pirasaaram seythaargal endru indha veediyovudan pala padhivugal veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil indha video 2024m aandilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Thirivuraa maanilathil piplaap kumaarukku aadharavaaga indha pirasaaram merkollappattiruppadhu theriyavandhulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil peegaaril 10 jamaathais saarndha islaamiyargal ondru koodi paajaga-vukku aadharavaagap pirasaaram seythaargal endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 6 latcham per.. Kaiyil AK-47.. Veedhiyil irangiya pengal! Iran-il thideer paravarappu!
text:
Iran thalainagar thehraanil 3 latchathukkum merpattor pangetra peraniyil, amerikkaa–isrelukku edhiraaga muzhakkangal ezhuppappattana. Trump meedhu edhirppu koshangal ezhundhana. Haarmus neerinaip pagudhiyil payanbaduthappatta trongal utbada pala raanuva uvagaranangal kaatchippaduthappattana. Podhumakkalai raanuvap payitsiyil inaithu, paadhugaapputh thayaarnilaiyai uyarthum muyatsiyaaga indha perani paarkkappadugiradhu. Sumaar 3 latcham per idhil kalandhugondanar.
Seythiyaalar - meeraa
amerikkaa–isrel udanaana pors soozhal needithu varum nilaiyil, Iran thalainagar thehraanil aayudham endhiya pengal ullitta nootrukkanakkaanor pangetra pirammaanda perani nadaivetrulladhu. ‘Janfada-ye Iran’ ‘eeraanukkaaga thiyaagam seybavargal endra peyaril nadaivetra indha arasaanga aadharavu perani, por thodangiya pinnar nadaivetra migapperiya peranigalil ondraaga paarkkappadugiradhu.
Vellikkizhamai nadaivetra indha peraniyil raanuva udai anindhavargal Iran kodigalai endhiyavadi Iran nagarin mukkiya saalaigalil anivaguthus sendranar. Avargaludan aayudham endhiya pengalum idambetrirundhanar. Kurippaaga, Iran-in IRGC amaippudan thodarbudaiya pengal thuppaakkigaludan kaanappatta kaatchigal kavanam petrana. Silar tirakkugalil poruthappattirundha iyandhirath thuppaakkigalukku arugilum paadhugaappup paniyil iruppadhu pondra kaatchigal veliyaagiyullana.
Indha peraniyin mukkiya nokkangalil ondru, podhumakkalai raanuvap payitsiyil inaippadhaagum. Iran arasu oodagangalinbadi, idhuvarai 6 latchathukkum merpattor indha thannaarva raanuvap payitsiyil pangerka padhivu seythullanar. Edhirgaalathil indha ennikkai 10 latchathukkum mel adhigamaagalaam endrum Iran-in IRGC thalavadhi jenaral hasan hasansaadhe therivithullaar.
Indha thannaarvalargalukku adippadai raanuva matrum avasaranilaip payitsigal vazhangappada ulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Erkenave Iran-in paadhugaappu amaippugalil mukkiya pangu vagikkum IRGC matrum adhan thannaarva thunai amaippaana Basij padaigalukku koodudhal aadharavaaga indha pudhiya thannaarvap padai seyalbadum ena adhigaarigal therivithullanar.
Iran-il mattum 3 latchathukkum merpattor peraniyil kalandhu kondadhaaga Iran arasu oodagam therivithulladhu. Sila adhigaarappoorva madhippeedugalil 3.13 latcham per pangetradhaaga koorappattulladhu.
Peraniyil America matrum isrelukku edhiraana muzhakkangalum ezhuppappattana. Silar iru naadugalin kodigalai midhithanar. America adhivar tonaalt tirambukku edhiraagavum muzhakkangal ezhuppappattana.
Engal thaaynaattukku edhiraana achuruthalgalukku eeraaniyargal payappadavillai endra seythiyai tirambukku therivikkave indha peraniyil pangetradhaaga palar therivithullanar.
Perani Iran-in raanuvath thiranai velippaduthum nigazhvaagavum amaindhadhu. Vaanvazhith thaakkudhal thaduppu amaippugal, iyandhirath thuppaakkigal matrum trongal ullitta raanuva uvagaranangal kaatchippaduthappattana. Kurippaaga haarmus neerinaip pagudhiyil payanbaduthappattadhaaga koorappadum trongalum idambetrana.
Idhan moolam, pors soozhalil Iran thanadhu aadharavaalargalai ondrudhirattuvadhudan, podhumakkal mattathilum paadhugaappu matrum raanuvath thayaarnilaiyai virivuvadutha muyatsippadhaaga adhigaarigal velippaduthiyullanar.

headline: Alariya karppiniyin kural.. 2 manineram maattikkonda aambulans! Karuvileye irandha kuzhandhai!
text:
Aakraa aruge kathvaar kiraamathil, 108 aambulans iravu 1 manikku karppini nidhi singai etri sendravodhu, mosamaana kiraamas saalaiyil ulla periya pallathil sikki 2 mani neram nindradhu. Tiraakdar udhaviyudan meetta pin adhigaalai 3.30kku maruthuvamanai sendravodhu, kuzhandhai karuvileye irandhadhu urudhi seyyappattadhu. 6 maadhathirku mun seeramaikkappatta saalai mazhaiyil sedhamadaindhadhaaga kiraama makkal kutram saattugindranar.
Oru kuzhandhaiyin uyir sariseyyappadaadha saalai pallathaalum, palamurai pugaar koduthum nadavadikkai edukkappadaadha arasu oozhiyargalin alatchiyathaalum karuvileye parivoyiruppadhu sogathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Saalai pallathil 2 manineram sikkikkonda aambulansil thudidhuditha thaay, thannudaiya kuzhandhaiyin azhuguralai kadaisivarai ketkaamal karuvileye maranithu maunamaayp pona ranathai mattume anuvavitha sambavam utharap piradhesathil arangeriyulladhu.
Utharap piradhesathin aakraa aruge ulla kathvaar kiraamathil, nidhi sing endra 25 vayadhu karppini pennukku pirasava vali erpattulladhu. Iravu 1 maniyalavil karppini valiyil thudithadhaal kudumbathaar 108 aambulansai azhaithullanar. Appodhu udanadiyaaga sariyaana nerathirku karppiniyin veettirku vandha aambulans, karppiniyai maruthuvamanaikku azhaithuchendrulladhu. Appodhu nalliravu 1 maniyalavil maruthuvamanaikkus sellum vazhiyil, mazhaiyinaal mosamadaindhirundha kiraamappura inaippuk saalaiyil irundha oru periya pallathil aambulans sikkik kondulladhu. Serum sagadhiyumaaga irundha andhappallathilirundhu vandiyai meetka evvalavu poraadiyum aambulans ottunaraal vandiyai veliyetra mudiyavillai. Adhanbin arugilirundha kiraamathinar vivarathai arindhu oru tiraakdarai konduvandhu aambulansai kayiru moolam katti veliyetra muyandrullanar. Idhais seyalbaduthi mudithu aambulansai pallathilirundhu meetkave sumaar 2 manineram kaalaviraiyam aagiyulladhu.
2 maninera thaamathirku piragu adhigaalai 3:30 maniyalavil andha karppinip pen arugil ulla aaramba sugaadhaara nilaiyathirku kondu sellappattaar. Aanaal, neenda nerath thaamadhathin kaaranamaaga kuzhandhai thaayin karuvileye uyirizhandhu vittadhaaga maruthuvargal therivithanar. Indha sambavam appagudhi makkalukku migundha sogathai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Indha visayam kurithu vedhanaiyudan therivikkum kiraama makkal, indha sedhamadaindha saalai 6 maadhangalukku munbudhaan podhuppanith thuraiyaal (PWD) seeramaikkappattadhu endrum, aanaal oru maadhathirku munbe peytha kanamazhaiyaal mosamadaindhuvittadhaagavum therivithullanar. Idhugurithu adhigaarigalidam palamurai pugaar alithum endha nadavadikkaiyum edukkappadavillai enavum avargal kutram saattiyullanar.
Karuvileye kuzhandhai uyirizhandhuvitta nilaiyil, theevira sigichaikkup pin thaay kaappaatrappattadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Sepdambar 2aam thedhi nadandha indha mosamaana sambavathirku piragu appennin kanavar, saalaiyaip paraamarikkum poruppil ullavargal meedhu nadavadikkai edukkak kori adhigaarigalidam pugaar kadidham koduthullaar. Ivvivagaaram kurithu visaaranai nadaivetru varuvadhaaga adhigaarigal therivithullanar..

headline: Thooymaip paniyaalargalai appurappadutha Needhimandram utharavittadhaal thavega-vinar therithu odinaargalaa?
text:
Chennai maanagaraatchi munbu poraattathil eeduvattuvarum thooymaip paniyaalargalai appurappaduthumbadi Needhimandram utharavittadhaith thodarndhu angirundha tha.ve.ka-vinar thappi odinar endru oru video

tha.ve.ka-vinar thappi odum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “kaavalargalai paarthadhum therithu odiya Vijay rasigargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “sennai maanagaraatchi munbu poraattathil eeduvattu varum thooymai paniyaalargalai appurappadutha utharavu kaavaldhuraikku Needhimandram utharavu – seythi needhimandrathin theerppaik kettadhai aduthu poratta kalathil irundha thavegavinar ottam..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thaniyaarmayamaakkalai edhirthum, pani nirandharam koriyum thooymaip paniyaalargal 13 naatkalaaga Chennai maanagaraatchi rippan maaligaikku veliye poraattathil eeduvattirukkindranar. Avargalai kalaindhu sellumbadi uyar Needhimandram utharavittirukkiradhu. Indha nilaiyil needhimandra utharavu patriya thagaval therindhadhum Thamizhaga vetrik kazhaga thondargal thappi odiyadhaaga video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Sila maadhangalukku munbu vakp satta masodhaa niraivetrappattavodhu adhaik kandithu thavega-vinar poraattam nadathinar. Appodhu Police kaidhu seyyappogiraargal endru thagaval kidaikkave, thondargal thappi odiyadhaaga seythi matrum video veliyaagi irundhadhu. Andha video-vai ippodhu veliyittiruppadhu pondru therindhadhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video-vai 2025 epral maadham mudhal vaarathil palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu idhu thodarbaaga thediya podhu idhe video-vai sila oodagangalum epral mudhal vaarathil veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Epral 4, 2025 andru nakkeeran veliyittirundha seythiyil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra kaatchigal irundhadhu.
Andha seythiyil, ” vakp vaariya sattath thirutha masodhaavai edhirthu TVK saarbil maanilam muzhukka aarppaattam nadathappattadhu. Chennai amaindhagarai pagudhiyil anumadhiyindri TVK katchiyinar poraattam nadathiyadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Angu sendra Police kaidhu seyya muyandra nilaiyil thavega-vinar kurugiya theruvil therithu odiyadhaal paravarappu erpattadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video pazhaiyadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
2025 epralil vakp sattath thiruthathirku edhiraaga thavega-vinar nadathiya poraattathin podhu thondargal thappi odiya kaatchiyai eduthu Chennai maanagaraatchi thuppuravup paniyaalargal poraattathin podhu thappi odiya TVK thondargal endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil veliyittiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ariyaamaiyum payamumdhaan pala noygalukku kaaranam
text:
Kovai: jem putrunoy sigichai maiyathil, 'ros' thina nigazhchi nadandhadhu. Aandudhorum, sep., 22m thedhi putrunoyaal paadhikkappatta noyaaligalukkaaga indha thinam kondaadappadugiradhu.
Vizhaavil jem maruthuvamanai thalaivar doctor pazhanivelu pesugaiyil, ''noy kurithu makkalukku ulla ariyaamai, payam thaan pala noygalukku kaaranamaaga ulladhu. Mudhalil enakku endha noyum illai enbadhai therindhu kolla vendum. Noy iruppadhai therindhu kondaal annoy illaamal seythu vidalaam.
Indraikku thozhilnutbam valarndhulladhaal endha noyaiyum kunamaakki vidalaam. Putrunoy kuritha payam thevaiyillai. Pala naveena sigichaigal ullana. Vasadhi illaadhavargalukku jem pavundeshan udhavi kidaikkum. Nambikkaiyodu noyai edhirgolla vendum,'' endraar.
Nigazhchiyai, jeyaa pazhanivelu, piravaa piraveenraaj aagiyor kuthuvilakku etri thuvakki vaithanar. Jem maruthuvamanai thalaimai nirvaaga adhigaari doctor piraveenraaj, putrunoy sigichai maiya iyakkunar doctor parath rangaraajan, maavatta mudhanmai kalvi adhigaari kirushna piriyaa, singaanalloor em.el.e., sreegiri pirasaath ullittor pangetranar.

headline: Karaathe pottiyil mudhalidam palladam maanavarukku paaraattu
text:

headline: ’tramppe engalai kaappi adikkiraar..’ karnaadaga mudhalvar ti.ke.sivakkumaar perumidham!
text:
America adhivar tonaaldu Trump therdhal vaakkurudhiyaaga arivitha 5,000 taalar thittam, karnaadagathil Congress arasu seyalbaduthi varum nalathittangalin nagalaagum endru ammaanila mudhalvar ti.ke.sivakkumaar therivithullaar.
America-vil varum navambar maadham therdhal nadakkiradhu. Idhil aalum kudiyarasu katchi vetri petraal, ovvoru amerikkarukkum, 5,000 taalargal, adhaavadhu Indhiya madhippil 4.79 latcham roobai vazhangappadum ena therdhal maanaattil adhivar Trump arivithullaar.
Indhasoozhalil idhai merkol kaatti pesiyirukkum karnaadaga maanila mudhalvar tige sivakkumaar, karnaadagaavin pengalukkaana ilavasa matrum maadha udhavithogai thittangalai kurippittu nam thittangalai amerikkaave kaappiyadithulladhaaga pesiyullaar.
Idhugurithu pengalooruvil pesiyirukkum avar, “magaaraashdiraa engalaip paarthu kaappi adithadhu. Mathiyap piradhesam engalaip paarthu kaappi adithadhu. Raajasdhaan engalaip paarthu kaappi adithadhu. Peegaar engalaip paarthu kaappi adithadhu. Ippodhu Trump engalaip paarthu kaappi adikkiraar. Paartheergalaa? 5,000 taalargal. Evvalavu? 5,000 taalargal. Ippodhu, yaar indha kaappiyai veliyidugiraargal? Vaakkalithaal ivvalavu taalargal koduppen endru Trump koorugiraar. Idhan artham, namadhu sindhanai indhiyaavirku mattumalla, ulagam muzhuvadharkum arimugappaduthappadugiradhu. Idhudhaan Congress katchiyin palam" endru sivagumaar koorinaar.

adhesamayam, vakp thirutha masodhaa meedhaana vivaadham sameevathil nadaivetra ondraagum. Idhanbodhu, ovaisi aakroshamaaga vivaadhathil pangetradhai naam thelivaagak kaanalaam. Melum, ivviru vivaadhangalilum ovaisi anindhulla aadai vevveraaga ulladhum kurippidathakkadhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram keezhe inaikkappattulladhu.

headline: Thiruchiyil 5 kovilgalil pon paadhugaappu ilavasam
text:
Sreerangam: Thamizhagathil, sep., 1 mudhal, mudhanmai kovilgalukkul movailbonukku thadai vidhikkappattadhaal, 52 kovilgalil, pakdhargalin movailbongalai paadhugaakka arai vasadhi erpaduthappattadhu. Adharkaaga, 5 roobai vasoolikkappattadhu.
Aanaal, thiruchiyil, sreerangam renganaadhar, samayavuram maariyamman, malaikkottai thaayumaanava suvaami, thiruvaanaikkaaval jambugesvarar, uraiyoor vekkaaliyamman aagiya kovilgalil, tokkan kodukkum idathil, sillarai thattuppaadaal avvappodhu vaakkuvaadham erpattadhu.
Aranilaiyathuraikku thodar pugaargal vandhadhaal, thiruchiyil ulla aindhu piradhaana kovilgalilum, movailbon paadhugaakka kattanam vasoolikkum murai rathu seyyappattulladhu. Pakdhargal, paadhugaappu arai laakkaril pongalai vaithu, tokkan mattum petruchella arivuruthappattullanar.

headline: Adhirupdhiyil amaichar aananth ? ADMK pulliyaal vandha sikkal!
text:
Mudhalvar Vijay-ai ADMK-vil irundhavodhu kadumaiyaaga vimarsitha singai raamasandhiranukku, thavegavil serndhavudan mukkiya arasup padhavi vazhangappattiruppadhu, neenda kaalamaaga katchikkaaga uzhaitha nirvaagigalukku adhirupdhiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Agamadhaavaath aiaidiyil pattam petra singai raamasandhiranai kadandha 2016-m aandu maraindha mudhalvar jeyalalidhaa, ADMK-vin ai.ti pirivin maanilas seyalaalaraaga niyamithaar. Adhanaith thodarndhu ADMK-vin mukkiya nirvaagigalil oruvaraaga maariya singai raamasandhiran kadandha 2024 naadaalumandrath therdhalil Coimbatore makkalavaith thogudhiyil ADMK vetbaalaraaga pottiyittu tholviyaith thazhuvinaar.
Idhanidaiye nadandhu mudindha sattamandrath therdhalil ADMK tholviyadaindhu moondraam idathukku thallappattadhu. Indha soozhalil kadandha joolai maadham ADMK-vil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga singai raamasandhiran arivithaar. Adhanaith thodarndhu mudhalvar Vijay-in Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathil thannai inaithukkondaar.
Katchiyil inaindha sila naatkalileye avarai Tamil Nadu staartap matrum puthaakka iyakka thalaivaraaga niyamithu Tamil Nadu arasu utharavittadhu. Katchiyil serndha sila naatkalileye mukkiyathuvam vaayndha arasup padhavi singai raamasandhiranukku vazhangappattadhu thavegavil salasalappai erpaduthiyadhaaga koorappattadhu.
ADMK-vil singai raamasandhiran irundhavodhu mudhalamaichar Vijay-ai kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu pesiyadhu samooga valaidhalangalil adhigamaaga kavanam petradhu. Appadippattavarukku thavegavil serndhadhum arasu padhavi vazhangappattulladharku TVK podhucheyalaalar aananth adhirupdhi adaindhulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Katchiyin podhucheyalaalarin viruppamindri indha niyamanam merkollappattiruppadhaaga sollappadugiradhu. Neenda kaalamaaga katchikku uzhaitha pala perukku idhuvarai padhavigal kidaikkaamal irukkiradhu. Innilaiyil, avargalukku padhavi alikkaamal, mudhalamaichar Vijay-ai kadumaiyaaga thaakkip pesiya, thavegavirkaaga uzhaikkaadha maatruk katchiyais serndha oruvarukku... Adhuvum serndhavudaneye periya arasup padhavi alithiruppadhaal katchiyinar kadum adhirupdhi adaindhiruppadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Padhaviyai edhirbaarthu kaathirukkum katchi nirvaagigalum idhugurithu podhucheyalaalar aanandhidam thodarndhu muraiyittu varuvadhaagavum sollappadugiradhu.
Pira katchigalai pola illaamal, thavegavil Vijay narpani mandrathil irundhavargalukke munnurimai ena TVK podhucheyalaalar aananth palveru medaigalilum koorivandhaar. Aanaal TVK aatchikku vandha pinnarum kooda pira katchigalil irundhu vandhavargalukku mukkiyathuvam vaayndha arasu padhavigal vazhangappattu varugiradhu. Idhanaal Vijay narpani mandrathil irundhu katchikku vandhavargal thangal adhirupdhiyai TVK podhucheyalaalar aananthidam velippaduthi varuvadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu.

headline: Vijay aatchiyil vidiyal bus payanam merkonda pengalukku paadhippu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Thamizhaga vetrikkazhagam aatchi amaitha nilaiyil Vijay aatchiyil arasu perundhugalil vidiyal payanam endra kattanamillaa pokkuvarathu payanam merkonda pengalai oru km nadandhu sellumbadi ottunar nadu vazhiyil irakkivittaar endru oru video

Polimer seythigal tholaikkaatchi veliyitta video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil magalir kattanamillaa payanam merkonda pengalai avamariyaadhai seythu oru km thooram nadandhu sellum vazhiyil paadhiyil irakkivitta ottunar endru seythi irundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “Actor Vijay kkum, TVK kku vaakkalithu, maatram vendum endravargal mattum idha paarunga..
Arumaiyaana maatram.. Kattanamillaa vidiyal payanam #svaagaa…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
TVK aatchikku vandha piragu kadandha DMK aatchiyil konduvarappatta thittangal niruthappadum endru samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappappattu varugiradhu. Andha vagaiyil, ilavasa bus payanam merkollum vidiyal payanam thittathin keezh perundhil payanitha pengalai, nadu vazhiyil irakkivitta ottunar endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Polimer seythigal samooga oodaga pakkangalai mudhalil paarvaiyittom. Adhil, sameevathil indha video veliyaagavillai enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Enave, pazhaiya video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvaith thodarndhom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2026 pipravari 16m thedhi indha seythiyai Polimer news veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Pipravari 16 enbadhu Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyilirundha kaalagattamaagum. Maars 15, 2026 andru thaan therdhal arivippe veliyaanadhu. Enave, idharkum tharpodhu pudhidhaaga poruppetrulla TVK arasukkum thodarbillai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal nadaiveruvadharku munbu kadandha DMK aatchiyin podhu perundhil irundhu pengal irakkividappatta sambavathin video-vai Vijay aatchiyil pengalukku paadhippu enbadhu pola thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Idi minnaludan velukkappogum kanamazhai.. 17 maavattangalukku echarikkai!
text:
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
Thamizhagathil palveru maavattangalil adutha sila mani nerangalil kanamazhaikku vaayppulladhaaga vaanilai aayvu maiyam therivithulladhu. Kurippaaga, sila maavattangalil idi, minnal matrum palatha kaatrudan kanamazhai peyyakkoodum ena echarikkai vidukkappattulladhu. Appadi endhendha maavattangalil kanamazhai peyyum? Endhendha pagudhigalil midhamaana mazhaikku vaayppulladhu enbadhaip paarkkalaam... Thamizhagathil vadakku ul karnaadagaa mudhal mannaar valaigudaa varai, therku ul karnaadagaa matrum Thamizhaga pagudhigal vazhiyaaga oru kaatrazhutha thaazhvup paadhai nilavi varugiradhu.
Adhevol, therkuk kadalora aandhiraa matrum adhanai ottiya raayalaseemaa pagudhigalin mel valimandala suzhatsiyum nilavi varugiradhu. Indha vaanilai amaippugalin kaaranamaaga, indru thamizhagathin palveru pagudhigalil mazhaikku vaayppulladhaaga vaanilai aayvu maiyam therivithulladhu.
Vaanilai aayvu maiyathin arivippinbadi , neelagiri, Coimbatore, karoor, thiruchiraappalli, perambaloor, ariyaloor matrum Thanjavur aagiya maavattangalil oriru idangalil idi, minnal matrum palatha kaatrudan kanamazhai peyyakkoodum. Indhap pagudhigalil manikku 40 mudhal 50 kilomeettar vegathil palatha kaatrum veesakkoodum enbadhaal, podhumakkal echarikkaiyudan irukka arivuruthappattulladhu. Adhevol, metnth thodarchi malai maavattangal matrum Chennai, Tiruvallur, Chengalpattu, kaanjjivuram, raanippettai, veloor, thiruppathoor, Salem, Tiruppur, Erode, Krishnagiri, tharmavuri, naamakkal, kallakkurichi, Madurai matrum sivagangai aagiya maavattangalil orusila idangalil midhamaana mazhaikku vaayppulladhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Indha maavattangalilum idi, minnal matrum manikku 40 mudhal 50 kilomeettar vegathil palatha kaatrudan mazhai peyyakkoodum ena vaanilai aayvu maiyam therivithulladhu. Idhudhavira, thamizhagathin enaiya pagudhigalilum orusila idangalil idi, minnaludan koodiya lesaana mazhai peyyakkoodum. Pudhucheri matrum kaaraikkaal pagudhigalilum lesaana mazhaikku vaayppulladhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Idhanaal, indru kanamazhai echarikkai vidukkappattulla maavattangalais serndha makkal, kurippaaga idi, minnal matrum palatha kaatru veesum nerangalil thevaiyatra payanangalai thavirthu, paadhugaappaana idangalil irukkavum arivuruthappattulladhu.

headline: Stalin, Edappadi mudhal sooryaa, kaarthik varai; piravalangal kuvindha thirumana vizhaa; pinnani enna?
text:
Odisaa, jaargant, satheesgar aagiya India-vin miga mukkiya thaadhu valam kozhikkum maanilangalil ulla periya surangangalai indha niruvanamdhaan nirvagithu varugiradhu.
Salem maavattathil netru nadaivetra piramaanda thirumana vizhaavil munnaal mudhalamaichargal M.K. Stalin, Edappadi Palaniswami, arasiyal katchith thalaivargal nayinaar naagendhiran, Seeman, thirumaavalavan, Annamalai ullitta palveru arasiyal thalaivargal pangetrullanar.
Adhumattumindri mathiya, maanila arasugalil angam vagikkum makkal piradhinidhigal, arasiyal piramugargal, amaichargal, thirai piramugargal ena naattin pala pagudhigalil irundhum vi.ai.pi, vi.vi.ai.pi- kkal ena indha nigazhvil kuvindhirukkiraargal. Mudhalvar Vijay pangerpadhaaga thagavalgal veliyaana nilaiyil, kadaisi nerathil rathaagiyulladhu.
Indhiya alavil kavanathai eertha indhath thirumana vizhaa kurithu nammidam pesiya thiriveni kuroops nirvaagigal, "India-vin munnani surangam matrum ulgattamaippu peruniruvanangalil ondraaga thiriveni kuzhumam iyangi varugiradhu.
1991-m aandu thodangappatta indha niruvanam selathaith thalaimaiyidamaagak kondu iyangi varugiradhu. Odisaa, jaargant, satheesgar aagiya India-vin miga mukkiya thaadhu valam kozhikkum maanilangalil ulla periya surangangalai indha niruvanam thaan nirvagithu varugiradhu.
India mattumindri indhonesiyaa, thennaappirikkaa matrum aappirikka naadugal silavatrilum thanadhu surangath thozhilai virivuvaduthiyulladhu. Indhak kuzhumathin nirvaaga iyakkunar pi. Piravaagarana avargalin magan thirumana vizhaadhaan tharpodhu selathil pirammaandamaaga nadaivetru varugiradhu.
Mumbaiyais serndha piravala irumbu matrum thaadhu urpathi niruvanamaana laayits mettals adhivarin magalais sammandham mudithirukkiraargal. Indhiya alavil arasiyal matrum adhigaara mattathil nerungiya thodarbu irukkiradhu. Salem pirundhaavan maidhaanathil pala ekkar parappalavil piramaanda aranmanai set podappattulladhu. Nootrukkanakkaana unavu vagaigal parimaarappattana. Thozhiladhivargal mattumindri naattin mukkiya piramugargal palarum pangetru varugiraargal. Helivet ullitta anaithu vasadhigalum seyyappattullana" endranar.

headline: "endhath thappum seyyavillai; Needhimandram moolam niravaraadhi endru niruvippom" - ke.en.neru vilakkam
text:
"avargal kooruvadhu pol tendar thodarbaaga naan yaaridamum pesiyadhu kidaiyaadhu. Vazhakku thodarbaaga aduthu enna koorugiraargalo adhaik kettu sattappadi sandhippom" endru DMK munnaal amaichar ke.en.neru therivithullaar.
Thiruchiyil DMK munnaal amaichar ke.en.neru veettil lanjja ozhipputhurai poleesaar sodhanai merkondanar.
Innilaiyil, seythiyaalargalais sandhitha ke.en.neru, "tendar muraigedu thodarbaaga sodhanai seyya vandhaargal. Trichy, Chennai-yil ulla ennudaiya veettilum ennudaiya sagodharar veettilum sodhanai seythaargal. Avargalukku edhuvum kidaikkavillai.
Vazhakkamaagap payanbaduthum oru koppaiyum ennudaiya sagodhararin varavu selavu kanakku thodarbaana vivarangalaiyum eduthuk kondaargal. 8 mani mudhal 3 mani varai sodhanai nadaivetradhu. Ovvondraagap paarthuvittu adhu thodarbaaga ezhudhi kaiyezhuthu vaangi ullaargal.
Naangal muzhumaiyaaga othuzhaippu vazhanginom. Avargal kooruvadhu pol tendar thodarbaaga naan yaaridamum pesiyadhu kidaiyaadhu. Vazhakku thodarbaaga aduthu enna koorugiraargalo adhaik kettu sattappadi sandhippom. Lanjja ozhipputhurai erkanave oru vazhakku enmeedhu padhivu seythullaargal. Andha vazhakku needhimandra visaaranaiyil ulladhu.
Adhu kurithu avargal ennidam edhuvum ketkavillai. Naangal endhath thavarum seyyavillai. Needhimandrathirkus sendru naangal niravaraadhi enbadhai niroovippom. Sattasavaiyil arasai nokki naan kelvi ezhuppuvadhaal ennai mirattuvadharkaagakkooda idhu pondra sodhanai avargal seyyalaam.
Arasai adikkadi neengal kelvi ketkireergal ena seythiyaalargal ennidam solvadhu enakku perumaiyaaga ulladhu. Indhas sodhanai pazhivaangum nadavadikkaidhaan. Sattasavaiyil ondriya arasu kurithu amaichar vanniyarasu pesiya karuthai avaikkurippilirundhu neekka vendum ena amaichar aadhav arjunaa kooriyadhu, ondriya arasum, maanila arasum otrumaiyaaga iruppadhaik kaattugiradhu.
Mathiya arasidam endhak ketta peyarum aagi vidakkoodaadhu enbadharkaaga Thamizhaga arasu seyalbattu varugiraargal. Erkanave, mudhalvaraaga irundhavargal naangal edhirkkatchiyaaga irukkum pozhudhu irandu murai en veettil lanjja ozhipputhuraiyinar sodhanai seythaargal. Tharpozhudhu, moondraavadhu murai sodhanai nadaivetrulladhu.
Kaazhppunarchiyin kaaranamaaga indhas sodhanai nadathappattulladhu. DMK thalaivar ennidam pesinaar. Sodhanaikku muzhu othuzhaippu alikka arivuruthinaar" endraar.

headline: Aazhappoli: arunaachalathil kalavarathai thoondum aar.es.es endru Trump kutramsaattiya video | Deepfake: Video of Trump Accusing RSS Of Inciting Riots In Arunachal Pradesh
text:
Aazhappoli: arunaachalathil kalavarathai thoondum aar.es.es endru Trump kutramsaattiya video
Trump athagaiya uraiyai nigazhthiyadhaaga endha nambagamaana seythi arikkaigalum illai endru poom kandarindhadhu.
Arunaachalap piradhesathil kalavarathai thoondivittadhaagavum, angirukkum taani pazhangudiyinaridaiye modhalaith thoondiyadharkaagavum aar.es.es amaippai America adhivar tonaalt Trump kutram saattum oru kaanoli viral-aagi varugiradhu.
Indha video or aazhamaana polithanmaiyudan uruvaakkappattadhu endru poom kandarindhulladhu. AI moolam maatrimaikkappatta video-vil pala muranbaadugal ullana. Melum, AI payanbaattai kandariyum karuvigalum indha video aazhamaana polithanmaiyaik kondadhu enbadhai urudhippaduthiyullana.
Arunaachalap piradhesathil pazhangudi nambikkai kondavargal, kirisdhavargal matrum pauthargal ena moondru mukkiya samoogangal ullana. Maanilathin kurippidathakka pazhangudiyinaril ondraana taani makkal, sooriyanaiyum (toni) sandhiranaiyum (polo) vazhivaduvavargal.
Indha viral video moondru nimidam 20 nodigal kondadhu. Idhil, toni polo samoogathil ulla sila navargal arasiyal nokkangalukkaaga thangal adaiyaalathaiyum nambikkaiyaiyum aar.es.es amaippukku vitru varuvadhaagavum, ichattathaip payanbaduthi kirisdhava taani makkalidaiye modhalaith thoonduvadhaagavum Trump kooruvadhu pola irukkiradhu. Taani makkalidaiye pirivinaiyai undaakka aar.es.es. Amaippukku udhava panam petravargalai adaiyaalam kaanavum avar valiyuruthugiraar.
Indha kaanoli aangilathilum thamizhilum pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Thamizhil, “amerikka adhivar ttiramp ulaga makkalukku migathelivaaga kooriyulla thagavalai nam indhiyargal ovvoruvarum kelungal,” endra karuthudan pagirappattu varugiradhu.
