headline: Agamadhaavaathil vivathukkullaana vimaanathil kadaisi nimidam endru paravum pugaippadangal unmaiyaa?
text:
Agamadhaavaathil vivathukkullaana vimaanathil kadaisi nerathil edukkappatta kaatchi endru sila pugaippadangalais silar

vimaanathirkul siriyavargal, periyavargal adhirchiyil alaruvadhu pondra pugaippadangalai ondru serthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilaith thagavalil, “agamadhaavaathil vimaana vivathin kadaisi tharunathin padam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Agamadhaavaathil vivathukkullaana vimaanathil vivathukku sila nimidangalukku munbu edukkappatta pugaippadam endru sila pugaippadangalai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Vimaanam purappattu oru nimidathirkullaagave vivathukkullaagivittadhu. Appadi irukka eppadi pugaippadam, video eduthirukka mudiyum endra kelvi ezhugiradhu. Melum, vimaanathirkulle kuzhandhaigal ellaam ore seettil amarndhiruppadhu pondru pugaippadam ulladhu. Ivai ellaam sandhegathai erpaduthave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil vimaanam evvalavu neram parandhadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya idhu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigalaip paarthom. Joon 12, 2025 andru er India vimaanam 1.38kku ranveyil irundhu purappattulladhu. Purappatta sila vinaadigalileye vimaanathin vimaani, “No thrust, not taking lift” endru me te echarikkaiyai veliyittullaar. 1.39 nimidathil vimaanam tharaiyil vizhundhu vedithulladhaaga seythigal namakkuk kidaithulladhu. Oru nimidathirkum kuraivaagave vimaanam parandhulladhu. Appadi irukka adharkullaaga pugaippadam eduthu eppadi veliyittirukka mudiyum endra kelvi ezhugiradhu.
Er India poying 787-8 treemlainar vimaanathirkul eppadi irukkum endru pazhaiya video, pugaippadangalai thedip paarthom. Adhil pisinas vaguppil irandu irandu irukkaigal serndhu irundhana. Ekkaanami vaguppil moondru moondraaga irukkaigal irundhana. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathil ore oru seet thaan ulladhu. Er India vimaanathin irukkai niramum, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathil ulla irukkaiyin niramum ul vadivamaippum vithiyaasamaaga iruppadhai kaana mudigiradhu.
Vimaanam tek aap aagum podhu payanigal anaivarum amarndhu, seet pelt pottiruppaargal. Andha nerathil yaarum nindru kondirukka maattaargal. Aanaal, otrai irukkaiyil irandu kuzhandhaigal amarndhu ullanar. Arugil innum irandu moondru kuzhandhaigal nindru kondirundhanar. Vimaanathil kolaaru erpattadhai arivitha vinaadiyileye vivathu erpattulladhu. Idharkullaaga ezhundhu nindru pugaippadam, video eduthu samooga oodagangalil veliyida neram irundhirukkaadhu.
Ippadi oru pugaippadam matrum video-vai arasu, vimaana niruvanam matrum uyirizhandha payanigalin kudumbathinar veliyittadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Paarkka seyarkai nunnarivu moolam uruvaakkappatta padam pol ulladhu. Enave, indha pugaippadathai eai pugaippadangalaik kandariyum thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Adhuvum idhu muzhukka muzhukka eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru urudhi seythadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu veediyovaagave silar padhivittirundhanar. Avatrai utruk kavanitha podhu idhu eai veediyodhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Video-vil kuzhandhaigalukku pinburathil oru jodi katti anaippadhu pondru kaatchi varugiradhu. Pennai pidithu izhuthuk kattiyanaikkum podhu andha pennin thalai thideerendru maraindhu, aanin thalai mattume therigiradhu. Eai moolam video uruvaakkum podhu idhu pondru kuraivaadugal ezhuvadhu vazhakkamaanadhudhaan. Ivai ellaam indha pugaippadam poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Aduthadhaaga periyavar oruvar thirumbi paarkkum pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Andha pugaippadathudan 2024m aandu tisambar 25m thedhi veliyaana ingilaandhin teyli meyil oodagathin seythi kidaithadhu. Adhil, “kajagasdhaan naattil vimaanam theeppidithu vivathukkullaana nigazhvil, vivathu erpaduvadharku munbu payanigal piraarthanai seytha kaatchi viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha thagaval adippadaiyil thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu X thalathil payani oruvar edutha kadaisi nera video veliyaagi irundhadhu namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla kaatchiyum irundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha pugaippadam agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathirku munbu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Jem veeramani vazhakku edhiroli.? 3 kaaval adhigaarigal kaathiruppu pattiyalukku maatram!!
text:
Sennaiyais serndha kiraanait thozhiladhivar aar. Veeramani meedhaana paaliyal vazhakku Indhiya alavil perum adhirvalaigalai erpaduthiyulladhu. Pala sirumigalai paaliyal vangodumaikku ullaakkiyadhaaga ezhundha pugaaraiyaduthu veeramani thodarbaana pokso vazhakkil visaaranai tharpodhu theeviramadaindhulladhu. Indha vazhakkil kadandha aagast 29aam thedhi veeramani, avaradhu thodarbudaiya magendhira simman matrum saandhi aagiyor kaidhu seyyappattanar. Idharkidaiye, veeramaniyin niruvanathil sumaar 23 aandugal paniyaatriyadhaagak koorappadum kanesan enbavaraiyum kaavaldhurai tharpodhu kaidhu seythulladhu.
Idharkidaiyil, veeramani thodarbaaga 2024-aam aandileye kaavaldhuraiyil pugaar alithirundhaalum, adhan meedhu endha nadavadikkaiyum edukkappadavillai endrum tharpodhu kaavaldhurai eduthulla nadavadikkaiyilum, thaam erkanave alitha pugaar kurithu endhavidha kurippum idamberavillai endrum therivithu paravarappaik kilappiyirukkiraar Congress nirvaagi ranjjan kumaar.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, ranjjan kumaar kooriya kaalakkattathil Chennai kaaval aanaiyaraaga poruppu vagitha arun aivies matrum Chennai maanagarak kaavalil mukkiyak kaavalil irundha kannan aivies aagiyorai kaathiruppu pattiyalukku maatri Thamizhaga arasu utharavittulladhu. Eninum, avargalai kaathiruppattiyalukku maatrappattadharkaana kaaranathai therivikkavillai.
Idhaith thodarndhu, tharpodhu, koyambedu kaaval udhavi aanaiyar yaasmin kaathiruppor pattiyalukku maatram seythu Tamil Nadu arasu utharavittulladhu. Erkanave, indha vazhakku thodarbaana visaaranaikku aajaraaga yaasminukku samman vazhangappattirundha nilaiyil, tharpodhu indha nadavadikkai edukkappattirukkiradhu.

headline: Aapgaanil idikkappatta indhu kovilgal kattitharappadum endru thaalivaangal arivithaargalaa?
text:
Aapgaanisdhaanil idikkappatta indhu koyilgal meendum kattitharappadum endru thaalivaangal arivithadhaaga oru video

aapgaanisdhaan thaalivaan arasais saarndhavar petti alithadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “pala aayiram varudangalukku munbe idhu raamajenma poomi aapgaanisdhaan indhukkal thesam. Idikkappatta kovilgalai meendum kattuvom” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “unmaiyaana musleem idicha kovilgal ellaathaiyum pudhushaa kattith tharenguraan.
Kalaachaara maravu parambarai varalaaru illaadha Pakistan panniga namma kovilgalai ellaam idikkiraan
vamsa varalaarum vandha varalaarum illaadha eethara pannigalukku sagipputhanmai irukkumaa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Aapgaanisdhaanil idikkappatta indhu kovilgalai meendum kattith tharugirom endru thaalivaangal kooriyadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil pesuvavargal aapgaanisdhaaniyargal pesum mozhiyil illaamal, indhiyil pesiyadhu pola irundhadhu.
Amaicharin pechum, vaay asaivum othuppogavillai. Pesum podhu parkal maraindhu, thotruvadhai ellaam vaithu paarkkum podhu idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappatta video-vaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Video-vil iruppavar aapgaanisdhaanin veliyuravuth thurai amaichar ameer kaan muthaagi (Amir Khan Muttaqi) endru theriyavandhadhu. Video-vil ANI seythi oodagathin logo irundhadhaal, andha video-vai thedi eduthom. 10 maadhangalukku munbu indha video-vai ANI veliyittirundhadhu.
Video-vai muzhumaiyaaga paarthom. Avar aapgaanisdhaaniyargalin mozhiyil pesa, arugilirundhavar aangilathil mozhiveyarthaar. Adhil endha idathilum aapgaanisdhaanil idikkappatta indhu koyilgal meendum kattitharappadum endru avar kooravillai. Melum avar andha pettiyil endha idathilum indhiyil pesavillai. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petrirundha kural oliyum, unmaiyaana pettiyilirundha kural oliyum vithiyaasamaaga irundhadhu. Idhan moolam idhu audio mattum edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
ANI veliyittirundha video-vil idam petrirundhavarin kuralum, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil irundha amaicharin kuralum vevveraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Andha pettiyil endha idathilum avar indhiyil pesavillai. Avar kovil kattitharappadum endru endha idathilum kooravillai. Idhan moolam video-vil ulla audio mattum edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serkkappattulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Peegaar vetri kondaattathil pennidam thavaraaga nadandha BJP thondargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaar therdhal vetri kondaattathin podhu pen oruvaridam silmisham seytha BJP thondargal endru oru video

pen oruvar seythiyaalargalukku petti alikkum podhu, avarukku nirkum navar, andha pennidam athumeeralgalai merkollum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peehaar therdhal sangigal kondaattam! Mondhu paathutte vetri kondaattatha aarambichirukkaanuga ethana peroda karpu kaanaama poga pogudho” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhal mudivugal navambar 14, 2025 andru veliyaanadhu. Indha therdhalil BJP – aikkiya janadhaa thala koottani migapperiya vetriyai petradhu. Indha vetrik kondaattathin podhu penmani oruvaridam sangi adhaavadhu BJP thondar thavaraaga nadandhugondaar endru oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vil andha penmani vanga mozhiyil pesuvadhu pola irukkindradhu. Video-vil ullavargalum merku vangam, vangadhesathais saarndhavargal pola ullanar. Video-vil ulla yaaridamum BJP kodiyo, sinnamo illai. Andha penmani pesum podhu BJP endru kurippidavum illai. Enave, pazhaiya video-vai peegaarudan thodarbuvaduthi veliyittullaargalaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu navambar 1, 2025l irundhu indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, indha video-vil iruppavar yaar, engu indha video edukkappattadhu endra pinnani thagaval edhuvum kidaikkavillai.
Zeenat_zoarder_ripa endra instaagiraam aidi kondavar indha video-vai navambar 1, 2025 andru thannudaiya instaagiraam pakkathil padhivittirundhaar. Adhil indha video thodarbaana endha thagavalum illai. Avaradhu suya vivara kurippai paarthavodhu avar vangadhesathais saarndhavar endrum nadigai / maadal endrum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Vangadhesathais saarndha palarum indha video-vai navambar 1, 2025 andru padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Peegaar therdhal mudivugal navambar 14m thedhi veliyaanadhu. Therdhal mudivugalukku irandu vaarangalukku munbaagave indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhulladhu. Idhan moolam idhu peegaar sattamandra therdhalil vetri petra piragu BJP thondargal nadandhugonda vidham endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Paagisdhaanukku paadam karpikka purappatta veerathaay endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:
‘’paagisdhaanukku paadam karpikka purappatta veerathaay,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ *paagisdhaanukku paadam karpikka purappattuvittaar veerathaay* vaazhga paaradham ,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan Indhiya paadhugaappup padai seerudai anindha pen oruvar, thanadhu kudumbathinarukku, kanneer malga vidai koduthuvittu, rail eri, panikkus selvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda oru veediyovum inaikkappattulladhu.
Idhanai paarkkumbodhu, India – Pakistan idaiye erpattulla modhalil pangerka, kurippitta veeraanganai purappattus selvadhaip pondru ulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha veediyovukkum, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Merkanda video-vin thalaippil, idhu tharpodhaiya video endru kurippidappattulladhu. Aanaal, video-vin ulladakkathaip paarthavodhu, thelivaaga, idhu kadandha 2023m aandu AB Plus Photography (Source) saarbaaga padhivu seyyappatta kaatchi endru, koorappattulladhaik kandom.
BSF padaip pirivil, magaaraashdiraa maanilam, kolhaavooril panivuriyum Varsha Patil enbavar perugaala viduppu mudindhu, thanadhu kudumbathinaridam irundhu vidaivetru, panikkuth thirumbis selvadhaagavum, andha veediyovileye aduthadutha kaatchigalil thelivaagak kurippittullanar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, video-vai muzhuvadhum paarkkaamaleye tharpodhaiya arasiyal soozhaludan thodarbuvaduthi, pudhiyadhu pondru pagirndhu, samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru theriyavarugiradhu.
Idhu mattumindri koodudhal aadhaaram silavatraiyum keezhe inaithullom.

headline: “jamaikkaavil melisaa puyal erpaduthiya paadhippu” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Jamaikkaa naattil melisaa puyal erpaduthiya paadhippu endru oru video

puyal paadhippu video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil aangilathil, “4-5m nilai puyalaana melisaa jamaikkaavai indru thaakkiyadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “mellisaa puyal jamaikkaa naattil manikku 200 kilomeettar vegathil veesum puyal endru koorappadugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Haithi, jamaikkaa ullitta kareeviyan theevu naadugalai melisaa puyal thaakkiyadhu. Manikku 300 km vegathil sooraavalik kaatru veesiyadhaaga seythigal veliyaanadhu. Indha soozhalil ‘jamaikkaa puyal’ endru kurippittu video ondru samooga oodagangalil adhiga alavil pagirappattu varugindrana. Idhu unmaiyil melisaa puyal jamaikkaavaith thaakkiyavodhu edukkappattavai thaanaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil pala idangalil padhivaana kaatchigalai ondru serthu ore video-vaaga veliyittirundhanar. Enave, ovvondraiyum thanith thaniyaaga aayvu seythom. Mudhalil kattidathin merkoorai kaatril parakkum video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, andha video kaatchi 2025 sepdambar 29m thedhiyilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Melisaa puyal jamaikkaavil annaattu nerappadi 27 akdovar 2025 andru iravu matrum 28m thedhidhaan paadhippai erpaduthiyadhu. Adhaavadhu, Indhiya nerappadi kanakkittaal 28m thedhi. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovo samooga oodagangalil 2025 sepdambar 29m thedhiyilirundhu padhividappattirundhadhu.
Kittathatta melisaa puyal jamaikkaavai thaakkuvadharku oru maadhathirku munbaaga video veliyaagi ulladhu. Enave, indha video jamaikkaavai melisaa puyal thaakkiya podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Kattidathin merkoorai parakkum kaatchi adangiya video thoguppu engu padhivaanadhu endru ariya thodarndhu aayvu seythom. Oru padhivil, 2025 sepdambar 29m thedhi viyatnaamil puvaaloy puyal (Bualoi) thaakkiyavodhu edukkappattadhu enbadhu kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal adhai urudhi seyya mudiyavillai.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil penmani oruvar kuzhandhaiyaith thookkikkondu varum kaatchi irundhadhu. Adhu patrith thediya podhu 2024m aandileye andha video veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhu America-vin alavaamaavil edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Enave, indha padhivilirundha endha oru kaatchiyum jamaikkaavudan thodarbudaiyadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra kaatchigal ellaam jamaikkaa melisaa puyal paadhippukku pala naatkalukku, maadhangalukku munbaaga irundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaith thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seythullom.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mamdhaa paanarji - kanimozhi sandhippu.. Thesiya alavil 3-vadhu ani? DMK adhiradith thittam?
text:
Thirinaamul Congress thalaivarum, munnaal merkuvanga mudhalvar mamdhaa paanarjiyai kolgathaavil ulla avaradhu illathil, DMK thunai podhucheyalaalarum naadaalumandra kuzhu thalaivarumaana kanimozhi sandhithup pesiyiruppadhaaga koorappadum nilaiyil, 2029 makkalavaith therdhalaiyotti thesiya alavil 3-vadhu aniyai kattamaikka muyatsi nadandhu varudhaagavum thagaval veliyaagiyirukkiradhu.
Tamil Nadu sattapperavaith therdhalil erpatta tholviyaith thodarndhu DMK koottaniyil irundhu mudhalaavadhaaga vilagiya Congress, TVK aatchiyamaikka aadharavalithadhudan amaicharavaiyilum pangetrirukkiradhu. Idhanaal, ivviru katchigalukkidaiyeyaana uravil perum virisal erpatta nilaiyil, indiyaa koottaniyil aarambathil irundhu angam vagithu vandha DMK andhak koottaniyil thodara mudiyaadhu ena arivithu vittadhu. Melum sameevathil Congress telliyil nadaivetra koottathirku azhaippu viduthum DMK thalaivargal purakkanippu seythirundhanar.
Kadandha 3 makkalavaith therdhalgalil thodarchiyaaga vendru BJP thalaimaiyilaana thesiya jananaayagak koottani aatchiyil irukkum nilaiyil, indhak koottanikku edhiraaga Congress, DMK ullitta edhirkkatchigal inaindhu 2023-m aandu indiyaa koottaniyai kattamaithirundhana. Melum, 2019 therdhalin podhu mudhanmudhalaaga raagulgaandhiyai piradhamar mugamaaga munmozhindhavar DMK thalaivar mu.ka. Stalin ivvaaru, Congress katchiyudan nerukkamaana katchigalil ondraaga irundha DMK akkoottaniyil vilagiya nilaiyil, aduthakkatta mudivu ennavaaga irukkum ena edhirbaarkkappattadhu. BJP koottaniyudan DMK inaiya vaayppirukkiradhu enavum pesappattadhu.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, thodarndhu naadaalumandra koottathodar matrum Delhi arasiyalilum theeviramaaga DMK kavanam seluthi varum nilaiyil, Congress katchiyin meedhu adhirupdhiyil irukkum matraa edhirk katchigaludan inaindhu thesiya alavil 3-vadhu koottaniyai uruvaakkum muyatsiyil eeduvattu iruppadhaaga arasiyal vimarsagargal kooruvarugindranar. Indha nilaiyil, thirinaamul Congress thalaivarum, munnaal merkuvanga mudhalvarumaana mamdhaa paanarjiyai kolgathaavil ulla avaradhu illathil, DMK thunai podhucheyalaalarum naadaalumandra kuzhu thalaivarumaana kanimozhi sandhithup pesiyiruppadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyirukkiradhu.
Sameevathil uthav sivasenaa katchiyin thalaivar, uthav thaakkarevai kanimozhi sandhithu pesi irundhadhum mukkiyamaaga paarkkappattadhu. Ivvaaru, BJP, Congress allaadha 3-vadhu aniyai uruvaakka DMK muyatsi ena pesappadum nilaiyil indha sandhippugal mukkiyamaanadhaaga paarkkindranar. Adhe soozhnilaiyil thogudhi maruvaraiyarai vivagaaram kurithum, thesiya alavilaana thozhilaalar virodha thoguppu sattangal kurithumindha sandhippin podhu aalosikkappaduvadhaaga thagaval koorugindrana.

headline: Thesiyam petti
text:

Akkatchi em.el.e., thanam naagendhar thagudhi neekkathai urudhi seytha ucha needhimandrathin mudivu, kaangirasai serndha loksavaa edhirkkatchith thalaivar raagul matrum thelungaanaa mudhalvar revanth retti aagiyorukku vizhundha kadumaiyaana adi. Ke.ti.raamaaraav seyal thalaivar paarath raashtra samidhi katchi
aadhaaram illai! Es.ai-.aar., enappadum vaakkaalar pattiyal sirappu theevira thiruthap paniyil edhuvum thavaraaga nadandhadharkaana aadhaaram illai. Idhu kurithu needhimandrathilum vivaadhikkappattadhu. Thavaru nerndhadhaaga aadhaarappoorvamaaga niroovikkappadavillai. Therdhal kamishanargal vivagaarathai edhirkkatchigal thevaiyindri peridhaakkugindrana. Thileep kosh paa.ja., amaichar merku vangam

headline: Thideer entri kodutha vijilens; roo.1,45,000 panathudan ottam piditha jeep tiraivar; enna nadandhadhu?
text:
Erode maavattam sathiyamangalam nagaraatchiyil nadaivetra lanjja ozhipputhurai sodhanaiyil, nagaraatchi aanaiyaalarin jeep tiraivaridamirundhu kanakkil varaadha roo.1,54,000 parimudhal seyyappatta sambavam adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Erode maavattam sathiyamangalam nagaraatchi aluvalathil netru maalai lanjja ozhipputhurai ti.es.pi thalaimaiyil aayvaalar ullitta 10 poleesaar thideer sodhanaiyil eeduvattullanar.
Nagaraatchiyin anaithuk kadhavugalaiyum moodi, anaivaradhu selbongalaiyum parimudhal seythu sodhanaiyai merkondullanar. Indhas sodhanaiyinbodhu thideerena ottam piditha navar oruvarai lanjja ozhippu poleesaar virattis sendru visaaranai nadathiyullanar.
Appodhu, aavanangal indri kanakkil varaadha 1.54 latcham roobai rokkap panam avarin pent paakkettil iruppadhaik kandarindhu parimudhal seythullanar. Melum andha navaridam visaaranai nadathiyadhil, nagaraatchi aanaiyaalarin vaagana ottunar rangasaami enbadhu theriyavandhulladhu .
Avaridam thodarndhu nadathappatta visaaranaiyil, nagaraatchi kangaanippaalar niranjjanaa thannidam indhap panathaik koduthu veliye eduthus sellumbadi kooriyadhaaga vaakkumoolam alithullaar.
Adhan adippadaiyil lanjja ozhippu poleesaar niranjjanaavidam visaaranai merkondanar. Idhil kanakkil varaadha 1,54,000 aayiram roobai panathai vaithirundha aanaiyaalarin vaagana ottunar rangasaami matrum nagaraatchi kangaanippaalar niranjjanaa aagiyor meedhu vazhakkup padhivu seythullanar. Thodarndhu visaaranai merkondu varugindranar.

headline: 90+ maruthuvamanaigalil.. Poli kensar marundhugal viniyogam! Nadunga vaikkum medikkal sgem!
text:
Pengalooruvil kruvaa helthger niruvanathai maiyamaagak kondu, 5 aandugalaaga poli kensar matrum uyirgaakkum marundhugal viniyogikkappatta adhirchi mosadi velichathukku vandhulladhu. Kaalaavadhiyaana, malivu marundhugalai pudhiya paattilgalil nirappi, piravala niruvana peyargalil levil otti, 90kkum merpatta maruthuvamanaigal, kilinikkugalukku 50% thalluvadiyil vitradhaaga visaaranaiyil kandariyappattulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - ma.jegannaath
kashdavattu kadan vaangi maruthuvamanaiyil serndhu Cancer-kkaana sigichai eduthuttu irooppeenga.. Marundhu ulla pogumbodhu nammoda ammaavo, appaavo, akkaavo, thambiyo seekkiram meendu vandhuduvaangandra nambikkaiyoda kaathiruppeenga. Aanaa sigichaikkaaga udalukkul seluthappatta marundhugal anaithum poli marundhu endru theriyavandhaal eppadi irukkum. Appadi oru sambavam thaan pakkathil ulla pengalooruvil nadandhirukku.
Podhuvaagave poli marundhugal viniyogam kodumaiyaanadhu endraal, kensarukkaana maruthugal poliyaaga virkappattulladhu, adhilum 90kkum melaana maruthuvamanaigalukku viniyogam seyyappattulladhu endraal idhu ethanai periya kodiya seyalaaga arangeriyulladhu. Enna nadandhadhu virivaaga paarkkalaam..
Adhirchi pinnani..
Pengalooril sirappu pulanaayvuk kuzhu matrum marundhuk kattuppaattuth thurai inaindhu nadathiya adhiradi sodhanaiyil, migapperiya poli marundhu virpanai kumbal kanduvidikkappattulladhu.
Minarvaa sarkkil aruge ulla kruvaa helthger niruvanathil nadathappatta sodhanaiyil, adhan urimaiyaalar veeresh kumaar jeyin kaidhu seyyappattaar. Angu poliyaana uyirgaakkum marundhugal, putrunoy sigichaikkaana marundhugal matrum ai.si.yoo.vil payanbaduthappadum oosi matrum marundhugal ullitta eraalamaana poli marundhugal parimudhal seyyappattana. Indha poli marundhugalin viniyoga sangili pengalooril ulla 90-kkum merpatta maruthuvamanaigal matrum kilinikkugalukku viniyogikkappattirukkalaam ena visaaranai adhigaarigal acham therivithullanar.
Kaalaavadhiyaana matrum kuraindha vilai marundhugalai pudhiya paattilgalil maatri adaithu, piravala marundhu niruvanangalin peyargalai poliyaaga payanbaduthi levilgal ottappattadhaagavum, pinnar indha marundhugal sumaar 50 sadhaveedham varai thalluvadi vilaiyil maruthuvamanaigalukku virpanai seyyappattadhaagavum, idharku 15-kkum merpatta maruthuva piradhinidhigal adangiya netvork udhaviyaaga irundhadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu.
Kadandha aagast 18aam thedhi pengalooru therku maavattathil ulla pannai veettil sugaadhaarathurai adhigaarigal nadathiya sodhanaiyil, sumaar 5 kodi roobai madhippilaana poli marundhugal, oosi marundhugalai nirappap payanbaduthappadum uvagaranangal matrum poli marundhu levilgal kanduvidikkappattana.
Idhaithodarndhu sirappu pulanaayvuk kuzhu amaikkappattu, karnaadagaa, hariyaanaa, imaachalap piradhesam, Tamil Nadu matrum magaaraashdiraa ullitta 6 maanilangalil 8-kkum merpatta idangalil ore nerathil sodhanaigal nadathappattana.
5 aandugalaaga nadathappatta viniyogam!
Indhasodhanaiyil thaan kruvaa helthger urimaiyaalar jeyin kadandha 5 aandugalaaga indha thozhilai nadathi vandhadhaagavum, kadandha oru aandaaga indha kumbalin mukkiya navaraaga karudhappadum pirasaandhudan inaindhu seyalbattu vandhadhaagavum visaaranaiyil theriyavandhulladhu.
Kruvaa helthgeril parimudhal seyyappatta marundhu maadhirigal, rasaayana matrum tharap parisodhanaikkaaga aayvagangalukku anuppappattullana. Paadhikkappatta marundhugalin pets engal karnaadagaa marundhu kattuppaattu nirvaagathin inaiyathalathil tharkaaligamaaga mudakkappattullana.
Melum, poli marundhugal endhendha maruthuvamanaigal matrum kilinikkugalukku sendrullana enbadhai kandariya, viniyogas sangili kurithu sirappu pulanaayvuk kuzhuvinar theeviramaaga visaaranai nadathi varugindranar. Idharkidaiye, indha kumbalin mukkiya navaraaga karudhappadum pirasaanth thalaimaraivaaga ulla nilaiyil, avarai kaidhu seyya Police theeviramaaga thedi varugindranar.
Putrunoy ullitta noygalukkaana poli marundhugal 90kkum merpatta maruthuvamanaigalukku viniyogikkappattadhaaga koorappadum ichambavam maaverum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Ithagaiya kutravaaligalai viraivil kandarindhu kadumaiyaana thandanaigalai vazhangavendum ena nettisangal korikkai vaithuvarugindranar.

headline: Thangam vilai indru sarivu; savaranukku ore naalil roo.1920 kuraivu
text:

headline: Koyilukkus sendra thirishaa, Vijay endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘koyilukkus sendra thirishaa, Vijay,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’emmaa thrishaa, vijaya veliya varachollungannu sollavum, kovamaa veliya kootti vandhuttiyaa?’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan samandhaa, thrishaa, Vijay ondraaga nirpadhu pondra pugaippadam ondru inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Sila naatkal munbaaga, BJP Tamil Nadu thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiran TVK thalaivar Vijay matrum nadigai thirishaavai thodarbuvaduthi, karuthu kooriyirundhaar. Idhu palveru tharappilum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Naam kooda adhuvatri fektchek seythullom.
Andha varisaiyil tharpodhu Vijay matrum nadigai thirishaa koyilukkus sendradhaagak koori, pugaippadam ondrai samooga valaidhalangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhuvondru endha oru seythiyum, pugaippadamum sameevathil veliyaagavillai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Thodarndhu vivaram thediyavodhu, thiruppadhi sendradhaaga, thirishaa avaradhu samooga valaidhala pakkathil padhivu veliyittirundhaar. Aanaal, andha pugaippadamum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadamum vevveraaga ulladhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, nadigai samandhaavai keli seyyum nokkil Naga Chaitanya Fans Club endra Facebook pakkathil padhivu ondru veliyittullanar. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam idambetrulladhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, TVK, thalaimaik kazhagathilum idhuvatri pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: '1974-il enna nadandhadhu theriyumaa..' mudhalvar Vijay-ai vimarsitha Udhayanidhi Stalin!
text:
Tamil Naattil TVK aatchiyin 100 naatkalai kadandha nilaiyil, sattam ozhungu pirachinaigal theeviramaaga pesappadum soozhalil, kadan thollai kurithu pugaar alitha ilainjar piradheepraaj kolai seyyappatta sambavam adhirchi erpaduthiyulladhu. Kaaval aayvaalar mirattiya veediyovukkup piragu nadandha indhak kolai kurithu Udhayanidhi Stalin kadum kandanam therivithu, kaavaldhuraiyinare mudhalvarai DUMMY CM ena ninaikkiraargalaa ena kelvi ezhuppiyullaar.
Tamil Naattil TVK thalaimaiyilaana aatchi amaindhu 100 naatkalai kadandhirukkum nilaiyil, sattam ozhungu pirasnaigal mukkiya pesuvorulaaga maariyullana. Pengal paadhugaappu, podhai ozhippu, sattam ozhungu pondravatrirku mudhalvar Vijay mukkiyathuvam vazhangi palveru nadavadikkaigalai eduthirundhaalum, thodarndhu pala kutrachambavangal arangeri varugindrana.
Indhasoozhalil kadan thollai kodukkiraargal, kaaval aayvaalare mirattugiraar ena ilainjar oruvar pugaaralithadhaaga veliyaana sambavathirku pin, andha ilainjar kolai seyyappattiruppadhu adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhaaga Udhayanidhi Stalin kandanam therivithullaar.
Idhugurithu avar veliyittirukkum X thala padhivil, “thalainagar Chennai-yil meendum oru kodoora kolai arangeri iruppadhu kadum adhirchi alikkiradhu.
‘kadan thollai kodukkiraargal’ ena paadhugaappu ketta piradheepraaj enum ilainjarai, ‘uyirodu irukka maatta.. Poy Case pottu ulla thalluven’ endru thiruvotriyoor kaaval aayvaalar mirattiyadhaaga sambandhappatta ilainjare netru mun thinam video veliyitta nilaiyil, netru avar kolai seyyappattu irukkiraar.
‘CM-tta venumnaa poy sollu. Ennaiya onnum panna mudiyaadhu’ endru thiruvotriyoor kaaval aayvaalar sonnadhaagavum kolaiyaavadharku oru naal munbu piradheepraaj kooriyullaar.
Kaavaldhuraikku poruppu vagikkum mudhalvarai kaavaldhuraiyinare DUMMY CM aaga ninaikkiraargalaa?
Kaavaldhuraiyidam paadhugaappu kettaal kolai seyyappaduvaargal endra pudhiya varalaatrai indha Circus aatchiyaalargal uruvaakki irukkiraargal.
Sattamandrathil sattam ozhungu kurithu kelvi kettaal, ‘1974-il enna nadandhu theriyumaa,, ED enna pannuchu theriyumaa’ endru Divert seyyum mudhalamaichar, indha kolaikku enna padhil vaithirukkiraar.
Indha vazhakkil thiruvotriyoor kaaval aayvaalar utbada sambandhappatta anaivar meedhum vazhakkuppadhivu seyvadhodu, sattathin mun niruthi uriya thandanai petruthara vendum.
Thalainagaril meendum oru kolai nadakkaamal iruppadharku thevaiyaana kadumaiyaana nadavadikkaiyai indha arasu edukka vendum” ena padhivittullaar.

headline: Thaaraavuram idaitherdhal panigal surusuruppu! Therdhal pirivu adhigaarigal vegam
text:
Tiruppur: thaaraavuram sattasavai thogudhi idaitherdhal ottuppadhivu varum ak. 6m thedhi nadaivera ulladhu. Vetbu manudhaakkal, sep .,9 l thuvangiyadhu. Idhanaal, maavatta therdhal pirivinar idaitherdhal nadathuvadharkaana aduthadutha panigalil theeviram kaatti varugindranar.
Vaakkaalargalin vasadhikkaagavum, therdhal pugaar meedhu nadavadikkai eduppadharkaagavum, thaaraavuram thaalugaa aluvalagam matrum Collector aluvalaga valaagathil kattuppaattu araigal amaikkappattu, thodarbu engal arivikkappattullana/ vaakkaalargalukku panam matrum parisupporul vazhanguvadhai kangaanithu thaduppu nadavadikkai merkollum vagaiyil, 9 nilai kangaanippukkuzhukkal matrum 9 parakkum padaigal amaikkappattullana. Ikkuzhuvinar thinamum moondru shiptkalil 24 mani neramum thogudhikkul suzhatsi muraiyil kangaanippu paniyil eeduvattu varugindranar.
Uriya aavanangal indri 50 aayiram roovaaykku mel eduthus sellappadum panam matrum parisupporutkal parimudhal seyyappattu varugindrana. Parakkum padai matrum nilai kangaanippukkuzhu vaaganangalin nagarvugal, ji.pi.es. Karuvi vaayilaaga Collector aluvalagathil amaikkappattulla kattuppaattu araiyil irundhu kangaanikkappattu varugiradhu.
Ottuppadhivu iyandhirangal
ottuppadhivukku thevaiyaana minnanu ottuppadhivu iyandhirangal odhukkeedu seyyappada ullana. Thaaraavuram thogudhiyil, 186 amaividangalil motham 320 ottuchaavadigal ullana. 20 sadhaveedham koodudhal endra adippadaiyil 384 kantrol yoonit, 384 pelat yoonit matrum 30 sadhaveedham koodudhal endra adippadaiyil 416 'vivi pet' iyandhirangal odhukkeedu seyyappada ullana. Adutha moondru naatkalukkul, Collector aluvalaga valaagathil ulla straang room thirakkappattu, ottuppadhivu iyandhirangal thaaraavurathukku anuppi vaikkappada ullana.

headline: ‘indhiyaavilirundhu sudhandhiram petradhaaga arivitha manippoor‘ endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Indhiyaavilirundhu manippoor thani naadaagap pirivadharkaana arivippu veliyaanadhu endru oru video

indhiyaavidam irundhu manippoor sudhandhiram petradhaaga irandu per pesum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil aangilathil, “indhiyaavidam irundhu sudhandhiram petradhaaga arivitha manippoor. Indhiya paadhugaappu padaigal saranadaiya echarikkai endru” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “indhiyaavil irundhu manippoor thani naadaaga pirivadhaaga arivithu vittaargal. Indhiya raanuvam udanadiyaaga saranadaiya vendum endrum echarikkai. Nallaa irundha maanilathai sangeegal ulle pugundhu iru pirivinaridaiye pirivinaiyai uruvaakki aatchikku vandhu maanilathai naasam seythu vittaargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Manippooril ulla BJP aatchi kaaranamaaga pirivinai modhal adhigarithu, thani naadaaga sudhandhiram petradhaaga arivitha manippoor endru video ondrais silar padhivittu varugindranar. Ammaanila araso, ammaanilathil ulla perumbaanmai makkalin amaippo, katchiyo ippadi arivithadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Video-vil ulla irandu per yaar endru endha thagavalum illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2019m aandilirundhe indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Melum, idhu thodarbaaga 2019m aandil veliyaana seythigalum namakku kidaithana.
Adhil, “manippoor samasdhaanathin arasa kudumbath thalaivarum, peyar alavil mannaraaga ullavarumaana leysembaa sajanaavovaavin (Leishemba Sanajaoba) aadharavudan indhiyaavilirundhu manippoor pirindhu sudhandhira thani naadaaga arivikkappadugiradhu endru landanil irandu per petti alithanar. Idhaith thodarndhu manippooril paravarappu erpattadhu. Ivargalin indha arivippukku appodhaiya mudhalamaichar piren sing edhirppum kandanamum therivithadhudan avargal meedhu pirivinaiyaith thoondum vagaiyil seyalbattadhaaga vazhakkup padhivu seyyappattulladhaaga” koorinaar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Adhu mattumindri, manippoorin peyaralavu mannaraana leysembaa sajanaavovaavum indha arivippukku kandanam therivithullaar. Indha arivippukkum thanakkum evvidha thodarbumillai endrum thevaiyindri ennudaiya peyarai idhil izhuthullanar endrum avar kooriyadhaaga ANI veliyittirundha seythiyum namakku kidaithadhu. Idhan moolam indhiyaavidam irundhu sudhandhiram petradhaaga manippoor arithadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Maraimugamaaga bus kattanathai uyarthiya DMK arasu endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Magalirukku roo.5000m urimaith thogai vazhangivittu, adhai vasoolikkum vagaiyil arasu perundhugalil maraimugamaagak kattanam uyarthappattadhu endru oru padhivu

Tamil Nadu arasu pokkuvarathuk kazhagathil vaangiya payanas seettin pugaippadam fesbakkil padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thamizhnaattil 1.13 kodi magalirukku ottu poda 5000 roovaayai kodai nidhi, urimai nidhi endru lanjjamaaga koduthuvittu.., eadhai maraimugamaaga 5000 vazhigalil vilai uyarvu, kattanam uyarvu ena vilaivaasi uyarthi vasoolikkiradhu theemuga arasu.!
Sreevillivuthoor – Madurai 75 roobaayaaga irundha arasu perundhu kattanam tharpodhu 100 roobai, idhuvola Tamil Nadu muzhukka anaithu vazhith thadangalilum perundhu kattanathai munnarivippu illaamal uyarthivittadhu theemuga arasu. Thalaa 5000 roobai therdhal lanjjam petradhu 1.13 kodi pengal mattumdhaan, aanaal adhai 8 kodi thamizhnaattu makkalidamum vilaivaasiyai uyarthi vattiyodu vasoolikkiradhu thiruttuth theemuga arasu.! Thamizhnaattu makkalai ippadi surandum kollaikkaara theemugavai varum therdhalodu ozhithuk kattuvom.!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil maraimugamaaga bus kattanam uyarthappattadhu endru palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Thinasari perundhil payanam seyyum therindhavargalidam visaaritha podhu vazhakkamaana kattanathaithaan seluthinom endru therivithanar. Kattanam adhigamaaga vasoolikkappattadhaaga yaarum kooravillai.
Aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil, sreevillivuthooril irundhu madhuraikku vandhadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Enave, madhuraiyais saarndha oodaga nanbargal moolam sreevillivuthooril irundha madhuraikku arasu pokkuvarathuk kazhagathil evvalavu kattanam endru visaarikkas sonnom. Avargalukku indha tikkettin pugaippadathaiyum anuppinom. Avargal visaarithuvittu “vazhakkamaana perundhugalil roo.75 kattanam vasoolikkappadugiradhu. Naam anuppiyirundha payanacheettaanadhu kulirsaadhana vasadhiyudan koodiya perundhaagum. Adharku roo.100 kattanam vasoolikkappadugiradhu. Kulirsaadhana vasadhiyudaiya perundhil payanam seythuvittu saadhaarana perundhu kattanam vasoolikkavillai endru thavaraagak kutramsaattiyullanar” endranar.
Veru aadhaarangal kidaikkiradhaa, Tamil Nadu fekt sek-l edhenum padhivu veliyaagi ulladhaa endru paarthom. Adhil, “indha thagaval thavaraanadhu. Indha navar kulirsaadhana perundhil payanam seythadhaal avaridam irundhu kattanamaaga roo.100 vasoolikkappattirundhadhu. Saadhaarana pasgalil kattanam roo.75 thaan. Indha navaridam koodudhal kattanam edhum vasoolikkappadavillai endru Madurai pokkuvarathuk kazhaga virudhunagar mandala udhavi melaalar vilakkam alithulladhaaga padhivittirundhanar.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhil idam petrirundha perundhu payanas seettil esi bus endru kurippidappattirundhadhai naamum paarthom. Idhan moolam thittamittu vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: I.es.ai., kaappeettaalar irappu kudumbathukku maadha udhavithogai
text:
Salem: Salem adutha, sinnagavundaavurathil ulla saayraam endarbi-raisas niruvanathil panivurindha, i.es.ai., kaappeettaalar raajaamani, paniyinbodhu maara-taippu erpattu, 2023 me, 4l uyirizhandhaar.
Avaradhu kudumbathukku maadham, 6,171 roobai saarndhor udhavithogai vazhanguvadharkaana aanaiyai, Salem i.es.ai., thunai mandala inai iyakkunar utharavinbadi pirappikkap-pattadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, Salem i.es.ai., kilai melaalar arunbaalaaji, netru mundhinam saarndhor udhavithogai aanaiyai vazhanga, irandha kaappeettaalarin manaivi, magal petruk-kondanar.
Endarbiraisas niruvana urimaiyaalar raama-naadhan udanirundhaar.

headline: China - America adhivargal indru aalosanai
text:
Vaashingdan: aaru maadhangal idaiveliyil meendum sandhikkum nilaiyil, America adhivar tonaaldu Trump matrum China adhivar shee jinbing, iru tharappu uravugal matrum sarvadhesa vivagaarangal kurithu, indru virivaaga aalosanai nadatha ullanar.
America adhivaraaga tonaaldu Trump, 2017 mudhal 2021 varai irundhavodhu, seenaavudan porulaadhaaram, varthagam ullittavatril kadum modhalbokkai kondirundhaar. Iru tharappum maari maari kutrachaattugalai munvaithu vandhana.
Kadandhaandu jana.,l irandaavadhu muraiyaaga adhivaraaga padhaviyetra piragum, indha modhal pokku thodarndhadhu. Idharkidaiye sarvadhesa alavil porgal utbada, pala sarvadhesa arasiyal kuzhappangal matrum maatrangalaal, tirambin mananilai maariyadhu.
Kadandha me maadham, seenaavukku sendru iru tharappu uravugal ullittavai kurithu jinbingudan Trump pesinaar. Appodhu America-vukku varumaaru azhaippu viduthaar.
Adhanbadi, 10 aandugal idaivelikkup pin, China adhivar jinbing, America-vukku moondru naal payanam merkondullaar.
Iru thalaivargalum indru sandhithu mukkiya aalosanaigal nadatha ullanar. Kurippaaga, iru tharappu varthagam thodarbaaga pesa ullanar.
Idhai thavira, merkaasiya por, Russia - Ukraine por, e.ai., enappadum seyarkai nunnarivil erpattulla potti utbada, pala tharappatta vivagaarangal kurithu iru thalaivargalum pesuvar endru edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Ai.naa., podhu savai koottam nadandhu varum nilaiyil, jinbing adhil pangerkavillai. Maaraaga, idhu arasumurai payanamaaga amaigiradhu.
Kadandha me maadhamdhaan iru thalaivargalum sandhithu pesinar. Aaru maadhangalukkul meendum sandhithu pesuvadhu mukkiyathuvam vaayndhadhaaga karudhappadugiradhu.
Rashyaavidam irundhu kachaa enney vaangum China, India ullitta naadugalukku, 100 sadhaveedham vari vidhithu, Trump sameevathil utharavu pirappithaar.
Idharku jinbing kadumaiyaaga edhirppu therivithirundhaar. Adhu kurithum vivaadhikkappadum endru edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Melum, thaivaanai than kattuppaattil ulla naadaaga China koori varugiradhu. Adhe nerathil, thaivaanukku raanuva udhavigalai America seygiradhu.
Idhai niruthumbadi jinbing valiyuruthuvaar endru koorappadugiradhu.
India-vin thittathukku aadharavu!
Kadandha 2023l pudhudilliyil nadandha, ji - 20 uchi maanaattin podhu, piradhamar narendhira Modi oru thittathai arivithaar. India - merkaasiya naadugal - airoppaavai inaikkum porulaadhaara vazhidhadathai uruvaakkuvadhe adhan nokkamaagum. Kappal, railway, saalaip pokkuvarathu moolam, indha naadugalukku idaiye inaippai erpaduthuvadhe idhan piradhaana nokkamaagum.
Innilaiyil, niyooyaarkkil netru mundhinam nadandha, valaigudaa kootturavu kavunsil matrum aravu naattuth thalaivargaludanaana uyarmatta aalosanaik koottathil, America adhivar tonaaldu Trump pangetraar.
Appodhu pesiya avar, merkaasiyaavil sengadal matrum haarmus jalasandhi kappal vazhithadangalil Iran matrum adhan aadharavup padaigalin thaakkudhalgal adhigarithu varugiradhu.
Indhap pirasnaikku India - merkaasiyaa - airoppaa porulaadhaara peruvazhippaadhai thittathai, America miga valuvaaga aadharippadhaaga avar therivithaar. 
Eeraanudan pechu Iran veliyuravu amaichar appaas araksi, America adhivarin sirappu thoodhar steev vitkaappai ragasiyamaaga sandhithu pesinaar.
Kathaar naattin thoodhar moolamaaga, 3 mani neram indha marai mugap pechu needithadhu. Haarmus jalasandhiyai meendum thirakka, America than kadarpadai mutrugaiyai udanadiyaaga vilakkikkolla vendum, ullitta sila mukkiya nivandhanaigalai Iran munvaithulladhu
Ukraine por mudivukku vara vaayppu! Aikkiya naadugal savaiyin podhuchavai koottathil pangerpadharkaaga, niyooyaark vandhulla Ukraine adhivar volodimir jelansgi, America adhivar tonaaldu tirambai netru sandhithup pesinaar. Adhan pin, seythiyaalargalidam pesiya Trump, por nirutham kurithu Russia adhivar vilaadimir pudinudan palamurai pesiyiruppadhaagavum, nalla vishayam viraivil nadakkum endrum therivithaar.
America-vin aadharavukku nandri therivitha jelansgi, viraivil indhap porai mudivukku konduvara vendum enbadhe Ukraine-in viruppam endraar.

headline: “piditha computer mozhi samasgirudham” endru kalgodiyaas palgalaikkazhaga maanavar koorinaaraa?
text:
Piditha computer mozhi edhu endru kettavodhu kalgodiyaas palgalaikkazhaga maanavar samasgirudham endru kooriyadhaaga oru padhivu

news card vadivil padhivu veliyaagi ulladhu. Adhil, “piditha computer LANGUAGE edhu? Samasgirudham ena padhilalitha vadamaanila maanavan!” “uthiraviradhesam GALGOTIAS UNIVERSITY-yai serndha oru maanavar, telliyil nadaivetra AI IMPACT maanaattil kalandhugondaar. Angu nadandha nergaanalil, “ungalukku migavum piditha computer lengkvej edhu?” endra kelvi ezhuppappattadhu. Adharku andha maanavar thannambikkaiyudan “samasgirudham” ena padhilalithaar. Indha padhil angu irundhavargalai aachariyappaduthiyadhodu, samooga valaidhalangalilum vegamaaga viral-aagi varugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sameevathil seyarkai nunnarivu (eai) maanaadu ondrai telliyil Indhiya arasu nadathiyadhu. Idhil seenaavilirundhu vaangappatta rovovai kalgodiyaas palgalaik kazhagam kaatchikku vaithirundhadhu migapperiya thalaigunivai erpaduthiyadhu. Indha nilaiyil andha palgalaik kazhaga maanavar oruvaridam piditha computer mozhi edhu endru kettavodhu avar samasgirudham endru padhil alithadhaaga palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. News card-il idam petrirundha kaatchiyai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediyavodhu andha video namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil kalgodiyaas palagalaik kazhaga maanavar oruvar velaikkaana nergaanalil alitha padhil endru kurippittirundhanar. Unmai video-vai kandariyath thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai sreyaas manogar (Shreyas Manohar) endra staandap kaamediyan oruvar pipravari 9, 2026l indha video-vai padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Eai maanaadu pipravari 16m thedhi thaan thodangiyadhu. Andha maanaattil China-vin rovovai thangaludaiya kanduvidippaaga kalgodiyaas palgalaik kazhagam vaithirundhadhu pirasnai aana nilaiyil andha staant ap kaamediyan sreyaas manogar thannudaiya andha pazhaiya video-vai edit seythu kalgodiyaas palgalaikkazhaga maanavar padhil endru maatri pipravari 19m thedhiyum padhivittirundhaar.
Avaradhu instaagiraam pakkathil idhe video-vai avar padhivittirundhaar. Adhil. “(nagaichuvaikkaaga)indhiyaa eai sammit 2026 il oru velai nergaanalil kalgodiyaas palgalaikkazhaga maanavar kalandhu konda kaatchigal kasindhana (nagaichuvai) endru kurippittirundhaar. Idhan moolam idhu naiyaandikkaaga veliyidappatta video enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Ellorum kalgodiyaas palgalaik kazhagathai vimarsithu varum soozhalil, andha palgalaik kazhagathai naiyaandi seyyum vagaiyil tharpodhulla soozhalai payanbaduthi adhiga veeyoos peruvadharkaaga ivar pazhaiya video-vai kalgodiyaas peyaril veliyittu piravalappaduthi varuvadhu therigiradhu.
Indha video eai maanaadu nadappadharku munbaagave YouTube-il veliyaagi ulladhu. Video-vil ulla navar thaan oru staandap kaamediyan endru therivithullaar. Avaradhu samooga oodaga pakkangalil pala aandugalaaga avar staandap kaamedi seythu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Melum, idhu naiyaandikkaaga endru avar urudhi seythullaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil thanakku piditha computer mozhi samasgirudham endru kalgodiyaas palgalaik kazhaga maanavar kooriyadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Es.ai.aar | Stalin, mamdhaa tholvi.. Sandhegam kilappiya avijith thipge!!
text:
SIR enappadum sirappu vaakkaalar pattiyal theevirath thirutham thodarbaaga therdhal aanaiyathukkul karuthu veruvaadu erpattadhaaga veliyaana thagaval, arasiyal vattaarathil pudhiya paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Indhiyan eksbiras veliyitta thagavalinbadi, thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaaneshgumaar matra aanaiyargalaana, sukbeer sing sandhu matrum vivek joshi aagiya iruvaridam, kadandha 10 maadhangalil palveru mudivugal thodarbaaga kuraindhadhu 14 murai aatchevanai therivithirundhadhudan, avar ragasiyamaaga seyalbattadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu.
Idhaiyaduthuthu, SIR nadavadikkaiyaal vaakkaalar pattiyalil perum kularuvadigal erpattadhaagavum, needhimandra utharavugalum purakkanikkappattadhaagavum koori, thesiya katchigal matrum maanila katchigal thalaimai therdhal aanaiyarai neekki, SIR nadavadikkaigalai nirutha vendum ena korugindrana.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, indha vivagaaram kurithup pesiyulla karappaan janadhaa katchiyin niruvanar avijith thipge, Tamil Naattil munnaal mudhalvar Stalin tholvi matrum merku vangathil mamdhaa paanarjiyin thirinaamul Congress katchiyin tholvi kurithum kelvi ezhuppiyullaar.
Telliyil nadaivetra seythiyaalar sandhippil pesiyirukkum avijith thipge, therdhal aanaiyathin seyalbaadugal kurithu kadumaiyaana kutrachaattugalai munvaithaar. Kurippaaga, vaakkaalar pattiyalil peyargalai neekkuvadhu matrum therdhal nadaimuraigalil muraigedugal nadaiveruvadhaaga avar kutramsaattinaar. Melum, vaakkalikkum urimai jananaayagathin adippadaiyaana urimai endrum, yaar vaakkalikkalaam enbadhai theermaanikkum adhigaaram thavaraagap payanbaduthappaduvadhaagavum avar vimarsithaar. Njaanesh kumaar padhavi vilagaavittaal, Delhi mattumindri naadu muzhuvadhum poraattam nadathappadum endrum avijith thipge echarithullaar.
Thodarndhu pesiya avar, ”es.ai.aar. Peyaril merku vangathil mamdhaa paanarjiyin thogudhiyil irundhu 50,000 vaakkugal neekkappattana; avar sumaar 15,000 vaakkugal vithiyaasathil tholviyadaindhaar. Mu.ka. Staalinin thogudhiyil 1 latcham vaakkugal neekkappattana; avar sumaar 8,000 vaakkugal vithiyaasathil tholviyadaindhaar. Ivvaaru, paajagavai theeviramaaga edhirtha Stalin, mamdhaa aagiyor aduthaduthu thorkadikkappattullanar. Paajagavai edhirthavargal aduthaduthu thorkadikkappattadhu edhechaiyaanadhu alla. Palam vaayndha maanila katchigalai aduthaduthu thorkadippadhe BJP-yin thittamaaga irundhadhu enak kutranjjaattiyullaar.
Adhesamayam, thanakku endhak katchiyin meedhu patru illai enak kooriya avar, or jananaayagathil, ottumotha edhirkkatchiyaiyum ozhithuvittaal, adhai innum jananaayagam endru azhaikka mudiyumaa? Enavum kelvi ezhuppiyirukkiraar.

headline: Nidhi matrum paniyaalar patraakkurai.. Kavalaikkidathil Chennai maanagaraatchi!!
text:
Chennai maanagaraatchi padhinaindhu mandalangalaagavum, irunooru vaardugalaagavum pirikkappattu iyangi varugiradhu. Maanagaraatchiyin motha vari varuvaayil sothu vari 63 sadhaveedhamum, thozhil vari 19 sadhaveedhamum, payanbaadugal moolam 11 sadhaveedhamum matrum idhara varuvaay moolam 7 sadhaveedhamum kidaikkiradhu. Maanagaraatchiyil 13 latchathu 80 aayirathukkum adhigamaana kattadangal vari seluthum thagudhiyil irundhaalum, 8 latchathukkum kuraivaana kattadangalukke vari vasoolikkappaduvadhaaga theriyavarugiradhu.
Saalai membaadu, poongaakkal, ammaa unavagam, kaalai unavuth thittangal, podhukkazhipparaigal matrum maamandra uruppinargalukkaana vaardu membaattu nidhi pondra palveru thittangalaal varavai vida selavu panmadangu adhigarithulladhu. 2022 - 2023-m aandil 3aayirathu 581 kodi roobaayaaga irundha selavinangal, 2024 - 2025-m nidhi aandil 5 aayirathu 676 kodiyaaga roobaayaaga uyarndhu kadumaiyaana nidhip patraakkuraiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Maanagaraatchiyin tharpodhaiya varavu 5 aayirathu 214 kodi roobai endra nilaiyil, selavu 5 aayirathu 676 kodi roobaayaaga ulladhu. Kadandha pipravariyil meyar piriyaa 700 kodi roobai madhippilaana 96 pudhiya thittangalai arivithaar. Aanaal, kadum nidhip patraakkurai kaaranamaaga maamandra uruppinargalin vaardu membaattu nidhiyaikkooda vazhanga mudiyaamal, pudhiya thittangalais seyalbadutha nidhiyindri maanagaraatchi thavithu varugiradhu. Maanagaraatchiyil 18 aayirathu 600 paniyaalargal irukka vendiya idathil, tharpodhu 12 aayirathu 700 per mattume paniyaatrugindranar.
Nirandhara thooymaip paniyaalargal 5 aayirathu 96 perukkup padhilaaga 3 aayirathu ennootru iruvathezhu per mattume ullanar. Melum, 2027-m aandil 800kkum merpattor oyvu peravulladhaal paniyaalar patraakkurai melum theeviramadaiyum. Maanagaraatchikku 1,970 kodi roobai nidhip patraakkurai iruppadhai maamandrak koottathil velippadaiyaagath therivithulladhaagavum, nidhi nerukkadiyilum makkalukkuth thevaiyaana adippadaith thittangal thodarndhu seyalbaduthappadum endrum Chennai maanagaraatchi aanaiyar therivithullaar.

headline: `parandhoor aruge madhuramangalathil pudhiya sipgaat thozhil poongaa' - Thamizhaga arasu edutha mudivu!
text:
Parandhoor aruge madhuramangalathil pudhiya sipgaat poongaa amaikka arasu thittamittirukkiradhu.
Kaanjjivuram maavattam parandhooril amaiyavirundha Chennaiyin 2-vadhu pudhiya pasumai vimaana nilaiyath thittathirku appagudhi vivasaayigalum eganaavuram makkalum kadum edhirppu therivithup poraattathil eeduvattu vandhanar. Vivasaaya nilangal matrum neernilaigal paadhikkappaduvadhais suttikkaatti nilaviya indha edhirppugalukku idaiye, aatchi maatrathirkup pin mudhalamaichar josap Vijay thalaimaiyilaana TVK arasu, parandhoor vimaana nilaiyath thittathai adhiradiyaaga rathu seythu sattasavaiyil arivithadhu.
Mundhaiya aatchiyil parandhoor vimaana nilaiyath thittathirkaaga nilangal kaiyagappaduthum nadavadikkaigal thodangappattirundhana. Thittam rathu seyyappattadhaith thodarndhu, kaiyagappaduthappatta nilangalai maatrup payanbaattirku kondu varavum, adhe velaiyil appagudhiyil thozhil valarchiyai ookkuvikkavum arasu mudivu seythirundhadhu.
Idharkidaiyil, parandhoor aruge irukkum madhuramangalam 'e' kiraamathil pudhiya sipgaat (SIPCOT) minnanu matrum semigandakdar (Semiconductor) urpathith thozhirpoongaavai amaikka arasu thittamittulladhu. Sarvadhesa alavil semigandakdar thuraiyil adhigarithu varum mudhaleedugalai eerkkum vagaiyil, madhuramangalathil roo.175 kodi madhippeettil indha thozhirpoongaa uruvaakkappada ulladhu. Sameevathil sattasavaiyil 110-vadhu vidhiyin keezh mudhalamaichar veliyitta arivippinbadi, ingu urpathi mattumallaamal aaraaychi matrum membaattu nadavadikkaigalum merkollappada ulladhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Idhan moolam neradiyaagavum maraimugamaagavum sumaar 5,000 perukku velaivaayppugal uruvaagum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Indha thittathirkaaga sreeverumbudhoor thaalugaa, madhuramangalam 'e' kiraamathil 103 sarve engalukku utbatta sumaar 8.3820 hekder 'punjjai' nilangalaik kaiyagappaduthuvadhu thodarbaana adhigaarappoorva arivippaith Tamil Nadu thozhil nokkangalukkaaga nilam kaiyagappaduthudhal sattam 1997-n keezh nila nirvaaga aanaiyar matrum koodudhal thalaimais seyalaalar raajesh lakkaani veliyittullaar. Adhil thaninavar manaigal, kaali nilangal, e.vi.aar. Puropparttees ullitta niruvanangalin nilangal, thevaalaya arakkattalai nilam matrum panjjaayathu idangal adangum.
Indha nilangalil amaindhulla kilinik, kadaigal, aazhdhulaik kinarugal, kambavunt suvargal matrum vembu, thennai, panai, maa pondra marangalukkum thagundha izhappeettuth thogaiyais sipgaat melaanmai iyakkunar vazhanguvaar ena arivikkappattulladhu. Nilak kaiyagappaduthudhal thodarbaana varaivadangal matrum vivarangal kaanjjivuram sirappu maavatta varuvaay aluvalar (nila eduppu) matrum sreeverumbudhoor sirappu vattaatchiyar aluvalagangalil podhumakkal paarvaikkaaga vaikkappattullana. Nila urimaiyaalargal matrum podhumakkal velai naatkalil neril sendru aavanangalais sarivaarthuk kollalaam enavum andha arikkaiyil therivikkavapttirukkiradhu.

headline: Aambulans thaamadham... Idindhu vizhundha merkoorai... Maruthuvargal patraakkurai!
text:
Vaadippatti arasu maruthuvamanaiyin avalanilai!
Aambulans thaamadhathaal uyirizhappu... Pinavaraiyil fireesar paaks illai... Podhiya maruthuvargal illai... Ivai podhaadhendru merkooraiyum idindhu vizhundhirukkiradhu! Madurai maavattam, vaadippatti arasu maruthuvamanaiyais sutri aduthaduthu ezhum pugaargal, `thaalugaa maruthuvamanaikke indha nilaiyaa?’ endra kelviyai ezhuppiyirukkindrana. Enna nadakkiradhu ange?
‘`10 nimidangalil aambulans vandhirundhaal...’’
idhu kurithu vaadippattiyais serndha paalagirushnan nammidam, “kadandha vaaram vaadippatti mettuneerethaan pagudhiyais serndha karunaanidhi enbavar meedhu, car modhi vivathaanadhu. 11 manikku nadandha vivathil 12 mani varai kaathirundhum aambulans varaadhadhaal, kadaisiyil oru tembovil avarai vaadippatti maruthuvamanaikkuk konduvogumbodhu, vazhiyileye uyir pirindhuvittadhu. Vivathu nadandha 10 nimidangalukkul aambulans kidaithirundhaal uyiraik kaappaatriyirukkalaam.
Avarudaiya udalai postmaarttam araiyil vaikka fireesar paaks kidaiyaadhu. Sila samayam veliyilirundhu vaadagaikku eduthu varuvom. Adhaik kondu vandhaalum vaikka idamillai. Irandu udalgalukku mel ange vaikka mudiyaadhadhu. Sariyaana taakdargalum illai. Ore oru doctor mattum irundhaar. Avaridam kettaal, `naan oru aal mattum enna seyya mudiyum?’ engiraar.
``endhap pirasnaiyaaga irundhaalum madhuraikkup ponga!’’
marunaal vinaayagar sadhurthi. Erkenave naangu udalgal irundhana. Vandhirundha makkalukku irukkavo, padukkavo, saappidavo, kazhipparai ullitta endha vasadhiyum kidaiyaadhu. Vaadippatti arasu maruthuvamanaiyil maruthuvargal patraakkurai neendagaalamaaga irukkiradhu. Vidumurai naalgalil iravu nerathil yaarume iruppadhu kidaiyaadhu. Idhu oru thaalugaa alavilaana mukkiyamaana maruthuvamanai. Adharkerpa maruthuvamanaiyai virivaakkam seyyavillai. Endhap pirasnaikkaaga aasbathirikkup ponaalum, `madhuraikkup ponga’ engiraargal. Aanaal, madhuraikkuk konduvoga vaagana vasadhi illai. Vaadippatti maruthuvamanaiyil oru vaaganam irukkiradhu. Aanaal, adhu eppodhu kidaikkum enbadhu theriyaadhu. Adhu illaadha nerathil sondha vandiyileyo, vaadagai vandiyileyodhaan konduvoga vendiya soozhnilai. Adhevol vaadippatti bus staandukkul poythaan maruthuvanaikkul sella mudiyum. Ore nerathil naangaindhu pasgal nindrirundhaal, emarjensikku aambulans vegamaagas sella mudiyaadhu.
Vaadippatti pagudhiyil adikkadi vivathugal nadakkindrana. Thenmaavattangalukkus sellum mukkiyamaana saalai... Adhiga pokkuvarathu... Aanaal, maruthuva vasadhigal illai. Indhak kattamaippu 40, 50 aandugalukku munbu eppadi irundhadho, adhe maadhiridhaan ippodhum irukkiradhu. Ithanai varudangalil pokkuvarathu adhigamaagi vittadhu. Vivathugalum adhigamaagivittana. Adharkerpa maruthuvamanai vasadhi mattum illai” endraar.
‘`maruthuvargal kilinikkildhaan irukkiraargal!’’
vaadippatti maruthuvamanai oozhiyargal silar, “ingulla maruthuvargal moovarum thaniyaaga kilinik nadathi varugiraargal. Perumbaalaana neram angeyedhaan irukkiraargal. Maruthuvamanaiyil irukkum tayaalisis uvagaranangalaikkooda kilinikkukku varuvavargalukku mattum payanbadutha anumadhikkiraargal. Neradiyaaga makkal vandhaal, anumadhippadhillai. Neendagaalamaaga maruthuvargalum seviliyargalum ingeye velai seyvadhaaldhaan ivvalavu pirasnaigal. Avargalai maatrinaale indhap pirasnaigal mudivukku vandhu vidum” endranar.
‘fireesar paaks vaanga nadavadikkai!’
Madurai maavatta sugaadhaarath thuraiyin inai iyakkunar raamachandhiranidam vilakkam kettom. “pinavaraiyil irandu pengal velai seygiraargal. Avargalil oruvar maatruthiranaali. Niraiya udalgal vandhaal, avatraip paadhugaappadhil sikkal irukkiradhu. Fireesar paaks vaanguvadhu patri arasukkuth therivithirukkirom. Koodiya viraivil vaangividuvom. Maruthuvargalaip pani nerathil veliye sellak koodaadhu enak kandithirukkirom. Sameevathil maruthuvamanaiyil sodhanai nadathiya amaichar arunraajum maruthuvargalai velai nerathil maruthuvamanaiyildhaan irukka vendum enas solliyirukkiraar. Avargalaik kangaanithuvarugirom. Ini thavaru seythaal thandikkappaduvaargal” endraar.
Idhu maruthuvamanaiyaa... Illai, makkalin uyirukkus sodhanaiyaa?

headline: Thangaiyai palaathgaaram seytha navarai kathiyaal kuthiya annan endra thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’aalappuzhaavil thangaiyai palaathgaaram seytha navarai kathiyaal kuthiya annan,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ sambavam 💥💥💥
aalappuzhaavil 12 vayadhu thangaiyai palaathgaaram seytha vaalivarai nadurottil vaithu kathiyaal kuthiya annan..,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan ilainjar oruvar matroru navarai kathiyaal kuthi, thaakkuvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil, naam idhuvatri Alappuzha Police Chief (DPC) aluvalagathai thodargondu vilakkam kettom. Nammidam pesiya adhigaari oruvar, ‘’idhu pazhikkup pazhi vaangum nokkil nadandha sambavamdhaan. Aanaal, samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappaduvadhu pondru, thangaikkaaga annan seytha sambavam alla. Aalappuzhaa KSRTC perundhu nilaiyam aruge kadandha joolai 31 andru nigazhndha sambavathin veediyodhaan idhu. Kannur pagudhiyai serndha riyaas enbavar ootti sendravodhu, angu padikkum keralaavais serndha 19vayadhu ilambennai sandhithullaar. Andha pennai, mayakka marundhu koduthu, riyaas palaathgaaram seythadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Idhanberil, kurippitta pennin aan nanbargal, Facebook moolamaaga saat seythu, riyaasai pazhivaangum nokkil, aalappuzhaavukku varavazhaithullanar. Angu vaithu, riyaasai kathiyaal kuthiyullanar. Idhuvatri sambandhappatta navargalai kaidhu seythu, visaarithu varugirom,’’ endru therivithaar.
Idhuvatri oodagangalilum seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
Manorama Online l Mathrubhumi l News18 Kerala
aanaal, indha vivagaaram thodarbaana video-vai eduthu, 12 vayadhu thangaiyai palaathgaaram seytha navarai pazhivaangum nokkil annan ivvaaru kathiyaal kuthiyadhaagak koori, samooga valaidhalangalil thodarchiyaagap parappugiraargal. Enave, idhuvatri Kerala State Police Media Centre saarbaaga, Facebook-il vilakkam therivikkappattulladhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video patri pagirappadum thagavalil muzhu unmaiyillai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Aazhvaar thirunagari ullitta navadhiruppadhi thalangalukku sirappu arasu pasgal iyakkam
text:
Thirunelveli:navaraathiri vizhaavaiyotti, Tirunelveli pudhiya bus staandil irundhu aazhvaar thirunagari ullitta navadhiruppadhi thalangalukku sirappu arasu pasgal iyakkappadugindrana.varum 19, 26m thedhi matrum ak., 3, 10, 17m thedhigalil kaalai 6:30 manikku sirappu pasgal purappadum.
Indha pasgal thiruvaigundam, natham, thiruppuliyangudi, irattai thiruppadhi, perungulam, thendhirupperai, thirupporoor matrum aazhvaar thirunagari vazhiyaaga sirappu perundhugalaaga iyakkappadum.arasu pokkuvarathuk kazhagathin inaiyathalam moolam munbadhivu seyyalaam. Payana kattanam roo.500 mattume.
Sirappu pasgalai podhumakkal payanbaduthik kollalaam ena arasu pokkuvarathuk kazhaga nirvaaga iyakkunar thiru.selvam therivithullaar.

headline: Hamaasin thaakkudhal echarikkai.. Nedhanyaaguvukku vandha thagaval.. Marutha arasu.. Sarchaiyil Israel!
text:
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
Israel piradhamar penjjamin nedhanyaaguvukku, 2023-aam aandu akdovar 7-aam thedhi nadandha hamaas thaakkudhal kurithu mungoottiye echarikkai kidaithadhaa endra kelvi ezhundhulladhu. Thaakkudhalukku sumaar 10 naatkalukku munbu, hamaas periya alavilaana thaakkudhalukku thayaaraagi varuvadhaaga aikkiya aravu ameeragam echarithadhaaga Israel naalidhazhaana haarets (Haaretz) veliyitta seythiyil koorappattulladhu.
Hamaas amaippin appodhaiya thalaivar yaahyaa sinvaar, migapperiya thaakkudhal ondrai nadathath thayaaraagi varuvadhaaga paalasdheena munnaal adhigaari oruvaridam therivithadhaaga andhas seythiyil kurippidappattulladhu. Indha thagaval pinnar aikkiya aravu ameeraga adhigaarigalukku kasindhadhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Adhanbiragu, ameeraga adhivar mugamadhu pin sayeeth al nahyaan (Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan), nedhanyaaguvai thodarbugondu echarithadhaaga haarets therivithulladhu. Aanaal, nedhanyaagu aluvalagam indha thagavalai mutrilum maruthulladhu. Ameeraga adhivarudan appodhu nedhanyaagu tholaivesiyil pesave illai endrum therivikkappattulladhu.
Innilaiyil, indha vivagaaram Israel-il arasiyal sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Akdovar 7 (2023) thaakkudhalukku mun kidaitha echarikkaigalai nedhanyaagu purakkanithadhaaga edhirkkatchith thalaivargal kutramsaatti varugindranar. Munnaal raanuva thalavadhiyum nedhanyaaguvin arasiyal pottiyaalarumaana kaadi aisangot (Gadi Eisenkot), thaakkudhal kurithu pala echarikkaigal kidaithum avai purakkanikkappattadhaaga kutramsaattiyullaar.
Munnaal piradhamar napdhaali pennattum, (Naftali Bennett) akdovar 7 uyirizhappugalukku nedhanyaaguve neradi poruppu endru kooriyullaar. Avar udanadiyaaga padhavi vilaga vendum endrum valiyuruthiyullaar. 2023 akdovar 7-m thedhi hamaas thalaimaiyilaana aayudhakkuzhukkal therku Israel-il periya alavilaana thaakkudhalai nadathina. Idhil 1,221 per kollappattadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Melum, 251 per panayakkaidhigalaaga kaasaavukku kondu sellappattanar.
Idharkup padhilaaga Israel kaasaavil migapperiya raanuva nadavadikkaiyaith thodangiyadhu. Kaasaa, sugaadhaara amaichagathin kanakkuppadi, idhuvarai 73,658 per uyirizhandhullanar.
Indha vivagaaram, nedhanyaaguvin arasiyal edhirgaalathilum thaakkathai erpaduthi varugiradhu. Sameevathiya karuthukkanippil, edhirkkatchith thalaivar kaadi aisangottin katchikku 23 idangalum, nedhanyaaguvin ligut katchikku 20 idangalum kidaikkum ena kanikkappattulladhu.
Eninum, endhak katchikkum aatchi amaikka thevaiyaana 61 idangal kidaikkaadhu ena karuthukkanippu therivikkiradhu. Idhanaal siriya katchigalin aadharavu adutha arasai amaippadhil mukkiyap pangu vagikkalaam ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.

headline: Nakkeeran kovaal meedhu vazhakku padhivu seyyappattadhai Tamil Nadu digital oodagaviyalaalar sangam varavetradhaa?
text:
‘‘nakkeeran kovaal meedhu vazhakku padhivu seyyappattadhai varavetra Tamil Nadu digital oodagaviyalaalar sangam,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ nakkeeran kovaal avargal meedhu vazhakkup padhivu seythadhai TNDJU varaverkiradhu,’’ endru thalaippittu, arikkai ondrai pagirndhullanar.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu TNDJU peyaril paravum poliyaana arikkai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, TNDJU saarbil nakkeeran kovaal meedhu vazhakkup padhivu seyyappatta vivagaarathil erkanave kandanam therivikkappattulladhu. Indha soozhalil, vendumendre idhuvondra poliyaana arikkai pagirappaduvadhaaga, TNDJU nirvaagigalil oruvar vilakkam alithullaar.
Melum, TNDJU veliyitta unmaiyaana arikkai keezhe inaikkappattulladhu.
Merkanda arikkaiyai edit seythu, vendumendre vadhandhi parappugiraargal, enbadhu idhanmoolam thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda arikkai poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 16m thedhi thiruppooril sarvadhesa pinnalaadai kangaatchi; 38 naadugalin varthagargal pangerpu: e.i.pi.si. Azhaippu
text:
Tiruppur: Indhiya sarvadhesa pinnalaadai sangathin (ai.ke.ep.e.,) saarbil aadai etrumadhi membaattuk kuzhu (e.i.pi.si.,) othuzhaippudan, 53-vadhu sarvadhesa pinnalaadai kangaatchi varum, 16m thedhi thiruppooril thuvangugiradhu.
Idhugurithu, e.i.pi.si., matrum India nitber sangathin thalaivar sakdhivel kooriyadhaavadhu:
kadandha, 30 aandugalukkum melaaga ai.ke.ep.e., vetrigaramaaga, 52 sarvadhesa kangaatchigalai nadathiyulladhu. Indhaandin, 53-vadhu kangaatchi 'seyarkai izhai aadaigalil pudhumai matrum nilaiyaana valarchi moolamaaga peshanin edhirgaalam' endra maiyak karupporuludan nadaiverugiradhu. Varum, sep., 16 mudhal 18m thedhi varai moondru naatkal ai.ke.ep.e., valaagathil kangaatchi nadathappada ulladhu.
Indha kangaatchiyil thiruppoorudan serthu Kovai, Erode, karoor, Chennai, pengalooru, mumbai, mohaali, noydaa, loodhiyaanaa ullitta India-vin palveru mukkiya javuli urpathi maiyangalais serndha aadai thayaarippaalargal matrum etrumadhiyaalargal perumalavil pangerkindranar. Innigazhvukku, e.i.pi.si., Tiruppur etrumadhiyaalargal sangam matrum e.es.i.e., aagiya amaippugal aadharavu alithullana.
Idhudhavira, e.pi.e.ti., pi.e.e., pi.es.el., sarvadhesa amaippugaludan purindhunarvu oppandhangal seyyappattu varthagargalukku azhaippu vidukkappattulladhu. Kangaatchi kurithu ulagalavil pirasaaram seyya, 'paarath teks 2026, jappaanin tokkiyovil nadaivetra kangaatchi, America-vin laasvegaasil nadaivetra mejik per matrum maasgo aagiya naadugalil nadandha munnani sarvadhesa varthaga nigazhvugalil vilambaram seyyappattulladhu.
Idhan palanaaga America, ingilaandhu, Japan, indhonesiyaa, nedharlaandhu, ilangai, aikkiya aravu ameeragam, morishiyas, jimbaapve, kanadaa ullitta pala naadugalais serndha munnani kolmudhal mugavargal matrum varthagargal kangaatchiyil pangerpadhai urudhi seythullanar.
Saadhagamaana soozhal
India tharpodhu, 38 naadugaludan seythu kondulla thadaiyillaa varthaga oppandhangal, Indhiya aadai etrumadhiyaalargalukku ulagalavil migapperiya vaayppugalai erpaduthiyullana. Sameevathil amalukku vandha India -- ingilaandhu oppandham matrum viraivil kaiyezhuthaagavulla airoppiya yooniyan udanaana oppandham aagiyavai moolam, ulaga makkal thogaiyil erathaazha, 65 sadhaveedha sandhaiyai Indhiya javulithurai elidhil sendradaiya vazhivagukkum.
Enave, idhuvaraiyillaadha vagaiyil, indha kangaatchi ulaga varthagargalin kavanathai eerkkum vagaiyil irukkum ena, edhirbaarkkirom. Maavatta poruppu amaichar arunraaj, em.el.e., sathiyavaamaa aagiyor kangaatchiyai thuvakki vaikkavullanar.ivvaaru, avar koorinaar.
Innigazhchiyil, Tiruppur etrumadhiyaalargal sanga thalaivar suppiramaniyan, e.i.pi.si., seyarkuzhu uruppinargal ilangovan, thirukkumaran, mezhi selvan, kumaar thuraisaami utbada palar pangetranar.

headline: “vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirathil muraigedu seyvom” endru velippadaiyaaga amithshaa arivithaaraa?
text:
Neengal Congress-ukku ottup pottaalum adhu Congress-ukku pogaadhu endru velippadaiyaaga minnanu vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirathil muraigedu seyyappadum endra arthathil amithshaa pesiyadhaaga oru padhivu

iru veru news kaardugalai ondru serthu ore padhivaaga Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Mudhal news card-il, “vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirangal thayaarikkum niruvanathil BJP nirvaagigal” endru irundhadhu. Adutha news card-il, “neenga Congress-ukku ottu pottaalum adhu kangirasukku pogaadhu poogambathai kilappiya amith shaa” endru irundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vaakkup padhivu iyandhiram thayaarikkum niruvanathil BJP nirvaagigal iruppadhu thodarbaana seythiyaiyum, Congress katchikku vaakkalithaal adhu Congress katchikku sellaadhu endru amithshaa kooriya seythiyaiyum ondru serthup padhivittullanar. Idhan moolam vaakkup padhivu iyandhirathil muraigedu seythullom endru amithshaa velippadaiyaaga oppudhal vaakkumoolam alithadhu pondra thotrathai erpaduthugiradhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Thandhi TV veliyitta seythiyai thedi eduthom. Adhil, thelangaanaavil piaares (munbu tiaares) katchikkum Congress katchikkum idaiye ragasiya udanbaadu ulladhu. Idhanaal Congress katchikku alikkum vaakku piaares katchikku sellum endru amithshaa koorinaar endru kurippittirundhanar. Congress katchikku vaakkalithaal adhu piaares katchikku saadhagamaaga maarividum endru amithshaa kooriyadhai makkalai kavarvadharkaaga vithiyaasamaana thalaippu vaikka vendum endru thandhi TV vaithulladhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan moolam vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirathil muraigedu seyyath thittam endru amithshaa kooravillai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Aduthadhaaga vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirangal thayaarikkum niruvanathil BJP nirvaagigal endra seythiyai thedi eduthom. Andha seythiyai kalainjar seythigal TV veliyittirundhadhu. Avargal veliyittirundha YouTube video-vin mugappu pakkamaaga andha news card irundhadhu. Minnanu vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirangalai thayaarikkum paarath elektraaniks niruvanathin 7 iyakkunargalil BJP nirvaagigal 4 per iruppadhaaga thagaval ariyum urimais sattathin keezh thagaval kidaithadhaaga andha seythiyil kurippittirundhanar.
Ajay pos enbavar thagaval ariyum urimais sattathin keezh petradhu thodarbaana X thala padhivaiyum thedi eduthom. Idhan moolam minnanu vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirathil muraigedu seythu Congress katchikku podum ottu akkatchikkus sellaamal seythuviduvom endra arthathil amithshaa pesiyadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kujaraathil mosamaana saalai kaaranamaaga kavizhndha auto endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kujaraathil piradhamar Modi amaitha mosamaana saalaiyil kavizhndha auto endru oru video

saalaiyil thengiya neeril maraindhirundha siriya pallam kaaranamaaga auto kavizhndha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattulladhu. Video-vin meedhu viral video endru kurippittu indhiyil ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “#kujaraath : thinamum #uranga kooda #neram illaamal odikkondu irukkum #aattokkalukku…
Automatic kaaga #aattokkal paduthu thoonguvadharku #rodugalai pottu ullaar… karunai ulla #piradhamar Modi ji” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kujaraathil kana mazhai peythu paadhippai erpaduthiyadhu. Indha nilaiyil saalaiyil thengiya mazhai neeril sellum podhu auto kavizhndha video ondrai eduthu, kujaraathil Modi amaitha saalai endru kurippittu palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha video kujaraathais saarndhadhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha vivathu utharappiradhesa maanilam vaaranaasiyil nadandhadhaaga veliyaana padhivugal namakku kidaithana. Aagast mudhal vaarathil instaagiraamil palarum indha video-vai padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Indha sambavam vaaranaasiyildhaan nadandhadhaa enbadhai urudhi seythugolla aayvaith thodarndhom. Instaavil veliyaana pala padhivugalai paarthom. Adhil ondril indha sambavam vaaranaasiyin sidhaaybooril (Chitaipur) nadandhadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhan adippadaiyil koogul mep-l andha kurippitta idathai thedinom. Video-vil idam petrirundha kadaigalin peyarai vaithuth thediya podhu andha idathai kandarindhom.
Kadaisiyaaga andha video-vil irundha indhi vaarthaigalai koogul lens udhaviyudan mozhi peyarthom. Adhil “vairalaana video vaaranaasiyil ulla sithaaybooril irundhu varugiradhu” endru irundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha sambavam kujaraathil nadandhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Indha padhivai veliyittavar thanakku indhi theriyavillai endraalum adhil enna sollappattulladhu endru koogul lens udhaviyudan mozhi peyarthu paarthirundhaale thavarai thavirthirukkalaam.
Kujaraath matrum utharappiradhesam ena irandu maanilangalilum BJP thaan aatchiyil ulladhu. Vaaranaasi naadaalumandra uruppinaraaga piradhamar narendhira Modi therndhedukkappattavar. Enave, sambandhappatta pagudhiyin naadaalumandra uruppinar endra vagaiyil indha padhivu muzhukka thavaraanadhu endru koorivida mudiyaadhu. Sambavam nadandha idam kujaraath endru kurippittadhu mattum thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil unmai sambavathudan paadhi thavaraana thagavalai serthup padhivittadhaaga indha padhivu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pahalgaam thaakkudhalukku amithshaa vetkappada vendum endru Annamalai koorinaaraa?
text:
Pahalgaam thaakkudhalukku mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaa vetkappada vendum endru Tamil Nadu BJP munnaal thalaivar Annamalai kooriyadhaaga oru news card

Annamalai pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondra news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “pahalgaam thaakkudhal amithshaa ji vetkappada vendum. Naadu enge selgiradhu oru sutrulaa payanigalai kaappaatha mudiyala ivargal enna aatchi seygiraargal vedhanaiyaaga irukkiradhu! – Thamizhaga BJP munnaal thalaivar annaamalai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “ippathaan neenga oru aivies adhigaari nu niroovichirukkeenga Annamalai jee !” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivaraaga irundha Annamalai mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaavai vimarsithup pesiyadhaaga news card-ai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar. Idharku vaayppe illai enbadhu namakku theriyum. Melum, news kaardin thamizh faant vazhakkamaaga pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidum news card-il ulladhu pola illai. Melum vaakkiya amaippilum pizhai ulladhu. Ivai ellaam indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Aadhaarangal adippadaiyil idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Mudhalil ippadi edhenum pettiyai Annamalai alithullaaraa endru koogulil thedinom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Amithshaavai vimarsithirundhaal adhu migapperiya seythiyaagiyirukkum. Thundu seythi kooda namakkuk kidaikkavillai.
Aduthadhaaga indha news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai enbadhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom. Adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarvaiyittom. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card illai. 2025 epral 23m thedhi naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card ondrai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittirundhadhu.
Adhil, “thagundha nerathil padhiladi kodukkappadum: Annamalai pahalgaam thaakkudhalukku mathiya arasu thagundha nerathil padhiladi kodukkum. Mathiya arasu kodukkum padhiladi migavum mukkiyamaanadhaaga irukkum. Amithshaa padhavi vilaga vendum ena pesuvavargal arasiyalukkaaga pesugiraargal” endru irundhadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku WhatsApp moolam anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaana news card enbadhai urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil pahalgaam thaakkudhal sambavam thodarbaaga amithshaa vetkappada vendum endru Annamalai kooriyadhaagap paravum thagaval matrum news card thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: PMK magalir maanaattil anbumaniyai keli seythu postar kaattappattadhaa?
text:
‘’PMK magalir maanaattil anbumaniyai keli seythu postar kaattappattadhu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ adey 😁😁 IF YOU ARE BAD IAM YOUR DAD 🔥🔥
#ayyaavin_magalirmaanaadu #DrAyya4_WomensRights,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan PMK thondargal silar raamadhaaskku aadharavaaga postar ondrai kaiyil endhiyavadi nirpadhu pondra pugaippadam ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil, naam idhudhodarbaaga PMK thalaivar ji.ke.mani aluvalagathai thodarbugondu visaarithom. Avargal, ‘’idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, idhuvondra penar, postar edhuvum poombugaaril nadaivetra PMK magalir maanaattil kaattappadavillai,’’ endru therivithanar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, kuritha pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru thediyavodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta padam, enbadharkaana aadhaaram kidaithadhu.
Unmaiyaana pugaippadathaiyum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadathaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Thatsamayam, paamaga.,vil raamadhaaskkum, avaradhu magan anbumanikkum idaiye modhal vedithulladhu. Yaar thalaimaiyil PMK iyanga vendum endru iruvarum vittuk kodukkaamal, karuthu modhalil eeduvattullanar. Ithagaiya soozhalil, poombugaaril, PMK magalir ani maanaattai, raamadhaas thaniyaaga nadathiyullaar. Andha maanaattil anbumani pangerkavillai. Maruvuram, anbumani aadharavu thirattum perani nadathi varugiraar. Idhanaal, unmaiyaana PMK thalaimai yaar endra kelvi ezhundhulladhu. Ithagaiya soozhalil, IF YOU THINK YOU ARE BAD I AM YOUR DAD endra pugaippadathai raamadhaas aadharavaalargal kaattiyadhaaga, samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Evuganaith thaakkudhal moolam America-vukku padhiladi kodutha Russia endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Rashyak kodiyudan vandha enney tengar kappalai America kaippatriyadharku padhiladiyaaga, evuganai moolam amerikkaavai achuruthiya Russia endru oru video

neermoozhgik kappalil irundhu evuganaigal seluthappadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “tengar kappal kaippatrappattadharkup padhiladiyaaga, Russia amerikkaavai evuganaith thaakkudhal moolam achuruthugiradhu, “oru iraanuvap padhil nadavadikkai avasiyam: taarbidokkalaal thaakkudhal nadathi, pala amerikkak kappalgalai moozhgadikka vendum,” — endru Russia-vin stet tumaa uruppinaraana ‘aleksi juraavliyov” koorinaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Russia enney tengar kappalai America kaippatriyadharku padhiladiyaaga, Russia evuganaith thaakkudhalai nadathiyadhu pondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Aanaal, America meedhu Russia thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Enave, pazhaiya video-vai pudhidhu pondru pagirndhirukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video 2018m aandu YouTube-il padhivetram seyyappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, “rashyaavin anusakdhi neermoozhgik kappalil irundhu kandam vittu kandam paayum tholai thoora evuganaigal parisodhanai seyyappattadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thediya podhu, 2018m aandu me maadham Russia evuganaigalais seluthi sodhanai nadathiyadhaaga seythigalum kidaithana. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petrirundha kaatchiyin sgireenshaat pugaippadathaiyum vaithirundhanar. Idhan moolam enneyk kappalai America kaippatriyadharku padhiladiyaaga Russia nadathiya evuganaith thaakkudhal endru paravum video matrum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaanadhu.
