headline: Sothu, kadan vivarangalai thaakkal seyya arasu adhigaarigalukku utharavu
text:
Chennai: arasu adhigaarigal anaivarum thangalin sothu matrum kadan vivarangalai, varum akdovar maadhathirkul thaakkal seyya vendum endru Thamizhaga arasu utharavittulladhu. Thamizhaga arasu adhigaarigal anaivarum thangalin sothu matrum kadan vivarangalai thaakkal seyya vendum endru kadandha janavari maadham sattathirutham seyyappattadhu.
Adhanbadi, 2025m aandu tisambar 31m thedhi varaiyilaana sothu matrum kadan kuritha vivarangalai, anaithu arasu adhigaarigaluma, orunginaindha nidhi matrum manidhavala melaanmai amaippu (IFHRMS) endra inaiyadhalathin moolamaaga padhivetram seyya vendum endru Thamizhaga arasu utharavittulladhu.
Arasu adhigaarigal thangalin veedu, nilam pondra asaiyaa sothukkal matrum vaaganangal, nagaigal, vangi tevaasit thogai pondra asaiyum sothukkalin vivarangalai varum akdovar maadhathirku thaakkal seyya vendum endru therivikkappattulladhu. Melum, thangalin kadan saarndha vivarangalaiyum arasu oozhiyargal samarbikka utharavidappattulladhu.
Nirnayikkappatta kaalathirkul arikkaiyais samarppikkath thavarinaal, adhu nadathai vidhigalai meeriyadhaagak karudhappadum endrum koorappattulladhu.

headline: Usilambatti nagaraatchiyil kavunsilargal mutrugai
text:
Usilambatti: usilambatti nagaraatchiyil 24 vaardu kavunsilargal ullanar. Sila maadhangalaaga nagaraatchi kavunsilar koottam nadatha adhigaarigal munvaravillai. Veenaagum kudineer, eriyaadha theruvilakku ullitta adippadai vasadhigal kurithu kavunsilargal koottathil theermaanam niraivetrinaal thaan panigal nadathappadum endra nilai ulladhu.
Enave koottathai nadathaamal purakkanippadhaik kandithum, koottathirku erpaadu seyya marukkum nagaraatchi poriyaalar sasikkumaarai kandithum aluvalagam munbu nagaraatchi thunaith thalaivar kaang., thenmozhi thalaimaiyil 8 DMK, 9 ADMK, kavunsilargal netru kaalai 11.30 mani mudhal mutrugaip poraattathil eeduvattanar.
Ezhu mani neramaaga
needitha poraattam
 mutrugaiyil eeduvatta kavunsilargal nagaraatchi kamishanar ullitta 15 aluvalargalai veliyera vidaamal thaduthanar. Iravu 7.00 maniyalavil nagaraatchi kamishanar sangar kanesanidam samarasa pechuvaarthaiyil eeduvattanar. Poriyaalar sasikkumaarai maatra vendum, oru sila thinangalil kavunsilargal koottathai kootta vendum, vaardugalil adippadai vasadhigalai seyya vendum. Ivai nadakkavillai endraal sep.28 l, saalai mariyal poraattathil eeduvaduvom ena arivithu mutrugaip poraattathai vaavas petranar.

headline: Needhi thurai meedhu avadhooru parappum navarai kanduvidikka ret kaarnar nottees pirappikka tilli High Court utharavu
text:
Needhi thurai meedhu avadhooru parappum navarai kanduvidikka 'ret kaarnar' nottees pirappikka tilli High Court utharavu
- sirappu niruvar -
needhith thurai matrum needhimandrangalukku edhiraaga thodarchiyaaga avadhooru kutrachaattugalai munvaithu, needhimandra nadavadikkaigalukku idaiyooru vilaivithu varum aadheeshvar singaal enbavarai kanduvidithu, needhimandrathil aajarbadutha, sarvadhesa Police amaippaana, 'indarbol' moolam, 'ret kaarnar' nottees pirappikkumbadi, si.pi.ai.,kku tilli uyar Needhimandram utharavittulladhu.
Tilli uyar needhimandrathin vazhakkamaana visaaranai nadavadikkaigalil, 'video kaanbarans' moolam inaindhu, aadheeshvar singaal thodarndhu idaiyooru vilaivithaar. Inaippu palamurai thundikkappatta podhum, meendum meendum kurukkeedu seytha avar, naattin needhimandrangal kurithum, needhith thuraiyin seyalbaadugal kurithum avadhooru pesinaar.
Needhimandra nadavadikkaigalai kelikkullaakkiya aadheeshvar singaal meedhu, thaamaaga munvandhu tilli uyar Needhimandram vazhakku padhivu seythadhu. Indha vazhakku, needhivadhigal naveen saavlaa, raveendhar thudhejaa amarvil visaaranaikku vandhadhu.
Appodhu pesiya needhivadhigal, 'needhimandra nadavadikkaigalai kelikkullaakki, avadhooru kutrachaattugalai munvaitha aadheeshvar singaalai appadiye vittu vida maattom. Needhimandrathil avar aajaraavadhai urudhi seyvom' endranar.
Mathiya arasu saarbil aajaraana vazhakkarinjar amith thivaari, ''2024l, nam naattil irundhu ithaalikku aadheeshvar singaal sendraar. Adhanbin, avar nam naattukku varave illai. Tharpodhu avar endha naattil irukkiraar enbadhum theriyavillai.
''eninum, kadandha epralil visaaranaiyin podhu, avar video kaanbarans moolam inaindha ai.pi., mugavariyai aayvu seythadhil, avar America-vin kalivorniyaa maagaanathil irundhadhu kandariyappattadhu,'' endraar.
Idhanbin, needhivadhigal utharavittadhaavadhu:
needhimandrathil aadheeshvar singaal neril aajaraavadhai urudhi seyya, 'indarbol' moolam avarukku edhiraaga, 'ret kaarnar' nottees pirappikka CBI, nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Avaradhu paasbort vivarangal, video kaanbaransil inaindha ai.pi., mugavari aagiyavatrai, America-vil ulla nam thoodharaga adhigaarigalukku veliyuravu amaichagam therivikka vendum.
Avar endhendha ai.pi., mugavarigal moolam needhimandra nadavadikkaigalil inaindhaar enbadhu kurithu, tilli saivar kiraim Police visaarithu needhimandrathil arikkai samarppikka vendum. Adutha katta visaaranaiyin podhu aadheeshvar singaal neril aajaraaga vendum.
Ivvaaru utharavitta needhivadhigal, vazhakkai tisa., 9-kku othivaithanar.

headline: Vijay thalaimaiyil uruvaana koottani.. Pudhiya peyar arivippu.. Thervu seythadhu eppadi?
text:
Kadandha therdhalil, thanithuth therdhalais sandhitha Vijay-in TVK, aatchiyaik kaippatriyadhu. TVK aatchiyamaikka Congress, themudhiga, vidudhalais siruthaigal katchi, kamyoonist katchigal, madhimuga, aiyooeml aagiya katchigal DMK koottaniyilirundhu vilagi aadharavu alithana. Indha nilaiyil, Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam thalaimaiyil amaindhulla pudhiya koottanikku, ’madhachaarbatra samooneedhi vetrik koottani’ enap peyar vaikkappattulladhu.
Therdhal kaalangalil katchigal koottanigal amaippadhu enbadhu arasiyalin mukkiya amsamaaga irundhu varugiradhu. Adhu, thamizhnaattilum thodargiradhu. Andha vagaiyil, kadandha sattamandrath therdhalil DMK thalaimaiyil ‘madhachaarbatra murpokkuk koottani’ amaikkappattirundhadhu. Idhil Congress, themudhiga, vidudhalais siruthaigal katchi, kamyoonist katchigal, madhimuga, aiyooeml ullitta palveru katchigal idambetrirundhana. Maruvuram, ADMK thalaimaiyil ‘thesiya jananaayagak koottani’ endra peyaril BJP, PMK ullitta katchigal inaindhu therdhalai edhirgondana.
Indhas soozhalil, kadandha therdhalil, thanithuth therdhalais sandhitha Vijay-in TVK, aatchiyaik kaippatriyadhu. Munnadhaaga, TVK aatchiyamaikka Congress, vidudhalais siruthaigal katchi, kamyoonist katchigal, madhimuga, aiyooeml aagiya katchigal DMK koottaniyilirundhu vilagi aadharavu alithana.
Indha nilaiyil adhaith thodarum vagaiyil, akkoottani Tamil Naattil nadaivera irukkum idaitherdhalai ondraagas sandhikkavullana. Adharkaana aayatha velaigalilum akkoottanik katchigal eeduvattu vandhana. Indha nilaiyil, TVK thalaimaiyil adhan koottanik katchigalin aalosanaik koottam indru nadaivetradhu.
Indraiya koottathil mudhalvar Vijay, Congress thalaivar maanikkam thaagoor, VCK thalaivar thirumaavalavan, aiyooemel thalaivar kaadhar moytheen, madhimuga podhus seyalaalar vaigo aagiyor ullittor kalandhugondanar. Appodhu, koottanikkaana peyar arivikkappattulladhu. Adhanbadi, TVK thalaimaiyilaana koottanikku “madhachaarbatra samooganeedhi vetrik koottani” enap peyar vaikkappattulladhu. Samooganeedhi matrum madhachaarbinmai kotbaadugalai mudhanmaiyaagak kondu ikkoottanip peyar thervu seyyappattulladhaagak koorappadugiradhu.

headline: Ulaga vallarasaiye adhiravaitha thaakkudhal.. Irattaik kovura thagarppin 25-vadhu aandu!!
text:
Ulaga vallarasaiye adhiravaitha thaakkudhal.. Irattaik kovura thagarppin 25-vadhu aandu!!
2001 sepdambar 11. Kaalai 8:46 mani. Amerikkan erlains vimaanam vallarasin kambeera adaiyaalamaaga nindra ulaga varthaga maiyathin meedhu adhivayangara vegathil modhiyadhu. Karumbugaiyum neruppup pizhambugalum kilarndhezhundhana. Thodakkathil idhanai oru vivathu endre oodagangalum makkalum karudhinar. Aanaal, sariyaaga 17 nimidangal kazhithu, kaalai 9:03 manikku, matroru vimaanam arugilirundhu kovurathai thulaithadhu. Moondraavadhu vimaanam kaalai 9:37 manikku amerikkap paadhugaapputh thalaimaiyagamaana pendagan (Pentagon) kattadathin meedhu modhiyadhu. Kadathappatta naangaavadhu vimaanathil payanigal theeviravaadhigalai edhirthu poraadiyadhaal, thittamidappatta vellai maaligai alladhu naadaalumandra ilakkai adaiyamudiyaamal pensilveniyaavil thirandhaveliyil vizhundhu norungiyadhu.
Nadandhadhu vivathalla, migak kodooramaagath thittamidappatta payangaravaadhath thaakkudhal enbadhu siridhu nerathirku pinbe uraithadhu. 19 payangaravaadhigal naangu vimaanangalai ore nerathil kadathi thaakkudhalgalai arangetriyirundhanar. Irattaik kovurangal theeppatri erindhavodhu uruvaana veppam, ekguth thoongalai urukkath thodangiyadhu. Vaanuyarndhu nindra kattadangal sila manithuligalil tharaimattamaanadhu. Indhak korath thaakkudhalil 2,977 appaavigal uyirizhandhanar.
Ithaakkudhal verum kattadangalai mattum thagarkkavillai; ottumotha ulaga ozhungaiye maatri amaithadhu. Indru andha irattaik kovurangal nindra idathil, uyirizhandhavargalin peyargal porikkappatta pirammaandamaana ninaividamum arungaatchiyagamum amaikkappattullana. Manidha varalaatril marakka mudiyaadha vadukkalai vittuchendra andha naal, manidhagulathin paadhugaappinmai, thuyaram matrum saga manidhargalaik kaakkath thunindha thiyaagathin adaiyaalamaaga indrum ninaivugoorappadugiradhu.

headline: “thi.mu.ka aatchiyal kovilukku vandhavargalaith thaakkiya polees” – endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK aatchiyil kovilukku vandhavargalai Police thaakkiyadhaaga oru video padhivu

kovilil irundha poosaari ullittavargalai veliye azhaithu kaavaldhurai adhigaari oruvar pirambaal adikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “adey thiruttu thiraavidiyaa mavanungalaa naasamaathaan pogapporeengadaa #koolikkumaaradithal #themeediyaas #indhuvirodhadhimuga #200uvis *😡kandikkirom…* *idhuvola engaavadhu masoodhiyilum sarsgalilum pakdhargalai aditha vidiyovai veliyidumaa madhasaarbatra Thamizhaga kaavaldhurai…* *hindhukkal thaan thangal thavarai thiruthik kolla vendum…* *hindhu virodha arasirku ini endha kaalathilum vaakkalikkaamal..*. *indhukkal ,, thiraavida aatchiyai purakkanikka vendum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhu kovilukku vandhadhaaleye makkalai DMK aatchiyil kaavaldhurai adhigaari thaakkiyadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Indhukkal kovilukku selvadhai DMK arasu thaduppadhu pondru padhivu ulladhu. Appadi yaaraiyum thadukka vendiya avasiyam arasukku nichayam irukkaadhu. Unmaiyil appadi thaduthaal perumbaanmaiyaaga vasikkum indhukkalin ottumotha kovathaiyum sandhikka vendiyirukkum. Adharku yaarum thayaaraaga irukka maattaargal.
Video-vil oruvar koronaa endru kooruvadhaik ketka mudindhadhu. Enave, koronaa laakdavun kaalathil indha video edukkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegam ezhundhadhu. Koronaa kaalathil ellaa madha vazhivaattuthalangalukkum podhu makkal sella thadai vidhikkappattirundhadhu. Andhak kaalagattathil thozhugai nadathiyadhaaga islaamiyargal meedhu kooda Police nadavadikkai eduthirundhanar. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2020m aandu epral 3m thedhi indha video-vai oruvar padhivittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Adhil indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidavillai. “suvaami vandhu mudhal adiyai poosaarikku koduthaar” endru naiyaandiyaaga padhividappattirundhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu 2020 maars 29m thedhi YouTube-il indha video padhivetram seythirundhadhai kandarindhom.
2020m aandu maars 29m thedhi enbadhu koronaa laakdavun arivikkappattirundha neram. India muzhuvadhum muzhu ooradangai appodhudhaan piradhamar narendhira Modi arivithirundhaar. Tamil Naattil appodhu adhimuga-vin Edappadi pazhanisaamidhaan aatchiyilirundhaar. ADMK koottaniyil paajaga-vum irundhadhu. Adharku mundhaiya naadaalumandrath therdhal matrum adharku piragu vandha sattamandra therdhalil andha irandu katchigalum koottani amaithuthaan pettiyittana. Koronaa kaalathil thadaiyai meeri vazhivaadu seythavargal meedhu ADMK arasin poleesdhaan nadavadikkai eduthulladhu.
India muzhuvadhum thadaiyai meeri vazhivaattuth thalangalukkus sendravargal meedhu Police thaakkudhal nadathiyullanar. Adhu thodarbaaga 2020m aandu veliyaana video thoguppil kooda indha video idam petrirundhadhu. Indha vivarangalai ellaam maraithu indha sambavathirku DMK arasudhaan kaaranam enbadhu pol thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Russia-vil nilanadukkam erpattadhum havaay nokkis sendra sunaami alai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Russia-vil nilanadukkam erpatta piragu, havaay nokki sunaami alaigal sendra kaatchi endru oru video thoguppu

kadalil alaiyil sikki siriya padagu ondru kavizhum video ulbada 10kkum merpatta siriya veediyokkalai ondraagath thoguthu Facebook-il padhivittulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “rashyaavin kamsaatkaa theevagarpathil 8.7 paariya nilanadukkam erpatta piragu, sunaami alaigal havaay matrum Japan parandha pasivik kadarkarai nokkis selgiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Russia-vil nilanadukkam erpattadhaith thodarndhu samooga oodagangalil pazhaiya veediyokkalai vaithu padhivugal pagirappattu varugindrana. Sunaami alaigal havaay, Japan kadarkaraiyai nokkis sendra kaatchi endru kurippittu oru video thoguppu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Padagu kavizhum video kaatchiyaip pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Irandu aandugalukku munbu kaardiyan endra munnani oodagam indha video-vai YouTube-il veliyittirundhadhu. Pipravari 5, 2023m aandu veliyaana andha padhivil “migapperiya alaiyil sikkik kavizhndha siriya kappalilirundhavargalai amerikkak kadalora kaaval padai veerargal paadhugaatha kaatchi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Aduthadhaaga nilanadukkathin kaaranamaaga uyaramaana kattidam aada, uchiyilirundha makkal thadumaariya video-vai pugaippadamaaga maatrith thedinom. 2025 maars irudhiyil thaaylaandhu, miyaanmar, seenaavil erpatta nilanadukkathin podhu thaaylaandhu naattil andha video padhivu seyyappattadhaagath thagaval namakkuk kidaithadhu.
Moondraavadhaaga metro rail kulungiya video kaatchi thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Adhuvum kadandha maars maadham thaaylaandhil erpatta nilanadukkathin podhu padhivaana kaatchi enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhan moolam idhuvum Russia nilanadukkathudan thodarbudaiyadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga kadarkaraiyoram ulla pangalaa kudiyiruppugalai raatchadha alai thaakkum kaatchi thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. America-vin maasasoosetsil ulla sichuvet pagudhiyai raatchadha alaigal thaakkiyadhaaga indha video 2020m aandu maars 4m thedhi YouTube-il padhividappattirundhadhu. Pala aandugalaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varuvadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Aduthadhaaga kudiyiruppu pagudhi ondru nilanadukkathaal kulungum video-vai aayvu seythom. 2024m aandil therku Japan-il erpatta nilanadukkathin podhu andha video padhivu seyyappattadhaaga veliyaana samooga oodaga padhivugal namakkuk kidaithana.
Aduthadhaaga kadaloram ulla kattidangal meedhu raatchadha alai thaakkum video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Andha video-vai 2021m aandu me 2m thedhi sienen oodagam payanbaduthi seythi veliyittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Sienen mattumindri veru pala oodagangalilum andha video veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhaith thodarndha vandha video-kkal anaithume pazhaiya veediyokkalaagave irundhana.
Adhil sila veediyokkalil Japan-il erpatta nilanadukkam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha aandu joolai maadham mudhal vaarathil Japan-il nilanadukkam erpattadhu. Japan nilanadukka sisidivi padhivugalai thoguthu ondraaga Russia nilanadukkam endru kurippittu veliyittirundhanar.
Kadaisiyil nilanadukkam erpattavodhu adhirvugalais samaalithu maruthuvargal aruvaisigichai seytha veediyovaiyum vaithirundhanar. Adhu ondru mattume unmaiyaanadhaaga irundhadhu. Russia-vil nilanadukkam erpatta andraiya thiname anaithu oodagangalilum indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu. Nilanadukkathin podhum aruvaisigichai seytha maruthuvargalin pettiyum seythi oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhu. Indha oru video-vai thavirthu veru edhuvum Russia nilanadukkathin podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu.

headline: Piradhamar Modi nigazhchiyil shaak.. Thuppaakkiyudan nuzhaindha marma navar.. Mumbaiyil paravarappu!
text:
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
ulagin mukkiyamaana Fintech maanaadugalil ondraaga karudhappadum Global Fintech Fest endra nigazhchiyai, magaaraashdiraar maanilam, mumbai paanthraa kurlaa kaamplaksil ulla nidhaa mugesh ambaani kalaasaara maiyathil piradhamar Modi indru thodangivaithaar. Idharkaana paadhugaappu erpaadugal seyyappattirundhana. Munnadhaaga, indha nigazhchi nadaiverum idathil oruvar sandhegappadumbadi sutrith thirindhadhai Police kavanithanar. Avaraip pidithu visaarithavodhu, avarudan vandhirundha avarudaiya paadhugaavalaridam thuppaakki iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu iruvaraiyum mumbai Police pidithu visaaranai nadathinar. Pidivatta 24 vayadhaana rohan parek, thaam piradhamar aluvalagamaana PMO-vil adhigaariyaaga iruppadhaaga kooriyullaar. Aanaal, avar vaithirundha PMO adaiyaala attai poliyaanadhu enbadhu visaaranaiyil theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanaal piradhamar nigazhchi nadaiverum idathil paadhugaappu echarikkai vidukkappattadhu. Thuppaakkiyudan poli adaiyaala attaigalai vaithukkondu iruvarum nigazhchi nadaiverum idathirkul vandhadharkaana kaaranam kurithu Police visaarithu varugindranar. Indhas sambavathin theevirathai karuthil kondu, mumbai kutrappirivu Police visaaranaiyai merkondullanar. Pidivatta iruvaridamum thodarndhu visaaranai nadaivetru varugiradhu. Avargalin selbongal, adaiyaala aavanangal matrum pira porutkalum sodhanai seyyappadugindrana.
Visaaranaiyil kutrachaattugal urudhi seyyappatta piragu aduthagatta satta nadavadikkai edukkappadum endru Police therivithullanar.

headline: Aasiya vilaiyaattu haakki potti; thengoriyaavai thorkadithu India avaaram
text:
Aychi-nagoyaa: aasiya vilaiyaattu haakki pottiyil thengoriyaavai 8-2 endra kol kanakkil Indhiya ani thorkadithadhu.
Aasiya vilaiyaattu thodaral indru nadaivetra aadavar haakki pottiyil India - thengoriyaa anigal modhina. Paravarappaaga nadaivetra indhap pottiyin 4vadhu nimidathileye shayilaananth lakraa aditha kolin moolam, Indhiya thanadhu kanakkai thuvangiyadhu. Thodarndhu, 9vadhu nimidathil thilpreeth sing kol adithaar. 11vadhu nimidathil kidaitha penaaldi kaarnar vaayppai kepdan harmanpreeth sing kolaaga maatrinaar. Adhanbiragu, avishekkum thanadhu pangirku oru kolai adithaar. Idhanmoolam, pottiyin mudhal paadhiyileye Indhiya 4-0 endra kanakkil munnilai vagithadhu.
Adhanbiragu, 2vadhu kaalirudhiyil 26vadhu nimidathil thilpreeth sing meendum kolai adithaar. Idhanmoolam, mudhal paadhiyin aattanera mudivil Indhiya ani 5-0 endra kanakkil aadhikkam seluthiyadhu. Thodarndhu, 32vadhu nimidathil thilpreeth sing thannudaiya 'haat rik' kolai adithaar.
Aattathin 42 matrum 52vadhu nimidangalil thengoriyaa padhil kolgalai adithadhu. Iruppinum, Indhiya anikkaaga kadaisi nimidathil rajindhar oru kolai padhivu seythaar. Idhanmoolam, 8-2 endra kanakkil India thanadhu 3vadhu vetriyaip padhivu seythadhu.
Indhath thodararil India erkanave indhonesiyaavukku edhiraaga 13-1 endra kanakkilum, ilangaikku edhiraaga 16-1 endra kanakkilum pirammaanda vetrigalaip padhivu seythulladhu. India thanadhu aduthadutha pottigalil varum 26m thedhi jappaanaiyum, varum 28m thedhi vangadhesathaiyum edhirgollavulladhu.
Nadappus saambiyanaana Indhiya ani, indhath thodaril thangap padhakkathaith thakkavaithukkolvadhodu, 2028m aandu nadakkum laas enjjals olimbik pottikku neradith thagudhi perum nokkil vilaiyaadi varugiradhu.

headline: Tharkolaippadai thaakkudhal Pakistan-il 16 per pali
text:
Islaamaavaath, sep. 19–
Pakistan-il, Police station valaagathil thozhugai nerathin podhu payangaravaadhigal nadathiya tharkolaippadai thaakkudhalil, 16 per paliyaaginar.
Nam andai naadaana paagisdhaanin kaivar pakdhungvaa maagaanathin kohath nagaril ulla Police station valaagathil irukkum masoodhiyil, netru mundhinam thozhugai nadandhadhu.
Appodhu, vedigundugal nirappappatta vaaganathudan angu nuzhaindha tharkolaippadai payangaravaadhi, Police station valaagathin velippuras suvarin meedhu vaaganathai modhi vedikka seythaar. Indha kunduvedippil masoodhi matrum arugilulla kattadangal sedhamadaindhana. Thodarndhu, paadhugaappu padaiyinarukkum, payangaravaadhigalukkum idaiye kadum thuppaakkis sandai vedithadhu.
Indha modhalil vedigundu udai anindhirundha matroru tharkolaippadai payangaravaadhiyai paadhugaappu padaiyinar suttuk kondranar. Tharkolaippadai thaakkudhalil, 5 Police utbada, 16 per uyirizhandhanar. Kaayamadaindha palar maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattullanar.
Pakistan-il, kaivar pakdhungvaa ullitta ellaip pagudhigalil paadhugaappu padaiyinarai kurivaithu payangaravaadhigal thaakkudhal nadathuvadhu adhigarithu varugiradhu. Idharku aapgaanisdhaanai thalamaagak konda, thehrik – i – thalivaan paak., payangaravaadhigale kaaranam ena, paak., arasu kutram saatti varugiradhu.

headline: Telliyil piriks-n 18 vadhu uchi maanaadu.. 20 aandugalaaga thodarum payanam.. Kavanam perum sandhippu!!
text:
Telliyin paarath mandavathil varum sepdambar 12 matrum 13-m thedhigalil piriks amaippin 18-vadhu uchi maanaadu nadaiveravulladhu. 4 vadhu muraiyaaga indha maanaattai India nadathavulla nilaiyil, telliyil palatha paadhugaappugal theevirappaduthappadullana. Idharkidaiyil, merkathiya aadhikkam konda sarvadhesa amaippugalukku maatraaga kadandha 2006-m aandu thodangappatta indha amaippu tharpodhu thanadhu 20 aandugalai ettiyirukkiradhu. Indhanilaiyil, indha amaippin kadandhu vandha paadhai kurithum, indha amaippil irukkum Iran matrum Russia aagiya 2 naadugal porgalil eeduvattu varum nilaiyil, kavanam perum piriks amaippin 20vadhu uchi maanaadu kurithum paarkkalaam.
Kadandha 2001-m aandu pirittish porulaadhaara nivunar jim o neel (Jim O'Neill), piresil, Russia, India matrum China aagiya valarndhu varum porulaadhaara naadugalai kurikkum vagaiyil BRIC (pirik) endra sollai payanbaduthinaar. Idhaith thodarndhu, 2006-m aandu ulaga vangi matrum sarvadhesa naanaya nidhiyam ullitta merkathiya amaippugalukku maatraaga indha naangu naadugalum ondrinaindhu BRIC endra amaippai uruvaakkina. Indha amaippin mudhal maanaadu 2009-m Russia-vin yekderinbark (Yekaterinburg) endra nagaril nadaivetradhu. Pinnar, 2010-m aandu then aappirikkaa inaindhadhaith thodarndhu, BRIC enbadhu BRICS (piriks) aaga maariyadhu.
Kadandha 20 aandugalil, porulaadhaara othuzhaippai mattumindri, varthagam, mudhaleedu, nidhi, thozhilnutbam ullitta palveru thuraigalilum indha amaippu thanadhu seyalbaadugalai virivuvaduthiyulladhu. Kurippaaga, merkathiya naadugal aadhikkam seluthum ulagalaaviya nidhi matrum arasiyal amaippugalukku maatraaga, valarndhu varum naadugalukku adhiga piradhinidhithuvam vendum enbadhe piriks naadugalin mukkiya nokkangalil ondraaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Idhan oru pagudhiyaaga, 2015-m aandu piriks naadugalaal pudhiya valarchi vangi (New Development Bank) enappadum pudhiya valarchi vangi uruvaakkappattadhu. Ulgattamaippu matrum nilaiyaana valarchith thittangalukku nidhiyudhavi vazhanguvadhe idhan mukkiya nokkamaagum.
Idharkidaiye, Iran, egipdhu, ethiyoppiyaa, aikkiya aravu ameeragam ullitta naadugal inaindhadhan moolam, adhan puvisaar arasiyal mukkiyathuvam melum adhigarithulladhu. Tharpodhu, piriks amaippin uruppu naadugalin ennikkai 11 aaga irukkiradhu. Adhesamayam, piriks oru muzhumaiyaana otrumaiyaik konda koottamaippu endru koorivida mudiyaadhu. Idhan, uruppu naadugalukku idaiye porulaadhaara potti, arasiyal karuthu veruvaadugal, veliyuravuk kolgaiyil maaruvatta anugumuraigal ena palveru savaalgal ullana.
Kurippaaga, India matrum China idaiyilaana ellaip pirasnai, Iran - aikkiya aravu ameeragam idaiyilaana mosamaana uravu pondravai indha amaippin seyalbaadugalil thaakkathai erpaduthakkoodiyavai. Indha soozhalildhaan telliyil nadaivera ulla 18-vadhu piriks uchi maanaadu mukkiyathuvam petrulladhu. Oruvuram rashyaa-ukrain por.. Maruvuram eeraanais sutriyulla modhalgal.. Melum America ullitta merkathiya naadugaludan nilavum varthagam matrum puvisaar arasiyal padhatrangal ena sarvadhesa soozhal paravarappaaga irukkum nilaiyil, piriks thalaivargal ore medaiyil koodavirukkindranar.

headline: Vaalnat saappittu vandhaal pithappai kal karaiyumaa?
text:
Vaalnat paruppai thinamum ooravaithu saappittu vandhaal pithappai karkal karaiyum endru oru padhivu

news card taippil maruthuvak kurippai pagirndhullanar. Adhil, “pithappaiyil karkal. Vaalnat paruppai thinamum oora vaithu saappida karkal padippadiyaaga karaiyum. Kurippaaga valiyindri karkalai udalil irundhu veliyetri vidum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pithappai karkal vandhuvittaal adharku podhuvaaga aruvaisigichaiyaith thavira veru endha sigichaiyum palan alikkaadhu. Kal siriya alavilirundhaal sitha, aayurvedha, akkuvanjjar muraigalil sigichai alippaargal. Adhuve migavum periya kallaaga irundhaal avargalum kooda aruvaisigichai seyvadhudhaan sari endru koorividuvaargal.
Aanaal, thinamum vaalnattai oora vaithu saappittaale pithappai karkal elidhaagak karaindhuvidum endru padhivittullanar. Kalleeralil surakkum pail (Bile) endra thiravam pithappaiyil segarikkappadum. Andha thiravam siriya menmaiyaana kuzhaay vazhiye payanithu sirugudalai adaindhu unavu serimaanathil kozhuppais serimaanam seyyath thunai purigiradhu. Indha siriya kuzhaayil adaippu erpattaal pitha neer veliyera mudiyaamal paadhippai erpaduthum. Sila samayangalil idhu kanaiyathilirundhu surakkum unavai serimaanam seyya udhavum surappugal selvadhai thadai seyyum podhu kanaiya azhatsi ullitta palveru paadhippugal erpadalaam. Appadi irukka indha theervai mattum oruvar nambiyirundhaal uyirukke kooda aavathaaga vaayppu ulladhu. Enave, indha thagaval thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Vaalnat saappittaal pithappai kal karaiyum endru edhenum aayvu ulladhaa endru ariya koogul lensil idhu thodarbaana adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru thagavalum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Melum, thamizhil veliyaana endha oru sitha maruthuvak kurippilum kooda vaalnat saappittaal pithappai kal karaiyum endru kooravillai.
Idhu thodarbaaga mootha, vayiru iraippai sigichai nivunar doctor paasumaniyidam pesinom. “pithappai kal irundhaal adhan alavu, kaampligeshan ullitta palveru kaaranigal adippadaiyil sigichai alikkappadum. Siriya kal endraal maathirai marundhu alikkappadum. Aanaal kal peridhaaga, sikkalaanadhaaga irundhaal aruvaisigichai ondre theervu.
Pithappai kal uruvaagaamal thadukka mudiyaadhu. Iruppinum monosaachurettat kozhuppu, naarchathu ulla unavugal, meen, puradhachathu mikka kaaygarigal, vaittamin si niraindha unavugal eduppadhu pithappai kal varuvadharkaana vaayppai kuraikka udhavum. Mono ansaachurettat kozhuppu avagedo, el, poosani vidhai, aaliv enney, paadhaam, vaalnat pondra kottai vagaigalil ulladhu. Adhe pol sarkkarai unavugal, adhiga ketta kozhuppu ulla unavugal, thuridha unavugal, enneyyil porikkappatta unavugal, padhappaduthappatta unavugalaith thavirppadhum pithappai karkal varuvadharkaana vaayppaik kuraikkum” endraar.
Idhu thodarbaaga arasu sitha maruthuvar vikram kumaaraith thodarbugondu pesinom. Adharku avar, “maruthuvargal parindhuraikkum marundhugal, veru sila unavugaludan vaalnattum saappittu vandhaal siriya alavilaana karkal karaiyalaam. Aanaal, vaalnat ooravaithus saappittu vandhaal pithappai kal karaiyum endru kooravida mudiyaadhu.
Kal migas siriya alavilirundhaal, pithanaalathai elidhaaga kadakkum alavukku irundhaal adhai vaalnat ullitta sila unavugal eduppadhan moolam karaikkalaam. Aanaal, periya karkal, pitha naalathil karkal adaithuk konda nilai pondravatril ellaam palan tharaadhu. Andha maadhiriyaana soozhalil aruvaisigichai ondre theervaaga irukkum. Enave, pithappai kal pirasnai endraal maruthuva aalosanai pera vendum. Kallin alavaip poruthu, maruthuvar parindhuraithaal, avar alikkum marundhugaludan vaalnat ooravaithu saappittu vandhaal palan pera vaayppu ulladhu. Illai endraal adhu sikkalai erpaduthividalaam” endraar.
Vaalnat mattum saappittu vandhaal pithappai kal kunamaagum enbadharku endha aadhaaramum illai. Maruthuvar parindhuraitha marundhu, unavugaludan vaalnat saappittu vandhaal kal karaiyalaam aanaal periya alavu kal endraal palan tharaadhu endru sitha maruthuvarum urudhi seythullaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kaamaraajar too Vijay 70 aandu sathunavuth thittap payanam.. Oru paarvai!
text:
Seythiyaalar: aanandhan
Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar kaamaraajaraal konduvarappatta sathunavuth thittam 70 aandugal kadandhu virivuvaduthappattu ezhai, eliya maanavargalin pasiyai pokki varugiradhu indha nilaiyil, virivaana kaalai unavuth thittathai Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar josap Vijay indru thodangivaithaar. Indha nilaiyil, ithittathin valarchi kurithu indhak katturaiyil paarkkalaam...
Thamizhagathin palli unavuth thittam enbadhu ore kaalagattathil uruvaana thittam alla. Palveru aatchik kaalangalil aduthadutha maatrangalaiyum, oottachathu membaadugalaiyum petru indru migapperiya samooganalath thittamaaga valarndhulladhu.
1956 -kaamaraajar aatchikkaalathil
palli maanavargalin pasiyaip pokki, ezhaik kuzhandhaigalum pallik kalviyaith thodara vendum endra nokkil, kaamaraajar thalaimaiyilaana aatchiyil madhiya unavu thittam maanila alavil virivuvaduthappattadhu. Thodakkathil1,300 unavu maiyangal moolam 65,000 maanavargalukku unavu vazhangum thittamaaga idhu seyalbaduthappattadhu.
1982 -em ji aar. Aatchikkaalathil
adutha mukkiya thiruppamaaga, 1982-il em.ji.aar. Thalaimaiyilaana aatchiyil madhiya unavuth thittam migapperiya alavil virivuvaduthappattu,sathunavuth thittamaaga maatrappattadhu. Idhanmoolam maanavargalin pasiyaip pokkuvadhu mattumindri, oottachathaiyum urudhi seyvadharku mukkiyathuvam alikkappattadhu.
Karunaanidhi aatchikkaalathil
sathunavuth thittathin aduthagatta valarchiyil, maanavargalin puradhachathu thevaiyai karuthilgondu muttai vazhangum nadaimurai valuppaduthappattadhu. Muttai vazhangum naatkal vaarathirku 3 naatkalil irundhu 5 naatkalaaga adhigarikkappattadhudan, muttai saappidaadha maanavargalukku vaazhaippazham vazhangum nadaimuraiyum kondu varappattadhu.
Jeyalalidhaa aatchikkaalathil
sathunavuth thittathil unavin vagaigalaiyum, oottachathu madhippaiyum adhigarikkum vagaiyil palveru maatrangal merkollappattana. Kurippaaga,13 vagaiyaana kalavai saadhangal matrum naangu vagaiyaana masaalaa muttaigal arimugappaduthappattana. Idhanmoolam maanavargalukku ore vagaiyaana unavu vazhangappaduvadhaith thavirthu, palvagai unavu muraikku mukkiyathuvam alikkappattadhu.
2022 - mu.ka Stalin aatchikkaalathil
palli unavuth thitta varalaatril matroru mukkiya athiyaayamaaga 2022 sepdambar 15il mudhalamaicharin kaalai unavu thittam thodangappattadhu mudharkattamaaga 1,545 arasu thodakkappalligalil 1,14,095 maanavargalukku 33.56 roobai kodi selavil kaalai unavu vazhangum thittam thodangappattadhu. Pinnar padippadiyaaga arasu thodakkap palligal, arasu udhavi perum palligal ena thittam virivuvaduthappattadhu.
2025 -2026 unavuth thittam virivaakkam
tharpodhu kaalai unavuth thittam 37,416 arasu matrum arasu udhavi perum thodakkap palligalil 20.59 latcham maanavargalais sendradaiyum alavukku virivadaindhulladhu. 2025-26aam aandukkaana Thamizhaga patjettil kaalai unavuth thittathirku 600 kodi roovaayaiyum sathunavuth thittathirku roo 2,602 kodi roovaayum odhukkappattulladhu.
70 aandugal kadandhum Thamizhaga maanavargalin pasiyaip pokkum 65 aayiram maanavargaludan thodangiya sathunavuth thittap payanam indru 20.59 latcham maanavargalai kaalai unavuth thittathin moolam payanberum vagaiyil Thamizhaga arasu virivuvaduthiyulladhu. 1956-l kaamaraajar kaalathil palli maanavargalin pasiyaip pokki kalviyaith thodaras seyvadhai nokkamaagak kondu maanila alavil virivuvaduthappatta madhiya unavuth thittam, 1982-l em.ji.aar. Kaalathil sathunavuth thittamaaga pudhiya parimaanam petradhu. Adhanbiragu karunaanidhi aatchiyil muttai ullitta puradhachathu unavugalukku mukkiyathuvam adhigarikkappattadhu. Jeyalalidhaa aatchiyil palvagai unavu muraigal arimugappaduthappattana. Indhath thodarchiyil, 2022-l kaalai unavu thittam arimugappaduthappattu, tharpodhu 20.59 latcham thodakkappalli maanavargalai sendradaiyum alavukku virivadaindhulladhu.

headline: America-vil thevaalayathai sedhappaduthiya aareses thondar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
America-vil kirisdhava thevaalayathai sedhappaduthiya aar.es.es thondar endru kurippittu oru video

kirisdhava thevaalayathin paliveedathin meedhu eri angirukkum porutkalai oruvar keezhe thallumbodhu, avarai kaaval thuraiyinar pidikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “amerikkaavil ulla thevaalayathil indhiyaavais serndha aareses sangiamaippai serndhavan thevaalayathil silaigalai udaikkum pozhudhu pidivattaan…🥵🥵adey sangi indhiyaavula kolai seythaalum thookkula poda maattaanuga aayul thandanai thaan kuduppaanga adhuvum edhaavadhu thalaivargal pirandha naal vandhaa nannadathainnu vidudhalai panneeruvaanga aanaa America appadi illa anga thuppaakki ellorum vaithu kollalaam endru sattam irukkiradhu. Niraiyaa America makkal sattappadi thuppaakki vaithu irukkiraargal. Avanuga unna suttaa ennu kekka kooda oruthanum vara maattaan sameevathil America-vil sing oruthan kathiyai vaithu achuruthiya kaaranathirku Police suttu konnaanuga andha poleesa Indhiya arasu ennu kooda kekkala unnaiyum amerikkaavula naaya sudura maadhiri suttaa indhiyaavula irundhu yaarum vara maattaargal adhai purindhu kolveli naadugalukku pogum podhu avargal madha, kalaachaarathai madhithu nadandhaal thaan endha pirachanaiyum irukkaadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
America-vil oru kirisdhava thevaalayathilirundha silaiyai India-vin aar.es.es amaippais saarndha navar oruvar udaithadhaaga video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, indha idathaip paarkkum podhu katholikka kirisdhavargalin thalaimaiyidamaana vathikkaan (Vatican) nagaril ulla punidha pedhuru peraalayam pola ulladhu. Angu sila maadhangalukku munbu ippadi oru sambavam nadandhadhaagas seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens inaiyathalathil padhivetri thedinom. Appodhu, 2025 pipravari maadham mudhal vaarathil indha sambavam vathigaan thevaalayathil nadandhadhaaga seythigal namakku kidaithana. Andha seythi edhilum athumeeri nadandhugonda navar indhiyar endro, aar.es.es navar endro kurippidappadavillai.
Ithaali naattu oodagangalil veliyaana seythigalaith thedip paarthom. Avatril, “indha sambavathil eeduvatta navar rumeniyaa naattais saarndhavar endrum, thannudaiya ti-shardil “ukrain kuzhandhaigalai kaakka vendum” endru vaasagam ezhudhiyirundhadhaagavum kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha navarai piditha vathigaan Police, avar patriya muzhu vivarangalaiyum thirattiya piragu, avarai naattaivittu veliyetra vendum endra utharavudan ithaali naattu Police-aridam oppadaithadhaaga kurippittirundhanar.
Melum, indha vivagaaram thodarbaaga pesiya vathigaan seythith thodarbaalar, “indha sambavathil eeduvatta navar kadum mananala paadhippukku ullaagiyirundhadhu therindhadhu. Avarai thaduthu vaithirundha vathigaan kaavaldhuraiyinar, visaaranaikkup piragu ithaali naattup poleesidam oppadaithanar” endru kooriyadhaaga seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Athumeeralil eeduvatta navaridam muzhumaiyaana visaaranai mudithuvittu avarai vathigaan Police viduvithuvittadhu endru seythigalil kurippidappattulladhu. Melum avar rumeniyaa naattais saarndhavar enbadhum visaaranaiyil theriyavandhadhaaga seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhan piragu andha navar patri endha oru seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Avar indhiyar endro, aar.es.es pinnani kondavar endro vathigaan poleeso alladhu veru nambathagundha visaaranai amaippo kooriyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum namakku kidaikkavillai. Appadi irukkum podhu edhan adippadaiyil indha navar aar.es.es thondar endru kurippittaargal endru theriyavillai. Adharku endha oru aadhaaramum kidaikkavillai.
2025 pipravariyil airoppaa kandathil ulla ulagin migas siriya naadaana vathigaan nagaril nadandha sambavathin video-vai eduthu, America-vil ulla thevaalayathais sedhappaduthiya aareses thondar endru thavaraana thagavalai serthu samooga oodagangalil veliyittiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Paajaga-vukku vaakkalithuvittu thamizhagam purappatta peegaarigal endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Paajaga-vukku vaakkalithu vetriveras seythuvittu thamizhagathirku velai thedi purappatta peegaarigal endru oru pugaippadam

rayilil padikkattugal, jannalgal ena kidaitha ellaa idangalilum makkal thongikkondu payanikkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peegaar la kavodhigalai ottu pottu jeyikka vachuttu ippo vaiyithu pozhappukku thamizh naattukku purappattu varomnga……” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum, pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhal vaakku ennikkai kadandha navambar 14m thedhi vaakku ennikkai nadandhadhu. Idhil aalum aikkiya janadhaa thalam matrum BJP koottani migapperiya vetriyai petrana. Therdhalukku pindhaiya karuthuk kanippaik kaattilum migap periya alavil indha koottani vetri petrirundhadhu.
Indha nilaiyil, therdhalil paajaga-vukku vaakkalithu vetri pera seytha peegaar makkal, velai vaayppaith thedi thamizhnaattukku rayilil purappattadhaaga endru oru pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Pala murai samooga oodagangalil paartha pugaippadam pol irundhadhaal idhu patri aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrithedinom. Appodhu pala aandugalaaga indha pugaippadam seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Oru seythip padhivil reuters endra seythi niruvanam indha pugaippadathai veliyittirundhadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thedinom.
Appodhu reuters inaiyathalathil indha pugaippadathai veliyittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, indha pugaippadam peegaar thalainagar patnaavil 2010m aandu pipravari maadham 23m thedhi edukkappattadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Melum indha pugaippadathai Krishna Murari Kishan enbavar eduthadhaagavum adhil kurippittirundhanar. Therdhal mudindhu ivargal thamizhnaattukku alladhu naattin veru pagudhikku sendraargal endrellaam adhil kurippidappadavillai.
Idhan moolam 2010m aandu pazhaiya pugaippadathai eduthu, 2025 peegaar sattamandra therdhal mudindhadhum peegaar makkal velai thedi thamizhagam purappattanar endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil veliyittiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ke.pi.raamalingam BJP-yil irundhu neekkappattadhaaga paravum vadhandhiyaal sarchai…
text:
‘‘ke.pi.raamalingam BJP-yil irundhu neekkappattaar’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ raasivuram maavattathai saarndha maanila thunaith thalaivarum Salem perungotta poruppaalarumaana thiru. K.P.raamalingam avargalai nadavadikkai kuzhuvin parindhuraippadi adippadai uruppinarilirundhu neekkappadugiraar. Aagave katchiyin nirvaagigal matrum thondargal avaridam evvidha thodarbum vaithuk kolla vendaam ena arivuruthappadugiradhu’’, endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu vendumendre pagirappadum vadhandhi, endru theriyavandhadhu. Idhuvatri KP Ramalingam avaradhu X valaidhalam moolamaaga veliyitta maruppu inge inaikkappattulladhu.
Idhevondru, BJP saarbaagavum veliyidappatta maruppu vivaram idho…
idhanbadi, ke.pi.raamalingam BJP-yil irundhu neekkappadavillai, endru thelivaagiradhu. Melum, indha vivagaarathil BJP saarbaaga, Police pugaar tharappattulladhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nambikkai tharum thamizh nadigargalil piradheep ranganaadhan mudhalidam endru thandhi TV seythi veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘’nambikkai tharum thamizh nadigargalil piradheep ranganaadhan mudhalidam,’’ endru thandhi TV seythi veliyittadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ thamizh sinimaavin adutha thalaimurai heerokkalil yaar nambikkai tharugiraargal. Thandhi TV nadathiya digital sarve mudivu. Piradheep ranganaadhan 55.5% vaakkugal petru mudhalidam,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhil koorappaduvadhu pondru piradheep ranganaadhan 55.5% vaakkugaludan mudhalidam endru kurippittu, thandhi TV seythi veliyidavillai, endru theriyavandhadhu. Maaraaga, sivagaarthigeyan 55.5% vaakkugal petru mudhalidathil ulladhaagak kurippidappattulladhu.
Idhanbadi, sivagaarthigeyan 55.5% vaakkugal petru mudhalidathilum, piradheep ranganaadhan 22.1% vaakkugal petru irandaavadhu idathilum, asok selvan 5.8% vaakkugal matrum thuruv vikram 16.5% vaakkugal petru, aduthadutha idangalilum ullanar.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
idhuvatri thandhi TV aasiriyar kuzhuvilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, edit seyyappatta ondru, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Lucknow-vil hakkeem salaavudheen enbavar veettil thuppaakkigal kaippatrappattadhaa?
text:
Lucknow-vil hakkeem salaavudheen enbavar veettilirundhu kaippatrappatta 3000 thuppaakkigal, 50 aayiram thottaa matrum America taalargal endru oru video

oru idathil eraalamaana thuppaakki ullitta payangara aayudhangal, kattukkattaaga panam adukki vaikkappattirukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “laknovil ulla hakkeem salaavudheenin veettilirundhu 3,000 thuppaakkigal, 50,000 thottaakkal matrum 20 paigal niraiya taalar panam kaippatrappattana…!*
*indhap panamum thuppaakkigalum yaarukkaaga, edharkaaga vaikkappattana????” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Utharappiradhesathil hakkeem salaavudheen enbavar veettilirundhu 3000 naattu thuppaakki ullitta aayudhangalai Police kaippatrinar. Lucknow-vil ulla malihaavaath (Malihabad) kaaval nilaiyathirku 100 meter tholaivil amaindhirundha salaavudheen veettilirundhu ivvalavu aayudhangal kaippatrappattiruppadhu adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Indha nilaiyil salaavudheen veettilirundhu kaippatrappatta aayudhangal endru oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video thelivillaamal ulladhu. Video-vil irukkum navargalaip paarkkum podhu Pakistan, aapgaanisdhaanais saarndhavargal pola therigindranar. Enave, pazhaiya video-vai eduthu salaavudheen veedu endru thavaraagap pagirndhullaargalaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video 2021m aandilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Sandhegappattadhu pondru indha video aapgaanisdhaanais saarndhadhu enbadhum theriyavandhadhu.
2023m aandu aapgaanisdhaanai vittu America veliyeriya podhu angu vaithirundha aayudhangalai appadiye vittuvittu veliyeriyadhu. Andha aayudhangalaith thaalivaangal kaippatrinar. Andha veediyovaithaan utharappiradhesam Lucknow-vil kaippatrappatta aayudhangal endru thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Mudhaleettukkaana aduthagattathai vazhinadatha pogum 6 thuraigal
text:
“ulagalaaviya mudhaleettin adutha kattathai valarndhu varum pudhiya thuraigal vazhinadathum” ena, es.pi.ai., thalaivar sallaa sreenivaasulu setti therivithu ullaar.
Es.pi.ai.,yin 13vadhu vangi matrum porulaadhaara maanaattai thodangi vaithu pesiya avar, India-vin thiramaiyaana paniyaalargal, thozhilmunaivor matrum thozhilnutba thiran aagiyavai pudhiya thuraigalin valarchikku udhavum endraar.ivatrai vanigangal, urpathi thiran, thozhilnutbangal matrum arivusaar sothugalaaga maatri, ulagalavil pottiyidum niruvanangalai uruvaakkuvadhu mukkiyam endrum kurippittaar.
Valarndhu varum thuraigal kurithu kurippitta avar, adhiga mudhaleedu thevaippadum indha thuraigalin valarchikku erpa vangigal matrum nidhi niruvanangalum thangaladhu seyalbaadugalai maatrikkolla vendum endraar.

headline: Thaaymaaman thanga modhira thittam: madhuraikku varum mudhalvar Vijay ; saalaigal amaikkum panigal theeviram!
text:
Thaaymaaman thanga modhiram thittathai thongi vaippadharkaaga mudhalvar Vijay varum thingalgizhamai madhuraikku vara iruppadhaaga thagaval veliyaagi irukkiradhu.
Thavegavin therdhal arikkaigalil ondraana thaaymaaman thanga modhiram thittam varugira sepdambar maadham 28 aam thedhi thodanga povadhaaga arasu tharappil therivikkavattulladhu. Indha thittathai aarambathil usilambattiyil vaithu thodangalaamaa ena adhigaarigal aalosanai nadathinar. Usilambattiyil pengalukku seer kodukkum kalaachaaram adhigam nadakkum pagudhiyaaga iruppadhaal adhanaal indha thittathai usilambattiyil irundhu thuvangalaam ena ninaitha arasu adharkaana aayvu panigalil eeduvattadhu.
Aanaal usilambattiyil adhigalavilaana therukkal kurugalaaga iruppadhaal mudhalvar vijayyai kaana varum koottathai kattuvaduthuvadhu siramamaagi vidum enbadhaal Maduraiyil vaithu thodangalaam ena aalosikkappattu arasu tharappil mudivedukkavattulladhu.
Thodarndhu varum sepdambar 28 aam thedhi thingagizhamai madhuraikku varum mudhalamaichar Vijay raajaaji maruthuvamanaiyil pirakku kuzhandhaigalukku neradiyaaga sendru thanga modhiram vazhangi thittathai thodangi vaikka irukkiraar. Mudhalvarin varugaiyaiyotti raajaaji maruthuvamanaiyil sutrilum saalaigal amaikku panigal mummaramaaga nadaippetru varugiradhu. Melum maruthuvamanaikkullum karkalai amaikku panigalum, thooymai paduthum panigal nadaippetru varugiradhu.!

headline: Nadaivaadhai aakkiramippai maraikkiradhu maanagaraatchi
text:
Kovai: nadaivaadhai nadappadharke endru Court utharavittum aakkiramippugal thodargindrana. Kaandhivuram, tavunhaal, aar.es.puram, thadaagam rodu ena maanagaril perumbaalaana nadaivaadhaigal aakkiramippil ullana.
Maanagaraatchi nirvaagam nanjjappaa rodu, Trichy rodu, resgors pagudhigalil kadandha maadham nadaivaadhai aakkiramippai agatriyadhaaga kooriyadhu. Tavunhaal periyagadai veedhiyil iruvuramum nadaivaadhai aakkiramippil irukkum.
Maanagaraatchi adhaiyum agatra vendumena korikkai ezhundhadhu.
Periyagadai vidhi, pothees aruge nadaivaadhaiyil irundha kadaigal, paadhasaarigal payanbaduthum vagaiyil nadavadikkai edukkappattadhu endru maanagaraatchi X pakkathil padhivu veliyittadhu.
Adhil munbu, pinbu endru kurippittu photo pagirndhanar. Pinbu ena e.ai. Thozhilnutbathil uruvaana photo veliyidappattadhu. Idhu sarchaiyaanavudan maanagaraatchi andha padhivai neekkivittu, orijinal pottovudan padhivittadhu.
Edhu unmai ena ariya naam neril sendrom. Nadaivaadhai muzhuvadhum aakkiramithirundha kadaigalai satru thalli poda vaithullanar. Avvalavudhaan. Ippodhum nadaivaadhaiyai aakkiramithu kadaigal irukkindrana.
Nadaivaadhai, paadhasaarigalin urimai. Kadaigalai muzhumaiyaaga agatrinaal mattume nadakka mudiyum. Tharkaaliga nadavadikkai theervalikkaadhu. Naaladaivil meendum nadaivaadhaiyai muzhumaiyaaga aakkiramippadharkaana vaayppe adhigam.

headline: Purattaasi maadham pirappu perumaal kovilil kuvindha pakdhargal
text:
Eerodu:purattaasi
 maadham perumaalukku ugandha maadhamaaga karudhappadugiradhu. Innilaiyil 
purattaasi maadham netru pirandhadhu. Idhaiyotti Erode maanaril ulla 
perumaal kovilgalil sirappu poojai nadandhadhu. Erode kottai kasdhoori 
aranganaadhar kovilil yaagasaalai poojai, thirumanjjanam ullitta palveru 
sirappu poojai nadandhadhu.
Idhai thodarndhu sreedhevi poodhevi samedha kasdhoori 
aranganaadhar sirappu alangaarathil ezhundharulinaar. Pakdhargal 
suvaamiyai pallakkil sumandhu kovil valaagathai sutri vandhanar. 
Maalaiyil simma vaaganathil suvaami purappaadu nadandhadhu.
Lattu thayaarippu mummuram
purattaasi
 maadha mudhalaavadhu sanikkizhamaiyaana indru, Erode kasdhoori aranganaadhar 
kovilukku aayirakkanakkaana pakdhargal varuvar. Ivargalukku 
pirasaadhamaaga tharuvadharku, kovil nirvaagam saarbil lattu thayaarikkum 
pani netru nadandhadhu. Idhil nootrukkanakkaana pengal eeduvattanar.

 veetrirukkum maragadha vengadesa perumaal kovil, paariyoor 
aadhinaaraayana perumaal kovilil kaalai mudhale pakdhargal tharisanam seythu 
sendranar.
Pirammotsava vizhaa
punsey puliyambatti aruge 
keezhmududhurai thimmaraaya perumaal kovilil, nadappaandu purattaasi 
pirammotsava thiruvizhaa, kaappu kattudhal matrum kodiyetrathudan 
netru thuvangiyadhu. Varum, 21m thedhi varai thinasari karuda vaaganam, kudhirai 
vaaganam, sesha vaaganangalil utsavar veedhi ulaa nadakkum. Pirammotsava 
mukkiya nigazhvaaga thirukkalyaana vaivavam, 22m thedhi nadakkavulladhu.

headline: Kaaraikkudi nagaraatchi maamandrathil nadigai thirishaa pugaippadam vaikkappattadhaa?
text:
‘‘kaaraikkudi nagaraatchi maamandrathil nadigai thirishaa pugaippadam vaikkappattadhu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kaaraikkudi nagaraatchi maamandrathil
nadigai thrishaa padam 
innum ennenna paarkka vendi irukko 
idhellaam paarkka namakku thalaiyezhuthu ,’’ endru  ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Idhanudan, pugaippadam ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Polimer News logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu. Idhuvatri TVK, thalaimai aluvalagathil kettavodhu, ‘’idhu vendumendre arasiyal ulnokkathudan pagirappadum vadhandhi,’’ endru therivithanar.
Thodarndhu thagaval thedinom. Adhanbadi, kaaraikkudi nagaraatchi maamandra koottam sameevathil nadaivetradhu. Adhil, munnaal mudhalvargal endra muraiyil, jeyalalidhaa, Edappadi Palaniswami matrum M.K. Stalin padangalai nagaraatchi maamandrathil vaikka vendum, endru ADMK matrum DMK kavunsilargal idaiye vaakkuvaadham ezhundhulladhu. Appodhu, suyechai kavunsilar meyyar enbavar, nadigai thrishaa padathaiyum inge vaikka vendum, endru vedikkaiyaagak kooriyullaar. Idhanaal, maamandra koottathil salasalappu erpattadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, palveru oodagangalum seythi veliyittullana. Aanaal, thrishaa padam idhuvarai angu maattappadavillai.

Melum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadathai Photoshop Detector udhaviyudan sarivaarthom. Idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, endru thelivaanadhu.

Muzhu video lingk idho…

headline: Nayinaarai sandhithavin annaamalaiyai vimarsitha si.vi.sanmugam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiranai sandhithuvittu, munnaal thalaivar annaamalaiyai migak kadumaiyaaga vimarsitha ADMK-vin si.vi.sanmugam endru oru video

nayinaar naagendhiranum ADMK munnaal amaichar si.vi.sanmugamum inaindhu eduthukkonda pugaippadathudan si.vi.sanmugam alitha pettiyai inaithu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil annaamalaiyai patri si.vi.sanmugam migak kadumaiyaaga pesugiraar. Nilaith thagavalil, “nainaarai sandhitha pin aadu annaamalaiyai kazhavi ootriya sivi sanmugam..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiran, ADMK munnaal amaichar si.vi.sanmugathai sameevathil sandhithadhaagas seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil indha sandhippukkup piragu Tamil Nadu BJP munnaal thalaivar Annamalai patri si.vi.sanmugam migavum kadumaiyaagap pesi petti alithadhaaga oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video-vil ABP naadu oodagathin logo ulladhu. Enave, sameevathil si.vi.sanmugam petti edhum andha oodagathil veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru veediyovum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Enave, idhu pazhaiya video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathil aayvaith thodarndhom.
ABP naadu oodagathin YouTube pakkathil si.vi.sanmugam, Annamalai endru sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra video-vai andha oodagam joon 13, 2023 andru veliyittiruppadhu therindhadhu. Andha video-vin 2vadhu nimidathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda Facebook pakkathilirundha video pagudhi irundhadhu. Idhan moolam Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiranai sandhitha piragu annaamalaiyai vimarsitha si.vi.sanmugam endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Thaaraavuram idaitherdhal a.thi.mu.ka.,vinar surusuruppu
text:
Tiruppur: thaaraavuram idaitherdhalil kalappaniyaatrum vagaiyil, ADMK maavatta nirvaagigal katchi mukkiya nirvaagigalai neril sandhithu aalosanai nadathinar.
Thaaraavuram thogudhikku idaitherdhal arivikkappattulladhu. Idhil aalum TVK saarbilum, DMK, ADMK, kamyoonist katchigal, naam thamizhar katchi ullitta arasiyal katchigalin vetbaalargal matrum vivasaaya sangam ullitta amaippugalais serndha suyechaigal ena motham 22 per pottiyidugindranar. ADMK nirvaagigal thangal therdhal kalappaniyai thodanginar. Tiruppur maanagar maavatta ADMK-vukku thaaraavuram thogudhiyil kundadam ondriyam odhukkappattulladhu.
Adhanbadi, pungathurai, siruginaru, sangaraandaambaalaiyam aagiya pagudhigalil maavatta seyalaalar velgumaar saaminaadhan, kundadam ondriya seyalaalar kuppusaami aagiyor netru kalappaniyai thodanginar. Avargal appagudhiyil ulla katchi munnodigal matrum nirvaagigalin veedugalukku neril sendru saalvai anivithu, therdhal panigal kurithu aalosanai nadathinar. Indha sandhippinbodhu Tiruppur maanagar maavatta matrum ondriya nirvaagigal, saarbu ani nirvaagigal udanirundhanar.

headline: Islaamiyargal vaakku adhimuga-vukku thevaiyillai ena raajendhira paalaaji koorinaaraa?
text:
Anvar raajaa ADMK-vil irundhu thimuga-virku ponaal pogattum islaamiyargal vaakku adhimugavirku thevai illai endru adhimuga-vin munnaal amaichar ke.ti.raajendhira paalaaji kooriyadhaaga oru news card

raajendhira paalaaji pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card ondru Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Adhil, “ponaal pogattum anvar raajaa ADMK-vil irundhu thimugavirku ponaal pogattum islaamiyargal vaakku adhimugavirku thevai illai – ADMK munnaal amaichar ke.ti.raajendhira paalaaji” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ADMK amaippus seyalaalaraaga irundha anvar raajaa Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinai sandhithu DMK-vil inaindhaar. Avarukku padhiladi alikkum vagaiyil islaamiyargal vaakku adhimuga-vukku thevaiyillai endru ADMK munnaal amaichar ke.ti.raajendhira paalaaji kooriyadhaaga oru news card samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Indha news card-ai paarkka pudhiya thalaimurai munbu veliyitta news card pola ulladhu. Tharpodhu indha tisainil pudhiya thalaimurai news kaardugalai veliyiduvadhu illai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Amaicharaaga irundha podhu, “modi engal taadi” endrum islaamiyargalukku edhiraagavum pesi paravarappai erpaduthi pinnar maruppu therivithavar raajendhira paalaaji. Enave, islaamiyargal vaakku vendaam endrellaam edhenum karuthaik kooriyirundhaaraa, seythi edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Namakku appadi endha oru seythiyum illai. Enave, indha thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga indha news card poliyaanadhaa enbadhai ariya aayvu seythom. Pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalaridam irundhe indha news card poliyaanadhu, idhai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai endru kurippittu nammudaiya WhatsApp ennukkup padhivu ondru vandhadhu. Pudhiya thalaimurai samooga oodaga pakkangalilum indha news card poliyaanadhu endru kurippittup padhivittirundhanar. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu poliyaanadhu, thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhi seythana.

headline: Pangalaadheshil indhu aasiriyarukku seruppu maalai anivitha islaamiyargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Vangadhesathil 43 aandugal paniyaatri oyvu petra indhu aasiriyarukku seruppu maalai anivithup pirivu uvasaara vizhaa nadathiya islaamiyargal endru oru video

vayadhaana oruvarukku islaamiyargal seruppu maalai anivithu video pugaippadangal edukkum video-vai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Andha navare kangalai moodiyavadi amaidhiyaaga irukkiraar. Nilaith thagavalil, “pangalaadheshil 43 varudam aasiriyaraaga panivurindha siruvaanmai hindhu aasiriyarukku andha naattu perumbaanmai islaamiyargal saarbil nadathavatta pirivu uvasaara vizhaa .. India-vil endha siruvaanmai islaamiya aasiriyarkkum indha kodumai nadandhadhu illai.. Vandha pin varundhuvadhai vida varum mun kaappaadhe sirandhadhu..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vangadhesathil indhukkal thaakkappadugindranar, indhukkalukku avamariyaadhai seyyappadugiradhu enave varummun kaakka vendum endru thodarndhu samooga oodagangalil padhivugal pagirappattu varugindrana. Avatril 99 sadhavigidham poliyaana poyyaana thagavalaagave ulladhu. Varum mun kaakka vendum endru oru kurippitta madhathinarukku edhiraaga vanmuraiyaith thoondum vagaiyil padhividappattulladhaal indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu palarum samooga oodagangalil indha padhivaip padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu joon 19m thedhi vanga mozhiyil veliyidappatta Facebook padhivu ondru namakku kidaithadhu. Adhai mozhimaatram seythu paartha podhu, “vangadhesathin raajbari maavattathil makkalukkaaga sevai seythu vandha maruthuvar agamadhu ali avamariyaadhai seyyappattaar. Madhathai avamariyaadhai seythaar endra poyyaip parappi endha visaaranaiyum indri thaakkappattaar” enbadhu pola kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Vangadhesam, raajbari maavattam, doctor agamadhu ali ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthi koogulil thedinom. Vanga mozhikku maatrith thediya podhu idhu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigal namakku kidaithana. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra kaatchiyai pugaippadamaaga vaithu veliyaana seythigalum irundhana. Adhil, “navigal naayagathai avamadhithadhaaga oyvu petra sugaadhaara adhigaariyai oru kumbal thaakki, seruppu maalai anivithadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Ellaa seythigalilum avarudaiya peyar agamadhu ali endre kurippidappattirundhadhu. Endha seythiyilum avar aasiriyar endru kurippidappadavillai. Islaamiyar oruvar thangal iraithoodharaip patri thavaraagap pesivittaar endra seythiyaik kettu islaamiyargale avaraith thaakkiyadhaagathaan kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha vadhandhi thodarbaaga nammudaiya fekt kirasando aangilathilum katturai veliyittullanar. Andhak katturaiyaik kaana inge kilik seyyungal.
Vangadhesathil islaamiyar oruvar thaakkappatta video-vai eduthu indhu aasiriyar thaakkappattaar endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mainas 15 tigiri kuliril thavam seyyum indhu madha thuravigal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘mainas 15 tigiri kuliril thavam seyyum indhu madha thuravigal,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ 🚩indhu madham enge.. 🚩
