Adhu thuni illaamal.. Idhu oru adhisayam… idhu magaadhevin sakdhi…🚩 ivvalavu kuliril iratham uraivadhillai?.. 🚩
padhilalikka mudiyaadha pala kelvigal ullana.. Padhil ondrudhaan: 🙏🕉️🙏
harahara magaadhev shambo sangaraa 🙏
om namash sivaaya 🙏🕉️🙏
Jai Bharat . . 🇮🇳
Jai Hindustani . . 🚩,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan indhu madha saadhukkal sattai illaamal kuliril thavam seyvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Google Reverse udhaviyudan thagaval thediyavodhu, idhu AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta video endrum, unmaiyaanadhalla endrum theriyavandhadhu.
MIND GROW G endra Facebook pakkathil indha video mudhalmuraiyaaga pagirappattulladhu. Adhil ‘’ ⚠️Disclaimer :~This video is a fictionalentertainment
video created using AI/VFX. No humans or animals have been harmed This video is not based on anyreal incident,’’ endru kepshan ezhudhappattulladhu.  
Kurippitta Facebook pakkathil idhuvondru niraiya video pagirappattullana.
Melum, -20 tigiri selsiyas veppanilaiyil thavam seyyum thuravi endrum koori oru video idhe Facebook pakkathil pagirappattulladhu. Idhuvum AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta veediyodhaan…
MIND GROW G mugappu pakkathileye pozhudhuvokku nokkil indha video-kkal pagirappaduvadhaagak kurippidappattulladhu.
Irudhiyaaga, facebook messenger moolamaaga, MIND GROW G tharappai thodarbugondu, vilakkam kettom. ‘’thozhilmurai nokkil pirathyega AI tools payanbaduthi idhuvondru video thayaarithu veliyidugirom,’’ endru therivithanar.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Jem veeramani vazhakku edhiroli; arun aivies ulbada 3 per kaathiruppor pattiyalukku maatram
text:
Chennai: jem veeramani paaliyal vazhakku thodarbaaga munbe pugaar alithum nadavadikkai edukkath thavariyadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundha nilaiyil, Police agaadami iyakkunar arun ulbada 3 per kaathiruppor pattiyalukku maatram seyyappattullanar.
Eraalamaana sirumigalai thozhiladhivar jem veeramani paaliyal vangodumai seythadhaaga ezhundha pugaar tharpodhu Thamizhagathil adhirvalaigalai erpaduthiyulladhu. Indha sambathil thodarbudaiyavargalai Police kaidhu seythu varugindranar. Sila aandugalukku munbe indha pugaar tharappattadhaagavum, appodhu sariyaana nadavadikkai edukkappadavillai endrum, kutrachaattugal ezhundhullana. Yaar yaarellaam idhai moodi maraikka muyatsithanar enbadhu thodarbaana visaaranaiyum oru pakkam theeviramaaga nadandhu varugiradhu.
Kadandha 2024m aandu Chennai maanagara kaaval koodudhal aanaiyaraaga irundha kannanidam pugaar alithadhaagavum, iruppinum andhap pugaar meedhu endha nadavadikkaiyum edukkavillai endrum Congress nirvaagi ranjjan kumaar kutramsaattiyirundhaar. Adhan thodarchiyaaga, tharpodhu Police agaadami iyakkunaraaga irukkum munnaal Chennai Police kamishanar arun, Kovai maanagara Police kamishanaraaga irukkum kannan aagiyor kaathiruppor pattiyalukku maatram seyyappattullanar. Adhevola, Chennai koyambedu kaaval udhavi aanaiyar yaashminum kaathiruppor pattiyalukku maatrappattullaar.
Arun aivies vagithu vandha Police agaadami iyakkunar poruppu, tijivi raajeev kumaaridam oppadaikkappattulladhu. Kovai maanagara Police kamishanar poruppu, merku mandala aiji ramyaa paaradhikku koodudhal poruppaaga oppadaikkappattulladhu.

headline: Pakistan aakkiramippu kaashmeeril panth; mudangiyadhu iyalbu vaazhkkai
text:
Namadhu niruvar
Pakistan aakkiramippu kaashmeeril, je.e.e.si., enappadum koottu avaami nadavadikkai kuzhu vidutha podhu velainiruthathaal, angu iyalbu vaazhkkai paadhikkappattadhu.
Pakistan aakkiramithulla kaashmeer pagudhiyil vasikkum makkal thangalin adippadai urimaigalai valiyuruthi poraadi varugindranar. Indhap poraattangalai, koottu avaami nadavadikkai kuzhu munneduthu nadathi varugiradhu.
Poraattangalai kattuppadutha paak., arasu pala adakkumuraigalai kaiyaandu varugiradhu. Idhil appaavi podhu makkal palar kollappattullanar. Melum, angu nadakkum adakkumuraigalai maraikka, inaiya mudakkam matrum kadumaiyaana oodaga thadaigalai annaattu arasu vidhithulladhu.
Innilaiyil, makkal poraattam naalukku naal uchathai etti varugiradhu. Je.e.e.si., azhaippu vidutha podhu velainiruthathaal, angu iyalbu vaazhkkai paadhikkappattadhu. Mukkiya vaniga maiyangal, ulloor sandhaigal matrum varthaga niruvanangal anaithum muzhumaiyaaga moodappattana. Podhu pokkuvarathum niruthappattulladhodu, mukkiya saalaigalum aal nadamaattamindri verichodi kaanappattadhu.

headline: Nellai: adargaattukkul pazhangudiyina kaani makkal; nadandhu sendru sandhitha amaichar vanni arasu |Photos
text: Nellai paavanaasam merkuth thodarchi malaiyil vaazhum malaivaazh pazhangudiyina kaani makkalai neril sandhithu avargalin kuraigalaik kettariya Thamizhaga samooga needhithurai amaichar vanni arasu adarndha kaattirkul nadandhe sendru angulla makkalais sandhithu, arasu seyal thittangalaiyum aayvu seythaar.

headline: Paagisdhaanai veezhthiyadhum Indhiya kirikket vaariyam veliyitta video idhuvaa?
text:
Saambiyans koppai pottiyil Indhiya ani paagisdhaanai veezhthiya podhu Indhiya kirikket vaariyam (pisisiai) veliyitta unarchippoorvamaana video endru oru video-vai palarum

Indhiya kirikket aniyinar e.aar.rahmaanin vandhe maadharam paadalai stediyathil paadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paagisdhaan aniyai varuthedutha piragu Indhiya kirikket kantrol pordu thangaludaiya eX valaidhala pakkathil padhivitta video paarthavar manadhil nirkum unarchimikka kaatchi… pandrisdhaan aadharavaalargalaana thiraavidiyaasgalin kavanathirku” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Saambiyans koppai kirikket pottiyil 2025 pipravari 23m thedhi nadandha leek pottiyil indhiyaavum paagisdhaanum modhina. Idhil India avaara vetri petradhu. Idhai indhiyaave kondaadiya podhu adhilum madhathai, vishamathai nuzhaithup padhivittullanar. Indha vetriyaik kondaadum vagaiyil maa thuje salaam (thaay manne vanakkam) endru indhiyil e.aar.rahmaan paadalai Indhiya kirikket veerargal paadiyadhai Indhiya kirikket vaariyam X thalathil veliyittadhaagavum adhaip paarthu thiraavida aadharavaalargalukku adhaik kandu manam vendhadhu polavum padhivittullanar.
Thiraavida kolgai alladhu katchikku aadharavaanavargal ellaam Pakistan aadharavaalargal endru edhan adippadaiyil padhivaalar therivithullaar endru theriyavillai. Andha vivagaarathirkul naam sellavillai. Kurippitta andha naalil appadi oru video-vai pisisiai veliyittadhaa endru mattum aayvu seythom. Mudhalil indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyai pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivittu thedinom.
Appodhu 2024m aandil ti20 ulagak koppaiyai India vetri petra podhu mumbaiyil nadandha vizhaavil indha video edukkappattadhaaga seythigal namakku kidaithana. Vandhemaadharam endru indhiyil kurippittu indha video-vai pisisiai thannudaiya X thala pakkathil 2024 joolai 4m thedhi padhivittirundhadhu.
2025 pipravariyil nadandha India – Pakistan pottikkup piragu indha video-vai pisisiai meendum padhivittadhaa endru ariya aayvaith thodarndhom. Pisisiai X thala pakkathil pipravari 23, 2025 andru veliyaana padhivugal anaithaiyum paarthom. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video illai. 23m thedhi veliyaana padhivugal thodarbaaga naam rekkaart seytha video-vai kaana inge kilik seyyungal.
Andraiya thinathil adhaavadhu pipravari 23m thedhi kirikket potti thodanguvadharku munbu hardhik paandiyaa thodarbaaga video ondrai pisisiai veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra oru kaatchi sila vinaadigal idam petrirundhadhu. Aanaal, vandhe maadharam paadal paaduvadhai olikkavidavillai. Melum, andha video India-vin vetri thodarbaanadhaagavum illai.
Idhan moolam paagisdhaanai Indhiya ani veezhthiyadhaith thodarndhu pisisiai vandhemaadharam paadal video-vai pisisiai veliyittadhaagap paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu, vishamathanamaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Israel min nilaiyam meedhu Iran thaakkudhal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Isrelin haifaa min nilaiyam meedhu Iran evuganaith thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu endru kurippittu oru video

thozhitsaalai meedhu thaakkudhal nadathappatta video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “🇮🇷eeraan, haifaa min nilaiyathai paalistik evuganai moolam thagarthulladhu.🚀🔥🇮🇱
828 megaavaat thiran konda indha min nilaiyam azhikkappattadhaal, isrelin paadhip pagudhi irulil moozhgiyulladhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Israel – Iran porin paadhippu endru pala pazhaiya video-kkal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindrana. Appadi sila aandugalukku munbu hisbullaa amaippu nadathiya thaakkudhal endru kurippittu pagirappatta video-vai tharpodhu meendum Iran nadathiya thaakkudhal endru palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video 2017m aandilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Palarum indha sambavam seenaavil nadandhadhu endrum singappooril nadandhadhu endrum kurippittup padhivittirundhanar.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu, indha sambavam seenaavil ulla oru rasaayanath thozhitsaalaiyil erpatta payangara vivathinudaiyadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Indha sambavam 2015m aandu China-vin sejiyaang (Zhejiang) maagaanathil ulla oru rasaayana thozhitsaalaiyil nadandhadhu endru kurippittu veliyaana video-kkal, seythigal namakku kidaithana. Idhan moolam China-vin rasaayana aalai vedivivathin video-vai isrelin min nilaiyam meedhu Iran nadathiya thaakkudhal endru thavaraaga pagirappattulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Modi, amith shaavukku mattum edhirppu alai veesaadhadhu en? Ketkiraar raagul
text:
Pudhudilli: indhiraa pondra thalaivargal sandhitha edhirppu alai, tharpodhaiya piradhamar Modi matrum amith shaavukku mattum veesaadhadhu en? Endru Congress embi raagul kelvi ezhuppiyullaar.
Tilliyil seythiyaalargalidam avar pesiyadhaavadhu; hariyaanaa, mahaaraashdiraa, utharap piradhesam, mathiyap piradhesam matrum kujaraath pondra maanilangalil edhirppu alai kaaranamaaga, ovvoru muraiyum aatchi maatram nigazhum. Aanaal, kadandha sila aandugalaaga appadi edhum nigazhavillai. Thaninavarin selvaakku matrum arasaangathin seyalbaadugalai nammaal purindhu kolla mudiyum. Aanaal, aalum katchikku edhiraaga adhirupdhi alai mattum eppadi maayamaagiyadhu enbadhaith thaan purindhu kolla mudiyavillai.
Udhaaranamaaga, Iraq, vadagoriyaa pondra naadugalil edhirppu alaiye irukkaadhu. Enenil angu jananaayagam endra vishayame kidaiyaadhu. Jananaayagam irukkum naadugalil kandippaaga edhirppu alai endra ondru irukkum. Naan thaan oru arasiyal kudumbathilirundhu vandhavan. Vangadhesa poril vetri petru, pugazhin uchikku sendra appodhaiya piradhamar indhiraavukkuk kooda, oru kattathil edhirppu alai nilaviyadhu.
Congress thalaivargal matrum maanila katchigalukku edhirppu alai erpattaal, mathiyil aalum piradhamar Modi, amith shaa matrum paajavukku mattum indha edhirppu alai enbadhe erpadavillai.
Therdhal aanaiyathaal paadhugaakkappada vendiya ottugalilirundhudhaan namadhu arasiyalamaippus sattam palathaip perugiradhu. Ottu azhikkappattaal arasiyalamaippus sattam azhikkappadum. Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Thozhiladhivar kolai vazhakku iru vaalivargal kaidhu panathai thiruppi kodukkaadhadhaal vericheyal
text:
Tirunelveli: Tirunelveli maavattam kallidaikkurichiyil thozhiladhivar kannan 58, vettik kollappatta vazhakkil vengadesh 30, sooryaa isakki, 27, aagiya iruvarai Police kaidhu seythanar.
Kallidaikkurichiyai serndhavar kannan, thirumana mandavam nadathi vandhaar. Kallidaikkurichi kuthukkal theruvil ulla tiyooshan maiyathil ivaradhu magal padikkiraar kannan thinamum maalai magalai tiyooshanil viduvadhum, iravil azhaithu varuvadhum vazhakkam.
Netru mundhinam iravu 8:30 maniyalavil tiyooshan sendar vaasalil tooveelarudan nindrirundha avarai pindhodarndhu vandha kumbal arivaalaal vettiyadhu. Idhil kannan sambava idathileye uyirizhandhaar.
Tiyooshan mudindhu veliye vandha magalin kan mun thandhai vettik kollappattaar. Maavatta es.pi., vishvesh saasdhiri neril visaaranai nadathinaar.
Thodarndhu indha kolaiyil eeduvatta vengadesh, sooryaa isakki aagiya iruvarai Police kaidhu seythanar.
Kannanum vengadesum ore samoogathai serndhavargal. Kannan thozhil seyvadharkaaga vengadesh thanadhu kudumba nagaiyai adagu vaithu panam koduthullaar. Andha panathai kannan thiruppi kodukkaadhadhaal iruvarukkum munvirodham erpattadhu.
Vengadesh meedhu erkanave vazhakkugal ulla nilaiyil, avar sameevathil jaaminil velivandhaar.
Panam kodukkaamal kannan kaalam thaazhthiyadhaal erpatta munvirodhathil, nanbargal udhaviyudan kannanai vengadesh kolai seythadhu Police visaaranaiyil theriyavandhadhu. Ichambavathil thodarbudaiya melum silarai Police thedi varugindranar.

headline: Toop vaithu aarudhal koorum nigazhchi nadathiya Vijay endru thandhi TV seythi veliyittadhaa?
text:
Toop podum nadigarai vaithu maamallavurathil karoor koottanerisalil uyirizhandhavargal kudumbathukku aarudhal koorum nigazhchiyai TVK thalaivar Vijay nadathiyadhaaga oru padhivu

thandhi TV news card vadivil veliyitta video pondru ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “viraivil karoor vandhu sandhippadhaaga Vijay urudhiyalithaar – paadhikkappattavar. Vijay-in tooppai vaithu nigazhchi nadathiyadhaaga thagaval! Magaavalivurathil natchathira hottalil netru nadaivetra aarudhal koorum nigazhvil, karooril paadhikkappatta kudumbathinarai sandhikka TVK thalaivar Vijay sandhikka thayangiyadhaal sinimaavil Vijay-kku toop podum nadigarai vaithu nigazhchiyai thavegavinar nadathi mudithadhaagath thagaval” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “unmaiya sollungadaa.. Toop edhuvum pottu appaavi makkalai emaathitteengalaadaa..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivitta varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karoor TVK pirasaara kootta nerisalil uyirizhandhavargal kudumbathai maamallavurathukku varavazhaithu nadigarum TVK thalaivarumaana vijayyum aarudhal koorinaar. Vijay nigazhvil pangetravargal alitha petti adippadaiyil thandhi TV news card veliyittadhu pondru ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aarudhal koorum nigazhvil pangetradhu nadigar vijayye illai endru andha padhivil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Paarkkum podhe edit seyyappattadhu endru therindhadhaal idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha news card-ai thandhi TV veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovudan thandhi TV veliyittirundha padhivu kidaithadhu. Aanaal adhil toop podappattadhu endrellaam illai. ““vijay azhudhu kaalil vizhundhadhu unmai thaan.. Avaroda udal, mugam ellaame… aale vera maari maarittaaru’’ – netru vijayyai paarthavargal kadharal ” endru kurippittup paadhikkappattavargalin pettiyai veliyittirundhanar. Endha idathilum toop podappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Indha video-vai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugollum vagaiyil, indha video padhivai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku WhatsApp moolam anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaana news card endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: DMK aatchiyil Chengalpattu palli maanavargal kanjjaa podhaiyil modhal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK aatchiyil Chengalpattu maavattathais saarndha palli ondrin maanavargal kanjjaa podhaiyil oruvarai oruvar thaakkikkonda kaatchi endru oru video

palli maanavargal payangaramaaga thaakkikkollum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “sennai, Chengalpattu maavattam Tamil Naattin appaa valarppil palli pillaigal kanjjaa podhaiyil aanandhamaay aadi paadi magizhndhu varugindranar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pallik koodam, kalloori endraal maanavargal kuzhu modhalil eeduvaduvadhu thodarndhu kondudhaan irukkiradhu. Indha aatchi, andha aatchi endru illai, endha aatchi vandhaalum palli, kalloori maanavargalin modhalai thaduthu niruthivida mudiyaadhu enbadhe unmai. Tamil Naattil M.K. Stalin aatchiyil palli maanavargal kanjjaa adithu podhaiyil modhik kondanar endru palarum video ondraip padhivittu varugindranar. Chengalpattu maavattam endrum kurippittavargal endha oor enbadhai kurippidavillai. Indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. 2024 sepdambarilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Ivatrukku idaiye thandhi tivi-yil veliyaana seythiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video kaatchi idam petrirundhadhu.
Adhil, “ravudigalai pola palli maanavargal -kolai veri thaakkudhal- oore nindru vedikkai paartha kaatchi” endru thalaippidappattirundhadhu. Seythiyai paartha podhu, pudhucheriyil arasup palli maanavargal kadumaiyaagath thaakkikkonda video veliyaagi adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Ariyoor arasu melnilaip palli maanavargal silar oruvarai oruvar kattaiyaal thaakkikkonda video tharpodhu viral-aaga paravi varugiradhu. Iruppinum indha sambavam thodarbaaga pugaar edhum varavillai endru pudhucheri Police koorinar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthi koogulil thedinom. Appodhu indha thaakkudhal sambavam thodarbaaga veliyaana seythiyum namakku kidaithadhu. Ivai ellaam indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadakkavillai, en.aar.kaangiras – BJP koottani aatchi nadakkum pudhucheriyil nadandhadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
BJP koottani aatchi nadakkum pudhucheriyil palli maanavargal thaakkik konda video-vai eduthu, Stalin aatchiyil Chengalpattu palli maanavargal thaakkik konda kaatchi endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: US-kku thanni kaattiya China 1,300 shipment muzhukka aayudhangal.. Asuravalam petra Iran?
text:
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
anu aayudhas sodhanaiyil eeduvattadhaaga koori, Iran meedhu, amerikkaavum, isrelum inaindhu, kadandha pipravari maadham mudhal koottuth thaakkudhalai nadathi varugindrana. Indha thaakkudhalukku padhiladiyaaga, andai naadugalil ulla America-vin raanuvath thalangalai thaakkiyadhodu, haarmus neerinaiyaiyum moodi, perum adhirchiyai thandhadhu Iran ivvaaru iru naadugalum, maarimaari thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaal, iru tharappilum perum porp padhatram needithu vandhadhu. America maadhiriyaana perum vallarasu naattaiye edhirkkum alavukku, Iran raanuva palam irundhadhu palarukkum perum aachariyathai erpaduthiyirundhadhu.
Ippadiyaana soozhnilaiyil, Iran-in indha asura palathirku kaaranamaaga China irundhulladharkaana aadhaarangal veliyaagiyullana. Adhaavadhu, eeraanukku yaarum udhavak koodaadhu enbadharkaaga, America perum porulaadhaarath thadaigalai vidhithirundha podhilum andha thadaigalai meeri, 2026-aam aandin murpagudhiyil, 1,300 shipmentkalil, eeraanukku China aayudhangalai anuppi vaithiruppadhaaga, aangila oodagangalil seythi veliyidappattulladhu.
Iran-in paadhugaapputhuraiyai valuppaduthum nokkil indha aayudhangal anuppappattiruppadhaagavum, eeraaniya sungathurai padhivugalai vaithu, idhu kanduvidikkappattadhaagavum, andha aangila oodagangal therivithullana. Trongal matrum pira aayudhangalukku payanbaduthakkoodiya udhirivaagangal indha etrumadhigalil adangum endrum, koorappadugiradhu. Mothamaaga, janavari 2025 mudhal joon 2026 varaiyilaana kaalakkattathil, jivies saadhanangal, mottaargal matrum vimaana iyandhira paagangal pondravatraiyum, China anuppiyadhaaga, oodaga seythigal thagaval therivikkindrana.
Kurippaaga, eeraanukkum, amerikkaavukkum idaiye 60 naal por nirutham arivikkappatta adhe naalaana joon 17 andrum, eeraanai oru shipment adaindhiruppadhaaga, koorappadugiradhu. Melum, irandu naatkalukkup piragu, trongalil payanbaduthakkoodiya 6 milliyan taalarukkum adhigamaana madhippulla paagangalais sumandhu kondu tajan kanakkaana etrumadhigal vandhu serndhana endrum sollappadugiradhu. Aikkiya naadu savai koottathil America matrum Iran idaiye vaarthai modhal nadaivetrirukkum soozhalil America-vil China adhivar ji jinbingirku sigappu kambala varaverpu kodukkappattirukkum velaiyil ithagaiya thagaval veliyaagi iruppadhu sarvadhesa arasiyal vattaarathil paravarappai erpaduthi irukkiradhu.

headline: “kanvaar yaathiraiyaik kalangappadutha sadhi” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Vada India-vil indhukkal merkollum kanvaar yaathiraiyaik kalangappadutha islaamiyargal sadhi seyvadhaaga koori oru video

kanvaar yaathirai vaaganathin adiyil thideerendru nuzhaindhu ilainjar oruvar tharkolai seythugollum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indha aatkal evvalavu aavathaanavargal. Netru sahaaranboorin thiyovandhil, kanvaar yaathreegargalai etris sendra laariyin adiyil vendumendre modhi “vaahith” endra navar irandhaar. Kaavaldhuraiyinarukku oru video kidaithavodhu kalavaram thodangiyadhu. Kanvaar yaathraavai video eduthukkondirundhavodhu, andha vazhiyaagas sendra oru siruvanin kemaraavil indha video padhivaagiyulladhu. Indha navar odivandhu laariyin sakkarangalukku adiyil paduthu sambava idathileye irandhadhu indha video-vil thelivaagath therigiradhu.
Andha navar yaar *”vaahith”*, avar en idhais seythaar?? *yaar idhais seyyas sonnaargal?? Indha video illaiyendraal enna nadandhirukkum endru yosithup paarungal??
Arasaangam indha sambavathin adippagudhikkus sendru, thiraikkup pinnaal idhuvondra vilaiyaattugalai nadathuvavargalaik kandarindhu avargal meedhu kadumaiyaana nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Idhu kanvar yaathiraiyaith thodarndhu avadhooru seyyum sadhiyin oru pagudhi. “indhukkalai ‘payangaravaadhigal’ endru arivikka muyatsippadhu yaar? Indhak kelviyai aazhamaagas sindhithaal, padhil thaanaagave kidaikkum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vada India-vil indhukkal ovvoru aandum kanvaar yaathirai merkolgindranar. Yaathiraiyaaga selbavargalukku utharappiradhesa arasum kaaval thuraiyum pookkalaith thoovuvadhu, unavu vazhanguvadhu endru pala udhavigalai seythu varugindranar. Ippadi pookkal thoovi, kaal pidithuviduvadhu thodarbaana video-kkal samooga oodagangalil paravi paravarappai erpaduthina. Indha soozhalil kanvaar yaathiraikku edhiraaga islaamiyargal soozhchi seyvadhaaga kutramsaatti video ondrais silar padhivittu varugindranar.
Utharappiradhesathin sahaaranboorin thiyovanth endra idathil netru indha sambavam nadandhadhaaga kurippittullanar. Ore padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil kaappi pest seygindranar. Idhanaal netru endru endha thedhiyaik kurippidugiraargal enbadhu theriyavillai. Kanvaar yaathiraikku edhiraaga sadhis seyal nadandhadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2017m aandil indha seythiyai theevira valadhusaari oodagangal veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Adhilum kooda sadhi nadandhadhaaga kooravillai. Andha seythiyil, “ilainjar oruvar kanvaar yaathirai sendra vaaganathin keezhe nuzhaindhu tharkolai seythugondaar.
Idhaith thodarndhu andha pagudhiyil paravarappu erpattadhu. Irandhavar veettin munbaaga eraalamaanavargal koodinaargal. Nallavelaiyaaga nadandha sambavam anaithum angirundha oruvaraal video edukkappattadhu. Andha video samooga oodagangalil paraviyadhu. Idhanaal endha pirasnaiyum erpadavillai” endru kurippittirundhanar. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil kurippittadhu pondru kalavaram ellaam thodangiyirukkavillai. Theevira valadhusaari oodagangalilum kooda kalavaram nadandhadhaaga kurippidappadavillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu utharappiradhesa kaavaldhurai veliyitta fekt sek padhivu ondru namakku kidaithadhu. Adhilum, indha sambavam 2017m nadandhadhu. Pazhaiya sambavathai tharpodhu nadandhadhu pondru samooga oodagangalil vairalaakka vendaam. Appadi seybavargal meedhu kadum nadavadikkai edukkappadum. Thavaraana padhivai veliyittavargal udanadiyaaga adhai neekkumbadi kettukkolgirom. Melum, idhu pondra seythi, veediyokkalai adhan unmaith thanmaiyais sarivaarkkaamal pagira vendaam” endru kurippittirundhanar.
Idhan moolam 2017m aandu nadandha tharkolai sambavathin video-vai eduthu, tharpodhu 2025m aandil kanvaar yaathiraikku edhiraaga islaamiyargal seyalbadugiraargal endru thavaraaga vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kuzhaay udaindhu kudineer virayam oru maadhamaaga thodarum avalam
text:
Kuzhaay udaindhu kudineer virayam oru maadhamaaga thodarum avalam
palladam, sep. 24–
palladathil kuzhaay udaippu kaaranamaaga kudineer virayamaagi varuvadhu kadandha oru maadhathukkum melaaga needithu varugiradhu.
Palladam naalrodu siknal aruge, mangalam rottil irundhu thesiya nedunjjaalaikku thirumbum idathil kudineer kuzhaay udaippu erpattulladhu. Idhilirundhu thinasari kudineer veliyeri, rottil vazhindhoduvadhudan, saakkadai kaalvaayilum kalandhu varugiradhu. Kadandha oru maadhathukkum melaaga kudineer virayamaavadhu thodargiradhu.
Nagaraatchi, nedunjjaalaithurai, pathirappadhivuthurai matrum ooraatchi ondriya aluvalagam ullitta palveru arasu aluvalagangal arugaruge amaindhullana. Palveru thurai arasu adhigaarigalum thinasari indha vazhiyaaga sendru varugindranar. Iruppinum, thinasari kaalai kudineer virayamaagi rottil vazhindhoduvadhu adhigaarigalin kavanathukku varaadhadhu podhumakkal mathiyil adhirupdhiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Erkanave podhiya mazhai illaadhadhaal thanneer thattuppaadu erpadum soozhal nilavi varugiradhu. Innilaiyil, idhuvondru kudineer virayamaavadhu thanneer thattuppaattai melum adhigarikkas seyyum. Enave, kuzhaay udaippai kandarindhu udanadiyaaga sariseythu, kudineer virayathai thadukka adhigaarigal nadavadikkai edukka vendum ena podhumakkal edhirbaarkkindranar.

headline: 'katchi maariya ADMK emele-kalukku roo.35 kodi kodukkappattulladhu'- pollaachi jeyaraaman pugaar!
text:
"mainaaritti aatchiyai kaappaatruvadharkaaga navar oruvarukku 35 kodi roobai kodukkappattulladhu. Ungal vaakkai vaangi emaatriya avargalukku sariyaana paadam karpippadharkaagadhaan thaaraavuram, madhuraandhagam idaitherdhal vandhulladhu"
Kovai maavattam pollaachi arugeyulla kottoor malaiyaandivattinam pagudhiyil ADMK saarbil munnaal mudhalamaichar annaavin 118 vadhu pirandha naal vizhaa podhukkoottam nadaivetradhu. Ikkoottathil pangetra pollaachi jeyaraaman kooriyadhaavadhu, "maragadham kumaravel, sathyavaamaa aagiyorin peyarai sollave enakku vaay varavillai. Irandu perum irattai ilai sinnathil nindru vetri petravargal. Thaaraavurathil sathyavaamaa visilai vida 40 aayiram vaakkugal vithiyaasathil vetri petravar. Edharkaaga ivar raajinaamaa seythaar ena makkal kettum sollavillai.
Namadhu aatchi vandhirundhaal namma katchiyil irundhiruppaaraam. Naam aatchikku varaadhadhaal aalungatchikku sella vendum ena raajinaamaa seythu poyiyullaar. 35 kodi roobai panathai petruk kondu katchi maariyullaar. Makkal ottai petru irattai ilai sinnathil vetri petru katchi maariya athanai perum navar oruvarukku 35 kodi roobai katchi maaruvadharku kodukkappattulladhu. Mainaaritti aatchiyai kaappaatruvadharkaaga navar oruvarukku 35 kodi roobai kodukkappattulladhu. Ungal vaakkai vaangi emaatriya avargalukku sariyaana paadam karpippadharkaagadhaan thaaraavuram, madhuraandhagam idaitherdhal vandhulladhu. Itherdhalil ADMK arudhi perumbaanmai udan vetri perum. Therdhal mudindha moondre naalgalil indha aatchi veettukku pogum. Meendum podhutherdhal varum. Meendum Edappadi Palaniswami mudhalamaicharaaga varuvaar" enath therivithaar.

headline: Mudhalvar Vijay-in pirittan payanam en?: Thamizhaga arasu vilakkam
text:
Chennai: 'thozhil uravugalai valuppaduthuvadhum, erkanave ulla niruvanangalin seyalbaadugalai virivuppaduthuvadhum, mudhalvar Vijay-in pirittan payanathin mukkiya nokkangal' ena, Thamizhaga arasu therivithulladhu.
 Thamizhaga arasu veliyittulla arikkai: TVK, arasu poruppetru, 100 naatkalaana nilaiyil, mudhaleettaalargal maanaadu vaayilaaga, oru latcham kodi roovaaykkum, adhigamaana mudhaleettirkaana purindhunarvu oppandhangal merkollappattu ullana.
Airoppiya naadugalais serndha pannaattu niruvanangal, 8,491 kodi roobai madhippilaana mudhaleettu thittangalai munvaithullana. Avatrin vaayilaaga, 5,690 perukku velai vaayppugal uruvaagum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Pirittanai serndha niruvanangal, neenda kaalamaagave Thamizhagathil, poriyiyal, nidhi sevaigal matrum thozhilnutbam ullitta thuraigalil, kurippidathakka alavil seyalbattu varugindrana. Ivatril pala niruvanangal, Thamizhagathil urpathi aalaigalaiyum, ulagalaaviya thiran maiyangalaiyum niruvi seyalbattu varugindrana.
Ithagaiya uravugalai valuppaduthuvadhum, erkanave ulla niruvanangalin seyalbaadugalai virivuppaduthuvadhum, mudhalvar Vijay-in pirittan payanathin mukkiya nokkangalaagum. Idhan vaayilaaga, Thamizhagathil uyardhara velai vaayppugalai uruvaakkum vaayppugal erpadum. Melum, 'ulagatharam vaayndha, mottaar sborts nagaram amaikkappadum' ena, mudhalvar arivithullaar.
Indha arivippai munneduthu sellum vagaiyil, ulagin munnani mottaar sborts vilaiyaattu ulgattamaippu vasadhigalai, neril paarvaiyittu, sirandha nadaimuraigalai arindhu kolvadhu payanulladhaaga irukkum. Idharkaaga, 'silvar ston mottaar resing sarkyoot' pottiyai, mudhalvar paarvaiyida thittamidappattulladhu.
Idharkaaga mudhalvar Vijay thalaimaiyilaana kuzhu, Chennai-yil irundhu netru purappattadhu. Ikkuzhu 17m thedhi meendum Chennai thirumba ulladhu. Ikkuzhuvil podhuppanithurai amaichar aadhav arjunaa, Tamil Nadu vilaiyaattu membaattu aanaiya uruppinar seyalar meganaadha retti, thozhildhurai vazhigaatti niruvana iyakkunar theevak jekkap matrum arasu aluvalargal idam petrullanar. Ivvaaru adhil koorappattulladhu.

headline: Idugaadaaga maatrum Pakistan; ai.naa.,vil kaashmeer pen kutrachaattu
text:
Jenivaa: aakkiramithulla kaashmeerai idugaadaaga maatra Pakistan muyatsippadhaaga ai.naa.,vil kaashmeerais serndha samooga aarvalaraana thasleemaa akdhar kutram saattiyullaar.
Jenivaavil nadaivetra 63vadhu ainaa manidha urimaigal kavunsil koottathil avar pangetru pesiyadhaavadhu; adippadai urimaigalaik kori amaidhiyaana muraiyil poraadiya podhumakkal meedhu Pakistan paadhugaappup padaiyinar thuppaakkis soodu nadathiyadhu kandanathirkuriyadhu. Adippadai urimaigalukkaaga poraadum makkalai thottaakkalaik kondu odukkum naattaal, kaashmeerigalin nalanil unmaiyaaga akkarai kolla mudiyaadhu. Pakistan aakkiramippu kaashmeerai aasaath kaashmeer endru Pakistan azhaippadhu migapperiya poy.
Kaashmeerukkul payangaravaadhigalai ooduruvas seythu, adhanai idugaadaaga maatra Pakistan muyandru varugiradhu. Tharpodhu Pakistan aakkiramippu kaashmeerilum appaavi edhirppaalargalaik kondru kuvithu varugiradhu. Pakistan aakkiramippu makkalin unmaiyaana piradhinidhigal yaarum ainaavil anumadhikkappadavillai. Paagisdhaanukkaagap pesa landanais serndhavargalai azhaithu vandhu oru poliyaana pimbathai uruvaakki varugindranar. Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Kudineer viniyogam seeraaga illaadhadhaal thavippu! : pollaachiyil alaimodhum makkal
text:
Pollaachi: pollaachi nagaril kadandha, 10 naatkalaaga kudineer viniyogam seeraaga illaadhadhaal, podhumakkal kudineerukkaaga alaimodhum nilai erpattulladhu.
Pollaachi nagaraatchiyil, 36 vaardugalil, oru latchathukkum merpatta makkal vasikkindranar. Ambaraambaalaiyathil aazhiyaaru aatril irundhu neer eduthu, suthigarippu seythu, neeretru nilaiyathil irundhu, thinamum, 14 milliyan liter kudineer pollaachikku kondu varappadugiradhu.
Maarkket rottil ulla neer undhu nilaiyam vaayilaaga, onbadhu uyar matta kudineer thekka thotti, irandu tharaimatta neer thekka thottigalukku kudineer viniyogikkappadugiradhu.
Nagaril, 17,650 kudineer veettu inaippugalum, 198 podhukkuzhaay inaippugalum ullana. Idhu mattumindri matra payanbaattukku thaniyaaga porvel, kinatru thanneerum viniyogikkappadugiradhu.
Ovvoru pagudhikkum, iru naatkalukku oru murai kudineerum, orunaal vittu oru naal matra payanbaattukkum thanneer saplai seyyappadugiradhu. Innilaiyil, kadandha, 10 naatkalaaga kudineer muraiyaaga viniyogam illai ena podhumakkal pugaar therivithanar.
Kudineer viniyogam thideerena thadaippattadhaal, makkal avadhikkullaagi ullanar. Kudikka neerindri vilaikku vaangi payanbaduthum nilai sila pagudhigalil erpattulladhu. Raajaamil rodu, amaidhi nagar pagudhigalilum makkal kudineerukkaaga alaimodhugindranar.
Nagarappagudhigalil kuzhaaygal pudhuppikkum soozhalil kudineer viniyogathil thittamidal illaadhadhaal pirasnai nilavuvadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu.
Innilaiyil, neer undhu nilaiyathil, irandu mottaargal payanbaduthappattu, neer viniyogam seyyappattadhu. Adhil, ondru ambaraambaalaiyam neeretru nilaiyathukku kondu sendradhaagavum, angu pazhudhaagiya mottaar sari seyyavillai endrum koorappadugiradhu. Tharpodhu ingu irundha oru mottaar, pazhudhaanadhaal kudineer viniyogam paadhikkappattadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Ippirasnaikku theervu kaana nagaraatchi adhigaarigal viraindhu nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Seeraaga kudineer viniyaagam seyya vendum ena podhumakkal valiyuruthi ullanar.

headline: ‘isrelin indraiya nilai’ endru paravum veediyo unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran thaakkudhalil kattidangal udaindhu, migavum paadhikkappatta nilaiyil Israel iruppadhaaga oru video

kattidangal ellaam idindha nilaiyil oru nagarame sidhaindhu poy irukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thannai azhikka yaarumillai endru ninaitha aanavakkaaranin indraiya nilai #indraiya_isrel_nilavaram” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran meedhu America, Israel inaindhu thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu. Idhil Iran naattin uyar thalaivar kollappattaar. Idharku padhiladiyaaga aravu naadugalil ulla America raanuva thalangal matrum Israel naattin meedhu Iran thaakkudhal nadathi varugiradhu. Iran thaakkudhalil isrelin nilai endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Indha video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2023m aandilirundhe indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, thurukkiyil erpatta 7.4 rikdar sakdhi vaayndha nilanadukkathil kattidangal idindhu vizhundhana endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video thurukki naattil ulla pasaarsik maavattathin kahramanmaraas (Pazarcık district of Kahramanmaraş) endra idathil edukkappattadhaaga 2023m aandu veliyaana padhivugalil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thurukki naattil ulla oodagangalilum kooda indha video veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Idhan moolam thurukki naattil 2023m aandu erpatta nilanadukkathin paadhippu thodarbaana video-vai eduthu, isrelin tharpodhaiya nilai endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Periya thozhil, vaniga niruvanangalukkaana min kattanam uyarthappattadhaa?
text:

headline: Vangiyil panam edukka thiranda Pakistan makkal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’vangiyil panam edukka thiranda Pakistan makkal’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ India eppodhu vendumaanaalum thaakkudhal nadathalaam engindra por peedhiyil…
Pakistan makkal panathai edukka vangiyil kuvindhanar…,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha veediyovukkum, tharpodhaiya Pakistan – India modhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Kadandha 2021m aandu aapgaanisdhaan naattil irundha America paadhugaappup padaiyinarai muzhuvadhum thirumbap peruvadhaaga, appodhaiya America adhivar jo Biden arivithaar.
Idhanberil, 2021, joolai maadham aapgaanisdhaanil irundha amerikkargal, 90 sadhaveedham per veliyerinar. Maruvuram, thalivaangal neradiyaaga aapgaanisdhaan paadhugaappup padaiyinarai thaakki, palveru idangalai thangal vasam nirvagikka thodanginar. Padippadiyaaga, munneriya thalivaangal aagast 15, 2025 andru, thalainagar kaavoolai kaippatrinar. Idhanaal peedhiyadaindha podhumakkal, andraiya aapgaanisdhaan arasu adhigaarigal, paadhugaappup padaiyinar, velinaattu makkal ulbada palveru tharappinarum aapgaanisdhaanil irundhu, thappithu odinar. Idhanbodhu, America aadharavu petra aapgan adhivar asrap kani, naattaivittu odiyadhaal, aapgan arasu nilaigulaindhadhu.
Ketbaaratra nilaiyil, thalivaangal meendum aapganil aatchi nadatha thodanginar. Idhaiyotti, aapgaanisdhaan makkalukku, palveru kattuppaadugalai thalivaangal vidhithanar. Adhil ondraaga, aapgan makkal, vangigalil panam eduppadharkum sila kattuppaadugal vidhikkappattana.
Idhanberil, munnecharikkai nadavadikkaiyaaga, vangigalil panam edukka podhumakkal thirandanar. Aapgaanisdhaanil ulla palveru vangigalilum makkal koottam alaimodhiyadhu. Appodhu edukkappatta video-vil ondraithaan, tharpodhu samooga valaidhalangalil maruvagirvu seygiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram…
enave, 2021m aandu aapgaanisdhaan naattil edukkappatta video-vai, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhaludan thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thaaraavuram idaitherdhal: ‘pengal padai’ kalathil... Vellappovadhu yaar?
text:
Aalungatchikku aknip pareetchai!
Thaaraavuram thogudhiyil therdhal kanakkugal vithiyaasamaaga irukkindrana. TVK, DMK, ADMK, naam thamizhar, kamyoonisttugal ena aindhumunaip potti nilavugiradhu. Idhil TVK saarbil munnaal ADMK em.el.e sathiyavaamaa, DMK saarbil vazhakkarinjar suganyaa, ADMK saarbil paanumadhi, naam thamizhar saarbil kaarthigaa ena mukkiyak katchigal anaithilum pengale vetbaalargalaagak kalamirangiyirukkindranar.
Therdhal panigalilum katchigal theeviram kaattivarugindrana. TVK saarbil amaichar arun raaj thalaimaiyil amaichargal, em.el.e-kkal kalamirakkappattullanar. DMK saarbil munnaal amaichar mu.pe.saaminaadhan, maavattas seyalaalar pathmanaavan aagiyorum, ADMK saarbil munnaal amaichar thindukkal seenivaasan thalaimaiyilum therdhal panigal merkollappadugindrana.
2.22 latcham vaakkaalargal... Theerppai ezhudhappovadhu yaar?
Thaaraavuram thogudhiyil 1,06,875 aan vaakkaalargal, 1,15,523 pen vaakkaalargal, 8 moondraam paalina vaakkaalargal ena motham 2,22,406 per ullanar. Ivargalil pen vaakkaalargale adhigam enbadhaal, pen vetbaalargal adhiga alavil kalamirangiyirup padhum therdhal kanakkil mukkiyathuvam perugiradhu.
Vivasaayam, kaalnadai valarppu, javuli, sengalsoolai aagiyavai indhap pagudhiyin mukkiyath thozhilgal. Adhevelaiyil, amaraavadhi aaru maasuvaduvadhu, kudineerth thattuppaadu, nilathadi neermattam sarivu, kalguvaari paadhippu, kidappilulla upperi paasanath thittam, tharam uyarthappadaadha arasu maruthuvamanai, saalai - mazhaineer vadigaal vasadhiyinmai ullitta palveru pirasnaigal ullana. Thakkaali, murungai ullitta kaaygarigalais semikka kulirbadhanak kidangu illaadhadhum vivasaayigalukkus sikkalaaga irukkiradhu.
Sathiyavaamaa - selvaakkaa... Adhirupdhiyaa?
Thaaraavuram thogudhiyil thi.mu.ka-vum a.thi.mu.ka-vum maari maari vetrivetru varugindrana. 2021-l thi.mu.ka-vin kayalvizhi selvaraaj vendru amaicharaana nilaiyil, 2026-l ADMK-vin sathiyavaamaa, DMK vetbaalar indhiraaniyai 16,727 vaakkugal vithiyaasathil veezhthinaar. TVK vetbaalar kavuri sithraa 46,438 vaakkugaludan moondraavadhu idam pidithaar.
Indha nilaiyil, vetrivetra adhe sathiyavaamaa, tharpodhu TVK vetbaalaraagak kalamirangiyiruppadhu idaitherdhalin mukkiya arasiyal thiruppamaagiyirukkiradhu. Avarmeedhaana adhirupdhiyaa, vijaykkaana aadharavaa enbadhe thaaraavurathin piradhaana vivaadhamaaga irukkiradhu.
Thaaraavurathil 36 aandugalaaga auto ottivarum kaalimuthuvidam pesiyavodhu, “pona murai
a.thi.mu.ka-vukkuthaan ottup potten. Idaitherdhalil aalungatchi vetriveruvadhu ezhudhap padaadha vidhi. Sathiyavaamaa meedhu adhirupdhi iruppadhu unmaidhaan. Aanaal, mudhalvar Vijay munbaaga adhu eduvadumaa enath theriyavillai. Yaar vetri petraalum, thogudhikku nalladhu seyya vendum” endraar.
‘sathiyavaamaavukku edhirppu’... Kiraamangalil penargal!
``aanaal, kalam appadiyondrum tha.ve.ka-vukkus saadhagamaaga illai’’ engiraar indhu makkal katchiyin maavattath thalaivar si.eesvaran. Avar koorugaiyil, “thaaraavuram nagarathaivida kiraamappurangalil sathiyavaamaavukku edhiraana adhirupdhi adhigamaaga ulladhu. Kudineer, vivasaayak kadan ullitta pirasnaigal mukkiyamaaga irukkindrana. Idhanaal sila kiraamangalil sathiyavaamaa ullitta yaarum ottuk kettu varak koodaadhu ena penargal vaikkappattullana. Tharpodhaiya nilaiyil irattai ilaikku aadharavu adhigamaaga irukkiradhu” endraar.
Peyar kurippida virumbaadha thalluvandip pazha viyaavaari oruvar, “ippodhudhaan therdhal panimanaigal amaikka aarambithirukkiraargal. Innum oru vaaram pogattum. Mukkiyak katchi nirvaagigal ingeye mugaamiduvaargal. Panam, parisupporulgal ena aaraaga odum. Vaakkaalargal kaattil mazhaidhaan. Idhu saadhaarana idaitherdhal illai. Aalungatchiyaana tha.ve.ka-vaal konduvarappatta therdhal enbadhaal vetrivera ellaa vazhigalaiyum kaiyaalvaargal. Thi.mu.ka-vum lesil vidaadhu” endraar.
Saadhik kanakku... Yaarukkus saadhagam?
Thaaraavuram therdhalil kongu velaalak kavundargal, arundhadhiyargal aagiya samoogangal vetri, tholviyaith theermaanippavargalaagap paarkkappadugindranar. Aanaal, piradhaana katchigal pallar samoogathinarukku vetbaalar vaayppu vazhangiya nilaiyil, arundhadhiyargalukkup podhiya mukkiyathuvam alikkappadavillai endra adhirupdhi pattiyal samoogathinaridaiye iruppadhaagak kalathil pesappadugiradhu.
Tha.ve.ka-vukku idhu mudhal therdhal vetriyaip padhivu seyya vendiya mukkiyak kalam. Munnaal ADMK em.el.e sathiyavaamaa vetbaalaraaga iruppadhaal, ‘kudhiraip peram’ kutrachaattaiyum muriyadithu, makkal theerppaal vendradhaaga niroovikkavendiya kattaayam andhak katchikku ulladhu. Thi.mu.ka-vukku izhandha thogudhiyai meetkavum, a.thi.mu.ka-vukku munnaal em.el.e-vai edhirthu ‘irattai ilai’ palathai niroovikkavum savaal. Naam thamizhar, kamyoonisttugalum kalathil irundhaalum, vetri, tholviyil avargalukku evvidhap pangum irukkappovadhillai.
‘valukkattaayamaagath therdhalai thinithullanar’ ena arasiyalreedhiyil vimarsanangal irundhaalum, adhu kurithuth thogudhikkul evvidhas salasalappum illai!

headline: Pichaikkaarar vedathil keralaavirku padaiyeduthulla kutravaaligal endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘pichaikkaarar vedathil keralaavirku padaiyeduthulla kutravaaligal,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kerala kaavaldhurai arivippu. Koodudhal kavanamaaga irungal.
Indha ramalaan maadhathil, vada maanilangalilirundhu keralaavirku eraalamaana pichaikkaarargal padaiyedukkiraargal. Avargal kadumaiyaana kutravaaligal. Avargalukku oru paisaa kooda kodukkaadheergal. Pengal mattume irukkum veettirku avargal vandhaal, kadhavaith thirandhu avargalai veliyeras sollaadheergal.
Kaavaldhurai pullivivarangalinbadi, kadandha vaarathil kozhikkodu, kannoor, ernaagulam, kollam matrum thiruvanandhavuram rail nilaiyangalil pira maanilangalais serndha sumaar oru latcham per vandhullanar.
Avargalin adhigaritha ottathirkaana kaaranathai Police visaarithavodhu, ramalaan maadhathil pichai edukkavum, ramalaan maadhathil nonbu norkum ezhaigal matrum ezhaigalidam kollaiyadikkavum avargal angu vandhiruppadhaik kanduvidithanar.
Pichaikkaarargalai odhukki vaikkavum! Ungal veettaiyum sutruppurathaiyum paadhugaappaanadhaakkungal.”
endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2018m aandu mudhal samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappattu varum vadhandhi endru theriyavandhadhu.
Kadandha 2018m aandu idhe vadhandhi malaiyaalam mozhiyil paraviyavodhu, kerala kaavaldhurai maruppu veliyittulladhaik kandom.
Idhevondru, 2019m aandum kerala kaavaldhurai saarbaaga meendum maruppu koorappattulladhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, 2024m aandu idhe vadhandhi meendum paraviya soozhalil kerala kaavaldhurai vilakkam alithadhu. Adhanaiyum aadhaarathirkaaga inge inaithullom.
Ivvaaru 2018m aandu mudhale indha vadhandhi samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappadum ondraaga ulladhu. Idhuvatri kerala kaavaldhurai thodarchiyaaga maruppu therivithu varugiradhu. Aanaal, indralavum merkanda vadhandhi, thamizh, malaiyaalam pondra mozhigalil thodarndhu paravugiradhu. Idhan unmaithanmai theriyaamal namadhu vaasagargal yaarukkum pagira vendaam endru kettuk kolgirom.
Irudhiyaaga, kerala kaavaldhurai tharappil Cyber Crime Helpline thodarbugondu, vilakkam kettom. Nammidam pesiya adhigaari ‘’idhu pala aandugalaaga paravum vadhandhi. Erkanave naangal palamurai maruppu veliyittirukkiraam,’’ endru koorinaar.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kannoor vimaana nilaiyathil pavarbengk vedithadhaa?
text: Kannoor vimaana nilaiyathil oruvar sattai paakkettil pavarbengai vaithu selbonil saarj pottukkondirukkumbodhu, pavarbengk vedithu, avarmeedhu theeppidithadhu.
investigation_details:
Ithagaval thavaraanadhaagum. Unmaiyil video-vil kaanappadum navar avarmeedhu avare theeyittullaar. Ichambavamaanadhu morokkovil nadandhulladhu.
Kannoor vimaana nilaiyathil oruvar sattai paakkettil pavarbengai vaithu selbonil saarj pottukkondirukkumbodhu pavarbengk vedithu, avarmeedhu theeppatriyadhaaga video ondru vaatsaappil paraviyadhai thodarndhu, niyoossekkarin vaatsaap tiplain ennukku (+91 9999499044) indha veediyothagavalai vaasagar oruvar anuppi idhukkurithu kettirundhaar.
Samooga oodagangalil paravi varum ithagavalin unmaithanmaik kurithu ariya ithagaval kurithu niyoossekkar thamizh saarbil aayvu seyya mudivu seythom.

kannoor vimaana nilaiyathil pavarbengk vedithu oruvar meedhu theeppatriyadhaaga video ondru vairalaanadhai thodarndhu avveediyovai thanithani keefiremgalaaga pirithu, avatrai rivars sars muraikku utbaduthi avveediyo kurithu thedinom.
Ithedalil Morocco World News enum inaiya oodagathil viral-aagum video-vil kaanappadum sambavamaanadhu morokko naattin agadhir nagaril nadandhadhaaga seythi veliyittiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Acheythiyil annavar thanakkuthaane theeyittuk kondadhaaga therivikkappattirundhadhu.
Idhukkurithu thodarndhu thedugaiyil agadhir 24 enum morokkovin inaiya oodagathil ichambavam kurithu seythi veliyittiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu.

headline: DMK aatchiyil kaavaldhuraikku nerndha avalam endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘DMK aatchiyil kaavaldhuraikku nerndha avalam,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’Stalin mudhalvaraaga irukkum varai udanbirappugal yaarum kaaval thuraiyai kandu kadugu alavu anjja maattaargal.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan Chennai thiruvotriyoor rail nilaiyathil paravarappu sambavam endru kurippittu, Police seerudai anindha navar ilainjar oruvarai thaakkum kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idharkum, Tamil Nadu kaavaldhuraikkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, Chennai thiruvotriyoor rail nilaiyathil podhai ilainjar oruvar tharakkuraivaaga nadandhugondadhaal, avarai angirundha railway paadhugaappup padai kaavalar oruvar thaakkiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
New Indian Express l Raj News Tamil
RPF enbadhu mathiya arasin neradik kattuppaattil ulla thuraiyaagum. Idharkum, Tamil Nadu arasu matrum poleeskkum, endha thodarbum illai.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, Tamil Nadu Police kattuppaattu araiyai thodarbugondu pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, railway paadhugaappup padai kaavalar oruvarin video-vai eduthu, Tamil Nadu Police udan thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thozhugai seytha islaamiyargal! Vedithu sidhariya punidha masoodhi.. Kothaaga pona uyirgal!
text:
Paagisdhaanin kaivar pakdhunvaa maagaanam, kohaat pagudhiyil kaavaldhurai thalaimaiyaga valaagathil ulla masoodhiyil vellikkizhamai thozhugai nerathil tharkolaippadai car kundu vedithadhu. Nuzhaivu vaayilil modhiya car vedippaal masoodhi kadumaiyaaga sedhamadaindhu, kuraindhadhu 16 per uyirizhandhu, 50-kkum merpattor kaayamadaindhanar. Palarin nilai kavalaikkidamaaga ulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
Pakistan naattin kaivar pakdhunvaa maagaanathil ulla kohaat endra pagudhiyil, islaamiyargal thozhugai seyvadharkaaga masoodhi ondru amaindhulladhu. Indha masoodhiyil vaarandhorum vellik kizhamaigalil, palveru islaamiyargal thozhugaikku varuvadhu vazhakkam. Andha vagaiyil, kaavaldhurai thalaimaiyagathin valaagathil amaindhulla andha masoodhikku, vellikkizhamaiyaana indru adhiga alavilaana islaamiyargal thozhugaikku vandhullanar. Appodhu, vedimarundhugal muzhumaiyaaga nirappappatta car ondrai oruvar ottivandhu, masoodhiyin nuzhaivu vaayilil modhiyullaar.
Idhangaaranamaaga, kaaril irundha vedimarundhugal adhivayangara sathathudan vedithadhil, masoodhi palatha sedham adaindhulladhu. Melum, adhan nuzhaivu vaayilil migapperiya pallam erpattulladhodu, angu paadhugaappu paniyil irundha kaavaldhuraiyinarum paadhikkappattullanar. Payangaravaadhigal nadathiya indha tharkolaippadai thaakkudhalil, idhuvarai 16 per uyirizhandhirukkalaam endrum, 50-kkum merpattor padugaayam adaindhirukkalaam endrum therivikkappattulladhu.
Kaayam adaindhavargal udanadiyaaga meetkappattu arugil ulla maruthuvamanaigalukku avasara sigichaikkaaga anuppi vaikkappattullanar. Ivargalil palaradhu nilai migavum kavalaikkidamaaga iruppadhaal, pali ennikkai innum adhigarikkum endru anjjappadugiradhu. Sambava idathirku viraindhu vandha paadhugaappup padaiyinarum meetbuk kuzhuvinarum appagudhiyai muzhumaiyaagath thangal kattuppaattukkul konduvandhu meetbup panigalaith theevirappaduthiyullanar. Ichambavam appagudhiyil perum padhatrathaiyum sogathaiyum erpaduthiyulladhu.
Tharpodhu varai indha thaakkudhalukku endhavoru amaippum, porupperkavillai endru koorappadugiradhu. Idharku munbu, kadandha 2022-aam aandu andru paagisdhaanin peshaavar shiyaa masoodhiyilum, vellik kizhamai sirappu thozhugaiyinbodhu nadandha payangaravaadha thaakkudhalil, 60-kkum merpattor uyirizhandhanar. Melum, kadandha 2023-aam aandu janavari maadhathil adhe peshaavar masoodhiyilum, sepdambar maadham masdhung masoodhiyilum perum payangaravaadha thaakkudhal nadathappattadhu. Indha irandu thaakkudhalgalilum serthu mothamaaga 119 per varai uyirizhandhirundhanar. Kittadhatta 3 aandugalukku piragu, Pakistan-il ulla masoodhi ondril, migapperiya payangaravaadha thaakkudhal nadandhiruppadhu, annaattil perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Mathiya BJP amaichargaludan ondraaga payanitha therdhal aanaiyar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar BJP mathiya amaichargaludan thani vimaanathil payanithaar endru oru video

siriya vimaanathilirundhu mathiya amaichargal matrum silar irangi varuvadhaiyum avargalukku varaverpu alikkappadum video-vai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilaith thagavalil, “thalaimai therdhal kamishanarukku ‘isat’ pirivu paadhugaappu mathiya arasu vazhangiyadhu. Thani vimaanathila BJP mandhirigaludan thalaimai therdhal kamishanar. BJP mandhirigal veru therdhal kamishanar veru alla. Raagul kaandhiyai mirattum thairiyam ingirundhudhaan pirakkiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vaakkaalar pattiyalil poliyaana vaakkaalargalais serthu BJP vetri petru varuvadhaaga Congress ullitta edhirkkatchigal kutramsaatti varugindrana. Paajaga-vin indha seyalukku therdhal aanaiyamum thunai seyvadhaaga kutram saattappattulladhu. Indha nilaiyil thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyarum mathiya amaichargalum ondraaga ore vimaanathil payanam seythaargal endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vai paarkkum podhu ucha needhimandrathin thalaimai needhivadhiyaaga irukkum pooshan raamagirushna kavaay vimaanathil vandhiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, tharpodhaiya thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyaraaga ulla njaanesh kumaar alladhu therdhal aanaiyargal sukbeer sing sandhu matrum vivek joshi ena yaaraiyum andha video-vil kaanappadavillai. Enave, thavaraaga video-vai pagirndhirukkalaam endru aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai mathiya naadaalumandra vivagaaram matrum siruvaanmaiyinar nalathurai amaichar kiran rijjoo thannudaiya X thala pakkathil padhivittirundhaar. Adhil, arunaachala piradhesam thalainagar ittaa nagaril kattappattulla kavugaathi uyar needhimandra kilaiyin kattidathaith thirandhu vaippadharkaaga vandha ucha needhimandra thalaimai needhivadhi piaar kavaay matrum ucha needhimandra needhivadhigal, mathiya sattathurai amaichar arjun raam mekvaal aagiyorukku ittaa nagaril sirappaana varaverpu alikkappattadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Kavugaathi uyarneedhimandrak kilaiyin pudhiya kattidathaith thirandhu vaippadharkaaga ucha needhimandra thalaimai needhivadhi arunaachalaviradhesa thalainagar ittaa nagarukku vandhullaar. Avarudan mathiya sattathurai amaichar arjun raam mekvaal, arunaachalaviradhesathin em.pi-yum mathiya amaicharumaana kiran rijjoo aagiyor vimaanathil vandhullaar. Idhaith thavaraaga thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar mathiya BJP amaichargaludan ondraagap payanikkiraar endru thavaraaga pagirndhullanar. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nedunjjaalaithuraiyil paaravatcha adhigaarigalaal padhavi uyarvillai ilanilaip poriyaalargal vedhanai
text:
Madurai: nedunjjaalaith thuraiyil paaravatcha adhigaarigalaal padhavi uyarvu illaamaleye oyvu peruvadhaaga ilanilaip poriyaalargal vedhanai therivikkindranar.
Thamizhaga arasin nedunjjaalaith thuraiyil ilanilai varaivaalar (je.ti.o.,), adutha nilaiyil ilanilai poriyaalargal (je.i.,) ena paniyaatruvor adharkadutha nilaiyil udhavi kottap poriyaalaraaga (e.ti.i.,) padhavi uyarvu pera vendum. Idhil sila vidhimuraigalaal, padhavi uyarvu pera iyalaadha vagaiyil paridhavikkindranar.
Padhavi uyarvai poruthavarai je.i.,kkalukku 25, neradi niyamanam perum e.i.,kkalukku 75 sadhaveedham ena ulladhu. 2018kku munbu padhavi uyarvu pera je.ti.o., matrum je.i.,kkal ena 2 paniyidangalilum motham 10 aandugal paniyaatri irundhaal podhum. Tharpodhu je.i.,yaaga mattume 10 aandugal paniyaatri irukka vendum ena vidhigalai vaguthullanar. Idhanaal je.ti.o., matrum je.i., ena 18 mudhal 20 aandugal paniyaatriyavargalukke padhavi uyarvu kidaikkiradhu.
Idhanaal 35, 40 vayadhil paniyil serndha palar meedhiyulla panikkaalathil padhavi uyarve pera mudiyaamal oyvu petru vidugindranar. Uyarbadhavigalil udhavip poriyaalargale (e.i.,) meedhiyulla perumbaalaana paniyidangalil nirambiyullanar endranar.
Nedunjjaalai poriyiyal matrum ooraga panithurai sanga maanila thunaith thalaivar em.murugan kooriyadhaavadhu: 2018 kku mundhaiya vidhiyai kadaividithaal engalukku padhavi uyarvu kidaithu irukkum. Kadaividikkaadhadhaal indru udhavi kottavoriyaalar engal tharappil 7 perdhaan ullanar.
Adhumattumindri engalukku padhavi uyarvu kidaikkaadhadhaal engal idathaiyum kanisamaaga (25 sadhaveedhathil) avargal aakkiramithullanar. Idharku kaaranam je.i.,yaaga motham pathu aandugal paniyaatri irukka vendum engira vidhidhaan.
Ithuraiyil iyakkunar paniyalavil ullavargal e.i.,yaaga irundhu padhavi uyarvil varuvore ullanar. Avargal engal tharappai paaravatchamaaga paarkkindranar. Enave idhuvondra uyarndha padhaviyil ai.e.es., adhigaarigalai niyamikka vendum endraar.

headline: Maligai kadaikkaararidam 14 savaran paritha pavaariyaa keng vaalivar kaidhu
text:
Maligai kadaikkaararidam 14 savaran paritha 'pavaariyaa keng' vaalivar kaidhu
madhuravaayal:madhuravaayalil maligai kadaikkaararidam, 14 savaran seyinai parithu sendra 'pavaariyaa keng' navarai Police kaidhu seythanar.
Madhuravaayal paaradhi theru kaamaatchi nagar pagudhiyil maligai kadai nadathi varuvavar thinesh paavu, 38.
Kadandha joolai 24m thedhi iravu kadaikku paikkil vandha vada maanilathais serndha iruvar thinesh paavu anindhirundha, 14 savaran seyinai parithu thappi sendranar.
Idhuguritha pugaarinbadi, madhuravaayal Police visaarithanar. Kangaanippu kemaraa kaatchigalai aayvu seythu, avargal vandha irusakkara vaagana nambarai parisodhanai seytha podhu, adhu thiruttu vaaganam enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Thodarndhu iruvarum Tiruvallur sendru angu irusakkara vaaganathai niruthi vittu kaaril, melum iruvarudan thappi sendranar. Poleesaarin thodar visaaranaiyil andha car uthiraviradhesathirku sendradhu theriya vandhadhadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu angu sendra Police, maligai kadai kaararit seyin parithu sendra arjun kumaarsing endra settan, 39 enbavarai kaidhu seythanar. Kaaraiyum parimudhal seythanar. Pin arjun kumaar singai thamizhagathirku azhaithu vandhanar.
Ivar 'pavaariyaa keng'kai serndhavargal enbadhum amaavaasaiyandru angu poojai seythu vittu thamizhagathirku vandhu palveru pagudhigalil thiruttu matrum kollai sambavangalil eeduvaduvar. Pin meendum amaavaasaiyandru sondha oorgalukku selvadhai vazhakkamaaga vaithirukkum pazhakkam ullavargal ena therindhadhu. Melum ichambavathil thodarbudaiya moovarai Police thedi varugindranar.

headline: Naalukku naal erum idaitherdhal soodu...
text:
Mudhalvar Vijay imejukku `sek’?
Madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram thogudhigalukkaana idaitherdhal kalam rombave soodaagiyirukkiradhu. Irandil ondraiyaavadhu kaippatrith thangaladhu palathai niroovikkap poraadugindrana DMK, ADMK katchigal. Irandaiyume kaippatrith thannudaiya selvaakku kuraiyavillai enbadhai nilainiruthap paarkkiraar mudhalvar Vijay aanaal, sameevathil mudhalvarukku alikkappattirukkum ulavuthurai ripport inippaanadhaaga illai engiraargal seeniyar amaichargal. Irandu thogudhigalin idaitherdhal kalam eppadi irukkiradhu?
Mudhalvar imejukku ‘sek’!
Idaitherdhalai edhirgollum irandu thogudhigalil, aalum tharappin motha kavanathaiyum eerthiruppadhu thaaraavuramdhaan. Nadandhu mudindha sattamandra podhutherdhalil, avvalavu periya ‘Vijay alai’ veesiyumgooda, thaaraavurathil moondraavadhu idame petradhu TVK 2011-kkup piragu nadandha therdhalgalil, indhath thogudhiyil 40 sadhavigidha vaakkugalukkuk kuraivaaga ADMK peravillai enbadhaal, idaitherdhalaik konjjam seeriyasaagave paarkkiradhu TVK
nammidam pesiya tha.ve.ka-vin seeniyar amaichargal silar, “irandu thogudhigalilum vetrivetraal mattume, sangadamillaamal aatchiyai nagartha mudiyum. Ondril sarukkinaalgooda, ‘makkal selvaakku kuraindhuvittadhu’ enas sollividuvaargal. Mudhalvarin imej norungividum. Adhanaal thaan, thaaraavurathukku arunraaj, madhuraandhagathukku aadhav arjunaa ena irandu podhucheyalaalargalukkum poruppugalaip pirithuk koduthadhu katchith thalaimai.
Thaaraavurathil perumbaanmaiyaaga irukkum kavundar samoogathinar ADMK saarbu mananilaiyildhaan irukkiraargal. Sengottaiyanaiyum arunraajaiyum anniyamaagap paarkkiraargal. Pattiyal samoogathinar mathiyil tha.ve.ka-vukkuk kanisamaana vaakkuvangi irundhaalumgooda, angeyellaam DMK pugundhu udaikkap paarkkiradhu. Pudhiya thamizhagam kirushnasaamiyai vaithu thevendhira kula velaalargalin vaakkugalai aruvadai seyyap paarkkiraar ADMK podhucheyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami
`thaaraavuram veekkaa irukku...’ - adhirchiyalitha ulavuthurai!
Perumbagudhi kiraamangal adangiya thogudhi enbadhaal, samoogam saarndhu vaakkalippavargale thaaraavurathil adhigam. Adhilum, 2,22,398 vaakkaalargal irukkum indhath thogudhiyil, 40 vayadhukkuk keezhaanavargal sumaar 76,000 perdhaan irukkiraargal. Adharku mel vayadhullavargalidam TVK innum poys seravillai. TVK vetbaalar sathiyavaamaavukku lokkalil ezhundhirukkum edhirppu, pi.e.pi paasanap pagudhikkup podhiya neervarathu illaadhadhu pondra vishayangal aalum tharappukkus saadhagamaaga illai.
Munnaal amaichargal ke.en.neru, sakkaravaani, vellakkoyil saaminaadhan, sendhil paalaaji ena DMK seeniyargal palarum thogudhiyil mugaamittu velai paarppadhaal, pattiyalinathavar, siruvaanmaiyinar mathiyilirukkum tha.ve.ka-vin vaakkuvangi piriyakkoodiya soozhal uruvaagiyirukkiradhu. ADMK-vin 40 sadhavigidha vaakkuvangiyil periya alavil ottai vizhuvadhaagath theriyavillai.
Idhaiyellaam `not’ pottu, ‘thaaraavuram veekkaaga irukku...’ ena ulavuthurai alart seyyavum, adhirchiyaagivittaar mudhalvar Vijay adhan pinnardhaan, ovvoru thogudhiyilum irandu naal pirasaarathukkus sellath thittamittaar. Thogudhikkuth thalaa naangu amaichargal poruppaalargalaaga niyamikkappatta nilaiyil, adhan ennikkaiyai uyarthavum mudiveduthirukkiraar” endranar virivaaga.
Madhuraandhagam sollum sedhi?
Madhuraandhagathilum, TVK vetbaalar maragadham kumaravelukku edhirppu nilavugiradhu. Police paadhugaappodudhaan pirasaarathukke selgiraar maragadham. Aanaalumgooda, thogudhiyil 40 sadhavigidhathukku mel irukkum pattiyal samooga vaakkugal tha.ve.ka-vukku palam serkkindrana. ‘pattiyal samoogathinarukku ettu mandhirigalaik koduthirukkirom’ endru pirasaarathil pesi, andhas samoogathinarin vaakkugalaik kurivaikkiraargal tha.ve.ka-vinar.
Podhaadhaguraikku, therdhal pottiyilirundhu PMK vilagikkondadhum, tha.ve.ka-vukkus saadhagamaana soozhalai uruvaakkiyirukkiradhu. ‘vanniyar samoogathais serndha 18 perai
em.el.e-kkal aakkiyirukkirom’ endru pesi, thogudhiyil kanisamaaga irukkum vanniyar samoogathinarai vasappaduthap paarkkiraar amaichar aadhav arjunaa. Sumaar 1 latcham vaakkaalargal 40 vayadhukkuk keezhullavargal enbadhum, kadandha podhutherdhalil irandaamidam petriruppadhum, maragadham kumaravelin kanavar thaiyoor kumaravelukku irukkum sondhas selvaakkum tha.ve.ka-vukku palam serthirukkindrana.
Nammidam pesiya tha.ve.ka-vin seeniyar nirvaagi oruvar, “idaitherdhalil engalai edhirthu pottiyidum kamyoonisttugal, therdhal mudivugalukkup piragu aadharavaith thodarvaargalaa enath theriyavillai. Indha aatchiye mudhalvarin imejai vaithuthaan odugiradhu. Adhil siru keeral vizhundhaalum, aatchiyaith thodarvadhu kadinamaagividum. Ulavuthuraiyin echarikkaiyaith thodarndhu, idaitherdhalai seeriyasaagave paarkkiraar mudhalvar Vijay ottukkup panam alippavargal yaaraaga irundhaalum, avargalaik kaidhuseyyumbadi kaavaldhuraikku utharavittirukkiraar. Appadiyirundhumgooda, thaaraavurathin oriru idangalil pana viniyogam thodangivittadhaagave therigiradhu” endraar.
Naalukku naal idaitherdhal soodu erugiradhu. Mudhalvarin imejukku savaalum egirugiradhu!

headline: Mudhalmurai idaitherdhal!. Paravarakkum madhuraandhagam thogudhi.. Vellap povadhu yaar?
text:
Sattamandra thogudhiyaaga uruvedutha pin mudhalmuraiyaaga idaitherdhalai sandhikka irukkiradhu madhuraandhagam thogudhi. ADMK, DMK-vin kottaiyaaga irundhuvandha madhuraandhagathil, kaal padhikkumaa TVK?... Than selvaakkai thakkavaikkumaa ADMK?... Ethanai murai thiraavidak katchigal athogudhiyai thangal vetrik kodiyai naattina endra vivarathai virivaaga paarkkalaam...
Thamizhnaattirku Chennai maagaanam ena peyar irundha kaalagattamaana 1951 aam aandil sattamandra thogudhiyaaga uruveduthadhu madhuraandhagam. Appodhu 1952-l nadathappatta sattamandra therdhalil Congress katchiye vetri petradhu. Thodarndhu adutha irumuraigalum adhaavadhu 1957 matrum 1962 aagiya aandugalil nadandha therdhalgalilum kaangirase vendradhu. Pin adutha moondru murai nadandha therdhalgalil thogudhi DMK vasam sendradhu. 1967, 71, 77 aagiya aandugalil nadandha therdhalgalil thodarchiyaaga thimugave vetrik kodi naattiyadhu. 1980-l mudhalmuraiyaaga madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil ADMK vetrik kaniyai parithadhu. Pin 1984-l DMK vendradhu. Mudhal vetrikkup pin adutha therdhalil vaayppai thavaravitta ADMK, 1989 therdhalil thodangi 1991-lum vetriyai thanvasappaduthiyadhu. Pin meendum 1996-l thimugavum, 2001-l adhimugavum maari maari vendrana.
1962 aam aandu madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil vaayppai izhandha Congress katchiyaanadhu 2006 aam aandu meendum angu vendradhu. Aanaal adutha murai 2011-l therdhal nadandhavodhu kaangirasaal vella mudiyavillai. 2011 therdhalil adhimugavum, 2016-l thimugavum madhuraandhagathai maatri maatri aandana. Adhan pin kadandha irumurai nadandha therdhalgal, adhaavadhu 2021 matrum 2026 aagiya therdhalgalilum, madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil adhimugave vendradhu.
2021 therdhalinbodhu 86,646 vaakkugalaip petru vetrivetra maragadham kumaravel, 2026-l 69,284 vaakkugalaip petru vetrik kaniyaip parithaar. 2021-l 83,076 vaakkugalaip petru irandaam idathai piditha DMK, kadandha murai nadandha therdhalil verum 59,838 vaakkugalaip petru moondraam idathukku thallappattaar. 2021-l 9,293 vaakkugalaip petru NTK moondraam idam pidithirundha NTK, nadandhumudindha therdhalil verum 4,950 vaakkugalai mattume petradhu. 2026 therdhalil mudhal muraiyaaga kalam kanda thavegavin ezhil ketharin ezhilmalai madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil 62,090 vaakkugalaip petru irandaam idathaip pidithirundhaar.
Ippadi 4 murai kaangirasum, 6 murai thimugavum, 7 murai ADMK vendra madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil, varakkoodiya idaitherdhalil yaar velvaargal endra edhirbaarppu ezhundhulladhu. Aatchiyai parigodutha adhirchiyil irundhu meendu vandhu kondirukkum DMK, 3m idathirku thallappatta ADMK, aatchi adhigaarathil irukkum TVK ena indha therdhal, mummunai pottiyaaga konjjam tap irukkum endre sollappadugiradhu. Tharpodhu madhuraandhagam thogudhiyaip poruthavarai 1 latchathu 7,288 pen vaakkaalargalum, 1 latchathu 3,943 aan vaakkaalargalum, 64 moondraam paalina vaakkaalargalum ena motham 2 latchathu 11 aayirathu 295 per ullanar
therdhalukkup pin ADMK-vil irundhu vilagi thavegavil aikkiyam aana maragadham kumaravel kadandha iru therdhalgalilum madhuraandhagathil adhiga vaakkugal vithiyaasathil vendrirukkum nilaiyil, avarukku TVK tharappil vaayppu alikkappadumaa endra kelvi ezhundhulladhu. Adhevol, DMK, ADMK aagiyavai munniruthum vetbaalargal yaar endra edhirbaarppum adhigarithirukkiradhu.

headline: Paajaga-vudan koottani amaindhaal a.thi.mu.ka-vilirundhu vilagi viduven endru Jayakumar koorinaaraa?
text:
Paajaga-vudan koottani amaithaal, ADMK-vil irundhu vilagividuven endru munnaal amaicharum ADMK mootha thalaivarumaana Jayakumar kooriyadhaaga oru news card

munnaal amaichar Jayakumar pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondra news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “adhimugavilirundha vilagi viduven. Podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami meedhu muzhu nambikkai ulladhu; oruvelai meendum avar BJP-yudan koottani vaithaal naan katchiyilirundhu vilagik kolven. Pathirigaiyaalar kelvikku Jayakumar padhil” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Meendum ADMK – BJP koottani amaiyum endra ennam Tamil Nadu arasiyalil ulladhu. Appadi koottani amaithaal ADMK-vil irundhu veliyeruven endru munnaal amaichar Jayakumar kooriyadhaaga oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar. Paarkka pudhiya thalaimurai veliyitta news card polave ulladhu. Oru nimidam namakke indha news card unmaiyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra thotrathai erpaduthiyadhu.
Aanaal, Jayakumar appadi petti alithadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha news card thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Mudhalil indha news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook, X thala pakkathai aayvu seythom.
2025 maars 3m thedhi pirpagal 3 manikku indha news card veliyaanadhaaga adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha nerathil appadi endha oru news kaardaiyum pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai. Oruvelai veliyittuvittu agatrivittaargalaa endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil, pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Indha news card-ai munnaal amaichar jeyakkumaarukku anuppinom. Avarum indha news card poliyaanadhu endru nammidam urudhi seythaar. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card thavaraanadhu, poliyaanadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ammaa unavagathirku roo.1 kodi nangodai vazhangiya yogi paavu endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Thiraippada nadigar yogi paavu ammaa unavagathirku roo.1 kodi nangodai vazhanginaar endru oru pugaippadam

Thamizhaga mudhalvar vijayyidam ammaa unavagathirkaaga roo.1 kodiyai nadigar yogi paavu alippadhu pondru pugaippadam threads.com-l padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ezhaigalin pasiyai pokka CM Vijay yidam 1kodi roobai ammaa unavagathirku vazhanginaar nadigar yogi paavu.#trendingreel #temple #politics #yogivaavu #ammaa ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ammaa unavagam moolam ezhai eliya makkalukku migak kuraindha vilaiyil unavu virpanai seyyappadugiradhu. Ammaa unavagathirku roo.1 kodiyai nadigar yogi paavu alithadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal appadi nidhi udhavi seythadhaaga yogi paavu tharappilirundho, Tamil Nadu arasu tharappilirundho endha thagavalum veliyaagavillai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathil idam petra kaasolaiyil 2025m aandu endru ulladhu. Tamil Nadu arasu sinnathil vaaymaiye vellum enbadhu thavaraaga ulladhu. Ivai ellaam indha pugaippadam eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana. Eai pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum inaiyadhalathilum indha pugaippadathai padhivetrith thedinom. Avaiyum idhu eai pugaippadam endru urudhi seythana.
Yogi paavu Tamil Nadu arasidam ammaa unavagathirkaaga panam koduthadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Tamil Nadu arasin seythi vilambarath thurai inaiyathalam, samooga oodaga pakkangalilum appadi endha oru seythiyum illai.
Idhu thodarbaaga yogi paavu tharappai thodarbugondu kettom. Avargalum indha thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seythanar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Utharap piradhesathil pengalai kindal seythavanukku yogi thandanai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’utharap piradhesathil pengalai kindal seythavanukku yogi aadhithyanaath arasu vazhangiya thandanai,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ uthirappiradhesathil pengalai kindal seythavanukku yogi medidesan 🤣🤣🤣
ingu Tamil Naattil paaliyal vanmai kodumai seythavanai savaanaayagar (saavanaayagar) thambi endru azhaippaar..,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2015m aandu mathiyap piradhesa maanilam, indhooril edukkappatta video endru, theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha 2015m aandu indhooril palveru vazhakkugalil kaidhu seyyappatta kutravaaligalai oorvalamaaga azhaithus sendru, ivvaaru mathiyap piradhesa maanila Police adithullanar. Kutravaaligal mattumindri, podhumakkalidaiye payam erpaduthum nokkil indha thandanai oorvalam nadathappattadhaaga, Police tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.
Muzhu video lingk keezhe inaikkappattulladhu.
Melum, sila seythi aadhaarangalum inge inaikkappattullana.
Enave, 2015m aandu mathiyap piradhesam maanilathil nigazhndha oru sambavam thodarbaana video-vai eduthu, utharap piradhesathil nadakkum BJP aatchiyai paaraatti, adhesamayam tharpodhu Tamil Naattil nadaiverum DMK arasai vimarsikkum nokkil, vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Ivatrin adippadaiyil, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video patriya thagaval thavaraanadhu endru, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thiruchendhoor supramaniyar pirasaadham pakdhar emaatram; mudhalvarukku pugaar
text:
Thalaivaasal: thalaivaasal, sadhaasivavurathai serndhavar sadheesh-kumaar. Ivar thiruchendhoor supramaniya suvaami kovilin panneer ilai vivoodhi pirasaadham kettu aanlainil padhivu seythu, adharku, 195 roobai seluthinaar.
Netru avarukku vandha paarsalai pirithu paarthaar. Adhil aanlainil kurippittavadi vivoodhi pirasaadham vazhangavillai ena, Thamizhaga mudhalvar thanippirivu, hindhu samaya aranilai-yathuraikku pugaar manu anuppinaar.idhugurithu sadheeshgumaar kooriyadhaavadhu: thirus-sendhoor supra maniya suvaami kovilin panneer ilai pirasaadham kettu vinnappithen.
Appodhu panneer ilaiyudan, 160 kiraam vivoodhi pirasaadham, thiruchendhooril mattum muruganukku padaikkum naivethiyamaana, 'puttamudhu' 100 kiraam, moolavar matrum sanmugar pugaippa-tangal vazhanguvadhaaga therivikkappattirundhadhu.
Paarsalai pirithu paarthaal panneer ilaiyil thelikkappatta alavil vivoodhi irundhadhu. Idhu oru aal mattume vaikka mudiyum. 160 kiraam alavil illai.
Naattu sarkkarai pondru ulladhai, puttamudhu ena kurippidappattulladhu. Andha paakkettil eppodhu thayaar seythanar, kaalaavadhi vivarangal illai. Siru alavil iru padangalai anuppi emaatrivittanar.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Nadaivaadhaiyil nadakka vidungappaa
text:
