headline: ”tooveelaril 229 kilo meter, thiruttu nagaiyil jaali toor”- seyin paritha nanbargal sikkiyadhu eppadi?!
text:
Seyin parippil kaidhu seyyappatta iruvarum Thanjavur sambavathai seyvadharku munbu kallakkurichiyil pen doctor oruvaridam thanga seyinai parithanar. Appodhu andha pen doctor 50 meter thooram varai izhuthus sellappattaar.
Thanjavur aruge ulla maanojippatti pagudhiyais serndhavar niruvaamalar ivaradhu kanavar doctor kadandha 8m thedhi maligai kadaikku sendru vittu veettukkus sendrullaar. Appodhu, tooveelaril vandha iruvar niruvaamalar kazhuthil irundha 11 savaran thanga seyinai parithus sendranar. Thanjavur, maruthuvakkalloori kaaval nilaiya ellaikku utbatta pagudhiyil nadandha indha sambavam kadum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirundhadhu. Idhugurithu niruvaamalar tharappil pugaar alikkappattu maruthuvakkalloori maruthuvamanai kaaval nilaiyathil vazhakku padhivu seyyappattadhu.
Thanjavur es.pi sundharavadhanam, kutravaaligalai pidikka thanippadai amaithu utharavittaar. Insbekdar jeyandhi thalaimaiyil idhan visaaranai nadaivetradhu. Kutrappirivu udhavi aayvaalar thennarasu teem sisidivi-yil padhivaana kaatchigalai adippadaiyaaga vaithu seyin parippil eeduppatta kutravaaligalai thedinar. Idhil madhuraiyais serndha sarithira padhivedu kutravaaligalaana thanavaandi(27), sadheesh(28) aagiya iruvarum indha sambavathil eeduvattadhai kanduvidithu poleesaar kaidhu seythanar. Iruvaridamum nadathiya visaaranaiyil pala adhirchi thagavalgal velivandhullana.
Idhu kurithu ulvivaram arindha Police tharappil pesinom, ``niruvaamalaridam seyinai parithu vittu tooveelaril thappis sendra kutravaaligal sendra saalaiyil ulla sisidivi kaatchigalai aayvu seythom. Tooveelarileye Trichy, karoor, Tiruppur varai sendrirundhanar. Adhai vaithu iruvaraiyum nottamittu vandhom. Thiruppooril mattum moondru veedugal vaadagaikku eduthu maari maari thangi vandhullanar. Moondru veedugalaiyum kangaanithom. Seyin parippil eeduvattavargal ivargal thaan enbadhai urudhi seythadhum andha iruvaraiyum kaidhu seythu visaaranai nadathinom.
Idhil madhuraiyais serndha, poleesaaraal kangaanikka koodiya sarithira padhivedu kutravaaligalaana thanavaandi, sadheesh aagiya iruvarum thaan indha kutracheyalgalil eeduvattu vandhanar. Avargalum seyin parippil eeduvattadhai oppukkondanar. Thanavaandi, sadheesh iruvarum nerukkamaana nanbargal. Eppodhum ondraaga iruppaargal. Aalillaadha veedugalai nottamittu ulle sendru nagai, panathai kollaiyadippadhu, saalaiyil thaniyaaga sellum pengalidam thanga seyinai parippadhu pondra sambavangalil eeduvattu vandhullanar.
Idhu thodarbaaga thamizhagathin pala maavattangalil iruvar meedhum pala vazhakkul ullana. Thanjavur sambavathai seyvadharku munbu kallakkurichiyil pen doctor oruvaridam seyinai parithanar. Appodhu andha pen doctor 50 meter thooram varai izhuthus sellappattadhu adhiracheythirundhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu adutha sambavamaaga thanjjaavooril seyin parippai nigazhthiyullanar. Idharkaaga thiruppooril irundhu tooveelaril kilambiyavargal kaangeyam narappagudhi varai vandhu vittu andha tooveelarai staandil pottu vittu veru tooveelaril kilambi vandhu kaariyathai seythullanar. Thirumbi pogum podhum idhe muraiyai kaiyaandullanar.
Police, sisidivi kaatchigalai aayvu seythaal sikkaamal irukka ippadi sgets pottullanar. Nunukkamaaga aayvu seythu idhai kandu pidithu kutravaaligalai nerunginom. Kollaiyadikkum panathil pala oorgalukku sendru jaaliyaaga iruppaargal. Panam theerndhadhum meendum kaivarisai kaattuvaargal. Idhuvol pala kutrangalai seythu vittu pala maavatta poleesaaridam sikkaamal timikki koduthu vandhavargalai Thanjavur Police teem kaiyum, kalavumaaga kaidhu seythulladhu. 17 vazhakkugalil aajaraagaadhadhaal needhimandrathil pidiyaanai pirappikkappattu thalaimaraivaaga irundhu kollai sambavangalil eeduvattadhum theriyavandhulladhu. Avargalidamirundhu kollaiyadikkappatta nagai, irandu tooveelargal, irandu selbongal parimudhal seyyappattadhudan iruvarum siraiyil adaikkappattullanar" endranar.

headline: 100 sadhavigidham koronaavai thadukkum marundhukku arasu angeegaaram endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
100 sadhavigidham koronaavaith thadukkum veettu vaithiya muraikku arasu angeegaaram alithulladhu endru oru padhivu

“koraanaavukku eliya marundhu!” endru photo padhivu Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Adhil, “magizhchiyaana vishayam ennavendraal mumbai kanduviditha naattu marundhai arasu angigarithulladhu. Oru sboon milagu podiyum, irandu sboon thenum, kaal sboon injji saarum kalandhu verum vayitril 5 naatkal thodarndhu saappittu vandhaal 100% koronaavai thaduthuvidalaam. Ethanai perukku ungalaal udhava mudiyumo udhavungal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Koronaa thotru meendum paravi varum soozhalil, adhu thodarbaana vadhandhigalum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirath thodangiyulladhu. Koronaavai nooru sadhavigidham thadukkum veettu kaivaithiya muraikku arasu angeegaaram alithulladhu endru palarum oru thagavalaip padhivittu varugindranar. 2020m aandu koronaa paravalin podhu pudhucheriyai saarndha maanavar kanduviditha marundhu endru indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Appodhe indha thagaval thavaraanadhu endru katturai veliyittirundhom.
Tharpodhu andha padhivai satru maatri, mumbai kanduvidithadhu endrum arasu angeegaaram alithulladhu endrum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Endha arasu angeegarithadhu endru adhil illai. Enave, mathiya – maanila arasu tharappil edhenum arivippu veliyaagi ulladhaa endru paarthom.
2020-21l koronaa uchathilirundha podhu ulaga sugaadhaara niruvanam indha marundhukku angeegaaram alithulladhu endru vadhandhi paraviyadhu. Appodhu ulaga sugaadhaara niruvanam tharappil unmaiyaa… poyyaa? Endru koronaa thodarbaaga makkal mathiyil nilavum thavaraana karuthukkal thodarbaaga padhivu veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, “injji, then matrum milagu aagiyavai koronaavil irundhu paadhugaakkum endra thagavalukku endha ariviyalboorvamaana aadhaaramum illai. Iruppinum, (milagu pondra) sila masaalaa porutkalil ulla sathukkal udalukku nanmaiyaith tharalaam endru karudhappadugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indhiya sugaadhaara amaichagam tharappilirundhu ippadi endha oru arivippum veliyaagavillai. Melum MyGovIndia endra Indhiya arasin Facebook pakkathil 2021 epral 28m thedhi veliyaana padhivil, “milagu, then, injji serthuth thayaarikkappadum marundhaal koronaa varaamal thadukka mudiyum enbadharku endha oru ariviyalboorvamaana aadhaaramum illai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Tamil Nadu arasin fekt sek pakkathil, “koronaavaith thadukkum naattu marundhai arasu angeegarithadhaagap paravum thavaraana thagaval!” endru kurippittup padhivittirundhanar. Idhan moolam Tamil Nadu arasu alladhu Indhiya arasu indha veettu vaithiya muraiyai koronaavai 100 sadhavigidham thadukkum marundhu endru angeegarithadhaagap paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: “ladaak BJP aluvalagathai eritha navar kaidhu” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Ladaakkil BJP aluvalagathai eritha islaamiyar kaidhu seyyappattadhaaga oru video

islaamiyar oruvarai Police kaidhu seythu azhaithus sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ladaak yooniyan piradhesa BJP aluvalagathil thee vaitha marma navar kaidhu…👌
adey pappu pappimaa & ithaali paar taansar ungal kanavu palikkaadhu…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sila aandugalukku munbu thani yooniyan piradhesamaaga pirikkappatta ladaakkukku maanila andhasdhu alikkak kori poraattam nadandhadhu. Idhil ladaak maanila BJP aluvalagam erikkappattadhu. Idhai seythadhu Congress matrum islaamiyargaldhaan enbadhu pola video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil ullavargalaip paarkkum podhu ladaak makkal pola illai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai sameeva naatkalaagathaan palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, uthiragaant maanilam kaasippooril “ai lav mugamadhu” peraniyaith thodarndhu erpatta vanmuraikkuk kaaranam endru koori kaidhu seyyappatta navargalul oruvaraana nadheem akdhar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga pala padhivugal mattume kidaithana.
Adhe nerathil vanmuraikkuk kaaranamaanavargal kaidhu endru veliyaana pala seythigal namakku kidaithana. Aanaal, indha navar ladaak BJP aluvalagam erippu thodarbaaga kaidhu seyyappattavar endru endha seythiyum kidaikkavillai.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil kaaval nilaiyathin peyarp palagaiyaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhai koogul lens moolam mozhiveyarthup paarthom. Kaasivoor (Kashipur), uthamsing nagar, utharagaant endru irundhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha navar utharagaandil vanmurai sambavam thodarbaaga kaidhu seyyappattavar enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Fatty Liver paadhippum vizhippunarvum.. Kalleeralaip paadhugaakka udhavum ‘taap’ kurippugal!
text:
India-vil adhigarithu varum fetti livar kurithu indha katturai echarikkai vidukkiradhu. Kalleeralil 5% mel kozhuppu serumbodhu thodangum indha nilai, vayitru asaugariyam, sorvu pondra arigurigalaal velippadugiradhu. Insulin samanilaiyinmai, valarsidhai maatrak kolaarugal mukkiya kaaranangal ena maruthuvargal koori, sarkkarai illaadha black kaavi, edai thookkum payitsi, GLP-1 marundhugal udhavakkoodum ena vilakkugindranar.
India-vil periyavargal mudhal kuzhandhaigal varai palaraiyum paadhikkakkoodiya ondraaga, 'fetti livar' (Fatty Liver) enappadum kozhuppu kalleeral kaanappadugiradhu. Idhugurithu maruthuvargal kooruvadhu enna...? Indha thoguppil paarkkalaam... PKG madhu arundhaadhavargalaiyum adhigam thaakkum indha paadhippu, nam kalleeralil 5 sadhaveedhathirkum adhigamaana kozhuppu serumbodhu thodangugiradhu. Vayitrup pagudhi aselagariyam, udal sorvu pondra aaramba arigurigal moolam idhu velippadugiradhu.
Insulin samanilaiyinmai, valarsidhai maatras sikkalgale idharku mukkiyak kaaranangalaagum. Samooga valaithalangalil paravum pala 'heks' muraigal, idhaith theerkkum endru nambappadugiradhu. Aanaal, maruthuvargal ivatril evai paadhugaappaanavai endru aayvu seythu madhippeedu seythullanar.adhanbadi, sarkkarai kalakkaadha Black Coffee kudippadhu kalleeral vadu, putrunoy avaayathai kuraippadhaaga kandarindhullanar. Adhevol, edai thookkum payitsigal insulin unardhiranai membaduthi, kalleeral kozhuppaik kuraikka udhavugindrana
melum, maruthuvarin parindhuraiyudan payanbaduthappadum GLP-1 pondra naveena marundhugalum nalla palanaith tharugindrana. Adheneram, kalleeral taanik, teedaaks tee pondravai kozhuppaik kuraikkaadhu endrum, maaraaga avai neerizhappai erpaduthi kalleeralai melum paadhikkum enavum echarikkindranar. Melum, asvagandhaavondra mooligaigalum silarukku kalleeral paadhippugalai undaakkalaam enak koorugindranar. Enave, aarokkiyamaana unavumurai, seeraana neerchathu, puradhas sathu niraindha unavu, muraiyaana udarpayitsi mattume kalleeralaip paadhugaakka sirandha vazhigal ena maruthuvargal arivuruthugindranar

headline: ‘anganvaadi maiyangalil paniyidam nirappa vendum’
text:
Mettupalayam: anganvaadi maiyangalil ulla kaali paniyidangalai udanadiyaaga nirappa kori, Tamil Nadu anganvaadi oozhiyar matrum udhaviyaalar sangathinar aarppaattam seythanar.
Mettupalayam bus staant aruge nadandha aarppaattathirku, Tamil Nadu anganvaadi oozhiyar matrum udhaviyaalar sanga maavatta orunginaippaalar kavidhaa thalaimai vagithaar. Si.ai.ti.yu., thaalugaa seyalaalar kanagaraaj, maanila kuzhu uruppinar sathyaa, oyvu petra arasu oozhiyar sanga uruppinar jeyaraaman ulbada palar pesinar.
Anganvaadi maiyangalil ulla kaali paniyidangalai udanadiyaaga nirappa vendum. Anganvaadi oozhiyargal matrum udhaviyaalargal anaivaraiyum, pani nirandharam seythu kaalam murai sambalam vazhanga vendum. Anganvaadi maiyathirku varum kuzhandhaigalin unavu selavina thogaiyai, mun panamaagavo alladhu maadham maadhamaagavo vazhanga vendum enbana utbada 17 amsak korikkaigalai valiyuruthi pesinar. Kaaramadai vattaaras seyalaalar keedhaa nandri koorinaar.

headline: Indhiyaavukkul nuzhaindhu mugaamgalai amaitha China endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Indhiyaavukkul 60 km thoorathirku nuzhaindhu pudhiya mugaamgalai amaitha China endru oru video

podhu makkal vanmuraiyil eeduvaduvadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vin meedhu aangilathil, “seena raanuvam indhiyaavukkul 60 km tholaivukkul nuzhaindhadhaaga thagaval” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “arunaachalap piradhesathin appar suvansiri maavattathin taaksing pagudhikkul China iraanuvam 60 kilomeettar thoorathirkul nuzhaindhu pudhiya mugaamgalai amaithadhaaga thagavalgal velivandhana. Indha kootrukkalai Indhiya raanuvam mutrilumaaga niraagarithulladhu. Iraanuvathin kootruppadi, viral arikkaigal aadhaaramatravai matrum unmaikku purambaanavai. Idhu thodarbaaga ulloor amaippaana naah nala sangam oru korikkai manuvai samarppithadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Iruppinum, kalathil pudhiya athumeeral edhuvum urudhippaduthappadavillai endru iraanuvam matrum arasaanga vattaarangal therivikkindrana.
Iraanuvathin kootruppadi, indha pagudhi neenda kaalamaaga maaruvatta kannottangalin piraandhiyamaaga irundhu varugiradhu, angu Indhiya iraanuvam matrum ai.ti.pi.pi (indho-thivethiya ellaik kaavaldhurai) thodarndhu rondhu selgindrana” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiyaavukkul China raanuvam endha thadaiyumindri nuzhaindhu mugaamgalai amaithulladhaaga samooga oodagangalil thagaval paraviyadhu. Indha thagaval thavaraanadhu, appadi China raanuvam indhiyaavukkul nuzhaiyavillai endru Indhiya arasu vilakkam alithirundhadhu. Aanaal, China raanuvathai makkal edhirthup poraaduvadhu pondru pala video-kkal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindrana.
Podhu makkal China raanuvathai edhirthadhu pondru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vil indhiyaavukkul China raanuvam nuzhaindhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil indha thagavalaip pagirndhu, arasu tharappil veliyaana seythiyaiyum padhivittirundhanar. Indha video patri adhil endha vilakkamum illai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai vadagizhakku maanilathais saarndha oodagam ondru 2026 joon 7 thedhi YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhaik kandom.
Adhil, asaam raifil padaiyinarukkum thaanghul naagaa meyraa paivi (Tangkhul Naga Meira Paibi) amaippinarukkum idaiye erpatta modhalil 22 pengalukku kaayam erpattadhu enbadhu pola kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha thagaval adippadaiyil thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu, manippoor maanilathil ukrool (Ukhrul) maavattathil naagaa makkal vasikkum pagudhiyil asaam raifil padaiyinar pudhiya mugaam amaikka muyandra podhu adhai thaanghul naagaa meyraa paivi endra amaippais saarndhavargal edhirthu poraattam nadathiyadhaagavum idhil iru tharappinarukkum idaiye modhal erpattadhaagavum seythigal kidaithana.
Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video China raanuvam indhiyaavukkul nuzhaindha podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vaigo oraandu siraiyil irundhu vidudhalaiyaanavodhu pirandhen endru thurai vaigo koorinaaraa?
text:
Oraandukkum melaaga siraiyil irundhu vaigo thirumbi vandha marunaal naan pirandhen endru thurai vaigo kooriyadhaaga oru news card

thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappadulladhu. Adhil, “en peyare misaadhaan! Nerukkadi kaalathaip patrip pesuvadharku enakku thaan adhiga thagudhiyum urimaiyum irukkiradhu. En thandhai oraandukkum melaaga siraiyil irundhu thirumbi vandha marunaal naan pirandhen. Enakku misaa endru thaan mudhalil peyar vaithaar vaigo. Pudhukkottaiyil em.pi., thurai vaigo petti” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Misaa sattathin keezh vaigo kaidhu seyyappattu oraandukkum melaaga siraiyil irundhu vidudhalaiyaana adutha naal naan pirandhen endru vaigovin magan thurai vaigo em.pi kooriyadhaaga oru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Thurai vaigovai izhivuvaduthum nokkil padhivu uruvaakkappattadhu pola ulladhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Thurai vaigo appadi petti alithadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Enave, thandhi TV ippadi oru news card-ai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarvaiyittom. Aanaal, adhil appadi endha oru news kaardum veliyaagavillai. Thurai vaigo alitha petti thodarbaaga veru sila news kaardugal irundhana. Aanaal, avatrilum ippadi oru thagaval illai.
Enave, idhai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppi unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Melum, idhu poliyaanadhu endru kurippittu padhivu ondrai samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyittuvittu, adhan lingkkaiyum alithaar. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Uthara piradhesathil poli palgalai nadathiya 5 per kaidhu
text:
Ettaa: uthara piradhesathil poli palgalai matrum thunai maruthuva kalloori nadathi palveru padippugalai mosadiyaaga vazhangi vandha aindhu per kumbalai Police kaidhu seythanar.
Uthara piradhesathil, kalvi niruvanam ondril maanavar serkkai thodarbaaga mosadi nadandhadhaaga kidaitha thagavalin adippadaiyil ettaa maavatta Police visaaranai nadathinar.
Visaaranaiyil, poli kalvi niruvanangal nadathi maanavar serkkaiyil eeduvattu vandha kumbal patriya vivaram kidaithadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu poli palgalai nadathi mosadiyil eeduvatta sadhendhira kumaar, 36, kavurav agarvaal, 42, pagavaan thaas, 59, narendhiraa endra pappu, 58, mugamadhu shareep kureshi, 75, aagiya aindhu perai kaidhu seythanar.
Idhu kurithu ettaa maavatta Police kooriyadhaavadhu:
ettaa maavattam marharaa pagudhiyil 2022 mudhal poli palgalai nadathi kaidhu seyyappatta kumbal ti.paarm., pi.paarm., pi.essi., narsing ullitta thunai maruthuva padippugalil serppadhaaga koori, eraalamaana maanavargalidam panam vasoolithullanar.
Avargalidam irundhu poli kaasolaigal, poli maanavar adaiyaala attaigal, vinnappa padivangal, serkkai aavanangal, kattana raseedhugal, thervu vidaithaalgal, poli muthiraigal, saandridhazhgal ullittavai kaippatrappattana.
Ethanai maanavargalidam mosadi nadandhadhu enbadhu kurithu thodarndhu visaarithu varugirom.
Ivvaaru Police koorinar.

headline: Trambin jaakbaat arivippu.. Kottappogum panamazhai.. Enna nadakkiradhu America-vil?
text:
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
America-vil navambar maadham nadaivera ulla idaikkaalath therdhalil kudiyarasuk katchi, naadaalumandrathin iru avaigalilum vetri petraal, naattil ulla ovvoru vayadhu vandha kudimaganukkum 5,000 taalar vazhangappadum ena adhivar tonaalt Trump arivithullaar.
Teksaas maagaanam tallaasil nadaivetra kudiyarasuk katchiyin maanaattil pesiya Trump, indhath thogaiyai ’Trump tivident’ ena kurippittaar. America-vil sumaar 27 kodi vayadhu vandhor ulla nilaiyil, anaivarukkum thalaa 5,000 taalar vazhanginaal arasukku sumaar 1.3 tirilliyan taalar selavaagum ena kanakkidappadugiradhu.
Indhath thogai evvaaru vazhangappadum, adharkaana panam engirundhu varum enbadhu kurithu Trump endha virivaana vilakkathaiyum alikkavillai. Aanaal, velinaadugalil irundhu irakkumadhi seyyappadum porutkalukku Trump vidhithulla varigal moolam kidaikkum varuvaayai idharkup payanbaduthalaam ena thunai adhivar je.ti.vaans therivithullaar.
Melum, amerikkargalukku vazhangappadum panam amerikkaavileye selavidappada vendum endrum Trump kooriyullaar. Aanaal, adhai arasu evvaaru kangaanikkum enbadhu thelivaagavillai.
Trambin indha arivippai jananaayagak katchiyinar “vetru vaakkurudhi” ena vimarsithullanar. Ivvalavu periya thogaiyai vazhanguvadhu nadaimuraiyil saathiyamaa endrum, sattappadi idhais seyalbadutha mudiyumaa endrum kelvigal ezhundhullana.
America-vil arasin selavinangalukku naadaalumandrathin oppudhal thevaippadugiradhu. Enave, therdhalil kudiyarasuk katchi vetri petraalum, indhath thogaiyai vazhanga naadaalumandrathin oppudhal pera vendiya soozhal varalaam.
Melum, therdhalaik karuthil kondu panam vazhanguvadhaaga arivippadhu thodarbaaga sattas sikkalgalum ezhundhullana. Vaakkaalargalin mudivaip paadhikkum vagaiyil panam vazhanguvadhai America sattangal thadai seygindrana. Aanaal, idhu vari kuraippu alladhu podhuvaana porulaadhaaras salugai enak karudhappattaal, sattappadi selluvadiyaagum ena sila satta nivunargal koorugindranar.
Idharku munbum irakkumadhi vari moolam kidaikkum varuvaayil irundhu amerikkargalukku 2,000 taalar vazhanguvadhu kurithu Trump pesiyirundhaar. Innilaiyil, navambar 3aam thedhi nadaivera ulla idaikkaalath therdhalil kudiyarasuk katchi iru avaigalilum vetri perumaa enbadhe tharpodhu mukkiya edhirbaarppaaga ulladhu.

headline: Udalin tharkaappu nadavadikkaiyaa vaandhi? Maruthuvargal kooruvadhu enna?
text:
Vaandhi enbadhu sila samayangalil, udalin tharkaappu seyalmuraiyaaga kooda irukkalaam ena maruthuva nivunargal therivikkindranar. Nachupporutkal, thotrugal ullittavai udalil kalakkum munbe veliyetruvadharkaaga kooda, oruvarukku vaandhi erpadakkoodum ena avargal therivikkindranar.
Aanaal, idhu oru kurippitta ellai varai mattume ena kurippidum maruthuvargal, thodar vaandhi irundhaalo, vaandhiyudan kadum vayitru vali, adhiga kaaychal, malathil ratham, neerizhappu, manadhil kuzhappam ullittavai erpattaalo, udane maruthuvarai anuga vendumena arivuruthugindranar. Kettuppona unavai utkondaal varum vaandhi enbadhu, sila mani nerangalil thaanaaga sariyaagividum enavum koorugindranar.

headline: Thaamirathukku ji.es.ti., kuraikka korikkai
text:
Pudhudilli: sarvadhesa sandhaiyil, kaappar enappadum thaamira vi lai adhiga alavil uyarndhu varuvadhai aduthu, thaamiram meedhaana ji.es.ti., variyai kuraikka vendum ena mathiya arasidam, Indhiya mudhanmai thaamira urpathiyaalargal sangam korikkai viduthulladhu.
Idhugurithu sangathin thalaivar rohith padhak kooriyadhaavadhu: landan uloga sandhaiyil thaamiram vilai oru tan kittathatta 14 latcham roovaayai thaandi pudhiya uchathai thottulladhu.
Thaamiram thayaarippugalukkaana moolapporutkalai vaangum mudhanmai urpathiyaalargal mudhal, adhan thunai porutkalai thayaarikkum niruvanangal varai anaivarum thodakkathileye 18 sadhaveedha ji.es.ti., vari selutha vendiyulladhu.
Idhanaal, niruvanangalin nadaimurai mooladhanathil kanisamaana thogai variyileye mudangugiradhu. Enave, palveru vagaiyaana thaamira porutkal meedhaana ji.es.ti., variyai 18 sadhaveedhathilirundhu 5 sadhaveedhamaaga kuraikka mathiya arasudan pechuvaarthai nadathi varugirom.
Indha korikkai erkappattaal, variyil mudangiyirukkum 30,000 kodi roobai nidhi viduvikkappadum. Hindaalgo ullitta munnani niruvanangal, thangalin urpathi virivaakkathukku innidhiyai payanbadutha mudiyum. Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Immaanuvel segaranaar 69-vadhu ninaivu thinam.. Thalaivargal mariyaadhai!!
text:
Thiyaagi immaanuvel segaranaarin 69-vadhu ninaivu indru anusarikkappadugiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, raamanaadhavuram maavattam, paramakkudiyil ulla avaradhu ninaividathil arasiyal katchith thalaivargal anjjali seluthi varugindranar. Ippagudhigalil, 700 kangaanippu kemaraakkal poruthappattu kangaanippu panigal nadaivetru varugiradhu. Sumaar, 8000 per paadhugaappu paniyil eeduvattullanar.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, Thamizhaga arasu saarbil TVK mudhalvar Vijay-in arivuruthalinbadi, amaichargal si.ti.aar. Nirmalgumaar, arunraaj, piravu aagiyor immaanuvel segaranaar ninaividathil malarvalaiyam vaithu anjjali seluthinar.
Thodarndhu, DMK saarbil edhirkkatchith thalaivar Udhayanidhi Stalin imaanuvel segaranaarin ninaividathirku neril vandhu mariyaadhai seluthiyirukkiraar. Thodarndhu, DMK thalaivar Stalin veliyittulla X padhivil, ”thiyaagi imaanuvel segaranaarin nootraandaiyotti avaradhu pirandhanaalinai arasuvizhaavaagak kondaada aanai, paramakkudiyil thiruvuruvas silaiyudan koodiya manimandavam ena avaradhu ninaivaip potrum sirappaana panigalaik kadandha 5 aandu thiraavida maadal aatchiyil merkondom. Naattin vidudhalaikkaagavum, samoogathil nilaviya saadhiyak kodumaigalukku edhiraagavum urudhiyaana poraattangalai munnedutha imaanuvel segaranaarin panigalum thiyaagamum samathuvathai nokkiya namadhu muyatsigalukku endrum thunainirkum! Imaanuvel segaranaarin perumbugazh vaazhga!” enath therivikkappattulladhu.
ADMK podhucheyalaalar ke. Palaniswami veliyittulla padhivil, ”odukkappatta makkalin kuralaaga olithu, samoogathil theendaamai neengi samathuvam thazhaikka paaduvattavarum, thanadhu ilam vayadhileye pirittish arasukku edhiraagap poraadiyavarum, Indhiya sudhandhirathirkaaga kural koduthavarum, Indhiya raanuvathil paniyaatriyavarum, 'vellaiyane veliyeru' iyakkathil pangetru sirai sendravarumaana sudhandhirap poraattath thiyaagi immaanuvel segaran avargalin 69-aavadhu ninaivu naalaana indru, avardham thiyaagathaip potri vanangugiren” enath therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: Varthaga oppandha salugai peruvadharku thiruppooril vazhigaatti karutharangu
text:
Tiruppur: thadaiyatra varthaga oppandha salugaigalai payanbaduthi, eppadiyellaam payanadaiyalaam enbadhai vivarikkum vagaiyil, aayatha aadai etrumadhi membaattu kavunsil(e.i.pi.si.,) saarbil vazhigaatti karutharangu thiruppooril nadathappattu varugiradhu.
Tharpodhaiya nilavarappadi, pirittan, niyoosilaandhu, oman, airoppiya naadugal utbada 38 naadugaludan oppandham erpattulladhu.
Pirittanudan oppandham amalukku vandhu vittadhu. Niyoosilaandhudan varum ak., 20 mudhal oppandham nadaimuraikku varugiradhu. Oppandham vaayilaaga, ulaga makkal thogaiyil 65 sadhaveedham per vasikkum naadugaludan varichalugaiyudan varthagam seyyum vaayppu uruvaagiyulladhu.
Varthaga oppandha salugaiyai payanbaduthi varthagam seyvadhu kurithu, e.i.pi.si., moolamaaga, 'kilastar' vaariyaaga vazhigaatti karutharangu nadathappattu varugiradhu.
E.i.pi.si., adhigaarigal kooriyadhaavadhu: varthaga oppandhangalaal muzhumaiyaana vari thalluvadi ullitta salugaigal kidaikkum. Mudhalil, urpathi porutkalin thotram kurithu, namadhu naattin angeegaara saandraaga 'aarjin' endra saandridhazh pera vendum. Adhanbin, varthagathuraiyin velinaattu varthagappirivu, sungavarithurai ena, palveru mun aayatha panigalai seyya vendum. Appodhu thaan, oppandha salugaigalai petru etrumadhi seyya mudiyum.
Etrumadhiyaalargal payanadaiyum vagaiyil, 'kilastar' vaariyaaga thozhilnutba vallunargal matrum arasuthurai adhigaarigal pangerkum vazhigaatti karutharangai nadathi varugirom. Viraivil sennaiyilum karutharangu nadaivera ulladhu. Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: ’vali nivaaranigalaal kalleeralukku peraavathu..’ - nivunargal echarikkai! Edhai edukkak koodaadhu?
text:
Maruthuva aalosanaiyindri paaraasittamaal ullitta vali nivaaranigalai alavukku meeri utkolvadhu kalleeralukku kadumaiyaana sedhathai erpaduthum ena nivunargal echarikkindranar. Kurippaaga pala marundhugalil maraindhu ulla paaraasittamaalai ore nerathil eduthukkolvadhu kalleeral seyalizhappirku vazhivagukkum. Kumattal, vaandhi, vayitruvali pondra arigurigal thenbattaal udanadiyaaga maruthuvarai anuga vendum.
Maruthuva aalosanaiyindri vali nivaaranigalaith thodarndhu utkolvadhu kalleeralukkup perum aavathai vilaivikkum ena maruthuva nivunargal echarikkindranar. Kurippaaga, paaraasittamaal maathiraigalai alavukku adhigamaaga eduppadhu alladhu sali, kaaychal pondra idhara marundhugaludan serthu utkolvadhu kalleeral seyalizhappirku vazhivagukkum engindranar.
Paaraasittamaalai alavukku adhigamaaga eduthukkolvadhu kalleeralukku kadumaiyaana paadhippai erpaduthum ena nivunargal echarikkindranar. Kurippaaga, parindhuraikkappatta alavai vida adhigamaagavo alladhu ore nerathil pala paaraasittamaal ulla marundhugalai eduthukkolvadho aavathai adhigarikkalaam. Kumattal, vaandhi, vayitruvali pondra arigurigal thenbattaal udanadiyaaga maruthuvarai anuguvadhu avasiyam.
Madhu arundhuvor matrum erkanave kalleeral paadhippu ullavargalukku idhan aavathu adhigam. Enave, maathiraigalais saarndhiruppadhaith thavirthu udarpayitsi, yogaa, pondra aarokkiyamaana vaazhviyal maatrangalaip pinbatruvadhe sirandhadhu endru maruthuva nivunargal koorugindranar.

headline: Udhaya sooriyan sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi Vijay koorinaaraa?
text:
Therdhalil thi.mu.ka-vin udhayasooriyan sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi Thamizhaga vetrikkazhaga thalaivarum nadigarumaana Vijay pesiyadhaaga oru video

Vijay therdhal pirasaaram seytha video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil avar, “ungalukkum namma jen see kitchukkum naan sollikkiradhu onne onnudhaan. Epral 23m thedhi, kaalangaathaala pakkaavaa rediyaagittu, unga ottar aidi card-ai kaiyila eduthukkittu, modho aalaa poothla poy ninnu andha udhaya sooriyanukku neraa irukkira andha pattana oru azhuthu azhuthunga” endru pesugiraar.
Nilaith thagavalil, “udhayasooriyan sinnathirku vaakku segarikkiraar Vijay ….. Thannai ariyaamal thimugavaal anuppappatta B Team endru pudhuvediyil oppukkondu vittaar nadigar Vijay …… udhayasooriyanukku ottu poduvadhum visil sinnathil ottu poduvadhum irandume ondrudhaan thamizhnaattukku naasam thaan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
TVK thalaivarum nadigarumaana Vijay thannudaiya peramboor thogudhikkaana vetbu manuvaith thaakkal seythuvitta thannudaiya therdhal pirasaarathai thodanginaar. Appodhu visil sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi kettukkondaar. Aanaal, thi.mu.ka-vin udhaya sooriyan sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi Vijay kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Unmaiyil Vijay appadi kooriyirundhaal adhu anaithu seythi oodagangalilum veliyaagi irukkum. Ellaa oodagangalum Vijay vaay thavari thi.mu.ka-vukku vaakkalikkumbadi kooriyadhaiye periya seythiyaakki iruppaargal. Aanaal, appadi endha oru seythiyum namakku kidaikkavillai. Enave, Vijay pechin oli (audio) padhivai edit seythirukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Vijay-yin pirasaaram thodakkam thodarbaaga oodagangalil veliyaana video-vai paarthom. Thi indhu aangilam idhazh thannudaiya YouTube pakkathil Vijay pechu video-vai veliyittirundhadhu. Video-vin 28:12vadhu nimidathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vin kaatchi vandhadhu. Adhil avar visil sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi mattume kooruvadhaik ketka mudindhadhu. Andha oodagam mattumindri ellaa oodagangal veliyitta veediyokkalaiyum aayvu seythu paarthavodhu, anaithilum visil sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi avar kooriyadhai thelivaagak ketka mudindhadhu.
Idhan moolam Vijay-yin pirasaara video-vin aadiyovai mattum edit seythu, udhaya sooriyan sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi avar kooriyadhu pondru maatri samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhu thelivaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “kodutha vaakkurudhiyai eppodhu niraivetruveergal sim.em saar?”
text:
Kadan thalluvadikkaaga poraattathil kudhitha vivasaayigal
“vivasaayak kadangalai nivandhanaiyindri muzhumaiyaagath thalluvadi seyya vendum” endra korikkaiyai valiyuruthi, 45-kkum merpatta vivasaaya sangangal thiruchiyil thodar kaathiruppup poraattathil eeduvattirukkindrana.
“kootturavu vangigalil kuru, siru vivasaayigal petra payirk kadangal muzhumaiyaagath thalluvadi seyyappadum” endru Thamizhaga mudhalvar Vijay therdhal pirasaarathil vaakkurudhi alithirundhaar. Aanaal, tharpodhu roo.75,000 varaiyilaana payirk kadangal mattume muzhumaiyaagath thalluvadi seyyappattiruppadhaaga vivasaayigal kutramsaattugindranar. “therdhal vaakkurudhiyai muzhumaiyaaga niraivetra vendum” endra korikkaiyudan, sepdambar 15-m thedhi mudhal Trichy samayavuram sarvees rodu aruge 45-kkum merpatta vivasaaya sangathinar thodar kaathiruppup poraattathil eeduvattu varugindranar. Poraattathukkup pandhal amaikkak kaavaldhurai anumadhikkavillai endrum, moondru amaichargal nadathiya pechuvaarthaiyum mudivindri mudindhadhaagavum poraattakkaarargal therivikkindranar.
“kaavaldhurai nerukkadi kodukkiradhu!”
poraattak kalathilirundha Thamizhaga vivasaayigal paadhugaappu sangathin maanila orunginaippaalar vadivel supramaniyanidam pesiyavodhu, “velaan kootturavu sangangalil roo.1 latcham varai kadan petra vivasaayigalukku roo.75,000 varai thalluvadi seythirukkindranar. Adharkum adhigamaagak kadan petravargalukku roo.35,000 mattume thalluvadi seyyappattirukkiradhu. Aindhu ekkar varai nilam vaithirukkum kuru, siru vivasaayigal petrulla roo.3 latcham varaiyilaana kadangalai muzhumaiyaagath thalluvadi seyya vendum. Erkenave ettu amaichargalgonda kuzhuvinar, moondru amaichargalgonda kuzhuvinar endru iru murai pechuvaarthai nadathinar. Mudhalvarais sandhikkavaithu korikkaiyai niraivetruvadhaagak koorinar. Aanaal, adhu nadakkavillai. Adhanaal, vazhakkarinjar eesan murugasaami thalaimaiyil poraattathaith thodanginom.
Andhap poraattathai nasukkum vagaiyil, poraattathukku mudhal naale mukkiya vivasaaya sanga nirvaagigal veedugalukkuk kaavalargalai anuppi veettus siraiyil vaithaargal. Thaniyaar nilathil pandhal amaikkavum, thanneer eduthus sellavum, unavu samaikkavum, maikset amaikkavum kaavaldhurai anumadhikkavillai. Idhanaal, aayirakkanakkaana vivasaayigal panai olaigalaith thalaiyil vaithuk kondu poraattathil eeduvattanar.
Idharkidaiye amaichargal kaandhiraaj, vinoth, ramesh, kootturavuthurai padhivaalar aagiyor Trichy aatchiyar aluvalagathil vivasaaya sanga nirvaagigaludan pechuvaarthai nadathinar. ‘oru kuzhuvai amaithu sennaikku vaarungal; pechuvaarthai nadathuvom. Poraattathaik kaividungal’ endre meendum valiyuruthiyullanar. Erkenave nadandha pechuvaarthaigalil endha mudivum ettappadaadhadhaal, korikkaiyai niraivetru vadharkaana arivippu varum varai poraattam thodarum enath therivithom” endraar.
“vaakkurudhiyai niraivetrum varai poraattam thodarum”
Thamizhaga vivasaayigal sanga niruvanath thalaivar eesan murugasaamiyidam pesiyavodhu, “naangal pudhidhaaga edhaiyum ketkavillai. Mudhalvar aatchikku varuvadharku munbu therivitha vaakkurudhiyaithaan niraivetras solgirom. Arasukku nidhichumai endraal, vivasaayigal vaangiya kadangalai neendagaalak kadangalaaga maatralaam. Arasukku nidhi kidaikkumbodhu avatraith thalluvadi seythu, kootturavu sangangalukku nidhi vazhangalaam. Adhevol, kuruvai vivasaayathukku anaithu vivasaayigalukkum roo.1 latcham pudhiya kadan vazhanga vendum enavum korikkai vaithom; edhaiyum seyyavillai. Aanaal, thalluvadi seyyappadaadha kadangalai vasoolippadharkaaga, vivasaayigalukku nerukkadi koduppadhudan, poraattathukkum kaavaldhurai moolam nerukkadi kodukkappadugiradhu. Mudhalvar thanadhu vaakkurudhiyai niraivetrum varai poraattam thodarum” endraar.
TMC vivasaaya aniyin Trichy mandalath thunaith thalaivar vayaloor raajendhiran, “engal saarbil vivasaayigal kuzhu sennaikku pechuvaarthaikkus sendraalum, korikkai niraiverum varai poraattathaik kaivida maattom. Neendagaalak kadangal, niluvaik kadangal ullittavatraiyum thalluvadi seyya vendum. Anaivarukkum pudhiya kadan vazhanga vendum enbadhum engal korikkai” endraar.
Thamizhaga velaandhurai amaichar vinothidam pesinom. “kootturavuthurai amaicharudan inaindhu mudhalvaridam pesavirukkirom. Avarudan aalosithu vivasaayigalin korikkaigalai niraivetra muyalvom” endraar.
Kootturavuthurai amaichar kaandhiraaj, “vivasaayigal sanga nirvaagigaludan thodarndhu pesikkondirukkirom. Innum irudhi mudivu edukkappadavillai. Avargal oru kuzhu amaithu pechuvaarthaikku varuvadhaagak kooriyullanar. Appodhu indha vivagaaram kurithup pesi mudiveduppom. Kaavaldhurai vivasaayigalukku nerukkadi kodukkavillai” endraar.
Kodutha vaakkurudhiyai niraivetraamal, innum ethanai muraidhaan pechuvaarthai nadathuvadhu?

headline: Doctor Vikatan: tengu kaaychal paadhithaal kattaayam maruthuvamanaiyil atmit seyya vendumaa?
text:
Tengu kaaychalaip poruthavarai rathath thattanukkalin ennikkai kuraivadhu mattume oru noyaaliyai maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhippadharkaana ore kaaranam alla.
Doctor Vikatan: tengu paadhitha nanbargal silar, maruthuvamanaiyil atmit seyyappattu, sigichai petru veettukkuth thirumbinaargal. Tengu paadhithaale maruthuvamanaiyil atmit seythudhaan sigichai edukka vendumaa.... Kaaychalukkaana marundhugal eduthukkondu veettileye sigichai pera mudiyaadhaa?
Padhil solgiraar, sennaiyais serndha, kudumbanala maruthuvarum indarnal medisin nivunarumaana saadhanaa thavappazhani
noyaalikku udambu sariyillaamal pogumbodhu, avaridam kaanappadum arigurigalaiyo alladhu arigurigalin thanmaigalaiyo saadhaarana manidharaal kanikka mudiyaadhu.
Tengu kaaychalukku aandivayaadik (Antibiotics) sigichaigal edhuvum illai. Idhu mukkiyamaaga arigurigalukkaana sigichaidhaan (Symptomatic Treatment). Enave, noyaaliyin kaaychalin theevirathaik kuraikka vendum enbadharkaaga noyaaligalukku paaraasittamaal (Paracetamol) vazhangappadum.
Adhan piragu, avargalin rathath thattanukkalin ennikkai (Platelet count) eppadi maarugiradhu enbadhai naam kangaanikka vendum. Oruvelai, noyaalikku sepdik shaak (Septic shock) alladhu tengu rathakkasivu kaaychal (Hemorrhagic fever) pondra theevirap pirasnaigal erpattaalo, alladhu rathath thattanukkal migavum kuraindhaalo, noyaalikku rathath thattanukkal selutha (Platelet transfusion) vendiya thevai erpadalaam.
Enave, indha vagaiyaana theevira sigichaigalai maruthuvamanaiyil mattume seyya mudiyum. Idhai veli noyaalip pirivil (Outpatient) seyya mudiyaadhu. Noyaali maruthuvamanaiyil ulnoyaaliyaaga anumadhikkappada vendum. Thotrunoy sirappu maruthuvar rathath thattanukkalaik kangaanithu, noyaaliyin udalnilaiyil erpadum munnetrathaik kangaanippaar.
Rathath thattanukkalin (Platelets) ennikkai kuraiyum podhu, sambandhappatta navarin kaigal, nenjju alladhu vayitrup pagudhiyil thadippugal, sivappup pulligal (Rashes) thondruvadhaip paarkkalaam. Noyaaliyin udalnilai migavum mosamadaiyalaam. Avargalaal edhuvume saappida mudiyaadhu.
Paaraasittamaal matrum pira arigurigalukkaana maathiraigalai edutha piragum kooda, avaraal mudiyaamal pogalaam. Matravargal ketkum saadhaarana kelvigalukkukkoodadi noyaali sariyaagap padhilalikkaamal irukkalaam.
Paadhikkappattadhu kuzhandhai endraal, adhu migavum amaidhiyaagividum. Adhu kavalaippada vendiya vishayam. Kuzhandhai migavum sorvaagak kaanappattaalo, vilaiyaadaamal irundhaalo, sariyaagas saappidaamalum adhiga alavu thanneer kudikkaamal irundhaalo matrum noyaalikku sepdik shaak (Septic shock) pondra adhirchi nilai iruppadhaik kandarindhaalo, udanadiyaaga maruthuvamanaikku azhaithus sella vendum. 
Rathath thattanukkalin ennikkai iyalbaaga  irukkalaam.  Aanaal, noyaali theevira neerizhappaal (Dehydrated) paadhikkappattirukkalaam. Athagaiya noyaaliyai maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhithu narambu vazhiyaaga thiravangal (IV fluids) selutha vendiyirukkalaam. 
Enave, tengu kaaychalaip poruthavarai rathath thattanukkalin ennikkai kuraivadhu mattume oru noyaaliyai maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhippadharkaana ore kaaranam alla. Maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhi thevaiyaa, vendaadhaa endra mudivai maruthuvargal mattume edukka vendum, noyaaligal edukkak koodaadhu.
Doctor saadhanaa thavappazhanisennai, appolo maruthuvamanaiyil kudumbanala maruthuvar matrum indarnal medisin nivunaraagap panivurivavar. Kovit sigichaiyil nivunathuvam petravar. 20 aandugal anuvavam ullavar.
Ungal kelvigalai kament pagudhiyil pagirndhugollungal; adharkaana padhilgal thinamum vigadan inaiyathalathil #DoctorVikatan endra peyaril veliyaagum.

headline: Musleem navarai thirumanam seytha indhu pennukku nadandha kodumai endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’pengalooruvil musleem navarai thirumanam seytha indhu pennukku nadandha kodumai’’, endru nakkeeran idhazh seythi veliyittadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ *pengalooruvil oru pen aidi nivunar mugamadhu mushdaakkai manandhaar. Avargal thangal kuzhandhaiyin pirandhanaalil indhu sadangugalinbadi vilakketrinar. Avar avalai eppadi nadathinaar endru paarungal. Idhai ovvoru indhu pennum, muzhu naadum paarkka vendum.
A girl in Bengaluru got married to IT professional Mohammed Mushtaq. She lit a lamp on their child’s birthday as per Hindu rituals. See how he treated her. ☝️This must be seen by every Hindu girl and the whole country.*,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video tharpodhu edukkappattadhalla, endru theriyavandhadhu. Melum, idhu kadandha 2015m aandu nigazhndha sambavam, idhil thodarbudaiya kanavan – manaivi iruvarume musleem; indhu alla…
idhanbadi, merkanda video-vil kaanappaduvor mugamadhu mushdaak matrum avaradhu manaivi aayishaa paanu. Ivargalukku kadandha 2009m aandu thirumanam nadaivetradhu. Mushdaak pengalooruvil ulla oru aidi niruvanathil panivurigiraar. Mushdaak matrum avaradhu kudumbathinar aayishaavai varadhatchanai kettu thunburuthiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Indha soozhalil, kadandha 2015aam aandu, ivargal thangaladhu maganin pirandhanaalai oru hottalil kondaadinar. Appodhu, andha nigazhvai kaatchippaduthuvadharkaaga mushdaak kemaraavai poruthik kondirundhavodhu, aayishaa kekkil mezhuguvarthi etriyullaar. Idhanaal, mushdaak aayishaavai thaakkiyullaar. Indha sambavam kemaraavil padhivaagiyulladhu. Indha video kaatchidhaan avvappodhu samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Muzhu vivaram ariya inge kilik seyyavum.
Aduthappadiyaaga, mushdaak matrum aayishaa tharpodhu pirindhu vaazhgindranar. Ivargaladhu vivagaaram pengalooru uyarneedhimandrathil ulladhum kurippidathakkadhu.
Idhanmoolamaaga, mushdaak matrum aayishaa Sunni Muslims endru namakku thelivaagiradhu. Idhu Love Jihad alladhu Inter Religious thirumanam kidaiyaadhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 4.10 kodi kuzhandhaigal udal parumanaal paadhippu.. Aisiemaar parindhuraigal enna?
text:
2026aam aandin ulaga udal paruman kuriyeettu tharavugalinbadi, India-vil sumaar 4 kodiye 10 latcham kuzhandhaigal adhiga udal edai kondavargalaaga alladhu udal parumanaaga ullanar enbadhu theriyavandhulladhu. Idhu saadhaaranamaaga kadandhu sellakkoodiya vishayamalla. Tharpodhaiya nilai thodarndhaal, 2030 aam aandukkul ulagin motha siruvar udal paruman sumaiyil 11 sadhaveedhathukkum adhigamaana panginai India kondirukkum enbadhu oru perum echarikkaiyaaga paarkkappadugiradhu.
Innilaiyil, aisiemaar veliyittulla parindhuraigalil unavup pottalangalin munbakkathil oottachathu kuritha thelivaana thagavalgal achidappada vendum endru koorappattulladhu. Palli valaagangal matrum 50 meter sutralavil adhiga niraivutra kozhuppu, niraivuraa kozhuppu, adhiga sarkkarai matrum sodiyam ulla unavugalai virkavum, vilambaram seyyavum thadai vidhippadhai theeviramaaga amalbadutha arivuruthappattulladhu. Kozhuppu, uppu matrum sarkkarai adhigamulla unavugalukku koodudhal varigalai vidhikkavum aisiemaar parindhuraithulladhu.

headline: Piradhamar Modi-kku paaradha rathnaa virudhu? Nattaa kodutha padhil!
text:
Paaradha rathnaa virudhu kurithu ezhundha kelvikku padhilalitha je.pi. Nattaa, Modi-kku virudhu vazhanguvadhu patri BJP vivaadhikkavillai endru koorinaar.
Piradhamar Modi-kku naattin uyariya virudhaana paaradha rathnaa vazhanguvadhu kurithu BJP-yil idhuvarai endha aalosanaiyum nadaiveravillai ena mathiya amaichar je.pi.nattaa therivithullaar.
Idhuvondra vishayangalil uriya nerathil katchi mudivedukkum enak kurippitta avar, Modi sarvaadhigaari pola seyalbaduvadhaagak koorum edhirkkatchigalin kutrachaattugalukku maruppu therivithaar. Melum, piradhamar Modi ulagin migas sirandha jananaayagath thalaivar endrum nattaa pugazhaaram soottinaar.

headline: Ore kaaril vandhu modiyai varaverpadhu pondru je.pi.nattaa nadithaaraa?
text:
‘‘ore kaaril arugaruge amarndhu payanithu, Modi keezhe irangiyavudan, Modi-kku poongothu koduthu varaverpadhu pondru nadikkum nattaa’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ piradhamar modiyum pijevi thalaivar nattaavum ore kaaril arugaruge amarndhu payanithu, iruvarum iranga vendiya idathil, mudhalil nattaa kaarilirundhu keezhe irangiyaviragu Modi keezhe irangiyavudan, avarai poongothu koduthu nattaa varaverpadhu, ee logathil yaarum cheyyaathadhu🧐🤣,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, ANI veliyitta muzhu video lingk namakku kidaithadhu. Idhu, BJP thalaimai aluvalagathil BJP aalum maanilangalin mudhalamaichargal matrum thunai mudhalamaichargaludan Modi nadathiya aalosanaik koottam thodarbaana video, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Melum, piradhamar modiyudan ondraaga, ore kaaril vandha navar nattaa illai, enbadhum purindhadhu. Idhevondru, piradhamar Modi-yin adhigaarappoorva yoo tiyup pakkathil veliyidappatta veediyovaiyum inge inaithullom.
Adhesamayam, idhe nigazhchi patri matra oodagangalil veliyaana seythigalaiyum aayvu seythavodhu, nattaa vandha vaaganam verondru, enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, kurippitta koottam mudindhadhum, angirundhu Modi veliyerum kaatchigal konda video ondrai ANI oodagam veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil, modiyudan kaaril vandha navar matrum nattaa ondraaga nadandhu varuvadhaik kandom.
Kurippitta koottathirku, Modi varumbodhum, angirundhu kilambumbodhum avarudan ondraagak kaaril sellum navar, avaradhu thanippatta seyalaalar endrum koorappadugiradhu.
Enave, nattaavum, modiyum ore kaaril varavillai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: KGF villan nadigar karudaa raam islaam madhathirku maarinaaraa?
text:
‘’KGF matrum pala padangalil villanaaga naditha piravala nadigar karudaa avargal thooya maarkkam islaathai thanadhu vaazhviyalaaga etru kondaargal,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ KGF matrum pala padangalil villanaaga naditha piravala nadigar karudaa avargal thooya maarkkam islaathai thanadhu vaazhviyalaaga etru kondaargal alhamdhulillaa…,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu. Adhil, karudaa raam musleem pondru thoppi , udai anindhu, silarudan kai kulukki pesuvadhu pondra kaatchigal idambetrullana.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda video unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval; ivargal kooruvadhu pondru karudaa raam endha madhathirkum maaravillai endru, theriyavandhadhu.
Sila naatkal munbaaga, madha nallinakka nigazhchi ondril pangetradhaagak kurippittu, karudaa raam thanadhu instaagiraam pakkathil padhivu ondrai veliyittirundhaar.
Melum, masoodhi ondrukkus sendru, ramalaan virundhil pangetru, parisugal vazhanginaar. Idhanbodhu, edukkappatta video ondraiye samooga valaidhalangalil pagirndhu, karudaa raam islaam madhathirku maarivittadhaaga, palarum thavaraana thagaval parappugindranar.
Idhaiyaduthu, karudaa raam udanadiyaaga, madham maaravillai, indralavum indhu madhathil thodarvadhaagak kurippittu, oodagangalil vilakkam alithuvittaar.
Idhu mattumindri, karudaa raam pangetra nigazhchiyai orunginaippu seytha masoodhi nirvaagamum uriya vilakkam alithulladhu. Adhil, karudaa raam islaam madhathirku maaravillai, endrum thelivaagak kooriyullanar.
Idhuvarai kidaitha aadhaarangalin adippadaiyil, karudaa raam islaam madhathirku maaravillai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Analaak paneer enumaavathu.. Echarikkum unavup paadhugaapputh thurai!!
text:
Unavagangalil aasaiyaaga vaangis saappidum paneer, namadhu aarokkiyathirku vettu vaikkum analaak paneeraagavum irukkalaam. Anmaiyil satheesgar, magaaraashdiraa matrum kujaraath aagiya maanila arasugal analaak paneer urpathi matrum virpanaikku adhiradiyaaga thadai vidhithullana. Analaak paneerai asalaana paneer endru koori vitraal 6 maadham mudhal aayul thandanai varai siraiyum, 10 latcham roobai varai avaraadhamum vidhikkappadum ena magaaraashdiraa arasu echarithulladhu.
Podhuvaaga paarambariya paneer enbadhu paalaith thirithu thayaarikkappadum paal porulaagum. Analaak paneer enbadhu paalukkup padhilaagath thaavara enneygal, kaaygari kozhuppugal, paal pavudar serthu seyarkaiyaaga uruvaakkappadum maatrup porulaagum. Paal paneerai vida idhanai malivaana vilaiyil thayaarikka mudiyum. Adhiga naatkalukkuk kettuppogaamal irukkum. Aanaal puradham, udalukku nanmai seyyum kozhuppus sathukkal migavum kuraivu. Unbavargal echarikkaiyaaga irukka, unavagangal thangal menu card-il analaak paneer payanbaduthuvadhaik kattaayam kurippida vendum ena mathiya unavup paadhugaapputh thurai utharavittulladhu.
Ayodin test moolam asal paneerdhaanaa enbadhaik kandariyalaam. Paneer thundai neeril kodhikka vaithu, aaravaithu adhil 2 mudhal 3 thuligal ayodin karaisalai ootrumbodhu neelam alladhu karuppu niramaaga maarinaal, adhu seyarkaiyaagath thayaarikkappatta 'analaak paneer' enbadhai urudhi seythugollalaam.

headline: DMK 187 thogudhigalaik kaippatrum endru thandhi TV karuthukkanippu veliyittadhaa?
text:
DMK koottani 187 idangalaik kaippatri thanip perumbaanmaiyudan aatchi amaikkum endru thandhi TV karuthuk kanippu veliyittadhu pondru oru pugaippadam

thandhi TV seythiyai sgireen shaat eduthadhu pondru oru pugaippadam fesbakkil padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “thamizhnaadu sattamandra therdhal 2026 – thandhi TV karuthuk kanippu. Aatchi amaikkap povadhu yaar? DMK 187 – 200 thogudhigal, ADMK 30 – 40 thogudhigal, TVK 1-0 thogudhigal. DMK 187 thogudhigalai kaippatri thanipperumbaanmaiyudan aatchi amaikkum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhal pirasaaram niraivadaiya ulla nilaiyil, DMK koottani 187 idangalaik kaippatrum endru thandhi TV seythi veliyittadhu pondru palarum samooga oodagangalil pugaippadam ondraip padhivittu varugindranar. Thandhi TV thannudaiya karuthuk kanippai tharpodhu veliyittu varugiradhu. Ovvoru maavattathil ulla thogudhigalin karuthuk kanippu mudivugalai veliyittu varugiradhu. Aanaal, ottumotha mudivu veliyittadhaaga seythi edhuvum illai.
Tharpodhu thandhi TV veliyittu varum karuthuk kanippaip paarkkum podhu DMK – ADMK koottanigal kittathatta sama alavil vetri peruvadhu pondru ulladhu. Koorndhu kavanikkum podhu ADMK koottanikku satru koodudhalaaga idam kidaikkum enbadhu pola ulladhu. Tharpodhu varai veliyittirukkum karuthuk kanippu adippadaiyil paarthaalum kooda 187 idangalil DMK koottani vellum endru koora vaayppillai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endru therigiradhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku indha pugaippadathai vaats ap moolam anuppi unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Idhan adippadaiyil DMK koottani 187 idangalil vellum endru thandhi TV karuthuk kanippu veliyittadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘parigaaram’ peyaril padhungiya adhirchi! - 3 sirumigal... 50-kkum merpatta video-kkal
text:
Sikkiya Salem ‘saamiyaar’
saamiyaar... Parigaaram... Aanmiga sakdhi... Indha vaarthaigalai nambi pirasnaigalukkuth theervu thedi varuvavargalaik kurivaithu, adhirchi tharum seyalgalil eeduvattadhaaga selathil saamiyaar oruvar kaidhuseyyappattirukkiraar. Vinaayagar sadhurthikkaaga nangodai kettu vandha sirumiyidam athumeera muyandradhaaga ezhundha pugaaraith thodarndhu, saamiyaarai poksovil kaidhuseythirukkiradhu vaazhappaadi Police
Salem maavattathais serndha 6-m vaguppu maanavi oruvar, vinaayagar sadhurthikkaaga akkam pakkathil nangodai vasoolithuvandhaar. Appodhu, veettin aruge seyalbattuvandha ‘saneesvaraa parigaara maiyam’ endra idathukkus sendru nangodai kettirukkiraar. Angirundha navar oruvar, nangodai tharuvadhaagak koori maanaviyai arugil azhaithu, thagaadha muraiyil nadakka muyandrirukkiraar.
Adhirchiyadaindha maanavi angirundhu thappithu vandhu, nadandha sambavathaith than thozhiyidam therivithirukkiraar. Andhath thozhiyum, adhe navar thannidamum idhe pondru athumeeriyadhaagath therivithirukkiraar. Idhaiyaduthu, irandu sirumigalum serndhu thangalukku nerndhadhai, thangal petroridam kooriyirukkindranar.
Aathiramadaindha petrorum, akkam pakkathinarum andhap parigaara maiyathukkus sendrirukkindranar. Appodhu, andha maiyam poottappattirundhadhu kandu aavesamadaindhavargal, poottai udaithu ulle sendrirukkiraargal.
Vijayaraajin pinnani!
Iruladaindha andha araiyil palli maanavigalin seerudaigal, kaalanigal pala iruppadhaik kandu adhirndhuvoyiruk kindranar. Idhu kurithu udanadiyaagak kaavaldhuraikkuth thagaval therivithirukkindranar. Viraindhu vandha poleesaar, andhap pagudhiyil padhungiyirundha vijayaraajaik kaidhuseythanar. Andhap parigaara maiyathil poleesaar nadathiya sodhanaiyil lepdaap, selbon ullitta saadhanangalaik kaippatrinar. Sirumigalukkum pengalukkum paaliyal thollai koduthadhu, aavaasa video-kkal eduthadhu ullitta kutrachaattugalin adippadaiyil, vijayaraaj meedhu pokso ullitta palveru sattappirivugalingeezh vazhakku padhivuseythu avarais siraiyil adaithirukkindranar.
`yaar indha vijayaraaj?’ endru kaavaldhurai pen adhigaari oruvaridam kettom. ``ivan vaazhappaadiyais serndhavan. Firitj, miksi, kiraindar ullitta veettu uvayogap porulgalaip pazhudhu paarthuvandhavan. 50 vayadhil, thideerenas saamiyaaraaga maari, ‘saneesvaraa parigaara maiyam’ endra peyaril maandhireegap parigaarangalais seythuvandhaan. Panak kashdam, kudumbak kashdam endru varum pengalidam `parigaaram’ endra peyaril aavaasa video-kkal eduthirukkiraan. Sirumiyidam thagaadha muraiyil nadakkave, sikkikkondaan.
Thannai aanmiga sakdhi kondavan enak koorik kolvaanaam. `saneesvara parigaaram seythaal pirasnaigal theerum’ endru koori pengalai maiyathukku varavazhaithirukkiraan. Parigaaram endra peyaril sila pengalaith thanimaiyil sandhithu, adhai veediyovaagap padhivuseythirukkiraan. Melum, padippu sirakkap parigaaram seyvadhaagak koori maanavigalaiyum emaatriyirukkiraan.
Video-kkal yaaridam sendrana? - thadayaviyal aayvil mukkiyath thadayam!
Idhuvarai 3 sirumigalin aavaasa video-kkal iruppadhu kandariyappattirukkiradhu. Siraar aavaasa veediyokkalukkuk kadumaiyaana thadaiyum thandanaiyum irukkindrana. Adhevelaiyil, Indhiya sirumigalai aavaasamaaga video eduthu kurippitta thalangalukku anuppinaal, 50 aayiram roobai mudhal pala latchangal varai vilai koduthu vaangum kumbal irukkiradhu. Kodooramaana paaliyal vakkiram konda athagaiya saikko kumbaludan thodarbu erpattu, sirumigalin aavaasa veediyokkalai vijayaraaj virpanai seythirukkalaam engira sandhegam ezhundhirukkiradhu.
Selbon, lepdaap moolam yaarukkellaam indha veediyokkalai anuppiyirukkiraan enbadhaik kandariya, thadayaviyal sodhanaikku anuppivaithirukkirom. Aayvu mudivugalukkaagak kaathirukkirom. Ivanudan veru yaarukkenum thodarbu irukkiradhaa enbadhu kurithum visaaranai merkonduvarugirom. Sirumigalin aavaasa veediyokkalai virpanai seythadhu, vaangiyadhu kurithu urudhiseyyappattaal, nadavadikkai innum kadumaiyaaga irukkum. Velinaattu netvorkkaaga irundhaalum nadavadikkai paayum” endraar.
Indhas sambavam kurithu vaazhappaadi anaithu magalir kaavaldhuraiyinar, ``visaaranaiyil moondru sirumigalai aavaasamaaga video eduthadhu theriyavandhirukkiradhu. Avai ragasiya inaiyadhalangalil virpanai seyyappattirukkalaam endra konathilum visaaranai nadakkiradhu. Melum palar paadhikkappattirukkalaam enbadhaal, paadhikkappattavargal thayakkamindri pugaaralikkalaam; thagavalgal ragasiyamaaga vaikkappadum. Pengal idhu pondra polis saamiyaargalidam echarikkaiyudan irukka vendum” endranar.
Sirumigalin vaazhkkaiyodu vilaiyaadiya saamiyaar thappividak koodaadhu!

headline: Epstein koppugal: pengaludan Modi iruppadhu pondru paravum pugaippadangal unmaiyaa?
text:
America paaliyal kutravaaliyum manidha kadathalgalil eeduvattavarumaana Jeffrey Epstein (Epstein Files) thodarbaana koppugalil piradhamar modhiyin peyar idambetrulladhaaga sarchai kilambiyulladhu. Indha soozhalil pala pengaludan Modi iruppadhu pondru oru pugaippadam

Epstein vivagaaram thodarbaaga neenda padhivu Facebook-il veliyidappattulladhu. “kangaigarai thottam .. Kannivengal koottam kannan naduvinile…!! Modi kannan naduvinile..” endru adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhanudan, pengaludan Modi iruppadhu pondru vidhavidhamaana padangal ondru serthu Epstein pugaippadathudan padhividappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
America-vin perum panakkaararaaga irundha Jeffrey Epstein, sirumigalaip paaliyal thozhilil eeduvaduthiya kutrachaattil kadandha 2019m aandu kaidhu seyyappattu siraiyil adaikkappattaar. Siraiyil marmamaana muraiyil avar irandhaar. Jeffrey Epstein (Jeffrey Epstein) thodarbaana latchakkanakkaana pudhiya koppugalai America needhith thurai veliyittulladhu.30 latcham pakkangal, 1,80,000 pugaippadangal matrum 2,000 video-kkal vellikkizhamai (janavari 30) pagirangamaaga veliyidappattana.
Idhil Indhiya piradhamar narendhira Modi peyarum iruppadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Indha soozhalil pala pengaludan narendhira Modi iruppadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Epstein koppugal vivagaarathudan padangal iruppadhaal, idhuvum adhil kidaithadhu pondra thotrathai idhu erpaduthugiradhu. Idhil vimaanathil avar sellum podhu veliyaana oru padathai edit seythu veliyittirundhanar. Idhanaal, matra padangalum poliyaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Vimaanathil sellum pugaippadathai mattum thaniyaaga eduthu koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Pen illaamal koppugalai Modi paarkkum unmaiyaana pugaippadathai 2021m aandu sepdambar 22m thedhi piradhamar narendhira Modi thannudaiya X thala pakkathil veliyittirundhaar. Indha pugaippadathai edit seythiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga, kaaril oru pennudan irukkum pugaippadathai aayvu seythom. Sila maadhangalukku munbu Russia adhivarudan Modi kaaril payanam seythavodhu veliyaana pugaippadam pola idhu irundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai thaniyaaga eduthu koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom.
Indha pugaippadathai piradhamar narendhira Modi thannudaiya X thala pakkathil 2025 tisambar 4m thedhi padhivittirundhaar. Thannudaiya nanbarum Russia adhivarumaana pudhinai varavetra podhu endru adhil kurippittirundhaar. Putin padathai agatrivittu, pennin padathai adhil vaithu edit seythu pennudan narendhira Modi iruppadhu pondru padathai uruvaakkiyirundhadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga ilam pen oruvarin kaiyai narendhira Modi pidithavadi irukkum karuppu vellai pugaippadathai aayvu seythom. Andha padathai thaniyaaga eduthu koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Veru oru pennidam Modi pesiya pugaippadathai edit seythu veliyittiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Andha pen patriya thagavalum namakku kidaikkavillai. Kujaraath mudhalamaicharaaga irundha podhu Modi-yin udhaviyaalaraaga irundhadhaaga avaraiyum narendhira modiyaiyum inaithu kisugisu paaniyil andha padhivu irundhadhu.
Idhan moolam pengaludan Modi iruppadhaaga pagirappadum moondru pugaippadangalum poliyaanadhu, edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil idam petra pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thamizhaga kadalil kuppai kottiya keralaa endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Thamizhaga kadalil keralaa kappalil kuppai kondu kottiyadhaaga oru video

kappal ondril irundhu kazhivugal kottappadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thamizhnaadu enna keralaavin kuppai thottiyaa? Thamizhaga arasu enna seythugonduyirukkiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Keralaavilirundhu Thamizhaga ellaip pagudhiyil maruthuva, migavum aavathaana kuppaigal kottuvadhu neenda kaalamaaga thodarndhu konde irukkiradhu. Tharpodhu ippadi kotta varum vaaganangalai Tamil Nadu arasu parimudhal seythu, vaaganangalai otti varuvavargalaik kaidhu seythu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu kadal pagudhikku kuppai kondu vandhu kottiya keralaa endru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vil idhu thamizhnaattuk kadalorap pagudhi enbadharko, kappal kerala arasukku sondhamaanadhu enbadharku endha aadhaarathaiyum alikkavillai. Ragasiyamaaga kuppai kottugiraargal endraal adhai oruvar video edukkum alavukku anaivarukkum theriyum vagaiyil eduthirukka vaayppu illai. Video-vai paarkkum podhu arugaruge irandu thirappugal iruppadhu polavum adhilirundhu varum kazhivukkum kadalil kottappadum kazhivukkum alavu vithiyaasam iruppadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Enave indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu kadandha sila naatkalaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal edhilum idhu Tamil Naattil edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Adhe pol engu edukkappattadhu endrum kurippidappadavillai.
Sila veediyokkalil Ali Aboutine endru vaattarmaark logo thelivaagath therindhadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil thediya podhu YouTube, instaagiraamil namakku profail kidaithadhu. Adhil eai aardist, digital kiriyettar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Kadalil kuppai kottappaduvadhu pondru eraalamaana eai veediyokkalai avar thannudaiya instaagiraam pakkathil padhivittirundhaar.
Idhan moolam idhu unmaiyaanadhu illai, eai video enbadhu thelivaanadhu. Eai video-vai eduthu thamizhnaattuk kadal pagudhiyil kappalil kuppai kottiya keralaa endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: DMK aatchikku vara virumbuvor maadham roo.1000 arasukku selutha vendum endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
DMK meendum aatchikku vara vendum endru ninaippavargal Thamizhaga arasin kadanai adaikka maadham roo.1000 arasukku kodukka vendum endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga oru news card

san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “aatchikku vandhaal. DMK meendum aatchikku varavendum ena makkal ninaithaal maadham 1000 roobai arasukku selutha vendum adhaivaithu thamizhnaattu kadan adaikkappadum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhal arivippu veliyaaga ulla nilaiyil ovvoru katchiyum makkalukku palveru ilavasangalai pottip pottu arivithu varugindrana. Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin makkalidamirundhu maadham roo.1000m vasoolithu Tamil Nadu arasin kadanai adaikka ulladhaaga arivithadhu pondru oru news card-ai palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Paarkka san TV veliyittadhu pondra news card polave ulladhu. Aanaal, makkalidam panam vasoolikkum thittathai arasiyal thalaivargal arivikka vaayppe illai, adhuvum edhirkkatchigal pottup pottu ilavasangalai arivithu varum nilaiyil ippadi arivippu veliyida vaayppillai enbadhaal idhu poliyaana news kaardaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Ippadi oru news card-ai san news veliyittulladhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil appadi endha oru news kaardum illai. Indha news card-ai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, idhe pondra oru news card-ai san news 2026 maars 4m thedhi veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Trichy railway aluvalagathil indhi mozhiyil peyar palagai vaikkappattadharku edhirppu therivithu Stalin viduthirundha echarikkai thodarbaana seythi adhilirundhadhu. Andha news card-ai edit seythu vishamathanamaana thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhiseythugolla san news digital poruppaalarukku indha naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai anuppi idhu unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru nammidam urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vattaara pokkuvarathu aayvaalargalukku payitsi
text:
Chennai: arasup paniyaalar thervaanaiyam moolam thervu seyyappatta vattaara pokkuvarathu aayvaalargalukkaana sirappu payitsi, kadandha moondru naatkalaaga kindiyil nadandhadhu.
Tamil Nadu arasup paniyaalar thervaanaiyam vaayilaaga vattaara pokkuvarathu aayvaalar kiredu – -2 paniyidangalukku thervu nadathappattu, kaaliyaaga irundha 53 paniyidangal nirappappattana. Thervaanavargalukku vaagana thagudhis saandru aayvu, ottunar thervu nadaimuraigal, vaagana vivathu pulanaayvu ullitta payitsigal alikkappattana.
Kadandha 16m thedhi mudhal netru varai mottaar vaagana sattam, kalappani, thanikkai, aar.ti.ai., sattam kurithu moondru naatkal payitsi alikkappattadhu. Meenambaakkam vattaara pokkuvarathu aluvalar arunaachalam ullittor payitsi alithanar. Nava., 30m thedhi pokkuvarathu pirivu, saalai paadhugaappu, sarakku vaagana paadhugaappu kurithu payitsi alikkappada ulladhu.

headline: Thookkam varavillaiyaa? Ini maathirai vendaam.. Idhai seythaal podhum! Taakdars sollum simbil aidiyaa!
text:
America-vin teksaas palgalaikkazhaga vinjnjaanigal, thookka maathiraikku maatraaga netriyil ottum ‘niyu sleep’ pets uruvaakkiyullanar. Idhu miga menmaiyaana altraasavunt alaigalai moolaikku anuppi rem thookkathai thoondugiradhu. 28 peridam nadandha aayvil, idhaip payanbaduthiyavargal rem thookka nilaiyai saraasariyaaga 43 nimidangal viraivaaga adaindhu, rem thookkathil 16 nimidangal koodudhalaaga irundhadhu kandariyappattadhu.
Thookkam varavillai endraal ini maathirai vendaamaa? Netriyil pets (PATCH) ottinaale, azhndha thookkam vara udhavum endru America vinjnjaanigal nadathiya pudhiya aayvu kurithu ithoguppil paarkkalaam..
Naam thoongumbodhu nam moolai pala kattangalil oyvedukkiradhu .adhil rem sleep (REM SLEEP) enbadhu migavum mukkiyamaana kattam. Indha rem (REM) thookkathinbodhudhaan kanavugal adhigam varum. Moolai ninaivugalai ozhunguppaduthavum, mana azhuthathilirundhu meelavum idhu udhavugiradhu. Rem thookkam sariyaaga illaiyendraal, maradhi, sorvu, manaazhutham pondra pirachinaigal erpadalaam.
Idharkaagave America-vin teksaas palgalaikkazhaga aaraaychiyaalargal, niyu sleep (NEU SLEEP) endra menmaiyaana petchai (PATCH) uruvaakkiyullanar. Indha petchai netriyil ottikkondu thoongumbodhu, migavum menmaiyaana altraasavunt (uLTRASOUND) alaigal, moolaiyin rem thookkathai thoonduvadhaagavum, 28 peridam nadathappatta aarambagatta aayvil, indha petchai payanbaduthiyavargal rem ( REM) thookka nilaiyai saraasariyaaga 43 nimidangal viraivaaga adaindhadhudan, rem thookkathila sumaar 16nimidangal koodudhalaaga irundhadhaagavum aaraaychiyaalargal therivikkindranar.

headline: 47 naadugalai serndhorai poril payanbaduthum Russia; ainaa koottathil Ukraine adhivar kutrachaattu
text:
Niyooyaark: poril India utbada 47 naadugalin kudimakkalai Russia payanbaduthugiradhu ena ainaa koottathil Ukraine adhivar jelansgi kutramsaattiyullaar.
Niyooyaarkkil nadaivetra aikkiya naadugal savaiyin podhuchavai koottathil Ukraine adhivar jelansgi pesiyadhaavadhu: Russia-vin varthaga varuvaaythaan porai needikkas seygiradhu; enave Russia-vin varuvaayai ilakkaagak kondu varthagathaik kattuppadutha vendum. Porai udanadiyaaga mudikkaavittaal, Russia aakkiramippu airoppaavin pira pagudhigalukkum paravum.
Poril India utbada 47 naadugalin kudimakkalai Russia payanbaduthugiradhu. Sila velinaattinar emaatrappattu rashyaavirkul nuzhaindhullanar. Avargal porukkaaga payanbaduthap padugindranar. Sambandhappatta naadugal nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Ukraine por niruthathirkuth thayaaraaga irukkiradhu; Russia thanadhu nilaippaattai maatra vendum.
Varavirukkum kulirgaalam kadinamaaga irukkakkoodum enbadhai Ukraine purindhugondulladhu. Engal meedhaana thaakkudhalgalukkup padhiladiyaaga Russia meedhu kadumaiyaana nadavadikkaigalai edukka Ukraine muyalum. Russia-vin erivorul viniyogathai azhippadhai vida, porukku nidhiyalikkum adhan thiranaik kuraippadhe Ukraine-in nokkam. Ivvaaru Ukraine adhivar jelansgi pesinaar.

headline: ‘vijayyai nambi vandhavargal vaazhndhadhillai’ endru TVK amaichar aananth koorinaaraa?
text:
