headline: Nandri kettavar endru modiyai vimarsithaaraa kavudham adhaani?
text:
Nandri kettavar endru piradhamar narendhira modiyai thozhiladhivar kavudham adhaani vimarsithaar endru oru poli news card samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu.

Piradhamar narendhira Modi, thozhiladhivar kavudham adhaani aagiyor ondraaga iruppadhu pondra padathudan san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “modhal nandri kettavar ena thozhiladhivar kavudham adhaani kadum vimarsanam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Piradhamar narendhira modiyai thozhiladhivar kavudham adhaani vimarsithadhu pondru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Paarkka unmaiyaana news card pola ulladhu. Iruppinum pinnaniyil amerikkak kodi, vellai maaligaiyil edukkappatta pugaippadam ellaam idhu edit seyyappatta news card enbadhai urudhi seygindrana. Iruppinum idhaiyum unmai endru nambi palarum comment seythu varugindranar.
Modiyai adhaani vimarsithadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Endha oru oodagamum appadi oru seythiyai veliyidavillai. Unmaiyil adhaani siru vimarsanam seythirundhaal kooda thesiya oodagangal thodangi ulloor oodagangal varaiyilum periya vivaadhame nadathiyiruppaargal. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Sila thinangalukku munbu ulagin munnani panakkaarargalul oruvaraana elaan mask matrum America adhivar tiramp-kku idaiye modhal erpattadhu. Adhai vaithu san news tholaikkaatchiyil news card veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhai eduthu edit seythu, thavaraana thagaval serthup pagirndhiruppadhu purindhadhu. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya san news veliyittirundha news card-ai adhan Facebook pakkathilirundhu eduthom.
Adhil, “modhal. Naan udhaviyirukkaavittaal therdhalil thotriruppaar. Trump nandri kettavar ena thozhiladhivar elaan mask kadum vimarsanam” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai eduthu Trump thalaikku padhil Modi-yin thalaiyaiyum mask thalaikku padhil adhaani thalaiyaiyum vaithu photo edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthup pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythugolla idhai san news digital poruppaalarin WhatsApp ennirku anuppinom. Avarum indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai nammidam urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu edit seyyappattadhu, thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Ungalukkaaga velai seyyum AI.. Mark Zuckerberg arimugappaduthiya ‘Muse’!
text:
Mark Zuckerberg thalaimaiyilaana Meta, payanarukkaaga neradiyaaga velai seyyum thanippatta AI ejendaana ‘Muse’-ai arimugappaduthiyulladhu. Muse, minnanjjal anuppudhal, payana thittamidal pondra panigalai payanar saarbil seythu, uraiyaadalgalil irundhu thagavalgalai ninaivil vaithu edhirgaala parindhuraigal vazhangum.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
seyarkai nunnarivu thuraiyil adutha kattathai nokki nagarum vagaiyil, Mark Zuckerberg thalaimaiyilaana Meta pudhiya ‘Muse’ thanippatta AI ejendai arimugappaduthiyulladhu. Sepdambar 8 andru arivikkappatta Muse, kelvigalukku padhil alippadhudan nindruvidaamal, payanargalukkaaga neradiyaaga palveru panigalaiyum merkollum vagaiyil uruvaakkappattulladhu.
Muse-kku oru paniyai koorinaal, adhai seyalbaduthuvadharkaana nadavadikkaigalai thaanaaga merkolla mudiyum. Udhaaranamaaga, minnanjjal anuppuvadhu, payanathaith thittamiduvadhu ullitta andraada panigalai payanar saarbil seyya mudiyum. Melum, payanarin uraiyaadalgalil irundhu mukkiyamaana thagavalgalai ninaivil vaithukkondu, edhirgaala thevaigalukku erpa parindhuraigalaiyum vazhangum ena Meta therivithulladhu.
Idharkaaga Muse Spark endra Meta-vin membatta AI maadal payanbaduthappadugiradhu. Muse, thanakkena uruvaakkappatta Muse Secure VM endra paadhugaappaana meynigar kanini soozhalil iyangugiradhu. Payanarin tharavu matrum inaikkappatta sevaigalin thagavalgalaip paadhugaappaaga kaiyaalum vagaiyil idhu vadivamaikkappattulladhu.
Minnanjjal anuppuvadhu alladhu kolmudhal seyvadhu pondra mukkiyamaana nadavadikkaigalukku munbu payanarin anumadhiyaiyum Muse ketkum. Melum, endhendha seyaligalukku anugal vazhanga vendum enbadhaiyum payanare theermaanikka mudiyum. Mudharkattamaaga America-vil iOS, Android matrum muse.ai thalangalil Muse arimugamaagiyulladhu.

headline: Salem: pala aangaludan ragasiya uravu; kanditha kanavanukku nerndha kodooram; adhirchi pinnani enna?
text:
''thannudaiya 13 vayadhu maganaiyum indhak kodoora kolaiyil eeduvaduthiyirukkiraar. Kolai marakkave sinimaavai minjjum vagaiyil naadagamaadiyirukkiraar'' - Police
Salem maavattam omaloorais serndhavar 45 vayadhaana poovadhi. Sangagiri saalai arugil sengal soolai nadathi vandhirukkiraar. Ivarin manaivi 31 vayadhaana sujidhaasree.
Kadandha 31 - m thedhi adhigaalai kaaril sendru kondirundha podhu thideerena vazhimaritha oru kumbal ondru kanavarai vetti padugolai seythuvittu nagaigalaith thirudis sendradhaaga uravinargal matrum kaavaldhuraiyinaridam therivithirukkiraar sujidhaasree.
Poovadhiyin udalaik kaippatriya kaavaldhuraiyinar, idhu kurithu vazhakkuppadhivu seythu visaaranaiyaith thodangiyullanar.
Sujidhaasreeyin nadavadikkaigalaal sandhegam erpattathaith thodarndhu avaridame visaaranaiyaith theevirappaduthiyullanar. Edhirveettil kudiyirundha sandhosh raaj enbavarudan thirumanam meeriya uravil irundhadhaik kandarindhu kanavar vaakkuvaadhathil eeduvattadhaal kolai seythom enath thidukkida vaithirukkiraar.
Sujidhaasree, sandhosh raaj iruvaraiyum kaidhu seythullanar. Melum indhath thambadhiyin 13 vayadhu siruvanai koornokku illathil anuppi vaithullanar. Sandhosh raaj mattumindri poovadhiyin nanbargal palarudanum thirumanam thaandiya uravil sujidhaa irundhu vandhiruppadhai kaavaldhuraiyinar kandarindhullanar.
Indha adhirchi pinnani kurithu therivitha omaloor kaavaldhuraiyinar, "sengal soolai urimaiyaalaraana poovadhiyin veettirku thozhil thodarbaagap pechuvaarthai nadatha nanbargal palarum adikkadi vandhu sendrullanar. Avargaludan ragasiyamaagap pazhakkathai erpaduthik konda sujidhaasree, thirumanam meeriya thagaadha uravil irundhu vandhirukkiraar.
Idhaik kandu adhirchiyadaindha poovadhi adikkadi kandithu vandhirukkiraar. Aanaal, edhaippatriyum kavalaippadaamal pala aangaludan ragasiya uravaith thodarndhu vandhirukkiraar. Edhir veettil kudiyirundha sandhosh raaj enbavarudanum thirumanam thaandiya uravil irundhu vivagaaram thodarbaaga kadandha 29 aam thedhi iravu vaakkuvaadham erpattirukkiradhu.
Poovadhiyin thalaiyil thaakki mayakkamadaiyas seythadhudan, sandhosh raajai veettirku varavazhaithu kathiyaal pala idangalil kuthi kolai seythirukkiraargal. Thannudaiya 13 vayadhu maganaiyum indhak kodoora kolaiyil eeduvaduthiyirukkiraar. Kolaiyai marakkave sinimaavai minjjum vagaiyil naadagamaadiyirukkiraar" endranar.

headline: Indru India varugiraar Russia adhivar pudin; piradhamar modiyai sandhithu pesugiraar
text:
Maasgo: piriks uchi maanaattil pangerpadharkaaga Russia adhivar pudin, indru India vara iruppadhaaga annaattin veliyuravuthurai amaichagam adhigaarappoorvamaaga arivithulladhu.
Piriks koottamaippin uchi maanaadu, varum sep.,12 matrum 13m thedhigalil pudhudilliyil nadaivera irukkiradhu. Idharkaana erpaadugal sirappaana muraiyil nadaivetru varugiradhu. Idhil, palveru naadugalais serndha thalaivargal India vara ulla nilaiyil, Russia adhivar vilaadimir pudin tilli varuvadhu urudhiyaagiyulladhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga Russia veliyuravuthurai amaichagam adhigaarappoorvamaaga veliyitta arikkaiyil; Russia adhivar pudin varum 11m thedhi mudhal 13m thedhi varai India-vil sutruppayanam merkolla irukkiraar. Indhap payanathin podhu, piriks uchi maanaattil pangerka irukkiraar.
Thodarndhu, piradhamar modiyaiyum thaniyaaga sandhithu pesugiraar. Indha sandhippin podhu, paadhugaappu, erisakdhi, varthagam pondra mukkiya thuraigalil irudharappu uravugal kurithu irunaattu thalaivargalum aalosanai nadatha ullanar, ivvaaru therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: ’therdhal aanaiyam thesa thurogam seythulladhu..’ - raagul kaandhi kadumaiyaana vimarsanam
text:
Therdhal aanaiyam merkondu varum SIR nadavadikkaiyil thagudhiyaana vaakkaalargalin peyargalum neekkappadalaam, velippadaithanmai illai ena edhirkkatchigal kutranjjaattum nilaiyil, irandu therdhal aanaiyargal 10 maadhangalil 14 murai edhirppu therivithadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. Idhai adippadaiyaagak kondu, vaakkuth thiruttu thesathurogam ena raagul kaandhi kadumaiyaaga kutramsaattugiraar.
Vaakkaalar pattiyalil thagudhiyatravargal, irandhavargal, idam maariyavargal matrum irattaip padhivugal ullittavatrai kandarindhu pattiyalaith thiruthuvadharkaaga Special Intensive Revision enappadum SIR nadavadikkaiyai therdhal aanaiyam merkondu varugiradhu. Aanaal, indha nadavadikkaiyaal thagudhiyaana vaakkaalargalin peyargalum neekkappadakkoodum endrum, SIR nadaimuraiyil podhiya velippadaithanmai illai endrum edhirkkatchigal thodarndhu kutrachaattugalai munvaithu varugindrana.
Indha nilaiyil, therdhal aanaiyathil ulla moondru therdhal aanaiyargalil sukbeer sing sandhu matrum vivek joshi aagiya iruvarum, kadandha 10 maadhangalil palveru mudivugal thodarbaaga kuraindhadhu 14 murai aatchevanai therivithadhaaga indru veliyaana thagaval perum vivaadhathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Vaakkaalar peyargalais serppadhu, neekkuvadhu, meendum serppadhu ullitta nadavadikkaigal thodarbaaga avargal kelvi ezhuppiyadhaagavum thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu.
Indhasoozhalil esaiaar vivagaarathil therdhal aanaiya ulmodhalgal kurithu veliyaana seythiyai suttikkaatti makkalavai Congress thalaivar raagul kaandhi vimarsithullaar. Vaakkuth thiruttu enbadhu Indhiya makkalukku edhiraana kutram matrum namadhu arasamaippus sattathin meedhaana neradith thaakkudhal ena X thalathil padhivittullaar. Vaakkuthiruttai orunginaitha BJP, aareses matrum therdhal aanaiyam aagiyavai koottaaga serndhu thesathurogas seyalil eeduvattullana endrum idharkaana needhi nichayam kidaikkum endrum avar therivithaar.

headline: Telliyilirundhu kujaraath.. 72 aandugalil mudhanmurai.. Thesiya thiraippada virudhugal idamaatram en?
text:
Thesiya thiraippada virudhugal vazhangum vizhaa, kadandha 72 aandugaala varalaatril mudhanmuraiyaaga pudhudelliyil irundhu kujaraath maanilathirku idamaatram seyyappattulladhu. Ivvizhaavai telliyil irundhu kujaraathirku maatriyadharkup piravalath thiraippada iyakkunar raagul tholagiyaa ullitta silar kelvi ezhuppiyullanar.
Indhiyath thiraippadath thuraiyin miga uyariya virudhaaga mathiya arasu vazhangum thesiya thiraippada virudhugal ullana. Idhu, 1954-aam aandu thodangappattadhu mudhal kittathatta 72 aandu kaalamaaga thalainagar telliyil ulla vinjnjaan pavanil mattume nadathappattu vandhana. Innilaiyil 72aavadhu thesiya thiraippada virudhugal vazhangum vizhaa varum sepdambar 22 andru, kujaraath maanilam narmadhaa maavattathil ulla ulagap pugazhbetra 'otrumaiyin silai' (Statue of Unity) valaagathil nadaivera irukkiradhu. 'ek paarath, sreshda paarath' thittathin keezh, thesiya alavilaana mukkiya vizhaakkalaith thalainagar telliyaith thaandi naattin palveru pagudhigalukkum kondusellum pudhiya kolgai mudivinbadi indha idam thervu seyyappattulladhu.
Sumaar 1,000 sirappu virundhinargal pangerkum vagaiyil, ekdhaa nagar valaagathil mathiya arasu matrum kujaraath maanila arasu saarbil pirammaandamaana paadhugaappu erpaadugal seyyappattu varugindrana. Ivvizhaavil, kudiyarasuth thalaivar thirauvadhi murmu vetriyaalargalukku virudhugalai vazhangi kauravikkavullaar. 2024aam aandil veliyaana thiraippadangalukku ivvaandu virudhugal vazhangappada ullana. Virudhup pattiyal kadandha joolai maadham telliyil arivikkappattadhu.
Thesiya, samooga matrum sutruchoozhal madhippulla sirandha padam endra pirivil arun maadhesvaran iyakkathil thanush naditha 'kepdan millar' thiraippadamu matrum thanush iyakki naditha 'raayan' thiraippadam aagiyana sirandha thamizh padathirkaana virudhukku thervaagiyulladhu kurippidathakkadhu.
Ivvizhaavai telliyil irundhu kujaraathirku maatriyadharkup piravalath thiraippada iyakkunar raagul tholagiyaa ullitta silar kelvi ezhuppiyullanar. Tellikku veliye nadathuvadhaaga irundhaal, Indhiya sinimaathuraikku adhiga pangalippai alitha Tamil Nadu, keralaa, magaaraashdiraa alladhu haidharaavaath pondra idangalaith thervu seythirukkalaame thavira kujaraath alla endru samooga valaithalangalil vivaadhangal kilambiyullana.

headline:
Seenaavidam seekret ragasiyam.. 
Aavathil sikkiya America aduthu nadakkappovadhu enna?
text:
Seenaavidam seekret ragasiyam.. Aavathil sikkiya America aduthu nadakkappovadhu enna?
Aasdhireliyaavilirundhu amerikkaavirkup pazhudhuvaarppadharkaaga anuppappatta F-35 stelth por vimaanathin sila paagangal, payanathinbodhu vazhimaari China-vin haangaangais sendradaindhullana. Idhudhodarbaaga amerikkap pendagan matrum aasdhireliyap paadhugaappu amaichagam visaaranaigalai merkondu varugindrana.
Aasdhireliyaavil ulla villiyam tavun maiyathilirundhu amerikkaavirkup pazhudhuvaarppadharkaaga F-35 vimaanathin pazhudhadaindha paagangal kondu sellappattana. Andhap paagangalil vimaaniyin araikkaana merkooraiyum, aayudhak kidanguk kadhavum adangum. Ivai irandum, vimaanathin maraindhirundhu thaakkum thiranai membaduthum redaarai urinjjum porulaal poosappattirundhana. Indhath thiranai muzhumaiyaaga uruvaakka, amerikkaavirkup pala aandugal pidithana. Indhas soozhalildhaan, andhap paagangal idaitharagu pokkuvarathu niruvanathin kularuvadiyaal haangaangirkuth thiruppividappattana. Aasdhireliyap paadhugaappu amaichar richart maarles indha vivagaarathai urudhippaduthiyullaar. Iruppinum, ivai migavum ragasiyamaana unardhiranmikka paagangal alla endru avar therivithullaar.
Adhevol, F-35 koottuth thitta aluvalagamum (JPO) ichambavathai urudhiseythu, viniyogas sangili kuraivaadugalai aaraayavum, paagangalai meetkavum nadavadikkai eduthu varugiradhu.
Melum, ichambavam vanigareedhiyaana pokkuvarathuth thavaru kaaranamaaga nadandhadhaa alladhu idhil pira thalaiyeedugal ulladhaa enbadhu kurithu America matrum aasdhireliyaavin ulavu amaippugal thodarndhu visaaranai nadathi varugindrana. Aanaal, athagaiya sambavam edhuvum thangalukkuth theriyaadhu endru China therivithulladhu. Eninum, sameevathiya aandugalil, China kadumaiyaana thesiyap paadhugaappus sattangal moolam haangaangin meedhaana thanadhu pidiyai valuppaduthiyiruppadhu kavanikkathakkadhu. Adhenerathil, vimaanathin redaaril sikkaamal thavirkka udhavum sirapputh thozhilnutbap poochu adhil iruppadhaal, China idhai aayvu seythu 'rivars injiniyaring' seyyakkoodum ena America kavalai therivithulladhu.
F-35 vimaanam America vaan sakdhiyin maiyappulliyaagum, ivvimaanathin thozhilnutbangalai America pala aandugalaaga migavum ragasiyamaagap paadhugaathu varugiradhu. Idhanaaldhaan America thanadhu netto natbu naadugalaith thavira matra naadugalukku indha vimaanathai virkath thayakkam kaatti vandhadhu. Iruppinum, adhivar tonaaldu Trump, kadandha vaaram savoodhi areviyaavukku 48 F-35 vimaanangalai virpanai seyya oppudhal alithullaar. Tharpodhu, F-35 vimaanathin paagangalai China thalaigeezhaagap poriyiyal seythu, adhanmoolam J-20 matrum J-35 pondra thanadhu sondha maraimugath thaakkudhal vimaanangalai membaduthakkoodum enbadhe America-vin migapperiya kavalaiyaaga ulladhu.

headline: Velinaattu azhuthathukku paniya maattom: mathiya arasu thittavattam
text:
Pudhudilli: naattu makkalin nalane engal arasin munnurimai; velinaattu azhuthathukku paniya maattom ena thanadhu nilaippaattai mathiya arasu thelivuvaduthi ulladhu.
Russia-vukku edhiraana adhiradi porulaadhaarath thadai masodhaavil America adhivar tonaaldu Trump kaiyezhuthittullaar. Idhan moolam, India, China meedhu, 100 sadhaveedha vari vidhikka mudiyum.indha vivagaaram kurithu nam veliyuravu inai amaichar keerthi vardhan sing kooriyadhaavadhu:
naattu makkalin nalane engal arasin munnurimai. Makkalukku payanalikkum anaithu nadavadikkaigalaiyum eduppom. India-vin valimai matrum sdhirathanmaiyai urudhi seyya theerkkamaana nadavadikkaigalai merkolvom.
India sudhandhiramaana veliyuravu kolgaiyai pinbatrugiradhu. Matra naadugalin utharavugalukku erpa nilaippaattai maatrik kolvadhillai. Naattin nalangalukku erpave mudivugalai edukkirom.
Engalukku vidhikkappadum varigal niyaayamatravai endra nilaippaattai thodarndhu therivithu varugirom. Endha naattin azhuthathukkum naangal paniya maattom.makkalukku thevaiyaana kachaa enneyyai saadhagamaana vilaiyil kidaithaal endha naattilirundhum vaanguvom. Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Peegaar therdhal mudivukku edhiraaga poraadum makkal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaar therdhal mudivugalukku edhiraaga veedhikku vandhu poraadum makkal endru oru video

makkal migapperiya alavil oorvalamaaga sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “pihaar makkal anaivarum veedhiyil vandhu poraadugiraargal
endraal nichayamaaga BJP kku ottu pottavargalaaga irukkave mudiyaadhu edho thillu mullu seythuBJP vetri kandadhu urudhiyaagiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhal nadandhu mudindhulladhu. Idhil aalum aikkiya janadhaa thalam matrum BJP koottani migapperiya vetriyai petrulladhu. Indha nilaiyil, paajaga-vin indha vetriyai edhirthu podhu makkal saalaiyil irangi poraadi varugindranar endru samooga oodagangalil video viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Aanaal, appadi angu migapperiya alavil poraattam nadappadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, kadandha sepdambar maadhathilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil assaami paadagar juveen kaarkkin irudhi oorvalam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhil irudhi oorvalam sellum koodudhal kaatchigalum irundhana. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovilum irandhavarin udalai eduthus sellum vaaganathaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Peegaar therdhal mudivugal navambar 14, 2025 andru veliyaanadhu. Therdhal mudivugalukku edhiraaga poraadum makkal endru tharpodhu samooga oodagangalil paravum veediyovo sepdambar irudhiyil veliyaagi ulladhu. Kittathatta peegaar therdhal mudivugal veliyaavadharku munbu ondrarai maadhangalukku munbu video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi ulladhu. Andha nerathil vaakkup padhivu kooda nadakkavillai. Idhan moolam pazhaiya video-vai eduthu therdhal mudivugalukku edhiraaga poraadum peegaar makkal endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kolaiyaali meedhu paayndhadhu kundaas
text:

headline: Mekkaavukku aruge evuganai padhatram! Savoodhi veliyitta adhiradi ALERT!
text:
Emanil pala aandugalaaga needithu varum ulnaattup por meendum theeviramadaindhulladhu. Iran aadharavu petra havudhi kuzhukkal, savudhi areviyaa aadharavu petra eman arasup padaigalin nilaigalai kurivaithu evuganai matrum tron thaakkudhalgalai theevirappaduthiyullana. Haarmus neerinaiyais sutri amerikkaa–eeraan modhal needikkum nilaiyil, sengadalilum havudhi nadavadikkaigal theeviramadaivadhu valaigudaa naadugalukku pudhiya nerukkadiyai uruvaakkiyulladhu. Idhan thaakkamaaga, kadandha vaaram sarvadhesa sandhaiyil kachaa enney vilai peral ondrukku 100 taalarukku mel uyarndhadhu.
Indha poril sepdambar 16aam thedhi islaamiyargalin punidha nagaramaana mekkaa aruge havudhi kilarchiyaalargal tron thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga savudhi areviyaa therivithadhu. Mekkaavin puranagarp pagudhiyil parandhu vandha tronai savudhi vaan paadhugaappup padaigal suttu veezhthiyadhaaga savudhi thalaimaiyilaana koottuppadaiyin seythith thodarbaalar thurgi al-maaligi therivithirundhaar.
Aanaal, mekkaavai thaangal kurivaikkavillai ena havudhigal udanadiyaaga maruppu therivithirundhanar. Havudhi amaippin raanuva seythith thodarbaalar yahyaa saari, kattuk kadhaigalum poygalum solli yaaraiyum emaatra mudiyaadhu endrum punidhath thalangalukku emanil irundhu endhavidha achuruthalum illai endrum kooriyirundhaar.
Innilaiyil meendum punidha nagaramaana mekkaavais sutri paadhugaappu echarikkai vidukkappattadhu. Sepdambar 24 andru savoodhi areviyaavin National Early Warning Platform moolam mekkaa nagaril aavathu erpadakkoodiya vaayppu iruppadhaaga koori echarikkai vidukkappattadhu. Jethaa, yanbu, thaayip matrum thavook pagudhigalukkum idhevondra echarikkaigal vidukkappattadhu. Sila nimidangalukkup piragu indha echarikkai thirumbap perappattu, aavathu kadandhuvittadhaaga adhigaarigal therivithullanar.
Makkal amaidhiyaaga irukka vendum, adhigaarigalin arivuruthalgalaip pinbatra vendum, thirandhaveli matrum jannalgal aruge nirpadhaith thavirkka vendum ena savoodhi sivil paadhugaapputhurai arivuruthiyadhu.
Indha echarikkai veliyaagiya adhe naalil, savoodhi thalaimaiyilaana koottuppadaigal emanin havudhi amaippu eviyadhaagak koorappadum 6 paalistik evuganaigalai idaimarithadhaaga therivithana. Avai thaayip matrum sengadal thuraimuga nagaramaana yanbu nokki seluthappattadhaaga savoodhi tharappu kooriyadhu.
Melum, sepdambar 19 andru riyaath nokki havudhigal paalistik evuganai eviyadhaagavum, adhai savoodhi vaanbaadhugaappu amaippu idaimarithadhaagavum thagavalgal veliyaagina. Idhu sameevathiya modhal theeviramadaindha piragu riyaath meedhu nadathappatta mudhal thaakkudhal muyatsiyaaga savoodhi tharappu kurippittadhu.
Idhanudan, eeraaniya adhigaarigal America-vin thadaigalukku udhavum andai naadugalukkum echarikkai viduthulladhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Iran vimaanangalukku edhiraaga nadavadikkai edukkavo, America-vukku udhavavo andai naadugal munvandhaal padhiladi kodukkappadum endra echarikkai idhil adangugiradhu. Idhanaal modhal enbadhu eeraan–amerikkaa alladhu savoodhi–havudhi ellaikkul mattum nindruvidaamal, valaigudaa matrum sengadal piraandhiyathil ulla pala naadugalaiyum paadhikkum soozhal uruvaagiyulladhu.

headline: UPI parivarthanaigalukku kattanam en? Pudhiya masodhaa thaakkalukku kaaranam enna?
text:
India-vil yuviai parivarthanaigal ilavasamaaga irundhaalum, thozhilnutbam, paadhugaappu, sarvar paraamarippu, KYC sarivaarppu aagiyavatrukkaaga aandukku sumaar 20,000 kodi roobai selavaagiradhu. Arasu maaniyam 11% mattume eeduseyvadhaal, meedhathai vangigal, sevai niruvanangal thaangi vandhana. Idhai samanilaippadutha 2026 thirutha masodhaa moolam periya vanigargalukku MDR kattanam arimugappaduthappadugiradhu.
India-vil yuviai (UPI) parivarthanaigal makkalukku ilavasamaagak kidaithaalum, idhanbinnaniyil ulla thozhilnutbam, paadhugaappu, sarvar paraamarippu matrum 'keoysi' (KYC) sarivaarppu aagiyavatrirkaagap perundhogai selavidappadugiradhu. Yuviai ullitta digital panap parivarthanaik kattamaippaip paraamarikka aandirku sumaar 20,000 kodi roobai varai selavaagiradhu. Arasu vazhangi vandha maaniyam indhas selavil verum 11 sadhaveedhathai mattume eeduseythadhu. Meedhamulla perum thogaiyai vangigalum yuviai sevai vazhangum niruvanangalume etruvandhana. Indhappana izhappai eedugattave ‘varividhippu matrum pira sattangal thirutha masodhaa 2026’ niraivetrappattulladhu.
Idhanbadi 50 kodi roovaaykku mel varudaandhira vitru mudhal konda periya niruvanangal alladhu varthagargalukku 0.3 sadhaveedham mudhal 0.6 sadhaveedham varai 'emdiaar' (MDR) kattanam vidhikka aalosikkappadugiradhu. Adhe neram ondru mudhal ondrarai kodi roobai varudaandhira vitru mudhal konda niruvanangalukku 0.05 sadhaveedham mudhal 0.07 sadhaveedham varai kattanam vasoolikkath thittamidappaduvadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Kattana vivarangalai arasuadhigaaravoorvamaaga arivikkavillai. 2000 roovaaykku merpatta yuviai parivarthanaigalukku mattume indhakkattanam porundhum endru koorappattulladhu. Motha yuviai vanigap parivarthanaigalil 4 sadhaveedham mattume 2,000 roovaaykku mel nadakkindrana.
Aanaal, pana madhippinadippadaiyil ivai ottumothap parivarthanaiyil moondril irandu pangaik kondullana. 96 sadhaveedhathirkum adhigamaana parivarthanaigal 2,000 roovaaykku utbattavai enbadhaal, saadhaaranap podhumakkal matrum siruvanigargalin andraada yuviai payanbaattirku evvidhak kattanamum irukkaadhu endru nidhith thurai nivunargal therivikkindranar.

headline: Harithuvaar selvadhaagak koorivittu nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai sandhithaaraa sengottaiyan?
text:
Harithuvaar selvadhaagap petti alithuvittus sendra sengottaiyan nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai sandhithadhaaga oru pugaippadam

mathiya nidhiyamaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai ADMK-vil irundhu sameevathil neekkappatta mootha thalaivar sengottaiyan sandhitha pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “mana nimmadhikkaaga harithuvaaril maamiyai sandhitha sengottaiyar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ADMK-vil pirindhu irukkum thalaivargalai ondru serkka vendum endru munnaal amaichar sengottaiyan kaalakkedu vidhithirundhaar. Idhaiyaduthu sengottaiyanai katchiyilirundhu neekki adhiradi kaattinaar Edappadi Palaniswami indha nilaiyil mana nimmadhikkaaga harithuvaar selvadhaaga Kovai vimaananilaiyathil sengottaiyan petti alithuvittu sendraar.
Aanaal telliyil avar mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaavai sandhithup pesiyadhaaga seythigal veliyaanadhu. Aanaal, idhu thodarbaana urudhiyaana seythi edhuvum veliyaagavillai. Indha nilaiyil, nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai sengottaiyan sandhithadhaaga oru padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha pugaippadam pala aandugalaaga seythi, samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhulladhu. Adhe nerathil sengottaiyan telliyil nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai sameevathil sandhithadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Enave, indha pugaippadam sameevathiya padamaaga irukkaadhu enbadhaal idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2017m aandil indha pugaippadathai appodhu varthagath thurai amaicharaaga irundha nirmalaa seedhaaraaman veliyittirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Mathiya varthagathurai amaicharin X thala pakkathil indha pugaippadam 2017m aandu aagast 31m thedhi padhivetram seyyappattirundhadhu.
Adhil, “thamizhnaadu arasin pallik kalvith thurai amaichar sengottaiyan mathiya amaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraamanai sandhithaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. 2017m aandu veliyaana pugaippadathai 2025m aandu ADMK-vil irundhu sengottaiyan neekkappatta soozhalil, sandhippu ippodhu nadandhadhu pondru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirappattulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “edappaadi Palaniswami alitha virundhil em.el.e-kkal nadanam” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami ADMK em.el.e-kkalukku virundhu vaithavodhu idhudhaan nadandhadhu endru oru video

oruvar nadanamaadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “netru Edappadi kodutha iravu virundhil idhudhaan nadandhadhaam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami 2025 epral 23m thedhi than katchi em.el.e-kkalukku virundhu alithaar. Kaashmeeril payangaravaadha thaakkudhalil appaavi makkal 26 per uyirizhandha nilaiyil, indha virundhu thodarbaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil vimarsanangalai ezhuppi varugindranar. Adhanudan, em.el.e-kkal nadanamaadinaargal endrum veediyokkalai padhivittu varugindranar.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video pala aandugalaaga samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Jeyalalidhaa maraivukkup piragu koovathooril ADMK em.el.e-kkal thangavaikkappattirundha podhu raajan sellappaa nadanamaadinaar endru appodhu indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar. Idhu thodarbaaga raajan sellappaavum kooda poleesil pugaar seythirundhaar. Enave, adhu thodarbaana seythi, veediyokkalai thedi eduthom.
Indha video-vai 2017m aandu malaiyaalathin maathruvoomi ullitta oodagangal veliyittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. 2017m aandu pipravari maadham 13m thedhi indha video-vai avargal veliyittirundhanar. Adhil, Madurai em.el.e raajan sellappaa (koovathoor) koldan pe risaardil endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha video-vil iruppadhu raajan sellappaa illai. Kanniyaagumari maavatta BJP nirvaagi jeyaseelan raajarathinam koovathoor sambavathukku sila maadhangalukku munbaaga nigazhchi ondril nadanamaadiya video idhu endru thamizh oodagangalil veliyaana seythiyaiyum thedi eduthom.
Idhanudan raajan sellappaa poleesil alitha pugaar thodarbaana seythiyaiyum thedi eduthom. Adhil, “vaats–appil veliyaana video-vil nadanam aaduvadhu naan alla. En meedhu avadhooru parappugiraargal endru Madurai vadakku thogudhi raajan sellappaa em.el.e. Poleesil pugaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Ivai ellaam Edappadi Palaniswami 2025m aandu epral maadham 23m thedhi than katchi em.el.e-kkalukku alitha virundhin podhu indha video edukkappadavillai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Kovai: ‘veedum illa... Minsaaramum illa’ - adarvanathil avadhippadum koomaatti pazhangudi kiraamam
text:
Mazhaikku ozhugum kudisaigal, paadhiyil nirkum veedugal, irulil thavikkum makkal ena adippadai vasadhigalukke allaadi varugiradhu, koomaatti endra kiraamam.
Kovai maavattathil minsaara vasadhi illaadha kiraamangal irukkiradhu endraal, ungalaal namba mudiyumaa?... Aam, irukkiradhu enbadhe kasappaana unmai. Aanaimalai puligal kaappagathirku utbatta sila pazhangudi kiraamangal ithanai aandugalaaga irulil moozhgik kidakkindrana.
Avatril ondraaga mazhaikku ozhugum kudisaigal, paadhiyil nirkum veedugal, irulil thavikkum makkal ena adippadai vasadhigalukke allaadi varugiradhu, koomaatti endra kiraamam.
Paadhiyil nirkum veedugal!
Aanaimalai puligal kaappagathukku utbatta taapsilip aruge adarndha vanappagudhiyil amaindhulladhu koomaatti pazhangudiyinak kiraamam. Ingu sumaar 45 pazhangudiyinak kudumbangal vasithu varum nilaiyil, avargalukkup podhiya adippadai vasadhigal illaadha nilaiyil, pudhidhaagak kattappattu varum veedugalum kadandha moondru aandugalaaga muzhumai peraamal paadhiyileye nirpadhaagak kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu.
Idhu kurithu koomaatti kiraamathais serndha kumaar koorugaiyil, “enga kiraamathula 45 kudumbangal irukku. Idhula 22 kudumbangalukkup pudhusaa veedugal katta aarambichaanga. Aanaa moonu varusamaagiyum veedugal muzhusaa katti mudikkala. Ellaa veedugalum paadhiyila nikkudhu. Moonu veedugal katta kuzhi eduthum, endha velaiyum aarambikkave illa.
Erkanave irundha kudisai veedugalukkum mazhaikku ozhugum. Ippa pudhusaa kattura veettulayum koorai illa. Idhanaala thagaras seettugalai vaichu set pottu irukkirom. Mazhai vandhaa thagaras seettum ozhudhum. Ulla utkaara kooda mudiyaadhu. Adhanaala thagaracheettukku mela thaarppaay pottu samaalichittu varom.
Idhu sambandhamaa adhigaarigalidam palamurai kooriyum, kattith tharomnu solluraangale thavira, ippa varai katti thandha paatta kaanom” enak kutramsaattinaar.
’velicham tharaadha solaar lait’
thodarndhu pesiya avar, ”enga kiraamathula karendu vasadhi illa. Theruvirku mattumdhaan solaar palp pottu thandhirukkaanga. Ellaa veettulaiyum mannenney vilakkudhaan irukku. Mazhai vandhaa solaar pettariyil saarj eraadhu.
Veyil irundhaa konjjam erum. Aanaalum nait aarula irundhu ettu mani varaikkumdhaan solaar theru lait eriyum. Idhanaala enga kiraamame irulula thavikkudhu. Ippadi adippadai vasadhigal illaama naanga allaadurom” ena vedhanai therivithaar.
‘panigal viraindhu mudikkappadumaa?’
Tamil Nadu malaivaazh makkal sangathin maavatta thunaith thalaivar paramasivam koorugaiyil, “koomaatti kiraamathula aadhidhiraavidar matrum pazhangudiyinar nalathurai saarbil pudhiya veedugal kattura pani thodangi, moondru aandugalaagiyum muzhumai perala.
Idhanaala andhak kiraama makkal nimmadhiyaagath thoonguvadharkukkooda koorai illaama, veedu illaama thavikkuraanga. Avargalukkenak kattappadugira kattumaana panigalum eno thaano ena aamai vegathil nadakkudhu. Idhumattumalla, tharamatra muraiyila veedu katturaanga. Indha velaiyais seekkiram mudichu tharamaana veedugal kattith thara vendum.
Idhemaadhiri koomaattikkup pakkadhulaye maanaamballi pavar havus irukku. Anga thayaarikkura minsaaram engengo kondu poraanga. Aanaa pakkathulaye irukkura veedugalukku tharuvadhillai. Pudhaivada min kambigal moolam anaithu veedugalukkum udanadiyaaga min vasadhi erpadutha vendum.
Ore kudumbathila irukkura paadhi perai vaalbaarai nagaraatchiyilum, paadhi perai vettaikkaaranbudhoor perooraatchiyilum vaakkaalargalaagap padhivu seyyuranaala, avargal vaakkalikka mudiyaama pogudhu. Idhaith thavirkka koomaatti pazhangudiyina makkal anaivaraiyum vettaikkaaranbudhoor perooraatchi vaakkaalargalaagap padhivu seyya vendum” ena valiyuruthinaar.
Irulil thavikkum pazhangudigal vaazhvirku vidiyal varumaa?...

headline: “visaaranai kaidhigal payathinaal maaradaippu erpattu maranamadaivadhu iyarkai” endru Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
Visaaranai kaidhigal visaaranaiyin podhu payathinaal maaradaippu erpattu uyirizhappadhu iyarkaiyaanadhudhaan endru Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga oru news card

news 7 thamizh veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “arasiyal seyyaadheer. Visaaranai kaidhigal visaaranaiyin podhu; payathinaal maaradaippaal maranamadaivadhu iyarkaiyaanadhu! Idhai vaithu malivaana arasiyal seyvadhu vetka kedaanadhu.. – mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalin” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sivagangai maavattam thiruppuvanam aruge ulla madappuram pathragaali amman kovil kaavalaaliyaaga irundha ajith kumaar Police visaaranaiyin podhu maranam adaindhaar. Indha vazhakkai kolai vazhakkaaga maatri nandhu kaavalargal kaidhu seyyappattullanar. Kutravaaligal meedhu kadum nadavadikkai eduthu adharkaana thandanaiyai viraivil petruth thandhu needhi nilainaattappadum endru Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinum urudhi alithirundhaar.
Indha nilaiyil laakap maranangal nadappadhu iyarkaiyaanadhudhaan endru laakap maranathirku mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin aadharavaaga pesiyadhu pondru oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha news card-ai paarkkum podhu vazhakkamaaga news 7 thamizh veliyidum news card pola illai. Adhan thamizh faant vithiyaasamaaga ulladhu. Idhuve, indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai thelivuvaduthugiradhu.
Aadhaarangal adippadaiyil indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru news card edhuvum veliyaagavillai. Enave, indha news card-ai andha oodagathin digital pirivu poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Adhaith thodarndhu, indha news card poliyaanadhu “indha seythiyai News 7 thamizh veliyidavillai!” endru kurippittup padhivittiruppadhaagath thagaval therivithaar. Andha padhivai avargaladhu Facebook pakkathilirundhu eduthom. ‘FAKE’ muthiraiyudan indha news card poliyaanadhu endru avargal padhivittirundhanar.
Visaaranai kaidhigal visaaranaiyin podhu maaradaippu erpattu uyirizhappadhu iyarkaiyaanadhu endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Aanaal, “kutravaaligalukku viraivil thandanai petruth thandhu needhiyai nilainaattuvom” endru avar veliyitta padhivu ulladhu. Kutramsaattappatta kaavalargalaik kaappaatra nadavadikkai edukkappadavillai. Avargal meedhu kolai vazhakkup padhivu seyyappattu kaidhu seyyappattullanar. Indha news card poliyaanadhu endru news 7 thamizh tharappil urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu poliyaanadhu, thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Nanneer odiyadhu andru; nurai thalluvadhu indru! Vivasaayigal, podhumakkal vedhanai
text:
Nanneer odiyadhu andru; nurai thalluvadhu indru! Vivasaayigal, podhumakkal vedhanai
sooloor: oru kaalathil nanneer perukkeduthu odiya noyyal aatril, nuraiyudan kazhivu neer vazhindhoduvadhaal, vivasaayigalum, podhumakkalum vedhanai adaindhullanar.
Kovaiyin jeevanadhiyaaga oru kaalathil irundhadhu noyyal aaru. Aatrin paadhaiyil odiya nanneeraal, sutru vattaarathil vivasaayam sezhithadhu. Karaiyora marangalai paravaigal thedi vandhana. Sutruvattaarathil pala km, thoorathukku kinarugalil ootru perukkeduthadhu. Noyyalil vellam perukkeduthu odinaal, Kovai, Tiruppur maavattangalil ulla kulangal, kuttaigalukku neer vandhuvidum. Andha alavukku, nam munnorgal thittamittu neer vazhippaadhaigalai amaithirundhanar.
Karaiyora kiraamangal mattumallaadhu, maavattam muzhukkave noyyal aatraal palan petradhu. Naalaidaivil, noyyal varandadhu. Nanneer perukkeduthu odiya aatril, indru kazhivu neer perukkeduthu odum avala nilai erpattulladhu. Kattada kazhivugal, rasaayana kazhivugal, thozhitsaalai kazhivugal kottum kuppai koodamaaga maari irukkiradhu.
Merku thodarchi malaiyadivaarathil irundhu karoor maavattathil kaaviri aatril kalakkum varai, ethanai vidhamaana kazhivugal neradiyaaga aatril selgiradhu enbadhai yaarum kanduvidikka mudiyaadha alavukku adhigarithulladhu. Aatril vazhindhodum kazhivu neeraal, aatril ulla paaraigale urumaari urukkulaindhu kaanum nilaikku, rasaayanam kalandha kazhivugal kaaranamaaga ulladhu.
Idhugurithu vivasaayigal koorugaiyil, ‘noyyal aatru neerai nambi vivasaayam seytha kaalam mudindhu vittadhu. Porvel neeraaldhaan perumbaanmaiyaana vivasaayam nadakkiradhu. Kazhivu neerai neradiyaaga aatril viduvadhai thadukka vendum enbadhu engaladhu pala aandu korikkai. Idhuvarai niraiveravillai. Kuraindha patcham kazhivu neerai suthigarithu pin aatril viduvikka, maavatta nirvaagam nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Illaiyel, noyyal aaru enbadhai marandhu vida venadiyadhu thaan’ endranar.
Neer nilai paadhugaappu aarvalargal kooriyadhaavadhu:
sep.18m thedhi ulaga thanneer kangaanippu thinamaaga kadaividikkappadugiradhu. Thanneer valathai paadhugaappadhu kurithu vizhippunarvu matrum eeduvaattai makkalidaiye uruvaakka vendum enbadhe ithinathin nokkam. Ulloor neernilaigalil ulla thanneer tharathai kangaanikka vendum. Tharathil ulla kuraivaadugalai kalaiya vendum. Siruvaani matrum pilloor koottu kudineer thittangal vaayilaaga, makkalin kudineer thevai poorthi seyyappadugiradhu. Varum kaalangalil kudineer thevai adhigarikkum. Adharku tharpodhe thittamida vendum. Kiraamangalil ulla neer nilaigalilum neer semikka vendum. Mazhai neer segarippu kattaayamaakkappada vendum. Noyyal aatril kazhivu neer kalappadhai muzhumaiyaaga thadukka vendum. Mazhai neer mattume aatril vazhindhoda vendum. Adharkaana nadavadikkaigalai arasu edukka vendum. Adharku makkal othuzhaippu avasiyam vendum.
Ivvaaru, avargal koorinar.

headline: Iran | mottaar saikkil ottum pengalin ennikkai adhigarippu.. Pinnaniyil oru poraattam!
text:
Seythiyaalar: thurgaa thevi sa
eeraaniya pengal mottaar vaaganangalai otta endha vidhamaana sattath thadaiyum illai. Iruppinum, nadaimuraiyil adhigaarigal urimam vazhanga maruthu vandhanar. Kadandha janavari maadham, pengal urimam peruvadharkaana theermaanathai Iran amaicharavai angeegarithadhu. Aanaal, adhu neendagaalamaaga nadaimuraippaduthappadaamal irundhuvandhadhu.
Urimam illaadhadhaal, pengalaal muraiyaana ottunar payitsi pera mudiyavillai. Vivathu erpattaalgooda endhavidhamaana kaappeettup paadhugaappum kidaikkaamal irundhadhu. Vivathil pengale paadhikkappatta nilaiyilum, sattappadi avargal meedhe kutram sumathappattadhu vazhakkamaaga irundhuvandhadhu. Iruppinum, Iran-il pengal mottaar saikkilil pinnaal amarndhu payanippadharku anumadhi undu.
Iran-il pengal mottaar vaaganam ottuvadharkus savaalaaga iruppadhu avargalin aadai vidhigale. 1979-il nadandha islaamiyap puratchikkup pin, eeraaniyap pengal pala samoogak kattuppaadugalai edhirgondu varugindranar. Indha aadai vidhigalinbadi, podhuveliyil mukkaadu anidhal, kanniyamaana thalarvaana aadai anidhal aagiyana kattaayamaaga irundhadhu. Eninum, sameeva aandugalil palarum andha vidhigalai meeri vandhullanar. 2022-il aadai vidhiyai meeriyadhaagak kaidhu seyyappatta mahsaa ameeni endra ilam pen, kaavalil irandha sambavam, sudhandhirangalaik kori Iran muzhuvadhum pengalaip poraattathil irangath thoondiyadhu. Adhan piragu, mottaar saikkil ottum pengal aadai vidhigalai vegamaaga meeri vandhanar.
Indhas sambavathaith thodarndhu, eeraaniya amaicharavai theermaanathil, pen vinnappadhaarargalukku nadaimuraip payitsi alithal, kaavaldhuraiyin neradi merpaarvaiyil thervu nadathudhal matrum pengalukku mottaar saikkil ottunar urimam vazhangudhal aagiyavatrai pokkuvarathuk kaavaldhurai kattaayamaagas seyya vendum enak koorugiradhu.
Idhanaal kadandha maadhangalil mottaar saikkilgal matrum sgoottargal ottum eeraaniya pengalin ennikkai adhigarithulladhu. Janavariyil pengal urimam peruvadharku arasu oru theermaanathai angeegarithavodhilum, adhu idhuvarai nadaimuraippaduthaamalum irundhuvaruvadhu kurippidathakkadhu.
"pengal mottaar saikkilil pinnaal amarndhu payanikka anumadhi undu" engiraar Iran-in pengal matrum kudumba nalath thunai adhivar jahraa pehroos-asar.
"'neengale ottak koodaadhu, aanaal adhu kanavano nerungiya aan uravinaro endru paaraamal veroruvarukkup pinnaal amaralaam endru solvadhu thavaraanadhu" ena avar suttikkaattugiraar. "idhu thelivaana irattai nilaippaadu" endrum avar koorugiraar.
Iran-il pengalukku, mottaar saikkil ottuvadharku vazhangappattirukkum sudhandhiram ulaga alavil varaverpaip petrulladhu.

headline: Madhu vidudhiyil nadanamaadiya soniyaa kaandhi endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Madhu vidudhiyil nadanamaadiya soniyaa kaandhi endru oru pugaippadam

madhu vidudhiyil moondru pengal nadanamaadum pugaippadathudan Congress thondargal sattaiyaik kazhatri poraattam nadathiya pugaippadathai ondraaga serthu padhivittullanar. Adhil, “melaadai indri koottathin naduve selvadhu avargalukku ondrum pudhidhalla. Ithaali paar taanr kuroop” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “paar taansar nadathum katchiyil, uruppinargalum avvaare seyalbadugindranar. Paaradhathin saavakkedu Congress katchi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Arasiyal katchith thalaivargalaith thanippatta muraiyil aavaasamaagath thaakki pesum pazhakkam thodarndhu kondudhaan irukkiradhu. Congress thalaivaraaga irundha soniyaa kaandhi madhu vidudhiyil velai paarthaar endrum, madhu vidudhiyil nadanamaadum velaiyai seythaar endrum thodarndhu BJP tharappilirundhu samooga oodagangalil padhividappatta varugiradhu.
Andha vagaiyil, soniyaa kaandhi paaril nadamaadinaar endru avaradhu peyarai neradiyaagak kurippidaamal, “paar taansar nadathum katchi” endru Congress katchiyai kurippittu palarum samooga oodagangalil indha pugaippadathaip padhivittu varugindranar. Idhan moolam padathil iruppavar soniyaa kaandhidhaan endru vimarsithu varugindranar. Enave, indha pugaippadam thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathil ulla penmaniyaip paarkka soniyaa kaandhi pola illai. Idhu therindhum vadhandhiyaip parappiyullanar. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvaith thodanginom. Indha pugaippadathileye gettyimages logo ulladhu. Andha inaiyadhalathirkus sendru pugaippadathai thedi eduthom. Adhil, indha pugaippadam 1967m aandu navambar maadham 12m thedhi America-vin Auburn endra idathil ulla oru hottalil edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhaavadhu, soniyaa – raajiv kaandhi thirumanam (pipravari 1968) nadappadharku naangu maadhangalukku munbu edukkappattadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Raajiv- soniyaa iruvarum sandhithukkondadhu ingilaandhil. Angulla kembiritj nagaril ulla kalloori ondril soniyaa aangilam thodarbaana padippaip padikka vandhaar. Raajiv angulla veru oru kallooriyil poriyiyal padippu padithukkondirundhaar. Aanaal, indha pugaippadame America-vil ulla oru idathil ulla hottalil edukkappattulladhu. Paaril nadanamaada ingilaandhilirundhu America-vukku sendriruppaar enbadhellaam nambum vagaiyil illai.
Raajiv – soniyaa iruvarum 1965m aandileye sandhithukkondanar. Kittathatta moondru aandugalukku avargal kaadhalithu vandhullanar. Andha kaalagattathil raajivin thaayaar indhiraa kaandhi India-vin piradhamaraaga irundhavar. Idhellaam therindha nilaiyil soniyaa kaandhi paaril nadanamaadinaar endru kooruvadhu sariyaanadhu illai. Melum indha pugaippadathai tharpodhu virpanaikku vaithulla gettyimages inaiyadhalamum endha idathilum pugaippadathil iruppavar soniyaa kaandhi endru kurippidavillai. Unmai ippadi irukka padathil iruppavar soniyaa kaandhi endru ivargal edhan adippadaiyil vadhandhiyai parappi varugiraargal enbadhu ivargalin pinnaniyai vaithe purindhugolla mudigiradhu.
1968m aandu nadandha raajiv – soniyaa thirumanathin video, pugaippadangal namakku koogul lens thalathil thedumbodhu kidaithana. Andha padathaiyum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla padathaiyum oppittum paarthom. Irandum veru veru navargal enbadhu thelivaagath therigiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Arasup palli maanavargalukku vilai uyarndha saikkil koduthadhaa TVK arasu?
text:
‘‘arasup palli maanavargalukku, TVK arasu vilai uyarndha saikkil koduthadhu’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’tharam uyarndhu stailaaga maariya ilavasa midhivandigal (News 26T Mountain Bicycles). Maanava, maanaviyar magizhchi ,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippada seythi unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhuvondru TVK arasu vilai uyarndha saikkil edhuvum arasup palli maanavargalukku, vazhangavillai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, vizhuppuram maavattam kengavuram pagudhiyil ulla Sri Parameswar Memorial uyarnilaippalliyil indha saikkil tharappattulladhu. Idhudhodarbaana video andha palli saarbaaga, instaagiraam pakkathil pagirappattulladhu.
Idhanbadi, kurippitta instaagiraam padhivai eduthu, TVK arasu ivvaaru vazhangiyadhaaga vadhandhi parappugiraargal. Aanaal, andha padhivileye sambandhappatta palli saarbaaga ‘’idhu thaniyaar palli, TVK arasukku idhil thodarbillai,’’ endru thelivaagak comment seyyappattulladhu. Eninum, indha vadhandhi nirkavillai.
Kurippitta palliyil aandudhorum ivvaaru 10m vaguppu padikkum maanava, maanaviyarukku saikkil tharuvadhu vazhakkam. Idhu mattumindri, palveru salugaigalum maanava, maanavigalai ookkuvikkum vagaiyil vazhangappadugiradhu. Idhil Tamil Nadu arasukku endha thodarbum illai. Idhuvatri Sri Parameswar Memorial High School tharappil pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Irudhiyaaga, TVK thalaimai aluvalagathilum pesi, maruppu petrullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Arasup palliyil aadalum paadalum nigazhchi nadathappattadhaa?
text:
Tamil Nadu arasup pallik koodam ondril aadalum paadalum nigazhchi nadathappattadhu endru oru video

palli maanavargal pondru seerudai anindha silar thamizh sinimaa paadal ondrukku nadanamaadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil, “sgoolla ye *** kootti kuduthaa evandaa kalyaanam pannuvaan” endru aavaasamaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “arasup palliyil nadandha *”aadalum paadalum”* nigazhchi..!🖤♥️_ *petrorgale ushaar* *thimuga aatchiyil pillaigalaip pethavanga ellaam sandhosamaa irukkaanga*
*thimuga appaava vaazhthuraanga.* oru sinimaa rasigar mandrath thalaivan kalvi amaicharaaga irundhaal andhap pallikkoodathil idhaithaan edhirbaarkka mudiyum.😭 *arasup pallikkoodathil padikkum maanavas selvangal eppadiyaavadhu naasamaa kettu ozhindhu pogavendum😫 endru sindhikkiraan DMK kaaran.* makkale! Ungal pillaigal nalvaazhvu ungal kaiyildhaan ulladhu🙏🙏🙏 *kavanamaaga irungal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil arasup palligalil latchakkanakkaana maanavargal padithu varugindranar. Avargalin padippukku vettu vaikkum velaiyai silar seythu varugindranar. Arasup palligal tharamatradhaaga irukkum, maanavargalai thavaraaga vazhinadathum enbadhu pondra karuthaip parappi arasup palligalil maanavargal servadhai niruthum muyatsiyil silar eeduvattu varugindranar. Chengalpattu arasup palli maanavargal kanjjaa podhaiyil adithuk kondanar endru vadhandhi parappinar. Tharpodhu, arasup palliyil aadalum paadalum endra nigazhchi nadathappattadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappi varugindranar.
Indha video-vil ullavargalaip paarkkum podhu maanavargal polath theriyavillai. Maanavargal pondru udai anindhu nadanamaaduvavargal pola ullanar. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, Erode pugazh Dr. Tharmaa vin taittaanik kuzhuvinarin nadana nigazhchi endru naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vin veru konathilirundhu edukkappatta video ondru sila thinangalukku munbu YouTube-il padhivetram seythirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil muzhu medaiyaiyum kaattavillai. Aanaal, namakkuk kidaitha YouTube video-vil muzhu medaiyaiyum muzhuvadhumaaga kaana mudigiradhu. Adhil, “taittaanik kuzhuvinarin nadana nigazhchi” endru penar kattappattiruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Andha YouTube senalil veru pala kiraamangalil nadandha thiruvizhaa nigazhchigalum irundhana.
Idhan moolam kalai nigazhchi endra peyaril kiraamangalil nadathum aadalum paadalum endra nigazhchiyin video-vai eduthu pallik koodathil aadalum paadalum nadandhadhu endru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu maanavargalin kalvi vishayathil thavaraana thagavalai parappum vagaiyil pagirappattulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Viraivil paruvamazhai theeyanaippu thurai ushaar
text:
Kovai: vadagizhakku paruvamazhai thuvangavulladhaal, palligalil mungoottiye vizhippunarvu erpadutha theeyanaippu nilaiya aluvalargalukku arivuruthappattulladhu.
Adhan padi, ovvoru theeyanaippu nilaiya ellaigalilum vaaram iru palligalil vizhippunarvu nigazhvu nadathappadugiradhu. Palligalukku sendru minbaraamarippu, sedhamadaindha kattadangal kurithu kangaanippadhudan vizhippunarvum erpaduthavullanar. 
Idi, mazhai nerangalil enna seyyavendum, thanneer thengiya idangalil paadhugaappaaga selludhal, arundha mingambigal pondravai kurithu echarikkindranar.

headline: Maadham 51% vatti valai... Sikkiya 5,000 per... Roo.500 kodi megaa mosadi!
text:
73 latcham roovaayai izhandha revadhi, “maadham periya alavil vatti kidaikkum; ore varudathil mudhaleedu irandu madangaagath thirumbak kidaikkum ena nanbargal, uravinargal koorinar.
Selathais serndha thaniyaar peyint niruvana melaalar mogan murali, ‘praafit evar online tiredars endra niruvanam 28 latcha roovaayai mudhaleedaagap petrukkondu emaatrivarugiradhu’ endru Salem porulaadhaarak kutrappirivil anmaiyil pugaaralithaar. Idhan adippadaiyil visaaranaiyaith thodangiya kaavaldhuraiyinar, ‘sadhuranga vettai’ thiraippadathai minjjum vagaiyil sumaar 5 aayiram peridam 500 kodi roobai varai petru megaa mosadiyil eeduvattiruppadhaik kandu thidukkittuppoyirukkiraargal.
Mogan muraliyaith thodarndhu nootrukkanakkaanor Salem porulaadhaarak kutrappirivu aluvalagathil pugaaralithuvarugindranar. Niruvanathin iyakkunaraagas seyalbattuvandha madhuraiyais serndha senbaga paandiyan kaidhuseyyappattu siraiyil adaikkappattirukkiraar. Thalaimaraivaaga irukkum mukkiya nirvaagigal moondru perai poleesaar theeviramaagath thedivarugindranar.
Indha megaa mosadi yin pinnani kurithu nammidam pesiya Salem maavattap porulaadhaarak kutrappirivu Police adhigaari oruvar, “selathais serndha vijayaraagavan - raagini thambadhi, madhuraiyais serndha senbaga paandiyan moovarum serndhu, Salem azhagaavurathil ‘praafit evar online tiredars’, ‘vaaraahi kuroops’ endra peyargalil irandu nidhi niruvanangalai 2024-m aandu thodangiyirukkiraargal. Raaginiyai vilambarath thoodharaaga munniruthi, mudhaleedu endra peyaril aal pidikkum velaiyil irangiyirukkiraargal.
Maadham 51 sadhavigidham vatti!
Ullooril nallavadiyaaga viyaavaaram seythu valarndhuvarum naduthara thozhilmunaivorgalaik kurivaithu, ‘oru latcham roobai mudhaleedu seythaal maadham 8,000 roobai vatti; mudhaleettuth thogai oraandil irattippu; 25 latcham roobai mudhaleedu seythaal maadham 51 sadhavigidham vatti’ enap paduvayangaramaana kavarchith thittangalai arivithirukkiraargal. Oor ooraaga nottees adithum, fileks vaithum koottangalai nadathiyirukkiraargal. Niruvanathin nadavadikkaigal velippadaiyaaga nadappadhaaga nambiya palarum latchangalil mudhaleedu seythirukkindranar. Mudhaleettukkaana aavanangalai vazhangiyadhudan, vaakkurudhi alithavadi mudhal irandu maadhangalukku vattith thogaiyaiyum vangik kanakkil varavu vaithirukkiraargal.
Idhaiyaduthu Salem mattumandri tharumavuri, Krishnagiri ullitta maavattangalais serndhavargalum potti pottukkondu mudhaleedu seythirukkiraargal. Sumaar 5 aayiram per varai sikkiyulla nilaiyil, vattith thogaiyai niruthiyadhudan, oraandu niraivadaindhum mudhirvuth thogaiyaith thiruppith tharaamal izhuthadithirukkiraargal. Sandhegamadaindhu aluvalagathukkus sendru kettavargalum mirattalukku ullaagiyirukkindranar. Idhaith thodarndhe engalai anugiyirukkiraargal” endraar.
“ammaa irandhaar... Appaavukku strok!”
73 latcham roovaayai izhandha revadhi, “maadham periya alavil vatti kidaikkum; ore varudathil mudhaleedu irandu madangaagath thirumbak kidaikkum ena nanbargal, uravinargal koorinar. Adhai nambi kaattai vitrum, veettai adamaanamvaithum en kanavar peyaril 25 latcham roobai, en peyaril 48 latcham roobai ena motham 73 latcham roobai mudhaleedu seythom. Mudhal aindhu maadhangal varai vatti koduthaargal. Piragu edhuvume tharavillai. `indraikku, naalaikku...’ ena izhuthadithavargal, kadandha vaaram thideerena aluvalagathaip poottivittu odivittaargal. Kadanukku vatti katta mudiyaamal thinarivarugirom. Marundhu kudithu saagum nilaimaiyil irukkirom” endraar.
18 latcham roovaayai izhandha laavanyaa, “pathmaa endra ejent moolam 10 latcha roobai, matroru ejent moolam 8 latcha roobai ena mudhaleedu seythom. Periya natchathira hottalgalil koottam nadathithaan engalai pirain vaash seythaargal. Ammaavukku kitni feyiliyar erpattavodhu panathaik kettom; tharavillai. Kadaisiyil ammaa irandhuvonaar. Kodutha sekkum pavunsaagivittadhu. Indhak kavalaiyil appaavukku strok vandhuvittadhu. Kadan thollaiyil thavikkirom. Potta panam kidaithaal podhum” endraar aadhangathudan.
Aduthagatta nadavadikkaigal kurithu porulaadhaarak kutrappirivu poleesaaridam kettavodhu, “pangus sandhai mudhaleettuth thittam endra peyaril indha mosadiyil eeduvattirukkiraargal. Em.el.em netvork pondru aatkalaip pidithu, 2 mudhal 4 sadhavigidha kamishan koduthu mudhaleettaalargalais serthirukkiraargal. Saamaaniya makkalaivida, ullooril thunikkadai, farnichar kadai ena viyaavaaram seybavargalaik kurivaithiruk kiraargal. Senbaga paandiyanaik kaidhuseythu Kovai siraiyil adaithullom. Mukkiyak katchigalais serndha silarukkum kaavaldhuraiyinar silarukkum indha mosadiyil thodarbu iruppadhaagath therigiradhu. Niruvanathin sothu vivarangal kurithu visaaranai merkondu varugirom” endraargal.
Aayiram ‘sadhuranga vettai’ padam varattum... Panathaasai pidithavargalai eppadithaan thiruthuvadhu? Mhoom..!

headline: Japan-il thuvangiyadhu aasiya vilaiyaattu potti; thesiya kodiyendhiya manu paagar, pavan sheraavath
text:
Nagoyaa: Japan-il thuvangiya aasiya vilaiyaattu pottiyin thuvakka vizhaavil nadandha anivaguppil, Indhiya veerargal manu paagar matrum pavan sheraavath aagiyor thesiya kodiyai endhis sendranar.
Jappaanin aychi-nagoyaavil 20vadhu aasiya vilaiyaattu indru mudhal akdovar 4m thedhi varai nadakka ulladhu. 45 naadugalai serndha 11,000 per pangerkindranar. India saarbil 35 pottiyil 501 per (267 veerar, 234 veeraanganaigal) kalandhu kolla irukkindranar.
Indha nilaiyil, aasiya vilaiyaattu pottiyin thuvakka vizhaa indru kolaagalamaaga thuvangiyadhu. Idhil, ovvoru naadugalin veerargal, veeraanganaigalum, avaravar naattu kodiyai endhiyavadi anivaguppu merkondanar. Andha vagaiyil, anivaguppil Indhiya moovarnakkodiyai iru olimbik padhakkam petra manu paagar (thuppaakki sududhal) matrum Indhiya kavadi veerar pavan sheraavath aagiyor endhis sendranar. Aarambathil manu paagarudan serndhu kundu eridhal veerar thajindharbaal sing, thesiya kodi endhuvavaraaga arivikkappattirundhaar. Aanaal, thozhilnutba pirasnai kaaranamaaga avar pangerka mudiyaadhadhaal, avarukkup padhilaaga pavan sheraavath therndhedukkappattaar.
Kadandha murai hangsovil nadaivetra aasiya vilaiyaattu pottigalil 28 thangap padhakkangal utbada motham 107 padhakkangalai Indhiya ani vendrirundhadhu. Enave, nagoyaavil indru thuvangum aasiya vilaiyaattu pottiyil adhigalavilaana padhakkangalai kuvikkum endru Indhiya rasigargal peridhum edhirbaarthullanar.

headline: “vivathukkullaana agamadhaavaath vimaanathirkul kadaisi nimidangal” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Agamadhaavaathil vivathukkullaana vimaanathirkul edukkappatta kadaisi nimida kaatchigal endru oru video

vimaanathirkul pugai mandalamaaga irukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “agamavaa paahaathil vivathu nadandha vimaanathin irudhi nimidangal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Agamadhaavaathilirundhu landan sendra vimaanam 2025 joon 12m thedhi vivathukkullaanadhu. Idhil payanitha oruvaraith thavira matra anaivarum uyirizhandhuvittadhaaga arivikkappattulladhu. Vimaanathirkul kadaisi nimidathil edukkappatta video endru oru video samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2020m aandilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. 2020m aandilirundhe indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhan moolam idhu agamadhaavaath vimaanathirkul edukkappatta kadaisi video illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indha video thodarbaaga thodarndhu aayvu seythom. Appodhu 2020m aandu rumaaniyaa naattin thalainagar pukkarest irundhu landan (Bucharest to London) vandha vimaanathirkul thideerendru pugai paraviyadhu. Udanadiyaaga andha vimaanam tharaiyirakkappattadhu endru seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil agamadhaavaathil vivathukkullaana vimaanathirkul kadaisi nerathil edukkappatta kaatchigal endru paravum video thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Jaadhi peyaril theru peyar maatrathai kandithu makkal mariyal poraattam
text:
Trichy : Trichy aruge, jaadhi peyaril theru peyar maatrappattadhai kandithu, appagudhi makkal mariyalil eeduvattanar.
Trichy maavattam, manappaaraiyai adutha nallaambillai kiraama panj.,sil, kirushnasamuthiram endra oor ulladhu. Ingu, 100kkum merpatta kudumbathinar vasikkindranar. Tharpodhu adhe ooril kirushnasamuthiram melbagudhi endru peyar palagai vaitha nilaiyil, adhe oorin oru pagudhiyil vasikkum makkalukku, kirushnasamuthiram 'edi' theru endru peyarittu, veettu vari raseedhugal, panj., nirvaagathaal vazhangappattulladhu.
Adhan pinnare thangal pagudhi kirushnasamuthiram e.ti. Theru endru peyar maatram seyyappattulladhu enbadhu, appagudhi makkalukku theriya vandhulladhu. Idhaiyaduthu netru kaalai, appagudhiyinar, thangalin theruvai peyarai jaadhiyai vaithu pirithulladhaaga koori, veerappoor saalaiyil mariyal poraattathil eeduvattanar. Pin nallaambillai kiraama panj., aluvalagathai mutrugaiyittu poraattathil eeduvattanar.
Avargalidam Police matrum vaiyambatti vattaara valarchi aluvalargal pechu nadathi, manappaarai thaasildhaar aluvalagathil pechu nadathi, sumooga theervu kaanappadum ena, urudhi alithanar. Idhaiyaduthu, poraattam vilakkik kollappattadhu.

headline: Paagisdhaanukku aadharavaagak kerala musleemgal poraattam nadathinaraa?
text:
‘’paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga, poraattam nadathiya kerala musleemgal’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ keralaa musleemgal India-vil vaazhndhu kondu paakkisdhaan aadharavaaga sindhunadhi neerai thirandhuvida kori aarbaattam nadathugiraargal..
Indhu makkale saadhiyai kadandhu arasiyalai kadandhu iniyaavadhu ondru serungal…🙏🏻 ivanunga perumbaanmaiyaanaal enna nadakkum vizhithukkol.’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video-vil idambetra kaatchigalai meendum kavanithom. Adhil, ANOOP ANTONY JOSEPH endru vaattar maark ezhudhappattulladhaik kandom.
Indha peyarai adippadaiyaaga vaithu, thagaval thediyavodhu kadandha epral 19,2025 andru keralaavais serndha Anoop Antony Joseph enum BJP nirvaagi, X valaidhalathil merkanda video-vai pagirndhulladhaik kandom.
Aanaal, indha video-vil idambetrulladhu Indhiya yooniyan musleemleek (IUML) kodiyaagum. Pakistan kodi kidaiyaadhu. Melum, video-vil Indhiya yooniyan musleem leek thalaivar C.H.Mohammed Koya peyarai kurippittu, koshamiduvadhaiyum kaana mudigiradhu.
Idhu mattumindri, kurippitta video-vil kaanappaduvor Arangadi endra peyar idambetrulladhaiyum kandom. Idhu keralaavil ulla oorin peyar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, Indhiya yooniyan musleem leek katchiyin arangaadi pirivu saarbaaga, instaagiraamil epral 17, 2025 andru veliyidappatta pugaippadam ondru namakkuk kidaithadhu.
Idhuvondra niraiya padhivugal avargaladhu instaagiraam pakkathil kaanappadugindrana.
Idhanmoolamaagak kurippitta video, arangaadi pagudhiyai serndha Indhiya yooniyan musleem leek nirvaagigalaal vakp sattathirutha masodhaavirku edhiraaga munnedukkappatta poraattam thodarbaanadhu endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Irudhiyaaga, kurippitta video-vin muzhu unmaithanmai patri erkanave namadhu Fact Crescendo kuzhuvinar virivaana fektchek veliyittullanar. Adhanaiyum aadhaarathirkaagak keezhe inaithullom.
Idhuvarai kidaitha aadhaarangalin adippadaiyil, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda veediyovukkum, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pudhaivada min kevilai maatri amaikkaamal vadigaal kattuvadhaal edhirgaalathil siramam
text:
Valasaravaakkam: poroor mudhal vadavazhani varaiyilaana aarkaadu saalaiyil, pudhaivada min kevilai agatraamal, adhan meedhu mazhaineer vadigaal kattappattu varuvadhu, pagudhimakkalidaiye adhirupdhiyai erpaduthi ulladhu. Adhigaarigalin indha alatchiyappaniyaal, edhirgaalathil min kevilil pazhudhu erpattaal, adhai seeramaippadhil sikkal erpadum avaayam ulladhu.
Poroor, kundrathoor, sreeverumbudhoor, poondhamalli, kindi, kodambaakkam, annaa saalai ullitta mukkiya pagudhigalai, aarkaadu saalai inaikkiradhu.
Idhil, poroor mudhal valasaravaakkam adutha aazhvaar thirunagar varaiyilaana saalai, nedunjjaalaith thurai paraamarippilum, aazhvaar thirunagar mudhal kodambaakkam varaiyilaana saalai maanagaraatchi paraamarippilum ulladhu.
Innilaiyil, poroor sandhippu mudhal vadavazhani varai, aarkaadu saalaiyin iruvuramum, maanagaraatchi saarbil 108 kodi roobai selavil, mazhaineer vadigaal kattum panigal nadandhu varugindrana.
Idhil, valasaravaakkam aazhvaar thirunagar pagudhiyil, thaniyaar palli aruge amaikkappattu varum vadigaal paniyil, adhigaarigal kangaanippu illaadhadhaal, edhirgaalathil makkalukku siramam erpadum nilai ulladhu.
Idhugurithu appagudhi makkal kooriyadhaavadhu:
thaniyaar palli aruge, nilathirkadiyil pudhaivada min kevil padhikkappattulla nilaiyil, adhai maatri amaikkaamal, adhanmeedhu vadigaal kattappattu varugiradhu.
Idhanaal, edhirgaalathil min kevilil pazhudhu erpattaal, vadigaalai muzhudhaaga udaikka vendivarum. Thavira, min kevil sedhamadaindhaal adhai seeramaikkavo, maatriyamaikkavo mudiyaadha nilai erpadum.
Idhuvondra pirasnaigalai thavirkka, maanagaraatchi, nedunjjaalaith thurai matrum min vaariya adhigaarigal muraiyaaga kangaanikka vendum.
Aanaal, adhigaarigal uriya muraiyil merpaarvai seyyaadhadhaal, pala meter thoorathirku pudhaivada min kevilin meedhu mazhaineer vadigaal kattappattu ulladhu.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.
Idhugurithu maanagaraatchi adhigaarigal koorugaiyil, ‘min kevil agatri vittudhaan, mazhaineer vadigaal amaikkum pani nadandhu varugiradhu’ endranar.
Aanaal, pudhaivada min kevil meedhu kaangireet kalavai kotti, mazhaineer vadigaal amaikkappattulladharku enna theervu enbadhu kurithu, adhigaarigal padhil alikkavillai.

headline: Koyilil neerin tharam neeraadhaarangalil aayvu
text:
Kovai: koyil kinarugalil ulla thanneerin tharathai aayvu seythu, adhai sariyaana muraiyil payanbaduthum muyatsiyil, indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai adhigaarigal irangiyullanar.
Kovaiyilulla koyilgalukku varum pakdhargalukku, thevaiyaana kudineer ulloor neeraadhaarangalilirundhum, koyil kinatrilirundhum eduthu suthigarithu pakdhargalukku vazhangappadugiradhu.
Innilaiyil, anaithu koyilgalilum kudineerin tharathai urudhi seyya tharpodhu aayvu nadappadhaaga, indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai adhigaarigal koorugindranar.
'Chennai-yil nadandha aranilaiyathurai adhigaarigal koottathil, kamishanar vinay kudineer tharathai aayvu seyvadhodu koyil neeraadhaarangalai paguppaayvu seyya utharavittullaar. Adhanbadi aayvu nadandhu varugiradhu' endranar.

headline: Neerodaikkul veesappatta kaalaavadhi marundhu porutkal
text:
Palladam: palladam ondriyam, panikkambatti ooraatchi, sinnaiya kavundambaalaiyathil kiraamathil arasu palli, kovil matrum reshan kadaiyai otti neerodai selgiradhu.
Indha neerodai aruge ulla kuttaiyil, o.aar.es. Paakkettugal, kudarpuzhu neekka maathiraigal, taanik, vaittamin maathiraigal, polik aasit maathiraigal adangiya paakkettugal matrum paattilgal ullittavai kuviyal kuviyalaaga veesappattullana.
Ivai Thamizhaga arasu matrum sugaadhaarathuraikku sondhamaanavai enbadhu theriya varugiradhu. Sila maadhangalukku munbe ivai kaalaavadhiyaagi vittana.
Payanbaduthakkoodiya alladhu kaalaavadhiyaana marundhugalaaga irundhaalum avatrai thirandhaveliyil veesaamal, uriya vidhimuraigalinbadi paadhugaappaaga appurappadutha vendum.
Aanaal, ingu marundhugal matrum maruthuvap porutkal neerodai matrum kuttai pagudhiyil kottappattullana.
Ippagudhiyil aadu, maadu ullitta kaalnadaigal meychalukku vidappadugindrana. Avai theriyaamal marundhu maathiraigal matrum maruthuvap porutkalai utkollum patchathil paadhippu erpada vaayppulladhu. Melum, mazhaikkaalangalil marundhugal neeril kalandhu sutruchoozhalukkum paadhippai erpaduthum avaayam ulladhu.
Enave, neerodai matrum kuttaiyil arasu sugaadhaarathuraikku sondhamaana kaalaavadhiyaana marundhugal kottappattadhu kurithu adhigaarigal visaaranai nadatha vendum.

headline: Payangaravaadha amaippudan thodarbu? Kaidhu seyyappatta pirittan seekkiyar.. 9 aandugalukkup piragu jaameen!
text:
Sgaatlaandhin tambaardanais (Dumbarton) serndha 39 vayadhaana jakdhaar sing johal, kadandha 2017aam aandu thanadhu thirumanathukkaaga India vandhirundhavodhu panjjaavil kaidhu seyyappattaar. Indhiyaavilirundhu panjjaavai thani seekkiya naadaana “kaalisdhaan” aagap pirippadhai nokkamaaga kondu seyalbattu varum thadai seyyappatta kaalisdhaan livareshan fors (Khalistan Liberation Force - KLF) amaippudan thodarbu iruppadhaagavum, panjjaavil 2016 matrum 2017aam aandugalil nadaivetradhaagak koorappadum thodar kolaigal thodarbaana sadhithittathil avar pangetradhaagavum India-vin thesiya pulanaayvu mugamai (NIA – National Investigation Agency) kutranjjaattiyirundhadhu.
Jakdhaar sing johal meedhu motham 7 vazhakkugal padhivu seyyappattullana. Ivatril kolai, kolais sadhi matrum payangaravaadha nadavadikkaigalukku aadharavu alithadhu ullitta theevira kutrachaattugal munvaikkappattana. Aanaal, indhak kutrachaattugalai johal thodarndhu maruthu vandhaar. Thaan endhavoru kolais sadhithittathilum eeduvadavillai endrum, visaaranaiyinbodhu thaam sithiravadhai seyyappattadhaagavum avar kutramsaattiyirundhaar.
Thodarndhu, jakdhaar sing johal pala aandugalaaga siraiyil adaikkappattirundha nilaiyil, indha neendagaala needhimandra thaduppuk kaaval kurithu sarvadhesa alavilum kelvigal ezhundhana. Kurippaaga, aikkiya naadugal savaiyin manidha urimai nivunargal kuzhu, johal neenda kaalamaaga visaaranaikku munbe siraiyil vaikkappattiruppadhu kurithu kavalai therivithadhu. Avar meedhaana kutrachaattugal thodarbaana needhimandra nadavadikkaigal neenda kaalam needippadhaagavum, idhanaal avar pala aandugalaaga siraiyileye thanadhu vaazhkkaiyai kazhikka vendiya nilai erpattulladhaagavum suttikkaattappattadhu. Melum, indha vazhakkil neenda kaalamaaga visaaranai nadaivetru varuvadhu "needhiyin perum thavaru" enavum ainaa nivunargal kurippittirundhanar.
Idharkidaiyil, johal kaidhu seyyappattadhil irundhe indha vivagaaram, pirittan arasin kavanathilum irundhu varugiradhu. Avarukku uriya satta nadaimuraigal pinbatrappada vendum endrum, vazhakku visaaranai viraivaaga nadaivera vendum endrum pirittan tharappil thodarndhu valiyuruthappattu vandhadhu. Innilaiyil thaan, neenda kaalamaaga siraiyil irundha johalukku Delhi uyar Needhimandram tharpodhu jaameen vazhangiyulladhu.

headline: Ilaiyaraajaa sothukkalai parimudhal seyyakkori sarigama niruvanam vazhakku
text:
Ilaiyaraajaa sothukkalai parimudhal seyyakkori 'sarigama' niruvanam vazhakku
- sirappu niruvar -
'needhimandra utharavai thodarndhu meeri varum isaiyamaippaalar ilaiyaraajaavin sothukkalai parimudhal seythu, adhai virpanai seyya thani adhigaariyai niyamikka vendum' enakkori, 'sarigama' niruvanam tilli uyar needhimandrathil needhimandra avamadhippu vazhakku thodarndhulladhu.
Ilaiyaraajaa isaiyamaitha sila thiraippada paadalgalukkaana urimaikku, 'sarigama' niruvanam sondham kondaadi varugiradhu. Idhu thodarbaaga ilaiyaraajaavukkum, 'sarigama' niruvanathirkum idaiye tilli uyar needhimandrathil vazhakku nadandhu varugiradhu.
Kadandha pip., 13l, sarigama niruvanam thodarndha vazhakkil tilli uyar Needhimandram mukkiya utharavai pirappithadhu. Adhil, 'sarigama niruvanam kaappurimai petra paadalgalai ilaiyaraajaavo alladhu avaradhu piradhinidhigalo payanbaduthak koodaadhu' enakkoori, idaikkaala thadai vidhithadhu.
Indha thadaiyai neekkakkori, ilaiyaraajaa thaakkal seytha manuvai kadandha joolai 1l tilli uyar Needhimandram thalluvadi seythadhu. Innilaiyil ilaiyaraajaa needhimandra utharavai pagirangamaaga meeri vittadhaaga koori, avarukku edhiraaga sarigama niruvanam tilli uyar needhimandrathil needhimandra avamadhippu vazhakku thodarndhulladhu.
 Idhu thodarbaaga sarigama niruvanam thaakkal seytha manuvil koorappattulladhaavadhu: 
isai piriyargalukkaana, 'sbaattivai, yudiyoop' pondra digital thalangalil engal vasam kaappurimai ulla paadalgal olivarappaagindrana. Aanaal, andha paadalgalin kaappurimai thannidam iruppadhaaga koori, olivarappukku ilaiyaraajaa aatchevam therivithu varugiraar.
Idhan moolam, needhimandra utharavai avar velippadaiyaaga meeriyullaar. Melum 'murattuk kaalai' endra thamizh thiraippadathil idam petra 'podhuvaaga emmanasu thangam' endra paadalin urimai thamakkuriyadhu ena koori, adhai payanbadutha thammidam urimam alladhu oppudhal pera vendum ena valiyuruthi 'piyaant piksars' niruvanathirku ilaiyaraajaa nottees anuppiyullaar. Idhuvum Needhimandram vidhitha thadaikku muranaanadhu.
Thadaiyai meeriyadharkaaga ilaiyaraajaavai siraiyil adaikka vendum. Avaradhu asaiyum matrum asaiyaa sothukkalai parimudhal seyya vendum. Andha sothukkalai vitru, adhan moolam kidaikkum thogaiyai engal niruvanathirku vazhanga vendum. Indha nadavadikkaigalukkaaga pirathyega adhigaariyaiyum Needhimandram niyamikka vendum. Ivvaaru adhil koorappattulladhu.
Immanuvai visaaritha needhivadhi anoop jeyaraam pambaani, sarigama niruvanam munvaitha kutrachaattugalukku padhil alikkumaaru, ilaiyaraajaavukku nottees anuppi utharavittaar.

headline: Payaniyar vaagana virpanai 6% uyarvu
text:
Pudhudilli:kadandha aandil, payaniyar vaagana virpanai 6 sadhaveedham adhigarithu, 45.50 latchamaaga irundhadhaaga vaaganathurai pullivivaram therivikkiradhu.
Kadandha aandu sepdambaril ji.es.ti., 2.O arivikkappattu, vari vigidhangal kuraikkappattadhaal adhigaritha vaagana virpanai, aandu irudhi varai needithadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Kurippaaga, ulnaattu vaagana niruvanangalaana maarudhi susoogi, mahindhiraa, taadaa mottaars aagiyavatrin, payaniyar vaagana aandu virpanai varalaaru kaanaadha uyarvu kandadhu.
Kurippaaga, es.yu.vi., virpanai, motha payaniyar vaagana virpanaiyil 56 sadhaveedha idambidithadhu. Mundhaiya aandil idhu 54 sadhaveedhamaaga irundhadhu.
Kadandha 2025l 18.44 latcham payaniyar vaagana virpanaiyudan maarudhi susoogi India niruvanam mudhalidam pidithadhu. Mundhaiya aandil inniruvanam 17.90 latcham vaaganangalai vitrirundhadhu.

headline: ’100 vayadhaik kadandha 1 latcham per..’ vayadhaana makkal thogai naadaaga Japan saadhanaiyaa.? Savaalaa.?
text:
Jappaanin “mudhiyorai madhikkum naal” munnittu veliyaana pullivivarangal, 100 vayadhukku merpattor 1 latchathai kadandhulladhaaga kaattugindrana; ivargalil perumbaalor pengal. Neenda aayul, membatta maruthuvam matrum vaazhkkaimuraiyin vetriyai velippaduthinaalum, 1.14 endra kuraindha karutharippu vigidham, 2070-kkul makkal thogai 8.7 kodiyaagak kuraiyum avaayam, thozhilaalar patraakkurai, oyvoodhiyam matrum mudhiyor paraamarippil perum azhuthathai uruvaakkugiradhu.
Ulagin neenda aayutkaalam konda naadugalil ondraana Japan-il 100 vayadhaik kadandhavargalin ennikkai varalaatrileye mudhanmuraiyaaga 1 latchathai thaandiyirukkiradhu ena annaattin sugaadhaara matrum nalavaazhvu amaichagam therivithulladhu. Idhu, annaattin maruthuvathuraiyin valarchi matrum membatta unavu muraigal aagiyavatrai kurippiduvadhaaga irundhaalum, adhigarithu varum mudhiyor ennikkaiyum, kuraindhu varum pirappu vigidhamum jappaanukku pudhiya samooga matrum porulaadhaara savaalgalaiyum erpaduthi varugindrana. Indha nilaiyil thaan, 100 vayadhaik kadandhavargalin ennikkai Japan-il thodarndhu adhigarithu varuvadhu saadhanaiyaa? Alladhu savaalaa? Enak kelvi ezhundhirukkiradhu.
Jappaanin varudaandhira "mudhiyorai madhikkum naal" (Respect for the Aged Day) podhuvidumuraiyai munnittu indhap pudhiya pullivivarangalai annaattin sugaadhaarathurai sameevathil veliyittadhu. Adhanbadi, indha aandu mattum, 100 vayadhaik kadandhavargalin ennikkai 1 latchathu 7 aayirathu 677 aaga padhivaagiyulladhu. Ivargalil 88 sadhaveedham per pengal. Adhesamayam, jappaanin makkal thogaiyil tharpodhu 65 vayadhu matrum adharku merpattavargal sumaar 29.4 sadhaveedhamaaga ullanar. Adhaavadhu, kittathatta 10 peril 3 per mudhiyavargal. Indha vigidham 2070-m aandukkul sumaar 40 sadhaveedhathai nerungum ena kanikkappattulladhu.
Indha arikkaiyai veliyittup pesiya annaattin sugaadhaarathurai amaichar kenichiro uyeno (Kenichiro Ueno), jappaanin maruthuvam matrum thozhilnutbathil erpattulla munnetrangalais suttikkaattiyadhudan, adhigamaanor, neenda kaalam aarokkiyamaagavum surusuruppaagavum palar vaazhndhu varuvadhu magizhchiyalikkiradhu enavum therivithullaar. Jappaaniyargalin neenda kaala vaazhkkaikku aarokkiyamaana unavumurai matrum surusuruppaana vaazhkkaimurai mukkiya pangu vagikkindrana ena nivunargal therivikkindranar.
Adhe nerathil, Japan-il mudhiyavargalin ennikkai thodarndhu adhigarithu varum nilaiyil, thirumanam meedhaana aarvaminmai, adhiga pengal velaikkus selvadhu pondra kaaranangalaal kuzhandhaigal pirappu vigidham thodarndhu kuraindhu varuvadhu annaattirku migapperiya pirasnaiyaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Kurippaaga, oru nilaiyaana makkal thogaiyaip paraamarikka 2.1 endra kuzhandhaip pirappu vigidham thevaippadugiradhu. Aanaal, 2025-l jappaanin karutharippu vigidham varalaaru kaanaadha alavukku kuraindhu 1.14 aaga padhivaagiyirukkiradhu. Melum, jappaanin makkal thogai 2008-l sumaar 12.8 kodiyaaga uchathai ettiyirundhadhu. Aanaal, 2070-kkul adhu sumaar 8.7 kodiyaagak kuraiyum ena kanikkappattulladhu.
Idhanaal, velai seyyum vayadhudaiya ilainjargalin ennikkai thodarndhu kuraivadhudan, idhan thaakkam oyvoodhiyam, maruthuvam, mudhiyor paraamarippu matrum thozhilaalar sandhai ena pala thuraigalilum edhirolikkum avaayam irukkiradhu. Melum, kattumaanam mudhal vivasaayam, pokkuvarathu, sugaadhaaram varai pala thuraigal thozhilaalar patraakkuraiyai edhirgolgindrana. Piradhamar sanaaye thaakkichi, makkaldhogai sarivai "amaidhiyaana avasaranilai" endru vivarithullaar.
Adhanaal, neenda kaalam aarokkiyamaaga vaazhvadhu oru saadhanai endraalum.. Pirappu vigidham kuraindhu, ilainjargalin ennikkai sarivadhu jappaanin samooga amaippu amaippu matrum porulaadhaarathirku migapperiya savaalaaga maariyirukkiradhu.

text:

headline: Taasmaakkil sarakku thattuppaadu: madhu piriyargal emaatram
text:
Taasmaakkil 'sarakku' thattuppaadu: madhu piriyargal emaatram
Chennai: Chennai utbada pala pagudhigalil ulla TASMAC kadaigalil, virumbum madhuvaanangal kidaikkaadhadhaal, madhu piriyargal emaatram adaindhullanar.
Thamizhaga arasin TASMAC niruvanam, sillarai kadaigal vaayilaaga madhuvaanangalai virpanai seygiradhu. Ezhu niruvanangalidam irundhu peer, 11 niruvanangalidam irundhu madhu vagaigalai kolmudhal seygiradhu.
Kadandha DMK, aatchiyil, akkatchiyinarin aadharavaalargal nadathum naangu madhuvaana aalaigalil irundhu adhigalavil kolmudhal seyyappattadhaal, kurippitta vagaigal mattume kadaigalil kidaithadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Idhanaal, virumbiya madhu kidaikkaamal palarum adhirupdhi adaindhanar.
Kadandha me maadham aatchi maatram erpatta nilaiyil, madhuvaana kolmudhalil adikkadi maatrangal seyyappattana. Joolai 20 mudhal anaithu niruvanangalin madhuvaanangalum samamaaga kolmudhal seyyappattu, kadaigalukku anuppappattana. Immurai, sep., 21 mudhal rathu seyyappattadhu.
Andru mudhal kadaigalin unmaiyaana thevai matrum virpanai adippadaiyil mattume madhuvaanangalai vazhanga vendum ena TASMAC utharavittadhu.
Idhanaal, tharpodhu pala kadaigalil vegamaaga virpanaiyaagum madhuvaanangalukku thattuppaadu erpattulladhu.
TASMAC paniyaalargal kooriyadhaavadhu:
kadaigalin sarakku thevai kuritha pattiyal perappattu iru naatkalaagiyum, podhiya alavil madhuvaanangal anuppappadavillai. Vegamaaga virpanaiyaagum vagaigal iruppil illai.
Avai kidaikkaadhadhaal, madhu piriyargal engalai thittivittu veru vagaigalai vaangis selgindranar. Samooga valaidhalangalilum pugaar padhividugindranar.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: Kaasaavai seeramaikka roo.21,000 kodiyil megaa thittam: Trump amaidhi vaariyam arivippu
text:
Niyooyaark: porinaal urukkulaindhu pona kaasaavai marugattamaippu seyya, 6 maadha kaala avagaasathil sumaar 2.45 pilliyan taalar (Indhiya madhippil sumaar roo.21,000 kodi) madhippilaana pirammaanda thittathai America adhivar tiramppin amaidhikkaana kuzhu munmozhindhulladhu.
Niyooyaarkkil nadandhu varum ai.naa., koottathin oru pagudhiyaaga tirambin, amaidhi vaariyathin aalosanaik koottam nadandhadhu. Idhil pirittan munnaal piradhamar toni piler, America adhivarin sirapputh thoodhar steev vitkaap matrum tirambin marumagan jaaret kushnar ullitta mukkiyap piramugargal pangetranar.
66 thittangal:

ikkoottathil, kaasaavai meendum marugattamaippu seyya, 66 thittangal adangiya virivaana varaivuth thittam veliyidappattadhu. Saalaigal, ulgattamaippu vasadhigal, kalvi matrum maruthuva vasadhigalai udanadiyaaga meetteduppadhu ithittathin mukkiya nokkamaagak kurippidappattulladhu.
Adhesamayam, porinaal seerazhindhulla ottumotha kaasaavaiyum muzhumaiyaagap punaramaikka idaikkaalathil sumaar 35.2 pilliyan taalargalum, adutha 10 aandugalil sumaar 71.4 pilliyan taalargalum thevaippadum ena kanakkidappattulladhu. Indha nidhiyaith thirattuvadharku sarvadhesa nangodaiyaalargalai naadavum thittamidappattulladhu.
Por nirutha oppandham nadaimuraikku vandhavodhilum, kaasaavil innum muzhumaiyaana amaidhikkuth thirumbavillai. Kaasaavin 60 sadhaveedha nilapparappai, Israel padaigal innum thangal kattuppaattileye vaithullana. Hamaas aayudhak kuzhuvinar thangaladhu aayudhangalai oppadaikka thodarndhu maruthu varuvadhum kurippidathakkadhu.
