headline: Naadaalumandrathil amithshaavai vaayai moodi utkaarumbadi koorinaaraa edhirkkatchi em.pi?
text:
Naadaalumandrathil thannudaiya pechin podhu kurukkitta uldhurai amaichar amithshaavai vaayai moodikkondu utkaarumbadi matrum BJP amaichargalaip paarthu edhirkkatchi em.pi oruvar kooriyadhaaga video ondru

sadhaapdhi raay endra thirinaamul Congress em.pi naadaalumandrathil pesiya video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Avaradhu pechin podhu amithshaa kurukkittadhu polavum, vaayai moodumbadi thirinaamul Congress em.pi kooriyadhaagavum, idhanaal pesa mudiyaamal amithshaa, piradhamar narendhira Modi ullittavargal amarndhiruppadhu polavum video ulladhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “vaaya moodikkittu utkaarudaa naaye. Pana ozhippil karuppu panam ozhindhadhaa? Theeviravaadham -adhai odukka mudindhadhaa?
Tavul injin sarkkaar telliyil eppadi kundu vedithadhu yaar vaithadhu? Pangalaadheshikkal nuzhaindhadhaaga sonna peegaaril neenga thaanadaa jeyicheenga pinjja seruppadi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naadaalumandrathil thirinaamul Congress em.pi sadhaapdhi raay piradhamar narendhira Modi, uldhurai amaichar amithshaa ullittavargalai neradiyaaga edhirthu, avargalai vaayai moodi utkaarumbadi thunichalaaga pesinaar endru palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Podhuvaaga uruppinar pesum podhu, amaichargal kurukkittu padhil alikka urimai ulladhu. Appadi irukka amithshaa eppadi pesaamal amarndhaar endra kelvi ezhundhadhu.
Melum, em.pi-kkal aakroshamaaga pesiya veediyokkalai eduthu, Modi, amithshaa ullittavargalin pazhaiya veediyokkalai serthu, padhil alikkath thinarinaargal endru samooga oodagangalil parappuvadhu thodarndhugonde irukkiradhu. Enave, indha veediyovum andha vagaiyais saarndhadhaaga irukkalaam enbadhaal aayvukku eduthukkondom.
Naadaalumandra uruppinar sadhaapdhiyin pechai thedi eduthom. Thirinaamul Congress-in adhigaarappoorva inaiyathalathil avaradhu muzhu pechum veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, therdhal seerdhirutham thodarbaaga avar pesiyiruppadhu therindhadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru avar pesiyadhaaga illai. Peegaaril endha katchiyum vetriveravillai, therdhal aanaiyam vendradhu endru avar kurippittirundhaar. “oru sila panakkaarargal panakkaarargalaagi varugiraargal. Payangaravaadhigalai en ungalaal thadukka mudiyavillai? Saivar kutrangalai en ungalaal thadukka mudiyavillai? Makkalukku en velai kidaikkavillai” endrellaam varisaiyaaga avar kelvi ezhuppinaar. Adhai satru maatri kurippittirukkalaam endru therindhadhu.
Amithshaavai miratti amara vaithaaraa endru ariya andha video-vai naadaalumandra inaiyadhala pakkathil thedi eduthom. Tisambar 10, 2025 andru avar therdhal seerdhirutham thodarbaana vivaadhathil pangetrup pesiyadhaaga adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Video-vin 6vadhu nimidathil aalungatchi uruppinargalaip paarthu “sup, sup, sup” (vaayai moodungal) endru avar kooruvadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Vaayai moodikkondu utkaarudaa naaye endru avar kooraadhadhai ellaam serthu vishamathanamaaga padhivittiruppadhu therindhadhu. Adhevol, aalungatchi pakkam amithshaa amarndhirundhadhaaga endha thagavalum illai. Muzhu veediyovaiyum paarthom. Aalungatchi tharappai andha video-vil avargal kaattave illai. Enave, indha video edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhiseythugolla, narendhira Modi, amithshaa idam petra kaatchigal eppodhu edukkappattana enbadhai ariya aayvaith thodarndhom. Amithshaavin video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2025 aagast maadham 20m thedhi amithshaa oru vivaadhathin podhu Congress katchiyinarai vimarsithup pesiya kaatchi adhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhaavadhu, thirinaamul Congress em.pi pesiyadharku kittathatta moondrarai maadhangalukku munbu amithshaa pesiya video veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Aduthadhaaga piradhamar narendhira Modi-yin video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Nammudaiya aayvil adhu immaadha thodakkathil, naadaalumandrathil 2026 patjet thaakkal seyyappatta podhu edukkappattadhu endru theriyavandhadhu. Andha veediyovum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil Modi idam petra kaatchiyum thulliyamaaga othupponadhu. Idhan moolam 2026 patjet uraiyin podhu naadaalumandrathil Modi amarndhirundha video-vai payanbaduthi thavaraana video uruvaakkappattiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Yaarukkum lanjjam tharaamal kudineer, kazhivuneer inaippu pudhu muyatsi! : kavunsilargal oppudhalindri vazhanga vaariyam nadavadikkai
text:
Chennai: arasu aluvalargal matrum kavunsilargalukku lanjjam tharaamal, makkale neradiyaaga vinnappithu, veedugalukku kudineer, kazhivuneer inaippu peruvadharkaana pudhiya muyatsiyil kudineer vaariyam eeduvattulladhu. 'online' vaayilaaga vinnappithu 15 naatkalil inaippugalai peruvadhodu, thavanai thogaiyai aindhu aandugal varai kattavum erpaadu seythulladhu.
Chennai maanagaraatchiyin 200 vaardugalil, Chennai kudineer vaariyam saarbil thinamum, 115 mudhal 120 kodi liter varai kudineer viniyogam seyyappadugiradhu.
Vaariyam saarbil kudineerukku 8.20 latcham inaippugal; kazhivuneerukku 10 latcham inaippugal tharappattu ullana.
Vadasennai matrum thensennai pagudhigal avaara valarchi adaindhu varum nilaiyil, kudiyiruppugal, vaniga kattadangalukkaana kudineer matrum kazhivuneer inaippugal podhumaana alavukku erpaduthappadavillai.
Idhanaal kuzhaayil mottaar poruthi kudineer thiruttu, mazhaineer vadigaalai udaithu kazhivuneer veliyetruvadhu ullitta muraigedugal nadandhu varugindrana.
Thavira, adukkumaadi kudiyiruppu kattum sila niruvanangal, veedu vaanguvoridam kudineer matrum kazhivuneerukku inaippu tharuvadhaaga koori, adhigalavil panam vasoolikkindrana.
Aanaal, anaithu veedugalukku inaippugalai tharaamal, sorpa veedugalukku koduthu 'aattai' podugindrana.
Kurippaaga, andhandha pagudhigalil kudineer, kazhivuneer inaippu peruvadharku, adhigaarigal, kavunsilargal ullitta arasiyal katchiyinarukku, idaith tharagargal vaayilaaga 'katting' tharum nilai ulladhu.
Idhanaal, anaithu tharappinarukkum inaippugalai vazhanga mudiyaamal, kudineer vaariyam thinari varugiradhu.
Innilaiyil, lanjjam, muraigedu thavirkka, idaitharagargal, kavunsilargal ena yaaraiyum anugaamal neraaga vinnappithu kudineer, kazhivuneer inaippugalai peralaam ena, kudineer vaariyam tharpodhu arivithulladhu. Melum pala vasadhi kalaiyum arivithulladhu.
Kudineer vaariya adhigaarigal kooriyadhaavadhu:
Chennaiyin anaithu kattadangalilum, kudineer, kazhivuneer inaippu iruppadhai urudhi seyyum vagaiyil, palveru nadavadikkai eduthu varugirom.
Chennai maanagaraatchiyin sozhinganalloor, maadhavaram, poroor ullitta virivaakka pagudhigalil 10 aayiram kodi roovaaykku mel kudineer matrum kazhivuneer thitta panigal nadandhu varugindrana. Ippani mudindha pagudhigalil, inaippugal aduthaduthu vazhangappattu varugindrana.
Tharpodhu, lanjjam, muraigettai thavirkkavum, kavunsilargal matrum idaitharagargalai anugaamal neradiyaaga vaariyathidam inaippugal peravum, nadavadikkai edukkappattu ulladhu.
Kudineer vaariya poriyaalargalaal vinnappam matrum kattadangalin kattamaippu vasadhigal kurithu aayvu seyyappadum.
Pin, 'online' vaayilaaga mattume kattanam selutha therivikkappadum. Vinnappangal meedhu 15 naatkalil nadavadikkai edukkappattu, inaippu vazhangappadum.
Ore kattanamaaga selutha mudiyaadhavargal, ondrarai aandu mudhal aindhaandugal varai thavanai muraiyil seluthalaam.
Vaariyam nirnayitha kattanathai thavira adhiga panam vasoolithaal, 044- - 4567 4567 endra ennil pugaar therivikkalaam. Inaippu pera, makkal muzhu othuzhaippu vazhanga vendum. Mugaam nadathiyum inaippu vazhangappadum.
Tharai matrum irandu thalam, adharku mel ulla kudiyiruppu kattadangal alladhu aaru veedugalukku mel ulla kudiyiruppugal matrum 3,230 sadhura adi parappukku mel ulla vaniga kattadangalukku, ai.ti.si., endra ulgattamaippu membaattu kattanam porundhum.
Tharpodhaiya nadai muraippadi, 1 sadhura meettarukku 319 roobai selutha vendum. Si.em.ti.e., maanagaraatchiyil thitta anumadhi perumbodhu, ai.ti.si., kattanam seluthi irundhaal meendum selutha thevaiillai.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: Altraadek niruvanathukku roo.782 kodi ji.es.ti., nottees
text:
Pudhudilli:altraadek siment niruvanathidam, roo.782.20 kodi vari seluthumaaru paatnaavil ulla mathiya ji.es.ti inai iyakkunar aluvalagam nottees anuppiyulladhu. Kadandha 2018 -- 19 mudhal 2022- - 23 kaala kattathil kuraivaaga vari seluthiyadhu,
ulleettu vari varavai thavaraaga payanbaduthiyadhu aagiyavatrai kaaranamaagak kurippittu andha aanai anuppappattul ladhaaga, altraadek niruvanam kooriyulladhu.
Ji.es.ti., vari paakki 390.96 kodi roobai matrum adharkaana vatti, koodudhal vatti 27.68 latcham roobai matrum avaraadha thogai serthu niluvaiyai kanakkittu ji.es.ti., aluvalagam nottees anuppiyulladhu.
Idhugurithu niruvana adhigaarigal koorugaiyil, 'naangal samarppitha aavanangalai varividhippu adhigaarigal pariseelikkavillai. Vari seluthakkorum aanaiyai aayvu seythu varugirom.
Engalukku ulla sattappadiyaana vaayppugalai aaraayndha piragu notteesai edhirthu uriya amaippil muraiyiduvom' endru therivithanar.

headline: Sepdambar 1, 2025 mudhal roo.500 nottugal niruthappadum endru risarv vangi arivithadhaa?
text:
‘’sepdambar 1, 2025 mudhal roo.500 nottugal niruthappadum’’ endru risarv vangi arivithulladhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ sepdambar – 1 mudhal ATMkalil 500 roobai nottu vazhangavadaadhu. 100 200 roobai nottugal mattume kidaikkum – risarv vangi arivippu 👍
padippadiyaaga 500 roobai nottugal puzhakkam kuraikkappadum enbadhum nivunargalin karuthu” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
Idhevondru, risarv vangi peyaril oru arikkaiyum pagirappadugiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval, ena theriyavandhadhu. Aam, risarv vangi veliyitta sameevathiya sutrarikkaiyil, roo.500 nottugal niruthappaduvadhaaga, engeyum koorappadavillai.
Adhaavadhu, ‘’By September 30, 2025: 75% of all ATMs shall dispense either rs 100 or rs 200 denmination banknotes from at least one cassette. By March 31, 2026: 90% of all ATMs shall dispense either rs 100 or rs 200 denmination banknotes from at least one cassette,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanbadi, ‘’ATM kesattugal (panam nirappum laakkar) roo. 100, 200, 500 pondra karansigalaal nirappappadum. Indha kesattugalil vaikkappadum panathaiye naam edukka mudiyum. Ovvoru ATM-kkum kuraindhavatcham 4 kesattugal irukkum. Ivatril edhenum oru kesattil kandippaaga, roo100 alladhu roo200 nottugalai nirappavendum. Indha panigalukku, sepdambar 30, 2025 mudhalgatta kaalakkedu matrum maars 31, 2026 irudhi kedu,’’ endrudhaan risarv vangi kooriyulladhu.
Endha idathilum roo500 nottugal thadai seyyappaduvadhaagak koorave illai. Idhudhodarbaaga, risarv vangi Chennai aluvalagathil pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Aduthappadiyaaga, mathiya arasukkus sondhamaana PIBFactCheck idhuvatri maruppu kooriyulladhu. Adhanaiyum inge aadhaarathirkaaga, inaithullom.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
enave, risarv vangi sutrarikkai patri vendumendre samooga valaidhalangalil thavaraana thagaval parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘teliviraamdar vaithup pesum narendhira Modi’ endru nakkal seythaaraa Annamalai?
text:
Teliviraamdar vaithup pesum Modi endru Annamalai vimarsanam seythadhaaga oru video padhivu

Annamalai pesiya video-vin oru siru pagudhi mattum Facebook, X postil pagirappattulladhu. Adhil, “idhu vandhunga roomai poottittu. Firantla oru piraamdarai vachikkittu, avaru tvittarla pesura video kidaiyaadhu. Pinnaadi oru piraamdar vachiruppaanga. Adhai paarthu tap tap tapnu padippaaru. Adhai aidi ving eduppaan. Tapnu kat panni potturuvaan” endru koorugiraar. Adhaith thodarndhu piradhamar narendhira Modi teliviraamdar paarthu thadumaari pesum video varugiradhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “padhavi parikkappaduvadhu urudhi endru therindhadhum modiyave nakkal panna thodankittaan aadu 😂 narendhira Modi Teleprompter vaithu padippadhai kuthikkaattum aadu 🥱” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Teliviraamt paarthu pesum Modi endru Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivar Annamalai vimarsanam seythadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, andha video-vil narendhira modiyai kurippittu Annamalai pesiyadhu pol illai. Yaaraip patri avvaaru solgiraar endru theriyaadha alavukku miga siriya pagudhi mattum vetti padhividappattirundhadhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video-vil evivi naadu endra inaiya oodagathin logo irundhadhu. Enave, andha oodagathin Facebook pakkathil indha video-vai thedi eduthom. 2024 joolai 31m thedhi indha video-vai reels aaga andha oodagam padhivittirundhadhu. Adhil, “staalinukku payam… pesath theriyaadhu Annamalai pageer” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Andha reels video-vai paarthom. ‘’anga ponaarnaa vandavaalam thandavaalam ellaam India-vil irukkira ellaarukkum therindhuvidum. Idhu vandhunga roomai poottittu. Firantla oru piraamdarai vachikkittu, avaru tvittarla pesura video kidaiyaadhu. Pinnaadi oru piraamdar vachiruppaanga. Adhai paarthu tap tap tapnu padippaaru. Adhai aidi ving eduppaan. Tapnu kat panni potturuvaan. Payam kaaranamaagathaan nidhiaayok koottathirku Stalin sellavillaiye thavira Tamil Nadu endra peyarai patjettil payanbaduthavilla enbadharkaaga pogavillai enbadhellaam kattukkadhai” endru Annamalai pesinaar.
Idhevondru, thinamalar indha pechin video-vai veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil, Stalin en nidhiaayok pogavillai endru Annamalai thannudaiya katchiyinaridam pesugiraar. Andha video-vin 1.55vadhu nimidathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pagudhi varugiradhu. Adhil Stalin athanai mudhalamaichargal munnilaiyil pesa mudiyaadhu enbadhaal sellavillai enbadhaagap pesugiraar.
Idhan moolam Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivar Annamalai, teliviraamt payanbaduthum indhiyap piradhamar narendhira modiyai vimarsikkavillai, Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinaiye vimarsithaar enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘Vijay Wave’ endru Frontline oodagam attaippadam veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘‘‘Vijay Wave’ endru attaippadam veliyitta Frontline oodagam’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ VIJAY WAVE. FRONTLINE,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda attaippadam unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Idhuvatri Frontline magazine aasiriyar kuzhuvil kettavodhu, ‘’idhu thavaraana padam. Naangal ivvaaru endha attaippadamum veliyidavillai. TVK aadharavaalargal indha vadhandhiyai parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithanar.
Melum, Frontline oodagathin adhigaarappoorva X valaidhala pakkathilum idhudhodarbaaga maruppu koorappattulladhaik kandom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda attaippadam, poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “maattu saanam saappitta sangi adutha naale ai.si.yoo-vil” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Maattu saanam saappitta navar adutha naal theevira sigichaip pirivil anumadhikkappattadhaaga oru video

vada Indhiya maruthuvar oruvar maattu saanam saappitta pazhaiya veediyovudan oruvar theevira sigichaip pirivil anumadhikkappatta pugaippadathai serthu video uruvaakki Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Andha video-vil, “maattu saanam saappitta adutha naal aisuvil sangi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “veeraappukku maattu saanam saappittu adutha naal maruthuvamanaiyil paduthirukkaan indha sangi ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Koronaa kaalathil maruthuvar oruvar maattu saanam saappittadhu thodarbaana video viral aanadhu. Andha video-vai vaithu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Enave, andha maruthuvar unmaiyil maattu saanam saappittu maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattaaraa alladhu veru kaaranathirkaaga anumadhikkappattaaraa, video-vil iruppadhu andha maruthuvar thaanaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video-vil idam petra ai.si.yoo endra theevira sigichaip pirivu kaatchiyai mattum pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu andha pugaippadamaanadhu 2017m aandu oru nidhi thirattum inaiyathalathil veliyaagi iruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil “padathil kaanappadum navarin peyar pidhaan thaavaa (Bidhan Thapa) ivar 2017m aandu joolai 7m thedhi thideer idhaya seyalizhappu kaaranamaaga America-vin jaan haakkins maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattaar. 10 joolai 2017 andru uyirizhandhaar. Ivaradhu udalai sondha naadaana nevaalathirkuk kondu sella vendum” endrum adharku nidhi udhavi thevaippadugiradhu endrum kurippittirundhanar. 19,952 America taalarai podhu makkal udhavi seythirundhadhum therindhadhu. Idhan moolam pazhaiya pugaippadathai eduthu vada Indhiya maruthuvar thodarbaaga vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga saanam saappitta maruthuvar thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Koogulil sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thediyavodhu andha maruthuvarin video-kkal matrum seythigal namakku kidaithana. Andha maruthuvar pala aandugalaaga maattus saanam saappittu vandhadhaagavum, karppinigal maattus saanam saappiduvadhu sugappirasavathukku udhavi seyyum endru avar video veliyittiruppadhum therindhadhu.
Andha maruthuvarin peyar manoj mittal enbadhum ivar hariyaanaavin karnaal (Karnal) endra ooril iruppadhaagavum seythigal therivithana. Ivar maattus saanam saappitta veediyovudan pala noygal matrum adharkaana sigichaigal thodarbaaga eraalamaana veediyokkalai veliyittiruppadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil saanam saappitta navar aisiyu-vil anumadhikkappattaar endru paravum pugaippadam America-vil irandha oruvarin pugaippadam enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Veeramani vazhakkil yaaraiyum kaappaatra muyatsikkavillai; solgiraar Stalin
text:
Chennai: sirumigal paaliyal vangodumai sambavathil kaidhaagiyulla veeramani vazhakkil yaaraiyum kaappaatra endha utharavum DMK aatchiyil pirappikkappadavillai, endru akkatchiyin thalaivar Stalin therivithullaar.
Avaradhu arikkai; sirumigalukku edhiraana manidhathanmaiyatra izhivaana seyalgalil eeduvatta kutrachaattugalin adippadaiyil jem veeramani kaidhu seyyappattullaar. Idhil veeramaniyum, avarukku udandhaiyaaga irundhavargal, avaraik kaappaatra muyandravargal evaraayinum, ethagaiya poruppil irundhavargal aayinum thappikka koodaadhu. Anaivarum sattathin mun niruthappattu, adhigavatcha thandanaiyaip petruth thara vendum. Idhudhaan DMK-vin nilaippaadu. Indha vazhakkin mudivu, ini ithagaiya kutracheyalgalil eeduvadum enname evarukkum varaadha vagaiyil amaiya vendum enbadhudhaan or arasiyal iyakkathin thalaivanaagavum, oru kudumbathalaivanaagavum, manasaatchi ulla manidhanaagavum enadhu viruppam.
Aanaal, indha vazhakkil thevaiye illaamal, kurugiya arasiyal nokkathudan DMK-vin meedhu poyyaaga avadhoorugalaip parappi, oru koottam kulirgaayndhu varuvadhu migavum aruveruppaana seyalaagum. Veeramani vazhakkil yaaraiyum kaappaatra endha utharavum DMK aatchiyil pirappikkappadavillai.
Pengal, sirumigalukku edhiraana kutra vazhakkugalil paaravatchamindri kutravaaligal kaidhu seyyappattu, kutrappathirigaiyum thaakkal seyyappattu, thandanai petruth tharappattadhu. Ivai anaithum podhuveliyil irukkum, marukka mudiyaadha unmaigal aagum. Evaraiyum kaappaatra vendiya thevai DMK aatchikku illai.
Tharpodhaiya TVK aatchiyil nadappadhuvola, emelekkal, maavattas seyalaalargal ullitta katchi nirvaagigal meedhu anaithup pathirigaigalin munbum paadhikkappatta pengal paaliyal kutrachaattugalai munvaitha pinnarum, nadavadikkai edukkaamal, samarasam pesi vazhakkai mudithu vaikkum izhiseyalgal DMK aatchiyil nadaiveravillai.
Enave, sirumigalukku erpatta thuyarathai idaitherdhalukkaana karuviyaagap payanbaduthum izhivaana seyalaiyum, mutrilum poyyaana avadhoorugalai oodagangal moolamaaga parappuvadhaiyum aalumgatchiyinar niruthik kolla vendum. Paadhikkappatta sirumigalukku needhi petruth tharuvadhu mattume nam anaivarin nokkamaagavum irukka vendum, ivvaaru kurippittullaar.

headline: Meendum aatchikku vandhaal silindar thattuppaattai sariseyvom endru Udhayanidhi Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘meendum aatchikku vandhaal silindar thattuppaattai sariseyvom,’’ endru Udhayanidhi Stalin kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ silindar thattuppaadu theervukkaana ragasiyam engakitta irukku. Naangal aatchikku vandhaal theervu kidaikkum- Udhayanidhi Stalin’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda seythi unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu Sun News peyaril paravum vadhandhi endrum, unmaiyaana news card verondru endrum, theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, unmaiyaana news card-il “ED, CBI, ECI ullitta thanadhu saarbu anigaludan serndhu therdhal panigalai thodangiyulladhu BJP indha amaippugalai vaithu miratti uruvaakkappatta kattaaya koottanidhaan ADMK ulla koottani. Vaarathukku orumurai ini piradhamar Modi thamizhnaattukku varuvaar. Aanaal endha pudhiya thittamum varaadhu- Udhayanidhi, thunai mudhalamaichar,’’ endrudhaan ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanai vendumendre edit seythu, DMK-vukku edhiraaga, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, Sun News aasiriyar kuzhuvilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, edit seyyappatta ondru, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Es. Raajaavukku pon raadhaagirushnan kandanam therivithaaraa?
text:
Naadaargal thamizhargal alla endru kooriya es.raajaavukku pon raadhaagirushnan kandanam endru oru news card

pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card fesbakkil padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “hes.raajaavukku kandanam. Naadaargal thamizhargal alla ena hes.raajaa pesiyadhai vanmaiyaagak kandikkiren. Enmeedhum thamizhisai saundhararaajan meedhum hes.raajaavukku irukkum kovathai oru samoogathin meedhe kaattuvadhu thavaru. Munnaal mathiya amaichar pon.raadhaagirushnan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugirom.
investigation_details:
Naadaargal thamizhargal alla endru kaalduvel koorinaar endru es.raajaa pesiyirundhaar. Idhai edit seythu naadaargal thamizhargal alla endru es.raajaa koorinaar endru silar samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappi varugindranar. Idhu thodarbaaga nammudaiya fekt kirasandovil katturai veliyittullom.
Indha nilaiyil es.raajaavukku pon raadhaagirushnan kandanam therivithadhu pondru silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha news card paarkka pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pola irundhaalum, avargal payanbaduthiyulla vaarthaigal, vadivamaippil ulla siru vithiyaasam ullittavai idhu poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygiradhu. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathaip paarthom. Naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru news card adhil illai. Enave, pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Idhu poliyaanadhu endru FAKE muthiraiguthi namakkup padhivu veliyittulla thagavalai anuppinar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ezhuthaalar vittalraavukku vishnuvuram ilakkiya virudhu
text:
Tirunelveli: ezhuthaalar, oviyar, pugaippadakkalainjar, kalai vimarsagar ki.vittalraavukku 2026m aandukkaana vishnuvuram ilakkiya virudhu arivikkappattulladhu.
1942l osooril pirandha vittalraav Chennai oviyak kallooriyil nungalai payindravar. Sirugadhaigal, naavalgal, katturaigal ena thamizh ilakkiyathil panmugappangalippai seythullaar. 'pokkidam', 'nadhimoolam', 'vannamugangal' ullittavai ivaradhu kurippidathakka padaippugal. 'thamizhagathuk kottaigal' ullitta noolgal moolam varalaaru, kalai, sinimaa kurithum padhivu seythullaar.
Oviyam, pugaippadam, sinimaa ullitta kalaithuraigalilum pangalithullaar. Thamizh padaippulagil pala aandugalaaga thodarndhu iyangi varum mootha padaippaaliyaaga thigazhgiraar.
2010 mudhal vazhangappadum vishnuvuram ilakkiya virudhu, mootha ilakkiya aalumaigalai kavuravithu varugiradhu. Indha virudhudan roo.5 latcham rokkap parisum, kalainayamikka virudhus sirpamum vazhangappadugiradhu. Virudhu vazhangum vizhaa tisambar irudhiyil kovaiyil nadakkiradhu.

headline: Kovai: vadamaanilath thozhilaaliyaik kondru pudhaitha 6 per kaidhu - adhiravaikkum kolaigalaal makkal acham
text:
Oru idathil thondappattu irundha kuzhikkul oru sadalam pudhaikkappattu irundhadhu. Adhan oru kai mattum veliye therindhulladhu.
Kovai othakkaal mandavam pagudhiyil indhu samaya aranilaiyath thuraikkus sondhamaana nilathil kadandha 8m thedhiyandru marakkandrugal nadum pani nadaivetrulladhu.
Appodhu oru idathil thondappattu irundha kuzhikkul oru sadalam pudhaikkappattu irundhadhum, adhan oru kai mattum veliye therindhulladhu. Idhanaip paarthu adhirchi adaindha thozhilaalargal, settivaalaiyam kaaval thuraiyinarukku thagaval alithanar.
Idhaiyaduthu kaaval thuraiyinar sadalathaith thondi eduthavodhu, udalil pala idangalil kaayangal iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu sadalam udarkooraayvirkaaga Kovai arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppi vaikkappattadhu.
Idhu kurithu kaaval thuraiyinar nadathiya visaaranaiyil, kolai seyyappattadhu othukkaalmandavam pagudhiyil thangiyirundhu, kinathukkadavu pagudhiyil ulla oru sbinning millil velai seythu vandha merkuvangathais serndha paadhal shith (24) enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Melum, kaanaamal pona avarin selbonai veru oruvar payanbaduthi vandhadhum theriyavandhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu andha selbon tavar logeshanai vaithu thirivuraavais serndha thuythe riyaang (22), sunil raay riyaang (24), kotho raam riyaang (30), sumith kumaar (20), sraamith traang (35), sandhoshgumaar (20) aagiya 6 perai kaaval thuraiyinar kaidhu seythanar.
Avargalidam nadathiya visaaranaiyil, kadandha 7m thedhiyandru iravu madhu podhaiyil irundha paadhal, sambava idathil madhu arundhi kondirundha 6 peridam madhu kettadhaagavum, idhanaal erpatta thagaraaril paadhalaith thaakki kolai seythadhaagavum kooriyullanar.
Melum idhanai maraikkum vagaiyil marakkandrugal naduvadharkaagath thondappattu irundha kuzhikkul sadalathai avasaramaagap pudhaithuvittu, angirundhu thappis sendradhaagavum kooriyullanar.
Idhevola paappambatti pagudhiyil udal thotram kurithu keli seythadhaal erpatta munvirodham kaaranamaaga nevaalathais serndha raajan engira raamesvar saah endra ilainjarai haalovilaak kallaal thaakki jaarkkant maanilathais serndha maathyaas maaldo matrum jegadheesh aagiyor kolai seythanar.
Indha vazhakkil maathyaasaik kaidhu seytha kaaval thuraiyinar jegadheeshaith thedi varugindranar. Indhas sambavangal appagudhi makkalidaiye adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Palusisdhaanil Indhiya kodiyudan oorvalam nadathappattadhaa?
text:
Paagisdhaanilirundhu pirivadhaaga arivitha palusisdhaanil Indhiya thesiyak kodiyudan oorvalam nadathappattadhu endru oru video

Indhiya kodiyudan “saare jahaanse achaa” endra paadalin isaiyai isaithavadi oorvalamaaga palarum sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paagisdhaanil irundhu pirindha paloos sugandhiram adaindhadhaaga arivithu Indhiya kodigaludan oorvalamaagas sendranar idhudhaan aganda paaradham” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Paagisdhaanilirundhu palusisdhaan endra pagudhi thaniyaaga pirindhu thaninaadaaga arivithuk kondadhaagavum adhaith thodarndhu Indhiya thesiyak kodiyai endhiyavadi, Indhiya thesavakdhi paadalai isaithuk kondu andha pagudhi makkal oorvalamaaga sendradhaagavum Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Video-vai muzhuvadhum paarkkum podhu, kujaraathi mozhiyil Modi pugaippadathudan penar vaikkappattirundhadhu. Kadaigalin peyargalum kooda kujaraathi mozhiyil ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Penaraavadhu Modi-yin meedhu ulla patru kaaranamaaga vaithirundhaargal endru vilakkam kooralaam… aanaal kadaiyin peyaraik koodavaa maatriyiruppaargal endra kelvi ezhugiradhu.
Video-vil idam petra tirams isaik karuviyil saifi sgavut soorath (Saifee Scout Surat) endru irundhadhu. Paloos pagudhikku India-vin soorathilirundhu isaik kalainjargal sendru oorvalam nadathiyirukka vaayppe illai. Enave, indha video India-vil kujaraathil nadandhadhaaga irukkalaam… adhai paagisdhaanin paloos pagudhiyil nadandha perani endru thavaraagap pagirndhirukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu aavareshan sindhoor vetriyaik kondaadum vagaiyil kujaraathin soorathil moovarnak kodi yaathirai nadandhadhaaga pala padhivugal namakkuk kidaithana. Seythi oodagangalilum kooda indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Koogulil Saifee Scout Surat endru taip seythu thediya podhu, andha isaik kuzhuvin pala video-kkal namakkuk kidaithana. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil ulladhu pondru seerudaiyil avargal isaik karuvigalai isaikkum pala video-kkal namakkuk kidaithana. Ivai ellaam indha video soorathil edukkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Aandhiraa thunai mudhalvar pavan kalyaan nonbu thirakkum kaatchi idhuvaa?
text:

Nalla nadikkireengadaa,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2019m aandu edukkappatta video enbadhum, idharkum ipdhaar nonbukkum endha sambandhamum illai enbadhum, theriyavandhadhu.
Kadandha 2019m aandu nadaivetra aandhira sattamandra therdhalil, kundoor kizhakkuth thogudhiyil, jana senaa katchi saarbaaga, pottiyitta Sheikh Zia Ur Rehman enbavarai aadharithu, pavan kalyaan pirasaaram merkondaar. Melum, andha vetbaalarin veettirku sendru, pavan kalyaan madhiya unavu saappittaar. Appodhu, edukkappatta veediyodhaan idhu…
The Hans India l Overseas News l Filmy Focus
idhudhodarbaaga, namadhu Fact Crescendo English pirivu erkanave, virivaana seythi veliyittulladhu.
Enave, 2019m aandu aandhira sattamandra therdhalinbodhu edukkappatta video ondrai tharpodhu pagirndhu, thamizh nadigar Vijay-in ipdhaar nonbu thirakkum nigazhvudan thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ”ennaiyum avaraippola maathidaadheenga..” kanneervidum maanavar.. Yaar andha rogith vemulaa?
text:
Malesiyaavil munaivar pattam padikkum thamizhnaattu maanavar Bharathidhasan, Thamizhaga arasin udhavithogai thaamadhamaagi palgalaikkazhagathil irundhu neekkappadalaam enak kanneerudan video veliyittadhu arasiyal sarchaiyai kilappiyadhu. Arasu, kattanam erkenave seluthappattadhaagavum, palgalaikkazhaga oppudhal kidaithavudan meedhith thogai vazhangappadum ena vilakkam alithadhu. “ennaiyum rogith vemulaa nilaikku maatraadheergal” endra avaradhu vendugol, saadhi paaguvaadu, maanavar urimaigal, rogith vemulaa maranam pondra vivaadhangalai meendum thoondiyulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
malesiyaavil munaivar patta aayvu payindru varum thamizhagathais serndha maanavar Bharathidhasan, Thamizhaga arasin udhavithogai thittathin keezh padikka vandha thanakku indha aandukkaana nidhiyudhavi idhuvarai kidaikkavillai endru kutramsaattiyirundhaar. Indha vivagaaram sattamandram varai pesuvorulaaga maariyirundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil, samooganeedhith thurai amaichar vanniyarasu, maanavargalukkaana nidhi vazhangappattu varuvadhaaga vilakkam alithaar. Aanaal, adharkup piragum “enakku nidhi varavillai” endru Bharathidhasan thodarndhu therivithirundhaar. Netru meendum video veliyitta avar, “thamizhaga arasidamirundhu vara vendiya nidhi innum kidaikkavillai. Idhanaal ennai palgalaikkazhagathilirundhu eliminate seyyum nilai erpattulladhu” endru kanneerudan urukkamaaga pesiyirundhaar.
Indha video vairalaanadhaith thodarndhu, Tamil Nadu arasiyal vattaarathil indha vivagaaram meendum poodhaagaramaaga vedithadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, Thamizhaga arasu saarbil maanavarukku erkenave indha aandukkaana kalvik kattanam palgalaikkazhagathirku seluthappattuvittadhaagavum, avar padikkum palgalaikkazhagathil maanavar alitha uthesap pattiyalukkaana oppudhal korappattulladhaagavum, adhu kidaithavudan meedhamulla udhavithogai vazhangappadum endrum vilakkamalithirukkiradhu.
Aanaal, indha vivagaarathil anaivarin kavanathaiyum eerthadhu Bharathidhasan kooriya oru varidhaan. “ennaiyum rogith vemulaa nilaikku maatridaadheenga” endru avar kanneerudan pesiyirundhaar. Indha video vairalaana nilaiyil, “yaar andha rogith vemulaa? En avarai Bharathidhasan kurippittaar?” endra kelvigal ezhundhullana.
Yaar andha rogith vemulaa? Munaivar patta aayvaalaraana avaradhu peyar en meendum pesappadugiradhu? Enbadhai paarkkalaam.
Aandhirap piradhesa maanilam kundoor pagudhiyais serndhavar rogith vemulaa. Avaradhu thaay raadhigaa vemulaa, maalaa samoogathais serndhavar enath therivikkappattu vandha nilaiyil, avaradhu thandhai vatteraa samoogathais serndhavar enap pinnar aavanangalil kurippidappattadhu. Rogith siruvayadhileye thanadhu thaayudan valarndhu vandhaar. Saadhiyap paaguvaadu matrum samooga odukkumuraigalukku mathiyilum, kalvidhaan thanadhu edhirgaalathirkaana ore vazhi enbadhai unarndhu padippil sirandhu vilangiya rogith vemulaa, haidharaavaathil ulla mathiyap palgalaikkazhagathil munaivar patta aayvil serndhaar. Avar payindra palgalaikkazhagathilum saadhiyap paaguvaadu iruppadhaagak koori seyalbattu vandha Ambedkar maanavar amaippil, rogith vemulaa theeviramaaga iyangath thodanginaar.
Indha nilaiyil, 1993 mumbai kunduvedippu vazhakkil kutravaaliyaagath theerppalikkappatta yaagoop memanukku 2015-il thookkuth thandanai niraivetrappattadhai edhirthu, Ambedkar maanavar amaippu palgalaikkazhaga valaagathil poraattam nadathiyadhu. Adhanbiragu, Ambedkar maanavar amaippinarukkum, BJP-yin maanavar amaippaana eviviviyais serndha maanavargalukkum idaiye modhal erpattadhu. Indha vivagaarathil evivivi maanavar thalaivar sushil kumaar, thannai Ambedkar maanavar amaippais serndhavargal thaakkiyadhaagak kutramsaatti pugaar alithaar. Maruvuram, Ambedkar maanavar amaippinar andhak kutrachaattai maruthanar.
Indha vivagaaram palgalaikkazhaga visaaranaikkum sendradhu. Palgalaikkazhagathin visaaranaikkup piragu rogith vemulaa ullitta maanavargal meedhu nadavadikkai edukkappattadhu. Aarambathil avargalukku kalvi reedhiyaana idaineekkam vidhikkappattadhu. Adhan piragu pudhiya thunaivendhar andhap palgalaikkazhagathirku niyamikkappattaar. Avarukku rogith oru kadidham ezhudhinaar. Andhak kadidhathil ’pattiyalina maanavargal meedhu saadhiya vangodumai eviye evivi amaippodu inakkamaaga seyalbadugira neengal, paadhikkappatta engalai ippadi vanmaiyaagak kandippadharku, engalai karunaik kolai pannividungal’ endru oru kadidham ezhudhinaar. Palveru poraattangalukkup piragu, pinnar andha nadavadikkai maatrappattu, 2015 tisambaril rogith vemulaa ullitta 5 maanavargal kallooriyil padippaith thodaralaam, aanaal vidudhiyil thangak koodaadhu, nirvaagak kattadathirkul sellak koodaadhu, maanavar sangath therdhalil pangerkak koodaadhu enath thadai vidhithu kattuppaadugalukku utbaduthappattanar..
Vidudhiyil irundhu veliyeriya rogith vemulaavum avaradhu nanbargalum palgalaikkazhaga valaagathil thirandhaveliyil thangip poraattam nadathinar. Avargal vidudhiyil irundhu veliyetrappattavodhu edukkappatta pugaippadam appodhu perum adhirvalaigalai ezhuppiyadhu. Oru kaiyil sattamedhai ambethgarin pugaippadamum, matroru kaiyil thanadhu udaimaigalaiyum eduthukkondu thanadhu nanbargaludan veliyeruvadhu pondra kaatchidhaan adhu. Indhas soozhalildhaan 2016 janavari 17 andru rogith vemulaa palgalaikkazhaga valaagathil ulla araiyil uyirizhandha nilaiyil kandedukkappattaar. Avaradhu maranam naadu muzhuvadhum perum adhirvalaigalai erpaduthiyadhu.
Palgalaikkazhagangalil saadhiyap paaguvaadu matrum maanavargalukku edhiraana paaguvaadugal kuritha vivaadhamum naadu muzhuvadhum theeviramadaindhadhu.
Rogith vemulaa vittus sendradhaagak koorappadum kadidhamum indha vivagaarathil miga mukkiyamaanadhaaga maariyadhu. Naanum anaivarumboladhaan amaidhiyaaga irukka aasaippatten. Aanaal en varalaaru ennai appadi irukka vidavillai...”
“oru manidhanin madhippu avanadhu udanadi adaiyaalamaagavum, avanudaiya aduthadutha vaayppugalaagavum surukkappattuvittadhu. Oru vaakkaaga, or ennaaga, oru porulaagak karudhappadugiraan. Oru manidhan oru sindhikkum manamaaga oruvodhum paarkkappaduvadhillai” endra porulil avar ezhudhiyirundhaar. Melum, thaan or ariviyal ezhuthaalaraaga vendum endra kanavu irundhadhaagavum andhak kadidhathil kurippittirundhaar.
Indhak kadidham naadu muzhuvadhum perum vivaadhathai erpaduthiyadhu. Idhanidaiye, rogith vemulaavin saadhip pinnani kurithum pinnar visaaranaigal nadaivetrana. Mathiya arasaal amaikkappatta needhivadhi asok kumaar roovanvaal thalaimaiyilaana visaaranaik kuzhuvum avaradhu saadhis saandridhazh thodarbaaga kelvigalai ezhuppiyadhu. Andhak kuzhu arikkaiyil, rogith vemulaa pattiyalinathais serndhavar alla endru mudivu seyyappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, idharku maaraaga kundoor maavatta aatchiyar alitha arikkaiyil, kidaitha aavanangalin adippadaiyil rogith vemulaa hindhu-maalaa samoogathais serndhavar endrum, andha samoogam aandhirap piradhesathil pattiyalinap pirivil iruppadhaagavum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha vivagaarathil vevveru arasuth tharappugalin mudivugal maaruvattirundhana. Pala aandugalaaga visaaranaiyil irundha rogith vemulaa maranam thodarbaana vazhakkil, 2024-m aandu thelangaanaa kaavaldhurai thaakkal seytha moodal arikkai (Closure Report) pudhiya sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Andha arikkaiyil, 2016 aam aandu haidharaavaath mathiya palgalaikkazhagathil rogith vemulaa endra maanavarai tharkolaikkuth thoondiyadharkaana endha aadhaaramum kidaikkavillai. Melum, avar uyargalvi payilvadharkaaga avaradhu thaayaar poliyaana saandridhazh petrirukkiraar. Avar pattiyalinathavare illai. Indha unmai rogithukkum theriyum. Andha unmai veliye therindhuvittaal, thannudaiya padippirku edhaavadhu pirasnai vandhuvidumo endra mana azhuthathilum kuzhappathilum irundhadhaaleye rogith tharkolai seythugondadhaaga visaaranaiyin adippadaiyil arikkai samarppikkappadugiradhu endru thelangaanaa Police andha arikkaiyais samarppithadhu. Adhanadippadaiyil, tharkolai seythugondadharku adippadai mugaandhiram alladhu kutram iruppadharkaana aadhaaram illai endru indha vazhakku visaaranaiyil mudikkiraargal.
Indha mudivai rogith vemulaavin thaay raadhigaa vemulaa maruthaar. Melum, avaradhu thaayaar ullittor sandhegam therivithadhaith thodarndhu, indha vazhakkil melum visaaranai nadathappadum endru thelangaanaa kaavaldhurai tijivi 2024-l arivithaar. Innamum rogith vazhakkil sattap poraattam thodarndhugondedhaan irukkiradhu...

headline: Mistar kazhugu: nerungum sooriyan - thaamarai... Visil - maambazham... Arasiyal pudhukkanakku!
text:
Piravala thozhiladhivar segar rettiyin kaatbaadi veettilirundha, sumaar 4 kodi roobai madhippilaana 2.5 kilo thangakkattigalum, 10 latcham roobai rokkap panamum kollaivoyvittanavaam.
Saaral mazhaiyil nanaindhavadi aluvalagathukkul nuzhaindhaar kazhugaar. Mazhaikku idhamaaga milagaay pajjiyudan, injji teeyum koduthom. Pajjiyai oru kadi kadithuvittu, `virut’tena seythigalukkul nuzhaindhaar.
“or arivippais seythu vittu, adhai vaavas peruvadhu TVK aatchiyil thodargadhaiyaagivittadhu. Pattinappaakkathil pudhiya thalaimais seyalagam amaippadhu thodarbaaga arasaanai veliyittadhu arasu. Adharku edhiraaga onbadhu meenava kiraamangal poraattathil kudhikka, ‘thalaimais seyalagam kattuvadhu thodarbaaga mudhalvar endha mudivum edukkavillai’ endrirukkiraar amaichar aadhav arjunaa. ‘piragu en arasaanai veliyitteergal?’ endru DMK thunaip podhucheyalaalar kanimozhi ezhuppiya kelvikku aatchiyaalargalidam padhilillai.”
“en ippadik kuzhappugiraargal?”
“idhu mattumaa... Seyyaaru thozhirpoongaa thittathukkaaga, thiruvannaamalai melmaa kiraamathil 22 hekder punsey nilam kaiyagappaduthuvadharkaana arivippaanaiyai veliyittadhu arasu. Adharkuk kadum edhirppu kilambave, ‘thiruvannaamalai aatchiyarin parindhurai adippadaiyil, nilangalaik kaiyagappaduthuvadhaaga veliyidappatta arikkai thirumbap perappadugiradhu’ endru pinvaangivittanar. Thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thitta thodakka vizhaavukkaana thedhiyaiyum idathaiyum irandu murai maatrivittaargal. Arasu nirvaagathil egappattak kuzhappam nilavugiradhu.”
“mm... Idaitherdhalaip purakkanippadhaaga PMK arivithuvittadhe!”
“edhirbaarthadhudhaane... Podhutherdhalinbodhu kodutha ‘vaakkurudhi’yai ADMK podhucheyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami niraivetraadhadhaal, idaitherdhalaip purakkanikkum mudivai eduthirukkiraar PMK thalaivar anbumani. Adhan pinnaal, veror arasiyal kanakkum olindhirukkiradhaam.”
“enna kanakku?”
“mudhalvar Vijay-kku miga nerukkamaana viyoogappulli oruvar, anbumaniyaith thodarbugondu pesinaaraam. ‘mudhalvar ungalmeedhu migundha mariyaadhaiyudan irukkiraar. Selamiyaa medathai amaicharaakka vendumena ninaikkiraar. Indha nerathula edhir nilaippaadu vendaame... Idaitherdhal mudindha piragu koottanikkul vandhuvidungal...’ ena viyoogappulli solla, anbumaniyum kanvins aagivittadhaagath thagaval.”
“oho... Madhachaarbatra samooga needhi vetrik koottaniyildhaan VCK irukkiradhe... Piragu eppadi PMK ulle varum?”
“appadiyoru koottani peyarukkuthaan irukkiradhuvola. Idaitherdhal podhukkootta medaiyai mudhalvarudan pagirndhugolla koottanik katchith thalaivargal virumbiyirukkiraargal. ‘adharkellaam vaayppe illai’ ena aatchi melidathilirundhu thagaval vara, koottanith thalaivargal padu apset. ‘VCK irundhaaldhaan pattiyal samooga vaakkugal kidaikkum endra nilai namakkillai. Adhenerathil, PMK nammudan irundhaal vanniyar vaakkugalai valaikkalaam. Irandu thogudhigal idaitherdhalilum vetrivetruvittaal, VCK, kamyoonist katchigal illaamaleye, PMK aadharavudan aatchi nadathividalaam’ enath thittamidugiradhaam aalum tharappu.”
“adhu sari... Moondraavadhu ani amaikka vadamaanila toor sendraare kanimozhi... Toor saksasaa?”
“thirinaamul Congress, samaajvaadi katchilai anugip pesiyirukkiraar kanimozhi. Aanaal, ‘konjjam taim kodungal... Naadaalumandrath therdhalukku irandu aandugalukku mel irukkindrana’ endre solli anuppinaargalaam. DMK edhirbaartha paasittiv padhiledhum varavillai. Aanaalum vidaamuyatsiyaith thodargiraar kanimozhi. Idharkidaiye, avaradhu katchiyais serndha seeniyargal silar, sooriyanaiyum thaamaraiyaiyum serthu vaikka menakkedugiraargal.”
“saridhaan. Mudhalvar Vijay meendum velinaattukkus selgiraaraame... Kelvippatteeraa?”
“thagaval vandhadhu. Adutha aandin thodakkathil, suvitcharlaandhu selvadhaagath thittamaam. El nino, porulaadhaara membaadu thodarbaana kaanfaransil pangerkaviruppadhaagas solgiraargal. Idhu maadhiriyaana koottangalukku amaichargal yaaraiyaavadhu anuppuvadhudhaan vazhakkam. Aanaal, velinaattup payanangalil mudhalvar aarvamaaga iruppadhaal, azhaippu vandhadhum oppukkondu vittaaraam. Landanukkus sendru vandhadharke innum muzhu vidai theriyavillai... Adharkullaaga adutha toor...” endra kazhugaarukku, thithippaana paal kozhukkattai koduthom. Suvaithuvittu, seythigalaith thodarndhaar.
“2011-l nadandha oru thanga mosadi thodarbaaga, magesh enbavarmeedhu ippodhu alikkappatta pugaaril vazhakku padhindhirukkiradhu Chennai kaavaldhurai. Viraivileye avaraik kaidhuseyyavumirukkiraargal. Vishayam adhuvalla... Andha magesh pinnaniyil irukkum ucha kaavaldhurai adhigaaridhaan vivagaarame. ‘andha adhigaariyin perum lanjja panathaik kaiyaandavardhaan magesh. Laas vegaas soodhaatta kilappugalil mudhaleedu seyyappattirukkiradhu andhap panam. Magesh kaidhuseyyappattu visaarikkappattaal, thaambarathukkuk kizhakke thookkiyadikkappattirukkum andha adhigaariyum vasamaagas sikkikkolvaar’ engiraargal seeniyar kaakkigal.”
“sikkattum... Sikkattum...”
“thanneerthurai ucha adhigaari patriyum oru thagaval vandhirukkiradhu. Nermaiyaanavardhaan endraalum, vadagizhakkup paruvamazhai thodangavirukkum nilaiyilumgooda, maanilam muzhuvadhum neernilaigalaith thoorvaaravum, neernilaigalin karaigalai valuppaduthavum endhavoru nadavadikkaiyaiyum avar thodangavillaiyaam. Aagast maadhame maavatta adhigaarigaludan nadandhirukka vendiya aayvuk koottam idhuvarai nadakkavillai. Idaitherdhal pisiyil ‘magizhchi’ maanbumigu kottai pakkame varaadhadhaal, adhigaarigal thangal ishdathukku aadugiraargalaam.”
“minsaarathuraiyil adhigaarigal pugaiyaik kakkugiraargale?”
“indha maadham oyvuveravirukkum mootha ai.e.es adhigaari raadhaagirushnanai, minsaara ozhungumurai aanaiyathin thalaivaraaga niyamithirukkiradhu Thamizhaga arasu. ‘oyvuveruvavargalaiye niyamithaal, naangal endraikkuthaan poruppukku varuvadhu...’ endra pugaichalaik kakkugiraargal thuraiyilulla seeniyar adhigaarigal. ‘visvaroovamedukkum minvettu pirasnaiyais samaalikkave seeniyar ai.e.es adhigaariyaik kondu vandhom’ endru aatchiyaalargal sollum kaaranangalai adhigaarigal erka marukkiraargalaam.”
“mm...”
“piravala thozhiladhivar segar rettiyin kaatbaadi veettilirundha, sumaar 4 kodi roobai madhippilaana 2.5 kilo thangakkattigalum, 10 latcham roobai rokkap panamum kollaivoyvittanavaam. Thanadhu selvaakkaip payanbaduthi, virudhambattu poleesaarai mudukkivittu, kollaiyil eeduvatta iruvarai ore naalil pidithu, avargalidamirundhu thangathaiyum, panathaiyum meettuvittaaraam segar retti. Poleesaar, ‘evvalavu panam, nagai enak kettavodhu, adharkellaam endhak kanakkum ennidam illai’ endru sonnadhodu, varumaana varithurai pirasnai varum enbadhaal, vazhakku edhuvum padhindhuvidaamal paarthukkondaaraam.”
“tha.ve.ka aatchiyil rettigal raajjiyamdhaan...”
“idhuvum rettigal sambandhappatta seythidhaan. ‘taasmaakkaith thaniyaar vasam oppadaikka vendum’ ena mudhalvar tharappukku aalosanaiyaagas sollappattuk kondeyirukkiradhaam. ‘naama en kadaiyai nadathanum... Thaniyaarkitta kuduthuttaa pengalkitta namakku aadharavu perugum...’ ena mudhalvarukku nerukkamaana rettigal aidiyaa kodukkiraargalaam. Aanaal, ‘arasukkuk karumbulliyaagividum. Kallachaaraayap puzhakkam adhigarikkum avaayangal irukkindrana. Kavanamaagak kaaynagarthungal...’ ena echarikkiraargal seeniyar adhigaarigal.”
“adhu sari... Nadigaigal ambigaa - raadhaa idaiye pirasnai aagiyirukkiradhe... Enna vivagaaram?”
“thannudaiya aindhu kaasolaigalaith thirudi, than kanakkilirundhu 49.8 kodi roovaayai ambigaa edukka muyandradhaagak kutramsaattiyirukkiraar raadhaa. Kadandha sila varudangalaagave akkaa, thangaikkidaiye sumugamaana uravu illaiyaam. Kudumbas sothugalaip pirithadhil kadum karuthu veruvaadu engiraargal. Chennai valasaravaakkathilulla piravala shootting sbaattaana ‘e.aar.es kaardan’ thanakkus sondham engiraar raadhaa. Aanaal, andha stoodiyo thodarbaaga vazhakku niluvaiyil iruppadhaagas solgiradhu raadhaavin sagodhararaana malligaarjun tharappu. Indha malligaarjunum ambigaavum serndhu kondudhaan than panathai mosadi seyya muyalgiraargal enbadhu raadhaavin kutrachaattu. Aanaal, adhai mutrilum maruthu kachaigattugiraaraam ambigaa. Panjjaayathu mutri veedhikku vandhirukkiradhu...” endruvittuk kilamba aayathamaana kazhugaar,
“sudhandhirap poraatta veerarin peyargonda, thoongaa nagarathais serndha TVK maavattas seyalaalar oruvar, thiruttu manal ottuvadhil thinamum pala latcham roobai kollaiyadikkiraaraam. Thinamum 200 laarigal avarukku odugindranavaam. Eriyaa maanbumiguvin peyaraith thavaraagap payanbaduthi, adanga maruppadhaal, sondhak katchikkaarargale seyvadhariyaamal thavikkiraargal. Aatchi melidam ushaaraagavillaiyendraal, peyar ripperaagividum” endruvittu siragugalai virithaar.

headline: Karooril pirasaara vaaganathin laittai aan-aap seythu vilaiyaadiya Vijay endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Karooril 41 per uyirizhappukkuk kaaranamaana Vijay-yin pirasaara koottathil, vaaganathil laittai aan, aap seythu vilaiyaadiya Vijay endru oru padhivu

nadigar Vijay pirasaara vaaganathirkul min vilakkugalai aan, aap seythavodhu rasigargal utsaagamaagum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Indha video-vai vimarsithu rasigargalin utsaagathaik kandu nadigar Vijay rasikkum seyalai vimarsithu oruvar pesugiraar. Yaar idhai koorinaargal endru illai.
Nilaith thagavalil, “karooril nadandha pirachaara vaaganathil Light On/ Off seythu vilaiyaadiya nadigar Vijay
rasigargalin aaravaarathai anu anuvaaga rasithup paartha magizhndha arasiyalvaadhi vijay” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
TVK thalaivar Vijay karooril pirasaaram seyya sendra podhu kootta nerisalil sikki 41 per uyirizhandhanar. Kootta nerisalukku Police sariyaana paadhugaappu alikkaadhadhu, sonna nerathirku padhil migath thaamadhamaaga Vijay vandhadhu, pagalilirundhu unavu, thanneer indri avaradhu katchith thondargal, rasigargal kaathirundhadhu endru palveru kaaranangal koorappadugindrana. Indha nilaiyil makkal mayangi vizhundhu irandhu kondirundha podhu pirasaara vaaganathil min vilakkugalai on/off seythu vilaiyaadiya Vijay endru kurippittu silar samooga oodagangalil video-vai padhivittu varugindranar.
Vijay pirasaara payanam thodangiya podhu perambalooril pirasaara vaaganathirku ulle vilakkugalai aan, aap seythu rasigargalai utsaagappaduthinaar. Andha video-vai karooril nadandhadhaagas silar padhivittu varugindranar.
Vilakkugalai aan, aap seytha seyalai palarum vimarsithirundhanar. Andha nerathil Vijay amarndhirundha nilai, rasigargalai avar paartha vidhathai vaithu Vijay-yin mananilaiyaip palarum vimarsithirundhanar. Karooril nadandhadhaaga kurippidavillai. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivilo indha seyal karoor pirasaara koottathil endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
News 18 veliyittirundha video-vai adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalil irundhu eduthom. Sepdambar 14, 2025 andru andha video-vai news 18 veliyittirundhadhu. Karoor pirasaaramo sepdambar 27, 2025 andru nadandhadhu. Adhaavadhu, laittai aan, aap seythu vilaiyaadiyadharku irandu vaarangal kazhithuthaan karoor koottame nadandhulladhu. Idhan moolam indha video 41 per uyirizhandha karoor sambavathin podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Thadagalathil thangam
text:

headline: Vinaayaga sadhurthi vizhaa -------------------- hindhu munnaniyinar kaappanindhu viradham thuvakkam
text:
Tiruppur :vinaayagar sadhurthiyaiyotti, hindhu munnaniyinar kaappanindhu viradhathai thodanginar.
Vinaayagar sadhurthi varum, 14-m thedhi kondaadappadugiradhu. Idhanaiyotti, hindhu munnani saarbil Tiruppur maanagaril 1,008 silaigal ulbada maavattam muzhuvadhum 5 aayiram vinaayagar silaigalai piradhishdai seythu vazhivaadu nadatha erpaadugal seyyappattu varugindrana. Idhan oru pagudhiyaaga, Tiruppur velliyangaadu muthaiyan kovilil netru maalai kaappanindhu viradham thodangum nigazhchi nadandhadhu. Maanila thalaivar kaadesvaraa supramaniyam thalaimaiyil, maanila podhucheyalaalar kishorgumaar, maanila seyalaalar thaamu vengadeshvaran ullitta nirvaagigal pangetranar. Pudhiya bus staant edhire ulla kottai eesvaran kovililum nirvaagigal maalai anindhu kaappanindhu viradhathai thuvanginar.

headline: TVK thondargal thaaylaandhil piravala yoodiyoovar meedhu kaalani veesinaargalaa?
text:
Amoikka yoodiyoovar IShowSpeed taaran jesan vaatkinsan jooniyar (Darren Jason Watkins Jr) meedhu Thamizhaga vetrikkazhagath thondargal kaalanigalai veesiyadhaaga oru video

kaaril sendru kondirundha amoikka yoodiyoovar IShowSpeed taaran jesan vaatkinsan jooniyar meedhu mottaar paikkil TVK endru kathikkonde vandha oruvar kaalanigalai veesiyadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “
indhaa innonnu 😂 #thalavidhige” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Amoikka yoodiyoovar IShowSpeed taaran jesan vaatkinsan jooniyar thaaylaandhil oru kaaril sendru kondirundhaar. Adhai avar YouTube-il neradi olivarappum seythu kondirundhaar. Appodhu mottaar saikkilil vandha silar TVK, TVK endru kathiyadhu thodarbaana kaatchi samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga paraviyadhu.
Indha nilaiyil, yoodiyoovar meedhu TVK endru kathiyavargal kaalanigalai veesiyadhaaga silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Melum, TVK endraal enna endru yoodiyoovar ketka thalavadhi Vijay, seep ministar aap India endru kooruvadhu pondru irundhadhu. Indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
IShowSpeed YouTube-il veliyittirundha live streems video-vai paarthom. Video-vin oru mani neram 38vadhu nimidam 40vadhu vinaadiyildhaan kaarukkul kaalani veesum kaatchi varugiradhu. Neela nira teeshart anindha ilainjar oruvar kaalanigalai veesugiraar. Adhan piragu 1:39:06 mani nerathil thamizh ilainjargal iruvar mottaar paikkil vandhu yoodiyoovarukku kai kodukkindranar.
Appodhu kaalanigalai veesiya navar angu vandhu thaandhaan kaalanigalai veesiyadhaaga vandhu pesugiraar. Neela nira teeshart anindhirundha andha ilainjarai paarkka indhiyar pola illai. Aaprikka amerikkar pola ullaar. Melum, avar andha kaalaniyil IShowSpeed-n aattogiraap vaangikkondu, sendruvidugiraar. Avar endha idathilum TVK, Vijay endrellaam kooravillai.
Video-vin 1:39:29vadhu mani nerathil thaan thamizh ilainjargal TVK endru kathugindranar. TVK endraal enna endru ketka, thalavadhi Vijay, thennindhiya nadigar, India-vin mudhalamaichar endrellaam koorugindranar. TVK endru avargal kathikkondu paikkil vandha kaatchi mattum thaniyaaga eduthu Vijay rasigargal palarum samooga oodagangalil video veliyittullanar. Andha video appadiye yoodiyoovar veliyittirundha live streem kaatchiyudan othirundhadhu. Aanaal, kaalani veesivittu TVK endru kathiya pagudhi illai. Idhan moolam indha video edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
America yoodiyoovar thaaylaandhil payanam merkonda podhu irandu per TVK endru kathiyullanar. Adhe nerathil veru oruvar kaalanigalai avar meedhu pottu adhil kaiyezhuthu pottu tharumbadi kettullaar. Indha irandu nigazhvugalin aadiyovai mattum satru edit seythu yoodiyoovar meedhu kaalani veesiyadhu pondru video-vai poliyaaga uruvaakki samooga oodagangalil padhivittulladhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video edit seyyappattadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Veru vazhiyindri BJP-yudan koottani vaithen endru Edappadi Palaniswami koorinaaraa?
text:
‘’kaalai virithen, kolvaar illai enbadhai pola ADMK-yudan koottani vaikka matra katchigal thayaar illai. Enavedhaan veruvazhiyindri BJP-yudan koottani vaithen,’’ endru Edappadi Palaniswami kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ kaalai virithen, kolvaar illai enbadhai pola ADMK-yudan koottanikku vara matra katchigal thayaar illai. Enavedhaan veruvazhiyindri BJP-yudan koottani vaithen. Aangila naalidhazhukku Edappadi Palaniswami petti,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Polimer News logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami, BJP-yudan koottani vaippadhaaga, sameevathil therivithaar. Idhanbadi, 2026m aandu nadaivera ulla Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhalil, adhimuga- BJP katchigal koottani amaithu, pottiyida ullana. Adhesamayam, melum sila arasiyal katchigal indha koottaniyil inaiya ulladhaagavum, maruvuram indha koottani eppodhu vendumaanaalum udaiyakkoodum enavum vimarsikkappadugiradhu.
BBC Tamil l ETV Bharat l DD Tamil News
innilaiyil, ADMK-yudan koottanikku vara matra katchigal thayaar illai. Enavedhaan veruvazhiyindri BJP-yudan koottani vaithen, endru Edappadi Palaniswami kooriyadhaagak kurippittu, samooga valaidhalangalil oru news card-ai silar parappugindranar.
Aanaal, idhu unmaiyaana news card kidaiyaadhu. Polimer News veliyitta veroru news card-ai eduthu, edit seythe ivvaaru vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Idhanbadi, Polimer News veliyitta unmaiyaana news card-il, ‘’thani mejaarittiyudan.. Thamizhagathil thanikkatchi aatchi amaivadhaiye makkal edhirbaarkkindranar. Thani mejaarittiyudan vetri petru ADMK aatchi amaikkum – i.pi.es ,’’ endrudhaan ezhudhappattulladhu.
Unmaiyaana news kaardaiyum, poliyaana news kaardaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, Polimer news aasiriyar kuzhu, ADMK ai.ti.pirivu tharappilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda niyoosgaardu, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Sek mosadi vazhakku: PMK, maaji seyalaalarukku sirai roo.6 latcham vazhangavum utharavu
text:
Tirunelveli: roo.6 latcham kaasolai mosadi vazhakkil Tirunelveli PMK, munnaal maavatta seyalaalar karuppasaamikku 6 maadham sirai thandanai vidhithu Needhimandram theerppalithadhu.
Thirunelveliyais serndha karuppasaami thozhil aviviruthikkaaga 2022l poyyaaliyidam roo.6 latcham kadan vaanginaar.
Adharku vatti seluthi vandhavar, pin panathai thiruppi seluthavillai. Avar 2023 joolai 30l roo.6 latchathukkaana kaasolaiyai vazhanginaar.
Andha kaasolaiyai poyyaali vangiyil seluthiyavodhu, podhiya panamindri thirumbiyadhu. Idhanaal needhimandrathil karuppasaami meedhu poyyaali vazhakku thodarndhaar.
Needhivadhi pon melisaa, karuppasaamikku 6 maadham saadhaarana sirai thandanai vidhithaar. Paadhikkappattavarukku roo.6 latchathai 2 maadhangalukkul izhappeedaaga vazhangavum utharavittaar. Adhanai vazhangath thavarinaal koodudhalaaga oru maadham sirai thandanai anuvavikkavum needhivadhi utharavittaar. Melmuraiyeedu seyyum vagaiyil ak.,17 varai thandanai niruthi vaikkappattadhu.

headline: Madurai: palluyir paadhugaappu vizhippunarvu; 500 maanavargal inaindhu uruvaakkiya ‘manidha pattaamboochi’
text:
Madurai amerikkan kallooriyil pattaam poochi maadham endra peyaril palluyir paadhugaappu vizhippunarvu nigazhchi nadaivetradhu.
Madurai amerikkan kallooriyil ilangalai pattappadippu matrum pasumai melaanmaith thittam saarbil ‘pattaamboochi maadham’ endra peyaril, palluyir paadhugaappu vizhippunarvu nigazhchi nadaivetradhu.
Kalloori vilaiyaattu maidhaanathil nadaivetra indha nigazhvil sumaar 500 maanavargal pangetru ‘manidha pattaamboochi’ vadivathai uruvaakkinar. ‘palar – ore nokkam – pasumaiyaana edhirgaalam’ endra karuthai maiyamaagak kondu, palluyir matrum sutruchoozhal paadhugaappin avasiyam valiyuruthappattadhu.
Kallooriyil amaikkappattulla pattaamboochi thottathirku aandudhorum palveru vagaiyaana pattaamboochigal varuvadhaagath therivithanar. Kurippaaga megamalai pagudhigalil irundhu pattaamboochigal vandhu sila kaalam thangi pinnar veru pagudhigalukku idambeyarvadhaagavum, ingu sumaar 45 vagaiyaana pattaamboochigal kaanappaduvadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu.
Idhanai kaana ulnaattu matrum velinaattu sutrulaap payanigalum varugai tharugindranar.
Pattaamboochigalin soozhaliyal mukkiyathuvam, magarandhas serkkaiyil avatrin pangu, iyarkai valangal matrum palluyirgalai paadhugaappadhan avasiyam kurithu maanavargalukku vizhippunarvu erpaduthappattadhu.
Nigazhchikku amerikkan kalloori mudhalvarum seyalarumaana doctor je. Paal jeyagar thalaimai vagithaar. Thitta orunginaippaalar doctor em.pijoolaa kumaal, iyakkunar doctor pi.vellaithurai, pasumai melaanmaith thitta orunginaippaalar em.raajesh ullittor kalandhu kondanar.

headline: ‘thavaaga’ thalaivar velmurugan meedhu Police thadiyadi endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:
‘’Thamizhaga vaazhvurimaik katchith thalaivar velmurugan meedhu Police thadiyadi,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ sattathai meeriya thalaivarai kavanitha kaavaldhurai… vaazhthukkal Thamizhaga kaavaldhuraikku..,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu. Adhil, Thamizhaga vaazhvurimaik katchi (thavaaga) thalaivar velmurugan ullittor meedhu Police thadiyadi nadathuvadhu pondra kaatchigal idambetrullana.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video kadandha 2015m aandu edukkappattadhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
One India Tamil l Hindu Tamil l Vikatan l DVK Periyar
kadandha 2015m aandu Nellai maavattam, kangaigondaan sipgaat valaagathil Thamizhaga vaazhvurimaik katchiyin thalaivar velmurugan thalaimaiyil, pannaattu kulirbaana aalaigal munbaaga aarppaattam nadaivetradhu. Adhil kalandhugonda munnaal sattamandra uruppinar kaaveri ulbada palar, kaavaldhuraiyaal thaakkappattanar. Idhuvatri erkanave palveru oodagangalilum seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
Idhudhodarbaana video-vai eduthu, pudhiyadhu pondru thagaval parappugiraargal. Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, Thamizhaga vaazhvurimaik katchiyin aluvalagathil pesi, idhu 2015m aandu appodhaiya ADMK aatchiyil edukkappatta video endru, urudhippaduthiyullom. Idharkum, tharpodhaiya DMK aatchikkum thodarbillai.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video 2015m aandu padhivu seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vijay: "sinimaavildhaan Vijay heero; nijathil avar villan" - ti.ti.vi. Thinagaran kaattam
text:
"katchikkum, thogudhi makkalukkum thurogam seythu vittu sendraargal. Adhanaal, idaitherdhal nadathappadugiradhu. Idhil, ADMK vetbaalargal vetri pera paaduvaduvom" endru ti.ti.thinagaran theruvithullaar.
A.ma.mu.ka podhucheyalaalar ti.ti.vi.thinagaran thiruchiyil seythiyaalargalais sandhithu pesinaar.
Appodhu avar, "katchikkum, thogudhi makkalukkum thurogam seythu vittu sendraargal. Adhanaal, idaitherdhal nadathappadugiradhu. Idhil, ADMK vetbaalargal vetri pera paaduvaduvom. Vilaivaasi vinnaimuttum alavirku uyarndhulladhu. Indha arasu immature arasaaga ulladhu.
Maatram vendum enbadharkaagath thavaraana arasaangathai makkal therndheduthu vittom enath tharpodhu varuthappadugiraargal. Vijay arasu irunda arasaaga ulladhu. Avaradhu velinaattup payanam kooda maraimugamaaga vaikkappattulladhu. Chennai-yil pokkuvarathu nerisal migundha pagudhiyil, meenavargalin vaazhvaadhaarathaip paadhikkum vagaiyil, thalaimais seyalagam katta mudiveduthullaargal.
Thuklak paaniyil indha aatchi sendru kondulladhu. Makkal idhanai unarath thodangi vittaargal. Nichayam idharku oru uriya theerppu vazhanguvaargal. Sattamandrathil mudhalvar Vijay tharam thaazhndhu pesugiraar. TVK aatchi amaiya aadharavalitha katchiyinar tharpodhu varuthappaduvaargal.
Avar tharam avvalavudhaan enbadhai velippaduthi ullaar. Matravargal pesinaal kaidhu seygiraargal. Misaa sattam enbadhu indhiraa kaandhi kondu vandha miga mosamaana nadavadikkai. Adhil, Stalin utbada palar siraikkus sendraargal. Siraikkus sendravargalai kaavaldhuraiyinar thaakkinaargal. Adhaip pazhithu kaattum vagaiyil Vijay pesi ullaar.
Sinimaavildhaan Vijay heero. Nijathil avar villan enbadhu avar pesuvadhilum, avar udal mozhiyilum therigiradhu. Than suyanalathirkaaga avar yaaraiyum palikkoduppaar. Aatchiyai eppadi nadatha vendum enbadhu avargalukkuth theriyavillai. Nel kolmudhal seyya mudiyaamal indha arasu ulladhu. Endhath thuraiyilum valarchi kodukka vendum engira thittam avargalidam illai.
Thittangalai vagukkakkoodiya podhiya arivum avargalidam illai. Madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram makkal adhimuga-virku erkanave aadharavu alithaargal. Thamizhnaattu makkal vizhippunarvu ullavargal. Idaitherdhalil TVK arasirku avargal thakka paadam pugattuvaargal. ADMK-vil a.ma.mu.ka inaiya ulladhu engira seythiyil thuliyum unmaiyillai.
Ilavu kaatha kili pol naan endhap padhaviyaiyum edhirbaarthu kaathirukkavillai. Tha.ve.ka-vai kooraiyil etri vittullaargal. Vijayyai piradhamar enak kooruvadhu vaanam eri vaigundam selven enak kooruvadhu. Sirippaagathaan ulladhu. Idaitherdhalil podhu vetbaalarai niruthuvadhu nalla yosanaidhaan. Idhu kurithu koottanith thalaimaiyidam pesuven. Avargaldhaam mudivu eduppaargal" endraar.

headline: Merku vangathil kalavaram seyyum islaamiya payangaravaadhigal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:

headline: Nidhi nerukkadiyil thiruvallikkeni kootturavu sangam ... Thinaral! :nirvaaga kularuvadiyaal nirandhara tivaasittil kaivaippu
text:

Chennai: palborul angaadigalil virpanaiyai adhigarikka nadavadikkai 
edukkaadhadhu, arasu thuraigal kolmudhalukkaana pala kodi roovaayai vazhangaamal paakki 
vaithadhu, nirvaaga kularuvadi ullitta kaaranangalaal, Chennai-yil 
paarambariyamikka thiruvallikkeni nagara kootturavu kadan sangam, nidhi 
nerukkadiyil sikki thinari varugiradhu. Paniyaalargal sambalam ullitta 
nirvaaga selavugalukkaaga, nirandhara vaippu nidhiyil irundhu panam edukkum 
nilaikku sangam thallappattulladhu.
Thamizhaga arasin
 kootturavu thuraiyin keezh, thiruvallikkeniyil, ti.yu.si.es., enappadum 
thiruvallikkeni nagara kootturavu sangam seyalbattu varugiradhu. Idhu, kootturavu
 thuraiyil ulla sangangalil pazhamaiyaana matrum paarambariyamaana sangamaaga 
thigazhgiradhu.
Indha sangathirku, thiruvallikkeni, 
keezhppaakkam, thenaambettai, aar.e.puram, raayappettai aagiya idangalil 
aindhu palborul angaadigal ullana. Melum, 251 reshan kadaigal, 12 kaas 
ejansigal, aindhu pannai pasumai kaaygari kadaigal, 11 marundhagangal, moondru 
petrol 'pangk'kugal, moondru thirumana mandavangal ullana.
Indha sangam, kootturavu inai padhivaalaraana melaan iyakkunarin keezh seyalbattu varugiradhu.
Sameevagaalamaaga sangathin palborul angaadigal pondravatril virpanai peridhum paadhikkappattu varuvadhaaga, kutrachaattugal ezhundhullana.
Virpanai sarivu
 idhugurithu, ti.yu.si.es., paniyaalargal kooriyadhaavadhu:
thiruvallikkeni kootturavu sangam vaayilaaga aandukku, 300 kodi roovaaykku
 virpanai nadandhadhu. Kurippaaga, palborul angaadigalil mattum maadhathirku,
 2.50 kodi roovaaykku virpanai nadandhadhu.
Podhumakkal mattumindri, 
arasu maruthuvamanaigal, arasu vidudhigal, kovilgal, 'ammaa' unavagangal, 
siraichaalaigal ena palveru tharappinar vaadikkai yaa largalaaga ullanar.
Ti.yu.si.es., nirvaagathirku thani adhigaari niyamikkappadaamal, 'tenbet'
 enappadum kootturavu virpanai inaiyathil ulla adhigaari, muzhu nera koodudhal 
poruppaalaraaga niyamikkappattu ullaar.
Palborul angaadigalil 
virpanai kuraindhu varugiradhu. Thaniyaar angaadigalil vaadikkaiyaalargalai eerkka 
pala vagaiyaana porutkal, veettirku neradi telivari ena, pala salugaigaludan 
virkappadugiradhu.
Adharku erpa, virpanaiyai adhigarikka nadavadikkai 
edukkaadhadhu ullitta kaaranangalaal, palborul angaadigalil kadandha maadha 
virpanai, 25 latcham roobaayaaga kuraindhulladhu. Idhevol, ovvoru pirivilum 
virpanai paadhikkappattu varugiradhu.
'pil' thaamadham
idhanaal 
paniyaalargal sambalam ullitta nirvaaga selavu kalukkaaga, vangigalil nirandhara 
vaippu nidhiyaaga vaikkappatta, 28 kodi roovaayil, aindhu kodi roobai 
edukkappattulladhu.
Melum, maligai ullitta porutkalai viniyogam 
seythadharku, 'pil' anuppa thaamadham aavadhaal, Chennai maanagaraatchi, siraichaalai 
nirvaagangalidam irundhu kodikkanakkil vara vendiya panam varaamal ulladhu.
'ammaa' unavagangalukku porutkalai vaangiya vagaiyil, Chennai maanagaraatchi, 10 
kodi roovaaykku mel paakki vaithulladhu. Melum, 20 kodi roovaaykku 
melaana porutkalai maanagaraatchikku koduthum, nirvaaga kularuvadigalaal, 
adharkaana 'pil'lai kootturavu sangam innum anuppaamal ulladhaagavum 
koorappadugiradhu.
Idhenilai thodarndhaal, sangam nidhi nerukkadiyil 
sikki kollum avaayam ulladhu. Enave, arasu thani kuzhuvai amaithu, 
ti.yu.si.es., nirvaagathil virpanai kuraivirkaana kaaranam ullittavai 
thodarbaaga visaarithu, sangathin viyaavaara nadavadikkaigalai mudukkivida 
vendum.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: ”Red-Light Area-vuladhaan adhiga ottu vandhuchu" - enna kaaranam theriyumaa? Nidhin katkari paravarappu pechu!
text:
Naakbooril paditha makkal vaazhum vasadhiyaana pagudhigalil thanakku 70% mudhal 75% vaakkugal kidaippadhaagavum, adhe nerathil kutrap pinnani matrum sivappu vilakku pagudhigal ulla idangalil 92% vaakkugal kidaippadhaagavum mathiya amaichar nidhin katkari therivithullaar.
Mathiya BJP arasil saalaip pokkuvarathu matrum nedunjjaalaith thurai amaicharaaga iruppavar, nidhin katkari. Indha nilaiyil kadandha sepdambar 6aam thedhi raajasdhaan maanilam naakbooril nadaivetra oodaga maanaattil kalandhugondu pesinaar. Appodhu avar, naakbooril paditha makkal vaazhum vasadhiyaana pagudhigalil thanakku 70% mudhal 75% vaakkugal kidaippadhaagavum, adhe nerathil kutrap pinnani matrum sivappu vilakkup pagudhigal ulla idangalil 92% vaakkugal kidaippadhaagavum avar therivithaar. Adharkaana kaaranathai vilakkiya avar, "naan arasiyalil nallavai, kettavai ena anaithaiyum parisodhithup paarthuvitten. Indhap pullivivarangal thanakkum kutrap pinnani kondavargalukkum idaiye thanippatta thodarbo alladhu avargalin nadavadikkaigalukku aadharavo iruppadhaagap porul kollak koodaadhu.
Appagudhigalil thaan merkonda saalai kattamaippu, utkattamaippu vasadhigal matrum samooga nalathittangal kaaranamaagave angulla makkalin nambikkaiyaip petru adhiga vaakkugalaip pera mudindhadhu” enath thelivuvaduthinaar. Melum avar, ”vaakkaalargal migavum puthisaaligal. Avargal ilavasangalaip petrukkondaalum, thangalukku yaar unmaiyaaga velai seyvaargal enbadhaip purindhu kondudhaan vaakkalippaargal” endravar, kadandha kaalathil therdhalil pottiyittavodhu vaakkaalargalukku thalaa 1 kilo aattiraichi vazhangiyadhaagavum, aanaal andhath therdhalil thaan tholviyadaindhadhaagavum avar ninaivugoorndhaar. Sila naatkalukku munbu matroru nigazhvil pesiya katkari, "ennaal ini pazhaiyavadi theeviramaagap paniyaatra mudiyaadhu. Poruppugalaip pudhiya thalaimuraiyinaridam oppadaikka vendum” enath therivithirundhadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

text:

investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu arasiyal ulnokkathudan vendumendre edit seythu, pagirappadum pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu.

Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, DMK aidi pirivu tharappilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Idhanmoolamaaga, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: DMK aatchiyil thenmandalak kuzhu koottathil thamizh purakkanikkappattadhaa?
text:
DMK aatchiyil nadaivetra thenmandalak kuzhu koottathil thamizh purakkanikkappattadhaagavum, aanaal TVK aatchiyil nadaivetra koottathil thamizhukku mukkiyathuvam alikkappattadhaagavum koori oru pugaippadam samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Thagavalin vivaram
M.K. Stalin pangetra thenmandalak kuzhu koottathin pugaippadathaiyum, mudhalvar Vijay pangetradhaagak koorappadum thenmandalak kuzhu koottathin pugaippadathaiyum ondraaga inaithu Facebook-il padhivu ondru pagirappattulladhu.
Andhap padhivil, “en taa, neengadhaana thamizhla kizhichennu sonneenga” endru kurippidappattulladhu. Indhap padhivu samooga oodagangalil palaraal pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Unmai arivom
sameevathil Chennai aruge maamallavurathil thenmandalak kuzhuvin 31vadhu koottam mathiya uldhurai amaichar amith shaa thalaimaiyil nadaivetradhu. Idhil Tamil Nadu, aandhirap piradhesam, keralaa matrum pudhucheri maanilangalin piradhinidhigal pangetranar. Indhak koottathukkaaga vaikkappattirundha penaril thamizhil “then mandalak kuzhuvin 31vadhu koottam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhai TVK arasin saadhanaiyaagak kurippittu palar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Idharku maaraaga, 2022aam aandu nadaivetra thenmandalak kuzhuvin 30vadhu koottathil thamizhil peyar idamberavillai endrum, andhak koottathil Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin pangetrirundhaar endrum koori, “thamizhukkaaga neengal seytha saadhanai idhudhaanaa?” endra vimarsanangalum munvaikkappattu varugindrana. Indhak kootrin unmaith thanmai kurithu aayvu seythom.
Thenmandalak kuzhuk koottathai mathiya uldhurai amaichagathin keezh seyalbadum maanilangalukku idaiyeyaana kavunsil seyalagam orunginaithu nadathugiradhu. Koottam nadaiverum maanila arasu idharkaana erpaadugalil othuzhaikkiradhu. Melum, thenmandalak kuzhuvin uruppu maanilangalin mudhalamaichargal suzhatsi muraiyil thunaith thalaivargalaaga seyalbadugindranar. Koottathai nadathum poruppum avaradhu maanilathukku vazhangappadugiradhu.
Thenmandalak kuzhuvin 30vadhu koottam 2022aam aandu sepdambar 3aam thedhi kerala maanilam thiruvanandhavurathil nadaivetradhu. Appodhu, keralaavin aatchi mozhiyaana malaiyaalam idamberaamal, indhi matrum aangilathil mattume penar vaikkappattirundhadhu. Andhak koottam keralaavil nadaivetra nilaiyil, koottathukkaana adhigaarappoorva penar matrum nigazhvu erpaadugalil Tamil Nadu arasukku neradi kattuppaadu irundhadhaagak koora mudiyaadhu. Enave, angu thamizhil penar vaikkappadaadhadharku appodhu Tamil Nadu mudhalamaicharaaga irundha mu.ka.staalinai neradiyaagap poruppaakkuvadhu poruthamaanadhalla. Melum, 2022aam aandu keralaavil nadaivetra koottathil andha maanilathin aatchi mozhiyaana malaiyaalame penaril idamberaadha nilaiyil, thamizhil peyar idamberavillai enbadhaik kurippittu Tamil Nadu arasai mattum vimarsippadhum poruthamaana oppeedu alla.
Maaraaga, 2026aam aandu koottam Tamil Naattil nadaivetradhu. Indha murai thenmandalak kuzhuvin thunaith thalaivaraaga Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar ullaar. Koottam nadaiverum maanilamaaga Tamil Nadu irundhadhaal, nigazhvukkaana erpaadugalil Tamil Nadu arasin pangalippum irundhulladhu. Koottathai Tamil Nadu arasu erpaadu seythadhu endru mathiya arasu seythikkurippil therivikkappattulladhu. Innilaiyil, Tamil Naattil nadaivetra koottathin penaril thamizh idambetriruppadhu iyalbaanadhaagum.
Enave, Tamil Naattil nadaivetra koottathil thamizhukku idam alikkappattiruppadhai mattum vaithu, idhai mundhaiya aatchiyudan oppittu arasiyal saadhanaiyaagak kooruvadhu sariyaana anugumurai alla. Kurippaaga, penaril thamizh idambetriruppadhai mattum adippadaiyaagak kondu adhai TVK arasin thanippatta saadhanai endru kooruvadharkum podhumaana aadhaaram illai.
Oruvelai M.K. Stalin pangetra koottame Tamil Naattil nadaivetrum, adharkaana adhigaarappoorva penaril thamizh thavirkkappattirundhaal, adhanai adippadaiyaagak kondu iru aatchigalaiyum oppiduvadhu niyaayamaanadhaaga irundhirukkum. Aanaal, 2022aam aandu koottam keralaavil nadaivetradhu; 2026aam aandu koottam Tamil Naattil nadaivetradhu.
Enave, iru koottangalin pugaippadangalai mattum vaithu “thi.mu.ka. Aatchiyil thamizh purakkanikkappattadhu; TVK aatchiyil thamizhukku mukkiyathuvam alikkappattadhu” endru kooruvadhu thavaraana oppeedaagum.
2022aam aandu koottam keralaavil nadaivetra nilaiyil, 2026aam aandu koottam Tamil Naattil nadaivetradhu enbadhaik karuthil kollaamal iru pugaippadangalaiyum oppittu arasiyal reedhiyaana mudivukku varuvadhu sariyalla. Enave, aayvukku eduthukkonda samooga oodagap padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu.
