headline: Chennai-yil mazhai vellam endru paravum video 2025l edukkappattadhaa?
text:
Chennai-yil roo.4000m kodi odhukkiyum mazhai neer thengiyulladhu endru oru video

mazhai neer thengi nirkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “odhukkappatta nidhiyai thangal veettukku odhukki kondadhaal indha nilai… theervu undaa meendum DMK aatchikku vandhaal… #4000kodi_ennaachu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Chennai-yil roo.4000m kodi selavu seythum mazhai neer thengi varugiradhu endru palarum DMK arasai vimarsithu video padhivugalai samooga oodagangalil veliyittu varugindranar. Ippadi veliyaagum sila video-kkal thamizhnaattais saarndhadhaaga iruppadhu illai. Sila samayam DMK aatchikku mundhaiya veediyokkalai ellaam vairalaakkum pokku ulladhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2020m aandu indha video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. ADMK aatchik kaalathil mazhai neer vadigaal amaikka odhukkappatta nidhiyai ADMK nirvaagigal thangal veettukku odhukkik kondadhaal Chennai-yil mazhai vellam erpattadhaaga 2020 akdovar 29m thedhi X thalathil oruvar indha video-vai padhivittirundhaar.
2011m aandu me mudhal 2021 me mudhal vaaram varai Tamil Naattin aatchip poruppil a.thi.mu.ka-thaan irundhadhu. Adhilum 2020m aandu Edappadi Palaniswami Tamil Naattin mudhalamaicharaaga irundhaar. 2021 me maadham thaan Tamil Naattin mudhalamaicharaaga M.K. Stalin poruppetraar. Enave, 2020m aandu erpatta vellathirkum 2021l poruppukku vandha DMK arasukkum thodarbillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu Chennai thiruvallikkeniyil indha video edukkappattadhaaga veliyaana YouTube padhivu ondru kidaithadhu. Adhuvum 2020m aandu YouTube-il padhividappattirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
ADMK aatchikkaalathil mazhai neer vadigaal sariyaaga amaithirundhaal vellam erpattirukkaadhu endru veliyaana video-vai DMK aatchiyil mazhai vellam endru thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaanadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Avvalavudhaan.. Inime indha ponil WhatsApp iyangaadhu.. Mettaa arivippu!
text:
Aantraaydu 6.0-kkum kuraivaana iyangudhalangalil (OS) iyangum smaartbongalil, varum sepdambar 8-aam thedhi mudhal WhatsApp sevai niruthappadum endru mettaa niruvanam arivithulladhu. Idhanaal aivon payanargalukku endha paadhippum illai. Indha maatram aantraaydu payanargalai mattume paadhikkiradhu. Aivongal matrum aivedugal paadhikkappadaadhu.
Selbongalil vaats ap enum seyali indriyamaiyaadhadhaaga ulladhu. Idhanmoolam tekst mesejgal, audio matrum video kaalgal, uraiyaadum vasadhi enap pala vasadhigal ullana. Melum ivai thavira, vaadikkaiyaalargalai eerkka vaats ap seyali, pudhuppudhu vasadhigalai arimugappaduthi varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, aantraaydu 6.0-kkum kuraivaana iyangudhalangalil (OS) iyangum smaartbongalil, varum sepdambar 8-aam thedhi mudhal WhatsApp sevai niruthappadum endru mettaa niruvanam arivithulladhu.
Thozhilnutba valarchi matrum membaduthappatta paadhugaappu amsangalai vazhanguvadharkaaga, aantraaydu 5.0 matrum 5.1 pondra pazhaiya padhippugalukkaana aadharavai WhatsApp vilakkikkolgiradhu. Adhaavadhu, aantraaydin mundhaiya padhippugalaana aantraaydu 5.0 matrum 5.1 padhippugalil iyangum pongalil ini WhatsApp iyangaadhu ena therivikkappattulladhu. Sepdambar 8 mudhal indha arivippu nadaimuraikku varum ena therivikkappattulladhu.
Pudhiya paadhugaappu vasadhigal matrum koodudhal amsangalai (udhaaranamaaga AI vasadhigal) vazhanga pazhaiya menborul matrum haarduver podhumaanadhaaga illai enbadhaal indha mudivu edukkappattulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Payanargalukku erkenave idhudhodarbaaga echarikkai kurunjjeythigal anuppappattu vittadhaagavum mettaa tharappil therivikkappattulladhu. Mukkiyamaana uraiyaadalgal matrum meediyaa koppugalai izhappadhaith thavirkka, payanargal thangal arattaigalai pekkap seythugollumaarum mettaa kooriyulladhu.
Ungal kaippesi aantraaydu 5.0 alladhu 5.1 padhippil iyanginaal, vaatsappaith thodarndhu payanbadutha, ungal menborulaip pudhuppikka vendum (mudindhaal) alladhu pudhiya saadhanathirku maara vendum. Idhu WhatsApp mesanjjar matrum WhatsApp pisinas aagiya irandirkum porundhum. Adhenerathil, aivon payanargalukku endha paadhippum illai. Indha maatram aantraaydu payanargalai mattume paadhikkiradhu. Aivongal matrum aivedugal paadhikkappadaadhu. IOS 15.1 matrum adharku merpatta padhippugalil iyangum saadhanangalil WhatsApp thodarndhu seyalbadum.

headline: Haarmus mudhal America varai.. Orenaalil rathaana pala vimaanangal.. Mirattiya Iran pinnani enna?
text:
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
mathiya kizhakkil amerikkaa–eeraan modhal meendum theeviramadaindhulladhaagak koorappadum nilaiyil, USS George Washington endra America vimaanam thaangik kappal meedhu Iran evuganai thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga Iran arasu oodagangal adhirchith thagavalai veliyittullana.
Iran arasu tholaikkaatchiyaana IRIB veliyitta seythiyil , mathiya kizhakku kadal pagudhiyil pudhidhaaga paniyil amarthappatta USS George Washington vimaanam thaangik kappal meedhu Iran thanadhu mudhal neradi thaakkudhalai nadathiyadhaaga kooriyulladhu.
Iran-in uyarmatta thesiya paadhugaappu kavunsil seyalaalar mohsen resaayi, adhinaveena kappal edhirppu evuganai ondru America kappalin mel vedithadhaaga therivithaar. Melum, America-vin F-35 por vimaanathaiyum AWACS vaanvazhi kangaanippu vimaanathaiyum suttu veezhthiya mudhal naadu eeraandhaan endrum avar kooriyullaar.
Aanaal, Iran-in indhak kootrugalai America innamum urudhippaduthavillai. USS Abraham Lincoln-ai maatri mathiya kizhakkirku anuppappatta George Washington, America-vin mukkiya thaakkudhal thiran konda vimaanam thaangik kappalaagum. Eeraan–isrel padhatram, haarmus neerinai paadhugaappu matrum indho-pasivik piraandhiyathil China-vin iraanuva nadavadikkaigalai kangaanikkum America-vin indhak kappal mukkiyathuvam vaayndhadhaaga karudhappadugiradhu.
Adhe nerathil, America karuvoolath thurai amaichar sgaat pesant veliyitta echarikkaiyinbadi, Iran vimaanangalukku erivorul vazhangum niruvanangal, tharaiyirakka anumadhi alikkum vimaana nilaiyangal matrum ticket sevaigal vazhangum niruvanangal meedhi porulaadhaarath thadaigal vidhikkappadum endru kooriyirundhaar.
America-vin pudhiya Secondary Sanctions sepdambar 23 mudhal amalukku vandhulla nilaiyil, Iran-in vimaanas sevaigal ulagalavil azhuthathais sandhithu varugindrana.
Idhanaal engal vimaanangalaith tharaiyirakka andai naadugal America-vukku udhavinaal, avargalin vimaana nilaiyangalum iyangaadhu. Mudivu ungaludaiyadhu endru Iran andai naadugalaik kadumaiyaaga echarithulladhu.
Idhan vilaivaaga, Iraq paakdhaathukkaana Iran vimaanangal niruthappattullana. Kathaar, jaarjiyaa, asarbaijaan ullitta sila vazhithadangalum paadhikkappattulla nilaiyil, China matrum isdhaanbul nokkiya sila sevaigal mattum thodarvadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Iran meedhu ulagalaaviya vimaanath thadaigalai America theevirappaduthik kondirundha adhe nerathil, America-vin sondha vimaanap pokkuvarathu amaippe periya sikkalais sandhithadhu.
Pensilveniyaavil ulla FAA thagaval thodarbu maiyathil mudhanmai inaippu seyalizhandhadhudan, niyoo jersiyil kattumaana paniyinbodhu oru kevil thavaraaga thundikkappattadhaal Newark, JFK, LaGuardia, Philadelphia, Boston ullitta migap paravarappaana vimaana nilaiyangalil 7000 vimaanangal thaamadhamaagina matrum rathaagina. Pinnar pazhudhugal sariseyyappattaalum, payanigal pala mani nera thaamadhathai edhirgondadhaaga adhigaarigal therivithanar.

headline: Irandu sirumigalai murattuthanamaaga thaakkum thamizhar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’irandu sirumigalai murattuthanamaaga thaakkum thamizhar,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ *ivan yaar endha oorunnu theriyala thamizhnaattai serndha ivana kaidhu seythu muttikku muttadi thatra varaikkum share pannunga plees firants*,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu. Adhil, aan oruvar, thelungil pesiyavadi, 2 sirumigalai adithu, thunburuthum kaatchigal idambetrullana.
Melum, indha video kadandha sila aandugalaagave, samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappattu varuvadhaiyum kandom.
investigation_details:
Merkanda video unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhudhodarbaaga, kadandha 2022m aandu sepdambar maadham, aandhiraavai serndha pathirigaiyaalar oruvar X valaidhalathil veliyitta oru padhivin lingk kidaithadhu. Adhil, naam aayvu seyyum video-vai pagirndhirundha avar, merku kodhaavari maavattathin Tadepalligudem sattamandra thogudhikkutbatta Pentapadu endra kiraamathil manaivi velinaattil velai seyyum soozhalil, kanavan ivvaaru thanadhu 2 magalgalai adithu sithravadhai seyvadhaagak kurippittirundhaar.
Merkanda X valaidhala padhivin peril, udanadiyaaga, merku kodhaavari maavatta kaaval kangaanippaalar (SP) matrum sambandhappatta pagudhi insbekdar ullittor udanadiyaaga viraindhu sendru, andha sirumigalai meettanar. Melum, kurippitta sirumigalin thandhai meedhu vazhakkup padhindhu, visaaranai merkondulladhaaga, Police padhil kooriyirundhanar.
Idhudhodarbaaga appodhe oodagangalilum seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
Idhu mattumindri, kurippitta navar kaidhu seyyappattu, siraiyilum adaikkappattaar endrum, sila maadhangal kazhithu, 2023m aandu jaameenil velivandha avar, thanadhu manaiviyai kondruvittaar endrum seythi aadhaaram kidaithadhu.
Adhanaiyum inge inaithullom.
Enave, kadandha 2022m aandu aandhiraavil nigazhndha kudumba vanmurai thodarbaana video ondrai eduthu, Tamil Naattil nadaivetradhu pola kurippittu, indralavum samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 'thoongum neram miga mukkiyam..' maruthuvargal kodukkum echarikkai!
text:
Maruthuvargal echarippadhaavadhu, 8 mani neram thoonginaalum, thookka neram udalin iyarkai kadigaarathudan othuppovadhu avasiyam. Iravu 2 mani mudhal kaalai 10 mani varai thoongum pazhakkam, pasi, valarchidhai maatram, haarmongalil maatram erpaduthi, adhiga pasi, sorvu, mana azhutham pondra pirachinaigalai uruvaakkakkoodum ena avargal koorugindranar.
Oruvar 8 mani neram thoonginaalum, avar eppodhu thoongugiraar enbadhum mukkiyam ena, maruthuva vallunargal koorugindranar. Iravu 2 maniyilirundhu kaalai 10 mani varai thoonguvadhai, palar vaadikkaiyaaga vaithullanar. Ippadi 8 mani neram thoonginaalum, idhu muzhumaiyaana palanai tharaamal pogalaam ena, maruthuvargal echarikkindranar.
Udalil iyarkaiyaana kadigaaram ondru iruppadhaaga kurippidum avargal, adhanudan namadhu thoongum neram othuppoga vendum engindranar. Thodarndhu migavum thaamadhamaagath thoonguvadhu, pasi, valarchidhai maatram matrum haarmongalil thaakkathai erpaduthakkoodum enavum, idhanaal, adhiga pasi, sorvu, mana azhutham pondravai erpada vaayppiruppadhaagavum echarikkindranar. Iruppinum, adhigaalai 2 mani mudhal W kaalai 10 mani varai idaiyoorindri thoongi puthunarvudan ezhundhaal, adhu podhumaanadhaagakkooda irukkalaam ena maruthuva nivunargal koorugindranar.

headline: Perambaloor: aamni perundhin meedhu modhi vivathukkullaana car 4 per paliyaana sogam!
text:
Perambaloor aruge, munnaal sendra aamni perundhin meedhu pinnaal sendra car modhiyadhil 4 per uyirizhandhulla sambavam sogathai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Raamanaadhavuram maavattam, mudhugulathoor kiraamathais serndhavar kaarthik (vayadhu: 38). Ivaradhu nanbargal, pillaiyaargulam kiraamathais serndha piravaagaran(vayadhu: 30), mudhugulathoor kaarthik (vayadhu: 38), kaaleesvaran (vayadhu: 25), ori vayal kannadhaasan (vayadhu: 22), kaarthi manaivi sooryaa (vayadhu: 35), thevivattinam jaan kennadi (vayadhu: 35), ravi manaivi saranyaa (vayadhu: 23). Ivargal anaivarum Chennai-yil velai paarthu varugindranar. Netru raamanaadhavuram maavattam, mudhugulathooril kaarthikkin thambi rajinigumaarin thirumanam nadandhadhu. Indha thirumanathil kalandhu kolvadharkaaga 7 perum Chennai-yil irundhu oru kaaril raamanaadhavurathirku sendranar. Angu thirumanam mudindhadhum, kaaril sennaikku thirumbi kondirundhanar. Innilaiyil, avargaladhu car indru adhigaalai 2.30 maniyalavil perambaloor maavattam, thuraimangalam aruge ulla thaniyaar petrol pangk aruge vandhavodhu, munnaal sendra aamni perundhin pinburathil car kattuppaattai izhandhu payangaramaaga modhi vivathukkullaanadhu. Indha vivathil, andha kaaril payanam seytha piravaagaran, kaaleesvaran aagiya 2 perum sambava idathileye udal nasungi uyirizhandhanar. Meedhamulla 5 perum uyirukkaaga poraadi kondirundhanar. Vivathai paartha appagudhi makkal poleesaarukku thagaval alithanar. Perambaloor nagara kaavalnilaiya poleesaar viraindhu vandhu padugaayam adaindhavargalai meettu arasu maruthuvamanaikku sigichaikkaaga anuppi vaithanar.
Idhil, perambaloor arasu maruthuvamanaiyil serkkappatta kaarthik sigichai palanindri uyirizhandhaar. Idhevola, Trichy arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppi vaikkappattirundha, sooryaavum sigichai palanindri uyirizhandhaar. Idhaiyaduthu, uyirizhappu ennikkai 4 aaga uyarndhadhu. Matravargalaana kannadhaasan, jaan kennadi, saranyaa aagiya 3 perukkum Trichy arasu maruthuvamanaiyil sigichai alikkappattu varugiradhu. 3 perum uyirukku aavathaana nilaiyil iruppadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Indha vivathu kurithu perambaloor tavun poleesaar vazhakkuppadhivu seythadhudan Thoothukudi maavattam, naasaret pagudhiyai serndha aamni perundhu tiraivar raajaseelan enbavarai kaidhu seythu visaarithu varugindranar. Aamni perundhil car modhiya vivathil naangu per uyirizhandhulla sambavam sogathai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.

headline: Hindhu munnaniyinar meedhaana vazhakku rathu: Uyarneedhimandram utharavu
text:
Madurai: Madurai thirupparangundram malaiyil kaarthigai theevam etrappadaadhadhai kandithu poraattam nadathiya hindhu munnaniyinar meedhu padhivaana vazhakkai uyarneedhimandra madhuraik kilai rathu seythadhu.
Thirupparangundram malaiyil kaarthigai theevam etrappadaadhadhaal Thamizhaga arasai kandithu 2023 nava.25l hindhu munnaniyai serndha nalladhambi matrum 303 per sattavirodhamaaga ondrugoodi kosham ezhuppiyadhaaga Police vazhakku padhindhanar. Idhai rathu seyyakkori nalladhambi uyarneedhimandrathil manu thaakkal seythaar. Needhivadhi aar.vijayagumaar visaarithaar. Manudhaarar tharappil vazhakkarinjar karunaanidhi aajaraanaar.needhivadhi pirappitha utharavu: makkalukku idaiyooru erpaduthiyadhaagavo alladhu podhu sothukkalukku sedham vilaivithadhaagavo kutrachaattu munvaikkappadaadha nilaiyil, acheyalai kutramaaga karudha mudiyaadhu. Manudhaararukkum, kutramsaattappatta matra navargalukkum edhiraaga kutraviyal nadavadikkai eduppadhu sattathai thavaraaga payanbaduthuvadhaaga amaiyum. Manudhaarar matrum kutramsaattappatta anaithu navargal meedhaana vazhakku rathu seyyappadugiradhu. Ivvaaru utharavittaar.

headline: Vijay aatchiyil thamizhagathirku vandha kaaviri neer endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kadavulum iyarkaiyum Tamil Nadu mudhalvar Vijay pakkam iruppadhai kaattum vagaiyil thamizhagathirku vandha kaaviri neerai makkal varavetra kaatchi endru video ondru

aatril varum neerai makkal vanangi, varaverkum pala veediyokkalaith thoguthu, Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar Vijay-yin pugaippadathudan video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “aandavan thalavadhiyin pakkam… iyarkaiyum thalavadhiyin pakkam!” 🌧️🙏 keralaavil peythu varum thodar kanamazhaiyaal kavini anai vegamaaga nirambi, kaaviri vazhiyaaga thamizhagathirkum neervarathu adhigarikkum soozhal uruvaagiyulladhu.
Thamizhagathin urimaikkaaga kural kodukkum nerathil, iyarkaiyum thamizhagathirku thunaiyaaga nirpadhu oru nalla ariguriyaagave makkal paarkkindranar. Makkal nalanai ninaithu seyalbadum thalaimaiyai kaalamum kaakkum; needhiyin paadhaiyil nadakkum thalaimaiyai iyarkaiyum vaazhthum.
“aandavan thalavadhiyin pakkam… iyarkaiyum thalavadhiyin pakkam… thamizhagathin edhirgaalamum thalavadhiyin pakkam!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vivasaayathirkaaga ovvoru aandum joon 12m thedhi mettoor anai thirakkappadum. Aanaal, indha aandu aagast mudhal vaaram aagiyum thirakkappadavillai. Kaaviriyil thanneer thirandhuvida mudiyaadhu endru karnaadaga arasu kooriyadhu. Mazhai peyyave uvari neerai thirandhuvittulladhu. Indha thanneer Thamizhaga ellaikkul nuzhaiyath thodanguvadharkullaaga Tamil Naattin teldaa maavattangalil kaaviri neer vandhadhu endrum adharku mudhalamaichar Vijay-yin adhirshdame kaaranam enbadhu polavum palarum samooga oodagangalil veediyokkalai padhivittu varugindranar.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video samooga oodagangalil pala aandugalaaga pagirappattu varuvadhudhaan. Enave, indha video Vijay aatchikkaalathil edukkappattadhu illai enbadhai thelivuvadutha aayvu merkondom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video 2025m aandil YouTube, Facebook ullitta samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Indha video 2025m aandu joon 19m thedhi padhividappattirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. 2025m aandu Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyil irundhadhu. 2026 me 10m thedhidhaan Tamil Nadu mudhalvaraaga poruppetraar. Enave, indha video Vijay aatchikku varuvadharku munbu edukkappattadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu. Vijay aatchiyil kaaviriyil thadaiyindri thanneer varuvadhaaga kaatta pazhaiya veediyokkalai eduthu padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘iru sakkara vaagana ottigal saidu staant eduthuvittu ottungal’ endru Vijay utharavittaaraa?
text:
‘‘iru sakkara vaagana ottigal saidu staant eduthuvittu ottungal’’, endru Vijay utharavittadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ iru sakkara vaagana ottigal kandippaaga saidu staandai eduthuvittudhaan otta vendum- mudhalvar Vijay utharavu.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu Polimer News peyaril paravum poliyaana news card, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Merkanda news card-il, 17.06.2025 endru thedhi kurippidappattulladhu. Aanaal, Vijay Tamil Naattin mudhalamaichar padhavikku vandhadhu 10.05.2026 andru…
idhanmoolamaaga, oraandukku mundhaiya thedhiyittu, Vijay peyaril vendumendre vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, Polimer News oodagathin aasiriyar kuzhuvilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kaalaiyil ezhundha udane MOBILE PHONE - ai theduvadhu en? Ulaviyal sollum suvaarasiyamaana vilakkam!!
text:
Kaalaiyil ezhundha udane movail ponai paarppavaraa neengal? Idhanaal ungalai movail adikkshan endru kurai sonnaal kavalai pada vendiya avasiyam illai. Idharku ulaviyal veru suvaarasiyamaana kaaranathai solgiradhu.
Kaalaiyil padukkaiyilirundhu ezhuvadharku munbaagave nammudaiya kaigal thaanaagave movailaith thedugindrana. WhatsApp, instaagiraam, eemeyil ena orumurai paartha piragudhaan palarin naal thodangugiradhu.
Idhuvondra pazhakkathaip paarthu, "movailukku adimaiyaagivittaargal" endru palarum ninaikkiraargal. Aanaal, ulaviyal nivunargal idharku veroru vilakkathaiyum koorugiraargal.
Movail adimaithanamaa? Ulaviyal sollum vilakkam
avargal kooruvadhanbadi, kaalaiyil ponai edukkum pazhakkam ellaa nerathilum adimaithanathaal mattum varuvadhillai. Nam moolai iyangum vidhamum, iravu muzhuvadhum enna nadandhadhu enbadhaith therindhugolla vendum endra iyalbaana aarvamumgooda idharku oru kaaranamaaga irukkalaam.
Naam iravil thoongikkondirundhaalum, ulagam thodarndhu iyangikkonde irukkiradhu. Andha nerathil yaaraavadhu namakku mesej anuppiyirukkalaam. Pudhiya seythigal vandhirukkalaam. Aluvalagathil irundhu minnanjjal vandhirukkalaam. Alladhu adutha naal thittangalil edhaavadhu maatram erpattirukkalaam. Kaalaiyil kan vizhitha udan pudhidhaaga enna nadandhirukkiradhu enbadhai therindhu kollum aarvam nam moolaikku adhigamaaga irukkiradhu. Ulaviyalil idhai "Uncertainty Reduction" endru azhaikkiraargal. Adhaavadhu, nichayamatra thanmaiyai kuraikka thagavalgalaith therindhu kollum pazhakkam thaan idhu.
'Variable Reward' ulaviyal enna solgiradhu?
Innum suvaarasyamaana vishayam ennavendraal, thinamum ponaith thirandhavudan periya seythi kidaippadhillai. Sila naatkalil mukkiyamaana mesej irukkum. Sila naatkalil nalla seythi ondru kaathirukkum. Sila nerangalil edhuvume irukkaadhu. Aanaalum, indru edhaavadhu pudhusaaga irukkalaam endra edhirbaarppai nammudaiya moolai oruvodhum viduvadhillai. Idhaithaan ulaviyalaalargal 'Variable Reward' endru solgiraargal. Eppodhu parisu kidaikkum endru theriyaadhadhaal, andhas seyalai meendum meendum seyya nam moolai nammaiye thoondugiradhu. Samooga valaidhalangal idhe ulaviyalaip payanbaduthithaan kodikkanakkaana makkalai thinamum thangalidam thirumba varavaikkindrana.
Ulagathudan meendum inaivadharkaana muyatsiyaa?
Idhodu innoru kaaranamum irukkiradhu. Pala mani neram thoongiya piragu, naam tharkaaligamaaga veli ulagathilirundhu vilagiyiruppom. Adhanaal, kaalaiyil ponai eduppadhu verum pozhudhuvokkukkaaga mattumalla. "ippodhu mani enna?" "veli ulagil enna nadakkiradhu?" "yaaraavadhu ennaith thodarbu kondirukkiraargalaa?" "indru ennenna velaigal irukkindrana?" endru andha naalai manadhalavil purindhugondu, meendum ulagathudan inaivadharkaana oru muyatsiyaagavum adhu irukkalaam. Adhanaaldhaan, palarukku ponaip paartha piragudhaan andha naal unmaiyaagath thodangiyadhu pondra unarvu erpadugiradhu.
Kaalaiyil movail paarppadhu nalladhaa? Kettadhaa?
Appadiyaanaal, kaalaiyil ezhundha udane ponai eduppadhu nalladhaa... Kettadhaa...? Idharku ulaviyalil neradiyaaga "aam" alladhu "illai" endra padhil illai.
Oru nimidam ponaip paarthuvittu ungal andraada velaiyaith thodanginaal, adhu palarukku iyalbaana pazhakkamaaga irukkalaam.
Aanaal, andha oru nimidam 30 nimidamaaga... Oru mani neramaaga... Mudivillaadha skrolingaaga maarivittaal, adhudhaan kavanikka vendiya vishayam. Enenil, adhu ungal nerathaiyum, kavanathaiyum, mananilaiyaiyum, velaithiranaiyum medhuvaaga paadhikkath thodangalaam.
Enave, inimel yaaraavadhu ungalaip paarthu "kaalaiyileye ponla moozhgittiye!" endru sonnaal, udane ungalai movail adimai endru ninaithu kavalaippada vendiyadhillai. Oruvelai, ungal moolai ulagathudan meendum inaivadharkaaga iyalbaagave muyatsi seythu kondirukkalaam. Aanaal, andha muyatsi oru nimidathil mudivadaiya vendumaa? Alladhu oru mani neramaaga neela vendumaa? Enbadhai mudivu seyvadhu ungal kaiyildhaan irukkiradhu.

headline: Maadugalil thallippogum karutharithal varumaanam izhandhu vivasaayigal paadhippu
text:
Maadugalil thallippogum 'karutharithal' varumaanam izhandhu vivasaayigal paadhippu
panamarathuppatti: panamarathuppatti vattaarathil vivasaayam piradhaana thozhilaaga merkollappadugiradhu. Athudan karavai maadu valarthu, paal virpanai moolam kanisamaana varuvaay eetti varugindranar. Sameeva kaalamaaga, karavai maadugal sariyaana kaala idaiveliyil sinai pidippadhillai. Idhanaal maadu valarppor, varumaanam izhandhu porulaadhaara reedhiyaaga paadhikkindranar.
Idhugurithu kaalnadai valarppor kooriyadhaavadhu:karavai maadugal, kandru eendru, 3 maadhangalil meendum sinai pidikkum. Aanaal, 12, 8, 6 maadhangalaaaakiyum karudharikka-villai. Palamurai seyarkai muraiyil karuvoottal seythum palanillai. Maadugal sinai pidithu, kandru eendra pin paal karandhu vitru varumaanam eetta mudiyum. Theevanam, punnaakku vilai uyarndhulladhu. Sinai pidikkaadha maattukku theevanam vaangi pottu kadanaagi vittadhu.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.
Arasu kaalnadai maruthuvargal tharappil koorugaiyil, 'maadugal karudharithal thalli poga, oottachathu, thaadhu uppu kuraivaadu, vayitril kudarpuzhukkam, haarmon kuraivaadu ullitta pal-veru kaaranangal ullana. Adharkaana kaaranathai kandarindhu sigichai alikka, arasu kaalnadai marundhagathil thevaiyaana marundhugal, vasadhigal ullana. Maadugalai kaalnadai marundhagath-thukku azhaithu vandhaal sinai pidikka uriya sigichai alithu, thagundha paraamarippu aalosanai vazhangappadum' endranar.

headline: Keralaavil musleem enbadhaal pen vetbaalarin kanavar photo vaithu ottu kettanaraa?
text:
‘’keralaavil musleem enbadhaal pen vetbaalarin kanavar photo vaithu ottu kettanar,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ keralaavil thaan indha postar ottiyirukkaanga ivarudaiya manaivikku ottu podungannu ivaru kekkuraaru… vetbaalar photo podaamal avarudaiya kanavar photo pottu ottu kekkuraanga adhigam padichaa maanilathil.. 🤔🤔🤔endha alavukku madham ivargalai mirugamaakki vaithulladhunu paarungal,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan pugaippadam ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhil koorappaduvadhu pondru PPDP endra peyaril arasiyal katchi edhuvum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, koogul udhaviyudan rivars imej muraiyil thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idhu Vellaripattanam endra malaiyaala sinimaa padathin kaatchi, endru vivaram kidaithadhu.
Muzhu video lingk keezhe tharappattulladhu.
Enave, sinimaa padathin kaatchiyai eduthu, keralaavil musleem enbadhaal pen vetbaalarin pottovukkup padhilaaga, avaradhu kanavar photo vaithu ottu kettadhaagak koori vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mudhal pen raanuva veerar kiran shegaavath veera maranam endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:

idhil, ‘’ aiyo thaaye
unnai izhandhu vittome, 😭😭
mudhal pen raanuva veerar kiran shegaavath (27) veera maranam..😭😭
veera vanakkam.. ,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan pen veerar oruvarin sadalam kidappadhu pondra kaatchi idambetra oru veediyovum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha veediyovukkum, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, idhu Ukraine naattil edukkappatta video
idhanbadi, Ukraine naattu raanuva veerargalai maiyappaduthi edukkappatta video-vin oru kaatchiyai thavaraana thagaval serthu, parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda padhivil koorappaduvadhuvondru, Kiran Shekhawat tharpodhu kollappadavillai. Indhiya kadarpadaiyin mudhal pen adhigaariyaana avar kadandha 2015m aandu kovaa kadarkarai aruge erpatta Dornier crash kaaranamaaga, veera maranam adaindhaar.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video-vil iruppavar Kiran Shekhawat kidaiyaadhu; adhu Ukraine naattu raanuva veerargalai maiyappaduthi edukkappatta oru veediyaa endrum, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline:
Roo.3,383 kodi sothu..
Orenaalil veedhikku vandha MLA..
Pinnani enna?
text:
Roo.3,383 kodi sothu.. Orenaalil veedhikku vandha MLA.. Pinnani enna?
Varthagathil thilaikkum mumbai endraale pirammaandamaana vaazhkkai murai, panakkaarargal, thozhiladhivargal, piravalangal, thozhil nagaram ena pala vishayangal ninaivukku varum. Adhe mumbai veedhigalil orunaal muzhuvadhum pichaikkaararaaga valam vandhirukkiraar BJP emele oruvar. Avar pichaikkaararaaga maariyadharkuk kaaranam enna pondra kelvigalaip palarukkum ezhuppi irukkiradhu. Magaaraashdiraavin panakkaara emelekkalil oruvaraaga irukkiraar mumbaiyin kaatkovar kizhakkuth thogudhi BJP emele paraak shaa. 3,383 kodi roobai sothu vaithirukkum ivar, pichaikkaararbola mumbai saalaigalil alaindhu thirindhu pichai edukkum video tharpodhu samooga valaidhalangalil viral-aagi varugiradhu. Aarambathil indha veediyovaip paartha palarum, “edharkaaga oru emele ippadi pichaikkaarar vedathil irukkiraar?” ena aachariyappatta nilaiyil, adharkaana kaaranamum tharpodhu veliyaagiyulladhu.
Thozhiladhivaraagavum, riyal estet thuraiyil mukkiyap pangu vagippavaraagavum irukkum paraak shaa, thanadhu jeyin aanmiga kuruvaana namramuniyin arivuraiyin peril indha muyatsiyai merkondadhaaga therivithullaar. Jeyin madha paarambariyathil mukkiyathuvam vaayndhadhaaga karudhappadum sirappu maadhathaiyotti, thannidam irukkum paadhugaappu erpaadugal, kaargal matrum vilai uyarndha porutkal ena anaithaiyum odhukkivittu, orunaal muzhuvadhum pichaikkaarar pola vaazhumaaru avaradhu kuru arivuruthiyadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, yaarukkum thannai adaiyaalam theriyaadha vagaiyil mekkap pottukkonda paraak shaa, thanadhu paadhugaappu adhigaarigal matrum vaaganangalaith thavirthuvittu mumbai kaatkovar pagudhikkus sendrullaar. Angu pichaikkaararbola pala mani neram saalaiyorangalil amarndhum, podhumakkalidam yaasagam kettum thanadhu naalai kazhithullaar.
Indha anuvavam kurithu pesiya paraak shaa, vaazhkkaiyin unmaiyaana nilaiyai indha anuvavam thanakku unarthiyadhaaga therivithullaar. “neengal sellum idangalil ungalais sandhikka makkal varisaiyil nirpaargal. Aanaal, adhe navargalidam neengal sendru nirkumbodhu, avargal ungalaivida uyarndhavargalaagath therigiraargal. Idhudhaan vaazhkkaiyin unmai” ena avar kooriyullaar. Adhumattumindri, mumbai makkalin udhavum manappaanmaiyaiyum indha anuvavam thanakku unarthiyadhaaga paraak shaa therivithullaar. Melum enakku oru navar thannidam roo.20 koduthu, ’poys saappidungal’ enak kooriyadhaagavum, adhanbiragu saalaiyorathil samosaa vitrukkondirundha navaridam panam illai enak kooriyavodhu, avar panam vaangaamaleye samosaa koduthadhaagavum paraak shaa therivithullaar.
Kurippaaga, andha samosaa virpanaiyaalar migavum ezhmaiyaana nilaiyil irundhavodhilum, thaan panam illai enak kooriyavodhu endhavidha thayakkamum illaamal punnagaiyudan unavu koduthadhu thannai negizha vaithadhaagavum avar kurippittullaar.

headline: Vimaana vivathirku munbaaga er India paniyaalargal edutha video idhuvaa?
text:
Vimaana vivathirku oru sila nimidangalukku munbu edukkappatta video endru oru padhivu

vimaana sippandhigal vimaananilaiyathil nadandhu varum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “vimaana vivathil uyirizhandha paniyaalar oruvaraal vivathukku oru sila nimidangal mun edukkappatta manadhai urukkum kaanoli..! Adutha nimidam nichayamillaadha vaazhkkai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Agamadhaavaathilirundhu landan sendra er India vimaanam purappatta sila nimidangalil tharaiyil vizhundhu vedithus sidhariyadhu. Indha vivathil vimaana sippandhigal, payanigal matrum maruthuvak kalloori vidudhiyilirundhavargal ena 265 per uyirizhandhadhaaga arivikkappattulladhu. Indha nilaiyil vimaanap paniyaalargal kadaisiyaaga edutha video endru oru video samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Vimaanam purappatta sila nimidangalileye vizhundhuvittadhu, appadi irukkaiyil eppadi indha video-vai vimaanap paniyaalargal padhivetriyirukka mudiyum endra kelvi ezhugiradhu. Oru sila nimidangalil edit seythu video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivetriyirukka vaayppillai enbadhaal indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil vivathil uyirizhandha vimaanap paniyaalargal indha video-vil ullaargalaa endru paarthom. Vimaanathil vimaanigal ulbada motham 9 er India sippandhigal irundhadhaagas seythigal koorugindrana. Avargalin pugaippadangal seythi oodagangalil veliyaagi ulladhu. Andha padathil ulla yaarum indha video-vil illai. Enave, idhu pazhaiya video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil video-vai aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, joon 9, 2025 andru adhaavadhu vimaana vivathu nadappadharku moondru naatkalukku munbu indha video instaagiraamil veliyaagi iruppadhu therindhadhu. Adhil, “ULH flight se phle ka motivation 🙏🏻” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. ULH endraal enna endru thedip paartha podhu, adhu saudhi areviyaavil ulla al-ulaa (Al-Ula) sarvadhesa vimaananilaiyathin kot (Code) enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Melum andha instaagiraam pakkathil idhe pondru veru sila veediyokkalum irundhana. Indha video-vai mudhalil instaavil padhivittirundha Yashasvi Sharma vidam indha video thodarbaaga vilakkam pera muyatsi seythullom. Aanaal, avarai nammaal thodarbugolla mudiyavillai. Avarudaiya instaagiraam pakkam moolamaaga samooga oodagangalil paravum vadhandhi thodarbaana thagavalai alithu avaradhu vilakkathaik kettullom. Avar namakkup padhil alithaal adhai pagirgirom.
Vivathukku moondru naatkalukku munbu indha video instaagiraamil padhividappattulladhu. Vivathil paliyaana vimaana paniyaalargal yaarudaiya thotramum indha video-vil ullavargaludan othuppogavillai. Ivai ellaam indha video agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathu nadappadharku sila nimidangalukku munbu edukkappattadhu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Aamstraang irappai vaithu aadhaayam adaiya vendaam endru maayaavadhi koorinaaraa?
text:
Aamstraang irappai vaithu aadhaayam adaiya vendaam endru avaradhu manaiviyai maraimugamaaga pagujan samaaj katchith thalaivar maayaavadhi vimarsithadhaaga oru news card

maayaavadhi matrum Tamil Nadu pagujan samaaj katchith thalaivaraaga irundhu kolai seyyappatta aamstraang aagiyorin pugaippadangalai vaithu thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “aamstraang irappai vaithu aadhaayam adaiya vendaam 2024 jeelai maadham pagujan samaajvaadhi katchiyin Tamil Nadu thalaivarum en thambiyum aagiya thiru.aamstraang avargal padugolai seyyappattaar. Padugolaiye seytha navargalidame aamstraang avargalin nerungiya oruvar aadharavu therivithu aadhaayam adaiya ninaikkiraar. Adhai naangal anumadhikkamaattom andha navarai therdhalil viratti adippom. Pathirikkaiyaalar sandhippil BSP thalaivar maayaavadhi aavesam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu pagujan samaaj katchith thalaivaraaga irundha aamstraang 2024m aandu padugolai seyyappattaar. Indha nilaiyil avaradhu manaivi porkodi ADMK koottaniyil inaindhu thiru.vi.ka nagar sattamandrath thogudhiyil pottiyidugiraar. Avarukku edhiraaga pagujan samaaj katchith thalaivar maayaavadhi petti alithadhu pondru news card ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha news card-il ulla thamizh faant thandha TV vazhakkamaaga veliyidum news card-il ulladhu pol illai. Vazhakkamaaga thandhi TV veliyidum news kaardugalil thedhiyaik kurippiduvaargal. Aanaal idhil thedhi illai. Melum joolai enbadhai ‘jeelai’ endru pagujan samaaj katchi enbadhai ‘pagujan samaajvaadhi katchi’ endrum thavaraaga ezhudhiyirundhanar. Ivai ellaam indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya indha news card-ai thandhi TV veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil appadi endha oru news kaardum illai. Enave, idhai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppi idhu unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu, thandhi TV idhai veliyidavillai endru urudhi seythaar.
Sameevathil maayaavadhi alitha pettiyil ippadi edhum therivithullaaraa endru paarthom. Epral 14, 2026 andru avar petti alitha video kidaithadhu. Aanaal, Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal thodarbaaga avar karuthu therivithadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Andha pettiyai indhi therindhavargalidam anuppi Tamil Nadu therdhal, porkodi patri edhum therivithullaaraa endru kettom. Indha video-vai muzhumaiyaaga paartha pin avargalum “maayaavadhi appadi edhuvum kooravillai” endranar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Mazhai vellam: Chennaiyin tharpodhaiya nilai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Chennaiyin tharpodhaiya nilai endru saalaiyil thengi nirkum mazhai neerilirundhu irusakkara vaaganangalaith thookkum video ondru

mazhai vellathil iru sakkara vaaganangal moozhgi irukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “enga oorukku vaanga sinnadhathi varaverkiraar 🤣 #chennaifloods #dmkmemes” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Matroruvar veliyittirundha padhivil, “sennaiyin tharpodhaiya nilai” endru kurippittirundhaar. Indha padhivugalai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum, pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Chennai-yil erpatta mazhai vellathil nagarame moozhgivittadhu pondru video-kkal samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugindrana. Pazhaiya video-kkal, veru maanilangalil edukkappatta veediyokkalai ellaam Chennai mazhai vella paadhippu endru palarum pagirndhu varugindranar. Tharpodhu, mazhai neerilirundhu irusakkara vaaganangalai thookkum video ondrai ADMK ullitta edhirkkatchigalais serndha palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video thelivillaamal irundhadhu. Chennai-yil endha idathil edukkappattadhu endru endha oru thagavalaiyum alikkavillai. Enave, indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2020m aandu indha video-vai silar veliyittirundhadhaik kandariya mudindhadhu. Aanaal, andha padhivilum kooda indha video engu edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. 2020m aandil thamizhnaattai adhimuga-vin Edappadi Palaniswami thalaimaiyilaana arasu aatchi seythadhu kurippidathakkadhu.
2020m aandu palarum indha video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhaalum, unmaiyil idhu Chennai-yil endha idathil edukkappattadhu endru kurippidavillai. Idhanaal, indha video Chennai-yil edukkappattadhudhaanaa enbadhai nammaal urudhi seyya mudiyavillai.
2020m aandil veliyaana video-vai eduthuvandhu 2025l DMK aatchiyil Chennaiyin nilai endru thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhai nammudaiya thedal mudivugal urudhi seythullana. Indha aadhaarathin adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Aavaasa video-vai veliyiduvadhaaga miratti jem veeramaniyidam panam paritha thozhi; Police visaaranaiyil thagaval
text:
Chennai: 'jem' veeramaniyin aavaasa veediyokkalai ambalappaduthi viduvadhaaga, avarin nerungiya thozhi saandhi miratti panam parithadhum, adharkaaga Thamizhaga Congress nirvaagi ranjjangumaar, Thamizhaga makkal munnetra kazhaga thalaivar jaanbaandiyan aagiyorin udhaviyai, veeramani naadiyadhum visaaranaiyil theriyavandhulladhu.
Idhu kurithu, Police adhigaarigal kooriyadhaavadhu:
'jem kiraanaits' veeramani, than nerungiya thozhiyaana saandhiyai, 61, migavum nambiyullaar. Saandhi matrum avaradhu kanavar magendhira simhan, 63, aagiyor kudiyirukka, Chennai thenaambettaiyil, sogusu pangalaa ondrai vaadagaikku eduthuk koduthullaar. Saandhiyaiyum than kaama ichaikku payanbaduthi ullaar.
Saandhi vaayilaaga, kalvi udhavi seyvadhu pola, 12 sirumiyar, veeramaniyin manmadha vilaiyaattirku paliyaagi ullanar. Idhai thanakku saadhagamaaga payanbaduthiya saandhi, veeramaniyidam konjjam konjjamaaga panam parikkath thuvanginaar. Oru kattathil, saandhikku panam koduppaidhai veeramani niruthi vittaar. Aathiramadaindha saandhi, 'ungalin sallaava video-kkal ennidam ullana. Adhai veliyil vittu viduven' endru, mirattath thuvangiyullaar.
Indhap pirasnai kaaranamaaga, Chennai ee.si.aaril., vaangiyirundha, 100 kodi roobai madhippulla nilathai, veeramani, 70 kodi roovaaykku virkum nilaikku thallappattullaar. Indha nila vivagaarathil thodarbudaiya vazhakkarinjar oruvar, veeramanikku aadharavaaga saandhiyidam pesi, indha vivagaarathil irundhu vilagik kollumbadi kooriyullaar.
Appodhu, thenmaavattathil ulla arasiyal katchi thalaivar oruvarin peyaraiyum payanbaduthi ullaar. Idhudhodarbaaga, ranjjangumaarai sandhithullaar. Veeramaniyin kutrathai moodi maraikka, avargal ethanai kodi roobai vaanginar; veeramanikku aadharavaaga thenmaavatta arasiyal pulli seyalbattaaraa enbadhu kurithum visaaranai nadakkiradhu.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: Inji., maanavargalin therchi vivarangal; aaraaya annaa palgalai thittam
text:
Chennai: injiniyaring maanavargalin therchi mudivugalai membadutha, pulli vivarangal segarikka, annaa palgalai thittamittulladhu.
Annaa palgalaiyin keezh, 457kkum adhigamaana injiniyaring kalloorigal iyangi varugindrana. Idhil, 151 thannaatchi kalloorigalum, 306 thannaatchi peraadha kalloorigalum adangum.
Indha kalloorigalil, 4 latchathukkum adhigamaana maanava - maanavigal padithu varugindranar. Kadandha sila aandugalaaga, inji., padikkum maanava - maanavigalin therchi sadhaveedham kuraindhu varugiradhu.
Innilaiyil, 24 injiniyaring kalloorigalai serndha 2,425 maanavargal, 2021- 25 kalviyaandugalil nadandha semastar thervugalil, ondril kooda therchi peravillai endra adhirchi thagaval veliyaagi ulladhu.
Indha soozhalil, ovvoru semastar thervinbodhu, maanavargalin therchi sadhaveedhangalai aayvu seyya, palgalai mudivu seythulladhu. Indha aayvin adippadaiyil, endhendha paadappirivugalil maanavargal pindhangi ullanar; ethanai kalloorigalil mosamaana therchi ulladhu enbadhai ariya mudiyum ena, palgalai adhigaarigal therivithanar.

headline: ADMK matrum DMK aatchi meendum vandhaal thamizhnaattai aandavanaal kooda kaappaatra mudiyaadhu endru rajinigaanth koorinaaraa?

headline: Kaavaldhurai moolam makkalaith thaakkiya TVK arasu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Tiruppur aruge palladathil kuppai kottak koodaadhu endru poraadiya makkalaith thaakkiya TVK arasin Police endru oru video

poraattathil eeduvatta podhu makkalai Police kaidhu seyyum video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “#thiruppoor aruge #palladathil kuppaigalaik kottakkoodaadhu ena poraattathil eeduvatta #podhumakkalai #reelsarasu kaavaldhurai moolam kundukkattaagath thookki appurappaduthinar 😭😭
#TVKITWING #sovaamudhalamaichar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tiruppur aruge poraattathil eeduvatta makkalai Police kaidhu seythadhaaga oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Podhu makkalai reels arasu, TVK arasu kaaval thuraiyaip payanbaduthi kundukkattaaga appurappaduthiyadhu endru palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2025m aandu tisambar maadham indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, video-vil kurippittirundha oodagathin padhivu namakku kidaikkavillai. Aanaal, veru oodagangalil veliyaana idhe kaatchigal konda seythigal namakku kidaithana. Melum, paajaga-vin seyalaalaraaga irundhu, sameevathil Annamalai-yin amaippil inaindha amarbirasaath rettiyin instaagiraam pakkathil indha video 2025 tisambar 17m thedhi padhividappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil koogulil palladam, Tiruppur, kuppai ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Appodhu 2025 tisambar 16m thedhi thinamalar ullitta oodagangalil veliyaana seythigal namakku kidaithana. Adhil Tiruppur maanagaraatchiyil segarikkappatta kuppaigalai palladam ondriyathirkutbatta ichippatti kiraamathil ulla payanbaadatra paaraik kuzhigalil kotta edhirppu therivithu makkal poraattam nadathinar. Tiruppur maanagaraatchiyin kuppaigalai eduthu vandha laarigalai makkal sirai pidithanar. Avargalai Police appurappaduthinar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video 2025 tisambar 16m thedhi samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi iruppadhai urudhi seythullom. Appodhu Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyil irundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha kaidhu sambavathirkum TVK arasukkum thodarbillai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: DMK emele.,kkal thola urichu thonga vitruven endru pavan kalyaan koorinaaraa?
text:

investigation_details:
