headline: Piriks maanaattirku ore passil sellum mathiya amaichargal, mudhalvargal!
text:
Pudhudilli: piriks maanaattil pangerka irukkum mathiya amaichargal matrum palveru maanila mudhalvargal ore passil sella thittamidappattulladhu.
Piriks koottamaippin uchi maanaadu, varum sep.,12 matrum 13m thedhigalil pudhudilliyil nadaivera irukkiradhu. Paarath mandavathil nadakkum indha maanaattirkaana erpaadugal sirappaana muraiyil nadaivetru varugiradhu. Palveru naadugalais serndha thalaivargal India vara ulladhaal, thalainagar tilliyil uchagatta paadhugaappu podappattulladhu.
Melum, maanaattu arangirku ulaga naadugalin thalaivargal paadhugaappaaga sellavum, adhenerathil, tilliyil pokkuvarathu nerisalaal podhumakkal paadhikkappadaamal irukkum vidhamaagavum, 4 naatkalukku pokkuvarathu maatram seyyappattulladhu. Indru mudhal 14m thedhi varaiyil paarath mandavathai sutriyulla saalaigalai Police thangalin muzhuk kattuppaattil kondu vandhullanar. Sumaar 5,000 Police paadhugaappu paniyil eeduvattullanar.
Indha nilaiyil, pokkuvarathu nerisalai thavirkkum vidhamaaga, piriks maanaattil panget irukkum mathiya amaichargalum, maanila mudhalvargalum ore passil payanikka erpaadu seyyappattulladhu. Paarli valaagathil irundhu purappadum indha passil, amaichargalum, mudhalvargalum ore samayathil varavazhaikkappattu, paarath mandavathirku azhaithus sellappada iruppadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu.
Piriks maanaattinaal, podhumakkalukku endhavidha pokkuvarathu idaiyoorum erpadaamal irukka indha nadavadikkaigalai mathiya arasu merkondulladhu.

headline: Thorkaditha kolathoor makkalukku kodaanu kodi nandri; solgiraar Stalin
text:
Chennai: TVK aatchiyil minvettu, arivaalvettu idaiyedhaan potti; endru DMK mupperum vizhaavil akkatchiyin thalaivar Stalin vimarsithullaar.
Othi vaikkappatta DMK-vin mupperum vizhaa Chennai-yil indru (sep.19) nadaivetradhu. Idhil akkatchiyin thalaivar Stalin kalandhu kondu nirvaagigal matrum thondargal mathiyil uraiyaatrinaar. Appodhu avar pesiyadhaavadhu;
oru iyakkam 75 aandugal nilaithu nirpadhu saadhaarana saadhanai kidaiyaadhu. 75 aandugal kazhithum adhe kambeerathudan kaatchiyalippadhu saadhaarana saadhanai kidaiyaadhu. Indha saadhanai ungalaal vandhadhu. Theerammikka katchith thondargalaal, avargalai nambithaan thaan naan vaazhgiren. Avargal irukkiraargal endru nambithaan urudhiyudan seyalbattu varugiren.
Ennai mudhalvar padhavi varai azhaithu vandhu uyarthiyadhu thondargalum, makkalum thaan. Indha iyakkathirku kolgaiyum, latchiyamum thaan mukkiyam. Naam paarkkaadha vetriyum illai, tholviyum illai. Indha therdhalil (2026 therdhal) adhiga thogudhigalai vendra katchikkum, thimugavukkum idaiyeyaana vithiyaasam 17 latcham ottugal thaan.
Edhiri yaar endru sariyaaga kanithu paniyaatri irundhaal indha tholviye erpattu irukkaadhu. Aatchi amaithulla katchikku perumbaanmaikku thevaiyaana idangal kooda kidaikkavillai. Aanaal edho periya alai aditha maadhiriyum, thamizhagame avargalin varugaikku kaathirundhadhu maadhiriyum imejai uruvaakkik kondu varugindranar.
Kudhiraiveram latchanam 

unmaiyil avargalin aatchi nadappadhe namadhu koottaniyil vendra katchigalin aadharavudandhaan. Aanaal aadharavu thandha katchigalaiye nambaamal kudhirai peram nadathik kondiruppadhudhaan aalumgatchiyin ippodhaiya latchanam.
Aalum TVK arasin ippodhaiya velai enna, DMK aatchiyin thittangalai niruthuvadhu alladhu peyarai maatri stikkar ottuvadhu.. Idhudhaan maatramaa? Mudhalvarai poruthavaraikkum thinamum shootting moodil thaan irukkiraar.
Sinimaavil nadippadhai niruthivittadhaaga sollivittu, yaar iyakkunar, yaar kemaraamen endru sollaamal makkal munbaaga nadithuk kondu irukkiraar. Mudhalil panjs tayalaak, ippodhu paarin shootting. Ellaame reelsdhaan. Parandhoor vimaana nilaiya thittathai rathu seythadhan moolamaaga thamizhagathin valarchiyai satrerakkuraiya 25 aandugal pinnukku thallivittanar.
Idhuve DMK aatchi thodarndhirundhaal magalir urimai thogai roo.2000 kidaithu irukkum. Anaithu kudumbangalukkum roo.8000 illatharasi kooppan kidaithu irukkum. 25 latcham vivasaayigalukku pudhiya min mottaar vaangi koduthiruppom.
Vilaivaasi uyarvu 

aanaal makkalukku udhavaadha indha udhavaakkarai aatchiyil enna nadakkiradhu? 4 maadhangal munbaaga arisi, paruppu, sarkkarai enna vilai vitradhu? Ippodhu enna vilaiyil virkiradhu? Indha vilaivaasi uyarve aatchiyin latchanathai solgiradhu.
DMK aatchiyil porulaadhaara valarchiyil thamizhagam nambar on aaga irundhadhu. Aanaal indha TVK aatchiyil vilaivaasi uyarvil naam nambar on maanilamaaga aaga pogirom. Mudhalvarai poruthavaraikkum avar nadathi varum thuklak tharbaarai makkal pesakkoodaadhu enbadharkaaga amaicharavai mudhal oodagangal varai thisaidhiruppik kondu irukkindranar.
Netrippottu 

naattukku avasiyamaana seythi enna theriyumaa? Mudhalvar indraikku enna kot tiras pottaar? Vellikkizhamai pattuvetti sattai. Netriyil enna kalar pottu, kaiyil enna kayiru, josiyar indraikku enna solli irukkiraar enbadhudhaan seythigalaaga vandhu kondu irukkiradhu. Mudhalvarum idhuseythaal podhum endra mananilaiyil thaan irukkiraar.
India-vil kalviyil sirandha thamizhagam, mudhaleettaalargalil mudhal mugavari mudhalil thamizhagam, trilliyan taalar porulaadhaara valarchi. Endha maanilathilum illaadha naan mudhalvan, pudhumaippen ullitta pala thittangal pesappatta naattil, adhai ellaam pindhalli kotchoot, vetti sattai pottaar, kaiyaal saigai seythaar, vaayaal saappittaar endru ippadithaan seythigal varugiradhu. Adhaidhaan ippodhu tirendum seygindranar.
Minvettu - arivaalvettu 

idhai ellaam paarppadharku aruvaruppaaga, asingamaagave irukkiradhu. Avargalin paashaiyil solla vendum endraal, avar (mudhalvar Vijay-ai kurippidugiraar) paashaiyil solla vendum endraal rende rendukkum naduvildhaan potti. Ondru minvettu, innondru arivaalvettu.
Pattappagalil kolaigal, thuppaakkichoodugal. Aalumgatchiyinare podhai porulai virpanai seyvadhu, paaliyal vangodumaigalil eeduvaduvadhu ena ippodhu kutravaaligalin vettaikkaadaaga thamizhagam maari irukkiradhu.
TVK aatchiyil sattamum illai.. Ozhungum illai. Aanaal mudhalvaraaga iruppavarukku idhai patri thuligooda kavalai illai. Emaaruvavargal irukkum varaikkum ippadippatta emaatruvavargal irukkathaan seyvaargal.
Ivargalaal makkalai ellaa naalum emaatra mudiyaadhu. Kadandha vaaram mudhaleedugalai eerkka velinaadugalukku payanam seythaar. Payanam seythadhaaga mudhalvare sonnaar. Idharku mun naan velinaattukku payanam sendra podhu enna sonnaaru? Siem saar... Velinaattu mudhaleedaa? Velinaattil mudhaleedaa? Endru medaiyil kathinaar.
Ippodhu naan avar alavukku irangi varavillai, Thamizhaga makkal avarai paarthu siem saar...indhiyaavil irukkum kambenikku edharku landanil poy kaiyezhuthu podureenga endru sathamaaga ketkindranar.
Adhaivida innoru periya kodumai enna theriyumaa? Thozhildhurai amaichar, thozhildhurai seyalaalar illaamal mudhaleedugalai eerkka poy irukkiraar mudhalvar, idhudhaan mudhaleedugalai eerkkira latchanamaa?
Reels veri 

adhumattum illai... Reels verividitha aalumgatchiyinaraal nootraandu pugazhbetra sattasavai kooda thannodu maanbai ippodhu izhandhu nirkiradhu. Nadandhu mudindha sattasavai koottathodarai paarthiruppeergal. Nallavelai.. Kolathoor makkalukku naan nandri solgiren. Thavavichom... Indha kodumaigalai ellaam paarkkaamal irundhadharku. Kolathoor makkalukku kodaanu kodi nandri (irugarangalaiyum thalaikku mele ezhuppi, kumbidugiraar).
Mudhalvar sirippadhai paarkka mudiyavillaiye endru kavalaippattu sattasavaiyil thirai vaikkas solli aalumgatchi emelekkal ketkiraargal. Idhudhaan naattukku thevaiyaa? Sattasavai edhirkkatchith thalaivar Udhayanidhi ketkum kelvigalukku padhil solla mudiyaamal, misaa, sarkkaariyaa samishan endru sambandham illaamal pesi avadhoorugalai parappugindranar. Thisaidhiruppugindranar.
Misaavai patri pesugiravargalukku naan solla virumbuvadhu ondre ondru thaan. En misaa kaidhai ingu evanukkum niroovikka vendiya avasiyam enakku illai. En thiyaagathirku maark poda unga evanukkum thagudhi kidaiyaadhu. Ennudaiya misaa varalaatrai annan sittivaavu sirai tairiyil padhivu seythirukkiraar. Adhu kaalathaal azhikkamudiyaadha kalvettaaga amaindhirukkiradhu.
Siraichaalai sithravadhaigalai patri visaarikka, ismaayil kamishanai emjiaar amaithaar. Arikkaiyum alithadhu, saatchiyum solli irukkiren, ellaarum poy sonnaargal. Padikka therindhavanaaga irundhaal adhai eduthu padikkattum.
Ottuvotta makkal vaakkurudhigalai patri kettaal avadhooru parappi reels podugindranar. Niyaayamaaga paarthaal thavegavukku Thamizhaga vetrikkazhagam endru peyar vaithirukkakkoodaadhu, Thamizhaga reels kazhagam endrudhaan peyar vaithirukka vendum.
DMK thandhadhu riyal aatchi. Ivargal nadathuvadhu reels aatchi. Orudhadavai makkal emaandhu irukkalaam, thodarndhu emaaruvaargal endru ninaithaal emaara povadhu ippodhu irukkakkoodiya mudhalvar thaan. Avadhooru pesi, kochaiyaaga pesi DMK-vai avamaanappaduthalaam, palaveenappaduthalaam endru seyalbadugindranar. Idhai ellaam 78 varudamaaga naangal paarthuk kondu varugirom.
Kettukkettu pulichu pona indha avadhoorugalai parappugira edhirigal thaan maarik konde irukkindranare thavira naangal urudhiyaaga, nilaithu nindru kondudhaan irukkirom. Thannai vida iyakkam peridhu, kolgai peridhu endru ninaippavargal DMK-vinar naangal vattiyum, mudhalumaaga thiruppithara kaathirukkirom, seekkirame varum.
Viraivile iru thogudhi idaitherdhal varappogiradhu. Adhuvum idhu muraiyaa varugira therdhalaa? Illai...thinikkappatta therdhal idhu. Evvalavu agambaavam irundhaal vera katchiyil jeyitha uruppinargalai viralil vaitha mai kaayvadharku munnare raajinaamaa seyyacholli, vetkame illaamal avargalai thangalin sinnathil vetbaalargalaaga niruthi vaithullanar.
Kettaal... Kudhirai peram illaiyaam, thooya aatchiyaam. Idhudhaan ivargalin maanangetta maatramaa? Podhuvaaga emele maranam adaindhaaldhaan idaitherdhal varum, mudhalmuraiyaaga jananaayagam maranam adaindhirukkiradhu. DMK-vinar aatchiyin tholvigaludan serthu irandu thogudhigalilum pirasaarathil veedu, veedaaga sendru idhai seyya vendum.
Arasaangame indraikku seyalizhandhu poyulladhu. Indru ore naalil makkal nadamaattam ulla pagudhiyil 8 kolaigal. Ovvoru naalum vidindhaal enna mudiyaadha alavukku kolaigal. Karant illaamal naduraathiriyil kuzhandhaigaludan makkal poraadik kondu ullanar. Thozhilgal mudindhuvittadhu, vilaivaasi uyarndhuvittadhu, varumaanam pathavillai. Ivargal sonna roo.2500 varavillai. Oru vaaramaaga tengu kaaychal, vairas kaaychal paravi varugiradhu.
Aanavam 

idhai ellaam kavarchiyaal sarigattividalaam endru aanavathodu mudhalvar irukkiraar. Oodagangalai sandhithu padhil solla maatten endru thimiraaga irukkiraar. Indha thimirukkum, aa.navathukkum paadam pugattugira vaayppudhaan idaitherdhal.
Indraiya jen si ilainjargalai kavaravendum endraal avargalin mozhiyileye pesa vendum. Adhuvum eppadi pesa vendum, avargalin movail ponil sendru serumaaru pesungal.
Ivvaaru Stalin pesinaar.

headline: Pen oruvarudan jaaliyaaga nadanamaadum saattai Duraimurugan endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’pen oruvarudan jaaliyaaga nadanamaadum saattai Duraimurugan,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ tey @Saattaidurai
ennadaa nadakkudhu anga? 🤣🤣🤣 kooda aaduradhu yaarudaa? Unnai en ellaarum maamaa payan solranganu ippadhaandaa puriyudhu 🤣🤣🤣
#NtKfails,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video-vil pen oruvarudan nadanamaadum navar saattai Duraimurugan illai, endru theriyavandhadhu. Idhuvatri naam saattai Duraimurugan tharappil pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Aduthappadiyaaga, kurippitta video-vin oru firemai piritheduthu, rivars imej muraiyil koogul udhaviyudan thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, praveenmp89 enbavar instaagiraamil, ‘90’s kid wth 20’s kid‘ endra thalaippil veliyitta padhivu ondrin lingk kidaithadhu. Adhil pagirappattulla veediyovum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda veediyovum ondraaga irundhadhaik kandom. Ivar keralaavais serndhavar aavaar.
Kurippitta instaagiraam pakkathil idhuvondru eraalamaana reels padhivugal pagirappattulladhaiyum kandom.
Idhe navar, avaradhu Facebook pakkathilum kurippitta video thodarbaana pugaippadam ondrai eduthu, padhivittullaar. Andha padhivil, kurippitta nadana veediyovirku, adhiga paarvaigal kidaithulladhaaga, avar kurippittullaar. Idhudhodarbaaga, avaridam vilakkam kettavodhu, ‘’reels seyvadharkaaga, enadhu uravukkaara pen oruvarudan inaindhu, indha nadanamaadum video-vai padhivu seythen. Naan arasiyalvaadhi kidaiyaadhu,’’ endru therivithaar. Idhanmoolam, ivardhaan kurippitta video-vil ulla navar enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, thavaraana video ondrai eduthu, saattai Duraimurugan patri arasiyal ulnokkathudan vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thimugavum, adhimugavum kalla koottani; amaichar sengottaiyan kutrachaattu
text:
Thaaraavuram: ''thi.mu.ka.,vum, a.thi.mu.ka.,vum kalla koottani' ena amaichar sengottaiyan kutram saattiyullaar.
Thaaraavuram thogudhi idaitherdhal kurithu, koottani katchigalin nirvaagigal aalosanai koottam nadandhadhu. Idhil amaichar sengottaiyan pesiyadhaavadhu:
sattasavai therdhalil vetri petra ADMK, - em.el.e.,kkal padhaviyai raajinaamaa seyya kaaraname, akkatchi podhucheyalar ivies thaan; avaraal thaan, 25 per nambikkai otteduppil tha.ve.ka.,virku ottalithanar. Iviesyin nadavadikkaiyum mudivum nermaiyaaga illai enbadhaal thaan, sathyavaamaa tha.ve.ka.,vil inaindhaar.
Thi.mu.ka.,vum, a.thi.mu.ka.,vum kalla koottani vaithullana. Thi.mu.ka.,vudan inaindhu aatchiyai kaippatra ivies ninaithadhaal thaan, 6 per em.el.e., padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythanar. Ivvaaru, avar pesinaar.
Amaichar arunraaj pesugaiyil, ''endhavoru vishayathilum thi.mu.ka.,vin nilaippaattil kuzhappam thaan ulladhu. Thi.mu.ka.,vinarin thalaikku mel CBI, vazhakkugal ullana. A.thi.mu.ka.,vil orunginaippe illai.
Ivies thalaimaiyai etru yaarum angu illai; veru vazhiyindri irukkindranar. Thi.mu.ka.,vum, a.thi.mu.ka.,vum kalla koottani amaithu, em.el.e.kkalai vilaikku vaanga murpattana. Thamizhagathil nadakkum idaitherdhal nermaikkum thurogathukkumaana por'' endraar.

headline: Aayiram sandhegangal
text:
Thavaraana 'sivil' padhivugalai sari seyvadhu eppadi?
Endha vivaramum kurippidaamal, oru paartti, engalukku oru kaasolai koduthirundhaar. Aanaal, adhu varappetru 10 mudhal 12 aandugal aagiyirukkum. Inimel adhai vaithukkondu edhenum vazhakku poda mudiyumaa?
Ramesh, Erode
adhaavadhu neengal vaangi vaithiruppadhu 'pilaangk sek' endru purindhu kolgiren. Inimel adhai vaithukkondu sattappadi panathai thirumbap peruvadhu migavum kashdam. Nam naattil oru kadanaiyo panathaiyo thirumba ketka, limideshan sattam, 1963nbadi, podhuvaaga moondru aandugal mattume kaala avagaasam undu. Ungalukku panam thara vendiya thedhiyilirundhu andhak kaalakkeduvukkul neengal vazhakku thodarndhirukka vendum. 10 mudhal 12 aandugal aagivittadhaal, andha panathai sattappadi vasoolippadhu migavum kashdam.
 Sameeva kaalamaaga vangiyil muzhu thogaiyaiyum, ep.ti.yil pottaal, vatti 7 mudhal 8 sadhaveedhathukku mele varuvadhillai. Aanaal pala vangi saaraa nidhi niruvanangal adhiga alavil vandhullana. Avai varudathirku 10 alladhu 12 sadhaveedha vatti kodukka thayaaraaga ullana. Ivaiyellaam nambagathanmai vaayndhavaiyaa, illaiyaa?
Mogan, Tiruvallur 
vangi saaraa pala nidhi niruvanangal namadhu naattil pallaandugalaaga iyangi varugindrana. Avargal thangalukkena oru sila kadan vagaigalai vaithukkondu, adhil vetrigaramaaga seyalbattu laavam eettugindrana. Aanaal, avargal sollum varavu- - selavu kanakkugal unmaidhaanaa? Avargal paadhugaappaana thuraigalildhaan kadan koduthu vatti vasoolikkiraargalaa endrellaam kanduvidippadhu saadhaarana vaadikkaiyaalargalaal mudiyaadha vishayam.
Melum, ellaa vangi saaraa nidhi niruvanangalukkum podhumakkalidamirundhu vaipputhogai peruvadharku anumadhi kidaiyaadhu. Enave, andha niruvanam risarv vangiyil padhivu seythulladhaa, podhumakkalidamirundhu tevaasit pera adhigaaram petrulladhaa enbadhaiyum urudhi seythugollungal.
Matravargal ellaam mudhaleedu seythu laavam paarthuvittaargal; naam mattum thayangi thayangiye vaayppai thavaravittuvittom endru 'pomo' (FOMO) manappaanmaikku idam kodukkaadheergal. Adhiga vatti endra ore kaaranathukkaaga endha mudhaleettilum iranga vendaam. Paadhugaappu mudhalil; vatti adhan piragudhaan. Ungal nambikkaidhaan ungal vazhigaatti.
 Enadhu magalin kalvi kadanukku vinnappitha podhu sivil sgor sariyillai endru kaanbithadhu. Vangiyil vazhangappatta sivil arikkaiyil en pirandha thedhi, thandhai peyar, kudumba attai en, ottunar urimam, veettu mugavari pondravai veruvattu irundhana. Kadandha 2011l thaan naan vangi kanakku thuvanginen. Aanaal, sivilil 1997m aandu mudhal kadan petrulladhaaga arikkaiyil ulladhu. Kadan niluvaiyil ulladhaal kadan vazhanga iyalaadhu endru vangiyil therivithaargal. Indha sivil vivarangalai sariseyya uriya vazhigaattungal.
Naa.seenivaasan, pattaaviraam
sivil valaithalathukku (https://www.cibil.com/) poy padhivuseythu kondu ulle nuzhaiyungal. Ange ungal 'paan' ennai koduthaale, ungal vivarangal anaithum pattiyal idappadum. Erkanave neengal kaiyil vaithulla arikkaiyaiyum, ange pattiyal idappattulla vivarangalum ondraaga irukkindranavaa endru paarungal. Ungalai patri ellaa vivarangalum thavaraagathaan irukkindrana endraal ange ovvoru pagudhiyaaga poy, ungal aatchevanaiyai padhivu seyyungal. Kurippaaga 'indhak kadanai naan vaangave illai' endru thelivaaga sollungal.
Innoru velaiyaiyum seyyungal. Indha kadanai ungal peyaril padhivu seythulla vangi alladhu nidhi niruvanam edhuvo, avargalukku ezhuthuppoorvamaaga pugaar koduthu, thavaraana padhivugalai neekkumbadi korungal.
Podhuvaaga idhuvondra pugaargal 30 naatkalukkul pariseelikkappada vendum. Aanaal, idhai solvadhu eesi. Aanaal, nadaimuraiyil vangi alladhu nidhi niruvanathidam irundhu vilakkam vaanga vendiyiruppadhaal, orusila maadhangal kooda aagalaam. Thavaraana vivarangalai neekkuvadharku thevaiyaana aavanangalai koduthu porumaiyaaga thaan seerseythugolla vendum.
 Sondha kaaranathaal naan oru kambeniyil irundhu raajinaamaa seythen. Appodhu pi.ep. Sardiviget koduthanar. Naan adhai kavanikkavillai. Ippodhu andha panathaiyum en maadha penshanaiyum vaanga mudiyumaa? Ennidam yu.e.en. (UAN) nambar illai.
Es. Janaarthana raav, paalakkodu, tharmavuri
oru thaniyaar sveet urpathi niruvanathil 16 varudam 2 maadham panivurindhen. Andha niruvanathin ji.em. Sonnadhaal janavari maadham raajinaamaa kadidham koduthen. Paniyil irundhu vilagiya piragu en pi.ep. Thogai 90 naatkal kazhithu varum endraar ji.em. Aanaal, 152 naatkal aagiradhu. Idhu varaikkum pi.ep. Panam varavillai. 3 maadham velai thedi nondhu poyvitten. Enakku oru nalla theervu sollungal.
Tha.iraamu, annaa nagar, Chennai pi.ep. Panathai niruvanam thaanaaga ungal vangi kanakkukku anuppaadhu. Adharkaana vinnappathai neengaldhaan alikka vendum. Mudhalil https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in/ endra i.pi.ep.o. Valaithalathilo, 'umang' endra seyaliyilo ungaludaiya yu.e.en. Ennai therindhugolla muyatsi seyyungal. Yu.e.en. Theriyaavittaalum, aadhaar en, paan en, padhivu seyyappatta selbon en pondra vivarangalin udhaviyudan adhai meettedukka muyatsi seyyalaam.
Janaarthana raav: ungalidam irukkum pi.ep., saandridhazhai eduthukkondu arugilulla i.pi.ep.o. Aluvalagathirku sendraal, ungal pazhaiya kanakkai kanduvidithu, yu.e.en. Udan inaippadharkaana vazhigaattuvaargal. Neengal i.pi.es. Penshanukku thagudhiyaanavaraa enbadhaiyum angeye solluvaargal.
Raamu: ungal niruvanam sonnadhu pola '90 naatkal kazhithuthaan pi.ep. Varum' enbadhu podhuvaana vidhimurai alla. Neengal velaiyai vittu aindhu maadhangalukkum melaagivittadhaal, ungal yu.e.en. Kanakkil pi.ep. Kanakkil irupputh thogai matrum sevai vivarangalais sarivaarungal. Adhan piragu, pi.ep. Thogai kettu aanlainileye vinnappiyungal.

headline: Madappuram ajithgumaar kaaval maranam: tiesbi utbada naalvar meedhu kolai vazhakku padhiya Needhimandram utharavu
text:
Madappuram kaavalaali ajithgumaar kolai vazhakkil DSP, aayvaalar, saarbu aayvaalar kaavalar ullitta 4 per meedhu kolai vazhakku padhivu seyya Madurai maavatta Needhimandram utharavittulladhu.
Sivagangai maavattam madappurathais serndha kaavalaali ajithgumaar meedhu nigidhaa enbavar nagai thiruttu pugaar alithaar. Indhap pugaar thodarbaaga thanippadai Police ajithgumaaraip pala idangalukku azhaithus sendru thaakkiyadhil ajithgumaar uyirizhandhaar.
Indha vivagaaram thamizhagam muzhuvadhum perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu.
Indhak kolai vazhakkai CBI visaarithu varugiradhu. Indha vazhakkil maanaamadhurai thanippadai poleesgaarargal kannan, raajaa, aananth, piravu, sangara manigandan, matroru poleesgaarar raamachandhiran aagiyor kaidhu seyyappattu Madurai siraiyil adaikkappattu ullanar.
Sambavathinbodhu maanaamadhurai ti.es.pi.yaaga irundha sanmugasundharam, thiruppuvanam insbekdar rameshgumaar, sap-insbekdar sivagumaar, poleesgaarar ilaiyaraajaa aagiyorukkum indhak kolaiyil thodarbu iruppadhaaga kutrappathirigaiyil therivikkappattu ulladhu.
Indha vazhakku Madurai maavatta 5 aavadhu koodudhal needhimandrathil indru visaaranaikku vandhadhu.
Appodhu maanaamadhurai saraga tiesbi sanmugasundharam, thiruppuvanam kaaval nilaiya aayvaalar rameshgumaar, saarbu aayvaalar sivakkumaar, thalaimai kaavalar ilaiyaraajaa aagiyor meedhu kolai vazhakkuppadhivu seyya Madurai maavatta 5 aavadhu koodudhal needhimandra needhivadhi thaamodharan utharavittaar.
Needhivadhi utharavitta nilaiyil DSP, aayvaalar, saarbu aayvaalar, kaavalar aagiya 4 perum needhimandrathil amaravaikkappattullanar.

headline: Kolathooril Stalin tholvi adaivaar endru thandhi TV karuthukkanippu veliyittadhaa?
text:
Kolathoor thogudhiyil TVK vetbaalaridam M.K. Stalin tholviyaith thazhuvuvaar endru thandhi TV karuthuk kanippu veliyittadhaaga palarum

thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru karuthuk kanippu seythiyai sgireenshaat eduthu adhai vaithu pugaippada padhivai uruvaakki Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil “kolathoor thogudhiyil TVK 41-47 sadhavigidha vaakkum, DMK 28 – 34 sadhavigidha vaakkum vaakkum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha pugaippadathin mel pagudhiyil aangilathil, “thandhi TV karuthuk kanippu padi angil Stalin kolathoor thogudhiyil tholviyaith thazhuvugiraar” endru mele ezhudhappattirundhanar. Indha padathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thandhi TV therdhalukku mundhaiya karuthuk kanippai therdhal pirasaaram niraivadaiyum kadaisi naal varai veliyittirundhadhu. Kadaisi naalil mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin pottiyidum kolathoor thogudhi patriya mudivai veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil, M.K. Stalin vetri perum vagaiyil 41 mudhal 47 sadhavigidha vaakku vaangum endru kurippittirundhadhu.
Thandhi tivi-yin seythiyai maatri, TVK 41 mudhal 47 sadhavigidham varai vaakku vaangum endru kurippittullanar. Samooga oodagangalil paravum indha karuthuk kanippu thandhi TV veliyittadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Thandhi TV veliyitta kolathoor thogudhikkaana karuthuk kanippai eduthu paarthom. Adhil DMK thaan 41 mudhal 47 sadhavigidha vaakka vaangum endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla samooga oodagangalil paravum news card-ai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppi vaithom. Avarum “idhu poliyaanadhu idhai thandhi TV veliyidavillai” endru urudhi seythaar.
Idhanaith thodarndhu thandhi TV X thala pakkathil samooga oodagangalil paravum edit seyyappatta padathai thandhi TV veliyidavillai endru kurippittup padhivu ondraiyum veliyittanar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 7 mani nerathirku kuraivaaga urangugireergalaa? Echarikkum maruthuvargal!
text:
7 mani nerathirku kuraivaaga uranginaal palveru pirasnaigal iruppadhaaga maruthuvargal echarithullanar..
Porulaadhaarathil munnera vendum, petrorgalai nalla nilaimaiyil paarthukkolla vendum, kuzhandhaigalukku nalla kalvi kodukka vendum, erpatta avamaanangalukkellaam nalla nilaimaikku sendru amaravendum ena palveru latchiyangaludan naveenagaala vaazhkkaiyaanadhu ellorukkum oru poraattak kalamaagave irundhuvarugiradhu..
Migavegamaaga nagarum ulagil thangaludaiya ilakkai nokki odum manidhargal iyandhirangalaagave maarividugindranar. Avargalil paadhikkum melaanorgalukku niraivaana urakkam enbadhu sorpamaagave kidaikkumnilai irukkiradhu.
Ippadiyaana soozhal irukkum nilaiyil, ovvoru manidharukkum niraivaana urakkam vendum ena maruthuvargal parindhuraikkindranar.. Kuraindhavatcham manidhanukku 7 manineram urakkam kattaayam endrum, appadi illai endraal palveru pirasnaigal varum endrum echarikkindranar.
7 mani nerathirkum kuraivaaga thoonguvadhu avaayagaramaanadhu ena maruthuvargal echarikkindranar. Kuraivaaga thoonguvadhu, idhaya noygal, pakkavaadham erpaduvadharkaana avaayathai adhigarikkum enavum, neerizhivu noy varuvadharkaana vaayppu adhigarippadhaagavum therivikkindranar. Edai adhigarippu, noy edhirppu sakdhi palaveenamadaidhal, mana azhutham ullitta pirachinaigalum erpadumena, maruthuvargal echarikkindranar. Idhanaal ovvoru manidhanum kuraindhadhu 7 maninera urakkathaiyaavadhu urudhiseyyavendum ena maruthuvargal therivikkindranar.

headline: Manamagizh mandrathai mooda utharavu
text:
Madurai: sivagangaiyil, raani velu naachiyaar aranmanai valaagathilulla manamagizh mandrathai mooda, uyar needhimandra Madurai kilai utharavittadhu.
Madurai, theeran thirumugan thaakkal seytha podhunala manuvil, 'sivagangaiyil, veeramangai raani velu naachiyaar aranmanai valaagathil seyalbadum manamagizh mandrathai agatra utharavida vendum' ena, therivithirundhaar.
Needhivadhigal si.vi.kaarthigeyan, aar.sakdhivel amarvu pirappitha utharavil, 'manamagizh mandrathai udanadiyaaga mooda, es.pi., nadavadikkai edukka vendum' endranar.

headline: Telliyil kundu veditha kaarai otti vandha navar ivaraa?
text:
‘’telliyil kundu veditha kaarai otti vandha navar,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ #JUSTIN telliyil kundu veditha kaarai otti vandhavarin adaiyaalam therindhadhu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan pugaippadam ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhe seythi tamil.news18.com inaiyadhalathilum veliyidappattulladhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Merkanda seythiyil,
‘’Delhi car kundu vedithavodhu kaarai ottivandhavarin adaiyaalam therindhadhu. Kundu vedippirku araimani neram munnadhaaga sungachaavadiyai car kadandhu sendradhu theriyavandhadhu. Kaarai otti vandhavarin pugaippadathai Delhi kaavaldhurai veliyittulladhu. Umar endru azhaikkappadakkoodiya andha navar kaarai padharppoor ellai vazhiyaaga tellikku kondu vandhadhaagavum netru maalai 3 manineram sengottai aruge ulla poongaavil niruthivaikkappattu adhanbin maalai 6.30 mani alavil kundu vedippu nigazhndha siknal aruge kaarai konduvandhadhaagavum Police therivithullanar.’’
ivvaaru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Adhesamayam, News 18 Tamil Nadu Facebook pakkathil, Delhi car kundu vedippu kutravaali endru kurippittu veru oruvarin pugaippadathudan koodiya news card ondrum pagirappattulladhu.
Idhanbadi, News 18 Tamil Nadu oodagam, paravarappu nokkil ivvaaru munnukkup pin muranaana thagavaludan seythi veliyittulladhaaga, namakku theriyavarugiradhu.
Unmai ennavenil, Delhi kunduvedippukku kaaranamaana navar endru Police kooruvadhu, Muhammad Umar endra taakdarin peyar…
idhudhodarbaaga, sisidivi kaatchigal matrum pugaippada aadhaarangal erkanave Police tharappil thelivaagak kurippidappattullana. Melum, umar ottivandha Hyundai i20 maadal kaarin padhivu en HR26CE7674.
Aduthappadiyaaga, News 18 Tamil oodagam veliyittulla news card-il ulla navar yaarendraal, Delhi kunduvedippil paliyaana navar. Avaradhu peyar Pankaj Sahni. Peegaar maanilathais serndha vaadagai car ottunar. Pangaj ottivandha kaarin padhivu en DL1RT6662.
Idhuvatri namadhu Fact Crescendo Malayalam pirivu saarbaaga, erkanave virivaana fektchek veliyidappattulladhu. Adhanai padikka inge Click seyyavum…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda News 18 Tamil news card-il thavaraana navarin pugaippadam idambetrulladhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Moottu vali, neerizhivu noy pondra avaayangalai thavirkka.. Udalukku valuvoottum mukkiyamaana 3 payitsigal!
text:
Vayadhaanaalumgooda muraiyaana, thodarchiyaana udarpayitsigal vaayilaaga mukkiya udal uruppugalai valuvaakkuvadhan moolam udalnalathudan vaazha mudiyum. Push-ap seythal, naarkaaliyindri amarvadhuvondra payitsi, nindravaaru kudhigaalai uyarthudhal aagiya moondru mukkiya udarpayitsigal sakdhivaayndhavai aagum. Idhugurithup paarkkalaam.
Push ap payitsiyaanadhu kaigal, tholbattaigal ullitta udalin merpagudhi, mudhugu aagiyavatrukku valu oottuvadhaaga irukkum. Push ap payitsi elimaiyaaga anaivarum seyyalaam. Samadharaiyil padukkai vasathil ullangai tharaiyai thottukkondirukka vendum. Iduppu, puttam, kaalgal tharaiyai thodaadhavaaru kaalviralgal mattum tharaiyil oondriyirukka vendum. Push-ap edukkumbodhu ungaludaiya nenjju pagudhi tharaiyai thottu ezhumbadi payitsi seyya vendum.
Aduthadhaaga naarkaaliyil amarndhu ezhuvadhu pondra payitsiyil udalin iduppukku keezhe ulla pinbagudhi, kaalgal, muzhangaal aagiyavai valupperugindrana. Irandu kaigalin viralgalaiyum kothu irukki pidithavadi naarkaaliyil utkaarndhu ezhuvadhuvola seyya vendum. Indha payitsiyai merkollumbodhu ungaladhu paadhangalai tholbattaiyin agalathukku erpa virithu vaikka vendum. Tharaippagudhikku inaiyaaga thodai irukkum vagaiyil paadhangal ungaludaiya udalin keezhbagudhikku veliye irukka vendum.
Moondraavadhaaga nindravaaru kudhigaalai uyarthum payitsiyil ottumotha udaludan kurippaaga kanukkaal thasaigal negizhvu perugindrana. Moottu, muzhangaal aagiyavai valuvadaigindrana. Indha payitsiyinbodhu thevaiyenil muzhangaalai satre valaithukkollalaam. Kaal viral nunigalai tharaiyil oondri, kudhigaalai uyarthi payitsi merkolla vendum.

headline: Meksigo kalavaram endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Meksigovil podhaip porul kadathal kumbal thalaivan kollappattadhaith thodarndhu erpatta kalavaram endru kurippittu oru video

kalavaram kaaranamaaga eraalamaana vaaganangal, vaniga niruvanangal theeppatri eriyum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “meksigovil el menso kollappattadhaaga thagaval veliyaanadhum, avaradhu aadharavaalargal podhu makkal pagudhigalil kalavaram erpaduthiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Meksigovil el menso” (El Mencho) endra podhaipporul kadathal kumbalin thalaivan kollappattadhaith thodarndha andha naattil kalavaram vedithadhaaga seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil, meksigo kalavara paadhippu endru kurippittu oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video kaatchigalaip paarkkum podhu India-vil nadandhadhu pol irundhadhu. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video-vai aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2025 sepdambarilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappatta vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil nevaalathil jen Z poraattathin paadhippu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nevaala vanmurai endru veliyaana pala video-kkal migavum thelivaaga irundhana. Oru video-vil vaaganathin padhivu en kooda migath thelivaagath therindhadhu. Andha nambar pilettai nevaala naattin podhuvaana vaagana nambar pilettudan oppittup paarthavodhu, adhu nevaala naattais saarndha vaaganamdhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
El menso endru azhaikkappatta meksigo naattin podhaip porul kadathalgaarar 2026 pipravari 22m thedhi kollappattadhaaga seythigal therivikkindrana. Aanaal, meksigovil kalavaram endru pagirappadum video-vai 2025 sepdambaril nevaalathil edukkappattadhu endru veliyaagi iruppadhai urudhi seythullom. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video meksigo naattais saarndhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Maleshiya ‘maaji’ piradhamar najip rasaakkin sirai thandanai veettu kaavalaaga maatram
text:
Kolaalamboor: oozhal vazhakkil siraiyil adaikkappattulla maleshiya munnaal piradhamar najip rasaak, 73, than thandanaiyin meedhamulla kaalathai veettuk kaavalil kazhikka annaattu mannar anumadhi alithullaar.
Then kizhakkaasiya naadaana maleshiyaavin piradhamaraaga, 2009 ep., – 2018 me varai najip rasaak padhavi vagithaar. Naattin porulaadhaara valarchiyai membadutha arasu mudhaleettu nidhiyathai avar thodanginaar. Idhu, ‘1 em.ti.pi.,’ endrazhaikkappattadhu. Idhan thalaivaraagavum, adhan mudhaleedugal matrum nidhi nadavadikkaigalil muzhu adhigaaram kondavaraagavum najip seyalbattaar.
Indha nidhiyathin pala kodikkanakkaana panam muraigedaaga najippin sondha vangi kanakkukku maatrappattadhu. Adhan moolam aadambara porutkal, velinaadugalil sothugalai avar vaanginaar. Idhu thodarbaana oozhal vazhakkil, 2022l, avarukku, 12 aandugal sirai thandanai vidhikkappattadhu. 2024 janavariyil, maleshiya mannarin mannippukkuzhu avaradhu thandanai kaalathai aaru aandugalaaga kuraithadhu.
Innilaiyil, najip tharappil irundhu thaakkal seyyappatta karunai manu matrum thodar sattap poraattangalai thodarndhu, maleshiya mannar suldhaan ipraahim isgandhar, meedhamulla thandanai kaalathai najip veettukkaavalil kazhikka oppudhal alithullaar. Avaradhu thandanai, 2028 aagastil niraivadaigiradhu.

headline: Niruvana seythigal
text:
Maarudhi susoogi aalaiyil 'kireen haitrajan' amaippu
maarudhi susoogi India niruvanam, hariyaanaavin maanesar aalai valaagathil 300 kilovaat thiran konda 'kireen haitrajan elaktrolaisar' aalaiyai amaithulladhu. Sooriya minsaarathai kondu pasumai haitrajan thayaarithu, adhai iyarkai erivaayuvudan kalandhu urpathi panigalukku payanbadutha thittam udhavugiradhu. Vidumurai naatkalil urpathiyaagum sooriya oli minsaarathai semithu haitrajan thayaarikka idhu payanbadum.
Ti.es.pi., tisain niruvanathin 51% pangugal anaraak vaangiyadhu
riyal estet sevai niruvanamaana anaraak, ti.es.pi., tisain asosiyets niruvanathin 51 sadhaveedha pangugalai kaippatriyulladhu. Evvalavu thogaikku vaangappattadhu endra vivarangal veliyidappadavillai. Vadivamaippu thuraiyil ti.es.pi., niruvanam 30 aandu kaala anuvavam kondadhu. Mumbai, pengalooru, pune ullitta nagarangalil kilaigalai kondulla ti.es.pi., 1,000kkum merpatta thittangalai niraivu seythulladhu.
Esgaarts kuvodaa pangugal es.ti.ep.si., em.ep., virpanai
velaan matrum injjiniyaring uvagaranangal thayaarippil eeduvattu varum esgaarts kuvodaa niruvanathin 1.45 sadhaveedha pangugalai, es.ti.ep.si., miyoochuval pandu niruvanam 453 kodi roovaaykku panguchandhaiyil virpanai seythulladhu. Mumbai panguchandhaiyil nadandha 'palk teel' vaayilaaga esgaarts kuvodaa niruvanathin 16.21 latcham pangugal, pangu ondrukku saraasariyaaga 2,794 roobai endra vilaiyil virpanai seyyappattullana. Idhan vaayilaaga es.ti.ep.si., parasbara nidhiyin pangu mooladhanam 6.94 sadhaveedhathilirundhu 5.49 sadhaveedhamaaga kuraindhulladhu. Adhevelaiyil, nippaan India parasbara nidhi niruvanam ippangugalai vaangiyulladhu.

headline: Merku vangathil kalavarathil eeduvatta muslimgalai adithu kaidhu seythadhaa Indhiya raanuvam?
text:
Merku vangathil kalavarathil eeduvatta islaamiyargalai Indhiya raanuvathinar adithu kaidhu seytha kaatchi endru oru video

islaamiyargalai sila kaavalargal adithu ven ondril etrum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “merku vangathil kalavarathil eeduvatta amaidhi maargathai amaidhiyaana muraiyil kavanitha Indhiya raanuvathinar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merku vanga maanilam murshidhaavaath maavattathil vakp vaariya thiruthas sattathirku edhiraaga nadandha poraattathil kalavaram vedithadhu. Kalavarathil eeduvattavargalai Indhiya raanuvathinar adithu udhaithu kaidhu seythanar endru oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2020m aandilirundhu indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Endidivi indhi-yilum indha video thodarbaana seythi 2020m aandil veliyaagi iruppadhaik kandom.
Endidivi veliyittirundha seythiyaip paarthom. Adhil 2020m aandu koronaa vairas paraval kaaranamaaga ooradangu amalilirundhadhu. Appodhu mathiyap piradhesa maanilam rathlamil thadaiyai meeri ondru koodith thozhugaiyil eeduvatta islaamiyargal kaidhu seyyappattanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Namakkuk kidaitha samooga oodaga padhivugalilum idhe thagaval padhividappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam mathiyap piradhesathil nadandha koronaa vairas ooradangu thadaiyai meeriya islaamiyargal kaidhu seyyappatta video-vai eduthu 2025l merku vanga kalavarathil eeduvattavargal endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nidhi illaamal neechal kulam paraamarippu pani thengi kidakkiradhu!payitsi pera mudiyaamal maanavargal thavippu
text:
Kovai:nidhi odhukkappadaadhadhaal paaradhiyaar palgalai neechal kulam paraamarippindri ulladhu. Maanavargalukku payitsiyum, pottigalum nadatha mudiyaadha nilai erpattulladhu.
Paaradhiyaar palgalaiyil 2 ekkar nilathil iru neechal kulangal 2018l roo. 8 kodi madhippil amaikkappattana. Ikkulangalil maanavargal, podhu makkal kattanam seluthi neechal payitsi petru vandhanar. Palli, kalloori maanavargalukku pottigalum nadathappattana.
2,000kku adhigamaanor payitsi petradhaal, palgalai udarkalviyiyal thuraikku aandukku thoraayamaaga roo.1 kodikku mel varuvaay kidaithu vandhadhu.
Kadandha ep., maadham maanavar oruvar payitsiyin podhu uyirizhandhaar. Adhan pin neechal kulangal poottappattana. Thanneerin niram pachaiyaaga maari, thurnaatram veesathuvangiyadhu.
Thanneerai suthigarikka poruthappattulla, aindhu mottaargalum aaru maadhangalaaga seyalbadaadhadhaal pazhudhaanadhu. Kadandha joolai maadhame neechal kulangalai payanbaattukku konduvara, nadavadikkai edukkappadum ena palgalai tharappil therivikkappattadhu.
Aanaal, thanneerai veliyetri kulathai suthappaduthum velaigal mattum nadakkindrana. Thanneerai suthigarikkum piltreshan pilaant, mottaargal, kuzhaaygalil thanneer kasivu, 'pamp' ullittavatrai paraamarikka podhiya nidhi odhukkavillai.
Aaru maadhangalaaga poottappatta neechal kulangalaal varuvaay izhappu erpattulladhu. Maanavargal payitsi pera mudiyaamal thavikkindranar. Tharpodhu palli, kalloori maanavargalukku 'mudhalvar koppai' vilaiyaattu pottigal nadakkindrana.
Kadandhaandugalil neechal pottigal paaradhiyaar palgalaiyil nadathappattana. Immurai ettimadai amirdhaa palgalaiyil nadakka ullana.
Idhanaal Kovai maanagara pagudhigalil irundhu selvor 25 ki.mee.,kku mel payanikka vendiyulladhaaga maanavargal pulambugindranar. Viraivil kulangalai seeramaithu payanbaattukku kondu vara vendumena virumbugindranar.

headline: Kuppai agatrum pirasnaikkuidho irukku theervu! Sugaadhaara aayvaalargal aidiyaa
text:
Kovai: veedu veedaagas sendru tharam pirithu segarithaalum, maanagaraatchiyil kuppai pirasnai theerndhavaadillai. Minsaaram thayaarikkum thittathukkum podhumaana varaverpu illai. Thooymai paniyaalar ennikkaiyai adhigarithu, muzhu nera paniyaaga seyvadhu utbada niraiya aalosanaiyai allitharugindranar sugaadhaara aayvaalargal.
Maanagaraatchiyil thinamum 1200 tan kuppai segaramaagiradhu. Ivatrai irandaaga pirithu vaangave thooymai paniyaalargal siramappadum nilaiyil, ippodhu naangaaga pirikka vendum engindranar.
Kuppai thottigalaiyum agatri vittadhaal, iravilum, pogira pokkilum theruvoram veesappadum pirikkappadaadha kuppai moottaigal adhigarithu vittana.
Idharku enna thaan theervu? Sugaadhaara aayvaalargal silaridam namadhu niruvargal pesinar. Avargal therivitha sila karuthukkal:
l ivvalavu periya nagaril kuppaiyai menej seyya, aatkal podhaadhu. 'maikro levalil' anuga vendum. 600 veedugalukku oru kangaanippaalar niyamikka vendum.
L ethanai veedugal irukkindrana, ethanai per vasikkindranar engira vivaram maanagaraatchiyidam thulliyamaaga irukkiradhu. Adharkerpa oozhiyargalai niyamikka vendum. * edhenum oru pagudhikku thooymai paniyaalar velaikku varavillai endraal, veru aalai anuppa vendum. 10 sadhaveedha oozhiyargal 'risarv' muraiyil thayaaraaga irukka vendum.
L vaarathil ezhu naatkalum kuppai alla vendum. Oozhiyargalukku suzhatsi muraiyil vaaram oru naal viduppu tharalaam. Kuppai vaaganam pazhudhaanaal, veru vaaganam anuppa vendum; oppandhappadi, 10 sadhaveedha vandi thayaaraaga vaithirukka vendum.
L kuppai segarippu kuraigetbu maiyam amaikka vendum. Laariyil ji.pi.es. Karuvi iyangugiradhaa; vazhakkamaana roottil selgiradhaa; kuppai allappadugiradhaa enbadhai kangaanikka vendum.
L kuppai alluvadhu pagudhi nera velai alla. Muzhu neramum thodara vendum. Endha idathilum kuppai thengaadhadhai urudhi seyya vendum. 2 shipt, 3 shipt ena velai nerathai maatralaam. Ookkathogai kodukkalaam.
L veedugalil kuppai edupporai ottalgalilum edukkas sonnaal, ore tirippil laari lodaagi vidum. Meedhamulla veedugalil edukka mudiyaadhu. Laari kidangirku sendru varuvadharkul veettil iruppavargal velaikku sendru viduvar. Adhanaal, ovvoru sekdaraaga pirithu segarippadhe theervu.
L makkum kuppaiyai thinamum segarikkalaam. Makkaadha kuppaiyai vaarathil oru naal segarithaal podhum. Keralathil pinbatrappadum indha nadaimurai, kuppaiyai elidhaaga pirikka udhavum.
Ivvaaru, avargal therivithanar.
Ma.pi.yin indhoor maanagaraatchiyil, kuppai melaanmai migachirappaaga seyalbadugiradhu. Nammooril iruppadhai pola, angum 22 latcham makkal thogaiye irukkiradhu. Angu poy paarthu vandhu pinbatrinaal pirasnaigal theerndhu vidum endrum sila sugaadhaara aayvaalargal koorugindranar.

headline: Vivasaayigalukku thinamum minvaariyam... Shaak!:seeratra min viniyogathaal paridhavippu
text:
Pedhappambatti: thennai saaguvadi piradhaanamaaga ulla udumalai, pollaachi pagudhiyil, nilavum varatchiyai samaalikka, thunai minnilaiyangalil irundhu seeraana mummunai minsaaram viniyogikka vendum. 'rooral peedar' enappadum kiraama minvazhithada paraamarippil koodudhal kavanam selutha vendum' ena, vivasaayigal valiyuruthugindranar. Udumalai minbagirmaana vattathin keezh, pollaachi, udumalai pagudhiyil, 10kkum merpatta thunai minnilaiyangal ullana. Iru pagudhigalilum, irandu latcham ekkarukkum adhigamaana parappil thennai saaguvadinadakkiradhu. Merkuthodarchi malai pagudhigalil indhaandu thenmerku paruvamazhai podhiyalavu peyyavillai. Pi.e.pi., anaigalin neermattamum thirupdhigaramaaga illai.
Kiraamappurangalil amaindhulla, thevanoor pudhoor, angalakkurichi, negamam, kongalnagaram, aalaamarathoor ullitta thunai min nilaiyangalil irundhu vivasaaya min inaippugalukku kurippitta neram mattume mummunai minsaaram vazhangappadugiradhu.
Andha velaiyildhaan vivasaayigal thangal minmottaargalai iyakki neerppaasanam seyya vendum. Sameevagaalamaaga rooral peedar enappadum kiraama minvazhithadangalil, seeraana mummunai minsaaram iruppadhillai endra pugaar ezhundhulladhu.
Vivasaayigal koorugaiyil, kadum varatchiyai sandhithu varuvadhaal kiraama minvazhithada paraamarippu matrum seeramaippu panigalil minvaariyathinar koodudhal kavanam selutha vendum' endranar.

headline: Tironil irundhu evuganai evi India nadathiya sodhanai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Tironil irundhu evuganai seluthi India sodhanai nadathiyadhaaga oru video

tironil irundhu evuganai seluthappadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “tironil irundhu evuganai evi sodhanai vetri . Indhiya raanuvathin adutha saadhanai..!!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sameevathil India-vin paadhugaappu aaraaychi matrum membaattu amaippu (tiaardio) tironil irundhu evuganaiyai evi India sodhanai nadathiyadhu. Indha sodhanai vetri petradhaagap paadhugaapputh thurai amaichar raajnaathsing therivithirundhaar. Indha soozhalil India nadathiya tironil irundhu evuganai seluthum sodhanai endru kurippittu video ondrai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vil piraiyudan koodiya logo irundhadhu. India-vin tiaardio-vin logo illaamal, pirai nilavudan logo iruppadhaal sandhegam ezhundhadhu. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video-vai aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2021m aandileye indha video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Enave, indha video tharpodhu nadandha sodhanaiyudan thodarbudaiyadhu illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Thurukkiyais saarndha ROKETSAN endra raanuvath thalavaada urpathi niruvanam indha sodhanaiyai nadathiyadhaaga 2021m aandu akdovar 3m thedhi veliyaana YouTube padhivil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovilum ROKETSAN endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Video-vin matroru pakkathil SSB endru logo ondru irundhadhu. Adhu enna endru aayvu seythu paarthavodhu, adhu thurukki arasin paadhugaappu thozhilaga seyalagam (Türkiye’s Defense Industries Secretariat) endru theriyavandhadhu. Adhan inaiyadhala pakkathil andha logovum irundhadhu.
Indhiyaavum appadi oru sodhanai nadathiyadhu unmaidhaan. Aanaal, video India nadathiya sodhanaiyin video illai. 2021l thurukki nadathiya tironil irundhu evuganai seluthum sodhanaiyin video-vai India-vin tiaardio nadathiya sodhanai endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaanadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thanalaavathirku mun vaanadhi seenivaasan endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’thanalaavathirku mun vaanadhi seenivaasan,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ *🧐oru kaalathil vasanth an ko vil indha stav vaangittu EMI katta mudiyaamal thiruppi kodutha indha penmani indru pallaayiram kodigalukku thanalaavathodu adhivadhiyaaga vilangum ivar yaar endru therigiradhaa…..*
*veru yaarumillai vaanadhi seenivaasan*,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu oru thavaraana pugaippadam endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, indha padathil iruppavar vaanadhi seenivaasan kidaiyaadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, naam vaanadhi seenivaasan tharappilum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, samooga valaidhalangalil kaanappadum pugaippadam ondrai eduthu, vendumendre arasiyal ulnokkathudan vaanadhi seenivaasan peyaril vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Saalai vivathil amaichar magal pali
text:
Jaamshetboor: jaarkkandil mudhalvar hemanth soran thalaimaiyilaana jaarkkant mukdhi morchaa, Congress koottani aatchi nadakkiradhu. Ingu ooraga membaadu matrum panjjaayathu raaj thurai amaicharaaga kaangirasai serndha theevigaa paande sing ullaar. Ivaradhu magal thirishaa sing pilas 2 padithu vandhaar. Ivar than nanbargal moondru perudan, 'maarudhi svipt' kaaril netru adhigaalai sendraar. Appodhu, jaamshetbooril ulla marain tiraiv saalaiyil sendravodhu pazhudhaagi nindrirundha lodu laariyin pinnaal car vegamaaga modhiyadhu. Idhil kaaril payanitha amaicharin magal thirishaa utbada naangu perum sambava idathileye paliyaaginar.
Muslim thirumanangal:asaamil kattaaya padhivu
kuvahaathi: vadagizhakku maanilamaana asaamil: maanilam muzhudhum thirumanap padhivaik kattaayamaakkuvadharkaana seeraana nadaimurai kattamaippai uruvaakkum vagaiyil, 'asaam muslim thirumanap padhivu kattaaya vidhigal, 2026' endra masodhaa thaakkal seyya oppudhal alikkappattulladhu. Idhanmoolam muslim thirumanangalaip padhivu seyvadhil irundhu kaajikkal vilakki vaithirundha nilaiyil, inivarum kaalangalil muslim thirumanangal padhivaalargalaal padhivu seyyappadum. Vinnappangalin ennikkai, adhigamaaga irundhaal, makkal siramappadaamal irukka, panjjaayathu alavilaana sila adhigaarigalukkum thirumanangalai padhivu seyya adhigaaram vazhanga vaayppu erpaduthappadum.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.
250 madharasaakkalai: mooda utharavu: kolgattaa: merku vangathil, madharasaa enappadum islaamiya madha kalviyai podhikkum eraalamaana palligal, arasin nidhiyudhavi petru iyangi varugindrana. Aanaal, pala palligal muraigedaagavum, arasin nidhi aadhaarathai thavaraaga payanbaduthuvadhaagavum thodarndhu pugaar ezhundhana.
Idhaiyaduthu, maanila siruvaanmaiyinar nalathurai matrum madharasaa kalvithurai inaindhu kala aayvu merkondadhu. Indha aayvil, arasu angeegaaram petra 250 thaniyaar madharasaakkalil, perumbaalaanavatril maanavar serkkai migak kuraivaagavum, podhiya utkattamaippu vasadhigal indriyum iyangi vandhadhu kandariyappattadhu.
Idhai thodarndhu, sambandhappatta madharasaakkalil padikkum sila maanavargalin nalanai karuthil vaithu, avatrai padippadiyaaga mooda kolgai reedhiyil mudivu edukkappattulladhu.

headline: Kolathoor emele vi.es.paavuvukku moochuthinaral.. Maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhi!
text:
Kolathoor thogudhiyil munnaal mudhalamaichar muga staalinai veezhthi, DMK varalaatril perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiya TVK emele vies paavu, tharpodhu 75 vayadhil moochuthinaral kaaranamaaga maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattullaar.
Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhalil kavanikkumbadiyaana vetri, tholvi endraal adhu kolathoor thogudhiyin vetri tholvi thaan. Munnaal mudhalamaichar muga Stalin avarudaiya sondha thogudhiyileye thavegavin vies paavuvidam tholviyai sandhithaar. Therdhalil 40.51% sadhaveedha vaakkugalai muga Stalin petra nilaiyil, koodudhalaaga 8795 vaakkugalai petra vies paavu 45.31 sadhaveedha vaakkugaludan vetrivetru DMK arasiyal varalaatril migapperiya tholvikku vazhivaguthaar. DMK-vin 70 aandugaala arasiyal varalaatril mudhalvaraaga irundhu adutha therdhalil thotra thalaivaraaga muga Stalin peyar ezhudhappattadhu.
Idhil kavanikkappadum matroru visayam ennavendraal, munbu DMK-vin angamaaga irundha vies paavu, muga staalinin therdhal vetrikku munnindru paniyaatrivar enbadhum, tharpodhu avaridame thotriruppadhum appodhaiya soozhalil pesuvorulaaga irundhadhu. Ippadi munnaal mudhalamaichar muga staalinukku edhiraaga sattamandra therdhalil pottiyittu vetrivetradhaal arasiyal vattaarathil kavanikkappadum oruvaraaga thavegavin kolathoor emele vies paavu maarinaar.
Innilaiyil thaan 75 vayadhaagum vies paavuvukku udalnalakkuraivu erpattu amaindhagaraiyil ulla emjiem maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattullaar. Moochuthinaral erpattu anumadhikkappattirukkum vies paavuvukku, avasara pirivil suvaasakkaruvi udhaviyudan theevira sigichai alikkappattuvaruvadhaagavum, avarudaiya udalnalan seeraaga iruppadhaagavum, thodarndhu avar kangaanikkappattu varuvadhaagavum maruthuvamanai nirvaagam therivithulladhu. Indhasoozhalil vies paavu viraivil udal nalam petru veedu thirumba vendum endru avaradhu aadharavaalargalum, thavegavinarum viruppam therivithu samooga valaithalangalil padhivittu varugiraargal.

headline: “kirushnarin thuvaaragai nagaram” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kirushnar aatchi seytha thuvaaragai nagaram kadalil kanduvidikkappattadhu pondru oru video Facebook-il pagirappattu varugiradhu.

Kadalukku adiyil kirushnarin uruva sirpangaludan koodiya nagarai aayvaalargal kandarindhadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “*sree kirushnar aatchi seytha thuvaaragai nagarathai naam anaivarum indru paarppom. Kaalangal kadandhaalum adhan azhagu maaraamal ulladhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Magaavaaradha kadhaiyil varum kirushnar thuvaaragai nagarathai aatchi seythadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Adhu kadalil moozhgivittadhu endrum sollappadugiradhu. Andha nagarathai kanduvidikka vendum endru indhiyath tholliyal aayvuth thurai thodarndhu aaraaychi seythu varugiradhu. Thuvaaragai irundhadhaaga nambappadum tharpodhu kadalukku adiyil ulla pagudhiyil nadathappatta aayvil sila porutkal kidaithullana. Avai 2000m aandukkup pirpattavai endru koorappadugiradhu. Nagarathin pazhaimaiyaana kudiyiruppu ullittavai kanduvidikkappattadhaaga endha thagavalum illai.
Indha nilaiyil, kadalukkadiyil sgoovaa taiving seythu pazhaiya thuvaaragai nagarai aayvaalargal kanduvidithadhu pondru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Video-vai paarkkum podhu kadal mattathilirundhu sila adi thoorathileye andha nagaram iruppadhu pola ulladhu. Andha pagudhi kattidangal idindhiruppadhu pola kaattappattulladhu. Aanaal, silaigal, kovilgal, kattidangalin merparappu meedhu endha paadhippum erpadaadha vagaiyil pala aandugalaaga nangu paraamaritha nilaiyil avai iruppadhu pola kaattappattulladhu. Paarkka eai moolam uruvaakkappatta video pola ulladhu.
Thuvaaragai nagarathai Indhiya arasu kanduvidithadhaaga, andha kattidangalin video-vai veliyittadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Unmaiyil appadi kanduvidikkappattirundhaal paajaga-vinar matrum mathiya arasu migapperiya alavil kondaadiyirukkum. Aanaal, aayvu nadandhu varuvadhaaga seythigal kidaithanave thavira kanduvidikkappattadhaaga edhuvum namakkuk kidaikkavillai.
Video-vil mbaiarts endru instaagiraam aidi irundhadhu. Andha instaagiraam pakkathirku sendru thedip paarthom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovum irundhadhu. Adhil, “indha video-vai uruvaakkiyadhu @mbaiarts” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Melum anaithu kaatchigalum seyarkai nunnarivaal (eai)- uruvaakkappattadhu endrum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Video-vai uruvaakkiyavare idhu eai video endru therivithullaar. Aanaal adhai eduthu samooga oodagangalil padhivittavargalo unmaiyil kanduvidikkappatta thuvaaragai nagaram enbadhu pondru vadhandhiyaip parappiyiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vakp sattath thirutha masodhaa niraivetrappatta piragu ovaisi azhuvadhaaga kooruvadhu poliyaana thagaval | Viral posts claiming Owaisi crying after Waqf Bill is false
text:
Vakp sattath thirutha masodhaa niraivetrappatta piragu ovaisi azhuvadhaaga kooruvadhu poliyaana thagaval
indha viral kaanoli 2024 naadaalumandra mazhaikkaala koottathodarilirundhu edukkappattadhu enbadhai poom kandarindhulladhu.
Vakp thirutha masodhaa naadaalumandrathil niraivetrappatta piragu, haidharaavaath makkalavai uruppinaraana asaadhudheen ovaisiyin kaanoli matrum pugaippadam samooga oodagangalil viral-aagi varugiradhu. Idhanudan, masodhaa niraivetrappatta piragu asaadhudheen ovaisi unarchivasappattadhaaga samooga valaidhalathil paraviyadhu.
Vairalaana kaanoli kadandha 2024aam aandu aagast 7aam thedhiyandru makkalavaiyil nidhi (en.2) masodhaa, 2024 meedhaana vivaadhathin podhu edukkappattadhu enbadhai poom kandarindhadhu. Peegaar maanilam poorniyaa naadaalumandra uruppinar raajesh ranjjan endra pappu yaadhav uraiyaatrumbodhu, avarukkup pinnaal amarndhirundha ovaisi thanadhu kannaadiyaik kazhatrivittu, netriyaiyum kangalaiyum kaigalaal thudaithu kondiruppadhaik kaanalaam.
Edhirppugal matrum vivaadhangalukku mathiyil, vakp thirutha masodhaa, 2025, naadaalumandrathin iru avaigalaalum niraivetrappattulladhu. Ippodhu adhu kudiyarasuth thalaivarin oppudhalukku anuppappattulladhu.
Idhep pondra padhivu, X thalathilum pagirappattadhu.

headline: "kest havusukku azhaithaar.." thelangaanaa mudhalvarin udhaviyaalar meedhu pen thozhiladhivar kutrachaattu!
text:
Thelangaanaa maanilathais serndha pen thozhiladhivar oruvar, ammaanila mudhalvar revanth rettiyin nerungiya udhaviyaalar meedhu kadumaiyaana kutrachaattugalai munvaithullaar. Ichambavam thelangaanaa arasiyalil puyalaik kilappiyulla nilaiyil, edhirkkatchiyaana paarath raashdira samidhi (BRS)arasidam kelvi ezhuppiyulladhu.
Thelangaanaa maanilathil mudhalvar revanth retti thalaimaiyilaana Congress katchi aatchiyil ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil, thelangaanaa maanilathais serndha 'midhunaa aats' (Mithuna Ads) niruvanathin urimaiyaalarum, thozhiladhivarumaana ke. Shovaa retti, mudhalvar revanth rettiyin nerungiya udhaviyaalar meedhu kadumaiyaana kutrachaattugalai munvaithullaar. Idhugurithu avar, thelangaanaavil velippura vilambara (Outdoor Advertising) vanigam thodarbaana thanadhu niruvanathin thittangalai munvaikkas sendravodhu, mudhalvarukku nerukkamaana udhaviyaalar oruvar thannidam thavaraaga nadandhugondadhaagavum, vivaadhangalukkaagath thaniyaar virundhinar illathirku (Guest House) varumaaru azhaithadhaagavum kutramsaattiyullaar.
Melum idhu thodarbaaga X thalathil mudhalvar revanth rettiyaith tag seythu padhivitta avar, oru pen thozhiladhivaraaga sattappoorvamaana thozhil vaayppugalai anugumbodhu ithagaiya anugumuraigal migundha mana ulaichalaiyum asaugariyathaiyum tharuvadhaagak kurippittullaar. Arasaanga vivagaarangalum tendar thodarbaana pechuvaarthaigalum thanippatta virundhinar illangalil allaamal, muraiyaana, velippadaiyaana matrum kanniyamaana arasu aluvalaga vazhigalil mattume nadaivera vendum endrum avar valiyuruthiyullaar. Ichambavam thelangaanaa arasiyalil puyalaik kilappiyulla nilaiyil, edhirkkatchiyaana paarath raashdira samidhi (BRS)arasidam kelvi ezhuppiyulladhu.

headline: ‘jem veeramani enadhu nanbar’ endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
Jem veeramani en nanbar endru DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga oru news card

vigadan veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “66 “jem kiraanaits veeramani enadhu nanbar. Naangal iruvarum siriya vayadhu mudhal edhu seythaalum ondraaga thaan seyvom” DMK thalaivar, staalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Paaliyal kutrachaattu adippadaiyil piravala thozhiladhivar jem kiraanaits veeramani kaidhu seyyappattullaar. Avarukkum thi.mu.ka-vukkum thodarbu ulladhu enbadhu pondra karuthai parappath thodarndhu samooga oodagangalil poliyaana news kaardugal parappappattu varugindrana.
Andha vagaiyil jem veeramani enadhu nanbar, siriya vayadhu mudhal edhu seythaalum ondraagathaan seyvom endru munnaal mudhalvar M.K. Stalin kooriyadhu pondru news card-ai palarum parappi varugindranar. Adhaavadhu, indha paaliyal kutrachaattil thanakkum thodarbulladhu endru maraimugamaaga avar oppukkolvadhu pondru news card-ai parappi varugindranar. Paarkka vigadan veliyittadhu pondre ulladhaal palarum idhai unmai endru karudhi vimarsithu varugindranar.
Unmaiyil M.K. Stalin appadi kooriyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Appadi kooriyirundhaal adhai ellaa oodagangalum veliyittirukkum. Aanaal, endha oodagathilum appadi oru seythi veliyaagi irukkavillai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam enbadhaal aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil vigadan veliyitta news kaardugalai paarthom. Adhil jem veeramani pirasnai erpatta piragu ippadi oru news card-ai vigadan veliyidavillai endru therindhadhu. Satru pinnokki paartha podhu sepdambar 15m thedhi idhe pondru news card-ai vigadan veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu.
Adhil, “mupperum vizhaa othivaippu! DMK thalaivar mu.ka.staalinukku erpattulla viral kaaychal kaaranamaaga, Chennai annaa arivaalayathil indru maalai nadaivera irundha DMK mupperum vizhaa othivaikkappattulladhu. Maatruth thedhi pinnar arivikkappadum endru DMK podhucheyalaalar Duraimurugan therivithullaar” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu vishamathanamaana karuthai serthu pagirndhiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla, aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai vigadan digital poruppaalarukku anuppi visaarithom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kadandha 2024aam aandu edutha kaanoli, sunidhaa villiyams poomikku thirumbum kaanoliyaaga pagirappattadhu | An Old Video of Sunita Williams being shared as her Earth-returning posts
text:
Kadandha 2024aam aandu edutha kaanoli, sunidhaa villiyams poomikku thirumbum kaanoliyaaga pagirappattadhu
sunidhaa villiyams sarvadhesa vinveli nilaiyathirku nuzhaindha pazhaiya kaanoliyai sameevathil avar poomikku thirumbiya kaanoliyaaga pagirappattadhu endru poom kandarindhadhu.
Vinveli veeraanganai sunidhaa villiyams poomikku thirumbiyadhaaga koorappadum kaanoli ondru vairalaanadhu. Aanaal, adhu kadandha 2024aam aandu avar sarvadhesa vinveli nilaiyathirku sendradaindha pazhaiya kaanoli endru poom kandarindhadhu.
Amerikkaavais serndha vinveli veeraanganai sunidhaa villiyams, kadandha 2024aam aandu joon maadham, puts vilmor enbavarudan serndhu sarvadhesa vinveli nilaiyathirku ettu naal payanam merkondaar. Aanaal, sila thozhilnutba kolaaru kaaranamaaga, avargal iruvarum onbadhu maadhangal angu thanga vendiya kattaayam erpattadhu. Pinnar, ivargal maars 19aam thedhi poomikku thirumbinaargal.
Indha kaanoliyil, sunidhaa villiyams sandhoshathil thulli kudhithu, saga oozhiyargaludan kondaadugiraar. Sumaar 24 nodigal neelum indha kaanoliyai, “sunidhaa sandhoshathil thulli kudhikkiraar. Sarvadhesa vinveli nilaiyathil 9 maadhangalaaga irundha sunidhaa villiyams poomikku thirumbinaar,” endru indhiyil ezhudhappatta karuthudan vairalaanadhu.
Indha padhivin

headline: Vinaayagar silaigalukku ... Paadhugaappu: Kovai es.pi., arivurai
text:
Mettupalayam: podhu idangalil vaikkappattulla vinaayagar silaigalukku kuraindhadhu 3 mudhal 5 per varai nirvaagigal kaaval irukka vendum,'' ena Kovai es.pi., koorinaar.
Vinaayagar sadhurthiyai munnittu, Mettupalayathil hindhu munnani saarbil 61 silaigalum, kaaramadaiyil152 silaigalum, visuva hindhu parishath saarbil 10 silaigalum, agila paaradha indhu magaa savaa saarbil 3 silaigalum, hindhu makkal katchi saarbil 5 ena mothamaaga180silaigal piradhishdai seyyappada ullana.
Adhe pol, sirumugaiyil hindhu munnani saarbil 38, vishva hindhu parishath saarbil 7 ena mothamaaga 45 silaigal podhu idangalil varum 14m thedhi piradhishdai seyyappadaullana. Mothamaaga Mettupalayam thaalugaavil 286silaigal piradhishdai seyyappada ullana.
Idhaiyaduthu, Mettupalayam Police station-il, Kovai es.pi., pavan kumaar thalaimaiyil ti.es.pi., paasgar, thanippirivu insbekdar sinnakkaamanan munnilaiyil, hindhu amaippugalin nirvaagigaludan aalosanai koottam netru nadandhadhu.
Koottathil, rooral es.pi., pavan kumaar pesugaiyil ''vinaayagar silaigalukku kuraindhadhu 3 mudhal 5 per varai nirvaagigal kaaval irukka vendum. Si.si.ti.vi., kemaraakkal poruthi irukka vendum. Visarjanam seyya silaigalai eduthu sellum podhu nangu paraamarippikkappatta vaaganangalai mattume payanbadutha vendum. Oorvalam thuvangi silai karaikkum varai kaavaldhuraiyinarukku muzhu othuzhaippu alikka vendum'' endraar.
Mettuppaalaiyathilvaikkappadum silaigal suppiramaniya suvaami kovil pavaani aatrangaraiyilum, kaaramadaiyil vaikkappadum silaigal thekkambatti vanavathragaaliyamman kovil pavaani aatrilum, sirumugaiyil vaikkappadum vinaayagar silaigal pazhathottam pavaani aatrangaraiyilum karaikkappada ullana.
Idharkaaga, Mettupalayathil sirappu adhiradippadaiyinar, kamaando Police, ulloor Police matrum oorkkaaval padaiyinar ena 700-kkum merpattor paadhugaappu paniyil eeduvaduthappada ullanar.

headline: Parsanal lonai mungoottiye kattinaal sivil sgor kuraiyumaa?
text:
En parsanal lon kaalakkeduvaana aindhu aandugalil, naangu aandugal kattivitten. Ippodhu adhai pree-kulos seythaal, kiredit sgor adivaangum endru vangiyil therivikkindranar. Enna seyvadhu?
Pi. Saravanan, Chennai 
aindhu mudhal 30 pulligal varai tharkaaligamaaga kiredit pulligal sariyakkoodum. Aanaal, adhu oru pirasnai illai. Enenil, ungaludaiya motha kadanaiyum ozhungaaga seluthi vitteergal enbadhe, adippadaiyil ungal sgorai uyarthi kodukkum. Ungaludaiya motha kadan pattiyalil, oru kadan neenguvadhaal erpadum kiredit sgor kanakkidum algaaridham maarum enbadhaaldhaan, indha tharkaaliga sarivu erpadum. Matra kadangalai ozhungaaga seluthi vandhaal, adutha 3 mudhal aaru maadhangalil ungal kiredit sgor pazhaiya nilaikku thirumbividum.
Sivil sgor ilavasamaaga petru kollalaam endru inaiyathil vilambarangal varugindranave; vinnappikkalaamaa?
Latchumanan, Madurai 
vilambarathai paarthu vinnappikka vendaam. Aar.pi.ai., vidhimuraiyinbadiye, sivil niruvanam, aandukku orumurai ilavasamaaga kiredit ripport vazhanga vendum. Sivil niruvanathin adhigaarappoorva valaidhalathukku sendru, ungal paan en, movail en ullittavatrai koduthu, indha ripporttai petrukkollalaam.
Pala thaniyaar valaidhalangalum idhe ripporttai vaazhnaal muzhudhum ilavasamaaga tharugirom endru vilambaram seyvadhai paarthiruppeergal. Ivatril irundhum petrukkollalaam. Aanaal, ore pirasnai, ungaludaiya movail en avargalidam maattikkollum. Veru veru nidhichevaigalaiyum kadangalaiyum vazhanguvadharkaaga ungalai thodarndhu thondharavu seythu konde iruppar. Adhanaal, adhigaarappoorva valaidhalathukku selvadhe nalladhu.
Oru purokkar vazhiyaaga, maadhandhorum 10 aayiram veedham, 4 alladhu 5 es.ai.pi.,kkalil 10 maadhangal pottu vandhen. Pin, adhai thodara mudiyavillai. Niruthi vitten. Naangaindhu aandugal aagivittana. Pin, andha purokkar niruvanathil irundhu azhaithadhaal, meendum 10 aayiram roobai mudhaleedu seythen. Ippodhu enakku oru kurunjjeythi vandhulladhu. Mainas 23 roobai, en puk pelans endru adhu solgiradhu. Naan mudhaleedu seytha panam pathiramaaga irukkumaa? Idhu enna negadiv pelans?
Paalaat. Suppiramani, minnanjjal 
purokkar vazhiyaaga miyoochuval pandugalil mudhaleedu seyyum podhu irandu vidhamaana kanakkugal uruvaakkappadum. Ondru ungal miyoochuval pandu poliyo. Matrondru tireding / letjar akkavunt. Idhu oru manivars maadhiri. Idhan vazhiyaagathaan, panathai miyoochuval pandu yoonittugal vaanga payanbadutha mudiyum.
Neengal naangaindhu aandugalaaga mudhaleedu seyyaadhadhaal, indha tireding / letjar kanakku mainas aagiyulladhu. Avargaludaiya sevai kattanathai neengal aandudhorum seluthaadhadhaal, adhu ippadi aagiyulladhu.
Ungal mudhaleettukku pirasnai illai. Adhu pathiramaagave irukkiradhu. Neengal andha purokking niruvanathil tireding sevaikkaana kattanathai seluthinaal, andha kanakku puthuyir petruvidum. Ungal poliyo ennai vaithu, ungal mudhaleedu evvalavu thooram valarndhirukkiradhu enbadhai kems en.es.ti.el., kes porttal (https://www.camsonline.com/) alladhu, https://www.kfintech.com/ porttalil poy paarthuk kollalaam.
Naan oru thaniyaar niruvanathil panivurigiren. En semippin kanisamaana oru thogaiyai en thaay peyaril mootha kudimakkal semippu thittathil panathai podalaamaa? Naan varumaana vari seluthi varuvadhaal, en thaay vaippu nidhi vattikku mattum varumaana vari seluthinaal podhumaa? Iruvarin varumaana vari thaakkalukkaaga edhenum teet ezhudha vendumaa ?
Kavin, Erode 
thaaraalamaaga ungal thaayin peyaril mootha kudimakkal semippu thittathil panam podalaam. Adharkaaga, avar andha thittathil mudhaleedu seyvadharkaana thagudhiyai petrirukka vendum.
Neengal, ungal thaaykku panathai anbalippaaga koduthu, avar andha panathai mudhaleedu seythaal, andha mudhaleettil kidaikkum vatti ungal varumaanamaaga karudhappadaadhu; ungal thaayin varumaanamaagave karudhappadum. Enave, avaradhu motha varumaanathukku erpa, avare varumaana vari selutha vendum.
Varumaana vari thaakkalukkaaga kattaayamaaga edhenum pathiram ezhudha vendum endra avasiyam illai. Aanaal, panam ungalidamirundhu ungal thaaykku sendradhu enbadharku thelivaana aadhaaram iruppadhu nalladhu.
Ungal vangi kanakkilirundhu ungal thaayin vangi kanakkukku panathai anuppungal. Rokkamaaga koduppadhai thavirungal. Panathai anbalippaaga vazhangugireergal endraal, adharkaana oru eliya 'kipt lettar' ezhudhi iruvarum kaiyezhuthittu vaithukkollalaam. Vangi parivarthanaikkaana aadhaarathaiyum paadhugaappaaga vaithukkollungal.
Mukkiyamaaga, idhu unmaiyaana anbalippaaga irukka vendum. Panathai ungal thaayin peyaril vaithuvittu, adhanmeedhu muzhu urimaiyaiyum neengal thodarndhu vaithirukka koodaadhu.
En pillai padippukkaaga 51.7 latcham roobai kalvik kadan vendum. Vangiyil adamaanam ketkiraargal. Kodukka vendumaa?
Suresh, pollaachi 
vangigalidam 7.5 latcham varai kalvikkadan kettaal, adharku adamaanam ketkakkoodaadhu endru vidhimurai irukkiradhu. Neengal ketkum thogai adhigam enbadhaal, adharku paadhugaappu vendum enbadharkaaga, vangiyil adamaanam ketkiraargal.

headline: Tamil Naattil sattam ozhungin tharpodhaiya nilai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Tamil Naattin sattam ozhungin tharpodhaiya nilai endru kurippittu oru video

ilainjar oruvarai ilam pen adikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha ilainjar aavaasamaagap pesiyadhaal adithadhaaga andha pen vilakkam alikkum kaatchiyum adhil irundhadhu. Andha video-vin meedhu, “sattam ozhungin tharpodhaiya nilai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Video me 21, 2026 andru Facebook-il padhividappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam tharpodhaiya TVK arasu aatchi amaitha piragaana nilai endra arthathil padhividappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “sattam ozhungin tharpodhaiya nilai 🚨 naattil sattam ozhungu endha nilaiyil ulladhu?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattin sattam ozhungin tharpodhaiya nilai endru kurippittu video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil tharpodhaiya aatchiyin peyarai engum kurippidavillai. Aanaal, me 21m thedhi padhivittiruppadhan moolam TVK aatchiyin sattam ozhungu endra arthathil video padhividappattiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Ilainjarai pen oruvar adikkum indha video sila maadhangalukku munbu paartha ninaivu irundhadhu. Enave, idhu tharpodhaiya video illai enbadhu theriyave, idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom.
Appodhu, 2026 maars maadham 2m thedhi indha video-vai seythi oodagangal veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Polimer news inaiyathalathil idhu thodarbaaga seythiyum veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, “kadaloor maavattam sidhambarathil paikkil sendra pengalai pin thodarndhu aavaasamaaga varnanai seytha irandu ilainjargalai madakkippidithu iru pengalum serthu adithanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam indha sambavathirkum tharpodhaiya aatchikkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Maars 2m thedhi Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyilirundhadhu. Appodhu nadandha oru sambavathin video-vai ippodhai sattam ozhungin nilai endru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
