headline: Thuvaay meedhu evuganai thaakkudhal nadathiya Iran endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran meedhu evuganaith thaakkudhal nadathiya Iran endru oru video

evuganai alladhu tiron thaakkudhal nadappadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thuvaay mela nallaa rasichu evuganai pottu vilaiyaaduraan eeraan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran meedhu America, Israel thaakkudhalai nadathiyadhu. Padhiladiyaaga aravu pagudhiyil ulla America raanuva thalangal meedhu Iran padhil thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu. Appadi thuvaay meedhu Iran nadathiya thaakkudhalin kaatchi endru kurippittup pala video-kkal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindrana. Appadip parappappadum oru video-vai aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. 2025m aandu Iran – Israel modhalin podhum indha video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Tel aviv meedhu thaakkudhal endru Israel raanuvame indha video-vai padhivittirundhadhaaga sila seythigalum namakku kidaithana.
Adhe nerathil 2024m aandil indha video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Sila padhivugalil endha idam endru kurippidavillai. Aanaal, sirappaana sambavam enbadhu pola padhivittirundhanar. Oru padhivil idhu tel aviv meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
2024m aandu Israel thalainagar telaviv meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhal ondrin video-vai eduthu, 2026l thuvaay meedhu Israel nadathiya thaakkudhal endru thavaraagap padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video thavaraana thagavalaik kondadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kadayanallur rail nilaiyathil aangila ezhuthai azhitha thi.mu.ka-vinar endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Kadayanallur rail nilaiya peyar palagaiyil indhikku padhil aangila ezhuthai azhitha thi.mu.ka-vinar endru oru pugaippadam

Kadayanallur rail nilaiyathil thamizh, indhi, aangilam endru moondru mozhigalil ezhudhappattirundha peyar palagaiyil aangila ezhuthukkalai mattum azhithadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “hindhi mozhiya azhichittom endra thalaippil ulaga alavil kadaiyanalloorai tirent seytha inaiya vaasigal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Matroru padhivil DMK thondargal koottamaaga vandhu aangilathil ezhudhappattirundha peyarai azhippadhu pondru video padhividappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “netru Kadayanallur railway nilaiyathil hindhiyai azhithe theeruvom ena verithanamaaga vandha #tharkuri_kothadimaigal200 roobai koolikkaarargal hindhi edhu… ingileesh edhu.. Ena theriyaamal ingileeshai thaar oothi azhithadhaal.. Sutri vedikkai paartha makkal vizhundhu vizhundhu sirithanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
investigation_details:
Pudhiya kalvik kolgaiyai etraal mattume palligalukku mathiya arasu vazhangum nidhiyai viduvikka mudiyum endru mathiya kalvi amaichar arivithirundhaar. Idhaith thodarndhu maraimugamaaga indhith thinippu nadakkiradhu endru koori thi.mu.ka-vinar poraattathil eeduvattu varugindranar. Mathiya arasu niruvanangalil ulla indhi peyar palagaigalai ellaam karuppu peyint poosi azhithum varugindranar.
Andha vagaiyil thengaasi maavattam Kadayanallur rail nilaiyathil ezhudhappattirundha indhi vaarthaigalaiyum thi.mu.ka-vinar azhithanar. Aanaal, indhikku padhil aangilathai azhitha thi.mu.ka-vinar endru palarum pugaippadam matrum video-vai padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, appadi aangila ezhuthai mutrilumaaga azhithadhaaga endha veediyovum illai. Aanaal, indhiyai vittuvittu aangilathai azhithadhu pondra padathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Idhu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigalaip paarthom. DMK nirvaagi oruvar Kadayanallur peyar palagaiyil ulla indhi vaarthaiyai azhikka muyatsi seygiraar. Veshdiyai sari seythu peyint eduthu azhikka muyandra podhu aangila ezhuthaana el (L) meedhu poosugiraar. Arugilirundhavargal thavatrais suttikkaattave, avarum indhi ezhuthukkalai azhikkiraar. Muzhuvadhumaaga indhi ezhuthu mattume azhikkappadugiradhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu thandhi tivi-yil mattum indhikku padhil aangila ezhuthai azhitha thimuga-vinar endru thalaippu vaithu seythi veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhai paartha podhu, “kadaiyanallooril thimuga-vinar indhikkup padhilaaga aangilathai azhitha kaatchi inaiyathil viral aagi varugiradhu. Rayilnilaiya peyar palagaiyilirundha aangila ezhuthai DMK munnaal maavattas seyalaalar selladhurai karuppu maiyinaal thavarudhalaaga azhithaar.
Appodhu thondargal indhi ezhuthai azhikka vendum ena arivuruthiyadhaith thodarndhu avar indhi ezhuthukkalai azhithaar” endru kurippittirundhanar. Aanaal, aangila ezhuthu muzhuvadhumaaga azhikkappattadhu pondru kaatchi illai. El (L) meedhu mai poosivittu pinnar avar indhi ezhuthai mutrilumaaga azhithadhai adhe video-vil kaana mudindhadhu.
Avar therindhu seythaaraa, theriyaamal seythaaraa, padhatrathil thavaraaga azhithaaraa endra aayvukkul naam sellavillai. Avar aangila ezhuthai azhithaar endru koorum thagaval matrum pugaippadam thavaraanadhu enbadhai mattum urudhi seythullom. Kadayanallur rail nilaiyathil ulla peyar palagaiyil aangila ezhuthu azhikkappadavillai, aangila ezhuthu azhikkappaduvadhaaga paravum pugaippadam thavaraanadhu edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Keralaavin adutha aalunar rajinigaanth endru san news seythi veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘‘keralaavin adutha aalunar rajinigaanth,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’keralaa maanilathin aalunaraagiraar nadigar rajinigaanth. Viraivil idharkaana arivippai veliyidugiradhu mathiya arasu. Rajinigaandhin niyamanam arasiyal vattaarathil perum vivaadhathai erpaduthiyulladhu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu san news peyaril paravum poliyaana news card, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhuvondru endha seythiyum sameevathil oodagangalil veliyaagavillai. Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, san news aasiriyar kuzhu tharappil pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kumbagonathil ji.ke.vaasan pechai ketka vandha koottam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Kumbagonathil ji.ke.vaasanin pechaik ketka koodiya koottam endru oru pugaippadam

sila aandugalukku munbu mumbaiyil Indhiya kirikket anikku alikkappatta varaverpin pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “Breaking news puratchi pechaalar aiyaa G k vaasan pechai ketka kudandhaiyil koodiyulla makkal koottathin siru pagudhi 😲” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil thamizh maanila Congress katchikku thondargal aadharavu migak kuraivaaga ulladhu. Andhak katchiyin thalaivar ji.ke.vaasanin pechaik ketkak koodiya koottam endru mumbaiyil Indhiya kirikket anikku alikkappatta varaverpin podhu edukkappatta pugaippadathaip padhivittullanar. Idhai naiyaandikkaagap padhivittaargalaa alladhu idhai unmai endru nambi padhivittaargalaa endru theriyavillai.
Namakku indha padhivu naiyaandikku veliyittadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhaalum, padhivil appadiyaana kurippu edhuvum illaadhadhaal idhu patri aayvu seythom. Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha pugaippadathai 2024m aandu sarvadhesa kirikket kavunsil thalaivaraaga irukkum jey shaa thannudaiya Facebook pakkathil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, mumbaiyil Indhiya kirikket anikku alikkappatta varaverpin podhu sirappaaga seyalbatta magaaraashdira mudhalamaichar, mumbai Police ullitta anaivarukkum nandri endru kurippittirundhanar.
2024m aandu ti20 ulagak koppaiyai India vetri petradhaith thodarndhu mumbaiyil Indhiya anikku varaverpu alikkappattadhu. Appodhu indha pugaippadam edukkappattadhu endru appodhu oodagangalil indha pugaippadathai veliyittirundhadhaiyum kandom. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Landan sendra nadigai keerthi suresh endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘landan sendra nadigai keerthi suresh,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ ennadhaan ellaathukkum tharkurigal muttukkoduthaalum, ippadi paplikkaavachaiyaa panradhum ayokkiyathanathin ucham.
Thamizhnaattumakkalin varippanathil innumethanai peroda hanimoon kondaaduva paappom.sivappugaay munnaadi pochu,karuppukkaay pinnaadiye poyiduchu nethu. Ippo vella kaayum landanukku poyittu irukku.
Ivanunga landanukku mudhaleeda eerkkap pogum latchanam idhudhaan.(2/2),’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu patri instaagiraam moolamaaga keerthi suresh maruppu kooriyulladhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, landan sellum keerthi suresh endru kurippittu instaagiraamil pagirappatta padhivu ondrukku, keerthi suresh neradiyaaga comment moolamaagap padhil alithullaar. Andha padhilil, ‘’ Aama Correct.. London la thane Toronto International Film Festival nadakkuthu.. 🙄 ,’’ endru keerthi suresh kurippittullaar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, avar kanadaa naattil nadaiverum Toronto International Film Festival nigazhchiyil pangerka sendrullaar enbadhu namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
Sg Café l Mid Day l Thanthi TV l Dinamalar
keerthi suresh kadhaanaayagiyaaga nadithulla Dorothy padam kanadaavil nadaiverum sarvadhesa thiraippada thiruvizhaavil sirappuk kaatchiyaaga thiraiyidappadugiradhu. Idhaiyotti, andha padathin iyakkunar kaarthik suppuraaj, nadigargal matrum nadigai keerthi suresh ullittor neril sendrullanar.
Idhudhodarbaana video ondrai eduthu, keerthi suresh patriyum, Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar Vijay patriyum thevaiyatra vadhandhigalai silar parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, adippadai aadhaaram edhumindri, keerthi suresh patri veen vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pakistan-il masoodhiyil thozhugaiyin podhu kundu vedippu; 16 per pali
text:
Islaamaavaath: paagisdhaanin kaivar pakdhunkvaavil ulla masoodhiyil erpatta kunduvedippil 16 per uyirizhandhanar.
Paagisdhaanin vadamerkup pagudhiyil ulla kaivar pakdhunvaa maagaanathin kohat maavattathin Police lains pagudhiyil indru (sep 18) masoodhiyil payangara kundu vedippu sambavam nigazhndhadhu. Vellikkizhamai thozhugaikkaaga makkal masoodhiyil koodiyirundha podhu, vedivorutkal nirappappatta car ondrai payangaravaadhi masoodhiyin meedhu modhi tharkolaippadai thaakkudhalai nigazhthinaar.
Indha tharkolaippadai thaakkudhalil 16 per uyirizhandhanar. Melum 50kkum merpattor padugaayam adaindhullanar. Masoodhiyin koorai idindhu vizhundhu perum sedham erpattulladhu. Indhath thaakkudhalukku idhuvarai endhavoru amaippum porupperkavillai. Iruppinum, Pakistan thalivaan amaippin meedhu sandhegam valuthulladhu. Indha sambavam kurithu visaaranai nadandhu varugiradhu.

headline: Vijay aatchiyil 24 mani nera kaaval rondhu sevai thodakkam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Josap Vijay mudhalvaraana nilaiyil makkal paadhugaappukkaaga 24 mani neramum rondhu paniyil eeduvadum sevai thodangappattadhaaga oru video

selathil, irusakkara mottaar vaaganangalil kaavalargal kangaanippil eeduvadum sevai thodakka nigazhvin video Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “CM Vijay thalaimaiyil aana tn polees” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kadandha sattamandra therdhalil Tamil Naattil sattam ozhungu sariyillai, kurippaaga pengalukku paadhugaappe illai endru pirasaaram seyyappattadhu. Indha nilaiyil aatchi maatram erpattu, mudhalvaraaga Vijay pudhidhaaga poruppetra piragu sattam ozhungai sari seyyum vagaiyil ’24 mani nera rondhu paniyil eeduvadum sevai thodangappattadhu’ endru Polimer TV veliyitta video ondrai samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video-vil ‘Polimer news’ tholaikkaatchiyin logo irundhadhaal adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarvaiyittom. Vijay poruppetra me 10m thedhikkup piragu ippadi oru video-vai Polimer seythigal veliyidavillai enbadhu therindhadhu. Enave, adharku munbaaga indha video veliyaagi ulladhaa endru ariya aayvaith thodarndhom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2026 janavari 25m thedhi indha video-vai Polimer news veliyittirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhaavadhu, kadandha DMK aatchik kaalathil indha sevai thodangappattirundhadhu. DMK aatchiyil thodangappatta thittathai Vijay aatchiyil pudhidhaaga thodangappatta sevai endru thavaraaga vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarathin adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kaathu varudhu! Porvel mottaarai aan seythaal... Nilathadi neer mattamaanadhaal avaaya mani
text:
Kovai: adhiga veppathaalum paruvamazhai thavariyadhaalum nilathadi neermattam kangaanaadha aazhathukku irangi vittadhu. Porvel enappadum aazhdhulai kinarugalil mottaar svis aan seythadhum, ootril thengiyirukkum thanneer veliyeriya pin thanneer varaamal kaatru vaangugiradhu.
Maanagaraatchi pagudhigalil ezharai latcham veedugal ullana. Nagaraatchi, perooraatchi, ooraatchigalil 9 latcham veedugal ullana. Puranagar pagudhigalil pudhidhaaga eraalamaana veettu manaigal mulaithullana. Anegamaaga ellaa veedu, niruvana kattumaanathilum porvel amaippadhu kattaayamaagi vittadhu.
Maanagaraatchi pagudhigalil 2 veedugalukku oru porvel endru kanakkittaalum, porvel ennikkai 4 latchathai nerungum. Puranagargalilum eraalamaana porvelgal ullana. Anaithu porvelgalum vatriya nilaikku vandhullana; alladhu vandhu kondirukkindrana.
Olambas, singaanalloor, ondippudhoor pagudhigalil, 150 adi aazham thulaivotta porvelgalilum thanneer varavillai ena pagudhi makkal koorugindranar. ”mottaar pottadhum konjjamaa thanneer varudhunga. Appuram sottu sottaa vandhu, adhuvum ninnududhunga. Adhukku piragu kaathu mattundhaanga varudhu, thanniya kaanaleenga..” endru pengal koorinar.
Puranagar pagudhigalilum idhe nilai kaanappaduvadhaaga angulla makkal therivikkindranar. Idhe nilai needithaal, thanneerukku kadumaiyaana thattuppaadu erpadum endru nivunargal echarikkindranar.
Adhigaarigalai kettaal, kudineerai mattumindri por thanneeraiyum sikkanamaaga payanbadutha makkal pazhaga vendum ena vaguppu nadathugindranar. Veettu vaasal thelikka, car kazhuva alave illaamal thanneerai selavida koodaadhu; mudindhavarai thanneerai semikka vendum engiraargal.
Porvel amaikka arasu erkanave kattuppaadugalai vidhithulladhu. Elnino kaaranamaaga adhigappadiyaana veppam alladhu mazhai pozhiyum ena sutruchoozhal vallunargal kanikkindranar. Mazhai vandhaal sari, veyil thodarndhaal..?

investigation_details:

headline: "eai ezhuchiyaal aidi thurai paadhikkappadaadhu.." - tek magindhiraa thalaivar aananth magindhiraa urudhi!
text:
Eai thozhilnutbathin ezhuchiyaal Indhiya thagaval thozhilnutbathurai paadhikkappadaadhu ena tek magindhiraa niruvana thalaivar aananth magindhiraa therivithullaar. Aidi niruvanangalin pani maaruvatta vadivangalil innum mukkiyathuvam vaayndhadhaaga maarum endrum avar urudhivadath therivithaar. Edho oru naattil uruvaakkappadum eai vasadhigalai payanbaduthikkollum naadaaga mattum India irukkakkoodaadhu endrum adhai uruvaakkuvavaraagavum, vadivamaippavaraagavum nambagamaana muraiyil seyalbaduthuvavaraagavum irukka vendum endrum therivithaar.
Eai kaaranamaaga aidi niruvanangalil velaivaayppu kuraiyum endra acham paravalaaga ulla velaiyil athurai pangugal vilai veguvaaga kuraindhulladhum athuraiyin edhirgaalam kuritha kelvigalai erpaduthiyirundhadhu. Innilaiyil aananth magindhiraavin vilakkam kavanam perugiradhu

headline: DMK arasu kattiya paalam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK arasin velai endru kurippittu kai vaithaale siment udhirndhu vizhum nilaiyil ulla paalam ondrin video-vai palarum

paalam ondri pillargal siment jalli kalavai ellaam karaindhu verum kambiyin palathil thaangi nirkum alavukku miga mosamaana nilaiyil irukkum video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattu varugiradhu. Adhil, “DMK Government work” endru kurippidappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhudhaan thiraavida maadal aatchi” endru kurippidappattulladhu. Indha video-vai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kadandha 2024m aandu peegaaril paalangal pala idindha vizhundhu kondirundhadhu. Appodhu, peegaar paalangalin nilai patri andha maanilathais saarndhavargal video eduthu padhivittirundhanar. Adhil, jalli-siment kalavai tharamatradhaaga irundhadhaal avai thanneeril adithus sellappattu verum kambigal palathil paalam nirpadhaaga kaattappattirundhadhu. Appodhu vairalaana video-vai ippodhu indha video Tamil Naattil edukkappattadhu pondru padhivittu varugindranar.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil indha paalam engu ulladhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Enave, video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, Indian nix endra Facebook pakkathil indha video veliyaagi iruppadhaaga koogul lens thalathil namakku thagaval kidaithadhu. Aanaal video kidaikkavillai.
Enave, Indian nix Facebook pakkathil paarvaiyittom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil irukkum navar paalam ondrin nilai patri neril sendru makkalidam visaarithadhu thodarbaana video kidaithadhu. 2025 janavari 24m thedhi andha video-vai padhivetriyirundhanar. Aanaal, andha video-vil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla kaatchigal illai. Aanaal andha video-vil idhu peegaar maanilam pangaa maavattathil ulla kumaarsaar paalathil kaatchi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Andha Facebook pakkam veliyittirundha reels pagudhiyil naam thedum video ulladhaa endru paarthom. Thodarndhu thediya podhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai andha Facebook pakkam veliyittiruppadhu therindhadhu. Adhil, andha video peegaarais saarndhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha paalathin pugaippadathai koogul mep-l thedip paarthom. Appodhu andha paalam migavum sedhamadaindhu iruppadhaagavum, tharkaaligamaaga moodappattulladhu endrum thagaval kidaithadhu. Melum andha paalathin pugaippadamum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil irundha paalathin pugaippadamum ondraaga irundhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha paalam DMK aatchiyil Tamil Naattil kattappatta paalam endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Kemaraavai maraithu aalaiyil pugundhu mugamoodi thirudargal panam parippu
text:
Panamarathuppatti: panamarathuppatti, thippambattiyil moolakkuraigaadu pagudhikku sellum vazhiyil, thaniyaar sego aalai ulladhu. Angu vada-maanila thozhilaalargal thangi panivurigindranar. Netru mun-thinam iravu thozhilaalargal, arai veliye thoongikkondi-rundhanar.
Nalliravil, mugamoodi anindha iruvar, aalaiyil pugundhu angirundha kemaraavai thuni pottu moodinar. Pin araikkul pugundhu thedikkondirundhanar. Satham kettu thozhilaalargal ezhundhullanar.avargalidam kathiyai kaatti miratti, avargal paakkettil irundha panathai eduthukkondanar. Thodarndhu thozhilaa-largal sathamida, marma navargal, sutruchuvar meedhu eri, kudiyiruppu pagudhikkul kudhithu thappivittanar.
Idhugurithu thozhilaalargal koorugaiyil, 'kadandha maadham iravil mugathai moodiyavadi vandha iruvar, thalaiyanai adiyil vaithirundha, 2 perin movail pongalai thirudichen-ranar. Tharpodhu meendum vandhu miratti panam parithullanar. Idhugurithu panamarathuppatti poleesil pugaar alithullom' endranar. Idhugurithu visaaranai nadandhu varugiradhu ena, Police therivithanar.

headline: Maarthaandathil tiraafik jaam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Maarthaandathil erpatta tiraafik jaam endru oru pugaippadam

seenaavil erpatta miga neenda nera tiraafik jaam endru paraviya video-vin oru kaatchiyai mattum pugaippadamaaga eduthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Aanaal, nilaith thagavalil, “maarthaandam la payangara
tiraavik (traffic) jam..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Seenaavil ettu naal thesiya vidumuraiyaith thodarndhu anhuyi maagaanathin (Anhui province) migapperiya sungachaavadiyaana vusuvaangil ulla 36 paadhaigalil kootta nerisal erpattadhaaga veediyovudan seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil andha video-vin kaatchiyai eduthu maarthaandam, Madurai endru Tamil Naattin sila pagudhigalaik kurippittu angu pokkuvarathu nerisal erpattadhaaga palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Idhaiyum palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varave, indha thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Maarthaandathilo, madhuraiyilo ivvalavu periya tolget illai. Adhumattumindri, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathais satru peridhaakkip paarthaale tolget-l China mozhiyil ezhudhappattiruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Idhuve indha pugaippadam seenaavais saarndhadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, China-vin pokkuvarathu nerisal endru sarvadhesa oodagangal mudhal Tamil Naattin oodagangal varaiyil indha pugaippadam idam petrirundha veediyokkalai padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Maanikkam thaagoorai naiyaandi seytha san news endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Tamil Nadu Congress kamitti thalaivaraagap poruppetrulla maanikkam thaagoorin pechai naiyaandi seyyum vagaiyil san news tholaikkaatchi news card veliyittadhaaga oru padhivu

Tamil Nadu Congress kamitti thalaivar maanikkam thaagoor matrum nadigar vennira aadai moorthi aagiyor pugaippadangalai vaithu san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “thiruppu adippom.. “naanga paattukku pesaama iruppom; aanaal, Congress katchiyai thottaal thiruppi adippom; adhu DMK, BJP, ADMK, PMK ena endhak katchiyaaga irundhaalum sari” Tamil Nadu Congress kamittiyin thalaivaraagap poruppetrulla maanikkam thaakkoor pechu” endru irundhadhu. Idhai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu Congress kamitti thalaivaraaga poruppetra pin maanikkam thaagoor pesiyadhai naiyaandi seyyum vagaiyil san news tholaikkaatchi news card-ai veliyittiruppadhaagap palarum indha padhivai samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar. News card-il ulla vaarthaigalil ezhuthup pizhai ulladhu. Paarkka e.ai (seyarkai nunnarivu) moolam uruvaakkappattadhu pol irundhadhu. Enave, indha news card thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai san news veliyittulladhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathaip paarvaiyittom. Appodhu, vennira aadai moorthiyin pugaippadam illaamal maanikkam thaagoor pugaippadathai mattum vaithu indha news card-ai san news joon 29, 2026 andru veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhai edit seythu maanikkam thaagoorai san news nakkal – naiyaandi seythuvittadhu endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla indha news card-ai san news digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum “idhu poliyaanadhudhaan. San news veliyittirundha news card-ai maatri thavaraaga pagirndhirukkiraargal” endraar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ADMK nirvaagigal adhirupdhiyil ulladhu unmaidhaan endru sengottaiyan koorinaaraa?
text:

investigation_details:

Ithagaiya soozhalildhaan, ADMK mootha nirvaagi ke.e.sengottaiyan, paajaga.,vudan thangaladhu katchi koottani vaithadhu patri adhirupdhi therivithadhaagak koori, merkanda vagaiyil silar samooga valaidhalangalil seythi parappugiraargal.
Aanaal, indha niyoosgaardai news 18 Tamil Nadu oodagam veliyidavillai. Idhudhodarbaaga, avargaladhu aasiriyar kuzhuvinaridam pesi urudhippaduthiyullom. Melum, idhuvatri news 18 Tamil Nadu oodagam tharappil adhigaarappoorvamaaga, maruppu therivikkappattulladhu. Adhanaiyum aadhaarathirkaaga, inge inaithullom.
Aduthappadiyaaga, ke.e.sengottaiyan aluvalagathai thodargondu pesi, idhu poliyaana seythi, enbadhai urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda niyoosgaardu, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thaalavaadi kaavaldhuraiyinarin `kodoora' thaakkudhal; padhaivadhaikka vaikkum `pazhaiya' veediyo- vilakkamalitha kaavaldhurai
text:
Oyvaraiyil ilainjar oruvarai irumbu sangiliyaal jannalil katti vaithu kaavaldhuraiyinar migak kodooramaaga thaakkum video ondru veliyaagi kaanboraip padhaivadhaikkas seythirukkiradhu.
Erode maavattam thaalavaadi kaavalnilaiyathin pinburam ulla kaavalargalukkaana oyvu araiyil ilainjar oruvarai sangiliyaal kaigalai jannaludan katti vaithu kaavalargal kodooramaaga thaakki sithravadhai seyyum video ondru inaiyathil paravi kaanborai padhai padhaikkas seythu varugiradhu. Indha seyalukku manidha urimaigal seyalbaattaalargal mudhal ulloor makkal varai kadumaiyaana edhirppai therivithu varugindranar. Kadandha 2024-m aandu nadaivetra indha sambavathai tharpodhu nadaivetradhaaga samooga valaidhalangalilum sila oodagangalilum seythi veliyittu varugindranar. Adhu unmai alla ena Erode maavatta kaavaldhurai adhigaaravoorvamaaga vilakkamalithulladhu.
Kollai sambavam thodarbaaga visaaranai ena magaadhevaa endra ilainjarai azhaithus sendra thaalavaadi kaavaldhuraiyinar, kaaval nilaiyathirkup pinburam ulla kaavalar oyvarai jannal kambiyil sangiliyaal kaigalaik katti vaithu kadumaiyaagath thaakkith thunburuthiyullanar.
Magaadhevaavirkuth thodarbillaadha matroru kollai sambavathilum poruppetru othukkollumaaru sithravadhai seythu thaakkiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Thunburuthalaith thaanga mudiyaamal kadharum ilainjar maadhevaavai manidhaavamatra muraiyil thaakkum kodoora kaavalargalin video kaatchigal inaiyathalathil veliyaagi kaanboraip padhara vaikkindrana.
Idhan pinnani kurithu Erode maavattak kaavaldhurai , "thaalavaadi kaaval nilaiyathin oyvu araiyil maadhu (e) magaadhevaa (19) enbavaraik kaavaldhuraiyinar tharpodhu saramaariyaaga thaakkiyadhaaga sila seythi oodagangal matrum samooga valaidhalangalil seythi veliyittu varugindranar. Video-vil iruppavar thaalavaadi kaaval nilaiyathil palveru kutra vazhakkugalil thodarbudaiya sarithirap padhivedu kutravaaliyaana maadhu engira magaadhevaa aavaar. Ivar, kadandha 20- 09- 2024-m thedhi kutra vazhakkugalukkaaga kaidhu seythu needhimandra kaavalukku utbaduthappattaar. Kadandha 2024-m aandu nadaivetra indhas sambavathai tharpodhu, kadandha sila naalgalukku munbu kaidhi oruvarai poleesaar thaakkiyadhaaga thavaraagas seythi veliyittu varugindranar. Tharpodhu idhu pondru oru nigazhvu nadaiveravillai ena Erode maavattak kaavaldhurai saarbil therivithuk kollappadugiradhu" ena vilakka arikkai veliyittullanar.
Idhu kurithu therivithulla manidha urimaigal seyarpaattaalargal, "kaaval nilaiya maranangal alladhu kodoorath thaakkudhalgal nadakkumbodhu, sambandhappatta kaavalargal meedhu verum paniyida maatram alladhu tharkaaliga sasbent pondra sadangu reedhiyaana nadavadikkaigal mattume edukkappadugindrana. Thavaru seyyum poleesaar meedhu udanadiyaaga kutraviyal vazhakku padhivu seyyappattu kadumaiyaana satta nadavadikkai edukkappada vendum. Jananaayaga naattil ithagaiya manidha urimai meeralgal mutrilumaagath thadukkappada vendum. Indhak kodooram eppodhu yaaraal nigazhthappattirundhaalum, udanadiyaaga uriya nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Manidha urimaigal aanaiyam thalaiyida vendum" endranar.

headline: “perundhu nilaiyathukku idamillai... Vaniga valaagam katta avasaram en?”
text:
Thagikkum Thanjavur
Thanjavur pazhaiya perundhu nilaiyathil perundhugalai niruthuvadharkum, veliye selvadharkum podhiya idavasadhi illai. Idhanaal, perundhugal saalaiyil nirpadhum, andhap pagudhiyil pokkuvarathu nerisal erpaduvadhum thodargadhaiyaagi varugiradhu. Idharkuth theervu kaana, perundhu nilaiyathai virivaakkam seyya vendum endra korikkai thodarndhu ezhundhuvarum nilaiyil, adharkup payanbaduthavendiya idathil roo.8.3 kodi madhippil 28 kadaigalgonda vaniga valaagam kattum panigal thodangiyiruppadhu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Thanjavur nagarin maiyappagudhiyilulla pazhaiya perundhu nilaiyam, ADMK aatchiyil smaart sitti thittathil mutrilum idikkappattu pudhidhaagak kattappattadhu. Aanaal, nagarap perundhugalai niruthavum, veliyeravum podhiya idavasadhi illaadhadhaal, perundhu nilaiyathukku edhire thodarndhu pokkuvarathu nerisal erpattuvarugiradhu.
Perundhu nilaiyathai ottiyulla sumaar 40,000 sadhura adi idathil munbu too veelar staant irundhadhu. Andha idathai, perundhu nilaiya virivaakkathukkup payanbadutha vendum endra korikkai ezhundha nilaiyil, tharpodhu vaniga valaagam kattum panigal thodangiyirukkindrana. Idharku Congress, a.ma.mu.ka., CBI, si.pi.em ullitta katchigalum, siru viyaavaarigalum edhirppu therivithu sameevathil poraattam nadathinaargal. Athudan, “makkal nalanaivida kamishanukke mukkiyathuvam alikkappadugiradhu” endrum kutramsaattinaargal.
Idhu kurithu si.pi.em maavatta seyarkuzhu uruppinar sendhilgumaaridam pesiyavodhu, “kadandha DMK aatchiyin irudhiyil, andha idathil roo.8.3 kodiyil 28 kadaigal katta tendar vidappattadhu. Appodhe edhirppu kilambiyadhu. TVK aatchi amaindha piragu too veelar staandai agatriya adhigaarigal, perundhu nilaiyathai virivaakkappovadhaagath therivithanar. Idhanaal nerisalukkuth theervu kidaikkum ena edhirbaarthom. Aanaal, kadandha aatchiyil vidappatta tendar adippadaiyil meendum vaniga valaagam kattum pani thodangiyirukkiradhu. Adhigaarigalidam manu alithadhaiyaduthu paniyai niruthuvadhaagath therivithanar. Aanaal, tendar eduthavar thodarndhu panigalai merkonduvarugiraar.
Makkal nalanai adippadaiyaagak konde thittangal seyalbaduthappada vendum. TVK arasu makkalukkaana arasu endru koorikkondaalum, perundhu nilaiya virivaakkathai merkollaamal kamishanukkaaga, kadaigal kattappaduvadhaith thadukkavillai” endraar.
A.ma.mu.ka maanagaras seyalaalar raajesvaranidam pesinom. “smaart sitti thittathil kattappatta kaamaraajar, saravoji maarkkettugalil adhiga vaadagai kaaranamaaga eraalamaana kadaigal kaaliyaaga irukkindrana. Pudhiya, pazhaiya perundhu nilaiyangalilum kadaigal moodappattullana. Thanjjaavooril 100-kkum merpatta kadaigal kaaliyaaga irukkum nilaiyil, keezhavaasal rottil roo.130 kodi madhippil maldifileks vaniga valaagam kattappadum endru sattamandrathil arivikkappattirukkiradhu.
Erkenave ithanai kadaigal kaaliyaaga irukkum nilaiyil, keezhavaasal saalaiyil veru oru piramaanda vaniga valaagam kattappadum endru arivithuvittu, pazhaiya perundhu nilaiyathukku aruge pudhidhaaga 28 kadaigalaik kattuvadhan avasiyam enna... Kadaigal kattuvadharku padhilaaga, perundhu nilaiyathai virivaakkuvadharku indha idathaip payanbaduthinaal, pokkuvarathu nerisalukkuth theervu kaana mudiyum.
Tharpodhaiya perundhu nilaiyathil kazhipparai ullitta adippadai vasadhigalum podhumaanadhaaga illai. Perundhugalai niruthavum, veliye sellavum podhiya idavasadhi illaadhadhaal, perundhu nilaiyathukku edhire pokkuvarathu nerisal erpattu makkal thinarugindranar. Thanjavur periya koyilukku thinamum aayirakkanakkaana pakdhargalum sutrulaappayanigalum varum nilaiyil, avargalukkuth thevaiyaana adippadai vasadhigalaiyum erpadutha vendum. Payanigal thangum vidudhiyum amaikka vendum.
Maatrangalaik konduvaruvadhaagak koori aatchi amaithirukkum TVK arasu, DMK aatchiyil thittamidappatta indha vaniga valaagathai niruthaamal iruppadhu emaatramalikkiradhu. Indhath thittathaik kaividavillai endraal, otha karuthudaiya katchigaludan inaindhu thodar poraattam nadathuvom” endraar.
Idhu kurithu Thanjavur maanagaraatchi aanaiyar ve.theevanaa visvesvariyidam pesinom. “thanjjaavoor nagaram valarchiyadaindhirukkum nilaiyil, kadaigalum thevaippadugindrana. Enave, arasu erkenave thittamittavadi vaniga valaagathukkaana kattumaanap panigal nadaivetruvarugindrana. Pokkuvarathu nerisalaith thadukka nadavadikkaigal edukkappattu varugindrana. Adhiga vaadagai kaaranamaaga kadaigal kaaliyaaga iruppadhaagak koorappadum nilaiyil, vaadagaiyaik kuraippadhu thodarbaagak korikkai vaikkappattirukkiradhu. Idhai arasu pariseelithuvarugiradhu. Makkal nalanaik karuthilgonde thittangal seyalbaduthappadugindrana” endraar.
Makkalaith thavikkaviduvadharkup peyardhaan makkal nalanaa?

headline: Naam thamizhar katchi saarbaaga ‘paaliyal izhappeedu paasarai’ thodangappattadhaa?
text:

headline: Ayothiyil kidaitha puthar silaigal endru paravum pugaippadangal unmaiyaa?
text:
Ayothiyil thondath thonda kidaikkum puthar silaigal endru irandu pugaippadangal

thalai udaikkappatta puthar silaigal matrum kugai ondril puthar silai irukkum pugaippadangal Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ayothiyil thonda thonda kidaikkum puthar silaigal. Raaman varalaaru alla punaiyappatta kadhai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ayothiyil nilathaith thondiya podhu kidaitha puthar silaigal endru kattidathirkul varisaiyaaga irukkum thalaigal udaikkappatta nilaiyil ulla puthar silai pugaippadathaip pagirndhullanar. Ayothiyil raamar kovil kattappattu thirakkappattuvittadhu. Appadi irukka engu nilathaith thondinaargal, engu kanduvidithaargal endru endha thagavalum illaamal padhivittullanar. Enave, indha padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil sameevathil ayothiyil nilathaith thondum podhu edhenum puthar silai kanduvidikkappattadhaa… adhu thodarbaaga seythi edhum ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal, namakku appadi endha oru seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. 2020m aandilirundhu indha pugaippadangalaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu indha puthar silaigal aapgaanisdhaan matrum Pakistan-il iruppadhaaga seythigal kidaithana. Thalai udaikkappatta nilaiyil varisaiyaaga ulla puthar silai pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu, andha silai Pakistan-il thatchaseelam alladhu thakseelaa (Taxila) endra pagudhiyil ulladhaaga 2016m aandu veliyaana agazhaayvu thodarbaana inaiyathalathil seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Kugaikkul puthar silai irukkum pugaippadathaik koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Andha pugaippadam aapgaanisdhaanil mes ainaak (Mes Aynak) endra pagudhiyil ulladhaagavum 2014m aandu indha puthar silai kanduvidikkappattadhaagavum popular-archaeology.com endra inaiyathalathil seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu.aljazeera.com inaiyathalathil 2015m aandil indha puthar silai pugaippadathudan seythi veliyittirundhanar. Ivai ellaam indha puthar silaigal ayothiyil kanduvidikkappattavai illai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Porai Indhiya perungadal varai virivuvaduthuvom; echarikkum Iran
text:
Tehraan: America meendum thaakkudhal nadathinaal, indhiyap perungadal varaiyil porai virivuvaduthuvom endru Iran echarikkai viduthulladhu.
America - Iran idaiye kadandha pipravari maadham thuvangiya por, tharpodhum neendu konde selgiradhu. Haarmus jalasandhi, valaigudaa matrum sengadal ena indhap por ellaith thaandiyum virivadaindhu varugiradhu. America-vin thaakkudhalukku padhiladi kodukkum vidhamaaga, haarmus jalasandhiyai Iran mudakkiyulladhu. Idhanaal, sarvadhesa kachaa enney matrum erivaayu pokkuvarathu peridhum paadhikkappattulladhu.
Indha nilaiyil, America thangal meedhu meendum thaakkudhal nadathinaal, tharpodhu needithu varum indhap porai indhiyap perungadal varaiyil virivuvaduthuvom endru Iran-in munnaal uchadhalaivar Ayatollah ali kameniyin aalosagar yahyaa raheem savavi echarithullaar.
Eeraanilirundhu sumaar 4,000 kilomeettar tholaivil ulla thiyego kaarsiyaa endra idathil amerikka-pirittan viyooga raanuvath thalam amaindhulla indhiyap perungadalai ilakkaaga vaithu Iran adhigaari oruvar velippadaiyaaga echarippadhu idhuve mudhalmuraiyaagum.

headline: Kaaychal vaardugalil alaimodhum koottam kaal kadukka kaathirukkum podhumakkal
text:
Chennai: Thamizhagathil palveru vagaiyaana kaaychal paadhippugal paravi varum nilaiyil, arasu maruthuvamanaigalil sigichai pera, neenda varisaiyil makkal kaathirundhu avadhip pattu varugindranar.
Kaalanilai maatrathaal, tengu, koronaa, inpluyansaa, adino vairas, unni kaaychal, taivaaydu ullitta palveru vagaiyaana kaaychal paadhippugal paravi varugindrana.udal vali kaaychal thaduppu nadavadikkaigalai, arasu theevirappaduthiyadhaaga koorappattaalum, avai peyaravil thaan ullana. Arasu maruthuvamanaigalil, kaaychalaal paadhikkappattu thinasari nootrukkanakkaanor varugindranar. Avargalukku uriya adippadai vasadhiyai, arasu seythu tharavillai.
Chennai raajiv kaandhi, staanli, keezhppaakkam, raayappettai, omandhooraar ullitta arasu maruthuvamanaigalilum, maanagaraatchi nagarppura aaramba sugaadhaara nilaiyangalilum, kaaychalukkaana sirappu vasadhigal illai. Anaithu idangalilum, kaaychalaal paadhikkappattavargal neenda varisaiyil kaathirundhu, sigichai pera vendiyulladhu.
Idhu kurithu, noyaaligal kooriyadhaavadhu: arasu maruthuvamanaigalil endhavoru sirappu erpaadum seyyappada villai. Erkanave irundha alavilaana taakdargal thaan ullanar. Puranoyaaligal pirivukku sendraal, aadhaar en ketkindranar. Appadi koduthaal, o.ti.pi., varum varai nirka vaikkindranar.
O.ti.pi., varavillai endraal, matroru varisaiyil sendru, puranoyaaligal seettai vaanga anuppugindranar. Andha varisaiyil, neenda neram meendum kaathirukka vendum.
Oruvazhiyaaga puranoyaali kal seettai vaangi, kaaychal vaardukku sendraal, neenda varisaiyil kaathirukka vendum. Angu, 20 per amara irukkaigal irukkindrana; matravargal, neenda neram, udal valiyudan nirka vendiulladhu.
Amaichar mudhal arasu adhigaarigal varai, paruva nilaiyaal kaaychal paadhippu iruppadhaaga therivikkindranar. Paadhikkappaduvor adhigam enbadhu arasukku therigiradhu. Appadiyendraal, sigichai alikka thevaiyaana adippadai vasadhigalai koodudhalaaga arasu seythirukka vendaamaa?
Indha arasu aatchi poruppetradhum, 'anaithu amaichargalum arasu maruthuvamanaigalil sigichai peruvom' ena, amaichar arunraaj therivithaar.aanaal, TVK, - em.el.e., kooda arasu maruthuvamanaiyil sigichai peravillai. Ivargalukku eppadi naangal padum avadhi theriyum?ivvaaru avargal koorinar.
Nadavadikkai 

noyaaligal en nikkai adhigamaaga iruppadhaal, sigichai pera thaamadham erpadugiradhu. Maruthuva manaigalil koodudhal vasadhigal seythu thara nadavadikkai edukkappadum.ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: Raajasdhaanil thinamum kadathappadum sirumigal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Raajasdhaanil BJP aatchiyil thinandhorum thaazhthappatta, pirpaduthappatta samoogathais serndha sirumigal kadathappattu varugiraargal endru oru video

ilam pen oruvarai silar kaaril kadathis sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “raajasdhaanil pattappagalil naaldhorum kadathappadum pengal siruguzhandhaigal…!! Perumbaalum kadathappadum pengal paarbannarallaadha pengal kuzhandhaigal thaan…!!
Makkal virodhi BJP arasai thookki eriyavendum….!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Raajasdhaan maanilathil kurippitta saadhiyinaraith thavirthu idhara samoogathais saarndha sirumigal, ilam pengal thinamum kadathappadum soozhal ulladhaaga video ondrai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idharku andha maanilathil aatchi seyyum paaradhiya janadhaa katchidhaan kaaranam endrum kutramsaattiyullanar. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha kadathal sambavam raajasdhaanil nadandhadhu illai, kujaraathil nadandhadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Angeyum paaradhiya janadhaa katchidhaan aatchi seygiradhu enbadhaal indha sambavathin pinnani therindhugolla aayvai thodarndhom.
Indha kadathal thodarbaaga taims aap India ullitta pala oodagangalil seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, veettaivittu veliyeri veru oruvarudan livving tugedhar muraiyil vaazhndhu vandha thannudaiya magalai sondha thandhaiye kadathinaar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Kujaraath maanilam aaravalli maavattathais serndha 19 vayadhaana pen oruvar kadandha maars maadham thannudaiya kaadhalarai natbu oppandhathil kaiyezhuthittu thirumanam seythu kondadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Indha thirumanathirku piragum iruvarum avaravar illathil vasithu vandhullanar. Thannudaiya magal thirumanam seythugondaar endru kelvippatta thandhai, kaadhalanaiyum avaradhu kudumbathinaraiyum mirattiyullaar. Indha nilaiyil andha pen than veettaivittu veliyeri kaadhalarudan vasithu vandhadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Sambavathandru kaadhalanin thaayaarukku sondhamaana kadaiyil indha pen amarndhirundhaar. Appodhu angu vandha andha pennin thandhai matrum silar serndhu avarai kaaril kadathi sendranar.
Sisidivi kemaraa video adippadaiyil vazhakkup padhivu seytha Police, kadathappatta pen matrum avaradhu thandhaiyai thedi varugindranar. Kadathiyavargalai kandariya aindhu thanippadaigal amaikkappattullana endru aaravalli tiesbi manogarsing jadejaa kooriyadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nammudaiya aayvil kujaraathil kudumba pirasnai kaaranamaaga thandhaiye than magalai kadathiyiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Idhan moolam raajasdhaanil kurippitta samoogathaith thavirthu matra samooga pengal thinamum kadathappadugiraargal endru paravum thagaval vishamathanamaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Masoodhi arugil pandrikkari unna thadaiyillai endru ucha needhimandra needhivadhi karuthu koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘masoodhi arugil pandrikkari unna thadaiyillai,’’ endru ucha needhimandra needhivadhi karuthu kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ masoodhi arugil panni piriyaani saappiduvadhu kutramillai; adhaith thadai seyyum endha sattamum illai. Islaamiya vazhivaattu sdhalangal arugil pandrikkari virpadho unbadho thadaiyillai ena adhu kurithu ucha needhimandra needhivadhi ujjal puyaan karuthu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
News 7 Tamil oodagathin logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta news card, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, unmaiyaana news card-il, ‘’kangai nadhiyil sikkan piriyaani saappiduvadhu kutramillai; adhaith thadai seyyum endha sattamum illai. Ramalaan nonbai mudikka kangai nadhiyil oru padagil sikkan piriyaani saappittadharkaaga 14 islaamiyargal kaidhu seyyappattadhu kurithu ucha needhimandra needhivadhi ujjal puyaan karuthu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanai eduthu, edit seythu, pandrikkari saappidalaam endru Uchaneedhimandram sonnadhaagak koori, arasiyal ulnokkathudan thavaraana thagaval parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Unmaiyaana news kaardaiyum, naam aayvu seytha news kaardaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Melum, kangai nadhiyil sikkan piriyaani saappiduvadhu patri ucha Needhimandram karuthu kooriyadhu thodarbaaga, melum pala oodagangalil seythi veliyaagiyulladhu. Avatril silavatrai aadhaarathirkaagak keezhe inaithullom.
Times Of India l Hindustan Times l Indian Express
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 'thambi Vijay sonnadhu unmai thaan..' misaa sarchai kurithu video veliyitta Stalin!
text:
Thamizhaga sattamandrathil kaavaldhurai maaniya vivaadhathin podhu, mudhalvar Vijay misaa vazhakkai suttikkaatti thaadai saigai seythadhu perum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Idharku padhilalitha Stalin, avasaranilai kaala sirai anuvavangalaiyum, thaadai elumbu murivu ullitta kodumaigalaiyum vilakki, varalaatrai maatra mudiyaadhu ena valiyuruthi, sattamandra mariyaadhai kaakka mudhalvar kanniyamaaga nadakka vendum endraar.
Thamizhagathil mudhalmuraiyaaga aatchiyai pidithirukkum mudhalvar sa. Josap Vijay thalaimaiyilaana TVK aatchiyin mudhal sattamandra koottathodar irandu kattamaaga me 11 mudhal joon 23 varai nadaivetradhu. Adhaithodarndhu TVK arasin mudhal patjet koottathodar aagastu 5aam thedhi mudhal thodangi kadandha sepdambar 8aam thedhi varai nadaivetradhu. Motham 28 naatkal, 170 mani neram nadaivetra ikkoottathodaril 14,399 kelvigal ezhuppappattana. Idhil pala kaarasaara vivaadhangalum sattapperavaiyil idambetrirundhana.
Innilaiyil kaavaldhurai maaniyakkorikkai meedhaana vivaadhathinbodhu pesiya mudhalamaichar Vijay, edhirkkatchigalin kelvigalukku aavesamaaga padhil alithaar. Appodhu DMK-vinar endhavoru vimarsanathirkum padhil alikkaamal, misaa vivagaarathaiye munniruthuvadhaaga kooriya avar, andha misaavai patri thangalukku nandraagave theriyum endru, thanadhu thaadaiyil kai vaithavadi, saigai ondrai, sattasavaiyil velippaduthiyirundhaar. Idhu, misaa vazhakkil kaidhu seyyappatta munnaal mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinai vimarsikkum vagaiyil irundhadhu endru perum edhirppu kilambiyadhu.
Mudhalamaicharin indha saigaikku edhiraaga palveru edhirppugal kilambiyulla nilaiyil, mudhalamaicharukku edhiraana kandana aarppaattathaiyum DMK arivithulladhu.
Indhasoozhalil thaan thanmeedhu mosamaana vimarsanathai vaitha mudhalamaichar Vijay-kku padhilalithirukkum DMK thalaivar muga Stalin, mudhalamaichar kanniyamaaga nadandhugolla vendum endru video ondrai velippaduthiyullaar.
X thalathil avar veliyittirukkum video-vil, “en anbaana thamizh makkalukku vanakkam .
Anmaiyila nadandhu mudindha sattamandrathula nadandha sila sarchaigal, thamizh makkalukkum - nammudaiya udanbirappugalukkum kovathaiyum adhirupdhiyaiyum undaakki irukkaradha naan unarran.
Adhuvum, indha sarchaila mukkiyamaa ennudaiya sirai varalaarum irukkaradhaala, naan adha pathi konjjam thelivuvadutha virumbaren. Thambi Vijay, neenga sonnadhu unmaidhaan.. Poy ellaam illa.. Emarjensi kaalathula, 30-1-1976 annaikku adha edhirthu thalaivar kalainjar merinaa kadarkaraila migapperiya koottatha kootti, misaa sattathai kadumaiyaa vimarsithadha thodarndhu- appa irundha ondriya arasaangam udane DMK aatchiya kalaichaanga.
Aatchiya kalaicha adutha nodi misaa sattathula enna arest panradhukkaaga kovaalavuram veettukku Police vandhaanga.. Annaikku naan veetla illa.. Paiyan pirachaarathukku poyirukkaan.. Naalaikku vandhuduvaan.. Vandhadhum naane pon panran.. Vandhu arest pannikkongannu kalainjar solli anuppittaaru. Adutha naal naan vandhadhum avare poleesa vara solli, arest panna sollittaaru.
Siraila enakku pala kodumaigal nadandhuchu.. Engala kondu poy adaichadhe thozhunoyaaligal irukkara idathuladhaan. 10 perai oru sinna araikkulla adaichu vechaanga.. Andha araikkullaye oru paanailadhaan athanai perum siruneer kazhikkanum. Andha idame romba thurnaatramaa irukkum. Angadhaan naanga thoonganum. Naitla thoonga vidaama Police lathiyaala adippaanga.. Poots kaalaala midhippaanga..
Innoru pakkam aayul thandanai kaidhigala vechu vera engala kodooramaa adippaanga. Avanga adichadhula en kooda irundha arumai annan naadaalumandra uruppinar sitti paavu jeyillaye irandhu ponaaru.
Avanga adichadhula en thaadai elumbellaam udainjjuchu... Neenga kooda ippadi kaivechu thaadaiya kaamicheenga illaiyaa? Adhu karekdudhaan .. Innikkum naan adivaangiya thazhumbugal enakku irukku.. Naan illannu sollala.
Podhu vaazhkkaila irukkaravangalukku.. Mukkiyamaa thamizhargalukkaagavum.. Thamizhnaattukkaagavum poraadaravanga niraiya perukku indha maadhiriyaana adakkumuraigal nadandhu irukku.. Poraaligal ellaam idha thaandidhaan vandhu irukkom. Edhirthu poraadaradhum… adhoda vilaivugala sandhikkaradhum engalukku onnum pudhusu illa.
Neenga kolgai thalaivaraa solra arinjar annaa kaalathula irundhu thimugavoda varalaare idhudhaan.. Andha varalaarula naanum irukkangaradhu enakku perumaiyaana oru visayamdhaan. Yaar enna kochaivaduthinaalum, varalaara maatha mudiyaadhu. Adhu kaalathukkum appadiyedhaan irukkum.
Sandhegamnaa neenga sattamandrathula oru laiprari irukkunnu sonneenga illayaa? Anga ellaa aavanangalum irukkum.. Anga poy ennoda poraatta varalaara neenga padichi paarunga! Unmai ennannu puriyum.
Irandaavadhaa sarkkaariyaa kamishan pathiyum enga thalaivar kalainjar pathiyum thavaraana thagavala pesi irukkeenga.. Oozhal kutrachaattugala solli irukkeenga... Sarkkaariyaa kamishan amaikkappattadhukku appuram ondriyathulayum, maanilathulayum pala murai aatchi maariduchu.. Indha kutrasaattugalla edhaavadhu unmai irundhirundhaa kandippaa nadavadikkai edukkappattirukkum.. Ithanai varusamaa arasiyalukkaaga kalainjar mel kaazhppunarchi kondavanga sonna poyyaana kutrachaatta neengalum sollittu irukkeenga.
Adhumattumillaama, amalaakkathurai ezhudhana kadidhathai eduthukkittu, adhula enga mela oozhal kutrachaattugal irukkaradhaa solreenga.. Amalaakkathurai kutramsaattiya 95 sadhaveedham vazhakkugalla, idhuvaraikkum kutrachaattu niroovikkavadaama – kutramsaattappattavargal viduvikkappattu irukkaanga.. Perumbaalum arasiyal pazhi vaangalukkaagave amalaakkathurai evavadudhungaradhu inga irukkara ellaarukkume nallaa theriyum. Ungalukku thelivaa sollanunnaa unga koottanila irukkara Congress katchi thalaivargal mela kooda amalaakkathurai pala vazhakkugala pottu irukku. Idhellaam ondriya arasa kolgai edhiriyaa sitharikkira ungalukku eppadi theriyaama pochu?
Maanbumigu mudhalamaichar thambi Vijay, naan ungakitta kekkaradhu onne onnudhaan.. Tamil Nadu sattamandrathukkunnu oru maanbum mariyaadhaiyum irukku. Pala perum thalaivargal.. Maamanidhargal thamizhnaatta sedhukkuna idam adhu. Andha poruppu ippa ungalukkum irukku . Sattamandrathula sattam ozhungu pirachanai. Makkal nala thittangal.. Thamizhnaatta melum melum eppadi munnetra paadhaikku kondu poradhu.. Thamizhnaattoda urimaigala eppadi paadhugaakkaradhu... Idhellaam vivaadham pannunga..
Adhudhaan thamizhnaattukkum thamizhmakkalukkum nalladhu.. Adhavittuttuttu thevaiyillaadha sarchaigalai sattamandrathula pesa venaangaradhudhaan ennoda korikkai. Neenga mudhalamaicharaa aanadhum enna sandhikka en veettukku vandheenga.. Appa naan unga karam pidithu varavetren. Appa, naama pesum podhu, neenga enkitta “therdhal pirachaarathula ungala romba vimarsichu pesitten.. I am sorry saarnnu sonneenga.. Adhukku naan, “paravaalla piradhar ... Adhaiyellaam naan manasula vechukkala… neenga ippa oru maanilathoda mudhalamaichar.. Ini yaarap pathi pesum podhum andha kanniyathoda pesungannu sonnan. Adhaiyellaam neenga marandhutteenga pola?
Thirumbavum solran... Oru mudhalamaicharukkaana kanniyathoda ungaloda vaarthaigalum udalmozhiyum irukkanum . Naamadhaan makkalukku munnudhaaranam. Adha marandhudaadheenga. Neenga vagikkara periya poruppa unarndhu neenga seyalbadanum. Sattasavaiyave reels edukkara idamaa maathunadhu... Naanga kattuna paalathu mela ninnu photo shoot panradhunnu aatchi nirvaagathaiyum sinimaa shootting maadhiriye nadathareenga .
Ungaloda thiranatra nirvaagatha maraikka ippadi vidhavidhamaa reels pottu oru thalaimuraiyaye emaathittu irukkeenga . Aanaa riyaalitti enna? Unmai oora thaanduradhukkulla poy ulagathaiye suthi vandhudumnu oru pazhamozhi solluvaangalla… adhudhaan nadandhuttu irukku…
unga aatchiyila thinam.. Thinam kolai .. Thiruttu.. Pengalukku edhiraana paaliyal kutrangalnnu sattam ozhungu paduguzhila irukku. Parandhoor erbort thittatha rathu panni thamizhnaattoda valarchiya 15 varusam pinnaadi kondu poy irukkeenga... Vivasaayigalukku muzhamaiyaana kadan thalluvadinnu vaakkurudhi kudutheenga.. Aanaa adhaiyum ozhungaa pannala.. Anaithu kudumbangalukkum varusathukku 6 silindarnnu sonneenga.. Ippa thagudhi ullavangalukku 3 silindar mattumnnu andhar paldi adichu irukkeenga..
Magalir urimai thogai 2500 roovaaynnu sonneenga.. Innum naanga kudutha adhe 1000 roovaayadhaan kuduthuttu irukkeenga . Innum pala vaakkurudhigal pathi vaaye thirakkaama irukkeenga.. Appa sonnadhellaam onnu .. Ippa seyyaradhu ellaam onnu. Maatram venumnnu ninaichu vaakkalicha makkal.. Kurippaa namadhu ilainjargal, unmaiyaave ippa enna maatram vandhu irukku.. Idhu sariyaana maatramaa appadingaradha kavaninga. Edhu nirvaaga thiran vaayndha arasu.. Edhu thiramaiyillaadha arasungaradha neenga purinjjungunga .
Kurippaa, kazhaga udanbirappugalukku naan valiyurutha virumbaradhu ennannaa… makkal namakku muzhumaiyaa ottu podala, naama aatchikku vara mudiyala adhanaala indha aatchila nadakkara thavarugalaala makkal paadhikkappadum podhu, namakkennanu irukka koodaadhu, appadi oru ennam namma sithaandhathulaye kidaiyaadhu. Aatchiya izhakkaradha DMK ennikkume tholviyaa ninaichudhu illa.. Oru naanayathukku irandu pakkam irukkara maadhiri, idha makkal paniyoda innoru mugamaadhaan naan paakkaran… aatchila irukkamo… illaiyo… ennikkum thamizhnaattoda urimaikkaagavum.. Valarchikkaagavum makkalukkaagavum naama sanda senjjitte irukkanum. Avanga thaathaavukkaaga sanda senjjom… avanga appaavukkaaga sanda senjjom.,. Ippa avangalukkaaga sanda seyvom… idhudhaan namma thimugavoda varalaaru.. Andha varalaaru eppavum maaraadhu. Maaravum koodaadhu. Nandri ..vanakkam” ena pesiyullaar.

headline: Ilamben palaathgaaram vaalivarukku 20 aandu sirai
text:
Trichy: ilambennai palaathgaaram seytha mugamadhu raveek, 25, endra vaalivarukku, 20 aandugal sirai thandanai vidhikkappattadhu.
Trichy maavattam, manigandam pagudhiyais serndhavar koolithozhilaali mugamadhu raveek. Ivar, adhe pagudhiyil vasikkum, 17 vayadhu ilambennai kaadhalippadhaaga koori, 2022 janavari maadham, palaathgaaram seythu karppamaakkinaar.
Ilamben kudumbathinar pugaaril, thiruverumboor magalir Police, pokso sattathil vazhakku padhindhu, mugamadhu raveekkai kaidhu seythanar.
Indha vazhakku visaaranai, Trichy magilaa needhimandrathil netru nadandhadhu. Mugamadhu raveekkirku, 20 aandugal sirai thandanai vidhithu, needhivadhi sanmugappiriyaa theerppalithaar.

headline: Jananaayagan padam paarthu vittu azhudha vaigo endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘jananaayagan padam paarthu vittu azhudha vaigo,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’jananaayagan padam paarthuttu kanneer vittu azhudha vaigo,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan, vaigo azhuvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2018m aandu edukkappatta video, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, vaigovin maithunar magan theekkulithadhaal vaigo azhudhadhaagak koori kadandha epral 13, 2018 andru thinamalar oodagam merkanda video-vai appodhu veliyittirundhadhu. Idhanai eduthe, jananaayagan padathudan thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram…
