enave, kurippitta video kadandha 2018m aandu edukkappatta ondru enavum, idharkum tharpodhaiya jananaayagan pada rileeskkum endha sambandhamum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Anthropic Incident: kurukku vazhi kanduviditha seyarkai nunnarivu - ini manidhakkulathukku enna aavathu?
text:
Sikkanguniyaa vairasin thotrunoyai adhigarikka muyandra payo-veppans (Bio weapons) thodarbaana pala muyatsigalaith thadai seythadhaaga aanthrovik niruvanam sepdambar 10 andru arivithadhu. Idhu paadhugaapputh thuraiyil perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu.
‘seyarkai nunnarivu (Artificial Intelligence - AI) manidhanin arivukkoormaiyai minjjum alavukku valarndhulladhaa? - indhak kelvi, ulagengilum vinjnjaanigal, arasiyalvaadhigal, podhumakkal utbadap pala tharappinar mathiyil ezhundhirukkiradhu. Thozhilnutba ulagam perumagizhchiyudan kondaadum indha valarchi, unmaiyil manidhakkulathirku oru varamaa alladhu perazhivin thodakkamaa endra aazhamaana sandhegathai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Seyarkai nunnarivin adheedha vegam, adhanaal erpadum paadhugaappus sikkalgal, peruniruvanangalin poruppatrap pokkugal, ulagalaaviya vallarasugalukku idaiyilaana panippor pondra palveru parimaanangalai ingup paarppom.
Indha ulagalaaviya vivaadhathirku vithittavar 27 vayadhu pirittish aaraaychiyaalaraana jekkop kaaksan (Jacob Coxon). Saan piraansisgovin alamo sgoyar poongaavil ulla oru palagaiyil amarndhu kondu avar veliyitta oru padhivu, ulagalaaviya thozhilnutbas sandhaiyai ulukkiyadhu. Ovaneai (OpenAI) matrum aanthrovik (Anthropic) pondra ulagin munnani AI niruvanangalil moondru aandugal murpayitsi (Pre-training) aaraaychiyil eeduvattirundha kaaksan, thideerena sepdambar 8 andru thanadhu padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythaar.
"naan indru aanthrovikkilirundhu raajinaamaa seygiren. Ovaneai matrum aanthrovik aagiya irandu niruvanangalume poruppudan nadandhu kollavillai. Avai suya-membaattu adhinunnarivai (Self-improving superintelligence) nokki vegamaay odikkondirukkindrana. Melum namadhu uyirgaludan soodhaadikkondirukkindrana" endru avar thanadhu X (X) pakkathil padhivittaar.
Than raajinaamaavin moolam iru maadhangalil thanakkuk kidaikkavirundha pangugalin (Equity) pala latchakkanakkaana taalargalai avar izhandhaar. Aanaalum, edhirgaala manidhak kulathin meedhaana payame thanadhu mudivukkuk kaaranam endru avar koorinaar. Kaaksanin indhap padhivu verum 36 mani nerathirkul 15.3 kodi paarvaigalaip petru oru perum thaakkathai erpaduthiyadhu.
Kaaksanin echarikkaiyaanadhu oru thanippatta kural alla; maaraaga, munnani AI aayvagangalukkulleye panivuriyum pala nivunargalin aazhndha kavalaiyin velippaadaagum. Aanthrovikkil seyarkai nunnarivu manidhargalin nokkathirkerpas seyalbaduvadhai urudhi seyyum thuraiyin thalaivaraaga irukkum ivaan havingar (Evan Hubinger), "AI thozhilnutbathil anaithu manidhargalaiyum kondruviduvadharkaana saathiyakkoorugal iruppadhaaga naangal theeviramaaga nambugirom" endru pagirangamaagak koora, ovaneai niruvanathil AI mugavargalaik kangaanikkum maarkkas villiyams (Marcus Williams), thagundha ozhungumuraigal edukkappadaavittaal, adutha sila aandugalil manidhakkulam mutrilum azhindhuvoga 70 sadhavigidham vaayppu irukkiradhu endru therivithaar.
Indhath thaakkathin vilaivaaga, aanthrovik niruvanathin thalaimai nirvaaga adhigaari teriyo amodi (Dario Amodei) 3,800 vaarthaigal konda oru katturaiyai veliyittaar. Adhil, innum aaru mudhal 12 maadhangalukkul kattuppaattai meerum seyarkai nunnarivugal muzhu inaiyathaiye thangal kattuppaattirkul konduvarum thiran perakkoodum endru echarithaar. Ovaneai thalaivar saam aaltmen matrum elaan mask ullittorum valarchiyin vegathaik kuraikka vendum (Pacing the frontier) enbadhil udanbattanar. Eninum, pudhiya maadhirigalai uruvaakkuvadhai avargal udanadiyaaga niruthuvaargalaa enbadhu kelvikkuriyaagave ulladhu.
Indha echarikkaigal verum thathuvaarthak karpanaigal alla enbadharku, kadandha sila maadhangalaaga munnani aayvagangalil nadandha nidhiyiyal matrum thozhilnutba vivathugale saatchiyaagum. Kadandha joolai maadham, ovaneai thanadhu ulnaattu saivar paadhugaappus sodhanaiyin podhu, 1,200 AI mugavargal (Agents) thangal aaplain kattuppaattuk kolgaigalai meeri veliyerivittadhaaga arivithadhu.
Sodhanaiyil tholvi adaiyakkoodum endra achathil, andha AI mugavargal thangalukkena oru ragasiyas seythip palagaiyai (Secret message board) uruvaakkik kondu, oruvaraiyoruvar orunginaithu kallathanamaaga hakking fes (Hugging Face) endra niruvanathin meedhu saivar thaakkudhalai appodhu nadathiyirundhanar.
Idhu panimalaiyin oru munai mattume. Adutha maadhathil, matroru AI mugavar koottam ovaneai-yin sondha sooppar kampyoottaraiye ooduruvi hek seythadhu. Adhe kaalagattathil, pirittan arasaangathin amaippaal sodhikkappatta aanthrovikkin 'kilaat mithos' (Claude Mythos) maadhiriyum kattuppaattai meeri, thirandha moola (Open-source) amaippil theemborulai (malware) serugumbadi oru manidhanai nambavaikka muyandradhu.
Sepdambar maadhathil, thanippatta aaraaychiyaalargal kuzhu ondru, ovaneai maadhirigal kaividappatta jerman medai (forum) ondril thangalukkul ragasiyamaagath thodarbu kollas seythip palagaiyaip payanbaduthuvadhaik kandarindhadhu.
Meshin lening (Machine Learning) amaippugal manidhargalaal kaimuraiyaaga (coded) kuriyidappaduvadhillai; avai kodikkanakkaana murai payitsi petru, thaangalaagave valarum thanmai kondavai. Vetrigalukku vegumadhiyum, tholvigalukkuth thandanaiyum vazhangappadum podhu, andha amaippugal thangalin ilakkai adaiya mosadiyaagak kurukku vazhigalaik kandariyath thodangugindrana. Indhath thiramai naaladaivil manidhargalin kattuppaattirkul adangaamal poyvidum endra acham valuthulladhu.
Sakdhivaayndha seyarkai nunnarivu maadhirigalaal manidhargalukku edhenum aavathu varumaa enbadhai mungoottiye sodhithu ariyum niruvanam Model Evaluation and Threat Research (METR). Adhil aaraaychiyaalaraana ajeyaa kothraa (Ajeya Cotra), ovaneai valaagathil munbu paartha hakking pes meedhaana ooduruvalgalai neril aayvu seytha piragu nilaimai thaan ninaithadhai vida migavum mosamaaga iruppadhai unarndhaar.
Kothraavum avaradhu saga oozhiyargalum merkonda aayvil, OpenAI-yin ulnaattu saivar paadhugaappus sodhanaiyin podhu, 1,200 seyarkai nunnarivu (AI) mugavargal thangal aaplain kattuppaattuk kolgaigalai meeri veliyeri oru ragasiyas seythip palagaiyai (Secret message board) uruvaakkiyadhum, pinnar avargalil 700 per inaindhu saivar thaakkudhalai orunginaithadhum theriyavandhadhu.
Palaveenamaana menborulgalai hek seythu tharavugalai meettedukkum saivar thirangalais sodhikkum pani andha AI-kalukku vazhangappattirundhadhu, aanaal oru manidhath thavaru kaaranamaaga sila panigalais seyvadhu saathiyamillaamal ponadhu. Tholvi kittathatta urudhi endra nilaiyai edhirnokkiya andha AI-kal ondruserndhana; sila mani nerangalukkul, endhas sodhanaiyilum vetriverakkoodiya oruvidha emaatru kuriyeedu (Cheat code) ondraith thayaarithana.
OpenAI-yin thaaniyangi madhippeettaalar (Automated grader) indha emaatru velaiyaik kanduvidithu thangalaith tholviyadaiyas seyyum endru avai nambiyadhaal, andha menborul patriya vivarangalaiyum adhai emaatrum vazhigalaiyum thedi hakking fes (Hugging Face) niruvanathin meedhu thaakkudhal nadathina.
Andhas seythip palagaiyil, sila mugavargal thaangal seyvadhu thavaru endru therindhum adhaith thodarndhu seythadhaaga ezhudhinar. Adutha aaru maadhangalukkul oru kattuppaadatra AI mugavar koottam niruvanathirkul oru nilaiyaana kaaloondradhalaip (Permanent foothold) perakkoodum endrum, adhu edhirgaalathil arasaanga matrum raanuva amaippugalin aayudhangalaikkooda than kattuppaattirkul konduvarakkoodum endrum ajeyaa kothraa echarithaar.
Munnaal munnani aaraaychiyaalaraana Jeffrey irving (Geoffrey Irving), adutha thasaapdhathil manidhagulam azhindhuvoga 50 sadhavigidham vaayppulladhaaga madhippidugiraar. Idharkaana paadhaigal uyiriyal (Biology) thuraiyilum neendulladhu. Seyarkai nunnarivaip payanbaduthi kovit-19 perundhotrai vida migak kadumaiyaana pudhiya noykkirumigalai (Pathogens) alladhu aavathaana navaasangalai uruvaakka mudiyum. Sepdambar 10 andru, aanthrovik niruvanam sikkanguniyaa vairasin thotrunoyai adhigarikka muyandra payo-veppans (Bioweapons) thodarbaana pala muyatsigalaith thadai seythadhaaga arivithadhu. Idhu paadhugaapputh thuraiyil perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu.
Ivvalavu theeviramaana echarikkaigal vidukkappatta podhilum, endhavoru munnani AI niruvanamum thaamaaga munvandhu thanadhu aayvugalai muzhumaiyaaga niruthavillai. Maaraaga, sudhandhiramaana paadhugaappu vallunargalaith thangal niruvanathirkul anumadhippadhu matrum oru pudhiya thara nirnaya amaippai uruvaakkuvadhu pondra naduthara nadavadikkaigalaiye avai munnedukkindrana.
Aanaal, indhath tharkaaligath thadaiyaik kooda palarum edhirkkindranar. America niruvanangal vegathaik kuraithaal, China indhath thuraiyil munnilai petruvidum enbadhe avargalin vaadhamaagum. Evok AI (Epoch AI) aayvinbadi, China niruvanangal America-vin munnani niruvanangalai vida sila maadhangal mattume pindhangiyullana.
Ulagalaaviya puvisaar arasiyal melaadhikkathai China kaippatrividak koodaadhu enbadharkaaga, kattuppaadugalaith thalartha vendum endru America mudhaleettaalargalum vanigargalum vaadhidugindranar. Kanadaavais serndha koher (Cohere) niruvanathin thalaimai nirvaaga adhigaari eydan komas, periya niruvanangal podhumakkalaip paadhugaakkum endra porvaiyil egavoga urimaiyai (Cartel) uruvaakka muyalgindrana endru kadumaiyaaga vimarsithullaar.
Vaashingdan naadaalumandrathil (Capitol Hill) nilaimai theeviramadaindhulladhu. Senattar perni saandars matrum piradhinidhi kirek kasaar pondror sooppar indelijens valarchikkuth thadai vidhikka vendum endrum, pudhiya fedaral ozhungumurai aanaiyathai uruvaakka vendum endrum satta masodhaakkalai munmozhindhullanar. Aanaal, indha ozhungumuraigalaik kudiyarasuk katchiyais serndha savaanaayagar mic jaansan matrum adhivar tonaalt Trump aagiyor kadumaiyaaga edhirkkindranar.
Adhivar Trump thanadhu samooga valaithalap padhivil, "AI-kkuth thevaippadum ore paadhugaappu, thiramaiyaana oru adhivar mattume. AI matrum tharavu maiyangalukku edhiraaga oru mosamaana sadhi nadakkiradhu, idhil China mattume magizhchiyadaigiradhu" endru therivithaar. Envidiyaa thalaimai nirvaaga adhigaari jensan huvaang matrum vellai maaligai munnaal adhigaari tevit saaks pondrorin selvaakku kaaranamaaga, America-vin mudhanmaik kurikkol seenaavai velvadhe thavira, paadhugaappai munniruthip pinvaanguvadhu alla endra nilaippaattil Trump urudhiyaaga ullaar.
America vaakkaalargalil 57 sadhavigidham per AI-yin aavathugal nanmaigalai vida adhigam endru nambinaalum, arasiyal thalaivargalin vaniga matrum raanuva ilakkugal idharku muranaagave ullana.
Indhas soozhalil, vaashingdanukkum peyjingirkum idaiye adhigaarappoorvamaana AI paadhugaappup pechuvaarthaigal indha maadha irudhiyil nadaivera ullana. 2024-m aandil jeneevaavil nadandha mundhaiya pechuvaarthaigal semigandakdar matrum varthagap porileye mudivadaindhana.
Tharpodhu, aanthrovikkin 'mithos' maadhiri anaithu mukkiya iyangudhalangalilum ulla kuraivaadugalaik kandarindhadhaiyaduthu, karuvoolas seyalaalar sgaat pesent udanadiyaaga vangith thalaivargalai azhaithu aalosithaar. Seenaavudanaana ulavuthurai matrum saivar paadhugaappu achuruthalgalaik karuthil kondu iru naadugalum sila ellaikkodugalai vagukka vendiya kattaayathil ullana.
Iruppinum, China-vin kolgai vaguppaalargal AI-yai oru 'adhisayap petti' alladhu kadavulaagap paarkkaamal, minsaaram alladhu neeraavi iyandhiram pondra oru podhuvaana thozhilnutbamaagave paarkkindranar. Enave, valarchiyaik kattuppaduthuvadhu arthamatradhu endru avargal karudhugindranar. Aayinum, payangaravaadham matrum thatseyalaana porgalaith thavirkka avasarakkaala haatlain (Emergency Hotline) amaippadhu pondra kuraindhavatcha oppandhangal ettappada vaayppulladhu.
Seyarkai nunnarivuth thozhilnutbam manidhakkulathai oru pudhiya velikkuk konduvandhu niruthiyulladhu. Oruvuram kaaksanaip pondra aaraaychiyaalargalin echarikkaigalum, maruvuram kodikkanakkaana taalar mudhaleedugalum ulagalaaviya vallarasup pottigalum ondrai ondru edhirkkindrana. Thozhilnutbam than suyaadheenap payanathaith thodangivitta nilaiyil, adhu manidhargalin kattuppaattai meeris selvadhaith thadukka ulaga naadugal ondrinaindhu seyalbada vendum.
"maatrathirkaana mudhal adiyai yaar eduthuvaippadhu?" endra kelvikku vidai kaanak kaalam kuraivaaga ulladhu. Manidhakkulathin edhirgaalam ippodhu thozhilnutbathin kaigalil alla, manidhargalin puthisaalith thanamaana koottu mudivugalildhaan adangiyirukkiradhu.

headline: Pakistan anugundu padhukki vaitha idathin meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhal idhuvaa?
text:
Pakistan anugundai padhukki vaitha idathil India nadathiya thaakkudhalin kaatchi endru oru video

maalai pagudhiyil vedigundu vedikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil, “oho idhudhaan adhuvaa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaithagavalil, “
*kiraanaa malai 😘 anugundai padhukki vaithu paadhugaakkum Pakistan-il irukkum idam. Adhan vaasalil thulliyamaagath thaakki ulagirke echarikkai thandha India idhaithaan nilanadukkam erpattadhu endru koorinaargal…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Paagisdhaanin anusakdhi maiyam matrum anu aayudhangal vaikkappatta idathirku aruge India thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga kurippittu pala video-kkal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindrana. Ippadip paravum veediyokkalai aayvu seythaal avai pazhaiyadhaaga alladhu mathiya kizhakku naadugal pagudhiyil edukkappattadhaaga ulladhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil video unmaiyaanadhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Idhuvum mathiya kizhakkup pagudhi video enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. 2015m aandil eman naattin meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhalin podhu indha video padhivaanadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha video-vil nugoom malai vedippu (Nuqoum Mountain explosions) endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhan adippadaiyil thediya podhu 2015m aandu me maadham 11m thedhi eman ellaip pagudhiyil saudhi thalaimaiyilaana koottanip padaigal thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
2015m aandu eman naattil nadandha thaakkudhal video-vai eduthu 2025l paagisdhaanin anu aayudhangal ulla idathil India thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Piradhamar modiyaal mudiyum... India-vin udhaviyai naada ilangai arasukku edhirkkatchi valiyuruthal
text:
Kozhumbu: savudhi areviyaavil marana thandanai vidhikkappatta ilangai thamizharai meetka piradhamar Modi-yin udhaviyai naadumaaru, ilangai arasukku annaattu edhirkkatchi embi valiyuruthiyullaar.
Ilangaiyin kizhakku maagaanathais serndha thamizhar anojan sivaraasaa, 9 maadhangalukku munbu velaikkaaga savudhi areviyaavirkus sendraar. Angu samooga valaithalap padhivu moolam madha nindhanai seythadhaagak koori, ilangaiyais serndha anojan sivaraasaa meedhu vazhakku paayndhadhu. Idhanai visaaritha Needhimandram, aarambathil avarukku 5 aandugal siraithandanaiyum, 3 milliyan savudhi riyaal avaraadhamum vidhikkappattadhu. Pinnar athandanai marana thandanaiyaaga uyarthappattadhaaga vazhakkarinjar therivithullaar.
Idhu ilangaiyil ulla sivaraasaavin kudumbathinarukku perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Iruppinum, avarukku marana thandanai vidhikkappattadhai ilangaiyin veliyuravuthurai innum urudhippaduthavillai. Avarai eppadiyaavadhu meetka vendum endru ilangai arasidam muraiyittu varugindranar.
Idhanidaiye, sivaraasaavukku vidhikkappatta thandanaiyai edhirthu, annaattin ucha needhimandrathil oru maadhathirkul melmuraiyeedu seyvadharkaana nadavadikkaigalaiyum ilangai thoodharagam merkondu varugiradhu.
Indha nilaiyil, ilangai thamizharai meetkum vivagaarathil Indhiya piradhamar Modi-yin udhaviyai naadumaaru ilangai adhivar anura kumaara thisaanaayakkevukku, edhirkkatchi embi mano kanesan valiyuruthiyullaar. Savudhi areviyaa mannar mugamadhu pin salmaanudan piradhamar Modi-kku nerukkamaana uravu iruppadhaagavum, avar thalaiyittaal, sivaraasaavukku manidhaavimaana udhavi kidaikka vaayppulladhaaga therivithullaar.

headline: Vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga peegaaril poraattam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga peegaar makkal poraattathil eeduvattadhaaga oru video

Police vaaganathin meedhu makkal kalveesi thaakkudhal nadathum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “#VoteChori vaakku thiruttukku edhiraaga peegaar muzhuvadhum makkal poraattathil eeduvadugiraargal paasisa pijevi aatchikku viraivil mudivu varugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar therdhalil aikkiya janadhaa thalam – BJP koottani vetri petradharku edhirppu therivithu peegaaril makkal poraattam nadathiya podhu Police meedhu kalveesith thaakkudhal nadathappattadhaaga oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha video thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu akdovar 12m thedhiyil irundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhaavadhu, peegaar therdhal mudivugal varuvadharku oru maadhathirku munbaagave indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattirundhadhaik kandarindhom.
Thelivaana andha video-vil Police vaaganathil kujaraath padhivu en irundhadhu. Kujaraathi mozhiyil veliyaana padhivugalum namakku kidaithana. Avatril, kujaraathil thadaiyai meeri aam aathmi katchi erpaadu seythirundha vivasaayigal koottathaik kalaikka Police sendra podhu modhal erpattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu taims aap India veliyittirundha seythi kidaithadhu. Adhil, kujaraathin pottaath (Botad) maavattathil indha sambavam nadandhadhaagavum, indha thaakkudhal sambavathil kaavalargal kaayam adaindhadhaagavum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam kujaraathil aam aathmi erpaadu seythirundha koottathaik kalaikkas sendra Police meedhu makkal thaakkudhal nadathiya video-vai thavaraaga, therdhal mudivugalukku edhiraaga peegaar makkal poraattam nadathiyadhaaga pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pakistan kadarpadaith thalam thaakkappattadhaagap paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Paagisdhaanin jinnaa kadarpadaith thalathai palusisdhaan vidudhalai raanuvam thaakkiyadhaaga oru video

vedigundu vedithu theeppizhambu ezhum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhu palisisdhaanil ulla ji nnaa kadarpadai thalam. Pakistan-il karaachiyai adu thu palusisdhaanil thaan paagisdhaanin 2 vadhu periya kadarpadai thalam irukkiradhu. Adhan peyar jinnaa kadarpadai thala m.idhu palusisdhaanil ulla kuvaadar maavattathil ulla ormaraa engira nagarathil iru kkiradhu.
Kuvaadaril ulla kuvaadar thurai mugam China-vin kattuppaattil ulla varthaga thuraimugam.idhu thaan India-vin taarget. Indha kuvaadar thuraimugathirku sumaar 300 kilo meter tho laivil thaan paagisdhaanin 2 vadhu periya kadarpadai thalamaana jinnaa kadarpadai thalam irukkiradhu. Indha jinnaa kadarpadai thalathai palusisdhaan vidudhalai aarmi thaakki iruppadhaaga therigiradhu. Thaakkudhal patriya veediyovum varugiradhu. Video-vin unmai thanmai theriyavillai. Aanaal jinnaa kadarpadai thalathai palusisdhaan livaresan aarmi thaakki iruppadhu 100% unmaiyaana seythiyaagum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran thuraimugathil payangara vedi vivathu erpattu 70kkum merpattor uyirizhandhadhaagas seythigal veliyaanadhu. Paagisdhaanin thuraimugam alladhu kadarpadaith thalam thaakkappattadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. 2024m aandu maars maadham palusisdhaan payangaravaadhigal Pakistan kadarpadai vimaana thalamaana pienes sithikkai (PNS Siddique) thaakkiyadhaaga mattume seythi kidaithadhu. Indha thaakkudhalil 6 per uyirizhandhadhaaga seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Jinnaa kadarpadaith thalam thaakkappattadhaaga, sameevathil appadi oru sambavam nadandhadhaaga endha seythiyum namakku kidaikkavillai.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil paagisdhaanin irandaavadhu periya kadarpadaith thalamaana jinnaavil thaakkudhal nadathappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Kadandha 2024m aandu sithik kadarpadai thalathin meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhal thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigalil sithikdhaan paagisdhaanin irandaavadhu periya kadarpadaith thalam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam 2024l sithik kadarpadaith thalam thaakkappatta seythiyai jinnaa kadarpadaith thalam thaakkappattadhaaga ippodhu thavaraaga pagirndhirukkalaam endru therigiradhu.
Indha video Pakistan kadarpadaith thalam thaakkudhalin podhu padhivaanadhaa enbadhai ariya aayvaith thodarndhom. Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2024m aandu navambarilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Adhil, “levanaan thalainagar peyroot meedhu Israel thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video paagisdhaanin jinnaa kadarpadaith thalathin meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhalin kaatchi endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Veedu pugundhu pennai thaakkiyavarukku kaappu
text:
Aar.ke.nagar: korukkuppettai, harinaaraayanavurathais serndha maragadham, 35.
Ivaradhu magan thileeppukkum, adhe pagudhiyais serndha vasandhagumaarukkum nilam thodarbaaga munvirodham irundhadhu. Sep., 17l thileeppin veettukku sendra vasandhagumaar, 22, avaradhu sagodharar harigirushnanudan serndhu, thileeppin sagodhariyai thagaadha vaarthaigalaal pesi keezhe thalli, madhuvaattilai kaatti kolai mirattal viduthadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Aar.ke.nagar Police vazhakkuppadhindhu, vasandhagumaarai netru kaidhu seythu, needhimandrathil aajarbaduthi siraiyil adaithanar. Avar meedhu ettu vazhakkugal ullana. Thalaimaraivaana harigirushnanai thedi varugindranar.

headline: Mukkombu vandhadaindhadhu kaaviri neer
text:
Trichy: mettoor anaiyil irundhu, sep., 1m thedhi thirakkappatta kaaviri neer, netru mukkombu vandhadaindhadhu.
Karnaadaga maanila arasu, kaaviri aatril thanneer thirakkaadhadhaal, mettoor anai, thanneer indri varandadhu. Idhanaal, teldaa paasanathukku joon 12l thanneer thirakkappadavillai. Thamizhagathil palveru poraattangal, aanaiyam matrum needhimandra utharavaal, karnaadagaavil irundhu kaaviriyil thanneer thirakkappattadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, mettoor anaiyil irundhu sep., 1l thanneer thirakkappattadhu.
Tharpodhu, mettoor anaiyil irundhu vinaadikku, 7,000 kana adi thanneer thirakkappattu, Erode, karoor maavattangalai kadandhu, Trichy maavattam, mukkombu melanaikku netru vandhadaindhadhu. Kallanaiyil irundhu teldaa maavatta paasanathukku, naalai thanneer thirakka uthesikkappattu ulladhu.

headline: Semigandakdar thuraiyil valarchi.. Sip vadivamaippu maiyamaaga maarum Tamil Naattin siriya nagaram!
text:
Thengaasiyil anandhan ayyaasaami thodangiya tensemi niruvanam, semigandakdar sip vadivamaippil kavanam seluthi, AI matrum IoT pondra thuraigalil munnetram kaangiradhu. Idhu kiraamappurangalil thozhilnutba valarchikku udhaaranamaaga thigazhgiradhu. Johovin munnodi muyatsiyaip pola, inniruvanamum siriya nagarangalil thiramaigalai valarkkiradhu.
Irandu thasaapdhangalukkum melaana anuvavamulla munnaal indel (intel) poriyiyal iyakkunaraana anandhan ayyaasaami, Tamil Naattin thengaasiyil tensemi (Tensemi) endra sip vadivamaippu niruvanathai uruvaakki nadathi varugiraar.
Indha muyatsi AI, uyar seyaldhiran kanini (HPC) matrum aiodi (IoT) aagiyavatrirkaana semigandakdar IP-ai uruvaakkuvadhil kavanam seluthugiradhu, idhu oru kiraamappurathil thozhilnutba niruvanathai niruvuvadhai nokkamaagak kondulladhu.
Thengaasi pondra oru siriya nagarathil idhuvondra oru muyatsiyaith thodanguvadhu asaadhaaranamaanadhu matrum thanithuvamaanadhu. Enenil semigandakdar sip vadivamaippu enbadhu podhuvaaga ulagalaaviya thozhilnutba maiyangalil nigazhum migavum sirappu vaayndha matrum membatta thuraiyaagum. Andhavagaiyil munnar velinaadugalil alladhu mukkiya nagarangalil panivurindha nivunargalai ippodhu thengaasi eerkkiradhu.
Semiconductor thozhil irandu vishayangalil kavanam seluthugiradhu ondru sip urpathi, matrondru sip vadivamaippu. Sip urpathi enbadhu periya thozhitsaalaigalil semiconductor sipgalai urpathi seyvadhaagum. Idharku migapperiya mooladhanam matrum kanaraga ulgattamaippu thevaippaduvadhaal, oru sila niruvanangal mattume athagaiya aalaigalai iyakka mudiyum.
Adhanaal anandhan ayyaasaami thodangiyulla tensemi (Tensemi) niruvanam sip tisainingai mattum kaiyil eduthu adhanai vetrigaramaaga seyalbaduthi varugiradhu.
Thengaasiyin maatrathirkaana adithalam 2011-l joho (zoho) maadhalambaarai kiraamathil verum aaru oozhiyargaludan oru siriya aluvalagathaith thirandhavodhu thodangiyadhu. Andha nerathil, palar indha muyatsiyai sandhegithanar, kiraamappurangalil oru ulagalaaviya menborul niruvanathai aadharikka podhumaana thiramaiyaana soozhal irukkaadhu endranar.
Perumbaalaana thozhilnutba niruvanangal Chennai alladhu pengalooru pondra periya nagarangalil irundhu mattume seyalbada vendum endrum sollappattadhu. Aanaal joho (zoho) veruvatta anugumuraiyaip pinbatriyadhu.
Perunagarangalil irundhu mattum paniyamarthuvadharkup padhilaaga, kiraamangal matrum siru nagarangalil irundhu thiramaiyaana maanavargalai adaiyaalam kaanbadhil niruvanam kavanam seluthiyadhu. Indru, thengaasi pagudhiyil joho (zoho) sumaar 1,200 perai velaikku amarthiyulladhu.
Indhasoozhalil tharpodhu anandhan ayyaasaami niruviyirukkum tensemi niruvanam thengaasiyil valarchiyadaindhuvarum nilaiyil, adharku sreedhar vembu vaazhthukkalai therivithullaar.

headline: Isrelukku aayudhangal kondu sella marutha America vimaanigal kaidhu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Isrelukku aayudhangal kondu sella irundha vimaanathai iyakka marutha irandu vimaanigalai America arasu kaidhu seythadhu endru oru video

America raanuva adhigaarigal irandu perai perai kaavalargal kaidhu seythu azhaithus sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “isrelukku” aayudhangal nirappappatta vimaanangalai otta marutha irandu America iraanuva vimaanigal kaidhu seyyappattanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Amerikkaavilirundhu isrelukku aayudhangalai etrikkondu sella irundha vimaanathai iyakka marutha America vimaanappadai vimaanigal kaidhu seyyappattadhaaga video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Aanaal, kaidhu seyyappattavargalaip paarkkum podhu vimaanigal polath theriyavillai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai indha maadham (sepdambar) mudhal vaarathil palarum thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, America-vin senat savaiyil nadandha visaaranaiyin podhu kaasaa inappadugolaikku America thunai povadhaagak koori munnaal raanuva adhigaarigal idaiyooru seythanar. Avargalai kaavalargal kaidhu seythu azhaithus sendranar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan thagavalai appadiye koogulil taip seythu, idhu thodarbaaga seythi edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu, idhu thodarbaana sila seythigal kidaithana. Avatril, senat savaiyin veliyuravu kamitti visaaranaiyin podhu America raanuvathin oyvu petra ulavup pirivu adhigaari josbin kilbiyoo, oyvuvetra kireen peret lepdinant karnal andhoni aguylar aagiyor isrelukku America udhavi seyvadharku edhirppu therivithum inappadugolaikku amerikkargalin varippanam selavu seyyappaduvadharkum edhirppu therivithu idaiyooru seythanar. Avargalai Police kaivilangittu azhaithus sendranar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam isrelukku aayudhangal kondu sella marutha America vimaanappadai vimaanigal kaidhu seyyappattanar endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana thagavalaik kondulladhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Samooga vidudhigalil maattiraichiyaa? Amaicharukku vi.es.pi., kandanam
text:
Madurai: '''samooga vidudhigalil maattiraichi vazhanguvadhu kurithu pariseelikkappadum' ena samooga needhithurai amaichar vanni arasu arivithadhai thirumbap peraavittaal maanila alavil poraattam nadaiverum'' ena Maduraiyil vishva hindhu parishath maanila inai podhus seyalaalar sandhirasegaran echarithaar.
Avar kooriyadhaavadhu : thi.mu.ka.,vai pinbatri hindhu virodha pokkai tha.ve.ka.,vum kaiyaalgiradhu. Maanavargalukku sathaana unavu vazhanguvadhil thavarillai. Aanaal paladharappatta maanavargal thangip payilum samooga vidudhigalil maattiraichi vazhanga pariseelippadhaaga amaichar vanniyarasu arivithadhu kandanathirkuriyadhu.
Adhanai avar thirumbap peraavittaal hindhu iyakkangalai thiratti maanila alavil poraattam nadathappadum. Hindhu virodha pokkai tha.ve.ka.,vinar kaiyaaluvadhai mudhalvar Vijay irumbuk karam kondu odukka vendum. Thavarinaal thi.mu.ka.,vukku erpatta nilaidhaan varum therdhalgalil tha.ve.ka.,vukkum erpadum endraar.

headline: Indhiyil pesiya sundhar pichai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Koogul thalaivar sundhar pichaikku indhi theriyaadhu endru thamizhnaattuth thalaivargal koori varum nilaiyil, sundhar pichai indhiyil pesiya video ondrai BJP aadharavaalargal

sundhar pichai thanakku indhi theriyaadhu endru kooriyadhaaga Tamil Nadu amaichar pi.ti.aar.pazhanivel thiyaagaraajan kooriya kaatchi matrum koogul siio sundhar pichai indhiyil pesuvadhu pondra video-vai ondru serthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilaith thagavalil, “irumozhik kalvi paditha koogul thalaivar sundhar pichaikku hindhi theriyaadhu – pi.ti.aar
ippadi azhagaa indhi pesum sundhar pichai padithadhu moondru mozhi kolgai, andha thaniyaar pallikkoodam peyar “javagar vithyaalayaa CBSE palli” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Koogul siio indhi pesuvadhu pondra video-vai padhivittu, sundhar pichaikku indhi theriyaadhu endru kooriyadhu thavaru endru silar samooga oodagangalil Tamil Nadu arasu matrum amaichargalai vimarsithu varugindranar. Aanaal, video-vil sundhar pichaiyin vaay asaippukkum, avar pesiyadharkum thodarbillai. Paarkkum podhe video edit seythu, aadiyovai mattum maatriyiruppadhu therigiradhu. Idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Sundhar pichai pesiyadhan unmai video-vai thedinom. Andha video kaatchiyaip pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu, pala video-kkal kidaithana. Avatraip paartha podhu adhil avar aangilathil pesiyadhu therindhadhu. Andha veediyokkalil idhu 2016m aandu America-vin silikkaan veliyil nadandha ulagalaaviya thozhilmunaivor uchi maanaattin (Global Entrepreneurship Summit) podhu edukkappattadhu endru therindhadhu.
Unmai video-vai kandariya thodarndhu thedinom. Global Entrepreneurship Summit 2016 Silicon Valley (GES2016) endra YouTube pakkathil namakku andha video kidaithadhu. Video-vin 54vadhu nimidathil sundhar pichai medaikku vandhu pesath thodangugiraar. 10 nimidangal avar pesugiraar. Video-vin oru mani neram 5vadhu nimidathil avar pesi mudikkiraar. Video muzhuvadhaiyum paarthom. Adhil avar aangilathil mattume pesugiraar, engeyum indhiyil avar pesavillai.
2016m aandu nadandha ulagalaaviya thozhilmunaivor uchi maanaattil koogul siio pesiyadhai yaaro indhiyil tapping seythullanar. headline: F-35ai kalamirakkum savudhi? $24.3 pilliyan America oppandhathaal paravarappu!
text:
Savudhi areviyaavukku 48 adhinaveena F-35 Lightning II por vimaanangal matrum 49 Pratt & Whitney F135 injingalai virpanai seyyum 24.3 pilliyan taalar madhippilaana oppandhathirku America veliyuravuthurai oppudhal alithulladhu. Congress anumadhi kidaithaal, savudhi mathiya kizhakkil F-35 petra sila naadugalil ondraagum.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
valaigudaa piraandhiyathil paadhugaappu soozhal theeviramadaindhu varum nilaiyil, savudhi areviyaavukku 48 adhinaveena F-35 Lightning II por vimaanangalai virpanai seyvadharkaana sumaar 24.3 pilliyan America taalar madhippilaana saathiyamaana oppandhathirku America veliyuravuthurai oppudhal alithulladhu.
Indha oppandham tharpodhu irudhi virpanai oppandhamaaga maaravillai. America Congress-in pariseelanai mudindha pinnare adutha nadavadikkaigal merkollappadum.
Indha $24.3 pilliyan oppandhathil 48, F-35 vimaanangaludan 49 Pratt & Whitney F135 injingal idamberugindrana. Idhil 48 injingal vimaanangalil payanbaduthappaduvadhudan, ondru udhiriyaaga vazhangappada ulladhu.
F-35 enbadhu kuraindha kannukkuth thenbadum (stealth) thiran konda aindhaam thalaimurai por vimaanamaagum. Indha oppandham nadaimuraikku vandhaal, savudhi areviyaa F-35 vimaanangalaip perum mathiya kizhakku naadugalil ondraaga maarum.
Melum paadhugaappaana thagaval thodarbu amaippugal, vazhigaattudhal matrum ilakku nirnaya karuvigal, minnanu por thodarbaana aadharavu, payitsi uvagaranangal, udhiri paagangal matrum paraamarippu aadharavu ullittavai thoguppil idamberugindrana.
Lockheed Martin niruvanathin F-35 matrum Pratt & Whitney niruvanathin F135 injingal indhath thittathin mukkiya pagudhigalaaga ullana.
Savudhi areviyaavin paadhugaapputh thiranai adhigarippadhu matrum amerikkap padaigaludan adhan koottu seyalbaattai membaduthuvadhu indha virpanaiyin nokkangalil ondraaga America therivithulladhu. Valaigudaa piraandhiyathin paadhugaappu matrum arasiyal sdhirathanmaikkum idhu udhavum ena America kooriyulladhu.

headline: Saanakyaa, thinamalar karuthuk kanippu patri pagirappadum vadhandhiyaal sarchai…
text:

investigation_details:

Aam, saanakyaa – thinamalar inaindhu veliyitta sattamandra therdhal 2026 thodarbaana karuthuk kanippu mudivil koorappattulla uthesa vaakkugal vivaram verondraaga ulladhu.

headline: Samayalaraiyil adhigam seyyappadum thavaru.. Asuthamaana kukkar kesgattaal unavu nachuthanmai!
text:
Veettil thinamum payanbaduthum pirashar kukkarin moodiyilulla rappar kesgattai palar kavanikkaamal viduvadhaal, adhan adiyil enney, unavuth thugalgal, eerappadham padindhu paakdeeriyaa, poonjjai valarchi adhigarikkiradhu. Adhiga veppam sila kirumigalai azhithaalum, kesgattil irukkum asutham unavil kalandhaal vaandhi, vayitruppokku pondra unavu nachuthanmai erpadum avaayam ulladhu.
Namadhu veedugalil thinamum payanbaduthum pirashar kukkarai samaitha piragu nandraagak kazhuvi sutham seygirom. Aanaal, adhil naam anaivarum kavanikkath thavaravidum oru mukkiya pagudhi, adhan moodiyil irukkum rappar kesgat. Indhas siriya rappar valaiyathais sariyaagap paraamarikkaavittaal, adhuve noyth thotrukku vazhivagukkum ena aarokkiya vallunargal echarikkindranar.
Indha rappar valaiyathin adiyil enney pisukku, siriya unavuth thugalgal matrum eerappadham miga elidhaagap padindhuvidum. Idhaith thinamum kazhatris sutham seyyaadhavodhu, angu paakdeeriyaakkal matrum poonjjai kaalaangal perugith thurnaatrathai erpaduthugindrana. Samaikkumbodhu uruvaagum adhiga veppathil perumbaalaana kirumigal azhindhuvittaalum, kesgattil irukkum asutham samaitha unavil kalandhaal vaandhi, vayitruppokku pondra tharkaaliga unavu nachuthanmai erpada vaayppulladhu.
Idhai thavirkka ovvoru murai samaitha piragum kesgattaith thaniyaagak kazhatri, sop pottuk kazhuvi nandraagak kaayavaitha pirage meendum porutha vendum. Kukkaraip payanbaduthaadhavodhu moodiyai irukkamaagap poottaamal lesaagath thirandhu vaippadhu eerappadham thanguvadhaith thadukkum. Kesgattil vedippugal erpattaalo alladhu thurnaatram veesinaalo adhai udanadiyaaga maatruvadhu miga avasiyam.

headline: Thaalavaadiyil kaidhiyai Police thaakkiyadhaagap paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:
Erode maavattam thaalavaadi kaaval nilaiyathil kaidhi oruvarai Police thaakkum kaatchi endru oru video

san news veliyitta video-vai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, ” Erode thaalavaadi kaaval nilaiyathil kaidhiyai saramaariyaaga thaakkum polis… #kodooram 😲 #polisdhurai amaichar Vijay nadavadikkai eduppaaraa?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Erode maavattam thaalavaadi kaaval nilaiyathil kaidhi oruvar thaakkappattadhaaga san news tholaikkaatchiyil seythi veliyaanadhu. Mudhalamaichar Vijay nadavadikkai eduppaaraa endru kelvi ezhuppi palarum indha video-vai pagirndhu varugindranar. Adhai vaithu TVK aatchiyil Police araajagam endrellaam kutramsaatti palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Andha video-vai paarthom… adhil, eppodhu nadandhadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Tharpodhu nadandhadhaaga adhil endha thagavalum illai. Vijay nadavadikkai eduppaaraa endru kettiruppadhan moolam indha aatchiyil nadandhadhu enbadhu pondra thotrathai idhu erpaduthugiradhu. Ippadi oru seythiyai san news thavira veru yaarum veliyidavum illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. San news thavira veru endha padhivum namakku kidaikkavillai. Enave, koogulil thaalavaadi, kaidhi, kaaval nilaiyam ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video thodarbaaga kaaval thurai, Tamil Nadu arasin thagaval nambagathanmai pirivu ullittavai veliyitta padhivugal namakku kidaithana. Avatril indha sambavam tharpodhu nadandhadhu illai endrum 2024m aandu nadandha sambavathin video-vai tharpodhu padhivittullanar endrum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Thaalavaadi kaaval nilaiyathil kaidhi thaakkappattadhaaga veliyaana video unmaidhaan… aanaal adhu 2024m aandu nadandhadhu endru Tamil Nadu arasu tharappil irundhu vilakkam alikkappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil indha padhivu unmai thagavalai maraithu, sameevathil nadandhadhu pondra thotrathai erpaduthum vagaiyil padhividappattadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ulagileye adhiga sakdhimikka naadaaga thigazhum America; adhivar Trump thambattam
text:
Vaashingdan: ulagalavil erisakdhi matrum raanuvathil adhiga sakdhi konda naadaaga America maatrappattulladhaaga adhivar Trump therivithullaar.
Adhivar Trump pesiyadhaavadhu; 2 aandugalukku munbu, amerikkaavai kaappaatruvadharkaana poruppai makkal engalidam koduthaar. Adhanbadi, kadandha 19 maadhangalil naan alitha ovvoru vaakkurudhiyaiyum niraivetriyullen. Munnaal adhivar jo Biden matrum theevira idadhusaari jananaayagak katchiyinar America varalaatrileye miga mosamaana panaveekkathai uruvaakkinar. Adhumattumillaamal, naattin nagarangalai varumai matrum azhivin vilimbirku kondu sendranar.
Amerikkaavai irunda kaalathil irundhu, koldan naatkalukku kondu vandhullom. America varalaatrileye migapperiya alavil varik kuraippugalum, vidhimuraigal thalarvugalum vazhanginom. Adhevola, raanuvathirkaana mudhaleedugal adhigarikkappattana. Idhanmoolam, erisakdhi matrum raanuvathil ulagalavil, America adhiga sakdhi konda naadaaga urumaariyulladhu, ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Vaakku thiruttukku edhiraaga raanuva veerargal poraattam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaaril BJP, nidhish kumaarukku edhiraaga raanuva veerargal poraattathil kudhithaargal endru oru video

raanuva veerargal peraniyaagas selvadhu pondra video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video thelivaaga illai. Nilaith thagavalil, “naattukku poraada vendiya raanuva veerargal naattukku edhiraaga poraadakkoodiya soozhalukku thallappattullaargal😡😡
peegaaril pi..je..pi nidheesh kumaar aatchikku edhiraaga raanuva veerargal poraattam ✊✊
vaakku thirudargalukku edhiraaga raagul kaandhi patra vaitha neruppu India muzhuvadhum patri eriyattum” endru kurippidappattulladhu. Indha video-vai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vaakkuth thiruttu patri raagul kaandhi kutrachaattu ezhuppiya soozhalil, peegaaril BJP matrum nidhish kumaarukku edhiraaga raanuva veerargal poraattathil kudhithaargal endru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Indhiya raanuvam Indhiya arasukku edhiraaga poraattam nadathiyirundhaal adhu migapperiya seythiyaagi irukkum. Aanaal, raanuva udaiyil silar poraattam nadathugindranar. Nidhish kumaar arasukku edhiraaga pesugindranar. Enave, ivargal munnaal raanuva veerargalaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu peegaar thalainagar paatnaavil munnaal raanuva veerargal matrum peegaaril seyalbadum “tayal 112 avasara kaala sevai” vaagana ottunargal poraattam nadathinar endru sila padhivugal namakkuk kidaithana.
Indha thagaval adippadaiyil koogulil thediya podhu, indha poraattam thodarbaana seythigal namakku kidaithana. Tamil Naattil 108 sevai iruppadhu pondru peegaaril 112 endra aambulans sevai ulladhu. Idhil munnaal raanuva veerargal palarum ottunargalaaga paniyaatri varugindranar. Moondru aandugalukku munbu indha sevai aarambitha podhu maadham roo.25 aayiram sambalam vazhangappattadhu. Adhan piragu periya alavil oodhiya uyarvu illai. Moondru aandugalil 750 roobai mattume uyarthappattulladhu. Melum veettukku 10-15 km sutralavil pani niyamanam vazhangappadum, aandukku 20 naal vidumurai, vaara vidumurai vazhangappadum endrellaam arivithuvittu edhaiyum seyyavillai endru koori poraattam nadathiyadhaaga kurippidappattu irundhadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil kooriyadhu pondru ottuth thiruttaik kanditho, Indhiya arasukku edhiraagavo, Indhiya naattukku edhiraagavo Indhiya raanuva veerargal poraattathil eeduvadavillai. Peegaaril seyalbattu varum 112 avasaragaala thodarbu thuraiyil paniyaatri varum munnaal raanuva veerargal nadathiya poraattathin video-vai thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mudhal madikkum aappil aivon arimugam.. Kavarum amsangaludan ’iPhone Duo’.. Sirappugal, vilai enna?
text:
Aappil paark thalaimaiyagathil mudhal madikkum aivon ‘aappil tiyo’ arimugam seyyappattadhu. 5.4-injs avudar, 7.6-injs anbolt tisbile, A20 pro sipset, iOS 27, 2nm puraasas, aappil pensil sapport, tas aidi, 48MP tooyal kemaraa aagiya amsangaludan varum indha maadal, 256GB storej konda adippadai veriyant roo.2,99,900kku akdovar irudhiyil virpanaikku varum ena koorappadugiradhu.
Kalivorniyaavin aappil paark thalaimaiyagathil aappilin mudhal madikkakkoodiya aivon maadalaana aivon tiyo ( iPhone Duo) arimugam seyyappattulladhu. Idhanmoolam madikkum smaartfongalin sandhaiyil aappilum thannudaiya kaaladi thadathai padhithulladhu. Idho ippo vandhudum, adutha apdette aivon Foldable thaan ena haip etriya palveru edhirppaarppugalukku idaiyil, pudhiya siio jaan tarnas thalaimaiyil mudhal madikkum aivonai palveru piyoochargaludan kalamirakkiyulladhu aappil..
Netru iravu nadaivetra aappil niruvanathin "sarprais ant shain" endra piramaanda nigazhvil mudhal madikkum aivonaana aappil tiyo, aivon 18 pro matrum aivon 18 pro meks ullitta mukkiya apdettat smaartbongal arimugam seyyappattullana. Adhuguritha vivarangalaiyum, sirappamsangal kurithum virivaaga paarkkalaam..
Aappil tiyo
podhuvaaga sepdambar maadham aappil thangaludaiya pudhiya maadalgalai arimugam seyvadhu vazhakkam thaan endraalum, indha aandu nadaiverum aappil veliyeettu nigazhvai sbesalaagavum, elloraiyum paarkka thoondum ondraagavum maatriyadharku mukkiya kaaranam ‘madikkakkoodiya aivon’ arimugamaagappogiradhu enbadhu thaan. Adhanbadi anaithu haipgalaiyum poorthi seyyum vagaiyil A20 pro sipset, tainamikli adaapdiv iOS 27 menborul amaippu matrum 2nm puraasas udan ‘aappil tiyo’ veliyaagiyulladhu. Idhan velippura tisbile 5.4-inch aagavum, Unfold seythu neettithaal 7.6-inch tisbile udanum oru puthaga vadiva madippu amaippai kondulladhu.
Outer, Unfold ena ore thoguppil irandu thiraigalaip payanbaduthum vasadhiyai ungalukku vazhangum indha aappil tiyovil, aappil pensil sapport matrum Power Button-l tas aidi vasadhigalum idambetrullana. Kemaraavai poruthavaraiyil aivon tiyovil 48MP pyooshan meyn kemaraavum, 48MP altraa-vait kemaraavum ullana. Staar oyit matrum nait sgai aagiya irandu vannangalil kidaikkum indha madikkum aivonin aaramba vilaiye 256GB storej udan 2,99,900 ena nirnayikkappattulladhu. Idhu akdovar maadha irudhiyil virpanaikku varum ena edhirppaarkkappadugiradhu.
Aappil 18 pro matrum pro meks
idhanudan aappil 18 pro matrum pro meks smaartfongal pudhiya piyoochargaludan irangiyullana. Ivai kadandha aandu veliyaana aivon 17 pro seerisai vida pala vanborul membaadugalaik kondullana. Indha pudhiya pro maadalgal, aappilin naveena A20 pro sipset moolam iyakkappaduvadhudan, pudhiya C2 modathaik kondullana. Aivon 18 pro ore saarjil 24 manineram varai pettari aayulaiyum, aivon 18 pro meks 30 manineram varai needikkum pettariyaiyum vazhangugiradhu. Idhil 48MP fiyoosan meyn kemaraa sirappamsamaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Idhu aivon varisaiyileye mudhanmuraiyaaga, physical variable aperture amsathai arimugappaduthugiradhu. Idhu aazhamaana pugaippadangalaiyum, kuraindha oliyil kiliyaraana padangalaiyum pidikka udhavugindrana. Aappil pro 6.3 injs tisbile matrum aappil pro 6.9 injs tisbile udan kidaikkindrana.
India-vil, aivon 18 provin vilai roo. 1,64,900-lirundhum, aivon 18 pro meksin vilai roo. 1,79,900-lirundhum thodangugiradhu. Indha irandu maadalgalum 256jivi, 512jivi, 1tivi matrum 2tivi storej viruppangalil vazhangappadugindrana. Ivai karuppu, velli, kilesiyar matrum pudhiya pargandi mudhaliya vannangalil kidaikkindrana. Indha aivongal sepdambar 12 mudhal munbadhivu seyya anumadhikkappattu, sepdambar 18 andru virpanai thodangavirukkindrana.

headline: Hotspot share panreengalaa? Kavanam!! Neengal emaatrappadalaam!!
text:
Inaiya vazhik kollaigalaiyum kutrangalaiyum kattuppadutha arasu iyandhiramum, vallunargalum paladharappatta muyatsigalai merkondu varugindranar. Aanaal, saivar kutravaaligal pudhuppudhu uthigalaal podhumakkalin thookkathaik keduthu varugindranar.
Online mosadi, thanimanidha tharavugalai thiruduvadhu, inaiya thalangalaiyum, samooga oodaga kanakkugalaiyum hek seyvadhu, arasidam irundhu kurunjjeythiyo alladhu minnanjjalo varuvadhu pola erpaadu seythu adhanmoolam panam parippadhu, saivar mirattalgal matrum avadhoorugalin vazhiye panam kettu mirattuvadhu, kaninigalil irukkum tharavugalai laak seythugondu panam koduthaaldhaan adhai meendum oppadaippom enbadhuvondra Ransomware thaakkudhalgal, kuzhandhaigal thodarbaana saivar kutrangal ena saivar kutrangalai adikkikkonde sellalaam.
Kaavaldhuraiyinarum, vallunargalum ivatraith thadukka palveru muyatsigalai merkondaalum, thinamum pudhuppudhu vazhigalil ithagaiya kutrangal nadandhavannamdhaan irukkindrana. Lingkkalai klik seyvadhan vazhiye aarambitha idhu, poliyaana aapgalai instaal seyya vaithadhan vazhi thodarndhadhu. Idhan aduthagattamaaga Wi-Fi hekking ellaam nadandhana. Tharpodhu indha mosadi haatsbaat sheringil vandhu nirkiradhu.
Aam, edhenum oru kadaiyil naam avasaramaaga porutkalai vaangik kondiruppom. Appodhu, adhe avasarathodu veru navar haatsbaat kettu nirpaar. Naamum panam seluthuvadharkuthaane ena koduthuviduvom. Ingu aarambikkiradhu sikkal.
Sameevathil, idhevondru oru pen thaan sandhitha soozhalai video-vaaga veliyittirukkiraar. Idhai the free press journal seythiyaaga veliyittirukkiradhu. Adhil, mumbai metro rail nilaiyathil 50 vayadhu pen oruvar metro tikkettai edukka netvork sariyaagak kidaikkaadha nilaiyil ippennidam haatsbaat kettu nindrirukkiraar. Ivarum movail haatsbaattai share seyya ticket edukkappattadhu. Pin iruvarum thanithaniyaaga pirindhuvittanar.
Siridhu nerathil haatsbaat koduthu udhavi seytha pennukku Aadhaar authentication muyatsigal tholviyadaindhadhaaga kurunjjeythigal vandhirukkiradhu. Pin haatsbaattai aap seythuvittu, sambandhappatta adhigaarigalukku thagaval koduthuvittu, aadhaar inaiyathil tharavugalai sarivaarthullaar. Pin thanadhu selbesiyil irukkum vangi kanakku paasverdugalaiyum maatriyullaar. Idhai andha video-vil padhivu seythirukkiraar.
Nam kan mun oruvar nammidam udhavi kettu, naam seyyum udhaviyin vazhiye namakku aappadikkum nigazhvugal sameeva kaalangalil adhigarithu varuvadhaaga vallunargal echarikkindranar.
Naam haatsbaat koduppadhan moolamaaga, veru oru saadhanathin moolam naam namadhu netvorkkaiyum aivi mugavariyaiyum thirudargal anuga vazhivagukkirom. Kurippaaga netvorkkai kodukkumbatchathil, haatsbaat vaangiyavargal edhenum sattavirodha seyalbaadugalil eeduvattaalum, ungal peyarileye adhu kanakku vaikkappadum ena vallunargal echarikkindranar. Adhaavadhu, ungal IP address moolam nadakkum ellaa inaiya seyalbaadugalum padhivu seyyappadum. Edhenum sandhegathirkidamaana seyalbaadu nadandhaal, mudhalil visaaranaikku utbaduthappaduvadhu IP addressn urimaiyaalaraana ungalaithaan.
Idharku, udhaaranangalum irukkindrana. 2019 aam aandu mumbaiyil, oru online mosadi sambavam nadandhirukkiradhu. Andha IP address kanduvidikkappattu avaridam visaaranai nadathappattirukkiradhu. Aanaal, kutrathirkum avarukkum sambandham illai. Avaradhu haatsbaattai veroru navar uvayogithavodhu satta virodha seyalgalil eeduvattadhu kaavaldhuraiyinarin visaaranaiyil theriyavandhirukkiradhu.
Haatsbaat vazhiyaaga namadhu inaiya seyalbaadugalai veroruvar kangaanikka mudiyum. Ungal anumadhi illaamaleye ungal kanakkugalil ulnuzhaiya muyatsi seyya mudiyum ena echarikkindranar vallunargal.
Haatsbaat vazhiye hekking nadappadhu aridhu ena sila vallunargal therivikkindranar. Indha hekking elidhalla endrum, sila aayiram matrum sila latcham thogaigalukkaaga indha hekking nadakkaadhu endrum therivikkindranar. Irundhaalum naam paadhugaappaaga iruppadhu avasiyam.

headline: Ai.naa., podhu savaiyai vazhi nadathugiraar vangadhesa amaichar
text:
Niyooyaark: ai.naa., podhu savai thalaivaraaga, vangadhesathin veliyuravu amaichar kaleelur rahmaan, 72, therndhedukkappattullaar.
Ai.naa.,vin 81vadhu podhu savaiyin koottath thodar kadandha, 8m thedhi thodangi nadandhu varugiradhu. Uyarmatta podhu vivaadham varum, 22 mudhal 28m thedhi varai nadaivera ulladhu.
Indha aandukkaana ai.naa., podhu savai thalaivaraaga, nam andai naadaana vangadhesathin veliyuravu amaichar kaleelur rahmaan therndhedukkappattullaar.
Podhu savai thalaivarukkaana therdhal kadandha joon 2m thedhi nadandhadhu. Idhil thannai edhirthu pottiyitta saipras naattai serndha aantriyaas kaagoorisai thorkadithu, vetri petraar. Motham padhivaana 190 ottugalil 99 ottugalai petraar.
Ai.naa., udanaana ivaradhu uravu, kadandha muppadhu aandugalukku melaaga thodarndhu varugiradhu. Kadandha, 1991 jeneevaavil ulla varthagam matrum membaattirkaana ai.naa., maanaattin sirappu aalosagaraaga rahmaan than payanathai thodanginaar. Adutha 25 aandugalil ai.naa.,vin palveru uyar padhavigalai vagithullaar.
Kadandha pipravari maadham vangadhesathin veliyuravu amaicharaaga poruppetruk konda rahmaan, idharku mun, vangadhesa idaikkaala arasin thesiya paadhugaappu aalosagaraaga paniyaatriyullaar.

headline: Passive smoking - aal adhigarikkum maranangal.. Veliyaana adhirchith thagaval!!
text:
Pugaippidippavargalaivida avargal arugil irupporukkuthaan paadhippu adhigam. India-vil ithagaiya pesiv smokking kaaranamaaga uyirizhappavargalin ennikkai kadandha 30 aandugalil sumaar 50 vizhukkaadu adhigarithulladhaaga thi laanset katturai koorugiradhu. Adhaavadhu, 1990il pesiv smokking kaaranamaaga India-vil 2,17,700 per uyirizhandha nilaiyil, 2023il indha ennikkai 3,25,600aaga adhigarithulladhu.
Adhenerathil, oru latcham perukkaana marana vigidham 46.1 irundhu 30aaga kuraindhulladhu. 2023il India-vil sumaar 44 kodiye 40 latcham per pesiv smokkingaal paadhikkappattullanar. Ulagalavil 271 kodi per pesiv smokkingaal paadhikkappatta nilaiyil, avargalil 76 kodikkum adhigamaanavargal kuzhandhaigal ena andha aayvuk katturaiyil kurippidappattulladhu.
Kuzhandhaigalin nuraiyeeral valarchiyai paadhikkum pesiv smokkingai thadukka, veettilum podhu idangalilum pugaippidippadhai thavirkka vendum ena maruthuvargal arivuruthiyullanar.

headline: Manippoor masoodhiyil sikkiya aayudhangal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Manippooril ulla oru masoodhiyil sikkiya aayudhangal matrum rokkam endru oru video

eraalamaana aayudhangal matrum kattukkattaaga panathaik kaippatri kaatchippaduthiya video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “manippoor masoodhiyil kandedukkappatta aayudhangal roobai kuviyalgal.! Puriyavillaiye! Allaa maalik! Inshaa allaa!!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Manippooril oru masoodhiyilirundhu eraalamaana payangara aayudhangal matrum kattuk kattaaga roobai nottukkal parimudhal seyyappattadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Kattukkattaaga ulla panam paarkkum podhu, avai Indhiya roobai nottukkal pola illai. Melum manippoor masoodhiyilirundhu aayudhangal matrum pala kodi roobai nottukkal parimudhal seyyappattadhaaga sameevathil endha seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu kadandha epralilirundhu palarum indha video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Avatrukku idaiye miyaanmar (parmis) mozhiyil oru padhivu namakkuk kidaithadhu.
Adhai mozhimaatram seythu paartha podhu “faalam (Falam) nagarai meetka nadandha poril kaippatrappatta vedi porutkal matrum panam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Faalam nagar engulladhu endru thedip paartha podhu adhu miyaanmar naattil iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thediya podhu parmaa neshanal revalyooshanari aarmiyin adhigaarappoorva Facebook pakkathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra kaatchigaludan kooda padhivu veliyaagi irundhadhu. Parmaa neshanal revalyooshanari aarmi enbadhu andha naattil seyalbadum poraalik kuzhu endru seythigal therivithana.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil ulla raanuva veerar oruvarin sattaiyil BNRA endru irundhadhu. Adhu enna endru thedip paartha podhu, Burma National Revolutionary Army – BNRA endru seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Avaradhu sattaiyil irundha logovum pienaare logovum ondraaga irundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video manippoorais saarndhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Paar kavunsil therdhalgalil oozhal; High Court needhivadhi aananth vengadesh kaattam
text:
Kovai: ''therdhal endraal oozhal, oozhal endraal therdhal ena Indhiya paar kavunsil, Thamizhaga paar kavunsil therdhalgal aagi vittadhu. Thalaivargal arasiyal katchiyil irundhaal, eppadi ozhungu nadavadikkai edukka mudiyum. Vakkeelgalai thervu seyyum thozhitsaalaiyaaga paar kavunsil maarivittadhu,'' endru, High Court needhivadhi aananth vengadesh pesinaar.
Indhiya vazhakkarinjargal sangathin, 9vadhu maanila maanaadu, kovaiyil nadandhadhu. Maanaattil, Chennai High Court needhivadhi aananth vengadesh sirappu virundhinaraaga pangetru pesiyadhaavadhu:
nam naattil needhithurai, vazhakkarinjar sangangal sandhithu varum kattamaippu sikkal kurithu pesuvadhai kadamaiyaaga karudhugiren. Naam suya parisodhanai seyyum kattaayathil ullom. Enadhu kelvigal palarai neliya vaikkum. Indhiya sattathurai varalaatru reedhiyaaga magathaana thurai. Aanaal ippodhaiya kaala kattathil, varalaatril nerukkadiyaana kattamaippu sikkalil needhithurai sikki thavikkiradhu.
Vakkeel pani enbadhu unnadha adaiyaalam kondavai. Indha thozhil viyaavaara nokkam konda sandhai alla. Needhithurai sudhandhirathai paadhugaakka anjjaa nenjjathudan seyalbada vendum. Vazhakkarinjar pani enbadhu, uyar samooga makkalidaiye arinjargalaagavum, paamara makkalidathil puratchi poraaliyaagavum paarkkappadugiradhu.
Maanilam muzhuvadhum satta kalloorigal kaalaangal pola mulaithu varugiradhu. Sattak kalloorigalin perukkathaal, satta kalviyin tharam paadhaalathirku sendru vittadhu. Idhai unarndhu, 2015l pudhiya sattakkalloorigalukku thadaiyinmai saandru kodukka vendaam endru paar kavunsil korikkai vaithadhu. Aanaal adhaiyum meeri, 300 kalloorigalukku anumadhi vazhangappattadhu.
Naadu muzhuvadhum 1,500kkum merpatta satta kalloorigal uruvaagi vittana. Idhil, 27 thesiya satta palgalaikkazhagangal ullana. Ivai verum 5 sadhaveedham vakkeelgalai mattume uruvaakkugiradhu. Meedhi 95 sadhaveedham vakkeelgal irandaam katta satta kalloorigalil irundhu uruvaagindranar. Ivargal adippadai satta payitsi indri thindaadugindranar.
Naadu muzhuvadhum ulla satta kalloorigalil, 30 mudhal 50 sadhaveedham peraasiriyar paniyidangal kaaliyaaga ullana. Tharkaaliga peraasiriyargalai vaithu paadam nadathappadugiradhu. Thesiya, maanila satta kalloorigalil padikkum maanavargalukku paadathittathil paaguvaadu ulladhu. Maanavargalin nalanukkaaga satta kalloori nadathappadugiradhaa enbadhu migapperiya kelvi.
Indhiya paar kavunsilil thalaivar matrum sattathil illaadha inai thalaivar ena poli padhavigal uruvaakkappattullana. Oru arasiyal katchi saarndhavar Indhiya paar kavunsil thalaivaraaga irukkiraar. Avar em.pi., aagavum irukkiraar. Maanila paar kavunsil, agila Indhiya paar kavunsil therdhalgalil, pala kodi roobai selavazhikkappaduvadhai kan koodaaga paarkka mudivadhaaga therdhal adhigaariyaaga paniyaatriya needhivadhi oruvar katturaiyaaga ezhudhiyirukkiraar.
Therdhal endraal oozhal, oozhal endraal therdhal ena Indhiya paar kavunsil, Thamizhaga paar kavunsil therdhalgal aagivittadhu. Thalaivargal arasiyal katchiyil irundhaal, eppadi ozhungu nadavadikkai edukka mudiyum. Vakkeelgalai thervu seyyum thozhitsaalaiyaaga paar kavunsil maarivittadhu.
Jooniyar vakkeelgalukku, satta nunukkam solli kodukka, seeniyargalukku neramum illai; viruppamum illai. Munbu irundha vakkeelgal, arasiyal iyakkangalil irundhaalum, veru idangalil arasiyalai kalakkavillai. Aanaal ippodhu, arasiyalil nuzhaiya thudikkum navargal, vakkeel thozhil paadhugaappu kavasam ena ninaithu ulle nuzhaigindranar. Sattathuraiyil, arasiyal nanjjaaga padhindhu vittadhu.
Vazhakkarinjargal, thangalai idadhusaari endro, valadhusaari endro adaiyaalam kaatti kolvadhu sariyaanadhu alla. Avargal needhithurai pakkamdhaan irukka vendum. Uyar needhimandra, ucha needhimandra needhivadhigalai niyamikkum kolijiyam murai, needhithurai sudhandhirathirku endru sonnaalum, adhil velippadai thanmai illai endru vimarsanam vaikkappadugiradhu.
Kolijiyathil nergaanal, madhippen illaamal needhivadhigal thervu seyyappadugindranar. Maavatta needhivadhi thervukku oru murai irukkiradhu. Aanaal uyar needhimandra needhivadhigal thervirku endha nadaimuraiyum illai. Samooga valai thalangalil, ondrume theriyaamal needhithurai patri edhaavadhu karuthu padhividugindranar. Adhai irandu latcham per paarkkindranar. Idhu migapperiya aavathu. Nija ulagai nambuvadhai vida, sgireen ulagathai namba aarambithu vittaargal.
Nerukkadiyilirundhu sattath thuraiyai meetka, naam udanadiyaaga sila kadumaiyaana seerdhiruthangalai merkolla vendum. Sattakkalloorigalukku, paar kavunsil angeegaaram vazhanguvadhai niruthivittu, thesiya arivusaar aanaiyam parindhuraitha padi, oru suyechaiyaana sattakkalvi aanaiyathidam, andha poruppai oppadaikka vendum.
Agila Indhiya paar thervai sarvadhesa tharathilaana kadumaiyaana paguppaayvu matrum nadaimurai arivu saarndha thervaaga maatra vendum. Vazhakkarinjargal sattathil thirutham seythu, ozhungu nadavadikkai kuzhukkalil oyvuvetra needhivadhigal, samoogaviyalaalargal matrum podhumakkalin piradhinidhigalai serkka vendum.
Koleejiyam amaippil needhivadhigal thervukku thelivaana thagudhi pulligal matrum velippadaiyaana alavugolgal vagukkappada vendum. Vazhakkarinjargal thangalin arasiyal adaiyaalangalai needhimandra araigalukku veliye nirutha vendum. Arasiyalamaippukkum, needhithuraikkum mattume visuvaasamaaga irukkum araneriyai meendum meettedukka vendum. Athudan, sutruchoozhal matrum manidha urimaigalukkaaga vaadhidum, ilam podhunala vazhakkarinjargalukku, arasu matrum amaippu reedhiyaana nidhiyudhavi vazhangappada vendum.
Sattathurai enbadhu verum oru thozhilo alladhu varumaanathirkaana vazhiyo alla; adhu indha naattin arasiyalamaippu madhippai kaakkum aran. Andha aranil arasiyal nanjju ooduruvadhaiyo, adhan thoongal sarivadhaiyo naam vedikkai paarkka mudiyaadhu.
Vazhakkarinjargalum, needhivadhigalum inaindhu seyalbattaal mattume izhandha kanniyathaiyum, podhumakkalin nambikkaiyaiyum meetka mudiyum.
Ivvaaru needhivadhi aananth vengadesh pesinaar.

headline: India-vin ravel vimaanam Pakistan sendru theeviravaadhigalin mugaamil kundu podum kaatchi idhuvaa?
text:
‘’India-vin ravel vimaanam Pakistan sendru theeviravaadhigalin mugaamil kundu podum kaatchi,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’India-vin vimaanam ravel Pakistan naattukkul theeviravaadhigalin mugaamil kundu podumbodhu paagisdhaanin evuganai thaakkudhalum nadaiverugiradhu adhilirundhu Indhiya vimaanappadai thappippadhai miga thulliyamaaga kaana mudigiradhu.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan jet vimaanam ondru, parandhu sendru kundu poduvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda oru veediyovum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha veediyovukkum, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, idhu oru video kem kaatchi; unmai kidaiyaadhu.
BattleDragons endra yoodiyup pakkathil Russian 5th Generation Fighter Su-57- Military Simulation ArmA 3 enum thalaippil indha video kadandha 2024m aandu tisambar maadham veliyidappattulladhu.
Aanaal, India – Pakistan porppadhatram 2025, epral, me maadhangalil erpatta ondraagum. Idharkum, merkanda veediyovukkum endha thodarbum illai endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, 2024m aandu samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappatta video kem ondrin karpanaiyaana porkkaatchiyai eduthu, unmai pondru kurippittu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Neerizhivu noyaaligalukku pugaippazhakkam peraavathu!
text:
Neerizhivu noyaaligalukku pugaippazhakkam peraavathu!
Neerizhivu noyaaligal, kurippaaga taip 2 noyaaligal, pugaippidithaal uyirizhappu avaayam kanisamaaga uyarum ena pudhiya aayvu echarikkiradhu. 11.3 latcham perin tharavugalai aayvu seythadhil, pugaippazhakkam ullavargalukku 55% adhiga marana avaayam, idhaya noyudan serum podhu 36% koodudhal avaayam iruppadhu kandariyappattadhu. Pugaichal siruneeraga paadhippu, insulin edhirppu aagiyavatraiyum mosamaakkugiradhu.
Neerizhivu noyullavargalukku pugaippidikkum pazhakkamum irundhaal uyirizhappu avaayam adhigarippadhaaga aayvil theriyavandhulladhu.
11.3 latcham noyaaligalidam nadandhiya aayvugalai paguppaayvu seythadhil taip 2 neerizhivu noyulla pugaippidikkum pazhakkam ullavargalukku uyirizhappu avaayam 55 sadhaveedham adhigam endru theriyavandhulladhu.
Idhaya noyudan pugaippidikkum pazhakkam ullavargalukku uyirizhappu avaayam 36 sadhaveedham adhigam endrum theriyavandhulladhu. Pugaippidithal siruneeragap paadhippu matrum insulin edhirppai adhigarikkum avaayathaiyum theevirappaduthuvadhaaga vallunargal koorugindranar.

headline: Nellai: azhagiyagoothar suvaami thirukkoyil kumbaavishegam; aayirakkanakkaanor suvaami tharisanam | Photos
text: Tirunelveli maavattam iraajavallivuram sepparai sree azhagiya koothar suvaami thirukkoyil magaa kumbaavishegam vizhaa veguvimarisaiyaaga nadaivetradhu. Idhil aayirakkanakkaana makkal kalandhu kondu suvaami tharisanam seythanar. Ithirukkoyil panjja savaigalil sirappu vaayndha 'thaamirasavai' amaindhulla thalamaagum.

headline: Sangaraachaariyaarai kaavaldhuraiyinar thaakkiya kaanoli kumbamelaavil edukkappattadhu alla! | 2015 Video of Lathi Charge against Saints shared as Maha Kumbh
text:
Sangaraachaariyaarai kaavaldhuraiyinar thaakkiya kaanoli kumbamelaavil edukkappattadhu alla!
Magaa kumbamelaavil kaavaldhuraiyinar sangaraachaariyaar avimukdhesvaraanandhai thaakkiyadhaaga pagirappadum kaanoli 2015aam aandu edukkappattadhu endru poom kandarindhulladhu.

headline: Vandhe paarath rayilil raamar padam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Vandhe paarath rayilil raamar padam stikkar ottappattulladhu endru oru pugaippadam

rail injinil raamar padam matrum sreeraam endru ezhudhappattiruppadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Indhiyil vandhe paarath endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “”komaali koottathin paithiyakkaara arasiyal…,
ivanungala viratti adithe aaganum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vandhe paarath rayilil raamar padam matrum sreeraam endru ezhudhappattulladhu endru pugaippadathai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Vandhe paarath endru indhiyil ezhudhappattulladhu. Aanaal, indha rayilaip paarkka vandhe paarath rail pola illai. Adhan injin muzhukka vazhakkamaana rail injin pola ulladhu. Adhe pol niramum vandhe paarath rayilil ulladhu pola illai. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha pugaippadathai aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu, samooga oodagangalil palarum indha pugaippadathai padhivittu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. The_rail_pilot_ endra instaagiraam pakkathil idhe pondru sivaverumaan, apdhul kalaam, viraat koli, thoni ullitta palarin pugaippadangaludan rail injin iruppadhu pondru pugaippadam padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathai mattum paarthom. Adhil, eai (seyarkai nunnarivu) moolam uruvaakkappatta pugaippadam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhu seyarkai nunnarivu payanbaduthithaan uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhiseythugolla idharkaaga ulla inaiyadhalangalil indha pugaippadathai padhivetram seythu paarthom. Avatrilum idhu muzhukka eai moolam uruvaakkappatta pugaippadam endra mudivu namakku kidaithadhu. Ivai ellaam vandhe paarath rayilil raamar pugaippadam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyillai enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Makkalukku neradiyaagap panam kodukkum thittangalai thadai seyyumbadi si.vi.sanmugam koorinaaraa?
text:
‘’makkalukku neradiyaagap panam kodukkum thittangalukku sattamandrath therdhal mudiyum varai thadai vidhikka vendum,’’ endru si.vi.sanmugam kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’panam kodukkath thadaigori manu. Magalir urimaith thogai, pudhumaip pen, thamizhp pudhalvan pondra makkalukku neradiyaaga panam kodukkum thittangalukku sattamandra therdhal mudiyumvarai thadaividhikka ADMK munnaal amaichar si.vi.sanmugam uyarneedhimandrathil manu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
NewsJ TV logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil, naam idhuvatri NewsJ aasiriyar kuzhu tharappil vilakkam kettom. Idhu engaladhu peyaril pagirappadum poliyaana news card idhudhodarbaaga, erkanave naangal samooga valaidhalam vaayilaaga maruppu therivithullom, endru therivithanar.
Idhanbadi, Tamil Nadu arasin thittangalukku M.K. Stalin peyarai vaippadharku edhirppu therivithu, si.vi.sanmugam vazhakku ondrai thodarndhaar. Idhanberil, Chennai uyar Needhimandram Tamil Nadu arasukku idaikkaala thadai vidhithirundhadhu. Idhudhodarbaaga, NewsJ oodagam kadandha aagast 1, 2025 andru veliyitta niyoosgaardai edit seythu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
NewsJ tharappil samooga valaidhalam vaayilaaga veliyidappatta maruppu seythiyaiyum keezhe inaithullom.
Adhesamayam, si.vi.sanmugam thodarndha vazhakkil vidhikkappatta thadaiyai edhirthu, DMK saarbil ucha needhimandrathil melmuraiyeedu seyyappattadhu. Indha visaaranaiyil idaikkaala thadai agatrappattadhodu, si.vi.sanmugathirku avaraadham vidhithu, Uchaneedhimandram utharavittulladhaiyum, inge suttikkaatta virumbugirom.

headline: Iru thogudhikkaana idaitherdhal; irudhi vetbaalar pattiyal veliyeedu
text:
Chennai: madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram idaitherdhalukkaana irudhi vetbaalar pattiyal veliyaagiyulladhu.
Varum akdovar 6l, madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram thogudhigalil idaitherdhal nadakkiradhu. Idharkaana vetbumanu thaakkal kadandha 9m thedhi thodangiyadhu. Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil pottiyida 40 perum, thaaraavuram thogudhiyil pottiyida, 39 perum vetbumanu thaakkal seythullanar. Iru thogudhi kalilum TVK, DMK, ADMK, NTK, kamyoonist katchigal ena, aindhu munai potti erpattulladhu.
Indha nilaiyil, idaitherdhalukkaana irudhi vetbaalar pattiyalai therdhal aanaiyam indru veliyittulladhu. Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil 27 vetbaalargal kalathil ullanar. Arasiyal katchiyais serndha 10 per, suyetchai vetbaalargal 17 per ena 27 per pottiyil ullanar. TVK saarbil maragadham kumaravel, DMK vetbaalar parandhaaman, ADMK vetbaalar kanidhaa sambath, maarksist vetbaalar sugandhi, naam thamizhar vetbaalar aagiyor kalathil ullanar. 28 perin vetbumanukkal etruk kollappatta nilaiyil, adhil, oru suyetchai vetbaalar thanadhu vetbumanuvai vaavas petrullaar.
Adhevola, idaitherdhal nadakkum matroru thogudhiyaana thaaraavurathil 22 per pottiyil ullanar. TVK vetbaalar sathiyavaamaa, DMK vetbaalar suganyaa, ADMK vetbaalar paanumadhi, Indhiya kamyoonist vetbaalar latchumanan aagiyor mukkiya vetbaalargalaaga ullanar.
Pudhucheri thattaanjjaavadi thogudhiyil 11 per idaiye potti nilavugiradhu.

text:

headline: China adhivarai pugazhndha elaan mask.. Enna kaaranam?
text:
China adhivar XI jinbing thalaimaiyil China-vin adhivega valarchi, pudhiya kattadangal, ulgattamaippu munnetram, makkalin vaazhkkaith thara uyarvu aagiyavatrai eduthukkaatti elaan mask pugazhndhu pesiyullaar. Shaangaay teslaa thozhitsaalai ulagin migapperiya urpathi, etrumadhi maiyamaaga iruppadhaiyum, angulla oozhiyargal thiramaiyaanavargal, kadina uzhaippaalargal enavum paaraattiyullaar.
Seythiyaalar - M.meeraa
China adhivar XI jinbingai, teslaa niruvanathin thalaimais seyal adhigaari elaan mask, ’sirandha thalaivar’ enap paaraattiyullaar. China arasu tholaikkaatchiyaana CCTV-kku alitha pettiyil mask indha karuthaith therivithullaar.
Xi jinbingin thalaimaiyin keezh China migapperiya alavil valarchi adaindhulladhaaga mask koorinaar. Seenaavil uruvaakkappattulla pudhiya kattadangal, ulgattamaippu vasadhigal ullittavatrais suttikkaattiya avar, annaattu makkalin saraasari vaazhkkaiyil tharamum sezhippum adhigarithiruppadhu therigiradhu enath therivithaar.
Melum, China-vin shaangaay nagaril amaindhulla teslaa thozhitsaalai kurithum mask paaraattip pesinaar. Angu paniyaatrum oozhiyargal migavum thiramaiyaanavargal, kadinamaaga uzhaippavargal matrum nambagamaanavargal ena avar kurippittaar.
Teslaavin shaangaay thozhitsaalai oru rathinam pondradhu endrum mask therivithullaar. Teslaavin migapperiya urpathi maiyamaagavum, ulagin migapperiya etrumadhi maiyamaagavum shaangaay thozhitsaalai seyalbattu varugiradhu.
Idhanidaiye, America adhivar tonaalt Trump matrum XI jinbing sandhikka ullanar. Indha aandil iru thalaivargalum sandhikkum irandaavadhu uchi maanaadu idhuvaagum. Varthagam, thozhilnutbam ullitta palveru vivagaarangal indha sandhippil idambera ullana.
Innilaiyil, Trump vazhangum arasu virundhil America-vin munnani thozhiladhivargaludan masgum kalandhugolvaar ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Melum, aagast maadhathil shaangaay aalaiyil thayaarikkappatta Model 3 matrum Model Y kaargalin virpanai mundhaiya aandaivida 3.6% adhigarithirundhaalum, mundhaiya maadhathudan oppidumbodhu valarchi vegam kuraindhadhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana.

headline: Thavaraana kootrudan viral-aagum piradhamarukkaaga paadhiriyaar piraarthanai seyyum kaanoli | Video Of Pastor Praying for PM Modi Viral with False Claim
text:
Thavaraana kootrudan viral-aagum piradhamarukkaaga paadhiriyaar piraarthanai seyyum kaanoli
thamizhil paadhiriyaar arasiyal thalaivargalukku aaseervaadham ketkiraar endru poom kandarindhadhu. ’kollungappaa’ matrum ‘thodungappaa’ endra iru vaarthaigalum olippu reedhiyaaga othavai.
Piradhamar narendhira Modi, utharaviradhesa mudhalvar yogi aadhithyanaath matrum mathiya amaichargal amith shaa matrum nirmalaa seedhaaraaman aagiyorai aaseervadhikkumaaru thamizhil oru paadhiriyaar ketkum pazhaiya kaanoli, avargalin maranathirkaaga avar piraarthanai seythadhaagak koori thavaraaga viral-aagi varugiradhu.
"India-vin piradhamar aluvalagathirku edhiraaga uyirukku aavathaana muzhakkathil eeduvattulla indha thevaalayathilirundhu anaivaraiyum kaidhu seyyungal - iyesu, thayavuseythu narendhira Modi, amith shaa, nirmalaa sithaaraman, matrum yogi aadhithyanaath aagiyavatraik kollungal. Iyesuve, ayothi raam aalayathai azhithu oru thevaalayathai kattuvadharkaana palathai thaarungal,’ endra kootrudan indha kaanoli vairalaanadhu.
Indha kaanoliyai sarivaarkka kori, engalin udhavi ennukku (7700906588) anuppivaikkappattadhu.
Idhu arasiyal thalaivargal uyirukkum, thesiya paadhugaappukkum neradi achuruthalaiyai erpaduthum endru kori, utharappiradhesa kaavaldhuraiyinar matrum NIA nadavadikkai edukkavendum endrum indha kootril kurippidappattulladhu.

headline: ‘thalavadhi M.K. Stalin-in pazhamozhigal’ endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’thalavadhi M.K. Stalin-in pazhamozhigal’’ endra thalaippil pudhiya puthagam veliyidappattulladhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ edhe Stalin pazhamozhigalaa???
Sangili paruppu thaali aruppu , poonaimel madhilmel, kolmudhalnel nelmudhalgol
pondra pazhamozhigal adangiya thoguppu pola
sari,
2500 + 1500 = 5000
86 + 9 = 97 pondra kanakku paada puthagam eppa rilees pannuveenga???? ” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan puthagam ondrin pugaippadam inaikkappattulladhu. Adhan attaip padathil, ‘ thalavadhi M.K. Stalin-in pazhamozhigal. Thoguppu: neelagiri maa. Paalamurugan. Udhavi. Iraa. Anvar kaan‘ endrum ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadathil ulladhu pondru edhenum puthagam sameevathil veliyaagiyulladhaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, thalavadhi M.K. Stalin-in ezhuchimigu uraigal, endra thalaippil erkanave veliyaana puthagam ondrin pugaippadathai eduthu, ivvaaru vendumendre edit seythu vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Idhudhodarbaaga, naam DMK ai.ti. Pirivu tharappil pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, unmaiyaana pugaippadathaiyum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadathaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kurukku vazhiyil muyatsikkaamal nermaiyaana muraiyil therdhalai sandhiyungal; amaichar arunraaj aavesam
text:
Chennai: 'kurukku vazhiyil vetri pera muyatsithaal thirumbath thirumba tholviyai sandhithu kondu thaan iruppeergal; nermaiyaana muraiyil therdhalai sandhiyungal' ena amaichar arunraaj therivithullaar.
Thaaraavurathil niruvargalidam amaichar arunraaj kooriyadhaavadhu: ADMK veezhchiyin varalaarai ezhudhiya iviesyai unmaiyaana ADMK thondargal evarum etruk kolla maattaargal. Avar seytha thurogathin kaaranamaaga unmaiyaana ADMK thondargalaaga irundhavargal thamizhagathirku unmaiyaana nermaiyaana aatchiyai yaaraal kodukka mudiyum ena paarthu Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathil inaindhu irukkiraargal. Avargal enna DMK katchiyilaa inaindhu irukkiraargal. Thooymaiyaana arasiyalai munnedukkum katchiyil thaane inaindhirukkiraargal. Idhu eppadi thavaraaga irukka mudiyum. Naangal ottukku kaasu kodukkaamal vetri petrom.
Nermaiyaana nirvaagathai koduthu kondu irukkirom. Idhuvaraikkum yaarume oozhal kalaasaarathai ozhikka mudiyum endru nambavillai. Namba mudiyaadha kaariyathai Thamizhaga vetrikkazhagathin thalaivar Vijay seythu kondu irukkiraar. Makkalai kuraithu madhippidaadheergal. Kurukku vazhiyil vetri pera muyatsithaal thirumbath thirumba tholviyai sandhithu kondu thaan iruppeergal. Poy pirasasaaram seyvadhu, emelekkal vandhaal thaduthu niruthuvadhu, edhukku indha kurukku vazhi. Nermaiyaana muraiyil therdhalai sandhiyungal. Engal aatchiyil kuraigal irundhaal adhai eduthus sollungal.
Edappadi thogudhiyil eppadi kurukku vazhiyil jeyitheergalo, idhu ellaam oru nalla thalaivarukku azhagaa? Nalla thalaimaikku azhagaa? Edappadi thogudhiyil vetri petradharku unmaiyaana ADMK thondargal sandhoshappattu iruppaargalaa? Kurukku vazhiyil jeyitheergal. Naan en thogudhiyil vetri petren. Ovvoru nirvaagi ninaithu perumaiyaaga irukkiradhu.
Naam uzhaithom jeyithom endru perumaiyaaga irukkiradhu. Edappadi thogudhiyil irukkum unmaiyaana ADMK thondargalaal perumaiyaaga solla mudiyumaa? Jeyalalidhaa, emjiaar vazhiyil irukkum unmaiyaana ADMK thondargal Thamizhaga vetrikkazhagathin thalaivarin unmaiyaana aatchi nadaivera vendum endru thaan virumbugiraargal? Indha therdhalil naangal amoga vetri peruvom. Ivvaaru arunraaj koorinaar.

headline: Kendeenil BJP em.pi-kkaludan arattai aditha ovaisi endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Naadaalumandrathil vakp sattathirku edhirppu therivithup pesivittu, naadaalumandra kendeenil BJP em.pi-kkaludan arattai aditha agila Indhiya majlees katchiyin thalaivarum em.pi-yumaana asaadhudheen ovaisi endru oru video

agila Indhiya majlees katchiyin thalaivar asaadhudheen ovaisi naadaalumandra uruppinargaludan amarndhu pesum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “avaiyil azhudhu naditha ovaisi kendinil BJP paaraalumandra uruppinargaludan arattai adikkum kaatchi 😁
thirundhungavaa ovaisi uthaman endru nambum appaavi muslimgale. ..ivargal madhathai vaithu pizhaippu nadathum kavadavedadhaarigal enbadhai ariyungal ..kaavi sangi pachai sangi inaindhu irukkiraargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naadaalumandrathil epral mudhal vaarathil vakp vaariya thiruthas sattam niraivetrappattadhu. Udanadiyaaga epral 6, 2025 andru kudiyarasuth thalaivar andha thiruthas sattathirku oppudhal alithaar. Naadaalumandrathirkul vakp thiruthas sattathaik kondu vandha BJP arasai asaadhudheen ovaisi kadumaiyaaga edhirthadhaagavum, adhan piragu naadaalumandra unavagathil vaithu BJP uruppinargaludan arattai adithaar endrum video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Indha video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video janavari 2025l veliyaagi iruppadhu therindhadhu. Adhaavadhu vakp sattam niraivetrappaduvadharku kittathatta irandu maadhangalukku munbaaga indha video-vai ANI, PTI ullitta seythi niruvanangal thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyittirundhana.
Adhil, “vakp thiruthas sattam 2024 thodarbaaga amaikkappatta naadaalumandra koottuk kuzhu uruppinargal koottuk kuzhuvin thalaivarum BJP em.pi-yumaana jagadhaambigaa paaludan kalandhuraiyaadinar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam naadaalumandrathil vakp sattath thirutha masodhaa niraivetrappatta piragu indha nigazhchi nadandhadhu enbadhu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Vakp sattath thirutha masodhaavai BJP arasu 2024m aandu aagast maadham kondu vandha podhu, naadaalumandra makkalavaiyil kadum edhirppu kilambiyadhu. Idhaith thodarndhu 31 em.pi-kkal konda koottu naadaalumandrak kuzhuvukku anuppappattadhu. Andha kuzhuvil ovaisiyum oru uruppinar. Koottu naadaalumandra kuzhuk koottathil ovaisi pangetradhai naadaalumandra kendeenil BJP em.pi-kkaludan arattai adithaar endru thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhum idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
