headline: Kovaalavurathu koyavals kiraamam endru naaval ezhudhinaaraa ki.raajanaaraayanan?
text:
Piravala ezhuthaalaraana maraindha ki.raajanaaraayanan thannudaiya kovaalavurathu koyavals kiraamam endra naavalil M.K. Stalin matrum josap vijayyai vimarsithirundhu ezhudhiyirundhaar endru oru padhivu

“ki.raajanaaraayanan ezhudhiya kovaala purathu koyavals kiraamam” endra puthagathin mugappu pakkathin pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peydu vivachaara meediyaavaana kovaalavurathu mungalangalin sadhivelaigal, poy pithalaattangalai maiyamaa vachi ki.raa avargal koyavals kiraamamnnu pudhinam ondrai ezhudhiruppaaru..
Adhula ippadi vasanam varum.. “ippo vikku mandaiyan vidiyaa moonjji nee mudhalvaraa irukka.. Thathippayal unnai ulagamagaa vinjnjaani maadhiri pugazhraanga indhap pathirikkai puzhuthinga.. TV thadiyanunga.. Naalai innoru vik mandaiyan varuvaan.. Appo avanaip pugazhndhu unnaith thookkip pottu midhippaanga” adhu unmaiyaagi vittadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum share seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ezhuthaalar ki.raajanaaraayanan 1976m aandu kovalla kiraamam endra naavalai ezhudhiyirundhaar. Adhan thodarchiyaaga ivar ezhudhiya kovallavurathu makkal endra naavalukkaaga 1991m aandil ivarukku saagithiya agaadami virudhu kidaithadhu. Aanaal kovaalavurathu koyals kiraamam endru endha oru puthagathaiyum ezhudhiyadhaaga tharavugal illai. Adhuvum M.K. Stalin 2021m aandu me 7m thedhi mudhalamaicharaagap poruppetraar. Adharku adutha 10vadhu naalil adhaavadhu, me 17, 2021l ki.raajanaaraayanan kaalamaanaar. Appadi irukka M.K. Stalin, josap Vijay patri ellaam puthagathil kurippittirukka vaayppillai.
Indha pugaippadathai appadiye koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. “kovalla kiraamam” endra puthagathin mugappu padathai edit seythiruppadhu therindhadhu. Enave, indha pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu endru thelivaanadhu.
Kovalla kiraamam naavalaip padithadhu illai enbadhaal adhan maiyak karuthu thodarbaaga veliyaana puthaga vimarsanangalaip paarthom. Adhil, “islaamiya aatchiyaalargal kaalathil aangileyar varugai samayathil aandhiraavilirundhu thamizhnaattukku idambeyarthu oru kiraamathaiye uruvaakkiya makkalin vaazhkkaiyai 137 vayadhaana mangathaayaar ammaal kadhai solvadhin vazhiye naaval nagargiradhu” endru thagaval kidaithadhu.
Ilakkiya aarvalargalidam pesiya podhu puthagathil DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin patri indha puthagam pesavillai endranar. Idhan moolam 1970kalil veliyaana naavalin mugappu pakkathai edit seythu, M.K. Stalin, josap Vijay aatchi seytha – seyyum murai patri ki.raajanaaraayanan theerkkadharisanamaaga ezhudhiyadhu tharpodhu niraiverivittadhu endru vishamathanamaana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nirmalaa seedhaaraamanukku kamalhaasan padhiladi: unmai enna?
text:
Thamizh padithaal yaasagam kooda edukka mudiyaadhu endru kooriya nirmalaa seedhaaraamanukku kamalhaasan padhiladi koduthullaar endru oru padhivu

thamizh oodagam ondru veliyittirundha news card-ai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “nidhiyamaicharukku kamalhaasan padhiladi thamizh yaasagam edukka udhavaadhu, thirudavum udhavaadhu. Thamizhan yaasagam edukka maattaan. Adhuvum ungal yaasagathai erkave maattaan. Thamizh padithaal yaasagam kooda edukka mudiyaadhu ena mathiya nidhiyamaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman pesiyirundha nilaiyil, naadaalumandrathil thanadhu mudhal uraiyileye padhiladi kodutha em.pi. Kamalhaasan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naadaalumandra maanilangalavai uruppinaraaga therndhedukkappatta makkal needhi mayyam thalaivar kamalhaasan naadaalumandrathil pesinaar. Appodhu thamizh yaasagam edukka udhavaadhu endru kooriyirundhaar. Idhai, thamizh padithaal yaasagam kooda edukka mudiyaadhu endru nirmalaa seedhaaraaman kooriyadharkup padhiladi endru oodagangal seythi veliyittullana. Unmaiyil idhai andha oodagamdhaan veliyittulladhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkathai paarthom. Adhil andha news card irundhadhu. Idhan moolam news card unmaiyaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Nirmalaa seedhaaraaman unmaiyil appadi eppodhume kooriyadhu illai. Naan yaaraip patri solgiren enbadhu thamizh oralavu therindhavargalukku kooda theriyum, avarin peyarai kurippida virumbavillai endru Tamil Naattin oru periya thalaivar (thandhai periyaar) kooriyadhaaga vidudhalaiyil veliyaanadhu endru kurippittu naadaalumandrathil nirmalaa seedhaaraaman pesiyadhai nirmalaa seedhaaraamanin sondha karuthu enbadhu pol palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Kadandha aandu idhu thodarbaaga nammudaiya fekt kirasando thamizhil katturai veliyittirundhom.
Tharpodhu meendum andha pirasnai ezhundhulladhu. Nirmalaa seedhaaraaman kooriyadhaaga oodagame seythi veliyittulladhu. Enave, meendum oru murai nirmalaa seedhaaraaman enna pesinaar enbadhai virivaagak katturaiyaaga veliyida mudivu seythom. Nirmalaa seedhaaraaman pesiya pechu Sansad TV YouTube pakkathil 2025 maars 11m thedhi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Video-vin 1 mani 9vadhu nimidathil andha kurippitta pagudhi varugiradhu. Mathiya amaichar tharmendhira piradhaan kooriya oru vaarthaikku avarai andha vaarthaiyai thirumbap pera vaithanar. Aanaal, oru periya thalaivar oruvar thamizh patri pesiya pechaik kelungal. Avaradhu peyarai kurippida virumbavillai. Adhe nerathil kurippitta andha pathiyai padikka virumbugiren. Oralavukku thamizh patri therindhirundhaal kooda yaaraip patri pesugiren enbadhu puriyum.
Indha navar thamizh patri pesum podhu, endha edhirppum varaadhu. Avar engalin thiraavida adaiyaalam endrellaam kooruvaargal. Avar solgiraar… idhu vidudhalai endra idhazhil 27 navambar 1943l veliyaagi ulladhu. Avar solgiraar, “thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu” indha oru variye podhumaanadhu saar. Iruppinum naan thodarndhu padikkiren. “thamizh padithadhu pichai eduppadhai thavira vera uyir vaazha ondrukkum payanbadavillai enbadhodu, idharkaaga selavu seytha kaalathai veru thuraiyil selavittaal, vaazhvil payan erpattirukkum enbadhai nooru aandugalukku munbe thamizh katra oru anuvava pulavar paadiyullaar” endru koorugiraar.
Idhan moolam indha karuthu nirmalaa seedhaaraamanudaiyadhu illai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Tamil Naattin maraindha thalaivar oruvar kooriyadhu endru migath thelivaaga nirmalaa seedhaaraaman kooriyullaar. Andha kurippitta pagudhiyai mattum agatrivittu, thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu endra pagudhiyai mattum vaithu nirmalaa seedhaaraaman thamizhai izhivuvaduthivittaar endru thavaraaga padhivittullanar.
Nirmalaa seedhaaraaman kooriyadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seythullom. Nirmalaa seedhaaraaman appadik kooravillai endra nilaiyil andha karuthukkaaga avarukku padhiladi kodukkappattadhaaga kooruvadhu thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Naadu muzhudhum pesuvorulaana Delhi thaniyaar vidudhi vivathu.. Matra vidudhigalukkum aavathu?
text:
Delhi palgalaikkazhagathil 1 latchathu 32 aayiram maanavargal payindruvarugiraargal. Adhil 44 aayiram maanavargal velimaanilangalais serndhavargal. Aanaal palgalaikkazhaga valaagathil ulla maanavar vidudhiyil, verum 10 aayiram perukku mattumdhaan thangumida vasadhi ulladhu. Idhanaal meedhamulla 34 aayiram maanavargalum valukkattaayamaaga thaniyaar vidudhigalai nokkith thallappadugindranar.
Palgalaikkazhagathukku arugileye thangavendiya kattaayam iruppadhaal maanavargalin thevaiyai payanbaduthi thaniyaar vidudhigal kattanam endra peyaril kallaa kattugindrana. Kollai laavathai mattume nokkamaagak kondu, maadhathukku 20 aayiram roobai varai vaadagai vasoolikkum indha vidudhigalil, adharketra endha adippadai vasadhiyum iruppadhillai. Pazhudhadaindha kattadam, mosamaana unavu pondra pirachinaigal perumbaalaana vidudhigalil iruppadhaaga kutrachaattu ulladhu.
Nadavadikkai edukkavendiya adhigaarigal peyarukku mattum aayvu seythuvittu, paakkettugal nirambiyadhum kandum kaanaamal sendruviduvadhaaga maanavargal kumurugindranar. Naattin edhirgaalamaagath thigazhum maanavargalukku thalainagarileye indhanilai ulladhu enbadhudhaan palaraiyum adhirupdhikku ullaakkiyulladhu.

headline: “5 varushamaa rottaiyum sarivannalai... Passum varalai!’’
text:
Sevimadukkappadaadha sullimettuppadhi makkalin kural
``rodu mosamaa irukkunnu solli enga oorukku vandhuttu irundha passai niruthittaanga. Anjju varushamaachu... Rottaiyum sarivannalai... Passaiyum vidalai. Idhanaala enga pasanga padippu paadhiyila nikkudhu” enbadhu Kovai sullimettuppadhi makkalin thuyarak kuralaaga irukkiradhu.
Kovai maavattam, aanaimalaikku arugeyulla pazhangudiyina kiraamam, sullimettuppadhi. Ingu, `iravaalar’ endra pazhangudi inathais serndha sumaar 110 kudumbangal vasithuvarugindrana. Nagarappagudhiyai ottiye indha kiraamam irundhaalum, perundhu, veedu ullitta podhiya adippadai vasadhigal illaamal andhak kiraama makkal thavithu varugindranar. Idhu kurithuth thagavalarindha joo.vi., andhak kiraamathukku neradi visit adithadhu. Pallikku nadakka mudiyaamal nadandhu sellum kuzhandhaigal, maruthuvathukkum reshanukkum pala km alaiyum makkal, paadhiyil nirkum veedu kattumaanap panigal, mazhaiyil ozhugum kudisaigal ena adippadai vasadhigalukkaaga sullimettuppadhi kiraamam thavippadhai neradiyaagak kaana mudindhadhu.
``pas illaama sgoolukkup poga mudiyalai’’
“iruvathanjju varushathukku munnaala kavarmenttu engalukku indha idathaik kuduthuchu. Aanaa, inge podhumaana vasadhi illai. Anjjaavadhu varaikkumdhaan sgool irukku. Adhukku mela padikkanumnaa aanaimalaikkuthaan poganum. Rodu mosamaa irukkunnu solli, enga oorukku vandha `11 ti’ passaiyum anjju varushathukku munnaadi niruthittaanga. Inga niraiya perkitta bike illai; kooli velaikkup poravangadhaan adhigam. Bus vasadhi illaadhadhaala pasanga sgoolukkup poga mudiyaama, aaraavadhukku mela padippaiye niruthittu veettula irukkaanga, illainnaa velaikkup poraanga” ena vedhanai therivithaar, andhak kiraamathais serndha selvi.
‘`padippaip paadhiyil kaividum maanavargal!’’
“pas illaadhadhunaala sgoolukkup poyittu varradhu rombak kashdamaa irukku. Engappaavukku velai illainnaa, ennai paikkula koottittup poy, koottittu vandhuduvaaru. Aanaa, velai irundhuchunnaa avaraala vara mudiyaadhu. Adhanaala kaalaiyila sgoolukkup poga oru mani neram, saayandharam veettukku vara oru mani neram nadakkavendiyirukku. Sgoolukkup poyittu varradhe ivvalavu siramamaa irundhaa, eppadinga engalaala padikka mudiyum... Bus vandhuchunnaa siramamillaama sgoolukkup poyittu vara mudiyum. Aanaa, anjju varushamaa bus varaadhadhunaala, niraiya peru aaraavadhukku mela padikkap pogalai” endru palli maanavi tharshini padavadathaar.
“modhalla kavarment bus oru naalaikku moonu thadavai vandhuchu. Ippo adhuvum illaama, sgoolukkum velaikkum poravanga mattumillai, udambu sariyillainnaakkooda aasbathirikkup poga mudiyalai. Reshan kadaikke 6 kilo meter nadakkanum. Vayasaanavanga eppadip porulgalaith thookkittu varuvaanga... Aattovukku oru aalukku 150 roovaa selavaagudhu. Naanga sambaadhikkuradhula paadhi idhukke poyidudhu. Bus vidas solli adhigaarigalkitta palamurai solliyum endha nadavadikkaiyum illai” endru matroru kiraamavaasiyaana indhiraani kutramsaattinaar.
``paadhiyil nirkum veedugal... Mazhaiyil ozhugum kudisaigal!’’
``arasaangathula irundhu padhinanjju pudhu veedunga katturaanga. Ellaam paadhiyileye nikkudhu. Enakku andha aardargooda varalai. Adhanaala kudisai veettula kashdappaduren. Veyil kaalathulagooda eppadiyaavadhu irundhukkalaam. Aanaa mazhaikkaalathula veettukkulla irukkave mudiyaadhu. Veedu muzhukka ozhugum. Podhaakkuraikku veliyila irukkura thanniyum ulle vandhudum. Naittellaam thoongave mudiyaadhu. Idhu sambandhamaa adhigaarigalidam pala thadavai pugaaralichum, endhap pirayojanamum illai. Veedu illaadhavangalukku, pudhu veedu kattitharavum, paadhiyila nikkura veedugalai muzhusaa mudikkavum arasaangam nadavadikkai edukkanum” ena valiyuruthinaar, koolith thozhilaaliyaana sakdhivel.
``theervu kaana nadavadikkai’’
vaalbaarai thogudhi sattamandra uruppinar sudhaagar, “indhap pirasnaigal kurithu adhigaarigalin kavanathukku eduthus sendru, theervu kaana nadavadikkai edukkappadum” endraar.
Idhu kurithu pollaachi sap Collector raamagirushnasaamiyidam kettavodhu, “veedugalin kattumaanap panigal nadandhuvarugindrana. Saalai, perundhu vasadhigal thodarbaaga aayvu seythu nadavadikkai edukkappadum” endraar, surukkamaaga.
Paadhiyil tholaiyum kalvikkum, paadhiyil nirkum veedugalukkum endraikkuth theervu kidaikkum?

headline: Iran edutha otrai mudivu... Kachaa enney vilaiyil perum maatram.. Mudivukku varumaa sikkal?
text:
Amerikkaa–isrel padaigal matrum Iran idaiyeyaana ezhu maadha por kaaranamaaga mathiya kizhakku enney etrumadhi kadumaiyaaga paadhikkappattadhu. Ulagalavil kachaa enney thattuppaadu, athiyaavasiya porutkalin vilai uyarvu erpatta nilaiyil, idhuvarai neradi pechuvaarthaiyai maruthirundha Iran, amerikkaavudan pesath thayaar ena arivithadhu. Idhanaal por mudivukku varum nambikkai uruvaagi, sarvadhesa sandhaiyil kachaa enney vilai iru naalil oru sadhaveedham kuraindhadhu.
America, Israel padaigalukkum eeraanukkum idaiye nadaivetru varum por 7 maadhathai thaandiyum thodarndhu varugiradhu. Ulagalaaviya enney etrumadhiyil sumaar 40% pangu mathiya kizhakku naadugalil irundhu kurippaaga valaigudaa naadugalil irundhu etrumadhi seyyappadum nilaiyil, indha por kaaranamaaga andha varthagam perumbaalum mudangiyulladhu.
Idhanaal kachaa enneykku ulagalavil perum thattuppaadu erpattulla nilaiyil, sarvadhesa sandhaiyil kachaa enney vilai kadumaiyaaga adhigarithadhu. Indha por kaaranamaaga ulagin palveru naadugalilum athiyaavasiya porulgalin vilaiyum adhigarithulladhu.
Iran America idaiyeyaana por mudivadaindhaal mattume kachaa enney vilai kattukkul varum ena karudhappatta nilaiyil, appadi oru soozhal tharpodhu erpattulladhu. Idhuvarai amerikkaavudan neradi pechu vaarthaiyai maruthu vandha Iran tharpodhu neradi pechuvaarthaikku thayaar endru arivithulladhu. Melum porp padhatrathai thanikkavum, porai mudivukkuk konduvaravum viruppam therivithulladhu.
Idhan kaaranamaaga por viraivil mudivukku varum ena nambikkaiyil kachaa enney vilai sarvadhesa sandhaiyil irande naalil oru sadhaveedham varai kuraindhulladhu. Sarvadhesa sandhaiyil 92.15 America taalarukku virpanai seyyappatta tavilyoo.ti.ai kachaa enney (WTI Crude), 91.56 taalar endra alavu vilai kuraindhulladhu. Melum indha vilai kuraivu melum sila naatkalukku thodarum endrum edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Idhu oru pakkam endraal, America-vin kachaa enney iruppu kadandha vaaram 3 milliyan peeppaaygal adhigarithu 426.4 milliyan peeppaaygalaaga uyarndhulladhaaga America arasu arikkai veliyittadhu. Idhuvum sarvadhesa sandhaiyil kachaa enney vilai kuraiya oru mukkiyak kaaranam endru koorappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘melisaa’ sooraavaliyin maiyap pagudhi endru paravum video idhuvaa?
text:
‘’melisaa sooraavaliyin maiyap pagudhi,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ merkindhiya theevugal jamaikkaa naattukku aruge nilaigondu ulla ‘melisaa’ endra sooraavalip puyalin maiyap pagudhikkus sendru video edutha America vimaanappadai veerargal!
Manikku 280 km vegathil suzhalum indha puyal, jamaikkaa, haidhi, tominigan kudiyarasu aagiya naadugalai purattip pottu varugiradhu 😳😳😳,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Earth impacts endra peyaril seyalbadum Tik Tok matrum Instagram pakkangalil indha video erkanave pagirappattulladhu. Melum, idhu AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhaaga, Caption pagudhiyil thelivaagak kurippittullanar.
Adhesamayam, America vimaanappadai veerargal ‘melisaa‘ sooraavalikku aruge sendru, adhan maiyap pagudhiyai video eduthadhu unmaidhaan. Andha veediyovukkum, naam aayvu seyyum veediyovukkum endha thodarbum illai.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
ABC News l Media Magik Entertainment l MLive
enave, AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta video-vai eduthu, ‘melisaa’ sooraavaliyin maiyap pagudhi endru koori samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 'pattinappaakkam thalaimais seyalagath thittam rathu?' - amaichar aadhav soosagam!
text:
Pattinappaakkathil pudhiya thalaimais seyalagam kattuvadharku edhiraaga meenava kiraama makkal inaindhu ondru koodi pesi edhirppu therivithirundhanar. Indhiya kamyoonist katchiyum maarksist kamyoonist katchiyum pattinappaakkathileye makkalai thiratti poraattathilum eeduvattirundhanar.
Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyin idaitherdhalukkaana velaigalil TVK mugaam mummuramadaindhirukkiradhu. Thogudhiyil nadandha paaga mugavargal koottathil pesiya amaichar aadhav arjoonaa,pudhiya thalaimais seyalagam thittam kurithum pesiyirundhaar.
Aadhav pesiyadhaavadhu, 'thalaimais seyalagam irukkum idam nammudaiyadhu alla. Ida nerukkadi adhigamirukkiradhu. Kalainjarum ammaavum kooda pudhiya thalaimais seyalagam katta ninaithaargal. Meenava makkal pattinappaakkathil poraadiyirukkiraargal. Pattinappaakkathil virivaana thitta arikkai mattume ketkappattirukkiradhu.
Mudhalvar innamum andha vishayathil mudivedukkavillai. Meenavargalaa thalaimais seyalagamaa endraal meenavargal pakkamdhaan mudhalvar nirpaar. Kamyoonisttugal nammaip patri pesuvadhu varuthamaaga irukkiradhu' endraar.

headline: Aivon 18 India-vil thaan vilai adhigam
text:
Pudhudilli: 'aappil' niruvanathin, 'aivon 18' maadal movail pongal arimugamaagiyullana. Idhan vilai ulagalavil India-vil thaan miga adhigamaaga ulladhu.
'aappil' niruvanam pudhidhaaga arimugam seythulla, 'aivon 18 seeris' maadalgalil, 'aivon 18 puro, puro meks' matrum madikkakkoodiya, 'aivon tuyo' aagiyavai idambetrullana. Idhil aivon tuyovin Indhiya vilai 2.99 latcham roobai aivon 18 purovin vilai 1.65 latcham roobai, aivon 18 puro meks vilai 1.79 latcham roobai idhe maadal pongal, America ullitta palveru naadugalil indhiyaavai vida vilai kuraivaaga ulladhu. Adhe pol mundhaiya aivon maadalgalin vilaiyum uyarthappattulladhu.
India-vil adhiga vilaikku virkappaduvadharkaana kaaranam kurithu thurai nivunargal kooriyadhaavadhu:
aivon tuyo vilai adhigam iruppadharku kaaranam, muzhumaiyaaga adhu seenaavil irundhu India-vukku irakkumadhi seyyappaduvadhaal indhas selavu erpadugiradhu. Melum, kadandha oraandil America taalarukku nigaraana Indhiya roobai madhippu 7 sadhaveedham sarindhiruppadhum aivon 18 puro matrum puro meks vilai adhigamaanadharku kaaranam.
Idhu thavira udhirivaagangalukkaana irakkumadhi varigal kaaranamaaga, Indhiya aivon vilaigal America vilaiyaivida adhigamaaga ullana.pudhiya aivongal mattumindri, erkanave virpanaiyil ulla pazhaiya maadalgalin vilaiyaiyum aappil uyarthiyulladhu. E.ai., niruvanangalukkaana, 'sip' thevai pala madangu uyarndhadhaal ulagalavil sipgalukkaana vilai adhigarithulladhu. Adhan thaakkam pazhaiya aivon maadalgalilum piradhivalikkiradhu.ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: Utharappiradhesa bus nilaiyam endru paravum China rail nilaiyathin video!
text:
Yogi aadhithyanaath aatchiyil utharappiradhesathil kattappattulla bus nilaiyam endru oru video

maal, vimaananilaiyam pondra pirammaanda kattidathin ulle edukkappatta video X thalathil padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indha bus nilaiyam iruppadhu utharappiradhesam endrizhaikkappadum punniya poomiyil. Idhai aandu kondiruppavar svaami yogi. India pooraavum ivarai pondra svaamigalin kaaladiyil kidathinaal, raajya parivaalanam milira, sanaadhanam sezhikka vaazhalaam.” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil Chennai matrum thiruchiyil pirammaanda perundhu nilaiyangal amaikkappattulla soozhalil, adhai vida pirammaandamaana perundhu nilaiyam utharappiradhesathil amaindhulladhu pondru silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, utharappiradhesathil endha ooril indha perundhu nilaiyam ulladhu endra thagavalai alikkavillai.
Utharappiradhesathil ippadi pirammaanda bus nilaiyathaiyo, rail nilaiyathaiyo, vimaana nilaiyathaiye yogi aadhithyanaath matrum Indhiya arasu amaithadhaaga seythigal edhum illai. Melum video-vai paarkka velinaadu pola therindhadhaal idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu sila maadhangalaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. China arasu oodagam matrum tirinidaat matrum tovaago (Trinidad and Tobago) naattukkaana China thoodharagam ullitta pala China saarbu samooga oodaga pakkangalil indha video-vai padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Adhil “seenaavil sameevathil thirakkappatta songing(Chongqing) kizhakku rail nilaiyam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Koogul street mep-l idhan ulbura pugaippadangal ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal, namakku kidaikkavillai. Aanaal, indha rail kattappaduvadhu thodarbaaga veliyaana China oodaga seythigal, pugaippadangal namakku kidaithana.
Melum, indha rayilnilaiyam patri palarum video veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Avatril naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra pagudhigalaik kaana mudindhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha video China-vin songing rail nilaiyathil edukkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: WhatsApp User Name vivagaaram.. Mathiya arasukku mettaa niruvanam vilakkam!
text:
WhatsApp arimugappadutha ulla yoosar nem amsam kurithu mathiya arasu ezhuppiya saivar kutrachaattu kavalaikku, mettaa niruvanam padhil alithulladhu. Amsam innum seyalbaattil illai endrum, pala adukku paadhugaappu erpaadugal seyyappattullana endrum vilakkam alikkappattulladhu. Indha padhilai thagaval thozhilnutba amaichagam theeviramaaga aayvu seythu varugiradhu; idhevondra amsam konda teligiraam, siknal seyaligalukkum nottees anuppappattulladhu.
WhatsApp arimugappadutha ulla yoosar nem (USER NAME) amsam thodarbaaga mathiya arasu anuppiya notteesirku, mettaa niruvanam vilakkam alithulladhu. Yoosar nem moolam saivar kutrangal adhigarikka vaayppulladhaaga arasu kavalai therivitha nilaiyil, indha amsam innum payanbaattirku varavillai endrum, idhil pala adukku paadhugaappu amsangal serkkappattulladhaagavum mettaa tharappil koorappattulladhu.
Indha vilakkathai mathiya thagaval thozhilnutba amaichagam theeviramaagap pariseelithu varugiradhu. Adheneram, idhevol yoosar nem amsangalaik konda teligiraam, siknal seyaligalukkum nottees anuppappattulladhaaga mathiya arasu therivithulladhu.

headline: TVK aatchiyil TASMAC kadaiyil thaakkudhal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
TVK aatchiyil sattam ozhungu seer kulaindhulladhu endru kurippittu TASMAC kadaikkul nadandha modhal video ondru

TASMAC kadaikkul nuzhaindhu kadaikkul irundhavargalai silar thaakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “sandhi sirikkum satta ozhungu TVK aatchiyil thalaivirithu aadudhu..
Sattathai naamale kaiyil eduthuk kondaal edharku sattam??” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathin aatchiyil sattam ozhungu seergulaindhuvittadhaaga samooga oodagangalil thodarndhu pazhaiya video-kkal pagirappattu varugindrana. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovum appadi ondraaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Sameevathil palarum indha video-vai pagirndhiruppadhaagak koogul lens kaattiyadhu. Aanaal nambagamaana oodagam edhuvum indha video-vai veliyittadhaaga seythi edhum namakku kidaikkavillai.
Enave, thodarndhu vevveru pugaippadangalai koogul lensil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2021m aandu pipravari 11m thedhi san news veliyittirundha video-vil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vin kaatchi iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhai paartha podhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda muzhu veediyovum adhil irundhadhu. Adhil, sidhambarathil kadanukku peer thara marutha virpanaiyaalar meedhu thaakkudhal nadathappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
2021 pipravariyil Tamil Naattil ADMK aatchiyil irundhadhu. Enave, idharkum thavega-vukkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil TVK aatchiyil sattam ozhungu seergulaindhuvittadhu endru paravum video thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Marathin meedhu kaarai niruthiya TVK thondar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Erode podhuk koottathirku vandha TVK thondar oruvar thannudaiya kaarai thavarudhalaaga marathin meedhu etriyadhaaga oru video

car ondru marathin kilaigalil sikki niruthappattirukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thavega thondargal thaniyaadhaane marathin mel erakkoodaadhu kaaroda eralaamla… Erode podhukkoottathil” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sameevathil Erode maavattathil TVK koottam nadandhadhu. Indha koottathirku vandha TVK thondar oruvar vivathai erpaduthi kaarai marathin meedhu niruthiyadhaaga video ondrai palarum padhivittu varugindranar. TVK nigazhchiyil ippadi oru sambavam nadandhirundhaal adhu migapperiya seythiyaagi irukkum. Aanaal, namakku appadi endha oru seythiyum kidaikkavillai.
Melum, video-vil ullavargalaip paarkka thamizhargalaip pola illai. Enave, velinaattu video-vai TVK maanaadu endru vishamathanamaaga pagirndhirukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video-vai aayvukku eduthukkondom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu India-vin parakkum car endru kurippittu 2025 epral maadhathilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, edhilum indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidappadavillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu China inaiya oodagam ondril indha video-vil idam petrirundha kaatchiyin pugaippadathai vaithu seythi veliyittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Adhil, China-vin sichuvaan maagaanathil oru vaagana ottunar payitsi niruvanam ondru indha kaarai marathin meedhu niruthi vithiyaasamaana muraiyil vilambaram seythirundhadhaaga kurippittirundhanar.
Kaarai ippadi marathin meedhu niruthiyadhu thavaraana seyal endru arasu adhigaarigal echarikkai viduthadhaagavum, adhaith thodarndhu inaiyathil veliyittirundha video-vai andha niruvanam agatriyadhu endrum andha seythiyil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Erode TVK koottam tisambar 18m thedhi nadandhadhu. Indha video-vai 2025 epralil irundhe samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhulladhu. Seenaavil oru vilambarathirkaaga indha video edukkappattadhaagas seythiyum kidaithulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: H-1B visaavukku roo.96 latcham kattanam.. Trump edutha adhiradi mudivu.. Indhiyargalukku adhirchi!
text:
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
America-vil velinaattil irukkum thiramaiyaana paniyaalargal panivuriya udhavum H-1B visaa thittam thodarbaana kadumaiyaana kattuppaadugalai adhivar tonaaldu Trump nirvaagam melum oraandukku neettithulladhu. Kurippaaga, pudhiya H-1B vinnappangalukku vidhikkappattulla $100,000 (kittathatta roo.96 latcham) kattanam 2027 sepdambar 21 varai thodarum ena vellai maaligai therivithulladhu. Indhiya aidi oozhiyargal matrum America-vil velaivaayppai edhirbaarkkum indhiyargalukku H-1B visaa mukkiyamaana vazhiyaaga irundhu varum nilaiyil, indha nadavadikkai paadhippai erpaduthi ulladhu.
2025 sepdambaril mudhanmudhalaagak konduvarappatta $100,000 kattanathai melum 12 maadhangalukku neettikkum piragadanathil Trump kaiyezhuthittullaar. H-1B paniyaalargalin pudhiya vinnappangalukkum indha kattanam porundhum. Thesiya nalan karudhi vilakku vazhangum adhigaaramum arasidam ulladhu.
Melum, H-1B vinnappangalaip pariseelikkumbodhu, sambandhappatta niruvanam sameevathil America oozhiyargalaip panineekkam seythulladhaa alladhu athagaiya nadavadikkaiyaith thittamittulladhaa enbadhaiyum kanakkil eduthukkollumaaru nirvaagam utharavittulladhu.
H-1B thittathais sila niruvanangal kuraindha oodhiyathil velinaattu oozhiyargalai niyamippadhaal, adhu amerikkargalin velaivaayppaip paadhikkiradhu enavum Trump nirvaagam kutramsaatti varugiradhu. Indha nadavadikkaigal moolam kuraindha oodhiya velaigalukkaana H-1B niyamanangalaik kuraithu, adhiga thiramai matrum adhiga oodhiya paniyaalargalai nokki thittathai maatruvadhe nokkam ena vellai maaligai kooriyulladhu.
2025il vidhikkappatta kattuppaadugal amalukku vandhaviragu, migapperiya aidi avutchorsing niruvanangal thaakkal seytha H-1B padhivugal 92 sadhaveedham kuraindhullana ena thagavalgal therivikkindrana.
Idharkidaiye, $100,000 kattanathai amalbaduthum America arasin nadavadikkaikku edhiraaga sattap poraattamum thodarndhu nadaivetru varugiradhu. Oru America needhivadhi indha kattana uyarvu sattavirodhamaanadhu ena theerppalitha nilaiyil, arasu melmuraiyeedu seythulladhu. Indha vazhakku thodarbaana satta nadavadikkaigal thodarndhu nadaivetru varugindrana. Melum, H-1B visaa thittathukkaaga 1,03,265 taalarai pudhiya nirandhara kattanamaaga arimugappaduthum thittathaiyum America nirvaagam munvaithulladhu. Idhanaal edhirgaalathil H-1B visaa peruvadharkaana selavu melum adhigarikkumaa endra kelviyum ezhundhulladhu.

headline: Paaradhiyaar paadalukkum, thirukkuralukkum vithiyaasam theriyaadhavar anbil magesh endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘paaradhiyaar paadalukkum, thirukkuralukkum vithiyaasam theriyaadhavar anbil magesh,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ yov Anbil_Mahesh tharkuri..!
Paaradhiyaar eppa thirukkural ezhudhunaaru avan sinna paiyan paaradhiyaar vesham pottu paaradhiyaaroda paadalai paaduraan unakku paaradhiyaara theriyala adhu thirukkural illai paaradhiyaar paattunu kooda theriyalayaa nee ellaam kalvi thurai amaichar vera vilangirum kalvithurai 💦’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Idhudhodarbaaga, DMK aidi., pirivil kettavodhu, ‘’ kurippitta video-vil amaichar anbil magesh poyyaamozhi, paaradhiyaar vedam anindhirukkum andha siruvanai azhaithu “medaiyil paaradhiyaar enna pesuneenga, paaradhiyaar thirukkural sonneengalaa?” endru ketkiraar. Adharku andhas siruvan “achamillai” endru koorugiraar. Adharku “achamillaiyaa, sari sollunga”endru paaradhiyaar ezhudhiya ‘achamillai achamillai’endra paadalaiye koorumaaru amaichar solgiraar.
Indha kaatchidhaan andha video-vil padhivaagiyulladhu. Amaichar pesuvadhai thelivaagak ketka mudigiradhu. Aanaal, idhanai vendumendre thavaraaga thirithu, amaichar anbil mageshkku paaradhiyaar – thiruvalluvar veruvaadu theriyavillai, endru koori vadhandhi parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithanar. 
Melum, unmaiyaana video lingk idho…
koodudhal aadhaaram idho…
idhevondru, amaichar anbil magesh aluvalagathilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Manidhargal selfonukku adimaiyaavadhu en?
text:
Selbongal matrum samooga oodagangalukku manidhargal elidhil adimaiyaavadharku moolaiyil surakkum tovamain rasaayaname mukkiya kaaranam ena maruthuva nivunargal koorugindranar.
Suvaarasyamaana alladhu pudhidhaana seyalgalais seyyumbodhu namadhu moolaiyil ulla tovamain rasaayanam surakkiradhu. Piraridam paaraattu peruvadhu, alladhu pudhiya thagavalaik kaanbadhu pondra seyalgalum idhaith thoondugindrana. Adhanaaldhaan moolaiyil ivvaaru tovamain surakkum pagudhiyai ‘parisup pagudhi’ endru azhaikkiraargal. Ore seyalil neenda neram kavanam seluthuvadhai vida, avvappodhu pudhiya, aarvamoottum vishayathil kavanathai thisai thiruppinaal tovamain surappu thideerena adhigarikkum. Indha ucha nilaikkuthaan moolai engugiradhu. Thodarndhu idhaith theduvadhe 'salippu' endru karudhappadugiradhu.
Selbongalil varum nottifigeshan enappadum arivippugal, inaippugal matrum 'laik' pondra paaraattugal aagiyavai edho oru pudhiya vishayam kidaikkappogiradhu endru enni tovamainais surakka vaikkindrana. Idhu 'pudhumai virumbum panbu' ena azhaikkappadugiradhu. Kaafi alladhu sigarettaividap pala madangu adhigamaana, aayirakkanakkaana thoondudhalgal inaiyathil iruppadhaal, indha adimaithanam nirutha mudiyaadha suzhalaaga maarugiradhu. Idhanaal thodarchiyaaga ore seyalais seyyamudiyaamal, 'kavanas sidharalukku adimaiyaadhal' endra pazhakkathai moolai virumbugiradhu ena maruthuva vallunargal koorugindranar.

headline: Kavunsilargal vaardu membaattukkaaga roo.60 kodi odhukkiyadhu maanagaraatchi
text:
Chennai, sep. 25–
Chennai maanagaraatchi koottam indru nadakka ulla nilaiyil, kavunsilargal vaardu membaattu nidhiyil, 50 sadhaveedha thogaiyaana, 60.60 kodi roobai odhukkappaduvadhaaga, maanagaraatchi kamishanar sameeran, netriravu arivithaar.
Chennai-yil palveru nidhiyin keezh thittappanigal merkollappattu varum nilaiyil, kavunsilargalukkaana vaardu membaattu nidhiyaaga, thalaa, 60 latcham roobai odhukkappattu vandhadhu.
Maanagaraatchiyil nidhi nerukkadi erpattu, sambalam kooda thara mudiyaadha nilai erpattadhaal, nadappu nidhiyaandukkaana kavunsilargal membaattu nidhi odhukkaamal niruthi vaikkappattirundhadhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga, palveru katchigalum kadum edhirppu therivithana. Kadandha maadham nadandha maanagaraatchi koottathil, idhu thodarbaaga kavana eerppu theermaanam kondu varappattu, vivaadham nadandhadhu. Karuppu sattai anindhu vandhu edhirppu therivithanar.
Innilaiyil, indru maanagaraatchi koottam nadakka ulla nilaiyil, kavunsilargal vaardu membaattu nidhiyil, 50 sadhaveedha thogaiyaana thalaa 30 latcham roobai odhukkappaduvadhaaga, maanagaraatchi kamishanar sameeran netru arivithaar. Idhanbadi, 60.60 kodi roobai odhukkappattulladhu.
Indha nidhiyil merkolla vendiya panigal kuritha vivaramum veliyidappattulladhu. Indha nidhiyai petru, vadagizhakku paruvamazhai thodarbaana panigal merkollavum adhigaarigalukku arivuruthappattu ulladhu.

headline: ‘raagulukku selvapperundhagai yaarendre theriyaadhu’ endru maanikkam thaagoor koorinaaraa?
text:
Raagul kaandhikku Thamizhaga Congress kamitti thalaivar selvap perundhagaiyai yaarendre theriyaadhu endru Congress em.pi maanikkam thaagoor kooriyadhaaga oru news card

oodagam ondru Congress em.pi maanikkam thaagoor pugaippadathudan veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “selva perundhagai yaarendre theriyaadhu. Selva perundhagaiya yaar endre raagul kaandhikku theriyaadhu. Avar en sandhikka pogiraar. Selva perundhagaiyai raagul kaandhi sandhithaaraa endra seythiyaalar kelvikku maanikkam thaagoor padhil” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu Congress kamittiyin thalaivaraaga irukkum selvap perundhagaiyai yaar endre raagul kaandhikku theriyaadhu endru Congress em.pi maanikkam thaagoor kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Ivargalil palarum ushaaraaga oodagathin logo pagudhiyai agatrivittu padhivittu varugindranar.
News card unmaiyaanadhu pola illai. Selvap perundhagaiyai enbadhai ezhuthup pizhaiyudan ezhudhiyullanar. Oru murai alla irandu murai ore thavaru andha news card-il seyyappattulladhu. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam enbadhu therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla andha kurippitta oodagathin Facebook pakkathaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil, indha news card-ai naangal veliyidavillai, idhu poliyaanadhu endru andha oodagam padhivu veliyittirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Aduthu maanikkam thaagoor ippadi edhum petti alithaaraa endru ariya thedinom. Namakku appadi endha oru seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Maanikkam thaagoorin samooga oodaga pakkathai paarvaiyittom. Avarum idhu “poy seythi” endru kurippittup padhivu ondrai veliyittirundhaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card matrum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Sgireen purodekdargalukku ini pi.ai.es., saandridhazh aduthaandu ep.,1 mudhal amalaagiradhu
text:
'sgireen purodekdar'kalukku ini pi.ai.es., saandridhazh aduthaandu ep.,1 mudhal amalaagiradhu
Pudhudilli: smaartbon thiraiyai paadhugaakka payanbaduthappadum 'sgireen purodekdar'kalukku pi.ai.es., enum Indhiya thara nirnaya amaippin saandridhazhai mathiya arasu kattaayamaakkiyulladhu.
Idhu kurithu minnanu amaichagam therivithulladhaavadhu:
kattaaya pi.ai.es., saa ndridhazh pera vendiya porutkalin pattiyalil movail pongalukkaana sgireen purodekdargal serkkappattullana.
Idhanbadi, 2027 ep., 1 mudhal virpanai seyyappadum anaithu smaartbon sgireen purodekdargalum 'IS 19348:2025' endra in thiya thara nirnaya vidhigalu kku utbattu padhivu seyyappattirukka vendum.
Pi.ai.es., saandridhazh amaippaanadhu, sgireen purodekdarin thadiman, alavu, kilaasin valimai matrum tharam, ottum thanmai, udaivadhai thadukkum pi lim, kairegai padiyaadha poochu matrum puloo-lait pildaring aagiya thozhilnutba amsangalai aayvu seyyum.
Indhiya smaartbon udhirivaagangal sandhaiyil piraandu illaadha matrum tharam kuraindha irakkumadhi tembardu kilaasgal adhigalavil virpanai seyyappadugindrana. Ippudhiya vidhiyaal tharam kuraindha matrum malivu vilaiyil irakkumadhi seyyum niruvanangal tharachaandru pera vendiya kattaayam erpadum alladhu sandhaiyai vittu veliyera neridum.
Niruvanangal thangaladhu thayaarippugalai pi.ai.es., angeegaaram petra aayvagangalil pari sodhithu padhivu seyya 7 maadha kaala avagaasam vazhangappattulladhu.

headline: Aavinukku ennaachu? Roo.143 kodi izhappu.. Adhigarikkum nerukkadi!
text:
Thamizhagathil sila thinangalaaga aavin paalukku kadum thattuppaadu erpattulla nilaiyil, adharkaana kaaranam enna, adhanaal yaarukku enna vidhamaana paadhippu, aavin niruvanathukkaana izhappu enna ullittavatrai alasugiradhu indhath thoguppu.
Thamizhagathil paal urpathiyaip perukkavum, kootturavu muraiyil paalaik kolmudhal seythu vivasaayigalukku udhavum nokkathilum 1981il uruvaakkappattadhudhaan aavin niruvanam. India-vil amul, nandhini varisaiyil mukkiya paal kootturavu niruvanamaana aavin, thamizhagam muzhuvadhum kootturavus sangangal moolam paalaik kolmudhal seythu, podhumakkalukku virpanai seythuvarugiradhu.
Thamizhagathin ottumotha paal urpathi sumaar 3 kodi littaraaga irukkum nilaiyil, adhil verum 10.3 sadhaveedha alavu paalaiye aavin niruvanam kolmudhal seygiradhu. Naal ondrukku aavinukku 37 latcham liter paal thevaippadum nilaiyil, 27 latcham liter paalai mattum aavin kolmudhal seygiradhu. Kolmudhal kuraivu kaaranamaaga iyalbaagave aavin paalukku thattuppaadu nilavuvadhaagavum oru kaaranam sollappadugiradhu.
Indhas soozhalil, nidhi izhappaik kaaranam kaatti, paal viniyogathai melum 10 sadhaveedham kuraikka vaaymozhi utharavu pirappikkappattiruppadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Idhuve tharpodhaiya paal thattuppaadukkuk kaaranam. Udhaaranamaaga, Chennai-yil naaldhorum 16.5 latcham liter aavin paal virpanai seyyappattuvandha nilaiyil, kadandha 6 maadhangalil adhil 25 sadhaveedha viniyogam kuraindhulladhu. Sepdambar 15aam thedhi mudhal adhilum 10 sadhaveedham viniyogam kuraikkappattulladhu. Chennai mattumindri thamizhagathin palveru pagudhigalilum aavin paalukku thattuppaadu ulladhaaga podhumakkal vedhanai therivikkindranar.
Aarokkiyaa ullitta thaniyaar niruvanangal aavinaivida adhiga kolmudhal vilai vazhanguvadhum, aavinukkaana paal varathu kuraivadharku mukkiyak kaaranam. Indhas soozhalil, paal urpathiyaalargalai ookkuvikkum vagaiyil Thamizhaga arasu aavin kolmudhal vilaiyai uyarthiyadhu.
Littarukku 38 roobaayaaga irundha kolmudhal vilai, tharpodhu 44 roobaayaaga uyarthappattulladhu. Aanaalum thaniyaar niruvanathudan oppidugaiyil kolmudhal vilai kuraivudhaan enbadhaal, idhu podhiya palan alikkavillai. Kolmudhal vilai uyarthappattaalum, adharkerpa virpanai vilai maatrappadaadhadhu, urpathis selavu adhigarippu ullitta kaaranangalaal aavin niruvanam perum nidhi nerukkadiyai sandhithulladhu. 2025-26aam nidhiyaandil mattum aavin niruvanathukku 143 kodi roobai izhappu erpattulladhaaga tharavugal therivikkindrana.

headline: Riyaath AIRPORT-ai kurivaitha havudhigal? Vaanvazhi achuruthal.. Savudhiyil paravarappu!
text:
Savudhi areviyaavin thalainagar riyaathil ulla king kaalith sarvadhesa vimaana nilaiyam aruge thideerena karumbugai, theeppizhambugal ezhundhadhaal paravarappu erpattadhu. Idharku mun riyaath, al-karj pagudhigalil vaanvazhi achuruthal echarikkai vidukkappattadhu. Havudhi thaakkudhal endra samooga valaidhala thagavalukku adhigaarappoorva urudhi illai. Sila vimaanangal thaamadham aanadhu.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
savudhi areviyaavin thalainagar riyaathil ulla mukkiya vimaana nilaiyam aruge sanikkizhamai thideerena karumbugaiyum theeppizhambugalum ezhundhadhaal paravarappu erpattulladhu. Idharku sila mani nerangalukku munbu, riyaath matrum al-karj pagudhigalil vaanvazhi achuruthal iruppadhaaga savudhi sivil paadhugaapputh thurai avasara echarikkai viduthirundhadhu.
Riyaathin king kaalith sarvadhesa vimaana nilaiyam aruge migapperiya karumbugai ezhundhadhai video-kkal matrum pugaippadangal kaattugindrana. Vimaana nilaiya saalai matrum munaiyak kattidangal pinnaniyil theriyum nilaiyil, oru pagudhiyil theeppizhambugal ezhundhadhaagavum Reuters therivithulladhu.
Vimaana nilaiyam aruge theeppatriyadharkaana sariyaana kaaranam udanadiyaagath theriyavillai. Melum, vimaana nilaiyame thaakkappattadhaa enbadhaiyum savudhi adhigaarigal adhigaarappoorvamaaga urudhippaduthavillai. Samooga valaidhalangalil havudhi padaigal vimaana nilaiyathaith thaakkiyirukkalaam endra thagavalgal paravinaalum, adhigaarappoorvamaaga innamum urudhippaduthavillai.
Indha sambavathin thaakkam vimaanap pokkuvarathilum kaanappattadhu. Sila vimaanangal thaamadhamaanadhudan, sila vimaanangal rathu seyyappattadhaaga vimaana kangaanippu thagavalgal therivithana. Iruppinum, pinnar vimaanangal riyaath vimaana nilaiyathil thodarndhu iyakkappattana. Enave vimaana nilaiyam muzhumaiyaaga moodappadavillai endru koorappadugiradhu.
Erkanave emanil seyalbadum havudhi padaigalukkum savudhi areviyaavukkum idaiyilaana modhal theeviramadaindhu varum nilaiyil, thalainagar riyaathil erpatta indha sambavam pudhiya padhatrathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Karumbugaikkaana kaaranamum, adhu vaanvazhi achuruthaludan neradiyaaga thodarbudaiyadhaa enbadhum innum thelivaaga theriyavillai.

headline: Trichy: roo.50 kodi madhippilaana sreerangam koyil nilam mosadi - DMK piramugar meedhu vazhakkuppadhivu!
text:
Sreerangam koyilukkus sondhamaana roo. 50 kodi madhippilaana nilathai poli aavanangal moolam avagarithadhaaga DMK piramugar meedhu vazhakkuppadhivu seyyappattulladhu.
Trichy, sreerangam thirukkoyilukku sondhamaana sumaar roo. 50 kodi madhippilaana nilathai poliyaana aavanangalai koduthu andha pagudhiyin DMK seyalaalar raamgumaar enbavar thanadhu peyarukku kadandha 2022-m aandu pathirappadhivu seythulladhaaga sollappadugiradhu. Appadi, koyil nilathai thanadhu peyarukku maatriyadhodu mattumallaamal, andha idathil DMK katchi aluvalagathai indralavum nadathi varugiraar. Indha DMK piramugarin manaivi, vaardu kavunsilaraagavum irukkiraar. Indha vivarangal kidaithavudan indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai amaichar ramesh thalaiyittu tharpodhu kaaval nilaiyathil pugaaralikkappattu andha DMK piramugar meedhu vazhakkuppadhivu seyyappattulladhu.
Melum, inai aanaiyar moolam andha idathil endha pathirappadhivum seyyak koodaadhu ena saarbadhivaalarukku kadidham ezhudhappattu ulladhu. Viraivil DMK piramugar kaidhu seyyappada iruppadhaaga solgiraargal. Pirasithivetra sreerangam koyilukku sondhamaana nilathai poli aavanangal moolam DMK piramugar oruvar avagarithadhaaga sollappadum sambavam, thiruchiyil paravarappai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.

headline: Ulaga saambiyanship thagudhichutrup pottigalil pottiyida vinesh pogathirku anumadhi maruppu
text:
Pudhudilli: ulaga saambiyanship thagudhichutrup pottigalil pottiyida anumadhi kori, malyutha veeraanganai vinesh pogath thaakkal seytha manuvai tilli High Court niraagarithadhu.
Kajagasdhaanin asdhaanaa nagaril varum akdovar 24 mudhal navambar 1 varai ulaga malyutha saambiyanship pottigal nadaiverugiradhu. Idharkaana Indhiya veerar, veeraanganaigalaith thervu seyyum pottigal tilliyil varum sepdambar 14m thedhi nadaiverugiradhu. Indha pottiyil kalandhu kolla Indhiya malyutha veeraanganai vinesh pogath needhimandrathai naadinaar.
Kadandha 2025 joolai maadham thaayaana vinesh pogath, magapperu viduppil irundhadhaal Indhiya malyutha sammelanam nirnayitha thagudhip pottigalil pangerka mudiyavillai. Idhanaal thervup pottiyil pangerka sirappu vilakku alikka vendum kori vinesh pogath tilli aigorttil manuthaakkal seythaar.
Indha vazhakkai visaaritha needhivadhi suvarna kaandha sarmaa visaarithaar. Vinesh pogath saarbil aajaraana mootha vazhakkarinjar raajasegar raav, ''pottiyil pangerka thagudhigal kurithu vinesh pogathukku sepdambar 7m thedhi thaan therivikkappattu ulladhu. Pirasavathukku piragu meendum malyutha pottikku vinesh pogath thirumbi iruppadhaal vidhigalil sila thalarvugalai vazhanga vendum'' ena vaadhittaar.
Idhanai erka marutha needhivadhi manuvai thalluvadi seythu utharavittaar. Vidhigalai aayvu seyyaamal avasarath theervu vazhanginaal matra veerargalukku paadhippu erpadum enak koori Needhimandram manuvai erka maruthuvittadhu. ''vidhigal anaithu veerargalukkum podhuvaanadhu; oru thaninavarukku mattum idhil vilakku alikka mudiyaadhu'' ena needhivadhi thittavattamaaga therivithullaar.

headline:
'unakkaaga naan irukken..'
nanbanukkaaga irangivandha Modi ore nimidathil thalaigeezh maatram!
text:
'unakkaaga naan irukken..' nanbanukkaaga irangivandha Modi ore nimidathil thalaigeezh maatram!
‘enge adichaa velai nadakkum..ena adhan thanmaiyai unarndhu seyalbaduvavargal thaan naattil adhigam..appadiyoru nigazhvu sameevathil arangeri ulladhu. Indha vivagaarathil piradhamar modiye idhil thalaiyittiruppadhu thaan pesuvorulaagi ulladhu...unmaiyil nadandhadhu enna paarkkalaam indha kaanoliyil..
Piradhamar narendhira Modi-yin pallikkaala nanbar asgar ali voraa. Ivarum, piradhamar modiyum kujaraathin vatnagaril ulla pi.en. Palliyil ondraagap padithavargal. Indhanilaiyil, thanadhu nilam aakkiramippu thodarbaaga piradhamarais sandhithu korikkai vaithullaar piradhamarin nanbar ali voraa..
Kadandha 1989aam aandu, magaaraashdiraa maanilam, mumbai payandhar kizhakkup pagudhiyil 2,810 sadhura alavil ali voraa idathai vaangiyullaar. Adhu poli aavanangal moolam BJP em.el.e narendhira methaavukkus sondhamaana kattumaanam ullitta niruvanangalaal aakkiramikkappattulladhu...idhai meettuth tharumaaru, ali voraa, sameevathil piradhamarais sandhithu udhavi seyyumaaru koriyullaar.
Avarais sandhitha adutha nodiye, magaaraashdira mudhalamaicharin mudhanmais seyalaalar sreegar pardhesi thalaimaiyil arasu adhigaarigaludan aalosanai nadathappattadhu. Appodhu, BJP em.el.e narendhira methaa andha nilathin meedhaana kattumaana anumadhiyaith thirumbap petru, aakkiramippaik kaividuvadhaaga oppuk kondadhudan, nilathaiyum ali voraavidame oppadaithaar.
Idhaiyaduthu, ali voraa, narendhira methaa meedhu kaaval thuraiyil alitha pugaaraiyum thirumbap petrukkondaar. Idhanmoolam 15 aandugalaaga needithuvandha nilap pirasnai, adutha sila mani nerangalileye mudivukku vandhulladhu

headline: Aayudha poojaiyai munnittu akdovar 3 andru podhu vidumurai arivikkappattadhaa?
text:

naam indha fektchek katturai veliyidum nodi varaiyilum akdovar 3, 2025 andru vidumurai edhuvum Tamil Nadu arasu arivikkavillai. Oruvelai maru arivippu vandhaal naam adhanaiyum apdet seyya thayaaraaga ullom.

headline: Landan natchathira vidudhiyil Vijay – thirishaa endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Landan natchathira vidudhiyil Vijay matrum thirishaa thangiyulladhaaga oru news card

thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “pugazhbetra vidudhiyil Vijay matrum thirishaa. Nadigar Vijay matrum nadigai thirishaa ingilaandhin pugazhbetra ‘Shangri-La The Shard’ natchathira vidudhiyil thangiyulladhaaga thagaval” endru kurippidappattulladhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar Vijay landanukku payanam merkondullaar. Idharku sila naatkalukku munbu nadigai thirishaavum landanil iruppadhaaga seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil indha irandaiyum inaithu, avargal iruvarum ore hottalil thangiyiruppadhaagath thandhi TV seythi veliyittiruppadhu pondru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Nadigaraaga irundha Vijay tharpodhu mudhalamaicharaaga aagivittaar, enave avarai nadigar endru kurippittu thandhi TV seythi veliyittirukkaadhu. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathil aayvu seythom.
Thandhi TV veliyitta news kaardugalai adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalil paarvaiyittom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru aanaal thirishaa pugaippadam illaadha news card-ai thandhi TV veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Adhil, pugazhbetra vidudhiyil Vijay matrum thirishaa nadigar Vijay matrum nadigai thirishaa ingilaandhin pugazhbetra ‘Shangri-La The Shard’ natchathira vidudhiyil thangiyulladhaaga thagaval” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraana thagavalai veliyittiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Idhai urudhi seyya indha news card-ai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Erkanave, indha news card poliyaanadhu endru kurippittu thandhi TV samooga oodagangalil padhivu ondraiyum veliyittirundhadhaik kandom.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu, edit seyyappattadhu endru urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Ilamben palaathgaaram naangu siraargal sikkinar
text:
Trichy: thiruchiyil, 16 vayadhu ilambennai palaathgaaram seytha, 14 vayadhudaiya naangu siraargalai, Police kaidhu seythanar.
Trichy, kaandhi maarkkettai serndha, 16 vayadhu ilamben, uravinar aravanaippil valargiraar. Mananalam paadhikkappatta andha ilambennai, adhe pagudhiyai serndha, naangu siraargal palaathgaaram seythullanar.
Udalnalam paadhikkappatta ilambennai, Trichy magaathmaa kaandhi arasu maruthuvamanaiyil netru anumadhithanar. Kottai magalir Police, pokso vazhakku padhindhu, palliyil padikkum, 14 vayadhudaiya naangu siraargalai kaidhu seythu, thanjjaiyil ulla koornokku illathil serthanar.

headline: Poondu milagu kuzhambu vivagaaram! Pongiya instaa piravalangal! Mani pro-kku vandha aavathu?
text:
Poondu milagu kuzhambu tirendaal instaa inbuluyansargal aanlainil virpanai seythu vairalaagiya nilaiyil, vimarsana veediyokkalaal piravalamaana mani pro endra manigandan, pengal meedhu aavaasamaaga thaninavar thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu. Idhanaal paadhikkappatta inbuluyansargal Chennai kaavaldhurai aanaiyaridam pugaar alithu, thangal thozhil sattavoorvam, tharas saandridhazhgaludan nadaiverugiradhu ena vilakkinar.
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
indru samaitha unavai indre saappitta kaalam maari, paakket unavugalukku podhumakkal palarum thodarndhu adimaiyaagi varugindranar. Idhumaadhiriyaana unavugal velaiyai elidhil mudithuviduvadhaalum, suvaiyum sirappaaga iruppadhaalum podhumakkal palarum, idhumaadhiriyaana pekkat unavugalai adhigam nambiyirukkindranar. Makkalin indha mananilaiyai purindhuk kondu, poondu milagu kuzhambu endra unavup porul, sameevathil tirent aanadhu.
Indha kuzhambai eppadi seyvadhu enainstaa piravalangal, idhanai aanlainil virpanai seythum vandhanar. Indha video-kkal vairalaanadhaith thodarndhu, palarum indha poondu milagu kuzhambu paattilgalai aanlainil vaangath thodanginar. Idharkidaiye, vimarsana video-kkal veliyittu aanlainil piravalamaana mani pro endru azhaikkappadum instaagiaam piravalam oruvar, instaaviravalangal kurithu kadumaiyaana vimarsanangalai munvaithirundhaar.
Melum, andha veediyokkalil idambetra pen inbuluyansargal kurithu, thaninavar vimarsanangalai munvaithaar. Ippadiyaana soozhnilaiyil, vimarsanangalai sandhitha pen inbuluyansargal, Chennai kaavaldhurai aanaiyar aluvalagathil pugaar ondrai alithullanar. Idhaiyaduthu, seythiyaalargalai sandhitha avargal, manigandan endra navar, thangal meedhu aavaasamaana vimarsanangalai munvaithadhaaga kooriyullanar.
Melum, ungalukku oru porul pidikkavillai endraal, vaanga vendaam. Vimarsanam irundhaal, kaavaldhuraiyil pugaar alikkalaam. Aanaal, ippadi thaninavar thaakkudhalgalai nadathak koodaadhu endrum therivithanar. Thodarndhu pesiya avargal, engalidam anaithu unavu tharas saandridhazhgalum ulladhu. Muraiyaaga thaan naangal thozhil nadathi varugirom endrum kooriyullanar.

headline:
Vels ilavarasi Diana maranam..
Charles sonna adhirchi vaarthai.. 29 aandukkup pin sarchai!
text:
Vels ilavarasi Diana maranam.. Charles sonna adhirchi vaarthai.. 29 aandukkup pin sarchai!
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
ilavarasi tayaanaa... Indhap peyarai ulaga naadugal avvalavu elidhil marandhirukkaadhu. Thanadhu karunai pongiya seyalgalaalum, makkalodu makkalaaga kalandhu pazhagiya panbaalum, vizhippunarvu seyalgalukkaagavum mattumindri, thanadhu anbaana anugumuraiyaal, ulaga makkalin manadhai vendravar ilavarasi tayaanaa. Pirittan ilavarasaraaga irundha saarlasai thanadhu 20-aavadhu vayadhil thirumanam seythugondu pakkinghaam aranmanaikkul nuzhaindha tayaanaa, pinnar thanadhu kanavarudan erpatta karuthu veruvaadugal kaaranamaaga vivaagarathu petru arasa kudumbathaivittu veliyerinaar. Avarin udaigal, avaradhu ovvor asaivugalum paapparasigalaal padambidikkappattukkonde irundhana. Irudhinodivarai avar virattiviratti padambidikkappattuk kondirundhaar.
1997-aam aandu paarisil tayaanaa thanadhu aan nanbarudan kaaril sendrugondirundhavodhu paapparasigal padambidikka virattiyanilaiyil, car vivathil thanadhu 36-aavadhu vayadhil tayaanaa uyirizhandhaar. Avaradhu maranam ulagam muzhuvadhum migapperiya adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Indha vivathukkum pakkinghaam aranmanaikkum thodarbu iruppadhaaga palveru kutrachaattugal munvaikkappattana. Aanaal, andhak kutrachaattugalai urudhippaduthum aadhaarangal edhuvum adhigaaravoorva visaaranaigalil niroovikkappadavillai.
Indha nilaiyil,tayaanaavin sagodharar saarlas sbensar ezhudhiyulla Swan Song: Diana, My Sister endra ninaivuk kurippup puthagam sepdambar 22-aam thedhi veliyaaga ulladhu. Indhap puthagathil, tayaanaavin vaazhkkai matrum avaradhu maranathukkup piragu nadandha sambavangalai, avaradhu sagodharar endra muraiyil saarlas sbensar padhivu seythullaar. Indhap puthagathin sila pagudhigal tharpodhu veliyaagiyulla nilaiyil, tayaanaavin irudhichadangu thodarbaaga appodhaiya ilavarasar saarlasukkum, saarlas sbensarukkum idaiye nadandhadhaagak koorappadum tholaivesi uraiyaadal kurithum avar kurippittullaar.
Tayaanaavin irudhi oorvalathil avaradhu magangalaana villiyam matrum haari nadandhu sella vendum ena aranmanai tharappil mudivu seyyappattadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Aanaal, andha alavukku thuyaramaana soozhnilaiyai villiyamum haariyum edhirgolla vendiyadhillai enbadhe thanadhu karuthaaga irundhadhaagavum idhudhodarbaaga appodhu ilavarasaraaga irundha saarlasudan thanakku erpattadhaagak koorappadum vaakkuvaadhathinbodhu, “Rest assured, we’ll forget her soon enough” endru avar kooriyadhaaga saarlas sbensar thanadhu puthagathil kurippittullaar.
Indha vaarthaigalaik kettavudan thaam adhirchiyadaindhadhaagavum, “neengal ippodhudhaan sonnadhai ennaal nambave mudiyavillai” endru koorivittu andhath tholaivesi azhaippaith thundithadhaagavum andha vaarthaigal tayaanaa meedhu saarlasukku irundhadhaaga thaam karudhum manakkasappai velippaduthiyadhaagavum avar kurippittullaar.
Idhumattumindri, tayaanaa uyirizhandha iravu saarlas thannidam tholaivesiyil pesiyavodhu, saarlas “Lottery winner” pola utsaagamaaga irundhadhaaga sbensar thanadhu ninaivugalaip padhivu seythullaar. Innilaiyil, indhak karuthugal veliyaagiyiruppadhu pirittish arasa kudumbathilum paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu. Idharkku aranmanai saarbil vilakkamum alikkappattulladhu. Adhil “puthagangal kurithu podhuvaaga naangal karuthu therivippadhillai” endru kurippittulla aranmanai, pala aandugalukkup piragu erpatta sagodhararin thuyaram, oruvarin ninaivaiyum, mudivedukkum thiranaiyum, sambavangalai ninaivugoorum vidhathaiyum paadhikkakkoodum ena therivithulladhu. Tayaanaavin maranathukkup piragu, avaradhu kudumbathinarukkum pirittish arasa kudumbathukkum idaiye palveru karuthu veruvaadugal kurithu erkenave vivaadhangal irundhu varum nilaiyil, tharpodhu saarlas sbensarin pudhiya puthagam andhap pazhaiya sambavangalai meendum pesuvorulaakkiyulladhu.

headline: ’Stalin misaavil sirai sendradharkaana aadhaaram..’ DMK aidi ving padhivu!
text:
Thamizhaga sattamandrathil kaavaldhurai maaniya vivaadhathin podhu, mudhalvar Vijay Stalin misaa vazhakkil sirai sendradhai keli seytha thaadai saigai kadum sarchaiyai kilappiyadhu. Innilaiyil misaa sirai aadhaaram illai endra vimarsanathukku padhilaaga, DMK aidi ving aavanangalai veliyittu TVK, mudhalamaicharai kadumaiyaaga thaakkiyulladhu.
Thamizhaga sattamandrathil kaavaldhurai maaniya vivaadhathin podhu pesiya mudhalvar Vijay, Stalin siraisendra misaa vazhakkai suttikkaatti thaadai saigai seythadhu perum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Idharku padhilalitha Stalin, avasaranilai kaala sirai anuvavangalaiyum, thaadai elumbu murivu ullitta kodumaigalaiyum vilakkiyadhodu, evvalavu kochaippaduthinaalum varalaatrai maatra mudiyaadhu ena video veliyittu vilakkam alithirundhaar.
Mudhalamaicharin saigaikku palveru tharappilirundhu kandanangal vandha nilaiyil, DMK kandana aarppaattathaiyum arivithulladhu. Indhasoozhalil muga Stalin misaa vazhakkil sirai sendradharkaana aadhaaram illai endru vimarsikkappatta nilaiyil, adharkaana aadhaaram idho ena DMK aidi ving padhivittulladhu. Melum andhappadhivil mudhalamaichar matrum thavegavinarai tharkuri endru kadumaiyaaga vimarsikkappattulladhu.
DMK aidi ving veliyittirukkum padhivil, ”echil pazham porukkum anilgal kannai moodikkondaal, uzhaippaalum thiyaagathaalum kattamaikkappatta DMK-vin varalaaru irundu poyvidaadhu! Oor muzhuvadhum poyyaip parappum saakkadaik koottathai ambalappadutha arasiyal naagarigathodu engal thalaivar alitha vilakkam, andhath tharkurigalukkaanadhu alla; avargalin poyyai nambi appaavi makkal meendum orumurai emaandhu vidak koodaadhu enbadharkaagathaan.
Varalaaru, thiyaagam endraal ennavendre theriyaamal, samooga valaidhalangalil poyyaiyum avadhooraiyum vaandhiyedukkum Abuser porukkigal nadathum katchidhaan TVK enbadhai maruvadiyum thaangal edutha vaandhiyaal niroovithu irukkiraargal.
Moolaiyum moonjjiyum illaamal, thandhaiyin thayavaal sinimaavil valarndhu, esi keravanukkul pavudar poosi, 'toop' vaithus sandai potta indhath tharkurikku, siraik kottadiyil MISA kaidhigal poleesaarin poots kaalaal midhivattus sindhiya rathathin madhippu eppadith theriyum?
Pathirigaiyaalargalai nerukku ner sandhikkath thuppillaamal, sattamandrathil ketta kelvikkaana padhiluraikku moondru naatkal manappaadam seythu, kemaraa munnaal kathi, kadhari nadikkum tharkurikku nija valigalin unarvu eppadip puriyum? Misaa thiyaagam enbadhu, sinimaavil nadippadhu pola, pinnaadi kaiyai vaithu thadavikkondu panjju methaiyil urulvadhalla; adhu kolgai urudhi maaraamal, siraichaalaiyin irumbuk kambigalukkidaiye ratham sindhiya nijam!
Call sheet kaappiyaiyum, varumaanathai maraithu vaangiya 'IT Raid' kaappiyaiyum, vasanagarthaakkal ezhudhikkodukkum Script pepparaiyum mattume paarthup pazhagiya moolaiye! Unakku emarjensi kaalathil nadandha misaa kodoorangalai aavanappaduthiya ismaayil kamishan arikkai enum varalaatru aavanathaip padithup purindhugollum vakku enge irukkap pogiradhu?
Muthamizharinjar kalainjar anindhirundha 'manjjal thundu', indha maanilathin samooganeedhiyaik kaatha suyamariyaadhaik kuriyeedu! Aanaal, indha 'tammi' mudhalamaicharin mekkappai kalaithuvittaal, ulle minjjuvadhu vetru arasiyal sooniyamum, nirvaagath thiramaiyinmaiyumdhaan.
Neengal vimarsikkum andha 'kattumaram', India-vin pala arasiyal sunaamigalaiye nenjjai nimirthi edhirgondu thamizhnaattaik kaathadhu maaverum varalaaru! Adhil ondrudhaan engal thalaivarum kazhaga udanbirappugalum MISA siraivaasathai edhirgonda emarjensi enum nerukkadi neruppaaru.
Kolgai, sithaandham edhuvum illaamal, thiyaagigalaik kochaippaduthi arasiyal seyya ninaikkum ungal anaagarigas saakkadaiyileye, TVK enum kaagidhak kappal moozhgum.
Idho andha emarjensi kaalathu misaa siraivaasam thodarbaana varaalatru aadhaarangal. Kuraikkum vilangugale kavvik kondu odungal.
Varalaatril nilaithu nirkum maaverum thiyaagathai uruva keli seytha ungalin kedugetta arpathanathai thamizhnaattu makkal kaarith thuppugiraargal.
Kaaranam, indha aavanangalil ulla padhivugalai avargal thangal nenjjil padhiya vaithirukkiraargal” ena kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu padhividappattulladhu.

headline: Adhirappalli vanappagudhiyil maanai izhuthus sendra puli endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Adhirappalli – vaalbaarai vanappagudhiyil maan ondrai vettaiyaadi puli ondru izhuthus sendradhu endru oru video

vanappagudhi saalaiyil maan ondrai puli izhuthus sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “maanai vettaiyaadum puli,vaalbaarai adhirappalli saalaiyil padhappadhaikkum kaatchi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Adhirappalli – vaalbaarai vanap pagudhiyil maan ondrai puli vettaiyaadi izhuthus sendradhaaga oodagangalil seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Indha thagaval unmaidhaanaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai immaadham thodakkathil oruvar thannudaiya instaagiraam pakkathil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, “thannudaiya risaart munbaaga puli ondru kaalnadaiyai izhuthus sendradhu” (Collarwala male infront of our resort dragging cattle) endru kurippittirundhaar. Avaradhu vivarak kurippu pagudhikku sendru paartha podhu, Resort owner at Tadoba endru kurippittirundhaar. Adhu magaaraashdiraa maanilathil ulladhu endrum kurippittirundhaar.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu andha kurippitta risaardin Facebook pakkathilum indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu. Andha pagudhiyin koogul street viyoovai paarthom. Puli izhuthus sendra pagudhiyaik kandariya mudiyavillai. Aanaal, andha vanap pagudhiyin kaatchiyum aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vin kaatchiyum oralavukku othupponadhu.
Matravadi veru yaarum indha video-vai veliyidavillai. Thamizh oodagangalil mattum idhu keralaa – Tamil Nadu vanap pagudhiyil edukkappattadhu endru kurippittu seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Enave, indha video-vai veliyittirundha rsg_ranveer-n instaagiraam pakkathilirundhu indha video-vai thaangaldhaan edutheergalaa endru urudhi seyyumbadi kettu mesej seythom. Avarum ‘indha video-vai naandhaan eduthen,’ endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Sinook heligaapdar udhaviyudan jesivi iyandhiram utharagaant eduthus sellappattadhaa?
text:
‘’sinook heligaapdar udhaviyudan utharagaant eduthus sellappatta jesivi iyandhiram,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ aamaam, indhap pugaippadam unmaidhaan. Utharagaandil mega vedippu sambavathil thaarali kiraamam thodarbu illaadhadhaaga maariyadhu. Saalaigal adaikkappattadhaal, nivaaranap panigalaith thodangath thevaiyaana jesiviyai saalaiyil irundhu edukka mudiyavillai, enave “muzhu jesivi aam muzhu jesivi” sinook heligaapdaril inaikkappattu sambava idathirku nivaaranam matrum meetbup panigal merkollappattana.
Idhu maarivarum India, pudhiya India, valuvaana India matrum naveena indhiyaa…
vaazhga India!. 🚩🇮🇳,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan heligaapdar ondril jesivi iyandhiram eduthus selvadhu pondra pugaippadam ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, iruveru pugaippadangalai ondrinaithu, edit seythu, ivvaaru vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, oodagangalil erkanave velivandha pugaippadangalai eduthu, ivvaaru edit seythu vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
Hindustan Times l Rediff l Zee News l Jetphotos
aduthadhaaga, Uttarakhand Police saarbaaga, kurippitta pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhalla, endru erkanave maruppu koorappattulladhaiyum, inge suttikkaatta virumbugirom.
Irudhiyaaga, namadhu Fact Crescendo English kuzhu idhuvatri veliyitta fektchek katturaiyaiyum inge inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam, edit seyyappattadhudhaan, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vivasaayigal poraattam: pechuvaarthaikku idaiye veliyeri sendra amaichar ramesh! - enna nadandhadhu?
text:
Vivasaayigalidam pechuvaarthai nadakkumbodhe purappattaar amaichar ramesh.
Vivasaayigal kootturavu vangigalil vaangiya muzhu payirgadangalaiyum thalluvadi seyya vendum endra korikkaiyai valiyuruthi, Trichy maavattam, samayavuram pallividai paalam sarvees saalai aruge vivasaayigal kaathiruppu poraattathai thodangi nadathi varugindranar. Indhap poraattathai mudivukku konduvara vendum ena velaandhurai amaichar vinoth, Trichy poruppu amaichar ramesh ullittavargal vivasaayigalidam pechuvaarthai nadathinaar.
Appodhu pesiya amaichar ramesh, ``thamizhnaadu mudhalamaichar avargal poruppetra mudhal 100 naalgalileye vivasaayigalin nalanaik karuthil kondu palveru thittangalai arivithus seyalbaduthiyullaar. Vivasaayigal munvaithulla korikkaigal thodarbaaga, netru paplik havus tivaartment matrum yooaardi (URD) amaichargal utbada onbadhu seeniyar amaichargal ondraaga amarndhu sumugamaana muraiyil virivaana aalosanai nadathiyullanar. Korikkaigalai niraivetruvadhil arasukku muzhu viruppam ulladhu. Vivasaayigalukku endha idathilum paadhippu erpadak koodaadhu enbadhil mudhalamaichar migath thelivaaga irukkiraar.
Vivasaayigal tharpodhu ketkum koodudhal nalathittangal matrum kadan thalluvadigalais seyalbadutha thoraayamaaga roo. 3,000 kodi koodudhal nidhi thevaippadugiradhu. Enave, arasin tharpodhaiya nidhinilaimaikku erpa endhendha nidhigalai maatri amaikka mudiyum, nidhichumaiyai evvaaru sariseyvadhu enbadhu kurithu nidhiyamaichagam matrum thurai adhigaarigaludan virivaaga aayvu seyya vendiyulladhu. Indha aayvarikkaiyaith thayaaritha pirage mudhalamaicharidam samarppithu irudhi mudivu edukka mudiyum. Tharpodhu irandu thogudhigalil idaitherdhal arivikkappattu nadaimuraiyil ulladhaal, therdhal nadathai vidhigalinbadi arasu pudhiya arivippugalaiyo utharavaadhangalaiyo udanadiyaaga vazhanga mudiyaadhu.
Enave, nidhis soozhalai aayvu seyya 20 naalgal kaala avagaasam thevaippadugiradhu. Idaitherdhal mudindhavudan idharkaana thelivaana arivippai mudhalamaichar veliyiduvaar. Adhigaarigal yaarum vivasaayigalai varpuruthavo, sangadathirku ullaakkavo koodaadhu endru seeniyar amaichargal moolam netraiya koottathileye migath thelivaaga arivuruthappattulladhu.
Tamil Naattin mudhugelumbaagath thigazhum vivasaayigalin unarvugalaiyum korikkaigalaiyum indha arasu muzhumaiyaaga madhikkiradhu. Arasu pechuvaarthaikku eppodhum thayaaraagave irukkiradhu. Edhaiyum seyya mudiyaadhu endru marukkavillai. Enave, adhigaarigalin aayvup panigal matrum mudhalamaicharin mudivukkuth thevaiyaana indha 20 naalgal avagaasathaik koduthu, poraattathaith tharkaaligamaaga othivaikkumaaru vivasaayigal perumakkalidam kettukkolgiren." enak kurippittaar. Idharkidaiye amaichar pesikkondirukkumbodhe salasalappu erpatta nilaiyil, idaiyileye amaichar purappattus sendruvittaar.
Amaichar sendraviragu seythiyaalargalidam pesiya ayyaakkannu, ``sennai pechuvaarthaiyil kootturavu vivasaayak kadan thalluvadikku roo. 3,000 kodi alla, motham roo. 9,000 kodi thevaippaduvadhaagath therivikkappattirukkiradhu. Adhu kurithu nidhiyamaichagam matrum seyalaalargaludan pesi oru vaarathirkul aalosippadhaaga amaichargal kooriyirundhanar. Aanaal, koottathil thalluvadith thogai evvalavu, siru-kuru vivasaayigal matrum periya vivasaayigalukkaana kadan thalluvadi alavu enna enbadhu pondra vivarangalai amaichargal thelivaaga arivikkavillai.
Adhanaal adhirupdhiyadaindha vivasaayigal koochalidave amaichargal kovithuk kondu sendruvittanar. Enave, arasin indha 20 naal kaala avagaasak korikkaiyai etrukkolvadhaa alladhu poraattathaith thodarndhu nadathuvadhaa enbadhu kurithu vivasaayigal tharpodhu ondrugoodi aalosithu mudivu seyyavullanar" endraar.

headline:
Velinaadu sellum mudhalvar..
Thallippogum thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittam.. Eppodhu thuvangum?
text:
Velinaadu sellum mudhalvar.. Thallippogum thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittam.. Eppodhu thuvangum?
Arasu maruthuvamanaigalil pudhidhaagap pirakkum kuzhandhaigalukku oru kiraam thanga modhiram vazhangum ‘thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittathai’ seyalbadutha ulladhaaga therdhal arikkaiyil TVK kurippittirundhadhu. Adhanbadi, therdhalil vetri petru aatchi amaithu, mudhalvaraagap poruppetrulla TVK thalaivar Vijay, sepdambar 15-aam thedhi, arinjar annaavin pirandha naalandru ‘thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittam’ seyalbaduthappadum ena arivithirundhaar. Indhath thittathukkaaga aandudhorum roo.755.83 kodi nidhi odhukkappadum endru arivikkappattirundhadhu. Thanga kolmudhalukkaaga tendar korappattu, joy aalukkaas, kalyaan joovallarsukku pani aanai vazhangappattirundhadhu. Innilaiyil, mudhalvar Vijay arasu muraip payanamaaga velinaadu sella iruppadhaal, thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittathin thodakka vizhaa thallippogum soozhal erpattulladhaaga amaichar arunraaj therivithullaar.
Indru Chennai raajeevgaandhi arasu podhu maruthuvamanaiyil seythiyaalargalais sandhitha sugaadhaarath thurai amaichar arunraaj, mudhalvarin velinaattup payanath thittam kaaranamaaga sepdambar 15-aam thedhi thittamidappattirundha thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittathai andraiya thinam thodanga mudiyaadha soozhal erpattulladhaagavum, maatruth thedhi adhigaarappoorvamaaga arivikkappadum endrum thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittathin keezh vazhangappada ulla thangathil evvidhak kuraiyum irukkaadhu endrum, 916 tharathilaana thangathileye modhirangal uruvaakkappadum endrum avar therivithaar. Idharkaana anaithu tharas saandrugalum perappadum endrum therivithirukkiraar. Innilaiyil, mudhalvar Vijay thanadhu velinaattup payanathai mudithukkondu naadu thirumbiya piragu, sepdambar 25-aam thedhi Madurai maavattam usilambatti arasu maruthuvamanaiyil thaaymaaman thanga modhirath thittathaith thodangi vaikka ulladhaagavum thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana.
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra

headline: “periyaar, annaa patriya video thavarillai” endru thindukkal seenivaasan koorinaaraa?
text:
Indhu munnani nadathiya murugan maanaattil periyaar, annaa patri veliyaana video-vil thavarillai endru ADMK munnaal amaichar thindukkal seenivaasan kooriyadhaaga oru news card

thindukkal seenivaasan pugaippadathudan thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “periyaar annaa patriya video thavarillai. Murugan maanaattil periyaar, annaa patri veliyitta video-vil thavaru ondrum illai; DMK thaan idhai arasiyal seygiradhu – ADMK munnaal amaichar thindukkal seenivaasan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
investigation_details:
Maduraiyil indhu munnani saarbil nadandha murugan samaya maanaattil periyaar, annaa pugaippadangaludan video olivarappu seyyappattadhu. ADMK munnaal amaichargalai medaiyil vaithuk kondu thiraavidam matrum thiraavidath thalaivargal patri pesiyadhu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. ADMK munnani thalaivargal ellaam indha vivagaaram thodarbaaga kandanangalaith therivithu varugindranar.
Indha nilaiyil, video-vil thavarillai endru munnaal amaichar thindukkal seenivaasan kooriyadhaaga oru news card samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Paarkka thandhi TV veliyittadhu polave ulladhu. Enave, idhai thandhi TV veliyittirukkalaam endra sandhegam ezhundhadhu. Aanaal, thindukkal seenivaasan appadi kooriyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Enave, news card poliyaaga irukkalaam endru aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai thandhi TV veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathaip paarthom. Joon 23, 2025 andru naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card-ai thandhi TV veliyidavillai enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Oruvelai news card-ai veliyittuvitta agatriyiruppaargalaa endra sandhegathil indha news card-ai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhai paarthuvittu idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Periyaar, annaa patriya video thavarillai endru thindukkal seenivaasan kooriyadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Thandhi tiviyum idhu poliyaana news card endru urudhi seythulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu matrum news card thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nevaala vellathil sikkiya pen meetkappattadhaagap paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Nevaala vellathil sikkiya pennai pathiramaaga meetta iruvar endru oru video

vellathil adithus sellappadum pen oruvarai thuppattaa veesi kaappaatruvadhu pondru video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “nevaala vellathil sikkiya pennai pathiramaaga meetta iruvar💔” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Nevaalathil erpatta thideer vellap perukkil nootruk kanakkaanor uyirizhandhullanar. Indha vellathil sikkiya pen oruvarai irandu per thuppattaa veesi kaappaatriyadhaaga video ondru samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Video-vai paarkka nevaalathil erpatta payangara vellapperukku pola illai. Melum, andha pennai kaappaatrum podhu arugil ullavargal migavum iyalbaaga iruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Enave, idhu reelskkaaga edukkappatta naadaga vadivilaana video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetri thedinom. Appodhu, immaadha (aagast 2026) thodakkathileye indha video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil harithuvaaril aatril adithus sellappatta pennai kaappaatriya iruvar endru kurippittirundhanar. Aanaal, idhu thodarbaaga endha nambathagundha seythi oodagangalilum seythi veliyaagi irukkavillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu, video-vil idam petrulla navarin YouTube pakkam namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video irundhadhu. 2026 joolai 6m thedhi andha video padhivetram seyyappattirundhadhu. Adhil verum nadippu nanbargale endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhe pondru eraalamaana veediyokkalai avargal thodarndhu padhivittu vandhirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam idhu samooga oodaga viyoos-kkaaga edukkappatta sgiripdat vagai video enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Aangilam pesath thadumaarum Udhayanidhi endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Udhayanidhi Stalin aangilam pesath thinarinaar endru oru video

Udhayanidhi staalinai niruvargal soozhndhugondu kelvi ezhuppiya video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhu Stalin iratham ingilees theriyaadhu 🤡😹 indha latchanathula thaan irumozhi kolgai irukkudhu’ endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil iru mozhi kolgai nadaimuraiyil ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil mummozhik kolgaiyai erka vendum endru mathiya arasu matrum BJP aadharavaalargal valiyuruthi varugindranar. Indha nilaiyil Udhayanidhi staalinukku aangilame pesath theriyavillai, indha nilaiyil irandu mozhi kolgai thevaiyaa endru paajaga-vinar samooga oodagangalil video-vai parappi varugindranar.
Indha video muzhumaiyaana video-vaaga illai. Muzhu video-vai veliyittirundhaal avar thinarinaaraa, pesinaaraa enbadhu therindhirukkum. Udhayanidhi Stalin saralamaaga aangilathil pesak koodiyavardhaan. Enave, indha video edit seyyappattadhaaga irukkalaam endru aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Udhayanidhi Stalin alitha petti thodarbaaga Polimer TV veliyittirundha video kidaithadhu. Adhil endha thadumaatramum indri Udhayanidhi Stalin pesuvadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aangilathil ketta kelvikku avar padhil alikka aarambikkiraar, adharkul thamizh oodagathais saarndhavargal thamizhil kelvi ketkindranar. Avar avargalukku thamizhil padhil alikkiraar.
Udhayanidhi Stalin aangilathil pesiya pazhaiya nigazhchi kaanoligalaith thedi eduthom. Aangila oodagangalukku alitha aangila petti, nigazhchiyil aangilathil pesiyadhu endru pala video-kkal namakkuk kidaithana. Enave, Udhayanidhi staalinukku aangilam theriyaadhu endra karuthu thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Video edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Vivasaayigal vaazhvai membaduthum vaazhai idhu pudhusu... Adhigarikkudhu mavusu...!valarchiyai aayvu seyyum vinjnjaanigal
text:
Vivasaayigal vaazhvai membaduthum 'vaazhai' idhu pudhusu... Adhigarikkudhu mavusu...!valarchiyai aayvu seyyum vinjnjaanigal
Mettupalayam: Trichy vaazhai aaraaychi maiyathil urpathi seytha vaazhaikkandrugalai, malaivaazh makkal matrum vivasaayigalukku ilavasamaaga vazhangappattana. Idhanaal, ivargalin vaazhvaadhaaram membadum ena nambikkai therivikkappattulladhu. Kaaramadai aranganaadhar uzhavar urpathiyaalar kuzhuvum, aram angaga velaan kootturavu amaippum inaindhu, malaivaazh makkal matrum migavum pindhangiya vivasaayigalukku, vivasaayam sambandhamaaga vizhippunarvai erpaduthi varugindranar. Mathiya, maanila arasugal vazhangum udhavigal kidaikka, vivasaayigalukku thevaiyaana muyatsi merkondu varugindranar.
Oru pagudhiyaaga, malaivaazh makkal matrum vivasaayigalukku, pudhiya raga vaazhaikkandrugal vazhangum nigazhchi, sirumugai aruge koothaamandiyil nadandhadhu. Kaaramadai aranganaadhar uzhavar urpathiyaalar kuzhuvin thalaivar muthusaami thalaimai vagithu pesiyadhaavadhu:
Trichy vaazhai maiyathil, 'jee 9 kiraant rovastaa' endra pudhiya vaazhai ragam kanduvidithullanar. Indha kandrugal nadavu seytha podhu, pathaavadhu maadhathil periya thaar aruvadai seythullanar. Pazhathin rusiyum arumaiyaaga irundhulladhu. Pudhiya vaazhai kandrugal urpathi seythu nadavu seyya pala idangalil vivasaayigalukku vazhangi ullanar. Ippazham suvaiyaaga irundhadhaal, velinaadugalukku vaazhaithaar etrumadhi seythullanar.
Indha ragathai, malaivaazh makkalukku ilavasamaaga vazhanginaal, idhan vaayilaaga ivargalin vaazhvaadhaaram membadum. Andha adippadaiyil migavum pindhangiya matrum malaivaazh makkal vivasaayigalukku vazhanga erpaadu seythom. Trichy vaazhai aaraaychi maiyathil irundhu, 9,000 vaazhaikkandrugal ilavasamaaga petrullom. Kaaramadaiyil ulla malaivaazh makkalukkum, vivasaayigalukkum vazhangappada ullana. Indha kandrugalin valarchiyai, vaazhai aaraaychi maiyam vinjnjaanigal aayvu seythu, valarkkum muraigal kurithu vazhimuraigal kooruvar.
Ivvaaru, avar pesinaar.
Aram angaga velaan kootturavu amaippu nirvaagi sadhees, iyakkunar rangaraaj ulbada palar pangetranar. Aranganaadhar uzhavar urpathiyaalar kuzhu iyakkunar velusaami nandri koorinaar.
