headline: Vaara irudhiyil mattum kanavan-manaivi.. Trendaagum Weekend Marriage! Gen Z-yai kavarvadhu en?
text:
Thirumanam endraale ore veettil ondraaga vaazhvadhu, kudumbathai inaindhu nadathuvadhu enbadhudhaan pala aandugalaaga irundhu varum vazhakkamaana nadaimuraiyaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Aanaal, andha paarambariyathai maatrum vagaiyil, pudhiya vaazhkkai murai ondru tharpodhu ulagin pala naadugalil kavanathai eerthu varugiradhu.
Indraiya ilam thalaimuraiyinaril palar, thirumana vaazhkkai enbadhu thangaladhu thanippatta sudhandhiram, thozhil valarchi matrum vaazhkkai ilakkugalai paadhikkakkoodum endru karudhugindranar. Adhenerathil, thirumanathaiyum virumbugiraargal. Indha irandukkum idaiye samanilaiyai uruvaakkum muyatsiyaaga tharpodhu pesappattu varum pudhiya vaazhkkai muraidhaan "Weekend Marriage."
indha vaazhkkai muraiyil, kanavan-manaivi iruvarum vaara naatkalil thangaladhu velai, thozhil alladhu padippu kaaranamaaga thanithaniyaaga vasikkalaam. Vaara irudhi naatkalaana sani matrum njaayitrukkizhamaigalil mattum ondraaga neram selaviduvaargal.
Indha pudhiya vaazhkkai murai tharpodhu kurippaaga Gen Z thalaimuraiyinaridaiye en piravalamadaindhu varugiradhu? Idhan pinnaniyil ulla kaaranangal enna? Enbadhai paarkkalaam.
Ulagam muzhuvadhum velaivaayppu, uyargalvi matrum thozhil valarchikkaaga palar vevveru nagarangalilum, naadugalilum vasithu varugindranar. Thirumanathirkup piragum thangaladhu thozhil matrum thanippatta ilakkugalai vittukkodukka virumbaadha thambadhigal, uravaiyum sudhandhirathaiyum samanilaippaduthum vazhiyaaga indha Weekend Marriage muraiyai thervu seythu varuvadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Kurippaaga Japan, then koriyaa, China, America matrum sila airoppiya naadugalil indha vaazhkkai murai kurithu adhigalavil vivaadhangal nadaivetru varugindrana.
Thanippatta sudhandhiram, thozhil munnetram, manaazhutham kuraivu, oruvarukkoruvar thanippatta idaiveliyai madhippadhu pondra kaaranangalukkaaga silar indha vaazhkkai muraiyai thervu seygindranar. Indraiya Gen Z thalaimuraiyinar, thirumanam vaazhkkaiyin oru pagudhi mattume, vaazhkkaiye thirumanam alla endra anugumuraiyai adhigam virumbuvadhaagavum aayvaalargal koorugindranar.
Adhenerathil, indha vaazhkkai muraikku aadharavum edhirppum irundhu varugiradhu. Vaara irudhiyil mattum sandhippadhaal, ondraaga selavidum nerathirku adhiga mukkiyathuvam kidaippadhaagavum, thevaiyatra siriya kudumbath thagaraarugal kuraiya vaayppulladhaagavum aadharavaalargal koorugindranar.
Maruvuram, neenda naatkal ondraaga vaazhaadhadhaal unarvuppoorvamaana nerukkam kuraiyalaam endrum, kuzhandhaigal irundhaal avargalin valarppu matrum kudumba poruppugalai pagirndhu kolvadhil savaalgal uruvaagalaam endrum vimarsagargal koorugindranar.
Sameeva kaalamaaga samooga valaidhalangalilum, vaazhkkai murai thodarbaana inaiyadhalangalilum Weekend Marriage kurithu adhigalavil vivaadhangal nadaivetru varugindrana. Thirumanam enbadhu ore veettil vaazhvadhaa? Illai, oruvarai oruvar purindhugondu vaazhvadhaa? Endra kelviyai meendum ezhuppiyirukkiradhu indha Weekend Marriage idhu verum samooga valaidhala trendaagave maraindhuvidumaa? Alladhu edhirgaala kudumba vaazhkkaiyin oru pudhiya vadivamaaga maarumaa? Enbadharkaana padhilai kaalamdhaan solla vendum

headline: Verum 28 naatkaldhaan.. Mundhaiya aandugalin ennikkaiyai udaitha Thamizhaga sattapperavai!
text:
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
kadandha oru maadhamaaga nadaivetru vandha sattapperavaik koottathodar indrudan niraivadaindhadhu. Sattapperavaiyil indru (sep. 8) podhuthurai maaniyak korikkai thaakkal seyyappattu, andhath thurai saarbil mukkiya arivippugal veliyidappattana. Appodhu pesiya sattapperavaith thalaivar je.si.ti. Piravaagar, sattamandra nigazhvugalai neril paarvaiyida podhumakkalukku anumadhi ulladhaa enbadhu kurithu munbu kuzhappam nilavi vandhadhaagak kurippittaar.
Tharpodhu sattapperavai nigazhvugal neralaiyil olivarappappattu vandhaalum, sattapperavai nadavadikkaigalai neril kaanavum, angu nadaiverum vivaadhangal matrum nigazhvugalai arindhugollavum podhumakkal aarvathudan varugai tharuvadhaaga avar therivithaar.
Paarvaiyaalargalin varugai thodarbaana pullivivarangalaiyum avar veliyittaar. Adhanbadi, kadandha 2021-aam aandu muzhuvadhum nadaivetra sattapperavai koottathodarai kaana 22,651 per varugai thandhullanar. 2022-aam aandu 22,150 perum, 2024-aam aandu sumaar 10 aayiram perum sattapperavaiyaip paarvaiyittullanar. Adhesamayam, 2025-aam aandil paarvaiyaalargalin ennikkai meendum adhigarithu 20,103 peraaga padhivaagiyulladhu.
Innilaiyil, 2026-aam aandu tharpodhu nadaivetru varum 28 naal sattapperavai koottathodaril mattum 32,555 paarvaiyaalargal varugai thandhulladhaaga je.si.ti. Piravaagar therivithaar. Kurippaaga palli matrum kalloori maanavargalin varugai indha aandu kanisamaaga adhigarithulladhaaga avar magizhchi therivithaar. Vazhakkamaaga sumaar 20 palli matrum kalloorigalais serndha maanavargal mattume sattapperavaiyai paarvaiyida varuvaargal. Aanaal, indha murai 75 palli matrum kalloorigalais serndha maanava, maanavigal aarvathudan varugai thandhullanar.
Ilainjargal matrum maanavargalidaiye sattamandram, arasiyal matrum podhuvaazhvu kuritha aarvam adhigarithu varuvadhaiye indha varugai ennikkai kaattuvadhaaga sattapperavaith thalaivar je.si.ti. Piravaagar therivithullaar.

headline: ’sunaami vandhu thalaimais seyalagam adithus sendraal suraa pola mudhalvar thaduppaaraa..?’ - pe. Sanmugam
text:
Chennai pattinappaakkathil thalaimais seyalagam amaikkum mudivai edhirthu maarksist kamyoonist katchi saarbil sanmugam thalaimaiyil aarppaattam nadaivetradhu. Palligal, pokkuvarathu nerisal, meenava makkalin vaazhvaadhaaram paadhikkappadum ena avar echarithu, kadalai kaippatrum muyatsiyin vilaivugalai varalaaru kaattiyadhaaga koorinaar. Arasaanai 564-ai thirumbap pera vendum ena valiyuruthinaar.
Chennai pattinappaakkathil thalaimais seyalagam amaikkum mudivai kaivida valiyuruthi maarksist kamyoonist katchiyin saarbil maanila seyalaalar sanmugam thalaimaiyil kandana aarppaattam nadaivetradhu. Indha aarppaattathil sanmugam pangetru kandana uraiyaatrinaar. Pudhiya thalaimais seyalagathirku veliyidappatta arasaanai en 564 udanadiyaaga thirumbap pera valiyuruthi koshangalai ezhuppinar.
Aarppaattathil pesiya avar, “endhath thittathai kondu vandhaalum oru silar edhirbaargal ena amaichar sengottaiyan pesiyullaar. Ellaa thittathaiyum edhirppadhum maarksist kamyoonist katchi kidaiyaadhu. Amaichar sengottaiyanin pechai vanmaiyaaga kandikkiren.
Thalaimais seyalagam pokkuvarathu nerisal illaadha, ellaa adippadai vasadhigalum kondadhaaga edhirgaala valarchiyaiyum avasiyamaagak kondu uruvaakkappada vendum enbadhil maarksist kamyoonist katchikku endhavidha maaruvatta karuthum kidaiyaadhu. Aanaal ippozhudhu thervu seytha idam poruthamatra idam.
Palligal iruppadhaal maalaiyil kadum pokkuvarathu nerisal saandhom pagudhiyil erpadugiradhu. Oruvelai pattinappaakkathil thalaimais seyalagam vandhaal ingu ulla palligalai kaali seyveergalaa?
Pattinappaakkathil thalaimais seyalagam ena ingulla makkalukku pudhiya nerukkadigalai kodukkireergale thavira endhavidha saadhagamaana vaayppugalum illai.ingulla meenava makkalai veru idathirku maatrinaal meenava makkalin vaazhvaadhaaramaana kadalai veru idathirku kondu selveergalaa ?
Pudhiya arasu, kadalai kaiyagappadutha muyatsi seytha munbu irundha aatchiyaalargalin kadhi enna aanadhu enbadhai varalaatrai thedip padikka vendum.
Kadarkaraikku arugileye thaan thalaimais seyalagam irukka vendumena arasu ninaithaal pattinappaakkathai thaandi sendraal All india radio aluvalagam 50 ekkar parappalavil ulladhu. Andha idathai eduthuk kollalaam enenil ippodhu yaarum rediyo kettu naan paarppadhillai.
Kadarkaraikku arugiledhaan thalaimais seyalagam vendum endraal all India radio aluvalagathai eduthuk kollungal. Illaiyenil tijivi aluvalagam irukkiradhu adhai eduthuk kollungal.
Kindi res kors maidhaanam, koyambedu perundhu nilaiyam, All india radio ena ithanai idam irukkumbodhu meenava makkalin sondha idathil thaan thalaimais seyalagam kattuvom ena en adam pidikkireergal.
Sunaami vandhu thalaimais seyalagam adithus sendraal suraa pola mudhalvar thaduppaaraa. Maarksist kamyoonist katchi, Indhiya kamyoonist katchi aadharavodu thaan arasaangam nadakkiradhu enbadhai manadhil vaithuk kondu arasu seyalbada vendum illai thaanbondrithanamaaga arasu seyalbadum endraal veru vidhamaana mudivai arasu sandhikka neridum.
Anaithu katchigalodu kalandhu pesi oru thittathai kondu varuvadhu en mudhalvarukku veppangaay pola kasakkiradhu. Pattinappaakkathil thalaimais seyalagam amaiyaadhu endra arivippai, arasaanaiyai mudhalamaichar veliyida vendum” ena pesiyullaar.

headline: Israel raanuvathai isreliyargale thaakkuvadhaaga paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran meedhu thevaiyillaamal thaakkudhal nadathi pirasnai erpaduthiyadhaaga Israel raanuvathai Israel makkal thaakkiyadhaaga oru video

saalaiyil koottamaaga silar modhikkollum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “isrel iraanuvadhai thuvaithu edutha isreliya podhu makkal.! Makkal koorugiraargal neengal eeraanai vambizhutheergal, ippodhu engal veedugal tharaimattamaagi vittadhu aanaal neengal paadhugaappaaga pangarukkul poy olindhu kondirgal endru Israel makkalin kootru. Melum Israel makkal kaiyil paadhaadhaigal veedhigalil nadandhu paagisdhaanidamum Pakistan makkalum eeraanidam porai nirutha sollungal endru isreliya makkal ketkiraargal . Melum ippodhu mundhaiya kalla thandhai amerikkavidam azhaithu udhavi ketbadhillai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran-in anu sakdhi maiyangalai kurivaithu joon 12, 2025 andru Israel thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu. Idharku padhiladiyaaga Israel meedhu Iran evuganaigalai veesi thaakki varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil Iran-in thaakkudhalukkuk kaaranam Israel raanuvamdhaan endru kutramsaatti sondha naattu makkale raanuva veerargalaith thaakkiyadhaagas silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Thavare seythaalum kooda thangal naattai yaarum vittukkodukka maattaargal. Appadi irukka isreliyargale Israel raanuvathaith thaakkinaargal endra thagaval sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom.
Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai 2025 janavari 22m thedhi silar thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalil padhivittirundhanar. Adhaavadhu sameevathiya Israel – Iran por thodangudharku aindhu maadhangalukku munbe indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, hildaap enappadum Israel kudiyetrap payangaravaadhigal jerusalem nagaril vanmuraiyil eeduvattanar. Merku karai pagudhiyil nadandha modhalil irandu isreliyargalai Police suttuk kondradhaith thodarndhu vanmurai erpattadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu al jaseeraavil veliyaana seythi namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil isreliya kudiyerigal merku karai pagudhiyil ulla paalasdheena kiraamam ondrin meedhu karkalai veesi thaakkudhal nadathinar. Israel Police paadhugaappudan indha thaakkudhal nadandhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal adhil irandu per kollappattadhu thodarbaana vivaram illai.
Melum thediya podhu, indha sambavam thodarbaana virivaana vivarangal kidaikkavillai. Kidaitha thagavalai vaithup paarkkaiyil isreliya paalasdheeniya makkalukku idaiye modhal erpattulladhu. Adhaith thodarndhu isreliyargal vanmuraiyil eeduvattulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Vanmuraiyil eeduvattavargalai Police kaidhu seythullanar. Appodhu indha video edukkappattiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Ivai ellaam Iran meedhu thaakkudhal nadandhadharku Israel raanuva veerargalai Israel makkal thaakkiyadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: DMK amaicharavaik koottathil pangetra sendhil paalaaji endru paravum pazhaiya pugaippadathaal sarchai…
text:
‘‘padhaviyil illaamaleye DMK amaicharavaik koottathil pangetra sendhil paalaaji’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’koottam thodangiyadhu. Chennai-yil mudhalvar M.K. Stalin thalaimaiyil Tamil Nadu amaicharavaik koottam thodangiyadhu. Idaikkaala patjettil idamberum thittangal, adharkaana selavugal thodarbaaga aalosanai’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu pazhaiya pugaippadam endrum, thavarudhalaaga avasara kadhiyil idhanai oodagangal pagirndhullana endrum theriyavandhadhu.
Adhesamayam, melum sila oodagangal sariyaana pugaippadathai veliyittulladhaik kandom.
Idhanbadi, unmaiyaana pugaippadathil ‘’ sendhil paalaaji illaadhadhu, Duraimurugan anindhulla sattaiyin niram, Udhayanidhi pinnaal nirkum pen, M.K. Stalin kannaadi kazhattiyavadi iruppadhu,’’ ullitta veruvaadugalai thelivaagak kaanalaam.
Indha veruvaadu theriyaamal kadandha 2024m aandu oodagangalil erkanave veliyaana pugaippadathai, thavarudhalaaga sila oodagangal pagirndhu, kuzhappam erpaduthiyulladhu, thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda seythiyil thavaraana pugaippadam idambetrulladhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 50 aandugal pindhangiya Pakistan? Nerukkadiyaal kadharum makkal! Nadandhadhu enna?
text:
Mathiya kizhakku poraal erivorul nerukkadi theeviramadaindha nilaiyil, Pakistan arasu kadumaiyaana sikkana nadavadikkaigalai arivithulladhu. Pudhiya vaaganangal vaanga thadai, arasu vaagana erivorul 50% kuraippu, arasu selavugalil 5% vettu, velinaattu payanath thadai, thirumanangalil oru unavu mattume pondra kattuppaadugal amalil. Idhanaal porulaadhaaram 50 aandugal pindhangum avaayam ezhundhulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
anu aayudha thayaarippil eeduvaduvadhaaga koori, America matrum Israel aagiya naadugal inaindhu nadathiya koottuth thaakkudhalil, Iran perum paadhippugalai sandhithadhu. Idharku padhiladiyaaga, Israel meedhum, andai naadugalil ulla America-vin raanuva thalangal meedhum, Iran thaakkudhal nadathiyirundhadhu. Melum, thanadhu kattuppaattil irundha haarmus neerinaiyai moodiyadhaal, ulagam muzhuvadhum iyarkai erivaayu thattuppaadu uruvaanadhu. Ivvaaru iru tharappukkum idaiye nadandha porin kaaranamaaga, ulaga naadugal perum avadhikku aalaagina.
Indha nilaiyil, indha poraal erpatta paadhippil irundhu paagisdhaanaal innum meela mudiyavillai endrum, andha naattil kadum nerukkadi nilai needithu varugiradhu endrum thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. Adhaavadhu, mathiya kizhakku naadugalil nilavum porinaal theeviramadaindhulla erivorul nerukkadiyais samaalikkavum, athiyaavasiyamatra selavugalaik kuraikkavum Pakistan arasu kadumaiyaana sikkana nadavadikkaigalai arivithulladhu.
Indha utharavu udanadiyaaga amalukku varuvadhaaga Pakistan amaicharavai pirivu arivithulladhu. Kurippaaga, anaithu vagaiyaana pudhiya vaaganangalaiyum vaanga thadai, arasin vaaganangalukku odhukkappadum erivorulai 50 sadhaveedham kuraithal, arasu oozhiyargalin sambalam allaadha pira selavugalil, 5 sadhaveedhathai kuraithal pondra utharavugal, korona kaalathil vidhikkappatta kattuppaadugalai njaavagappaduthuvadhaaga ulladhu. Idhumattumindri, koottaatchi arasu oozhiyargal velinaadu selvadharku 3 maadhangalukku muzhuth thadai vidhikkappattulladhu.
Thavirkka mudiyaadha soozhnilaigalil amaichargal matrum adhigaarigal porulaadhaara vaguppup pirivileye payanam seyya vendum endru aanaiyittulla arasaangam, anaithu thirumana nigazhchigalilum ore oru unavu mattume parimaarappada vendum enavum therivikkappattulladhu. Mathiya kizhakku modhalgalaal ezhumbiyulla erisakdhi viniyogap patraakkurai matrum uyarndhuvarum enney vilaiyaik samaalikka Pakistan arasu indha adhiradi nadavadikkaigalai eduthulladhu. Indha kadum nerukkadiyaana soozhnilaiyaal, paagisdhaanin porulaadhaaram 50 aandugal varai pinnokki sendrirukka vaayppu iruppadhaaga, porulaadhaara nivunargal kanithullanar.

headline: Thi kaaviri poriyiyal kallooriyil mudhalaandu maanavar varaverpu vizhaa-
text:
Mecheri: mecheri thi kaaviri poriyiyal kallooriyil mudhalaam aandu maanavargalukkaana arimugam matrum varaverpu vizhaa nadandhadhu. Teen nandhagumaar(atmishan) varavetraar. Orunginaippaalar revadhi, kuthuvilakketri thodangi vaithaar.
Sirappu virundhinaraana, thiraippada nadigar kanesh vengat-raaman, maanavargal thanith thirangalai valarthu thozhil niruva-nangalin edhirbaarppukku erpa thayaar paduthikkolla arivu-ruthinaar. Melum avaradhu vaazhkkai savaalgalai pagirndhu kondaar.
Thi kaaviri kalvi niruvana kavurava thalaivar nadesan, pori-yiyal thuraiyin tharpodhaiya mukkiyathuvam kurithu eduthu-raithaar. Thalaivar anbazhagan, potti niraindha ulagukku erpa maanavargal, evvaaru thayaarbaduthikkolla vendum ena vilakkinaar.seyalar ilangovan, doctor apdhulgalaamin ponmo-zhigalai merkolgaatti, kalviyin magathuvathai unarth-thinaar. Inai seyalar harisangar, thaalaalar raamanaadhan, maana-vargalai ookkappaduthi pesinar.
Mudhalvar thuraisaami, thuraithalaivargalai maanavargalukkum, avargaladhu petrorgalukkum arimugappaduthinaar. Thervu kat-tuppaattaalar penjjamin laasaras, poriyiyal kalloori thuraithalaivargal, peraasiriyargal, maanavargal, petror pangetranar.

headline: Karaathe pottiyilgadhiravan palli asathal
text:
Tiruppur: thiruppooril nadandha sarvadhesa karaathe pottiyil, mangalam kadhiravan metrik melnilaippalli maanavargal asathinar.pottiyil, kadhiravan palliyai serndha, 32 per pangetranar.
Idhil, 12 per mudhalidam petru thangam vendranar. Irandaavadhu idathil, 7 per velli padhakkam, 13 per moondraamidam pidithu vengalam vendranar. Padhakkathudan saandridhazhum vazhangappattadhu. Saadhitha maanavargalai palli thaalaalar sreesaranyaa raajgumaar, porulaalar raajgumaar, palli mudhalvar, thunai mudhalvar ullitta palarum vaazhthinar.

headline: Pilippainsil palliyil 2 perai suttukkondru maanavanum tharkolai
text:
Pilippainsil palliyil 2 perai suttukkondru maanavanum tharkolai
manilaa: pilippainsil palliyil nadandha thuppaakkichoottil, thaakkudhalil eeduvatta maanavan utbada moondru per uyirizhandhanar.
Thengizhakku aasiya naadaana pilippainsil ulla therku kodavaatto maagaanathin paangaa nagaril, thesiya uyarnilaip palli seyalbadugiradhu. Angu netru mundhinam madhiya unavukku pin, 16 vayadhaana maanavar oruvar, vagupparaiyil saramaariyaaga thuppaakkichoodu nadathinaar.
Idhil iruvar uyirizhandha nilaiyil, thaakkudhalil eeduvatta maanavarum thannai thuppaakkiyaal suttu tharkolai seythaar. Idhil, ettu maanavargal kaayamadaindhanar. Paadhikkappatta anaivarum, 14 – 17 vayadhukku utbattavargal.
Thuppaakkis soodu nadathiya maanavan, madhiya unavukku mun, than nanbargalidam, ‘naan madhiya unavukku pin, en thittathai seyalbadutha pogiren. Adhanaal neengal veettirkus sellungal’ ena, kooriyadhaaga sollappadugiradhu. Thaakkudhalukkaana kaaranam kurithu Police visaarikkindranar.

headline: Roo.1.50 kodi kadathal thangam Trichy erborttil parimudhal
text:
Trichy: velinaattil irundhu kadathi varappatta, 1.50 kodi roobai madhippulla thangathai, Trichy vimaana nilaiyathil, kastams adhigaarigal parimudhal seythullanar.
Maleshiyaa thalainagar kolaalambooril irundhu, thiruchikku netru adhigaalai vandha vimaana payaniyarai, Trichy vimaana nilaiyathil kastams adhigaarigal sodhanaiyittanar. Appodhu, sandhegathukku idamaana, moondru payaniyarin kaippaiyai sodhanaiyittadhil, avatril, 1 kodi roobai madhippulla, 750 kiraam thanga seyingal irundhana. Avatrai adhigaarigal parimudhal seythanar.
Netru mundhinam, singappooril irundhu Trichy vandha 'er India eksbiras' vimaana payaniyarai, kastams adhigaarigal sodhanaiyitta podhu, oru payani, 50 latcham roobai madhippulla, 290 kiraam thangathai kadathi vandhadhu theriyavandhu, adhaiyum adhigaarigal parimudhal seythanar.

headline: Meendum adhigarikkum samaiyal enney vilai? Theevaavali nerungum nilaiyil 7%-8% vilai uyarvu?
text:
India thanadhu samaiyal enney thevaiyin 60% velinaadugalil irundhu irakkumadhi seygiradhu. Merkaasiyap por, roobai madhippu sarivu, kachaa enney vilai 8-11% uyarvu aagiya kaaranangalaal kadandha 6 maadhangalil 10-12% uyarndha vilai meendum 7-8% varai adhigarikkalaam. Irakkumadhi vari kuraippai arasu pariseelippadhu vilai nilaimaiyai theermaanikka ulladhu.
Merkaasiya por kaaranamaaga irakkumadhi selavugal adhigarippu, roobai madhippu sarivu ullitta kaaranangalaal enney vilai uyarthappada vaayppulladhaaga sandhai vattaarangal therivithullana.
Kadandha 6 maadhangalil mattum samaiyal enney vilai 2 thavanaiyaaga 10 mudhal 12% varai uyarthappattulladhu kurippidathakkadhu. Idharku pinnarum irakkumadhi seyyappadum kachaa samaiyal enney vilai 8 mudhal 11% adhigarithuvittadhaaga Indhiya samaiyal enney suthigarippu niruvanangal sangam therivithullana.
Merkaasiya por kaaranamaaga ulagalavil samaiyal enney vilai 15% adhigarithulladhaagavum anniruvanangal kooriyullana. India-vil samaiyal enneykku irakkumadhi variyai kuraikka arasu pariseelithu varuvadhaagavum arasin mudivu adippadaiyil merkondu vilai uyarvu irukkum endrum suthigarippu niruvanangal therivithullana. India thanadhu samaiyal enney thevaiyil sumaar 60 sadhaveedhathai velinaadugalil irundhu perugiradhu. Paamaayil, sooriyagaandhi enney, soyaaveen enney aagiyavai adhigalavil irakkumadhiyaagindrana.

headline: Thappi odum isreliyargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran nadathi varum evuganaith thaakkudhalilirundhu thappikka isreliyargal koottam koottamaaga veru idangalukku thappis selgindranar endru oru video

aayirak kanakkaana makkal saalaiyil nadandhu sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “Happy Trip” endru Israel kodiyudan ezhudhappattulladhu. Adhanudan andru naamum azhudhome valikkiradhu endrum ezhudhappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “netru appaavi paalasdheena makkalukku.vali kodutha ungalukkum adhe vali indru sondhamaagiradhu adhuvum engalukku valikkiradhu naam patta thunbam innoruvan padakkoodaadhu idhudhaan thaarmeegam aanaal vinai vidhaithavan vinaiyai aruthuthaane aagavendum azhudhazhudhu kanneer vatri nenjju kallaagi vittadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Matroru padhivil koodudhalaaga paalathil nadandhu sellum kaatchiyaiyum serthup padhivittirundhanar. Nilaith thagavalil, “engal makkal mullivaaykkaalil nadandhadhai marakkamaattaargal ippodhu kaasaavil makkal pattiniyaal thudithaargal aduthu Israel nadakkiradhu vinai vidhaithavan vinaiyai anuvavippaargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha veediyokkalai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Israel – Iran por irandaavadhu vaaramaaga thodarndhu kondirukkiradhu. Iran-in anusakdhi maiyangalai kurivaithu Israel thaakkudhal nadathi varugiradhu. Eeraanum isrelukku padhiladi alithu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil Iran-in thaakkudhalilirundhu thappikka isreliyargal nadandhu veru idangalukku idambeyarthu varuvadhaaga oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai joon 8m thedhiye palarum instaagiraam ullitta samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhaavadhu, Israel meedhu Iran padhiladi thaakkudhal nadathiyadharku kittathatta aindhu naatkalukku munbaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu. Joon 12-13m thedhidhaan thaakkudhale thodangiyadhu. Adharku munbaaga joon 8m thedhiye indha video veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idharkum Israel – Iran porukkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Joon 8m thedhi X thalathil veliyaana padhivai paarthom. Adhil makkal en koottamaaga selgiraargal enbadhu patri edhaiyum kurippidavillai. Vaazhthu pola padhivittirundhanar. Joon 10m thedhi veliyaana instaagiraam padhivil, “50 aayiram makkal anaithaiyum vittuvittu siluvaiyai pin thodargindranar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Thodarndha thediya podhu Russia-vil kirov endra nagaril ulla kirisdhava punidhar nigolas ninaivus sinnathai nokki makkal punidha payanam merkolvadhai vazhakkamaaga vaithullanar. Indha aandu 40 mudhal 50 aayiram makkal indha punidha payanathil pangetranar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha punidha payanathirku veligoretsgi endru peyarittu azhaikkindranar.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu joon 6m thedhi naam aayvukku eduthukkonda irandu veediyokkalaiyum vaithu oruvar veliyittirundha padhivu namakku kidaithu. Russia mozhiyilirundha padhivai mozhimaatram seythu paarthom. Adhilum, veligoretsgi oorvalathil 22 aayiram makkal kalandhu kondanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Kalandhu konda makkalin ennikkaiyil veruvaadugal irundhaalum anaithilum kirisdhava punidha yaathirai endru thelivaaga kurippittirundhanar. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil kooriyiruppadhu pondru idhu thaakkudhalukku payandhu isreliyargal veliyeriya kaatchi illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Karappaan poochi janadhaa katchiyinar haitrajan rail meedhu kal veesinaargalaa?
text:
‘‘haitrajan rail meedhu kal veesiya karappaan poochi janadhaa katchiyinar’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ India-vin adhinaveena mudhal haitrajan rail sevai thodangappatta sila kaalangalileye, telliyil naattin amaidhiyaik kulaikkum karappaan poochi pondra theeviravaadha sakdhigalaal ithagaiya vanmuraith thaakkudhal nadathappattiruppadhu miga vedhanaikkuriyadhu, poraattam endra peyaril podhus sothukkalaiyum naattin valarchiyaiyum sedhappaduthum idhuvondra azhivus sakdhigal meedhu mathiya arasu thayavudhaatchaniyamindri kadum nadavadikkai edukka vendum…,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan, ilainjargal rail nilaiyathirkul pugundhu, kal veesi thaakkuvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu peegaar maanilam paatnaavil rail thaamadham kaaranamaaga nigazhndha vanmurai sambavam thodarbaana video, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha 14.06.2026 andru peegaar maanilam paatnaavil ulla Patliputra Junction rail nilaiyathil rail ondru thaamadhamaaga vandhulladhu. Idhanaal, mukkiyamaana pottith thervu ondrai ezhudha iyalaamal ponadhaagavum, thangaladhu velaivaayppu paadhikkappattadhaagavum koori ilainjargal mutrugaip poraattathil eeduvattanar. Oru kattathil, maanavargalukkum, poleesaarukkum idaiye kadum modhal erpattu, karkal veesi, thaakkik kondanar. Idhudhodarbaana video-vai eduthu, NEET poraattathudan thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
India TV News l Times of India l Republic World
aduthappadiyaaga, India-vin mudhal Hydrogen rail sevai 17.07.2026 andrudhaan thodangappattadhu. Adhuvum, telliyil alla; Jind-Sonipat vazhithadathil… idhuvatri erkanave Northern Railway vilakkam alithulladhu.
Enave, oru maadhathirkum munbaaga nadaivetra sambavathai eduthu Hydrogen rail sevai matrum Neet poraattathudan serthu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “pengal naadaala vandhaal veettai yaar kavanippadhu” endru raagul kaandhi pesinaaraa?
text:
Pengalukku 33 sadhavigidha ida odhukkeedu endra peyaril kudumbam endra adippadai indhiyak kalaachaarathai BJP azhikkath thudikkiradhu. Pengal naadaala vandhaal veettai kavanippadhu yaar endru raagul kaandhi pesiyadhaaga oru news card

thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “raagul sarchai pechu. Pengalukku 33 sadhaveedha ida odhukkeedu endra peyaril kudumbam endra adippadai Indhiya kalaachaarathai BJP azhikka thudikkiradhu. Pengal naadu aala vandhaal veettil vayadhaanavargalaiyum, kuzhandhaigalaiyum, petrorgalaiyum kavanippadhu yaar endru pirachaarathin podhu kelvi ezhuppinaar” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pengalukku 33 sadhavigidha ida odhukkeettai vazhangak koodaadhu endru raagul kaandhi kooriyadhu pondrum, pengal veettu velaiyai seyya vendum endru kooriyadhu polavum news card ondraip palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Unmaiyil raagul kaandhi appadi pesiyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Adhe nerathil avar naadaalumandrathil pesiya video namakku YouTube-il kidaikkiradhu. Adhil engum pengalukku 33 sadhavigidha ida odhukkeedu kodukkak koodaadhu endru raagul kaandhi kooravillai.
Avar pesum podhu, “unmaiyil idhu magalir masodhaave illai. Idharkum pengalin munnetrathirkum endha thodarbum illai. Pengalukkaana masodhaa endru ondru ulladhu. Adhu 2023m aandu idhe avaiyil thaan niraivetrappattadhu. Ennudaiya BJP nanbargalum, aasiriyargalum indha magalir masodhaa 10 aandugalil nadaimuraippaduthappadum endru koorinaargal. Adhudhaan pengalukkaana masodhaa. Pengale nam naattin maiyap pulli. Indha avaiyil ulla ovvoruvarum, thangal vaazhvil thaayaaga, sagodhariyaaga, manaiviyaaga ulla pengalidamirundhu edhaavadhu ondraik katruk kondiruppaargal” endru pesiyirundhaar.
Unmai ippadi irukka, pengal arasiyalukku vandhaal veettil ullavargalai yaar kavanithukkolvadhu endru raagul kaandhi pirasaarathil pesiyadhaaga vadhandhiyaip parappiyullanar. Tamil Naattil therdhal pirasaaram merkolla vandha avar endha idathilum appadi pesiyadhaaga seythi illai. Enave, indha thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga indha news card-il ulla thamizh faant vazhakkamaaga thandhi TV veliyidum news kaardugalil ulladhu pol illai. Enave, idhuvum poliyaanadhu endru therigiradhu. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seythugolla aayvaith thodarndhom. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-il epral 18, 2026 endru thedhiyaik kurippittirundhanar. Andha kurippitta thedhiyil thandhi TV-yil veliyaana news kaardugalai paarthom. Raagul kaandhi thodarbaaga pala news kaardugalai veliyittirundhanar. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha news kaardum namakku kidaikkavillai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhu endru thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla indha news card-ai thandhi TV digital pirivu poruppaalarukku vaats ap moolam anuppinom. Avarum indha news card-ai thandhi TV veliyidavillai. Idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thaalivaangalaal thaduthu niruthappatta keralap pen.. Nadandha adhirchi sambavam!
text:
Keralaavais serndha payana vilaakkar arunimaa, thaniyaaga aapgaanisdhaanin paamiyaan pagudhiyil sutrulaa sendravodhu thaalivaan kattuppaattil ulla ulloor adhigaarigalaal thaduthu niruthappattaar. Aan thunai illaamal payanam seythadhu vidhimeeral ena koori avaradhu paasbort, visaa sodhanai seyyappattadhaal, kaidhu achathil samooga valaidhalathil Indhiya thoodharaga udhavi korinaar. Pinnar pechuvaarthaiyaal viduvikkappattaar.
Seythiyaalar- M. Meeraa
keralaavin paalakkaadu maavattam ottappaalathais serndha arunimaa ai.pi., ‘Backpacker Arunima’ endra peyaril payana veediyokkalai veliyittu varugiraar. Sameevathil thaniyaaga aapgaanisdhaanukku sendra avar, paamiyaan pagudhiyil edhirbaaraadha sikkalai edhirgondaar.
Angu ulloor adhigaarigal avaradhu paasbort matrum visaavai sodhanai seythadhudan, aan thunai alladhu vazhigaatti illaamal thaniyaagap payanam seythadhu vidhimeeral enak kooriyadhaaga arunimaa therivithullaar. Munnadhaaga jalaalaavaathilum thaniyaagap payanam seytha kaaranathaal avarukku anumadhippathiram vazhangappadavillai ena avar kooriyullaar.
Indhas soozhalil kaidhu seyyappadalaam ena achamadaindha arunimaa, samooga valaidhalathil avasara udhavi kori, Indhiya thoodharagathai thodarbugolla udhavumaaru kettukkondaar. Pinnar ulloor thodarbugal moolam adhigaarigaludan pechuvaarthai nadathappattu, avar angirundhu sella anumadhikkappattadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Pinnar thaan paadhugaappaaga iruppadhaaga arunimaa therivithaar. Melum, “naan oru pen enbadharkaagave ithanai sikkalgalai sandhikka vendiyirundhadhu” endru avar thanadhu anuvavathaip pagirndhullaar

headline: Silindar kidaikkaamal siramappatta Kovai roo.1 itli paatti; udhavikkaram neettiya amaichar sambath
text:
Amaichar sambathgumaar arivuruthalinberil, oru roobai itli paatti kamalaathaalukku indru mudhal thadaiyindri kattanamillaa silindar vazhanga maavatta aatchiyar pavangumaar utharavittullaar.
Kovai maavattam vadivelambaalaiyam pagudhiyil ezhai, eliya thozhilaalargalin pasi theerkkum vagaiyil pala aandugalaaga verum 1 roovaaykku kamalaathaal paatti itli vazhangi varugiraar.
Paattiyin indhas sevaikkaaga thaniyaar niruvanam saarbil vazhangappattu vandha ilavasa samaiyal erivaayu urulaigal tharpodhu sariyaagak kidaikkaamal irundhu vandhadhu. Idhanaal paatti viragugalais segarithum, veettilulla siriya aduppaip payanbaduthiyum itli suda vendiya kattaayathirkuth thallappattullaar.
Viragu aduppin kadum veppathilum, pugaikkum naduve nindru kuraindha alavilaana itligalaiye sudum kamalaathaal paattiyayin udal uzhaippum, adharkaagas selavidum neramum irattippaagiyadhu.
Iruppinum mudhumai matrum udalnalak kuraivu ullitta pirasnaigalaith thaandi, oru roovaaykku itli tharuvadhai niruthi vidaamal thodarndhu vandhaar.
Idhanidaiye thodarndhu kiyaas silindar kidaikka nadavadikkai edukkumaaru kamalaathaal paatti Kovai maavatta aatchiyar pavangumaaridam manu alithaar.
Idhu kurithu kamalaathaal paatti kooriyadhaavadhu, ”aimbadhu varusamaa itli suduren. Eppavum en itli oru roovaaythaan. Indha 2 maasamaa silindar kidaikkaama thattuppaada irukku. Idhanaala itli sariyaa suda mudiyala. Kadaikku varavanga en itli suduvadhillai paattinu ketkuraanga.
Kes illa saaminu naan sollittu irukken. Kaasu irukkuravanga vera kadaikkup poyi saappiduvaanga. Kaasu illaadha romba ezhaiga eppadis saappiduvaanga? Pasiyodu varavangalai verum vayitrodu anupparadhu kashdamaa irukku.
Kes aayirathu nooru roovaakku vikkudhu. Adhai vaangi itli suttu oru roovaaykkuth thara mudiyumaa? Irundhaalum ennaala mudindhalavu itli suttu tharen. Enakku thandhittu irundha kes meendum kidaichaa nallaayirukkum” endraar.
Indhak kaatchigal vairalaana nilaiyil pirpaduthappattor nalathurai amaichar sambathgumaar arivuruthalinberil, oru roobai itli paatti kamalaathaalukku indru mudhal thadaiyindri kattanamillaa silindar vazhanga maavatta aatchiyar pavangumaar utharavittullaar. Idhu kamalaathaal paattikku magizhchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline:
Pigaarai moozhgaditha vellam!
40 latcham makkal paadhippu 
nevaalap peruvellamdhaan kaaranamaa?
text:
Pigaarai moozhgaditha vellam! 40 latcham makkal paadhippu nevaalap peruvellamdhaan kaaranamaa?
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
imayamalaiyil ulla panippaarai udaindhusila naatkalukku munbu, erpatta thideer peruvellathaal nevaalathin pala pagudhigal kadumaiyaaga paadhikkappattana. Indhap peruvellathil sikki 1,300-kkum adhigamaanor uyirizhandhadhaagavum, 5,000-kkum merpattor kaanavillai. Idhaiyaduthu, nevaalathai ottiyulla Indhiya maanilangalilum munnecharikkai nadavadikkaigal merkollappattu, echarikkaiyum vidukkappattirundhadhu. Innilaiyil, tharpodhu pigaaril erpattulla vellapperukkaal appagudhi makkalin iyalbu vaazhkkai mutrilum paadhikkappattulladhu. Aanaal, pigaaril erpattulla indha vellapperukkukku nevaalathil erpatta peruvellam kaaranamalla endru ammaanila adhigaarigal tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.
Pigaaril kadandha sila naatkalaaga kanamazhai peythu varugiradhu. Idhan kaaranamaaga kangai aatril vellapperukku erpattulladhu. Pigaar maanila vaanilai aayvu maiyam (DMD) thagaval padi paagalbooril ulla suldhaanganjjil kangai nadhiyin neermattam, 36.78 meettaraagap padhivaagiyulladhu. Idhu, 2021-aam aandu aagast 17-aam thedhi padhivaana mundhaiya adhigavatcha vella neer mattamaana 36 meettaraith thaandiyulladhu idhan kaaranamaagave vellapperukku erpattulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Kangai mattumindri, nevaalathin neerppidippup pagudhigalil irundhu paayum kandak, kosi, thigaa, hadhidhaa ullitta mukkiya aarugalilum vellam karai purandodugiradhu. Idhanaal thalainagar paatnaa ullitta palveru maavattangal vellathaal paadhikkappattullana. Ammaanila peridar melaanmaith thuraiyin thagavalgalinbadi, paatnaa, pojboor, saran, vaishaali, paagalboor ullitta 14 maavattangal vellathaal kadumaiyaaga paadhikkappattullana.
Idhan kaaranamaaga sumaar 40 latchathu 21 aayiram makkal vellathaal paadhikkappattulladhaagath therivikkappattulladhu. Veedugal, saalaigal, sandhaigal matrum vivasaaya nilangal neeril moozhgiyullana. Vellam soozhndha kudiyiruppup pagudhigalil sikkiyulla makkalaip padagugal moolam meetkum panigal thodarndhu nadaivetru varugindrana. Vella neer soozhndhulla pagudhigalil saalaigal thundikkappattulladhaal makkalin iyalbu vaazhkkai kadumaiyaaga paadhikkappattulladhu.

headline: Em.pi-yin kelvikku padhil koora thinariya Modi, amaichargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Naadaalumandrathil edhirkkatchi uruppinar ezhuppiya kelvigalukku padhil koora mudiyaamal piradhamar ullitta BJP mootha nirvaagigal, amaichargal thinariyadhu pondru oru video

em.pi oruvar pesa pesa piradhamar narendhira Modi, utharappiradhesa mudhalvar yogi aadhithyanaath, nidhiyamaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman aagiyor padhil koora mudiyaamal thinariyavadi avarai paarppadhu pondru oru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kelvi ketkappadumbodhu #sangeegalin #moonjjigalai paarungal…🤣🤣🤣🤭 #puldosar vaithu #miratti makkalai #kelvi ketka vidaamal senjjadhu thaandaa unga #saadhanai. Kadandha #kaalangalil unavup porutkalin #vilai? #ippo enna #vilai? Idhellaam #ungalukku eppadidaa theriyum? #midil kilaas #pirachinai edhuvum theriyaadha nee #visvaguruvaa ? Mayi..kuruvaa ? #seruppadi kelvigal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naadaalumandrathil edhirkkatchi em.pi oruvar pesum podhu padhil koora mudiyaamal piradhamar ullittavargal thinariyadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Idhil thideerendru utharappiradhesa mudhalamaichar yogi aadhithyanaathum varugiraar. Avarum padhil koora mudiyaamal nirpadhu pondru video ulladhu. Naadaalumandrathil maanila mudhalamaichargalai ellaam pesa anumadhikka maattaargal. Idhu edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu thelivaagath therindhadhu. Indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video kidaikkavillai. Aanaal, video-vil pesuvavar thirinaamul Congress em.pi sayoni kosh (Sayani Ghosh) enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naadaalumandrathin Sansad TV-yin YouTube pakkathil sayoni kosh pesiya veediyokkalil irundhu adhai thedi eduthom. Naadaalumandra nigazhvugalai thaniyaar video eduthu veliyida mudiyaadhu. Naadaalumandrathin Sansad TV mattume video eduthu veliyidum. Appadi Sansad TV veliyittirundha video-vil edit seythiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Andha video-vai muzhumaiyaaga paarthom. Adhil piradhamar narendhira Modi appodhu avaiyil illai enbadhu therindhadhu. Mathiya nidhiyamaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman avaiyilirundhu uruppinarin pechai ketkiraar. Matravadi piradhamar, utharappiradhesa mudhalvar yogi aadhithyanaath ellaam andha video-vil illai. Piradhamarin video kaatchiyai mattum eduthu koogul lens thalathil padhivittu thedinom. Appodhu adhu 2025m aandu patjet thaakkal seyyappatta podhu edukkappattadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhan moolam naadaalumandrathil thirinaamul Congress embi-yin kelvikku padhil alikka mudiyaamal piradhamar, nidhiyamaichar ullittor thinarinar endru paravum video edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Pengalidam silmisham seythavargalukku thandanai kodutha aandhira Police endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘pengalidam silmisham seythavargalukku thandanai kodutha aandhira Police,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ ponnunga kitta ini silmisham pannuveenga!
Aandhira Police kalloori pengalidam silmisham seythavargalukku thakka paadam sollik kodutha video viral,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan moondru perai saalaiyil amara vaithu, Police lathiyaal thaakkum kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu. 
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippada seythi unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu paaliyal seendal pugaar thodarbaana seythi illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha 2025m aandu aandhiraa maanilam kundoor maavattathil (Guntur Urban Police District) ulla Tenali I Town Police Station ellaikku ulbatta Lingaraju Centre endra idathil merkanda sambavam nigazhndhulladhu. Sambandhappatta 3 perum kanjjaa payanbaduthiyadhaagavum, adhanai thattik ketta poleesaarai thaakkiyadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Idhanberil avargalukku Police ivvaaru podhumakkal munnilaiyil thandanai vazhangiyullanar. Idharkum, Eve Teasing pugaarukkum endha thodarbum illai.
Idhudhodarbaaga, Police nilaiyathilum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom. Palveru oodagangalilum erkanave idhuvatri seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…

enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval nambagamaanadhu illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Soppu, parpasaikku saiva, asaivak kuriyeedu.. Mathiya arasu adhiradi thirutham!
text:
Unavup porutkalaip pola soppu, shaambu, parpasai pondra andraadap payanbaattu porutkalilum saivam, asaivam kuriyeedu kattaayam ena mathiya arasu satta alaviyal vidhigal 2011ai thiruthi udanadi amalukku kondu vandhulladhu. Vilanguk kozhuppu ulla porutkalukku sivappu alladhu pazhuppu pulli, illaadhavatrukku pachai pulli achida utharavu pirappikkappattulladhu.
Unavup porutkalaip polave, soppu, shaambu, parpasai ullitta andraadap payanbaattup porutkalilum 'saivam alladhu asaivam' enbadharkaana kuriyeedugalaip padhikkum vagaiyil pekkejing vidhigalil mathiya arasu thirutham konduvandhulladhu.
Idhanbadi, vilanguk kozhuppu serkkappattadhai asaivam endru kurikkum vagaiyil sivappu alladhu pazhuppu nirap pulliyum vilanguk kozhuppu serkkappadaadha porutkalil pachai nirap pulliyum, achida utharavidappattulladhu.
Idharkaaga satta alaviyal vidhigal 2011il seyyappattulla indhath thirutham udanadiyaaga amalbaduthappattulladhu.

headline: Petti vaangiya vaigo endru paravum edit seyyappatta pugaippadam!
text:
Aadhav arjunaavidam irundhu petti vaangiya madhimuga podhus seyalaalar vaigo endru oru pugaippadam

amaichar aadhav arjunaavidamirundhu madhimuga podhus seyalaalar vaigo petti vaanguvadhu pondru alladhu koduppadhu pondru pugaippadam ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “petti vaangiya kovaalasaami mavan! Ada pedhila povaan vilakkumaaru pinjjirum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
DMK koottaniyilirundhu ma.thi.mu.ka vilaga mudiveduthulladhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Joon 27m thedhi nadaivera ulla ma.thi.mu.ka podhuk kuzhuk koottathil koottani thodarbaana mudivu edukkappadum endru koorappadugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil vaigovaith Thamizhaga amaichar aadhav arjunaa sandhithup pesinaar. Idhaith thodarndhu TVK koottaniyil ma.thi.mu.ka inaiyum endru koorappadugiradhu.
Indha sandhippin podhu vaigovukku panap pettiyai aadhav arjunaa vazhangiyadhu pondru pugaippadam samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Panam kodukkal vaangal ellaam ivvalavu velippadaiyaaga nadaiveraadhu. Melum, ippadi oru pugaippadathai TVK tharappilirundho ma.thi.mu.ka tharappilirundho veliyidavillai. Enave, DMK koottaniyilirundhu vilaguvadhaal andha koottaniyin aadharavaalargal ippadi pugaippadathai edit seythu veliyittirukkalaam. Enave, indha pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu enbadhai ariya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil aadhav arjunaavin samooga oodaga pakkangalilirundhu vaigo sandhippu thodarbaana padhivai eduthom. Adhil, puthagam koduppadhu pondru pugaippadam irundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai edit seythu thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya eai pugaippadangalaik kandariya udhavum inaiyathalathil indha pugaippadathaip padhivetri aayvu seythom. Andha inaiyathalam indha pugaippadam eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru urudhi seythadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Putrunoy meendum varuvadhaith thadukkum pudhiya thaduppoosi.. Maruthuva aayvil oru pudhiya mailgal!!
text:
Putrunoy meendum varuvadhaiyum adhu, pira uruppugalukkup paravuvadhaiyum perumalavil kattuppaduthum ulagin mudhal ‘thaninavar putrunoy thaduppoosi’ maruthuva aayvil perum vetriyaip petrulladhu. Merk matrum maadarnaa niruvanangal inaindhu uruvaakkiyulla ‘indismeran’ endra indhath thaduppoosi, putrunoy maruthuvath thuraiyil oru pudhiya mailgallaagap paarkkappadugiradhu. Ovvoru noyaaliyin putrunoy sellilum ulla kurippitta puradhangalai adaiyaalam kandu, 'mRNA' thozhilnutbam moolam ithaduppoosi pirathyegamaagath thayaarikkappadugiradhu.
Idhu udalin noy edhirppu mandalathirkup putrunoy selgalaik kandarindhu azhikkum ninaivaatralai vazhanguvadhaaga koorugindranar. Piravala 'keethrudaa' marundhudan inaindhu vazhangappadugaiyil, idhu thol putrunoy meendum vandhu erpadum irappu avaayathai 49 sadhaveedhamaagavum, pira uruppugalukkup paravuvadhaal erpadum irappai 59 sadhaveedhamaagavum kuraikkiradhu ena idhan aayvaalargal therivithullanar. Indha 'mRNA' thozhilnutbathai matra vagai putrunoygalukkum virivaakka mudiyum enbadhu putrunoy sigichaiyil migapperiya nambikkaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Veliye payirai meyndhadhaal kaduppaana es.pi... Insbekdarai sasbent seythu nadavadikkai!
text:
`raathiri neram... Romba lettaagivittadhu’ endru solli kaidhuseyyappatta iruvaraiyum veettu valaagathileye padukkavaithirukkiraar sanmugam.
Kutkaa kadathalaith thadukkavendiya poleesaare, kadathalgaarargaludan koottuppottu, avargalaith thappikkavaitha insbekdar utbada moondru per paniyidai neekkam seyyappattirukkum sambavam Thanjavur Police vattaarathil paravarappai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Thanjavur merku kaaval nilaiya insbekdar sanmugathin arivuruthalinbadi, ettu kavudhamanum kaavalar azhagarsaami yum aagast 10-m thedhi iravu Thanjavur maavattam, irumbuthalaiyilulla oru veettil sodhanai nadathi, 40 moottai kutkaavaip parimudhal seythirukkiraargal. Athudan aarumugam, murugan aagiya iruvaraik kaidhuseythu, kutkaavudan insbekdar sanmugam veettukku azhaithus sendrullanar. Adhan piragu, vazhakku padhivu seyyaamal kutkaa kadathalgaarargaludan koottus serndhu avargalai thappikkavaithadhaaga sanmugathin meedhu kutrachaattu ezhundhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, es.pi visaaranaiyil vivagaaram urudhiyaanadhaith thodarndhu, sanmugam utbada moondru poleesaar sasbent seyyappattullanar.
Idhu kurithu ul vivarangal arindhavargalidam pesinom. ``pengaloorilirundhu Thanjavur, ammaavettai pagudhikkuk kadandha aagast 10-m thedhi iravu car moolam kutkaa kadathappaduvadhaaga merku kaaval nilaiya poleesaarukku infaarmar oruvar moolam thagaval kidaithirukkiradhu. Udane sanmugam, kavudhaman, azhagarsaami moondru perum vaagana sodhanaiyil eeduvattirukkindranar. Idharkidaiye sanmugam veru panikkus sendruvittaar.
Indha nilaiyil, kutkaa kadathiyavargal ammaavettai irumbuthalaiyil iruppadhaagath thagaval kidaikka, avargalaip pidithuvarumaaru insbekdar sanmugam, kavudhamanaiyum azhagarsaamiyaiyum anuppivaithirukkiraar. Adhanbadi angu sendravargal oru veettil padhungiyirundha iruvaraiyum kaidhuseythadhudan, angu adukkivaikkappattirundha 40 moottai kutkaavaiyum parimudhal seythanar. Melum veettil irundha sumaar onne kaal latcham roovaayaiyum kaippatriyirukkiraargal.
Appodhu kaidhaana aarumugam, murugan tharappu, `idhu adaguvaitha nagaiyaith thiruppuvadharkaaga vaithirukkum panam saar, engalidam koduthuvidungal’ endru kenjjiyirukkiraargal. `edhuvaaga irundhaalum station-il pesikkollalaam’ endru solli izhuthus sendrullanar. Indha nadavadikkai vivarathai, kaavalargalukkena ulla WhatsApp kurooppil pottovudan kavudhaman pagirndhirukkiraar. Idhaith thodarndhu parimudhal seyyappatta kutkaa, panathudan kaidhuseythavargalai steshanukku azhaithus sellaamal insbekdar sanmugathin veettukkus sendru oppadaithirukkindranar.
`raathiri neram... Romba lettaagivittadhu’ endru solli kaidhuseyyappatta iruvaraiyum veettu valaagathileye padukkavaithirukkiraar sanmugam. Vidindhadhum kaidhuseyyappatta iruvar kaiyilum thalaa roo.1,000 selavukkuk koduthu, `nadandhadhu edhaiyum veliyila sollaadheenga’ endru kutkaavaiyum koduthu, thiruppi anuppi vaithirukkiraar. Ivargalaith thappikkavaikka parimudhal seyyappatta panathudan koodudhalaaga lanjjam vaangikkondadhaagas solgiraargal. Kidaitha panathil kavudhaman, azhagarsaami iruvarukkum insbekdar sanmugam pangu koduthirukkiraar.
`vaatsap kurooppil kutkaa parimudhalaana vivarangalaip padhivittanare... Adhu thodarbaana vazhakku edhuvum padhivuseyyappadavillaiye...’ endru es.pi sundharavadhanam kelvi ezhuppa, sanmugathidamirundhu muraiyaana padhil varavillai. Udane veru Police teemai irakki visaarikkavaithirukkiraar es.pi. Adhildhaan kutkaa kadathiyavargaludan koottus serndhu lanjjam petrukkondu kaidhuseyyappatta iruvaraiyum thappikka vaithadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhaith thodarndhu, aarumugamum muruganum meendum kaidhu seyyappattadhudan, kutkaavum parimudhal seyyappattadhu.
Es.pi sundharavadhanam parindhuraiyin peril, Thanjavur saraga ti.ai.ji jiyaa ul hak, insbekdar sanmugam utbada moondru peraiyum paniyidai neekkam seythaar. `udhayanidhi kaidhu vivagaarathil thanjjaavooril poraattam nadathiya thi.mu.ka-vinar, tha.ve.ka-vinar idaiye modhal erpadum soozhal uruvaanadhu. Idhai muraiyaagak kaiyaalavillai. Online laattari virpanaiyaik kandugollaamal irukka maamool kettirukkiraar. Laattari virpavargal saarbil vakkeel oruvar vandhu sanmugathidam maamool koduthadhai vaangaamal online laattari nadathugiravaraiye neradiyaaga varavaithu, koodudhalaaga vaangikkondaar...’ idhuvol sanmugathin meedhu pala sarchaigal thodarndhu ezhundhuvandha nilaiyil nadavadikkai paayndhirukkiradhu’’ endranar.
Idhu kurithu Thanjavur maavatta es.pi sundharavadhanathidam pesinom. ``kutkaa kadathiyavargalidam muraiyaaga visaarithuk kaidhuseyyaamal insbekdar sanmugam thappikkavaithaar. Visaaranaiyil idharkaana mugaandhiram irundhadhaal, sanmugam utbada moovarum sasbent seyyappattullanar. Indha vivagaarathil melum visaaranai thodargiradhu’’ endraar.
Ethanai naalaikkuthaan veliye payirai meyum?

headline: Kaangirasudan adhirupdhi kaaranamaaga modiyai sandhitha jaargant mudhalvar endru paravum pugaippadam – unmaiyaa?
text:
Congress katchiyudan erpatta adhirupdhi kaaranamaaga thanadhu manaiviyudan piradhamar narendhira modiyai sandhitha jaargant mudhalamaichar hemanth soran endru oru pugaippadam

jaargant mudhalamaichar hemanth soran than manaiviyudan piradhamar narendhira modiyai sandhitha pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “#jaargandil Congress katchiyudan adhirupdhiyil irukkum mudhalvar hemanth soranum, avaradhu manaiviyum piradhamar modiyudan sandhippu!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Sila padhivugalil sivu soran maraivin podhu piradhamar narendhira Modi neril vandhu anjjali seluthiya pugaippadathaiyum inaithu padhividappattirundhadhu. Andha padhivugalil, “jaargandil Congress katchiyudan adhirupdhiyil irukkum mudhalvar hemanth soranum, avaradhu manaiviyum piradhamar modiyudan sandhippu!
#munnadhaaga sivusoran maraivukku piradhamar Modi neradiyaaga sendru aarudhal kooriyadhu ninaivirukkalaam! #jaarkkandil BJP koottani aatchi vara vaayppaa??” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadangalaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
India koottaniyil miga mukkiyath thalaivargalul oruvaraaga iruppavar jaargant mudhalamaichar hemanth soran. Ivar sameeva naatkalaaga Congress katchi meedhu adhirupdhiyil iruppadhaagavum adhanaal India koottaniyilirundhu vilagi endie koottaniyil inaiyap povadhaagavum oodagangalil seythi veliyaagi varugiradhu. Avar veliyeruvaaraa, illaiyaa endra aayvukkul naam sellavillai.
Kaangirasudan adhirupdhi kaaranamaaga thannudaiya manaiviyudan piradhamar narendhira modiyai sandhithaar endru pugaippadathai padhivittu varugindranar. Indha sandhippu unmaiyaa endru mattum aayvu seythom. Hemanth soran piradhamar narendhira modiyai sameevathil sandhithadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Appadi irukka pugaippadam mattum eppadi unmaiyaaga irukkum endra kelvi ezhugiradhu.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2024m aandu jaargant sattamandra therdhalil vetri petra piragu, adutha mudhalvaraaga porupperpadharku munbu piradhamar narendhira modiyai avar sandhithadhaaga indha pugaippadathai oodagangal veliyittirundhana. Jaargant maanila mudhalvaraaga porupperka irundha hemanth soran, thannudaiya padhaviyerpu vizhaavil pangerkumbadi piradhamar narendhira Modi-kku azhaippu viduthaar endru andha seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda indha pugaippadathai ANI seythi niruvanamum kooda 2024 navambar 26m thedhi veliyittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Adhil indha pugaippadathai piradhamar aluvalagam veliyittirundha padhivilirundhu eduthadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Adhan adippadaiyil piradhamar aluvalaga pakkathil thedip paarthom. Appodhu, indha pugaippadathudan koodiya padhivai piradhamar aluvalagam 2024 navambar 26m thedhi veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam 2025l Congress katchiyudan erpatta adhirupdhi kaaranamaaga piradhamarai sandhitha podhu indha pugaippadam edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Panruttiyil paravarappu - mudhalvar marundhaga pen oozhiyarukku kathikkuthu!
text:
Panrutti kaamaraaj nagaril ulla Thamizhaga mudhalvar marundhagathil paniyaatrum 23 vayadhu thivyaa meedhu, pazhakkamulla sandhosh endra ilainjar thideerena marundhagathukkul nuzhaindhu kathiyaal palamurai kuthiyadhaal paravarappu erpattadhu. Kadumaiyaaga kaayamadaindha thivyaa arugilulla arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppappattaar. Podhumakkal sandhoshai pidithu araiyil pootti vaithu Police-ukku oppadaithanar.
Panrutti kaamaraaj nagaril seyalbattuvarum Thamizhaga mudhalvar marundhagathil kadandha irandu aandugalaaga paniyaatri varum thivyaa (vayadhu 23) enbavar vazhakkambol paniyil irundhavodhu, marundhagathirku vandha vaalivar oruvar ulle nuzhaindhu avarai kathiyaal saramaariyaaga kuthiyullaar.
Idhil padugaayamadaindha avarin sathamgettu akkambakkathinar odi vandhu avarai kaappaatri panrutti arasumaruthuvamanaikku sigichaikkaaga anuppi vaithanar. Kathiyaal kuthiya navarai podhumakkal pidithu araiyil pootti vaithu kaavaldhuraikku thagaval koduthanar.
Innilaiyil kaavaldhurai visaaranaiyil kathiyaal kuthiya navar sandhosh enbadhu theriyavandhulladhu. Avarai kaavalnilaiyathil vaithu Police theevira visaaranai nadathi varugindranar. Thivyaavukkum sandhoshukkum 5 aandugalaaga pazhakkam irundhadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu.

headline: Periyaar pirandhanaal: palagaarap pettagam veliyittadhaa adaiyaaru aanandha pavan?
text: Periyaar pirandhanaal kaaranamaaga adaiyaaru aanandha pavan sirappu palagaarap pettagam veliyittadhu.
investigation_details:
Ithagaval thavaraanadhaagum. Thiraavidak kazhagame palagaarap pettagam vazhangugindradhu.
Periyaar pirandhanaal kaaranamaaga adaiyaaru aanandha pavan sirappu palagaarap pettagam veliyittadhaaga pugaippadam ondru samooga valaithalangalil paravi varugindradhu.
Adaiyaaru aanandha pavan niruvanathirku aadharavaagavum edhiraagavum indhap pugaippadam pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Samooga valaithalangalil paravum ithagaval kurithu niyoossekkar thamizh saarbil aaraayndhu unmaiyai vilakka mudivu seythom.
Fact Check/Verification
adaiyaaru aanandha pavan periyaar pirandhanaal kaaranamaaga sirappu palagaarap pettagam veliyittadhaaga thagaval ondru paraviyadhai thodarndhu athagaval kurithu aaraayndhom.
Mudhalil adaiyaaru aanandha pavan niruvanathai thodarbukkondu ithagaval kurithu visaarithom. Avargal “ithagaval thavaraanadhu. Adaiyaaru aanandha pavan periyaar pirandhanaalukkaaga sirappu pettagam edhuvum veliyidavillai” ena therivithanar.
Idhanaiyaduthu aaraaygaiyil thiraavidar kazhagathin adhigaarappoorva Facebook pakkathil periyaar pirandhanaalaiyotti palagaarap pettagam vazhanguvadhaaga padhivittiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Idhugurithu thiraavidar kazhagathais serndha kalaimaniyai thodarbugondu visaarithom. Thiraavidar kazhagame periyaar pirandhanaalaiyotti palagaarap pettagathai vazhanguvadhaaga avar therivithaar.
Melum, aardar adippadaiyil panam petrukkondu palagaarap pettagangalai thayaarithu vazhanguvadharku adaiyaaru aanandha pavan niruvanathudan erpaadu seyyappattirundhadhaagavum, samooga valaithalangalil anniruvanathirku edhiraaga padhivugal pagirappattu varuvadhaal tharpodhu andha erpaattil thayakkam erpattulladhaagavum avar therivithaar.
Idhuvarai kidaitha aadhaarangalinbadi paarkkaiyil adaiyaaru aanandha pavan niruvanam periyaar pirandhanaalaiyotti palagaarap pettagam veliyittadhaaga paravum thagaval oru thirivu (Misleading) thagaval ena thelivaagindradhu.
Unmaiyil thiraavidar kazhagame palagaarap pettagam veliyidugindradhu.
Also Read: Vijay mudhalamaicharaana piragu es.e.sandhirasegar BMW car vaanginaaraa? Unmai enna?
Conclusion
adaiyaaru aanandha pavan periyaar pirandhanaal kaaranamaaga sirappu palagaarap pettagam veliyittadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhaagum.
Thiraavidar kazhagathin palaagaarap pettagathai adaiyaaru aanandha pavan veliyittadhaaga thirithu parappappadugindradhu.
Indha unmaiyaanadhu kidaitha aadhaarangalin vaayilaaga thelivaagiyulladhu. Aagave vaasagargal yaarum ithagavalai namba vendaam endru niyoossekkar thamizh saarbil kettuk kolgindrom.

headline: Saattai Duraimurugan matrum jooli ragasiya sandhippu endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
