headline: Landan sendra M.K. Stalin thiruneeru poosiya thiruvalluvar silaiyai vananginaaraa?
text:
‘’landan sendra M.K. Stalin thiruneeru poosiya thiruvalluvar silaiyai vananginaar,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ Tamil Nadu aaga irundhaal vivoodhiyai azhithu vellai tiras pottu vitturuppaanga. Landanla enna seyya mudiyum.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan M.K. Stalin kot soot anindhu, thiruvalluvar silaiyai vananguvadhu pondra pugaippadam inaikkappattulladhu. Thiruvalluvar silaiyin netriyil thiruneeru poosappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu unmaiyaana pugaippadam kidaiyaadhu enavum, edit seyyappatta ondru enavum, theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, landan sendra Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin, angulla SOAS palgalaikkazhaga valaagathil vaikkappatta thiruvalluvar silaikku mariyaadhai seluthinaar.
Idhudhodarbaana pugaippadam M.K. Stalin-in adhigaarappoorva samooga valaidhala pakkangalil pagirappattulladhu.
Idhevondru, SOAS palgalaikkazhagamum sila maadhangalukku mun kurippitta thiruvalluvar silai thodarbaana padhivu ondrai veliyittulladhu. Aanaal, indha padhivugalil ulla thiruvalluvar silaiyin netriyil thiruneeru pattai edhuvum kaanappadavillai.
Idhanmoolamaaga, thiruvalluvar silaiyin mugathai edit seythu, thiruneeru pattai vaikkappattulladhaagak koori, arasiyal ulnokkathudan vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Irudhiyaaga, DMK ai.ti., pirivilum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam edit seyyappatta ondru, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vaazhnaal muzhudhum sirai thandanai vidhikka amarvu needhimandrathirku adhigaaram illai: ucha Needhimandram adhiradi theerppu
text:
'vaazhnaal muzhudhum' sirai thandanai vidhikka amarvu needhimandrathirku adhigaaram illai: ucha Needhimandram adhiradi theerppu
Pudhudilli: 'kolai kutravaali oruvarukku thandanai alikkumbodhu, avar vaazhnaal muzhudhum siraiyileye irukka vendum endru amarvu Needhimandram utharavida mudiyaadhu' ena, ucha Needhimandram theerppalithulladhu.
Kadandha 2009l, panjjaavin loodhiyaanaavil pingi endra pennum, avaradhu 8 matrum 5 vayadhu magalgal iruvarum kollappattanar. 2014l indha vazhakkai visaaritha visaaranai Needhimandram, naval kishor ullitta iruvarai kutravaaligal ena arivithadhu. Iruvarum vaazhnaal muzhudhum siraiyil irukka vendum endra utharavittadhudan thalaa, 2,500 roobai avaraadham vidhithadhu.
Indha utharavai edhirthu, panjjaap matrum hariyaanaa uyar needhimandrathil kutravaaligal melmuraiyeedu seythanar. Indha manu thalluvadi seyyappattadhai aduthu, ucha needhimandrathil avargal muraiyittanar. Indha vazhakku, needhivadhigal aravinth kumaar matrum vivul em. Panjjoli aagiyor adangiya amarvu mun visaaranaikku vandhadhu. Appodhu needhivadhigal pirappitha utharavu vivaram:
aayul thandanai enbadhu kutravaaliyin vaazhnaal muzhudhum siraiyil iruppadhai kurippadhaaga irundhaalum, thandanai kuraippu matruma thandanai maatram thodarbaana sattareedhiyaana adhigaarangalai amarvu needhimandrangal kattuppadutha mudiyaadhu. Enave, thandanai kuraippu illaadha sirappu vagaiyilaana aayul thandanaiyai vidhikkum adhigaaram amarvu needhimandrangalukku illai; uyar Needhimandram matrum ucha needhimandrathukku mattume ulladhu.
Kutravaaliyin iyarkaiyaana vaazhnaal mudiyum varai aayul thandanai thodara vendum endru amarvu Needhimandram pirappikkum utharavu, sattareedhiyaana nadaimuraikku muranaanadhu. Indha vazhakkil vaazhnaal muzhudhum siraith thandanai vidhikkappatta utharavu maatrappattu, kutravaaligalukku 25 aandugal kadungaaval thandanai vidhikkappadugiradhu.
Ivvaaru utharavil koorappattulladhu.

headline: “misaa kaidhai evanukkum niroovikka vendiya avasiyamillai..” muga Stalin pechu!
text:
TVK aatchiyin mudhal sattamandra koottathil misaa kaidhu vivagaarathai ezhuppiya mudhalvar Vijay-kku padhilalitha muga Stalin, than misaa kaidhai evarukkum niroovikka vendiya avasiyamillai endru valiyuruthinaar. DMK mupperum vizhaavil pesiya avar, TVK arasu avadhooru parappi thisaidhiruppugiradhu, than thiyaagathukku yaarukkum madhippen poda thagudhi illai ena kadumaiyaaga thaakkinaar.
TVK aatchiyil nadandha mudhal sattamandra koottathodaril pesiya mudhalvar Vijay, DMK meedhaana sargaariyaa kamishan kurithu vimarsithadhodu, DMK thalaivar muga staalinin misaa kaidhu kurithum vimarsithirundhaar. Melum misaa kurithu pesivittu avar kaattiya saigai arasiyalil sarchaiyai kilappiya nilaiyil, DMK saarbil kandana aarppaattamum nadaivetradhu.
Innilaiyil misaa vazhakkil DMK thalaivar Stalin kaidhaanadhai niroovikka sollungal endra karuthu TVK tharappil ezhuppappatta nilaiyil, tharpodhu evanukkum niroovikka vendiya avasiyam illai endru Stalin pesiyullaar.
DMK mupperum vizhaa katchiyin thalaivar M.K. Stalin thalaimaiyil annaa arivaalayathil nadaivetradhu. Podhucheyalaalar Duraimurugan ullitta pala nirvaagigal idhil kalandhu kondanar.
Innigazhchiyil pesiya muga Stalin, “nadandhu mudindha sattapperavai koottathodarai anaivarum paarthiruppeergal. Andha kodumai ellaam paarkkaamal naan thappichen. Adharku kolathoor makkalukku kodaana kodi nandrigal. Peravaiyil thambi Udhayanidhi ketkum endha kelvikkum padhilalikkaamal thisaidhiruppave avadhoorugalai parappugiradhu TVK arasu. Ennudaiya misaa kaidhai ingu evanukkum niroovikka vendiya avasiyam enakku illai; ennudaiya thiyaagathukku maark poda evanukkum thagudhi illai.
TVK aatchiyil irandukku idaiyedhaan pottiye, ondru minvetti, innondru arivaal vettu. Naanga vattiyum mudhalumaa thiruppi kodukka kaathirukkirom.. Seekkiramaa varom.. Thimir thanathukkum aanavathukkum paadam pugattum vaayppudhaan indha idaitherdhal.
Mudhalamaichar thinamum SHOOTING MODEldhaan irukkiraar. Sinimaavil nadippadhai niruthivitten endru sollivittu, makkal mun nadikkiraar. Thiraavida maadal aatchiyil konduvandha thittangalai niruthuvadhu, stikkar ottuvadhu idhudhaan TVK aatchiyin velai” ena kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu pesinaar.

headline: Kaikkuzhandhai mudhal lakkej varai.. Vimaanap payanigalukku adhirchi.. Kattanathai uyarthiya indigo!
text:
Indigo vimaana niruvanam pachilanguzhandhai payanam, thunaiyindri varum siraargalukku udhavi, munnurimaip payana erpaadu matrum koodudhal payanap petti ullitta pala koodudhal sevaigalukkaana kattanangalai uyarthiyulladhu. Kurippaaga, 2 mudhal 3 vayadhudaiya kuzhandhaigalukkaana payanak kattanam roo.2000lirundhu roo.3000 aaga uyarthappattulladhu.
India-vin vimaanap pokkuvarathil indigovin (IndiGo) pangum miga mukkiyamaanadhaaga ulladhu. Indha niruvanam, ulnaadu matrum velinaattus sevaigalaik kondulladhu. Thinamum, 2,000kkum merpatta vimaanas sevaigalai vazhangi varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, indigo niruvanam kaikkuzhandhaigalukkaana kattanam, koodudhal lakkej matrum munnurimais sevaigal ullitta palveru sirappus sevaigalukkaana kattanangalai uyarthiyulladhu. Pachilanguzhandhaigalukkaana kattanam ₹2,000 -lirundhu ₹3,000 aaga uyarthappattulladhu.
Idhu 2 vayadhukkutbatta pachilanguzhandhaigalukkup porundhum. Indha erpaattin keezh avargalukkuth thani irukkai odhukkappadaavittaalum, avargalukkena oru payanacheettu munbadhivu seyyappada vendum. Adhevol, thunaiyindrip payanikkum siraargalukkaana kattanam ₹999 uyarthappattulladhu. Adhaavadhu, indhas sevaiyaip payanbaduthum thaninavar ini ₹5,999 selutha vendum. Vimaana niruvanathin porundhakkoodiya vidhigalukku inanga, periyavar thunaiyindrip payanikkum kuzhandhaigalukku indhas sevai porundhum.
Sarvadhesa vimaanap payanangalil, thunaiyindri payanikkum siruvargalukkaana sevaikku ₹12,999 kattanam vasoolikkappadum. Melum, koodudhalaaga eduthuchellum porutkalukkaana kattanamum uyarthappattulladhu. Munbu ₹700 aaga irundha nilaiyil, ini oru kilovirku ₹800 aaga uyarthappattulladhu. Idhanaal, ovvoru koodudhal kilovirkum ₹100 koodudhalaagas selavaagum. Aduthu indigo niruvanam munnurimai sek-in matrum pordingirkaana kattanathaiyum uyarthiyulladhu.
Munbu ₹450 aaga irundha nilaiyil, tharpodhu adhu ₹650 aaga adhigarithulladhu. Adhevol, mundhaiya kattana amaippinbadi, ₹200 aaga irundha payanas saandridhazhin kattanathai, andha vimaana niruvanam ₹300 aaga uyarthiyulladhu. Payanigalukku munnurimai sek-in matrum pording vazhangum thanadhu faast faarvart sevaiyin vilaiyaiyum andha vimaana niruvanam uyarthiyulladhu. Idharkaana kattanam ₹500-lirundhu ₹650-aaga uyarthappattulladhu. Sarvadhesa vimaanangalukkaana kattanam oru sekdarukku ₹850 aaga uyarthappattulladhu. Kachaa enney, petrol, teesal matrum ediep aagiyavatrin sarvadhesa vilaigalin adippadaiyil, petroliyap porutkal meedhaana etrumadhi varigalai arasaangam padhinaindhu naatkalukku orumurai maruvariseelanai seythu varum nilaiyil, indha sameevathiya nadavadikkai edukkappattulladhu.

headline: Irandu thogudhi idaitherdhalil 5 munai potti; kalaigattiyadhu pirasaaram
text:
Chennai: thaaraavuram, madhuraandhagam thogudhigalin idaitherdhalukkaana irudhi vetbaalargal pattiyal veliyidappattu, aindhu munai potti uruvaagiyulladhaal, kalathil ulla katchiyinar surusuruppaagi ullanar. DMK, TVK, ADMK ullitta munnani katchigal saarbil, natchathira pechaalargal arivikkappattu ulladhaal, pirasaaramum kalaigattath thodangiyulladhu.
Kadandha epralil nadandha sattasavai therdhalil vendra, ADMK emelekkal aaru per, thangaladhu padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythu vittu, aalum thavegavil inaindhanar. Adhil, thaaraavuram, madhuraandhagam thogudhigalukku mattum, adutha maadham, 6m thedhi idaitherdhal nadakkiradhu.
Idharkaana vetbumanu thaakkal, kadandha, 9 mudhal 16m thedhi varai nadandhadhu. Vetbu manukkalai thirumbap peruvadharku kadaisi naalaana indru (sep.19) irudhi vetbaalargal arivikkappattanar. Adhanbadi, thaaraavurathil, TVK - sathyavaamaa, DMK - suganyaa. ADMK - paanumadhi, naadhaga- kaarthigaa, Indhiya kamyoonist - latchumanan utbada, 22 per pottiyidugindranar.
Madhuraandhagathil, TVK - maragadham kumaravel, DMK - parandhaaman, ADMK -kanidhaa sambath, NTK - jaanagiraaman, maarksist kamyoonist - sugandhi utbada, 27 per kalathil ullanar.
Idaitherdhalukkaana natchathira pechaalargalin pattiyalaiyum, therdhal kamishan veliyittulladhu. TVK saarbil mudhalvar Vijay, amaichargal aananth, aadhav arjunaa, arunraaj, sengottaiyan, nirmalgumaar, raajmogan, ramesh, Thamizhaga Congress thalaivar maanikkam thaagoor, madhimuga podhucheyalaalar vaigo, VCK thalaivar thirumaavalavan, muslim leek thesiya thalaivar kaadhar mogidheen ullittor, natchathira pechaalargalaaga arivikkappattu ullanar.
DMK saarbil, akkatchiyin thalaivar Stalin, podhucheyalaalar Duraimurugan, porulaalar ti.aar.paalu, mudhanmai seyalaalar ke.en.neru, thunaip podhucheyalaalar kanimozhi, edhirkkatchith thalaivar Udhayanidhi aagiyor, pirasaaram seyya ullanar.
ADMK saarbil, akkatchiyin podhucheyalaalar ivies, thunaip podhus seyalaalar ke,pi.munusaami, porulaalar thindukkal seenivaasan ullittor natchathira pechaalargalaaga arivikkappattullanar.
Irudhi vetbaalargal arivikkappattulla nilaiyil, kalathil pottiyidum katchiyinar surusuruppu adaindhullanar. Iru thogudhigalilum, TVK, DMK, ADMK, NTK, kamyoonist katchigal ena, aindhu munai potti uruvaagiyulladhu.
Kadandha sattasavai therdhalil, DMK koottaniyil irundha, Congress, VCK, muslim leek katchigal, ippodhu TVK koottaniyil ullana. TVK arasukku veliyil irundhu aadharavalikkum maarksist, Indhiya kamyoonist katchigal, iru thogudhigalilum thanithu pottiyidugindrana.
Adhevola, kadandha sattasavai therdhalilin podhu, ADMK koottaniyil irundha PMK 'idaitherdhalil yaarukkum aadharavillai' ena, odhungi kondadhu. Madhuraandhagathil paamagavukku kanisamaana ottu vangi irukkum nilaiyil, akkatchiyin indha mudivu, ADMK-vukku pinnadaivaagap paarkkappadugiradhu.
Aalum katchiyaaga, koottani palathodu thavegavum, mukkiya koottani katchigal illaamal thimuga-adhimugavum kalam kaangindrana. Mukkiya katchigalin vetbaalargal veedu veedaagas sendru, pirasaaram seythu varugindranar.
ADMK saarbil vendru raajinaamaa seytha emelekkalaiye, TVK kalamirakkiyulladhu. Idhai solli, 'ottalitha makkalukku thurogam seythavargalai thorkadikka vendum' ena, ADMK-vinar pirasaaram seythu varugindranar.
Eppadiyaavadhu vendru aatchiyai palappadutha vendum ena, thavegavum; edhai seythaavadhu vendru, tholviyil irundhu katchiyai meettedukka vendum ena, thimugavum theeviramaaga kalamirangiyullana.
Therdhal pirasaarathirku innum, 15 naatkal irukkum nilaiyil, thaaraavuram, madhuraandhagam idaitherdhal kalam kalaigattath thodangiyulladhu.

headline: Paa.ja., magalir ani thalaiviyaaga aandhiraavin purandhesvari niyamanam
text:
–sirappu niruvar–
paa.ja.,vin ezhu mukkiyap pirivugalukkaana pudhiya thesiya poruppaalargal netru niyamikkappattanar. Adhanbadi, thesiya magalir ani thalaiviyaaga aandhiraavai serndha purandhesvari niyamikkappattullaar.
Paa.ja.,vin thesiya thalaivaraaga nidhin navin poruppetra pin, pudhiya nirvaagigal kuzhuvai kadandha maadham 17l arivithaar. Mothamulla 65 uruppinargalil, 51 per pudhiya mugangal. Idhil 18 sadhaveedham pengalukku padhavigal vazhangappattana.
Innilaiyil, paa.ja.,vin ezhu mukkiya anigalukkaana thesiya poruppaalargal netru arivikkappattanar. Idhil, ilainjar ani poruppaalaraaga u.pi.,yai serndha harish thivedhi arivikkappattullaar.
Paa.ja., magalir ani poruppaalaraaga aandhiraavai serndha purandhesvari, es.ti., ani poruppaalaraaga raajasdhaanai serndha sadheesh pooniyaa, es.si., ani poruppaalaraaga hariyaanaavai serndha sanjjay paathiya, idhara pirpaduthappattor ani poruppaalaraaga odishaavin vaijeyanth paandaa, vivasaayigal ani poruppalaraaga mathiya piradhesathin laal sing aaryaa, siruvaanmaiyinar ani poruppaalaraaga ma.pi.,yin kajendhadhira padel arivikkappattullanar.

headline: ”ponniyin selvan payanam oru varam”- sozhargal varalaatrai ariya thanjjai aatchiyar asathal muyatsi!
text:
Thanjjaavoorin perumaiyai ulaga alavil eduthu sella vendum, velinaadu matrum ulnaattu sutrulaap payanigalai eerthu sozhargalin pokkishangalai ariya seyyanum enbadhu maavatta aatchiyar revadhiyin ennam adhu nadandhirukkiradhu.
Thamizhagathin nerkalanjjiyamaana Thanjavur vayalgalukku mattumalla varalaatrukkum sirappu mikka ooraagum. Vayalum, varalaarumaana vaazhviyalai konda pagudhi. Ithagaiya perumaigalukku ulagaiye viyakkum vagaiyil aatchi purindha sozha mannargale kaaranam. Ulaga adhisayangalil ondraaga karudhappadum thanjjaavoorai periya koyilai ezhuppiyavar maamannan raajaraajasozhan. Vinnai mutti nimirndhu nirkum periya koyil vimaana kovurathai kandu aayiram aandugalai kadandha pinnarum ulaga sutrullaap payanigal adhisayithu rasithu selgindranar.
Thanjavur periya koyilai pol pala adhisangalai, aacharyangalai pokkishangalai ulladakki vaithu vittu sendrullanar sozhargal. Sozhargalin aatchi murai, varalaaru, kalaachaarathai arindhu kolvadharkaana aarvam indraikkum makkalidaiye perugiyulladhu. Innilaiyil sozhargalin varalaatrai paladharappu makkalum arindhu kolvadharkaana munneduppai Thanjavur maavatta aatchiyar revadhi nigazhthiyirukkiraar. Ponniyin selvan endra peyaril nadandhu vandha andha varalaatru sirappumikka payanam nindru pona nilaiyil meendum andha varalaatru payanathai uyirbithirukkiraar aatchiyar revadhi.
Kadandha 9m thedhi nadandha sozhargalin varalaatrai arindhu kolla koodiya indha ponniyin selvan varalaatru payanathai Thanjavur periya koyilil irundhu maavatta aatchiyar revadhi thodangi vaithadhudan sozhargal kuritha ariyaadha thagavalgal kurithu pesiyirukkiraar. 14 navargaludan oru naal payanamaaga purappatta ponniyin selvan varalaatru payanathil kalandhu kondavargal meyisilirthu maavatta aatchiyarukkum, payana kuzhuvukkum paaraattai therivithullanar. Ini ponniyin selvan payanam endha soozhalilum nirka koodaadhu endra vendugolaiyum viduthulladhaaga solgiraargal.
Idhu kurithu vivaram arindha tharappil pesinom, kadandha irandu aandugalukku munbu sozhargal varalaarai arindhu kollum vagaiyil ponniyin selvan payanathirku erpaadu seyyappattadhu. Sila murai payanamum merkollappattadhu. Aanaal palveru kaaranangalaal kadandha oru varudamaaga andha payanam nadaiveravillai. Idhaiyarindha aatchiyar revadhi, sozhargalin pokkishamaana varalaarai arindhu kolvadhu enbadhu oru varam. Idhai naam meendum seyalbadutha vendum endraar. Idhaiyaduthu udane adharkaana erpaadugal seyyappattu arivippai veliyittom.
Pengaloor, Chennai, Kovai, Trichy, Thanjavur ena paravalaaga pala pagudhigalil irundhu 14 navargal puk seythanar. Oru navarukku roo.2,000 kattanam. Vaaganam matrum tee mudhal nalla tharamaana unavu varai anaithirkum erpaadu seythom. Thanjavur periya koyilukku elloraiyum vara vaithu angirundhu kaalai 6 manikku ponniyin selvan payanathai thodanginom. Veeraanaam eri thaan mudhal sbaat. Angirundhu udaiyaargudi, kadamboor, kudandhai, pazhaiyaarai, udaiyaaloor ena sozhargal vaazhndha varalaatru sirappu mikka pagudhigalai paarvaiyittu sozhargalin adaiyaalamaaga irukkum periya koyilil niraivu seythom. Idhil kalandhu konda anaivarum vandhiyadhevan kaaviya payanathai anuvavikka oru vaayppaaga amaindhadhaaga muthaaythanar. Thadai pattirundha sozhargalin thadathai arivadharkaana payanathirku meendum uyiroottiyavar maavatta aatchiyar revadhi.
Payanam mudindha piragum varalaatru sutrulaavil kalandhu konda navargal idharkaana anuvavathai silirppudan pagirndhu varugindranar. Moondru maadhathirku oru murai ponniyin selvan payanam merkolla thittamidappattulladhu. Idhe pol sozhargal kaalathil kattappatta koyilgalai kaanbadharkum, vivasaayam kurithu arindhu kolvadharkaana payanamum nadandhu mudindhulladhu. Thanjjaavoorin perumaiyai ulaga alavil eduthu sella vendum, velinaadu matrum ulnaattu sutrulaappayanigalai eerthu sozhargalin pokkishangalai anaivaraiyum ariya seyya vendum endraar maavatta aatchiyar revadhi adhu tharpodhu nadandhirukkiradhu endranar.

headline: Peegaaril piriyangaa kaandhi pirasaaram endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaaril piriyangaa kaandhiyin therdhal pirasaara koottathirku latchakkanakkaaga makkal thirandu vandhadhaaga oru video

migap periya makkal koottathirku naduve Congress podhus seyalaalar piriyangaa kaandhi pirasaaram merkollum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peegaaril piriyangaa kaandhiyin therdhal pirachaarathin podhu koodiya ilatchakkanakkaana makkal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhalil Congress katchiyin podhus seyalaalar piriyangaa kaandhi merkonda pirasaarathil latchakkanakkaanor pangetraargal endru video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu. Indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, idhu peegaar sattamandra therdhalin podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Utharappiradhesathil piriyangaa kaandhi rot sho merkondavodhu endru kurippittu indha video-vai 2024m aandu epralil palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu Indhiya thesiya Congress katchiyin adhigaarappoorva YouTube pakkathil indha video 2024m aandu epral 17m thedhi padhividappattirundhadhu. Saharanbooril piriyangaa kaandhiyin rodu sho endru adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil kurippittadhu pondru idhu 2025 peegaar sattamandra therdhal pirasaarathin podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: "India payanaali alla; padaippaali" - ovan eai niruvana si.i.o saam aaltmen pugazhaaram.!
text:
Saam aaltmen, eai thozhilnutbam velaivaayppugalai maatrum endraalum, manidhargalin padaippaatral azhiyaadhu ena nambikkai therivithaar. Melum, India eai uruvaakkathil munneri varuvadhai paaraattiya avar, taadaa kuzhumathudan inaindhu India-vil tharavu maiyangalai amaikkath thittamittulladhaagavum koorinaar.
Seyarkai nunnarivuth thuraiyin ulagalaaviya adaiyaalamaagath thigazhum ovan eai niruvanathin siio saam aaltmen, telliyil nadaivetra eksbiras attaa' (Express ADDA) nigazhvil pangetrup pesinaar. Appodhu, India tharpodhu eai thozhilnutbathaip payanbaduthuvadhil mattum munnaniyil illai, adhai uruvaakkuvadhilum viyakkathakka vegathil valarndhu varugiradhu enap pugazhaaram soottinaar.
Eai-aal velaivaayppugal parivogumaa? Endra kelvikkup padhilalitha saam aaltmen, velais soozhalil periya maatrangal irukkum enavum, aanaal manidhargalin padaippaatralukku oruvodhum azhivillai enavum kurippittaar. Melum, munbai vida innum aakkappoorvamaana pudhiya velaigal uruvaagum enavum nambikkai therivithaar. Kurippaaga, seviliyar pani pondra manidha unarvugalum, aravanaippum thevaippadum velaigalai rovokkalaal oruvodhum eedu seyya mudiyaadhu endru saam aaltmen negizhchiyudan kurippittaar.
Kaalgulettar vandhavodhu kanidham maaravillai. Adhevol, eai vandhaalum maanavargal sindhikkum muraiyai maatrikkolla vendume thavira, kalvi azhiyaadhu enavum saam aaltmen thelivuvaduthinaar. Thanadhu niruvanathin saatjividi (ChatGPT) oru sirandha thozhilnutba udhaviyaalaraaga irukkume thavira, 'eppadi magizhchiyaaga vaazhvadhu?' enbadhu pondra vaazhkkaith thathuvangalaik ketka naan adhai oruvodhum naadamaatten endrum saam aaltmen nagaichuvaiyaagath therivithaar.
'taadaa kuzhumathudan' inaindhu eai utkattamaippai membaduthap povadhaagavum, staarget' (Stargate) thittathin keezh India-vil pirammaanda tharavu maiyangalai amaikkath thittamittulladhaagavum kurippitta saam aaltmen, India viraivil ulagin migapperiya eai sandhaiyaaga maarum endrum nambikkai therivithaar.

headline: Trichy: ke.en.neru veettil lanjja ozhipputhurai sodhanai; veettin mun kuvindha DMK-vinar
text:
Thiruchiyil munnaal amaichar ke.en.neru veettil lanjja ozhipputh thuraiyinar thideer sodhanai merkondu varugindranar.
DMK mudhanmai seyalaalarum, munnaal amaicharumaana ke.en.neru kadandha DMK aatchiyil nagaraatchi nirvaaga thuraiyaik kavanithu vandhaar.
Andhath thuraiyil pani niyamanam seyya lanjjam petradhaaga avar meedhu amalaakkathurai kutram saattiyadhu. Andhak kutrachaattin adippadaiyil lanjja ozhipputhurai vazhakku padhivu seyya vendum ena amalaakkathurai korikkai viduthadhu.
Thamizhagathil aatchi maatram erpatta pin munnaal amaichar ke.en.neru meedhu lanjja ozhipputhurai poleesaar vazhakkup padhivu seythanar.
Andha vazhakkin adippadaiyil, indru kaalai Trichy thillai nagaril ulla ke.en.neru veettirku vandha lanjja ozhipputhurai ti.es.pi manigandan thalaimaiyilaana sumaar 20-kkum merpatta lanjja ozhipputhurai poleesaar avar veettil sodhanai seythu varugindranar.
Indha thagavalarindha thi.mu.ka-vinar avar veettin munbu kuvindhanar. Andhap pagudhiyil poleesaarum paadhugaappu paniyil eeduvattullanar. Indru va.u.sidhambaranaarin pirandha naalai munnittu avarudaiya uruva silaikku ke.en.neru maalai anivikka sella virundhaar.
Indha nilaiyil avarai maalai anivikka sella vidaamal indhas sodhanai nadaivetru varugiradhu. DMK munnaal amaichar ke.en.neru veettil lanjja ozhippudhuraiyinar adhiradi sodhanai nadathi varuvadhu, Trichy maavatta DMK-vil paravarappai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.

headline: Magalir urimaithogai mungoottiye vazhangappattadhai edhirthu aadhav arjunaa manu thaakkal seythaaraa?
text:
Magalir urimaith thogaiyai Tamil Nadu arasu mungoottiye vazhangiyadhai edhirthu TVK saarbil ucha needhimandrathil aadhav arjunaa manu seythulladhaaga pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattu varugiradhu.

Aadhav arjunaa pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “aadhav arjunaa manu! Kalainjar magalir urimathogaiyai mungoottiye vazhangiyadhai edhirthu tha.ve.ka.vin saarbil uchaneedhimandrathil aadhav arjunaa manu thaakkal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal vara ulla nilaiyil, Tamil Nadu arasu magalir urimaith thogaiyai mungoottiye indru (13 pipravari 2026) payanaalargalin vangik kanakkil varavu vaithadhu. Idhai edhirthu TVK saarbil ucha needhimandrathil aadhav arjunaa manu thaakkal seythulladhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, aadhav arjunaa appadi vazhakku thaakkal seythadhaaga seythigal edhuvum illai.
Idhu thodarbaaga TVK tharappai visaarithavodhu idhu thavaraana thagaval endru koorinar. Aadhav arjunaavin karuthai ariya mudiyavillai. Avarudaiya samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarvaiyittom. Adhilum avar appadi endha oru padhivaiyum veliyidavillai. Ucha needhimandrathil vazhakku thodarndhadhaaga aadhav arjunaa kooriyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai, vazhakku thodarappattadhaaga oodagangalilum endha oru seythiyum illai. Enave, indha thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga, ippadi oru news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook ullitta samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarvaiyittom. Adhil appadi edhuvum illai. Enave, idhu poliyaaga uruvaakkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla, indha news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru therivithadhudan. Indha news card poliyaanadhu endru kurippittu pudhiya news card-ai thayaarithu namakku anuppinaar. Idhai thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalilum veliyiduvadhaaga nammidam therivithaar. Adhanbadi, “indha seythiyai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai” endru kurippittu Facebook-il padhivaiyum veliyittanar.
Indha aadhaarathin adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Adhimuga-vai tayarudan oppittaaraa Annamalai?
text:
ADMK vai tayarudan oppittu “vandi oda tayar mukkiyam” endru Annamalai kooriyadhaaga oru news card

pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “tayar mukkiyam – Annamalai vandi odavendum endraal adharku tayarum mukkiyam.tayargalai payanbaduthikkondu 2026l BJP vaaganam Tamil Naattil odum. Edappadi Palaniswami amithshaavai telliyil sandhithadhu kuritha kelvikku Annamalai padhil” endru irundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Adhimuga-vai payanbaduthi Tamil Naattil aatchikku varuvom enbadhu pola Annamalai kooriyadhaaga news card ulladhu. Unmaiyil ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaavai sandhithadhu thodarbaaga niruvargal kelvi ezhuppiya podhu, adharku neradiyaaga padhil alikkavillai Annamalai uldhurai amaicharai yaar vendumaanaalum sandhikkalaam enbadhu pola pesiyirundhaar.
Enave, indha news card poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Mudhalil pudhiya thalaimurai veliyitta news kaardugalai paarvaiyittom. Maars 26, 2025 andru naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha news kaardaiyum pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai. Idhai urudhi seyya, pudhiya thalaimurai digital pirivu poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Aduthadhaaga indha news card-ai BJP nirvaagi es.ji.sooryaavukkum anuppi indha thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythom. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

text:

headline: Tamil Nadu arasu roo.74.8 kodikku 85 irusakkara vaaganangalai vaangiyadhaa?
text:
Kaavalargalukku roo.74.8 kodiyil vaangappatta 85 irusakkara vaaganangalai M.K. Stalin kodiyasaithuth thodangi vaithaar endru oru padhivu

news 7 thamizh veliyitta news card Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Adhil, “sennai kaavaldhuraikku roo.74.8 kodiyil naveena thozhilnutba vasadhigaludan koodiya 85 irusakkara vaaganangalin sevaiyaik kodiyasaithu thodangi vaithaar mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “74.8 kodiyil 85 irusakkara vaaganangal naa oru bike vilai 88 ilatcham varudhu… 88 ilatchathukku appadi enna paiknu theriyalaye 🤔” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
74.8 kodi roobai koduthu verum 85 mottaar paikkukkal vaangappattadhaaga news card-il pagirappattulladhu. Kittathatta oru bike 85 latcha roobai varugiradhu endru palarum samooga oodagangalil Tamil Nadu arasai vimarsithu varugindranar. Indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil indha news card unmaidhaanaa endru ariya news 7 thamizh samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Joolai 24, 2024 andru indha news card-ai news 7 thamizh veliyittiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhan moolam indha news card unmaiyaanadhudhaan enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya koogulil thedinom. Appodhu seythi oodagangalil veliyaana seythigal namakku kidaithana. Thinamani veliyittirundha seythiyin thalaippe, “roo.74 latcham selavil kaaval thuraikkaana 85 irusakkara vaaganangal sevai: mudhalvar thodangi vaithaar” endrudhaan irundhadhu. Idhan moolam news 7 thamizh veliyitta seythiyil thavaru erpattiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugollath Tamil Nadu arasu pathirigai seythi edhum veliyittulladhaa endru Tamil Nadu arasu inaiyathalathil thedip paarthom. Indha seythi joon 24m thedhi veliyaagi irundhadhaal, andha kurippitta thedhiyil paarthom. Tamil Nadu arasin pathirigai seythiyum namakkuk kidaithadhu.
Adhil, “sennai perunagara kaaval thuraiyin payanbaattirkaaga roo.74 ilatcham selavil membaduthappatta naveena thozhilnutbathudan koodiya 85 irusakkara vaaganangal – maanbumigu Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar thiru.mu.ka.staalin avargal kodiyasaithuth thodangi vaithaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
84 latchathil irusakkara vaaganam vaangappattadhu endru Tamil Nadu arasu veliyitta seythiyai news 7 thamizh thavarudhalaaga roo.84 kodi endru veliyittulladhu. Idhu theriyaamal nettisangalum Tamil Nadu arasai vimarsithup padhivittu varuvadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ADMK koottani vellum ena evivi karuthuk kanippu veliyittadhaa?
text:
Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhalil ADMK koottani vellum endru evivi naadu karuthukkanippu veliyittadhaaga san news seythi veliyittadhu pondru oru pugaippadam

tholaikkaatchiyil olivarappaana san news seythiyai pugaippadam eduthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “adhimuga koottani vellum ena karuthuk kanippu. ADMK koottani 179 idangalaik kaippatrum: ABP naadu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivitta varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Nadaivera ulla sattamandra therdhalil DMK koottani vellum endru perumbaalaana karuthuk kanippugal koorugindrana. ADMK koottani vellum endru sila karuthuk kanippugalum vandhullana. Idhai vaithu samooga oodagangalil vivaadhangal, vadhandhigal pagirappattu varugindrana.
E.pi.pi naadu oodagam saarbil veliyaana karuthuk kanippil DMK koottani vellum endru kooriyirundhadhu. Aanaal, ADMK koottanikku 179 idangal endru san news seythi veliyittadhaaga palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
San niyoosil veliyaana seythiyai paarthom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra padhivu kidaikkavillai. Aanaal, san news veliyittirundha seythiyil DMK koottanikku 179 idangal kidaikkum endre kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, DMK koottani 179 idangal kaippatrum endru kurippittu veru silar padhivittirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Irandu pugaippadangalaiyam satru utru paarkkum podhu edit seythiruppadhu thelivaaga therindhadhu. DMK koottani 179 idangalai vellum endru veliyaana pugaippadathil ADMK – BJP koottani endru thelivaaga irundhadhu. ADMK koottani 179 idangalai kaippatrum endru veliyaagi irundha naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathil BJP endra pagudhi thelivillaamal irundhadhu. Seyarkai nunnarivu moolam thayaarikkum podhu erpadak koodiya ezhuthup pizhaigal, maraivugal adhil irundhadhu. Enave, indha pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla naam aayvukku eduthukkonda indha pugaippadathai san news poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avar idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam san news veliyittirundha seythiyil DMK koottanikku 179 idangal kidaikkum endru evivi naadu karuthukkanippil theriyavandhiruppadhaagave seythi veliyittirundhom endraar. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Sreerangam kovil nilathai avagarithu DMK aluvalagam; aadhaarangalai veliyittaar amaichar ramesh
text:
Trichy: sreerangam kovilukku sondhamaana nilam avagarikkappattu, DMK katchi aluvalagam kattappattulladharkaana aadhaarangalai amaichar ramesh veliyittaar.
Sreerangathil avar seythiyaalargalidam pesiyadhaavadhu; indru purattaasi sanikkizhamai. Perumaal pakdhargal anaivarum kondaadak koodiya mukkiyamaana naal. Adhilum kurippaaga, ulagap pugazhbetra 108 thivyadhesangalil mudhanmaiyaana sreerangam aranganaadhar kovil munbu naam irukkirom.
Sreerangam aranganaadhar kovilaip poruthavaraiyil ethanaiyo pakdhargal, aanmeegavaadhigal, kovilukkaaga sothukkalai thaanamaaga koduthullanar. Indhak kovilgalukkaana nalappanigalum, tharma kaariyangalaiyum seyvadharkaaga koduthullanar. Aanaal, thamizhagam muzhuvadhum palveru kovilgalin sothukkalai sattavirodhamaaga aakkiramippu seythullanar. Idharkaaga thanikkuzhukkal pottu visaaranai nadandhu varugiradhu.
DMK aluvalagam
 ennudaiya sreerangam thogudhiyil ulla sreerangam kovil nilathai DMK nirvaagi aakkiramithu, adhanaiye DMK aluvalagamaaga nadathi varuvadhaaga niraiya per pugaar alithullanar. Adhaiyellaam visaarithu paarkkum podhu, migapperiya alavil aadhaarangal kidaithullana.
1866l 329 ekkar nilangal sreerangam aranganaadhar kovilukku sondhamaanadhu endru oru sothurimaip pathiram erkanave koduthirukkiraargal. Sothurimai pathiram 1027 endra en konda aavanathil varum 329 ekkar, palveru sarve nambaril ulla anaithu nilangalum kovilukku sondhamaanadhu endru koduthu irukkiraargal. 1910m aandu inaam kamishanarum urudhi seythullaar. 1930 'e' padhivettilum kovil nilam endru thelivaaga kurippidappattulladhu.
Sattavirodhamaaga
ippodhu naam sollakkoodiya DMK pagudhis seyalaalar sattavirodhamaaga peyar maatram seythu DMK aluvalagam kattiyirukkum nilathin sarve ennum e padhivettil kovil nila vagaivaattil ulladhu. 1998l inaam theerppaayamum sothurimaip pathirathil irukkum anaithu nilangalum kovil nilam endru urudhi seythulladhu.
2020l DMK aatchi varuvadharku munbaaga, kovil nirvaagam saarbil, sothurimai pathiram 1027kku keezh varum nilangal anaithum kovilukku sondhamaanadhu. Indha nilangalai indhu aranilaithuraiyin anumadhiyindri virkavo, vaangavo koodaadhu endru padhivaalar aluvalagathirku kadidham ezhudhappattulladhu.
Court thalluvadi
2023l sothurimai pathiram 1027kku keezh varum nilangal engaludaiyadhu endru niraiya per thaakkal seytha manuvai Madurai High Court thalluvadi seythulladhu. Andha vazhakku nirkavillai. Enenil, kovilukku sondhamaana nilam endra aavanangal thelivaaga ulladhu. Kurippaaga, sarve en 762m, sothurimai pathiram 1027kku keezh thaan varuvadharkaana thelivaana aavanangal irundhum, poliyaana aavanangalaith thayaarithu, adhai vaithu DMK pagudhi seyalaalar, indha nilathai avaradhu peyarukku maatriyullaar.
Kovilgalilum DMK-vin vinjnjaana oozhal
kovil nilam enbadhai maraithu thaniyaarukku sondhamaana nilam endru kooriyum, moolappathiram kaanavillai endru pudhucheriyil pugaar alithu, adhil kidaitha saandrai vaithu indhap pathirappadhivu nadandhulladhu. Vinjnjaana reedhiyil oozhal seyvadhu DMK enbadhu anaivarukkum theriyum. Adhai kovilgalilum payanbaduthi, vinjnjaana muraiyil, noodhana muraiyil maatriyirukkiraargal. Indru kovilukku sondhamaana nilathil thaan DMK aluvalagam amaindhulladhu. Angu thaan sattasavai matrum paarli therdhalukkaana velaigal nadandhu vandhana. Indha idam aranganaadhar kovilukku sondhamaanadhu, noodhana muraiyil avargal thangalin peyaril maatri vittanar.
Varuvaaythurai, Police, aranilaiyathurai, pathirappadhivuthurai endru ithanai thuraigalai emaatri, oru saadhaarana DMK pagudhis seyalaalaraal eppadi pathirappadhivu seythirukka mudiyum. Appodhu, idhu avar seythadhaa? Avar pinbu yaar irundhu idhais seythullaar. Indru andha nilathin madhippu roo.50 kodi endru solgiraargal. Ivvalavu madhippulla nilathai saadhaarana pagudhis seyalaalar, andru irundha indhu aranilaiyathurai amaichar, kamishanar, pathirappadhivu adhigaarigalukku theriyaamal eppadi udanadiyaaga pathirappadhivu seyya mudindhadhu. Moolappathiram illaadha oru sarchaikkuriya nilathai, oru Police pugaar saandrai vaithu eppadi pathirappadhivu seyya mudindhadhu. Idhai en yaarume aayvu seyyavillai.
Mukkiya pullikku thodarbu
kandippaaga migapperiya navargalin thalaiyeedu illaamal, idhai seythirukka mudiyaadhu enbadhu sinnak kuzhandhaikku kooda theriyum. Indha alavukku noodhanamaaga seyalbattu migapperiya alavil mosadi nadandhulladhu. Idhu thodarbaaga alikkappatta pugaarin peril, ithanai aavanangalaiyum aayvu seythu, idhil edho thavaru nadandhirukkiradhu, idhil pagudhi seyalaalar mattumillai, idharku munbu irundhu indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai adhigaarigalaa? Amaicharaa? DMK-vin mukkiya pulligalo illaamal idhai seyya mudiyaadhu. Idhil edho oru periya vishayam irukkiradhu. Idhu thodarbaana aadhaarangalaik koduthu, kamishanar aluvalagathil pugaar alikkappattu, FIR podappattulladhu.
Idhudhaan latchanamaa?
Sattasavaiyil vaay kizhiya 'sivan sothu kula naasam' endru pesalaam. Appuram eppadi perumaal sothai sondha katchikkaaranukku koduthu vidalaamaa? Sondhak katchiyai nadathalaamaa? Idhu sariyaana muraiyaa? Kadandha 5 aandu kaala aatchiyil naanga thaan kovil sothai meettom, engalai maadhiri yaaraalum meetka mudiyaadhu appadi ellaam vasanam pesuneengale, idhudhaan sothai meetta latchanamaa?
Vidai theriyavarum
kovil sothai meettu kovilukku sertheengalaa? Thimugavoda katchi aluvalagam nadatha DMK-vil sertheergalaa? Endru naan ketkavillai. Sreerangam makkal ketkiraargal. Avargalin piradhinidhiyaaga naan ketkiren. Ellaa kovil sothaiyum meettavar, sondha katchikkaaran nadathum kovil nilam patri en pesavillai. Appadiyenil yaar solli idhu nadandhadhu. Idhu ellaathukkum vidai visaaranaiyil theriya varum endru naanum nambugiren, ivvaaru avar koorinaar.
Sreerangam kovil nilathai DMK nirvaagi aakkiramippu seythu, DMK aluvalagam kattiyadhu thodarbaaga amaichar ramesh veliyitta aadhaarangalai video-vaaga kaana, indha klik seyyungal

headline: Vadagizhakku paruvamazhai erpaduthap pogum thaakkam? Thayaarnilaiyil irukkiradhaa Thamizhaga arasu?
text:
Thamizhagathirku adhiga mazhaiyai kodukkum vadagizhakku paruvamazhai kaalam adutha maadham thodanga ulla nilaiyil indha aandu Thamizhagathil iyalbaivida adhiga mazhai padhivaaga vaayppulladhaaga kanikkappattulladhu. Kurippaaga, navambar maadhathil iyalbaivida sumaar 60 sendimeettar varai koodudhal mazhai padhivaaga vaayppulladhaaga vaanilai aayvaalargal therivikkindranar. Idhil kavanikka vendiya mukkiya amsam ennavendraal, ore naalil 50 sendimeettar varai miga kanamazhai peyya vaayppu iruppadhaaga koorappaduvadhudhaan.
Kurippaaga Chennai ullitta vadagizhakku maavattangal matrum kadalora maavattangalil edhenum oru pagudhiyil, ithagaiya adheedha mazhaippozhivu padhivaaga vaayppulladhaaga kanikkappattulladhu. Idharku sooppar el ninovin irandaam katta thaakkam kaaranamaaga irukkalaam ena vaanilai aayvaalargal karudhugindranar. Mudharkattathil varatchi matrum mazhaippozhivu kuraivu erpattadhu. Innilaiyil, akdovar 15aam thedhikkup piragu vadagizhakku paruvamazhaiyil maatram erpadalaam ena kanikkappattulladhu. Idhanidaiye, kadal parappin veppanilaiyum iyalbaivida adhigarithiruppadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Kadal veppanilaiyil erpadum maatram, valimandalathil eerappadhathai adhigarithu, kanamazhaikkaana soozhalai uruvaakkakkoodum enbadhaal, varum vadagizhakku paruvamazhai, thamizhagathirku mukkiyathuvam vaayndhadhaaga paarkkappadugiradhu.
Maruvuram, varavirukkum vadagizhakku paruvamazhaiyai edhirgolla Thamizhaga arasum thayaaraagi varugiradhu. Neernilaigal, neervazhithadangalai seeramaithal, paadhippukkullaagum pagudhigalai mungoottiye kandaridhal, munnecharikkai nadavadikkaigalai theevirappaduthudhal ullitta panigal merkollappattu varugindrana. Podhiya nidhi odhukkeedu seythu, panigalai viraivuvaduthinaal, kanamazhaiyaal erpadum paadhippugalai mungoottiye kattuppadutha mudiyum ena thurai saarndha nivunargal therivikkindranar.

headline: DMK aatchiyil mudhiyavarukku saadhiya vangodumai nadandhadhaaga paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK aatchiyil pattiyalinathais saarndha mudhiyavarukku saadhiya vangodumai nadandhulladhu endru oru video

mudhiyavar oruvar silar kaalil vizhum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thamizhagathil nadappadhu DMK-vin #kovaalavura_komaali yin
samooga needhi aatchiye…. Thoothukudi maavattathil thalith mudhiyavar oruvarin aadugal matra saadhiyinar vayalgalil meyndhadhaal avarai kaalil vizha vaithu video veliyitta saadhi veriyargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
DMK aatchiyil pattiyalina makkalukku edhiraana saadhiya vangodumai nadandhulladhu endru oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, sameevathil appadi oru sambavam Thoothukudi maavattathil nadandhadhaaga endha seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Aanaal, namakku endha mudivum kidaikkavillai. Enave, Thoothukudi, kayathaaru, aadu meytha thalith mudhiyavar ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthi koogulil thedinom. Appodhu, 2020m aandu indha video-vai thirumaavalavan veliyittirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu.
2020m aandu akdovar 12m thedhi indha video-vai thannudaiya X thala pakkathil padhivittirundha thirumaavalavan, “#anaagarigam: vada Indhiya maanilangalil mattumalla; thamizhnaattilum thodarum anaagarigam. Kayathaaru aruge olaikkulam kiraamam aadhikkudiyinathais saarndhavarin aadugal thangalin kollaip pagudhiyil eppadi nuzhaiyalaamena indhak kevalathai arangetriyullanaraam” endru kurippittirundhaar. 2020m aandu Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyil illai. Edappadi Palaniswami thalaimaiyil ADMK thaan aatchiyilirundhadhu.
Thirumaavalavan veliyittirundha tveet adippadaiyaaga vaithu thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu idhu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Adhil indha sambavam kayathaaril nadandhadhu endrum, kaalil vizhundha navarin peyar paalraaj endrum, avarai kaalil vizha vaitha ezhu per meedhum vangodumai thaduppus sattathin keezh vazhakkup padhivu seythu kaidhu seyyappattullaargal endrum andha seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil DMK aatchiyil thalith mudhiyavar saadhiya vangodumai seyyappattaar endru paravum sambavam 2020m aandu ADMK aatchiyil nadandhadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Thangal aatchiyil nadandha sambavathai DMK aatchiyil nadandhadhu pondru a.thi.mu.ka-vinar tharpodhu pagirndhu varuvadhaith thagundha aadhaarangaludan urudhi seythullom. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Panathaasaiyaal edhiraniyil serndhavargalukku paadam pugattungal: ivies
text:
-namadhu niruvar-
'panathaasai kaaranamaaga ottuppotta makkalai marandhu, uzhaithavargalai marandhu edhiraniyil poy serndhavargalukku thagundha paadam pugatta vendum' endru, madhuraandhagam thogudhi pirasaarathil ADMK podhucheyalaalar ivies pesinaar.
Madhuraandhagam thogudhikkutbatta maamandooril nadandha idaitherdhal pirasaarathil ADMK podhucheyalaalar ivies pesiyadhaavadhu;
'indha idaitherdhal edharku endru ungalukku theriyum. Kudhirai perathil vilai poyvittanar. Idhu, vendumendre thittamittu thinikkappatta therdhal, iyarkaiyaanadhu alla. Arasaik kaappaatruvadharku Vijay arivuruthal peril, ADMK thondargal uzhaippaal vendravarai vilai pesi, raajinaamaa seyyavaithullanar. Avar indru idhe thogudhiyil pottiyidugiraar. Vetkakkedaana vishayam.
Nadaivetra mudindha therdhalil ADMK saarbil madhuraandhagam makkalukku sevai seyya vaayppu koduthom. ADMK aatchikku varave makkal vaakkalithu avarai vetri pera vaithanar. Konjjam kooda nandri visuvaasam illaamal, makkalai madhikkaamal, ADMK thondargalai madhikkaamal, panathaasai kaaranamaaga ottuppotta makkalai marandhu, uzhaithavargalai marandhu indru edhiraniyil poy serndhanar. Avargalukku thagundha paadathai pugatta vendum, tevaasit izhakkas seyyungal.
Indhiya varalaatrileye mudhanmudhalaaga sattamandra uruppinaraaga thervuseyyappattu 12 naatkalil raajinaamaa seythu katchikkuth thurogam seythuvittanar. Avargalukku paadam pugattungal. TVK perumbaanmai idathil vellavillai, 107 idam thaan ulladhu. Avargalukku em.el.e thevai, adharkaaga thittamittu kuzhandhaigalai kadathichelvadhai pola, nam em.el.ekkalukku enna mittaay koduthanar endru theriyum ungalukku.
Appadi koduthu, raajinaamaa seyya vaithu, therdhalai sandhikkum avala nilaiyai uruvaakkinaargal. Innoru katchi em.el.e.vai vilaikku vaangi arasu nilaikka vendum endru ninaippadhe thavaru, ippadi indhiyaavileye izhivaana seyalil eeduvatta ore katchi TVK mattum thaan.
Indha therdhal thevaiyaa?
Therdhalil vendru ennodu sattamandrathil amarndhirundhanar. Pinnar raajinaamaa seythuvittu, adutha aindhu nimidathil thavegavil inaindhuvittanar. TVK nellikkaay moottai maadhiri. Avizhthuvittaal sidharivoyvidum. Karooril therdhal parappurai seythavodhu 41 per irandhanar. Avargal yaaraip paarkka vandhanar? Josap vijaykkaaga vandhanar. Avargalaik kooda paarkkaamal vimaanam eri Chennai vandhu 72 naatkal velivaravillai. Ivaraa naattai kaappaatrappogiraar?
Ilainjargale, podhumakkale sindhiyungal. Irandhavargalin udalukku anjjali seluthavillai, kaayappattavargalai kandugollavillai. Naam edhirkkatchiyaaga irundhaalum ododip ponom. Endha katchi endru paarkkavillai. Odi poy aarudhal sonna katchi ADMK
ungal katchi thalaivar thaan varavillai, irandaam katta thalaivargal endru iruppavargalaavadhu poy aarudhal sonnaargalaa? Ellorum thundaikkaanom thuniyaik kaanom ena odinaargal. 15 naatkal katchi aluvalagathaip poottivittanar. Ingu pirasaaram seythugondirukkum oru amaichar, veru maanilathukkup poyvittaar. Ippadippattavargal nammai vimarsikkiraargal.
Ivvaaru ivies pesinaar.

headline: Saalaiyil sellum pasukkalai thondharavu seyyak koodaadhu endru Delhi mudhalvar utharavittaaraa?
text:
Saalaiyil pokkuvarathukku idaiyooraagas sellum pasukkalai yaarum thondharavu seyyak koodaadhu, avatrai yaarum kadandhu sellak koodaadhu endru Delhi mudhalamaichar utharavittadhaaga oru video

telliyil saalaiyil pasukkal koottamaaga nirpadhai ammaanila mudhalamaichar regaa kupdhaa paarvaiyidum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paajaga aatchi seyyum thalainagar telliyil.. Pasumaadugal saalaiyil selvadhaal vaaganangal yaarum adhai thondharavu seyyakkoodaadhu adhai kadandhu sellakkoodaadhu endru Delhi maanila mudhalamaichar aanaiyittaar..
Paithiyakkaaranunga kaiyila aatchiya koduthaa ippadithaan irukkum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Telliyil BJP aatchiyil ulladhu. Ammaanila mudhal amaicharaaga regaa kupdhaa ullaar. Ivar saalaiyil sellum pasukkalai makkal thondharavu seyyak koodaadhu endru utharavittadhaaga kurippittu video ondrai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Saalaiyil sellum pasukkalai thondharavu seyyak koodaadhu endraal saalai muzhukka pasukkal mattumdhaan irukkum. Oru mudhalamaichar ippadi utharavittiruppaaraa endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Koogulil, regaa kupdhaa, pasukkal, saalai ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovudan oodagangalil veliyaana seythigal kidaithana. Adhil, “telli mudhalamaichar regaa kupdhaa haidharboor membaalathil sellum podhu kaalnadaigal kurukkittadhaal thideerendru pirek pottu vaaganam niruthappattadhu. Idhan kaaranamaaga perum vivathu thavirkkappattadhu.
Vaaganathilirundhu irangiya regaa kupdhaa, saalaiyil pasukkal sutrith thirivadhaith thadukkavum avai thanga thagundha idathai erpaadu seyyumbadiyum adhigaarigalukku utharavittaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Saalaiyil pasukkal selvadhaith thadukkak koodaadhu, avatraith thondharavu seyyak koodaadhu endru edhenum utharavai Delhi mudhalamaichar pirappithaaraa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru arivippum veliyaagavillai.
Regaa kupdhaavin X thala pakkathai paarvaiyittom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovudan padhivu ondrai indhiyil veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Adhai mozhi peyarthup paarthom. Adhil, “shaalimaar paak pagudhiyil ulla haidharboor membaalathil indru kaanappatta pasuvirku muraiyaana thangumidathai urudhi seyya arivuruthappattadhu. Pasu paadhugaappu matrum saalaigalai paadhugaappaanadhaaga maatruvadhil engal arasu muzhu arppanippudan ulladhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam saalaigalil selvor saalaiyil sutrith thiriyum pasukkalaith thondharavu seyyak koodaadhu endru Delhi mudhalamaichar utharavittaar endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: “maamool kodukkaadhadhaal saalaiyora kadaiyai kaali seytha Stalin polees” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK aatchiyil nermaiyaaga thozhil seythu varum siru unavu viyaavaariyai Police thondharavu seythadhaaga oru video

saalaiyorathil unavup porutkal kottikkidakka, oru penmani poleesaarudan sandaiyidum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha video-vil “siru viyaavaarigalai vaazhavidungal” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Unmaiyaana audio neekkappattu, thamizh thiraippada paadal ondru serkkappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “#kaaval thuraikku #maamul illaiyaa… siru kadaigal irukkaadhu… adhigaarigal evvalavu #kollai adithu kollungal… #staalin edhai sonnaalum ketka vendum .. #podhaipporul vitru pizhaithu kollalaam… #nermaiyaaga vaazha koodaadhu… #staalin kattalai..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Saalaiyora unavu kadaiyaith Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin utharavin peril Police agatriyadhaaga oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Nadaivaadhai enbadhu podhu makkal nadappadharkuthaane thavira viyaavaaram seyvadharku illai. Nadaivaadhai aakkiramippai agatriyadhu sariyaa thavaraa endra vivaadhathirkul sellavillai. Indha video thamizhnaattais saarndhadhaa endru mattume aayvu seythom.
Video thelivaaga illai. Indha sambavam Tamil Naattil engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Audio neekkappattirundhadhu. Unmaiyaana audio irundhirundhaal andha penmani endra solgiraar enbadhu therindhirukkum. Enave, indha video patri ariya video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video-vai 2024m aandil silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Thelungu mozhiyilirundha padhivai mozhimaatram seythu paarthavodhu “madhukkadaigal erpaduthaadha pokkuvarathu nerisalaiyaa indha saalaiyora unavuk kadaigal erpaduthivittana” endru kurippittu thelangaanaa mudhalamaicharai tek seythiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Andha video-vil unmaiyaana audio irundhadhu. Adhil andha penmani thelungu mozhiyil sandai poduvadhai ketka mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video thamizhnaattais saarndhadhu illai thelangaanaavais saarndhadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Namakkuk kidaitha X thala padhivin comment pagudhiyil indha penmaniyai “kumaari akkaa kadai” endru kurippittu palarum padhivittirundhanar. Idhan adippadaiyil koogulil “haidharaavaath, kumaari akkaa kadai agatram” ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. 2024 janavariyil haidharaavaath aidi- poongaa pagudhiyil saalaiyora kadai nadathi vandha kumaari enbavarin kadai agatrappattadhaaga seythigal namakkuk kidaithana.
Idhan adippadaiyil koogul mep-l andha kadai irundha pagudhiyai thedinom. Appodhu, “Kohenur Rd, Hyderabad, Telangana” endra pagudhiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra kattidangalaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha sambavam thelangaanaa maanilam haidharaavaathil nadandhadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Trichy pirasaara koottathil paadiya Vijay endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Thiruchiyil nadandha pirasaara koottathil pesa vendiyadhai marandha TVK thalaivarum nadigarumaana Vijay sinimaa paadalai paadinaar endru oru video

nadigar Vijay pirasaara koottathil sinimaa paadal paadiyadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thottavetta rottu mela muttai purottaa paadiya Vijay
oru nadiganidam idhai thavira veru enna edhirbaarkka mudiyum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam thalaivar nadigar Vijay-yin, ‘makkal sandhippu pirasaaram’ thiruchiyil sep 13, 2025 andru thodangiyadhu. Indha pirasaara nigazhchiyil pesa vendiyadhai marandhadhaal paadal paadinaar Vijay endru oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Video-vai paarkkum podhe edit seyyappattadhu endru therigiradhu. Iruppinum edhirth tharappinar idhai adhiga alavil samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varuvadhaal idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Nadigar Vijay thiruchiyil seytha makkal sandhippu pirasaarathin neralaiyai pala tholaikkaatchigalum olivarappina. Idhanaal, Vijay pesiya video-vai thedi eduppadhil avvalavu siramam illai. Oodagangal veliyittirundha veediyokkalai YouTube-il irundhu eduthom. Video-vai muzhuvadhumaaga paarthom. Adhil, Vijay paadal edhuvum paadavillai.
Aduthadhaaga ippadi oru video-vai news thamizh veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarvaiyittom. Aanaal, adhil appadi endha oru padhivum veliyaagavillai. Enave, indha padhivai appadiye news thamizh seythip pirivukku anuppi unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avargalum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythanar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu, edit seyyappattadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “sennaiyin singaara kolam” endru paravum mazhai vella video unmaiyaa?
text:
Chennaiyin singaara kolam endru saalaiyil mazhai neer thengiyirukkum video ondru

saalaiyil mazhai vellam pol thengiyirukka, adhil vaaganam ottis sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thamizhnaattin thalainagaram Chennaiyin singaaragolam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Chennai-yil kaatrazhutha thaazhvu nilai kaaranamaaga 2025 tisambar 1, 2m thedhigalil mazhai peythadhu. Mazhai peythu kondirukkum podhe vadiyavillai endru kutramsaatti palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha nilaiyil, Chennai saalaigalil vellam thengiyiruppadhaaga video ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vai paarkkum podhu Chennaiyin endha idam endru theriyavillai. Thamizhil endha peyar palagaiyum illai. Indhi ezhuthukkal pondru sila kadaigalil ezhudhappattiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video-vai aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Adhil video-vil kaattappattirundha Royal Indian Restaurant endra peyaril merku vanga thalainagar kolgathaavil unavagam iruppadhaaga theriyavandhadhu. Andha kadaiyum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vin kadaiyum ondraaga irundhadhu. Melum kadandha akdovar maadhathilirundhu indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam idhu Chennai mazhai vellathin kaatchiyillai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indha video kolgathaavil edukkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythugegaalla andha saalaiyil koogul street viyoovai paarthom. Video-vil idam petrirundha saalaiyin kadaigal anaithum koogul street viyoovil kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha saalai Chennai-yil illai, kolgathaavil ulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mayaanathil sadalam pudhaikka edhirppu: maanagaraatchi keduvidiyaal raamaanujar nagaril paravarappu
text:
Kovai: masakkaalivaalaiyam, neelikkonaambaalaiyathukkum podhuvaaga raamaanuja nagar rail rodu arugil mayaanam ulladhu. Appagudhiyil vasikkum iru samudhaaya makkal inaindhu mayaanathukku idam vazhanginar. Maanagaraatchi mayaanamaaga payanbaattil irundhadhu. Thideerena ingu sadalam pudhaikkak koodaadhena thiruppi anuppugindranar.
Thaniyaar niruvana sekyoorittigal niruthappattu, kuppai allum maanagaraatchi laarigal niruthappadugindrana. Tiraivar, kileenargalai appagudhiyil oyvedukka maanagaraatchi adhigaarigal arivuruthinar. Tiraivargal edhirppu therivithanar.
Pani paadhugaappu alikkakkori, mudhalvarukku tiraivar oruvar manu anuppinaar. Adharku, 'narsari amaikkavum, podhumakkal nadaivayitsi seyyavum avvidam maanagaraatchiyaal thervu seyyappattirukkiradhu.
Maanagaraatchi vaaganangal niruthappadugindrana. Thaniyaar niruvanam yoonit amaithu thooymai paniyaalargalukku unavu vazhangappadugiradhu' ena padhil alikkappattadhu.
Ichoozhalil appagudhiyai serndha moodhaatti irandhadhaal, mayaanathil udalai pudhaikka netru erpaadu seythanar. Angirundhavargal edhirppu therivithadhaal, vaakkuvaadham erpattadhu.
Maanagaraatchikku sondhamaana mayaanam, thaniyaar niruvana kattuppaattukkul vandhadhu eppadi engira kelviyai makkal ezhuppiyadhum avargal odhunginar.
Appagudhiyinar koorugaiyil, 'ivvidathukku aruge riyal estet niruvanam kudiyiruppugal kattum velaiyai thuvakkiyulladhu. Adharkaagave mayaana payanbaattai mudakki, avvidathai veru payanbaattukku maanagaraatchi kondu vara muyatsikkiradhu. Mayaana payanbaattukkaaga iru samudhaaya makkal kodutha idam idhu. Enave, maanagaraatchi mayaanam engira peyar palagaiyai meendum niruva vendum. Mayaanathukkaana vasadhiyai seythu thara vendum' endranar.

headline: Raagul kaandhiyin adhiradiyaal BJP koottaniyil irundhu veliyeruvadhaaga nidhish kumaar arivithaaraa?
text:
Raagul kaandhiyin adhiradi seyalbaattaik kandu anjji BJP koottaniyilirundhu nidhish kumaar veliyeriyadhaaga oru padhivu

nakkeeran idhazh veliyitta video-vai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “paajagavukku aadharavu vaavas. Koottaniyil irundhu EXIT” endru irundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “than kovanam avarathukkulla naam idhilirundhu vilagi irukkanumnu vivaramaa vilakittaan
raagul innum adikkave illai thodakkame amarkkalam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar vaakkaalar pattiyalil irundhu 65 latcham vaakkaalargal thideerendru neekkappattadhu thodarbaaga Congress mootha thalaivar raagulgaandhi pirasnai ezhuppinaar. Adhaith thodarndhu vaakkuth thiruttu endru Congress katchiyinar naadu muzhuvadhum poraattangalil eeduvattu varugindranar.
Indha soozhalil thanakku aavathu vandhuvidum endru payandhu BJP koottanikku alithu vandha aadharavaith thirumbap petradhudan, koottaniyil irundhu nidhish kumaar vilaguvadhaaga oru padhivaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Sila maadhangalukku munbu manippooril paajaga-vukku alithu vandha aadharavai nidhish kumaar katchi thirumbap petradhu. Appodhu thesiya jananaayagak koottaniyilirundhe avar veliyeriyadhu pondru thalaippai vaithu seythi veliyittirundhadhu nakkeeran idhazh. Andha video thodarbaana seythiyai appodhe palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirndhirundhanar.
Enave, raagul kaandhiyin adhiradikkum indha seythikkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaagath therindhadhu. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Video-vil idam petra thalaippai appadiye koogulil taip seythu thediya podhu, 2025 janavariyil nakkeeran veliyittirundha YouTube video namakkuk kidaithadhu. Nakkeeran veliyitta video-vin mugappu pugaippadathai edit seythu, muzhu veediyovilum BJP-vukku aadharavu vaavas endra thalaippu varum vagaiyil maatri tharpodhaiya seythi pola samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar. Idhu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil ulladhu.
Unmaiyil manippoorilum kooda nidhish kumaar koottaniyil irundhu velivaravillai. Manippoor maanila aikkiya janadhaa thala katchith thalaivar ippadi oru arivippai veliyittaar. Avar indha aandu janavariyil thideerendru manippoor BJP arasukku alitha aadharavaith thirumbap peruvadhaagavum thesiya jananaayagak koottaniyil irundhu veliyeruvadhaagavum arivithaar.
Maanila thalaivarin indha arivippaik katchith thalaimai erkavillai. “thannichaiyaaga avar indha arivippai veliyittaar. Katchith thalaimaiyin aalosanaiyai avar peravillai. Avar maanila thalaivar poruppilirundhu neekkappattullaar. Thesiya jananaayagak koottaniyil aikkiya janadhaadhalam oru angamaaga ulladhu. Koottaniyil irundhu aikkiya janadhaa thalam veliyeriyadhaagap paravum seythi adippadaiyatradhu” endru akkatchiyin thesiya seythith thodarbaaga raajeev ranjjan pirasaath 2025 janavariyileye thelivuvaduthivittaar.
Aanaal indha vivaram theriyaamal, nakkeeran idhazh paravarappukkaaga vaitha thalaippu seythiyai raagul kaandhi therdhal aanaiyam matrum piradhamar modiyai vimarsithu varum soozhalil nidhishgumaarum koottaniyai vittu veliyeruvadhaaga arivippu seythadhu pondru thavaraana seythiyai samooga oodagangalil padhivittullanar. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kaatraalaiyil thee vivathu
text:
Palladam:palladam adutha vaavivaalaiyam ooraatchikkutbatta kazhuverivaalaiyam kiraamathil eraalamaana kaatraalaigal ullana. Netru maalai kaatraalai ondril irundhu karumbugai veliyeriyadhu. Idhaik kavanitha appagudhi vivasaayigal matrum podhumakkal, palladam theeyanaippu nilaiyathukku thagaval therivithanar.
Theeyanaippu veerargal varuvadharkul kaatraalaiyin mel pagudhiyil theeppidithu eriyath thodangiyadhu. Angirundhu veliyeriya theeppizhambugal arugil ulla vivasaaya nilathil irundha thennai marangalilum vizhundhu, sila marangal theeppidithu eriyath thodangina.
Viraindhu vandha theeyanaippu veerargal, kaatraalaiyin iyakkathai niruthiyadhudan, thennai marangalil paraviya theeyaiyum thanneerai peeychi adithu kattukkul kondu vandhanar. Idhanaal perum vivathu thavirkkappattadhu.
Kaamanaayakkanbaalaiyam Police visaaranai nadathi varugindranar.

headline: Idaitherdhal poruppaalargal: paa.ja., niyamanam
text:
Chennai: madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram idaitherdhal panigalukkaaga, paa.ja., Thamizhaga thalaimai saarbil, therdhal poruppaalargal niyamikkap pattullanar.
Madhuraandhagam thogudhi poruppaalargalaaga, paa.ja., thesiya seyalar vengadesan, maavatta thalaivar piraveen kumaar, maanila seyarkuzhu uruppinar kalivaradhan aagiyor niyamikkappattullanar.
Thaaraavuram thogudhi poruppaalargalaaga, paa.ja., Thamizhaga seyalar nandhagumaar, maruthuvap pirivu maanila amaippaalar pirem kumaar aagiyor niyamikkappattu ullanar.

headline: ‘’vaayai thirandhaar Udhayanidhi’’ endru san news seythi veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘‘vaayai thirandhaar Udhayanidhi’’ endru san news seythi veliyittadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ vaayai thirandhaar Udhayanidhi indru.. 2021 DMK-vin 5 aandu aatchiyil 2000-kku merpatta karpazhippu vazhakkugal 5000-kku merpatta pokso vazhakkugal.. Idhaip patri andha aatchiyil kandugollaamal indru edhirkkatchi aanadhum pen paadhugaappu patri pesiyirukkiraar’’, endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
San news logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu vendumendre edit seythu, pagirappadum news card, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha me maadham 23, 2026 andru ‘’ “kovaiyil 10 vayadhu sirumi, kadathi kolai seyyappattulla sambavam perum adhirchiyaiyum, vedhanaiyaiyum erpaduthi irukkiradhu..” -edhirkkatchith thalaivar Udhayanidhi Stalin kandanam.,’’ enum thalaippil san news veliyitta card-ai eduthe, edit seythu, thavaraana thagaval parappugiraargal, endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, Udhayanidhi Stalin avaradhu adhigaarappoorva X valaidhala pakkathil veliyittirundha padhivu idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pahalgaam thaakkudhalukkup piragu Indhiya raanuvathin padhiladi ena viral-aagum pazhaiya kaanoli | Old Video Viral As Retaliation By Indian Army After Pahalgam Attack
text:
Pahalgaam thaakkudhalukkup piragu Indhiya raanuvathin padhiladi ena viral-aagum pazhaiya kaanoli
vairalaana kaanoli inaiyathil iruppadhaiyum, 2020aam aandu epral maadham indha kaanoli kuritha seythi arivikkappattadhaiyum poom kandarindhulladhu.
Jammu kaashmeerin pahalgaamil ulla paisaran pulveliyil sameevathil nadandha payangaravaadha thaakkudhaludan thodarbudaiyadhaaga, Indhiya paadhugaappup padaiyinarin kadumaiyaana peerangith thaakkudhal nadathuvadhaik kaattum oru pazhaiya kaanoliyai thavaraaga viral-aagi varugiradhu. Pahalgaam sambavathirku padhiladi kodukkum vidhamaaga Indhiya raanuvam 12 Pakistan veerargal thaakkuvadhaik kaattuvadhaaga thavaraana kootrudan indha kaanoli pagirappadugiradhu.
Indha kaanoli kadandha 2020aam aandu epral maadham mudhal inaiyathil iruppadhaagavum, tharpodhaiya soozhnilaiyudan thodarbudaiyadhu alla endrum poom kandarindhulladhu. Indhiya raanuvam padhiladi kodukkum vidhamaaga Pakistan veerargal meedhu thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga endha nambagamaana seythi arikkaiyaiyum naangal kandariyavillai.
Indha aandu(2025) epral 22 thedhiyandru, kaashmeerin pahalgaamil ulla paisaran pallathaakku pagudhiyil, sutrulaap payanigal matrum ulloorvaasigal meedhu payangaravaadhigal thuppaakkis soodu nadathinar. Idhil 26 per kollappattanar. Thadaiseyyappatta lashgar-i-thoybaa (el.i.ti) udan thodarbudaiya nizhal kuzhuvaana resistans prant, indha payangaravaadha thaakkudhalukku poruppetrulladhu. Indha thaakkudhal podhumakkal meedhaana migak kodiya thaakkudhalgalil ondraagak karudhappadugiradhu.
Thaakkudhal nadathiyavargal indhu madhathais serndha aan sutrulaap payanigalai kurivaithu, avargalaik kolvadharku munbu avargaladhu adaiyaalangalaiyum peyargalaiyum kettadhaaga paadhikkappattavargalin kudumbangal kutram saattiyullana.
Thamizhil, X thalathil oru payanar, “LOC Pakistan ellai kattuppaattu kottil irundhu namadhu raanuva veerargal thaakkudhalai thoduthu irukkiraargal. Irandu Pakistan theeviravaadhigalai suttukkondradhu Indhiya raanuvam. POK kaasmeerai meetka vendiya neram idhu. Adikkira adiyila indhiyaavirkul theeviravaadham peche irukka koodaadhu.” endra kaapshanudan indha kaanoli pagirappattadhu.
Idhuve, aangilathil migakkurippaaga, paagisdhaanais serndha 12 veerargal kollappattanar endra kootrudan indha kaanoli vairalaanadhu. @Realbababanaras endra X kanakkil, “mukkiya seythi: taattaa paani pagudhiyil nadandha por nirutha meeralukku Indhiya raanuvam padhiladi koduthadhil kuraindhadhu 12 Pakistan veerargal kollappattanar. 3 nilaigal matrum 2 peerangi nilaigal azhikkappattana. Kanaraga peerangi matrum mottaar shel thaakkudhalgal padhivaagiyullana. (aadhaarangal). Melum vivarangal viraivil," endra vaasagathudan kaanoli pagirappattulladhu.
investigation_details:
Pahalgaam thaakkudhalukkup piragu Indhiya raanuvathin padhiladi ena viral-aagum pazhaiya kaanoli
vairalaana kaanoli inaiyathil iruppadhaiyum, 2020aam aandu epral maadham indha kaanoli kuritha seythi arivikkappattadhaiyum poom kandarindhulladhu.
Jammu kaashmeerin pahalgaamil ulla paisaran pulveliyil sameevathil nadandha payangaravaadha thaakkudhaludan thodarbudaiyadhaaga, Indhiya paadhugaappup padaiyinarin kadumaiyaana peerangith thaakkudhal nadathuvadhaik kaattum oru pazhaiya kaanoliyai thavaraaga viral-aagi varugiradhu. Pahalgaam sambavathirku padhiladi kodukkum vidhamaaga Indhiya raanuvam 12 Pakistan veerargal thaakkuvadhaik kaattuvadhaaga thavaraana kootrudan indha kaanoli pagirappadugiradhu.
Indha kaanoli kadandha 2020aam aandu epral maadham mudhal inaiyathil iruppadhaagavum, tharpodhaiya soozhnilaiyudan thodarbudaiyadhu alla endrum poom kandarindhulladhu. Indhiya raanuvam padhiladi kodukkum vidhamaaga Pakistan veerargal meedhu thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga endha nambagamaana seythi arikkaiyaiyum naangal kandariyavillai.
Indha aandu(2025) epral 22 thedhiyandru, kaashmeerin pahalgaamil ulla paisaran pallathaakku pagudhiyil, sutrulaap payanigal matrum ulloorvaasigal meedhu payangaravaadhigal thuppaakkis soodu nadathinar. Idhil 26 per kollappattanar. Thadaiseyyappatta lashgar-i-thoybaa (el.i.ti) udan thodarbudaiya nizhal kuzhuvaana resistans prant, indha payangaravaadha thaakkudhalukku poruppetrulladhu. Indha thaakkudhal podhumakkal meedhaana migak kodiya thaakkudhalgalil ondraagak karudhappadugiradhu.
Thaakkudhal nadathiyavargal indhu madhathais serndha aan sutrulaap payanigalai kurivaithu, avargalaik kolvadharku munbu avargaladhu adaiyaalangalaiyum peyargalaiyum kettadhaaga paadhikkappattavargalin kudumbangal kutram saattiyullana.
Thamizhil, X thalathil oru payanar, “LOC Pakistan ellai kattuppaattu kottil irundhu namadhu raanuva veerargal thaakkudhalai thoduthu irukkiraargal. Irandu Pakistan theeviravaadhigalai suttukkondradhu Indhiya raanuvam. POK kaasmeerai meetka vendiya neram idhu. Adikkira adiyila indhiyaavirkul theeviravaadham peche irukka koodaadhu.” endra kaapshanudan indha kaanoli pagirappattadhu.

headline: Utharagaandil paajaga-vukku edhiraaga kalavaram endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Utharagaandil paajaga-vukku edhiraaga makkal kalavarathil eeduvattadhaaga oru pugaippadam

arasu aluvalagathai ilainjargal kaippatri kondaadiyadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “uthiragaandil… BJP-vukku edhiraaga maaverum kalavaram” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Maanila andhasdhu kori ladaakkil ilainjargal poraattam nadathinar. Adhaith thodarndhu BJP aatchi seyyum utharagaant maanilathilum ilainjargal poraattathil eeduvattadhu pondru pugaippadathudan koodiya padhivu ondru samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Sameevathil utharagaant maanilathil islaamiyargal nadathiya peraniyil vanmurai erpattadhu. Idhaith thodarndhu vanmuraikku kaaranam endru koori silarai andha maanila kaaval thuraiyinar kaidhu seythanar. Arasukku edhiraaga kalavaram nadandhadhaaga endha seythiyum illai. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivilum endha idathil kalavaram erpattadhu endru kurippidavillai. Enave, padhivil ulla pugaippadathai vaithu thagaval kidaikkiradhaa endru paarthom.
Pugaippadathil ulla kattidathil enna ezhudhappattulladhu enbadhai koogul tiraanslettar moolam paarthom. Nevaala mozhiyil ezhudhappattulladhaagak koogul tiraanslettar kooriyadhu. Melum adhil, “maavatta nirvaaga aluvalagam, sitvaan (District Administration Office, Chitwan) endru ezhudhappattirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Sitvaan enbadhu nevaala naattil ulladhaagath theriyavandhadhu.
Indha pugaippadathaik koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu palarum ladaak kalavaram endru kurippittu indha pugaippada kaatchi idam petrirundha video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu thediyavodhu, nevaalathil jen Z poraattathin podhu edukkappattadhaaga pala video padhivugal namakkuk kidaithana. Adhil nevaala naattin kodiyudan poraattam nadathiyirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Vasadhiyaaga nevaala kodiyai neekkivittu India-vil nadandhadhu pondru padhivittiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Nevaalathil sitvaan maavatta nirvaaga aluvalagathin koogul mep, street viyoo pugaippadam edhum kidaikkumaa endru thedip paarthom. Andha kattidathin pugaippadam namakku kidaithadhu. Adhuvum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadathilirundha kattidamum ondru enbadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil utharagaandil kalavaram endru paravum pugaippadam thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Asuravega thaniyaar pasgal soolooril makkal acham
text:
Sooloor: sooloor – Trichy rottil asura vegathil thaniyaar pasgal iyakkappaduvadhaal, vivathugal adhigarithulladhaal makkal achamadaindhullanar.
Sooloor – Trichy rottil Tiruppur, palladathil irundhu Kovai nokkiyum, kovaiyil irundhu Tiruppur nokki pala thaniyaar pasgal iyakkappadugindrana. Innilaiyil, pala thaniyaar pasgal adhivegamaagavum, kavanakkuraivaagavum iyakkappaduvadhaal, vivathugal adhigarithu varuvadhaal, vaagana ottigal, podhumakkal achamadaindhullanar.
Sooloor makkal koorugaiyil, ‘Trichy rottil thaniyaar pasgal asura vegathil iyakkappaduvadhaal, matra vaagana ottigalum, podhumakkalum achamadaindhullanar. Netru mundhinam Kovai nokki asura vegathil sendra thaniyaar bus, iru paikkugal meedhu modhiyadhil iruvar kaayamadaindhanar. Idhevol thinamum nadakkiradhu. Pokkuvarathu thurai adhigaarigal, Police, adhivega thaniyaar pasgal meedhu nadavadikkai edukka vendum’ endranar.

headline: Thalaigeezhaay suzhandru kets piditha harmanpreeth kavur endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Niyoosilaandhukku edhiraana magalir kirikket pottiyin podhu India-vin harmanpreeth kavur thalaigeezhaaga suzhandru kets pidithadhaaga oru video

Indhiya magalir kirikket aniyin harmanpreeth kavur kets pidikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil avaaramaana thiramaikku vaazhthu. Aangale niyoosilaandhu aniyidam alarum podhu enna thiramai. Idhu kanavaa illa rovo vaa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “pora pokkai paarthaa kerls teemgaagave thirumba kirikket paarkka aaramikkanum pola” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiya magalir kirikket aniyin harmanpreeth kavur suzhandru kets pidithadhu pondru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Paarkka unmaiyaanadhu pola illai. Kurippaaga avar paldi adithuth thirumbumbodhu avaradhu udal sila vinaadigal appadiye nirkiradhu. Avaradhu sattaiyil India endru ezhudhappattiruppadhum pizhaiyaaga irukkiradhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu palarum indha video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varuvadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Andha video-kkal migavum thelivaaga irundhadhu. Video-vil sgor pordil niyoosilaandhu enbadhai thavaraaga ezhudhiyirundhanar. Video-vil, “INDIA 2 v INDIA” endrum valadhuvuram “NEW Zz4” endrellaam ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Eai moolam video-kkal uruvaakkum podhu idhu pondra pizhaigal erpaduvadhu iyalbaanadhu enbadhaal indha video eai veediyodhaan enbadhu thelivaagath therindhadhu. Iruppinum aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvai thodarndhom.
Harmanpreeth kavur ippadi paldi adithu kets pidithadhaaga endha oru seythiyum namakku kidaikkavillai. Adhe nerathil nammudaiya fekt kirasando malaiyaalam ulbada palveru fekt sek thalangalil idhu eai veediyodhaan endru urudhi seythu veliyaagi irundha katturaigalai kaana mudindhadhu. Indha video eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhaa endru ariya eai veediyokkalai kandariya udhavum inaiyathalathil indha video-vai padhivetri aayvu seythom. Adhil ovvoru premaaga aayvu seythu paarthavodhu adhuvum indha video eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru urudhi seythadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Paathimaa paavu peyaril poongaa thirandhu vaithaaraa M.K. Stalin?
text:
‘‘paathimaa paavu peyaril poongaa thirandhu vaitha M.K. Stalin,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kolathooril roo.4.20 kodi madhippil membaduthappatta paathimaa paavu poongaavai thirandhu vaithaar mudhalvar Stalin’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Thandhi TV logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda news card unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, ‘’idhu thandhi TV peyaril paravum poliyaana news card,’’ endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhil ‘’ murasoli maaran poongaa. Kolathooril roo.4.20 kodi madhippil membaduthappatta murasoli maaran poongaavai thirandhu vaithaar mudhalvar Stalin,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanai edit seythu, paathimaa paavu poongaa endru vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
