headline: Ulaga sugaadhaara amaippu padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythaar vangadhesa maaji piradhamarin magal
text:
Jeneevaa: ulaga sugaadhaara amaippin thengizhakkaasiya piraandhiya iyakkunar padhaviyai, vangadhesathin munnaal piradhamar shek haseenaavin magal saymaa vaaseth, 53, raajinaamaa seythullaar.
Nam andai naadaana vangadhesathil, 2024l nadandha maanavar poraattam kaaranamaaga annaattin appodhaiya piradhamar shek haseenaa than padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythaar. Idhaith thodarndhu, haseenaa matrum avaradhu kudumbathaar meedhu palveru oozhal kutrachaattugal matrum muraigedugal thodarbaana vazhakkugalai annaattin oozhal thaduppu aanaiyam padhivu seythadhu.
Innilaiyil, 2024l aindhu aandu kaala padhaviyaaga, ulaga sugaadhaara amaippin thengizhakkaasiya piraandhiya iyakkunaraaga shek haseenaavin magal saymaa vaaseth therndhedukkappattaar. Vangadhesathil erpatta arasiyal maatrangal kaaranamaaga ivar meedhum pala kutrachaattugalai vangadhesa arasu sumathiyadhaiyaduthu, avar kadandhaandu mudhal kattaaya viduppil vaikkappattaar.
Innilaiyil, ulaga sugaadhaara amaippin thalaimaiyai ini thaan nambap povadhillai endrum, neendagaalamaaga oodhiyamindri kattaaya viduppil vaikkappattadhaal than nidhinilaimai paadhikkappattulladhaagavum koori, than padhaviyai raajinaamaa seyvadhaaga saymaa netru arivithaar.

headline: “staalinin kaalai unavuth thittathil vazhangappatta unavaik kottiya maanavargal” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Tamil Naattil Stalin aatchiyil vazhangappatta palli maanavargalukkaana kaalai unavu sariyillai endru adhai maanavargal keezhe kottinar endru oru video

palli maanavargal unavai oru pakkettil kottum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “Ohh… Stalin aatchiyil
idhu thaan kaalai unavu thittamaa.. #DMKFailsTN #GetOutStalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu arasu vazhangum kaalai unavu nandraaga illai endru maanavargal keezhe kottiyadhaaga video ondraip palarum viral-aaga samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, indha video engu eppodhu edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Melum indha maanavargalaip paarkkum podhu Tamil Nadu arasu palli maanavargal pola illai. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video aandhirap piradhesathais saarndhadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Aandhiraavin en.ti.aar maavattathil ulla thevaniseruvu embivi palliyil (Devanicheruvu MPP School) indha sambavam nadandhadhaaga pala padhivugal namakku kidaithana.
Aandhira oodagangal palavum indha video-vai veliyittirundhana. Melum, tharamillaadha unavu vazhangiyadharkaaga aandhira maanila manidhavala membaattuth thurai amaichar naaraa logesh mannippu kettadhaagavum seythigal namakku kidaithana. Melum, unavai keezhe kottiya maanavargalidam aandhira Police pesiyadhu thodarbaana veediyokkalum namakku kidaithana. Ivai ellaam indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Nammudaiya aayvil indha video aandhira piradhesathais saarndhadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Tharamatra unavu vazhangappadadharku ammaanila amaichar mannippu kettukkonda seythigalum namakku kidaithulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kulathukku thanneer thirakka valiyuruthi poraattam! Paappaangulam kiraama makkal aavesam
text:
Udumalai: kudineer thattuppaattukku theervu kaanavum, varatchiyai samaalikkavum amaraavadhi piradhaana kaalvaayil irundhu kiraama kulathukku thanneer thirakka valiyuruthi, paappaangulam ooraatchi makkal saalai mariyal poraattathil eeduvattanar; thanneer thirakka neervalathurai adhigaarigal urudhiyalithadhaal poraattam kaividappattadhu. Madathukkulam ondriyam, paappaangulam ooraatchiyil, paappaangulam, rettivaalaiyam, saalarappatti kiraamangal ullana; kiraamangalil, 6 aayirathukkum adhigamaana makkal vasikkindranar.
Mazhai peyyaamal varatchi nilavuvadhaal, ooraatchiyil paraamarikkappadum 5 porvelgal thanneerindri varandu vittadhu. Thattuppaadu adhigarithu kudineerai vilaikku vaangi payanbaduthi varugindranar.
Appagudhiyilulla karavai maadugalukkum thanneer kidaikkaamal, avatrai virpanai seyyum nilai erpattulladhu. Vilainilangalilulla kinaru, porvelgalil thanneer illaadhadhaal, nilaippayiraana karumbu karugi varugiradhu; thennai marangalum kaayndhu varugiradhu.
Nilathadi neermattathukku aadhaaramaana paappaangulam kiraama kulamum varandu vittadhu. Paadhippugalukku theervu kaana valiyuruthi, netru kaalai rottil kiraama makkal saalai mariyal poraattathil eeduvattanar.
Kaalikkudangaludan, udumalai-kozhumam rottil makkal nadathiya poraattathaal avvazhithadathil pokkuvarathu paadhithadhu. Sambava idathukku kumaralingam Police, neervalathurai amaraavadhi anai udhavi seyarporiyaalar aadhisivan, udhavi poriyaalar theenadhayaalan ullittor pechuvaarthai nadathinar.
Appodhu kiraama makkal, 'kudineer thattuppaattu neengavum, nilathadi neermattam sarivaal varandulla porvelgalukku neervarathu kidaikkavum, paappaangulam kiraama kulathukku thanneer thirakka vendum ena pala murai manu koduthom.
Amaraavadhi anaiyilirundhu piradhaana kaalvaayil pudhiya aayakkattu pagudhikku netru mundhinam thanneer thirakkappattulladhu. Aanaal, paappaangulam kiraama kulathukku thanneer thirakkavillai.
Udanadiyaaga kulathukku thanneer thirakka vendum. Kulathai nirappinaal sutruppagudhiyil nilathadi neermattam uyarum. Kiraama porvelgalukku neer varathu kidaithu kudineer thattuppaadu neengum,' endranar.
Kiraama makkal korikkai adippadaiyil, paappaangulam kiraama kulathukku, amaraavadhi piradhaana kaalvaayil irundhu naalai( indru) thanneer thirakkappadum ena neervalathurai adhigaarigal tharappil therivithanar. Idhaiyaduthu makkal poraattathai kaivittu thirumbichendranar.

headline: Nevaalathil masoodhi sooraiyaadappadum kaatchi endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘nevaalathil masoodhi sooraiyaadappadum kaatchi’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ nevaalathilirundhu viral video sondha kaasil sooniyam vachu kitta maadhiri indhukkal saami oorvalathil kallai vittu adithadhil irandu indhukkal sethuttaanga kalavarathai adakka vandha Police suttu melum oru indhu saava ippo pathikku eriyudhu paaeeeeee pooraa kadharikkittu kidakkaanga thevaiyaa,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2020m aandu telliyil edukkappatta video, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Kadandha 2020m aandu pipravari maadham, telliyin vadagizhakkup pagudhiyil ulla asok nagaril CAAkku edhiraaga nadaivetra poraattam ondril vanmurai vedithadhu. Idhanbodhu, kalavarakkaarargal silar angirundha masoodhi ondrai thaakki, sooraiyaadiyullanar. Melum, andha masoodhiyin kovura uchikke sendru, adhanai sedhappaduthi, uchiyil thangaladhu amaippin kodi matrum thesiyak kodiyai etriyullanar. Idhanai Police thadukkaamal vedikkai paarthadhaagak kutrachaattum munvaikkappadugiradhu.
Indha video-vai eduthu, nevaalathil erpatta indhu – musleem modhaludan thodarbuvaduthi, tharpodhu vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
The Telegraph l The Print l The Quint
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda veediyovukkum, nevaalam naattil nadaivetru varum kalavaram thodarbaana seythigalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ’arivikkappadaadha minvettaal perum idi vizhundhadhu pola ulladhu’ – Kovai thozhil thuraiyinar vedhanai!
text:
”sila idangalil 10 nimidangal mudhal 20 nimidam varai oru naalaikku pathu muraikku mel min niruthamum, sila idangalil oru mani neramum mudhal irandu mani neram min nirutham ena pala mani neram arivikkappadaadha minvettu erpaduthappadugiradhu”
Tamil Nadu muzhuvadhum kadandha sila naatkalaaga erpattu varum min thadai kaaranamaaga, podhumakkal kadum avadhikku ullaagi varugindranar. Idhuvarai min thadai pirachanai illaamal irundhu vandha thozhil nagaramaana kovaiyilum kadandha 2 naatkalaaga min vettu thalaidhookki varugiradhu. Munnarivippu indri adikkadi min thadai erpaduvadhaal thozhil paadhippu erpaduvadhaaga thozhil thuraiyinar vedhanai therivithullanar.
Idhugurithu Tamil Nadu kaithozhil matrum kurundhozhil munaivor sangathin (taakt) thalaivar jems kooriyadhaavadhu, “kadandha pala naatkalaaga thamizhagam engum min thadaiyaal podhumakkalum, thozhil munaivorgalum perum paadhippukku ullaagi vandhanar. Aanaalum Kovai maavattathil periya paadhippu illaamal irundha nilaiyil, Thamizhagathil minvettu sari seyyappattadhaaga minsaara vaariyamum, amaichargalum therivithu vandhanar. Indha nilaiyil Kovai maavattathil kadandha irandu naatkalaaga arivikkappadaamal sila thunai min nilaiyangalil 10 nimidangal mudhal 20 nimidam varai oru naalaikku pathu muraikku mel min niruthamum, sila thunai min nilaiyangalil oru mani neramum mudhal irandu mani neram min nirutham ena pala mani neram arivikkappadaadha minvettaal thozhil munaivorgalukku perum idi vizhundhadhu pol aagi ulladhu.
Kovai thozhil thuraiyinarai thuyarathil irundhu meetbadharku minsaara thurai amaichar mun varavendum. Arivikkappadaadha irandu naatkalaaga thodarum minvettaal pallaayirakkanakkaana roobai thozhil munaivorgalukku izhappugal erpaduthik kondirukkiradhu. Erkanave min kattanathil nilai kattana uyarvu, payan paduthum min kattana uyarvu, moolapporul vilai uyarvu, thozhilaalar patraakkurai, vada maanilath thozhilaaligalin kooli uyarvu endru ennatra pirachanaigalai sandhithu varum kuru siru thozhilgal irandu naatkalaaga irunda naatkalaaga maatrappattullana. Odi kondirukkum iyandhirangal arivikkappadaadha minvettaal mishanarigal sadaar endru niruthappaduvadhaal, aattomettik iyandhirangalil ulla udhiri paagangal payanbaduthappadum vilai uyarndha toolgal paadhippu ena pala nashdangalai sandhithuk kondirukkindrom.
Ekkaaranathaik kondum thozhildhuraiyin mel min vettai thinikkaamal paarthuk kolla vendum. Tamil Naattil unmaiyil minbatraakkurai erpattu minsaaram vazhanguvadhil nerukkadi erpadumaanaal minsaara vaariyam minvettu seyyum pagudhigalai mungoottiyaaga arivithu, kuraindhavatcham thozhildhuraiyinarai iyandhirangalum udhiri paagangalum payanbaduthum toolgalaiyum nashdappadaamal paarthuk kolla vendum. Tamil Nadu arasu porkkaala nadavadikkai eduthu indha minvettu nadavadikkaiyil irundhu kovaiyai paadhugaakka vendum” enath therivithaar.

headline: Thuvaay kalyaan joovallars kadaiyil thanga nagai mosadi nadaivetradhaa?
text:
‘’thuvaay kalyaan joovallars kadaiyil nadaivetra thanga nagai mosadi,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ *kuvaithai* , thodarndhu *thuvaayil* nadandha sodhanaiyilum *kalyaan joovallari* l ulla nagai kalil *_irumbu_* kalandhulladhu kanduvidikkappattu indha iru naadugalilum kalyaan joovallarikku *_thadai_* vidhikkappattu moodappattulladhu..
Thangam virkira vilaiyil ini endha kadaiyilum thangathai nambi vaangamudiyaadhu.munbu sembu ippodhu irumbu..
Enave ini *nagai vaanga* endha kadaikku sendraalum kaiyil *kaandhathodu( Magnet )* sendru sodhanai seythu vaangungal.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, samooga valaidhalangalil paravi varum kurippitta video-vukku, udanadiyaaga, Kalyan Jewellers niruvanam maruppu veliyittulladhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kuritha vadhandhi video kadandha 2017m aandu mudhale palveru mozhigalil pagirappattu vandha ondru. Idhanai parappiya navargalai, 2018m aande thuvaay Police vazhakkup padhindhu, kaidhu seythullanar. Indha soozhalil, meendum idhe vadhandhiyai pudhiya seythi pondru, samooga valaidhalangalil parappa vendaam endru, Kalyan Jewellers arivuruthiyulladhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
Times Of India l The News Minute
irudhiyaaga, naam Kalyan Jewellers tharappai thodarbugondu vilakkam ketka mudivu seythom. Avargaladhu Customer Care pirivai thodarbugondu pesinom. Nammidam pesiya kastamar ker nirvaagi, ‘’idhu engaladhu niruvanathil edukkappatta video kidaiyaadhu. Inaiyathalathil kaanappadum edho oru video-vai eduthu, engaladhu niruvanathin peril thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal. Naangal erkanave indha vivagaarathil Police pugaar seythullom. Koodudhal satta nadavadikkai thevaippadum patchathil adhanaiyum naangal merkolvom,’’ endru therivithaar.
Erkanave Police nadavadikkai edutha nilaiyil, unmai theriyaamal meendum pazhaiya vadhandhiyai eduthu, pudhiyadhu pondru kurippittu, samooga valaidhalangalil maruvagirvu seygiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

text:
’RAPIDO-vai ini namba mudiyaadhu; thinamum EXTRA CHARGE..' kondhalikkum podhumakkal!
Seythiyaalar- raajgumaar.ra
Thamizhagathil revido, olaa, uver ullitta online taaksi thalangal seyalbattu varugindrana. Auto pidikka auto staandukkus sella vendiyadhillai... Irukkum idathileye pikkap... Sella vendiya idathileye tiraap... Ena arimugappaduthappatta online taaksi sevaigal, aaramba kaalathileye makkalidam nalla varaverpaip petrana. Aanaal, sameevagaalamaaga, seyaliyil kaattappadum kattanathaivida koodudhalaagap panam seluthumaaru payanigalidam ottunargal ketbadhaaga thodarndhu pugaargal ezhundhu varugindrana.
Sameevathil, instaagiraam piravalamaana oruvar revidovil bike taaksiyai puk seythuvittu neendaneramaagak kaathirundhadhaagath therivithullaar. Aanaal, ottunar neenda neramaagiyum varavillai enak koorappadugiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, kalloorikkus sella vendiyiruppadhaal viraindhu varumaaru ottunarukku andha navar mesej anuppiyullaar. Adharku ottunar, “koodudhalaaga 50 roobai koduthaal udane varugiren. Idhu Priority Cab” ena padhilalithadhaaga andha instaagiraam piravalam therivithullaar. Melum, sameevagaalamaaga idhuvondra sambavangal thodarndhu nadappadhaagak kutramsaattiyullaar.
Melum, kalloorikkus sellum navargalidam koodudhalaaga 10 alladhu 20 roobai kettaal sila nerangalil kodukka mudiyum. Aanaal, seyaliyil 120 roobai kattanam kaattappattaal, 200 roobai kodukkumaaru, adhaavadhu koodudhalaaga 80 roobai ketbadhu niyaayamaa endrum avar kelvi ezhuppiyullaar.
Erkenave oru Ride-kku kurippitta thogaiyai kattanamaagak kaattivittu, andhath thogaikku Ride kidaikkavillai endraal, adhaivida adhigamaana thogaiyai seluthumbadi seyaliyil kaattappaduvadhaagavum pugaargal ezhundhadhaal revido niruvanathukku mathiya nugarvor paadhugaappu aanaiyamaana CCPA 10 latcham roobai avaraadham vidhithadhu. Melum, payanigalai koodudhal kattanam seluthath thoondum vagaiyilaana prompts matrum idhuvondra nadaimuraigalai niruthumaarum CCPA utharavittadhu. Aanaal, idhuvondra pugaargal thodarndhu ezhundhugonde iruppadhaagap payanigal therivithu varugindranar.
Andha instaagiraam piravalathin padhivil munvaikkappatta kutrachaattukku revido niruvanamum padhilalithulladhu. Adhil, “koodudhal kattanam ketkum nigazhvugalai neengal meendum meendum sandhikka nerittadharku naangal migavum varundhugirom. Seyaliyil kaattappadum kattaname neengal selutha vendiya kattanam endru edhirbaarthirukkum nilaiyil, idhuvondra anuvavam evvalavu emaatramaagavum niyaayamatradhaagavum irukkum enbadhai naangal purindhugolgirom. Idhuvondra sambavangalaith thadukka thevaiyaana nadavadikkaigal thodangappattullana. Nermaiyaana matrum velippadaiyaana sevaiyai urudhiseyya, idhuvondra pugaargalai naangal thodarndhu unnippaagak kangaanippom. Kurippitta oru payanam thodarbaaga naangal maruvariseelanai seyya vendum ena neengal virumbinaal, thayavuseythu ungal Ride ID matrum padhivuseyyappatta movail ennai thanippatta seythi (DM) moolam pagirungal. Adhanai aayvu seythu, adharkerpa uriya nadavadikkai eduppom” ena raavido niruvanam therivithulladhu.
Andhap padhivil online taaksi thalangal thodarbaaga payanigal palveru pirasnaigalaith therivithu varugindranar. Kurippaaga, koodudhal kattanam vasoolippadhu, munbadhivu seytha payanathai rathu seyvadhu, paadhiyileye irakkividuvadhu, paadhugaappatra muraiyil vaaganam ottuvadhu, payanigalin thanippatta tholaivesi ennai eduthukkondu thanippatta muraiyil thodarbugolvadhu ullitta palveru kutrachaattugalaip payanigal munvaikkindranar. Oruvuram, online taaksi sevaigal makkalin payanathai elidhaakkiyulla nilaiyil, maruvuram kattana velippadaithanmai matrum payanigalin paadhugaappu thodarbaana pugaargal thodarndhu ezhuvadhu onlain taaksi thalangal meedhaana nambikkaiyaik kuraithulladhu. Melum, arasu idhuvondra online taaksi niruvanangalaik kattamaikkak kattuppaadugalai vidhikka vendum endra korikkaiyum valuthu varugiradhu.

headline: Thamizhaga BJP thalaivaraanadhum adhimuga-vai vimarsithaaraa nayinaar naagendhiran?
text:
Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivaraaga poruppetradhum ADMK-vai vimarsitha nayinaar naagendhiran endru oru video

nigazhchi ondril nayinaar naagendhiran pesiya video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil avar, “annaa DMK indraikku koottaniyil irukku, illaingiradhu irandaavadhu vishayam. Sattamandrathil thairiyamaa oru aanmaiyoda mudhugelumbodu pesakkoodiya annaa thimuga-vai paarkka mudiyavillai” endru pesinaar. Nilaith thagavalil, “thalaimai etravudan BJP thalaivar adhiradi pechu ADMK-vil aanmaiyulla oruvarai kooda paarkka mudiyavillai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivaraaga nayinaar naagendhiran niyamikkappattullaar. Adhe nerathil paajaga-vudan ADMK koottaniyum urudhiyaagi ulladhu. Mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaa matrum ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami aagiyor inaindhu petti alithullanar.
Indha nilaiyil katchith thalaivaraaga niyamikkappatta udaneye adhimuga-vukku edhiraaga nayinaar naagendhiran pesiyadhu pondru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Unmaiyil idhu nayinaar naagendhiran thalaivaraanadhum pesiyadhu illai. Sila aandugalukku munbu avar pesiyirundhaar. Adhu appodhu paravarappaaga pesappattadhu. Enave, indha video unmai aanaal thalaivaraana piragu pesinaar endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu namakku therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aadhaarangalaith thedinom.
Indha video kaatchiyai pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Aanaal namakku pazhaiya video kidaikkavillai. Nayinaar naagendhiran pesiyadhai appadiye koogulil taip seythu thedinom. Appodhu 2022m aandu janavariyil avar appadi pesiyadhu thodarbaana video-kkal namakku kidaithana. San news veliyittirundha YouTube video-vin 1.33vadhu nimidathil andha pechu varugiradhu.
“madhamaatrak kodumai kaaranamaaga maanavi oruvar irandhaar” endru BJP nadathiya poraattathin podhu avar appadi pesiyadhu namakku theriyavandhadhu. 2022m aandu nayinaar naagendhiran pesiyadhai eduthu, 2025l avar BJP thalaivar aana piragu pesiyadhaaga thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Piriks maanaadu India-vukku kidaitha perumai; pa.sidhambaram Vs sasi tharoor... Congress-il modhal
text:
Pudhudilli: piriks maanaattai India-vil nadathuvadhu thodarbaaga Congress mootha thalaivar pa.sidhamravam kelvi ezhuppiya nilaiyil, saga katchi nirvaagiyum, Congress embiyumaana sasi tharoor padhiladi koduthullaar.
Ulaga naadugalin koottamaippugalil ondraana piriks maanaadu naalai mudhal iru thinangalukku nadaiverugiradhu. Indha maanaattil pangerka Russia, thennaaprikkaa ulbada palveru ulaga naadugalais serndha thalaivargal India-vukku vandha vannam ullanar.
Indha maanaadu India-vil nadappadhai kavuravamaaga karudhi varum nilaiyil, piriks maanaattinaal India-vukku enna payan endru Congress mootha thalaivarum, munnaal mathiya nidhiyamaicharumaana pa.sidhambaram netru kelvi ezhuppiyullaar.
Idhu thodarbaaga avar kooriyadhaavadhu; piriks amaippu pola, essio (SCO), ja20, kuvaat aagiya amaippugalilum India angam vagikkiradhu. Idhanaal, namakku enna palan kidaithadhu. Idhuvarai nadandha piriks maanaadugalaal, endhavoru oru nanmaiyum kidaithadhaaga enakku theriyavillai, ivvaaru kurippittirundhaar.
Idharku paajavinar padhiladi koduthu varum nilaiyil, saga Congress mootha thalairum, thiruvanandhavuram embiyumaana sasi tharoorum, pa.sidhambarathin karuthukku edhiraaga pesiyullaar.
Idhu thodarbaaga avar veliyitta video-vil kooriyiruppadhaavadhu; 'piriks amaippu valarndhu varum naadugalukku oru mukkiya thalamaagas seyalbadugiradhu. Indha amaippil angam vagithulla 11 naadugal maaruvatta karuthugalin panmugathanmaiyai ondrinaithu piradhinidhithuvappaduthugindrana. Piriks naadugal ulaga makkal thogaiyil perumbagudhiyaiyum, ulagalaaviya motha ulnaattu urpathiyil 41 sadhaveedhathaiyum kondullana.
Tilliyil nadaiverum piriks uchimaanaadu, palveru naadugalin thalaivargal matrum adhivargal, piradhamargal pangerpadhum India-vukku perumai serkkindrana. Adhumattumillaamal, ulaga arangil India-vin raajadhandhira palathai ondru koottum vidhamaaga amaindhulladhu, ivvaaru avar kooriyullaar.
Sasidharoorin pechu Congress katchiyinaridaiye adhirchiyaiyum, adhirupdhiyaiyum erpaduthiyulladhu.
Mathiya arasin seyalukku aadharavaaga sasi tharoor pesuvadhu idhu mudhalmuraiyalla. Idharku munnadhaaga, aappareshan sindhoor nadavadikkaiyai, Congress katchiyinar vimarsithu vandha nilaiyil, mathiya arasukkum, piradhamar modikkum aadharavaana karuthukkalai sasi tharoor pesiyirundhaar.

headline: 10,000 panai vidhaigal nadavu thittam kundrathu sirpi kuraivindri erpaadu
text:
Thirupparangundram: thirupparangundrathu sirpi thurairaaj, kaaliyidangal, kanmaay karaigalil indhaandum pathaayiram panai vidhaigalai nadavu seyya thittamittu vidhaigalai segarithu varugiraar.
Ivar 20 aandugalaaga 7 latchathirkum adhigamaana marakkandrugal vazhangi ullaar. Thirupparangundrathil 2 adar vanangalil ariya marakkandrugalai nattu paraamarithaar. Paravaigal, kurangugal unavukkaaga thenbarangundram kirivalam rottin iruvuramum sondha selavil pazha marakkandrugalai uruvaakki paraamarikkiraar.
Kadandhaandu thirupparangundram kurukkattaan kanmaayil 2 aayiram, thengaal kanmaayil aayiram, sevvandhi kulathil aayiram, paanaangulathil aayiram, ariyaangulam kanmaayil 800, malaikkup pinburam, thirupparangundram vattaarathil 10 aayirathirkum merpatta panai vidhaigalai nattu paraamarikkiraar. Indhaandum pathaayiram vidhaigalai nadavu seyya, panai vidhaigalai segarikkiraar.
Thurairaaj kooriyadhaavadhu: siru vayadhu mudhal 20 aandugalukku melaaga marakkandrugalai uruvaakki ilavasamaaga vazhangugiren. Poomiyai pasumaiyaakkuvadhu, sutruchoozhalai paadhugaappadhu, paravaigalukku unavu kidaippadhu, sutruchoozhalai paadhugaappadhu pondravatrukkaaga immuyatsiyai thodargiren. Enadhu muyatsikku nanbargal raajaa, sanmugam, seenivaasan, maragadha sundharam, arivazhagan udhavugindranar, endraar. Ivaradhu sevaiyai paaraatti 2021l Madurai Collector pasumai mudhanmaiyaalar virudhu vazhangiyullaar.

headline: ‘koottani patri pesiyadharkaaga annan eevieskku nandri’ endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘koottani patri pesiyadharkaaga annan eevieskku nandri,’’ endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’thozhamaikku nandri. ADMK-yudan DMK koottani pechuvaarthai nadathinom. Aanaal adhil pala sikkalgal irundhadhaal andha mudivai kaivittom. Iru katchigalum thiraavidak katchigale enbadhaal idhil periya vishayam edhuvum illai. Enave annan maanbumigu eevies avargalukku nandri therivithukkolgiren. Melum aatchi amaikka ulla pudhiya katchikku ennudaiya vaazhthugal- mu.ka.staalin. DMK thalaivar’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta news card, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, unmaiyaana news card-il, ‘’ thozhamaikku nandri. Mukkiyamaana sodhanaik kaalathil urudhiyudan udan nindra thozhamai iyakkath thalaivargal peraasiriyar kaadhar mogidheen, annan vaigo, sagodhari piremaladhaa, peraasiriyar javaahirullaa, sagodharargal eesvaran, thamimun ansaari ullitta anaivarukkum en nenjjaarndha nandriyaith therivithukkolgiren. Avargalin urudhikku ethagaiya nandriyum paaraattum porundhum. Mu.ka.staalin. DMK thalaivar,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Koodudhal aadhaaram idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ariya 2026m aandu pipravari endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Nammudaiya vaazhnaalil meendum nigazha vaayppillaadha, 823 aandugalukku oru murai mattum nigazhum ariya pipravari maadham 2026m aandu erpada ulladhu endru oru padhivu

2026 pipravari maadha naatkaatti pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “varavirukkum 2026 pipravari maadham ungal vaazhnaalil meendum oruvodhum nigazha vaayppillai. Enendraal, indha varavirukkum pipravari maadhathil pinvaruvana irukkum: • 4 njaayitrukkizhamaigal • 4 thingatkizhamaigal • 4 sevvaaykkizhamaigal • 4 pudhangizhamaigal • 4 viyaazhakkizhamaigal • 4 vellikkizhamaigal, matrum • 4 sanikkizhamaigal. Idhu ovvoru 823 aandugalukkum oru murai mattume nigazhgiradhu. Idhu ‘miraakkilin’ endru azhaikkappadugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pipravari maadha vazhakkamaaga 28 naatkalaik kondadhu. Leep varudam mattum 29 naatkal kondirukkum. 28ai vaarathin ezhu naatkalukku vaguthaal ovvoru kizhamaikkum sarivigidhamaaga 4 naatkal varum. Leep aandaith thavirthu ippadi ovvoru kizhamaikkum naangu naatkal varuvadhu enbadhu pipravari maadhathil vazhakkamaana ondrudhaan. Aanaal, samooga oodagangalil 823 aandugalukku oru murai nadakkum ariya nigazhvu endru kurippittu palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Leep aandugalukku idaippatta moondru aandugalil ippadi maadhathirku ellaa kizhamaigalukkum naatkal sarisamamaaga varuvadhu vazhakkamaana ondrudhaan. Adhil sirappaanadhu endru kurippida ondrum illai. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil kurippittirundhadhu pondru miraakkil in endru edhaavadhu ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appadi edhuvum illai endru theriyavandhadhu.
Indha vadhandhi pudhiyadhu illai, 2025m aandilum kooda ippadi vadhandhi paraviyadhu. Appodhu idhu thodarbaaga fekt kirasando thamizhil katturai veliyittirundhom. Aanaal indha vadhandhi 2024m aandil illai. Enenil adhu leep varudamaaga irundhadhaal andha aandu mattum indha vadhandhi illai. Meendum 2028m aandu leep aandu vara ulladhu. Adhu varai idhu pondra vadhandhigal samooga oodagangalil paravikkondu thaan irukkap pogiradhu. Ariya thagaval endradhum adhu thodarbaaga siridhum sindhikkaamal udanadiyaaga paravum pokke, idhu pondra vadhandhigal parava kaaranamaaga irukkiradhu. Enave, samooga oodagangalil thagavalai share seyvadharku munbu adhu patri sindhithu, adhu sariyaa endru sarivaartha pirage pagirvadhu sariyaanadhaaga irukkum.

headline: Neechal udaiyil jodhigaa endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Nadigai jodhigaa neechal udaiyil iruppadhu pondru oru pugaippadam

neechal udaiyil nadigai jodhigaa iruppadhu pondra pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indha visayam seldhatti savagumaar ku therinjjaa thookkula thongiduvaane thaa… innaikku oorukkulla oru saavu kanbaarm taa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pala aandugalukku munbu virudhu vizhaa ondril kovilukku selavu seygirom adhu pola arasu palli, maruthuvamanaigalukkum udhavi seyvom enbadhu pola nadigai jodhigaa pesiyirundhaar. Adhaith thodarndhu kovilukku nidhi alikka vendaam endru jodhigaa pesivittaar endru avar meedhu vanmam parappappattu varugiradhu. Tharpodhu avar neechal udaiyil iruppadhu pondra pugaippadathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Nadigai jodhigaa neechal udaiyil iruppadhu pondru padhivu edhum veliyittullaaraa endru ariya avaradhu instaagiraam pakkathaip paarthom. 2025 joon 28m thedhi seeshelskku (Seychelles) sutrulaa sendradhu thodarbaaga padhivu ondrai veliyittirundhaar. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulladhu pondru kaatchi vandhadhu. Aanaal, adhil jodhigaa neechal udaiyil illai. Indha pugaippadathai edit seythu avar neechal udaiyil iruppadhu pondru maatrip padhivittiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Aduthaduthu 7 idangalil veditha kundugal.. Padhatrathil vangadhesam.. Nadandhadhu enna?
text:
Vangadhesa thalainagar taakkaavil jathraavaari, maalivaak, akragaan, mohaagaali, paavuvajaar, mokbajaar, raamburaa ullitta 7 idangalil pirpagal mudhal nalliravu varai thodarchiyaaga naattu vedigundugal veesappattadhaal paravarappu erpattadhu.
Vangadhesa thalainagar taakkaavin palveru pagudhigalil, netru pirpagal thodangi nalliravu varai aduthaduthu nadaivetrirukkum kundu vedippu sambavangal annaattil perum paravarappai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, taakkaa nagaram muzhuvadhum kaavaldhuraiyin kattuppaattukkul konduvarappattulladhu. Innilaiyil, angu enna nadandhadhu? Enbadhu kurithup paarkkalaam.
Indhak kundu vedippus sambavangal, taakkaavin jathraavaari, maalivaak, akragaan, mohaagaali, paavuvajaar, mokbajaar matrum raamburaa ullitta 7 idangalil netru pirpagal 2.25 mani mudhal iravu 11 mani varai nadaivetriruppadhaaga kaavaldhurai tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.
Pala idangalil kundugal vedithaalum, aalillaadha idangalilum saalaigalilum perumbaalum naattu vedigundugal veesappattadhaal adhirshdavasamaaga uyirizhappugal edhum erpadavillai. Adhesamayam, indha sambavangalil, auto ottunar utbada 3 per kaayamadaindhullanar.
Idhanidaiye, netru iravu 10 maniyalavil kaaprul kaaval nilaiyam aruge aalillaadha payanigal perundhu ondrukkum thee vaikkappattulladhu. Indhas sambavam thodarbaagavum Police vazhakkuppadhivu seythu visaaranai nadathi varugindranar.
Indha thodar sambavangalaith thodarndhu taakkaa maanagara kaavaldhurai paadhugaappu nadavadikkaigalai theevirappaduthiyulladhu. Nagarin mukkiya saalaigal, membaalangal, nuzhaivu matrum veliyerum pagudhigalil sodhanais saavadigal amaikkappattullana. Koodudhalaaga Police rondhup paniyum, kangaanippum adhigarikkappattulladhu.
Melum, taakkaavukkul nuzhaiyum matrum veliyerum mukkiyamaana naangu pagudhigalilum paadhugaappu palappaduthappattullana. Indha vedippugal matrum perundhu theevaippu sambavangalukkup pinnaal yaar irukkiraargal enbadhu kurithu visaaranai nadaivetru varugiradhu. Sambava idangalil padhivaana sisidivi kaatchigalum segarikkappattu varugiradhu ena taakkaa kaavaldhurai thunai aanaiyar niyaas mehdhi (Niaz Mehedi) therivithullaar.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, vangadhesathin thalainagar taakkaavil, aduthaduthu 7 idangalil nadandhirukkum kundu vedippus sambavangal annaattil perum paravarappai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.

headline: Paarambariya oviya kangaatchi thodakkam
text:
Chennai: ‘kelari rithu rang’ kalaikkoodathin saarbil, naattil ulla 12 vagaiyaana pazhangudiyina matrum paarambariya kalaasaara oviyangalin moondru naal kangaatchi, adaiyaar kilap ket saalaiyil ullana ingo sendaril netru thodangiyadhu.
Mathiya piradhesam maanilam, indhooril ulla ‘kelari rithu rang’ endra paarambariya kalaikkoodam seyalbadugiradhu. Idhan niruvanar rithu pandaari.
Naattin pazhangudiyina matrum paarambariya kalaigalai paadhugaathu, ulagalavil kondu serkkum nokkil, ikkalaikkoodam seyalbadugiradhu. Kangaatchiyil, pengaali kaaligaat kalai, maadhaa ni pachedi, maisoor thasaraa oviyangal, pat oviyangal, pashminaa embiraaydari, pattasithraa, kerala murals, kondu, madhuvaani, kaangkraa ullitta 12 vagaiyaana oviyangal kaatchippaduthappattullana. Aavana pada thiraiyidalum nadakkiradhu.
Thodakka vizhaavil, thatchishasithraa maravu arungaatchiyagathin kalaasaara thurai iyakkunar anidhaa pottamgulam, aavanappada iyakkunar raguraam aagiyorudan rithu pandaari kalandhuraiyaadinaar.
Appodhu avar kooriyadhaavadhu:
paarambariya kalainjargal pazhangaala nilaippaattaiye virumbugindranar. Evvalavu thaan seyarkai saayangal vandhaalum, iyarkai saayathaiye payanbaduthugindranar.
Paarambariya oviyam, kaivinaith thozhilgalil pengalin eeduvaadu adhigam kaanappadugiradhu. Naveena thozhilnutba vasadhigalaal digital pirinding, kuraindha nerathil adhigappadiyaana urpathi vandhuvittadhu. Irundhaalum, paarambariya kaivinai porutkal, oviyangal, aadaigalukku indralavil madhippu ulladhu.
Naattin paarambariyam kalaasaara oviyangal, kaivannangal, kaivinainjargal valarchikku, arasu nidhi udhavi alippadhu miga mukkiyam.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.
Indrum, naalaiyum nadakkum indha kangaatchiyil payilarangu, kuzhu vivaadham ullittavai nadakka ullana.
***

headline: Kalguvaari vidhimeeral; paa.ja., maaji em.el.e.,vukku roo.3.43 kodi avaraadham vidhippu
text:
Kalguvaari vidhimeeral; paa.ja., 'maaji' em.el.e.,vukku roo.3.43 kodi avaraadham vidhippu
pengalooru: kalguvaari thozhilil, vidhimuraigalai meeriyadhaal, karnaadagaavin haaveri maavatta paa.ja., thalaivarum, munnaal em.el.e.,vumaana viruvaakshappaa pallaarikku, surangam matrum nila aayviyal thurai, 3.43 kodi roobai avaraadham vidhithulladhu.
Karnaadaga surangam matrum nila aayviyal thurai, vidhimeeralaaga seyalbadum kalguvaarigal meedhaana nadavadikkaiyai theevirappaduthiyulladhu. Ithagaiya kuvaarigalin urimaiyaalargalukku avaraadham vidhikkiradhu.
'karnaadaga rimot sensing apligeshan sendar' sameeva naatkalaaga haaveri maavattam muzhudhum, kal kuvaarigalai tron payanbaduthi aayvu nadathiyadhu. Vidhigalai meeriya, 46kkum merpatta kuvaari urimaiyaalargalidam, 26.1 kodi roovaaykkum adhigamaana avaraadham vidhithadhu.
Moondru thavanaigalil avaraadham selutha, aaru maadham kaalakkedu vidhikkappattulladhu. Urima vidhimuraigalai meeri, kalguvaari nadathiyadhaal Congress katchiyai serndha sarkkarai matrum javulithurai amaichar ruthrappaa lamaanikku, surangathurai netru mun thinam moondru kodi roobai avaraadham vidhithadhu.
Adhe pola, kalguvaari vidhimuraigalai meeriyadhaal, haaveri maavattathin, pedagi thogudhi munnaal paa.ja., - em.el.e.,vum, haaveri maavatta paa.ja., thalaivarumaana, viruvaakshappaa pallaarikku, 3.43 kodi roobai avaraadham vidhithu, netru utharavittadhu.
Ivar haaveriyil, 'vi.aar.pallaari' endra peyaril, irandu idangalil kalguvaari nadatha, laisens petrullaar. Aanaal vidhikkappatta nivandhanaigalai meeri, akkam, pakkathil ulla nilathai aakkiramithu, sattavirodhamaaga kalguvaari nadathiyullaar.
Melum, anumadhikkappatta alavai vida, koodudhalaaga, 3.84 latcham tan karkalai vetti eduthullaar enbadhu aayvil urudhiyaanadhu. Enave viruvaakshappaa pallaarikku, 3.43 kodi roobai avaraadham vidhithu, surangathurai nottees alithulladhu.
Viruvaashappaa pallaari mattumindri, ivaradhu sagodharar es.aar.pallaariyum kooda, vidhimeeralaaga kalguvaari nadathugiraar. Ivarukkum, 1.23 kodi roobai avaraadham vidhikkappattulladhu.

headline: Me.vanga idaitherdhal vetbumanuvai vaavas vaanguvadhaaga arivithu yoo - tarn aditha mamdhaa tharappu vetbaalar
text:
Me.vanga idaitherdhal vetbumanuvai vaavas vaanguvadhaaga arivithu 'yoo - tarn' aditha mamdhaa tharappu vetbaalar
kolgattaa: merku vangathil, rejinagar sattasavai thogudhi idaitherdhalil pottiyidum munnaal mudhalvar mamdhaa paanarji tharappu vetbaalar raviyul aalam savuthri, 66, netru thideerena, vetbumanuvai thirumba peruvadhaaga arivithaar. Eninum, sila mani nerangalukku pin, andha mudivai thirumba petraar. Nandhigiraam thogudhiyil mamdhaa niruthiya vetbaalar sanjjidhaa piradhaan, vetbumanuvai vaavas petra nilaiyil, raviyul aalam savuthriyum munnukku muranaaga pesiyadhu paravarappai erpaduthi ulladhu.
Merku vangathil, mudhalvar suvendhu adhigaari thalaimaiyil paa.ja., aatchi nadakkiradhu. Ingu epralil nadandha sattasavai therdha lil adaindha tholviyaal, mamdhaa paanarjiyin thirinamul kaang., irandaaga pilavuvattadhu. Akkatchiyin mothamulla, 80 em.el.e.,kkalil, 60 per, katchiyil irundhu neekkappatta em.el.e., ridhaviradhaa paanarjikku aadharavu ali kkindranar. Avar, sattasavai edhirkkatchith thalai varaaga ullaar.
Indha soozhalil, nandhigiraam, rejinagar sattasavai thogudhigalukkaana idaitherdhal, ak., 6l nadakkiradhu. Idhil, mamdhaa tharappum, ridhaviradhaa tharappum thirinamul peyar, sinnathukku urimai kori yadhaal, katchiyin peyar, 'purkal, iru pookkal' endra sinnathai iru tharappum payanbadutha therdhal kamishan thadai vidhithadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, mamdhaa tharappukku, 'mamdhaa agila Indhiya thirinamul kaang.,' endra peyarum, 'kaalbandhu veerar' endra sinna mum, ridhaviradhaa tharappukku, 'jananaayaga thirinamul kaang.,' endra peyarum, 'thavaal urai' sinnamum odhukkappatta thu.
Therdhal kalam sooduviditha nilaiyil, nandhigiraam thogudhi mamdhaa tharappu vetbaalar sanjjidhaa piradhaan, mudhalvar suvendhu adhigaariyai netru mundhinam sandhithaar. Thodarndhu, than vetbumanuvaiyum avar thirumba petraar. Idhanaal adhirchi adaindha mamdhaa paanarji, nandhigiraam thogudhiyil Congress-ukku aadharavalippadhaaga arivithaar.
Innilaiyil, rejinagar thogudhiyil mamdhaa tharappil kalamirakkappattulla munnaal em.el.e., raviyul aalam savuthri, netru kaalai thideerena vetbumanuvai thirumba peruvadhaaga arivithaar. Eninum, sila mani nerangalukku pin, andha mudivai thirumba petraar.
Idhu kurithu, raviyul aalam savuthri koorugaiyil, ''idaitherdhalil pottiyida vendaam ena, mudhalil mudivu seythen. Mamdhaa paanarji alitha ookkathaal andha mudivai tharpodhu thirumba perugiren. Pirasaarathin podhu enakkum, en aadharavaalargalukkum paadhugaappu alippadhaaga Police urudhi alithullanar. Katchi thondargalin paadhugaappe enakku mukkiyam. 10 per pirasaarathukku vandhaale elidhil vendru viduven,'' endraar.

headline: Vimaana vivathaip paarvaiyida vandha Modi vidhavidhamaana udaigalai anindhaaraa?
text:
Agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathaip paarvaiyida vandha piradhamar narendhira Modi vevveru idangalil vevveru udai anindhirundhaar endru oru pugaippadath thoguppu

agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathu erpatta idathirku Modi sendra pugaippadam, vimaana vivathil thappiyavarai nalam visaaritha pugaippadathudan veru sila pugaippadangalais serthup padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Adhil aangilathil, “one tragedy – four dresses for modi” adhaavadhu oru vivathu naangu udaigalil Modi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippada padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Agamadhaavaathil vimaana vivathu nigazhndha pagudhikku piradhamar narendhira Modi sendru paarvaiyittaar. Melum vivathil uyir pizhaithu sigichai petruvarum ore oru navaraiyum vivathil sikki kaayam adaindhavargalaiyum sandhithup pesinaar. Indha nigazhchi thodarbaana seythigal, pugaippadangal, video-kkal seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Indha nilaiyil veru sila pugaippadangalaiyum serthu vivathaip paarvaiyida vandha Modi vidhavidhamaana aadaiyai maatri pos koduthaar enbadhu pondru silar padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Vimaanathin enjjiya pagudhigalaip paarvaiyidum matrum sigichai petru varuvavarais sandhitha pugaippadathil paarkka ore aadaidhaan anindhullaar.
Iruppinum adhai urudhi seythugolla Modi-yin agamadhaavaath payanam thodarbaana veediyokkalai paarvaiyittom. India tude veliyittirundha video-vil piradhamar Modi vivathu nadandha idam matrum maruthuvamanaiyil sigichai petru varuvavargalais sandhitha video ena irandaiyum ondraaga veliyittirundhanar. Adhil avar udaiyai maatravillai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga oru irumbu paalathin meedhu nirkum pugaippadathai aayvu seythom. Adhai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu kujaraathil 2022m aandu morbi irumbu paalam idindha vizhundha podhu edukkappattadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Vivathu nadandha idathai piradhamar Modi paarvaiyitta podhu indha pugaippadam edukkappattadhaaga appodhu veliyaana oodagangalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Aduthadhaaga varaivadathai vaithu aayvu seyyum pugaippadathai aayvu seythom. Piradhamar narendhira Modi aruge railway amaichar asvini vaishnav ullaar. Enave, idhu pazhaiya pugaippadam enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Padathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu, adhu 2023m aandu odisaavil erpatta mosamaana rail vivathin podhu edukkappattadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Idhan moolam indha pugaippadamum agamadhaavaath sambavathin podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Piradhamar narendhira Modi-yin vevveru pugaippadangalai eduthu, agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathai aayvu seyya sendra podha vidhavidhamaana aadaiyai anindhirundhaar endru thavaraana thagavalai pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: India-vin aiviep thalainagaraaga uruvedutha Tamil Nadu, 669 aiviep maiyangaludan mudhalidam!
text:
IVF Clinic enappadum seyarkai karutharippu maiyangalin ennikkaiyil Tamil Nadu mudhalidathil ulladhaaga seyarkaik karutharippu matrum vaadagaith thaay vazhimuraip padhivettin tharavugal therivikkindrana. 2026 janavari nilavarappadi, India-vil 2650 padhivuseyyappatta aiviep kilinikkugal ullana. Tamil Naattil mattum 669 aiviep maiyangal ullana; irandaam idathil ulla kujaraath maanilathil 361 aiviep kilinikkugal ullana. Thelangaanaavil 276, karnaadagaavil 216 matrum aandhira piradhesathil 203 aiviep kilinikkugal ullana.
Tamil Naattil karuvurudhal vigidham 1.3 aagak kuraindhulladhe immaiyangal adhigarippukku mukkiyak kaaranamaagak koorappadugiradhu. Oru pen than magapperu vayadhil ethanai kuzhandhaigal petrukkolgiraar enbadhan saraasari ennikkaiye karuvurudhal vigidham aagum. Delhi, merku vangam, mahaaraashdiraa maanilangalil karuvurudhal vigidham kuraivaaga irundhavodhilum aiviep kilinikkugal thamizhnaattaivida aindhil oru pangukkuk kuraivaagave ullana.
Tamil Naattil pengal kalvi karpadhum velaikkus selvadhum adhigarithulladhu. Kalvi matrum paniyil pengal aduthadutha nilaigalukkus sella vendum endraal thirumanam, magapperu aagiyavatrai thallivaikka vendiya nirppandham erpadugiradhu. Idhanaal, seyarkaik karutharippu vazhimuraigalin thevai adhigarithiruppadhaaga maruthuvargal koorugindranar. Adhigak kalvi arivu petravargal, karuvurudhal saarndha pirachinaigalukkuth thayakkamindri naveena maruthuvas sigichaigalai naaduvadhum IVF maiyangalin ennikkai adhigarithulladharkuk kaaranamaagum.
Tamil Naattil maruthuvak kattamaippu membattiruppadhaal pira maanilangal matrum velinaadugalilirundhum seyarkaik karutharippu sigichaikku palarum thamizhnaattukku varugindranar. Idhuvum aiviep kilinikkugal adhiga ennikkaiyil iruppadharkup pangalithulladhu. Adhe neram Tamil Naattil maruthuvam migavum vanigamayamaagiyiruppadhum kaaranam endru koorappadugiradhu.

headline: Kadarkaraiyil kanjjaa kaaya vaithuth thoongiya navar… Tamil Naattil nadandhadhaa?
text:
Vidiyal aatchiyil kadarkaraiyil kanjjaavai kaayavaithuth thoongiya navar endru oru padhivu

inaiya oodagam veliyittirundha video-vai sgireenshaat eduthu instaagiraamil padhivittullanar. “‘payame illaama pochu’..😡 kanjjaavai kadarkaraiyil kaaya vaitha navar..! Asandhu thoongiya podhu Twist” endru adhil irundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “amaichar maasu kanjjaavai olithu vittom endru solli kooda ivvalavu velippadaiyaaga vaithiruppadhu avarukku seyyum thurogam allavaa udanbirappe” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Matroru Facebook padhivil inaiya oodagathin veediyovum veliyaagi irundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kanjjaavai veyil kaaya(ulara) vaithukkondu urangiya ilainjan 🙄 thiraavida maadal aatchiyin saadhanai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyil kadarkaraiyil kanjjaavai kaaya vaithuvittu asandhu thoongiya navar endru palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu thodarbaaga thediya podhu indha sambavam kerala maanilathil nadandhadhaaga thagaval namakkuk kidaithana. Aanaal, Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru palarum padhivittu varave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil inaiya oodagam veliyittirundha video padhivai paarthom. Sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru andha padhivil kurippidappadavillai. Idhanaal, vadhandhi parappugiravargalukku vasadhiyaaga poyvittadhu. Video-vai paarthom. 45vadhu vinaadiyil indha sambavam kerala maanilam kozhikkodu kadarkaraiyil nadandhadhu endru kurippidugindranar. Idhan moolam indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga malaiyaala oodagangalil veliyaana seythigalaith thedi eduthom. Adhil, “kanjjaa podhaiyil 370 kiraam alavulla kanjjaavai kadarkaraiyil kaaya vaithuvittu, arugil paduthuth thoongiya navar. Kadarkaraikku vandhavargal indha kaatchiyai video-vaaga eduthu samooga oodagangalil padhivittanar. Indha nilaiyil kanjjaavai kaaya vaithu thoongiya navarai kozhikkodu Police kaidhu seythanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Kerala oodagangal mattumindri PTI ullitta seythi niruvanam, thesiya oodagangal kooda indha seythiyai veliyittullana. Keralaavil nadandha sambavathai Tamil Naattil, thi.mu.ka-vinar seythadhu pondru vishamathanamaaga thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil padhivittulladhu urudhiyaagiradhu.indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline:
728 adi agalam.. 141 adi aazham..
Thideerena uruvaana pirammaanda pallam.. Nilavil kanduvidikkappatta marmam!
text:
728 adi agalam.. 141 adi aazham.. Thideerena uruvaana pirammaanda pallam.. Nilavil kanduvidikkappatta marmam!
Nilavai naam vaanathil paarkkumbodhu, adhan merparappu muzhuvadhum eraalamaana pallangaludan iruppadhaagas sonnaal yaaraavadhu nambuvaargalaa? Aanaal, andha nilavil 141 adi aazhathirku pallam ondru iruppadhaagas sonnaal eppadi irukkum? Appadiyoru pudhiya pallathaithaan America vinveli aayvu niruvanamaana NASA-vin Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter enappadum LRO kanduvidithulladhu. Pala aandugalaaga nilavais sutri vandhu adhan merparappai migath thulliyamaagap padam pidithu varum indha vingalam, pazhaiya matrum pudhiya pugaippadangalai oppittup paarthavodhu, nilavin merparappil pudhidhaaga uruvaana migapperiya pallam ondraik kandarindhulladhu. NASA vinjnjaanigal idharku McGetchin crater enap peyarittullanar. Nilavin kizhakkup pagudhiyil uruvaagiyulla indhap pallam, sumaar 728 adi agalamum, 141 adi aazhamum kondadhaaga ulladhu. Adhaavadhu, sumaar irandu kaalbandhu maidhaanangalin neelathirkus samamaana agalathaik kondirukkiradhu.
Aanaal, ivvalavu periya pallam eppadi uruvaanadhu? NASA vinjnjaanigalin aayvuppadi, oru sirugol alladhu vaalnatchathirathin oru pagudhi nilavin merparappil modhiyadhaaldhaan indhap pallam uruvaagiyirukkalaam endrum, andha vingal sumaar 3 mudhal 6 maadik kattadathin alavukku irundhirukkalaam ena madhippittullanar.
Melum, indha modhal 2024-m aandu epral 11 mudhal me 22-m thedhikkul edho oru naalil nigazhndhirukkalaam ena aayvaalargal kanithullanar. Indhap pallathais sutriyulla pagudhiyil sumaar 4 mail, adhaavadhu 6.4 km agalathirku nilavin merparappu maariyiruppadhai NASA-vin Diviner endra karuviyin tharavugal kaattugindrana. Indhap pagudhi sutriyulla nilapparappaivida iravu nerathil sumaar 16 tigiri Fahrenheit alavukku kulirchiyaaga iruppadhum kandariyappattulladhu. Idharku kaaranam ennavendraal, vingal modhiyavodhu nilavin merparappil irukkum man matrum paaraithugalgal enappadum regolith thalarndhu, adhigamaagak kilarappattirukkiradhu.
Idhanaal andhap pagudhi veppathai vazhakkambol thakkavaithuk kolla mudiyaamal pogiradhu ena vinjnjaanigal therivithullanar. Ippadi pala kodi aandugalaaga irundha pallangalukku mathiyil, sameeva kaalathil uruvaana oru pudhiya pallathai NASA kanduvidithiruppadhu, nilavu innum muzhumaiyaaga amaidhiyaana ulagam illai enbadhaiye kaattugiradhu. Naam poomiyil irundhu amaidhiyaagap paarthukkondirukkum nilavin merparappil, vingarkalin thaakkathaal indrum maatrangal nigazhndhugondudhaan irukkindrana!

headline: Pennukku paaliyal thollai thandhavar kaidhu
text:
Tirunelveli: Tirunelveli tavun maadhaa sannadhi theruvai serndha raajendhira perumaal, 47, kevil 'tivi'aavarettaraaga velai seythu varugiraar.
Ippagudhiyil itli kadai nadathi varum 35 vayadhu pennukku aavaasa kurundhagavalgal anuppi thollai koduthullaar. Idhu kurith thu andha pen tavun magalir poleesil pugaar alithaar. Police azhaithu echarithu anuppinar. Adhanbinnum andha pennai pindhodarndhu sendru paaliyal thollai koduthadhudan, sammadhikkaavittaal mirattalum viduthullaar. Idhaiyaduthu raajendhira perumaalai Police kaidhu seythanar.

headline: ”adutha thalaimuraikku aavathaana arasiyal..” atlee pechukku pos vengat padhil!
text:
Atlee arasiyal kurithu kooriya karuthukku padhilalitha pos vengat, adutha thalaimurai katrukkolla vendiya arasiyal arinjar annaa mudhal M.K. Stalin varai ulla sindhanaigalil irukka vendum, tharpodhaiya thavaraana arasiyal periya samooga seerazhivai erpaduthum ena echarikkiraar.
Vijay sedhuvadhi nadippil velivaravirukkum paathaa isai veliyeettu vizhaavil pangetru pesiya atlee, oor vaayai adaikka mudiyaadhu. Oor aayiram pesum. Oor vaayil vizhundhadhai nambi naam vaazhndhuttu povadhu muttaal thanam ena ninaikkiren. Yaar enna sonnaalum ketkaadheergal. Neengal ungal ilakkai nokki sendru konde irungal. Naduvil sinna sinna thadaigal varathaan seyyum. Jensi thalaimuraiyinaraana naam thaan aduthu varappogirom. Samooga valaithalangalil ivaru avarai solgiraar, avar ivarai solgiraar ena koora vendaam. Solla vendum endraal neradiyaaga solli vittu pogalaam.
Arasiyalil adutha thalaimuraiyinar valuvaaga iruppaargal. Adharku ore kaaranam Vijay annan. Naan arasiyalvaadhiyum alla, naan arasiyal pesuvadhum illai. En mundhaiya thalaimuraiyaiyum paarthirukkiren. Aanaal, ippodhu 5 vayadhu kuzhandhaigalum sattasavai neralaiyai kaalaiyil irundhu utkaarndhu paarkkiraargal. Valuvaana thalaimuraiyinarai Vijay annaa uruvaakki ullaar. Adhil sandhegame kidaiyaadhu. Arasiyal ellaam nalladhalla, sarivaraadhu endrellaam munbu solvaargal. Aanaal adhu maari ulladhu. Arasiyal namakkaanadhu. Adhai naam eppadi eduthukkolgirom, eppadi paarkkirom enbadhu namadhu moolaiyaip poruthadhu endraar” ena pesiyirundhaar.
Sameevathil pikbaas nigazhchiyil thalaivan, thalaimaippanbu kurithu Vijay sedhuvadhi pesiya karuthukkal sarchaiyaana nilaiyil, atleeyin indhap pechu adhanudan oppidappattu viral-aaga paravivarugiradhu.
Innilaiyil atleeyin pechukku padhilalithirukkum iyakkunarum, nadigarumaana pos vengat, indha arasiyal adutha thalaimuraikku aavathaiye kodukkum ena kooriyullaar.
X thalathil padhivittirukkum pos vengat, “adutha thalaimurai katrukkolla vendiya arasiyal, sattamandra nigazhvugal arinjar annaavil aarambithu thalavadhi mu.ka.staalinil mudindhadhaaga karudhugiren.
Indha thalaimurai thavaraana arasiyalai katrukkolgiradhu.. Idhu periya samudhaaya seerazhivai undaakkum.
Mudhal konal mutrilum konal aagum.. Pillaigal arinjar annaa, thandhai periyaar, kaaral maaks. Lenin,maavo.. Ena ivargalai padithu nalla puratchigaramaana karuthukkalai katrukkolla vendum.
Iyakkunar atli sollum arasiyal katral enbadhu adutha thalaimuraikku aavathaiye vilaivikkum” ena padhivittullaar.

headline: Siraar paasbort vidhigalil maatram; kattanamum adhigarippu; veliyuravuthurai nadavadikkai
text:
- sirappu niruvar -
naattil, 15 vayadhukku utbatta siraargalukkaana paasbort vidhigalil maatram seyyappattulladhu; kattanamum adhigarikkappattulladhu.
Siraar paasbort vidhigalil nam veliyuravu thurai adhiradi maatrangalai seythulladhu. Adhanbadi, 15 vayadhukku utbatta siraargalukku vazhangappadum saadhaarana, 36 pakka paasbort, vazhangappatta thedhiyilirundhu, 5 aandugal mattume selluvadiyaagum alladhu andha siraarukku, 18 vayadhu poorthiyaagum varai mattume sellum. Idhil, edhu munnadhaaga varugiradho adhuve kanakkil edukkappadum.
Udhaaranathukku, oru siruvanukku tharpodhu, 10 vayadhu ena, vaithuk kolvom. Avarukku ippodhu paasbort eduthaal, adhu adutha, 5 aandugalukku, adhaavadhu siruvanukku, 15 vayadhaagum varai sellum.
Adhuve, siruvanukku, 14 vayadhu nadakkum podhu paasbort eduthaal, adutha 5 aandugal kanakkidappadaadhu. Siruvanukku, 18 vayadhu eppodhu mudigiradho, andha naangu aandugalileye andha paasbort kaalaavadhiyaagi vidum. Enenil, 18 vayadhu poorthiyaanavudan, mejar pirivukkul siruvan vandhu viduvaar. Idharku mun, indha vidhi, 5 aandugal alladhu siraargalukku, 15 vayadhaagum varai mattume selluvadiyaagum vagaiyil irundhadhu.
Pudhiya nadaimuraiyaal kuzhandhaigalin paasborttugalai adikkadi pudhuppikka vendiya avasiyam, ini petrorukku irukkaadhu. Siraargalukkaana saadhaarana, 36 pakka paasborttin vilai, 1,000 roovaayil irundhu, 1,775 roobaayaaga adhigarikkappattulladhu. 'thathgaal' paasbort kattanam, 3,000 roobaayaaga nirnayikkappattulladhu.

headline: Vanmuraiyil eeduvatta karappaanboochi janadhaa katchiyinar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Car ondrai erikka muyatsi seythu thesa virodha kumbalaaga maariya karappaanboochi janadhaa katchiyinar endru kurippittu oru video

islaamiyar oruvar car ondrai erikka muyatsi seyyum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “nija karappaan poochiyaagave maariya thesa virodha kumbal! #CJPExposed” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Neet thervai vinaathaal kasivu muraigedugalukkup poruppetru mathiya kalvi amaichar tharmendhira piradhaan padhavi vilaga vendum enbadhu ullitta korikkaigalai valiyuruthi kadandha joon maadham mudhal maanavargal karappaan poochi janadhaa katchi endra peyaril poraattam nadathi varugindranar. Indha nilaiyil karappaan poochi janadhaa katchiyinar kaarai erithu vanmuraiyil eeduvattanar endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video thodarbaaga indhi oodagangalil seythi veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Sila aangilathil veliyaana seythigalum namakku kidaithana. Avatraip paarthavodhu, idhu karappaanboochi janadhaa katchi poraattathin podhu edukkappattadhu illai endru theriyavandhadhu.
Avatril, “indha sambavam peegaar maanilam kayaavil joolai 16m thedhi nadandhadhu. BJP kodi stikkar ottappatta kaaril vandhavar irandu auto rikshaakkal modhi sedham erpaduthinaar. Idhil kaayam adaindhavargal udanadiyaaga maruthuvamanaikkuk kondu sellappattanar. Indha sambavathaal aathiramadaindha andha pagudhi makkal karkalai veesi kaarin kannaadigalai udaithanar. Oruvar kaarukku thee vaikka muyatsi seythaar. Angu vandha Police indha vanmurai seyalgalai thaduthu nilaimaiyaik kattukkul kondu vandhanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam indha sambavathirkum tharpodhu Delhi jandhar mandharil nadandhu varum karappaanboochi janadhaa katchi poraattathirkum thodarbillai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘panathai koduthuttu po..’ pirasava valiyil thuditha pennai thadutha navar.. Thaay, sisukku nerndha thuyaram!
text:
Kaanjjivuram aruge maram vettum paniyil eeduvatta irular samoogathais serndha thenmozhi, 9 maadha karppiniyaaga irundhavodhu thideerena pirasava vali erpattadhu. Maruthuvamanaikku sella vaangiyagadan kaaranamaaga urimaiyaalar thadai seythadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu. Koodaarathileye pirasavam nadandhu, kadumaiyaana vali, rathappokkaal thaay, pachilam kuzhandhai iruvarum uyirizhandhanar. Police visaaranai nadathi varugindranar.
Kaanjjivuram maavattam singaadivaakkam ooraatchiyais serndha irular samooga thambadhi aanandhan (40), thenmozhi (35). Arakkonam saalai vellai ket aruge maram vettum paniyil kadandha 6 maadhangalaaga eeduvattu vandhullanar. Ivargaludan matroru irular thambadhiyum paniyaatri vandhullanar.
Innilaiyil, 9 maadha karppiniyaana thenmozhikku thideerena pirasava vali erpattadhaagavum, maruthuvamanaikku sella anumadhikkumaaru kanavarudan serndhu marakkadai urimaiyaalar aarumugathidam kettadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Aanaal, avaridam petrirundha roo.20,000 kadanai seluthaamal paniyidathai vittu sellakkoodaadhu enak koori maruthuvamanaikku sella vidaamal thaduthadhaaga pugaar therivikkappattulladhu.
Idhanaal, koodaarathileye pirasavam thodangiya nilaiyil, kuzhandhaiyin udal paadhi veliye vandhavodhu kadumaiyaana vali matrum rathappokku kaaranamaaga thenmozhiyum, pirandha pachilam kuzhandhaiyum uyirizhandhadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Idhugurithu ponnerigarai kaaval nilaiyathil pugaar alikkappattulla nilaiyil, Police visaaranai merkondu varugindranar. Maruthuvamanaikku sella thaduthadhaaga koorappadum kutrachaattu kurithu Police visaaranaikkup pinnare muzhu unmai theriyavarum ena kaavaldhurai tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: “imayamalaiyil vaazhum oru adhisaya poochi” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Imayamalaiyil vaazhum adhisaya rojaa poo pondru kaatchi alikkum poochi endru oru video

oruvarin kai viralil amarndha poochi ondru than siragugalai virikka adhu rojaa malar pol maarugiradhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “iraivan padaippil thaan ethanai adhisayam
idhu imayamalaiyil vaazhum oru adhisaya poochi aagum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Imayamalaiyil nooru aandugalukku oru murai malarum malar endru vadhandhi parappi vandhanar. Tharpodhu, poochi ondru rojaa malar pol irukkiradhu endru eai video-vai vaithu vadhandhi parappi varugindranar. Unmaiyil ippadi adhisaya poochi irundhirundhaal adhu patri oralavukku makkal mathiyil arimugam irundhirukkum. Eraalamaanavargal appadippatta poochiyai valarkkave aarambithiruppaargal.
Idhu poliyaanadhu enbadhu namakkuth therigiradhu. Aanaalum idhaiyum imayamalaiyil vaazhum adhisaya poochi endru palarum pagirndhu varugindranar. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Palarum indha video-vai padhivittirukkave, unmaiyil mudhalil idhai yaar veliyittadhu enbadhaik kandarivadhu migavum kadinamaaga irundhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu, oleg.pars endra instaagiraam pakkathil 2025 maars 18m thedhi oruvar padhivu veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Avarukku munbaaga yaarum indha padhivai veliyidavillai.
Andha padhivil adhu unmaiyaana poochi enbadhu polave kurippittirundhaar. Aanaal avatrukkuk keezhe, Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Aftereffects, Elevenlabs endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhil, After Effects enbadhu Adobe-n pugaippadangalai uruvaakkum menborulaagum. Matravai patrith thediya podhu avai anaithum seyarkai nunnarivu, pugaippadangal, video-kkal uruvaakka payanbadum thalangal enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Melum, andha instaagiraam pakkathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video pondru eraalamaana video-kkal padhividappattirundhana. Poochi, puzhukkal ellaam malargalaaga maaruvadhu pondru ore maadhiriyaaga avai irundhana. Ellaa padhivilum avai unmaiyaanavai enbadhu polave padhivittirundhaar. Aanaal, keezhe video-vai thayaarikka udhaviya seyarkai nunnarivu thalangal patrik kurippittirundhaar. Enave, idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Melum thannaip patriya suyavivarak kurippil Digital creator endru kurippittirundhaar. Melum namba mudiyaadha uyirinangalai theduvavar endrum kurippittirundhaar. Computer kot-kalai uruvaakka, thirakkum thozhilnutbamaana Cryptologis endru thannai kurippittullaar. Idhan moolam seyarkai nunnarivu thozhilnutbathai nangu payanbaduthath therindhavar ivar enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan moolam ippadi poochikkalai vaithu veediyokkalai uruvaakki veliyittirukkalaam enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Verum 3 idangaldhaan vithiyaasam.. Aatchiyaip piditha edhirkkatchi.. Savaalil sveedan!
text:
Sveedan naadaalumandrath therdhalil valadhusaari koottani tholviyadaindhadhaith thodarndhu, annaattin piradhamar ulp kiristarsan thanadhu padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythullaar. Anmaiyil nadandha therdhalil idadhusaari edhirkkatchik koottani 176 idangalaik kaippatri migak kuraindha perumbaanmaiyudan vetri petradhu. Idhanaith thodarndhu pudhiya arasai amaippadharku vazhivagukkum vagaiyil piradhamar thanadhu raajinaamaa kadidhathais samarppithullaar.
349 thogudhigalaik konda sveedan naadaalumandrathukku anmaiyil therdhal nadaivetradhu. Idhil, 176 idangalaip petra edhirkkatchiyaana idadhusaarik koottani vetri petradhu. Therdhal mudivugal veliyaanadhaith thodarndhu, pudhiya arasu amaippadharkaana adhigaarappoorva pechuvaarthaigalaith thodanga ulp kiristarsan thanadhu raajinaamaa kadidhathai savaanaayagaridam samarppithullaar.
Idhanmoolam samooga jananaayagak katchiyin thalaivaraana makdalinaa aandarsan piradhamaraagap porupperpaar ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. 2021–2022 kaalakkattathil sveedanin mudhal pen piradhamaraagap paniyaatriya makdalinaa aandarsan, 4 aandugalukkup piragu meendum aatchip porupperka ullaar. Vetri kurithu makdalinaa aandarsan, "sveedan makkal naattin pudhiya thisaikkum, pilavugalukku edhiraana otrumaikkum vaakkalithullanar; makkalin indha viruppathai enadhu arasu niraivetrum. Kaalanilai maatram, kalvith thurais seerdhirutham, membaduthappatta sugaadhaaram, mudhiyor paraamarippu matrum seeraana kudiyetrak kolgai aagiyavai pudhiya arasin mukkiya munnurimaigalaaga irukkum” enath therivithullaar.
349 naadaalumandra idangalil 176 idangalai mattume idadhusaarik koottani petrulladhu. Adhaavadhu, verum 3 idangal mattume akkatchi koodudhal perumbaanmaiyaip petrulladhu. Idhanaal endhavoru pudhiya sattathaiyum niraivetra anaithuk koottanik katchigalin aadharavum avasiyamaagum. Naadaalumandrathil valadhusaarik koottani 173 idangaludan miga palamaana edhirkkatchiyaaga irukkum enbadhaal, arasin ovvoru nagarvilum nerukkadigal adhigarikkum.
Kurippaaga, koottaniyil idambetrulla maiyak katchi (Centre Party) matrum idadhusaarik katchi (Left Party) idaiye porulaadhaarak kolgaigal matrum vari vidhippil muranbaadugal nilavugindrana. Aandarsanin soshiyal temaakrats katchi kadumaiyaana kudiyetrak kattuppaadugalaiyum kutrath thaduppil theevirap pokkaiyum aadharikkiradhu. Aanaal koottaniyil ulla kireens matrum idadhusaarik katchigal idhil maaruvatta thaaraalamaya nilaippaattaik kondullana. Idhanaal akkatchigal idaiye ulla kolgai veruvaadugalais seerseythu nilaiyaana arasai uruvaakkuvadhu aandarsanukku mukkiya savaalaaga irukkum.

headline: ‘TVK thundu anindha raagavaa laarans’ endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘TVK thundu anindha raagavaa laarans’’ endru koori,

idhil, raagavaa laarans TVK thundu anindhiruppadhu pondra pugaippadam, idambetrulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu vendumendre edit seythu, pagirappadum pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, raagavaa laarans tharappil kettavodhu, ‘’AI muraiyil rasigargal ivvaaru poliyaana pugaippadangalai thayaarithu parappugindranar. Idhuvondru endha padamum raagavaa laarans veliyidavillai,’’ endru therivithanar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, naam aayvu seyyum pugaippadathai veliyitta raghavalawrenceoffl endra instaagiraam pakkam sendru paarthom. Adhil, thelivaaga, ‘’idhu oru Fan Page’’ endru thelivaagak kurippidappattulladhu.
Idhanmoolamaaga, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhalla; AI moolamaaga thayaarikkappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ji7 maanaattil Modi pangerkavillai endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
“ji7 maanaattil pangetravargal pugaippadathil Modi illai… avar maanaattil pangerkave illai. Maanaadu nadandhu mudindha piragu thaan Modi angu sendraar” endru oru padhivu

ji7 maanaattil thalaivargal eduthukkonda pugaippadam ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhanudan news thamizh veliyitta news kaardum inaikkappattulladhu. Adhil, “payangaravaadhathai ozhikka vendum. Payangaravaadhathirku aadharavu alikkum naadugal, adharkaana palanai nichayam anuvavithe aaga vendum. Kanadaavil nadaivetra ji7 uchimaanaattil piradhamar soolurai” endru irundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “ji 7 maanaattil pangetravargalin pugaippadathil Modi-yin pugaippadam illaiye! Appo Modi pesiyadhu enge?
Ji 7 maanaattu thalaivargal ondru koodi pesi mudithu maanaattai niraivu seytha piragu, jee7 naadugalin thalaivargaludan pesiyayai, edho Modi ji7 maanaattil pangetru pesiyadhai pol veliyittu BJP izhivaana poli vilambarathai thedugiradhu unmaiyileye ji 7 enbadhu indha ezhu naadugal thaan. Piraans, jermani, ithaali, Japan matrum yunaidet kingdam (UK) idhil India illave illai.
Madhiyaadhaar thalaivaasal midhiyaadhe! Enbadhu suyamariyaadhaiyai suttikkaattum oru pazhamozhi! Modi-kku adhu illaiyendraalum, Indhiya naattai unmaiyaaga nesikkum ovvoru indhiyanukkum undu! Thannudaiya izhivaana vilambara mogathaal ulaga arangil India-vukku avamaanathai petru tharum miga mosamaana piradhamar Modi thaan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
“ji7 maanaattil indhiyap piradhamar narendhira Modi pangerkave illai. Ji7 thalaivargal eduthukkonda pugaippadathil Modi illai” endru oru padhivu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Maanaattil pangerkaamaleye pangetradhaaga India-vil vilambaram seythu kondadhu pondru padhivittu varugindranar. Indha thagaval matrum pugaippadam thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Ji7 2025m aandukkaana uchi maanaadu kanadaavin aalbarttaavil ulla kananaasgisil joon 16 mudhal 17m thedhi varai nadandhadhu. Idhil ji7 naadugal mattumindri, valarum naadugalin thalaivargalum kalandhugondanar. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil kooriyadhu pondru ji7 naadugalil India uruppinar illaidhaan. Aanaal ovvoru aandum sirappu virundhinargalaaga azhaikkappadum naadugalul indhiyaavum ondru.
Valarum naadugal ji20 endra amaippai uruvaakkiyadhu pondru valarndha naadugalukku ji7 endra amaippu ulladhu. Idhil America, ingilaandhu ullitta naadugal ullana. Thodakkathil 6 naadugaludan indha amaippu thodangappattadhu. 7vadhu naadaaga kanadaa serkkappattadhu. Adhaith thodarndhu airoppiya yooniyanum inaindhadhu. Indha maanaattil India, aasdhireliyaa, piresil ullitta naadugal sirappu azhaippaalargalaaga azhaikkappadum.
Indha aandu kanadaavil nadandha ji7 maanaattil indhiyap piradhamar narendhira modiyum azhaikkappattirundhaar. Avar maanaattil pangetradhu thodarbaana pala video-kkal, pugaippadangal seythi oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhana. Avatrai ellaam nambaamal Modi ji7 maanaattil pangerkave illai endru padhivittirundhadhaal oodagangalil veliyaana seythiyai odhukkivaithuvittu ji7 maanaattin adhigaarappoorva inaiyathalathil Modi pangerpu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigalaith thedinom.
Ji7 inaiyathalathil maldimeediyaa pagudhiyil maanaattukku vandha thalaivargal eduthukkonda pugaippadam veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, piradhamar narendhira Modi irukkiraar. Family photo with outreach partners endru thalaippittu indha pugaippadathai veliyittirundhanar. Indha pugaippadathai piradhamar narendhira modiyum thannudaiya X thala pakkathil padhivittirundhaar. Ji7 inaiyadhalathileye Modi pugaippadam iruppadhan moolam avar ji7 maanaattil pangerkavillai endra thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Edharkaaga irandu murai ji7 thalaivargal pugaippadam eduthukkondaargal enbadhaith therindhugollath thodarndhu aayvu seythom. Appodhu 17m thedhi ji7 thalaivargal mattumum 18m thedhi ji7 thalaivargaludan azhaikkappatta naadugalin thalaivargalum serndhu pugaippadam eduthukkondadhu therindhadhu.
Ji7 maanaattil mudhal naalil uruppu naadugalin thalaivargal mattum kuzhuvaagap pugaippadam eduthukkolvadhum, 2vadhu naal maanaattil pangetra anaithu ulagath thalaivargalum ondraaga pugaippadam eduthukkolvadhum vazhakkamaana ondru endru koorappadugiradhu. Adhan padi mudhal naalil ji7 thalaivargal mattum pugaippadam eduthullanar. Adhaavadhu 17m thedhi ji7 thalaivargal mattum pugaippadam eduthukkondanar. Adharku adutha naal adhaavadhu joon 18m thedhi ji7 thalaivargal matrum sirappu azhaippu vidukkappatta naadugalin thalaivargal adhaavadhu Modi ullitta thalaivargal ellaam ondru serthu pugaippadam eduthullanar.
Ji7 maanaattin indha vazhakkamaana nadavadikkai patriya puridhal indri, mudhal naal pugaippadathai mattum vaithukkondu, maanaattil Modi pangerkavillai endru thavaraana thagavalai veliyittullanar.
Nammudaiya aayvil Modi maanaattil pangetradhu thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Raajnaath sing kaalil vizhundha kudiyarasuth thalaivar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Mathiya paadhugaapputh thurai amaichar raajnaath sing kaalil indhiyak kudiyarasuth thalaivar thiravuvadhi murmu vizhundhadhaaga oru video

amaichar raajnaath singidam puthagam ondrai vazhangivittu avaradhu kaalil Indhiya kudiyarasuth thalaivar thiravuvadhi murmu vizhundhu vananguvadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vin meedhu, “namadhu indhiyaven janaadhivadhiyin avala niyai (nilaiyai) paarungal. Enge samooga needhi” endru taip seythu serkkappattirundhadhu. Indha veediyovaiyum idhan sgireenshaattaiyum palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Mathiya amaichar raajnaath sing kaalil thiravuvadhi murmu vizhundhadhu pondru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Paarkka eai (seyarkai nunnarivu) moolam uruvaakkappatta video pola ulladhu. Raajnaath sing kaalil vizhumbodhu thiravuvadhi murmuvin mugam maaruvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Aanaalum, idhaip palarum pagirndhu varave idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil video kaatchiyin thodakkathil varum puthagam vazhangum pagudhiyai mattum thaniyaaga eduthu koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu andha pugaippadam 2025 joon maadha irudhiyil mathiya arasin piaivi matrum pala seythi oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil kudiyarasuth thalaivar maaligaiyil kudiyarasuth thalaivar thiravuvadhi murmuvai sandhitha podhu “vings aap avar hop” endra puthagathai vazhangiya mathiya amaichar raajnaath sing endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Piaivi veliyittirundha seythik kurippil, “thagaval matrum olivarapputhurai amaichar thiru. Asvini vaishnav matrum thagaval matrum olivarapputhurai inaiyamaichar doctor el. Murugan aagiyorudan inaindhu, paadhugaappu amaichar thiru. Raajnaath sing, ‘vings tu avar hops’ matrum ‘aashon ki udhaan’ puthagangalin irandaavadhu thogudhiyin mudhal piradhigalai kudiyarasuthalaivar thirumadhi. Thirauvadhi murmuvidam indru (joon 23, 2025) kudiyarasuthalaivar maaligaiyil vazhanginar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Kudiyarasuth thalaivaridam puthagangalai vazhangum pugaippadangalaiyum piaivi veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil idam petrirundha kaatchiyai aie moolam video-vaaga maatriyiruppadhu therindhadhu. Unmaiyil ippadi oru sambavam nadandhirundhaal adhai mathiya amaicharo, kudiyarasuth thalaivar aluvalagamedhaan veliyittirukkum. Aanaal nammudaiya aayvil appadi endha oru seythiyo, padhivo kandariya mudiyavillai.
Namakkuk kidaitha seythiyil thiravuvadhi murmuvidamdhaan amaichar puthagangalai vazhangiyadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovilo kudiyarasuth thalaivar thaan raajnaath singukku puthagathai vazhanguvadhu pola irundhadhu. Indha pugaippadam joon maadham veliyaagi irundhadhu. Raajnaath sing kaalil vizhundhirundhaal adhu appodhe migapperiya seythiyaaga veliyaagi irundhirukkum. Aanaal, appadi endha oru seythiyum illai. Ivai ellaam indha video poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Indha video kaatchiyai pugaippadamaaga maatri eai kaatchigalaik kandariya udhavum inaiyadhalangalil padhivetrith thedinom. Avaigalum idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil mathiya amaichar raajnaath sing kaalil vizhundha thiravuvadhi murmu endru paravum video poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Naadaalumandram iyatrum sattangalil ucha Needhimandram thalaiyidakkoodaadhu endru Edappadi Palaniswami koorinaaraa?
text:
‘’naadaalumandram iyatrum sattangalil ucha Needhimandram thalaiyidakkoodaadhu. Vakp sattathirku edhiraaga Edappadi Palaniswami karuthu’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ sattamiyatruvadhil needhimandrangal thalaiyidakkoodaadhu. Naadaalumandram iyatrum sattangalil needhimandrathin thalaiyeedu koodaadhu. Appadi thalaiyittaal needhivarivaalana samanbaadu kuraindhuvidum avaayam undu. Vakfu sattam kuritha uchaneedhimandrath theerppu patriya kelvikku eevies padhil,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Thinamalar logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu vendumendre arasiyal ulnokkathudan pagirappadum vadhandhi, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, idhudhodarbaaga, thinamalar aasiriyar kuzhu matrum ADMK aidi pirivu aagiyoridam pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga ADMK aidi pirivu thanadhu adhigaarappoorva X valaidhala pakkathil veliyitta padhivu ondraiyum keezhe inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Postar seythi –––––––––––––––––– thiraippadathil mudhalvaraaga nadikkiraar sitharaamaiyaa
text:
Postar seythi –––––––––––––––––– thiraippadathil mudhalvaraaga nadikkiraar sitharaamaiyaa
pengalooru, sep. 25–
karnaadaga Congress katchiyai serndha sitharaamaiyaavai meendum mudhalvaraaga paarkkum vaayppu, avaradhu aadharavaalargalukku kidaithulladhu. Aam... Thiraippadathil mudhalvaraaga nadikka, avar thayaaraagiraar.
Karnaadagaavil mudhalvar sivagumaar thalaimaiyil Congress aatchi nadakkiradhu. Kaangirasin selvaakkumikka thalaivar sitharaamaiyaa. Sirandha nirvaaga thiramai konda ivar, 2013 – 18 varaiyilum, 2023 mudhal nadappaandu joon 3 varai ena, ettu aandugal mudhalvaraaga irundhaar.
Melidathin azhuthathaal sivagumaaridam mudhalvar padhaviyai oppadaithu vittu padhavi vilaginaar. Idhanaal, avaradhu aadharavaalargal varuthathil irundhadhanar. Tharpodhu, avarai meendum mudhalvaraaga paarkkum vaayppu, aadharavaalargalukkum, maanila makkalukkum kidaithulladhu.
Viraivil thayaaraaga ulla kannada thiraippadathil mudhalvaraaga sitharaamaiyaa nadikka ullaar. Pudhumuga iyakkunar raajesh iyakkathil indha thiraippadam thayaaraagiradhu. Aar.e.pilim pekdari endra niruvanam thayaarikkiradhu. Idhil sitharaamaiyaa mudhalvaraagave nadikkavullaar. Iyakkunar kooriya kadhai pidithadhaal sitharaamaiyaa nadikka sammadhithullaar. Indha thiraippadathukku, mukkiya mandhiri endra peyar soottappadalaam ena therigiradhu.
Melum, padappidippu, editting utbada anaithaiyum 48 mani nerathil mudithu, ulaga saadhanai padaikka padakkuzhuvinar thittamittullanar.
Sitharaamaiyaavukku nadippu pudhidhalla; palli, kalloori naatkalil naadagangalil naditha anuvavam ulladhu. 2017l kavidhaa langesh iyakkathil thiraikku vandha sammar haalides endra kuzhandhaigal thiraippadathil, mudhalvaraagave sitharaamaiyaa nadithirundhadhu kurippidathakkadhu.
Ippadathil munnaal amaichar hes.em.revannaavum nadikkiraar. Mudhalvar sivagumaar, munnaal amaichar thinesh kunduraav aagiyoraiyum sirappu thotrathil nadikka vaikka, padakkuzhuvinar muyatsikkindranar. Navambaril padappidippu thuvangum ena therigiradhu.

headline: TVK therdhal pirasaaram 28.01.2026 mudhal thodangiyadhaa?
text:

Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval, endru theriyavandhadhu.

enave, therdhal pirasaara aalosanaik koottam nadaivetradhu endra seythiyai eduthu, therdhal pirasaaram thodangappattadhaagak koori vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Chennai annaa nootraandu noolaga kalaiyaranga kattanam uyarthappattadhaa?
text:
Annaa nootraandu noolaga kalaiyarangam matrum thirandhaveli kalaiyarangil nigazhchigal nadathuvadharkaana kattanathai TVK arasu moondru madangaaga uyarthiyadhu endru oru thagaval

kalainjar seythigal TV veliyitta news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “moondru madangu kattana uyarvu! Chennai annaa nootraandu noolagathin kalaiyarangam matrum thirandhaveli kalaiyarangil nool veliyeedu pondra nigazhchigal nadathuvadharkaana kattanathai moondru madangu uyarthiyulladhu TVK arasu!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam Tamil Naattil aatchikku vandha piragu Chennai annaa nootraandu noolagathin kalaiyarangil nigazhchigal nadathuvadharkaana kattanam uyarthappattulladhaagak kalainjar seythigal tholaikkaatchi seythi veliyittulladhu. Aanaal, Tamil Nadu arasu tharappilirundhu appadi endha oru arivippum veliyaanadhaaga seythigal illai. TVK aatchikku vandha piragu pala vishayangal maraimugamaagas seyyappaduvadhaal indha vivagaaram thodarbaaga unmai kandariya aayvu seythom.
Idhu thodarbaaga Tamil Nadu arasu noolagath thurai adhigaarigalaith thodarbugondu ketta podhu, appadi arivippu veliyaagavillai endranar. Aanaal, uyar adhigaarigalaith thodarbugondu idhai urudhi seyya mudiyavillai.
Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu arasin fekt sek amaippu idhu thodarbaaga maruppu seythiyai veliyittadhu. Adhil, “annaa noolagathil nigazhchigal nadathuvadharkaana kattanam uyarthappattadhaaga paravum thavaraana thagaval,’’ endru koorappattulladhu.
Chennai annaa nootraandu noolagathin kalaiyarangam matrum thirandhaveli kalaiyarangil nool veliyeedu pondra nigazhchigal nadathuvadharkaana kattanam moondru madangu uyarthappattulladhaaga seythi veliyaagiyulladhu. Idhu mutrilum thavaraana thagavalaagum.
Idhu thodarbaaga annaa nootraandu noolagam alithulla vilakkathil, “kalaiyarangam, nool veliyeettukkoodam, maanaattukkoodam matrum thirandhaveliyarangam aagiyavai arasaanai (nilai) en.152 pallik kalvithurai (podhu.noo) naal 04.07.2017-in padi kurippidappattulla vaadagaik kattanathin adippadaiyil, indraiya thedhi varai endhavidha maatramum illaamal vaadagaikku vidappadugiradhu. Merkanda arangugalukku endhavidha kattanamum uyarthappadavillai” endru therivikkappattulladhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Tamil Nadu arasu tharappilirundhe vilakkam alikkappattulladhaal, moondru madangu kattana uyarvu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
