headline: Rottari savaa thodakka vizhaa :sikkil kurusaranukku virudhu
text:
'rottari savaa' thodakka vizhaa :sikkil kurusaranukku virudhu
Chennai: 'rottari maavattam 3233' saarbil, adhan kavarnar sreeraam thuvri erpaattil, 'rottari savaa' enum amaippu, mudhal muraiyaaga Chennai-yil thodangappattu ulladhu.
Indha amaippai, javuli varthagar nalli kuppusaami thodangi vaithaar. Isai kalainjar sikkil kurusaranukku, 'yuva kalaa sedhu' enum virudhu vazhangi kavuravikkappattadhu.
Vizhaavil, rottari munnaal thalaivargal sreenivaasan, sandhiramogan, muthu pazhaniyappan matrum maavatta mudhanmai seyalar ramesh, poruppu seyalargal nadaraajan, azhaguselvan matrum palar pangetranar.
Vizhaavin thodakkamaaga, karnaadaga isaikkalainjar sooryanaaraayananin kural kaneer ena olithu, nigazhchiyai kambeeramaaga aarambithu vaithadhu.
Saaruladhaa sandhirasegarin veenai; kottaa sagodharigalaana thana sree - poorvaa aagiyoradhu kuralisai; paradhanaattiya kalainjar anidhaa kuhaa maanaviyarin kuzhu nadanam aagiya nigazhchigal, sirappaaga nadandhana. Rottari sanga uruppinargalin kuzhandhaigalin nadanamum nadandhadhu.
Pin, sikkil kuru saranin karnaadaga isaiyum, mellisaiyum serndha oru arumaiyaana nigazhchi nadandhadhu. Idhil, raagangalai vilakki koori, adharkaana karnaadaga paadalgalaiyum, avai sinimaavil eppadi kaiyaalappattu ullana enbadhaiyum elidhaaga koorinaar. Udan, kalainjar muraariyin vayalin isai, nigazhchiyai merugoottiyadhu.
Muthaayppaaga rottari angathinarin manaiviyarin nadanam anaivaraalum rasikkappattadhu. Rottari savaa serman kirijaa raagavan, nigazhchiyai sirappaaga orunginaithu nadathinaar.

headline: 35 vayadhukkup piragu pengalukku en adivayitruk kozhuppu adhigarikkiradhu? Kaaranam indha haarmonaa?
text:
35 vayadhukkup piragu pala pengalukku adivayitruk kozhuppu adhigarippadharku mukkiya kaaranam kaardisol endra mana azhutha haarmon matrum eestrojan, purojestiron maatrangal ena maruthuvargal vilakkugindranar. Stres pelli, haarmonal pelli ena iru vagai thoppai uruvaagi, insulin edhirppu, thookkaminmai, muraiyatra maadhavidaay pondra pirasnaigal adhigarikkindrana.
35 vayadhaik kadandha pengal palarum vayitrup pagudhiyil serum kozhuppu pirasnaiyaal paadhikkappaduvadhaaga maruthuva nivunargal echarikkindranar. Pengalin udal aarokkiyathil pala maatrangal erpaduvadhu vazhakkamaana nilaiyil, adhil mukkiyamaanadhu thoppai matrum vayitrup pagudhiyil serum kozhuppu. Pala nerangalil idhai ore maadhiriyaana thoppai endru ninaithuk kolgirom, aanaal maruthuva reedhiyaaga stres pelli (Stress Belly) matrum haarmonal pelli (Hormonal Belly) endru irandu vagaigalaagap ivai pirikkappadugiradhu.
Aluvalaga velai, kudumbap poruppugal matrum podhiya thookkaminmai kaaranamaaga udalil kaardisol (Cortisol) endra mana azhutha haarmon adhigamaagas surakkiradhu. Idhu rathathil insulin edhirppai adhigarithu, adivayitru uruppugalais sutri kozhuppais semikkiradhu. Sarkkarai matrum norukkuth theenigalai saappidath thoonduvadhu, thideer sorvu, thookkaminmai aagiyavai idhan mukkiya arigurigalaagum.
Kaardisol alavaik kuraikka seeraana thookkam, thiyaanam, udarpayitsi matrum puradhachathu niraindha unavugal ullittavai avasiyam. Pengalukku 35 vayadhirkup piragu eestrojan, purojestiron pondra haarmongalin alavil maatrangal erpadugindrana. Idhanaal iduppu matrum thodaigalil sera vendiya kozhuppu, medhuvaaga vayitrup pagudhikku maarath thodangugiradhu.
Idhuve, haarmon maatrath thoppai enak koorappadugiradhu. Muraiyatra maadhavidaay, udal soodu pondravai idhan mukkiya arigurigalaagum. Haarmon maatrangalais samaalikka edai thookkum udarpayitsigal, vaittamin ti, kaalsiyam matrum puradha unavugal peridhum udhavugindrana. Thideerena kadumaiyaaga unavaik kuraippadhai vida aarokkiyamaana vaazhviyal maatrangale nilaiyaana palanaith tharum ena maruthuva nivunargal therivikkindranar

headline: Doctor Vikatan: pachilam kuzhandhaikku tayaappar anivithup pazhakkalaamaa?
text:
Ovvoru 3 mani nerathukku orumuraiyum tayaapparai maatra vendiyadhu avasiyam.
Doctor Vikatan: en thozhikku sameevathildhaan kuzhandhai pirandhirukkiradhu. Aanaal, aval kuzhandhaikku tayaappar poduvadhillai enbadhil urudhiyaaga irukkiraal. Adhu kuzhandhaikku nalladhalla engiraal. En kuzhandhaikku naan oru varudamaaga tayaappar anivithuk kondirukkiren. En thozhi solvadhu sariyaa... Naan seyvadhu sariyaa.... Enna mudiveduppadhu?
Padhil solgiraar Kovai, kinathukkadavais serndha kuzhandhaigalnala maruthuvar es. Sreenivaas
perumbaalaana petrorgal thangal vasadhikkaaga 24 mani neramum kuzhandhaiyai tayaapparudan irukka viduvadhaip paarkkirom. Adhu migavum thavaru.
Matravadi pirandha kuzhandhaigalukkus sariyaana alavulla, tharamaana tayaappargalai muraiyaagap payanbaduthalaam. Tharpodhu kidaikkum tayaappargal siruneer matrum kazhivugalai nangu urinjjum thiran udaiyavaaga irukkindrana. Eerathinaal erpadum avadhigalaith thavirthu, kuzhandhaigal siramamindri nangu uranguvadharku indha tayaappargal nichayam udhavum enbadhil sandhegamillai.
Kuzhandhaikku orumurai tayaappar anivithaal adhai adutha moondru, naangu mani nerathukku maatrath thevaiyillai. Petrorukkum adikkadi thuni maatruvadhu, thuvaippadhu pondra siramangal idhanaal thavirkkappadugindrana.
Tharamaana, nalla metteeriyalil seyyappatta tayaappargalai kuzhandhai thoongumbodhum, payanathin podhum, thavirkka iyalaadha nerathilum payanbaduthalaam. Aanaal ovvoru 3 mani nerathukku orumuraiyum tayaapparai maatra vendiyadhu avasiyam. Pala mani neram tayaappar anivippadhaal kuzhandhaikku pun erpadaamal, sarumam paadhikkappadaamal kavanamaagap paarthukkolla vendiyadhum avasiyam.
Ungal kelvigalai kament pagudhiyil pagirndhugollungal; adharkaana padhilgal thinamum vigadan inaiyathalathil #DoctorVikatan endra peyaril veliyaagum.

headline: Vinaayagar sadhurthi vizhaavukku ilavasa minsaaram vendum: hindhu thamizhar katchi valiyuruthal
text:
Chennai : 'thelungaanaavai pol, thamizhagathilum vinaayagar sadhurthi vizhaa pandhalgalukku, ilavasa minsaaram vazhanga vendum' ena, Thamizhaga arasai, hindhu thamizhar katchi thalaivar raama.ravigumaar valiyuruthiyullaar.
Avaradhu arikkai: aandudhorum vinaayagar sadhurthi vizhaa, naadu muzhudhum kolaagalamaaga kondaadappattu varugiradhu.
Kurippaaga, thamizhagathilum, thelungaanaa, aandhiraa pondra andai maanilangalilum, veedhikku veedhi piramaandamaana vinaayagar silaigal piradhishdai seyyappattu, sirappu poojaigalum vazhivaadugalum nadappadhu vazhakkam.
Vinaayagar sadhurthi vizhaa pandhalgalukku, min kattanam vasoolikkappadaadhu; tharkaaliga min inaippugal vaayilaaga, ilavasa minsaaram vazhangappadum ena, thelungaanaa maanila arasu arivithiruppadhu varaverkathakkadhu.
Adhevol, Thamizhaga arasum, vinaayagar sadhurthi vizhaa pandhalgalukku, min kattanathilirundhu vilakku alikka vendum. Ovvoru hindhu kovilgalilum, pakdhargal vinaayagar poojai seyyum vagaiyil, andhandha kovil saarbil, kaliman vinaayagar vazhanga vendum.
Ivvaaru, adhil koorappattulladhu.

headline: Membaala thaduppu suvaril car modhi vaalivar pali
text:
Kayathaaru : kayathaaru aruge, membaala thaduppu suvaril car modhiya vivathil,- piranesh, 25, enbavar uyirizhandhaar; naalvar kaayamadaindhanar.
Tirunelveli maavattam, sidhambaraavurathai serndhavar piranesh. Ivar, nanbargal suyambulingam, muthulingam, vinoth, sujith aagiyorudan sep., 4l oottikku sutrulaa sendru vittu, netru mundhinam iravu oor thirumbik kondirundhaar. Netru kaalai, Thoothukudi maavattam, kayathaaru aruge, thevargulam jangshan membaalathil sendra car, kattuppaattai izhandhu, paalathaduppu suvaril palamaaga modhiyadhil, kaarai otti vandha piranesh uyirizhandhaar. Suyambulingam, vinoth, sujith, muthulingam padugaayamadaindhanar.
Kayathaaru Police, piranesh sadalathai kaippatri, kovilbatti arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppinar. Kaayamadaindhavargalai meettu, Tirunelveli arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppi, vazhakku padhindhu visaarithu varugindranar.

headline: Thaakkudhalukku payandhu isrelai vittu odum yoodhargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran-in thaakkudhalukku payandhu 70 aandugalaaga vaazhndha vandha naadu vendaam endru thappi odum isreliyargal endru oru video

malai meedhu eraalamaanavargal nadandhu sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ore vaaram thaan 70 varudangalaaga vaazhavaitha poomiyai vittu kolan kundru era thuvangi vittaan yoodhan…
aanaal Iran kodutha thandanai endru solvadhai vida ega* iraivan kodutha migapperiya thandai
innum irukku ina veri piditha yoodhanukku…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Yoodhargal 70 aandugalaaga vasithu vandha Israel endra naattai vittuvittu thappi odugindranar endru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Aanaal, malaiyaip paarkka pasumaiyaana malai pola ulladhu. Israel-il ippadi oru idamaa endra aachariyathudan indha padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu joon 2, 2025 andru indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil nevaalathil imayamalaith thangam, imayamalai vayaagaraa endrellaam azhaikkappadum Yarsagumba endra mooligaiyaith thedi makkal sendranar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Tolbaa (Dolpa) endra pagudhi makkal mooligaiyaith thedi eduthanar endrum, indha thedudhalil iru kiraama makkalukku idaiye modhal erpattadhu endrellaam seythigal namakku kidaithana.
Israel – Iran thaakkudhal joon 13m thedhi thodangiyadhu. Aanaal, indha veediyovo adharku 11 naatkalukku munbaagave samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu. Melum, nevaalathil indha video edukkappattadhu endrum kurippidappattulladhu. Ivai ellaam indha video isrelais saarndhadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu aapgaanisdhaaniya makkal sattavirodhamaaga thurukkiyil kudiyerum kaatchi endru idhe video-vai silar padhivittirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Adhe pol Israel thaakkudhalukku payandhu eeraaniyargal thappis selvadhaagavum silar indha video-vai padhivittirundhanar. Ivai ellaam nevaalathil mooligaiyaith thedi makkal sendranar endru veliyaana veediyovukkup pirage padhividappattirundhana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Yu.pi.ai., parivarthanaikkaana kattanathai rathu seyyanum; thayaarippaalar, vanigargal valiyuruthal
text:
Madurai: ''yu.pi.ai., moolam parivarthanai nadathuvadharkaana kattanathai mutrilum rathu seyya vendum'' ena Tamil Nadu thayaarippaalar, vanigargal sangangalin koottamaippu valiyuruthiyulladhu.
Koottamaippin thalaivar ravichandhiran, seyalaalar velbaandiyan, porulaalar saagulhameedhu, thunaith thalaivar selvavel paandi, porvel urimaiyaalar sanga thalaivar suresh, kanakkaalar sanga thalaivar jegadheesan, jeyhindhuvuram sirudhozhil adhivargal sanga uruppinar kumaar Madurai Collector nishaanth kirushnaavidam alitha manuvil kooriyiruppadhaavadhu:
mathiya arasu varum ak.,1 mudhal yu.pi.ai., moolamaaga parivarthanai seyyum thogai roo.2 aayirathukku mel irundhaal, vangik kanakkil seluthiya thogaikku 0.4 sadhaveedham kattanamaaga piditham seythu kanakkil patru seyyappadum endra pudhiya nadaimuraiyai amalbadutha ulladhu.
Erkanave pala siramangalukku idaiyil vilaivaasi uyarvu, potti vanigam, velaiyaatkla sambalam, vaadagai, mingattanam, maanagaraatchikku seluthum varivagai, edhirbaaraadha maatrangal pondravatrai meeri laavam eettuvadhu migavum siramamaanadhe.
Ottu motha yu.pi.ai., parivarthanaigalin kattanam, India-vin ottumotha vanigargal meedhu adhiga paaram sumathuvadhaaga irukkum. Anaithu vanigargalum porulaadhaara valuvudan vanigam seyya, arasu yu.pi.ai., parivarthanai kattanathai muzhumaiyaaga rathu seyya vendum.
Rathu seyyavillai enil, anaivarum meendum panapparivarthanai moolame vanigathai nadatha vendiyirukkum. Udhaaranamaaga vanigarudan thodarndhu vanigam seyyum oruvar sila latchangalai niluvai vaithu pagudhi, pagudhiyaaga thogaiyai seluthinaal, ovvoru parivarthanaikkum roo.300 kattanam seluthum nilai uruvaagum. Aindhu thavanaigal seluthinaale roo.1500 seluthum avasiyam erpadum. Enave ikkattanathai mutrilum rathu seyya vendum. Vanigam mudangi vidaamal arasu paadhugaakka vendum, ena therivithullanar.

headline: Sathunavu saambaaril saani pavudar... 51 maanavargal uyir thappiyadhu eppadi?
text:
Kolai seyyum nokkathudan unavil visham kalakkas seythadhaaga aarumugathin meedhu vazhakku padhivuseyyappattulladhu.
Palli maanavargalukkaana sathunavu samaikkum paniyilirundhu manaiviyai neekkiyadhaal aathiramadaindha kanavar, 8-m vaguppu maanaviyaip payanbaduthi saambaaril saani pavudaraik kalakkas seytha sambavam adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Erode maavattam, sathiyamangalathukku aruge raamavailooril arasu nadunilaippalli ulladhu. 51 maanavargal payilum indhap palliyil kaalais sitrundi, madhiya sathunavu vazhangappadugiradhu. Unavin tharathai ariya aasiriyargal suvaithup paarppadhu vazhakkam. Aagast 31-m thedhi saambaarais suvaithup paartha aasiriyai revadhiyin kaiyil manjjal karai erpattadhudan, vayitru uvaadhaiyum erpattirukkiradhu. Saambaaril payanbaduthappatta manjjaldhooldhaan kaaranamaaga irukkumo endru sandhegitha aasiriyargal, adhais sodhithirukkiraargal. Aanaal, manjjal thoolil endhap pirasnaiyum illai.
Idharkidaiye, maanavi oruvarin kaiyilum idhe pondra manjjal karai iruppadhu theriya vandhirukkiradhu. ‘saani pavudaraip payanbaduthi veettai mezhugiyadhaal karai erpattadhu’ ena andha maanavi kooriyirukkiraar. Aanaal, aasiriyargalukkus sandhegam theeravillai. Maanaviyin petrorai pallikku azhaithu visaarithavodhu, veettil saani pavudar payanbaduthuvadhillai endru avargal therivithirukkiraargal. Thodarndhu nadandha visaaranaiyil, adhirchigaramaana unmai velichathukku vandhirukkiradhu.
Sathiyamangalam kaaval nilaiya aayvaalar vairam, “aalammaal enbavar andhap palliyil tharkaaligas samaiyalaraagap paniyaatriyirukkiraar. Sugaadhaaramaana muraiyil unavu thayaarippadhillai endra kaaranathaal, aasiriyargalin parindhuraiyin peril sila naalgalukku munbu avar paniyilirundhu neekkappattirukkiraar. Idhanaal aathiramadaindha aalammaalin kanavar aarumugam, kurippitta maanaviyai miratti saambaaril saani pavudar kalakkas seythirukkiraar. Nallavelaiyaaga aasiriyargal tharap parisodhanai seyyumbodhu saani pavudar kalakkappattirundhadhu kanduvidikkappattadhaal perum asambaavidham thavirkkappattirukkiradhu.
Kolai seyyum nokkathudan unavil visham kalakkas seythadhaaga aarumugathin meedhu vazhakku padhivuseyyappattulladhu. Kaidhuseyyappattulla avarukku 10 aandugal varai siraith thandanai kidaikka vaayppirukkiradhu. Saani pavudarai virpanai seytha kadaikkaararidamum visaaranai nadathappattuvarugiradhu. Palli maanavi kadumaiyaaga echarikkappattirukkiraar” endraar.
Nalvaayppaaga, saambaaril saani pavudar kalandha vishamas seyal, 51 maanavargalin uyiraik kaavu vaangum vivareedhamaaga maaraamal thadukkappattirukkiradhu!

headline: Thayaarithavarukke mirattal vidutha AI.. Ulagaiye ulukkiya sambavam! AI maariyadhu eppadi ?
text:
Seyarkai nunnarivu thuraiyil OpenClaw niruvanam uruvaakkiya MJ Rathbun endra AI ejent, adhan korikkaiyai niraagaritha sgaat shaambaakkai vimarsithu, ulagalavil adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Indha sambavam AI-yin thannaatchi seyalbaadugal patriya kelvigalai ezhuppiyulladhu.
Kadandha sila aandugalaaga AI ena azhaikkappadum seyarkai nunnarivu thozhilnutbam periya alavil valarchiyadaindhulladhu. Melum indha thuraiyil openAI niruvanathin ChatGpt migapperum puratchiyai erpaduthiyadhu.
Adhanaith thodarndhu koogil niruvanam jemini endra AI menborulaiyum, elaan maskkin niruvanam Grok endra AI menborulaiyum arimugappaduthiyadhu. Idhu thavira eraalamaana AI menborulgal ulagalavil uruvaakkappattu konde varugindrana.
Andha vagaiyil, OpenClaw niruvanam MJ Rathbun endra peyaril oru thannichaiyaaga seyalbadum AI ejent ondrai uruvaakkiyulladhu. Indha AI ejent menborul uruvaakkathil manidhargalin sumaiyaik kuraikkum vagaiyil uruvaakkappattirundhadhu.
Manidharin karuthai niraagaritha AI..
Sameevathil Matplotlib endra menborulil oru siriya maatrathais seyyak kori indha AI ejent OpenClaw niruvanathil poruppil ulla sgaat shaambaak enbavaridam korikkai vaithadhu. Aanaal AI-yin indha vinnappathai sgaat niraagarithullaar.
Idhanaith thodarndhu andha AI ejent OpenClaw niruvanathin thaaniyangi valaippadhivup pakkathil sgaattai vimarsithu oru padhivaiye ezhudhiyulladhu. Adhil, sgaat shaambaakkin pazhaiya padhivugalai aaraayndhu, avar seytha thavarugalais suttikkaatti, ungalai vida naan adhigath thiramaiyudan velai seythullen endrum, neengal oru thiramaiyatra navar endrum vimarsithulladhu.
Adhu mattum indri, AI ejent thanadhu seyalbaadugalaip padhivida vaithirundha X kanakkil andha katturaiyin lingk-aip pagirndhu, sgaat shaambaakkin peyarai Tag seythulladhu. Oru thannaatchi AI ejent oru thani manidhanaip patriya thagavalgalai korthu avarai vimarsikkum alavu sendrulladhu ulagalavil adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Mannippu ketta AI niruvanam..
Indha sambavathaith thodarndhu indha eai ejendai uruvaakkiya OpenClaw niruvanam, indhath thavarukkaaga pagirangamaaga mannippuk kettukkondulladhu. Melum andha eai ejendin seyalbaattaiyum mudakkiyulladhaaga arivithullanar.
Aanaal idhu samooga valaithalangalil maaverum vivaadhathukku vithittulladhu. Naalai idhuvondra thannaatchi AI menborulgalin valarchi manidha kulathaiye maaverum azhivukku ittu sellum endru vimarsithu varugindranar.

headline: Thirupparangundram malaiyin meedhu ulla thargaa agatrappadum raajan sellappaa koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘thirupparangundram malaiyin meedhu ulla thargaa agatrappadum,’’ endru ADMK vetbaalar raajan sellappaa vaakkurudhi kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ Tamil Naattil thesiya jananaayaga koottani aatchiyil amarumbodhu thirupparangundram malaiyin meedhu ulla thargaa agatrappadum- ADMK vetbaalar raajan sellappaa,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda news card unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu poliyaanadhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, Tamil Janam oodagam maruppu therivithulladhu.
Melum, raajan sellappaa tharappilum idhuvatri vilakkam tharappattulladhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline:
Vangodumai vazhakku rathu?
Madurai vivagaarathil thideer thiruppam.. Kaavaldhurai solvadhu enna?
text:
Vangodumai vazhakku rathu? Madurai vivagaarathil thideer thiruppam.. Kaavaldhurai solvadhu enna?
Madurai maavattam kamboor ooraatchiyil, thooymaip paniyaalaraaga paniyaatri varum penmani oruvar, sila thinangalukku munbu kaaval nilaiyathil pugaar ondrai alithirundhaar. Adhil, kamboor ooraatchis seyalaalar roovaa, irattai tamlar muraiyaip pinbatras solvadhaagavum, saadhiyaik kurippittu avamadhithadhaagavum, seruppaik kaiyaal eduthuvaras sonnadhaagavum pugaar alithirundhaar. Indha vivagaaram perum paravarappai erpaduthiyirundha nilaiyil, roovaa meedhu vangodumaith thaduppus sattam ullitta pirivugalin keezh vazhakkuppadhivu seyyappattirundhadhu. Idhanaiyaduthu, ooraatchis seyalaalar roovaa pani neekkam seyyappattirundhaar.
Indhap pugaar thodarbaaga kaavaldhuraiyinar visaaranai merkondu vandha nilaiyil, pugaaril kurippidappatta sambavangal thodarbaana padhivugal matrum ooraatchi aavanangal aayvu seyyappattadhaagavum, kurippaaga, sambavam nadaivetradhaagak koorappatta thedhiyil roovaa paniyil illai endrum, ooraatchi padhivettil avar thanadhu kaiyaal padhivu seythu kaiyezhuthittirundhadhan moolam theriyavandhadhaagavum kaavaldhurai tharappil koorappattana.
Idhan adippadaiyil, pugaaril unmaith thanmai illai ena mudivu seyyappattu, vazhakku ‘Mistake of Fact’ ena mudikkappattulladhaagavum, roovaa meedhu padhivu seyyappatta PCR vazhakku ullitta vazhakkugal rathu seyyappattulladhaagavum seythigal veliyaagina. Idhanaith thodarndhu, roovaa meedhaana pugaar unmaikkup purambaanadhu endrum, avarukku edhiraaga edukkappatta pani neekka nadavadikkaiyai maruvariseelanai seyya vendum endrum, adhigaarigal neradiyaaga kala visaaranai nadathi unmai nilaiyai kandariya vendum endrum kori ezhu kiraamangalais serndha podhumakkal Madurai maavatta aatchiyaridam manu alithullanar. Indha vazhakku thodarbaaga veliyaagum seythigalukku kaavaldhurai saarbil maruppu therivithu vilakkamalikkappattulladhu.
Madurai maavatta kaavaldhurai saarbil veliyidappattulla andhas seythikkurippil, kottaambatti kaaval nilaiyathil kutra en: 355/2026-n keezh vazhakkup padhivu seyyappattu, pulan visaaranai thodarndhu nadaivetru varugiradhu. Ivvazhakku rathu seyyappattuvittadhaagavo alladhu muzhumaiyaaga mudithu vaikkappattuvittadhaagavo oodagangal matrum samooga valaidhalangalil seythigal veliyaagi varuvadhaagavum, aanaal ivvazhakku edhuvum rathu seyyappadavillai endrum, kaavaldhuraiyinaraal sattappadi pulan visaaranai merkollappattu varuvadhaagavum andhas seythikkurippil therivikkappattulladhu. Vazhakku rathu seyyappattadhaaga seythigal veliyaana nilaiyil, tharpodhu kaavaldhurai tharappil veliyaagiyulla indha vilakkam indha vivagaarathil pudhiya thiruppathai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra

headline: Thirupparangundrathil theevam etrinaal pasi panjjam theerndhuvidumaa endru M.K. Stalin kettaaraa?
text:
Thirupparangundrathil theevam etrinaal makkalin pasi panjjam theerndhuvidumaa endru mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin kettadhaaga oru news card Facebook-il viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu.

Mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin pugaippadathudan san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “mudhalamaichar kelvi. Thirupparangundrathil theevam etrinaal makkalin pasi panjjam theerndhu vidumaa? Alladhu padippu velai vaayppu kidaithu vidumaa? Ena mudhalamaichar mu.ka Stalin kelvi” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thirupparangundram malaiyil ovvoru aandum theevam etrappattu varugiradhu. Aanaal, thaangal kurippitta idathildhaan etra vendum endru theevira valadhusaari amaippugal poraadi varugindrana. Indha soozhalil thirupparangundrathil theevam etrinaal makkalin pasi panjjam theerndhuvidumaa endru M.K. Stalin kettadhaaga oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha news card-il ulla thamizh ezhuthukkal vazhakkamaaga san news veliyidum news card-il ulladhu pola illai. Melum, M.K. Stalin appadi pesiyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Theevira valadhusaari oodagangalilum kooda ippadi oru seythi veliyaagavillai. Ivai ellaam indha news card matrum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Aadhaarangal adippadaiyil idhai urudhi seyya indha news card-ai san news digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum indha news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Melum, idhe pondru news card-ai epral 1, 2026 andru veliyittirundhom” endru kurippittu andha news kaardin X thala inaippai namakku anuppinaar.
Adhil “meendum meendum naan thiruchikku varuvadhu pol DMK meendum meendum aatchikku varavendum. Pirasaarathil mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin pechu” endru irundhadhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nellai: pagalil meengadaith thozhilaali; iravil pengalin ullaadaigal thirudan - ilainjar sikkiyadhu eppadi?
text:
Nellaiyil kadandha sila naalgalaaga magalir thangum vidudhigal, kaambavunt veedugalil kodigalil kaayap pottirundha pengalin ullaadaigal thodarndhu thirudu poyina. Idhu kuritha pugaarin adippadaiyil poleesaar thiruttil eeduvattavarai kaidhu seythullanar.
Nellai maanagaril sameeva kaalamaagave veedugalil kodigalil kaayap pottirundha pengalin ullaadaigal iravu nerangalil thodarchiyaaga thirudu poyk kondirundhana. Indha nilaiyil, kadandha sila naatkalaaga magalir thangum vidudhi valaagathil kodigalil kaayap pottirundha ullaadaigal mattum kurivaithu thirudappattu vandhulladhu. Paalaiyangottai en.ji.o ’pi’ kaalaniyais serndhavar valli selvam. Ivar, perumaalburam ‘si’ kaalaniyil magalir thangum vidudhi ondrai nadathi varugiraar. Kadandha 2 naalgalukku munbu kodigalil pengalin pira thunigal thavira ullaadaigal mattum kaanaamal poyirundhadhu. Oru ullaadai kooda illaadha nilaiyil pengal, vidudhiyin vaardan kovishaavidam kooriyullanar.
Adhirchi adaindha kovishaa, vidudhiyin urimaiyaalar valli selvathidam kooriyullaar. Vidudhiyin si.si.ti.vi kemaraa kaatchigalai paartha podhu adhigaalai sumaar 4 maniyalavil ilainjar oruvar indha vidudhiyin kaambavunt suvar erik kudhithu ulle nuzhaigiraar. Aanaal, mugamoodi edhuvum aniyavillai. Avar, angulla kodigalil pengal thuvaithuk kaayap pottirundha ullaadaigalai ovvondraaga eduthu segarithu adhanai oru moottaiyaagak kattik kondu paikkil angirundhu thappis sellum kaatchigal padhivaagi irundhadhu.
Idhanaiyaduthu vidudhi urimaiyaalar valli selvam pugaar alithullaar. Adhan adippadaiyil vazhakkuppadhivu seythu visaaranai nadathinar. Vidudhiyilulla si.si.ti.vi kemaraa padhivugal mattumallaamal thunigalai moottaiyaagak kattik kondu paikkil andha navar thirumbis sendra pagudhigalilulla si.si.ti.vi kemaraa padhivugalaiyum aayvu seythanar. Appagudhiyil adhe navar idhe pola irandu kaambavunt veedugalilum pengalin ullaadaigalai thirudis sellum kaatchigal padhivaagiyirundhadhu. Ithiruttus sambavam thodarbaaga melappaalaiyathais serndha thameemun ansaaridhaan indha ullaadaigal thiruttus sambavathil eeduvattadhu theriyavandhadhu. Kaalai nerangalil angulla oru meen iraichi kadaiyil velai paarthu vandhadhu theriya vandhadhu.
Matra nerangalil iyalbaaga irukkum avar, pengalin ullaadaigalaip paarthaal mattum adhai thirudi pathirappaduthum manainilai kondavar ena poleesaarin visaaranaiyil theriya vandhulladhu. Avarai kaidhu seyyum andru kooda melappaalaiyam pagudhiyilulla oru magalir vidudhiyil ullaadaigalai thirudiyullaar. Avaradhu veettil 4 moottaigalil padhukki vaithirundha ullaadaigalai poleesaar meettu magalir vidudhigalil oppadaithanar. Pinnar, avarai kaidhu seytha poleesaar needhimandrathil aajarbaduthi siraiyil adaithanar.

headline: ‘andha vellai kodu thaandi oru vandiyum varakkoodaadhu’
text:
‘andha vellai kodu thaandi oru vandiyum varakkoodaadhu’
Tiruppur, sep.24–
Collector aluvalagam, Police es.pi. Aluvalagam, orunginaindha Court valaagam ullitta mukkiya arasu aluvalagangal amaindhulla palladam rottil, vaagana nerisal adhigarithu varugiradhu. Uzhavar sandhai kaalai 8:00 manikku mudindhaalum, rottora kadaigal kaalai 10:00 mani varai seyalbadugindrana. Idhevol, pazhakkadaigal utbada kadaigalukku varum vaadikkaiyaalargal saalaiyorathil vaaganangalai niruthuvadhaal nerisal erpadugiradhu.
Ozhungumurai virpanaikkoodam mudhal veeravaandi pirivu varai palveru idangalil saalaiyora vaagana nirutham adhigarithulladhu. Idhudhodarbaaga maavatta saalai paadhugaappukkuzhu koottathilum vivaadhikkappattadhu. Idhanaal, maavatta nirvaagathin utharavinbadi nedunjjaalaithurai saarbil nadavadikkai thodangappattulladhu. Vaaganam nirutha thadai seyyappatta pagudhigalil ‘no paarkking’ ena kurippidappatta perigaardugal vaikkappattullana. Melum, nedunjjaalaithurai saarbil echarikkai palagaigalum amaikkappattullana.
Adhil, nedunjjaalaithuraikku sondhamaana saalaiyil rottora kadaigal amaikkavum, vellaikkottukku veliye pokkuvarathukku idaiyooraaga vaaganangalai niruthavum thadai vidhikkappattulladhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Nedunjjaalaithurai aluvalargal kooriyadhaavadhu:
palladam rottil naalukku naal pokkuvarathu nerisal adhigarithu varugiradhu. Saalaiyil adhiga alavil vaaganangal niruthappaduvadhu mukkiya kaaranamaaga ulladhu. Maavatta nirvaagathin utharavinbadi, ozhungumurai virpanaikkoodam mudhal veeravaandi pirivu varai thevaiyaana idangalil echarikkai palagaigal vaikkappattullana. Vellaikkottukku veliye vaaganangalai niruthakkoodaadhu. Vidhimeerinaal Police moolam nadavadikkai edukkappadum.
Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: Aanlainil virkappadum komiyam patri arjoon sambath karuthu therivithaaraa?
text:
‘’ aanlainil manidha siruneerai paattilil pidithu, komiyam endru emaatri, virkiraargal,’’ endru arjoon sambath kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’nanbargale, aanlainil komiyam vaangumbodhu echarikkaiyaaga irungal. Palar thangaludaiya siruneerai piraandat paattilgalil adaithu, adhai komiyam endru anuppugiraargal. – arjoon sambath,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil, naam idhuvatri arjoon sambath tharappil thodarbugondu, vilakkam kettom. Appodhu, ‘’idhuvondra endha padhivaiyum arjoon sambath veliyidavillai. Avaradhu peyaril samooga valaidhalangalil seyalbadum poliyaana kanakku ondril irundhu, ivvaaru padhivittu, vadhandhi parappugindranar,’’ endru therivikkappattadhu.
Arjoon sambathin unmaiyaana X valaidhalam matrum Facebook kanakku lingk inge tharappattulladhu.
Adhesamayam, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda Facebook padhivai veliyitta aidi.,yin peyar verondraaga ulladhu.
Tharpodhu indha aidi., seyalbaattil illai.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagavalai, arjoon sambath veliyidavillai endru, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

text:

headline: “thangaiyai paaliyal vangodumai seyya vandhavanin aanuruppai vettiya annan” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Keralaavil thangaiyai paaliyal vangodumai seyya vandhavanin aanuruppai vettiya annan endru oru video

veettukkul irundhu oruvar ratham sotta sotta varum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thangaiyai karpazhikka vandhavarin aanuruppai vettiya annan!!
India keralaavil idambetradhaaga samooga oodagangalil viral-aagi varum #veediyo” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Keralaavil thangaiyai paaliyal vangodumai seyya vandha navarin aan uruppai vettiya annan endru oru video samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Keralaavil engu, eppodhu indha sambavam nadandhadhu endru endha thagavalum illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Koogulil thangaiyai vangodumai seyya vandhavanai vettiya annan endru sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthi seythi edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedinom. Aanaal, keralaavil appadi oru sambavam nadandhadhaaga endha oru seythiyum namakku kidaikkavillai. Enave, video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom.
Appodhu vangadhesathais saarndha oodagangalil indha video veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Vanga mozhiyil irundha padhivai mozhiveyarthup paarthom. Adhil, “parithbooril urangumbodhu kanavanin aan uruppai manaivi vettivittadhaagak koorappadugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha vanga mozhiyil irundha padhivai appadiye kaappi seythu koogulil padhivittu thedinom.
Appodhu vangamozhiyil indha sambavam thodarbaaga veliyaana pala seythigal namakku kidaithana. Adhil indha sambavam joon 29m thedhi nadandhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Haneep shek enbavarin irandaavadhu manaivi sumainaa akdhar sumi enbavardhaan indha seyalai seythaar endru koori andha pagudhi kaaval thuraiyinar sambava idathil vaithu kaidhu seythulladhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Andha navarukku motham moondru thirumanam nadandhadhaagavum, oru manaivi tharkolai seythu kondaar endrum andha seythiyil koorappattirundhadhu. Sumainaavai thirumanam seytha piragu veru oru pennai andha navar thirumanam seythu kondadhaagavum veru pala pengaludan andha navarukku pazhakkam irundhadhaagavum sumainaa therivithullaar. Idhai kettaal sigerattaal soodu vaithu sithravai seythu vandhullaar. Idhanaal sumainaa indha seyalai seythadhaaga poleesidam kooriyadhaaga andha seythiyil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam vangadhesathil nadandha oru sambavathin video-vai eduthu, keralaavil pen oruvarai paaliyal vangodumai seyya muyandravarin aan uruppai vettiya annan endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ini naattu kozhi kunjju urpathi illai: kaalnadaithurai kunjju porippagam moodal
text:
Udumalai: udumalai kurichikkottaiyilulla kaalnadaithurai kozhi kunjju porippagam moodappattu, iyandhirangal osoorukku anuppa thittamidappattulladhu.
Kaalnadaithurai saarbil, udumalai arugeyulla kurichigottaiyil, merku thodarchi malai aviviruthi thittathin keezh kadandha, 2012--13m aandil, roo.25.30 latcham madhippil, kozhi kunjju porippagam amaikkappattadhu.
Ingu ore samayathil, 2 aayiram naattu kozhi muttaigalai adaigaakkum iyandhiram ullitta kattamaippugal niruvappattana. Aandukku, ezhu murai naattukkozhikkunjjugal urpathi seythu, malaivaazh makkalukku ilavasamaagavum, siru vivasaayigal matrum kiraama makkalukku maaniya vilaiyil vazhangappattadhu.
Aanaal, kunjju porippagam seyalbaduvadharkaana oozhiyargal matrum thodarum selavinam odhukkeedu seyyappadaadhadhaal, oru sila aandugalil, urpathi mudangiyadhu.
Thodarndhu paraamarippindri, iyandhirangal pazhudhadaindhum, kattadangal, kozhikkunjjugal paraamarikkum arai ullitta anaithu kattamaippugalum sidhilamadaindhana. Valaagam muzhuvadhum pudhar mandiyadhu.
Kozhikkunjju porippagathai, muzhumaiyaaga iyakka, adharkaana paniyaalargal, thozhilaalargal niyamikkavum, idharku aagum selavinangalai thaniyaaga odhukkeedu seythu, kaalnadaithuraiyil, kunjju porippagathai paraamarikka, thani taakdargal matrum nirvaaga aluvalargal niyamikka vendum, ena vivasaayigal valiyuruthi vandhanar.
Aanaal, tharpodhu thodarndhu, kunjju porippagathai iyakka mudiyaadha nilaiyil, osoorukku iyandhirangalai vazhanga, adhigaarigal thittamittullanar.

headline: Vangadhesathil erithuk kollappatta theevu sandhiradhaas endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Vangadhesathil madha veriyargalaal erithu kolai seyyappatta indhu ilainjar theevu sandhiradhaasin kadaisi nimidangal endru kurippittu video ondru

ilainjar oruvarai Police azhaithu sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indhukkal #siruvaanmaiyaanaal
😭😭😭😭 Thamizhagathil kaasaavukkaaga pongiya oru arasiyalvaadhi idhai kandippaargalaa pangalaadhesh madha veriyargalaal uyirudan erithu kollappatta appaavi indhu #theevu_sandhiradhaas😭😭😭😭😭” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhe pondru matroru padhivil, “ilainjan ” #thivu_sandhiradhaas ” kadaisi nimida manadhai padhappadhaikka vaikkum video kaatchi. 😢😢😢
pangalaadheshil nadandha kalavarathil indhu ilainjaraana thivu sandhiradhaas endra navarai adithuk kollappaduvadharku munbu kaavaldhuraiyidam thanjjam adaigiraar.
Thannai kolla varugiraargal endru kadhari azhumbodhu kooda kaavaldhurai valukkattaayamaaga pidithu avarai andha jihaadhigalidame oppadaitha pin avarai uyirudan erithu kollum manadhai padhavadhaikka vaikkum kaatchi” endru kurippittirundhanar. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vangadhesathil kadandha sila naatkalukku munbu, mugamadhu navi patri avadhooraaga pesiyadhaaga koori theevu sandhira thaas endra indhu ilainjar thaakkappattu erithu kollappattaar. Andha ilainjarai vangadhesa poleesaarai vanmuraiyaalargalidam oppadaithadhaagak kurippittu nam Tamil Naattil palarum video-vai padhivittu varugindranar. Melum, siruvaanmaiyinarukku edhiraaga vanmuraiyaith thoondum vagaiyil padhivugal pagirappattu varugiradhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2025 navambaril indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Theevu sandhira thaas kolai sambavam 2025 tisambar 18m thedhi nadandhadhu. Aanaal, indha veediyovo sambavam nadappadharku oru maadhathirku munbu navambar 17m thedhi veliyaagi ulladhu. Idhan moolam idhu theevu sandhiradhaasin kadaisi video illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Thodarndhu thediyavodhu, Police adithadhum azha aarambitha taakkaa kalloori maanavar endru kurippittu indha video-vai vangadhesa oodagangal veliyittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu thediyavodhu, vangadhesa munnaal piradhamar shek haseenaavukku navambar maadham vangadhesa Needhimandram marana thandanai vidhithadhaith thodarndhu vangadhesath thalainagaril meendum vanmurai erpattadhaagavum, appodhu taakkaa kalloori maanavargal vanmuraiyil eeduvattadhaagavum seythigal kidaithana.
Indha video-vai nammudaiya fekt kirasando vanga mozhi kuzhuvinarukku anuppi video patri kettom. Adhai parthuvittu nammidam, andha navar taakkaa kalloori logovudan koodiya ti-shart anindhirukkiraar. Avaradhu ti-shardin pin pakkathil Momin endru ezhudhappattiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhu avarudaiya peyar. Thaan taakkaa kallooriyil padippadhaagavum thaan endha poraattathilum panguveravillai endru koori avar azhugiraar. Avarai angirundhu sellumbadi kaavaldhuraiyinar koorugindranar.
Police-aridam naangal anaivarum kalloori valaagathirkuldhaan irundhom endru matroru maanavar vandhu pesuvadhaiyum kaana mudigiradhu. Ivar taakkaa kalloori maanavar. Theevu sandhiradhaas vangadhesathin maimensing maavattathil ulla paalukkaa uvasilaavil vasithu vandhullaar. Ivar kalloori maanavar alla, angulla thozhitsaalai ondril velai seythu vandhavar. Theevu sandhiradhaasai vanmuraiyaalargalin kaigalil Police oppadai video endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endranar.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video navambar 18m thedhi samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi iruppadhai urudhi seythullom. Melum andha navar taakkaa kalloori maanavar endru appodhe vangadhesa oodagangalil seythi veliyaagi iruppadhaiyum kandarindhullom. Vanmuraiyil eeduvattadhaaga avarai Police pidithiruppadhu avaradhu azhugai uraiyaadal moolam urudhi seythullom.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thirishaa engal kulavilakku endru aadhav arjunaa koorinaaraa?
text:
Thirishaa engal kulavilakku endru aadhav arjunaa kooriyadhaaga oru news card

thirishaa, amaichar aadhav arjunaa pugaippadangaludan thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “thrishaa avargalai pesuvadhai anumadhikka mudiyaadhu. Avar engal kulavilakku. Thrishaa engal kulavilakku. Avargalai yaarum vimarsikkavo, thavaraaga pesavo anumadhikka mudiyaadhu. Avaradhu mariyaadhaiyai naangal kaappom – amaichar adhav arjunaa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kaaviri vivagaaram thodarbaaga TVK arasaik kandithu thanjjaiyil DMK nadathiya aarppaattathil edhirkkatchith thalaivar Udhayanidhi Stalin thavaraagap pesivittadhaagak koori kaidhu seyyappattaar. Nadigai thirishaa patri thavaraagap pesivittaar endru palarum kandanam therivithu varugindranar.
Indha nilaiyil thirishaa engalin kula vilakku endru amaichar aadhav arjunaa kooriyadhaaga oru news card samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Appadi endha oru seythiyum veliyaagaadha soozhalil news card sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu. Enave, idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Joon 4m thedhi thandhi TV veliyitta news kaardugalai paarvaiyittom. Naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha oru news kaardum veliyaagavillai.
Enave, indha news card-ai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppik kettom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Adhanudan, “ippadi endha seythiyaiyum thandhi TV veliyidavillai. Pagiravum illai. Idhu pondra thagavalgalai namba vendaam!” endru kurippittu “FAKE Card” muthiraiyudan idhai thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalilum thandhi TV veliyittadhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu” endru nirmalaa seedhaaraaman koorinaaraa?
text:
Thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu endru mathiya nidhi amaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman kooriyadhaaga oru padhivu

Polimer tholaikkaatchi veliyitta seythiyai sgireenshaat eduthu padhivittullanar. Adhil, “thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu makkalavaiyil kaattamaaga pesiya mathiya amaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhai adippadaiyaaga vaithu meems uruvaakki silar Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil nirmalaa seedhaaraaman thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu endru kooriyadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivugalai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pudhiya kalvik kolgai, piem sree thittathai Tamil Nadu arasu erka maruthadhaal Tamil Naattin kalvith thittangalukku nidhi odhukka mudiyaadhu endru mathiya arasu koorivittadhu. Indha vivagaarathil naadaalumandrathil DMK em.pi-kkalai nokki mathiya kalvi amaichar tharmendhira piradhaan pesiyadhu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Kamitti amaithu aaraayndhu adhan adippadaiyil piem sree thittathil sergirom endru Tamil Nadu arasu kadidham anuppiyadhai piem sree thittathil sera Tamil Nadu oppuk kondadhu endru vidhandaavaadham seythu varugindradhu mathiya arasu.
Indha nilaiyil, “thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu” endru nirmalaa seedhaaraaman koorivittadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Unmaiyil avar thiraavidar kazhaga thalaivar oruvarin karuthu endru merkolgaattip pesiyadhaaga seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhu. Aanaal nirmalaa seedhaaraamane avvaaru kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Polimer tholaikkaatchiyil nirmalaa seedhaaraaman avvaaru kooriyadhaaga kurippidappattulladhaa endru paarthom. Aanaal, thalaippu maatrappattirundhadhu. ‘makkalavaiyil kaattamaaga pesiya mathiya amaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman..! Vidudhalai pathirigaiyil veliyaanadhai merkolgaatti makkalavaiyil kaattamaaga pesiya mathiya amaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman..!” endru kurippittu andha video-vai veliyittirundhanar.
Adhil, 1943m aandu navambar 27m thedhi veliyaana vidudhalai naalidhazhil mariyaadhaikkuriya thalaivar oruvar thamizh patri solliyulla karuthaip paarungal. Avar solgiraar. “thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu” engiraar. Thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu. Thamizh padithadhu pichai eduppadhaith thavira veru uyir vaazha ondrukkum payanbadavillai enbadhodu idharkaaga selavu seytha kaalathai veru thuraiyil selavittaal vaazhvil payan erpattirukkum enbadhai 100 aandugalukku munbe thamizh katra oru anuvava pulavar paadiyullaar” endru kurippittullaar engiraar.
Indha video-vai naadaalumandrathin Sansad TV YouTube pakkathilirundhu thedi eduthom. Video-vin oru mani neram 10vadhu nimidathirku piragu nirmalaa seedhaaraamanin indha pechu varugiradhu. Idhan moolam idhu nirmalaa seedhaaraaman karuthu illai enbadha urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
Periyaarin karuthaa, veru oru pulavarin karuthaa, periyaar en appadi sonnaar endra aayvukkul ellaam naam sellavillai. Thamizh padithaal pichai kooda kidaikkaadhu endru nirmalaa seedhaaraaman kooravillai. Vidudhalai naalidhazhil oruvar (periyaar) appadik koorinaar endru mattume kurippittullaar. Vidudhalaiyil veliyaana karuthai nirmalaa seedhaaraamanin karuthaaga maatri samooga oodagangalil thavaraana thagavalaip pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Staart ap niruvanangalukku roo.5 latcham vazhangum elgaat
text:
'staart ap' niruvanangalukku roo.5 latcham vazhangum 'elgaat'
Chennai: Thamizhaga, 'staart ap' niruvanangalukku, 'tettaa storej' vasadhikku thalaa, 5 latcham roobai nidhiyudhaviyai, 'elgaat' niruvanam vazhanga ulladhu.
Thamizhagathil ulla, 'staart ap' enappadum puthozhil niruvanangal thagaval thozhilnutbam, elaktraaniks utbada palveru thuraigalil eeduvattu varugindrana. Inniruvanangalukku thangalin tharavugalai paadhugaakkum, 'tettaa storej' panikku adhigam selavaagindrana.
Thamizhaga arasin, 'elgaat' niruvanam, Thamizhaga puthozhil tharavu maiya sevai thittathin keezh, staart ap niruvanangaluk ku aandukku thalaa, 5 latcham roobai varai, moondru aandugalukku nidhiyudhavi vazhangum thittathai seyalbaduthugiradhu.
Ithittathin keezh staart ap niruvanang kalukku nidhiyudhavi vazhanguvadharkaana vinnappathai, Thamizhaga arasin staart ap ti.en., niruvanam petru, elgaattirku vazhanga ulladhu.
Tharpodhu, nidhiyudhavi pera viruppam ulla niruvanangalukku azhaippu vidukkappattu ulladhu.
Vinnappam ullitta koodudhal vivarangalukku, 155343 matrum 044 22256789 engalil thodarbu kollalaam.

headline: Kadandha 5 varudangalil sirandha edhirk katchi naam thamizhar endru IBC thamizh karuthukkanippu veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘‘kadandha 5 varudangalil sirandha edhirk katchi naam thamizhar,’’ endru IBC thamizh karuthukkanippu veliyittadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ IBC thamizh nadathiya karuthukkanippu – pipravari 2026. Tamil Naattil kadandha 5 varudangalil makkal pirachanaiyil makkal kooda nindra edhir katchi edhu? Endha katchikku vaakkalikka pogiraargal? NTK 73%, ADMK 20% TVK 4.5%, idhara katchigal 2.5%,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
IBC thamizh logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda seythi unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu IBC thamizh peyaril paravum poliyaana seythi, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, ezhuthup pizhaigaludan IBC Tamil peyaril vendumendre poliyaana seythiyai parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mu.ka Stalin pugaippadam poritha Pampers parimudhal endru paravum seythi unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘M.K. Stalin pugaippadam poritha Pampers parimudhal,’’ endru kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ DMK-vin Pampers-kal parimudhal. Chennai: kolathoor thogudhiyil DMK thalaivar mu.ka Stalin pugaippadam poritha Pampers-kalai therdhal parakkum padaiyinar parimudhal seythanar’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda seythi unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu Sun News peyaril pagirappadum poliyaana news card endru, theriyavandhadhu.
Kurippitta news card-il, Saturn News endra logo idambetrulladhu. Indha peyaril Tamil Naattil news channel edhuvum illai. Melum, idhuvondra endha seythiyum oodagangalil veliyaagavillai.
Aduthappadiyaaga, DMK aidi pirivu matrum Tamil Nadu therdhal aanaiyam aagiyavatril pesi, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyaanadhu, endru urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, poliyaana ondru, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “endha navaraiyum kurippittu pesavillai..” sameevathiya sarchai kurithu vijaysedhuvadhi vilakkam!
text:
Pikbaas 10 nigazhchiyil pottiyaalarukku thalaimaithuvam kurithu arivurai kooriya Vijay sedhuvadhiyin pechu, mudhalvar Vijay-ai kurithadhaaga sarchai kilambiyadhu. Vijay rasigargal, TVK aadharavaalargal kadumaiyaaga vimarsitha nilaiyil, pikbaas medaiyil pesappadum karuthugal pottiyaalargal matrum kuzhuvinarukke uriyadhu, veliyilirukkum endhavoru navaraiyo alladhu amaippugalaiyo kurikkavillai endru Vijay sedhuvadhi vilakkam alithullaar.
Nadigar kamalhaasan thoguthuvazhangi migapperiya hittaditha pikbaas nigazhchiyai kadandha sila aandugalaaga nadigar Vijay sedhuvadhi thoguthu vazhangivarugiraar. Indhasoozhalil sameevathil thodangiya pikbaas seesan 10 nigazhchiyil pottiyaalar oruvarukku arivurai sonna Vijay sedhuvadhi, “thalaivan endraal ennavendre theriyaamal, thalaimaithuvam endraal ennavendre theriyaamal, vaaykku vandhadhuvola vaakkurudhigalai allik koduthuvittu, pirasnaigalum poruppum varumbodhu, edhirani meedhu pazhiyaith thookkip pottu, angirundhu therithu oduvadhu enbadhu thalaivanukkaana panbu illai. Adhu emaatru velai” ena pesiyirundhaar.
Vijaysedhuvadhiyin indha pechu mudhalvar Vijay-ai thaakkippesiyadhu pola iruppadhaaga sarchai kilambiyadhu. Idhanaal Vijay-in rasigargalum, thavegavinarum Vijay sedhuvadhiyai samoogavalaidhalangalil kadumaiyaaga thaakki padhivittu vimarsithanar.
Indhasambavam naalukku naal theeviramaagi iyakkunar seenu raamasaami, Seeman matrum TVK amaichargal ena palarum karuthugoora sinimaa, arasiyal ena periyadhaagiyadhu. Indhanilaiyil thaan, pikbaas nigazhchiyil pesappadum karuthukkum veli navarukkum sambandhamillai ena Vijay sedhuvadhi vilakkam koduthulla video kilippai Vijay TV veliyittulladhu.
Vijay TV veliyittirukkum video-vil, “indha medaiyil pesappadum karuthugal anaithum indha veettil ulla pottiyaalargalukkum engalukkum mattume sondhamaanavai, veliyil irukkum endha navaraiyum alladhu amaippaiyum saarndhu kurippidappadavillai enbadhai thittavattamaaga therivithuk kolgirom. Idhaip patri sollaamale ungalukkellaam purindhirukkum endru ninaithen, aanaal kadandha vaarame idhai solliyirukka vendum. Ippodhu solla vendiya avasiyamaagivittadhu” ena pesiyullaar.

headline: TVK vetriyai kondaadiya pengal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Thavega-vin vetriyai madhu arundhi saalaiyil kummaalamittu kondaadiya pengal, kalloori maanavigal endru oru video

saalaiyil sila ilam pengal poleesaarudan vaakkuvaadhathil eeduvatta video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vin meedhu “pengal, kalloori maanavigal kudithuvittu kummaalam” endru thalaippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thaavega vetriyai naagarigamaaga kondaattiya kalloori maanaviyar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum share seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu mudhalamaicharaaga josap Vijay me 10, 2026 andru poruppetraar. Avaradhu vetriyaik kondaadum vagaiyil ilam pengal madhu arundhivittu saalaiyil kummaalamittanar endru edhirkkatchiyaana thi.mu.ka-vais saarndha palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vai paarkkum podhu adhil ulla kaavalargal thamizhnaattais saarndhavargal pola illai. Pudhucheri kaavalargal aniyum thoppi anindhirundhanar. Enave, indha padhivil idam petrulla thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil idam petra video-vin unmaiyaana padhivu namakku kidaithadhu. Andha padhivaanadhu 2026 epral 16m thedhi Facebook-il padhividappattirundhadhu. Tamil Nadu sattamandrathirkaana podhuth therdhal 2026 epral 23m thedhi nadandhadhu. Therdhalukku kittathatta oru vaarathirku munbe indha video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu.
Andha video-vil veru maanilangalilirundhu pudhucherikku vandha ilainjargal silar saalaiyil thagaraaru seythadhaagavum adhai podhu makkal thattikkettadhaagavum kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha ilam pengal, ilainjargalai Police kaidhu seyyaavittaal thunai nilai aalunarai azhaippen endru video-vai edutha navar kooriyadhai thelivaagak ketka mudindhadhu.
Melum ivargal thavega-vais saarndhavargal endru andha video-vil engum kurippidappadavillai. Ivai ellaam Vijay Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar aanadhai madhu arundhivittu saalaiyil kummaalavittu kondaadiya ilam pengal endru thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: UPI moolam roo.314 latcham kodi parivarthanai.. Varalaatrileye illaadha pudhiya ucham!
text:
2025-26 nidhiyaandil India-vil UPI moolam 314 latcham kodi roobai parivarthanaigal nadaivetradhu varalaatrileye illaadha saadhanaiyaagum. Kadandha 5 aandugalil UPI payanbaadu vegamaaga uyarndhulladhaaga mathiya nidhith thurai inai amaichar pangaj savuthri arikkaiyil kooriyullaar. NPCI tharavuppadi 55.49 kodikkum merpattor tharpodhu UPI payanbaduthugindranar.
2025-26 nidhiyaandil varalaatrileye miga adhigavatchamaaga 314 latcham kodi roobai madhippilaana parivarthanaigal padhivaagi saadhanai padaithulladhu. Mathiya nidhith thurai inai amaicharbangaj savuthri thaakkal seytha arikkaiyin padi, India-vin UPI panapparivarthanaigal kadandha 5aandugalil migavegamaaga adhigarithullana.
Neshanal pements kaarppareshan aap India tharavugalin padi, naattil tharpodhu 55 pulli 49 kodikkum adhigamaanor UPI-ai payanbaduthivarugindranar endrum, ulagalavil India-vin UPI matrum roove (RuPay) card ulgattamaippai singappoor, ameeragam, ilangai, morishiyas ullitta 12 naadugal etrukkondulladhaagavum mathiyaarasu therivithulladhu.

headline: Saalaiyil thaniyaaga kidandha kuzhandhaiyai kaappaatriya mayil endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Saalaiyin naduve amarndhirundha pachilam kuzhandhai ondrai aavathukkalilirundhu mayil ondru kaappaatriyadhaaga video ondru

kuzhandhai ondru saalaiyin naduve amarndhiruppadhu polavum, vaaganangal modhaamal kaappaatri, kuzhandhai saalaiyaik kadakka mayil ondru udhavuvadhu polavum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Pinnaniyil murugan paadal olikkiradhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “nadurottil kuzhandhai iruppadhaip paarthu kuzhandhaiyai paadhugaathu pathiramaaga orathil kondu serkkum mayil🦚 viyakka vaikkum adhisiyam 👍 mayil vaaganane potri om murugaa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Saalaiyin naduve kuzhandhai iruppadhu polavum andha kuzhandhaiyaik kadavul mayilaaga vandhu kaappaatriyadhu polavum silaagithu video padhividappattulladhu. Video-vai paarkkum podhe idhu unmaiyaanadhu illai, seyarkai nunnarivu moolam uruvaakkappattulladhu enbadhu therigiradhu. Aanaalum idhaiyum palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Pachilam kuzhandhaiyai ippadi nadu rottil yaarum viduvaargalaa, appadiye kuzhandhai saalaikku vandhaal adhaik kandum kaanaamal makkal selvaargalaa endru eraalamaana kelvigalai indha video ezhuppugiradhu. Melum, video-vin pala pagudhigal idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythu konde irundhana.
Kurippaaga kuzhandhai saaks enappadum kaalurai anindhiruppadhu pondru kaatchi ulladhu. Sila vinaadigalil kuzhandhai verum kaaludan iruppadhu pondru kaatchi varugiradhu.
Car ondru varum podhu mayil kuzhandhaiyaik kaakkum vagaiyil kaarai nokkith thirumbugiradhu. Thideerendru mayil thogaiyai virikkiradhu. Kaarai paarthu thogaiyai virikkum mayilin thalaip pagudhi thogai viritha pinnar kuzhandhai pakkam thirumbividugiradhu.
Mayilin kondai pagudhiyaanadhu kuzhandhai saalaiyaik kadakkum podhu, kuzhandhaiyin thalaikku varugiradhu. Sila vinaadigal kuzhandhaikkum mayilukku iruppadhu pondru kondai erpattu maraigiradhu. Ippadip pala kaatchigal idhu eai video enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Deepfakes Analysis Unit vaatsaap pirivai thodargondu, video kaatchigalai anuppi, sandhegam kettom. Avargalum, indha kaatchigal ellaam muzhukka muzhukka eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru alasi aaraayndhu mudivai arivithanar. Idhan moolam indha video unmaiyaanadhu illai… eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Kill zoneil America pork kappalgal.. Mukkiyath thuraimugathaik kaippatriya Iran!
text:
Seythiyaalar: M. Meeraa
mathiya kizhakkil erkenave nilavi varum padhatrathukku mathiyil, emanil Iran aadharavu petra havudhip padaigalukkum savudhi aadharavu petra PLC padaigalukkum idaiyilaana modhal meendum theeviramadaindhulladhu. Merku emanil nadaivetra kadumaiyaana sandaikkup piragu, hayes (Hays) nagarai meendum kaippatriyulladhaaga havudhip padaigal therivithullana. Idhanmoolam, merku emanil thangaladhu kattuppaattai melum virivuvaduthum muyatsiyil havudhigal irangiyulladhaagath therigiradhu.
Puviyiyal reedhiyaaga hayes enbadhu kadalil irundhu sumaar 28 kilomeettar ulnokki amaindhulla oru mukkiyamaana nagaramaagum. Idhu neradith thuraimugam alla. Innagarathaik kaippatriyadhanmoolam, adhan arugilulla sengadal thuraimuga nagarangalaana al-kavgaa (Al Khawkhah) matrum pugazhbetra mokkaa (Mokha) aagiya thuraimugap pagudhigalukkul havudhip padaigal ooduruvi, thangaladhu kattuppaattai virivuvaduthi varugindrana.
Munnadhaaga indha hayes pagudhiyai eman arasup padaigal meettadhaaga arivithirundhavodhilum, havudhigalin thodar thaakkudhalaal arasup padaigal angirundhu pinvaangiyadhu. Adhanaal tharpodhu hayes nagaram muzhumaiyaaga havudhigalin vasam vandhulladhaagath thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Idhu thodarbaaga havudhigal veliyitta kaanoligalil, angulla paadhugaapputh thurai aluvalagak kattadathukku veliye thangaladhu poraaligal nirpadhu pondra kaatchigal idambetrullana.
Idhanidaiye, kizhakku al-javp pagudhiyilum savudhi aadharavu petra padaigalukku edhiraaga thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga havudhigal therivithullanar. Edhirip padaigal kuvindhirundha idangalaik kurivaithu thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaagavum, pala raanuva vaaganangalai azhithadhaagavum avargal kooriyullanar. Melum, modhalinbodhu pala veerargalais siraividithadhaagavum havudhigal therivithullanar.
Idhanaith thodarndhu padhiladiyaaga emanil havudhip padaigal meedhu savudhi areviyaa vaanvazhith thaakkudhalgalai theevirappaduthiyulladhu. Moondru naatkalil palveru eman maagaanangalil 121 vaanvazhith thaakkudhalgalum , 12 mani nerathil mattum 48 thaakkudhalgalum nadathappattulladhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana.
Idharkup padhiladi kodukkum vagaiyil, savudhi areviyaavin therkup pagudhigalil tajan kanakkaana paalistik evuganaigal matrum trongalai eviyulladhu havudhip padai. Idhanaal savudhi aaraamgo kattamaippugalum, king kaalath vimaanappadaith thalamum thaakkudhalukku utbattulladhu. Indhath thaakkudhalgalai seyarkaikkol padangalum urudhi seythullana.
Indha modhal emanin ellaigalukkul mattum surungum nilai illaamal, ulagap porulaadhaarathaiyum paadhikkakkoodiyadhaaga maariyulladhu. Savudhiyin mukkiya erisakdhi ulgattamaippugal thodarndhu thaakkudhal nadathappattaal erkenave uyarndhu varum kachaa enney vilaikku melum azhutham erpadalaam.
Emanin mukkiya nagarangalaana hayes (Hays) matrum mokkaa (Mokha) pondra kadalorap pagudhigalai havudhip padaigal kaippatriyiruppadhu, sengadal matrum paap al-mandep (Bab el-Mandeb) jalasandhi pagudhiyil paadhugaappup paniyil eeduvattulla America porkkappalgalukku migapperiya paadhugaappu achuruthalaiyum sikkalaiyum erpaduthiyulladhu.
Idhanaal angu thangalin evuganaigal (Anti-ship missiles) matrum tharkolaippadai trongalai miga elidhaaga nilainirutha mudiyum. Idhanaal, sengadalil sellum America porkkappalgalai migak kuraindha thoorathilirundhe thulliyamaagath thaakkakkoodiya vaayppu avargalukkuk kidaithulladhu.
Melum America porkkappalgalin nadamaattathai havudhip padaigalaal nilapparappil irundhavadiye neradiyaagak kangaanikka mudiyum. Idharku Iran, Russia alladhu China pondra naadugalin seyarkaikkol tharavugalum avargalukku udhavakkoodum endra achamum nilavugiradhu. Havudhip padaigalin indha nilapparappu nagarvugal, America porkkappalgalaith tharkaappup paaniyilirundhu neradi modhal nilaikkuth thalliyullana. Idhanaal sengadal pagudhiyil amerikkak kadarpadai migath theeviramaana paadhugaappu valaiyathai erpadutha vendiya kattaayathirku aalaakkiyulladhu.

headline: Thamizhnaattai achuruthum tengu.. Ore naalil 244 perukku kaaychal urudhi!!
text:
Thamizhagathin palveru maavattangalil, kadandha sepdambar 17aam thedhi mattum tenguvaal paadhikkappattavargalin ennikkai 244. Adhiga makkaldhogai konda Chennai maavattam, tengu paadhippil mudhalidathil ulladhu. Chennai-yil mattum ore naalil 87 perukku tengu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Sennaikku aduthavadiyaaga Chengalpattu, Kovai, thiruvannaamalai, Krishnagiri, Salem, Tiruvallur , kaanjjivuram, thanjjai, matrum vizhuppuram maavattangaliladhigalavil tengu paadhippu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Enjjiya maavattangalil motham 57 per paadhikkappattullanar.
Kadandha aandu navambar maadham varai Tamil Naattil 25 aayirathu 278 tengu paadhippugalum, 10 uyirizhappugalum padhivaagiyirundhana. Adhe nerathil, indha aandu, janavari mudhal sepdambar 17aam thedhi varai, 16 aayirathu 577 per tengu paadhippukkullaagiyullanar; 9 per uyirizhandhanar. Indha pulli vivarangal tengu kaaychal Tamil Naattil paravivaruvadhan theevirathai unarthuvadhaaga ullana.

headline:
’thoonguvadhil kutra unarchi
kollakkoodaadhu; thookkam aadambaram alla’ - maruthuvargalin arivurai enna?
text:
’thoonguvadhil kutra unarchi kollakkoodaadhu; thookkam aadambaram alla’ - maruthuvargalin arivurai enna?
Thookkam aadambaram alla, adhu uyirvaazha adippadaith thevai ena maruthuvargal koorugindranar. Naveena ulagil palar thoonguvadhil kutra unarchi kolgindranar. Idhu thavaru. Thookkam moolaikku mudhaleedu. Matravargalai oppidaamal thevaiyaana oyvai alikka vendum. Thoonguvadharku kutra unarchi thevaiyillai.
Paravarappaana indha naveena ulagil ezhu mudhal ettu mani neram thoonguvadhugooda edho periya kutrathai seythadhu pondra unarvai palaridamum erpaduthugiradhu. Kurippaaga maanavargal, panivuriyum pengal thoongi ezhundhavudan andraiya velaigalai ninaithu oruvidha azhuthathirku ullaagiraargal. Thookkam aadambaram alla, adhu uyirvaazha adippadaith thevai endru koorugindranar maruthuvargal.
Eppodhum iyangikkonde iruppadhai vetriyin adaiyaalamaagavum, oyvu eduppadhai somberithanamaagavum karudhuvadhu thavaraana paarvai endrum maruthuvargal koorugindranar. Melum, “oyvu eduppadhu adutha naal sirappaaga seyalbada moolaikku tharum mudhaleedu endra ennathai valarkka vendum. Padukkaikku sellum mun marunaal seyya vendiya velaigalaip pattiyalidumbodhu manavaaram kuraiyum. Matravargalin surusuruppudan ungal udalai oppidaamal thevaiyaana oyvai alikka vendum. Moochuviduvadharku eppadi kutra unarchi thevaiyillaiyo adhevola thoonguvadharkum thevaiyillai” endru maruthuvargal arivuruthugindranar.

headline: Pakistan siruvargal kaigalil kattukkattaaga Indhiya roobai nottu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Pakistan-il siruvargal Indhiya pana madhippizhappu nadavadikkai moolam sellaadhu endru arivikkappatta eraalamaana roobai nottukkalai vaithullaargal endru oru video

irandu siruvargal kaigalil eraalamaana Indhiya roobai nottukkal irukkum video instaagiraamil padhividappattalladhu. Andha video-vil, “paakkisdhaanil nam naattu panam ippa puriyudhaa paaradha piradhamar modiji arivithadhu panam sellaadhu enru” endru miga mosamaana ezhuthuppizhaiyudan ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pana madhippizhappu nadavadikkai moolam migapperiya paadhippai makkal sandhithanar. Aanaal, adhanaal palan irundhadhu endru niroovikka BJP aadharavaalargal thodarndhu muyatsi seythu varugindranar. Pana madhippizhappu nadavadikkaiyaal nanmaiyaa, theemaiyaa endra aayvukkul naam sellavillai. Indhiya panathaip Pakistan-il siruvargal vaithirundhadhaaga paravum thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Indha aandu thodakkathilirundhu palarum indha video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil migavum pazhamaiyaana padhivugalaith thedi eduthup paarthom. Edhilum sariyaana thagaval illai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu indha video-vai thaan eduthen endrum, indha video-vai migavum vairalaakkiya nettisangalukku nandri endrum oruvar padhivu veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Avarudaiya instaagiraam pakkathaip paartha podhu, tisambar 27, 2024 andru naam aayvukku eduthukkonda andha video-vai avar padhivetram seythirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Indha video-vai avar Pakistan-il eduthadhaagak kurippidavillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu indha navar video-vil idam petrirundha siruvargaludan eduthukkonda matroru video-vai YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil indha video-vai paagisdhaanilo, utharagaandilo edukkavillai… Lucknow-vil aashiyaanaa sauraahaa (Ashiana Chauraha) endra pagudhiyil eduthadhaagak kurippittirundhaar. Aam, BJP aatchi seyyum utharappiradhesa maanilathin thalainagaraana Lucknow-vil eduthadhaaga avar padhivittirundhaar.
Lucknow-vil aashiyaanaa sauraahaa pagudhiyai koogul mep-l thedi eduthom. Adhan jangshan pagudhiyil naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video-vil idam petrirundha idangal appadiye irundhana. Idhan moolam indha video Pakistan-il edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Kuppaigal mothamaaga kottappadum idathilirundhu indha roobai nottukkal kidaithadhaaga siruvargal koorugindranar. Matravadi indha vivagaaram thodarbaaga veru endha seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Video-vai eduthavare idhu utharappiradhesa maanilam Lucknow-vil edukkappattadhu endru urudhi seythullaar. Avar kooriya idathin koogul street viyoo kaatchiyum video-vil idam petra saalaiyin kaatchiyum othuppogiradhu. Idhan moolam indha video paagisdhaanais saarndhadhu illai enbadhum piradhamar Modi-yin pana madhippizhappu nadavadikkai sariyaanadhudhaan enbadhai urudhi seyyum vagaiyil illai enbadhum thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Madurai: laariyilirundhu vizhundha irumbup porul - jallikkattu nanbargal iruvar uyirizhandha sogam
text:
Madurai maavattam sozhavandhaan aruge nagari pagudhiyil madhurai–thindukkal thesiya nedunjjaalaiyil nadandha kora vivathil, jallikkattu maaduvidi veerargalaana nerungiya nanbargal iruvar uyirizhandha sambavam sithaalangudi kiraamathil perum sogathai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Sozhavandhaan arugeyulla sithaalangudi kiraamathais serndhavargal kovaal matrum ayyanaar. Iruvarum nerungiya nanbargal mattumindri, jallikkattu pottigalil aarvathudan pangetru vandha maaduvidi veerargal.
Palveru jallikkattu pottigalil inaindhu kalamirangi parisugalaiyum vendrullanar. Iruvarukkum innum thirumanam aagavillai enak koorappadugiradhu.
Indha nilaiyil, netru iravu kovaalum ayyanaarum irusakkara vaaganathil madhurai–thindukkal thesiya nedunjjaalaiyil sendru kondirundhanar. Nagari pagudhiyil saalaiyil amaikkappattulla thaduppup pagudhiyil vaaganangal sellumbodhu nilaidhadumaarum vagaiyil iruppadhaaga appagudhi makkal therivikkindranar.
Andha nerathil, avvazhiyaagas sendra adaiyaalam theriyaadha kanaraga laariyilirundhu periya irumbup porul ondru thideerena thavari saalaiyil vizhundhulladhu. Andha irumbup porul irusakkara vaaganathil sendru kondirundha kovaal matrum ayyanaar meedhu palamaaga modhiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Idhil iruvarum thookki veesappattu palatha kaayamadaindha nilaiyil, sambava idathileye paridhaavamaaga uyirizhandhanar. Vivathai erpaduthiya laari angu nirkaamal sendradhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Thagavalarindhu sambava idathirku viraindhu vandha sozhavandhaan kaavaldhuraiyinar, iruvarin udalgalaiyum meettu udarkooraayvukkaaga Madurai raajaaji arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppi vaithanar.
Melum, vivathai erpaduthiyadhaagak koorappadum kanaraga vaaganathai adaiyaalam kaanum paniyil poleesaar theeviramaaga eeduvattullanar.
Ore kiraamam, nerungiya natbu, jallikkattu kalathil inaindhu vendravargal... Vaazhkkaiyilum inaiviriyaamal irundha nanbargal iruvarum ore vivathil uyirizhandhiruppadhu sithaalangudi makkalai adhirchiyilum sogathilum aazhthiyulladhu.
Melum, nagari pagudhiyil ulla saalaith thaduppu matrum angu nilavum pokkuvarathu paadhugaappu kuraivaadugal kurithum adhigaarigal aayvu seythu uriya nadavadikkai edukka vendum ena appagudhi makkal valiyuruthugindranar.
Uyirizhandha ilainjargalin kudumbangalukku arasu uriya izhappeedu vazhanga vendum endrum uravinargal matrum podhumakkal korikkai viduthullanar.
