headline: Islaamiyar enbadhaal 98.31% madhippen petra maanaviyai kandugollaadha oodagangal endra thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
Kujaraathil auto ottunarin magal 10m vaguppu podhuth thervil 98.31 sadhavigidha madhippen petradhaagavum aanaal oodagangal andha seythiyai iruttadippu seythu varuvadhaagavum oru thagaval

auto arugil thandhaiyum magalum irukkum pugaippadathai vaithu pugaippada vadivilaana padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Adhil, “endha oodagangalum velippaduthavillai agamadhaavaath auto ottunarin magal aaprin shek, GSEB 10-aam vaguppup podhuth thervugalil 98.31% madhippengalai petraar. Ivar muslim enbadhaal endha oodagangalum kandugollavillai. Neengalaavadhu oru vaazhthu sollalaame” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kujaraath maanilam agamadhaavaathil auto ottum islaamiyar oruvarin magal 10m vagupputh thervil 98.31 madhippen petradhaagavum, avar islaamiyar enbadhaal endha oodagamum avarai kandugollavillai endrum samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Kurippitta saadhi, madham saarndhu seyalbadum oodagam appadi seyalbadalaam. Aanaal, podhuvaaga endha oodagamum ippadi saadhi, madham paarthu seythiyai maraippadhu illai. Enave, indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Koogulil agamadhaavaath, auto ottunarin magal, aprin shek, GSEB, 98.31 sadhavigidha madhippen ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalai koogulil padhivittu thedinom. Appodhu, indha seythi pudhidhu illai, 2018m aandu veliyaana seythi enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. 2018m aandileye indha seythiyai taims aap India, endidivi, evivi, pisinas staandardu, finaanshiyal eksbiras ena anaithu oodagangalum veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
ANI seythi niruvanam kooda indha seythiyai 2018m aandu veliyittirundhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu munnani seythi oodagam mudhal siru inaiya oodagam varai ellorum indha seythiyai veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Enave, islaamiya maanavi thervil 98.31 sadhavigidha madhippen petra seythiyai oodagangal iruttadippu seygindrana endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
2018m aandu seythiyai, ippodhu nadandhadhu pola kurippittu, oodagangal meedhu pazhi sumathi padhivittiruppadhu thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil iruppadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘naan mudhalvaraaga vendum’ endru milagaay avishegam seythu kondaaraa Annamalai?
text:
Modi, amithshaa matrum ADMK koottanikku edhiraaga Annamalai milagaay podi avishegam seythu kondadhaaga oru video

kittathatta Tamil Nadu BJP munnaal thalaivar Annamalai pondru thotram alikkum oruvarukku milagaayp podi avishegam nigazhndha video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha video meedhu, “1500 liter milagaay podiyai araithu ootri avishegam. Arogaraa muzhakkathudan pakdhargal pakdhip paravasam!!” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “than padhaviyai paritha amithshaa Modi adharku kaaranamaaga irundha pannichaami BJP ADMK koottam naasamaaga pogavendum endru milagaay podi kuliyal nadathi saamiyai vendiya annaamalai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhe video-vai veru silar, “2026 Tamil Nadu sattamandrath therdhalil BJP koottani vetri petru thangal katchi aatchi amaikka vendum endrum, thaan Tamil Naattin mudhalamaicharaaga padhavi erka vendum endrum. Thanakku varamilagaay karaisal avishegam seythu muruganai manamurugi vendiya kaatchi.
Idhuvondra kadumaiyaana vendudhalgalai tharpodhaiya thalaivaraaga ullavarum pazhaiya thalaivargalum seyya thunichal irukkiradhaa endru Annamalai-yin theevira aadharavaalargal kidukkippidi kelvi” endru kurippittu padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thannudaiya padhaviyaip paritha piradhamar narendhira Modi matrum uldhurai amaichar amithshaavukku edhiraagavum ADMK – BJP koottani muriya vendum enbadharkaagavum Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivar Annamalai milagaayp podi avishegam seythu vazhivattaar endru silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. 2026 sattamandra therdhalil BJP vetri petruth thaan mudhalamaicharaaga vendum endru thanakkuth thaane milagaay karaisal avishegam seythu kondaar endrum silar padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vil ulla navaraip paarkkum podhu Annamalai-yin saayal therigiradhu. Aanaal, Annamalai illai enbadhu therigiradhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom. Video-vil V thamizh endru logo irundhadhu. Appadi edhum Facebook, instaagiraam pakkam ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Vthamizhdigital endra peyaril appadi oru pakkam Facebook, instaagiraamil irundhadhu. Adhil, epral 29, 2025 andru indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Adhil, “sennaip perumbaakkam indhiraa nagar pagudhiyil ulla valli – theyvayaanai vetrivel murugan kovilil, sithirai thirukkaarthigai naalai munnittu indhas sirappu vazhivaadu nadaivetradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Tamil Nadu BJP munnaal thalaivar annaamalaikku milagaay podi avishegam nadandhadhu endru andha oodagam kurippidavillai.
Koogulil, milagaayp podi karaisal, avishegam ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthith thedinom. Appodhu thandhi TV, vendhar news ullitta tholaikkaatchigalil veliyaana seythi namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil, Chennai perumbaakkathil ulla murugan kovilil arul vandha pakdhar oruvarukku milagaay podi karaisal avishegam nadandhadhu endru kurippidappattadhu. BJP aadharavu oodagamaana vin tivi-yilum kooda indha seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhilum kooda annaamalaikku avishegam nadandhadhaaga kurippidappadavillai.
Therdhalil vetri petru mudhalamaichar aaga vendum endro, ADMK – BJP koottani muriya vendum endro Annamalai vazhivattaar endru endha seythiyum illai. Melum, annaamalaikku milagaay karaisal avishegam seyyappattadhaaga endha seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai.
Annamalai pondra thotram konda oruvarukku milagaayp podi karaisal avishegam nadandhadhai, annaamalaikku nadandhadhaagath thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Koronaa kaaranamaaga njaayiru muzhu ooradangu arivithadhaa Tamil Nadu arasu?
text:
Muruga maanaattaith thadukkum vidhamaaga koronaa paravalaik kaaranam kaatti njaayitrukkizhamai muzhu ooradangu arivippaith Tamil Nadu arasu veliyittulladhu endru oru padhivu

sathiyam TV veliyitta seythiyin sgireenshaat eduthu Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “thamizhagathil njaayirandru muzhu ooradangu koronaa paraval kaaranamaaga njaayitrukkizhamai podhumudakkam – amaichar maa.suppiramaniyan” endru irundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “thimugavukku_payam_vandhuvittadhu muruga pakdhargal maanaadu- 5 latcham pakdhargal kooduvaargal ena thittamidappattu, 10 latcham ena mudivaagi- kadaisiyil 15 latchathaiyum thaandi kooduvaargal ena ulavuthurai alitha ragasiya arikkaiyinai paarthu mirandadhu indhu virodha pithukkuli komaaligalin arasu.
Indhukkalin ezhuchi oru pudhiya uthvegathai erpaduthividum enappayandhu mirandu thadai podap paarthaargal. Needhimandram – sevul arai araindhu anumadhi alithadhu. Kadaisiyil kirukku moodhevigal thirumuruga pakdhargal maanaattai thadukkum nokkileye ippadi oru arivippai veliyittu ulladhaagath therigiradhu. Idhaiyum thagarppom. Edhaiyum velvom” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Maduraiyil joon 22m thedhi muruga maanaattai indhu munnani nadathugiradhu. Idhai vaithu oru pakkam arasiyal nadakkiradhu. Maanaattaith thadukka DMK arasu koronaavai kaaranam kaatti muzhu ooradangai arivithulladhu endru silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha news card-ai paarkka unmaiyaanadhu pola ulladhu. Iruppinum pudhidhu pola illai. Melum, Tamil Nadu arasu appadi oru arivippai veliyittirundhaal migapperiya seythiyaaga vandhirukkum. Aanaal, siru thagaval kooda illai. Enave, pazhaiya seythiyai eduthu pudhidhu pola pagirndhirukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathil ulla thagavalai appadiye koogulil taip seythu thedinom. Appodhu 2022 janavari 5m thedhi sathiyam TV veliyittirundha seythi YouTube-il namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkondirundha sgireenshaat kaatchi 100 sadhavigidham ondraaga irundhadhaik kandom. Indha video-vil irundhu sgireenshaat eduthu vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaanadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu Tamil Nadu unmai kandariyum kuzhuvum indha sgireenshaat thavaraanadhu endru kurippittu padhivu veliyittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam njaayitrukkizhamai koronaa kaaranamaaga muzhu ooradangu arivitha Tamil Nadu arasu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Aasiya vilaiyaattu; 4*400 meter kalappu thodar ottathil pirivil India-vukku velli
text:
Aychi-nagoyaa: aasiya vilaiyaattil 400 meter kalappu thodar ottap pottiyil India velli vendrulladhu. Idhanmoolam oru thangam, 07 velli, 09 vengalam ena motham 17 padhakkangalai India kaippatriyulladhu.
Jappaanin aychi- nagoyaavil nadandhu varum aasiya vilaiyaattu pottiyin thadagalap pirivil, 4x400 meter kalappu thodar ottathil India-vukku melum oru padhakkam kidaithulladhu. Paravarappaaga nadaivetra indhap pottiyil, pahrain 3:12.87 nimidangalil thangappadhakkathai kaippatriyadhu. Idharku aduthavadiyaaga, India-vin manu, poovammaa raajoo, vishaal, Thamizhaga veeraanganai vithyaa raamaraaj aagiyor konda ani 3:14.46 nimidangalil ilakkai etti, velli vendradhu.
Vengalam vendra viyatnaam aniyai (3:14.54) vida verum 8 vinaadigalil ilakkai etti, India indhap padhakkathai thattis sendrulladhu. Pottiyin thuvakkathil Indhiya ani pindhangiya nilaiyil, Thamizhaga veeraanganai vithyaa, thannudaiya sirappaana seyalbattaal, India-vukku padhakkam thedik koduthullaar. Munnadhaaga, magalir 10,000 meter ottappandhayathil India-vin seemaa vengalam vendrirundhaar
2018l jagaardhaavil nadandha aasiya vilaiyaattil thangamum, 2023l haangsovil nadandha potyil India velliyum vendrirundhadhu. Nadappu aasiya vilaiyaattil oru thangam, 7 velli, 9 vengalam ena motham 17 padhakkangalai India kaippatriyulladhu.

headline: UPI-kku ini kattanam seluthavendum.. SILENT-aaga masodhaa niraivetram! Idhu podhumakkalukku aavathaa?
text:
India-vil UPI parivarthanaigalukku kattanam vasoolikka vazhivagukkum ‘varividhippu matrum pira sattangal thirutha masodhaa 2026’ naadaalumandrathil vivaadhamindri niraivetrappattadhu. Zero MDR vidhi maatram moolam, aandukku 1 kodi roovaaykku mel parivarthanai seyyum periya vanigargal, niruvanam-niruvanam idaiyeyaana digital parivarthanaigalukku 0.25% mudhal 0.4% varai kattanam vidhikkappadalaam ena thagaval. Idhu naaladaivil makkal meedhu thinikkappadum ena anjjappadugiradhu.
Naveenagaala vaazhkkaimuraiyil sooppar maal, sooppar maarkket thodangi pettikkadai, ilaneer kadai varai UPI panapparivarthanai vandhuvittadhu. Ellaam digital mayamaagivitta nilaiyil, perumbaalaana makkal thangal paakkettugalil panam vaithiruppadhai urudhiseyvadhillai. ‘adhaan yuviai irukke, movailil PAY pannikkalaam’ endra ennathil 5 roobai, 10 roobai panipparivarthanai mudharkondu yuviai-n kaigalil oppadaithuvittanar.
Indhasoozhalil thaan sameevagaalamaagave yuviai panapparivarthanaikku kattanam vasoolikkum murai konduvaraviruppadhaaga pechukkal irundhuvarugindrana. Aanaal podhumakkal alladhu vanigargal yaarume oru paisaa kooda kattanam selutha vendiyadhillai enbadhe yuviai-n asurathanamaana valarchikku mukkiya kaaranamaaga irundhuvarugiradhu. Adhan kaaranamaagave ovvoru naalum pala aayiram kodi madhippilaana parivarthanaigalai yuviai saathiyamaakki ulladhu.
Aanaal idhaiyellaavatraiyum kadandhu yuviai panapparivarthanaigalukku kattanam vasoolikkum sattadhirutha masodhaavai mathiya arasu naadaalumandrathil niraivetriyulladhu. Mathiya arasu arimugappaduthiyulla 'varividhippu matrum pira sattangal thirutha masodhaa 2026'-n padi, 'panam seluthudhal matrum theervu nadaimuraigal sattam 2007'-il ulla 10A pirivin Zero MDR endra 'poojyak kattanam' vidhigalai thirutha masodhaa vazhivagai seygiradhu. Adhaavadhu indha masodhaavin padi kurippitta sila digital parivarthanaigalaikku ini thaniyaaga kattanam pidikkappadum. Idharku arasu anumadhiyalikkum thirutham seyyappadavirukkiradhu.
Idhai amalbaduthinaal, "idhu padippadiyaaga munneri podhumakkal matrum siru vanigargalai paadhikkum soozhal uruvaagum" ena edhirkkatchigal kutranjjaattiyirundhana. Aanaal indha masodhaa naadaalumandrathil nadandha matra amaligalukku mathiyil evvidha vivaadhamum indri sailanttaaga niraivetrappattulladhu.
Congress tharappil edhirppu..
Indha masodhaavai vimarsithulla Congress podhucheyalaalar jeyraam ramesh, "indha masodhaa UPI parivarthanaigalai ilavasamaaga vaithirukkum sattappoorva utharavaadhathai neekkugiradhu. Idhu vanigar thalluvadi vigidha MDR kattanangalai selutha vazhiyai undaakkugiradhu, idhu edhirgaalathil anaithu pement-kalukkum elidhaaga virivuvaduthappadalaam. Indhas selavai thavirkka mudiyaamal irudhiyil saadhaarana makkaldhaan adhai erka vendiyirukkum, avargal ini UPI parivarthanaigalaip payanbadutha panam selutha vendiyirukkum. UPI-ai nidhi reedhiyaaga nilaithirukkas seyya idhuve ore vazhi endru mathiya arasu kooruvadhu poy” ena vimarsithullaar.
Idharkup padhilalitha nidhiyamaichar, idhu thavaraana vadhandhi endrum, digital parivarthanai thalangalin paadhugaappai adhigarikkave ithagaiya seerdhiruthangal merkollappaduvadhaaga kooriyullaar.
Naadaalumandrathil niraivetrappattirukkum masodhaavai poruthavaraiyil, podhumakkalaal seyyappadum navar-navar panapparivarthanaigal, saalaiyora viyaavaarigal, siru vanigargal matrum pettik kadaikkaarargal idaiyeyaana panapparivarthanaigalukku kattanam vidhikkappadaadhu endrum, maaraaga aandukku 1 kodi roovaaykku mel parivarthanai seyyum peru vanigargal matrum niruvanam-niruvanam idaiye seyyappadum parivarthanaigalukku mattume kattanam vasoolikkappadum endru thagavalgal koorugindrana. Aanaalum maruvuram online thalam, vanigargalukku seyyappadum 2000 roovaaykku melaana digital parivarthanaigalukku 0.25% mudhal 0.4% varai MDR kattanam vasoolikkappadum endrum sollappadugiradhu.
Iruppinum naadaalumandrathin iru avaigalilum immasodhaa niraivetrappatta pinnare, idhuguritha muzhumaiyaana vazhigaattudhal Indhiya thesiya parivarthanaik kazhagathaal alikkappadum ena koorappattulladhu.
MDR enbadhu vanigar tharappuk kattanamaaga irundhaalum, idhu naaladaivil makkal meedhaana kattanamaaga vanigangal thinikkakkoodum ena anjasappadugiradhu. Makkal meedhaana indha thaakkam eppadi irukkappogiradhu enbadhu MDR vigidham matrum arasaangathaal nirnayikkappadum vidhigalai poruthe theriyavarum.

headline: India-vil thayaaraagum jam jam thanneer endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’India-vil kalappada muraiyil thayaaraagum jam jam thanneer’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’indha 5 liter jam jam thanneer ingu India-vil thayaaraagindrana…نعوذ بالله allaah paadhugaakka vendum…,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan pilaastik kengalil thanneer pidithu, kalandhu, pekking seyvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda oru video inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu vendumendre madhakkalavaram erpaduthum nokkil pagirappadum oru vadhandhi, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, kadandha 2017m aandu saudhi areviyaavil nigazhndha sambavam ondru thodarbaana video-vai eduthu, India-vil nadandhadhu pondru kurippittu, tharpodhu vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Musleem makkal, punidha neeraagak karudhum Zamzam water peyaril thozhitsaalai ondrai niruvi, adhil kalappada neerai kalandhu vitradhaaga, oruvar 2017m aandu saudhiyil kaidhu seyyappattaar. Andha video-vai eduthe, pudhiyadhuvondru tharpodhu parappugiraargal. Idhuvatri saudhi Police erkanave vilakkam alithu, X valaidhala pakkathil padhivu ondraiyum veliyittullanar.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video India-vil edukkappattadhu illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thattaanjjaavadiyil kalamgaanum asok aananth.. Ivarin pinnani enna theriyumaa?
text:
Pudhucheri thattaanjjaavadi thogudhikku idaitherdhal arivikkappattulla nilaiyil, therdhal arivippirku munbaagave en.aar.kaangiras katchi, thanadhu vetbaalaraaga asok aanandhai arivithirundhadhu. Needhimandra vazhakkaal thanadhu emele padhaviyai izhandhu, meendum pottiyidum indha asok aananth pinnani kurithu paarkkalaam.
Asok aanandhin thandhai aanandhan, pudhucheri podhuppanith thuraiyil 1997 mudhal 2006 varai poriyaalaraaga paniyaatriyavar. Mudhalvar rangasaamiyin nerungiya nanbaraaga ariyappatta ivar, podhuppanith thurai poriyaalaraaga paniyaatriya kaalakkattathil varumaanathirku adhigamaaga sothu serthadhaaga CBI vazhakkuppadhivu seythadhu. Indha vazhakkil avaradhu magan asok aanandhaiyum inaindhadhu. 2018-l indha vazhakkil iruvar meedhaana kutrachaattugalai pudhucheri keezhamai Needhimandram urudhi seythadhu.
Idhanaal, thanadhu emele padhaviyai izhandha asok aananth, Chennai uyar needhimandrathil melmuraiyeedu seythaar. Idhanai visaaritha uyar Needhimandram, iruvaraiyum vidudhalai seythu utharavittadhu. Idhaiyaduthu asok aanandhukku vidhikkappattirundha therdhal thadai neengiya nilaiyil, tharpodhu thattaanjjaavadi idaitherdhalil en.aar.kaangiras vetbaalaraaga kalamirangi ullaar. Rangasaami, 2011il en.aar. Congress katchiyai thodangiyavodhu, thattaanjjaavadi thogudhiyil asok aananth pottiyittu vetri petraar. 2016 sattamandra therdhalilum adhe thogudhiyil pottiyittu vendradhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Israel adhivar maganai viratti adikkum yoodhargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’Israel adhivar maganai viratti adikkum yoodhargal’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ Israel adhivar maganai viratti adikkum yoodhargal thevaiyillaamal Iran meedhu thaakkudhalai erpaduthi engalukku siramathai erpaduthi naangal indru thunbathil ullom endru solli adithu thuvaikkum kaatchi thaan ivai
innum sila naatkalil adhiraiyum adithu oda viduvaargal inshaa allaah,” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idharkum tharpodhaiya Iran – Israel porukkum endha thodarbum illai endru theriyavandhadhu. Athudan, indha video-vil iruppavargalil yaarum Israel adhivar magan kidaiyaadhu.
Mudhalil, Israel adhivar yaar endru paarkkalaam. Tharpodhu, annaattin adhivar padhaviyil Isaac Herzog ullaar. Aduthappadiyaaga, piradhamar padhaviyil Benjamin Netanyahu ullaar. Isrelaip poruthavarai, adhigaaram migundha padhavi endraal, adhu piradhamar padhavidhaan.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda padhivil, Iran meedhu por thodutha kaaranathaal adhirupdhi adaindha Israel adhivarin magan endru kurippiduvadhan moolamaaga, penjjamin nedhanyaagu maganai suttugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Adhesamayam, penjjamin nedhanyaagu, adhivaraa, piradhamaraa endra podhu arivu illaamaleye kurippitta vadhandhiyai palarum samooga valaidhalangalil parappuvadhu, vedhanai alippadhaaga ulladhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, ivargal pagirum video kadandha 2023m aandu edukkappatta ondru. 2023, akdovar 7 andru hamaas nadathiya thaakkudhalil, Israel podhumakkal 1200kkum merpattor paliyaaginar. 250kkum merpattor pinaikkaidhigalaaga pidithus sellappattanar. Indha thaakkudhalai thadukkath thavariya Israel arasai kandithu, paadhikkappattavargalin kudumbathinar annaattu naadaalumandrathai mutrugaiyittanar. Appodhu erpatta thallumullu thodarbaana kaatchigaldhaan ivai.
Times of Israel l Al Jazeera l NY Post
enave, 2023m aandu edukkappatta veroru sambavam thodarbaana video-vai pudhiyadhuvondru tharpodhu meendum samooga valaidhalangalil parappugiraargal endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

text:

headline: ``thamizhnaadu mudhalamaichar Vijay pola vendumendru vadanaattil engugiraargal"- amaichar sengottaiyan
text:
"indhi mozhi pesum maanilangalilgooda mudhalamaichar Vijay avargalin thaakkam ulladhu. Vadanaattilgooda Tamil Nadu mudhalamaicharaip pola oruvar mudhalamaicharaaga varavendum endru makkal engugiraargal"- amaichar sengottaiyan
Erode maavattam, kovisettivaalaiyam karattoor pagudhiyil ulla Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathin aluvalagathil arinjar annaavin 118- vadhu pirandhanaal vizhaa nigazhvil, varuvaaythurai matrum peridar melaanmaithurai amaichar sengottaiyan pangetraar. Annaavin uruvappadathirku malar thoovi mariyaadhai seluthi, podhumakkalukku inippugalai vazhanginaar. Thodarndhu seythiyaalargalais sandhitha amaichar sengottaiyan, ``thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathin thalaivar Vijay avargal melai naadugalukkus sendru, 11,000 kodi roobai alavukku Tamil Naattil thozhil thodanguvadharkaana mudhaleedugalai eerthullaar. Tamil Nadu indhiyaavileye mudhanmai maanilamaaga irukka vendum, anaivarukkum velaivaayppu kidaikka vendum,
adhe nerathil satta ozhungu peni kaakkappada vendum endra ennathudan, makkalin viruppangalai piradhivalikkakkoodiya mudhalamaicharaaga Vijay vilangugiraar. Anaithu maanilangalum avarai edhirbaarthu kondirukkindrana. Pira maanila makkalgooda Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar Vijay avargalaip pola mudhalamaichar kidaikka vendum endru pesugindranar. Indhi pesum maanilangalilgooda Vijay avargalin thaakkam adhigamaaga ulladhu enbadhai magizhchiyodu therivithuk kolgiren. Idaitherdhalil vetri enbadhu mudivu seyyappatta ondru. Adhe nerathil, vaakku vithiyaasam endha alavukkup pogiradhu enbadhaip poruthirundhudhaan paarkka vendum" endraar.

headline: U.pi., therdhalil Vijay bus!
text:
Uthara piradhesa sattasavai therdhal adutha aandu pipravari - -maars maadhangalil nadakka ulladhu. Naangu kattamaaga indha therdhal nadakka ulladhaaga sollappadugiradhu. Anaithu katchigalum erkenave therdhal velaigalaith thodangivittana.
Tharpodhu ingu mudhalvar yogi aadhithyanaath thalaimaiyilaana paa.ja., aatchi nadakkiradhu. Mukkiya edhirkkatchiyaana samaajvaadhi katchiyin thalaivar agilesh yaadhav therdhal pirasaarathirkaaga oru sigappu nira passai thayaar seythullaar. Moondru araigal, kaanbirans haal, taaylet ena pala naveena vasadhigalaik konda indha passil kooraiyil irundhavadiye pirasaaram seyya mudiyum.
Karoor therdhal pirasaarathil Vijay-kku vadivamaithavardhaan agilesh yaadhavirku indha passai thayaar seythullaar. Mudhal bus u.pi., sendradaindhuvittadhu. Matra irandu pasgal thayaaraagikkondirukkindrana.
Indha passin mun pakkathil ore oru padam idam perum. Adhu agilesha yaadhavin padamdhaan. Koottanikkatchiyaana kaangirasin endha padamum kidaiyaadhaam. Avvalavu en… samaajvaadhi katchiyai thodangiya agileshin appaa mulaayam singin padam kooda idam peraadhaam.
Indha bus migavum periyadhu enbadhaal kiraamangalin siriya therukkalil selvadhu kurippaaga thirumbuvadhu kadinam engindranar. Innoru pakkam moondraavadhu muraiyaaga aatchiyaip pidikka yogi aadhithyanaath oru siriya venai pirasaarathirkaaga erpaadu seythullaar.
'agileshin vaaganam panakkaarargal payanam seyyakkoodiyadhu… ezhaigal pirayaanam seyyum vandi ennidam ulladhu… potti… ezhaikkum panakkaararukkum' engiraaraam mudhalvar yogi aadhithyanaath.
Edhu eppadiyo…. Thamizhaga sinimaa paani therdhal pirasaaram ippodhu vada indhiyaavilum parava aarambithuvittadhu.
En thamizhagathirku idamillai?
Sinimaavai thanikkai seyyum mathiya sensaar pordu uruppinargal pattiyalai mathiya arasu sameevathil veliyittadhu. Vada indhiyaavais serndha nadigai pireethi jindhaa, nadigargal sunil shetti, pangaj thirivaadhi utbada 18 per uruppinargalaaga niyamikkappattullanar. Malaiyaala iyakkunar piriyadharshan, isaiyamaippaalar rikki kej, thelungu sinimaa thayaarippaalar supriyaa yaarlagattaa aagiyorum indha kuzhuvil ullanar.
Indha 18 per konda kuzhu sensaar pordu thalaivar sasi segar vembadhi thalaimaiyil seyalbadum. Indhiya sinimaa ena eduthukkondaal adhil adhiga alavil sinimaakkal thamizhagathildhaan edukkappadugindrana. Idhanaal kandippaaga Thamizhaga thiraippadath thuraiyilirundhu oruvar angathinaaraaga niyamikkappattirukka vendum.
Aanaal oru thamizhar kooda mathiya sensaar pordil uruppinaraaga niyamikkappadavillai. Indha kuzhuvai niyamippadhu mathiya arasin thagaval matrum olivarapputhurai. Idhan inai amaichar namma oorais serndha el.murugan. Ivar padhaviyil irukkum podhe thamizhagathirku indha kuzhuvil idam illaamal ponadhu varuthamaana vishayam ena tilli thamizhargal vattaarangalil pesappadugiradhu.
Sinimaa heero Thamizhaga mudhalvaraaga irukkum podhu en sensaar pordil thamizhagam odhukkappadugiradhu enavum kelvigal ezhuppappadugindrana.
En odhungugindranar?
India muzhudhum vinaayagar sadhurthi vimarsaiyaagak kondaadappattadhu. Mahaaraashdiraavil indha pandigai piravalam. Ovvoru pagudhiyilum vinaayagar silaigal periya alavil niruvappattu poojaigal nadakkum. Idhil katchi paaguvaadindri arasiyal thalaivargal pangerpar.
Mumbaiyil mudhalvar thevendhira patnavis indha kondaattathil pangetru vinaayagarukku poojai seythaar. Matra arasiyal katchigalin thalaivargalum vevveru idangalil pangetranar.
Tilliyilum pala idangalil vinaayagar silaigal amaikkappattana. Thunai janaadhivadhi si.pi.raadhaagirushnan, mahaaraashdira kavarnaraaga munnar padhavi vagithaar. Enave tilliyil mahaaraashdira arasin virundhinar maaligaiyil nadandha vinaayagar sadhurthi vizhaavil pangetru poojai seythaar.
Mahaaraashdiraavais serndha mathiya amaichar peeyoosh koyalin veettilum vinaayagar sadhurthi kondaattangal nadandhana. Idhil thunai janaadhivadhiyudan piradhamar modiyum pangetraar.
Vinaayagar sadhurthi pola navaraathiri nerathil merku vangathil thurkkai poojai piravalam. Tilliyil pengaaligal adhigam vasikkum sitharanjjan paark pagudhiyil thurkkai silaigal vaithu periya pandhal amaithu kondaaduvar.
Anaithu katchi thalaivargalum indha kondaattangalil pangetraalum soniyaa, raagul matrum piriyangaa aagiyor indha irandu vizhaakkalilum eppodhume pangerpadhillai. Pala aandugalaaga ivargal indha pandigaigalai odhukki vandhaalum tharpodhu soniyaa kudumbam pangerkaadhadhu pesu porulaagi varugiradhu.
Kalakkathil mathiya amaichargal!
Immaadham 23, 24 thedhigalil tilliyil sindhanai amarvu enappadum, 'sindhan sivir' engira aalosanaik koottathai koottiyullaar piradhamar Modi anaithu mathiya amaichargalum idhil pangerpar.
Moondraam muraiyaaga Modi piradhamaraagi irandarai aandugal mudindhuvitta nilaiyil, amaichagangalin seyalbaadugal kurithu indha koottathil vivaadhikkappadum. Suya munnetram, makkaludan thodarbu, nirvaagam aagiyavai kurithu ingu alasappadum.
Amaichargalin seyalbaadugal, edhirgaala thittangal, amaichagangalidaiye orunginaippu ena pala vishayangal kurithu piradhamar pesuvaar. Palliyil maanavargalukku kodukkappadum maark adangiya, 'progaras ripport' pola amaichargalin ripportkal piradhamarukku alikkappadum.
Indha aalosanaik koottam amaichargalidaiye perum kalakkathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Mathiya amaicharavai maatram ena kadandha 6 maadhangalaaga seythigal adivattum idhuvarai edhuvum nadakkavillai. Indha aalosanaik koottathirku piragu amaicharavai maatrappadalaam ena amaichargalidaiye pesappadugiradhu. Pala amaichargal thangal padhavi parivogumo engira achathil ullanar.
Amaicharavai maatram nadakkumaa nadakkaadhaa enbadhu iruvarukku mattume theriyum. Oruvar piradhamar, matravar amith shaa engindranar paa.ja.,vinar.

headline: ‘Vijay pesiyadhu arasiyal arivinmaiyin velippaadu’ endru rangasaami kandanam therivithaaraa?
text:
‘‘Vijay pesiyadhu arasiyal arivinmaiyin velippaadu,’’ endru rangasaami kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ pudhucheriyil thambi Vijay pesiyadhu arasiyal arivinmaiyin velivaadudhaan avarukku sariyaana vazhigaatti illai, melum ngal maanilathai naangal paarthukkolgirom
ungal arasiyal naadagathai thamizhnaattodu vaithugollungal.- pudhucheri mudhalamaichar N.rangasaami’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil naam pudhucheri mudhalamaichar rangasaami aluvalagathai thodarbugondu kettom. Appodhu, ‘’idhuvondru endha karuthum mudhalamaichar rangasaami kooravillai. Avar oodagangalukku alitha pettiyai thavaraaga thirithu parappugindranar,’’ endru vilakkam tharappattadhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, sameevathil Vijay pudhucheri sendru vandha piragu, ammaanila mudhalamaichar rangasaami pesiyadhaaga, oodagangalil velivandha seythiyai kandom.
Idhanbadi, Vijay-in pudhucheri podhukkoottam thodarbaaga seythiyaalargal kettadharku, ‘’nandri, vanakkam, vaazhthugal,’’ endrudhaan rangasaami karuthu kooriyullaar.
Puthiyathalaimurai TV l News18 Tamil l Thanthi TV
idhanmoolamaaga, rangasaami pesaadha ondrai avaradhu peyaril pagirndhu samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kuzhandhaigaludan vandha petrorukku avaraadham vidhikkum Police endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:
‘’kuzhandhaigaludan vandha petrorukku avaraadham vidhikkum Police,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kolai, kollai, paaliyal kutram seybavan, kallachaaraayam kaaychivavanai ellaam indha kaavaldhurai vittududhu, kuzhandhaiyai enga poyi vittuttu ponum saar…
idhe kelviyai adhigaarathil irukkum evanidamaavadhu ketkumaa indha kaaval thurai…
kuzhandhaiyai azha vaithu petrorgalai avamaanam seyvadhu thaan kaaval thuraiyin paniyaa? 😡😡😡,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhudhodarbaaga, Cuddalore District Police tharappil erkanave maruppu therivikkappattulladhaik kandom.
Idhanberil koodudhal thagaval thediyavodhu, kadandha 2019m aandu ichambavam nadandhadhaagak koori Cuddalore District Police saarbaaga, meendum oru vilakkam tharappattulladhaiyum kandom.
Idhanbadi, kadandha 2019m aandu pongal pandigaiyinbodhu, sidhambaram nagaril iru sakkara vaaganam ondril, kanavan, manaivi matrum 2 kuzhandhaigal sagidhamaaga, kadaikkup porul vaanga vandha oru kudumbathinarai, sidhambaram nagara Police thaduthu niruthi, vazhakkup padhivu seythanar. Idhuvatriya video appodhe samooga valaidhalangalil paraviyadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, sambandhappatta Police paniyidamaatram seyyappattanar. Appodhu, Tamil Naattil ADMK aalungatchiyaaga irundhadhu.
Vikatan l Minnambalam l Oneindia Tamil
enave, 2019m aandu nigazhndha oru sambavam thodarbaana video-vai eduthu, tharpodhaiya DMK aatchiyudan thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Savarimalaiyil 56 pavun thanga kireedam maayamaa?
text:
Savarimalai, sep. 25 –-
savarimalaiyil paadhugaappu araiyil vaikkappattirundha 56 pavun thanga kireedam maayamaanadhaaga veliyaana thagavalai thiruvidhaangoor thevasvam pordu maruthulladhu.
Savarimalai ayyappan kovil sannidhaanam mun ulla thuvaara paalagar silaiyil irundha thangam kollaiyadikkappattadhu thodarbaana vazhakku visaaranai nadandhu varugiradhu. Idhil, thevasvam pordu munnaal thalaivargal vaasu, pathmagumaar, pirasaanth, munnaal nirvaaga adhigaarigal ullittor kaidhu seyyappattu jaaminil ullanar.
Idharkidaiyil savarimalai paadhugaappu araiyil irundha 56 pavun edai udaiya thanga kireedam maayamaanadhaaga seythigal veliyaanadhu. Mandala magara vilakku seesan thodanga ulla nilaiyil indha thagaval adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu.
Idhu kurithu thevasvam pordu thalaivar ke.jeyakkumaar niruvargalidam netru kooriyadhaavadhu:
savarimalai thanga aavaranangalai vaippadharkaaga savarimalaiyilum aaranmulaa paarthasaaradhi koyililum irandu paadhugaappu araigal ullana. Savarimalaiyil ulla paadhugaappu araiyil sila panigal nadandha podhu angu irundha kireedam matrum nagaigal idam maatri vaikkappattadhu.
Indha nerathil thaan kireedathai kaanavillai endru thagaval paraviyadhu. Aanaal andha kireedam savarimalai paadhugaappu araiyileye idam maatri vaikkappattu irundhadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga thiruvaavaranam aanaiyar harilaal thevasvam pordukku arikkai thaakkal seythullaar. Avaradhu arikkaiyin meedhu thevasvam pordukku nambikkai ulladhu.
Kaanaamal ponadhaaga koorappatta thanga kireedathai, thamizhagathais serndha vaithiyanaadha suvaamigal 2012-l kaanikkaiyaaga vazhanginaar.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar

headline: Vijay tharam thaazhndhavar endru M.K. Stalin vimarsithaaraa?
text:
‘’Vijay tharam thaazhndhavar endru M.K. Stalin vimarsanam,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’thaan nallaatchi nadathi varuvadhaagavum Vijay tharam thaazhndhavar endrum Stalin vimarsanam’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu oru edit seyyappatta video endru theriyavandhadhu. Muzhu video lingk MK Stalin adhigaarappoorva X valaidhalathil kaana kidaikkiradhu.
Kadandha aagast 11, 2025 andru pagirappattulla indha video-vil, ‘nallaatchi nadathum ennai, mudhalamaichar engira poruppukku mariyaadhai tharaamal, tharam thaazhndhu, ennai orumaiyil pesi varugindraar edhirkkatchith thalaivar,’ endru Edappadi pazhanisaamiyai kurippitte M.K. Stalin pesugiraar. Endha idathilum Vijay peyar idamberavillai.
Aagast 11, 2025 andru M.K. Stalin thiruppooril palveru nalathittangal thodangi vaithu, pesiyavodhu edutha veediyodhaan idhu. Aanaal, Vijay Maduraiyil maanaadu nadathiyadhu aagast 25, 2025 andru. Enave, M.K. Stalin pesum indha veediyovukkum, vijaykkum endha thodarbum illai, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
The Hindu l Thanthi TV l Dinamalar
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video edit seyyappatta ondru, nambagamaanadhu illai endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Arthamillaadha tharkolai sambavam thadukkappada vendum es.el.si.es., karutharangil vizhippunarvu
text:
Madurai: arthamillaadha tharkolai sambavangal thadukkappada vendum ena Madurai suppalatchumi latchumivadhi ariviyal kallooriyil nadandha ulagath tharkolai thaduppu thina vizhippunarvu karutharangil Madurai aaliyaa maintbulnas sendar niruvanarum, mananala aalosagarumaana kaayathri magadhi therivithaar.
Ikkalloori maanavar mandram saarbil nadandha nigazhchiyil avar pesiyadhaavadhu:
tharkolai enbadhu unarvu, ulaviyal nalanudan thodarbudaiyadhu. 'jen si' enappadum ilam thalaimuraiyinarin panbugal, avargal edhirgollum savaalgal adippadaiyil adhigalavu tharkolaikku thoondum thaakkangal erpadugindrana. Kurippaaga soshiyal meediyaakkalil thavaraana 'aidi'kal maanavargal mananalanai paadhikkum vagaiyil parappappadugindrana. Athagaiya 'aidi'kalai maanavargal pinbatravo, kiriyet seyyavo koodaadhu. Vaniga reedhiyaaga inbuluyansargal palar palveru thavaraana thagavalgalai, karuthukkalai soshiyal meediyaakkalil parappugindranar. Adhai nambakkoodaadhu.
Adhil erpadum tholvigal tharkolai mudivukku kondusellum. Nam samoogam uyariya nokkam kondadhu. Ilam thalaimuraiyinarai kadansumai, kudumba soozhal ullitta palveru kaaranangal tharkolaikku thoondugindrana. Avai perumbaalum arthamillaadha kaaranangalaaga ullana. Idhugurithu vizhippunarvu erpadutha vendum endraar. Peraasiriyargal, maanavargal pangetranar.

headline: IIT mumbai maanavar uyirizhappu.. Peraasiriyarukku nerukkadi? 10 per kuzhu amaippu!
text:
Mumbai aiaidi maanavar thervinbodhu selbon matrum ChatGPT payanbaduthiyadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundha pinnar, aalosanai vazhangappattu, ozhungu nadavadikkai edhuvum edukkappadavillai ena nirvaagam koorugiradhu. Aanaal maanavar vidudhi araiyil uyirizhandha nilaiyil kanduvidikkappattadhaal, saadhip paaguvaadu, azhutham, idaineekkam achuruthal kuritha pugaarudan petror, maanavargal poraattathil eeduvattanar.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
mumbai aiaidi valaagathil, enarji sayins andu injineeyaring (Department of Energy Science and Engineering) thuraiyil irandaam aandu padithuvandha saahil vagode endra maanavar, thervinbodhu selbonai payanbaduthiyadhaagavum, thervu vinaathaalai ChatGPT-l padhivetri adharkaana padhilgalai pera muyandradhaagavum IIT mumbai nirvaagam therivithirundhadhu. Indha vivagaaram kurithu maanavaridam thervuk kangaanippaalar matrum thuraith thalaivar pesiyadhaagavum, avarukku aalosanai vazhangiyadhudan, indha sambavam avaradhu kalvi vaazhkkaiyaip paadhikkaadhu ena urudhiyalithadhaagavum nirvaagam kooriyirundhadhu. Melum, maanavar meedhu endha ozhungu nadavadikkaiyum edukkappadavillai endrum koorappadugiradhu.
Indhas sandhippukkup piragu maanavar thanadhu vidudhi araikkuth thirumbiyullaar. Pinnar avaradhu araiyil avar uyirizhandha nilaiyil kandedukkappattaar. Idhaiyaduthu maanavargal poraattathil eeduvattanar.
Avar meedhu or aandu idaineekkam ullitta kadumaiyaana nadavadikkai edukkappadalaam ena achuruthappattadhaaga poraattathil eeduvatta maanavargal kutramsaattiyirundhanar. Adhan kaaranamaaga, padippu kaalam neelum vaayppum irundhadhaaga avargal therivithanar. Eninum, indhak kutrachaattugal urudhi seyyappadavillai.
Innilaiyil uyirizhandha maanavarin petror, kalloori valaagathil saadhip paaguvaadu matrum palveru azhuthangalai thangal magan edhirgondadhaagavum idhaiyaduthu, padippai muditha piragu edhirgaalam sirappaaga irukkum endrum, porumaiyaaga irukkumaarum petror avarukku arivuruthiyadhaagavum avargal therivithirundhanar. Petrorin pugaarin adippadaiyil vazhakkuppadhivu seyyappattirunthadhu.
Idhu thodarbaana visaaranai theeviramadaindhulladhu. Mumbai kutrappirivu erkanave saahilin petror matrum avarudan thervu araiyil irundha maanavargal, vidudhiyil avarudan thodarbil irundhavargal ullittoridam vaakkumoolam petrulladhu. Melum, IIT paambe peraasiriyargal matrum pira aasiriyargalidamum visaaranai nadathappada ulladhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Melum maanavarin maranathirku thoondudhalaaga irundhadhaaga kudumbathinar kutramsaattiyulla peraasiriyar sooryanaaraayan toollaavai, mumbai kutrappirivu indru visaaranaikku azhaithulladhu.
Idharkidaiyil, IIT paambe peraasiriyar toollaavai viduppil anuppiyulladhu kalloori nirvaagam. Maanavarin maranam thodarbaana soozhnilaigalai visaarikka 10 per konda uyarmattak kuzhuvaiyum kalvi niruvanam amaithulladhu. Indhak kuzhu oru vaarathirkul arikkai samarppikka utharavidappattulladhu. Peraasiriyar ramesh vengadesvaran thalaimaiyil amaikkappatta kuzhuvil IIT paambe peraasiriyargal, maanavar piradhinidhigal, oyvuvetra adhigaari ullittor idambetrullanar. Maanavargal munvaitha korikkaigalil perumbaalaanavai erkappattulladhaagavum, sambandhappatta adhigaarigalin raajinaamaa korikkai mattum erkappadavillai endrum koorappadugiradhu.
Melum saahil payanbaduthiya laak seyyappatta iPhone-ai thozhilnutba udhaviyudan kutrappirivu aayvu seythu varugiradhu. Adhilirundhu thagavalgalai meetkum muyatsiyil, avaradhu ChatGPT payanbaattu varalaarum visaaranaikku utbaduthappattulladhu. Idhanmoolam tharpodhu munvaikkappattulla kutrachaattugalai sarivaarthu, sambavangalukku idaiyilaana thodarchiyai kandariya adhigaarigal muyatsithu varugindranar.

headline: Rayilil movailbon thirudiya yoodiyoovar kaidhu
text:
Trichy: rayilil movailbon thirudiya 'yoodiyoovar' saadhikbaatshaa, 41, enbavarai, Police kaidhu seythanar.
Thoothukudi maavattam, koottaambuliyais serndhavar arpudharaaj, 20. Ivar, Chennai-yil than uravinar thirumanathukku sendruvittu, netru mundhinam iravu, andhiyodhayaa rayilil oorukku thirumbinaar.
Nalliravu than movailbonai rayilil saarj pottu vittu, arpudharaaj thoongi vittaar. Trichy aruge ezhundhu paarthavodhu, movailbon kaanaamal poyirundhadhu.
Arpudharaaj, Trichy railway poleesil pugaar alithaar. Police vazhakku padhindhu, visaarithanar. Adhil, thiruvaaroor maavattam, mannaargudiyais serndha yoodiyoovar saadhikbaatshaa enbavar, movail ponai thirudiyadhu therindhadhu. Police avarai kaidhu seythu, movailbonai parimudhal seythanar.

headline: Nevaala thuyarathai pola keralaavilum : mazhaiye peyyaamal vandha vellam... Velivandha adhirchi pinnani !
text:
Keralaa malappuram kottappuzhaa aatril, mazhai illaadha nilaiyil thideerena vellapperukku erpattu sutrulaa payanigal utbada palar sikkinar. Vanathurai, meetbuppadai inaindhu kayiru moolam palarai meettaalum, oru pen utbada 6 per uyirizhandhanar. Neelagiri appar pavaani pagudhiyil peytha perumazhai kaaranamaaga vandha vellam idharku kaaranam ena adhigaarigal vilakkam alithullanar.
Keralaavin malappuram maavattathil kottappuzhaa aaru odi varugiradhu. Ulloor makkal indha aatrai pookkottumbaadam aaru endrum azhaithu varugindranar. Indha aatril kurukke ti.ke. Kaalani endra pagudhiyil thaduppanai ondrum amaindhulladhu.
Iyarkai ezhil konjjum pagudhiyaana ingu eraalamaana sutrulaa payanigalum varugai tharuvar. Indha aatril kadandha njaayiru andru ulloor makkalum sutrulaa payanigalum kulithukkondirundhullanar. Appodhu thideerena aatrin neervarathu pala madangu adhigarithu vellapperukku erpattulladhu.
Aatruneerin alavu adhigarippadhai unarndha vanathuraiyinar udanadiyaaga makkalai angirundhu veliyerumaaru arivurutha palar angirundhu udanadiyaaga veliyeriyullanar. Eninum sumaar 27 per aatru vellathil sikki angirundha paaraiyil eriyullanar. Avargalai vanathuraiyinarum meetbu padaiyinarum kayirugal moolam meettanar.
Eninum indha vellathil adithuchellappatta oru pen utbada 6 per paridhaavamaaga uyirizhandhanar. Andha pagudhiyil mazhaiye peyyaadha nilaiyil, thideerena ivvalavu periya vellam vandhu uyirizhappai erpaduthiyulladhu perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Kadandha maadham nevaalathilum ippadi mazhaiye peyyaadha nilaiyil, panippaarai udaippaal peruvellam erpattu, aayirathukkum adhigamaanor uyirizhandhanar. Adhe pondra matroru iyarkai nigazhvaal indha keralaa vellam erpattulladhaaga vanathurai adhigaarigal kooriyullanar.
Kottappuzhaa aaru Tamil Naattin neelagiri maavattathil ulla appar pavaani neerthekkap pagudhiyil uruvaagi keralaavirkul paaygiradhu. Adarndha vanappagudhigalai konda indha neelagiri pagudhiyil peytha perumazhai kaaranamaaga angirundhu uruvaana vellam kottappuzhaa aaru vazhiyaaga paayndhu mazhaiye peyyaadha ti.ke. Kaalani perum paadhippai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Indha kottappuzhaa aatril idharku munnar palamurai ippadi mazhaiye peyyaadha nilaiyilum peruvellam erpattu uyirizhappugalai erpaduthiyulladhaaga ulloor makkal kooriyullanar. Idhanaal theriyaadha idangalukku sutrulaa sellumbodhu kavanamaaga irukka vendum enbadhaiye indha nigazhvu unarthiyulladhu.

headline: Vijay-ai paarkka Salem maanaattirku anivagutha vaaganangal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘Vijay-ai paarkka Salem maanaattirku anivagutha vaaganangal,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ namba #ThalapathyVijay avargalai paarppadharku Salem maanaattirku anivagutha vaaganangalin kaanoli 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥#ᴛʜᴀʟᴀᴘᴀᴛʜʏᴠɪᴊᴀʏ,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan vaaganangal anivaguthus sellum kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.

investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu raajasdhaan maanilathil edukkappatta video endrum, idharkum selathil nadaivetra TVK, maanaattirkum endha thodarbum illai endrum theriyavandhadhu.
Koogul rivars thedal seythavodhu, kadandha janavari 14 aam thedhi indha video Nirmal Choaudhary endra instaagiraam pakkathil mudhalmuraiyaaga pagirappattulladhu, ena theriyavandhadhu. Raajasdhaanin thorimannaa pagudhiyil merkanda video edukkappattadhaagavum andha padhivil koorappattulladhu.
Melum, Nirmal Choaudhary enbavar raajasdhaan palgalaikkazhagathin maanavar sangath thalaivar aavaar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, TVK, thalaimai aluvalagathil kettavodhu, ‘’idhuvondra vaagana anivaguppu edhuvum naangal selathil nadathavillai,’’ endru koorinar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda veediyovukkum, TVK, maanaattukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ’ennai mannithuvidungal keerthanaa’ –amaichar keerthanaavin aavaresan kurithu kanimozhi
text:
"en anbu thangai amaichar keerthanaa aruvai sigichaikkup piragu maruthuvargal 20 naatkal oyvu edukka arivuruthiya nilaiyilum, 4 naatkalileye meendum makkal panikkuth thirumbinaar" - kanimozhi
Kovai kavundambaalaiyam thogudhi TVK sattamandra uruppinar kanimozhi sandhosh veliyittulla arikkaiyil, “oru pennaagavum, oru sagodhariyaagavum idhai neril paarthadhaal solgiren. En anbu thangai amaichar keerthanaa aruvai sigichaikkup piragu maruthuvargal 20 naatkal oyvu edukka arivuruthiya nilaiyilum, 4 naatkalileye meendum makkal panikkuth thirumbinaar.
Maruthuvamanai padukkaiyil irundhavodhum, mudhalamaicharin landan payanathirkaana erpaadugal sariyaaga nadaiverugiradhaa enbadhildhaan avaradhu kavanam irundhadhu. Aanaal, avar sila naatkal panikku varaadhadhaip patri pesumbodhu, avaradhu udalnilai, kaayam kurithu sindhikkaamal adhai maadhavidaayudan thodarbuvaduthum pirpokkuthanamaana sindhanai vedhanai alikkiradhu.
Pengal avargalin udal suzhatsiyaal mattum varaiyarukkappaduvavargal alla. Naangal thalaivargal, thozhil vallunargal, thaaygal, magalgal. Vali, noy, kaayam ena anaithaiyum kadandhu kadamaiyaith thodarndhu seybavargal.
Oru pennin paniyai vimarsikka mudiyaadhavodhu, avaradhu udalaip patri pesuvadhu arasiyal vimarsanam alla; adhu pirpokkuthanamaana mananilaiyin velippaadu. Pengalai avargalin saadhanaigalukkaaga madhippom. Avargalin udalai arasiyal kelikkuriya porulaaga maatruvadhai niruthuvom.
Pengal idhaivida sirandha mariyaadhaikku uriyavargal. Thamizhnaadum idhaivida sirandha arasiyal panbaattukku uriyadhu. Ennai mannithuvidungal keerthanaa. Idhai ragasiyamaaga vaithirukkave neengal virumbineergal endru enakkuth theriyum. Aanaal, ungal arppanippai paartha oru sagodhariyaaga idhai solla vendiya kadamai enakku ulladhu” enath therivithullaar.

headline: Iran thaakkudhalukku payandhu isreliya raanuva veerargal padhungu kuzhigalil thanjjam pugundhanaraa?
text:
Iran evuganaith thaakkudhalukkup payandhu isreliya raanuva adhigaarigal matrum veerargal padhungu kuzhigalil thanjjam adaindhullanar endru oru video

isreliya raanuva veerargal amaidhiyaaga paadal paadi vazhivaadu seyvadhu pondra video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “eeraaniya evuganaigalukku payandhu isreliya adhigaarigalum veerargalum padhungu kuzhigalil thanjjam pugundhullanar!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran-in evuganaith thaakkudhalukku payandhu Israel raanuva adhigaarigal matrum veerargal padhungu kuzhigalil thanjjamadaindhullanar endru video ondrai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vai paarkkum podhu edho paadal olikkiradhu. Anaivarum sogamaaga ullanar. Unmaiyil avargal padhungu kuzhiyil padhungiyirundhaal adhai video-vaaga eduthu veliyida vaayppillai. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2024m aandu me maadhathilirundhu indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Enave, indha veediyovukkum tharpodhu Israel – Iran modhalukkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
2024 me 13m thedhi veliyaana andha padhivil indha yom haasigaron (Yom HaZikaron)-l veerargal ondru serthu uyirizhandhavargalukkaaga When the heart cries endra paadalai paadinar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Yom haasigaron endraal enna endru paartha podhu Israel-il uyirthiyaagam seytha veerargalukkaana ninaivu thinam endru theriyavandhadhu. Andha thinam ovvoru aandum thedhi maari varuvadhum therindhadhu. 2024m aandil me 12 maalai mudhal anusarikkappattu vandhiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu Memorial Day endru kurippittu silar 2024 me maadham indha video-vai YouTube, instaagiraam, Facebook, X thalam ena pala samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha video 2025 joon maadham Iran nadathiya evuganaith thaakkudhalukkup payandhu isreliya raanuvathinar padhungu kuzhigalil padhunginar endru paravum video padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

investigation_details:

headline: 20 aandukku mun thodarappatta vazhakku: arasu adhigaariyai viduvithadhu supreem Court
text:
Pudhudilli: lanjja vazhakkil, 20 aandugalukku mun kutranjjaattappatta railway paadhugaappup padaiyin munnaal adhigaarikku edhiraana CBI, visaaranaiyil ulla theevira kuraippaadugalaiyum avasara pokkaiyum suttikkaattiya ucha Needhimandram avarai viduvithu utharavittadhu.
Keralaavil, 2005m aandu railway paadhugaappup padaiyin paalakkaadu mandalathil paadhugaappu kamishanaraaga paarath raaj meenaa enbavar paniyaatrinaar. Appodhu, keezhnilai oozhiyargalin idamaatram matrum padhavi uyarvukkaaga avargalidam irundhu idaitharagargal moolam lanjjam petradhaaga pugaar ezhundhadhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga, idaitharagaraaga lanjja panam petra kaavalar anandha naaraayanan enbavarai CBI, adhigaarigal kaidhu seythanar. Paarath raaj meenaavidam neradiyaaga panam edhuvum CBI, adhigaarigal kaippatraadhadhaal, appodhu avarai kaidhu seyyavillai. Eninum, avar meedhu CBI, Police, vazhakkuppadhivu seythadhudan, kutrappathirigaiyum thaakkal seythanar.
Indha vazhakkai visaaritha, keralaavin ernaagulam CBI, sirappu Needhimandram, 2016l paarath raaj meenaavukku irandu aandu siraith thandanaiyum, 1 latcham roobai avaraadhamum vidhithu utharavittadhu. Indha utharavai edhirthu, kerala uyar needhimandrathil avar melmuraiyeedu seythaar. Indha manuvai visaaritha kerala uyar Needhimandram, 2024l sirappu needhimandrathin theerppai urudhiseythadhu.
Idhai edhirthu, paarath raaj meenaa, ucha needhimandrathil mel muraiyeedu seythaar. Indha vazhakku ucha needhimandra needhivadhigal thivangar thathaa, kodeesvara sing amarvu visaaranai nadathiyadhu. Anaithu tharappu vaadhangalum niraivadaindha nilaiyil, sameevathil amarvu alitha theerppu:
idaitharagaraaga seyalbatta oru kaavalar panam vaangum podhu si.pi.ai.,yidam pidivattaar. Aanaal, andhap panam paarath raaj meenaavukkuthaan sendradhu enbadhaiyo alladhu avardhaan lanjjam kettaar enbadhaiyo si.pi.ai.,yaal urudhiyaana aadhaarangaludan niroovikka mudiyavillai.
Idhu, oru theeviramaana kuraivaadu; CBI, merkonda visaaranaiyil kaattappatta avasarathanmai, manudhaararukku saadhagamaaga amaigiradhu. Verum sandhegathin adippadaiyil oruvarukku thandanai vazhanga mudiyaadhu. Enave, avarukku keezh needhimandrangalaal alikkappatta thandanaigal muzhudhum rathu seythu, paarath raaj meenaavai ivvazhakkil irundhu viduvikkirom.
Ivvaaru adhil kurippidappattulladhu.

headline: Thesiya kodiyai thalaigeezhaagap pidithirundhaaraa BJP thalaivar nidhin navin?
text:
BJP thesiya thalaivar nidhin navin, thesiya kodiyai thalaigeezhaaga pidithirundhadhaaga oru pugaippadam

BJP thesiya thalaivar nidhin naveen Indhiya thesiyak kodiyai thalaigeezhaaga pidithavadi irukkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paajagavin thesiya thalaivar eppadi vendum endraalum thesiya kodiyai thalaigeezhaaga pidikkalaam en endraal unmaiyil Indhiya thesathin meedhu akkarai illaadhavargal enbadhu thaan unmai
idhaiyaiye oru muslim thalaivaro alladhu oru muslim seythu irundhaal enna solvaargal sangiligal?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
BJP thesiya thalaivar nidhin navin Indhiya thesiyak kodiyai thalaigeezhaaga pidithirundhadhaagap palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Oru katchiyin thesiya thalaivaraaga iruppavarukkuk kooda thesiya kodi eppadik kattappada vendum endru theriyavillai enbadhu pola palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, pugaippadathaip paarkka edit seyyappattadhu pola therindhadhu. Enave, indha pugaippadathai aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathaik koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu, unmaiyaana pugaippadam namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil thesiyak kodi sariyaana muraiyil kattappattirundhadhu. Oodagangalil idhu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythigalaip paarthom. Aagast 13m thedhi veliyaagi irundha seythigalil sudhandhira thinathaiyotti thannudaiya veettin meedhu thesiya kodiyai parakkavitta nidhin navin endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha nigazhvin video-vai thedinom. Nidhin navine thannudaiya X thala pakkathil adhai veliyittirundhaar. Adhilum thesiyak kodi sariyaagak kattappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu, thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Indhiyaavidam petra kadan.. Muzhumaiyaaga adaitha maalatheevu.. Adutha sikkal enna?
text:
Kadumaiyaana porulaadhaara nerukkadikku mathiyilum indhiyaavidam irundhu petra sumaar ₹1,250 kodikkum adhigamaana kadanai maalatheevu arasu muzhumaiyaagath thiruppis seluthiyulladhu. Aanaal kadandha 5 aandugalil adharkaaga aana vattith thogaiyai Indhiya arase etrukkondadhu.
Maalatheevu adhivaraana mugamadhu muysu, poruppetra naal mudhal seenaavirku nerukkamaagas seyalbada aarambithaar. Idhanaal, irunaadugalukkum idaiyilaana uravu kadumaiyaagap paadhikkappattadhu. Iruppinum, 2024il adhivar muysu indhiyaavirku varugai thandhaviragu, iru uravugalum seeraanadhu. Indha nilaiyil, kadandha 2019aam aandu esbiai vangi maalatheevil karuvoolap pathirangalai vaangiyadhan moolam 150 milliyan taalar (sumaar ₹1,250 kodikkum adhigam) kadan vazhangappattadhu. Ikkadan seluthum kedu motham 6 murai neettikkappattadhu. Ikkadanin asalai tharpodhu maalatheevu arasu seluthiyulladhu.
Janavari 2024-il mudharkattamaagavum, me 2026-il irandaam kattamaagavum, tharpodhu irudhith thavanaiyaaga $50 milliyanum seluthappattu kadan muzhumaiyaaga mudivukku vandhulladhu. Aanaal kadandha 5 aandugalil adharkaaga aana vattith thogaiyai Indhiya arase etrukkondadhu. Idharkaaga India seluthiya vattith thogai mattum sumaar 45 milliyan taalar aagum.
Adhenerathil, indha irudhith thogaiyais seluthiyadhaal, maalatheevin anniyas selaavani kaiyiruppu $600 milliyanukkum keezhe kuraindhulladhu. Aagast maadha irudhiyil maalatheevu panaviyal aanaiyathin tharavuppadi, annaattin anniyas selaavani kaiyiruppu 643.8 milliyan taalaraaga irundhadhu kurippidathakkadhu. Maruvuram, ikkadan adaikkappatta piragum, maalatheevin motha velinaattuk kadan sumaar $3.59 pilliyanaaga ulladhu.
Idhil seenaavukkus selutha vendiya kadangal matrum paaradha stet vangikku (SBI) 2029-30 varai kaalavaraiyarai konda $350 milliyan pathirangalum (Treasury Bonds) adangum. Innoru puram, maalatheevin kaiyiruppu kuraindhulladhaal avasara nidhiyaadhaarathirku meendum sarvadhesa nidhiyathaiyo (IMF) alladhu natbu naadugalaiyo naada vendiya kattaayam uruvaagiyulladhu. Melum, ulagalaaviya porulaadhaara mandhanilai alladhu sarvadhesak padhatrangalaal sutrulaap payanigal varugai kuraindhaal, naattin varthagap patraakkurai (Trade Deficit) melum adhigarikkum.

headline: Vaakku segarikkas sendra kanimozhi virattiyadippu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Vaakku kettu sendra idathil kanimozhiyai makkal virattiyadithanar endru oru video

investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil sattapperavaith therdhal sooduvidikkath thodangiyulladhu. Indha nilaiyil anaithu katchigal tharappilirundhum samooga oodagangalil vadhandhigal parappappattu varugindrana. Andha vagaiyil thi.mu.ka-vinarai viratti adikkum makkal, kanimozhiyai virattinar endrellaam oru video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Indha video sila aandugalukku munbu veliyaagi irundhadhu ninaivilirundhadhaal idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2024m aandu epral 1m thedhi indha video-vai san news veliyittirundhadhu. “akkaa neenga pesunaa podhumkkaa-Kanimozhiyin vaaganathai marithu anbaaga kadhavugonda Thoothukudi makkal” endru thalaippidappattirundha andha video-vai paarthom. Kiraama makkal thangal ooril pesumbadi, vaaganathil irundhavadiye pesumbadi anbuk korikkai viduthadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. 2024m aandu naadaalumandrath therdhalin podhu Thoothukudi naadaalumandrath thogudhiyil DMK saarbil kanimozhi pottiyittaar. Appodhu indha nigazhvu nadandhadhu endru seythigal namakku kidaithana.
Idhan moolam vaakku segarikkas sendra kanimozhi matrum thi.mu.ka-vinarai makkal virattiyadithanar endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Madurai TVK maanaadu patri es.e.sandhirasegar adhirupdhi therivithaaraa?
text:

investigation_details:
Sameevathil Madurai aruge Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathin 2vadhu maanaadu nadandhadhu. Indha maanaattil nadigar Vijay-yin petror es.e.sandhirasegar, shovaa kalandhugondanar. Nadigar vijaykkum avaradhu thandhaikkum modhal irundhu vandhadhu. Indha soozhalil maanaattil avarai kattaayappaduthi azhaithu vandhadhai velippaduthum vagaiyil niruvargalin kelvikku es.e.sandhirasegar padhil alithaar endru video padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vil Madurai maanaadu endru niruvar kooravillai. Enave sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video-vai aayvu seythom. Indha video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2024m aandil indha video veliyaagi iruppadhu therindhadhu. Vijay vikkiravaandiyil mudhal maanaadu nadathiyavodhu indha petti veliyaagi iruppadhu therindhadhu.
2024m aandu akdovar 27m thedhi vikkiravaandiyil Vijay maanaadu nadathinaar. Andha maanaattu thodarbaaga es.e.sandhirasegaridam niruvargal kelvi ezhuppirundhanar. Adharkuthaan “maanaadu patri avarkitta kelunga, maanaadu padathai avar thaan eduthaar” ena naisaaga vengat piravuvai korthu vittaar es.e.sandhirasegar. Idhu thodarbaaga 2024m aandu veliyaana seythigalum namakkuk kidaithana.
Idhan moolam 2024m aandil es.e.sandhirasegar alitha pettiyai, 2025 Madurai maanaattudan thodarbuppaduthi thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline:
Pak-in nerungiya koottaali.. 
Indhiyaavidam kaiyendhum nilai.. Thurukkiyin adhiradi nagarvu!
text:
Pak-in nerungiya koottaali.. Indhiyaavidam kaiyendhum nilai.. Thurukkiyin adhiradi nagarvu!
Andai naadaana paagisdhaanin miga mukkiya koottaaliyaaga irukkum thurukki, tharpodhu India-vin udhaviyai naadiyiruppadhu vivaadhangalaith thoondiyulladhu. Ukraine-in tron thaakkudhalgalaal thurukkikkaana Russia teesal viniyogam kuraindhulladhu. Idhanaal, India-vin suthigaripputh thiranaiye mudhanmaiyaagas saarndhirukka vendiya soozhal thurukkikku erpattulladhu.
Thoodharaga matrum paadhugaapputh thalangalil thurukki, paagisdhaanin nerungiya koottaaliyaagas seyalbattu varugiradhu. Kurippaaga, kadandha aandu aavareshan sindhoor nadavadikkaiyinbodhugooda, thurukki arasaangam raanuvath thalavaadangalai anuppi paagisdhaanukku udhavi seythadhaagavum seythigal veliyaagi irundhana. Indhas soozhalil mathiya kizhakkil nilavi varum porp padhatram kaaranamaaga erivorul viniyogathil thattuppaadu nilavugiradhu. Thavira, vilaiyum kadumaiyaaga uyarndhulladhu. Innoru puram, Ukraine-in tron thaakkudhalgalaal Russia enney suthigarippu nilaiyangal paadhikkappattullana. Thavira, Russia arasu etrumadhik kattuppaadugalaiyum vidhithulladhu. Idhanaal, thurukkikkaana Russia teesal viniyogam kuraindhulladhu. Vazhakkamaaga thurukki, thanadhu teesal thevaiyil sumaar 85% rashyaavilirundhe irakkumadhi seythu vandhadhu. Adhaavadhu, orunaalaikku 2,00,000 peeppaaygalukkum adhigamaaga irundha Russia teesalukkaana thurukkiyin irakkumadhi, tharpodhu naalondrukku sumaar 80,000 peralgalaagak kuraindhulladhu. Idhaiyaduthu, India-vin udhaviyai thurukki naadiyulladhu.
Sarvadhesa sandhaiyil nilavum nerukkadi kaaranamaaga, thanadhu ulnaattup porulaadhaara nilaithanmaiyai urudhiseyya India-vin suthigaripputh thiranaiye mudhanmaiyaagas saarndhirukka vendiya soozhal thurukkikku erpattulladhu.
Aagast 2026 tharavugalinbadi (Kpler tharavu niruvanam), thurukki India-vil irundhu naalondrukku 1,20,000 peralgalukkum adhigamaaga teesalai irakkumadhi seythu varalaatrus saadhanai padaithulladhu. Idhu 2017-aam aandirkup piragaana miga uyarndha maadhaandhira kolmudhal alavaagum. Melum, kadandha aandil India, thurukkikku 5,62,421 tan teesalai etrumadhi seythulladhu. Idhanmoolam, Russia matrum egipdhirkup piragu thurukkiyin moondraavadhu periya viniyoga naadaaga India thigazhgiradhu.
Ulagin munnani enney suthigarippu maiyangalil ondraana India, Russia matrum pira naadugalilirundhu kachaa enneyai vaangis suthigarithu etrumadhi seygiradhu enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu. Adhenerathil, thurukkiyin teesal etrumadhi indhiyaavodu nindruvidavillai. Kpler tharavugalinbadi, amerikkaavum aagast maadhathil orunaalaikkus sumaar 90,000 peeppaaygal endra alavil thurukkikku etrumadhi seythu, maadhaandhira uchathaip padhivu seythulladhu. India-vin indha varthagam, vivaadhathai erpaduthiyulla nilaiyil, porutkalai vaanga virumbavarukku adhai virpadhudhaane murai; adhai enge vitraal enna enbadhe India-vin padhilaaga ulladhu

headline: “jananaayagap padugolaigalukku thunai nirka mudiyaadhu!”
text:

Madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram idaitherdhalil tha.ve.ka-vukku edhiraaga vetbaalargalaik kalamirakkiyadhudan arasin meedhaana vimarsanangalaiyum kaathiramaaga munvaithuvarugindrana CBI, si.pi.em katchigal. Padhiladiyaaga, kamyoonist katchigalin aadharave thevaiyillai endra mudivukku TVK arasu vandhuvittadhaagas solgiraargal vivaramarindhavargal!
2026 sattamandrath therdhalil 107 idangalil vendra Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam, Congress, CBI, si.pi.em., VCK, ai.yoo.em.el aagiya katchigalin aadharavudan aatchiyamaithadhu. Thalaa 2 em.el.e-kkalaikkondirukkum CBI, si.pi.em thavirthu, idhara katchigal mudhalvar Vijay thalaimaiyilaana madhachaarbatra samooga needhi vetrik koottaniyil aikkiyamaagivittana. CBI, si.pi.em katchigalo koottanikkus sella maruthadhodu edhirkkatchigalaik kaattilum kaattamaana, adheneram aakkavoorvamaana vimarsanangalai munvaithuvarugindrana.
``appattamaana kudhiraip peram...’’
nammidam pesiya CBI nirvaagigal silar, “sattamandrath therdhalil endhak katchikkum thanipperumbaanmai kidaikkaadha nilaiyil, BJP pinnaniyil thi.mu.ka-vum a.thi.mu.ka-vum aatchiyamaikka muyandradhaagak karudhi, 107 idangalai vendra tha.ve.ka-vukku veliyilirundhu aadharavalithom. Aanaal, paa.ja.ka-vukkus satrum salaikkaadha aatchiyai TVK nadathivarugiradhu.
Maanavargal idadhusaarip poraattangalil pangerpadhaith thadukkum uyargalvithuraiyin sutrarikkaiyum, adharkup pinnaniyil irundha thalaimais seyalaalar saaygumaarai maatra vendum endra korikkaiyai niraivetraadhadhum mudhal adhirupdhi. Aduthu, kaaviri vivagaarathil anaithuk katchik koottam koottaadhadhu, neet edhirppu poraattangalil maanavargal kaidhuseyyappattadhu aagiyavai engal porumaiyai melum sodhithana. Idhanudan, sattamandrathil edhirkkatchigalin kelvigalukku padhilalikkaadhadhu, maraimuga mingattana uyarvu, seergetta sattam-ozhungu enath thodarndhu pirasnaigal adhigarithu varugindrana.
Pinnar kaavaldhurai maaniyak korikkaiyil pesiya mudhalvar Vijay, ‘amalaakkathuraiyin kadidhangalaiyum, arikkaigalaiyum aadhaaramaaga munvaithadhu avarmeedhaana arasiyal puridhalaiye kelvikkullaakkiyadhu. Mudhaleedugalai eerppadhil endhavoru velippadaith thanmaiyum illai. ADMK em.el.e-kkalai raajinaamaa seyyavaithu, tha.ve.ka-vil inaithu, avargalaiye tharpodhu TVK vetbaalaraaga arivithiruppadhu appattamaana kudhiraip peram. Idhu pondra jananaayagap padugolaigalukku engalaal thunai nirka mudiyaadhu. Aagave, TVK vetbaalar thorkadikkappada vendum enath thanichaiyaaga vetbaalargalaik kalamirakkiyirukkirom” endranar.
``aadharavai vaavas peruvom!’’
nammidam pesiya si.pi.em nirvaagigal, “kamyoonisttugalin thayavildhaan TVK aatchi amaindhadhu. Aanaal, koottanik katchigal endraal, avargalukku aadharavaaga jaalraa poda vendum enak karudhugiraargal. Aakkavoorvamaana vimarsanangalai munvaithaal, engalai thi.mu.ka-vin kaikkooliyaaga sithirikkap paarkkiraargal. Aatchiyamaindha indha naangu maadhangalil palamurai mudhalvarais sandhikkath thittamittirundhom. Aanaal, mudhalvarai eppodhume thodarbu ellaikku veliyileye vaithirukkiraargal. Palveru makkal virodhath thittangalaik konduvarum indha arasukku, naangal thodarndhu aadharavu koduthukkondirundhaal, engal narpeyar kalangappattuvidum. Enave, TVK aatchikkaana aadharavai vaavas perum moodukkuk katchith thozhargal vandhuvittaargal. Enave, idaitherdhalukkup piragu maanilakkuzhuvaik kootti mudiveduppom” endranar.
Nammidam pesiya TVK amaichargal silaro, “amaicharavaiyil idamum, thunai savaanaayagar padhaviyum tharugirom ena kamyoonist katchigalukku aafar koduthavodhilum, adhai maruthuvittu tha.ve.ka-vukku idaiyooru tharumvidhamaaga nadandhugolgindrana kamyoonist katchigal. DMK munvaikkum adhe paaniyilaana vimarsanangalaithaan kamyoonisttugalum munvaikkiraargal. Idaitherdhalil engalai edhirthu vetbaalargalai niruthum alavukkus sendruvittadhaal, inimel kamyoonisttugalin aadharavu thevaiyillai ena mudiveduthuvittaar mudhalvar Vijay sattamandrathin tharpodhaiya palam 227 idangal. Adhil perumbaanmai ennikkaiyaana 114 engal koottani vasamiruppadhaal kamyoonist aadharave engalukkuth thevaiyillai. Edhirvarum anaithu idaitherdhalgalilum naangale velvom. Enave, aatchi kavizha vaayppe illai” endranar.
Adutha ilakku paa.ma.ka-vaa?
Nammidam pesiya arasiyal nokkargal silar, “edhirvarum idaitherdhalgalai muzhumaiyaaga vendruviduvom endra nambikkaiyil kamyoonisttugalin thayavu inimel avasiyamillai endra mudivukku varugiradhu TVK vi.si.ka-vin nilaippaattai porutbaduthaamal paa.ma.ka-vai amaicharavaikkul konduvarum pilaanum tha.ve.ka-vukku irukkiradhu. Adhanaaldhaan paa.ma.ka-vudan teel pesi idaitherdhalil yaarukkum aadharavu illai endru sollavaithirukkiradhu TVK endhap pirasnaiyum seyyaamal inakkamaaga iruppavargalaik koottaniyil inaithu aatchi seyvom endra mudivukku vandhirukkiraar mudhalvar vijay” endranar.
Aadharavu kodutha kaigal, ippodhu arasiyal azhutham kodukkiradhaa?

headline: Vijay-kku pottiyaaga ajith ? Arasiyalil nuzhaindha rasigargal.. Pudhiya arasiyal katchigal thodakkam !
text:
Vijay-in arasiyal vetrikkup piragu, ajith arasiyalukku vara vendum endra korikkai rasigargalidaiye theeviramadaindhulladhu. Ulundhoorbettaiyil mudhalil pudhiya katchiyai thodangiya ajith rasigargal, tharpodhu kundrathooril 2vadhaaga pudhiya katchiyai thodangiyullanar.
Nadigar Vijay Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam endra katchiyaith thodangi irandu aandugalil Tamil Naattil aatchiyai kaippatriyullaar. Neenda kaalathukku piragu oru nadigar katchi thodangi aatchiyai pidithulladhu Indhiya arasiyalai ulukkiyulladhu.
Vijay katchi thodangum munnar avarum ajithumdhaan Thamizhaga thiraiyulagil adhiga rasigargalai konda ucha natchathirangalaaga thigazhndhanar. Idhan kaaranamaaga Vijay-in vazhiyai pinbatri nadigar ajithum arasiyal katchiyai thodanga vendum ena avarin rasigargal thodarndhu korikkai viduthu vandhanar.
Aanaal, arasiyalil viruppam illai endru velippadaiyaaga arivithuvittaar ajith. Idharkidaiye avarum vijayum ondru serndhu landanil car res nigazhchiyil kalandhugondadhu arasiyalil perum vivaadhamaagiyadhu. Idhanaal ajith ini arasiyalukku varamaattaar endre avaradhu rasigargalaal paarkkappattadhu.
Idhan kaaranamaaga kadandha irandu naatkalukku munnar ulundhoorbettaiyil ondrugoodiya ajith rasigargal silar, ’Thamizhaga makkal kazhagam’ endra pudhiya arasiyal katchiyaith thodangiyadhaaga arivithanar. Melum katchiyin thalaivar ullitta padhavigalukku nirvaagigalai niyamanam seythu, katchiyin ‘maanilap podhucheyalaalar’ padhaviyai ajithukkaagak kaaliyaaga vaithulladhaagavum avar arasiyalukku vandhaal ikkatchi avarukkus samarppikkappadum endrum therivithanar.
Indha nilaiyil, kaanjjivuram maavattam kundrathooril ondru koodiya ajith rasigargal anaithu nanbargal munnetrak kazhagam endra peyaril pudhiya arasiyal katchiyai thodangiyullanar. Indha nigazhvil naalaiya mudhalvare padhaviyerka vaa ullitta vaasagangal adangiya penargalai vaithu ajith arasiyalukku varavendum ena korikkai viduthullanar.
Adhevol ajith pugaippadathirku paal avishegam seythu "naalai mudhalvar ajith" ena koshangalaiyum avargal ezhuppinar. Pinnar katchiyin kodi, sinnam arimugappaduthappattu, katchi nirvaagigalukku adaiyaala attaiyum vazhangappattadhu. Ajith rasigargalin idhuvondra seyalgalaal arasiyal kalam soodu pidithulladhu.

headline: Mudhal thesiya virudhu petra pinnani paadagi es.jaanagi endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘mudhal thesiya virudhu petra pinnani paadagi es.jaanagi,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’mudhal thesiya virudhu. Paadagargalukku thesiya virudhu illaamal irundha nilaiyil, andha kaalagattathil arivikkappattu, 16 vayadhinile padathil ‘sendhoorappoove…‘ paadalukku es.jaanagikku thesiya virudhu kidaithadhu.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, 1954m aandu mudhal thesiya virudhugal vazhangappadugindrana. Thodakkathil, sinimaa nadigargal, nadigaigal, iyakkunargal pondra pirivugalukku virudhu vazhangappattadhu. Pinnar 1967-68m aandil irundhe, sinimaa thozhilnutba kalainjargal, pinnani paadagargal pondra pirivugalukkum virudhugal arivikkappaduvadhu vazhakkamaagiyulladhu.
Idhil, 1967m aandu mudhanmudhalaaga pinnani paadagar (aangal) pirivil Mahendra Kapoor thesiya virudhu petrullaar. Aduthadhaaga, 1968m aandildhaan pinnani paadagar pirivil pengalukkum virudhu arivikkappattadhu. Appodhu, P. Susheela mudhalil indha virudhai petraar.
Adhesamayam, S Janaki kadandha 1978m aandudhaan 16 vayadhinile padathil paadal paadiyadharkaaga, thesiya virudhu petraar.
Idhanmoolamaaga, mudhalil thesiya virudhu petra pinnani paadagi es.jaanagi endra thagaval, thavaraanadhu endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
