headline: ”engalaith thaandi yaarum..” kireenlaandhil kaalbadhikkum America? Trump potta oppandham!
text:
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
panippaaraigal niraindha theevu endraale... Kireenlaandhudhaan ninaivukku varum. Tenmaarkkin kattuppaattil irukkum indha aarkdik theevu, kadandha sila aandugalaaga America adhivar tonaaldu trambin kavanathaiyum eerthu varugiradhu. Orugattathil kireenlaandhaiye America kaippatra vendum ena Trump velippadaiyaagap pesiyirundha nilaiyil, tharpodhu andhath theevu thodarbaaga America eduthirukkum pudhiya nadavadikkai sarvadhesa alavil kavanam petrulladhu.
Kireenlaandhil America-vin raanuva iruppai kanisamaaga adhigarippadharkum, adhevelaiyil America-vin edhiri naadugal andhath theevil raanuvath thalangalai amaippadhaith thaduppadharkum America, tenmaark matrum kireenlaandhu idaiye or oppandham erpattulladhaaga tonaaldu Trump arivithullaar. Thanadhu Truth Social padhivil indha oppandham kurithup pesiya Trump, kireenlaandhin paadhugaappaiyum America-vin paadhugaappaiyum urudhi seyya, andhath theevil America-vukku thevaiyaana nadavadikkaigalai edukkum thiran endrendrum irukkum ena therivithullaar.
Melum, indha oppandhathirku kaalaavadhi thedhi edhuvum illai endrum avar kurippittullaar. Idhumattumindri, America-vin edhiri naadugal kireenlaandhil raanuvath thalangalai amaippadharkum, raanuvap padaigalai nilainiruthuvadharkum, mukkiyamaana mudhaleedugalai merkolvadharkum America-vin anumadhi thevaippadum enavum Trump therivithullaar.
“appadiyaanaal America kireenlaandhai vaangivittadhaa?” endraal illai.... Indha oppandham kireenlaandhai amerikkaavidam oppadaippadharkaana oppandham alla. Kireenlaandhu thodarndhu tenmaark iraajjiyathin thannaatchip pagudhiyaagave irukkum. Maaraaga, aarkdik piraandhiyathin paadhugaappu thodarbaaga America-vin raanuva anugal matrum iruppai adhigarippadharkaana erpaadugale idhil mukkiyamaaga idambetrulladhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Aanaal, indha oppandhathin vidhimuraigal matrum amsangal enna enbadhu kurithu muzhumaiyaana arivippu innum veliyaagavillai enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Thunaith thalaivar padhavi koduthaal tha.ve.ka-vil inaiya thayaar endru ji.ke.vaasan koorinaaraa?
text:
Tha.ve.ka-vil inaiyath thayaar endrum thunaith thalaivar padhavi thara vendum endrum vijayyidam thamizh maanila Congress thalaivar ji.ke.vaasan korikkai vaithadhaaga oru news card

san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “korikkai. Thunaithalaivar padhaviyudan tha.ve.kavil inaiya thayaar Vijay-kku vaasan korikkai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizh maanila Congress thalaivar ji.ke.vaasan Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathil (TVK) inaiya viruppam therivithadhaaga news card ondrai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal thunaith thalaivar enbadhai “thunai thalaivar” endrum inaiya enbadhai “inaiya” endrum ezhuthup pizhaiyudan kurippittirundhanar. Ivvalavu pizhaiyaaga news card-ai oodagangal veliyida vaayppillai.
Melum, tha.ve.ka-vil inaiya thayaar endru ji.ke.vaasan kooriyadhaaga endha oru seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Avar appadi kooriyirundhaal adhu migapperiya seythiyaagi irukkum. Aanaal, ji.ke.vaasan appadi kooriyadhaaga oru thundu seythi kooda kidaikkavillai. Ivai ellaam indha news card unmaiyaanadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Indha news card-ai san news veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalai paarvaiyittom. Akdovar 12, 2025 andru indha news card veliyaanadhaaga adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, kurippitta andha naalil san news samooga oodaga pakkangalil, ji.ke.vaasan thodarbaaga endha oru news kaardum veliyaagavillai.
Thodarndhu thediyavodhu, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card-ai 2025 aagast 14m thedhi san news veliyittiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Aanaal adhil, “korikkai, samooga valaidhalangalil aavaasa padangal veliyiduvadhai thadukka sirappus sattam konduvara vendum ena TMC thalaivar ji.ke.vaasan valiyuruthal” endru irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthu veliyittiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Idhai urudhiseythugolla, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai san news digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum “idhu poliyaanadhu, san news veliyidavillai” endru urudhi seythaar.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Muslimgalai ragasiyamaaga aayvu seythom endru America-vin ep.pi.ai arivithadhaa?
text:
Muslimgalai ragasiyamaaga aayvu seythu asandhu ponom endru America-vin pulanaayvu niruvanamaana ep.pi.ai arivithadhu endru oru padhivu

ep.pi.ai thalaivar endru oruvar pugaippadathai vaithu pugaippada padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Adhil, “muslimgalai ragasiyamaay aayvu seythom piragu asandhu nindrom FBI” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “ulavu’ paarkkas sendrom…! Muzhu ‘nilavu’ paarthu nindrom…! [America-vin 03.03 milliyan sanathogai konda muslim samoogathaiyum adhan nadavadikkaigalaiyum kangaanikka, 2001 mudhal 2016 varai sumaar padhinaindhu varudangal,
padhinaindhaayiram ulavaaligal moolam, naadu muzhuvadhum ulla pallivaayilgal, kuraaniya vaguppugal, vazhivaattu matrum samooga nigazhchigalin ragasiya olippadhivugal, matrum kangaanippugal, ulaga alavil ulla 7485 muslim piravalangalin minnanjjalgal ena thedithuruvi ulavuvaarthu, ek.pi.ai. In panippaalar ‘jems pi komi’yum adhan munnaal adhigaari ‘kesi hannaa’vum samarppitha aayvarikkaiyin saaraamsam idhu!]” endru thodangi neenda padhivai veliyittirundhanar. Adhanudan oru seythik katturaiyin inaippaiyum alithirundhanar. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
America-vil vaazhum islaamiyargalai 2001m aandilirundhu 2016m aandu varai ep.pi.ai ragasiyamaaga kangaanithu aayvu seythadhaagavum, adhan adippadaiyil ep.pi.ai arikkai veliyittadhaagavum kurippittullanar. Adhu thodarbaaga oru katturai inaippaiyum alithirundhanar. Andha inaippaip paarthom.
Adhu America-vil veliyaagum The Onion endra inaiyadhalathin katturaiyaagum. Aaniyan adhaavadhu vengaayam endru pathirikkaiyin peyaraip paarkkum podhe idhu unmaiyaana oodagamdhaanaa endra sandhegam ezhundhadhu. Enave, thi aaniyan pathirigai patri thedip paarthom. Adhu poy seythigalai naiyaandi endra peyaril veliyidum oodagam endru theriyavandhadhu.
The Onion oodagam patriya vivaram About us’ pagudhiyil namakkuk kidaithadhu. 1756l thodangappattadhu endrum thinamum 4.3 trilliyan makkal adhai padikkiraargal endrum 3.5 latcham muzhu matrum pagudhi nerap pathirikkaiyaalargal paniyaatri varugiraargal endru migapperiya kadhaiyai ezhudhiyirundhaargal. Disclaimer pagudhiyil The Onion® is a Satirical Newspaper endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhaavadhu naiyaandi seythithaal endru therivithirundhanar.
Adhil veliyaana katturaigalaip paarthom. Sameevathil kaalamaana pop piraansisukku kuzhandhaigal ulladhu endrum, pudhiya poppai therndheduppadhai vida erumbugalai kavanikkum velai ulladhu endru kadavule kooriyadhaagavum katturaigalai veliyittirundhanar.
Poyyaana, naiyaandi katturaigalai veliyidum oodagathin seythiyai eduthu vandhu, islaamiyargal patri ep.pi.ai aayvu seythadhu endru unmai seythi pola samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Madhuraandhagathil naalai mudhalvar Vijay pirasaaram; 7,000 perukku mattume anumadhi
text:
Chennai: madhuraandhagathil mudhalvar Vijay naalai (sepdambar 25) pirasaaram seyyavulla nilaiyil, 7,000 perukku mattume anumadhi vazhangappattu ulladhu.
Madhuraandhagam sattasavai thogudhi idaitherdhal, adutha maadham, 6m thedhi nadakkiradhu. A.thi.mu.ka.,vil irundhu em.el.e., padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythu, tha.ve.ka.,vil inaindha maragadham kumaravelukku pottiyida vaayppu vazhangappattu ulladhu.
Maragadham kumaravelai aadharithu amaichargal aananth, aadhav arjunaa ullittor theevira pirasaarathil eeduvattu varugindranar. Ivargalai thodarndhu, madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil, mudhalvar Vijay naalai pirasaaram seyya ullaar. Idharkaaga, Chennai - Trichy thesiya nedunjjaalaiyil, Aathoor sungachaavadi aruge piramaanda pandhal amaikkappattu varugiradhu. Ingu naalai (sepdambar 25) pirpagalil, thanadhu pirasaara vaaganathil nindravadi, mudhalvar Vijay pesavullaar.
Indha pirasaara koottathil pangerka, TVK, matrum koottani katchi nirvaagigal matrum thondargal 7,000 perukku, 'kiyooaar' kuriyeedudan koodiya anumadhi seettugal vazhangappattu ullana.
Maragadham kumaravel pirasaaram seyyum idangalil, silar pirasnaigalil eeduvattu varugindranar. Idhanaal, avarukku vetri vaayppu kuraindhulladhaaga, nirvaagigal pugaar koori varugindranar. Enave, theevira pirasaaram vaayilaaga, maragadham kumaravel vetri vaayppai urudhi seyya, mudhalvar Vijay thittamittullaar.

headline: Mukkombu vandhadaindha kaaviri neer
text:
Trichy:
mettoor anaiyil irundhu, sep., 1m thedhi thirakkappatta kaaviri neer, netru mukkombu vandhadaindhadhu.
Karnaadagaa maanila arasu, kaaviri aatril thanneer thirakkaadhadhaal, mettoor anai, thanneer indri varandadhu. Idhanaal, teldaa paasanathukku joon 12l thanneer thirakkappadavillai.
Thamizhagathil palveru poraattangal, aanaiyam matrum needhimandra utharavaal, karnaadagaavil irundhu kaaviriyil thanneer thirakkappattadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, mettoor anaiyil irundhu sep., 1l thanneer thirakkappattadhu.
Tharpodhu, mettoor anaiyil irundhu vinaadikku, 7,000 kanaadi thanneer thirakkappattu, Erode, karoor maavattangalai kadandhu Trichy maavattam, mukkombu melanaikku netru thanneer vandhadaindhadhu. Kallanaiyil irundhu teldaa maavatta paasanathukku naalai thanneer thirakka uthesikkappattu ulladhu.

headline: Ulagin miga mukkiya valarchi maiyamaaga thigazhum India; aiemep paaraattu
text:
Vaashingdan: 'aayvaalargalin kanippugalai vida India-vin motha ulnaattu urpathi (GDP) valarchiyadaindhulladhu. Ulagin miga mukkiya valarchi maiyamaaga India thigazhgiradhu,' endru sarvadhesa naanaya nidhiyathin (aiemep) seythithodarbaalar jooli kosaak therivithullaar.
Idhu thodarbaaga avar kooriyadhaavadhu; India-vin irandaavadhu kaalaandu jidivi 7.8% aaga valarndhulladhu. Idhu engal kuzhuvin edhirbaarppugalaiyum, pira aayvaalargalin kanippugalaiyum vida adhigamaagum. Indha edhirbaaraadha valarchikku sevaith thurai matrum etrumadhith thuraigalil sirappaaga seyalbattadhe kaaranamaagum. Erivorutkalin vilai thodarndhu adhigarithu vandha podhilum, indhiyap porulaadhaaram meeldhanmai kondadhaagave irundhu varugiradhu. Adhumattumillaamal, India ulagirkaana oru mukkiya valarchi maiyamaaga thodarndhu thigazhgiradhu enbadhai idhu kaattugiradhu.
India pondra kachaa enneyai irakkumadhi seyyum naadugalukku, adhan vilai uyarvu perum azhuthathai erpaduthugiradhu. Idhu ovvoru naattin nidhik kattamaippaip poruthu maaruvadum. Idhan thaakkathai kuraikka palveru naadugal nadavadikkaigalai eduthu varugindrana. Kurippaaga, India pondra sila naadugalil, valuvaana porulaadhaara nilai irundha kaalagattathil indha nerukkadi nilai erpattulladhu, ivvaaru koorinaar.

headline: Neervazhippaadhai mooda munaippu aazhndha urakkathil adhigaarigal
text:
Palladam: palladam aruge neervazhippaadhaiyai muzhumaiyaaga moodum muyatsi nadandhu varum nilaiyil, adhanai thadukka vendiya adhigaarigal kandugollaamal iruppadhaaga podhumakkal kutram saattugindranar.
Paruvamazhai poythadhaal palladam vattaarathil varatchi nilavi varum nilaiyil, mazhaineerai segarithu nilathadi neerai paadhugaappadhan avasiyam adhigarithulladhu. Aanaal, neernilaigalukku mazhaineerai kondu serkkum neervazhippaadhaigal aakkiramippugal matrum kuppaigal kottappaduvadhaal maayamaagi varugindrana.
Aarumuthaambaalaiyam ooraatchikku utbatta arivoli nagar – - thottiyappuchi kovil sellum vazhiyil ulla neervazhippaadhai, kaalivelambatti, maanikkaavuram, kallambaalaiyam, sedavaalaiyam vazhiyaaga sendru karaippudhoor pagudhiyil noyyal aatrai sendradaigiradhu.
Indha neervazhippaadhaiyin oru pagudhi kadandha oraandukku mun mannaal moodappattadhaal, mazhaikkaalangalil thanneer sella vazhiyindri thengi nindradhu. Idhai adhigaarigal kandugollaadha nilaiyil, tharpodhu matroru pagudhiyaiyum kazhivugal, kuppaigalai kotti moodum muyatsi nadandhu varugiradhu.
‘mazhaineerai segarippom, nilathadi neerai paadhugaappom’ ena vizhippunarvu erpaduthuvadhu mattumindri, neervazhippaadhaigalai aakkiramippil irundhu meettu, neer aadhaarangalai paadhugaakka adhigaarigal nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Illaiyenil, edhirgaalathil thanneer thattuppaadu erpaduvadhai thavirkka mudiyaadhu.

headline: Calligraphy: kaiyezhuthuk kalaiyil muthirai padhikkum Madurai ilainjar!
text:
``en appaavin muzhumaiyaana vazhigaattudhalodu 13 vayadhilirundhe payitsi petru moondru maadhangalil katren. Thodar payitsikkup pinnar, 18 vayadhirkutbattorukkaana ulagalaaviya “karsiv raitting” (Cursive Writing) pottiyil irandaamidam pidithen."
kaiyezhuthin nalinathaik kaattum narendhira moorthi!
Sithiraiyum kaippazhakkam sendhamizhum naappazhakkam endra auvaiyin kootrukkinanga, Madurai maavattam avaniyaavuram pagudhiyil nesavaalar kudumbathais serndha 22 vayadhu ilainjar narendhira moorthi madhanagovaal, keligiraavi (Calligraphy) endra kaiyezhuthuk kalaiyil moondrumurai ulaga “pen” (Pen) saambiyan pattathai vendru asathiyirukkiraar. Pallippadippilirundhe ikkalaiyai muraiyaagak katru ichaadhanaiyai nigazhthiyirukkiraar. Tharpodhu thaniyaar vangi ondril velai paarthu varuvadhodu @naren_penmanship endra instaagiraam pakkathil ivarin kaiyezhuthukkalaiyaana “keligiraavi” padaippugalaip padhivittu varugiraar. Avar nammidaiye pagirndhugondadhu,
keligiraavi ezhuthumurai endraal enna?
Ezhuthu enbadhu verum udhirippookkalalla! Adhu oru azhagaana kalai vadivam. Endha mozhiyaaga irundhaalum adhan ezhuthuppookkalai nerthiyaagavum, paarvaikkuk kavarchiyaagavum vadivamaikkum kalaiye “keligiraavi.”
kaappar pilet(Copperplate), sbenseriyan(Spencerian), ittaalik(Italic), roman kevidals(Roman Capitals), favundeshanal hent(Foundational Hand), karsiv(Cursive) enap pala paanigal indhak kalaiyil undu. Ovvoru paanikkum thanithani ozhungu, ezhuthalavu matrum saaymaanam undu. Koormaiyaana matrum pattaiyaana penaa munaigalaik konde avai ezhudhappadugindrana. Appadi ezhudhumbodhu indhak kalai enakkul aazhgadal amaidhiyaiyum, porumaiyaiyum katrutharugiradhu.
Keligiraaviyaik katrukkolla vendum endra aarvam eppodhu vandhadhu?
Enakkuk keligiraaviyaik katrukkolla vendum endra aarvam en appaavidamirundhe vandhadhu. En appaavum ulaga “pen” saambiyan pattathai vendravar. Enadhu appaa Madurai perungudiyil “elaktrikkal” kadai nadathi varugiraar. Appaavin kalloorik kaalangalilirundhe vithiyaasamaaga ezhudhum pazhakkam irundhadhu. Pinnar inaiyadhalathin moolam “keligiraavi” ezhuthumuraiyai muraiyaagap payindraar. 2009, 2010, 2011 ena thodarndhu moondru aandugal pala pirivugalil appaa, ulaga “pen” saambiyan pattathai vendrirukkiraar. Naan ettaam vaguppu padikkumbodhe indhak keligiraavi ezhuthumuraiyin meedhu enakku eerppu vara aarambithadhu. Adharkuk kaaranam appaadhaan. Idhil avare enakkuk “kuru”
keligiraaviyai muraiyaagak karka aana kaalam enna?
Naamellaam siruvayadhilirundhe thinandhorum ezhudhugirom. Kaiyezhuthai azhagaakka namakkup palliyil irandu kodu, naangu kodu potta nottil payitsi ellaam koduppaargal. Aanaal nam kaiyezhuthu azhagaaga maaruvadhillai.
Kaaranam sariyaana vazhimuraiyum, thodar payitsiyum illaadhadhudhaan. En appaavin muzhumaiyaana vazhigaattudhalodu 13 vayadhilirundhe payitsi petru moondru maadhangalil katren. Pin thodar payitsikkup pinnar, 2018aam aandu naan onbadhaam vaguppu padithukkondirundhavodhu, 18 vayadhirkutbattorukkaana ulagalaaviya “karsiv raitting” (Cursive Writing) pottiyil irandaamidam pidithen. Indhak kaiyezhuthuppotti World Handwriting Contest 1991aam aandilirundhu aandudhorum amerikkaavais serndha Ms. Kate Gladstone https://handwritingrepair.info endra ammaiyaaraal sarvadhesa alavil vazhinadathappadugiradhu.
Adhan thodarchiyaaga 2021 matrum 2022aam andugalil “aardistikstail” (Artistic Style) pirivugalil mudhalidamum, irandaamidamum petru vaazhnaal saadhanaiyaalaraaga (Lifetime Triple Crown Winner) uyarndhullen. 2021aam aandu “Global Handwriting School” nadathiya “Global Handwriting Olympiad” pottiyil 15 vayadhukkutbattorukkaana pirivil pangetru, moondru vevveru pirivugalil (Calligraphy, Printed Handwriting, Cursive Handwriting) “Grand Master” pattangalai vendrullen. 2023aam aandu nadaivetra India-vin migapperiya kaiyezhuthup pottiyaana “National Penman Championship” endra thesiya alavilaana pottiyil mudhalidam vendru saadhanaip padaithullen.
Keligiraavi ezhuthumuraiyin thanithuvamum payanbaadugal ennenna?
Kaalam kadakka kadakka ennadhaan achu ulagirku naam maarivandhaalum kaiyezhuthirku irukkum madhippum angeegaaramum endraikkum thanithuvamaana ondru. Kaiyezhuthirkendru eppodhum oru uyirottam undu. Oru vellaik kaagidhathil nammudaiya saadhaarana kaiyezhuthil ezhudhikkoduppadharkum, keligiraavi moolam ezhudhikkoduppadharkum irukkum veruvaadum, adhaip paarthu rasikkum paarvaiyaalarin enna ottamume idharku irukkum thanithuvam.
America vellai maaligaiyil indrum kaiyezhuthuk kalainjargalukkena arasup pani irukkiradhu. Piranaattu adhivargalukku vaazhthu madal, azhaippidhazh, paaraattus saandridhazh ezhudhuvadharkum payanbaduthugiraargal. India-vin arasiyal saasana sattathai thiru. Pirembihaari naaraayanraaysaadhaa avargal than kaigalaaldhaan ezhudhinaar.
Nam Tamil Naattin Maduraiyil pazhangaalathil vaazhndha kaiyezhuthuk kalainjargalin vaazhviyalai eduthukkaattum vidhamaaga “ezhuthaanikkaaratheru” indralavum irukkiradhu. Ethanai perukkuth theriyum? Achu oodagam varuvadharku munnaal thirumanam, kiraama vizhaa, kalainigazhchigal, parisup porulgal, vaazhthu attaigal, azhaippidhazhgal, olaichuvadigalil ena ellaavatrilum ezhuthaani, thoorigai konde kaippada nerthiyaaga ezhudhinar.
Indha ezhuthukkalaikku (keligiraavi) neengal aatriya pangugal ennenna?
Naan ikkalaiyai muzhumaiyaagak katrukkonda piragu, enadhu veettirku arugilulla palli, kalloori maanavargalukkum, azhagaana kaiyezhuthudaiya maanavargalaik kandaalo avargalukku enadhu muzhumaiyaana vazhigaattudhalaik koduthu, indhak kalaiyai katrukkollavum payitsiveravum ookkappaduthi varugiren. Porulaadhaara nilai karudhi ikkalaiyaik kaivittu veru velai thedi sendravargal eraalam. Naan thaniyaar vangikku velaikkus sendrirundhaalum enadhu oyvu nerangalilum, vidumurai naalgalilum enadhu kaiyezhuthukkalaiyin moolam pala padaippugalai ezhudhi varugiren.
Indha ezhuthukkalaiyai aduthak kattathirku eduthuchella ungal pangalippu?
Indraikkup penaa pidithu ezhudhuvadhe aridhaagivittadhu. Thattachu seyyum vaarthaigal vizhigalai mattume thodum. Aanaal kaigalaal ezhudhum kadidham idhayathaith thodum. Digital ulagirkul maraindhuvarum indha ariya kaiyezhuthukkalaiyai azhiyaamal meettu, adhai adutha thalaimuraikku muraiyaagak katrukkoduthu, kondu serppadhe en mudhanmaiyaana nokkam.
Ikkalaiyai aduthakkattathirku eduthus sella arasin aadharavum, adharkaana angeegaaramum irundhaal melai naadugal pola naamum arasuppani vazhangi akkalainjargalai adaiyaalappaduthalaam. Arasin mukkiyas saandridhazhgal, thalaivargalukkuk kadidhangal, vaazhthumadal ena anaithilum keligiraaviyaip payanbaduthi ezhudhalaam.
Ulaga naadugal ikkalaikkup pottigal nadathuvadhu pol, nam thamizh naadum ikkalainjargalai sariyaaga inam kandugondu muraiyaana payitsi vazhangi pottigal nadathi angeegarikka vendum" enak koorinaar.

headline: Madappuram ajithgumaar kolai vazhakkil ti.es.pi., utbada 4 per siraiyil adaippu
text:
Madurai: -sivagangai maavattam, madappuram pathragaaliyamman kovil kaavalaali ajithgumaar kolai vazhakkil, ti.es.pi., ullitta naangu poleesaarai kaavalil vaikka, Madurai Needhimandram utharavittadhu.
Indha kovilukku vandha peraasiriyai nigidhaa kaarilirundha nagai thiruduvonadhaaga thiruppuvanam poleesil pugaar seythaar. Idhu thodarbaaga, ajithgumaarai, 2025 joon 27l thanippadai Police thaakkiyadhil avar irandhaar. Si.pi.ai.,visaarikkiradhu.
Poleesgaarargal raajaa, aananth, sangaramanigandan, piravu, kannan, Police ven tiraivar raamachandhiran kaidhaagi, Madurai mathiya siraiyil ullanar.
Maanaamadhurai ti.es.pi., sanmugasundharam, thiruppuvanam insbekdar rameshgumaar, sirappu es.ai., sivagumaar, ettu ilaiyaraajaa aagiyorai koodudhal edhirigalaaga CBI, thaakkal seytha kutrappathirigaiyil serkkappattanar.
Madurai 5vadhu koodudhal amarvu needhimandrathil, needhivadhi ke.thaamodharan netru visaarithaar. Raajaa ullitta 10 perum aajaraaginar. Avargal meedhu kolai ullitta palveru pirivugalin keezh kutrachaattugal padhivu seyyappattana.
CBI, tharappu vazhakkarinjar vijayan vaadham: sanmuga sundharam sasbent seyyappattullaar. Rameshgumaar tharpodhu maanaamadhurai insbekdar. Sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa sivagangai tavun poleesil pani purigindranar.
Sanmugasundharam ullitta naangu peraiyum kaavalil edukkaamal niyaayamaana, sudhandhiramaana visaaranaiyai urudhi seyya mudiyaadhu.
Vazhakku mudivadaiyum varai avargalai needhimandra kaavalil vaikka vendum. Illaiyenil avargal saatchigalai kalaikkakkoodum; aadhaarangalai azhikka vaayppulladhu.
Ivvaaru vaadhittaar.
Needhivadhi pirappitha utharavu: sanmugasundharam thanippadaiyai sattavirodhamaaga amaithu ullaar. Avargal, ajithgumaarai sattavirodhamaaga kaavalil eduppadharku rameshgumaar, sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa udhavi seythullanar.
Ajithgumaar irandha pin, avar Police kaavalil irundhu thappis sella muyandravodhu kaayamadaindhadhil irandhadhaagakkoori, poy pugaarai kannan alithadhaaga, CBI, tharappu kutram saattiyulladhu.
Kolaiyai maraikkum nokkil poy vazhakku padhivu seythadhaaga, rameshgumaar meedhu kutrachaattu ulladhu. Sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa, thiruppuvanam poleesil podhu naatkurippu padhivugalai thiruthiyadhaagavum, nigidhaa pugaaril, sivagumaar mun thedhiyittu si.es.aar., padhivai poliyaaga uruvaakkiyadhaagavum kutram saattappattulladhu.
Sanmugasundharam ullitta naangu perum kutram nadandhadhai maraikkum nokkil, erkanave aavanangalil poy padhivugalai uruvaakka muyandrullanar.
Ajithgumaar petroridam, ulloor arasiyal katchiyai serndhavargal udhaviyudan ti.es.pi., samarasam erpadutha muyandradhaaga CBI, kutram saattiyulladhu.
Thangal movail pongalil aadhaarangalai, 10 perum azhithuvittadhaaga kutrachaattu ulladhu. Sanmugasundharam, rameshgumaar, sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa saarbil idhuvarai jaamin manu thaakkal seyyappadavillai.
Ivargal veliye irundhaal saatchigal meedhu selvaakku seluthavum, aadhaarangalai seergulaikkavum vaayppulladhu.
Sanmugasundharam, rameshgumaar, sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaavai sep., 16 varai needhimandra kaavalil vaikka vendum.
Ivvaaru utharavittaar.
Anaivarum Madurai mathiya siraiyil adaikkappattanar.

headline: ‘thiralnidhi kanakku ketbavargalai katchiyil irundhu neekkuven’ endru Seeman mirattinaaraa?
text:
‘‘‘thiralnidhi kanakku kettaal katchiyil irundhu neekkappaduveergal’’ endru Seeman kooriyadhaaga,

idhil ‘’ kanakku kettaal katchiyilirundhu neekkappaduveergal. Thiral nidhi tharum thambigal endha kaaranam kondum kanakku ketkakkoodaadhu – Seeman, naam thamizhar katchi orunginaippaalar,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Pudhiya thalaimurai logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta news card, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, pudhiya thalaimurai aasiriyar kuzhuvil kettavodhu, ‘’naangal idhuvondra seythi edhuvum veliyidavillai. Idhu thavaraana seythi,’’ endranar.
Aduthappadiyaaga, naam thamizhar katchith thalaimai aluvalagathilum idhuvatri pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Congress katchikku koodiya koottam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Telliyil vaakku thiruttukku edhiraaga kandana Congress katchi saarbil aarppaattam nadathappatta soozhalil, Congress katchikku koodiya koottam endru oru pugaippadam

maidhaanam muzhukka makkal koodiyirukkum pugaippadam ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kaangiras enge… Congress ini avvalavu thaan… Congress illaadha indhiyaa… endru kooriyavargalukku” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Telliyil 2025 tisambar 14m thedhi vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga raam leelaa maidhaanathil Congress katchi saarbil poraattam nadathappattadhu. Indha nilaiyil, tisambar 15m thedhi Congress katchi enge endru kettavargalukkaana padhil endru maidhaanam muzhukka makkal koodiyirundha pugaippadam ondrai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittullanar.
Neradiyaaga idhu telliyil Congress katchi nadathiya peraattathin podhu edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Aanaal, poraattam nadandhu mudindha soozhalil indha padhivu veliyaagi iruppadhu maraimugamaaga Delhi poraattathin podhu edukkappatta pugaippadam enbadhu pondra thotrathai erpaduthugiradhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2019m aandilirundhu indha pugaippadam seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhe pugaippadathai 2021m aandu Congress matrum maarksist kamyoonist katchi inaindhu erpaadu seythirundha perani endru kurippittu oruvar padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
2019m aandu pipravari 6m thedhi veliyaagi irundha padhivu ondril merku vangam kolgathaavin piritj maidhaanathil idadhusaari koottani saarbil erpaadu seyyappattirundha peraniyil latchakkanakkaanor kalandhu kondanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil thediya podhu, pipravari 3, 2019m aandu kolgathaavil idadhusaarigal saarbil perani nadandhadhaagap pala seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Piravala pugaippadangal virpanai thalamaana alamy.com-l kooda indha pugaippadam veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhilum idadhusaarigal nadathiya perani endre kurippittirundhanar.
Idhan moolam Congress katchi nadathiya peraniyil koodiya makkal endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha pugaippadathirkum Congress katchikkum endha thodarbum illai enbadhum urudhi seyyappattulladhu. 2019m aandu kamyoonist aadharavu amaippugal nadathiya peraniyin pugaippadathai Congress katchiyin koottam pola thavaraaga pagirappattiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pakistan kodiyai eritha kerala makkal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’Pakistan kodiyai eritha kerala makkal,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ keralaavil nadandha sirappaana sambavam
paakkisdhaan kodiyai erithu poraattam
veera keralaavil tharpodhu..,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan paagisdhaanukku edhiraagak koshamittavaaru, Pakistan thesiyak kodiyai silar theeyittu erippadhu pondra kaatchigaludan koodiya video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Kurippitta video-vil Indian Express logo idambetrulladhaik kandom. Idhan adippadaiyil, thagaval thediyavodhu, idharkum keralaavukkum endha thodarbum illai endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, sameevathil nadaivetra Pahalgam theeviravaadha thaakkudhalai kandithu, Dogra Front endra amaippu jammu kaashmeeril poraattam nadathiyadhu. Appodhu, paagisdhaanukku edhiraaga muzhakkamitta poraattakkuzhu, annaattu thesiyak kodiyai theeyittu, erithadhu. Indha video-vai eduthu, kerala makkal ivvaaru poraattam nadathiyadhaagavum, thamizhnaattu DMK arasu idhuvondra poraattangalai seyya anumadhikkavillai enavum kurippittu, samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram…

headline: Thiruchiyil vivasaayigaludan amaichargal pechuvaarthai: 20 naatkalukku poraattam othi vaippu
text:
Trichy: thiruchiyil vivasaayigal nadathiya poraattam tharkaaligamaaga 20 naatkalukku othi vaikkappattu ulladhu.
Samayavuram aruge kootturavu sangangalil petrulla payirkkadangalai muzhumaiyaaga thalluvadi seyya vendum enbadhu angulla vivasaayigalin korikkaiyaagum. Idhai valiyuruthi, 3000kkum merpatta vivasaayigal poraattathil kudhithanar.
Poraattam 5vadhu naalaaga needitha nilaiyil, poraattakkalathirku amaichargal ramesh, vinoth, kaandhiraaj aagiyor neril vandhanar. Vivasaayigaludan avargal pechuvaarthai nadathinar.
Korikkaigal thodarbaaga pariseelikka 20 naatkal avagaasam vazhangumaaru vivasaayigalidam avargal kettuk kondanar. Adhai etruk konda vivasaayigal, tharkaaligamaaga thangaladhu poraattathai othi vaippadhaaga arivithanar.

headline: DMK aatchiyil saalaiyil mazhai neer thengiyulladhaaga paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK Stalin aatchiyil pala aayiram kodi roobai selavazhithum saalaiyil mazhai neer thengiyulladhu endru oru video

saalaiyil thengiyirukkum mazhai neeril bike ottikkondu oruvar vara, thideerendru nilai thadumaari pinnaal amarndhirundha pen matrum kuzhandhai keezhe vizhundha video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil, “thimuga Stalin aatchiyil makkalin nilaimai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “thimuga Stalin aatchiyil makkalin nilaimai idhuvola thaan thangal veettu vaasalil thangaludaiya theruvil kannukku pulappadaadha ethanai thaaymaargal podhumakkal idhuvondru avadhippadugiraargal idhuvola pala vagaiyaana siramangalukku aalaagiraargal idharku DMK aatchiyil pala aayiram kodigalukku mel podhu makkalin varip panathai veenadithum payanillaadha manasaatchi illaadha indha Stalin aatchiyai mudivukku kondu vara makkal thayaaraagi vittanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Chennai-yil akdovar mathiyil mazhai aarambithadhu. Adhaith thodarndhu saalaiyil mazhai neer thengiyirukkum pala video-kkal samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Saalaiyil mazhai neer vadigaal velai nadandhugondirukkum soozhalil mazhai neeril vaaganam ottis sellum padathai ellaam pagirndhu roo.4000 kodi enge ponadhu endru palarum padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha nilaiyil, mazhai vella neeril paikkil kudumbathudan vandha oruvar thadumaari vizhundha video-vai silar Facebook-il padhivittu varugindranar. Indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythu paarthom. Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu kadandha (2025) aagast maadhathilirundhu indha video Facebook-il padhividappattu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Karaachi kandishan endru kurippittu indha video-vai palarum 2025 aagastil padhivittirundhanar. Karaachiyin mosamaana nilai endru kurippittu palarum padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Pakistan oodagangalilum kooda indha veediyovudan seythi veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video sameevathil erpattulla Chennai mazhai paadhippudan thodarbudaiyadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Thodarndhu thediyavodhu nammudaiya fekt kirasando aangilathil kadandha aagast maadhathil indha video thodarbaana fekt sek katturai veliyaagi irundhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhilum indha video paagisdhaanais saarndhadhu endru urudhi seythirundhanar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil Tamil Naattil Stalin aatchiyil saalaiyil mazhai neer thengiyadhaaga paravum video thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pirandhanaal vaazhthugal annaa endru thirishaa padhivu veliyittaaraa?
text:
‘‘pirandhanaal vaazhthugal annaa endru padhivu veliyitta thirishaa,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ Happy Birthday Anna,’’ endru koori Vijay pugaippadathai nadigai thirishaa pagirndhullaar.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu thirishaa peyaril vendumendre pagirappadum poliyaana padhivu, endru theriyavandhadhu.

Vijay pirandha naalukku thirishaa vaazhthu kooravillai endru thagaval veliyaana nilaiyil satru thaamadhamaaga, joon 23, 2026 andru thirishaa padhivu veliyittaar. Idhudhodarbaaga, thirishaa tharappil kettavodhu, idhu poliyaana padhivu, endru therivithanar. Melum, wasitai, hive moderation, photoshopdetector pondra inaiyadhalangal udhaviyudan sarivaarthavodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta padhivudhaan, endru thelivaanadhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Indhiya kodiyai eritha eeraaniyargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran-il America, Israel kodigaludan serthu Indhiya thesiyak kodiyum erikkappattadhu endru oru video

America, Israel matrum Indhiya thesiyak kodigal saalaiyil erikkappadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil “eeraanil Indhiya thesiyak kodi erippu. Ulagam muzhuvadhum paravarappu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran-in meedhu kadandha pipravari 28, 2026 andru America matrum Israel nadathiya thaakkudhalil Iran naattin ucha thalaivaraana ali Khamenei uyirizhandhaar. Avaradhu irudhis sadangugal tharpodhu nadandhu varugindrana. Indha nilaiyil Iran-il Indhiya thesiya kodi erikkappattadhaaga video ondru samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Indhiyaavukkum eeraanukkum natburavu undu. Appadi irukka India-vin kodiyai erikka vaayppu kuraivu enbadhaal indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu Iran-il indha sambavam nadandhadhaagap palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Appadi padhividappattirundha video-kkal palavum thelivaaga irundhadhu.
Appadi padhividappattirundha oru video-vai paarthom. Adhil, ratha thaana mugaam endru kattappattirundha penar ondril karaachi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Enave, indha video eeraanais saarndhadhaaga irukkaadhu endru therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugollath thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu karaachiyil India, America, Israel kodigal erithu aarppaattam nadathappattadhaaga veliyaana padhivugal namakku kidaithana.
Nammudaiya fekt kirasando aangilathilum kooda idhu thodarbaana fekt sek katturai veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adhil, indha aarppaattam nadandha idam paagisdhaanin karaachiyil irukkiradhu endru koogul street kaatchigalaiyum vaithirundhanar. Andha idamum, aarppaattam nadandhadhu thodarbaaga veliyaana idhara padhivugalil idam petra idamum ondraaga irundhadhu. Enave, indha sambavam Iran-il nadandhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Valaigudaavil adhigarikkum padhatram.. Iran kaiyil sikkiya kappalgal.. Aduthu enna?
text:
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa -
amerikkaa–eeraan modhal needithu varum nilaiyil, kaippatrappatta America matrum Israel thodarbudaiya kappalgalai virpanai seythu, adhilirundhu kidaikkum panathaip poril uyirizhandhavargalin kudumbangalukku vazhanga Iran thittamittulladhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu. Iran needhithurai maiyathais serndha hasan apdhulliyanboor idhugurithu therivithadhaaga annaattu Mizan seythi niruvanam seythi veliyittulladhu.
Ethanai kappalgal kaippatrappattullana enbadhu kuritha muzhumaiyaana ennikkaiyai Iran veliyidavillai. Aanaal, kappalgal matrum sarakkugalai virpanai seyvadhan moolam kidaikkum thogai poril uyirizhandhavargalin kudumbangalukku izhappeedaagap payanbaduthappadum ena therivikkappattulladhu. Idhanmoolam, kadalil kaippatrappadum sothugal porin porulaadhaara nadavadikkaigalin oru pagudhiyaaga maarakkoodiya soozhal uruvaagiyulladhu.
Idharkidaiyil, ’America alladhu Israel meendum thaakkudhal nadathinaal, porin puviyiyal ellaiyai maatruvom ena Iran-in islaamiya puratchigara kaaval padai (IRGC) echarithulladhu. Melum, neendagaala modhalukku thangal padaigal thayaaraaga iruppadhaagavum IRGC kooriyulladhu.
Indhap padhatrathirku mathiyil ulagin mukkiyamaana erisakdhi kadal vazhigalil ondraana haarmus neerinaiyil varthagak kappalgal meedhaana thaakkudhalgal thodargindrana. Sepdambar 21 andru, adaiyaalam theriyaadha evuganaigal LPG tengar ondraith thaakkiyadhaaga UK Maritime Trade Operations (kadalsaar varthaga kangaanippu niruvanam) therivithulladhu. Kappalil irundha anaithup paniyaalargalum paadhugaappaaga iruppadhaagavum, sutruchoozhal paadhippu edhuvum padhivaagavillai endrum therivikkappattadhu.
Adhe naalil matroru tengar adaiyaalam theriyaadha eri porulaal thaakkappattadhil 2 paniyaalargal lesaaga kaayamadaindhanar .
Idharku sila naatkalukku munbum haarmus neerinaiyil oru tengar meedhu adaiyaalam theriyaadha erivorul thaakki thee erpattirundhadhu. Idhanaal, ulagin mukkiyamaana kadalvazhi varthagap paadhaiyaana haarmus meedhaana paadhugaappu kavalai melum adhigarithulladhu.
Innilaiyil Iran thanadhu vazhakkamaana raanuvap padaigalaiyum ellaip pagudhigalukku nagarthi varuvadhaaga thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana. Fars seythi niruvanathin thagavalbadi, sirappup padaigal, viraivuth thaakkudhal pirivugal, iyandhira mayamaakkappatta padaigal matrum peerangi pirivugal ullittavai ellaip pagudhigalil nilainiruthappattulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Kurippaaga paaraseega valaigudaa, haarmus neerinai matrum oman valaigudaavai ottiya makraan kadarkaraiyil padai kuvippu iruppadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Iran-in vazhakkamaana raanuvamaana Artesh-l sumaar 4.2 latcham per iruppadhaaga madhippidappattulladhu. Aanaal, tharpodhu ethanai veerargal ellaip pagudhigalukku nagarthappattullanar enbadhu kurithu adhigaarappoorvamaaga thagavalgal edhuvum veliyaagavillai.
Idhanaal, erkenave evuganaigal, trongal matrum kadarpadai modhalgalaal theeviramadaindhulla amerikkaa–eeraan modhal, nilapparappilum virivadaiyumaa endra kelvi ezhundhulladhu. Adhe nerathil, America tharaivazhi padaiyeduppukkaana thittathai arivithadhaaga urudhiyaana thagaval illai.

headline: “2vadhu muraiyaaga aatchi amaikkaavittaalum edhirkkatchiyaaga seyalbaduvom” endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
2vadhu muraiyaaga aatchi amaikkaavittaalum edhirkkatchiyaaga seyalbaduvom endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga oru news card

san news veliyittadhu pondru mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin pugaippadathudan koodiya news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “thittavattam. Thodarndhu 2vadhu muraiyaaga DMK aatchiyai amaikkaavittaalum edhirgatchiyaaga seyalbaduvom. Villivaakkathil mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin parappurai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vaakkuppadhivu epral 23m thedhi nadaivera ulla nilaiyil, DMK tholviyadaiyalaam endru mudhalamaichare maraimugamaaga koorivittadhu pondru edhirkkatchiyaaga seyalbaduvom endru avar kooriyadhaaga oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Thaangaldhaan vetriveruvom endru ellorum koori varum nilaiyil, indha news card poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Ippadi oru news card-ai san news veliyida vaayppillai. Aanaal, san news veliyittadhu polave idhu ulladhu. Enave, idhai san news veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathai paarvaiyittom.
Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru news card veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal adhil, “thodarndhu 2vadhu muraiyaaga DMK aatchikku vandhadhillai enbadhai udaithu immurai aatchiyamaippen” endru irundhadhu. Idhai edit seythu maatri, vishamathanamaana thagavalai serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla san news digital poruppaalarukku naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum “idhu poliyaanadhu, naangal veliyitta news card-ai maatri, thavaraana thagaval serthu vadhandhi parappiyullanar” endraar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Miyaanmar nilanadukkathin podhu kuzhandhaigalaik kaappaatriya seviliyargal endru paravum veediyo unmaiyaa?
text:
Miyaanmar naattil erpatta nilanadukkathin podhu maruthuvamanaiyil kuzhandhaigal vaardil irundha seviliyargal pachilam kuzhandhaigalukku edhum aagividakkoodaadhu endru paadhugaatha kaatchi endru oru video

niladukkathin podhu pachilam kuzhandhaigalai irandu seviliyargal paadhugaakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “nilanadukkathin podhu ladhannuyirai porutbaduthaamal pachilam kuzhandhaigalai paadhugaatha seviliyargal 🔥💪♥️ miyaanmar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
2025 maars 28m thedhi miyaanmar, thaaylaandhu naattil miga sakdhivaayndha nilanadukkam erpattadhu. Miyaanmar naattil aayirakkanakkaanor uyirizhandhadhaaga seythigal vandhu kondirukkiradhu. Indha nilaiyil miyaanmar naattil nilanadukkathin podhu oru magapperu maruthuvamanaiyil kuzhandhaigalaik kaappaatrap poraadiya seviliyargal endru oru video samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Adhe pondru indha video thaaylaandhil padhivaanadhaaga silar padhivittu varugindranar. Unmaiyil indha video ippodhu erpatta nilanadukkathin podhu padhivaanadhaa, thaaylaandhilaa alladhu miyaanmaril erpattadhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Indha video-vai pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu aayirak kanakkaanor indha sambavam miyaanmaril nadandhadhu endru kurippittu samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhu namakkuk kidaithadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu oodagam ondril China-vin ruyiliyil (Ruili City, southwest China’s Yunnan Province) maars 28, 2025 andru indha video padhivaanadhaaga seythi kidaithadhu. Idhu miyaanmarukku miga nerukkamaaga ulla nagaram endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga pivisi ullitta sarvadhesa oodagangalilum seythi matrum video veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. 2025m aandu maars maadham erpatta nilanadukkathin podhu padhivaana video kaatchidhaan enbadhu theriyavarugiradhu. Aanaal miyaanmarilo thaaylaandhil ulla maruthuvamanaiyilo padhivaana kaatchiyalla… seenaavil padhivaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagi ulladhu.
Nilanadukkathin podhu kuzhandhaigalaik kaappaatriya seviliyargal alitha pettiyum namakku kidaithadhu. Ivai ellaam indha video seenaavil padhivaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil miyaanmar naattil ulla maruthuvamanaiyil nilanadukkathin podhu padhivaana video enbadhu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
