Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda video unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2019m aandu utharap piradhesa maanilam, korakbooril nadaivetra siee edhirppup poraattam ondrin thodarbaana video endru theriyavandhadhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
News Nation l Live Hindustan l ANI News l Hindustan Times
aduthappadiyaaga, kurippitta video-vil varum theru, kattidangal edhenum ondrai aadhaaramaaga vaithu, idhu korakboordhaan enbadhai urudhi seyya mudiyumaa ena muyatsi seythom.
Idhe kattidam, namakkuk kidaitha seythi aadhaarangalilum satru thelivaagak kaana mudigiradhu.
Idhanbadi, Google Earth udhaviyudan thagaval thediyavodhu, indha kattidam korakbooril ulla Nakhas Chowk – Kotwali Road endra idathil, naangu saalaigal sandhikkum pagudhiyil amaindhulladhaaga, namakku vivaram kidaithadhu.
Idhuvarai kidaitha aadhaarangalin adippadaiyil, 2019m aandu korakbooril nadaivetra siee edhirppup poraattam thodarbaana vanmuraik kaatchi ondrai eduthu, tharpodhu maruvagirvu seythu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ambethgarai avamariyaadhai seythaaraa DMK em.el.e?
text:
DMK em.el.e aitreem moorthi ambethgarai avamariyaadhai seythaar endru oru video

DMK em.el.e aitreem moorthi Ambedkar pugaippadathirku anjjali seyvadhai thavirthuvittu periyaar, annaa, kalainjar karunaanidhi aagiyor pugaippadangalukku mattum malar anjjali seyvadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “annal Ambedkar avargalai avamadhitha DMK emele… mudhalvar matrum thimugavinaraal avamadhikkappadum thalith samudhaaya makkal” endru kurippidappattulladhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ambethgarai avamariyaadhai seytha DMK em.el.e aitreem moorthi endru palarum video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vai paarkkum podhu ambethgarai thavirthuvittu matravargalukku anjjali seluthuvadhu pola ulladhu. Aanaal, Ambedkar pugaippadathukkum maalai anivithu pookkal podappattiruppadhaik kaana mudigiradhu. Enave, unmai enna endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Aitreem moorthiyin samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paartha podhu, adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai kaana mudiyavillai. Adhe nerathil Chennai DMK X thala pakkathil indha video-vai veliyittirundhanar. Adhil, mudhalil Ambedkar padathirkuthaan aitreem moorthi anjjali seluthiyullaar. Adhan piragu thaan thandhai periyaar, arinjar annaa, karunaanidhi aagiyor pugaippadangalukku avar anjjali seluthugiraar.
Mudhalil Ambedkar pugaippadathukku anjjali seluthiya kaatchiyai agatrivittu, matra thalaivargalin pugaippadangalukku mattum anjjali seluthuvadhu pondru video-vai edit seythullanar. Idhan moolam ambethgarai izhivuvaduthivittaar endru thavaraana kutrachaattai uruvaakkiyiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: India thaakkiya piragu karaachi thuraimugathin nilai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Karaachi thuraimugathin meedhu India nadathiya thaakkudhalil andha thuraimugathil periya alavil paadhippu erpattadhu endru oru video

vedigundu thaakkudhalil kandeynargal patri erindha nilaiyil, sidharik kidakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paagisdhaanin karaachi thuraimugathil netru iravu Indhiya padaigal ruthra thaandavam aadiya kaatchi ..🔥🔥
paarkkave kangollaa kaatchiyaaga irukkiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum, pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiyaavukkul nuzhaindhu athumeeriya Pakistan payangaravaadhigalukku migak kadumaiyaana muraiyil India padhil alithu varugiradhu. Indha thaakkudhalil India-vukku paadhippu endru Pakistan nettisangal vadhandhi parappi varugindranar. Adhe pola Pakistan-il erpatta paadhippu endru ingulla silarum thavaraana veediyokkalai veliyittu varugindranar. Idhanaal, India nadathiya thaakkudhal meedhu ivargale veen sandhegathai erpaduthi varugindranar.
India karaachi thuraimugathin meedhu nadathiya thaakkudhalil migapperiya paadhippu erpattulladhu endru oru video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indhiya raanuvam karaachi thaakkudhal kaatchi endru endha veediyovaiyum veliyidavillai. Appadi irukkum podhu ivargalukku mattum eppadi ekskloosivaaga indha video kidaithirukkum endra kelvi ezhugiradhu.
Indha video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu kadandha epral (2025) maadha irudhiyil Iran-in thuraimugathil erpatta vivathin kaatchi endru indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhirundhadhaik kanduvidithom. Andha padhivugalil Iran-in pandhar appaas thuraimugathil erpatta vedivivathukkup piragu tron moolam edukkappatta video endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
2025 epral 27 andru pivisi veliyittirundha seythiyil, “paadhugaappu kuraivaadu kaaranamaaga Iran-in thuraimugathil migapperiya vivathu erpattadhu. Idhil 28 per uyirizhandhanar, 800kkum merpattor kaayam adaindhanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Paagisdhaanin meedhu India-vin raanuva thaakkudhal me maadham 7m thedhi thodangiyadhu. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovo epral maadham 28m thedhi samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu. Adhaavadhu Pakistan meedhaana thaakkudhal thodanguvadharku kittathatta 10 naatkalukku munbu indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi ulladhu. Ivai ellaam paagisdhaanin karaachi thuraimugam meedhu India nadathiya thaakkudhalil erpatta paadhippin kaatchi endru paravum video thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: “kudiyarasuth thalaivar aatchi amulbaduthi.. Pudhiya therdhal nadathuvadhe sari..”- sreedhar vembu
text:
Thamizhagathil Vijay-yin TVK 108 idangalai vendrum muzhu perumbaanmai ettaadhadhaal thongu sattasavai nilai uruvaagiyulladhu. Congress mattum aadharavu therivitha nilaiyil, matra katchigal thayakkam kaattugindrana. Indha soozhalil sreedhar vembu, kudiyarasuth thalaivar aatchi amulbaduthi, vaakkukkup panam thadaiseyyappatta kadumaiyaana marudherdhal nadathinaal mattume unmaiyaana makkal aadharavu velippadum enak koorugiraar.
Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal varalaaru kaanaadha oru mummunai pottiyai kandulladhu. Mudhal therdhalileye 34.92% vaakkugalai padhivuseytha Vijay-yin TVK 108 thogudhigalil vetrivetradhodu, 1967-kku piragu DMK, ADMK irandil ondrillaamal thaniverungatchiyaaga uruveduthulladhu. Melum mudhal therdhalil adhiga vaakkugalai petra emjiaarin (33.52%) saadhanaiyai muriyadithu Vijay varalaaru padaithullaar.
Vijay-yin TVK 108 thogudhigalai vendravodhilum, perumbaanmaiyai ettaadhadhaal thongu sattasavaiye Thamizhagathil erpattulladhu. Perumbaanmaiyai niroovikka Congress, VCK matrum idadhusaarigalukku TVK aadharavugoriyirukkum nilaiyil, Congress mattume idhuvarai aadharavu therivithulladhu.
Tharpodhu mothamaaga 112 thogudhigal irukkum soozhalil innum perumbaanmaiyai niroovikka 6 thogudhigal thevaiyaaga irukkindrana. Ippadiyaana soozhalil matra katchigal yaarum thavegavirku aadharavu therivikka munvaraadha soozhale irundhuvarugiradhu.
Innilaiyil thongusattasavai moolam aatchi niruvappattaal adhu nilaiyatradhaagave irukkum endrum, Thamizhagathil kudiyarasuth thalaivar aatchi niruvappattu pudhiya therdhal nadathuvadhe sariyendrum ZOHO niruvanathin thalaimai saindist sreedhar vembu therivithullaar.
Pudhiya therdhal nadathuvadhe sari..
X thalathil padhivittirukkum sreedhar vembu, “mejaaritti engal kidaikkavillai. Amaikkappadum endha arasaangamum palveru izhuvarigal matrum azhuthangalaal nilaiyatradhaagave irukkum. Tamil Nadu idhaivida sirandhadharkuth thagudhiyaanadhu.
Kudiyarasuth thalaivar aatchiyudan pudhiya therdhalgalai nadathuvadhe sirandha vazhiyaaga irukkalaam, 'vaakkukkup panam illai' endra migak kadumaiyaana amalaakkathudan idhaiseyalbadutha vendum. Appodhudhaan yaarukku unmaiyaana makkal aadharavu irukkiradhu enbadhu theriyum.
Marudherdhal nadathappattaal Vijay avargal thanipperumbaanmaiyudan meendum aatchikku varuvaar endru naan ninaikkiren. Adhai thimuga-adhimuga thadukka virumbinaal, avargal ondraagap poraadattum. BJP thanithup pottiyida vendum, adhu oru idathaik koodap peraavittaalum paravaayillai. Tamil Naattil BJP oru pudhiya thodakkathai merkolla vendiya neram idhu. Makkal pudhidhaagath theermaanikkattum” ena padhivittullaar.
Idharku nettisangal edhirppai padhivuseythu varugindranar.

headline: ‘thavarudhalaaga ilam jodi kaalil vizhundha Vijay’ – endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Maamallavuram nadandha aarudhal nigazhchiyin podhu thavarudhalaaga arai maaris sendru ilam jodi ondrin kaalil Vijay vizhundhaar endru oru news card

TVK thalaivarum nadigarumaana Vijay pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “vijay ilamjodi kaalil vizhundhadhaaga thagaval! Magaavalivurathil ulla natchathira hottalil netru nadaivetra aarudhal koorum nigazhvil, paadhikkappatta makkal ulla araikku padhilaaga ilam jodi irundha araikkul TVK thalaivar Vijay thavarudhalaaga nuzhaindhu avargal kaalil vizhundhadhaal sirudhu neram angu paravarappu erpattadhaaga thagaval” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karoor TVK pirasaara nigazhchiyin podhu erpatta kootta nerisalil sikki uyirizhandhavargalin kudumbathinarukku Vijay aarudhal koorum nigazhchi maamallavurathil ulla oru natchathira vidudhiyil vaithu nadathappattadhu. Indha nigazhchiyil pathirigaiyaalargal anumadhikkappadavillai. Indha nilaiyil, hottalil thangiyirundha ilam jodi ondrin araikkul thavarudhalaaga nuzhaindhu avargal kaalil vizhundha Vijay endru palarum samooga oodagangalil news card ondraip pagirndhu varugindranar.
Indha news card-ai paarkkum podhu pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pola irundhaalum siridhu enbadhai ezhuthup pizhaiyudan “sirudhu” endru kurippittirundhadhu, ilam jodi thangiyirundha araikku thavaraagas sendraar endra thagaval naiyaandi kalandhadhaaga irundhadhu ellaam idhu poliyaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu. Enave, indha news card thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha news kaardum illai. Enave, idhai pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom.
Namakku padhil alitha avar, indha news card poliyaanadhu endru kurippittu, idhu thodarbaaga pudhiya thalaimurai inaiyathalathil veliyittirundha padhivaiyum anuppinaar. Adhil, indha seythiyai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai endru kurippittu padhivittirundhanar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pennukku paaliyal thondharavu; petrol pangk melaalar kaidhu
text:
Tirunelveli: kangaigondaanil pennukku paaliyal thondharavu kodutha petrol pangk melaalar kanesh sandhiran 57, kaidhu seyyappattaar.
Virudhunagar maavattam, kaariyaappatti thaalugaa pudhuppattiyai serndha ivar, Tirunelveli maavattam kangaigondaanil ulla petrol pangil melaalaraaga paniyaatri vandhaar. Angu panivuriyum pennukku paaliyal thondharavu koduthullaar.
Idhu kuritha pugaaril kangaigondaan Police kanesh sandhiranai kaidhu seythanar.

headline: Roo.2,700 marundhu roo.27,000-kkaa? Ucha Needhimandram kadum adhirchi!
text:
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
athiyaavasiya putrunoy marundhu ondrin vilai, sillarai virpanaiyaalargalukku vazhangappadum vilaiyaivida 10 madangu adhigamaaga nirnayikkappattiruppadhaagak koorappatta vivagaarathil ucha Needhimandram kadum adhirupdhi therivithulladhu.
Athiyaavasiya marundhugalin vilaiyai kattuppaduthavum, marundhu niruvanangal matrum sillarai virpanaiyaalargalin adhigappadiyaana laavathaith thadukkavum kori thaakkal seyyappatta manu indru ucha needhimandrathil visaaranaikku vandhadhu. Melum, matrumoru manuvil maruthuvargal podhup peyaril ulla (generic) marundhugalai parindhuraippadhai urudhi seyya vendum endrum korappattirundhadhu.
Needhivadhigal vikram naath matrum sandheep methaa adangiya amarvu munbu, marundhugal thodarbaana indha irandu manukkal indru visaaranaikku vandhana. Appodhu, roo.2,700-kku sillarai virpanaiyaalargalukku vazhangappadum or athiyaavasiya putrunoy marundhin adhigavatcha sillarai vilai (MRP) roo.27,000 ena achidappattiruppadhaaga needhimandrathil therivikkappattadhu.
Idhaik ketta needhivadhigal, idhu miratti panam parippadhu illaiyendraal veru enna? Ena kelvi ezhuppinar. Melum, putrunoy sigichaikkaaga makkal veedugalaiyum nagaigalaiyum virkum nilaiyil, ithagaiya vilai nirnayam migavum adhirchiyalippadhaaga therivithanar. Marundhugalin vilaiyai kattuppadutha vendiya adhigaarigal idhuvondra vivagaarangalil nadavadikkai edukkaamal iruppadhu en endrum Needhimandram kelvi ezhuppiyadhu. Indha nilaimai noyaaligalukku edhiraana pattappagalil nadakkum kollai endrum needhivadhigal kadumaiyaagak kurippittanar.
Indha vazhakkin adutha visaaranai sepdambar 29-m thedhi nadaiverum ena ucha Needhimandram therivithulladhu.

headline: Thirudu pona 309 movail pongal meetkappattu uriyavargalidam oppadaippu
text:
Perumbaakkam: Chennai puranagar pagudhiyil thirudu pona, 309 movail pongalai kaippatriya Police uriyavargalidam oppadaithanar.
Thaambaram maanagara Police kamishanaragathirku utbatta semmanjjeri, kelambaakkam, selaiyoor aagiya moondru kaaval udhavik kamishanar saragathil ulla, 10 kaaval nilaiya ellaiyil thiruduppona movail pongal kandu pidithu tharumbadi pugaargal vandhana.
Idhaiyaduthu, pallikkaranai thunaik kamishanar raguvadhi matrum saivar kiraim Police inaindhu palveru maavattangal, maanilangalil irundhu vandhu, ingu thirudappatta movail pongalai meettanar. Kadandha pathu naatkalil mattum kaanathoor kaaval nilaiyathil, 60kkum merpatta movail pongalai parimudhal seythullanar.
Avvaaru parimudhal seyyappatta, 309 movail pongalai perumbaakkam kaaval nilaiyathil vaithu, uriyavargalidam oppadaikkum nigazhchi netru nadandhadhu. Semmanjjeri udhavik kamishanar kandhan urimaiyaalargalidam movail pongalai vazhanginaar.

headline: Aandhira arasil nadigar siranjjeevi magal.. Aadhikkam seluthum kudumbam!
text:
Thelunguth thiraiyulagin piravala nadigaraana siranjjeeviyin mootha magal sushmidhaa konidelaa, adhe thiraiyulagil munnani aadai vadivamaippaalaraagavum, thayaarippaalaraagavum iyangi varugiraar. Indha nilaiyil sushmidhaa konidelaavukku aandhira arasu or uyarndha poruppai vazhangiyulladhu. Avar, sree kanaga thurgaa (sree thurgaa mallesvara suvaami) thevasdhaanathin pudhiya arangaavalar kuzhuvil sirappu azhaippaalaraaga niyamikkappattullaar.
Thelunguth thiraiyulagin piravala nadigaraana siranjjeeviyin mootha magal sushmidhaa konidelaa, ivar thelunguth thiraiyulagil munnani aadai vadivamaippaalaraagavum, 'kolt paaks endardeyinments' endra niruvanathin moolam thiraippadath thayaarippaalaraagavum iyangi varugiraar. Melum, aandhirap piradhesa arasil kalai, sutrulaa matrum thiraippadath thurai saarndha aalosanaigal matrum orunginaippup poruppugalil kavanam seluthi varugiraar.
Siranjjeeviyin sagodhararum, aandhirap piradhesathin thunai mudhalvarumaana pavan kalyaan poruppetradhaith thodarndhu, maanilathin thiraithurai matrum sutrulaa membaattu nigazhvugalil sushmidhaavin thozhilmurai anuvavam payanbaduthappattu varugiradhu. Aandhira maanilathil sinimaa padappidippugalai adhigarippadhu, thiraiyulagak ulgattamaippai membaduthuvadhu matrum arasu saarndha kalai nigazhchigalai vadivamaippadhil ivar mukkiyap pangaatri varugiraar.
Indha nilaiyil, sushmidhaa konidelaavukku aandhira arasu or uyarndha poruppai vazhangiyulladhu. Vijayavaadaa indhirageelaathri malaiyil ulla sree kanaga thurgaa (sree thurgaa mallesvara suvaami) thevasdhaanathin pudhiya arangaavalar kuzhuvil sirappu azhaippaalaraaga sushmidhaa konidelaa niyamikkappattullaar. Aandhira arasu aanmigath thalangalai nirvaagikka amaithulla pudhiya thevasdhaana arangaavalar kuzhuvil indha niyamanam seyyappattulladhu.
Ikkuzhuvil idambetrulla uruppinargal matrum sirappu azhaippaalargal koyilin nirvaaga membaadu, pakdhargal vasadhi matrum aanmiga nigazhvugalai membaduthuvadhil mukkiyap pangaatruvar. Idhugurithup pesiya sushmidhaa, “kanaga thurkkai ammanin sevaiyil migundha pakdhiyudanum nermaiyudanum paniyaatruven” enath therivithiruppadhudan mudhalvar sandhiravaavu naayudu matrum aranilaiyathurai amaicharukku nandri therivithullaar. Idhanmoolam siranjjeeviyin kudumbam arasiyal, sinimaa, aanmigam ullittavatril aandhiraavil aadhikkam seluthivarugiradhu.

headline: Kovaa BJP amaicharin magal madhu podhaiyil thagaraaru endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kovaa maanila BJP amaicharin magal madhu podhaiyil Police-aridam thagaraaru seythaar endru oru video

pen oruvar Police-aridam thagaraaru seyyum avarai adikka muyatsi seyyum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Paarkka andha pen madhu podhaiyil ulladhu pola ulladhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “kovaa maanila BJP amaicharin magal kozhutha kudivodhaiyil, poleesgaararidam vambadi vambu seyyum kaatchi. “nandu kozhuthaal, valaiyil thangaadhu” enbaargal. “aatchi adhigaaram kidaithaal, aar.es.es-kaarargal attoozhiyam seyvaargal” enbadhu kaavik kaaligalin nadaimurai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kovaa maanila BJP amaicharin magal kudi podhaiyil thagaraaru seythadhaaga video ondru Facebook ullitta samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Aanaal, andha pennin appaa yaar endru kurippidappadavillai. Kovaavil BJP koottani aatchiyil 10 per amaichargalaaga ullanar. Idhil oruvar koottanik katchiyais serndhavar. Ivargalil yaarudaiya magalai ivargal kurippidugindraargal endru theriyavillai.
Koogulil kovaa amaicharin magal madhu podhaiyil thagaraaru seythadhu thodarbaaga seythi edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal, appadi endha oru seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2022m aandil indha video samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Adhil oruvar nadandha sambavam muzhuvadhaiyum 11 video padhivaaga 2022m aandu joon 19m thedhi thannudaiya X thala pakkathil veliyittirundhaar. Andha video-vai paarkkum podhu sambavam nadandhadhu magaaraashdiraavil endru theriyavandhadhu. Madhu podhaiyil andha pen saalaiyil thagaraaru seygiraar. Udan vandhavargal andha pennai amaidhippadutha muyalgindranar. Avargalaiyum adikkiraar. Kadaisiyil poleesaaraiyum thaakka muyatsi seygiraar. 11 veediyokkalaiyum paarthom. Adhil andha pen thannudaiya peyar arsithaa endru kooruvadhaik ketka mudindhadhu. Aanaal endha idathilum andha pen thannai amaicharin magal endru kooravillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu idhu thodarbaaga 2022m aandu maars maadham veliyaana seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Adhil indha sambavam mumbaiyil nadandhadhu. Madhu arundhivittu podhu idathil athumeeri nadandhu, kaaval thuraiyinaraith thaakka muyandradhaaga andha pen ullitta moondru per meedhu Police vazhakkup padhivu seythu kaidhu seythadhaaga adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Edhilum andha pen kovaa maanila BJP amaicharin magal endru kurippidappadavillai.
2022 maars maadhathil magaaraashdiraavil uthav thaakkare thalaimaiyilaana sivasenaa – Congress – thesiyavaadha Congress koottani aatchi irundhadhu. Indha video samooga oodagangalil viral aanadhu endru 2022 joon maadham 20m thedhi seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Appodhum kooda BJP angu aatchiyaik kaippatriyirukkavillai. BJP amaicharin magal ippadi podhu idathil athumeeri nadandhirundhaal adhai maraithirukka vendiya avasiyam sivasenaa koottani arasukku irundhirukkaadhu. Appadi maraikka vendum endru ninaithirundhaal nadandha sambavathaiye podhu veliyilirundhu azhithirukka mudiyum.
Indha pen thagaraaru seytha video-vai theevira valadhusaari BJP aadharavu oodagamaana opindia.com kooda veliyittirundhadhu. BJP amaicharin magalaaga irundhirundhaal andha seythiyai mutrilumaaga iruttadippu seythiruppaargal. Avargale thunindhu veliyittullaargal endraal ivar BJP amaicharin magalaaga irukka vaayppillai.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video magaaraashdiraa maanilathil 2022m aandu nadandhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Andha pen kovaa maanilathais saarndha BJP amaicharin magal enbadharku endha oru aadhaaramum illai. Andha pen meedhu vazhakkup padhivu seythu kaidhu seyyappattadhaaga appodhu veliyaana seythigal namakkuk kidaithullana. Idhan moolam pazhaiya video-vai eduthu thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “naadaargal thamizhargal alla” endru es.raajaa koorinaaraa?
text:
Naadaargal thamizhargal alla endru es.raajaa kooriyadhaaga oru video

BJP mootha thalaivar es.raajaa pesiya pechin oru sila vinaadigal mattum vetti samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “naadaar samudhaaya makkal thamizhargal alla” endru koorugiraar. Video meedhu, ‘naadaar samudhaaya makkal thamizhargal alla – es.raajaa’ endru kurippidappattulladhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naadaar samudhaaya makkal thamizhargal alla endru es.raajaa kooriyadhaaga munbu oru video viral-aaga paraviyadhu. Adhu thodarbaaga nammudaiya fekt kirasando thamizhil aayvu seytha podhu, kaalduvel appadik kooriyadhaaga es.raajaa pesiyadhu urudhi seyyappattadhu.
Tharpodhu, meendum naadaargal thamizhargal illai endru es.raajaa pesivittaar endru palarum veru oru video-vai viral-aaga pagirndhu varugindranar. Tamil Naattil adhiga alavil paajaga-vukku vaakku alikkum samudhaayamaaga naadaar makkal ullanar. Appadi irukkum podhu avargalukku edhiraaga BJP pesa vaayppillai. Melum muzhu pechaiyum podaamal, verum 3-4 vinaadi mattume pottullanar. Idhellaam indha video thagaval thavaraanadhaaga irukkum enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Aadhaarangal adippadaiyil idhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu namakku endha mudivum kidaikkavillai. YouTube-il indha vaarathil es.raajaa pesiya video kidaikkiradhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu ulaga piraamanargal nalasangathin aandu vizhaa koottathil es.raajaa pesiya video namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil ulla kaatchiyum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video kaatchiyum othupponadhu. Andha video-vai paarthom.
NewsTamil 24X7 indha pechai neradi olivarappu seythirundhadhu. Video-vin 1:7:30-vadhu mani nerathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda kaatchi varugiradhu. Adhil, kaalduvel thaan ezhudhiya mudhal puthagamaana saanaars aap Tirunelveli (unmaiyil andha puthagathin peyar The Tinnevelly Shanars) endra puthagathil naadaargal thamizhargal alla endru kooriyullaar endru pesinaar.
Naadaargal thamizhargal alla endru kaalduvel kooriyadhaaga es.raajaa pesiyirundhaar. Adhil kaalduvel enbadhai neekkivittu, es.raajaave neradiyaaga kooriyadhu pondru thotram alikkum vagaiyil video-vai edit seythu padhivittullanar. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Israel siraiyil theeviravaadhiyai uyirudan aasit thottiyil thallum kaatchi idhuvaa?
text:
Israel siraiyil paalasdheena kaidhigalai uyirudan aasit thottiyil irakki kolai seygiraargal endru oru video

kaidhi oruvarai avaayam endru ezhudhappattulla thotti ondrukkul irakki, elumbuk koodaaga maariya piragu avarai veliye edukkum video fesbakkil padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “isrel naattil siraiyil irukkum theevira vaadhikku vazhangappadum thandanai. (uyuru tan aasit tengk ulle irakki elumbuk koodaaga veliye edukkum kaatchi idhu pol ellaa theevira vaadhikkum thandanai vazhanga vendum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Israel siraiyil payangaravaadhigalai amilath thottiyil irakki kolai seygiraargal endru palarum video ondrai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aasit thottiyil uyirudan oruvarai irakkugindranar. Avar elumbuk koodaaga veliye varuvadhu pol video ulladhu.
Unmaiyil aasit thottiyil irakkiyirundhaal elumbu kooda minjjaadhu. Appadiye elumbu mattum urugaamal irundhirundhaalum kooda inaippugal ellaam arikkappattuk kuviyalaaga vizhundhirukkum. Aayvuk koodangalil vaikkappattirukkum elumbuk koodu pola muzhu udal elumbukkoodaaga varuvadharku vaayppe illai. Enave, idhu thiraippada kaatchiyaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Israel siraiyil paalasdheena kaidhigal kolai seyyappadum kaatchi endru kurippittu palarum indha video-vai padhivittirundhanar. Ivatrukku idaiye thaaylaandhu naattil haalivut sandaik kaatchi endru kurippittu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil irukkum idathil edukkappatta pala video-kkal namakku kidaithana.
Avatraip paartha podhu, vevveru naatkalil edukkappatta stant video idhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Kaidhi oruvarai adithu aasit thottikkul irakki, elumbu koodaaga avarai veliye eduppadhu pondru thinamum angu stant sho nadappadhu therindhadhu. 2012m aandil padhividappatta YouTube video namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhilum adhe kaatchi irundhadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thedi andha theem paarkkin inaiyadhalathaik kanduvidithom.
Adhil, haalivut aakshan sho endru kurippittu vilambaram seythirundhanar. Thozhilmurai sandaip payitsi kalainjargalaal nigazhthappadum haalivut sandaik kaatchi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Sandaik kaatchi nadaiverum idathin koogul street kaatchiyaiyum thedi eduthom. Oru pakkam rasigargal amara arangamum, edhir purathil sandai nadakkum idathin settum amaikkappattirundhadhu.
Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video Israel siraiyil payangaravaadhigal kolai seyyappadum kaatchi endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana. Thaaylaandhu theem paarkkin video-vai eduthu thavaraana thagaval serthup pagirndhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Sinimaavil aavaasam, vanmurai kaatchigalukku kattuppaadu; mathiya arasu vazhigaattudhal veliyeedu
text:
Pudhudilli: podhaipporul payanbaduthum kaatchigalukku pudhiya kattuppaadu, vayadhu saarndha saandridhazh pirivugal utbada thiraippada saandridhazhukkaana thiruthappatta vazhigaattudhalgalai mathiya thagaval matrum olivarappu amaichagam veliyittulladhu.
Mathiya thagaval matrum olivarappu amaichagathin keezh seyalbadum, si.pi.ep.si., enappadum, mathiya thiraippada thanikkai vaariyam kadandha 16m thedhi seeramaikkappattadhu. Adhanbadi, 18 per konda pudhiya kuzhuvum amaikkappattadhu. Idhan thodarchiyaaga, thiraippada saandridhazhukkaana thiruthappatta vazhigaattudhalgalai mathiya thagaval matrum olivarappu amaichagam veliyittulladhu. Idhu thodarbaana utharavai si.pi.ep.si., than samooga valaidhala pakkathil veliyittulladhu. Adhan vivaram:
* podhaipporutkal payanbaadu, kadathal pondra kaatchigalil sattappoorva echarikkai kattaayam idambera vendum. Indha kaatchigalil ini, 'podhaipporutkal payanbaduthuvadhu sattavirodham; idhu aarokkiyathai seerazhikkum matrum siraithandanaiyai urudhippaduthum; podhaipporutkalukku 'no' sollungal' endra echarikkai idambera vendum.
* thiraippadangalukku vayadhu saarndha vagaiyil, yu/e 7+, 13+, 16+ aagiya pirivugalin keezh saandridhazh vazhangappadum. Muraiye, 7, 13, 16 vayadhukku merpattavargal idharkaana saandridhazh alikkappatta thiraippadangalai kaana anumadhikkappaduvar.
* madhu arundhudhal, podhaipporul pazhakkam, pugaiyilai nugarvu aagiyavatrai niyaayappaduthuvadhaiyo alladhu ookkappaduthuvadhaiyo thiraippadangal kaattakkoodaadhu.
* inam, madham alladhu pira kuzhukkalai izhivuppaduthum kaatchigal alladhu vaarthaigalukku thadai vidhikkappadugiradhu. Vaguppuvaadha, pirpokkuthanamaana, ariviyalukku edhiraana alladhu thesavirodha manappaanmaigalai ookkuvikkum ulladakkathukkum thadai vidhikkappadum.
* paaliyal vanmurai alladhu seendal utbada, pengalai izhivuppaduthum kaatchigal kaattappadakkoodaadhu. Athagaiya kaatchigal karupporulukku poruthamaanadhaaga irukkum patchathil, avai kuraindhavatcha alavil vaikkappada vendum matrum thevaiyatra vivarangalai kondirukkakkoodaadhu. * vanmurai utbada samooga virodha seyalgalai niyaayappaduthum alladhu ookkuvikkum kaatchigalukku anumadhi illai.
Ivvaaru adhil koorappattulladhu.

headline: Amithshaa kaaladiyil Stalin iruppadhu pondru kavar photo veliyittadhaa aanandha vigadan?
text:
Amithshaa kaaladiyil M.K. Stalin amarndhiruppadhu pola, thogudhi maruvaraiyaraikku oge sollum DMK endru aanandha vigadan attai padam veliyittadhaaga oru padhivu

mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaa kaalaruge Tamil Naattin munnaal mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin amarndhirundhu eriyum kaagidhathai oodhi anaikka muyatsippadhu pondru aanandha vigadan vaara idhazhin attaip padam veliyittadhu pondra pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “thogudhi maruvaraikku oge sollum thimuga” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padathaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Mathiya arasu nadathiya anaithuk katchi koottathirkup piragu DMK naadaalumandra kuzhuth thalaivar ti.aar.paalu matrum Trichy sivaa aagiyor niruvargalai sandhithanar. Appodhu, “naadaalumandrath thogudhigalai maruvaraiyarai seyvadhu endha adippadaiyil amaiyap pogiradhu enbadhu kuritha adhigaarappoorvamaana endhavoru thagavalaiyum mathiya arasu idhuvarai edhirkkatchigalukku vazhangavillai. Thogudhigalin ennikkaiyai 25 mudhal 50 sadhaveedham varai uyartha arasu thittamittulladhaaga oodagangalil veliyaagum seythigal yaavum anumaanangalin adippadaiyilaanavai; adhigaarappoorvamaanavai alla.
Then maanilangalin naadaalumandrap piradhinidhithuvam paadhikkappadum vagaiyil endha vadivathil thogudhi maruseeramaippu masodhaa konduvarappattaalum, adhai DMK edhirkkum” endru kooriyirundhanar.
Aanaal mathiya arasu kondu vara ulla thogudhi maruvaraiyarai masodhaavukku DMK aadharavu alikkiradhu thamizhagathin aalum katchigalum, avargal saarbu oodagaviyalaalargalum thodarndhu karuthaip padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha nilaiyil thi.mu.ka-vin indha seyalai aanandha vigadan vimarsithu attaip padathai veliyittadhaaga oru pugaippadam samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Attaippadath thalaippu seythiyil, “maruvaraiyarai” enbadhai thavaraaga “maruvarai” endru kurippittirundhanar. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda attaippadathil puthagathin thedhi joolai 24, 2026 endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Vazhakkamaaga aanandha vigadan viyaazhakkizhamai thedhigalil mattume veliyaagum. Joolai 24 vellikkizhamai enbadhaal indha pugaippadam poliyaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvaith thodarndhom. 2026m aandil joolai maadham veliyaana aanandha vigadan idhazhgalin attaip padangalai adhan inaiyadhalathirkus sendru paarthom. Naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra attaippadathai aanandha vigadan veliyidavillai. Kadaisiyaaga mudhalvar Vijay-yin magan jesan pugaippadathudan attaippadam (joolai 21, 2026) veliyittirundhanar. Andha puthagathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam pondru karuthuppadam edhum veliyittullaargalaa endru paarthom. Appadi edhuvum veliyaagi irukkavillai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhu enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla aanandha vigadan digital poruppaalarukku indha pugaippadathai WhatsApp moolam anuppi visaarithom. Idhai paarthadhum idhu poliyaana pugaippadam idhai aanandha vigadan veliyidavillai endru avarum urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadam poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ’adhiga neram moochai adakkuvadhu aavathu..’ maruthuvargal echarikkai!
text:
Moochai evvalavu neram adakka mudigiradhu enbadhaik kondu nuraiyeeral aarokkiyathai madhippida mudiyaadhu; udarpayitsi nilai, moochaik kattuppaduthum pazhakkam, kaarban tai aaksaidu thaangum thiran pondravai idhai theermaanikkindrana ena nivunargal koorugindranar. Neenda neram moochai adakkuvadhu aaksijan kuraivaattai erpaduthi palaveenam, kuzhappam, mayakkam pondra aavathugalai tharum enbadhaal, nuraiyeeral kuritha sandhegangalukku maruthuva parisodhanaiye paadhugaappaana vazhi ena valiyuruthappadugiradhu.
Oru nimidam .... Irandu nimidam ...adharkumel moochai adakka mudindhaal,nuraiyeeral aarokkiyamaaga iruppadhaaganinaippadhu thavaru.. Maaraaga namadhuudalukkul nadakkum maatrangal verumaadhiriyaanavai....
Podhuvaaga naam moochai izhuthuadakkiya nodiye, udalukkulirukkum aaksijanai, selgalbayanbadutha thodangugindrana.. Adhenerathil suvaasathin moolam veliyeravendiya kaarban tai aaksaidu,rathathil padippadiyaaga adhigarikkiradhu...thodarndhu adhigarikka adhigarikka,udane moochu vida vendum endraazhutham undaagiradhu. Siridhunerathileye nenjjil azhuthamerpaduvadhu pondrum, siladhannichaiyaana asaivugalumerpadalaam....
Aanaal thodarchiyaaga neenda nerammoochai adakkumbodhu , rathathilulla aaksijan alavu kuraindhu,thalaisutral, palaveenam, kuzhappambondra arigurigal erpadalaamendrum, miga adhigamaaga aaksijan kuraindhaal, mayakkam,suyaninaivinmai erpadum endrummaruthuva nivunargal echarikkindranar..kurippaaga idhaya matrum nuraiyeeralbirachanai ullavargal,maruthuvargalin aalosanaiyindri,moochai adakkum payitsiyinaimerkollakkoodaadhu endrumarivuruthugindranar...
Adheneram evvalavu neram moochaiadakka mudiyum enbadhai kondunuraiyeeralgalin aarokkiyathaiganakkida mudiyaadhu endrum,oruvarudaiya udarpayitsi, moochaigattuppaduthum pazhakkam, kaarban taiaaksaidu alavai thaangum thiranbondra kaaranigal, moochai adakkumnerathai maatrum endrum maruthunivunargal therivikkindranar....
Melumnuraiyeeral aarokkiyathil sandhegamiruppin, muraiyaana maruthuvavarisodhanai seythu kolvadhe sirandhavaadhugaappu engindranar maruthuvargal

headline: Azhugiya nilaiyil oozhiyar sadalam meetbu
text:
Salem: aattaiyaambatti, thiyaagi sellappan veedhiyai serndhavar raguvadhi, 43. Thirumanam seythu kol-laamal thaniye vasitha ivar, kaalippattiyil ulla nidhi niruvanathil panam vasool seyyum velai seythu vandhaar.
'alsar' pirasnaiyaal udalnilai paadhikkap-pattu raasivuram arasu maruthuvamanaiyil sigichai petru vandhaar. 4 naatkalaaga, avar, veettil irundhu veliye varavillai. Netru maalai, veettil irundhu thurnaatram veesu-vadhaaga akkambakkathinar pugaar therivithanar. Idhai arindhu, vennandhoor adutha minnak-kallil vasikkum avaradhu sagodharar ravi, 56, veettukkul sendru paarthavodhu, raguvadhi udal azhugiya nilaiyil irandhu kidappadhu therindhadhu.
Avaradhu pugaarbadi, aattaiyaambatti Police, irandhavarin udalai meettu visaarikkindranar.

headline: Japan-il vatti vigidham 31 aandugalil illaadha uyarvu
text:
Ja ppaanin mathiya vangiyaana 'pengk aap Japan' netru, vatti vigidhathai 0.25 sadhaveedham uyarthi, 1.25 sadhaveedhamaaga nirnayithulladhu. Idhu, kadandha 31 aandugalil illaadha uyarvaagum. Erkanave airoppiya mathiya vangiyum, America pedaral vangiyum vatti vigidhangalai uyarthiyullana.
Merkaasiya por, kachaa enney vilai uyarvu pondra kaaranangalaal, sarvadhesa alavil panaveekka azhutham kaanappadugiradhu. Idhai samaalippadharkaagave, mathiya vangigal vatti vigidhathai uyarthi varuvadhaaga nivunargal koorugindranar.

headline: Mettaavin ragasiyangal leek.. 20 vayadhu pen thodarndha vazhakku.. Jukkarberkkai thinaraditha kelvigal!
text:
Samooga oodagangal siraargalaith thittamitte adimaiyaakkugindranavaa? Laavathirkaaga ilaiya thalaimuraiyin mananalam adagu vaikkappadugiradhaa? Indha adhiradi kelvigalukkup padhilalikka, mettaa niruvanathin thalaimais seyal adhigaari maark jukkarberk, kalivorniyaa needhimandrathil mudhalmuraiyaaga oru joori munnilaiyil aajaraagiyullaar. Ulagame utru nokkum indha 'Social Media Addiction' kuritha vazhakkin virivaana thagavalgalai inge paarkkalaam..
Instaagiraam matrum Facebook thalangal, siruvargalaith thangal seyaligalukku adimaiyaakkum vagaiyil vadivamaikkappattulladhaagath thodarappatta aayirakkanakkaana vazhakkugalil, idhu oru munnodi (Landmark trial) vazhakkaagum. Tharpodhu 20 vayadhaagum 'keli' (Kaley) endra ilamben, thaan sirumiyaaga irundhavodhu indhas seyaligalaal kadum mana ulaichalukkum tharkolai ennangalukkum thallappattadhaagak koori mettaa matrum YouTube meedhu vazhakkuth thodarndhullaar.
Needhimandrathil sikkiya aadhaarangal!
Needhimandra visaaranaiyin podhu, munnani vazhakkarinjar maark laaniyar (Mark Lanier) mettaa niruvanathin adhirchiyoottum ulnaattu minnanjjalgalai aadhaarangalaaga munvaithaar. Kurippaaga, mettaavin munnaal ulagalaaviya vivagaarath thalaivar nik kilek (Nick Clegg) ezhudhiya minnanjjal ondril, "niruvanathin vayadhuk kattuppaadugal muraiyaaga amalbaduthappadavillai, idhanaal naangal engalaal mudindha anaithaiyum seygirom endru kooruvadhu kadinam" ena avar kavalai therivithullaar. Melum, 13 vayadhukkutbatta 'tveens' (Tweens) enappadum siruvargalaith thalathil thakkavaippadhu kurithum, 2017-aam aandil 'teenej' (Teenage) payanargalai adhigarippadhe niruvanathin mudhanmai ilakku ena jookkarberk nirnayithadhum ambalamaanadhu.
Idharkup padhilalitha maark jookkarberk, vazhakkarinjargal thanadhu minnanjjalgalaith thavaraagas sitharippadhaaga kutram saattinaar. Siruvargalukkenap paadhugaappaana 'mesanjjar kits' pondra thalangalai uruvaakkuvadhu kurithe thaangal vivaadhithadhaagavum, adhaith thanadhu sondhak kuzhandhaigale payanbaduthuvadhaagavum kooriyullaar.
Maarkkai thinaraditha kelvi..
Visaaranaiyin oru pagudhiyaaga, 'adimaithanam' kuritha kaarasaaramaana vivaadhaangal nadaivetradhu. Instaagiraam thalaivar aadam moseri (Adam Mosseri) munnadhaaga alitha saatchiyathil, oru naalaikku 16 manineram payanbaduthuvadhai adimaithanam endru koora mudiyaadhu ena vaadhittirundhaar.
Idhu kurithu jookkarberkkidam kettavodhu, "oru vishayam payanulladhaaga irundhaal makkal adhai adhigamaagap payanbaduthuvaargal" enap padhilalithaar. Aanaal, podhaikku adimaiyaanavargalum oru porulaith thedith thedip payanbaduthuvaargale endra vazhakkarinjarin kelvikku, thannidam thelivaana padhil illai enbadhai avar maraimugamaaga oppukkondaar.
Tikdaak matrum snaapsaat niruvanangal meedhaana vazhakku..
Indha vazhakkil erkanave kutram saattappattirundha tikdaak matrum snaapsaat niruvanangal, needhimandrathirku veliye ragasiyamaagas samarasam seythugondu veliyerivittana. Aanaal, mettaavum koogulin yoodiyooppum mattume indhas sattap poraattathaith thodarndhu nadathi varugindrana.
Aasdhireliyaa pondra naadugal erkanave 16 vayadhukkutbattavargalukkus samooga oodagath thadai vidhithulla nilaiyil, America Needhimandram alikkappogum indhath theerppu, ulagalaaviya digital thalangalin edhirgaalathaith theermaanikkum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.

headline: Udhayanidhi thogudhiyil reshan kadaigal katti mudithum appadiye ullana; amaichar vengadaramanan
text:
Chennai: ''edhirgatchi thalaivar udhayanidhiyin seppaakkam - thiruvallikkeni thogudhiyil, moondru reshan kadaigal kattappattu, appadiye irukkindrana,'' ena, unavu thurai amaichar vengadaramanan therivithaar.
Chennai, soolaimedil pudhiya reshan kadaiyai savaanaayagar je.si.ti.piraavagar, amaichar vengadaramanan thodangi vaithanar.
Pin, vengadaramanan alitha petti: athiyaavasiya porutkalin vilai uyarvai thadukka, maanilam muzhudhum thinamum, 61 porutkalin vilai vivarangal kangaanikkappattu varugindrana.
Emelekkal nidhiyil katti mudikkappatta, kattappattu varum reshan kadaigalai aayvu seythu, thuridhamaaga thirakka nadavadikkai edukkappadugiradhu. Thirakkappatta naalil irundhe, andha kadaigalil porutkal vazhangappadum.
Idhevol pala idangalil, kurippaaga solla vendum enil, edhir katchi thalaivar Udhayanidhi emelevaaga ulla seppaakkam- thiruvallikkeni thogudhiyil, moondru reshan kadaigal kattappattu, appadiye irukkindrana.
Katti mudithu oru maadhamaagi ulladhu. Avar thedhi odhukkiyadhum, akkadaigal thirandhu vaikkappadum. Idhevol, pudhidhaaga kattappatta reshan kadaigalai thirakka em.el.e.,kkal neram odhukkinaal udane thirakkappattu, makkal payanbaattirku varum. Ivvaaru avar koorinaar

headline:
Poodhaagaramaagum SIR vivagaaram..
Therdhal aanaiyathukkulleye edhirppu? Marudherdhal korum edhirkkatchigal!
text:
Poodhaagaramaagum SIR vivagaaram.. Therdhal aanaiyathukkulleye edhirppu? Marudherdhal korum edhirkkatchigal!
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
vaakkaalar pattiyalil thagudhiyatravargal, irandhavargal, idam maariyavargal matrum irattaip padhivugal ullittavatrai kandarindhu pattiyalaith thiruthuvadharkaaga Special Intensive Revision enappadum SIR nadavadikkaiyai therdhal aanaiyam merkondu varugiradhu. Aanaal, indha nadavadikkaiyaal thagudhiyaana vaakkaalargalin peyargalum neekkappadakkoodum endrum, SIR nadaimuraiyil podhiya velippadaithanmai illai endrum edhirkkatchigal thodarndhu kutrachaattugalai munvaithu varugindrana.
Indha nilaiyil, therdhal aanaiyathil ulla moondru therdhal aanaiyargalil sukbeer sing sandhu matrum vivek joshi aagiya iruvarum, kadandha 10 maadhangalil palveru mudivugal thodarbaaga kuraindhadhu 14 murai aatchevanai therivithadhaaga indru veliyaana thagaval perum vivaadhathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Vaakkaalar peyargalais serppadhu, neekkuvadhu, meendum serppadhu ullitta nadavadikkaigal thodarbaaga avargal kelvi ezhuppiyadhaagavum thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, Congress mootha thalaivar raagul kaandhi therdhal aanaiyathaik kadumaiyaaga vimarsithullaar. Vaakkuth thiruttu enbadhu Indhiya makkalukku edhiraana kutram endrum, idhu arasiyalamaippin meedhu nadathappadum neradi thaakkudhal endrum avar therivithullaar. Melum, BJP, aareses matrum therdhal aanaiyam inaindhu thesath thurogas seyalil eeduvattulladhaagavum raagul kaandhi kutramsaattiyullaar.
Merku vanga mudhalamaichar mamdhaa paanarjiyum indha vivagaarathil thanadhu edhirppai padhivu seythullaar. SIR matrum therdhal aanaiyathin seyalbaadugalai munvaithu, merku vangathil marudherdhal nadatha vendum ena avar korikkai vaithullaar. Idhumattumindri, thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaarukku edhiraaga kaidhu matrum kutraviyal nadavadikkai edukka vendum endrum mamdhaa paanarji valiyuruthiyullaar.
Idhevol, sivasenaa yuvidi thalaivar uthav thaakkarevum therdhal aanaiyathin seyalbaadugal kurithu kelvi ezhuppiyullaar. Thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaarai udanadiyaaga padhaviyil irundhu neekka vendum endrum, avar meedhu nadavadikkai edukka vendum endrum uthav thaakkare therivithullaar. Melum, magaaraashdiraa, merku vangam matrum Tamil Naattil nadaivetra therdhalgalai rathu seythu, meendum therdhal nadatha vendum endrum, andhath therdhalgalai vaakkucheettu muraiyil nadatha vendum endrum uthav thaakkare korikkai vaithullaar.
Thamizhnaattilum indha vivagaaram thodarbaaga DMK thalaivar M.K. Stalin indru arikkai veliyittullaar. Therdhal aanaiyargal iruvar 10 maadhangalil 14 murai aatchevanai therivithadhaaga veliyaagiyirukkum thagaval, SIR-kku pinnar nadaivetra sattapperavaith therdhal mudivugalaiyum kelvikkullaakkuvadhaaga M.K. Stalin therivithullaar. Thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaar iniyum andhap padhaviyil needikkak koodaadhu endrum, avarai udanadiyaaga padhavineekkam seyya vendum endrum avar valiyuruthiyullaar. Adhevol, SIR nadavadikkaigalai nirutha vendum endrum, therdhal aanaiyathil nadaivetradhaaga koorappadum anaithu vivagaarangalaiyum niyaayamaana muraiyil visaarikka vendum endrum Stalin korikkai vaithullaar.
Idharkidaiye, therdhal aanaiyam indru vilakkam alithulladhu. Therdhal aanaiyathil uruppinargal thangaladhu karuthugal, kelvigal matrum aalosanaigalai padhivu seyvadhu vazhakkamaana nadaimurai endrum, irudhi mudivu eduppadharku munbaana vivaadhathin oru pagudhiyaagave ivai iruppadhaagavum aanaiyam therivithulladhu. Melum, moondru therdhal aanaiyargalidaiye maaruvatta karuthugal iruppadhu iyalbaanadhu endrum, kadandha oraandil SIR ullitta therdhal aanaiyathin anaithu adhigaarappoorva mudivugalum muzhu therdhal aanaiyathin orumitha mudivugalaagave edukkappattadhaagavum ECI therivithulladhu. Anaithu utharavugalum satta nadaimuraigalukku utbatte pirappikkappattulladhaagavum therdhal aanaiyam vilakkam alithulladhu.
Oruvuram, therdhal aanaiyathukkulleye SIR thodarbaaga aatchevanaigal ezhundhadhaaga veliyaagiyirukkum thagavalai munvaithu edhirkkatchith thalaivargal maru therdhal korikkai ezhuppi varuvadhu arasiyal vattaarangalil paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Isreludanaana thoodharaga uravai sbeyin thundithadhai kondaadiya sbeyin makkal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Isrelukkaana sbeyin thoodharai sbeyin arasu nirandharamaaga thirumba petradhai sbeyin makkal kondaadinar endru oru video

saalaiyil aayirakkanakkaana makkal thirandu kondaattathil eeduvatta video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vin meedhu thamizhil, “sbeyin naattil paalasdheena thoodharagathai amaithadharkum, Israel thoodharagathai moodiyadharkum sbeyin makkal kondaadi magizhchiyadaigiraargal” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “sbeyin ulla Israel thoodharagam moodappattamaiyinaal annaattu makkal adhanai sandhoshathil kondaadinar..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum, pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kaasaa meedhaana thaakkudhalaik kandithu sbeyin naadu kadandha 2025m aandu thanadhu Israel naattukkaana thoodhuvaraith thirumbap petradhu. Indha nilaiyil 2026 maars 11m thedhi Israel naattukkaana sbeyin thoodharaga padhavi mudivukku varuvadhaaga thanadhu adhigaarappoorva arasidhazhil sbeyin arasu arivithadhu. Indha arivippai sbeyin makkal kondaadiyadhaaga video ondru samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil paalasdheenathudanaana thoodharaga uravai thodangiyadharkaagavum, isreludanaana thoodharaga uravai thundithadharkaagavum sbeyin makkal kondaadinaargal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Paalasdheenathudanaana thoodharaga uravai sbeyin eppodhu thodangiyadhu endru thediya podhu, 2024m aandu thodangiyiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video 2025 joolai maadhathilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Al jaseera endra sarvadhesa oodagam indha video-vai 2025 joolai maadham veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil, “sbeyinin pamplonaa nagaril nadaivetra saan fermin (San Fermin festival) thiruvizhaavil pangetra aayirak kanakkaanor sudhandhira Palestine kori muzhakkamittanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha thagaval adippadaiyil thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu, 2025 joolai 6m thedhi veliyaana pala seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Adhil, ovvoru aandum sbeyin pamplonaa endra nagaril joolai maadham 6m thedhi saan fermin thiruvizhaa nadaiveruvadhu vazhakkam. Indha aandu thiruvizhaavaanadhu sudhandhira paalasdheenathirku aadharavu, paalasdheenathil nadandhu varum ina azhippukku edhirppu therivippadhu endra maiyakkaruthin adippadaiyil nadandhadhu. Thiruvizhaavil kalandhugondavargal paalasdheenathukku aadharavaaga koshangalai ezhuppinar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam isreludanaana thoodharaga uravai sbeyin thundithadharku aadharavaaga sbeyin makkal saalaiyil irangi magizhchiyai velippaduthinar endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Si.vi. Sanmugam patri pagirappadum poliyaana news kaardu…
text:
‘‘thookku pottu saagalaamaa alladhu visha marundhu kudithu saagalaamaa’’, endru si.vi. Sanmugam kooriyadhaaga,

headline: Oodagangal maraitha raagul kaandhiyin perani endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaaril raagul kaandhiyin yaathiraikku adhiga alavil makkal koottam koodiyadhaal adhai oodagangal kaattaamal maraithuvittana endru koori oru video

saalaiyil latchakkanakkaanor thirandirukkum video Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Andha video-vil, “Jannayak Rahul Gandi” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “raagul kaandhi varalaatrai ezhudhiyullaar. Raagul kaandhi anaithu saadhanaigalaiyum muriyadithuvittaar endru kodi meedeeyaa oruvodhum solla maattaargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar vaakkaalar pattiyalil irundhu pala latcham per neekkappattadhai kandithu Congress thalaivar raagul kaandhi perani nadathi varugiraar. Indha nilaiyil raagul kaandhiyin peraniyil kalandhugonda makkal endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vil aambulans ondru selvadhai kaattugindranar. Engeyum Congress katchiyin kodiyai kaanavillai.
Sila maadhangalukku munbu poori jegannaadhar kovil therottathin podhu latchakkanakkaana makkal koodiyirundha nerathil aambulans vaaganathirku vazhivittadhu thodarbaana seythi viral aagiyirundhadhu. Paarkka poori jegannaadhar kovil therotta video pol therindhadhu. Enave, indha video sandhegathai erpaduthave indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai 2025 joon maadhathil irundhu palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhulladhai kaana mudindhadhu. Avatril poori jegannaadhar kovil endru kurippittu avargal padhivittirundhanar. Raagul kaandhi peegaaril merkondu varum perani aagast maadham thodangiyadhu. Aanaal, veediyovo joon maadhame veliyaagi ulladhu. Idhan moolam idhu raagul kaandhiyin peraniyin video illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indha video poori jegannaadhar kovil therottathin podhu edukkappattadhu endru palarum padhivittirundhanar. Idhai urudhi seythugolla koogul street viyoo kidaikkiradhaa endru paarthom. Kovilukku sellum paadhaiyil koogul street viyoo illai. Aanaal, koogul meppil melirundhu paarkkum podhu andha saalaiyin mudivil kovil iruppadhai kaana mudigiradhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovilum saalaiyin mudivil vellai kovurangaludan jegannaadhar kovil iruppadhai kaana mudigiradhu. Ivai ellaam indha video odisaavil ulla poori jegannaadhar aalayathirku sellum vazhiyil edukkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Indha aandu radha yaathirai joon 27m thedhi nadandhadhu. Adharku munbaagave indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idhu pazhaiya video-vaaga irukkalaam. Indha video eppodhu edukkappattadhu endra aayvukkul naam sellavillai. Indha video raagul kaandhi peraniyin video-vaa illaiyaa endru mattume aayvu seythom. Nammudaiya aayvil indha video poori jegannaadhar kovil therottathin podhu edukkappattadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu.

headline: 5 maanila sattapperavaith therdhal.. BJP selavazhithadhu ithanai kodiyaa? Veliyaana adhirchith thagaval!!
text:
2026 sattapperavaith therdhalgalil 5 maanilangalil BJP, roo.529 kodikkum adhigamaaga therdhal selavu seythulladhaaga, akkatchi thaakkal seythulla therdhal selavuk kanakkugalin moolam theriyavandhulladhu.
Tamil Nadu, asaam, keralaa, pudhucheri matrum merkuvangam aagiya 5 maanilangalilum BJP seythadhaagak kurippidappattulla motha therdhal selavu roo.529 kodiye 39 latcham idhil, merkuvangathildhaan BJP adhigavatchamaaga roo.286 kodiye 99 latcham selavu seythulladhaagak koorappattulladhu. Idhu 5 maanilangalilum BJP seytha motha selavil paadhikkum adhigamaagum.
Merkuvangathil Congress thaakkal seytha kanakkil roo.27 kodiye 65 latcham selavu kurippidappattulladhu. Idhanbadi, iru katchigalin kanakkugalukku idaiye sumaar roo.259 kodi vithiyaasam ulladhu. Asaamil BJP roo.96 kodiye 27 latchamum, Congress roo.30 kodiyum selavu seythadhaagak kanakkugal therivikkindrana. Keralaavil BJP roo.82 kodiye 67 latchamum, Congress roo.27 kodiye 67 latchamum selavu seythadhaagak koorappattulladhu.
Aanaal, Tamil Naattil indha nilai maaruvattulladhu. Ingu BJP roo.51 kodiye 56 latcham selavu seythadhaagak kanakku thaakkal seythulladhu. Adhenerathil, DMK-vin kanakkil thamizhnaattukkaana selavaaga roo.193 kodiye 70 latcham kurippidappattulladhu. Pudhucheriyil BJP roo.11 kodiye 90 latchamum, DMK roo.1 kodiye 95 latchamum selavu seythadhaagak kanakkugal therivikkindrana.
5 maanilangalin kanakkugalai oppidumbodhu, BJP-yin motha selavu roo.529 kodiye 39 latchamaagavum, DMK-vin selavu roo.197 kodiye 85 latchamaagavum, ADMK-vin selavu roo.112 kodiye 40 latchamaagavum, Congress-in selavu roo.95 kodiye 52 latchamaagavum ulladhu.
“therdhal selavil velippadaithanmaiyai urudhi seyvadharkaaga, therdhalukkup piragu arasiyal katchigal thangaladhu therdhal selavuk kanakkugalai therdhal aanaiyathidam thaakkal seyya vendum. Sattapperavaith therdhalaip poruthavarai, therdhal mudindha 75 naatkalukkul indhak kanakkai samarppikka vendum” enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Padhavi mogathudan therdhalukku thayaaraavom endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
‘’padhavi mogathudan therdhalukku thayaaraavom,’’ endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ Stalin Model Core 🤡 unmaiya solradhukkum oru manasu venum. Vaazhthugal vaazhthugal M. K. Stalin ! #DMKFailsTN #ByeByeStalin,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan video ondru inaikkappattulladhu.
Indha video-vil, ‘’edho aatchip poruppukku vandhom; poruppai marandhu padhavi mogathil irundhom; sila kavarchith thittangalai senjjom; maruvadiyum padhavi mogathodu therdhalukku thayaaraavom,’’ endru Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin pesum kaatchi idambetrulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, M.K. Stalin pesiyadhil oru pagudhiyai mattum edit seythu, ivvaaru vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha sepdambar 15, 2025 andru Chennai, kalaivaanar arangathil “anbukkarangal’’ endra samooga nalath thittathai Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin thodangi vaithaar.
Indha nigazhchiyil pesiya mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin, ‘’ arasiyal endraal palar enna ninaikkiraargal endraal, edho aatchip poruppukku vandhom; poruppai marandhu padhavi mogathil irundhom; sila kavarchith thittangalai senjjom; maruvadiyum padhavi mogathodu therdhalukku thayaaraavom endru silar ninaikkiraargal,’’ endru kurippittaar.
Aanaal, M.K. Stalin pesiyadhil oru pagudhiyai mattum edit seythu, thavaraana artham karpithu, vendumendre vadhandhi parappugiraargal.

headline: Adhivar tirambudan China adhivar jinbing sandhippu; thozhil thuvanga varumaaru America-vukku azhaippu
text:
Vaashingdan: seenaavil thozhil thuvanga varumaaru America niruvanangalukku China adhivar jinbing azhaippu viduthullaar. Adhivar tirambudanaana sandhippin podhu, America niruvanangalukku thangalin kadhavu eppodhum thirandhiruppadhaaga kooriyullaar.
Arasu murai payanamaaga America sendrulla China adhivar ji jinbingirku America adhivar Trump utsaaga varaverpalithaar. Adhanbiragu, irunaattu thalaivargalin sandhippu nigazhchi adhivar maaligaiyaana vellai maaligaiyil nadaivetradhu.
Appodhu, adhivar Trump pesiyadhaavadhu; China adhivar jinbing matrum avaradhu manaivi peng aagiyorai vellai maaligaikku varaverpadhil perumagizhchi adaigiren. America-vukku 2vadhu muraiyaaga arasu payanam merkondulla mudhal China adhivar endra perumaiyai jin ping petrullaar. America-vin niruvana vizhaavin 250vadhu aandu niraivaik kurikkum indhas sirappumikka tharunathil avargal varugai purindhullanar. Melum avargal sudhandhirap piragadanam matrum arasiyalamaippus sattam pondra varalaatrus sinnangalaik kaana ullanar.
Kadandha me maadham naan merkonda seenap payanathinbodhu, naangal varthaga vaariyathai uruvaakkinom. Idhu oru pudhiya vazhimuraiyaaga amaindhadhodu, nambamudiyaadha alavirku vetriyum petrulladhu. America vivasaayigal matrum kaalnadai valarpporukkaana pudhiya sandhai vaayppugal utbada, iru tharappukkum idaiye migavum seeraana varthaga uravai ookkuvikkum vagaiyil engal kuzhukkal paniyaatri varugindrana.
Indhap payanathinbodhu, paadhugaappu, thozhilnutbam matrum sooppar indelijens thodarbaana mukkiya vivagaarangal kurithum naangal vivaadhippom. Ithuraigalil indru naam edukkum mudivugal, varavirukkum pala aandugalukku amaidhiyaiyum, sezhippaiyum membaduthakkoodum. Namadhu podhuvaana nalangalil kavanam seluthinaal, nammaal pala saadhanaigalaip padaikka mudiyum endru naan urudhiyaaga nambugiren, ivvaaru avar koorinaar.
China adhivar jinbing kooriyadhaavadhu; seenaavum, amerikkaavum iru mukkiya naadugal. Iru naadugalukkum idaiyeyaana potti aarokkiyamaanadhaagavum, ellaikkul utbattadhaagavum irukka vendum. America niruvanangal seenaavil thozhil thuvanga vara vendum. Ungalukkaaga engal kadhavu thirandhe irukkum, enak koorinaar

headline: Thaniyaaga pirandhanaal kondaadiya Vijay endru paravum pugaippadathaal sarchai…
text:
‘‘thaniyaaga pirandhanaal kondaadiya Vijay,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ ithanai kodi per unakkaaga irukkurappo thaniyaa pirandhanaal kondaadittu irukkiyenaa,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan, Vijay kek vettuvadhu pondra pugaippadam ondrum pagirappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadam patriya thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, ‘’ To the person who makes it all worth it,HBD❤️🧿 00.00,’’ endru thalaippittu, nadigai thirishaa pugaippadam ondrai, avaradhu X valaidhalathil joon 23, 2026 andru pagirndhullaar. Idhanai eduthu, edit seythu, merkanda vagaiyil parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Aanaal, indha pugaippadam eppodhu edukkappattadhu, enge edukkappattadhu pondra endha vivaramum namakku theriyavillai. Idhuvatri koodudhal vivaram kidaithaal, adhanaiyum inge veliyida thayaaraaga ullom.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, Tamil Nadu mindhurai amaichar aluvalagathilum pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kanneer vitta Pakistan raanuva veerar endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:

Idhanudan, India matrum Pakistan raanuva veerargal, thangaladhu thesiyak kodi endhiyavadi nirka, mele Pakistan veerar oruvar kanneer sindhuvadhu pondra kaatchigal adangiya video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
