headline: Vangakkadalil uruvaagum kaatrazhuthath thaazhvup pagudhi.. Idi minnaludan velukkappogum mazhai!
text:
Vangakkadal vadakku andhamaan pagudhiyil oru pudhiya kaatrazhuthath thaazhvup pagudhi uruvaaga ulladhaagavum, idhu adutha sila naatkalil melum valupperum enavum Indhiya vaanilai aayvu maiyam (IMD) adhigaarappoorvamaaga arivithulladhu. Idhan kaaranamaagath thamizhagam ullitta thennindhiya maanilangalilum, kadalorap pagudhigalilum paravalaaga mazhai peyyakkoodum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Vangakkadalil nilavum valimandala meladukku suzhatsi kaaranamaaga, oru pudhiya kaatrazhuthath thaazhvup pagudhi uruvaaga ulladhaaga Indhiya vaanilai aayvu maiyam arivithulladhu. Naalai marunaal vadakku andhamaan kadal pagudhiyil oru pudhiya kaatrazhuthath thaazhvup pagudhi (Low Pressure Area) uruvaaga adhiga vaayppulladhu. Indha pudhiya kaatrazhuthath thaazhvup pagudhi, thodarndhu kadalil nilavum saadhagamaana soozhal matrum eerappadham kaaranamaaga melum valuvadaiyakkoodum enath therivikkappattulladhu. Vangakkadalil kaatrazhutha thaazhvu mandalam theeviramadaivadhan kaaranamaaga, kadalora maavattangal matrum ul maavattangalil idi, minnaludan koodiya kanamazhaikku vaayppulladhu. Neelagiri, Kovai maavattangalil indru (sep.18) idi minnal matrum palatha kaatrudan koodiya kanamazhai peyyakkoodum ena vaanilai aayvu maiyam echarithulladhu. Idhevondru, naalai (sep.19) neelagiri, Kovai, tharumavuri, Krishnagiri, veloor, vizhuppuram, thiruvannaamalai, thiruppathoor, raanippettai, kallakkurichi, Salem, Tiruvallur aagiya 12 maavattangalukku kanamazhai echarikkai vidukkappattulladhu.
Sep. 20 matrum 21 aagiya thedhigalil neelagiri, Kovai, thindukkal, tharumavuri, Krishnagiri, Trichy, ariyaloor, perambaloor, vizhuppuram, kallakkurichi, Madurai aagiya 11 maavattangalil kanamazhai peyyakkoodum endrum vaanilai aayvu maiyam kanithulladhu. Chennaiyin orusila pagudhigalil 2 naatkalukku mazhaikku vaayppulladhaaga vaanilai aayvu maiyam kanithulladhu. Maalai alladhu iravu nerangalil nagarin orusila pagudhigalil idi minnaludan koodiya mazhai peyyakkoodum endrum, adhigavatcha veppanilai 37 mudhal 38 tigiri selsiyasai ottiyum, kuraindhavatcha veppanilai 26 mudhal 27 tigiri selsiyasai ottiyum irukkakkoodum endrum kurippittulladhu.

headline: Kujaraath membaalam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Kujaraathil kattappattulla nedunjjaalai, membaalam endru kurippittu video ondru

membaalam ondrin video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kathivaaraa membaalathirku Fire vidura uvis…
kujaraath membaalathai paarunga taa.” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Chennai kathippaaraavil kattappattulla paalathai thi.mu.ka-vinar thangal katchiyaal vandhadhu endru sollip perumaiyadaigindranar. Adhai vida sirappaana membaalam BJP aatchi seyyum kujaraathil kattappattulladhu endru video ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Paarkka unmaiyaanadhu pola irundhaalum eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegamum ezhundhadhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Adhu indha paalam vangadhesathin thalainagar taakkaavil ulladhu endru kurippittadhu. Vangadhesathil ivvalavu pirammaandamaaga membaalam kattappattirukkumaa endra sandhegathil thodarndhu aayvu seythom. Palarum indha video-vai vangadhesam poorbachaal viraivuchaalai (Purbachal Expressway) endru kurippittup padhivittirundhanar.
Enave, koogulil Purbachal Expressway endru taip seythu thedinom. Migavum pirammaandamaana saalaiyai taakkaavil amaithiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Andha idathin koogul street viyoo kaatchiyaiyum thedi eduthom. Video-vil ulla saalai appadiye taakkaavil iruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Idhan moolam vangadhesathil ulla viraivuchaalaiyin video-vai eduthu kujaraathil ulladhu endru thavaraaga padhivittiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Seerazhikkappatta sirumigal... Sikkappogum mukkiyappulligal!
text:
‘si.pi.si.ai.ti visaaranaikku utharavidalaamaa?’ endru mudhalvar kettavodhu, ‘Chennai poleese visaarikkattum’ endru sollivittaar kamishanar amalraaj.
Samoogathil vi.vi.ai.pi-kkalaaga valamvaruvavargal sirumigalais seerazhithadhaaga veliyaana ‘epsteen fails’, sarvadhesa alavil periya adhirvalaigalai uruvaakkiyadhu. Adharkus satrum kuraiyaadha adhirvai uruvaakkivarugiradhu ‘jem’ kiraanait thozhiladhivar veeramaniyin pokso kutrangal. Kadandha DMK aatchiyil izhuthu moodappatta ‘jem’ veeramaniyin pokso kutra vazhakkai thoosudhatti eduthu, visaaranaiyaith theevirappaduthiyirukkiradhu TVK arasaangam. Veeramaniyodu serthu, saandhi, magendhira simgan ena moovar kaidhuseyyappattu siraiyil adaikkappattirukkiraargal.
Indha vazhakkaith thondath thonda, seerazhikkappatta sirumigalin vivarangalum, veeramaniyin kutrangalai moodimaraippadharkup peram pesappatta thogaiyum ovvondraaga velivara, kaavaldhurai adhigaarigale adhirchiyil uraindhu poyirukkiraargal. Mudhalvare neradiyaagak kangaanikkum indha vazhakkin visaaranaiyil, melum sila mukkiyappulligal sikkappovadhaagas solgindrana kaakki vattaarangal.
Kadavulaay vandha needhivadhi... Siraikkus sendra veeramani!
‘jem’ veeramani meedhu padhiyappatta vazhakku, mooduvizhaa varai sendradhan pinnaniye perum marmamdhaan. Sennaiyais serndha thannaarvalar oruvar kadandha aandu, akdovar 6-m thedhi Chennai Police kamishanar aluvalagathil seyalbadum mathiya kutrappirivil, pen tiraivodu oru pugaar koduthaar. Pen tiraivai oppan seythu paarthavodhu, adaiyaalam theriyaadha mudhiyavar oruvar sirumiyaip paaliyalreedhiyaaga thunburuthum kaatchigal varave, adhirndhuvoyvittaargal kaavalargal. Police visaaranaiyil, video-vil irukkum mudhiyavar ‘jem’ kiraanait niruvanangalin adhivar veeramani enbadhum, avarukkus sirumiyai arimugappaduthiyadhu, avarin thozhiyaana thenaambettaiyais serndha saandhi enbadhum theriyavandhadhu.
Adutha naale, veeramani, saandhi iruvar meedhum pokso pirivugalingeezh vazhakku padhindha Chennai vivasaarath thaduppup pirivu poleesaar, saandhiyin thenaambettai veettilum sodhanai seythanar. Taap kiyaril sendra visaaranaiyil thideerena pirek vizhundhu, ‘visaaranaiyil endha aadhaaramum kidaikkavillai’ endru pipravari 18-m thedhi pokso sirappu needhimandrathil arikkai thaakkal seythadhu kaavaldhurai. Koodave,
‘Further action dropped’ endru vazhakkai mudithu vaippadhaaga ripport ondraiyum thaakkal seythavar, appodhu vivasaarath thaduppu pirivin udhavi kamishanaraaga irundha yaasmin.
Poleesin arikkaiyaip padithup paartha needhivadhi pathmaa, ‘ivvalavu periya kutram nadandhirukkiradhu. Aadhaaramillai endru vazhakkais saadhaaranamaaga izhuthu moodugireergale... Pen tiraiv aadhaaramdhaan irukkumbodhu, adhaivaithu visaarikka enna thadai?’ endru tenshanaanavar, meendum visaaranai nadathi arikkai samarppikka, Chennai Police kamishanaraaga irundha arun ai.pi.es-sukku utharavittaar. Oru perum kutrathukku mooduvizhaa nadatha silar muyandravodhu, kadavulaay vandhu vazhakkai meendum thirandhaar needhivadhi pathmaa. Appodhumgooda, kadandha aatchiyil visaaranai thodangavillai. Aatchi maariyavudan kaatchigalum maarina.
TVK aatchip poruppetravudan, Chennai perunagara kaaval aanaiyaraagap poruppetraar amalraaj ai.pi.es. Needhimandram visaarikka utharavittum niluvaiyil irukkum vazhakkugalai aayvuseythavar, ‘jem’ veeramani meedhaana pokso vazhakkin vivarangalai arindhavudan adhirchiyadaindhaar. Indha vazhakku thodarbaana aadhaarangalais segarikka vivasaarath thaduppup pirivu poleesaar theeviramaagak kalamirakkappattanar. Adhil kidaitha aadhaarangalin adippadaiyil, 84 vayadhaagum ‘jem’ veeramani, avarukku udhaviya saandhi, avarin kanavar magendhira simgan aagiyor kaidhuseyyappattanar. Moovarum puzhal siraiyil adaikkappattanar.
Veeramani fails... Seerazhikkappatta sirumigal!
Puzhal siraiyil adaikkappatta veeramaniyai Police kaavalil eduthu, thunai kamishanar keedhaanjjali, udhavi kamishanar raajalatchumi aagiyor sameevathil visaarithavodhu, avar kutrangalai maruthirukkiraar. Saandhi kurithaana kelvikku mattum, ‘aval oru thurogi’ endru aavesamaagiyirukkiraar. Than meedhaana kutrangalai veeramani maruthaalum, avar valuvaagave sikkiyiruppadhaagas solgindrana kaavaldhurai vattaarangal. Veeramaniyaal seerazhikkappatta sirumigalaith thedippidithu vaakkumoolam petruvarugiradhu Police idhuvarai, 12 sirumigalidam Police vaakkumoolam petru adhai Court-il padhivum seythirukkiradhu.
Vivasaarath thaduppup pirivu poleesaar silar nammidaiye pesugaiyil, “veeramaniyaal paadhikkappatta sirumigal, pokso needhimandra needhivadhiyidam ragasiya vaakkumoolam alithirukkiraargal. Adhil, thangalukku ennenna kodumaigal nadandhana enbadhaith thelivaagak kooriyirukkiraargal. Veeramanikku, sirumigalai anuppum ejenttaagave irundhirukkiraar saandhi. Varumaiyaalum, padikka vasadhiyillaamalum irukkum sirumigalaith thedippidithu, avargalai aasaivaarthaiyil veezhthiyirukkiraar saandhi. Adhil, pattiyal samoogathais serndha oru sirumiyum adakkam.
Sennaiyais serndha 12 vayadhu sirumi ketta selbonaiyum saaklettugalaiyum parisaaga alithuvittu, ‘nee kettadhai angil vaangik kuduthuttaaru. Avar manasu sandhoshappadura maadhiri nadandhukkanum. Unakku innum niraiya kipt kidaikkum’ endru sirumiyai moolaichalavai seythirukkiraar saandhi. Adhan piragu, than veettin padukkaiyaraikkul sirumiyai azhaithus sendra saandhi, veeramaniyudan thanimaiyil irukkavaithirukkiraar. Veeramaniyin paaliyal thunburuthalaal manadhalavilum udalalavilum paadhikkappatta andhas sirumi, thanakku nerndha kodumaigalai saandhiyidam koori azhudhavodhu, ‘avarai edhirthu nammaal onnum seyya mudiyaadhu. Idhaik ketta kanavaa ninaichu marandhudu’ endru solliyirukkiraar saandhi. Ippadithaan pala sirumigalum seerazhikkappattirukkiraargal.
Indha pokso vazhakkil or aadhaaramaagas serkkappattirukkum pen tiraiv video, saandhiyin padukkaiyaraiyil edukkappattiruppadhu urudhiyaagiyirukkiradhu. Veeramaniyai mirattip panam parippadharkaaga, andha video-vai saandhiye eduthirukkiraar. Thaangal edutha veediyovaal saandhiyum, avarudaiya kanavarume sikkivittanar’’ endranar.
Panam paritha arasiyal thalaivar!
Thozhiladhivar veeramanikku, Chennai-yil thenaambettai, poyas kaardan, adaiyaaru, ee.si.aar eriyaakkalil sogusu pangalaakkal ullana. Angu vaithuthaan sirumigalukkup paaliyal thollai kodukkappattiruppadhaagak kandarindhirukkiradhu Police pangalaakkalin munbakkamaaga azhaithus sendraal sisidivi-kkalil padhivaagividum enak karudhi, pinbakkamaagave sirumigal azhaithuvarappattirukkiraargal. Paaliyal thollaigalukku ullaana sirumigal anaivarum, kutram nadandha samayathil 12 vayadhilirundhu 16 vayadhukku utbattavargalaaga irundhirukkindranar. Tharpodhu avargalil silarukku thirumanam mudindhu kuzhandhaigalum iruppadhaal, avargalukku thairiyam solli vaakkumoolam petrirukkiradhu Police
nammidam pesiya Chennai Police kamishanar aluvalaga uyaradhigaarigal silar, “saandhiyin padukkaiyaraiyil edukkappatta video-vai vaithu, veeramaniyai pilaakmeyil seyyap podappatta thittathil irandu arasiyal piramugargal sambandhappattirukkiraargal. Thenmaavattathais serndha oru arasiyal katchiyin thalaivar, video aadhaarathaik kaanbithu kodikkanakkaana roovaayaik kettu panjjaayathu seythirukkiraar. Avarukku, ee.si.aar saalaiyilulla oru idathaiyum, latchakkanakkaana roovaayaiyum koduthu vaayai adaithirukkiradhu veeramani tharappu.
Adhodu, andha arasiyal thalaivar moolamaagave saandhiyaiyum mirattas solliyirukkiradhu veeramani tharappu. Adhanaal adhirchiyadaindha saandhi, sambandhappatta arasiyal piramugaraal thannudaiya uyirukke aavathu endru video veliyittirukkiraar. Andha veediyovum aadhaaramaagas sikkiyirukkiradhu. Indha vivagaaram poodhaagaramaaga vedikkavum, veeramaniyin pen vaarisu oruvar, railway thozhitsangap piramugarin vaarisidam udhavi kettirukkiraar. Andhath thozhitsanga piramugarin vaarisu kalamirangi, Chennai poleesaar silar moolamaaga saandhikkuk kudaichal koduthirukkiraar. Indhas sambavangalai aduthuthaan, veeramaniyin paaliyal thunburuthal video thannaarvalar moolamaaga Police vasam sendradhu.
Kansivandha mudhalvar... Sikkappogum mukkiyappulligal!
Indha pokso vazhakkilirundhu veeramaniyaik kaappaatra, 100 kodi roobai peram pesappattu, 50 kodi roobai sila adhigaarigalukkuk kaimaariyirukkiradhu. Sameevathil Police ti.ji.pi mageshgumaar agarvaal, Chennai Police kamishanar amalraaj, ulavuthurai ai.ji asraa kark aagiya moovaraiyum azhaithu, veeramani meedhaana vazhakku visaaranai kurithuk kettarindhaar mudhalvar Vijay nadandha sambavangal anaithaiyum amalaraaj eduthus sollavum, kovathil kansivandhavar, ‘sinna pillaingannugoodap paarkkaama ippadiyoru kodumai senjjirukkaanga. Orutharaiyum vidaadheenga... Veeramanikku udhavi senjjavanga melayum kes podunga’ endru utharavittirukkiraar.
‘si.pi.si.ai.ti visaaranaikku utharavidalaamaa?’ endru mudhalvar kettavodhu, ‘Chennai poleese visaarikkattum’ endru sollivittaar kamishanar amalraaj. Indha vazhakkai mudhalvare neradiyaagak kangaanippadhaal, panam vaangikkondu veeramanikku udhaviya Police adhigaarigalaik kandariya, koodudhal aanaiyar narendhira naayar thalaimaiyil oru teemai amaithirukkiraar amalraaj. Panathukkaaga ippadiyoru paduvaadhagas seyalai maraikka udhaviya mukkiyappulligal palarum viraivileye sikkappogiraargal.
Indha vazhakkai mudithuvaikka ripport kodutha udhavi kamishanar yaasmin, tharpodhu koyambedu udhavi kamishanaraagap panivurigiraar. Avarmeedhu mudhalil nadavadikkai edukkappadavirukkiradhu. Veeramaniyidam panam paritha arasiyal thalaivar, railway thozhitsanga nirvaagiyin vaarisu aagiyorukkum samman anuppi visaarikkavirukkirom. Veeramani, sirumigalais seerazhithadhodu, ai.e.es., ai.pi.es adhigaarigal enap palarukkum sirumigalai iraiyaakkiyadhodu, arasiyal katchith thalaivargal palaraiyum kest havusugalukku azhaithus sendrirukkiraar. Adhu kurithum theeviramaaga visaarithuvarugirom” endranar virivaaga.
Veeramani tharappil nammidam pesiyavargal, “siraiyilirukkum veeramaniyin uyirukku aavathu irukkiradhu. Avar kudumbathil sothup pirasnai thalaivirithaadugiradhu. Veeramaniyai miratti saandhiyum, avarin kanavarum aidi niruvanam, veedu ullittavatrodu kodikkanakkaana roobai madhippulla sothugalaiyum avagarithukkondanar” engiraargal.
“thodarndhu pala aandugal indhak kutram nadandhirukkiradhu. Veeramani mattumillaamal, samoogathil andhasdhodu irukkum periya manidhargal palarum sirumigalais seerazhithiruppadhaal, oruvaraikkooda vittuvidaamal sattathin munbu niruthi thandikka vendum” engiraargal kuzhandhaigal nala aarvalargal.
Oothi moodappatta ‘veeramani fails’ vazhakku, meendum uyir petrirukkiradhu. Niyaayamaaga visaaranai nadathappadugiradhaa enbadhai mudhalvardhaan kangaanikka vendum!

headline: Angeegarikkappatta arasiyal katchiyaaga TVK - mudhalvar Vijay magizhchi!!
text:
Angeegarikkappatta arasiyal katchiyaaga thavegavai therdhal aanaiyam angeegarithulladharku akkatchiyin thalaivarum, mudhalvarumaana Vijay magizhchi therivithullaar. Idhugurithu X valaidhalathil avar veliyittulla padhivil, oozhalatra, nermaiyaana nirvaagathai latchiyamaagakkondu madhachaarbatra samooganeedhi vetrik koottani amaithu, TVK thalaimaiyil varalaatru sirappumikka aatchiyai niruvikkaatti ulladhaaga kurippittullaar.
Thamizhaga arasiyal varalaatril oru peradhisayathai makkal nigazhthikkaattiya nilaiyil, adhan velippaadaaga, Indhiya therdhal aanaiyam Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathai, angeegarikkappatta arasiyal katchiyaaga arivithulladhaaga kurippittullaar. Jananaayaga puratchiyai sathamillaamal nigazhthiya visil sinnamum thavegavin sinnamaaga angeegarikkappattulladhaaga therivithullaar. Madhachaarbatra samooganeedhik kolgaiyudan ottumotha makkalukkaana nandrikkadan pani endrendrum thodarum ena mudhalvar Vijay therivithullaar.

headline: ‘India’ endra peyarukku virivaakkam ulladhaa?
text:
India (INDIA) endra peyarukku aagast maadham sudhandhiram petra naadu (Independent Nation Declared In August) endru virivaakkam ulladhu endru silar

India endra vaarthaikku enna virivaakkam endru oru pen ketkum video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Adharku oruvar aagast maadham vidudhalai petra naadu (Independent Nation Declared In August) endru oruvar koora, adhu sari engiraar.
Nilaith thagavalil, “‘INDIA’ endra vaarthaikku virivaakkam enna? Velinaattila ketkappatta kelvi idhu! Namma naattu payavullaiga yaarukkum padhil theriyala(appidi onnu irukkaa? Kelvippattadhe illa).😂 aanaa Pakistan paay pattunu sollittaan.🔥 idhaippaathuttu namma sangiga enna solvaanugalo!?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pandaiya kaalathil kirekkargal, paaraseegargal sindhu nadhikku kizhakke iruppavargalai hindhu endru azhaithanar . Sindhu (Sindhu) nadhiyin peyarai vaithu indha naattukku India endra peyar vandhadhaaga varalaaru koorugiradhu. India endra sollai podhuk kaalam 5m nootraandil erodottasu (Herodotus) endra kirekka varalaatrarinjar payanbaduthiyulladhaaga thagaval namakku kidaithadhu. Ulaga varalaaru ensaikkiloveediyaa inaiyathalathil India endra peyar varalaatril eppodhu ellaam payanbaduthappattulladhu endru pattiyalaiye veliyittirundhadhu.
India-vukku 1947m aandu aagast maadham sudhandhiram kidaithadhu. Aanaal, India endra peyar pala nootraandugalukku munbu irundhe payanbaduthappattu vandhulladhu. Aindhaam nootraandil kirekkargal India endra sollaip payanbaduthiyadhaaga varalaaru koorugiradhu. India-vukku vaanivam seyya vandha ingilaandhu naattavargal thodangiya niruvanathin peyar, kizhakkindhiya kambeni (The East India Company).
1947m aandu aagast maadham India-vukku sudhandhiram kidaikkap pogiradhu endru therindhu 5m nootraandileye India endra peyarai vaithuvittaargalaa enna? Adippadai puridhal indri Independent Nation Declared In August enbadhudhaan INDIA endra sollin virivaakkam endru palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
1697m aandu pirittish naadaalumandrathil iyatrappatta kizhakkindhiya kambeni sattathai ingilaandhu naadaalumandra inaiyadhalathilirundhu eduthom. 16m nootraandil India endra sol adhigaarappoorvamaaga payanbaduthappattulladhu enbadhai idhu urudhi seygiradhu. Adhan piragu India-vukku sudhandhiram koduppadharku munbaaga thaniyaaga Indhiya arasus sattathai 1935m aandu ingilaandhu naadaalumandram niraivetriyadhu. Idhudhaan indhiyargalukku thannaatchiyai alithadhu. Appodhu kooda 1947m aandu aagast maadham sudhandhiram vazhangappadum endru arivikkappadavillai.
India-vukku kaandhiyadigalin muyatsiyaal sudhandhiram kidaikkavillai, suvaash sandhiravosin theevira thaakkudhal nadavadikkaikkup payandhu ingilaandhu vidudhalaiyaik koduthadhu endru samooga oodagangalil theevira valadhusaarigal vivaadham seyvadhu undu. Suvaash sandhira pos aarambitha raanuvathirku peyar Indhiya thesiya raanuvam. India sudhandhiram adaivadharku munbu adhaavadhu 1942l indha raanuvathai avar uruvaakkinaar. Aagast maadham sudhandhiram kidaikkap pogiradhu endru therindhirundhaal avar edharkaaga India endra peyaril raanuvathai amaithirukka vendum?
Aagast maadham sudhandhiram petra naadu endra thagaval sila aandugalukku munbu theevira valadhusaarigalaal samooga oodagangalil parappappattadhu. India endra peyarai paarath endru maatra vendum… enenil India endra peyarai pirittish naattinar vaithanar endru vadhandhi parappappattadhu. Aanaal, indha thagaval thavaraanadhu endru nammudaiya fekt kirasando thamizhil katturai veliyittirundhom. Andha katturaiyaik kaana inge kilik seyyungal. Ivai ellaam India enbadharku Independent Nation Declared In August (aagast maadham sudhandhiram petra naadu) enbadhu virivaakkam endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindradhu.

headline: Vijaythaan mudhalvar endru nadigar paarthivan koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘vijaythaan mudhalvar,’’ endru nadigar paarthivan kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’ vijaythaan mudhalvar. Sameevathil thoothukkudikku therdhal pirachaarathirku sendra TVK thalaivar Vijay-kku vandha koottathai paarthu viyandhu poy vitten. Vijayyai paarkka vendum endru siriyavargal mudhal periyavargal varai maalaiyudan vandhu nindraargal. Therdhalukku munbe vijayyai oru mudhalamaicharaaga makkal paarkka aarambithu vittaargal- nadigar paarthivan,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda seythi unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagavalin adippadaiyil veliyidappatta seythi, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, justbefilmy endra oodagam podhiya aadhaaram indri merkanda seythiyai veliyittulladhu. Pinnar paarthivan idhuvatri vilakkam ketta nilaiyil andha seythiyai justbefilmy oodagam, samooga valaidhalathil irundhu, agatriyulladhu.
Enave, sambandhappatta oodagam indha thavaraana seythikku varutham therivitha piragum, unmai theriyaamal, palarum idhanai share seyvadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda niyoosgaardu thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Shaarjaavil kodooram.. 9 thundugalaaga vettappatta indhiyarin udal.. Manaivi, magan maayam!
text:
Aikkiya aravu ameeragathil karnaadaga maanilathais serndha navar oruvar kodooramaagak kolai seyyappattu, avaradhu udal 9 thundugalaaga vettappattuk kandedukkappatta sambavam perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Melum, indhak kolaikkup piragu avaradhu manaiviyum, maganum shaarjaavai vittu veliyeri iruppadhum sandhegathai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Karnaadaga maanilam uduppi maavattam kundhaavoorais serndhavar aalvin piragaash kundhar (38). Ivar kadandha 14 aandugalaaga, aikkiya aravu ameeragathil ulla shaarjaa vimaana nilaiyathil paniyaatri vandhaar. Ivar thanadhu kudumbathinarudan angeye vasithu vandhullaar. Ivaradhu manaivi teenaa kundhar palli aasiriyaiyaagavum, avargalin magan 10aam vaguppu padithu vandhadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, kadandha joolai 20aam thedhi aalvinin sagodharar anil avaraith thodarbugondullaar. Appodhu avaradhu azhaippai erkaamal, ’naan nandraaga irukkiren’ ena verum kurunjjeythi mattume sendrulladhu. Aalvin, vazhakkamaaga kural padhivugal moolame padhil anuppuvaar enbadhaal kudumbathinarukku sandhegam ezhundhulladhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, kudumbathinar shaarjaavil ulla aalvinin nanbar moolam visaarikkas solliyullanar. Visaaranaiyil avar, India varavillai enbadhum, paasbort padhivugalinbadi avar ameeragathileye iruppadhum urudhi seyyappattadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, kaaval nilaiyathilum pugaar alikkappattadhu.
Indha nilaiyildhaan, avar joolai maadhame kolai seyyappattiruppadhu visaaranaiyil theriya vandhadhu. Oman sellum paadhaiyil kaividappatta nilaiyil irundha aalvinin kaarin tikkiyil, irandu paigalil avaradhu udal 9 thundugalaaga vettappattu adaikkappattirundhadhu kanduvidikkappattadhu. Aanaal, indhak kolaikkup piragu avaradhu manaivi teenaa kundharaiyum, avargaladhu padhinvayadhu maganaiyum kanduvidikka mudiyavillai enath thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Avargal shaarjaavai vittu veliyeri indhiyaavukkus sendrirukkalaam endrum koorappadugiradhu.
Iruppinum, avargal tharpodhu engu irukkiraargal enbadhum, kolaikkum avargalukkum ulla thodarbu enna enbadhum kurithum visaaranai nadaivetru varugiradhu. Melum, avaradhu udalai India konduvaravum nadavadikkai edukkumaaru manu alikkappattulladhu. Aikkiya aravu ameeragathil karnaadaga maanilathais serndha navar oruvar kodooramaagak kolai seyyappattiruppadhu adhirvugalai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Car modhi thozhilaali pali
text:
Vaazhappaadi: vaazhappaadi, sesansaavadiyai serndha, koolithozhilaali aarumugam, 60. Netru kaalai, 8:30 manikku velaikku saikkilil, sesansaavadi aruge Salem - Chennai thesiya nedunjjaalaiyai kadakka muyandraar.
Appodhu thalavaaybattiyai serndha sivachandhiran, 26, selathil irundhu Aathoor nokki otti vandha, hondaa car, aarumugam meedhu modhiyadhu. Avar sambava idathil uyiri-zhandhaar. Vaazhappaadi Police, aarumugam udalai kaippatri, sivachandhiranidam visaarikkindranar.
Kaayam adaindhavarum pali
thaaramangalam, pavalathaanoor sundharangaattai serndha koolitho-zhilaali maarakkaal, 65. Kadandha, 18l velaikku sendru vittu, maalai, 5:45 manikku, athikkattaanoor pirivil saalaiyai kadakka muyandraar.
Appodhu thaaramangalam pakkamirundhu, 'pajaaj' paikkil vandhavar modhiyadhil, maarakkaal padugaayam adaindhaar. Makkal, avarai meettu, selathil ulla thaniyaar maruthuva
manaiyil sertha nilaiyil, netru mundhinam
uyirizhandhaar.

headline: Aardar pazhakkam | aarokkiyathaik kedukkum online thuridha unavugal; adimaiyaagum ilam thalaimuraiyinar!
text:
Aantraaydu movailum, inaiyamum thanimanidhan mattumallaamal nam ottumotha Indhiya samoogathin alappariya munnetrathirku alavillaamal kaigoduthulladhu enbadhil maatrugaruthillai. Indha thozhil nutba valarchi munnetrangalukku mattumindri migapperiya maatrangalukkum vazhivaguthulladhu enbadhaiyum naam oppukkonde aagavendum avvaaru inaiyam erpaduthiya maatrangalil nam unavuppazhakkavazhakkathil erpattulla maatrame migundha thaakkamudaiyadhu enbadhai sameevathil veliyaana aayvugalin mudivugal urudhivaduthugindrana.
Adhirchi tharum aayvugal
naattil ilainjargalin unavuvazhakkam maari varuvadhu kurithu 'lokkal sarkkils' endra amaippu sameevathil nadathiya aayvil gen z thalaimuraiyinar veettu unavugalilirundhu vilagi aanlainil virkappadum padhappaduthappatta unavugalai adhigam virumbi unbadhaagavum andha unavupporulgalil kozhuppu, sarkkarai matrum uppu adhigalavil iruppadhum kandariyappattulladhu.
Naadu muzhuvadhum 277 maavattangalil 24,000 peridam nadathappatta indha aayvil amesaan firesh ,pilingit, jepdo, svikki, instaa maart pondra igaamars matrum viraivu varthaga thalangalil virkappadum unavupporulgalil 50 sadhaveedhathirkum adhigamaanavai pekkej seytha migavum padhappaduthavatta matrum kuppai unavugal enak kandariyappattulladhu. Aanlainil unavu vaangum kudumbangalil 39 sadhaveedham thangal veettil ilainjargal unavupporulgalai adhigam aardar seyvadhaaga therivikkindranar. Kurippaaga pilingit (62%) matrum jepdo(58%) pondra seyaligalil thaan adhigam aardar seyyappaduvadhaaga aayvugal therivikkindrana.
Ilamvayadhil BP, Sugar
kadandha 2024 aam aandu mattum online unavu virpanai sumaar 80,300 kodi roobai alavirku nadandhulladhaagavum, indha madhippu 2028 aam aandu 2,70,810 kodi roobai varai uyarum enath thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Idhan moolam adhil paniyaatruvavargal, telivari seyyum oozhiyargalukkaana oodhiyam matrum arasirku kidaikkum varuvaay enap pala porulaadhaara kaaranigal ulladangiyirundhaalum pala kodi makkalin udal aarokkiyathaik kavanathil kondu arasu matrum unavu paadhugaapputh thuraiyum aarokkiyamatra, tharakkuraivaana unavupporulgalai virpanai seyyum online niruvanangal meedhu kadumaiyaana nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Indha padhappaduthappatta unavupporulgalil ulla kozhuppu , sarkkarai matrum uppu patriya unmaiyaana vivarangalai thelivaagavum,peridhaagavum achiduvadhai urudhi seyya vendum.
Thuridha unavugalukku pazhakkamaagi palavidha udal uvaadhaigalukku aalaagik kondirukkum indraiya thalaimuraiyinar online unavugalai thavirthu udalnalathaik kavanathil kondu aarokkiyamaana unavu pazhakkavazhakkathirku maaruvadhe edhirgaalathil avargal nalla udalnalathudan vaazha vazhivagai seyyum endru nivunargal arivuruthugindranar.
- je.thamizharasan

headline: Theeviravaadhi sadalathaip paarthu kadhari azhum Pakistan makkal endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’theeviravaadhi sadalathaip paarthu kadhari azhum Pakistan makkal,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ engala mattum madham kettu ullaadaiyai avuthu su paarthu suttu konneenga…😡 ippa neenga edhukkaaga azhugureenga,,?,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan sadalam ondrai sutri eraalamaana podhumakkal thirandu nindru, kadhari azhuvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda oru veediyovum inaikkappattulladhu.
Idhanai paarkkumbodhu, paahalgaam theeviravaadha thaakkudhalukku pazhivaangum vagaiyil India nadathiya padhil thaakkudhalil kollappatta theeviravaadhi udalukku irudhi anjjali seluthiya Pakistan makkal, enbadhu pondru ulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha veediyovukkum, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, kurippitta video-vil idambetrulla shady_atall endra vaattarmaark adippadaiyaaga vaithu, thagaval thediyavodhu, unmaiyaana video lingk kidaithadhu. Kadandha maars maadham indha video mudhanmudhalaaga, instaagiraamil pagirappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, idhu Hossam Shabat endra oodagaviyalaalarin irudhis sadanginbodhu edukkappatta video endru koorappadugiradhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, adhe instaagiraam pakkathil melum sila video-kkal pagirappattirundhana. Avatril silavatrai koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, keezhe inaithullom.
Idhanbadi, kadandha maars maadham, kaasaa meedhu Israel thaakkudhal nadathiyavodhu, angu paniyil eeduvattirundha Al Jazeera oodagathin paniyaalar Hossam Shabat kollappattullaar. Avaradhu irudhichadangil saga paniyaalargal, nanbargal, uravinargal ena palarum soozhndhugondu, kadhari azhudha kaatchidhaan idhu…
koodudhal aadhaam idho…
enave, kaasaavil padhivu seyyappatta video ondrai eduthu, tharpodhaiya India – Pakistan modhaludan thodarbuvaduthi vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: AI sonna ore oru poy! China - America idaiye por? AI-aal manidha inam azhiyumaa?
text:
Merku aasiya kadalil China kappal anu aayudha moolapporutkalai etris selgiradhu ena AI chatbot vazhangiya thavaraana thagavalai nambi, America raanuvam aayvukku thayaaraana sambavam nadandhulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
manidha inathai edhirgaalathil rovokkal thaan aalappogiradhu endru, terminettar endra haalivut padam uruvaakkappattirukkum. Indha thiraippadathai paarthavodhu, idhu verum karpanaiyaanadhu endre palarum kadandhu sendriruppaargal. Aanaal, tharpodhu thodarndhu nadakkum palveru sambavangal moolam, oruvelai idhu edhirgaalathil unmai aagividumo endra payam, podhumakkal mathiyil ezhath thodangi irukkiradhu. Andha alavukku, AI-kkalin attagaasam thodarndhu adhigarithulladhu.
Ippadiyaana soozhnilaiyil, America, China aagiya iru ulagin perarasu naadugalukku idaiye, migapperiya por erpadave, seyarkai nunnarivu seyaligal kaaranamaaga amaindhulladhaaga thagaval veliyaagi, palaraiyum adhirchi adaiya vaithulladhu. Adhaavadhu, merku aasiya pagudhiyil, anu aayudha thittathirkaana moolapporutkalai kappal moolam China etri selvadhaaga, America raanuvathirku thagavalgal kidaithulladhu.
Enave, indha kappalil eri, sodhanai seyvadharkaaga, America raanuva veerargal thittamittirundhanar. Adharkaaga, raanuva vimaanangalum vaanvazhiyil parakkath thodangiyirundhana. Aanaal, anu aayudha thittathirkaana moolapporutkalai China kappalil etris sendradhaaga kidaitha ulavuthurai thagaval, poyyaanadhu endru irudhi nerathil theriyavandhulladhu. Andha kappalin aavanangal kuritha thagavalgalai, oru AI Chatbot-yidam arasin aayvaalar oruvar kettadhaagavum, adharku andha e.ai thavaraana thagavalgalai vazhangiyadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Indha thagavalgalai nambi, idhanai oru vazhakkamaana ulavuthurai arikkaiyaaga andha navar veliyittullaar.
Aanaal, irudhi nerathil adhu poy endru theriyavandhadhaal, China-vin kappalai America raanuvathinar aayvu seyyavillai. Oruvelai aayvu seythirundhaal, seenaavukkum, amerikkaavukkum idaiye migapperiya por erpattirukkum endru koorappadugiradhu. Indha aandu thodakkathil indha sambavam nadandha nilaiyil, tharpodhu thaan indha thagaval oodagathirku theriyavandhulladhu. America adhivaraaga tonaalt Trump poruppetradhu mudhal, ulavuthuraiyil seyarkai nunnarivu orunginaippai viraivuvaduthumaaru thodarndhu valiyuruthappattu varugiradhu. Endha ilakkugalaith thaakkuvadhu alladhu iraanuva thalavaadangalai engu nagarthuvadhu pondra kala mudivugalai iraanuvam viraivaaga edukka AI udhavum enbadharkaaga, indha nadavadikkaigal merkollappattadhu. Aanaal, irudhiyil perum por erpaduvadharke, idhu kaaranamaaga amaiyum endru, America raanuvathinar edhirbaarthirukka maattaargal.

headline: Ottup podap pora ponne odhungi nikkaadha! - paattuppaadi vaakku segaritha Seeman!!
text:
Madhuraandhagam matrum thaaraavuram aagiya iru thogudhigalukkaana idaitherdhal adutha maadham 6 m thedhi nadaiverugiradhu. Innilaiyil, naam thamizharga katchi vetbaalargalaaga madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil, ko. Jaanagiraaman, thaaraavuram thogudhiyil mu.kaarthigaa aagiyor vetbumanuth thaakkal seythirukkindranar. Indha nilaiyil thaan, Tiruppur maavattam thaaraavuram thogudhiyil naam thamizhar katchi saarbil pottiyidum vetbaalar mu.kaarthigaavai, akkatchiyin orunginaippaalar Seeman arimugam seythu vaithup pesinaar.
Appodhu pesiya avar, ”makkalin kaasai pera maattom enak kooriyavargal, innoru katchiyil vetri petravargalai padhaviyilirundhu vilaga vaithu, thangal katchiyil pottiyida vaippadhu enna maadhiriyaana arasiyal? Aalum katchiyil irundhaal thaan nalladhu seyya mudiyum endraal, edhirkkatchi varisaiyil ulla sattamandra uruppinargalin thogudhigalukku nalladhu seyyamaattaargal endru porulaa? Edhirkkatchiye irukkak koodaadhu enbadhu eppadippatta jananaayagam” enak kelvi ezhuppinaar.
Thodarndhu pesiya avar, vaakkukku kaasu kodukkaamal angeegaaram petra mudhal katchi naam thamizhar thaan. Koottathaip paarthu maas enap potta ottu ippodhu thoosaaga maarivittadhu. Ingu minvettu en endru kettaal, amaichar nirmal kumaar ‘panjjaavaip paar, pangalaadheshaip paar’ engiraar. Ellaak kudumba attaigalukkum 6 silindar enak koorinaar. Aatchikku vandhavudan 10 latcham kodi kadan enak koorugiraar. Tamil Naattil 100 naal aatchiyai vilambarappadutha ellaa achu oodagangalukkum vilambaram alikkappattulladhu. Tamil Naattil 100 naal aatchi patri, karnaadagaa matrum aandhiraavil edharkaaga achu oodagangalil muzhup pakkam vilambaram kodukkappattadhu? 200 yoonit minsaaram ilavasam enak koorinaar. Tharpodhu minsaarame illai. ‘minsaara kanavu’ ena padam ulladhu; ippodhu minsaarame kanavaagath thaan ulladhu enath therivithaar.
Melum, makkalin vaakkugalaip petru vetri petravargal tharpodhu oru thevaiyatra therdhalaik kondu vandhullanar. Enave naam thamizhar vetbaalarukku vaakku alikkumbadi kettukkondaar. Melum, ottup podap pora ponne odhungi nikkaadha! Kanda kanda sinnam kandu kalangi nikkaadha! Uzhaikkum makkal sinnam; adhu vivasaayi sinnam endru paattup paadi, thaaraavuram thogudhiyil pottiyidum naam thamizhar vetbaalar kaarthigaavukku vaakkus segarithaar.

headline: Japan-il sunaami endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Japan-il epral 20, 2026 andru erpatta nilanadukkathaith thodarndha vandha sunaami endru oru video

saalaiyil vella neer varuvadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil. “vadagizhakku Japan-il sakdhivaayndha nilanadukkam erpattadhaal sunaami erpattadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Epral 20, 2026 andru Japan-il 7.4 – 7.4 rikdar alavukku nilanadukkam erpattadhu. Idhaith thodarndhu sunaami echarikkai vidukkappattadhu. Sila pagudhigalil 80 se.mee alavukku alaigal uyarndhadhaagavum adhanaal paadhippu edhum illai endrum seythigal veliyaagina. Aanaal, Japan-il migapperiya sunaami paadhippu erpattadhu pondru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, idhu pazhaiya video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu pala aandugalaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. 2016m aandu then koriyaavil erpatta sunaami endru indha video-vai YouTube-il padhivittirundhanar. Then koriyaavil sunaami erpattadhaa endra sandhegathudan idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvai thodarndhom. Adhil kurippittadhu podhu 2016m aandu akdovar 5m thedhi then koriyaavin pooshan nagaril sunaami paadhippu erpattadhaaga thagaval kidaikkavillai. Aanaal andraiya thinam migapperiya puyal thaakkiyadhaagavum adhaith thodarndhu kadal alaigal uyaramaaga ezhundhu paadhippai erpaduthiyadhaagavum seythigal kidaithana.
Enave, idhu then koriyaa sunaamiyaaga irukkaadhu endru aayvaith thodadarndhom. Appodhu, namakku kidaitha X thala padhivu ondril idhu 2011m aandu Japan-il erpatta sunaami paadhippu endru kurippittirundhanar. Enave nammudaiya aayvai thorndhom. Appodhu, 2015m aandu padhividappattirundha andha video-vil idhu 2011m aandu Japan-il erpatta sunaamiyin paadhippu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Jappaanin kesenumaa (Kesennuma) endra idathil maars 11, 2011 andru erpatta sunaami endru adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam pazhaiya video-vai eduthu tharpodhu nadandhadhu endru thavaraaga padhivittiruppadhu thelivaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthak koodiyadhu, thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Seenaavil vimaana nilaiyathin merkoorai idindhu vizhundhadhaa?
text:
‘’seenaavil vimaana nilaiyathin merkoorai idindhu vizhundhadhu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ seenaavil vimaana nilaiya koorai idindhu vizhundhadhu.
Valarndha China endru azhaikkappaduvavatrin unmai idhudhaan. 🤡
China thayaarippugal mudhal China vimaana nilaiyangal varai, seenaavil edhuvum needithu uzhaikkaadhu.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu seenaavil ulla shaapping maal ondril erpatta paadhippu endrum, vimaana nilaiyam kidaiyaadhu endrum theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, joolai 8, 2025 andru seenaavil ulla Chongqing endra idathil seyalbadum Xicheng Tiandi endra shaapping maal kattidathin oru thalathil thideerena merkoorai idindhu vizhundhadhodu, kazhivuneer adhan vazhiyaaga nirambi odiyulladhu. Idhanaal, peedhiyadaindha podhumakkal angirundhu thappiyodum kaatchigal samooga valaidhalangalil vegamaaga paravina. Kurippitta shaapping maal thaniyaarukkus sondhamaana ondru. Wang Jianlin enbavarukkus sondhamaana Wanda Group indha Xicheng Tiandi kattidathai nirvagikkiradhu.
Enave, shaapping maal ondril edukkappatta video-vai eduthu, China arasukkus sondhamaana vimaana nilaiyathil merkoorai idindhu vizhundhadhaagak koori, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga Tamil Naattil poraattam nadathappattadhaa?
text:
Paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga Tamil Naattil nadandha podhu medaiyil indhiyaavai payangaravaadha naadu endru islaamiyar oruvar kooriyadhaaga oru padhivu

X thalathil islaamiyargal nadathiya poraattam ondrin video padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga Thamizhagathil podhu medaiyil, indhiyaavai “payangaravaadha naadu” ena sollum, indha islaamiya theeviravaadhi meedhu nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Namma siruvaanmaiyinar adhanaal namma enna pesinaalum DMK arasu nadavadikkai edukkaadhu endra thimiril eppadi pesuraanungannu paarunga” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pakistan meedhu aavareshan sindhoor endra thaakkudhalai India thodangi mudithadhu. Indha soozhalil paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga Tamil Naattil podhuk koottam nadathappattadhu endru oru video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Melum, indhiyaavai payangaravaadha naadu endru avargal kooriyadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha koottam paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga nadathappattadhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetri thedinom. Appodhu 2023m aandil irundhe indha video theevira valadhusaari aadharavaalargal matrum valadhusaari aadharavu oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam tharpodhu nadandha India – Pakistan por sambavathirkum indha veediyovukkum thodarbillai enbadhu thelivaagiradhu. Video-vai muzhumaiyaaga paarkkum podhu paalasdheena makkalukku aadharavaaga indha poraattam nadandhadhaaga andha medaiyilirundha penaril kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga indha koottam nadathappattadhaagap pagirappadum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
India payangaravaadha naadu endru avar pesinaaraa illaiyaa endra aayvukkul naam sellavillai. Ulagathil oru naadu payangaravaadha naadaaga irukkum endraal mudhalaavadhaa Israel, irandaavadhu naadu edhu endru kettaal, naam vaazhndhu kondirukkindra naadu endru sollalaam. Naan India endru solla maatten, enendraal India endraikkum samaadhaanathin pakkam nindrirukkiradhu” endru avar koorugiraar. Indhiyaavai koora maatten endru avar naam vaazhum naadu endru maraimugamaaga indhiyaavaik kurippidugiraar. Appadi maraimugamaaga avar ippodhaiya aatchiyaalargalai appadik koorinaaraa, en appadis sonnaar endra aayvukkul sellavillai. Neradiyaaga sonnaalum maraimugamaagas sonnaalum avar sonnadhu migath thelivaaga ulladhu.
Paalasdheenathukku aadharavaaga 2023m aandu islaamiyargal poraattam nadathiya video-vai Pakistan por mudindha soozhalil Tamil Naattil paagisdhaanukku aadharavaagak koottam nadandhadhu endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyyappattulladhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu unmaiyudan thavaraana thagavalaiyum kondadhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: `poruppunarvudan munneduthus selven' - TVK em.el.e. Kanimozhikku koodudhal poruppu!
text:
"enakku vazhangappattulla indhak koodudhal poruppai muzhu arppanippudanum, poruppunarvudanum niraivetri munneduthus selven” - kanimozhi sandhosh
Kovai kavundambaalaiyam thogudhi sattamandra uruppinaraaga tha.ve.ka-vais serndha kanimozhi sandhosh irukkiraar. Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu sattapperavaiyin satta vidhigal aayvukkuzhu uruppinaraaga kanimozhi sandhosh thervu seyyappattu, avarukku koodudhal poruppu vazhangappattulladhu.
Indhap pudhiya poruppu vazhangappattadharku nandri therivithu kanimozhi sandhosh veliyittulla arikkaiyil, “ Tamil Nadu sattapperavaiyin satta vidhigal aayvukkuzhu uruppinaraaga ennaith thervu seythu, koodudhal poruppu vazhangiya mudhalamaichar Vijay, sattapperavaith thalaivar je.si.ti. Piravaagar aagiyorukku enadhu mariyaadhaiyudan koodiya nandriyaith therivithukkolgiren.
Jananaayagathin maanbai munniruthi seyalbaduvadharkaana matrumoru vaayppaaga indhap poruppai karudhugiren. Satta vidhigal thodarbaana mukkiya vivagaarangalai poruppunarvudan anugi, sattapperavai seyalbaadugalin sirappai valuppaduthum vagaiyil enadhu pangalippai vazhanguven. Enakku vazhangappattulla indhak koodudhal poruppai muzhu arppanippudanum, poruppunarvudanum niraivetri munneduthus selven” enath therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: ‘ullaasa ulagil udhay’ endru nakkeeran idhazh seythi veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘’ullaasa ulagil udhay’’, endru nakkeeran idhazh seythi veliyittadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’ pittu puthagam nakkeeran . Ullaasa ulagil udhay? Padhara vaitha udhayaavin instaa ri tvit,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhuvondra endha seythiyum nakkeeran idhazh veliyidavillai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, nakkeeran aasiriyar kuzhuvilum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Vijay karoor sendravodhu erpatta kootta nerisalil sikki, 40kkum merpattor paliyaana sambavam ulaga alavil sarchai erpaduthiyulladhu. Indha nigazhvu patri thodarchiyaaga, nakkeeran oodagam seythi veliyittu varugiradhu. Idharkup padhil tharum vagaiyil Vijay aadharavaalargal merkandavaaru poli seythi thayaarithu, samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, nakkeeran peyaril paravum vadhandhi, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “paajaga-vukku alikkappatta vaakku merku vangathai sutham seygiradhu” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Merku vangathil paajaga-vukku alikkappatta vaakku kaaranamaaga vangadhesa sattavirodha kudiyerigal koottam koottamaaga veliyeri varuvadhaaga oru video

saalaiyil koottamaaga alladhu peraniyaaga makkal sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “merku vangathil BJP-vukku potta otha ottu ottumotha maanilathaiyum sutham seyyudhu!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merku vanga sattamandra therdhalil BJP vetri petru aatchi amaithulladhu. BJP aatchikku vandhaal sattavirodhamaaga merku vangathil kudiyeriya vangadhesa makkal veliyetrappaduvaargal endru vaakkurudhi alikkappattadhu. Adhai tharpodhaiya BJP arasu niraivetri varuvadhu pondru padhividappattulladhu.
Ivargal merku vangathilirundhu vangadhesathukku sellum makkalaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu samooga oodagangal muzhukka indha video-vai tharpodhu palarum padhivittu varuvadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Satru pazhaiya padhivugalai thedinom. Appodhu, indha aandu janavari maadham 5m thedhi instaagiraamil indha video veliyaagi irundhadhaik kandom.
Sattamandra therdhal 2026 epral maadham nadandhu me maadham mudivugal veliyaanadhu. BJP 2026 me maadham thaan padhavikku vandhadhu. Adharku naangu maadhangalukku munbaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idhu BJP aatchikku payandhu vangadhesa sattavirodha kudiyerigal veliyeriya video illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu. Andha video-vil Hooghly Bishwa Ijtema 2026 endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhu enna endru thediya podhu thaplik jamaath endra islaamiya pirivu nadathiya madha nigazhchi endru theriyavandhadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu indha nigazhchi nadandha idam thodarbaana pala seythigal namakku kidaithana. Idhan adippadaiyil kurippitta andha pagudhiyil nedunjjaalai membaalam ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu oru kurippitta idathil 2025m aandu tisambar maadham edukkappatta street viyoo kaatchi namakku kidaithadhu. Saalai orathil oru siriya koodaaram irundhadhu. Andha koodaaram naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovilum irundhadhu.
Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil kurippittadhu pondru BJP aatchi amaindhadhaal merku vangathilirundhu kurippitta oru pirivu makkal veliyerum nigazhvin video idhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Indhiyaavirku kachaa enney etrumadhi nirutham.. Savudhi niruvanam mudivu!! Kaaranam enna?
text:
Savudhi areviyaa matrum havudhikkal idaiyeyaana thaakkudhalgal theeviramadaindhu varum nilaiyil, savudhiyinn arasu enney niruvanamaana araamgo, Indhiya suthigarippu niruvanangalukku kachaa enney vazhanguvadhai maru arivippu varum varai niruthiyulladhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyirukkiradhu. Idharku mukkiyak kaaranamaaga koorappaduvadhu, savudhi areviyaavin kizhakku - merku enney kuzhaay meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhal.
Sumaar 1,200 kilomeettar neelamulla indha kuzhaay, savudhi areviyaavin kizhakku pagudhiyil irundhu merku kadarkarai pagudhikku kachaa enneyai kondu sellum mukkiya vazhithadamaaga ulladhu. Haarmus neerinai vazhiyaaga kappal pokkuvarathil erkanave paadhippu erpattulla nilaiyil, indha kuzhaay savudhi areviyaavukku maatru viniyoga paadhaiyaaga irundhadhu. Aanaal, sameevathiya tron thaakkudhalaith thodarndhu indha kuzhaay moodappattulladhu.
Melum, paap al mandhap neerinaip pagudhiyil ulla 'mayon' theevai havudhigal kaippatriyulladhaal savudhiyin kadalvazhip pokkuvarathum mudangiyulladhu.
Idhan thodarchiyaagathaan, Indhiya suthigarippu niruvanangalukku vazhangappattu vandha kachaa enney viniyogathaiyum araamgo niruvanam niruthiyulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Savudhi areviyaavil irundhu India-vin kachaa enney irakkumadhiyil araamgovin pangu kurippidathakkadhu. Porukkup piragu, India-vin kachaa enney irakkumadhiyil sumaar 9 sadhaveedhathai araamgo vazhangi vandhadhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana.
Erkanave sarvadhesa sandhaiyil kachaa enney vilai 100 taalaraith thaandi varuvadhudan, kappal pokkuvarathukkaana kattanangalum adhigarithullana. Idhanaal, savudhi enneykku padhilaaga veru naadugalil irundhu kachaa enneyai vaangumbodhu, Indhiya suthigarippu niruvanangalukku koodudhal selavu erpadalaam. Adhe nerathil, savudhi areviyaa sila kachaa enney sarakkugalai, varthagargal moolam India-vukku anuppuvadharkaana erpaadugalai seythulladhaagavum thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu.
Aanaal, andha alavu vazhakkamaana oppandha viniyogathudan oppidumbodhu kuraivaaga irukkalaam ena koorappadugiradhu.

headline: ’kuzhappathai erpaduthum Delhi SIR nottees..’ ucha Needhimandram adhirupdhi!
text:
Delhi SIR sirappu vaakkaalar pattiyal thiruthathil laajikkal pizhai endra kaaranathaal 33 latcham perukku nottees anuppappattadhil, mudhalamaichar regaa kupdhaa, aravinth kejrivaal, kavil sival, elge athvaani, maneesh sisodiyaa ullitta mukkiya navargalum ullanar. Unmais sarivaarppu illaamal iyandhirathanamaaga nottees anuppappaduvadhai ucha Needhimandram kadumaiyaaga kandithu, muraiyai maruvariseelikka therdhal aanaiyathukku utharavittulladhu.
Telliyil nadaiverum sirappu theevira vaakkaalar pattiyal thirutha (SIR) nadavadikkaiyin oru pagudhiyaaga, nirappappatta padivangalil laajikkal mistek iruppadhaaga 33 latcham perukku nottees anuppappattulladhu. Andha pattiyalil pala mootha arasu adhigaarigal, arasup paniyaalargal matrum arasiyalvaadhigal ullittavargalum idambetrullana.
Mukkiyamaaga indhappattiyalil Delhi mudhalamaichar regaa kupdhaa, aam aathmi katchith thalaivar aravinth kejrivaal matrum munnaal mathiya amaichar kavil sival aagiyorukkum idhevondra muranbaadugal thodarbaaga notteesgal anuppappattulladhaaga adhigaarigal therivithanar. Adhaithodarndhu munnaal thunai piradhamar elge athvaani, munnaal thunai mudhalvar maneesh sisodiyaavukkum mistek iruppadhaaga nottees anuppappattulladhu.
Ippadiyaana soozhalil thaan Delhi vaakkaalar pattiyal thiruthathil therdhal aanaiyam iyandhirathanamaaga nottees anuppuvadhaaga ucha Needhimandram kandanam therivithulladhu. Unmais sarivaarppu illaamal nottees anuppappaduvadhaal vaakkaalargal kuzhappamadaindhulladhaaga needhivadhigal therivithullanar. Enave, indha muraiyai marumadhippeedu seyyumaarum, WhatsApp alladhu minnanjjal moolam aavanangalaip peralaamaa enap pariseelikkumaarum aanaiyathirku Needhimandram utharavittulladhu.
Idhugurithu irandu vaarangalil arikkai thaakkal seyyavum therdhal aanaiyathukku ucha Needhimandram utharavittulladhu.

headline: Thanushin ore oru padhivu! Vedithu kilambiya poogambam? Arasiyal payanathil adutha aattam?
text:
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
nadigargal naadaala mudiyumaa endra kelvi, thamizhagathin arasiyal varalaatril eppodhum ketkappattuk konde irukkum kelvi thaan. Aanaal, indha kelvikku aam endru padhil alithavargal em.ji.aar, jeyalidhaa, Vijay aagiyor thaan. Vijayagaanth mattum, edhirgatchi thalaivar padhavi varai uyarndhaar. Matravadi, sivaaji, sarathgumaar, paakyaraaj, ti.raajendhar pondror katchiyai aarambithu, paadhiyileye kalaithuvittu arasiyalil irundhu kaanaamal ponaargal. Avvalavu en, thamizhagathin migundha aalumaiyaana navar endru koorappatta kamal kooda, indha resil jeyikka mudiyaamal, tholviyai thaan thazhuviyirukkiraar.
Ippadiyaana soozhnilaiyil, nadigar thanush indha arasiyal payanathil inaiya iruppadhaaga thodarndhu koorappattu varugiradhu. Thanushin pirandhanaal vizhaa medaiyil avar pesiya karuthukkal, indha thagavalgalukku koodudhal palam serthirundhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, mudhalamaichar vijay-kku pottiyaaga innoru nadigaraa? Thanushaal mudhalamaichar aaga mudiyumaa? Pondru palveru karuthukkalai, nettisangal samooga valaidhalangalil padhivittu vandhanar.
Indha nilaiyil, nadigar thanush veliyittulla X thala padhivu ondru, nettisangal mathiyil perum kavanadhadhai eerthulladhu. Adhaavadhu, piradhamar narendhira Modi indru thanadhu 76-vadhu pirandha naalai kondaadugiraar. Avaradhu pirandha naalukku, palveru arasiyal thalaivargalum, sinimaa piravalangalum vaazhthukkalai therivithu varugindranar. Andha vagaiyil, nadigar thanush-m X pakkathil padhivu veliyittu, vaazhthukkalai kooriyullaar.
Indha padhivai paartha nettisangal, mudhalamaichar Vijay-in pirandha naalukku padhivu veliyitteergalaa? Endrum, BJP-yin koottaniyil iruppen enbadhai, maraimugamaaga solgireergalaa? Endrum kelvi ezhuppi varugindranar.
Orusilar mudhalmuraiyaaga piradhamar Modi-kku vaazhthukkal solli irukkireergale? Idhu enna pudhusaa irukku? Endrum karuthukkalai koori varugindranar. Idharkidaiye, thanush pesiya adhe tayalaak templettil, en nangalaam Birthday Wish pannak koodaadhaa? Endrum kindalaaga, kaments padhivittu varugindranar.
Aanaal, kadandha 2020-aam aandilum piradhamar Modi-kku thanush pirandha naal vaazhthu kooriyiruppadhaagavum, silaver thanush-kku aadharavaaga karuthukkalai padhivittu varugindranar. Ivvaaru palveru tharappatta vivaadhangalai, thanushin indha oreyoru padhivu erpaduthiyulladhu. Idhu avaradhu arasiyal payanathirkaana adutha aattamaa? Illayaiaa enbadhai poruthirundhu thaan paarkka vendum.

headline: 100 vayadhu varai vaazhanumnu aasaiyaa? Andraada vaazhkkaiyil enna maatrangal thevai?
text:
100 vayadhu varai vaazhanumnu aasaippadaadhavargal yaarume irukka mudiyaadhu.. Aanaal neenda aayul varai aarokkiyamaaga vaazha, nam andraada vaazhkkaiyil sila maatrangal thevai endru maruthuva nivunargal parindhuraikkindranar. Andha vagaiyil 100 vayadhai kadandhu vaazhum silarai aayvu seytha nivunargal, avargaludaiya vaazhkkai muraiyil sila podhuvaaga pazhakkavazhakkangal irundhadhai arindhanar.
Adhaavadhu thinasari udarpayitsi, seeraana thookkam, kaaygari pazhangal ullitta samacheer unavu, manadhai surusuruppaaga vaithiruppadhu, kudumbam, nanbargaludan inakkamaaga iruppadhu matrum mana azhuthathai kattuppaduthuvadhu pondra andraada vaazhkkai muraikku mukkiyathuvam alippavargal neendagaalam vaazhum vaayppu adhigam engiradhu aayvu mudivu. Neenda aayul enbadhu nammaal kattuppaduthakkoodiya vishayam illaiyendraalum, aarokkiyamaaga vaazhum vaayppai, nam vaazhkkaimurai moolam adhigarikka mudiyum. 100 vayadhai nokki oduvadharku mun, irukkum ovvoru vayadhaiyum magizhchiyaaga, aarokkiyamaaga vaazhndhu kadappom.

pennukku thalaiyil kattuppottu vittu ; mamdhaa katchiyai serndha islaamiya aadharavaalargal thaakkiyadhaaga nadithadhai kanduviditha makkal…

Indha thagaval unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu peegaar maanilathil ulla maruthuvamanai ondril noyaaliyin kudumbathinarukkum maruthuvap paniyaalargalukkum idaiye erpatta modhal thodarbaaga veliyaagi irundha video-vil indha penmani irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu indha video 2026 epral 28m thedhi samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhaavadhu therdhal mudivukku munnare indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Namakku kidaitha seythigalil, peegaar maanilam musaafarbooril ulla sreegirushnaa maruthuvak kalloori maruthuvamanaiyil noyaaliyin uravinarukkum maruthuvamanai oozhiyargalukkum modhal erpattiruppadhu therindhadhu. Idhu kurithu maruthuvamanaiyil e kiredu staap narsaaga paniyaatri varum aklaakkoor rahmaan enbavar petti alithirundhaar. Avarukku pinburam indha penmani irukkum video-kkal namakku kidaithana. Noyaaligalin uravinargal thaakkiyadhil maruthuvamanai oozhiyargalukku erpattadhaaga avar petti alithirundhaar.
Appodhu oruvar andha penmaniyin thalai kattai pidithu izhukka, avarukku kaayam edhum illai enbadhu theriya varugiradhu. Indha video-vai Maurya Dhwaj Express endra oodagathin seythiyaalar pirem sangar enbavar eduthadhaaga sila padhivugal namakku kidaithana. Nammudaiya fekt kirasando kuzhu saarbil avarai thodarbugolla muyatsi merkollappattadhu. Aanaal avarai thodarbugolla mudiyavillai. Adhe nerathil seythiyaalar pirem thannudaiya Facebook pakkathil indha video merku vangathai saarndhadhu illai, peegaaril edukkappattadhu endru urudhi seythu padhivittirundhadhaiyum kandarindhom.
Peegaar maanilathin indha video-vai eduthu, merku vangathil paajaga-vinar naadagam endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: DMK vetbaalar thervil pangetra o.panneerselvam endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK vetbaalar thervil pangetra o.panneerselvam kunindhu vanakkam therivithaar enbadhu pondru oru pugaippadam

DMK vetbaalar thervuk kuzhuvinar munbu munnaal mudhalamaichar o.panneerselvam ADMK-vil irundhavodhu kunindhu vanakkam vaithadhu pondru pugaippadam ondru threads.com-l padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kunindhavan, DMK-vukku vandha evanaa irundhaalum nimirndhu thaan nirpaan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhalil pottiyida ulla DMK vetbaalargalaith thervu seyyum kuzhu munbaaga o.panneerselvam udalai valaithuk kunindhu vanakkam solliyadhu pondru pugaippadam samooga oodagangalil padhividappattu varugiradhu. Pugaippadathaip paarkka pudhiyadhu pola illai. Sila aandugalukku munbu DMK-vil irundhu vilagiya suppulatchumi jegadheesan ullittor andha kuzhuvil iruppadhu pola pugaippadam ulladhu. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Enave, aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathaik koogul lens thalathil padhivetri thedinom. Appodhu, 2021m aandu Udhayanidhi Stalin DMK thervuk kuzhu munbu aajaraana pugaippadathai edit seythu o.panneerselvam pugaippadathai vaithu veliyittiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Udhayanidhi Stalin irukkum pugaippadathai ANI seythi oodagam 2021m aandu veliyittirundhadhu.
Tharpodhu 2026m aandu DMK thervuk kuzhuvil o.panneerselvam pangetradhu thodarbaaga pugaippadam edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru koogulil thedip paarthom. Appadi endha oru pugaippadamum kidaikkavillai. 2021m aandu DMK vetbaalar thervuk kuzhuk koottathil Udhayanidhi Stalin pangetra pugaippadathai edit seythu o.panneerselvam kunindhu vanakkam seythadhu pondru maatri samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘en udalil oduvadhu ADMK-vin ratham,’ endru nayinaar naagendhiran karuthu therivithaaraa?
text:
‘’en udalil oduvadhu ADMK-vin ratham’’ endru BJP maanila thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiran kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’udalil oduvadhu ADMK-vin ratham. En udalil oduvadhu ADMK-vin rathamdhaan. Mudhalvaraaga Edappadi pazhanichaamidhaan meendum varavendum. Jeyalalidhaavin maraivukku pin enakku paadhugaappaana katchiyaaga BJP therindhadhu – BJP maanila thunaithalaivar nayinaar naagendhiran pechu’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
San news logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu kadandha 2021m aandu san news oodagam veliyitta seythiyai ivvaaru maruvagirvu seythu varugiraargal, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, 2021m aandu san news veliyitta seythiyai aadhaarathirkaaga, inaithullom.
Idhanbadi, kadandha 2021m aandu, adhimuga.,vil erpatta koshdi modhal thodarbaaga, nayinaar naagendhiran ivvaaru karuthu therivithullaar. Idhudhodarbaaga, palveru oodagangalilum seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
Aanaal, tharpodhu nayinaar naagendhiran, paajaga.,vin Tamil Nadu maanila thalaivaraaga ullaar. Melum, BJP matrum ADMK idaiye koottani udanbaadu erpattulladhu. Indha soozhalil pazhaiya seythiyai eduthu, pudhiyadhu pondru samooga valaidhalangalil silar vendumendre ivvaaru vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kaiviritha Russia, Ukraine 4 aandugalukkup piragu India-vin udhaviyai naadum vangadhesam!
text:
Indhiyak kodhumaiyai malivaagavum viraivaagavum kondu sella mudivadhaal, naangu varuda idaivelikkup piragu vangadhesam meendum indhiyaavilirundhu kolmudhal seyyath thodangiyulladhu. Tharpodhu India-vil saadhanai alavilaana kodhumai urpathi matrum ulnaattu iruppu adhigarithulladhaal, Indhiya arasu etrumadhi vidhigalil thalarvu alithulladhu.
India-vil thanjjamadaindhirukkum munnaal piradhamar shek haseenaa vivagaaram thodarbaaga, andai naadaana vangadhesathukkum indhiyaavukkum idaiyilaana uravil virisal needikkiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, indhiyaavilirundhu meendum kodhumai kolmudhal seyya vangadhesam munvandhulladhu. Vangadhesathil, arisi vilai varalaatrus saadhanaiyai ettiyulladhodu, kodhumai maavin (Flour)vilai kadandha ore maadhathil 17% varai uyarndhulladhu. Idhanaal makkalukku malivaana vilaiyil unavu thaaniyangalai vazhangavendiya kattaayam annaattu arasukku erpattulladhu. Munnadhaaga, 2022-aam aandu Indhiya arasu kodhumai etrumadhikkuth thadai vidhithirundhadhu. Migak kuraivaana vilaichal matrum adhigarithu varum ulagalaaviya thevai kaaranamaaga ulnaattu vilaigal uyarndhadhaith thodarndhu India etrumadhikkuth thadai vidhithirundhadhu.
Idhanaal, India-vin motha kodhumaith thevai irakkumadhiyil vangadhesathin 70% pangu paadhikkappattadhu. Eninum India-vin indha etrumadhith thadai amalil irundhavodhu, arjendinaa, kanadaa, Russia matrum Ukraine aagiya naadugalidam vangkdhesam kodhumaiyai irakkumadhi seythadhu. Idhil, rashyaa-ukrain por kaaranamaagak karungadal vazhiyaaga nadaiverum thaaniyap pokkuvarathu mudangiyadhaal, ulagas sandhaiyil kodhumaiyin vilai kanisamaaga uyarndhulladhu.
Aasdhireliyak kodhumai oru tan 450 taalarukku mel virkappadum nilaiyil, indhiyak kodhumai oru tan 305 mudhal 326 taalar endra migak kuraindha vilaiyil kidaikkiradhu. Melum, kadal vazhip pokkuvarathaik kaattilum indhiyaavilirundhu ellai thaandiya rail paadhaigal moolam kuraindha nerathilum, migak kuraindha selavilum kodhumai sarakkugalai udanadiyaagak kondusella mudiyum enbadhaal, vangadhesam India-vin udhaviyai naadiyirukkiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, annaattu vanigargal idhuvarai 2,00,000 tangalukku adhigamaana indhiyak kodhumaiyaik kolmudhal seyya oppandham seythiruppadhaagath thagaval veliyaagi ulladhu.
Tharpodhu India-vil saadhanai alavilaana kodhumai urpathi matrum ulnaattu iruppu adhigarithulladhaal, Indhiya arasu etrumadhi vidhigalil thalarvu alithulladhu. Idhanmoolam naangu varuda idaivelikkup piragu iru naadugalukku idaiyeyaana varthagam meendum pudhuppikkappattulladhu. Adhenerathil, vangadhesam kodhumaiyai ulnaattileye kolmudhal seyyath thodangiyulladhu. 'thi teyli staar' pathirigaiyinbadi, vangadhesam aandudhorum sumaar 10 latcham tan kodhumaiyai urpathi seygiradhu, aanaal ulnaattuth thevaiyaip poorthiseyya koodudhalaaga 70 latcham tan kodhumaiyai irakkumadhi seyya vendiyulladhu. Vangaaladhesathin piradhaana thaaniyam arisi endraalum, annaattil adhigam nugarappadum irandaavadhu thaaniyam kodhumai aagum enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Rajinigaanth matrum thanush ondru serndhu pudhiya katchik kodiyai arimugam seythanaraa?
text:
‘‘rajinigaanth matrum thanush ondru serndhu pudhiya katchik kodiyai arimugam seytha kaatchi,’’ endru koori,

idhanudan rajinigaanth matrum thanush ondru serndhu pudhiya katchik kodi ondrai veliyiduvadhu pondra pugaippadam inaikkappattulladhu.

investigation_details:

headline: `vaarathirku orumurai podhum!' – neerizhivu noyaaligalukkaana pudhiya insulin!
text:
“vaarathirku orumurai” enbadhaal idhu anaivarukkum etradhu alladhu aavathillaadhadhu endru porul kollak koodaadhu.
Ulagin mudhal vaarathirku orumurai seluthappadum neendagaala insulin marundhaana avikli (Awiqli), sarkkarai noy sigichaiyil pudhiya maatrathai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Idhu kurithu neerizhivu maruthuvarsathyan raagavan, endogirainaalajist, pirinith kilinik, Salem - nammudan virivaagap pagirndhu kondaar.
``idhan mukkiyak kooru insulin aigodek aagum. Thinamum insulin selutha vendiya siramathirku maatraaga, maruthuvar parindhuraiyin adippadaiyil vaarathirku orumurai mattume oosi seluthum muraiyai idhu vazhangugiradhu. Avikli periyavargalukkaana taip-1 matrum taip-2 neerizhivu sigichaiyil payanbaduthappadugiradhu.
Taip-1 neerizhivu noyaaligalukku unavu nerathil thevaiyaana kurugiyagaala insulinudan idhu inaikkappada vendum. Taip-2 neerizhivu noyaaligalukku thaniyaagavo alladhu pira neerizhivu marundhugaludan sertho payanbadutha mudiyum.
Neerizhivu noy indru India-vil adhigarithu varum mukkiyamaana udalnalap pirasnaigalil ondraagum. Pala noyaaligalukku, kurippaaga vagai 2 neerizhivu noyil, kaalappokkil rathas sarkkaraiyaik kattuppadutha insulin thevaippadalaam. Thinamum insulin oosi poda vendiyiruppadhu silarukku siramamaagavum, sila nerangalil marundhai thavaraviduvadharkum kaaranamaaga irukkalaam.
Insulin aigodek (Insulin Icodec) enbadhu miga neendagaalam seyalbadum adippadai insulin (basal insulin) vagaiyais serndhadhu.
Idhan mukkiyamaana sirappu, maruthuvar parindhuraikkum soozhalil vaarathirku orumurai seluthakkoodiyadhaaga iruppadhaagum. Idhanaal thinasari oosi selutha vendiya sumai kuraiyalaam.
Indhiya noyaaligalai ulladakkiya ONWARDS aayvugalil, aigodek payanbaduthiyavargalin HbA1c kuraippu (3 maadha sarkkarai alavu)matrum rathas sarkkarai kattuppaadu thinasari adippadai insulingaludan oppidumbodhu podhuvaaga othirundhadhu.
Aanaal, `vaarathirku orumurai' enbadhaal idhu anaivarukkum etradhu alladhu aavathillaadhadhu endru porul kollak koodaadhu.
Rathas sarkkarai kuraidhal (haippogilaiseemiyaa) insulin sigichaiyin mukkiyamaana pakkavilaivaagum. Kurippaaga vagai 1 neerizhivu noyaaligalil aigodek payanbaduthumbodhu rathas sarkkarai kuraidhal kurithu koodudhal kavanam thevaippadalaam.
Enave, insulin aigodekkai maruthuvarin aalosanai illaamal thodangavo, alavai maatravo, niruthavo koodaadhu. Sariyaana oosi murai, rathas sarkkarai kangaanippu, unavu, udarpayitsi matrum maruthuvar koorum parisodhanaigalai muraiyaagap pinbatra vendum.
Kannottam matrum adhu seyalbadum vidham:
seyaldhiran mikka moolapporul:
insulin aigodek, idhu miga neenda neram seyalbadum oru manidha insulin analaak aagum.
Seyalmurai:
idhu rathathil ulla seeram albuminudan valuvaagap pinaindhu, medhuvaaga veliyaagum oru semippidathai uruvaakkugiradhu. Idhu muzhu ezhu naalgalukkum rathas sarkkaraiyin alavai seeraagak kuraikkum vilaivai alikkiradhu.
Sumai kuraippu:
aandudhorum seluthappadum adippadai oosigalin ennikkai, thinamum seluthappadum 365 tosgalilirundhu, varudathirku verum 52 tosgalaagak kuraikkappadugiradhu.
Payanbaduthum murai:
ovvoru vaaramum ore naalil, vaarathirku oru murai avikli plaks tas ( Awiqli FlexTouch) penaavaip payanbaduthi tholadi oosiyaaga (sap-kiyoodeniyas) seluthappada vendum.
Ninaivil kollungal:
pudhiya sigichai enbadhu anaivarukkum ore maadhiriyaana sigichai alla. Ungal neerizhivu nilai, vayadhu, pira noygal matrum tharpodhaiya marundhugalaip poruthu maruthuvare sirandha insulin muraiyaith thervu seyya vendum.
Pakka vilaivugal matrum kavanikka vendiyavai
podhuvaana pakka vilaivugal:
haippogilaiseemiyaa (kuraindha ratha sarkkarai alavu, kurippaaga sariyaana nerathil alladhu sariyaana alavil kodukkappadaavittaal), oosi podum idathil erpadum edhirvinaigal matrum udal edai adhigarippu.
Paadhugaappuk kangaanippu:
sugaadhaarap paraamarippaalargal, kurippaaga marundhin alavais sariseyyum aarambak kattathil, rathas sarkkarai alavaik kavanamaagak kangaanikkumaaru parindhuraikkappadugindranar."

headline: Siraar paaliyal thushbirayoga ulladakkangal paravalai thadukka edukkappatta nadavadikkai enna? Mathiya arasu padhilalikka Court irudhi vaayppu
text:
Siraar paaliyal thushbirayoga ulladakkangal paravalai thadukka edukkappatta nadavadikkai enna? Mathiya arasu padhilalikka Court irudhi vaayppu
–sirappu niruvar–
‘samooga oodagangalil paravum siruvar paaliyal thushbirayoga ulladakkangalai thadukka mathiya arasu enna nadavadikkai eduthadhu. Mathiya minnanu matrum thagaval thozhilnutba amaichagam padhil alikka irudhi vaayppu vazhangugirom’ ena, ucha Needhimandram therivithulladhu.
Nam naattil iyangum samooga valaidhalangalil siraargal thodarbaana paaliyal thushbirayoga ulladakkangal parappappaduvadhai thadukka kori, ‘jast raits paar siltran alaiyans’ endra siraargal nala amaippu ucha needhimandrathil manu thaakkal seythadhu.
Idhu thodarbaaga mathiya minnanu matrum thagaval thozhilnutba amaichagam, satta amaichagam padhil manu thaakkal seyya vendum ena kadandha aaga., 14l ucha Needhimandram utharavittirundhadhu. Aanaal, idhuvarai padhil manuth thaakkal seyyappadavillai. Innilaiyil, ucha needhimandra needhivadhigal je.pi.pardhivaalaa, vinoth ke.sandhiran amarvil ivvazhakku netru meendum visaaranaikku vandhadhu.
Appodhu mathiya arasu tharappil aajaraana koodudhal solisittar jenaral natraaj, ‘‘mathiya arasu indha vivagaarathai theeviramaaga anugi varugiradhu. Vidhimeeralil eeduvatta niruvanathirku nottees anuppi, satta nadavadikkaigalai thodangi irukkirom,’’ ena therivithaar.
Manudhaarar tharappil munvaikkappatta vaadham:
samooga valaidhalangalil siraar paaliyal thushbirayoga ulladakkangal paravinaal, pokso satta vidhigalinbadi ulloor Police-aridam udanadiyaaga pugaar alikka vendum ena ucha Needhimandram erkanave utharavittulladhu. Aanaal, indha utharavai pala samooga valaidhala niruvanangal muraiyaaga pinbatruvadhillai.
‘instaagiraam’ samooga oodagathil ithagaiya ulladakkangalai vilambarappaduthi, panam petru, andha kaatchigal matroru samoogavalaidhalamaana, ‘teligiraam’ moolam virkappadugiradhu. Idhanai sarvadhesa seythi niruvanam aadhaarathudan veliyittulladhu.
America-vil irundhu iyangum samoogavalaidhalamaana, ‘pesbuk’kin thaay niruvanamaana, ‘mettaa’ America arasin kavanathirku kondu sendradhe thavira, nam naattin pokso sattappadi, ingulla kuzhandhaigal nala pirivukko, ulloor poleesaarukko endha thagavalaiyum alikkavillai.
Ivvaaru manudhaarar tharappil vaadhidappattadhu.
Idhaith thodarndhu needhivadhigal pirappitha utharavu:
siraargalukku edhiraana paaliyal thushbirayoga ulladakkangal paravuvadhai thadukka mathiya arasu idhuvarai enna nadavadikkai eduthadhu. Kadandha 2024l ucha Needhimandram pirappitha utharavai amalbadutha enna nadavadikkai edukkappattadhu. Samoogavalaidhala niruvanangal vidhigalai meeruvadhai thadukka merkollappatta munnecharikkai nadavadikkaigal enna. Idhu kurithu mathiya minnanu matrum thagaval thozhilnutba amaichagam, satta amaichagam aagiyavai virivaana padhilai thaakkal seyya vendum. Idhai irudhi vaayppaaga vazhangugirom.
Ivvaaru needhivadhigal utharavittanar.

headline: Roo.70,000 arasu sambalam.. Velaikkup pogaadha doctor? Sikkiya MLA marumagal!
text:
Karnaadaga maanilam paagalgottil ulla arasu maruthuvamanaiyil paniyaatrikkonde thaniyaar kallooriyil mudhugalai maruthuvap padippu paditha Congress em.el.e-vin uravinar oruvar panineekkam seyyappattullaar.
Karnaadaga maanilam paagalgot thogudhi Congress em.el.e umesh metti. Ivaradhu marumagal, doctor angidhaa yaargal. Ivarudaiya thandhai raajgumaar yaargal maavatta sugaadhaara adhigaariyaaga ullaar. Indha nilaiyil, paagalgottil ulla arasin 'namma kilinik' (Namma Clinic) maiyathil oppandha adippadaiyil maruthuva adhigaariyaagap paniyaatriya doctor angidhaa yaargal, adhanmoolam maadham roo.75,000 varai sambalamum petru vandhullaar. Idharkidaiye, thaniyaar maruthuvak kallooriyil em.ti (Pathology) padippaiyum padithu vandhullaar.
Idhu thodarbaagap pugaar alikkappatta nilaiyil, avar panineekkam seyyappattullaar. Adhaavadhu, arasup paniyai raajinaamaa seyyaamalum, uriya anumadhi peraamalum thaniyaar maruthuvak kallooriyil em.ti padippai muzhuneramaagap padithu vandhadhum, melum pala maadhangalaaga maruthuvamanaikkus sellaamal thodarndhu sambalam petru vandhadhum visaaranaiyil theriya vandhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, angidhaa yaargal oppandhap paniyil irundhu udanadiyaaga viduvikkappattup panineekkam seyyappattaar. Melum idhudhodarbaaga visaaranai nadatha utharavidappattulladhu. Ichambavam maanilathil paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Karoor TVK koottathil mayangiyavarukku pen kaavalar seytha mudhaludhavi endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Karooril nadandha TVK pirasaara koottathin podhu erpatta kootta nerisalil sikki mayangiya oruvarukku pen kaavalar oruvar mudhaludhavi alitha kaatchi endru oru video

pen kaavalar oruvar ilainjar oruvarukku vaayil kaatrai oodhi mudhaludhavi alitha video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Veediyayovil “kaavalar irundhaalum avalum oru thaay thaane kadaisi varaikkum moochu koduthu uyir kodukka poraadum thevadhainga saaga irundha ilainjanai moochu kagoduthu kadaisi varaikkum andha ilainjan kan thirakkavillai” endru irundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil. “kaavalaraaga irundhaalum thaayullam konda sagodhari…🥲 #karoorgoottanerisalbali ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karooril TVK nadathiya pirasaara koottathil pangetra 41 per nerisal kaaranamaaga uyirizhandhanar. Indha nilaiyil Tamil Nadu kaavaldhurai saarbil koottathirku sariyaana paadhugaappu vazhangappadavillai endru kutramsaattappadugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil koottathil sikki mayangiya oruvarukku thamizhagak kaavaldhuraiyais saarndha pen kaavalar oruvar mudhaludhavi vazhanginaar endru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video kadandha joolai maadhathilirundhu samooga oodagangalil matrum seythi oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Abplive indhiyil veliyittirundha seythiyai mozhimaatram seythu paarthom.
Adhil, peegaaril aaraa maavatta aatchiyar aluvalagathil kaalaraaga paniyaatri vandha penmaniyin 15 vayadhu magan tharkolai seythugondadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Magan uyirizhandhadhai erka marutha thaay, irandha siruvanin udalukku mudhaludhavi seythu, eppadiyaavadhu uyir pizhaikka vaithuvida mudiyaadhaa endru muyatsi seytha seyal paarthavargalaik kan kalangas seythadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam karooril TVK kootta nerisalil sikkiya ilainjarukkuth Tamil Nadu kaavaldhurai pen kaavalar mudhaludhavi alithaar endru paravum video peegaarais saarndhadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Savarimalai thanga kireedam thirudu ponadhaa? Thiruvaavarana aanaiyar vilakkam!!
text:
Keralaavin migavum pirasitha kovilgalil ondru savarimalai aiyappan kovil. Indhak kovilukkum India-vin palveru pagudhigalilum irundhu eraalamaaga pakdhargal sendru varugindranar. Idharkidaiyil, andhak kovilais sutri eralamaana muraigedu sarchaigalum irundhu varugindrana.
Andha vagaiyil thaan, kadandha 2012m aandu aagast maadham thamizhagathai serndha pakdhargalaal nangodaiyaaga vazhangappatta 55.75 savarangal ( 446 kiraam) edaiyulla thanga keeridam kaanamal ponadhaaga thagaval veliyaagi sameevathil adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu. Kurippaaga, asal keeridathirku poliyaana keeridam vaikkappattirundhadhaagavum koorappattadhu.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, thangak kireedam kaanaamal ponadhaaga koorappatta thagavalukku thiruvaavarana aanaiyar rejilaal maruppu therivithullaar. Idhugurithu avar koorugaiyil, savarimalaiyin "stiraang room" mil vaikkappattirundha "asal thangak kireedam" adhe paadhugaappu araiyil pathiramaaga ulladhu. Paadhugaappu araiyil madhippumikka aavaranangalin piradhigal matrum maadhirigal utbada palveru porutkal ullana. Enave sarivaarppin podhu kuzhappam erpattirukkalaam ena vilakkamalithullaar.
