headline: Palusisdhaan sudhandhiram petradhaaga arivikkappattadhaa?
text:
Paagisdhaanin oru pagudhiyaaga irukkum palusisdhaan thani naadaaga arivikkappattadhaaga oru video

podhuk koottathil pen oruvar pesum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paagisdhaan irandaa udainjjiruchaa…!!? Indru sudhandhira thinathai arivithulla palusisdhaanathirku vaazhthukkalai therivippom… 💐💐💐
namma oor marma navargal oruthan kooda vaazhthu therivikka maattaanunga…
naamalaavadhu vaazhthu therivippom…
#vaazhthukkal_palusisdhaan…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Paagisdhaanin oru pagudhiyaaga irundhu varugiradhu palusisdhaan. Paloos makkal paagisdhaanin oru pagudhiyaaga palusisdhaan thodarvadhai virumbavillai endru koorappadugiradhu. Thangalukku thani naadu vendum endra korikkai angu nilavugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil paagisdhaanilirundhu palusisdhaan vidudhalai petradhaaga oru padhivu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Appadi endha oru arivippum veliyaagaadha nilaiyil indha video padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video 2024m aandil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. “pen singathin karjanai. @MahrangBaloch_
muzhakkathirku pallaayirakkanakkaanorin padhil” endru kurippittu 2024 janavari 28m thedhi indha video-vai The Balochistan Post – English endra X thala pakkam veliyittirundhadhu. Aanaal andha video patri adhil veru edhuvum kurippidappadavillai.
Yaar andha @MahrangBaloch_ endru thedip paartha podhu, palusisdhaan pagudhiyin manidha urimai poraali endru sila seythigal therivithana. 2024m aandu palos yakjehdhi kamittiyin (BYC) varalaaru kurithu shaavaani stediyathil nadandha koottathin podhu manidha urimai aarvalar doctor savihaa palos uraiyaatrinaar” endru sila seythigal namakku kidaithana. Adhu thani palusisdhaan piragadana koottam endru endha idathilum kurippidappadavillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu 2024 janavari 27m thedhi indha nigazhchi thodarbaaga veliyaana sila seythigalum namakku kidaithana. Adhil paagisdhaanin athumeeralgalaik kandithu paloos makkal poraattam nadathinar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam palusisdhaan sudhandhiram petru endru kurippittup paravum video thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video aagast 12, 2026 andru padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhil indru adhaavadhu aagast 12m thedhi palusisdhaan sudhandhiram petradhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Palusisdhaan thani naadaaga arivikkappattirundhaal adhai Pakistan veliyittirukka vendum. Paloos makkale arivithirundhaalum adhai matra naadugal angeegarithirukka vendum. Aanaal, appadi endha oru seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Idhan moolam indha thagavalum thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: “A4 kutravaaliyaaga raaj mogan peyar serppu” endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
A4 kutravaaliyaaga raaj mogan peyar serppu endru pudhiya thalaimurai tholaikkaatchi veliyittadhu pondru news card ondru

pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru niyoosgaardu Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “A4 kutravaaliyaaga raajmogan peyar serppu! Karoor needhimandrathil thaakkal seyyappattulla CBI mudhal thagaval arikkaiyil maavatta seyalaalar madhiyazhagan, pussi aananth, nirmalgumaar peyargalaith thodarndhu TVK thunaip podhucheyalaalar raajmogan peyarum A4 aaga serkkappattulladhaaga thagaval. Aadhav arjoonan peyar illaadhadhaal, avar paajagavidam vilai poyvittaar endru thavegavinar vimarsanam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karoor kootta nerisal thodarbaana vazhakkai CBI visaarithu varugiradhu. Vazhakku thodarbaana mudhal thagaval arikkaiyai needhimandrathil CBI thaakkal seythulladhaaga seythigal veliyaagina. Aanaal, adhu thodarbaana vivarangal edhuvum veliyaagavillai. Indha nilaiyil sila oodagangal mudhal thagaval arikkaiyil kurippittulla vishayangal thodarbaaga pirathiyega seythigalai veliyittu varugindrana. Idhil evvalavu unmai enbadhu mudhal thagaval arikkai veliyaana piragudhaan theriyavarum.
Indha nilaiyil raaj mogan peyarum serkkappattulladhaaga news card samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Karoor sambavathirkup piragu thamizhagak kaavaldhurai padhivu seytha mudhal thagaval arikkaiyil raajmogan peyar illai. Aanaalum avarum thalaimaraivaagave iruppadhaaga samooga oodagangalil vimarsikkappattu varugiraar. Indha nilaiyil avaradhu peyar mudhal thagaval arikkaiyil serkkappattulladhaagavum aadhav arjoonaa peyar viduvikkappattiruppadhaagavum palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha news card-il aadhav arjoonaa peyar aadhav arjoonan endru thavaraagak kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thamizh paakndum vazhakkamaaga pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidum news card-il ulladhu pol illai. Enave, indha news card thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Pudhiya thalaimurai 2025 akdovar 24m thedhi veliyittirundha news kaardugalai paarvaiyittom. Aanaal, adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyidavillai enbadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Indha news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku anuppi idhu unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru kurippittu, idhu thodarbaaga pudhiya thalaimuraiyil veliyaana padhivai namakku anuppinaar. Idhan moolam indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: “thi.mu.ka-vil inaindha kamalhaasan” endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Makkal needhi mayyam thalaivar kamalahaasan, DMK-vil inaindhaar endru oru pugaippadam

Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinukku makkal needhi mayyam thalaivar kamalhaasan poongothu alikkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaithagavalil, “vijayin puli pada kadhaanaayagi srudhihaasanin thandhai kamalahaasan Stalin munnilaiyil DMK-vil inaindhaar…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadam matrum thagavalai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Makkal needhi mayyam katchith thalaivar kamalhaasan, DMK-vil inaindhuvittadhaagap palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Appadi oru sambavam nadandhadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illaadha soozhalil, kurippittavargalukku edhiraaga vadhandhiyai parappum nokkil indha padhivu veliyidappattiruppadhai ariya mudigiradhu.
Indha vadhandhiyaiyum palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varave, indha thagaval patriya thelivai erpaduthum nokkil aayvu seythom. Mudhalil kamalhaasan thannudaiya katchiyaik kalaithuvittu alladhu thannudaiya katchiyai DMK-yudan inaikka arivippu edhum seythullaaraa, adhu thodarbaaga seythi edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru paarthom. Appadi oru thagaval iruppadhu pondru kisugisu kooda pathirigaigalil veliyaagavillai.
Aduthadhaaga indha pugaippadam eppodhu edukkappattadhu endru thedinom. Nammudaiya thedalil indha pugaippadathai thunai mudhalamaichar Udhayanidhi Stalin 2025 me maadham thannudaiya samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyittirundhadhai kandarindhom. Adhil, “kazhaga koottani saarbil maanilangalavaith therdhalil @maiamofficial vetbaalaraaga pottiyidavulla akkatchiyin thalaivar kalainjaani @ikamalhaasan saar, kazhagath thalaivar – maanbumigu mudhalamaichar @mkstalin avargalai annaa arivaalayathil indru mariyaadhai nimithamaaga sandhithu vaazhthu petra nigazhvil naamum udanirundhom. Anbodu vaazhthi magizhndhom” endru kurippittirundhaar. Idhan moolam indha pugaippadam kamalhaasan DMK-vil inaindha podhu edutha padam illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Kamalhaasan DMK-vil inaindhaar endru pagirappadum vadhandhi thodarbaaga makkal needhi mayyathin mootha nirvaagiyidam pesinom. Avarum, “idhu vishamigal parappum vadhandhi. Idhil unmaiyillai. DMK koottaniyil ullom. Idhai poruthukkolla mudiyaamal vadhandhi parappiyullanar” endraar. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythadhu.

headline: Kaanjjivuram aruge oru vittalavuram piremiga vittalan aalayam; inge hari naamam sonnaal kavalaigal theerum!
text:
Vittalavuram piremiga vittalan aalayathil naamasangeerdhana muraippadiye archanai enbadhaal, mandhirangalukkup padhilaaga ‘hare raama hare raama, hare kirushna hare kirushna...’ enum naamame olikkiradhu.
Magaaraashdira maanilathil pugazhbetru vilangum thalam pandarivuram. Ange perumaal paanduranganaagak koyilgondullaar.
Vittallan endru potrappadum andhap perumaal naadengilum adhe thirunaamathodu ezhundharuliyirukkiraar. Appadi oru thalamdhaan kaanjjivuram aruge ulla vittalavuram.
Sennai-pudhucheri kizhakkuk kadarkarai saalaiyil, maamallavuram thaandi vengambaakkathilirundhu sumaar 4 km tholaivil ilaiyanaarguppam endra oor varum. Angirundhu sumaar 2 km tholaivil ulladhu vittalavuram piremiga vittalar thirukkoyil.
Vijayanagarap perarasar kirushnadhevaraayar saarbil indhap pagudhiyai aatchi seytha kondaiyadheva magaaraajaa vittalanin paramavakdhar. Ivarukku arulseytha vittalan, ivarin viruppappadi maamallavurathai adutha thulasivanathil, pandarivurathil ullavaare ezhundharulinaar.
Angeye sreevittalanukku aalayam ezhuppi andha ooraiyum `vittalavuram' endru maatrinaar kondaiya thevamagaaraajaa.
Ivar kaalathukkup piragu sadhaasivaraayar kaalathil (1558-m aandu) indhak koyil visdharikkappattu, thiruther ondrum seyyappatta varalaatrai ingulla kalvettugal koorugindrana.
Pazhaimaiyaip paraisaatrum azhagaana katrali indhak koyil. Kovuram thaandi ulle sendraal, kodimaram paliveedamum thigazha... Koyilin parandha amaippum amaidhiyum nammaip paravasappaduthugindrana.
Munmandavathudan koodiya karuvarai. Ange rukmini, sathyavaamaa samedharaagasreeviremiga vittalan arulgiraar. Sumaar 5 adi uyarathil, iduppil kai vaithu nindra kolathil namakkaagak kaathu nirkiraar. Piremiga vittalan ketkum varam alikkum thayaavaran engiraargal.
Mangiya vilakkoliyil indha aanandhak kannanaith tharisikkumbodhe, nammul kavalaigal marandhu kalippum nambikkaiyum pirakkindrana. Indhas sannidhiyil nindru hari naama javam seythaal nam kavalaigal anaithum marandhuvogumaam.
Ingu naamasangeerdhana muraippadiye archanai enbadhaal, mandhirangalukkup padhilaaga ‘hare raama hare raama, hare kirushna hare kirushna...’ enum naamame olikkiradhu. Ingu thinamum maalaiyil kirushna naama sangeertha pajanaiyum nadakkiradhu.
Kuzhandhai varam thirumana varam arulum arulum kannanaaga indhap piremiga vittalan vilangugiraar. Ingu vandhu vendikkondu noynodigal theerndhavargal anegamber engiraargal.
Moolavarukku munbu utsavar thirumeni. Iru theviyarudan kaatchi tharugiraar utsavar. Koodave sreesandhaana latchumi thaayaar, sakkarath thaazhvaar aagiyorin utsavath thirumenigalum ullana.
Karuvaraikku edhire 5 padigaludangoodiya thanis sannidhiyil sreegarudaazhvaar kannanaik kumbitta nilaiyil kaatchi tharugiraar. Koyil thiruchutril sreesandhaana latchumi thaayaar, sreenivaasap perumaal, sreevaradharaajap perumaal, sreevikshvaksenar, sreeraamaanujar sannidhigal azhagiya katraligalaaga ullana.
Azhagiya vimaanathodu kaanappadum indhak koyilin sutril nandhavanamum iru udaivatta silaigalum, kalvettugalum kaanappadugindrana.
Ingu vandhu thirattuppaal vaithu vazhivattaal thirumanath thadai neengum enbadhu nambikkai. Kuzhandhai varam venduvor, indhak koyilukku vandhu sandhaana magaalatchumiyaiyum, sandhaana kirushnaraiyum vazhivada, viraivil puthirap paakkiyam kittum; paal paayasam padaithu vazhivattaal kalviyil menmai undaagum engiraargal pakdhargal.
Kaalai 7 mudhal 10.30 mani varaiyum; maalai 5 mudhal 6.30 mani varaiyum piremiga vittalan aalayam thirandhirukkum. Egaadhasi naalil madhiyam 12 mani varai thirandhirukkum. Ingu kannan siva-vishnu amsathudan arulvadhaaga aidhigam.
Aagave, sivaraathiriyum ingu viseshamaagak kondaadappadugiradhu. Melum kogulaashdami, vaigunda egaadhasi ullitta vaivavangalum indha aalayathil kolaagalamaagak kondaadappadugindrana.
Peridhum koottamindri amaidhiyum perum saannithiyamum kondu vilangum indhath thennaga pandarivuram, tholborul aayvuthuraiyin keezh ulla indha aalayam.
Enave miga suthamaagavum theyvigath thanmaiyudanum paramaarikkappattu varugiradhu. Maamallavuram selbavargal kattaayam tharisikkavendiya arpudha aalayam idhu.

headline: Modiyai thorkadikkum velaiyaith thodangivitten endru sandhiravaavu naayudu koorinaaraa?
text:
Modiyai thorkadippadharkaana velaigalaith thodangivitten endru aandhira mudhalamaichar sandhiravaavu naayudu kooriyadhaaga oru padhivu

oodagangalil veliyaagum pirekking news card pondru aandhirap piradhesa mudhalamaichar sandhiravaavu naayudu pugaippadathudan padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Adhil, “modiyai piradhamaraakka naandhaan migapperiya muyatsigalil eeduvatten. Ippodhu naane avaraith thorkadippadharkaana velaigalaiyum thodangivitten. Naan ninaithaal paajagavai mugavariye illaamal seythuviduven” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
2024 naadaalumandrath therdhalil endha katchikkum thanip perumbaanmai kidaikkavillai. Thesiya jananaayagak koottanikku perumbaanmai kidaithadhu. Aandhiraavin thelungu thesam, peegaarin aikkiya janadhaa thalam aagiyavatrin aadharavudan moondraavadhu muraiyaaga narendhira Modi piradhamaraaga poruppetraar.
Indha nilaiyil koottaniyil pirasnai erpattadhu polavum, narendhira modiyai thorkadippadharkaana velaiyaith thodangivitten endru thelungu thesam katchiyin thalaivarum aandhirappiradhesa mudhalvarumaana sandhiravaavu naayudu kooriyadhu pondru oru thagavalai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Oodagathin peyar indri, thani navar yaaro oruvar uruvaakkiya news card-ai palarum pagirndhu varave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
News card-il ulla thagavalai appadiye taip seythu, koogulil padhivittuth thedinom. Appadi sandhiravaavu naayudu pesiyadhaaga endha seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Adhai appadiye Facebook-il padhivittu thediya podhu, 2018m aandil indha news card-ai palarum viral-aaga padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. 2018m aandil thesiya jananaayagak koottaniyilirundhu thelungu thesam veliyeriyadhu. Narendhira Modi matrum paajaga-vukku edhiraaga sandhiravaavu naayudu aavesamaagap pesiya kaalam adhu.
Paajaga-vai azhithuviduven endrellaam 2018, 2019m aandil sandhiravaavu naayudu pesiyadhu thodarbaana seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulladhu pondra seythi kidaikkavillai. Adhil thedhiyum kurippidappadavillai. Enave, eppodhu avar ippadip pesinaar enbadhaik kandariyavum mudiyaamal ponadhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil indha news card 2018m aandilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. 2018l BJP koottaniyilirundhu thelungu thesam vilagiyadhaith thodarndhu paajaga-vai modiyai vimarsithu sandhiravaavu naayudu pesiyadhu unmaidhaan. Aanaal, 2024 therdhalil BJP koottaniyil thelungu thesam meendum inaindhuvittadhu.
Tharpodhu mathiya arasu seyalbada thelungu thesathin aadharavu miga mukkiyamaanadhaaga ulladhu. Indha soozhalil pazhaiya news card-ai parappi koottaniyil kuzhappam erpattadhu pondra vadhandhiyai samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kelvi ketkum maanavargal achuruthalaaga maarivittaargal; solgiraar raagul
text:
Indhoor: thervugalil muraigedugal, kasivugal matrum kalvi nilaiyangalin ulgattamaippu seergulaivadhu kurithu maanavargal kelvi ezhuppa vendum endru Congress embi raagul therivithullaar.
Mathiya piradhesam indhooril nadaivetra 'sathron ki koonjs' nigazhchiyil Congress embi raagul kalandhugondu maanavargaludan kalandhuraiyaadinaar. Appodhu, avar pesiyadhaavadhu; maanavargal thaan naattin edhirgaalam. Avargal illaamal endha naadum munnera mudiyaadhu. Maanavargal eppodhum aarvathudanum, achamindrik kelvi ketbavargalaagavum irukkindranar. Aanaal, sila aadharavaalargal endhak kelviyum ketkaamal oru maaya ulagathil vaazhvadhodu kozhaigalaaga irukkiraargal.
Arasukku maanavargal kelvigal ketbadhu achuruthalaaga irukkiradhu. Thervugalil muraigedugal, kasivugal matrum kalvi nilaiyangalin ulgattamaippu seergulaivadhu kurithu maanavargal kelvi ezhuppa vendum.
Mathiyap piradhesathil kadandha 8 aandugalaaga aatcherppu nadavadikkaigal paadhikkappattullana. Pirilims, meyins matrum nergaanalgal utbada anaithuth thervugalilum 13 sadhaveedha paniyidangal mudakki vaikkappattullana. Kaalip paniyidangal muraiyaaga nirappappadaamal oppandha adippadaiyil nirappappaduvadhaal, pala ilainjargalin vayadhu varambu mudindhu thavikkindranar. Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Valimaiyaana paaradhathai uruvaakkuvadhil pangalippom; thunai janaadhivadhi siviaar valiyuruthal
text:
Chennai: otrumaiyum nallinakkamum niraindha valimaiyaana paaradhathai uruvaakkuvadhil naam anaivarum thodarndhu pangalippom ena thunai janaadhivadhi sivi raadhaagirushnan therivithullaar.
Avaradhu padhivu: tham vaazhnaalaith thesap panikkum thamizhth thondirkum arppanitha paaradha annaiyin thavappudhalvar, paattup pulavan magaagavi suppiramaniya paaradhiyaarin ninaivu naalil malaranjjali seluthi vananginen. “paaradha naadu pazhamberum naadu - neeradhan pudhalvar inninaivagatraadheer” ena indhiyap perunaattin otrumaiyaiyum perumaiyaiyum paadiyavar.
“mandhiram pol vendumadaa sollinbam” ena mozhiyin aatralaip potriya paaradhiyaarin sorkal, kaalam kadandhum nam manangalil adhe veeriyathudan olithukkondirukkindrana. Thesappatru, samathuvam, pengal munnetram aagiya uyariya vizhumiyangalaith tham kavidhaigalaalum vaazhvaalum eduthuraitha magaagavi paaradhiyaarin ninaivaip potruvom.
Avar kanda kanavugalai nanavaakki, otrumaiyum nallinakkamum niraindha valimaiyaana paaradhathai uruvaakkuvadhil naam anaivarum thodarndhu pangalippom. Ivvaaru sivi raadhaagirushnan kooriyullaar.

headline: Kolathoor thogudhi BJP vetbaalaraaga nadigai kasdhoori arivikkappattaaraa?
text:
Kolathooril BJP vetbaalaraaga nadigai kasdhoori arivikkappattadhaaga oru padhivu

nadigai kasdhoori pugaippadathudan yaaro veliyitta samooga oodaga padhivai sgireenshaat eduthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “kolathoor BJP vetbaalar arivippu. Neenda izhuvarikku pinnar! Thamizhisaiyin aadharavin moolam kolathoor-yil pottiyida seet petraar nadigai kasdhoori! Ennai siraiyil adaitha muga staalinai arasiyal kalathil oda viduven ena unarchi ponga pechu!” endru adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “arasiyal kalathil oda viduviyaa..?! Nee enna naayaa avar unnai thurathi oda..?! Alvaa kodukkum DMK appadiye thunginu odumme..!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhalil paajaga-vum adhimuga-vum inaindhu therdhalai sandhikkindrana. Idhil paajaga-vukku thogudhigal odhukkappattum vetbaalar pattiyal veliyaagaamal ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil nadigai kasdhoorikku kolathoor thogudhiyai BJP odhukkiyulladhaagap palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Paajaga-vukku Chennai-yil mayilaappoor thogudhi mattume odhukkappattulladhu. Aavaludan edhirbaartha thi.nagar, velacheri ullitta thogudhigal marukkappattulladhu. Indha soozhalil kolathoor thogudhiyil BJP saarbil kasdhoori pottiyidugiraar endra thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu thelivaagath therigiradhu. Idhai aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
ADMK koottaniyil paajaga-vukku odhukkappatta pattiyalgal thodarbaaga BJP veliyitta padhivai adhan X thalathilirundhu eduthom. Adhil kolathoor thogudhi idam peravillai. ADMK saarbil andha thogudhiyil sandhaana kirushnan enbavar pottiyida ulladhaaga ADMK arivitha seythigal namakku kidaithana. ADMK koottaniyil kolathoor thogudhiyil adhimuga-ve pottiyidugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil kolathoor thogudhi paajaga-vukku odhukkappattadhaagavum angu kasdhoori pottiyida ulladhaagavum paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: ‘arunaachala piradhesathil haayaaga nuzhaindha China raanuvam’ endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Arunaachalaviradhesathukkul haayaaga China raanuvam nuzhaindha podhu, varaadheergal endru China raanuva veerargalin kaalil vizhundhu Indhiya moodhaatti kadharinaar endru oru video

raanuva veerargalai kiraama makkal thaduppadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “indhiya pagudhiyaana arunaachal piradhesathukkul evvidha thadaiyum indri haayaaga nuzhaiyum China raanuvam. Ulle varaadheergal endru kaalil vizhundhu kadharum Indhiya moodhaatti…
namma kusuva kuru haayaaga velinaattu sutrulaavil irukkiraan kavodhi modi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiyaavukkul 60 km tholaivukku China raanuvam aakkiramippu seythulladhaaga samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi paravi varugiradhu. Indha thagaval thavaraanadhu endru Indhiya arasu saarbil vilakkam alikkappattirundhadhu. Indha nilaiyil India-vin arunaasalappiradhesa maanilathukkul China raanuvathinar endha thadaiyumindri sudhandhiramaaga nuzhaindhadhaagavum, avargalin kaalil vizhundhu Indhiya kiraama makkal varaadheergal endru kenjjiyadhaagavum vidiyo ondru samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu. Raanuva veerargalaip paarkka seenaavais saarndhavargal polath theriyavillai. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai joon 30, 2026 andru Poknapham & The People’s Chronicle endra oodagam thannudaiya Facebook pakkathil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Manippuri mozhiyil veliyaana padhivai saatjividi moolam mozhiveyarthu paarthom.
Adhil, “netru, paambey thalaimaiyilaana UNLF-in kedargal veliyeriya piragu, maanilap paadhugaappup padaiyinar andha idathil nuzhaindhanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhudhodarbaaga virivaana thagavalai nammaal pera mudiyavillai.
Adhe nerathil video-vil ulla raanuva adhigaarigalin tholbattai petj oralavukku theriyave, adhai vaithu aayvai thodarndhom. Oruvarin petjil embie endru irundhadhu. Adhu enna endru paartha podhu manippoor peeppils aarmi endru theriyavandhadhu. United National Liberation Front (UNLF) endra amaippin raanuva pirivu idhu endru theriyavandhadhu. Andha United National Liberation Front (UNLF)n Facebook pakkathai paarthom. Adhil oruvar naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil irundhavar sattaiyil irundha petjjai avarum anindhirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam ivargal China raanuvathinar illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil indha video manippoorais saarndhadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil arunaachalaviradhesathirkul China raanuvathinar nuzhaindhadhaaga paravum indha video thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Naarchathu adhigamaaga saappittaal podhumaa? Maruthuvargal parindhurai enna?
text:
Naarchathu adhigamaaga saappittaal podhumaa? Evvagai naarchathai saappidugirom enbadhum mukkiyam... Naarchathu endraale namadhu serimaanathukku migavum mukkiyamaanadhu endru anaivarum arindhadhe. Aanaal, naarchathil irandu vagaigal ullana. Adhil ondru karaiyakkoodiya naarchathu. Matrondru karaiyaadha naarchathu. Adhanbadi ots, peens, paruppu vagaigal, pazhangalil kidaikkakkoodiya karaiyakkoodiya naarchathai unavil eduthukkolvadhaal rathas sarkkarai matrum kozhuppaik kattuppaattukkul vaithirukkum endrum, adhe neram kaaygarigal, muzhu thaaniyangal pondra karaiyaadha naarchathu unavugal unbadhaal, kudal iyakkathukku udhavi malachikkalai thavirkkum endru maruthuva nivunargal koorugindranar.
Adhanaal irandu vagaiyaana naarchathugalaiyum unavil serthugolla vendum endrum, aanaal thideerena naarchathu unavugalai adhigarikkamaal, padippadiyaaga eduthugolvadhudan podhumaana thanneerum arundha vendum ena maruthuvargal parindhuraikkindranar. Ore oru naarchathu vagaiyai mattum eduthukkollaamal, irandu vagaiyaana naarchathu unavugalaiyum eduthukkolvadhe aarokkiyamaana vazhi.

headline: Tiruppur palli, kalloorigalil kangaanippu! Tengu kaaychal paraval edhiroli
text:
Tiruppur: tengu kaaychal paraval adhigarithu varum nilaiyil, kalvi niruvanangalil kangaanippu matrum aayvup panigalai theevirappadutha arivuruthappattulladhu. Tiruppur maavattathil ippanigal vegameduthullana. Thamizhagathil kadandha oru vaaramaaga tengu paadhippu adhigarikkath thodangiyulladhu. Idhaiyaduthu, podhu sugaadhaarathurai saarbil thaduppu matrum munnecharikkai nadavadikkaigal theevirappaduthappattullana. Adhan oru pagudhiyaaga, kalvi niruvanangalil nanneer matrum mazhaineer thengaamal thaduppadhu, kosu muttai matrum laarvaa urpathiyai kattuppaduthuvadhu, kosu paravalai thaduppadhu ullitta nadavadikkaigalai muraiyaaga merkolla arivuruthappattulladhu.
Maanagaraatchi, nagaraatchi ullitta ullaatchi amaippugal saarbil, adhigalavil maanava, maanaviyar padikkum thuvakka, nadunilai matrum uyarnilaip palligalai kangaanithu, sugaadhaaram, sutruchoozhal, kudineer vasadhi, thaazhvaana pagudhigal matrum mazhaineer thekkam kurithu virivaaga aayvu seyya vendum. Arasu kalloorigal matrum vidudhigalilum sugaadhaara nadavadikkaigalai theevirappadutha vendum. Vaarathil 2 naatkal kattaayam kosu marundhu thelikka vendum. Thevaiyenil palli valaagathai sutrilum maas kileening panigalai merkolla vendum.
Melum, maanava, maanavigalil yaarukkenum kaaychal paadhippu erpattaal, udanadiyaaga palliyileye maruthuva mugaam nadathi, thevaiyaana marundhu, maathiraigalai vazhanga vendum enbana ullitta palveru arivuraigal vazhangappattullana. Adhigaarigal arivuruthal kaaranamaaga, Tiruppur maavattathilulla anaithu palli matrum kalloorigalil, kaaychal paraval kurithu palli nirvaagathinar kangaanithu varugindranar.

headline: Vijay aatchikku vandhaal maanila alavil adhivar murai kondu varappadum endru arun raaj koorinaaraa?

Nilaith thagavalil, “vijay aatchikku vandhaal maanila alavil adhivar murai kondu varappadum….!”_ Vijay katchiyil serndha arunraaj adhiradip petti…
😄😅🤣(idhai kettu adhivar saiman adhirchi 😳 engirundhu indha muttaa peesu ellaam varugiraanungalo?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
America-vil adhivarai makkale therndheduppadhu pondru Tamil Naattil TVK aatchikku vandhaal mudhalamaicharai makkale therndhedukkum murai kondu varappadum endru thavega-vil sameevathil inaindha aiaares adhigaariyaaga irundha arun raaj kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil video-vai padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, avargal padhivittu varum video-vil Vijay aatchikku vandhaal endru avar engum kooravillai. Enave, indha thagaval unmaidhaanaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Indha video-vai vigadan oodagam veliyittulladhu. Enave, andha video-vai paarthom. 43 nimida video-vil 31vadhu nimidathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pagudhi vandhadhu. Maanila suyaatchi vendum endru koorugindreergal aanaal maanilathirku mattum adhivar murai vendum endru munbu solliyirundheergal. Idhu eppadi sariyaagum endru niruvar kelvi ezhuppugiraar.
Adharku arun raaj, maanilathil mattum adhivar murai enbadhu maanila suyaatchikku vazhivagukkum. Nammudaiya arasiyalamaippus sattathai iyatriyavargal theevira vivaadhathirkup piragu India naadaalumandra jananaayaga naadaaga irukka vendum endru mudivu seythaargal. Veruvatta makkal konda naattil ore oru thalaivarai elloraalum etrukkolla mudiyaadhu.
Peegaaro, jaargando alladhu thamizhnaattais saarndha thalaivarai ellaa maanilangalais saarndhavargalaalum etrukkolla mudiyaadhu. Aanaal maanilathil andha paladharappatta makkal enbadhu satru menej seyyum alavukkuthaan ulladhu. Veruvaade illai endru kooramaatten, aanaal oralavukku nirvagikkum alavukku ulladhu.
Ippodhu nadakkum therdhal enbadhu yaarum em.el.e-kkalai paarppadhu illai. Katchiyaip paarthu vaakkalikkindranar. Indha thadavai ADMK aatchi vendaam endraal thi.mu.ka-vukku vaakkalikkalaam. DMK nirkavillai endraal DMK koottanik katchikku vaakkalikkalaam engira mananilaidhaan ulladhu. Indha nilai maarinaal, arasiyal nilai nandraaga irukkalaam endru naan ennudaiya aalosanaiyai solgiren.
Idhai naan 2011m aandileye ezhudhinen. Idhu oru parisodhanai thittam thaan. Arasiyalamaippus satta nivunargal irukkiraargal idhu patri vivaadhikkalaam” endru koorugiraar.
Pettiyil endha idathilum naangal aatchikku vandhaal Tamil Naattil mudhalamaicharai makkale neradiyaaga therndhedukkum therdhal muraiyaik kondu varuvom endru avar kooravillai. Arasiyalamaippil mathiya arasu naadaalumandra jananaayaga muraiyilum maanila arasugal mudhalamaicharai podhu makkal neradiyaaga vaakkalithuth therndhedukkum muraikkum maara vendum enbadhu ennudaiya viruppam endru mattume arun raaj koorugiraar.
2011m aandil idhai naan ezhudhinen endru avar pettiyil kooriyirundhaar. Avarudaiya black pakkathil 2011m aandu avar ezhudhiya padhivaith thedi eduthom. Adhil avar mudhalamaicharai makkal neradiyaaga vaakkalithuth therndhedukka vendum. Nalla mudhalamaichar yaar enbadhai makkale mudivu seyya vendum. Em.el.e-kkalukku thaniyaagavum mudhalamaichar vetbaalarukkuth thaniyaagavum makkal vaakkalikkum murai vendum. Oruvar ethanai aandugal mudhalamaicharaaga irukkalaam enbadhai mudivu seyya vendum. Idhan moolam kudhirai perathai thadukkalaam. Kurippitta thuraiyil nivunargalaaga ullavargal therdhalais sandhikkaamaleye amaichargalaaga niyamikkappada vendum” endrellaam thannudaiya ezhudhiyirundhaar.
Oruvarin thanippatta karuthai, arasiyal katchiyin kolgai polath thavaraagap pagirndhullanar. Arun raaj alitha pettiyai muzhumaiyaaga veliyittirundhaal kuzhappam erpattirukkaadhu. Thangal thevaikkerpa kurippitta pagudhiyai mattum vetti eduthu thavaraana artham varum vagaiyil samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Venisulaa nilanadukkam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Venisulaavil erpatta nilanadukkam endru kurippittu kattidam ondru idindhu vizhum video Facebook-il pagirappattu varugiradhu. Idhu venisulaa nilanadukkathin podhu padhivaana kaatchiyaa endru aayvu seythom.

Kattidam ondru idindhu vizhum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vil aangilathil venisulaa nilanadukkam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “venisulaavil aduthaduthu payangara nilanadukkam erpattulladhu.
7.1 matrum 7.5 endra rikdar alavu iru sakdhivaayndha nilanadukkam erpattulladhu. Melum sunaami echarikkai vidukkappattulladhu
kundu veesappattadhai pola andha naade urukkulaindhu poyulladhu. Nootrukkanakkaana kattangal adukku maadi kudiyiruppugal sidhaindhu poyullana. Indha paadhippil aayirakkanakkaana makkal paliyaagi irukkalaam ena acham ezhundhulladhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Venisulaa naattil miga mosamaana nilanadukkam erpattulladhu. Eraalamaanor uyirizhandhirukkalaam endru anjjappadugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil venisulaa nilanadukkam endru kurippittu video ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Venisulaa kirisdhavargal adhigamaaga vaazhum naadu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil islaamiyargalin sinnamaana pirai natchathira alangaara vilakku ulladhu. Enave, idhu pazhaiya video-vaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu venisulaa nilanadukkam endru kurippittu palarum idhai pagirndhiruppadhaagath thedudhal mudivu kaattiyadhu. Ivatrukku idaiye pipravari 6, 2023 andru padhividappattirundha YouTube video ondru namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil thurukkiyil erpatta sakdhivaayndha nilanadukkathin podhu adukkumaadi kattidam ondru idindhu vizhundha kaatchi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Migavum nambikkaikkuriya sarvadhesa oodagangalaana New York Post, Guardian News ullitta pala oodagangalin YouTube pakkangalilum kooda indha video 2023m aandu pipravari maadham veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Anaithume thurukki nilanadukka kaatchi endru kurippittirundhana. Ivai ellaam indha video 2026 joon maadham venisulaa naattil erpatta nilanadukkathin podhu padhivaana video kaatchi illai enbadhai urudhi seythana. Https://youtu.be/BpwJeXrC5Kg

headline: DMK aatchiyil Tamil Naattin sattam ozhungu endru paravum san TV news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Tamil Naattin kadandha aindhu aandu sattam ozhungu endru kurippittu san news veliyittadhu pondru oru news card

M.K. Stalin, Udhayanidhi Stalin aagiyor pugaippadangaludan san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “sattam ozhungu kadandha 5 aandugalil… 8900 kolaigal, 3729 irattaik kolaigal, 20000+ paaliyal kutrangal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil sattam ozhungu sariyillai, naangal aatchikku vandhaal sattam ozhungu sariyaaga irukkum endru koori aatchikku vandhadhu Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam. Aanaal, vandha naalil irundhu siridhum peridhumaana kutrangal adhiga alavil nadappadhaaga seythigal veliyaagi varugindrana. Indha nilaiyil mundhaiya aatchiyil sattam ozhungu endru san news veliyittadhu pondru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
DMK nirvaagiyin tholaikkaatchiyil DMK-vai vimarsikkum vagaiyil padhivugal varaadhu. Ungal aatchi mattum ozhungaa endru ketkum vagaiyil san TV peyaril poliyaana news card-ai uruvaakki tha.ve.ka-vinar parappi varuvadhai kaana mudigiradhu. Indha news card unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil idhil ulla pulli vivaram ellaam sariyaa endru ariya thesiya kutra aavana kaappagathin (NCRB) tharavugalai paarthom. 2024m aandu varaiyilaana tharavugal adhil irundhana. 2025m aandukkaana tharavugal illai. 2026m aandukku ippodhudhaan aindhaavadhu maadhame nadakkiradhu. Enave, indha me maadham varaiyilaana thagaval engirundhu petraargal endru theriyavillai.
2025m aandu kolai matrum kutrangal thodarbaaga appodhu aatchiyilirundha DMK arase thagaval veliyittirundhadhu. 2025m aandu 1461 kolaigal nadandhulladhaaga appodhu uldhurai seyalaalaraaga irundha theeraj kumaar therivithirundhaar. Kadandha maars maadham mathiya amaichar piyoosh koyal alithirundha pettiyil kooda kadandha aindhu aandugalil 8900 kolaigal nadandhadhu endru kooriyirundhaar. 2021m aandil nigazhndha kolai enbadhu 4 maadha ADMK aatchiyaiyum serthe enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu. Indha vivarathai eduthu ivargal padhivittirukkalaam endru therigiradhu.
Thesiya kutra aavanak kaappagathin mundhaiya aandu padhivugalai paarkkum podhu ovvoru aandum saraasariyaaga Tamil Naattil 1400 – 1600 varaiyilaana kolai sambavangal nadappadhaagath therigiradhu. Thamizhnaadudhaan munnilai vagikkindradhaa endru paarthaal appadiyum illai. Mathiyap piradhesam, utharappiradhesam, magaaraashdiraa, peegaar, merku vangam ena pala maanilangal idhai vida adhiga alavil kolai kutrangal padhivaagi irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Enave, pulli vivaram sariyaaga irukkalaam. Idhai san news thaan veliyittadhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
San news Facebook pakkathaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru news card edhaiyum andha oodagam veliyidavillai enbadhu therindhadhu. Enave, indha news card-ai san news digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil Tamil Naattil kadandha DMK aatchiyin podhu sattam ozhungu nilai endru paravum news card poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline:
‘Robot Vs Human’ sandai..
Ongi oru 'pans' vitta rovo..
Manidharaith thookki veesiya payangara kaatchi!
text:
‘Robot Vs Human’ sandai.. Ongi oru 'pans' vitta rovo.. Manidharaith thookki veesiya payangara kaatchi!
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
America-vin saan piraansisgovil nadandha vithiyaasamaana MMA sandaiyil, sumaar 6 adi uyaram konda manidha uruva rovovukku edhiraaga samooga valaidhala piravalamaana firaangi lavennaa kalamirakkappattaar. Sandaiyinbodhu rovo kodutha adhiradi kikkaal lavennaa thadumaari keezhe vizhundha kaatchigal tharpodhu samooga valaidhalangalil vegamaaga paravi varugindrana. Indha nigazhvai REK enappadum Robot Entertainment Kombat amaippu nadathiyulladhu. Indhas sandaiyil firaangi lavennaavukku edhiraaga kalamirakkappatta rovo, EngineAI niruvanathin T800 humanoid robot vagaiyai saarndhadhu enas sollappadugiradhu
sandai thodangiyavodhu lavennaa rovovai nokki thaakkudhalai merkondullaar. Adhanbiragu, rovo thanadhu kaalgalaal vegamaagath thaakkath thodangiyadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Kurippaaga, rovovin oru valuvaana kik kaaranamaaga lavennaa thadumaari keezhe vizhundhullaar. Idhanaal, rovo manidharai veezhthiyadhaaga indha veediyovaip paartha palarum aacharyathudan padhivittu varugindranar.
Silar, idhai manidhargalukkum rovokkalukkum idaiyilaana edhirgaalap pottigalukkaana thodakkamaaga paarthu varum nilaiyil, innum silar idhuvondra sandaigal endha alavukku paadhugaappaanavai endra kelviyaiyum ezhuppi varugindranar. Aanaal, indhas sambavathil migavum mukkiyamaana oru vishayam ulladhu. Lavennaavudan sandaiyitta rovo muzhumaiyaaga thannaatchi muraiyil seyalbadavillai. Adhanai oru manidhar remote control moolam iyakkiyadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Adhaavadhu, koondukkul rovo irundhaalum, adhan asaivugal matrum thaakkudhalgalai pinnaal irundhu oru manidhar kattuppaduthiyullaar.
Idhanaal, idhu manidharukkum seyarkai nunnarivukkum idaiyilaana neradis sandai endru kooruvadharku padhilaaga, manidharaal iyakkappadum manidha uruva rovovukkum, oru manidharukkum idaiyilaana seyal vilakkam endre paarkkappadugiradhu. Innilaiyil, manidhargalaip polave asaindhu, thaakkudhal nadathakkoodiya thiran konda rovokkalin valarchi kurithu indhas sambavam meendum kavanathai eerthulladhu. Edhirgaalathil idhuvondra rovokkal vilaiyaattu matrum pozhudhuvokkuth thuraigalil endha alavukku payanbaduthappada ullana enbadhum tharpodhu pesuvorulaagiyulladhu.

headline: DMK aatchiyil amaikkappatta minsaarak kambiyaal azhindha panai marangal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK aatchiyil amaikkappatta min kambangal kaaranamaaga vazhiyilirundha panai marangal azhindhadhaaga oru video

min kambigal uraasiyadhaal panai marangal pattuvoy irukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhu thaan thiraavida maadal aatchi… en andha karant lainna maatri amaikkalaame.. Ivargal thaan arivu thiruvizhaa nadathuraanga…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Minsaarak kambiyai sariyaaga amaikkath theriyaadha DMK arasu endrum, idhan kaaranamaaga andha pagudhiyilirundha panai marangal azhindhuvittadhaagavum Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Aanaal, idhu Tamil Naattil endha pagudhiyil enbadhaik kurippidaamal vittuvittanar. Panai maram Tamil Naattil mattumdhaan irukkum endru ninaithuvittaargal pola. Video-vil varum sila vaaganangalaip paarkkum podhu adhu Tamil Nadu polath theriyavillai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, sila naatkalukku munbu idhe video-vai vangadhesathais serndha silar Facebook-il padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, indha kaatchi vangadhesathil ulla navogaan paivaas saalaiyil edukkappattadhaaga kurippittirundhanar.
Adhan adippadaiyil minsaara kambi, navogaan, panaimaram ena sila adippadai vaarthaigalai aangilathil koogulil taip seythu thedip paarthom. Appodhu idhu thodarbaaga vangadhesa oodagangalil veliyaana seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Adhil minsaara kambigal amaippadharkaaga navogan paivaas saalaiyil 500kkum merpatta panaimarangal vettappattadhaagavum eraalamaana panai marangal minsaaram thaakki karugiyadhaagavum kutramsaatti iyarkai aarvalargal poraattam nadathiyadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Andha video-vil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda andha idamum idam petrirundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video vangadhesathil edukkappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Idhan moolam, vangadhesathin video-vai Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyil amaikkappatta min kambam endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

Paakkisdhaan iraanuvadhudan yootham aarambam aagivittadhu 🚩,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan Indhiya raanuvam kundu veesuvadhu pondra kaatchigaludan koodiya video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video tharpodhu edukkappattadhalla, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, Republic oodagam naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video-vai kadandha 2020m aandu joon maadham pagirndhirundhadhu. Jammu kaashmeeril ulla Poonch endra pagudhiyil por nirutha oppandhathai meeriya paagisdhaanukku, Indhiya raanuvam padhiladi koduthadhu, endru Republic veliyitta seythiyil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Muzhu video keezhe tharappattulladhu.
Idhe sambavathai maiyappaduthi, melum sila oodagangal appodhe seythi veliyittirundhadhaiyum kandom.
Adhesamayam, kurippitta video ‘India raanuvathin sirappu’ endru kurippittu, Facebook pondra samooga valaidhalangalil, 2020m aandukku munbirundhe pagirappattu varuvadhaiyum kaana mudigiradhu.
Ivatrin moolamaaga, samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappadum pazhaiya video ondrai eduthu, tharpodhu Pakistan meedhu India thaakkudhal nadathuvadhaagak kurippittu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Raajinaamaa arivippu veliyida ulla Modi endru paravum vishama news card!
text:
Thannudaiya padhavi vilagal thodarbaaga naalai kaalai 9 manikku naattu makkalidam video veliyitta ullaar narendhira Modi endru oru padhivu

news 7 thamizh veliyitta news kaardudan pugaippada padhivu uruvaakkappattulladhu. Adhil, “meendum piradhamar Modi urai! Naalai kaalai 9 manikku naattu makkalidam video moolam siriya seythiyai pagira irukkiren – piradhamar narendhira modi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “thanakku 75 vayadhu aagappogiradhu enbadhaal, athvaani, murali manogar joshiyai pinbatri, thaanum piradhamar padhaviyai iraajinaamaa seythu vittu! BJP-yin mudhiyorukkaana maark tharshak mandalil modiyum inaiyap pogiraar enbadhai naalai kaalai 9 manikku avare solla irukkiraar! Poduraa vediyai!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhe pugaippadathai vaithu Facebook ullitta idhara samooga oodaga pakkangalilum padhivugal padhividappattullana. Idhaiyum palamum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Piradhamar narendhira Modi padhavi vilagap pogiraar endru samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Idharkaaga pazhaiya news card-ai ippodhu payanbaduthi samooga oodagangalil vadhandhi parappi varugindranar. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news kaardileye thelivaaga epral 2, 2020 endru ulladhu. Idhai 2025l veliyaana news card pola thavaraaga padhivittullanar.
2025l podhu makkalukku video veliyida ulladhaaga Modi endha arivippaiyum veliyidavillai. Indha news card 2020l veliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya unmaiyaana padhivai thedinom.
News 7 thamizh Facebook pakkathirkus sendru naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-il ulla thagavalai appadiye taip seythu thedinom. Appodhu, 2020l news 7 thamizh veliyitta padhivu namakku kidaithadhu. Idhan moolam indha thagaval vishamathaip parappum vagaiyil padhividappattulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: DMK aatchiyil palliyil raaging endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
DMK aatchiyil arasu ilanilaik kallooriyil raaging nadandhadhaaga oru video

ilainjargal palarum serndhu oru maanavanai adikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thaacheppalli arasu ilanilai kallooriyil raaging alapparai
esbi kaaru matrum avaradhu kudumba uruppinargalukku theriyum varai indha video-vai share seyyavum.
DMK aatchiyil maanavargal paadhugaappu illai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
DMK aatchiyil maanavargalukku kooda paadhugaappu illaadha soozhal ulladhu endru kurippittu video ondrais silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Tamil Naattil ilanilai kalloori endrellaam illai. Palli, kalloori thaan. Pilas1, pilas 2 murai illaadha maanilangalildhaan ilanilai kalloorigal seyalbadugindrana. Adhuvum thaacheppalli endra oorin peyar sandhegathai adhigarikkas seythadhu. Melum, maanavanai adippavargal thelungu mozhiyil pesuvadhai ketka mudigiradhu. Ivai ellaam indha video aandhiraa alladhu thelungaanaavais saarndhadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha sambavam aandhiraavil 2025 aagast maadham paalanaadu (Palnadu) maavattathil ulla thaachevalli (Dachepalle) endra ooril nadandhadhaaga seythigal palavum kidaithana. Thelungu oodagangalil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovudan seythiyai veliyittirundhanar. Thaakkudhalukku aalaana maanavanin petror idhu thodarbaaga poleesil pugaar seythiruppadhaagavum, adhan adippadaiyil kutravaaligal meedhu kiriminal sattappadi vazhakkup padhivu seyyappattiruppadhaagavum seythigal kidaithana.
Melum, thaakkudhal sambavam thodarbaana video samooga oodagangalil viral aana nilaiyil haastal vaardan theevigaa matrum vaatsmen sanjjeesvar raav aagiyorai tharkaaliga pani neekkam seythum thaakkudhalil eeduvattadhaagak kandariyappatta maanavargalai haastalil irundhu veliyetriyum maavatta aatchith thalaivar utharavittulladhaaga seythigal kidaithana. Paadhikkappatta maanavar maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattu sigichai alikkappattadhaagavum seythigal kidaithana.
Indha aadhaarangal ellaam indha sambavam aandhirappiradhesathil nadandhadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana. Aandhiraavil thelungu thesam, BJP koottani aatchi ulladhu. Aandhiraa arasukkum thi.mu.ka-vukkum thodarbillai. Aandhiraavil nadandha video-vai Tamil Naattil nadandhadhaagath thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil Tamil Naattil DMK aatchiyil maanavargalukkup paadhugaappu illaadha soozhal nilavuvadhaagap paravum video thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Erode: 3.50 ekkar nilathai rijistar seyya roo.7 latcham lanjjam; sap-rijistar, pathira ezhuthar kaidhu
text:
Moondrarai ekkar nilathaip padhivu seyya sap- rijistar matrum pathira ezhuthar iruvarum 7 latcham roobai lanjjam vaangiya sambavam adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Erode maavattam kavundhappaadi raayar paalaiyathais serndhavar vivasaayi kaarthik. Ivarukkus sondhamaana moondrarai ekkar nilathaip padhivu seyvadharkaaga kavundhappaadi sap-rijistar sangarai anugiyullaar.
3.50 ekkar nilathai pathirap padhivu seyya vendumaanaal thangalukkuk kattaayam roo.7 latcham lanjjam vazhangiyaaga vendum enas sangar kooriyullaar. Lanjjamaaga panathaik kodukka virumbaadha vivasaayi kaarthik, lanjja ozhipputhuraiyil pugaar alithullaar.
Lanjja ozhipputhuraiyinarin vazhigaattudhalgalin adippadaiyil roobai nottugalil rasaayanam thadavi andhap panathai kaarthik kaiyil koduthullanar.
Kaarthik moolame sangar kaiyil kodukka seythullanar. Pathira ezhuthar vetriyidam vazhangumbadi sangar kooriya nilaiyil, netru maalai vetriyidam andhap panathai vazhangiyullaar kaarthik. Maraindhirundha lanjja ozhipputhurai insbekdar regaa thalaimaiyilaana poleesaar kaiyum kalavumaaga vetriyaiyum sangaraiyum kaidhu seythullanar.
Moondrarai ekkar nilathaip padhivu seyya sap- rijistar matrum pathira ezhuthar iruvarum 7 latcham roobai lanjjam vaangiya sambavam adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.

headline: Pattiyal samoogathinar poraattam.. Thelangaanaavil ”thooymaippaduthum sadangu”?piaares meedhu pugaar!!
text:
Utharagaandil kadandha aagast maadham, Congress thalaivar malligaarjuna kaarge pesiya idam theettuppattadhaagak koori, kangai neer thelithu suthigarippu seyyappatta sambavam thesiya perum sarchaiyai erpaduthiyirundhadhu. Andha adhirvalaigale innum oyaadha nilaiyil, adhevondradhoru sambavam tharpodhu thelangaanaavilum arangeriyiruppadhu, saadhiya paaguvaadu kuritha vivaadhathai meendum theevirappaduthiyulladhu.
Thelangaanaavil Congress katchiyin revanth retti thalaimaiyilaana aatchi nadandhu varum nilaiyil, paaradha raashdira samidhi (piaares) katchiyin sandhirasegar raav edhirkkatchith thalaivaraaga irundhu varugiraar. Indhachoozhalil thaan, kadandha sepdambar 7 nadaivetra ammaanila sattapperavaiyin podhu, Congress katchiyin savaanaayagar katham pirasaath kumaarai piaares katchiyais serndha nirvaagigal silar avamadhikkum vagaiyil pesiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Idhaith thodarndhu, sepdambar 8-m thedhi pi.aar.es em.el.si.kkalaana taadaa madhusoodhan matrum naveen kumaar aagiyor pattiyal samoogathais serndha savaanaayagarai avamadhithadhudan, savaanaayagar padhavikku uriya kanniyathai avamadhithadhaagavum koori, sithivet maavattathil ulla erravalli pagudhiyil, piaares katchiyin thalaivarumaana ke.sandhirasegar raavin pannai veettai mutrugaiyittu Congress nirvaagigal matrum thondargal porattathil eeduvattanar. Thodarndhu, angu “thappu” enappadum paarambariya melathai adithu edhirppu therivithadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu.
Indhachoozhalil thaan, poraattam nadandha adutha naal, adhaavadhu sepdambar 9-m thedhi adhe idathil piaares-ais serndhavargal enak koorappadum silar, andha idathaiyum saalaiyaiyum “thooymaippaduthum sadangu” nadathiyullanar. Innilaiyil, pattiyal samoogathais serndha poraattakkaarargal appagudhikku sendradhaal, andha idam theettuvattuvittadhu endru karudhiyadhaaleye ‘thooymaippaduthum sadangu’ nadandhiruppadhaaga Congress katchi kutranjjaattiyulladhu.
Indhas sambavam thaan, tharpodhu thelangaanaa arasiyalil migapperiya sarchaiyaaga maariyulladhu. Pattiyal samooga makkal sendra idathai avargal sendra piragu “thooymaippaduthuvadhu” enbadhu saadhiya paaguvaattai velippaduthum seyal endrum, idhu thalith makkalin suyamariyaadhaiyai avamadhikkum seyal endrum Congress thalaivargal vimarsithullanar.
Thelangaanaa thunai mudhalamaichar mallu paatti vikramaargaavum indhas sambavathai kadumaiyaaga kandithullaar. Pattiyal samooga makkalin suyamariyaadhaiyai mattumalla... Ottumotha thelangaanaa samoogathin suyamariyaadhaiyaiyum indhas sambavam kaayappaduthiyulladhaaga avar therivithullaar. Melum, idhu pondra nilappiravuthuva matrum saadhiya paaguvaadu konda sindhanaigalai thelangaanaa oruvodhum etrukkollaadhu endrum avar kooriyullaar.
Idhanidaiye, indhachambavam kurithup pesiyulla mudhalamaichar revanth retti, idhugurithu virivaana visaaranai nadathappadum endrum, thevaiyaana sattappirivugalin keezh nadavadikkai edukkappadum endrum avar sattapperavaiyil therivithullaar. Kurippaaga, paaradhiya niyaaya sanhidhaa matrum pattiyalina matrum pazhangudiyina makkalukku edhiraana vangodumai thaduppus sattathin keezh nadavadikkai edukkappadum endrum, indha vivagaarathai visaarikka mootha aivies adhigaari niyamikkappattulladhaagavum avar therivithirukkiraar.

headline: Israel porai nirutha vendum endru yoodhargal vanmuraiyil eeduvattanaraa?
text:
Iran udanaana porai udane nirutha vendum endru Israel naattil ulla yoodhargal poraattathil eeduvattadhaaga oru video

vanmuraiyaalargal palarum serndhu Police vaaganathaith thaakki, adhai thalaigeezhaagath thiruppip poduvadhu, irusakkara vaaganathaith thaakki theevaithu erithadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ISREL por nirutham seyya vendum yoodhargal poraattam…!!isrel Police thaakkudhal vaaganam theekkarai” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Israel meedhu Iran nadathi varum padhiladi thaakkudhalil isreliyargal paadhikkappattadhaagavum idhanaal avargal porai nirutha poraadi varuvadhaagavum pala video-kkal samooga oodagangalil padhividappattu varugindrana. Andha vagaiyil Israel por nirutham seyya vendum endru yoodhargal vanmuraiyil eeduvattadhaaga oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetri thedinom. Appodhu, indha video 2026 pipravari 16m thedhi samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Iran meedhu Israel -amerikkap padaigal pipravari 28m thedhidhaan thaakkudhal nadathina. Adhaith thodarndhudhaan Iran padhiladi thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu. Aanaal thaakkudhalukkuk kittathatta 14 naatkalukku munbu indha video veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idhu porai nirutha yoodhargal poraadiya sambavam illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Thodarndhu indha video thodarbaaga thedinom. Appodhu theevira pazhamaivaadham pinbatrum yoodhargal irukkum pini piraak (Bnei Brak) endra pagudhikku sendra irandu pen isreliya raanuva veerargalai andha pazhamaivaadha yoodhargal thaakkiyadhaagavum avargalai Israel Police paadhugaappaaga meettadhaagavum seythigal namakku kidaithana.
Israel-il theevira pazhamaivaadha yoodhargal ullitta oru silaraith thavirthu anaivarukkum kattaaya raanuva sevai ulladhu. Indha nilaiyil theevira pazhamaivaadhathaip pinbatrum yoodhargalukkum kattaaya raanuva sevai endru arivikkappattadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil indha yoodhargal vasikkum pagudhikku samooga sevai seyyum nokkil irandu isreliya pen raanuva veerargal vandhullanar.
Idhaith thavaraagap purindhugonda andha yoodhargal thaakkiyadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Indha sambavathai Israel piradhamar kandithadhaagavum kooda seythigal namakku kidaithana. Ivai ellaam indha video Israel por nirutham seyya valiyuruthi yoodhargal poraattathil eeduvattadhaaga paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythadhu.

headline: Madurai TVK maanaattin car paarkking endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Maduraiyil nadandha Thamizhaga vetrik kazhaga maanaattin car paarkking endru oru pugaippadam

car paarkking ondrin pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thalavadhi vijayyoda Madurai maanaadu Car Parking 🔥 thalavadhi eppavume maas thaan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sameevathil Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathin 2vadhu maanaadu Madurai aruge nadandhadhu. Indha naattil latchakkanakkaana Vijay rasigargal kalandhugondanar. Indha maanaattukku vandha vaaganangal niruthi vaikkappattirundha idathin pugaippadam endru oru padathai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar. Aanaal, indha pugaippadam maanaattu paarkking pola illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediya podhu idhu kujaraathil ulla maarudhi car niruvanathil thayaarikkappatta vaaganangal niruthi vaikkappattirundha idam enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Seythi niruvanam ondru indha video-vai veliyittirundhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Adhai vaithu seythi oodagangalil indha video matrum pugaippadam veliyaagi ulladhu.
Kujaraathil ulla maarudhi niruvanathin pudhiya vaaganangal niruthappadum paarkking idamum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil ulla idamum ondraaga ulladhaa enbadhai urudhiseythugolla koogul mep-l andha idathai paarthom. Appodhu irandum ondraaga iruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam idhu maarudhi niruvanathin car niruthum idamdhaan enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: E.ai. Vandhuruchu, velai poyidumaa.. Enna ninaikkiraargal ilainjargal?
text:
Kovai:'seyarkai nunnarivu' enappadum e.ai, tharpodhu verum kelvigalukku padhil sollum endhiramaaga illaamal, pala velaigalaiyum thaanaaga seythu mudikkum alavukku valarndhu varugiradhu.
Andha varisaiyil, ovan e.ai. Niruvanam sameevathil arimugappaduthiyulla ‛ji.pi.ti. 6 aastraa', kampyoottarai payanbaduthuvadhu, koding, risars, pails thayaarippadhu ena sikkalaana velaigalai seyyum vagaiyil uruvaakkappattulladhu.
Oru pakkam teknaalaji valarchi ena varaverkappattaalum, maruvakkam idhanaal thangaludaiya velaikku enna aagumo endra achamum ilainjargalidam uruvaagiyulladhu. Kurippaaga tevalappar, tisainar, kandent kiriyettar pondra thuraigalil indha acham adhigamaaga ulladhu. Avargalil silaridam pesinom.
'velai parivogaadhu, aanaal e.ai.-yaal aatkalin ennikkai kuraiyum' engiraar tevalappar reni.
E.ai. Vandhaalum, pazhaiya seyaligal, tettaa paadhugaappu pondra vishayangalil manidhargalin thevai thodarndhu irukkum, adhe nerathil, 30 per seyyum velaiyai 10 per seyyum nilai varalaam endraar. Thiramaigalai valarthukkolbavargalukku velai vaayppu thodarndhu irukkum enbadhu avaradhu karuthu.
Aanaal, tisainarin paarvai veraaga ulladhu. 'e.ai-.yaal paadhippu 100 sadhaveedham irukkiradhu' engiraar kiraavik tisainar jey.
Endraalum tisainargal e.aiyai thavirkkaamal, adhai payanbadutha katrukkolla vendum engiraar. Oru kurippitta tisain uruvaakka e.ai.-kku sariyaana 'praampt' kodukkavum, vandha tisainyai thangaludaiya thevaikku erpa maatravum tisaining arivu avasiyam engiraar.
Munbu 4 per seytha velaiyai, tharpodhu e.ai udhaviyudan 2 per sirappaaga seythu mudikkum nilai vandhuvittadhaaga koorugiraar. 'tisaining kors padithadhu veen endru solla maatten; aanaal andha arivai e.ai-yudan serthu payanbadutha therindhirukka vendum' endru than karuthai vilakkugiraar.
'saat ji.pi.ti. Vandhavodhe engal velai poyvittadhu' engiraar kandent kiriyettar maragadham.
Oru video-vukku thevaiyaana sgiript, 'shook' pondravatraiyum e.ai. Tharpodhu koduthu viduvadhaal, kandent kiriyettargalin thevai kuraindhu varuvadhaaga avar koorugiraar. Meediyaavil ulla piravalamaana niruvanangal e.ai. Nutbathai melum melum adhiga alavil payanbaduthuvadhaal, angu kandent kiriyettargalin velai kanisamaaga kuraindhu vittadhu. Aanaal, poy seythi, poli video pondravatrin thaakkam adhigarippadhaal, kandent soopparvaisar velaikku thevai uyarndhulladhu; kiriyettargal adhan moolam palan adaiyalaam ena oru vazhi kaattugiraar.
Ippadi, 'velaigalai e.ai. Muzhumaiyaaga parithuvidumaa?' endra kelvikku thelivaana padhilai yaaraalum solla iyalavillai. Aanaal, idhuvarai irundhadhai kaattilum kuraindha aatkalai vaithe eai thunaiyudan velaigalai mudikkalaam endra nilai uruvaagi vittadhai ilainjargal nangu unarndhullanar.

headline: TVK aatchikku aavathaa? Idadhusaarigal vilaginaalo.. Idaitherdhalil thotraalo enna aagum?
text:
Tamil Naattil TVK arasukku thanipperumbaanmai illaadha nilaiyil, Congress, VCK, IUML, iru idadhusaari katchigalin aadharavodu aatchiyamaithulladhu. Idhil pira katchigal amaicharavaiyil idambetrulla nilaiyil, idadhusaari katchigal mattume veliyil irundhu arasukku aadharavu alithu varugindrana.
Indhas soozhalil, idadhusaari katchigal kadandha sila naatkalaagave palveru vivagaarangalil TVK arasai kadumaiyaaga vimarsithu varugindranar. Melum, engaladhu aadharavaaldhaan indha aatchi nadaivetru varugiradhu endrum naangal aadharavai vaavas petraal mandhiri savaiye irukkaadhu endrum CBI mootha thalaivar mutharasan kooriyirundhaar.
Idhan kaaranamaaga idadhusaarigal arasukkaana thangal aadharavai eppodhu vendumaanaalum vaavas peralaam endra arasiyal vimarsagargal thodarndhu koori varugindranar. Idhanaal TVK arasu kavizha vaayppulladhaaga koorappadum nilaiyil, idadhusaarigal aadharavu illaamaleye TVK arasukku perumbaanmai irukkum soozhaldhaan tharpodhu ulladhu. TVK arasu aatchi poruppetra pinnar, adhimugavais serndha 6 per thangal sattamandra uruppinar padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythu thavegavil inaindhanar. Melum irandu thogudhigalil vetrivetra mudhalvar Vijay thanadhu Trichy kizhakku thogudhi sattamandra uruppinar padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythaar.
Idhanaal 234 uruppinargalaik konda Thamizhaga sattap peravaiyil motham 7 idangal kaaliyaaga ulla nilaiyil, aatchikkuth thevaiyaana perumbaanmai idangal tharpodhu 114 aagak kuraindhulladhu. Tharpodhu thavegavin 107 sattamandra uruppinargal, Congress katchiyin 5 uruppinargal, VCK matrum IUML katchiyin thalaa 2 uruppinargal ena TVK arasidam 115 uruppinargal ullanar.
Tharpodhu irandu thogudhigalukku idaitherdhal nadaiveravulla nilaiyil, adhil TVK vetrivetraal TVK arasin palam sattapperavaiyil 117 aaga uyarum. Adhe neram, edhirkkatchigal vetrivetraalumgooda peravaiyil perumbaanmaiyai niroovikka 115 uruppinargalin aadharavu irundhaale podhum endra soozhal uruvaagum. Enave idaitherdhalil irandu thogudhigalilum tholviyai thazhuvi, idadhusaarigal arasukkaana thangal aadharavai vaavas petraalgooda TVK arasukku sattapperavaiyil podhiya perumbaanmai ulladhu enbadhum, idhanaal aatchi kavizha vaayppillai enbadhum kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: “vijaya nenachaa thaan payamaa irukkudhu” endru Stalin pulambuvadhaaga paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Vijaya nenachaa thaan payamaa irukkudhu endru Stalin pulambi varugiraar endru san news veliyittadhu pondru oru news card-ai palarum

san news veliyittadhu pondru oru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “vijaya nenachaa thaan payamaa irukkudhu. Vijay-kku irukkum makkal aadharavai paarthaal thaan peedhiyaaga ulladhu endru Stalin thanakku nerukkiya vattaarathile pulambugiraaraam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
DMK aadharavu oodagamaana san news Tamil Nadu mudhalamaicharum DMK thalaivarumaana mu.ka.staalinai vimarsikkum vagaiyil news card veliyittadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Ippadi oru news card-ai indraiya soozhalil san news veliyida vaayppillai. Melum pechu vazhakkil thagaval ulladhu. Nerungiya enbadharkup padhil nerukkiya endru thavaraaga ezhudhappattulladhu. Ivai ellaam indha news card poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvai thodarndhom. Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai san news maars 3, 2026 andru veliyittulladhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Maars 3m thedhi naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha news kaardaiyum san news veliyidavillai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla indha news card-ai san news digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu, san news veliyidavillai endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card poliyaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Laagooril kundu vedippu endru America video-vai veliyitta thandhi TV!
text:
Laagooril kundu vedithadhu endru thandhi TV oru video-vai veliyittulladhu.

Kundu vedippu thaakkudhalukku aalaagi saalai muzhukka porutkal, vaaganangal sidhari, erindha nilaiyil irukkum video ondru X thala pakkathil veliyittulladhu thandhi TV adhil, “laagooril kunduvedippu – paravarappu kaatchigal. Porutkal anaithum sidharik kidakkum kaatchigal veliyeedu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “BREAKING || lahore | oru iravukku thaangumaa Pakistan – laagoor sidhariya kaatchigal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thandhi TV veliyittirundha seythiyai palarum thangal samooga oodaga pakkangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pakistan meedhu Indhiya raanuvam thaakkudhal nadathi varugiradhu. Idhanaal, Pakistan-il migapperiya paadhippu erpattulladhaaga Indhiya oodagangal seythi veliyittu varugindrana. Pakistan tharappil indhiyaavukkuthaan paadhippu enbadhu pondru seythi parappappattu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil paagisdhaanin laagoor nagaril India migapperiya thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu polavum idhil migapperiya paadhippu erpattadhu endrum thandhi TV veediyovudan seythi veliyittulladhu.
Indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythu paarthom. Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu moondru maadhangalukku munbaagave indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. India thaakkudhalaith thodangiyadhu 2025 me maadhathil… aanaal, 2025 pipravariyil indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi iruppadhan moolam idhu India nadathiya thaakkudhalin video illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Indha video thodarbaaga thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu, kadandha 2025 pipravariyil America-vin piladelbiyaa (Philadelphia) endra nagaril vimaana vivathu erpattadhu. Noyaaliyai etrikkondu sendra siriya raga vimaanam keezhe vizhundhadhil vimaanathil payanam seytha siru kuzhandhai ulbada 6 perum, tharaiyil kaaril sendru kondirundha oruvarum uyirizhandhanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Pakistan-il kundu vedippu endru me 8, 2025 andru thandhi TV veliyittirundha video 2025 pipravariyilirundhu samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhai urudhi seythullom. Idhan moolam America-vin vimaana vivathu video-vai Pakistan kundu vedippu endru thavaraagath thandhi TV pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Seyalbadaadha movail pon tavar :paaraamugam adhigaarigalaal thik... Thik...
text:
Seyalbadaadha movail pon tavar :'paaraamugam' adhigaarigalaal thik... Thik...
Mettupalayam: pudhargalukku idaiye seyalbadaamal ulla movailbon tavar, endha nerathil vizhumo endra achathil, makkal vasikkindranar.
Sirumugai perooraatchikku utbatta paaradhi nagaril, 150kkum merpatta veedugal ullana. Kudiyiruppu pagudhiyin maiyappagudhiyil, paaradhinagaril ulla saasdhiri veedhiyin oru pagudhiyil, 1999m aandu, thaniyaar movail pon tavar, 100 adi uyarathilum, idhan aruge kattuppaattu araiyum amaikkappattulladhu. Indha movail pon niruvanam tharpodhu seyalbaattil illaadha nilaiyil, idhai agatra, ippagudhiyinar, sambandhappatta niruvanathukkum, arasukkum korikkai viduthum nadavadikkai illai.
Saasdhiri veedhi podhumakkal kooriyadhaavadhu:
tavar amaindhulla idam muzhuvadhum sedigalum, marangalum valarndhu, pudhar pol ullana. Vishajandhukkalin nadamaattathaal, makkal achathil ullanar. Tavaril inaithulla kambigalum, irumbu raadum raadum thuruppidithullana. Tavar amaindhulla idam aruge, uyar min azhutha kambigal ullana. Idhai agatrumbadi, maavatta Collector, idathin urimaiyaalarukku, pala aandugalaaga korikkai manukkal anuppiyum nadavadikkai illai. Asambaavidham erpadum mun, idhai agatra nadavadikkai edukka vendum.
Ivvaaru, avargal koorinar.

headline: Sengottaiyanai suthuppodum tha.ve.ka-vinar tu manam varundhum thirumaa | kazhugaar apdets
text:
''naalaa pakkamum thaakkudhal nadappadhaal kadum mana ulaichalil irukkiraaraam thirumaa. 'ennai ellorum thaakkugiraargal.. Aanaal, avatrai tifent seyya enakkaaga yaarum pesuvadhillai''
madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram thogudhigalukkaana idaitherdhal vetbumanu thaakkal niraivadaindhuvittana. TVK, DMK, ADMK kamyoonist, naam thamizhar katchiyin vetbaalargal kalamirangum nilaiyil, pottiyidaadha matra katchigal thangal nilaippaattai therivithu varugiraargal. Madhuraandhagathil vetri tholviyai theermaanikkum PMK mattum innum nilaippaattai arivikkaamal sasbens vaithirukkiradhu.
Sooriyak katchiyin melida kudumbap pulli, PMK thalaimaiyidam neradiyaagap pesi 'namma koottanikku vandhuvidungal... Naangalum o.pi.si arasiyalaidhaan munnedukkirom' ena pesip paarthaaraam. Ilaik katchip pulligalum, 'namakku aadharavu therivithuvidungal' ena vendik kettuk kolgiraargalaam. Aanaal, irandu tharappukkum pidigodukkaamal irukkiradhaam PMK thalaimai. Aalumdharappum palveru roottugalil PMK thalaimaiyai anugiyiruppadhaal, 'idaith therdhalai purakkanikkirom' ena PMK arivithuvidumo ena anjjugiraargalaam ilaik katchi nirvaagigal silar!
'madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram thogudhi idaitherdhalil a.thi.mu.ka-vilirundhu vandhavargalukke meendum seet koduppadhaa?' enak kodhikkiraargal lokkal TVK pulligal. Adhilum, thaaraavuram TVK vetbaalar sathiyavaamaavukku velai seyya viruppamillai ena othuzhaiyaamai iyakkathai nadathi varugiraargal TVK pulligal. Innilaiyil, kadandha 14-m thedhiyandru Erode vandhirundha amaichar sengottaiyan, thaniyaar nigazhchi ondril pangetru pesiyavodhu, "perundhurai sattamandra idaitherdhalil pottiyida ulla anbu vetbaalar Jayakumar avargale" enak kurippittirukkiraar.
'perundhuraikku idaitherdhal vandhaal TVK nirvaagikku seet kodukka vendum' ena Erode tha.ve.ka-vinar mathiyil korikkai valuthuvarum nilaiyil, sengottaiyanin pechu salasalappai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu. Mudhalvar vijayyum podhucheyalaalar aanandhum mudivedukka vendiya vivagaarathil, than mudivais solla amaichar sengottaiyan yaar endra kelvi tha.ve.ka-vukkul theeyaay paravi varugiradhu!
Idaitherdhal nadaiveravulla thogudhigalil sarve nadathiyirukkiradhaam arivaalayam. Sarve risalttil, 'thaaraavurathil TVK veekkaagavum ADMK vetrivera vaayppum irukkiradhu. Madhuraandhagam pakkam kavanathai thiruppinaal vetripperalaam' endru ripport alikkappattadhaam. Adhaithodarndhu, madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil muzhumoochaaga irangugiradhu DMK sameevathil nadandha ilainjarani koottathil, 'maanilam muzhuvadhilirundhum nirvaagigalai varavazhaiyungal. Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyai 7 paagamaaga pirithu poruppaalargalai niyamiyungal' ena utharavittirukkiraaraam Udhayanidhi
udhayanidhiyin pirasaaram kurithum vivaadham nadandhirukkiradhu. Appodhu, 'ilandhalaivar orunaal pirasaarathukku varuvaar.. Kazhagath thalaivar pirasaarathukku varamaattaar. Adhevola, nirvaagigal medaip pottu pesuvadhaivittu veeduveedaaga sendru vaakku segariyungal' ena sollappattirukkiradhu. 'madhuraandhagathai vella vendum ena ninaikkiraar udhay. Aanaal mudhalvar Vijay steyilil orunaal pirasaaramdhaan varuvaar enas solvadhu nalla mudivalla' ena kumurugiraargalaam udanbirappugal!
Therdhalukku piragu DMK koottaniyai udharivittu TVK koottaniyil pangeduthadhu vidudhalai siruthaigal katchi. Amaicharavaiyilum pangeduthu vanni arasai samooganeedhithurai amaicharaakkinaar akkatchith thalaivar thirumaavalavan. Innilaiyil, 'thirumaa maari maari pesugiraar.. VCK thadammaarivittadhu' pondra kaattamaana vimarsanangalai arasiyal nokkargal, DMK, the.mu.thi.ka ullitta katchigal munvaithu varugindranar. Karoor vivagaarathil, 'Vijay thaamadhamaaga vandhaar.. Vazhakku padhiyas sonnen' ena thirumaa pesiyadhaal, avarai tha.ve.ka-vinarum thaakkinaargal.
Ippadi, naalaa pakkamum thaakkudhal nadappadhaal kadum mana ulaichalil irukkiraaraam thirumaa. 'ennai ellorum thaakkugiraargal.. Aanaal, avatrai tifent seyya enakkaaga yaarum pesuvadhillai. Sondhak katchiyin mukkiyap pulligale enmeedhaana thaakkudhalai vedikkai paarkkiraargal' ena manam nondhuvittaaraam. 'vanni arasu amaicharaagivittaar. Podhucheyalaalar ravikkumaar, sindhanaichelvan aagiyor apsettil irukkiraargal. Aaloor shaanavaas DMK pidiyil irukkiraar. Enmeedhaana vimarsanangalukku naane padhil sollik kolla vendiyirukkiradhu' ena varundhugiraaraam!
Thaniyaar palligalukku anumadhi vazhanga lanjjam petradhaaga anbil mages meedhu mathiya kutrappirivu poleesaar vazhakkup padhivu seythullanar. Avarudaiya idangalil sodhanai merkollappattulladhu. Aanaal, anbil mages aadharavaalargalum DMK munnani nirvaagigalum indha reydai rombave koolaaga teel seythanaraam. Enenil, anbil mages veettukku reydu varappogiradhu endra thagaval avaradhu teemukku munbe therindhuvittadhaam. 'sikkalaana vivagaarangalai kleen seythuvida vendum' ena netru madhiyame utharavugal parandhirukkindrana.
Anbilin udhaviyaalargal, avaradhu aluvalagathil panivurivorin selbongal ena edhilume endhavidha sarchaikkuriya vivagaarangal illaadhavadi thayaar nilaiyil irundhirukkiraargal. DMK munnaal amaichargal ke.en neru, e.va velu aagiyor veedugalil reydu nadandhavodhum thagavalgalai munbe kasindhadhaaga sarchaigal vedithana. Tharpodhum thagaval kasindhiruppadhaal kadum apsettil irukkiradhaam aatchi melidam.

headline: Idaitherdhalil TVK 100% vetriyai perum: amaichar sengottaiyan urudhi
text:
Mayilaadudhurai: thamizhagathin nirandhara mudhalvar Vijay thaan; TVK idaitherdhalil 100 sadhaveedha vetriyai ettum ena amaichar sengottaiyan therivithullaar.
Mayilaadudhuraiyil niruvargalidam amaichar sengottaiyan kooriyadhaavadhu: Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathin thalaivar Vijay Thamizhaga makkal maatrathai virumbiyadhan adippadaiyil, oru pudhiya varalaaru padaikkum thalaivaraaga, indhiyaavukke vazhikkaattiyaaga thigazha koodiya Thamizhaga mudhalvaraaga irukkiraar. Avar irukkum varai avar thaan thamizhagathin nirandhara mudhalvar. Varalaatrai padaikkoodiya thalaivaraaga irukkiraar.
Avargal solvadhai pol naatkal ennappadavillai. Avargalukku thaan naatkal ennappattu kondu irukkiradhu. TVK idaitherdhalil 100 sadhaveedha vetriyai ettum; matra katchigal enna seyya pogiradhu enbadhai neengal therdhal mudivil therindhu kolveergal. TVK koottaniyil kamyoonist inaivaargalaa enbadhai poruthirundhu paarungal; innum niraiya katchigal koottanikku varum. Ivvaaru sengottaiyan koorinaar.

headline: Thurandhar padakkuzhu ayothi raamar koyilukkus sendraargalaa?
text:
‘‘thurandhar padakkuzhu ayothi raamar koyilukkus sendranar,’’ endru koori,

ippo thaan sodala Tamil Naattil therdhalukku piragu thurandharai thiraiyida vendum ippodhu thadai seyyavendum endru Court-il muraiyittullaan,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

investigation_details:
