headline: Seyyum thozhile - "velaikku vandhuttaa kashdam kavalai ellaam marandhuvogum!"
text:
Oru naal velai senjjaa, arunoorula irundhu ennooru roobai varaikkum sambalam kidaikkum. Indhak kaasuladhaan pillaiga rendu peraiyume tigiri padikka vechen. Ippo periya ponnukkuk kalyaanamum aagiruchu.
Ongi uyarndhu nirkira kattadam. Peyint adikkum pani theeviramaaga nadandhugondirukkiradhu. Oru pakkam 30 adi uyarathil, saarathil thongiyavadiye peyint adithukkondirukkiraar amudhaa. Udambellaam sidhariya peyinttugal kodugalida, oru naveena oviyambolave kaatchiyalikkiraar.
“vazhakkamaa peyint velaigalai, adhilum saarathil thodangi uyaramaana pagudhigalil peyint adikkum velaigalil perumbaalum aangaldhaane eeduvaduvaargal... Neenga eppadikkaa?” endru kettaal azhagaagas sirithavadi pesugiraar amudhaa.
“velaiyila enna aambalai, pombalai ellaam. Inga pombalainga rombap per peyint velai seyyirom. Sbire peyinding, rolar peyinding, pirash peyinding, patti paakkuradhu, avuttar adikkiradhunnu ovvorutharum ovvoru velaiyila pazhakkappattavangalaa iruppaanga. Naan 20 varushathukku mela indha velai seyyiradhaala enakku ellaa velaiyum athuppadi...” veyilin vemmai vaatta kangalai idukkiyavadi solgiraar amudhaa.
“indhath thozhilukkulla neenga vandhadhu eppadikkaa?”
“enakkus sondha ooru Salem maavattam, thappaguttai kiraamam. Kalyaanam mudichu ilambillaikku vandhuttom. Enga veettukkaarar tharikku vaarppu podura velai seyyiraaru. Engalukku rendu ponnunga. Avaroda varumaanathula kudumbathai nadathuradhu kashdamaa irundhuchu. Naamalum edhaavadhu velaikkup ponaathaan samaalikka mudiyumnu thonichu. Akkam pakkathu veettukkaarangakitta, ‘edhaavadhu velai irundhaa sollunga’nnu solli vechirundhen. Enga veettukkup pakkathu veetla irundha oru akkaa sunnaambu adikkira velaikkup povaanga. Orunaal, ‘thinamum 100 roovaa sambalam. Sunnaambu adikka varriyaa?’nnu kettaanga. Munnap pinna anuvavam illai. Namakkus sariyaa varumaannu sandhegamaa irundhuchu. Aanaa, andhak kaasu irundhaa pullainga padippukkaavadhu udhavumennu ‘sari’nnu sollitten.
Enga veettukkaarar, ‘nee en kashdappadure... Naan paathukka maattenaa’nnu varuthappattaaru. Neenga mattume kashdathaith thaanganumaa... Ennaala mudiyum mattum seyyiren’nu pesi othukka vechu velaikku vandhen” endravar, naam avar anindhirundha ‘aambalai sattai’yaip paarppadhai unarndhu sirikka aarambithaar.
“ `pombalaip pullai saarathula ellaam eri velai seyyalaamaa?’nnu aarambathula kekkathaan senjjaanga. Manasula thairiyamum thannambikkaiyum irundhaa seyyalaamdhaane... Mathavanga thappaa pesak koodaadhennu aambalais sattaiyaip pottukkitten. Romba siramamaana velaippaa... Peyint kannula therikkum... Ore erichalaa irukkum. Idho paaru... Kaiyellaam kaaychuppochu. Sunnaambu velaikku vandhappo soodu othukkaama, udambellaam koppalam vandhuruchu. En veettukkaarargooda payandhuttaaru. Aanaa, velaikkup poganumnu naan edutha mudivula urudhiyaa ninnutten. 20 varushamaa andha mananilaiyila endha maatramum illai” endravaridam ivvalavu uyarathil saarathil thongiyavadi peyint adippadhaip patrik kettom.
“aarambathula veettukkulla mattumdhaan velai seyven. Avuttor adikkiradhillai. Orunaal avuttor adikkira aambalaiyaal varalai. Aanaa, annaikku velaiyai mudichuk kudukkanumnu enga onar solliyirundhaaru. Adhanaala vera vazhiyillaama saarathula eritten. Mudhalmurai konjjam payamaavum thayakkamaavumdhaan irundhuchu. Aanaa enakku naane thairiyathai varavazhaichukkitten. Anga irundha ellaarum aacharyamaathaan paarthaanga.
Kayithula erumbodhu kashdamaathaan irukkum. Eri velai seyyumbodhu keezhe paarthaa thalai suthum. Seelai kattikkittu saarathula iranguradhum kashdamdhaan. Ellaarum, ‘pent pottukko’nnu solvaanga. Enakku adhu thayakkamaa irukku...” endru vetkappadugiraar amudhaa.
Amudhaavukku ippodhu 40 vayadhu. Vayadhukke uriya sorvu mugathil theriyathaan seygiradhu. Aanaalum velai seyyum vegathil kuraivillai.
“20 vayasula senjja maadhiri ippo velai seyya mudiyalaidhaan. Aanaalum orunaalgooda veettula irukka mudiyaadhu. Enakku indha velai pidichirukku. Thinamum saarathula eruradhum iranguradhum saagasam maadhiri irukkum. Aambalainga niraiya per velai mudinjjadhum neraa oyin shaappukkup poyiruvaanga. Enakku oru tee podhum, inge velai senjjuttu veettulayum poy velai seyya. Udambu sorndhuvogudhu. Aanaa, eppavum manasai sorndhu poga vida maatten” endravarin mugam satru vaadugiradhu.
``en pullaingadhaan rombak kashdappadudhungappaa. ‘emmaa... Imbuttu paadu padura?'nnu ketkudhunga. Peyint adikkiravaloda pullai tigiri padichirukkunga’nnu oor sollattume...oru vairaakkiyamdhaan. En pullaigalukkaagath thalaigeezhaakkooda naan thonguven” endravarin kangal kalangugindrana.
“velaikku vandhuttaa naan edhaip pathiyum ninaikka maatten. Peyint adikkiradhu oru rasanaiyaana velai. En kavanamellaam adhuladhaan irukkum. Kashdam, kavalaiyellaam marandhuttu velaiyai rasichu seyven. Paattuk ketkap pidikkum. Kaalaiyila samaichu mudichuttu, 10 manikku velaikku vandhaa saayangaalam 6 mani varaikkum velai irukkum. Aarambathula akkam pakkathula indha velaikkup poradhai oru maadhiri pesathaan senjjaanga. Aanaa, adhaiyellaam ninnu ketkavum, padhil sollavum enakku neram illai. En kudumbam, en pillaigal, vaazhkkaidhaan enakku mukkiyam. Nammaip pathi mudhugukkup pinnaala pesuravanga endhas soozhallayum namakkaaga vandhu nikkap poradhillai. Nam kaidhaan namakku udhavi.
Oru naal velai senjjaa, arunoorula irundhu ennooru roobai varaikkum sambalam kidaikkum. Indhak kaasuladhaan pillaiga rendu peraiyume tigiri padikka vechen. Ippo periya ponnukkuk kalyaanamum aagiruchu. Konjja naal munnaadi, naan saarathula ninnu velai senjjukkittirundhadhai enga onar video eduthu netla pottuttaaru. Adhai ellaarum paarthuttaanga. Ippo sandhaikko, bus staandukko ponaakkooda ellaarukkum ennaith theriyudhu... ‘peyint adikkira akkaa thaane neenga’nnu kekkuraanga. En marumagap pullaigooda en veediyovaip paarthuttu, ‘athai, neenga maas’nu sonnaaru. Enna maaso... Namakku namma velai saami maadhiri. Adhai virumbis seyyirom... Udambula valu irukkura varaikkum seyven. Adhukku mela veettula mudangikkidandhaa, pullainga paathukkap poraanga...” endravar, thideerendru, mele annaandhu paarkkiraar.
“potta velai potta maadhiriye kidakku. Andhikkulla velaiyai mudikkanum...” endravadi thirumbavum saarathil erath thodangugiraar. Andhak kaatchi avvalavu artham podhindhadhaaga irukkiradhu!

headline: Tamil Nadu arasu roo.5,725kku oru kiraam thangam vaanga tendar arivippu veliyittadhaa?
text:
Thaaymaaman thanga modhiram thittathin keezh oru kiraam thanga modhirathai roo.5,725kku kolmudhal seyya Tamil Nadu arasu tendar (oppandhavulli) arivippai veliyittadhaaga oru thagaval

news 18 Tamil Nadu veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “”thaaymaaman thanga modhiram thittam” thaaymaaman thanga modhiram thittathirkaana oppandha arivippai veliyitta Tamil Nadu arasu. Oru kiraam thangam roo.5,725-kku kolmudhal seyya tendar arivippu. Indru(joolai 14) mudhal aagast 17 aam thedhi varai tendarukku vinnappikkalaam. Arinjar annaa pirandhanaalaana sep.15 aam thedhi thaaymaaman thangam modhiram thittam thodangum ena arivithulla mudhalamaichar. Oru kiraam edaiyulla 4,41,667 thanga modhirangalai vaanga oppandha arivippu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil pirakkum ellaa kuzhandhaigalukkum thanga modhiram podappadum endru TVK therdhal arikkaiyil koorappattadhu. Aatchikku vandha piragu arasu maruthuvamanaiyil pirakkum kuzhandhaigalukku thanga modhiram endru maatri arivikkappattadhu. Indha thittam sepdambar maadham thodangappadum endru arivikkappattulladhu. Thanga modhiram vaanga Tamil Nadu arasu tendar arivippai veliyittulladhu.
Indha tendar arivippai sariyaaga purindhugollaamal oodagangal seythi veliyida, adhai nettisangal kurippaaga edhirkkatchiyais saarndha samooga oodaga aarvalargal viral-aaga pagirndhu varugindranar. Aanaal, “arasin tendaril thaaymaaman thanga modhira thittathin keezh oru kiraam thanga modhirangalai (22 kaarat/916) viniyogippadharkaana oppandham” endru thelivaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Tendar arivippin kadaisi pagudhiyil roo.5,725 endru kurippittirundhanar. Adhuve kuzhappathirkuk kaaranamaaga maarivittadhu. Namakkum adhu enna roo.5,725 endru puriyavillai. Adhe nerathil 22 kaarat thangam roo.13 aayirathirku virkum nilaiyil roo.5725kku vaanga vaayppillai enbadhaal arasin oppandhappulligalai eduppavargalidam kettom.
Nammidam pesiya arasu tendar eduppavargal adhu tendar vinnappathirkaana kattanam endranar. Tendar arivippileye taakkument kaast endru kurippittirukkiraargal. Meleye adhai kurippittuvittadhaal keezhe thaniyaaga kurippidath thevaiyillai endru vittuvittanar. Vazhakkamaaga tendar eduppavargalukku idhu puriyum. Thideerendru paarppavargalukku idhu puriyaamal poyirukkalaam” endranar.
Melum Tamil Nadu maruthuva sevaigal niruvanathin mundhaiya tendar thodarbaana arivippugalaiyum inaiyathilirundhu eduthu namakku alithanar. Adhil tendar aavanathin vilai roo.5,725 endru thelivaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thanga modhiram thodarbaana tendar arivippil adhai thelivaaga kurippidaamal vittadhan vilaivu sila oodagangal adhaith thavaraagap purindhugondu seythi veliyittiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Munnadhaaga Tamil Nadu arasu munnaal mudhalamaichar annaadhuraiyin pirandhanaalandru thaaymaaman thanga modhira thittam thodangappadum endru arivithirundhadhu. Roo.755.83 kodiyil 4.41 latcham oru kiraam thanga modhiram vaangappadum. Andha thanga modhiram 22 kaarat tharathil 916 thara saandridhazhudan irukkum endru arivikkappattirundhadhu. Indha kanakkup padi paarthaalum kooda kittathatta oru modhirathin vilai 17 aayiram roobai endru varugiradhu. Tendar aavanangalai vaanginaal mattume idhu thodarbaana muzhu vivarathaiyum ariya mudiyum. Enave, roo.5725kku oru kiraam thanga modhiram vaanga Tamil Nadu arasu tendar koriyadhu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pakistan payangaravaadhigal koodaaram azhippu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Pakistan payangaravaadhigal koodaarathai azhitha Indhiya raanuvam endru oru video

koodaarangal aruge kundugal vedikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “*aappareshan #sindhoor* theeviravaadhigal koodaarangal meedhu … thulliyamaaga kundu veesi azhithadhu 🔥 *indhiyaa raanuvam ❤️* *🔴 ‘aavareshan sindhoor’ – peyar kaaranam enna?* pahalgaam thaakkudhalil kanavarai izhandha pengalukkaaga pazhidheerkkave ‘aavareshan sindhoor’
thirumanam aana pengal netri vadugil vaikkum kungumam ‘sindhoor’ ena azhaikkappadum. Pahalgaam thaakkudhalil pala pengala kan edhiril avargal kanavan suttukkollappattu thangal kungumathai izhandhanar. Pengal netriyil vaikkum kungumathai kurikkave, raanuva nadavadikkaikku ‘aavareshan sindhoor‘ ena peyar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Pakistan payangaravaadhigal mugaamgal meedhu India thaakkudhal nadathiyulladhu. Indha nilaiyil thaakkudhal sambavathin kaatchi endru pala video-kkal samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirappattu varugindrana. Payangaravaadhigal mugaamgal thulliyamaaga kundu veesi azhikkappattadhu endru paravum video unmaiyaa endru mattum aayvu seythom.
Video-vil al jaseeraa oodagathin logo ulladhu. Enave, indha video-vai al jaseeraa veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarthom. Me 7, 2025 andru appadi endha video padhivaiyum al jaseeraa veliyidavillai. Adhil ulla aravu ezhuthukkalaik koogul tiraanslettarai payanbaduthi mozhimaatram seythu paarthom. Adhil indhoneshiya maruthuvamanai (المستشفى الإندونيسي – قبل قليل) endru irundhadhu.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu palarum indha video-vai 2023m aandil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil kaasaavil ulla indhoneshiyan maruthuvamanai meedhu Israel nadathiya thaakkudhal endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Thodarndhu thedi al jaseeraa oodagam veliyittirundha veediyovaiyum kanduvidithom. 2023m aandu navambar 9m thedhi andha video-vai YouTube-il padhivittirundhanar. Adhil, Israel vimaanappadai vimaanangal indhoneshiya maruthuvamanai aruge nadathiya thaakkudhalil eraalamaanor padugaayam adaindhanar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Ivai ellaam indha video Pakistan payangaravaadhigal mugaam meedhu Indhiya nadathiya thaakkudhalin video illai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.

headline: ‘Plan A’ koyil.. ‘Plan B’ sengottai.. Kunduvedippil nadandha thideer Twist.. Veliyaana pageer thagaval!
text:
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
2025il Delhi sengottai aruge nadandha car kunduvedippu sambavam thodarbaaga thesiya pulanaayvu mugamai thaakkal seythulla kutrappathirigaiyil palveru adhirchith thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana. Sengottai aruge kunduvedippu nadathappatta idam mudhalil kurivaikkappatta idam illai endrum, adharku munbaaga sandhini savukkil ulla laal mandhir koyilai kurivaithu thaakkudhal nadatha thittamidappattirundhadhaagavum visaaranaiyil theriyavandhulladhu.
Kadandha aandu navambar 10-aam thedhi, vedivorutkal nirappappatta hoondaay i20 kaaril umar-un-navi enbavar sendradhaaga thesiya pulanaayvu mugamai therivithulladhu. Maalai 6.37 maniyalavil avar laal mandhir aruge kaarai nirutha muyandradhaaga appagudhiyil padhivaana kangaanippu kemaraa kaatchigalil theriyavandhulladhu. Aanaal, andha nerathil laal mandhir amaindhulla pagudhiyil kadumaiyaana pokkuvarathu nerisal irundhulladhu. Adhevol, angu Police paadhugaappum adhigamaaga irundhadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Idhanaal kaarai thittamittavadi angu nirutha mudiyaamal umar thirumbiyullaar. Pinnar kaarai sengottai nokki ottis sendrullaar.
Sila nimidangalukkup piragu, sengottaiyin 4-aavadhu nuzhaivuvaayil aruge avar kaarai niruthiyadhaaga visaaranaiyil theriyavandhulladhu. Maalai 6.50 maniyalavil andha kaaril irundha vedigundu vedikka vaikkappattadhaaga thesiya pulanaayvu mugamaiyin kutrappathirigaiyil koorappattulladhu. Adhaavadhu, laal mandhir aruge kaarai nirutha muyandradharkum sengottai aruge kunduvedippu nadandhadharkum idaiye verum 13 nimida payana thoorame irundhirukkiradhu.
Indha kunduvedippil 11 per uyirizhandhanar. Melum 29 per kaayamadaindhanar. Kunduvedippin thaakkathaal arugil irundha kattadangalum sedhamadaindhana. Andhas sedhathin madhippu sumaar roo.17.7 latcham ena adhigaarigal madhippittullanar.
Indha vazhakkil car kunduvedippai nadathuvadharkaaga sirappu muraiyil thayaarikkappatta vedigundu payanbaduthappattadhaaga thesiya pulanaayvu mugamai therivithulladhu. Kundai vedikkas seyvadharkaana karuvi, umar anindhirundha kaalaniyil poruthappattirundhadhaagavum visaaranaiyil koorappattulladhu.
Melum, umarudan thodarbudaiyavargalidam irundhu kaippatrappatta vedivorutkal matrum idhara porutkalilum ore vagaiyaana rasaayanangal iruppadhu thadayaviyal parisodhanaiyil theriyavandhadhaaga thesiya pulanaayvu mugamai therivithulladhu. Idhanmoolam indha thaakkudhalukkup pinnaal oru thittamitta kuzhu seyalbattirukkalaam endra sandhegam valuppetrulladhu.
Idhuvarai nadandha visaaranaiyin adippadaiyil paarkkumbodhu, sengottai aruge nadandha kunduvedippu thideerena thervu seyyappatta idathil nadathappatta thaakkudhal alla endrum, mudhalil laal mandhirai kurivaithirundha nilaiyil, angu nilaviya pokkuvarathu nerisal matrum kaavaldhurai paadhugaappu kaaranamaaga thittam maatrappattirukkalaam endrum thesiya pulanaayvu mugamaiyin kutrappathirigai suttikkaattugiradhu.

headline: Thirupparangundrathil islaamiyargal aadu, kozhi pali koduthu nerchai niraivetralaam endru M.K. Stalin vaakkurudhi alithaaraa?
text:
‘‘thirupparangundrathil islaamiyargal aadu, kozhi pali koduthu nerchai niraivetralaam,’’ endru M.K. Stalin vaakkurudhi alithadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’vaakkurudhi!!! Thirupparangundrathil islaamiya perumakkal thozhugai seythu aadu, kozhi paliyittu, nerchai niraivetru vidhamaaga pudhiya satta masodhaa niraivetrappadum- mu.ka.staalin.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda news card unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu poliyaanadhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, san news aasiriyar kuzhu matrum DMK aidi pirivu aagiyoridam pesi, idhu unmaiyalla, endru urudhippaduthiyullom.
Melum, DMK-vin therdhal arikkai maars 29 andrudhaan veliyaaga ulladhu. Ithagaiya soozhalil thavaraana thagaval parappugiraargal, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Megathaiye kaanom: indhaandaavadhu podhumaana mazhai kidaikkumaa: irandu aandugalaaga saraasariyai vida kuraivu
text:
Madurai: Madurai maavattathil 2 aandugalaaga mazhaiyalavu saraasari alavaivida sarindhu varuvadhaal, indhaandu varatchi erpadumo ena vivasaayigal acham therivikkindranar. Maduraiyil indhaandu thuvakkam mudhal thenmerku paruvamazhai kaalam varai podhumaana alavil peyyaadhadhaal veppam innum kuraindhavaadillai. Idhanaal podhumakkal kurippaaga vivasaayigal perum emaatrathil ullanar.
Indhaandu angondrum, ingondrumaaga peythaalum saraasari mazhaiyaik kaattilum kuraivaagave peythulladhu. Varum tisambar varai el nino paadhippu irukkum ena edhirbaarppadhaal thenmerku paruvamazhaiyaith thodarndhu akdovar mudhal tisambar varaiyaana vadagizhakkup paruvamazhaiyum emaatri vidumo ena vivasaayigal acham therivikkindranar.
Appadi nadandhaal neernilaigalil thanneer iruppum, nilathadi neermattamum vegamaaga kuraindhuvidum. Maavatta nirvaagam ippodhe varatchi kaala nadavadikkaikkum thayaaraaga vendum endru vivasaayigal therivithanar.
Irandaandu mazhaiyalavu Madurai maavattathil kadandha 2024 l kodai, thenmerku, vadagizhakku paruvamazhai kaalangalil iyalbai vida adhigamaagave peythulladhu. Aandu saraasari mazhaiyaana 874.86 mi.mee.,yai vida 152.51 mi.mee., koodudhalaaga 1027.37 mi.mee., alavukku peythulladhu. Idhanaal neernilaigalilum, nilathadiyilum neermattam thirupdhiyaana alavil irundhadhu.
Adutha aandil (2025) saraasari mazhaiyaivida 118.12 mi.mee., kuraindhu motham 756.74 mi.mee., alavukke mazhai peythulladhu. Idhanaal neernilaigalil iruppum, nilathadi neerum kuraindhu vandhana. Indhaandu (2026) mazhai pozhivu irukkum endru edhirbaartha nilaiyil janavari mudhale saraasariyaik kaattilum mazhai patraakkuraiyaagave irundhulladhu.
Idhanbadi 2026 janavariyil 22.40 mi.mee.,kku padhilaaga 20.83 mi.mee.,yum, pipravariyil 13 mi.mee.,kku padhil 3.60 mi.mee.,yum, maarchil 20.60 mi.mee.,kku padhil 19.08 mi.mee.,yum, epralil 59.80 mi.mee.,kkup padhil 12.08 mi.mee.,yum, me maadham 63.80 mi.mee.,yai vida koodudhalaaga 123.15 mi.mee.,yum peythulladhu.
Idhaiyaduthu joon mudhal aagast varai podhumaana mazhai illai endru adhigaarigal therivithanar. Idhanaal vadagizhakku paruvamazhaiyum emaatrinaal indhaandu varatchiyai sandhikka vendi irukkumo ena vivasaayigal acham therivithanar.

headline: Sreerangam koyil nila vivagaaram: ``needhimandram uriya nadavadikkai edukkum" - DMK piramugar raamgumaar
text:
Sreeranga koyil nila vivagaaram kurithu raamgumaar pettiyalithirukkiraar.
Trichy, sreerangam thirukkoyilukku sondhamaana sumaar roo. 50 kodi madhippilaana nilathai poliyaana aavanangalai koduthu andha pagudhiyin DMK seyalaalar raamgumaar enbavar thanadhu peyarukku kadandha 2022-m aandu pathirappadhivu seythulladhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundhirukkiradhu. Indha vivagaaram kurithu indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai amaichar ramesh thalaiyittu tharpodhu kaaval nilaiyathil pugaaralikkappattu andha DMK piramugar meedhu vazhakkuppadhivu seyyappattulladhu.
Indha vivagaaram kurithu seythiyaalargalidam pesiya DMK piramugar raamgumaar, ``indha idam thodarbaana vazhakku Chennai uyar needhimandrathin madhuraik kilaiyil niluvaiyil ulladhu. Engal tharappil ulla niyaayangalaiyum thevaiyaana aavanangalaiyum needhimandrathil thaakkal seythullom. Indhu samaya aranilaiyathuraiyin 1930AA padhivedu matrum sothu perettil indha en illai. Saarbadhivaalar muraiyaaga visaaranai nadathi, sariyaana aavanangal irundhaal mattume pathirap padhivu seyvaar.
Needhimandram idhil uriya nadavadikkai edukkum enbadhaal adharkaagak kaathirukkirom. En meedhu pugaar alikkappattiruppadhu kurithuk ketkireergal. En sondhak katchiyileye enakku vendaadhavargalum edhirigalum iruppaargal. Idhellaam arasiyal matrum podhuvaazhkkaiyil sagajamaana ondrudhaan. Yaar indhas seyalais seythirundhaalum, adhai andha sreeranganaadhap perumaalin mudivukke vittuvidugiren. Aranilaiyathurai amaichare idhil eeduvattiruppadhaaga neengal meendum meendum thuruvith thuruvik kettaalum, adhaiyum andha ranganaadharidame vittuvidugiren. Naan thavaru seythirundhaal perumaal en meedhu nadavadikkai edukkattum, adharku naan thayaaraaga irukkiren.
Indha vivagaaram needhimandrathil niluvaiyil irukkumbodhu pugaar alithavar yaar endru enakkuth theriyavillai. Avargal needhimandrathin meedhu nambikkai illaamal pugaar alithaargalaa endra kelvi ezhugiradhu. Kaavaldhurai tharappilirundhu ennai visaaranaikku innum azhaikkavillai. Vazhakku needhimandrathil niluvaiyil iruppadhaal, idhu thodarbaana koodudhal vivarangalai en vazhakkarinjardhaan therivikka vendum. Naan koora mudiyaadhu. Sreerangam koyil inai aanaiyar pugaar alithiruppadhaaga neengal solgireergal, aanaal adhu kurithu enakku idhuvarai endha adhigaarappoorvath thagavalum varavillai. Thagaval edhenum vandhaal therivikkiren. Aduthagatta nadavadikkaigal kurithu engal vazhakkarinjarum katchiyum mudivu seyvaargal."

headline: Merku vangathil thozhugai seythavargalai BJP thondargal thondharavu seythanaraa?
text:
Merku vangathil vetri petra piragu BJP, aareses thondargal masoodhi ondrukkul nuzhaindhu isaik karuvigalai isaithu thozhugai seythavargalaith thondharavu seythaargal endru oru video

islaamiyar oruvar thozhugai seyyum podhu avarukku pinnaal silar isaik karuvigalai isaikkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idho aareses, BJP matrum indhuthuvaa madhavaadha sakdhigal thangal velaiyai vangaalathil aarambithuvittaargal….!! Therdhalukkup piragu kolgathaa masoodhiyil thozhugai nerathil makkal amaidhiyaana muraiyil thozhum kaatchi…!! Indhudhuvaa sangigal pirarin vazhivaattu thalathirkul athumeeri. Nuzhaindhu mela thaala isai vaathiyangalai isaithu attoozhiyam seyvadhu. Aruvarukkadhakkadhu…!! Munbu masoodhikku veliye aniyaayam seythanar..ippo masoodhikkul..!! Indhudhuvaavinarin India unmaiyileye oru naagarigamatra naadu.. Trump sonna narakka kuzhi idhudhaan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Nadandhu mudindha merku vanga sattamandra therdhalil BJP migapperiya vetriyaip petradhu. Idhaith thodarndhu BJP, aareses thondargal islaamiyargalai thunburuthath thodangivittanar endru samooga oodagangalil padhividappattu varugiradhu. Appadi masoodhiyil islaamiyargal thozhugaiyil eeduvattirundha podhu paajaga-vinar isaik karuvigalai isaithu thondharavu seythaargal endru palarum video ondrai padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video 2025m aandu joon maadhame YouTube-il padhividappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Enave, idhu merku vanga therdhal mudivukkup piragu nadandha sambavam illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil namakku kidaitha video-vil indha sambavam patri edhuvum kurippidappadavillai. Aanaal, idhe pondru andha islaamiya vazhivaattuthalathil isaik karuvigalai isaikkum veru sila video-kkal veliyidappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil vanga mozhiyilirundha padhivai mozhiveyarthup paartha podhu “kaashi shaahi tharbaar shareep” paadal endru vandhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil thediya podhu islaamiya vazhivaattuthalathil palarum paadalgal paadi vazhivaadu nadathuvadhu thodarbaana pala video-kkal namakku kidaithana. Thodarndhu koogulil thediya podhu vangadhesathin sittagaang aruge indha thargaa iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Namakku kidaitha veru sila veediyokkalil irundha kattidamum koogul mep pugaippadathilirundha kattidamum ondraaga irundhadhu. Idhan moolam indha video vangadhesathais saarndhadhu enbadhum thelivaanadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu indha video sittagaangil ulla oru vazhivaattuthalathirku ulle edukkappattadhu endru kurippittu veliyaana samooga oodaga padhivugalum namakku kidaithana. Merku vanga sattamandra therdhal nadappadharku oru aandukku munbe indha video veliyaagi iruppadhaalum, vangadhesathil indha vazhivaattuthalam iruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhaalum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Roo.5000 tharum mathiya arasu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Anaithu indhiyak kudimakkalukkum mathiya arasu roo.5000 vazhangugiradhu endrum, video-vil thesiyak kodiyai kilik seythaal roo.5000 kidaikkum endrellaam oru vadhandhi

piradhama mandhiriyin muthraa thittathin keezh anaithu indhiyak kudi makkalukkum mathiya arasu vazhangum roo.5000 ungal kanakkil ilavasath thittam. Inaippaik kilik seythu ungal kanakkil panathaip perungal” endru video padhivu ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhe pondru, kodiyai kilik seyyavum roo.5000 neradiyaaga kanakkil. Indre ungal vaayppu” endru kurippittu matroru padhivu Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Idhai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiyak kudimakkalukku neradiyaaga oru lingkkai thoduvadhan moolam, inaiyathil padhivu seyvadhan moolam roo.5000 vazhangappadum endru mathiya arasu idhuvarai endha oru arivippaiyum veliyidavillai. Appadi veliyittadhaaga endha oru seythiyum illai. Aanaal, mathiya arasu roo.5000 vazhangugiradhu endru thodarndhu vadhandhigal mattum samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindrana.
Munbu BJP saarbil roo.5000 vazhangappaduvadhaaga idhu pondru vadhandhi paraviyadhu. Adhil nammudaiya pediem, roove pondra panam pera, anuppa udhavum seyaligalin kanakku vivarangalaik kettirundhanar. Andha inaippai kilik seythu, vivarathai alithaal nammudaiya panamdhaan kaanaamal pogum endru katturai veliyittirundhom.
Appadi naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil endha oru inaippum illai. Aanaal, mathiya arasu roo.5000 tharugiradhu, lingai kilik seyyungal endru video-vai mattum veliyittullanar. Indha pakkam nambagamaanadhu polavum illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga thodarndhu aayvu seythom.
Mathiya arasin muthraa thittathil roo.5000 vazhangappadugiradhaa endru thedinom. Aanaal, andha inaiyathalathil kooda appadi endha oru thagavalum illai. Indha padhivu moolam makkal mathiyil kuzhappathai erpadutha muyandriruppadhu therigiradhu.
Mathiya arasu mattumalla, endha oru arasum, thaniyaar niruvanamum ippadi inaiya inaippugalai kilik seythaal panam vazhangum endrellaam arivikkaadhu. Ippadi varum mesejgalai black seythuviduvadhu nalladhu. Adhai kilik seyvadhan moolam nammudaiya akkavundil irukkum panathai izhakkum vaayppu ulladhu.

headline: 2026 kudiyarasu thina alangaara oordhiyil thamizh purakkanikkappattadhaa?
text:
‘‘2026 kudiyarasu thina alangaara oordhiyil thamizh purakkanikkappattadhu’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ Tamil Nadu oordhi
thamizh illaamal indhi.’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval, endru Tamil Nadu arasin adhigaarappoorva fektchek kuzhu TN Factcheck maruppu therivithulladhaik kandom.
Idhanbadi, kudiyarasu thina vizhaa anivaguppil pangerkum ovvoru maanilangalukkaana alangaara oordhigalil andhandha maanila mozhigal engu idambera vendum endra vidhimurai ulladhu. Idhanai mathiya paadhugaapputh thurai amaichagam vaguthu, seyalbaduthi varugiradhu.
Indha vidhimuraiyin padi, alangaara oordhiyin munbakkathil indhiyum, pin pakkathil aangilamum, oordhiyin iruvurangalil andhandha maanila mozhigalum idamberum.
Idhan adippadaiyildhaan, telliyil nadaivetra 2026 kudiyarasu thina vizhaa anivaguppil Tamil Nadu saarbil pangetra alangaara oordhiyin iruvurangalilum thamizh mozhiyil ‘Tamil Nadu’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Munburam indhi matrum pinburam aangilamum ulladhu.
Aanaal, thamizh mozhi idamberavillai endrum, indhikku Tamil Nadu arasu mukkiyathuvam koduthuvittu, makkalai emaatrugiradhu endrum kurippittu, samooga valaidhalangalil thavaraana thagaval parappappadugiradhu.
2026 kudiyarasu thina vizhaa anivaguppu thodarbaana muzhu video idho…
enave, kudiyarasu thina vizhaa anivaguppil thamizh purakkanikkappattadhu endru pagirappadum thagaval thavaraanadhu, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Siritha mugathudan karoor vandha M.K. Stalin endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Karooril 41 per kootta nerisalil uyirizhandha nilaiyil, siritha mugathudan karoor viraindha M.K. Stalin endru oru pugaippadam

mu.ka.staalinai munnaal amaichar sendhil paalaaji varaverkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “sirichaa mugathodu karooril irangiya staalin….
Stalin maint vaays -sonna velaiyai kachidhamaa mudichitteenga paalaaji…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippada padhivaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karooril TVK pirasaara koottathil erpatta nerisalil sikki 41 per uyirizhandhullanar. Kootta nerisal vivathu erpattadhume Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin karoor sendraar. Paadhikkappatta makkalai sandhithu aarudhal koori, nivaarana udhaviyaiyum arivithaar. Indha nilaiyil karoor vandha M.K. Stalin magizhchiyaaga sirithavadi vandhaar. Sendhil paalaajiyaik kandavudan “sonna velaiyai sariyaaga seythavittaay enbadhu pola sirithaar” endru silar padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha pugaippadathil amaichargal maa.suppiramaniyan, naasar, munnaal amaichar ponmudi ullittor ullanar. Naasar, ponmudi ellaam karoor sendradhaagas seythi illai. Enave, pazhaiya padamaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha pugaippadathai sendhil paalaaji thannudaiya samooga oodaga pakkangalil 2024m aandu sepdambar 27m thedhi padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, “471 naatkal thanimaiyin irul neengi sooriyanin kaaladiyil. Ovvoru naalum, nimidamum, nodiyum ungalaiye ninaithirundhen. Thalaivare.! Thaayumaanavaraay thaangineergal.. En uyir ungal kaaladiyil samarppanam.. Ungal nambikkaikkum anbirkum vaazhnaal muzhukka nandrik kadanbattirukkiren!” endru kurippittirundhaar.
Siraiyilirundhu veliye vandha piragu avar indha padhivai veliyittirundhaar. Adhan pinnaniyai ariya appodhu veliyaana seythigalaith thedi eduthom. Siraiyilirundhu sendhil paalaaji veliye vandha piragu mudhan muraiyaaga Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinai Chennai vimaananilaiyathil vaithu sandhithaar endru seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan moolam 2024m aandu edukkappatta (sambavam nadappadharku oraandukku munbu edukkappattadhu) pazhaiya pugaippadathai eduthu, karoorukku siritha mugathudan M.K. Stalin vandhaar endru thavaraana thagavalaip parappiyiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu vishamathanamaanadhu, thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vali nivaaranigalum ratha azhutha adhigarippum.. Andraadam payanbaduthum marundhugalil kavanam thevai!!
text:
Uyar ratha azhutham ullavargal thinasari uvayogikkum sila eliya vali nivaaranigal, sali marundhugal ullittavai ratha azhuthathaik kattukkadangaamal uyarthum aavathaik kondullana. Maruthuvargal parindhuraikkum ratha azhutha marundhugalaith thavaraamal saappittu vandhaalum, kadaigalil suyamaaga vaangip payanbaduthum aivuvuroofan taiklofenaak matrum naapraaksan pondra vali nivaaranigal siruneeragathin seyalbaattaip paadhippadhodu ratha azhuthathaiyum uyarthuvadhaaga maruthuvargal echarikkindranar.
Kurippaaga, siruneeragathil ratha naalangalai virivadaiyas seythu ratha ottathai seeraakkum saikloaaksijanes ensaimgal matrum purostaaklaandin surappaith thadukkindrana. Idhanaal siruneeragathin vadigattum thiran kuraindhu saraasariyaaga sistaalik ratha azhutham 3 mudhal 6 mmHg varai uyarndhu, idhayas seyalizhappu erpadum aavathai 20 sadhaveedham varai adhigarikkum endrum maruthuvargal koorugindranar. Adhevondru, sali maathiraigalil ulla soodovetrin ratha naalangalin aalfaa-1 atrinerjik risipdarsai thoondi ratha naalangalai surukkugiradhu. Melum, nenjjerichalukkaagap payanbaduthappadum sodiyam kalandha amila edhirppu marundhugal, adheedha kaafin konda enarji paanangal aagiyavai uyar ratha azhuthathai melum adhigaarikka vaayppulladhaaga maruthuvargal therivikkindranar.
Enave kadaigalil saadhaaranamaaga kidaikkum valinivaaranigalai utkolvadharku munbu maruthuva nivunargalin aalosanaiyaip peruvadhudan, thaamaaga ratha azhutha maathiraigalai niruthavo kuraikkavo koodaadhu endrum maruthuvargal arivuruthugindranar.

headline: Kaalvaayil thanneer sella idaiyooru thengiya aagaayathaamaraigal agatram
text:
Mettoor: Salem, naamakkal, Erode maavattangalil karaiyora nagar, kiraama makkalin kudineer thevaiyai poorthi seyya, kadandha, 7l, mettoor kizhakku, merku kaalvaayil vinaadikku, 400 kanaadi neer thirakkappattadhu. Varum, 17 varai, kaalvaayil neer thirakkap-padum.
Munnadhaaga kaalvaay varandu pala idangalil aagaayathaama-raigal, kuppai thengina. Innilaiyil kudineerukku thanneer thirakkappattadhaal, aangaange thengiya aagaayathaamaraigal, thanneer thodarchiyaaga sella idaiyooraaga irundhadhu. Idhai, sila naatkalaaga neervalathurai oozhiyargal poklain moolamum, sila pagudhigalil neeril irangiyum aagaayathaamaraigalai agatrum paniyil eeduvattullanar. Netru mettoor nagaraatchi ponnagar paalam adivaaram eraalamaana kuppai, aagaayathaama-raigalai, neervalathurai oozhiyargal kaalvaayil irangi agat-rinar.thodarndhu aangaange kaalvaayil thengiyirundha aagaayathaa-maraigal, kuppaiyai agatri, thanneer thadaiyindri sella nada-vadikkai merkondanar.

text:

investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, X valaidhalathil pagirappattirundha oru padhivin lingk kidaithadhu.

headline: Chennai-yil ore iravil 70 ravudigal kaidhu; Police adhiradi
text:
Chennai: Chennai-yil aduthaduthu kolai sambavangal arangeriya nilaiyil, netru iravil mattum 70 ravudigalai Police kaidhu seythullanar.
Vattikku panam vaangiya vivagaarathil ezhundha modhalil, sinimaa thunai nadigar piradheep raaj,30, enbavar netru mundhinam iravu kodooramaaga kollappattaar. Thanakku kolai mirattal viduthadhaaga thiruvotriyoor Police station-il pugaar alitha marunaale, avar kollappatta sambavam perum adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu. Indhak kolai sambavam thodarbaaga 4 per kaidhu seyyappattu, visaarithu varugindranar.
Idhevola, pesant nagaril TVK nirvaagi kannan,45, enbavar munvirodham kaaranamaaga kolai seyyappattaar.indha sambavathil thodarbudaiya 5 per kaidhu seyyappattanar.
Thalainagar Chennai-yil aduthadutha nadandha indhak kutram sambavam podhumakkal mathiyil peradhirichiyai erpaduthina. Enave, Chennai-yil kutracheyalgalai kuraikka mudivu seytha Police, 'aappareshan tiraiv' endra adhiradi nadavadikkaiyai merkondanar. Vidiya vidiya nadaivetra indha sodhanaiyil, piravala ravudigal matrum thodarndhu kutracheyalgalil eeduvaduvavargalai kandarindhu kaidhu seythanar.
Kurippaaga, pidivaarant pirappikkappattu, needhimandrathil aajaraagaamal irundhu vandha ravudigalaiyum sutri valaithu pidithanar. Netru ore iravil mattum, kutrathaduppu munnecharikkai nadavadikkaiyaaga 70 ravudigalai Police kaidhu seythullanar.

headline: Roo.1,020 kodi oozhal vazhakku; DMK maaji amaichar neruvin koottaali kaidhu
text:
Chennai: DMK, munnaal amaichar neruvin valadhu karamaaga thigazhndhavarum, oozhal vazhakkil thedappattavarumaana, kavivirasaath, 48, enbavarai, lanjja ozhippu Police kaidhu seythu, visaarithu varugindranar.
Kadandha DMK, aatchiyinbodhu, satta virodha pana parimaatram thodarbaaga, appodhu, nagaraatchi matrum kudineer vazhangal thurai amaicharaaga irundha neruvin thambi ravichandhiran veedu ullitta idangalil, amalaakkathurai adhigaarigal sodhanai nadathinar. Appodhu, neru thuraiyil, 1,020 kodi roovaaykku oozhal nadandhiruppadharkaana aavanangal sikkina.
Idhu thodarbaaga, 252 pakka aadhaarangaludan, Thamizhaga arasu, ti.ji.pi.,kku, amalaakkathurai kadidham ezhudhiyadhu. Adhan meedhu evvidha nadavadikkaiyum edukkavillai.tha.ve.ka., aatchikku vandhadhum, neru thurai oozhal thodarbaana aavanangal matrum aadhaarangal kurithu visaarikkumaaru, lanjja ozhippu thuraikku, arasu utharavittadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, neru, avaradhu thambigal manivannan, ravichandhiran, neruvin valadhu karamaana kavivirasaath utbada, 13 per meedhu lanjja ozhippu Police vazhakkup padhivu seythanar. Adhil, kavivirasaath, yaaridamellaam panam vaanginaar enbadharkaana aadhaarangal inaikkappattullana.
Avaradhu 'vaatsaap'pil, 'annaa, kovaiyil irundhu, 20.90 matrum 50, thiruppooril irundhu, 12.08 riseevdu' ena, kurippittu iruppadhaiyum, andha thogai kodigalil perappattu iruppadhaiyum, Police kandarindhullanar.
Oozhal thodarbaaga, neru, ravichandhiran, manivannan, kavivirasaath ullittor veedugalil sodhanai nadathi, mukkiya aavanangalai kaippatri ullanar. Ivvazhakkil thedappattu vandha kavivirasaath, netru iravu, Chennai vimaana nilaiyathil irundhu, landan sella muyandravodhu, avarai, kudiyurimai adhigaarigal thaduthu niruthi, lanjja ozhippu poleesaarukku thagaval therivithanar. Avargal viraindhu sendru, kavivirasaathai kaidhu seythu visaarithu varugindranar.

headline: Ulagileye adhiga sambalam perum piradhamar.. Yaar theriyumaa? Pinnani enna?
text:
Singappoor piradhamar laarans vongin (Lawrence Wong) aandu oodhiyam akdovar 15 mudhal 64 sadhaveedham adhigarikkappadavulladhu. Idhanaal ulagileye adhiga sambalam vaangum piradhamaraaga laarans vong thodarugiraar. Adhugurithu ippodhu paarkkalaam...
Singappoorin pudhiya oodhiyak kattamaippinbadi, piradhamar laarans vongin aandu varumaanam 2.2 milliyan singappoor taalarilirundhu 3.6 milliyan singappoor taalaraaga uyarthappada ulladhu. Adhaavadhu Indhiya madhippil 26 kodiye 9 latcham roobai aagum. Idhanmoolam, ulagileye adhiga sambalam perum arasuth thalaivar endra idathai laarans vong thodarndhu thakkavaithukkolgiraar. 2012aam aandukkup piragu singappoor amaichargalin oodhiyathil nadakkum mudhal periya maatram idhuvaagum. Piradhamaraith thavirthu idhara amaichargalin adippadai oodhiyamum 1.1 milliyan singappoor taalaril irundhu 1.8 milliyan singappoor taalaraaga uyarthappattulladhu.
Eninum ovvoru amaicharukkum avargalin seyalbaadugal matrum poruppugalin adippadaiyileye indha oodhiya uyarvu vazhangappadum ena arasuth tharappil therivikkappattulladhu. Singappooril arasiyal thalaivargalukku adhiga oodhiyam vazhanguvadhu neenda kaalamaagap pinbatrappadum oru nadaimuraiyaagum. Arasu nirvaagathil oozhal erpaduvadhaith thadukkavum, thiramaiyaanavargalai arasiyalukku eerkkavum idhu avasiyamaanadhu ena singappoor arasu karudhugiradhu.
Iruppinum, saamaaniya makkal sambaadhikkum thogaiyai vida arasiyalvaadhigalin sambalam pala madangu adhigamaaga iruppadhu makkalidaiye adhirupdhiyai erpaduthiyulladhu. Idhanai unarndha piradhamar vong, oodhiya uyarvaal kidaikkum koodudhal thogaiyai adutha 5 aandugalukku arakkattalaigalukku nangodaiyaaga vazhangappovadhaaga arivithullaar.

headline: Havudhi thaakkudhalaal shaak.. Savoodhiyaivittu veliyerum padaigal? Sikkalil ithaali!
text:
Seythiyaalar - M.meeraa
mathiya kizhakkil erkenave padhatram adhigarithulla nilaiyil, emanin havudhi amaippin thaakkudhalgal piraandhiya paadhugaappu nilaimaiyai melum sikkalaakkiyullana. Savoodhi areviyaavil havudhigalin thaakkudhalgal theeviramadaindhullana. Idaimarikkappatta tronin sidhaivugal savoodhi nagarap pagudhiyil vizhundhadhil oruvar uyirizhandhadhaagavum, iruvar kaayamadaindhadhaagavum thagavalgal therivikkindrana.
Uyirizhandhavar eman naattais serndhavar endrum, kaayamadaindhavargalil savoodhi pen matrum Pakistan naattavar iruppadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Indha kurippitta thaakkudhalukku havudhigal udanadiyaaga porupperkavillai. Aanaal, savoodhi adhigaarigal tron emanil irundhu havudhigalaal evappattadhaaga therivithullanar.
Idhanaal savoodhi areviyaa thanadhu vaan paadhugaappu amaippugal thodarbaaga pudhiya savaalai edhirgolgiradhu. Havudhi evuganaigal matrum trongalai idaimarikka payanbaduthappadum interceptor-kal amerikkaavidam kuraindhu varuvadhaal udhavi ketkavillai endru thagavalgal koorugindrana. Adhesamayam piraans, pirittan, Pakistan matrum egipdhu ullitta naadugalidam savoodhi vaan paadhugaappu udhaviyai naadiyulladhaagath thagavalgal koorugindrana.
Indhas soozhalil savoodhi areviyaavil ulla ithaaliya raanuvap padaigalai veru paadhugaappaana thalathukku maatra ithaali mudivu seythulladhaaga thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana. Savoodhi areviyaavin Taif vimaanappadaith thalathil ithaaliyin 500 veerargal paniyil ullanar. Indha thalathil niruthappattirundha ithaaliya Eurofighter por vimaanam meedhu evuganai thaakkudhal nadathappattadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, ithaaliya piradhamar jaarjiyaa meloni matrum paadhugaapputhurai amaichar kuydo krosetto aagiyor, angu paniyaatrum ithaaliya veerargalukku koodudhal paadhugaappu vazhanga savoodhi areviyaavidam utharavittadhaaga thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu.
Idhan thodarchiyaaga, kanisamaana ennikkaiyilaana ithaaliya veerargalai Taif thalathil irundhu savoodhi areviyaavileye ulla matroru paadhugaappaana thalathukku maatra mudivu seyyappattulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Anaithu veerargalum ingirundhu veliyetrappadavillai. Adhanaal Taif thalathil ithaaliyin raanuva nadavadikkaigal thodarndhu nadaiverum ena therivikkappattulladhu. Idhu Iran matrum adhan koottaaliyaana havudhigalukku saadhagamaana nagarvaaga paarkkappadugiradhu.
Oruvuram savoodhiyil thanadhu veerargalin paadhugaappai adhigarikkum ithaali, maruvuram sengadal matrum Bab el-Mandeb neerinaiyil thanadhu raanuvap pangalippai adhigarikkavum thayaaraagi varuvadhaagavum thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Airoppaavaiyum aasiyaavaiyum inaikkum mukkiyamaana kadalvazhigalil ondraana Bab el-Mandeb vazhiyaaga eraalamaana sarakkuk kappalgal, enney matrum erivaayuk kappalgal selgindrana. Indhap paadhai thodarndhu paadhikkappattaal, kappalgal aappirikkaavais sutri neendavaadhaiyil sellavendiya nilai erpadum. Idhanaal erivorul selavu, pokkuvarathu neram matrum ulagalaaviya viniyogas sangiliyil azhutham adhigarikkalaam.
Idhanaal, ithaali thanadhu vanigak kappalgalin paadhugaappukkaaga naangu kadarpadai kappalgalai anuppuvadhu kurithu aalosithu varuvadhaaga thagavalgal therivikkindrana. Airoppiya ondriyam orumitha mudivu edukka thaamadhithaalum, ithaali thaniyaaga nadavadikkai edukkath thayaaraaga iruppadhaaga krosetto therivithullaar.
Idharkidaiyil, emanin merkuk kadarkaraip pagudhiyil havudhigal thangaladhu kattuppaattai virivuvaduthiyulladhaaga thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana. Idhanaal, havudhigalin achuruthalai evvaaru edhirgolvadhu enbadhu kurithu ithaalikku pudhiya kavalai ezhundhulladhu. Sengadalil havudhigalin aadhikkathaal seenaavum achuruthalai edhirgolgiradhu. Havudhigalaik kattuppadutha Iran thanadhu selvaakkaip payanbadutha vendum endru China kettuk kondadhaaga Reuters seythi therivikkiradhu.
Sengadal vazhiyaaga nadaiverum kappal pokkuvarathu paadhikkappattaal, adhu China-vin erisakdhi viniyogathaiyum paadhikkakkoodum. Iran-in kadalvazhi enney etrumadhiyil perumbagudhi seenaavukke selgiradhu. Melum, China-vin enney irakkumadhiyil mathiya kizhakku mukkiyap pangu vagikkiradhu. 2023-l eeraan–savoodhi areviyaa idaiyilaana thoodharaga uravai meendum erpaduthuvadhilum China mukkiyap pangu vagithadhu. Enave, Iran meedhu peyjingirku irukkum porulaadhaara matrum thoodharaga selvaakkaip payanbaduthi padhatrathaik kattuppadutha mudiyumaa enbadhu mukkiyak kelviyaagiyulladhu.

headline: Vijay sedhuvadhikku mirattal vidutha Seeman endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘Vijay sedhuvadhikku mirattal vidutha Seeman’’ endru koori,

idhil ‘’ thambi Vijay sedhuvadhi arasiyalukku vandhaal thunai mudhalvar padhaviyai tharuven. Aanaal, engalukku edhiraaga arasiyal seythaal avarai tharkuri enakkoori en thambi saattai thuraimuruganai vaithu thinamum video pottu kadikka vaippen – Seeman, naam thamizhar katchi orunginaippaalar,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Vigadan logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta news card, endru theriyavandhadhu. Idhudhodarbaaga, vigadan tharappil pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Idhanbadi, ‘’idhu jananaayagam alla… thambi vijaysedhuvadhi yaarudaiya peyaraiyum kurippidavillai; endha arasiyal katchiyaiyum suttikkaattavillai. Oru vilaiyaattil uruvaana soozhalai vaithu thalaimaithuvam kuritha thanadhu karuthais solgiraar. Adhanai udanadiyaagath thangaladhu thalaivarodu poruthip paarthu, karuthu sonnavaraiye thaakka murpaduvadhu en? Thanakkup piditha karuthai mattume matravargal pesavendum ena ninaippadhu jananaayagam alla. Thanakku edhiraana karuthaiyum pesa anumadhithu, adharku karuthaal padhil solvadhudhaan jananaayagam – Seeman padhivu,’’ endrudhaan unmaiyaana news card-il ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, Seeman X valaidhala pakkathil veliyitta padhivaiyum aadhaarathirkaaga, keezhe inaithullom.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
unmaiyaana news kaardaiyum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news kaardaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ‘aambulansil nadanamaadiya thi.mu.ka-vinar’ endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Karooril TVK pirasaarathin podhu aambulansil thi.mu.ka-vinar nadanamaadinar endru oru video

aambulansinul silar nadanamaadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “netru DMK kaaranunga nadanam aadiullanar. Ungala summaa vida maattom angil” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karooril nadandha TVK pirasaara kootta nerisalil sikki 41 per uyirizhandhanar. Aanaal, koottathirku idaiyooru seyvadharkaaga aambulans vaaganangal kondu varappattadhaaga TVK thondargal kutramsaatti varugindranar. Indha nilaiyil aambulans ulle thi.mu.ka-vinar nadanamaadiyadhaaga video-vai silar padhivittu varugindranar.
“edhai saadhithadharkaaga ivargal aambulansil aattam aadugiraargal enbadhu theriyavillai” endrellaam kurippittu video-vai pagirndhu varugindranar. Idhan moolam uyirizhappukkuk kaaranam thi.mu.ka-thaan enbadharku aadhaaram kidaithuvittadhu enbadhu pol padhivittullanar. Indha video karooril TVK pirasaara koottam nadandhavodhu edukkappattadhaa endru mattum aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai seythi oodagangal thangal YouTube pakkathil sepdambar 21, 2025 andru padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Karoor TVK pirasaaram sepdambar 27, 2025 andru nadandhadhu. Adharku 6 naatkalukku munbaagave indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Thandhi TV veliyittirundha video-vil “thirunelveliyilirundhu naanguneri nokkis sendra arasu nadamaadum maruthuvamanai vaaganathil oozhiyargal nadanamaadiya video veliyaagi adhirchiyai erpaduthiyadhu” endru kurippittirundhanar. Idhu aambulans illai, arasu nadamaadum maruthuvamanai. Idhil oozhiyargal eppodhum irukkamaana mananilaiyileye irukka vendum, sirithaal kooda thavaru endru solvaargal pola.
Oozhiyargal nadanamaadiyadhu sariyaa, thavaraa endra aayvukkul naam sellavillai. Aanaal indha video karooril 41 per uyirizhandha podhu edukkappattadhu illai enbadhai mattum urudhi seythullom. Nellaiyil arasu nadamaadum maruthuvamanai vaaganathil oozhiyargal nadanamaadiya kaatchiyai, karooril TVK pirasaara koottathin podhu edukkappattadhu pondru thavaraaga vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhaith thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seythullom. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Eai ulagil China-vin adutha adhiradi.. Kimi ke3 endra pudhiya eai maadal arimugam!
text:
Eai thuraiyil China-vin pudhiya adhiradiyaaga moonshaat niruvanam uruvaakkiya kimi ke3 maadal arimugamaagiyulladhu. Ulagalavil piravalamaana kilaat, saat jividi pondra maadalgalai vida idhu membattadhu ena niruvanam valiyuruthugiradhu. Eai aadhikkam ore naattukkus sellakkoodaadhu, ulagalaaviya othuzhaippin palanaaga irukka vendum ena China adhivar shi jinbing karuthu therivithulla nilaiyil indha arivippu veliyaagiyulladhu.
Eai thuraiyil America niruvanangalukku kadumbotti thandhuvarum China aduthu pudhidhaaga melum oru thiran migundha eai maadalai arimugappaduthiyulladhu. Kimi ke3 endra indha maadalai peyjingai serndha moonshaat endra puthaakka niruvanam uruvaakkiyulladhu. Indha eai maadal ulagalavil piravalamaaga ulla aanthravik niruvanathin kilaat matram ovan eai-yil saat jividiyai vida thiranmikkadhu ena moon shaat kooriyulladhu.
Adhinaveena thozhilnutbangal seenaavirku kidaippadharku America pala vazhigalil muttukkattai podum nilaiyil indha pudhiya eai maadal ulagin kavanathai eerthulladhu. Seyarkai nunnarivu enbadhu oru naattin aadhikkam seluthuvadhu sariyaagaadhu endrum adhu ulagalaaviya koottu othuzhaippin piradhivalippaaga irukkavendum endrum China adhivar shi jinbing kooriyulladhu kurippidathakkadhu

headline: Rapid FactCheck: naay pola urumaariya jappaaniya navar endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘200 kodi roobai selavil aruvai sigichai moolamaaga thannai naayaaga maatrik konda Japan navar,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’220 kodi roobai selavil thannai naayaaga maatri konda ilainjan. 26 vayadhaana kodeesvarar ‘jaiso’, thannai oru naayaip pola thotramalikkas seyvadharkaaga sumaar ₹220 kodi selavu seythadhaagak koorappadugiradhu!,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, kurippitta navar aruvai sigichai moolamaaga, naay pondru edhuvum thannai urumaatrik kollavillai endrum, naay pola kaastyoom thayaarithu, anindhugondaar endrum, theriyavandhadhu.
Koogul udhaviyudan thagaval thediyavodhu, idhudhodarbaana vivaram namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil, togo endra jappaaniya ilainjar naay pondru thotramalikkum vagaiyilaana aadaigalai thayaarithullaar endrum, idhuvondra aadaigalai adhiga vilai koduthu vaanguvadhai vazhakkamaagak kondullaar endrum kurippidappattulladhu.
Idhanbadi, kurippitta ilainjar naayaaga urumaarum aruvai sigichai edhuvum seyyavillai enbadhu, thelivaagiradhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
indha navar patri erkanave sila aandugalukku mun idhevondru vadhandhi ondru paraviya soozhalil, naamum idhuvatri aayvu seythu appodhu fektchek veliyittullom.
Enave, ore seythiyai vidha vidhamaana video kaatchigaludan serthu, thodarchiyaaga samooga valaidhalangalil parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Nammoor paaniyai pinbatrugiraar America adhivar tiramp:therdhalil vendraal aalukku roo.5,00,000 arivippu
text:
Vaashingdan:amerikkaavilum, nammoor paaniyai pinbatri, 'varum navambar maadham nadaivera ulla paarliment therdhalil kudiyarasu katchi vendraal, ovvoru kudimaganukkum thalaa, 5,000 taalar adhaavadhu, 5 latcham roobai vazhangappadum' endru, adhivar tonaaldu Trump arivithullaar.
America-vin adhivaraaga kudiyarasu katchiyais serndha Trump, kadandhaandu janavariyil irandaavadhu muraiyaaga padhaviyetraar. Appodhu mudhal kudiyetrak kolgai, visaa nadaimuraigal, pala naadugal meedhu adheedha irakkumadhi vari vidhippadhu ena adhiradi nadavadikkaigalai avar merkondu varugiraar.
 Trump nirvaagathin kolgaigalaal America-vil athiyaavasiya porutkalin vilai uyarndhulladhudan, porulaadhaara nerukkadiyum erpattulladhu. Athudan eeraanudan erpatta por matrum adhanaal naattin erivorul selavugal adhigarithadhu, annaattu makkalidaiye adhirupdhiyaiyum, kadum kovathaiyum erpaduthi ulladhu.
Innilaiyil varum nava., 3m thedhi, piradhinidhigal savai matrum senat savaikkaana paarliment therdhal nadaivera ulladhu .
Adhivarin naangu aatchi kaalathin idaivatta kaalathil nadakkum therdhal enbadhaal, idhai idaikkaala therdhal endrum kooruvar. Indhath therdhal, adhivar meedhu makkalin nambikkaiyai parai saatruvadhaaga amaiyum.
Tharpodhu adhivar Trump meedhaana adhirupdhi miga adhigamaaga ulladhu. Adhanaal, varum paarliment therdhalil tirambin kudiyarasu katchikku periya adhirchiyaana mudivugal velivarum ena, karuthuk kanippugal koorugindrana.
Vazhakkamaaga idhuvondra idaikkaala therdhalinbodhu, adhivargal pirasaaram seyvadhillai. Aanaal, mudhal muraiyaaga tharpodhu pirasaara koottathukku erpaadu seyyappattulladhu.
Adhanbadi, tallaasil netru nadandha kudiyarasuk katchiyin maanaattil pesiya Trump, therdhalil thangal katchi vendraal, ovvoru kudimaganukkum thalaa, 5 latcham roobai vazhangappadum endru arivithullaar.
Aanaal adharku oru nivandhanaiyum avar vidhithu irukkiraar. Trump vazhangum indha panathai velinaadugalukkus sendru selavazhikkak koodaadhu endrum amerikkaavirkul mattume selavazhikka vendum endrum avar kooriyullaar.
Paarlimendin iru savaigalaiyum kudiyarasuk katchi kaippatra vendum endra nokkathil avar indha arivippai veliyittullaar.
Avarudaiya indha arivippukku edhirkkatchigal kadum edhirppu therivithullana. Makkalukkum katchikkum idaiye oru peram pesuvadhu pola indha arivippu ulladhaaga edhirkkatchigal kooriyullana. Therdhal nerathil makkalaik kavara Trump velippadaiyaaga lanjjam koduppadhaagavum kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu.
Idharku munbum, idhuvondru makkalukku panam koduppadhaaga Trump kooriyirundhaar. Velinaadugalil irundhu varum vari varuvaayil, 2,000 taalargalai, adhaavadhu, 2 latcham roovaayai makkalukku vazhanguvadhaaga, kadandhaandu avar kooriyirundhaar. Aanaal, idhu verum arivippodu nindruvittadhu.

headline: Peegaaril “laandhar vilakku thevaiyaa” endru Modi kettavodhu minsaaram thadaivattadhaa?
text:
Movail ponileye taars vilakku vandhuvitta piragu, peegaaril laalu pirasaath yaadhav katchiyin sinnamaana laandhar vilakku ippodhu thevaiyaa endru piradhamar Modi kettavodhu minsaaram thadaippattadhaaga oru video

peegaar sattamandra therdhal pirasaarathil piradhamar Modi pesiya video edit seyyappattu Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peegaarla namma modiji, inga ivvalavu lait velicham irukkumbodhu Lantern ( RJD sinnam ) vilakku edharkunnu kettu mudichadhum karent poyirukku 😂 laitkaarar enga irundhaalum medaikku varavumnu koovittu irukkaanunga” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhalil aikkiya janadhaa thalam – BJP koottani vetbaalargalai aadharithu piradhamar Modi pirasaaram seythaar. Appodhu, koottathirku vandhavargalai movailil ulla taars vilakkai aan seyyas solli, adhan piragu ivvalavu taars velicham ulla nilaiyil raashdiriya janadhaa katchiyin sinnamaana laandhar vilakku ippodhu avasiyamaa endru kelvi ezhuppinaar.
Indha nilaiyil piradhamar Modi laandhar vilakku avasiyamaa endru kettavodhu minsaaram thadaippattadhaaga video-vai palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Mudhalil piradhamar narendhira Modi-yin pirasaarathil minsaaram thadaippattadhaa endru ariya, adhu thodarbaaga seythi edhum veliyaagi ulladhaa endru paarthom. Namakku appadi endha oru seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Modi pesum podhu minsaaram thadaippattadhaaga endha oru veediyovum kidaikkavillai.
Appadi irukka indha video unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvaith thodarndhom. Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Irandu vevveru idangalil Modi pirasaaram seytha kaatchiyai ondru serthu vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Mudhal kaatchi adhaavadhu, movail taars adikkum kaatchiyaanadhu peegaarin samasdhivooril (Samastipur) edukkappattadhu. Irandaavadhu medai vilakkugalai aan seyyumbadi arivippu veliyaagum kaatchi peegaarin pegusaraay (Begusarai) endra idathil nadandha pirasaara koottathil edukkappattadhu. Pegusaraay podhuk koottathin muzhu veediyovaiyum thedik kandeduthup paarthom.
Piradhamar Modi pirasaara medaiyil amarndhirukkiraar. Appodhu amaichar kiriraaj ezhundhu selvadhu therigiradhu. Avar medaiyil ulla podiyathirku sendru nigazhchiyin vilakkugal erpaattaalar medai vilakkugalai aan seyyungal endru koorugiraar. Indha nerathil medaiyil vilakkugal edhuvum anaikkappattadhu pol illai. Video-vin thodakkathil evvalavu velicham irundhadho, adhe alavu velicham amaichar vilakkugalai aan seyyungal endru arivippu seyyum podhum irundhadhu. Minsaaram thadaippadavillai. Appadi thadaippattirundhaal mic, sbeekkarum seyalbadaamal poyirukkum. Indha arivippukkup piragu sila arivippugal seyyappadugiradhu, silar pesugiraargal. Adhan piragu thaan Modi thannudaiya uraiyaith thodangugiraar.
Idhan moolam laandhar vilakku edharku endru Modi kooriya podhu medaiyil min vilakkugal thideerendru anaindhuvittana. Idhanaal enna seyvadhu endru ariyaamal thigaithup poy Modi amarndhuvittaar enbadhu pol paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu, video edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Karooril vivathaith thavirkkave minsaaram thundikkappattadhu endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
Karoor TVK pirasaara koottathil vivathaith thavirkkave minsaaram thundikkappattadhu endru Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga oru padhivu

irandu niyoosgaardugalai vaithu Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Mudhal news card-il, “minsaaram thundikkappadavillai” endru sendhil paalaaji kooriyadhu kurippidappattirundhadhu. Irandaavadhu news card-il, “vivathai thavirkkave minsaaram thundippu. Karooril kootta nerisal erpattavodhu oru pagudhiyinar jenarettar araikkul nuzhaindhanar, thagarakkottagaiyai agatri veliyera muyandranar. Idhan kaaranamaaga asambaavidhathaith thavirkkave minsaaram thundikkappattadhu – mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “minsaaram thundikkappadavillai endru minsaara adhigaari mudhal sendhil paalaaji varai uruttu. Vivathai thavirkkave minsaaram thundippu endru innoru uruttu. Ethanai pithalaattam ?” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Karooril Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam (TVK) nadathiya pirasaara koottathil erpatta nerisalil sikki 41 per uyirizhandhanar. Indha kootta nerisalukku DMK matrum Tamil Nadu arasu thaan kaaranam endru TVK matrum ADMK ullitta edhirkkatchigal koori varugindrana. Koottam nadandhavodhu andha pagudhiyil minsaaram niruthappattadhe nerisal erpadak kaaranam endru oru kaaranathai TVK tharappil kooriyirundhanar.
Aanaal, andha pagudhiyil minsaara vaariyam minsaarathaith thundikkavillai endru aadhaarathudan seythi veliyittadhu. TVK erpaadu seythirundha jenarettar niruthappattadhaal, adhilirundhu petra minsaaram mattume thadaivattadhu enbadhai video moolam minsaara vaariyam vilakkiyadhu. Munnaal amaichar sendhil paalaajiyum minsaaram thundikkappadavillai endru kooriyirundhaar.
Indha nilaiyil indru (akdovar 15, 2025) andru sattapperavaiyil sambavam thodarbaaga pesiya mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin minsaaram niruthappattadhai oppukkondaar enbadhu pondru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Oodagam ondru andha news card-ai veliyittuvittu, edhirppu ezhave agatriyiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Aanaal, andha news card-ai eduthu matravargal vadhandhi parappi varuvadhai kaana mudigiradhu.
Enave, unmaiyil mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin enna pesinaar enbadhai ariya aayvu seythom. Tamil Nadu sattapperavai nigazhvugal YouTube-il neradi olivarappu seyyappadugiradhu. Akdovar 15, 2025 sattapperavai neradi olivarappu nigazhvai paarthom. Video-vin 1:51:42vadhu mani nerathil jenarettar kottagaikkul koottam koodiyadhaip patri Stalin pesugiraar. Appodhu, “koottathil oru pagudhiyinar jenarettar pagudhikkul nuzhaindhu thagarakkottagaiyai agatriyum veliyera muyatsi seythirukkindranar. Idhanaal, minsaaram thaakkuvadhaith thadukka jenarettar aavarettar minsaarathai thundithirukkiraar” endru koorugiraar. Endha idathilum Tamil Nadu minsaara vaariyam andha pagudhiyil minsaarathai niruthiyadhu endru kooravillai.
Unmai ippadi irukka, jenarettar aavarettar minsaarathai thundithirukkiraar endradhai maatri, “vivathai thavirkkave minsaaram thundikkappattadhu” thavaraana seythiyai oodagam veliyittulladhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ayalaga maanavar vivagaaram: ``idho aadhaaram; unga IT Wing moolam thavaraana thagavala parappureenga" - maanavar Bharathidhasan
text:
Ayalaga maanavar Bharathidhasan aadhaarangalai video moolam veliyittirukkiraar.
Annal Ambedkar ayalaga uyargalvi thittathin keezh malesiyaa thesiya palgalaikkazhagathil padikkas sendra Bharathidhasan endra maanavar, kalvi udhavithogai kidaikkaamal thaam migavum siramappaduvadhaaga epral maadham mudhal thodarndhu arasidam korikkai vaithirukkiraar.
Indha vivagaaram tharpodhu perum vivaadhamaagiyirukkiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, samooga needhithurai amaichagam veliyittirundha vilakka arikkaiyil, ``maanavar Bharathidhasan X thalathil kaanoli ondraip padhivuseythu unmaikku maaraana thagavalgalaip padhivu seythullaar. Maanavarukku idhuvaraiyil mudhalaamaandu padippirku roo.36 latcham matrum irandaamaandirku roo.12 latcham aaga motham roo.48 latcham vazhangappattulla nilaiyil, maanavaradhu kaanoliyil kurippittulla karuthukkal mutrilum unmaikkup purambaanadhaagavum, avappeyar erpaduthum nokkathudan ulladhu" enath therivithirundhadhu.
Arasin kutrachaattukku maanavar Bharathidhasan padhilalithirukkiraar. Adhil, ``samooga needhith thuraiyidamirundhu meendum oru arikkai vandhirundhadhu. Adhil, '20-m thedhi anuppiya kattanas seettirku (Bill) neengal innum padhil anuppavillai' endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, naan adharku erkanave padhil anuppivitten. Naan padhil anuppavillai endru kooruvadhu thavaraana thagavalaagum. Naan anuppiya minnanjjal (Email) oruvelai ungalin 'sbem' (Spam) koppuraiyil ulladhaa endru sarivaarkkavum.
Naan aagast 26-m thedhiye adharkaana kattanas seettai anuppivitten. Adharkaana aadhaarathai idho (thiraiyileye) kaattugiren. Aanaal, 'naan anuppave illai' enath thavaraana seythiyai, ungaladhu thagaval thozhilnutbap pirivin (IT Wing) moolam parappi, ennudaiya kanavais sidhaikkireergal.
Melum, 'maanavar thittathaith thavaraagap payanbaduthugiraar' endrum koorugireergal. Samooga needhith thuraikku naan oru panivaana korikkai vaikkindren. Indhath thittathin keezh ethanai per munaivar (Ph.D.) pattam padikkiraargal endra vivarathai arasu veliyittaal nandraaga irukkum ena ninaikkiren.
Enenil, perumbaalaanor mudhugalaip pattame (Master's Degree) padikkiraargal. Mudhugalai enbadhu oraandup padippu mattume. Adharku oraandirkaana kalloorip kattanam matrum vaazhkkais selavugalai (Living Expenses) vazhanginaal podhumaanadhu. Aanaal, aaraaychip padippu (Research) enbadhu appadippattadhu alla. Adharkup payitsik kattanam selutha vendum.
Aaraaychikkuth thevaiyaana uvagaranangal (Equipments) vaanga vendum. Karutharangugalukkus (Conferences) sella vendum. Puthagangal vaangip padikka vendum. 24 mani neramum aaraaychiyaip patri mattume sindhikka vendum.
Silar 'indhiyaavileye padithirukkalaame?' endru kettaargal. India-vil 'jooniyar risars felloship' (JRF) enappadum ilanilai aaraaychi udhavithogai enakkuk kidaithadhu. Aanaal, adhaivida periya vaayppu velinaattil kidaithadhu enbadharkaagavum, ingu padithu mudithaal ai.ai.ti (IIT), ai.ai.es.si (IISc) pondra uyar niruvanangalil peraasiriyaraagalaam endra nambikkaiyilumdhaan ingu vandhu kalviyaith thodargiren.
JRF moolam kidaithirukka vendiya oodhiyathaik kaivittuvittu vandhadhaal, en petrorai migavum kashdappaduthivitten. Endhavidha oodhiyamum illaamal, enadhu muzhu nerathaiyum indha aaraaychikkaagave arppanithu uzhaithuk kondirukkiren.
Aanaal, en meedhu meendum meendum thaninavar thaakkudhal (Personal Attack) thoduppadhu enakku migavum vedhanaiyalikkiradhu. Aam, neengal roo.36 latcham kodutheergal. Naan roo.37 latchathirkaana kattanas seettugalai joon 8-m thedhiye anuppivitten. Adhan piragu neengal ketta vilakkangalaiyum, palgalaikkazhagathin (University) moolamaagave anaithu vivarangaludan anuppi vaithuvitten.
Neengal vazhangiyadhaagak kooruvadhellaam mudhalaandirku vazhangiya panathaip patriyadhu. Tharpodhu neengal koduthadhu 6 maadha kaalathirkaana vaazhkkais selavugalukku mattume. Adhuvum mudindhuvittadhu.
Aaraaychikkuth thevaiyaana sels (Cells), riyejents (Reagents), matrum porutkal (Consumables) vaanguvadharkuk koodudhal nidhi tharumaaru kettirundhen. Aanaal, idhuvarai indhap pirasnaikku mudive varavillai. 'naan kattanas seettu anuppavillai' endra thavaraana parappuraiyai samooga needhith thurai en meedhu meendum meendum sumathugiradhu.
Appadiyendraal, naan kaattum indha aavanangalukkup padhil enna? Joon 8-m thedhi anuppiya aavanangalukkum, sameevathil palgalaikkazhagam anuppiya minnanjjalukkum padhil enna? Neengal meendum vilakkam kettavodhum, adharkaana sariyaana vilakkathaiyum alithuvitten" enak kurippittu, asal aavanangalai video-vil kaanbithaar.

headline: UPI parivarthanaigalukkuk kattanam.. BJP arasukku Congress kadum vimarsanam!
text:
Mathiya arasu 2,000 roovaaykku merpatta kurippitta vaniga yooviai parivarthanaigalukku roo.5 matrum 0.4% varai kattanam, adhigavatcham roo.300 ena nirnayithulladhu. Thaninavar idaiyeyaana parivarthanaigal vilakku perum nilaiyil, indha mudivai Congress kadumaiyaaga edhirthu, naadaalumandra vivaadhamindri sattath thirutham seythu kattanam vasoolikka thodangiyadhaaga kutramsaattugiradhu.
2000 roovaaykku melaana vaniga parivarthanaigalukku kattanam nirnayam seyyappattiruppadhaaga mathiya arasu arivithulladhu. Arivippin padi, “thaninavargalukku idaiyeyaana digital parivarthanaigalukku kattanam kidaiyaadhu. Adhevelaiyil railway, tholaithodarbu sevaigal, kaappeedu, erivorul pondra kurippitta vaniga pirivugalil roo.2,000-kku merpatta UPI parivarthanaikku roo.5 kattanam nirnayam seyyappattulladhu. Mukkiyamaaga roo.2,000-kku merpatta varthaga UPI parivarthanaigalukku 0.4% kattanam vidhikkappadum endrum, oru parivarthanaikkaana adhigavatcha varthaga kattanamaaga roo.300-aaga nirnayam seyyappadum ena arivikkappattulladhu.
Indhasoozhalil yuviai parivarthanaigalukku kattanam nirnayam seyyappattiruppadhagu Congress kadumaiyaaga edhirppu therivithulladhu.
2,000 roovaaykku merpatta yooviai parivarthanaigalukku kattanam vasoolippadharkaana mudharkatta nadavadikkaiyai mathiya arasu thodangiyulladhaagak Congress podhus seyalar jeyraam ramesh kutramsaattiyullaar. 2,000 roobai varaiyilaana UPI parivarthanaigalukku mattume kattana vilakku alithu mathiya nidhi amaichagam pudhiya arivippai veliyittulladhu. Idhu kurithu X thalathil padhivittulla ramesh. Naadaalumandrathil vivaadhamindri niraivetrappatta pudhiya sattath thirutham moolam yooviai parivarthanaigalukkuk kattanam vasoolikkum nadavadikkaiyai mathiya arasu thodangiyulladhaagak kooriyullaar.
Melum, velippadaithanmai indri yooviai payanaaligalin nambikkaiyai arasu udaithulladhaaga ramesh vimarsithullaar, America niruvanangalin digital sandhaikkaaga adhivar tramppai thirupdhippaduthave ithagaiya nadavadikkai edukkappadugiradhaa endrum avar kelvi ezhuppiyullaar.

headline: ‘DMK vetbaalargal vaavas vaangungal’ endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:

idhil ‘’ idaitherdhal vetbaalargal vaavas vaangungal”10 nimidam pesi ennai kolathooril mannai kavva vachuttaan “thaaraavuram matrum madhuraandhagam” vetbaalargal asingappattu thorpadharku vaavas vaanguvadhu nalladhu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. M.K. Stalin padamum idambetrulladhu.

headline: Osooril min vaagana aalai roo.779 kodi mudhaleettil altraavayalat amaikkiradhu
text:
Osooril min vaagana aalai roo.779 kodi mudhaleettil 'altraavayalat' amaikkiradhu
Pudhudilli: minsaara irusakkara vaagana thayaarippu niruvanamaana 'altraavayalat', thamizhagathin osooril 779 kodi roobai mudhaleettil pudhiya urpathi aalaiyai amaikka ulladhaaga arivithulladhu.
Idhugurithu niruvanathin si.i.o., naaraayan supramaniyam koorugaiyil, ''osooril amaiya ulla aalaikkaaga, adutha aindhu aandugalil 779 kodi roobai mudhaleedu seyyappadum. Ingu, mudharkattamaaga aandukku 2.50 latcham vaaganangal urpathi seyya ullom. Adhan pin, thevaiyai poruthu urpathi thiranai aandukku 5 latcham vaaganangalaaga adhigarikkavum kattamaippu vasadhigal seyyappada ullana,'' endraar.
Pengalooril altraavayalat niruvanathukku erkanave oru aalai ulla nilaiyil, ulnaadu matrum sarvadhesa sandhaigalin thevaiyai poorthi seyya osooril pudhiya aalai amaikkappadugiradhu.
Indha aalai virivaakkathin vaayilaaga, Thamizhagathil kittathatta 2,000 perukku pudhiya velaivaayppu uruvaagum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.

headline: TVK: "madhuraandhagathil DMK vendraal TVK aatchi janavari maadhathil kavizhum" - aar.es.paaradhi
text:
Idaitherdhalil DMK saarbil madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil munnaal ezhumboor sattamandra uruppinarum, DMK sattathurai thunais seyalaalarumaana ai.parandhaaman pottiyidugiraar.
Chengalpattu maavattathin madhuraandhagam (thani), Tiruppur maavattathin thaaraavuram (thani) aagiya iru sattamandrath thogudhigalukkum akdovar 6-aam thedhi idaitherdhal nadaiverum enath therdhal aanaiyam arivithirukkiradhu.
ADMK saarbil madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil vetri petrirundha maragadham kumaaravel, thaaraavuram thogudhiyil vetri petrirundha sathiyavaamaa aagiya iruvarum thangal em.el.e padhavigalai raajinaamaa seythuvittu, Vijay thalaimaiyilaana thavega-vil inaindhadhaal ivviru thogudhigalum kaaliyaanadhaaga arivikkappattu, indha idaitherdhal kalam uruvaagi irukkiradhu.
Indha idaitherdhalil DMK saarbil madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil munnaal ezhumboor sattamandra uruppinarum, DMK sattathurai thunais seyalaalarumaana ai.parandhaaman pottiyidugiraar.
Thaaraavuram thogudhiyil DMK vazhakkarinjar matrum magalir aniyais serndha es.suganyaa pottiyidugindranar. Innilaiyil madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil DMK vetri petraal janavari maadham TVK aatchi kavizhum endru DMK amaippus seyalaalar aar.es.paaradhi therivithirukkiraar.
Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil nadaivetra koottathil pesiya DMK amaippu seyalaalar aar.es.paaradhi, "sattasavaikku parandhaaman pola oru aal thevai. Ivar vetri petru em.el.e.vaagas sendraal adutha ainavari maadhathirkul TVK aatchi kavizhum.
Naan yaaraiyum izhivuppaduthiyum, thavaraagavum pesavillai. Tamil Naattin thalaiyezhuthu en munnaal ingu amarndhirukkakkoodiya koottanik katchi thozhargal matrum DMK thondargalin kaiyildhaan ulladhu.
Kalainjar karunaanidhi, mu.ka.staalinai TVK izhivuppaduthip pesiyadhai adutha 21 naatkal manadhil vaithuk kondu paniyaatra vendum.
DMK-vin varalaarai, Tamil Naattin edhirgaalathai nirnayikkum vagaiyil 21 naatkal manadhil vaithu vairaakkiyamaaga velai seythaal parandhaaman vetri peruvadhu urudhi.
Misaavin varalaaru madhuraandhagathildhaan thodangiyadhu. Indraiya sattamandra uruppinargal yaarukkum misaavaip patri theriyaadhu. Duraimurugan, ti.aar.paalu, M.K. Stalin, ennaip pondravargaldhaan misaavin kodoorathai neril paarthavargal" endru pesiyirukkiraar.

headline: Karnaadaga mudhalvar nigazhchiyil paa.ja., – em.el.e., aavesam
text:
Shivamokkaa: karnaadaga mudhalvar sivakkumaar pangetra nigazhchiyil: karnaadagaavin shivamokkaa maavattam theerthahalliyil, merku thodarchi malai sutruchoozhal unardhiran mandalangal kurithu kasdhoori rangan arikkai thodarbaaga, podhumakkaludan kalandhuraiyaadal koottam netru nadandhadhu.
Idhil Congress katchiyai serndha mudhalvar sivagumaar, paa.ja., – Congress thalaivargal pangetranar. Nigazhchi thuvanguvadharku mun, maanila keedham isaikkappattadhu. Adhan pin, vandhe maadharam irandu pathigal mattume paadappattadhu.
Ippaadal mudindhadhum, medaiyil irundha paa.ja., – em.el.e., sannavasappaa, mic arugil vandhu, ‘‘mudhalvaridam oru korikkai vaikka virumbugiren. Avar, pala nalla panigalai seythu varugiraar. Aanaal engal unarvugalai punbadutha, arasu muyatsikkumbodhu adhu engalukku vedhanai alikkiradhu.
‘‘vandhe maadharam irandu pathigal mattum paada vendum endra ungal mudivu, maanila makkal meedhu thaakkathai erpaduthugiradhu. Vandhe maadharam muzhu paadalum paada vendum enbadhe en korikkai. Thayavu seythu, vandhe maadharathai muzhumaiyaaga paada vaayppu kodungal,’’ endraar.
Ivar pesik kondirukkumbodhu kaangirasai serndhavargal avarukku edhiraaga kural ezhuppinar. Medaiyil irundha silarum, avarai soozhndhu, edhirppu therivithanar.
Appodhu, sannavasappaavin mudhugil thatti kodutha mudhalvar sivakkumaar, avarai amara sonnaar. Idhaiyaduthu, salasalappu adangiyadhu.

headline: Verum otraik kolaarudhaan.. Rathaana 1000 vimaanangal.. Sdhambitha ingilaandhu!
text:
Ingilaandhil vaanvazhip pokkuvarathil erpatta oru sikkal kaaranamaaga orunaalil mattum kittathatta aayirakkanakkaana vimaanangalin sevai rathu seyyappattulladhu. Indhas sikkal innum sila naatkalukku thodarum enbadhaal naattin vaanvazhip pokkuvarathu sdhambithulladhu. Enna nadakkiradhu enbadhai virivaaga paarkkalaam...
Ingilaandhin vaanvazhip pokkuvarathu kattuppaattu niruvanamaagas seyalbattu varugiradhu NATS. Naattin anaithu vaanvazhip pokkuvarathaiyum kattuppaduthak koodiya indha niruvanathin flight data processing system-l kandariyappadaadha oru kolaaru erpattulladhu. Idhanaal, naattil ulla anaithu vimaana nilaiyangalilum vimaanangalin purappaadu paadhikkappattadhu. Naattin paravarappaana vimaana nilaiyangalil vimaanangal purappadaadhadhaal, velinaadugal matrum ulnaattin sila pagudhigalil irundhu purappattu payanithu vandha pala vimaanangal tharaiyiranguvadhil sikkal erpattadhu.
Naattin paravarappaana vimaana nilaiyangalil ondraana heethroo vimaana nilaiyathil netru madhiyam varai evvidha paadhippugalum indri vimaanangal iyangivandhadhaaga therigiradhu. Aanaal, madhiyathukkup pin vimaanangalin purappaattil sikkal ezhundha nilaiyil, tharaiyiranga vendiya 13 vimaanangal veru vimaana nilaiyangalukku thiruppividappattadhaagath therigiradhu. Idhevolathaan ketvik, maansestar matrum permingam ullitta mukkiya vimaana nilaiyangalilum sevai paadhikkappattadhu. Vimaanangal edhum purappadaadhadhaal nilaiyangalil aangaange vimaanangal niruthappattirundhadhaagavum, sila vimaanangal odudhalathil niruthappattadhaagavum sollappadugiradhu.
Idhanaal andai naadugalaana ayarlaandhu, sgaatlaandhil irundhu landan vara irundha vimaanangalin sevaigalum paadhikkappattadhaagath therigiradhu. Thangal niruvanathil puk seythirundha 65,000 payanigal 8 mani nerathukkum melaaga kaakka vaikkappattadhaaga rayan er endra niruvanam solliyirukkiradhu. Idhuvol pala niruvanangal thangal payanigalai pala mani neram kaakka vaithullana. Vimaanam thaamadhamaavadhu kurithu vimaana nilaiyap paniyaalargalidam kelvi ezhuppiya payanigalidam, sambandhappatta vimaana niruvanathaith thodarbu kollumaaru therivikkappattadhaal payanigal thavithup poyinar.
Naangal nambiyadhaivida pirasnaiyais sariseyya adhiga kaalam edukkum enakkoori mannippu koriyulladhu NATS niruvanam. Pirasnai adaiyaalam kaanappattu theerppadharkaana nadaimurai thodangiyadhaa enbadhu kurithu sarivara theriyaamal irukkum nilaiyil, payanigal thangalin vimaanam kuritha appodhaiya apdetkalai therindhugondavin veettilirundhu purappada vendum enavum, erkenave thangal aluvalagangal pisiyaaga iyangivaruvadhaal thangalai thodarbugolla vendaam enavum kaiyai virithirukkindrana vimaana niruvanangal.

headline: Tamil Naattin adutha mudhalvarukkaana pandhayathil anbumani raamadhaas endra seythi unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’Tamil Naattin adutha mudhalvarukkaana pandhayathil 36% aadharavudan anbumani raamadhaas,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ adutha mudhalvarukkaana pandhayam- 2vadhu idathil DMK
Tamil Naattin adutha mudhalvarukkaana pandhayathil 36% aadharavudan maruthuvar anbumani raamadhaas avargal.
18% peril aadharavaip petru TVK thalaivar Vijay 3vadhu idam pidithullaar; edhirkkatchith thalaivar Edappadi Palaniswami 10% aadharavudan 5vadhu idam; BJP maanilath thalaivar Annamalai 9% aadharavudan 5vadhu idathil ullaar – si-vottar nadathiya karuthukkanippil thagaval,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Pudhiya thalaimurai logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu oru edit seyyappatta niyoosgaardu endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, pudhiya thalaimurai veliyitta niyoosgaardil, Tamil Naattin adutha mudhalvarukkaana pandhayathil 27% aadharavudan mudhalvar M.K. Stalin mudhalidam, endre kurippidappattulladhu. Idhil, anbumani peyar endha idathilum kaanavillai.
Unmaiyaana niyoosgaardaiyum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news kaardaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
