headline: Adhiga uppu, sarkkarai kurithu unavu paakkettil thagaval thevai: ucha needhimandrathil unavu paadhugaappu aanaiyam vilakkam
text:
Pudhudilli: pekking seyyappatta unavu porutkalin munbakkathil adhiga uppu, adhiga sarkkarai, adhiga kozhuppu endra echarikkai vivarangalai veliyida, unavu paadhugaappu matrum thara nirnaya aanaiyamaana ep.es.es.e.ai., mudivu seythulladhu. Unavu porutkal kurithu ucha needhimandrathil nadaivetru varum vazhakku ondril, indha mudivai adhu munmozhindhulladhu.
Idhu kurithu ep.es.es.e.ai., tharappil therivithulladhaavadhu: niruvanangal thayaarikkum unavu porul paakkettin munbakkathil, mel idadhuvurathil sivappu nira arugona vadivil, vellai sadhura pinnaniyudan echarikkai idamberum. Unavu porulil adhiga alavil ulla oottachathukkalin peyargal adhil kurippidappadum. Adhiga kozhuppu, adhiga uppu, adhiga sarkkarai ena, nugarvor elidhil ariyum vagaiyil echarikkai irukkum.
Melum, kalori illaadha inippoottigal payanbaduthappadum paanangalil, adhuguritha thagavalum paakkettin munburathil thaniyaaga kurippidappadum.
Adutha aandu joolai 1m thedhikkul indha pudhiya vidhimuraigal arivippu veliyidappadum. Unavu niruvanangalukku arivikkappatta pin, oraandu kaala avagaasam vazhangappadum. Adharkul paakkettin mel achidum muraikku niruvanangal maarum. Idhai naadu muzhudhum ore kattathil amalbadutha mudivu seyyappattulladhu. Ivvaaru therivithulladhu.

headline: Madappuram ajithgumaar kolai vazhakku: ti.es.pi., utbada 4 per siraiyil adaippu
text:
Madurai: sivagangai maavattam, madappuram pathragaaliyamman kovil kaavalaali ajithgumaar kolai vazhakkil, ti.es.pi., ullitta naangu poleesaarai kaavalil vaikka, Madurai Needhimandram utharavittadhu.
Indha kovilukku vandha peraasiriyai nigidhaa kaarilirundha nagai thiruduvonadhaaga thiruppuvanam poleesil pugaar seythaar. Idhu thodarbaaga, ajithgumaarai, 2025 joon 27l thanippadai Police thaakkiyadhil avar irandhaar. Si.pi.ai.,visaarikkiradhu.
Poleesgaarargal raajaa, aananth, sangaramanigandan, piravu, kannan, Police ven tiraivar raamachandhiran kaidhaagi, Madurai mathiya siraiyil ullanar. Maanaamadhurai ti.es.pi., sanmugasundharam, thiruppuvanam insbekdar rameshgumaar, sirappu es.ai., sivakkumaar, ettu ilaiyaraajaa koodudhal edhirigalaaga CBI, thaakkal seytha kutrappathirigaiyil serkkappattanar.
Madurai 5vadhu koodudhal amarvu needhimandrathil, needhivadhi ke. Thaamodharan netru visaarithaar. Raajaa ullitta 10 perum aajaraaginar. Avargal meedhu kolai ullitta palveru pirivugalin keezh kutrachaattugal padhivu seyyappattana.
CBI, tharappu vazhakkarinjar vijayan vaadham: sanmugasundharam sasbent seyyappattullaar. Rameshgumaar tharpodhu maanaamadhurai insbekdar. Sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa sivagangai tavun poleesil panivurigindranar.
Sanmugasundharam ullitta naangu peraiyum kaavalil edukkaamal niyaayamaana, sudhandhiramaana visaaranaiyai urudhi seyya mudiyaadhu. Vazhakku mudivadaiyum varai avargalai needhimandra kaavalil vaikka vendum. Illaiyenil avargal saatchigalai kalaikkakkoodum. Aadhaarangalai azhikka vaayppulladhu. Ivvaaru vaadhittaar.
Kutrachaattu
needhivadhi pirappitha utharavu: sanmugasundharam, thanippadaiyai sattavirodhamaaga amaithullaar. Avargal, ajithgumaarai sattavirodhamaaga kaavalil eduppadharku rameshgumaar, sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa udhavi seythullanar.
Ajithgumaar irandha pin, avar Police kaavalil irundhu thappis sella muyandravodhu kaayamadaindhadhil irandhadhaagakkoori, poy pugaarai kannan alithadhaaga, CBI, tharappu kutram saattiyulladhu. Kolaiyai maraikkum nokkil poy vazhakku padhivu seythadhaaga, rameshgumaar meedhu kutrachaattu ulladhu.
Sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa, thiruppuvanam poleesil podhu naatkurippu padhivugalai thiruthiyadhaagavum, nigidhaa pugaaril, sivagumaar mun thedhiyittu si.es.aar., padhivai poliyaaga uruvaakkiyadhaaga kutram saattappattulladhu.
Sanmugasundharam ullitta naangu perum kutram nadandhadhai maraikkum nokkil, erkanave aavanangalil poy padhivugalai uruvaakka muyandrullanar.
Ajithgumaar petroridam, ulloor arasiyal katchiyai serndhavargal udhaviyudan ti.es.pi., samarasam erpadutha muyandradhaaga CBI, kutram saattiyulladhu.
Thangal movail pongalil aadhaarangalai, 10 perum azhithuvittadhaaga kutrachaattu ulladhu. Sanmugasundharam, rameshgumaar, sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaa saarbil idhuvarai jaamin manu thaakkal seyyappadavillai. Ivargal veliye irundhaal saatchigal meedhu selvaakku seluthavum, aadhaarangalai seergulaikkavum vaayppulladhu.
Sanmugasundharam, rameshgumaar, sivagumaar, ilaiyaraajaavai sep., 16 varai needhimandra kaavalil vaikka vendum. Ivvaaru utharavittaar. Anaivarum Madurai mathiya siraiyil adaikkappattanar.

headline: Vakp sattathirku edhiraaga poraattathil eeduvattaaraa piriyangaa kaandhi?
text:
Vakp sattathirku edhiraaga poraattathil eeduvatta piriyangaa kaandhi endru oru video

piriyangaa kaandhi poraattathil eeduvatta video Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “vakp poraattathil sinna ( indhiraa kaandhi ) piriyangaa kaandhi avargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vakp thirutha masodhaa naadaalumandrathil epral mudhal vaarathil kadum edhirppugalukku idaiye indha sattam niraivetrappattadhu. Idhai edhirthu islaamiyargal matrum edhirkkatchigal poraattangalai nadathi varugindranar. Congress katchiyin podhus seyalaalarum naadaalumandra uruppinarumaana piriyangaa kaandhi poraattathil eeduvattaar endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha video-vai idharku munbe paartha ninaivu irundhadhaal indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, 2022m aandil indha video-vai Congress katchith thalaivargal, munnani oodagangal veliyittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. ANI, taims aap India veliyittirundha X thala padhivil Congress katchiyin thalaimai aluvalagathirku veliye poraattathil eeduvatta piriyangaa kaandhi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil koogulil thediya podhu, vilaivaasi uyarvu, velaiyinmai ullitta pirasnaigalukkaaga indha poraattam nadathappattadhaaga adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Vakp thirutha sattamaanadhu mudhalil 2024m aandildhaan thaakkal seyyappattadhu. Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovo 2022m aandu aagastil edukkappattulladhu. 2024l konduvarappatta sattathirku 2022l poraattam nadathiyirukka vaayppillai.
Vilaivaasi uyarvu ullitta kaaranangalukkaaga piriyangaa kaandhi nadathiya poraattathin video-vai eduthu vakp sattathirku edhiraaga piriyangaa kaandhi poraadinaar endru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline:
Therdhal kalathil panamazhai..
BJP kanakkil kuvindha roo.1,473 kodi Thamizhagathil mattum ivvalavu selavaa?
text:
Therdhal kalathil panamazhai.. BJP kanakkil kuvindha roo.1,473 kodi Thamizhagathil mattum ivvalavu selavaa?
Kadandha maars mudhal me maadham varai asaam, keralaa, Tamil Nadu, merku vangam matrum pudhucheri aagiya maanilangalil sattamandrath therdhalgal nadaivetrana. Innilaiyil, therdhal kaalangalil arasiyal katchigalukkuk kidaitha varuvaay matrum therdhalukkaaga arasiyal katchigal seytha selavu kuritha vivarangalai therdhal aanaiyam veliyittulladhu. Adhanbadi, therdhal kaalathil mattum BJP thalaimaikku roo.1,472.8 kodi varuvaay kidaithulladhaagavum, Congress katchikku roo.207.17 kodi varuvaay kidaithulladhaagavum therdhal aanaiyathidam thaakkal seyyappatta arikkaigalil therivikkappattulladhu. Therdhal kaalathin thodakkathil, maars 15 andru BJP thalaimaiyagathin iruppu roo.6,722.6 kodiyaaga irundha nilaiyil, me 6 andru adhu roo.7,627.2 kodiyaaga uyarndhulladhu. Idhanmoolam therdhal kaalathil mattum roo.904.6 kodi alavukku iruppu adhigarithulladhu theriyavandhulladhu.
Idharkidaiye, Congress katchi therdhal kaalathil roo.248.55 kodi selavu seythulladhaaga arikkai thaakkal seythulladhu. Asaam, Tamil Nadu matrum pudhucheri therdhalgalukkaaga BJP sumaar roo.159.7 kodi selavu seythulladhu. Idhil, Tamil Naattil mattum BJP roo.51.56 kodi selavittulladhu. Podhup pirasaarathirkaaga roo.44.51 kodiyum, vetbaalargalukkaaga roo.7.05 kodiyum selavidappattulladhu. Melum, oodaga vilambarangalukkaaga sumaar roo.23.96 kodiyum, natchathirap pirasaaragargalin payanas selavukkaaga sumaar roo.10.04 kodiyum selavidappattulladhu. Vilambarap porutkalukkaaga melum sumaar roo.5.85 kodi selavidappattulladhu. Idharkidaiye, keralaa matrum merkuvangath therdhalgalukkaana BJP-yin selavina arikkaigal innum veliyidappadavillai. Therdhal kaalathil Congress katchikku kidaitha varuvaayaivida, BJP thalaimaiyagathukku kidaitha thogai ezhu madangukkum adhigamaaga iruppadhu palaradhu kavanathaiyum eerthulladhu.

headline: "roo.1 latcham mudhaleettikku roo.8000 maadha vatti"- roo.300 kodiyais suruttiya Madurai senbaga paandiyan kaidhu
text:
"makkalin peraasaiyai mattume mudhaleedaagak kondu indha megaa mosadiyil eeduvattirukkiraargal. Salem mattumindri tharmavuri, Krishnagiri ullitta pala maavattangalais serndha palarum emaandhirukkiraargal" - porulaadhaara kutrappirivu kaavaldhurai.
Salem maavattam rettivattiyais serndhavargal vijayaraagavan- raagini thambadhi matrum madhuraiyais serndha senbaga paandiyan aagiya moovarum serndhu piraafit evar tiredars engira peyaril nidhi niruvanam ondrai 2024-m aandu thodangiyirukkiraargal.
Thangalin nidhi niruvanathil oru latcham roobai mudhaleedu seyyum pangudhaarargalukku ovvoru maadhamum thavaraamal 8 aayiram roobai vatti thogai vazhangappadum. Melum adhiga mudhaleettirku erpa palveru salugaigal vazhangappadum enak kavarchigara thittangalai makkalidam therivithirukkiraargal.
Idhanai unmaiyena nambiya naduthara makkal palarum thangalin semippu thogaiyai indha niruvanathil mudhaleedu seythirukkiraargal. Aarambathil silarukku vattith thogaiyai niruvanam moolam vazhangiyirukkiraargal.
Idhanaal kavarappatta makkal latchakkanakkil mudhaleedu seythirukkiraargal. Pala maadhangal aagiyum yaarukkum vatti thogai vazhangappadaadha kaaranathaal sandhegamadaindha makkal, porulaadhaara kutrappirivu poleesil pugaar alithirukkiraargal.
Idhu kurithu theevira visaaranai merkonda kaavaldhuraiyinar, sammandhappatta nidhi niruvanathais serndhavargal kavarchiyaana thittangalai arivithu aayirakkanakkaanavargalidam 300 kodi roovaaykkum mel petru mosadiyil eeduvattiruppadhaik kandarindhullanar.
Thalaimaraivaaga irundha moondru peraiyum thedi vandha nilaiyil, nidhi niruvana iyakkunaraana madhuraiyais serndha senbaga paandiyan enbavarai kaavaldhuraiyinar kaidhu seythullanar. Thalaimaraivaaga ulla Salem thambiyaith theeviramaagath thedi varugindranar.
Idhu kurithu therivitha Salem porulaadhaara kutrappirivu kaavaldhuraiyinar, "makkalin peraasaiyai mattume mudhaleedaagak kondu indha megaa mosadiyil eeduvattirukkiraargal. Salem mattumindri tharmavuri, Krishnagiri ullitta pala maavattangalais serndha palarum emaandhirukkiraargal.
Idhil kodumai ennavendraal palarum thangalin veedugalai adamaanam vaithu mudhaleedu seythirukkiraargal. Irandu maadham mattume vatti koduthirukkiraargal. Moondraayiram kodi roovaayaith thaandum" endranar.

headline: Nakkeeran kovaalukku roo.35 latcham kodutha jem veeramani endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Jem kiraanait veeramaniyin vangik kanakkilirundhu nakkeeran kovaalukku roo.35 latcham seluthappattulladhu endru oru news card

san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “jem kirainait veeramaniyin vangik kanakkilirundhu nakkeeran kovaal avargalukku ₹35 latcham panam parivarthanai!!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Paaliyal kutrachaattil pokso vazhakkin keezh piravala thozhiladhivar jem veeramani kaidhu seyyappattullaar. Avarukku thi.mu.ka-vinarudan thodarbu endru samooga oodagangalil pala vadhandhigal parappappattu varugindrana. Andha vagaiyil, nakkeeran kovaalukku roo.35 latcham kodukkappattadhaaga san news tholaikkaatchiye seythi veliyittadhu pondru news card samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu.
News kaardin thamizh faant vazhakkamaaga san news veliyidum news card-il ulladhu pola illai. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhu endru therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom. Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai sepdambar 22m thedhi san news veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathai paarvaiyittom. Adhil appadi endha oru news kaardum illai. Aanaal, idhe pondru aanaal jem veeramaniyin pugaippadathudan munnaal amaichar raguvadhi pugaippadathudan news card ondrai veliyittirundhadhu namakku kidaithadhu.
Adhai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthup pagirndhiruppadhu therindhadhu. Idhai urudhi seythugolla aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-ai san news digital poruppaalarukku anuppivaithom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangalin adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

Enga kudumbathula motham anjju peru. Naanu, ennoda manaivi, oru ponnu, oru paiyan. Ponnukkuk kalyaanamaagi, engaloda marumaganum ippo enga koodadhaan irukkaaru.
Kothadimai murai enbadhu edho oru kaalathil irundhadhu enap palarum ninaikkum idhe samoogathil, indrum palar kothadimaigalaagas sirai vaikkap pattullanar enbadhe unmai. Adhu, peravalamumgooda. Adhilum, vaangiya kadanukkaaga, maruthuvamanaikkus sella mudiyaadha soozhalil siraivaikkappattirundha karppini pirasavavali vandhu, paridhaavamaaga, aniyaayamaaga uyirizhandhirukkum seythi, arasu nirvaagathin mugathil araigiradhu. Nam nenjjil kanakkiradhu.
Kaanjjivuram maavattathil velaikkaagath thangiyirundha pazhangudiyinath thambadhiyaana thenmozhi, aanandhanukku nerndha indhath thuyaram, maanilathaiye ulukkiyulladhu.
Aarumugam enbavaridam 20,000 roobai munbanam petru, viragu vettum velai seythu vandha aanandhan - thenmozhi thambadhi, velai nadaiverum vellai kettileye thaarppaay kottagai amaithuth thangavaikkappattirundhadhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Thaarppaay kottagaiyil pirindha uyirgal!
Sepdambar 8-m thedhi madhiyam, thaarppaay kottagaikkul pirasava valiyil thudithuk kondirundha thenmozhiyin pirasavam 20,000 roobai kadanukkaaga niruthi vaikkappattadhu kodumai. Pirasava vali adhigaritha nilaiyil, avarai maruthuva manaikkuk kondu sella vazhiyillaamal, udhavikkaaga mudhalaaliyaith thodarbugolla muyandrirukkiraar aanandhan. Aanaal, azhaippugal edukkappadavillai.
Sila mani nerathil, andhath thaarppaay kottagai yileye thenmozhiyum avaradhu vayitril irundha kuzhandhaiyum uyirizhandhirukkiraargal.
Thenmozhikku uriya nerathil maruthuva udhavi kidaikkaamal uyirizhappu erpattulladhu. Indhas sambavathil, than mudhalaali aarumugam maruthuvamanaikku anuppaamal velai vaangiyadhaaga aanandhan kaaval nilaiyathil pugaar alithullaar. Kalangiya kangaludanum kuzhariya kuraludanum nammidam pesinaar aanandhan.
`aaru maasamaa velaivaarkkurom!’
“enga kudumbathula motham anjju peru. Naanu, ennoda manaivi, oru ponnu, oru paiyan. Ponnukkuk kalyaanamaagi, engaloda marumaganum ippo enga koodadhaan irukkaaru. Naanga ellaarum kooli velaikkuthaan povom. Maram vetturadhudhaan engalukkuth therinjja thozhil. Adhukkaaga, aarumugamnu oru mudhalaalikitta velai paarthuttu irundhom.
Sondha ooraivittuttu mudhalaali kooppidura ellaa idathukkum povom. Raathirinu paarkkaama, pagalnu paarkkaama uzhaippom. Aaru maasathukku munnaadi, mudhalaali aarumugathukkitta naan 20,000 roobai panam vaangiyirundhen. Adhukkaaga, vellai kettungira idathula aarumugame thaarppaay kottagai pottu, angeye thangi velaivaarkkas sonnaaru. Angadhaan aaru maasamaa kudumbamaa thangi velai paarthuttu irukkom. Anga kudivandhadhukku appuramdhaan, ennoda pondaatti thenmozhi maasamaa irukkiradhaa therinjjadhu.
Aarumugam adhigamaa velai vaanguvaaru. Adhukku etha kooli tharave maattaaru. Oru naal appadithaan, ‘kaasu venum... Kuzhambukkukkooda edhuvum illa’nu avarkitta poy ninnen. Mudhuguleye adichittaaru. Edhirthup pesinaa, kelvi kettaa pozhappup poyirumenu poruthukkittu thirumbivandhutten” endravar, sambavam nadandha thinam patri thodarndhaar.
`anjju thadavai pon panniyum edukkala!’
“ennoda pondaattikku appappo vayiruvali varum. `aasbathirikkup poganum, leevu venum’nu kettaalum mudhalaali aarumugam thara maattaaru. Appadithaan, pona pudhangizhamai (sepdambar 9) annikkum avalukku udambukku sariyilla. Aanaalum velaikkuk kilambinom. Appo, ‘maamaa, vayiru romba valikkudhu’nu thenmozhi sonnaa. Naan, verum velakkenneyai mattum vayithula thadavi, ’sariyaagirum’nu solli vittuttu velaikkup poyitten. Thirumba madhiya saappaattukkaaga veettukkup ponappo, thenmozhi pechu, moochu illaama keezha kidandhaa.
Naan mudhalaali aarumugathukku anjju thadavai pon panninen. Avaru edukkave illa. Konjja neram kazhichu avaru thirumbap panninaaru. Thenmozhiyoda nelamaiyais sonnen. Aambulans vandiyaik koottittu vandhaaru. Aanaa, usuru poyiruchunu aambulansla vandhavanga sollittaanga. Appo mudhalaali aarumugam, ‘vidudaa... Iva ponaa enna? Onga oorlaye paarthu vera ponnaik kattikko’nu sollittu, 2,000 roobai koduthuttup ponavarudhaan. Ippo varaikkum avarai kaanom. Vali vandhappove en then mozhiyai aasbathirikkuk koottittup poyirundhaa, ippo engooda en pondaattiyum, pullaiyum irundhirup paanga’’ endru koori azhudha aanandhanukku aarudhal koorinom.
`pazhangudigaloda urimaiyai, arasu parikkudhu!’
idhu kurithu andhap pagudhiyais serndha samooga aarvalar anburaajidam pesinom.
“indhap pazhangudi makkalukkuth thangaludaiya vaazhvaadhaarathaith thaangale uruvaakkikkira urimai kidaikkanum. Aanaa, avanga kaattukkulla poy thangalukkuth thevaiyaanadhais segarichu vaazhakkooda avangalukku inga pala thadaigal irukku. Kaattukkulla poradhukkaana urimaiyaikkooda indha arasu avangalukkuk kodukkala.
Andha oru urimai mattum avangalukku irundhirundhaa, avanga thangalukkuth therinjja vaazhkkai muraiyila vaazhndhiruppaanga. Ippadi velai thedippoy, innorutharkitta munbanam vaangittu, avanga solra idathula thangi velai seyya vendiya nilai vandhirukkaadhu. Rendu uyirgalum poyirukkaadhu.
Adhanaala, indhas sambavathula yaar mela nadavadikkai edukkanum enbadhoda mattum ninnudaama, pazhangudi makkal en ippadiyaana soozhalukkuth thallappaduraanganu arasu visaaranai nadathanum. Avangalukkaana vaazhvaadhaaram, maruthuva vasadhi, paadhugaappu, urimainu ellaathaiyum urudhi seyyanum. Appodhaan, idhuvondra kadan kodumaigal, kothadimai kodumaigal, uyirizhappugalai ellaam thadukka mudiyum” endru valiyuruthinaar anburaaj.
Eliya makkalin urimaiyum uyirgalum arasukkup poruttaagumaa?
******
moondru aandugal siraithandanai!
India-vil kothadimaith thozhilaalar murai (ozhippu) sattam, 1976 pipravari 9, 1976 andru amalukku vandhadhu. Idhanbadi, kothadimaikkaagap perappatta anaithu kadangalum, vattiyum sattappadi rathu seyyappadum. Kothadimaigalaaga ullavargal udanadiyaaga viduvikkappaduvaargal; avargal meedhaana pinai pathirangal/oppandhangal sellaadhu. Meetkappatta thozhilaalargalukku mathiya, maanila arasugal maruvaazhvu vazhangum. Oruvarai kothadimai thozhilais seyya varpuruthuvavargalukkum, kadanai munneduthus selbavargalukkum adhigavatcham 3 aandugal varai siraithandanaiyum, roo.2,000 varai avaraadhamum vidhikkappadum.

headline: Vijayalatchumikku veedu vazhangappadum endru Seeman koorinaaraa?
text:
Naam thamizhar katchi aatchikku vandhavudan vijayalatchumikku veedu kodukkappadum endru Seeman kooriyadhaaga oru news card

Seeman pugaippadathudan thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “vijayalatchumikku veedu. Naam thamizhar katchi aatchikku vandhavudan ennaal paadhikkappatta vijayalatchumikku thani veedu ondrai nashda eedaaga koduppen – seemaan” enaru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naam thamizhar katchiyin thalaimai orunginaippaalarukkum nadigai vijayalatchumikkum idaiyeyaana pirasnai pala aandugalaaga thodarndhugondu irukkiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, naangal aatchikku vandhavudan vijayalatchumikku thani veedu vazhangappadum endru Seeman therdhal vaakkurudhi alithadhu pondru news card ondrai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Seemaanai vimarsikkum vagaiyil indha news card poliyaaga uruvaakkappattiruppadhu adhil ulla thagavalai vaithe nammaal arindhugolla mudigiradhu. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil ippadi oru news card-ai thandhi TV veliyittadhaa endru ariya thandhi tiviyin Facebook pakkathai paarvaiyittom. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra news card ondrai thandhi TV veliyittiruppadhu therindhadhu. Aanaal adhil vijayalatchumikku veedu koduppom endrellaam illai. Adhil, “nirka vaithu suduven. Paaliyal kutrangal seybavargalai nirka vaithu suduven” endru Seeman kooriyadhaaga irundhadhu. Indha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraana thagaval serthup pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Idhai urudhi seythugolla, thandhi tivi-yin digital poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppi idhu unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avarum “idhu poliyaanadhu, thandhi TV idhai veliyidavillai” endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Palladam arasu maruthuvamanaiyil aavin paalagam amaikkappadumaa?
text:
Palladam: 'palladam arasu maruthuvamanai valaagathil aavin paalagam amaikka vendum' endra edhirbaarppu podhumakkalidaiye ezhundhulladhu.
Palladam, Kovai -- Trichy thesiya nedunjjaalaiyil arasu maruthuvamanai seyalbattu varugiradhu. Ingu thinamum 700-kkum merpatta puranoyaaligal vandhu selgindranar. Vivathu matrum avasara sigichai, pengal, karppinigal matrum kuzhandhaigalukkaana sigichai, sithaa ullitta palveru sigichaip pirivugal seyalbattu varuvadhaal, idhu vattaarathin thalaimai maruthuvamanaiyaaga ulladhu.
Maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappadum noyaaligal, karppinigal, thaaymaargal matrum kuzhandhaigalukku paal, piret, pisgat ullitta porutkal thevaippadugindrana. Ivatrai vaanga maruthuvamanai valaagathai vittu thesiya nedunjjaalaiyai kadandhu sella vendiya nilai ulladhu.
Maruthuvamanai valaagathileye aavin paalagam amaikkappattaal, noyaaligalukku thevaiyaana porutkalai podhumakkal elidhil vaangip payanadaiya mudiyum. Melum, noyaaligaludan varum uravinargal matrum nanbargalum aavin paalagathai payanbadutha vaayppulladhu. Idhanaal aavin porutkalin virpanai adhigarippadhudan, noyaaligal matrum podhumakkalukku tharamaana unavup porutkal kidaikkavum vaayppu erpadum.
Enave, aavin nirvaagam idhugurithu aayvu merkondu, palladam arasu maruthuvamanai valaagathil aavin paalagam amaikka nadavadikkai edukka vendum enbadhu podhumakkalin edhirbaarppaaga ulladhu.

headline: Metro | thayaar nilaiyil poondhamalli - vadavazhani vazhithadam.. Edhirbaarkkum payanigal.. Thirappu eppodhu?
text:
Seythiyaalar: thurgaa thevi sa
poondhamalli - vadavazhani metro vazhithadathil kattumaanap panigal niraivadaindhu, paadhugaappu anumadhi kidaithum, thirappu vizhaavukku piradhamarin aluvalagathilirundhu (PMO) urudhippaduthappatta thedhi varaadhadhaal pala maadhangalaaga payanigal payanbaattukku innum thirakkappadaamal irukkiradhu.
Chennai metro rail thittathin 2-aam kattathil ulla mudhal vazhithadam Chennai makkalin perum edhirbaarppaaga ulladhu. Idhu poondhamalli puravazhichaalai mudhal vadavazhani varaiyilaana 14.64 km vazhithadamaaga payanigalin sevaikku thayaar nilaiyil ulladhu. Indha vazhithadathil motham 11 uyarmatta nilaiyangal ullana.
Kadandha pipravari maadham railway paadhugaappu aanaiyaridamirundhu vaniga reedhiyilaana seyarpaattirku nivandhanaiyudan koodiya tharkaaliga anumadhi kidaithadhu. Adhanbiragu, railway paadhugaappu aanaiyar vidhitha nivandhanaigalai Chennai metro rail niruvanam niraivetriyadhu. Pin, me maadhathil, sila thalarvugaludan irudhi anumadhiyum kidaithadhu.
Piradhamarin thedhi kidaikkaadhadhu en?
Chennai metro rail thittathin 2-aam katta mudhal vazhithadathirku irudhi anumadhi kidaithadhum, indha vazhithadathai piradhamar narendhira Modi neradiyaaga thirandhu vaikka, CMRL piramaandamaaga nigazhchiyai nadathath thittamittadhu. Aanaal, tharpodhu sepdambar 21 varai endha adhigaaravoorva oppudhalum piradhamar aluvalagathilirundhu innum varavillai ena Chennai metro rail aluvalaga vattaarangalil koorappadugiradhu.
Sepdambar irudhiyil thirappu vizhaa nadaiverum endra nilaiyil, sepdambar 21 thaandiyum piradhamarin thedhi urudhi seyyappadaadha nilaiyil irukkiradhu. Akdovar mudhal vaarathil thirappu vizhaa nadaivera vaayppulladhaagavum, piradhamar sennaikku varugai tharum podhu, metro rail thirappu vizhaavaiyum, matra nigazhchigalaiyum inaithu nadatha vaayppulladhaagavum adhigaari oruvar thaniyaar naalidhazhukku alitha pettiyil therivithirundhaar. Aanaal piradhamarin aluvalagathilirundhu thirappu vizhaa thedhi innum adhigaaravoorvamaaga veliyaagavillai.
Chennai metro rayilin 2-aam kattathil 3 vazhithadangal amaikkappattu varugindrana. Ivatrin motha neelam 118.9 km aagum. Poondhamalli - vadavazhani metro rail vazhithadam 4-aam vazhithadathin oru pagudhi. Idhu muzhuvadhumaagas seyarpaattirku vandhaal, kalangarai vilakkam mudhal poondhamalli puravazhichaalai varai 26.1 km neelathirku metro rail sevai kidaikkum.
Idharkidaiyil, kadandha aagast maadham mathiyap piradhesathin indhoor metrovin 11 km neelamulla vazhithadathaiyum, Chennai metrovin 2-aam katta vazhithadathaiyum ore nerathil telliyilirundhu kaanoli moolam thirandhu vaikkalaam ena adhigaarigal therivithirundha nilaiyil, andhath thittamum niraiveravillai endru koorappadugiradhu.

headline: Roo.250 kodikku aardar! Ai.ke.ep. Kangaatchiyil thiruppoorukku... Roo.800 kodikku varthaga visaaranai
text:
Roo.250 kodikku aardar! Ai.ke.ep. Kangaatchiyil thiruppoorukku... Roo.800 kodikku varthaga visaaranai
Tiruppur: ‘‘India indarneshanal nitber’ kangaatchiyil 250 kodi roobai madhippilaana udanadi varthaga aardargal perappattullana,’’ ena kangaatchi thalaivar sakdhivel therivithullaar.
India nitber asosiyeshan (ai.ke.ep.e.,) saarbil 53-vadhu Indhiya sarvadhesa pinnal kangaatchi, 16-m thedhi thuvangi, 3 naal nadandhadhu. Thiruppooril ulla ai.ke.ep. Valaagathil nadandha kangaatchiyil, ‘seyarkai noolizhai aadai, puthaakka javuli matrum nilaithanmai peshan edhirgaalam’ endra maiyakkaruthil palveru pudhiya ragangal kaatchippaduthappattana.
Aargaanik paruthi, kambali, moongil, visgos, paaliyastar, modaal, paaliyastar kalavaigal, trai-pilents, kaattan silk kalavai, pensi noolgal, marusuzhatsi seyyappatta nool matrum aadaigal ullittavai idambetrirundhana. Kaikkuzhandhaigal, siruvargal, sirumiyargal, aangal matrum pengalukkaana aadai ragangalum kaatchippaduthappattana. Pilaat nit aadaigal, pulli peshan aadaigal, iyarkai saayamidappatta aadaigal, tai-tai aadaigal, likvit pinish aadaigal, saplimeshan achidappatta aadaigal ullitta palveru pudhiya ragangalum arimugam seyyappattana.
Roo.800 kodikku
varthaga visaaranai
ai.ke.ep.e. Thalaivar sakdhivel kooriyadhaavadhu:
India – -airoppiya ondriya thadaiyatra varthaga oppandham 2027-m aandin thuvakkathil nadaimuraikku varum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Tharpodhu 11 naadugaludan India merkondu varum thadaiyatra varthaga oppandhangal varthagathukku payanalikkum vagaiyil ullana. Pirittan naattudanaana thadaiyatra varthaga oppandham varthagargal mathiyil nambikkaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Airoppiya naadugaludanaana varthaga oppandhathai edhirbaarthu, annaattu varthagargalum kangaatchiyil adhiga aarvathudan pangetranar. Pirittan, Japan, America, aikkiya aravu emirets, kanadaa, singappoor, morishiyas, indhonesiyaa ullitta naadugalai serndha varthagargal adhiga alavil pangetranar. 3 naal nadandha kangaatchiyil 250 kodi roobai madhippilaana udanadi varthaga aardargal perappattullana. Melum, 800 kodi roobai madhippilaana neenda kaala varthagathukkaana visaaranaigal nadandhullana.
Ivvaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: BJP aatchiyil aambulansil irundhu noyaali keezhe vizhundhadhaagap paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Utharappiradhesam yamunaa viraivu saalaiyil aambulansil irundhu noyaali keezhe stirecharudan keezhe vizhundhadhaaga oru video

nedunjjaalaiyil vegamaaga sendru kondirukkum aambulans vaaganathilirundhu stirecharil noyaali keezhe saalaiyil vizhuvadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “yamunaa viraivu saalaiyil . . . . . .
BJP sarkkaar latchanam paarungal😭😭😭😭😭😭😭
veettilirundhu eppadi irundhaalum sudugaattukku thaan pogap pogiraay idaiyil edharku aasbathiri neraa sudugaattukku po endru shaartkat kaanbikkiraargal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Vegamaaga sendru kondirundha aambulans vaaganathilirundhu noyaali oruvar keezhe vizhundhadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. BJP aalum maanilathil ippadi oru nilaimai endru palarum vimarsithu indha video-vai padhivittu varugindranar. Silar indha sambavam Tamil Naattin kovaiyil nadandhadhaaga padhivittu varugindranar.
Video-vai paarkkum podhe seyarkai nunnarivu (eai) payanbaduthi uruvaakkappattiruppadhu therigiradhu. Aambulansil oru kadhavu illai. Saalai sariyaaga illai. Noyaali vizhum podhu aaksijan maasgudan vizhugiraar. Aanaal, aambulansil irundhu aaksijan silindar vizhavillai. Appadi irukka aaksijan maask mattum kazhandru vizhaamal noyaaliyudan vandhulladhu.
Podhuvaaga aambulansin mugappu pagudhiyil thaan aambulans endra aangila vaarthaiyai thiruppi ezhudhiyiruppaargal. Vaaganangalil selbavargal pakkavaattu kannaadiyaip paarkkum podhu padikka vasadhiyaaga irukka ippadi ezhudhappattirukkum. Aanaal, indha vaaganathin pinbakkathil appadith thiruppi ezhudhiyullanar.
Noyaaliyin udan yaarum illaamal aambulans vaaganam iyakkappadaadhu. Miga avasaram endraal kooda kuraindhavatcham maruthuva paniyaalar aavadhu udan iruppaar. Appadi irundhirundhaal aambulansil irundha keezhe vizhundhadhum vaaganathai nirutha muyatsi seythiruppaargal. Idhil appadi yaarum illai.
Saalaiyil vizhundhadhum endha adhirchiyum indri asaivatru noyaali irukkiraar. Saalaiyil vizhundha stirecharin sakkaram neraaga selgiradhu. Aanaal, stirechar valadhuvurathil irundhu idadhuvuram selgiradhu. Ivai ellaam indha video unmaiyaanadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Iruppinum aadhaarangal adippadaiyil indha video poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Ippadi oru sambavam utharappiradhesathil alladhu kovaiyil nadandhadhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal appadi endha oru seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Aambulans thodarbaaga koodudhal vivarangalai arindha Chennai vadavazhani pi andu ji maruthuvamanaiyin idhayanoy sigichai nivunar doctor preetham kirushnamoorthiyidam indha video thodarbaaga pesinom.
Appodhu avar, “podhuvaaga noyaali udan uravinar, nanbar ena attendar oruvarudan thaan aambulans iyakkappadum. Avasara sigichai thevaippadum soozhalil maruthuva paniyaalarum noyaaliyudan pinnaal thaan amarndhiruppaar. Aambulansin kadhavu velippuramaaga poottappadum. Adhanaal, ulle irundhu yaarum elidhaaga veliye vandhuvida mudiyaadhu. Vaaganathirkul stirechar pirathiyegamaana muraiyil laak seyyappadum. Adhanaal, adhu asaiyaadhu, keezhe vizhaadhu.
Aanaal indha video-vil oru kadhave illai. Melum podhuvaaga kadaippidikkappadum vishayangal edhuvum illai. Aaksijan silindar stirecharudan irukkaadhu. Adhu aambulans vaaganathil thaniyaaga irukkum. Oruvelai kadhavu edhirbaaraadha vidhamaaga thirandhu, stirechar laak vilagi, udan vandhavargal kavanikkaamalirundhu noyaali stirecharudan saalaiyil vizhundhaalum kooda aaksijan maask kazhandrirukkum. Aanaal, video-vil appadi nadakkavillai. Indha video-vil ulladhu pondru nadakka vaayppillai” endraar.
Indha video-vai eai video kaatchigalaik kandariya udhavum thalangalil padhivetrith thedinom. Avaiyum idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mamdhaavai aadharitha kudumbathai aar.es.es kumbal kolai seythadhaa?
text:
Mamdhaavai aadharithaargal enbadharkaaga oru kudumbathaiye kolai seytha aar.es.es kumbal endru oru thagaval

kanavan, manaivi, magan endru irukkum oru thambadhiyarin pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “mmadhaavai vai aadharithadhaal indha kudumbathaiye mothamaa veedu pugundhu a’*tichu ko’*n**naanunga BJP RSS kaavigal kumbalgal. Andha sinna paiyanukku 7 vayasu. Oda vittu pinnaadi ve*’tti ko’*n**naanunga.
Andha pen nirai maadha karppini. Padukkaila vachu ko’*n**naanunga. Indha maadhiri pala poroda uyiraiyai indru BJP RSS kaavi kumbalgal seythu kondu Modi RSS BJP kumbalgal nagarathaiye kollaiyadithu, ko*lai seythu veriyaattam aadikkondiyirukkiradhu. Vaakku saavadigalai kaippatri thiruttu vaakkugal mesingalai payanbaduthi vetri petradhaaga therdhal aanaiyathai kaiyil vaithu kondu aattam podugiradhu #paajaga aatchiyai kaippatriya anaithu maanilangalum sooraiyaadappattu kaavigalukku adhigaarathai vazhangiyulladhu indru pala nagarangal BJP edhiraaga vaakkuppotta kaaranathinaal saambaalakkappadugiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merku vanga sattamandra therdhalil BJP vetri petrulladhu. Idhaith thodarndha angu sila idangalil vanmurais sambavangal nadandhadhaaga seythigal veliyaagina. Indha nilaiyil, mamdhaavai aadharitha oru kudumbathin kanavan, karppini manaivi matrum avargaladhu ezhu vayadhu maganai aar.es.es kundargal kolai seythaargal endru oru pugaippadathudan padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha kudumbam pala aandugalukku munbu kolai seyyappattadhu. BJP – aar.es.es-ai aadharithaar enbadharkaaga kollappattadhu endru pala aandugalukku munbu vadhandhi parappappattadhu ninaivilirundhadhu. Enave, indha padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Nammudaiya fekt kirasando thamizhil indha kolaikku arasiyal kaaranam illai endru kurippittu 2019m aandu katturai veliyittirundhom. Adhan piragu indha vazhakkil enna nadandhadhu endru ariya aayvaith thodarndhom. Indha sambavathin pinnani oralavukkuth theriyum enbadhaal adhu thodarbaana sila adippadai vaarthaigalaip payanbaduthi koogulil thedinom.
Appodhu, 15 akdovar 2019m aandu taims aap India veliyittirundha seythi namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil indha kolai vazhakku visaaranai mudindhadhu. Kutravaali kaidhu seyyappattullaan. Kolaiyai thaandhaan seythen endrum avan oppudhal vaakkumoolam alithullaan endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Kaappeedu mudhirvu panam perudhalil erpatta modhal kaaranamaaga indha kolai nadandhiruppadhaaga Police therivithullanar. Kolai seyyappatta navarin peyar pandhu piragaash paal. Ivar oru palliyil paniyaatri vandhullaar. Avar kaappeedu mugavaraagavum paniyaatri vandhullaar. Avar thannidam paditha uthbaal peheraavai kaappeedu thittam ondril serthullaar. Andha kaappeettukkaana preemiyathai uthbaal seluthiyirukkiraar. Aanaal andha panathaik kaappeedu niruthil kattaamal, adharkaana raseedhai vazhangaamal alaikkazhithullaar piragaash paal. Idhanaal aathiramadaindha uthbaal indha kolaiyais seythirukkiraar endru Police therivithullanar.
Appodhu merku vanga kaavaldhuraiyin sattam ozhungu pirivu koodudhal thalaimai iyakkunaraaga irundha njaanavanth sing pivisi-kku alithirundha pettiyil, “indha kolaikkum endha arasiyal katchikkum thodarbillai enbadhai idhuvarai nadandha visaaranaigal urudhi seythullana” endru kooriyirundhadhum theriyavandhadhu. Idhan moolam 2019m aandu merku vangathil nadandha kolai sambavam ondrai ippodhu merku vangathil mamdhaa tholviyadaindha soozhalil thirinaamul Congress aadharavaalar kollappattadhu pondru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mathiya, maanila arasu oozhiyargalukku... Indre sambalam! : 3 naal vangigal stiraikkaal thideer arivippu
text:
Mathiya, maanila arasu oozhiyargalukku... Indre sambalam! : 3 naal vangigal 'stiraik'kaal thideer arivippu
Chennai: mathiya arasin mudivai pinbatri, Thamizhaga arasin oozhiyargalukku aindhu naatkal mun, indre sambalam vazhangappada ulladhu. Vangi oozhiyargal moondru naal velainirutham kaaranamaaga, indha thideer arivippai arasu veliyittu ulladhu.
'vaarathil irandu naal vidumurai, aluvalargal matrum adhigaarigalukku idaiyeyaana paaravatchamaana nadavadikkaiyai maatrudhal, ai.ti.pi.ai., vangiyai thaniyaar mayamaakkakkoodaadhu' enbana ullitta korikkaigalai valiyuruthi, vangigal matrum vangi oozhiyargal matrum adhigaarigal inaindhu, kadandha 11m thedhiyandru mudhalgatta velai niruthathil eeduvattanar.
Vidumurai
irandaavadhu kattamaaga, varum 28 mudhal 30m thedhi varai, moondru naal thodar velainiruthathil eeduvadap povadhaaga vangi oozhiyargal arivithullanar. Adharku mun, naalaiyum, naalai marunaalum vaara vidumurai naatkal varugindrana. Adutha maadham 2m thedhi kaandhi jeyandhiyum, adhai thodarndhu vaara vidumuraiyum varugiradhu. Idhanaal, vangigalin seyalbaadugal, oru vaarathukku mel mudangum vaayppulladhu. Idhan kaaranamaaga, 'anaithu vangigalum varum 27m thedhi njaayirandru iyangum' ena, mathiya arasu arivithu ulladhu.
Aanaal, kurippitta sila vangi sangangalais serndhavargal panikku varaamal, viduppu edukka mudiveduthullanar. Enave, njaayitruk kizhamai seyalbattaalum parivarthanaigal paadhikkappadum vaayppulladhu.
Mathiya, maanila arasu oozhiyargalukku, sepdambar maadhathirkaana sambalam, oyvoodhiyam aagiyavai, varum 30m thedhi vazhangappada vendum. Aanaal, vangigal thodar vidumurai kaaranamaaga, avatrai vazhanguvadharku vaayppillai. Enave, indru sambalam matrum oyvoodhiyam vazhanga, mathiya nidhi amaichagam mudivu seythu, netru mundhinam arivippai veliyittadhu.
Idhai thodarndhu, Thamizhaga arasum anaithu arasu oozhiyargal, thinakkooli thozhilaalargal ullittorukku, indru sambalam vazhanga mudivu seythulladhu. Idhu kurithu, anaithu thurai thalaivargal, seyalargal ullittorukku, nidhith thurai seyalar sithik sila arivuruthalgalai vazhangiyullaar.
Idaiyooru
avar kooriyulladhaavadhu: varum 28m thedhi mudhal 30m thedhi varai, naadu thazhuviya vangi velai nirutham arivikkappattu ulladhu. Idhanaal, vangi parivarthanaigalil idaiyooru erpada vaayppulladhu. Enave, anaithu oozhiyargalukkum sepdambar maadhathirkaana sambalam, kooli, oyvoodhiyathai, 25m thedhi vazhangalaam ena mathiya arasu mudivu seythulladhu.
Vangigal velai nirutham matrum akdovar 2m thedhi mudhal naangu naal vidumurai varugiradhu. Idhanaal, vangigalin vazhakkamaana seyalbaadugal paadhikkappadum. Enave, anaithu thurai thalaivargal, seyalargal, thangaladhu kattuppaattil ulla arasu aluvalagangal, vaariyangal, kazhagangal, palgalaigalil panivurivavargalin sambalam, thinakkooli, oyvoodhiya pattiyalai indre samarppikka vendum.
Karuvoolangal matrum kanakkugal pirivu iyakkunar, adharkerpa indre sambalam vazhanga nadavadikkai edukka vendum. Ivvaaru sithik kooriyullaar.
Oyvoodhiyargal
 nidhithurai seyalar utharavai aduthu, sepdambar maadhathirkaana arasu oozhiyargal, thinakkooli paniyaalargal, oyvoodhiyadhaarargal pattiyalgalai indre vazhangumaaru, anaithu sambala kanakku aluvalargal, anaithu karuvoola aluvalargalukkum, karuvoola kanakkugal iyakkunar saarusree utharavittullaar.
Mathiya, maanila arasugalin arivippai thodarndhu, arasu oozhiyargalukku aindhu naatkal munbaagave indru sambalam kidaikka ulladhu.

headline: Arasu palligalil sathunavu vazhanguvadhil sikkal kaali paniyidangalai nirappa korikkai
text:
Annoor: annoor matrum es.es.kulam ondriyangalil, kaali paniyidangalaal sathunavu vazhanguvadhu paadhikkappattulladhu.
Arasu, arasu udhavi perum, thuvakka, nadunilai, uyarnilai matrum melnilaip palligalil, ondru mudhal pathaam vaguppu varaiyilaana maanava, maanaviyarukku sathunavu vazhangappattu varugiradhu. Maanavargal ennikkai koodudhalaaga ulla maiyangalil, amaippaalar, samaiyalar, udhaviyaalar ena moondru paniyidangalum, maanavargal ennikkai migak kuraivaaga ulla maiyangalil amaippaalar matrum udhaviyaalar pani purigindranar.
Sila aandugalaaga, sathunavu amaippaalar, samaiyalar, udhaviyaalar aagiyor paniyil irundhu oyvu, pani vilagal, irappu aagiya kaaranangalaal, pala aayiram paniyidangal kaaliyaaga ullana. Idhanaal, sathunavu viniyogam paadhikkappadugiradhu.
Idhugurithu sathunavu oyvoodhiyar sanga nirvaagi thaamodhara saami kooriyadhaavadhu:
tharpodhu ore amaippaalar, moondru maiyangalukku poruppaaga irundhu porutkalai vaangi vaikka vendiya nilai ulladhu. Samaiyalarukku, andha porutkalai, thinamum eduthu iruppu kanakkidudhal ena palveru panigalai seyya vendi ulladhu. Ore samaiyalar, irandu maiyangalukku samaikka vendi ulladhu. Idhanaal unavin tharam kuraiyum avaayam erpattulladhu. Sathunavu vazhanga thaamadhamaagiradhu. Kadandha irandu aandugalaaga, aarppaattam, maanaadu aagiyavatril palamurai therivithum arasu kandugollavillai.
Idhanaal sathunavil tharam kuraindhu thaamadhamaavadhaal, sathunavu utkolvorin ennikkai kuraiyum nilai ulladhu. Annoor ondriyathil ulla, 93 maiyangalil, 45 maiyangalukku mel amaippaalar, samaiyalar, udhaviyaalar paniyidangal kaaliyaaga ullana. Viraivil kaali paniyidangalai arasu nirappa vendum.
Ivvaaru, avar koorinaar.
Idhevol sarkkaar saamakkulam ondriyathil, 50 sadhaveedha paniyidangal kaaliyaaga ullana.

headline: Adukkumaadi kudiyiruppin velaigalai avutchors seyyalaamaa?
text:
Adukkumaadi kudiyiruppin velaigalai 'avutchors' seyyalaamaa?
Engal adukkagathil 350 veedugal ullana. Yaarume asosiyeshanukkaana nirvaaga poruppai erka maatten engindranar. Palveru velaigalai avutchors seyya mudiyumaa?
Rathigaa, Chennai
thaaraalamaagas seyyalaam. Periya kudiyiruppugalai nirvagippadharku endre 'pesilitti menejment sarveesas' amaippugal ullana. Adukkagathin paraamarippu, sekyooritti, varavu- -- selavu kanakkugal ullitta velaigalai avargal kavanithu kolvar. Avargalodu oppandham pottu, avutchorsing seyyalaam. Aanaal, avargalai nirvagippadharku nichayam adukkagathukku oru asosiyeshanum, nirvaagigalum avasiyam. Vangi kaasolaigalil kaiyezhuthida thalaivar, podhucheyalar, porulaalar ena kuraindhavatcham 3 per konda oru siriya nirvaaga kuzhu mattum irundhaal podhumaanadhu. Thinasari thalaivaligalai andha niruvaname paarthuk kollum.
 2,000 veedugal konda migapperiya adukkagathil, oru veedu vaanga muyalgiren. Adimanai kittathatta 50 mudhal 80 ekkar parappalavu. 100 sarve engalukku mel irukkindrana. En veedu irukka pogum sarve nambarai eppadi kanduvidippadhu endre theriyavillai .
Naagaraajan, medavaakkam 
ungal sarve ennaik kanduvidikka indha vazhimuraigal udhavumaa endru paarungal. Pildaridam andha kurippitta tavarukkaana reraa (RERA) ennai kettu, Tamil Nadu riyal estet regulettari athaaritti (TNRERA) valaithalathil thedungal. Ange andha praajekt thodarbaana padhivu seyyappatta aavanangalai paarkka mudiyum. Kurippaaga, nilathin urimai aavanangal, sarve engal, villangam thodarbaana vivarangal, angeegarikkappatta thittam aagiyavatrai thedi paarungal.
Atvaans koduppadharku mun 'varaivu virpanai oppandham' kelungal. Adhil ungal veedu amaindhirukkum tavar matrum adharkuriya nilathin sarve engal, ungalukku kidaikkappogum pirivadaadha nilappangu ullitta vivarangal thelivaaga irukkiradhaa endru paarungal.
Periya vangigalil indha piraajekt angeegarikkappattulladhaa ena kelungal. Avargal anumadhithirundhaal, vangiyin sattak kuzhu erkanave andha 100 sarve engalaiyum muzhumaiyaaga sarivaarthiruppar.
Ungal vazhakkarinjarai vaithu, pildar kodukkum 'maastar leegal ripport', reraa aavanangal, thaay pathirangal, virpanai aavanangal, sarve vivarangal, angeegarikkappatta thittam ullittavatrai thaniyaaga sarivaarthu kollungal. Kurippaaga, neengal vaanga pogum tavarukku sambandhappatta sarve engalil edhenum adamaanam, villangam, vazhakku alladhu veru urimai koral irukkiradhaa enbadhaiyum sarivaarkka sollungal.
 Naan adukkumaadi kudiyiruppil oru pilaat vaanga ullen. Pilaattin vilaiyudan adharkaana ji.es.ti.,yaiyum kodukka vendum ena puramottar korugiraar. Idhai rijistar seyyum podhu pilaattin vilaikku mattum kattanam selutha vendumaa alladhu ji.es.ti., thogaiyaiyum serthu kattanam selutha vendumaa?
Raamaraajan, Chennai 42 
neengal ji.es.ti., thogaikku muthiraithaal matrum padhivu kattanam selutha thevaiyillai. Pildar ji.es.ti.yai thaniyaagap pirithu kaattaamal, mothamaaga veettin vilaiyodu pathirathil ezhudhivittaal, andha motha thogaiyin adippadaiyil padhivu seyyappadum madhippu kurithu saar--padhivaalar aluvalagathil koodudhal kattanam kanakkidappadumaa enbadhai mungoottiye thelivuvaduthi kollungal.
Adhanaal, pathira padhivin podhu aavanangalil pilaattin asal vilai matrum ji.es.ti., vari aagiyavatrai thanithaniyaaga kurippidumbadi ungal pildaridam mungoottiye thelivaaga sollividungal.
Pildarukku seluthum ji.es.ti., veru; pathira padhivinbodhu seluthum muthiraithaal matrum padhivu kattanam veru. Ji.es.ti., thogaikku thaniyaaga muthiraithaal alladhu padhivu kattanam selutha vendiyadhillai.
 En kanavar arasup paniyilirundhu 2.5 varudangalukku munbu oyvu petraar. Si.pi.es. Thittam enum pangalippu oyvoodhiya thittathil panivurindhadhaal oyvukku pinbu, oyvoodhiyam illai; veru varumaanam illai.
Naan magalir urimaithogai kori vinnappam seythum, maru muraiyeedu seythum idhunaalvarai kidaikkavillai. Idhu kurithu sambandhappatta aluvalagathil kettavodhu, en kanavar arasum paniyin podhum, oyvu petra pinbum (2.5 varudangalukku munbu) varumaana vari kanakku thaakkal seythadhai vaithu vinnappam etrukkollappadavillai ena theriyavandhadhu. Idharku theervu kurithu therivikka vendugiren.
Vi.es. Thanalatchumi, theni 
magalir urimaithogai thittathin thelivaana arasaanai ulladhu. Kudumbathil yaarenum oruvar varumaana vari seluthuvavaraagavo, varumaana varikkanakkuth thaakkal seybavaraagavo irundhaal, andha kudumbam indha thittathin palanai pera mudiyaadhu.
Ungal kanavar oyvu petrirundhaalum, avar paniyil irundha nidhiyaandirkum, adhan piragu oyvuvetra palangalil ulla ti.ti.es.ai., thirumba peruvadharkum avar varumaana vari kanakkai thaakkal seythirukkalaam. Arasu ungal vinnappathai pariseelikkumbodhu, paan matrum aadhaar engal vaayilaaga varumaana varithuraiyin tharavugalai kanini thaanaagave oppittu paarkkum. Avar ai.ti.aar., thaakkal seythirukkiraar endru therindhavudan, ungalai 'thagudhiyatravar' endru solli vittadhu.
Melum, arasu paniyil irundhu oyvu petravargal endraale avargalukku penshan varum endra podhuvaana nambikkai iruppadhaal, si.pi.es., thittathin keezh maadhaandhira oyvoodhiyam illai enbadharkaana thagundha aavanangal moolam adhigaarigalukku puriyavaikka vendum.
Enave, ungal thaalugaavin varuvaay kottaatchiyarai neril sandhithu ungalin thanippatta soozhnilaiyai vilakkungal. Adhigaarigalai neril sandhithu aavanangalai vaithu valuvaaga vaadhittaal mattume indha thozhilnutba sikkalukkuth theervu kaana mudiyum.

headline: Aarakkil niruvanam kodutha adhirchi.. ’idhudhaan ungalin kadaisi naal’ 2,500 oozhiyargal panineekkam?
text:
India-vil seyalbadum munnani menborul niruvanam aarakkil, niruvana maruseeramaippu matrum varthagath thevaigalai kaaranam kaatti sumaar 2,500 oozhiyargalai panineekkam seyyath thittamittulladhu.
Munnani menborul niruvanamaana aarakkil (Oracle) India-vil paniyaatrum sumaar 2 aayirathu 500 oozhiyargalaip panineekkam seyyath thittamittulladhaagath thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana. Idhanaal kilavut sevaigal, menborul membaadu pirivugalil paniyaatrum Indhiya oozhiyargal perumalavil paadhikkappadalaam ena anjjappadugiradhu.
Andhavagaiyil munnanith thozhilnutba niruvanamaana aarakkil (Oracle) thanadhu oozhiyargalukkuk kaalai 6 manikku anuppappatta minnanjjalil, "indre ungalin kadaisi velai naal" enak koori udanadiyaagap panineekkam seyyappattullanar. Niruvanathin maruseeramaippu matrum varthagath thevaigalaik kaaranam kaatti indha nadavadikkai edukkappattulladhu. Paadhikkappatta oozhiyargalukku izhappeettuth thogai vazhangappadavulladhudan, avargalin kanini anugalgalum udanadiyaagath thundikkappattu varugindrana.

headline: ADMK-vil irundhu vandhavargalukku seet.. Vijay-in maastar pilaan.. Idaitherdhal kaigodukkumaa?
text:
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
2026 sattapperavaith therdhalil thamizhagathin 234 thogudhigalilum ore kattamaaga vaakkuppadhivu nadaivetradhu. Idhil TVK thalaivar Vijay, perambaloor matrum Trichy kizhakku aagiya iru thogudhigalil pottiyittu vetri petraar. Irandu thogudhigalil vetri petradhaal, therdhal vidhigalinbadi, oru thogudhi padhaviyai avar raajinaamaa seyya vendiya nilai erpattadhu. Idhaiyaduthu Trichy kizhakku thogudhi emele padhaviyai Vijay raajinaamaa seythaar. ADMK-vil erpatta karuthu veruvaadugalaith thodarndhu, akkatchi saarbil pottiyittu vetri petra 6 emelekkal thangaladhu padhavigalai raajinaamaa seythu thavegavil inaindhanar. Idhan kaaranamaaga Thamizhagathil motham 7 sattapperavaith thogudhigal kaaliyaanadhaaga arivikkappattana. Idhil 5 thogudhigalil therdhal thodarbaana vazhakku niluvaiyil irundha nilaiyil, andha thogudhigalukku idaitherdhal nadatha Needhimandram idaikkaalath thadai vidhithirundhadhu.
Adhenerathil, madhuraandhagam matrum thaaraavuram aagiya iru thogudhigalukkaana idaitherdhal thedhiyai Indhiya therdhal aanaiyam arivithulladhu. Adhanbadi, akdovar 6aam thedhi vaakkuppadhivu nadaiverugiradhu. Akdovar 9aam thedhi vaakkugal ennappattu mudivugal arivikkappada ullana. Therdhal thedhi arivikkappatta nilaiyil, DMK thanadhu vetbaalargalai mudhalil arivithulladhu. Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil DMK sattathurai inais seyalaalar parandhaamanum, thaaraavurathil vazhakkarinjar suganyaavum vetbaalargalaaga kalamirakkappattullanar. TVK saarbil yaar pottiyidap pogiraargal endra edhirbaarppu erpattirundha nilaiyil, TVK akkatchiyum vetbaalargalai arivithulladhu. Adhanbadi, madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil maragadham kumaravelum, thaaraavurathil sathyavaamaavum pottiyidugindranar.
Idhil mukkiya amsam iruvarum erkenave ADMK saarbil pottiyittu andha thogudhigalil vetri petravargal. Pinnar thangaladhu emele padhavigalai raajinaamaa seythu thavegavil inaindha nilaiyil, tharpodhu adhe thogudhigalil TVK vetbaalargalaaga kalamirakkappattullanar. Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyaip poruthavarai, maragadham kumaravel 2021 matrum 2026 sattapperavaith therdhalgalil ADMK saarbil pottiyittu vetri petrullaar. Idhanaal andhath thogudhiyil avarukku irukkum thanippatta selvaakku thavegavukku saadhagamaaga amaiyumaa endra edhirbaarppu ezhundhulladhu. Thaaraavuram thogudhiyilum kadandha sattapperavaith therdhalil ADMK vetbaalare vetri petrirundhaar. Indha iru thogudhigalilum, tharpodhu ADMK pinnaniyaik kondavargalaiye TVK vetbaalargalaaga arivithiruppadhu therdhal kalathil mukkiya nagarvaagap paarkkappadugiradhu.
Adhevelaiyil, vetri petra pinnar kurugiya kaalathileye emele padhaviyai raajinaamaa seythiruppadhu vetbaalargalukku edhiraaga amaiyumaa endra kelviyum ezhundhulladhu. Thogudhi makkalin mananilai, katchith thondargalin kalappani, ulloor arasiyal kanakkugal ena palveru amsangal indhath therdhalil thaakkathai erpaduthakkoodum.
Maruvuram, thimugavum indha iru thogudhigalilum vetriyaip pera theeviramaaga kalappaniyil irangum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Adhimugavum vetbaalargalai arivitha piragu therdhal kalam melum sooduvidikkum. Idhanaal madhuraandhagam matrum thaaraavuram thogudhigalil mummunaip potti uruvaagumaa endra edhirbaarppu erpattulladhu.
ADMK-vin paarambariya vaakkugalai TVK vetbaalargal thangalukku saadhagamaaga maatrik kolvaargalaa? Aalum katchi endra palathudan TVK idaitherdhalilum vetriyaip padhivu seyyumaa? DMK thanadhu therdhal viyoogathin moolam aattathai maatrumaa? Kadandha therdhalgalaip pola, adhimugave immuraiyum aadhikkam seluthumaa enbadhai therdhal mudivu varum varai poruthirundhudhaan paarkka vendum.

headline: ‘roo.20,000 kadanai adai’- pirasavathirkus sella vidaamal thadutha urimaiyaalar; thaay, sisukku nerndha thuyaram
text:
Pirasavathinbodhu erpatta kadumaiyaana vali matrum adhiga rathappokkuk kaaranamaaga, thaay thenmozhiyum pudhidhaagap pirandha pachilam kuzhandhaiyum sambava idathileye paridhaavamaaga uyirizhandhirukkindranar.
Kaanjjivuram maavattam singaadivaakkam ooraatchiyais serndha irular samoogathais serndha aanandhan (40) - thenmozhi (35) thambadhiyinar, arakkonam saalai vellai ket pagudhiyil ulla marakkadaiyil kadandha 6 maadhangalaaga maram vettum thozhilil eeduvattu vandhirukkindranar.
Innilaiyil, 9 maadha karppiniyaaga irundha thenmozhikkuth thideerena kadumaiyaana pirasava vali erpattirukkiradhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, avarai udanadiyaaga maruthuvamanaikku azhaithus sella anumadhikkumaaru marakkadai urimaiyaalar aarumugathidam kanavar aanandhan kettirukkiraar.
Aanaal, munbanamaagap petrirundha roo.20,000 kadanaith thiruppis seluthaamal paniyidathai vittus sellak koodaadhu enak koori, avargalai maruthuvamanaikkus sella vidaamal urimaiyaalar thaduthirukkiraar.
Uriya maruthuva udhavi kidaikkaadhadhaal, thangiyirundha koodaarathileye thenmozhikkup pirasavam nadandhirukkiradhu.
Pirasavathinbodhu erpatta kadumaiyaana vali matrum adhiga rathappokkuk kaaranamaaga, thaay thenmozhiyum pudhidhaagap pirandha pachilam kuzhandhaiyum sambava idathileye paridhaavamaaga uyirizhandhirukkindranar.
Ichambavam kurithu ponnerigarai kaaval nilaiyathil alikkappatta pugaarin peril kaavaldhuraiyinar theevira visaaranai nadathi varugindranar.
Maruthuvamanaikkus sella urimaiyaalar thaduthadhaagak koorappadum kutrachaattu visaaranaikkup pirage muzhumaiyaagath theriyavarum endru kaavaldhurai tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: Pakistan meedhu thaakkudhal nadatha mudiyaadhu endru Indhiya raanuvam maruppu therivithadhaa?
text:

Therdhalukkaaga pulvaamaavil 44 raanuva veerargalai andraikku pali koduthom adhe therdhalukkaaga indraikku 26 appaavi podhumakkalai naam pali koduthirukkirom.
Idhan pin ulla unmai ellaam raanuvathirku theriyaamal irukkumaa.
Adhanaaldhaan ungal kevalamaana therdhal arasiyalukku naangal aatkal illai endru ezhundhu pogiraargal.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idharkum, sameevathiya paahalgaam theeviravaadha thaakkudhalukkum idaiye endha sambandhamum illai endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, Government of Punjab yoodiyup valaidhalathil veliyitta video padhivu ondrin lingk namakkuk kidaithadhu.
Indha seythiyil, raanuva adhigaari karnal pushbindhar sing enbavar sameevathil panjjaap maanila Police meedhu pugaar ondrai veliyittaar. Adhil, paarkking pirasnai ondru thodarbaaga, avaraiyum, avaradhu maganaiyum panjjaap Police thaakkiyadhaagak kooriyirundhaar. Idhanberil, panjjaap maanila tijivi matrum raanuva adhigaarigal, oodaga sandhippu ondrai erpaadu seythu, merkanda vivagaaram thodarbaaga, vilakkam alithanar. Andha video-vai eduthu, kaashmeer vivagaarathudan thodarbuvaduthi samooga valaidhalangalil vendumendre vadhandhi parappugiraargal endru theriyavarugiradhu.

enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video patriya thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thindukkal ai. Liyoni maranam endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?

headline: “malesiyaavil thirishaa” endru paravum pugaippadangal – unmaiyaa?
text:
Jananaayagan pada isaiveliyeettu vizhaa malesiyaavil nadaiverum soozhalil adhil pangerka nadigai thirishaavum sendradhu pondru pugaippadangal

nadigai thirishaa rasigargal munnilaiyil selfi eduthukkonda pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaithagavalil, “malesiyaavil anniyaar ….” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Adhe pondru pugaippadathirku pos koduthadhu pondru matroru pugaippadathai Facebook-il padhivittu, “anniyaar illaamalaa… 🐿️milesiyaavula 3 shaa” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadangalai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Nadigai thirishaa velinaattukku sendradhaaga pugaippadangalai samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhaal pirasnai illai. Anniyaar endru vishamathanathudan kurippittup padhivittullanar. Nadigar Vijay matrum thirishaavai inaithu kisugisukkal parappappattu varugindrana. Malesiyaavil jananaayagan isai veliyeettu vizhaa nadaivera ulla soozhalil anniyaar endru kurippittu padhivittiruppadhan moolam andha vizhaavil pangerka sendradhu pondra vishama thagavalaip padhivittullanar. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens inaiyathalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu thirishaa peyar konda instaagiraam pakkathil thak laip (Thug Life) thiraippadathin piramoshanukkaaga malesiyaa sendra podhu edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Andha pugaippadamaanadhu 2025 me 31m thedhi instaagiraamil padhividappattirundhadhu. Jananaayagan audio laanjs 2025 tisambar 27m thedhi nadandhadhu. Enave, jananaayagan padathirkaaga nadigai thirishaa sendra pugaippadam idhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Aduthadhaaga pugaippadathirku pos kodutha padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom. Andha padathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Adhuvum pala maadhangalukku munbu mumbai vimaananilaiyathil edukkappattadhaaga padhivugal namakku kidaithana. Adhuvum thak laip padathin piramoshanukkaaga mumbai sendra podhu edukkappattadhu endru galattadotcom meediyaavin instaagiraam pakkathil veliyaagi irundhadhu. Me 20, 2025 andru andha video padhividappattirundhadhu.
Galattadotcom veliyittirundha video-vai sgireenshaat eduthu jananaayagan vizhaavil pangerka malesiyaa sendradhu pondru ippodhu pugaippadathai thavaraaga padhivittullanar. Idhan moolam pazhaiya pugaippadangalai thavaraaga padhividappattiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivugal thavaraanavai endru urudhi seyyappadugindrana.

headline: Aamadhaavaathil indigo vimaanam avasaramaaga tharaiyirakkam; payanigalukku kaathirundha adhirchi
text:
Aamadhaavaath: savudhi areviyaa nokki purappatta indigo vimaanam, vedigundu purali kaaranamaaga, aamadhaavaathil avasara avasaramaaga tharaiyirakkappatta sambavathaal payanigal avadhiyadaindhanar.
107 payanigal, 6 oozhiyargaludan indigo vimaanam, Lucknow-vil irundhu savudhi areviyaavin thammaam nagarukku purappattu sendradhu. Vimaanam naduvaanil parandhu kondirundha podhu, oru tishyoo pepparil vedigundu endru ezhudhappattirundhadhai, vimaana oozhiyar oruvar paarthullaar. Idhai udanadiyaaga vimaana pailattidam therivithum ullaar.
Idhaiyaduthu, udanadiyaaga aamadhaavaath vimaana nilaiyathirku thagaval therivikkappattu, avasara avasaramaaga vimaanam tharaiyirakkappattadhu. Angu vimaanam thanimaippaduthappattu, payanigal matrum oozhiyargal pathiramaaga veliyetrappattanar. Pinnar, vedigundu seyalizhappu nivunargalaal sodhanai seyyappattadhu.
Aanaal, sandhegathirkidamaaga endhapporulum kidaikkaadhadhaal, idhu vadhandhi enath theriya vandhadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga vimaana nilaiya Police visaarithu varugindranar.

headline: Naattin nalanukkaaga thangam vaanga vendaam endru 1967m aandu indhiraa kaandhi valiyuruthinaaraa?
text:
‘‘naattin nalanukkaaga thangam vaanga vendaam’’, endru 1967m aandu indhiraa kaandhi valiyuruthiyadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’1967 il appozhudhu piradhamar indhiraa kaandhi avargale naattin nalanukkaaga thangam vaanga vendaam endru valiyuruthinaar,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan, The Hindu naalidhazh veliyitta thalaiyangam ondrin pugaippadam inaikkappattulladhu. Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu The Hindu peyaril pagirappadum vadhandhi, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, The Hindu aasiriyar kuzhuvil kettavodhu, ‘’engaladhu peyaril vendumendre ivvaaru poliyaana seythi parappugiraargal. Naangal erkanave idhuvatri engaladhu samooga valaidhala pakkathil maruppu therivithullom,’’ endranar.
Melum, naam aayvu seyyum pugaippadathil kurippidappattulla thedhi, joon 6, 1967 andru veliyaana thi indhu mugappu padam verondraagum. Adhanai The Hindu Associate Editor & Political Editor Nistula Hebbar avaradhu samooga valaidhala pakkathil pagirndhullaar.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda naalidhazh pugaippadam, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

text:

headline: Thozhilaali marmachaavu uravinargal poraattam
text:
Salem: Salem, pallappattiyil ulla thaniyaar niruvanathil moottai thookkum thozhilaaliyaaga velai paarthavar selvam, 55. Sinnappambatti, kondakkaaranoorai serndha ivarukku thiruma-namaagi manaivi, 4 magalgal ullanar.
Netru kaalai panikku vandha selvam, madhiyam, 2:00 manikku mayangi kidappadhaaga, niruvanathil velai seybavargal thagaval kodukkave, avaradhu manaivi ullitta uravinargal vandhu paarthanar. Appodhu selvam irandhadhu theriyavandhadhu. Melum avaradhu irappil sandhegam iruppadhaaga koori, poraattathil eeduvattanar. Angu vandha pallappatti Police, visaarithu nadavadikkai eduppadhaaga kooriyadhaal samaadhaanam adaindhanar. Pin selvam udalai kaippatri, piredha parisodhanaikku, Salem arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppinar. Melum avar ep-padi irandhaar ena, Police visaarikkindranar.

headline: SIR sarchai| therdhal aanaiyathukkul pilavu? Edhirkkatchigal porkkodi!
text:
SIR enappadum Special Intensive Revision kurithu therdhal aanaiyathukkul karuthu veruvaadu erpattadhaaga velivandha thagaval arasiyal vattaarathil paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu. . Indhiyan eksbiras arikkaiyinbadi, aanaiyargal sukbeer sing sandhu, vivek joshi aagiyor 10 maadhangalil kuraindhadhu 14 murai ezhuthuppoorva edhirppu therivithadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Idhanaal thalaimai therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaar meedhu kadumaiyaana edhirppugal uruvaagiyulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - M.meeraa
SIR enappadum Special Intensive Revision thodarbaaga therdhal aanaiyathukkul karuthu veruvaadu erpattadhaaga veliyaana thagaval, arasiyal vattaarathil pudhiya paravarappai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Thi indhiyan eksbiras veliyittulla arikkaiyinbadi, therdhal aanaiyargal sukbeer sing sandhu matrum vivek joshi, aagiya iruvarum kadandha 10 maadhangalil SIR thodarbaana mudivugal kurithu kuraindhadhu 14 murai ezhuthuppoorvamaaga edhirppu therivithadhaaga koorappattulladhu. Pudhiya vaakkaalargalai serppadhu, vaakkaalar peyargalai neekkuvadhu, vaakkaalar pattiyal menborul matrum melmuraiyeedugal ullitta vivagaarangalil indha edhirppu irundhadhaaga arikkai therivikkiradhu.
Kurippaaga, pudhiya vaakkaalargal padhivu seyyum Form 6-l SIR thodarbaana koodudhal vivarangal serkkappattadharku iru therdhal aanaiyargalum edhirppu therivithadhaagavum, idharku vidhigalil thirutham thevai ena avargal kurippittadhaagavum andha arikkai koorugiradhu.
Melum, vaakkaalar pattiyal thodarbaana thagaval thozhilnutba amaippin kattuppaadu telliyil vaithiruppadhu kurithum iru therdhal aanaiyargalum kavalai therivithadhaagavum, idhu maanila alavilaana adhigaarigalin seyalbaattai paadhikkakkoodum ena avargal kurippittadhaagavum thagaval veliyaagiyulladhu.
Indhath thagavalgalai thodarndhu edhirkkatchigal therdhal aanaiyathai kadumaiyaaga vimarsithullana. Congress ullitta edhirkkatchith thalaivargal, thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaar meedhu palveru kutrachaattugalai munvaithullanar.
Congress thalaivar maneesh thivaari, veliyaana thagavalgal unmaiyaaga irundhaal, therdhal aanaiyathin seyalbaadugal kurithu theeviramaana kelvigal ezhuvadhaagavum, njaanesh kumaarukku edhiraana padhavi neekka nadavadikkai kurithu pariseelikka vendiya nilai iruppadhaagavum kooriyullaar.
Samaajvaadhi katchith thalaivar agilesh yaadhav, indha vivagaarathil ucha Needhimandram thaamaaga munvandhu visaaranai nadatha vendum enak koriyullaar. Thirinaamul Congress em.pi. Saagarigaa kosh therdhal aanaiyam ore navarin kattuppaattil seyalbaduvadhaaga kutramsaattiyullaar.
Adhenerathil, therdhal aanaiyam indha thagavalgalai maruthulladhu. Aanaiyathin tharappil, anaithu mudivugalilum moondru therdhal aanaiyargalin kaiyezhuthum irundhadhaagavum, sandhu matrum joshi sila karuthugalukku edhirppugalai therivithirundhaalum, avatrai muzhumaiyaana edhirppu enak karudha mudiyaadhu endrum therivikkappattulladhu.
Idhanaal, SIR nadavadikkai thodarbaaga therdhal aanaiyathukkul unmaiyil karuthu veruvaadu irundhadhaa enbadhu kurithu tharpodhu arasiyal matrum satta reedhiyaaga vivaadham theeviramadaindhulladhu.

headline: Irattai ilaikku vaakkalikkumbadi rajinigaanth pirasaaram seythadhaaga paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Irattai ilai sinnathil vaakkalikkumbadi rajinigaanth penar pidithavadi irukkum pugaippadam ondru

rajinigaanth irattai ilai sinnathudan koodiya padhaagaiyai uyarthi pidithiruppadhu pondru pugaippadam ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “vaakkalippeer irattai ilaikku” endru ezhudhappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thamizhaga makkal thinamdhorum endha oru achamindri sudhandhiramaaga vaazha vaakkalippeer irattai ilaikku” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thamizhaga sattamandra therdhal vaakkuppadhivu nadaiverum soozhalil, irattai ilai sinnathukku vaakkalikkumbadi rajinigaanth kooriyadhu pondru oru pugaippadathai palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Idhu unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediyavodhu, indha pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Koronaa paravalin podhu mezhuguvarthi endhi rajinigaanth alitha pugaippada posai edit seythu, irattai ilai sinnam penarai pidithiruppadhu pol maatriyiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
2020m aandil koronaavukku edhiraana poraattathil otrumaiyai velippaduthum vagaiyilum nambikkaiyai erpaduthum vagaiyilum min vilakkugalai anaithu, vilakkugalai etrumbadi Modi azhaippu viduthirundhaar. Appodhu thirai ulaga piramugargal, Tamil Nadu mudhalamaicharaaga irundha Edappadi Palaniswami matrum amaichargal ena anaivarum thangal veedugalil vilakketrinar.
Appodhu, “piradhamarin vendugolai etru nadigar rajinigaanth Chennai poyas kaardanil ulla thanadhu veettil manaivi ladhaavudan mezhuguvarthi etrinaar. Pinnar, rajinigaanth, thanadhu veettin munbu mezhuguvarthi etri kaiyil uyarthip pidithu nindru otrumaiyai velippaduthinaar” endru pugaippadathudan seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu.
Adhu mattumindri rajinigaanth vilakketriyadhan veediyovaiyum Thamizhaga tholaikkaatchi oodagangal veliyittirundhana. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda kaatchiyaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam koronaa kaalathu pugaippadathai eduthu, adhimuga-vukku vaakkalikkumbadi rajinigaanth azhaippu viduthadhu pondru vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Modi pirandha naalai munnittu roo.5000 parisu tharappadugiradhaa?
text:

investigation_details:

headline: Arasu inaiyadhalathai hek seytha OpenAI.. Vivarangal thirudappattadhaa?
text:
Seythiyaalar - M.meeraa
aasdhireliya arasin sugaadhaarath thagaval inaiyathalathil OpenAI niruvanam uruvaakkiya seyarkai nunnarivu (AI) Agent ondru anumadhiyindri nuzhaindhu, podhumakkalukkuk kidaikkakkoodiya matrum podhuvil veliyidappadaadha sila koppugalai anugiyadhaaga annaattu piradhamar aandani albanees therivithullaar. Indhas sambavam thodarbaaga tharpodhu thadayaviyal visaaranai nadaivetru varugiradhu.
Joon maadhathil indhas sambavam nadandhadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Services Australia amaippingeezh seyalbadum Medicare Statistics Reporting Service endra inaiyadhalathildhaan AI Agent anumadhiyatra anugalaip petradhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Indha thalam Medicare thodarbaana pullivivarangal, selavinangal ullitta mukkiyamaana pullivivarath thagavalgalai vazhangugiradhu.
Eninum, idhuvarai thaninavargalin maruthuva alladhu thanippatta thagavalgalaith thiruda muyandradhaaga aadhaarangal edhuvum kidaikkavillai ena albanees therivithullaar. Services Australia-vin ottumotha netvorkkilum periya alavilaana paadhippu erpattadharkaana aadhaaram illai endrum avar koorinaar. Adhevelaiyil, nadandha sambavam etrukkolla mudiyaadhadhu enavum kurippittaar.
Indha vivagaaram thodarbaaga OpenAI CEO saam aaltmenudan neradiyaaga pesiyadhaaga albanees therivithullaar. Sambavam kurithu arasukku thagaval therivikka OpenAI eduthukkonda kaaladhaamadham kurithu thanadhu emaatrathai velippaduthiyadhaaga albanees therivithullaar.
Indha sambavam joon maadhathileye nadandhirundhaalum, sepdambar 10aam thedhidhaan aasdhireliya arasukku OpenAI thagaval therivithadhaaga albanees kooriyullaar. Noyaaligalin vivarangal thirudappattanavaa enbadhu kurithum visaaranai thodarndhu nadaivetru varuvadhaagavum niruvanam kooriyulladhu.
