headline: Paakket unavu porutkalil echarikkai levil: thesa nalan karudhi mudivedukka Court valiyuruthal
text:
Pudhudilli:'naattu makkalin aarokkiyathil kavalai kolgirom. Kurippaaga kuzhandhaigalin udalnalam migavum mukkiyamaanadhu. Enave, paakket unavup porutkalil ulla adhiga uppu, sarkkarai matrum kozhuppu kurithu, echarikkum vagaiyil, munbakkathileye levilaaga achittu ottuvadhu thodarbaaga orunginaindha mudivu edukka vendum' ena, ucha Needhimandram arivuruthiyulladhu.
Naadu muzhudhum udal paruman podhu sugaadhaara pirasnaiyaaga uruveduthulladhu. Paakkettugalil adaithu vaikkappadum norukku theenigalil adhiga alavu uppu, sarkkarai matrum kozhuppu serkkappaduvadhaal, adhai virumbi vaangi unnum kuzhandhaigal mudhal periyavargal varai paadhikkappadugindranar.
Idhaith thodarndhu paakket unavugalil idambetrulla unavup porutkal patri therindhu kollavum, adhiga sarkkarai, uppu, kozhuppu irundhaal adhai patri echarikkai seyyavum nadavadikkai edukkappada vendum ena kori, ucha needhimandrathil podhunala manu thaakkal seyyappattadhu.
Immanuvai visaaritha ucha Needhimandram, paakket unavugalin munbakka mugappil echarikkai levil ottum muraiyai arimugam seyvadhil ep.es.es.e.ai., enappadum Indhiya unavu paadhugaappu matrum thara nirnaya aanaiyam thaamadham seythu varuvadhaaga adhirupdhi therivithirundhadhu.
Innilaiyil, ivvazhakku needhivadhigal je.pi.pardhivaalaa matrum vinoth sandhiran adangiya amarvil netru meendum visaaranaikku vandhadhu.
Appodhu needhivadhigal pirappitha utharavu:
thesa makkalin aarokkiyathil thaan adhiga kavalai kolgirom. Kurippaaga kuzhandhaigalin aarokkiyam kaakkappada vendiyadhu avasiyam. Enave, unavu paakkettin munbakka mugappil echarikkai levil ottum vivagaaram thodarbaaga, thesiya nalanai karuthil kondu sambandhappattavargal orunginaindha mudivai edukka vendum.
Ivvaaru needhivadhigal utharavittanar.
Idhai thodarndhu ep.es.es.e.ai.,kku sila kelvigalai needhivadhigal ezhuppinar. Adhil, 'paakket unavugalil ennenna porutkal kalakkappattullana endra vivarangal eppodhum pinburathil thaan achadikkappadugindrana. Nirnayikkappatta alavai vida uppu, sarkkarai, kozhuppu adhigamaaga irundhaal, adharkaana thelivaana vazhigaattudhalgalai aanaiyam vaguthulladhaa?' ena vinavinar.
Appodhu manudhaarar saarbil aajaraana mootha vazhakkarinjar thevadhath kaamath, ''kurgure pondra norukku theenigalaiyum, muttai, mundhiri pondra pondra oottachathu unavugalaiyum ore alavil arasu karudhugiradhu. Adhiga alavil padhappaduthappadum 'altraa piraasastu' unavugalukku kadumaiyaana echarikkai kuriyeedu avasiyam. Ithagaiya porutkalukku pirathyega nirathil echarikkai kuriyeedugalai vazhanga vendum,'' ena yosanai therivithaar.
Idhai padhivu seythu konda needhivadhigal, 'anaithu thuraiyinarum indha vivagaarathil theevira kavanam selutha vendum. Idhu thodarbaaga virivaana utharavu oriru thinangalil pirappikkappadum. Inaiyathalathil padhivetrappadum andha utharavai anaithu tharappinarum padithu, adutha visaaranaikku thayaaraaga vendum' ena koori, vazhakkai varum 28m thedhikku othivaithanar.

headline: Karnaadaga vangiyil kannadam pesiya islaamiya pennukku anumadhi marukkappattadhaa?
text:
‘’karnaadaga vangiyil kannadam pesiya islaamiya pennukku anumadhi marukkappattadhu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ karnaadaga vangiyil panavardhanai seyya oru islaamiya penmani vandhullaar avar kannada mozhiyil vangi pen aluvalaridam pesiyullaar. Aanaal vangi pen oozhiyaro kannadathil pesaadhe hindhiyil pesu ena vaakkuvaadhathil eeduvadum kaatchi.,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video-vin audio edit seyyappattulladhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, merkanda video-vil purgaa anindha islaamiya pendhaan indhiyil pesugiraar; matroru pen avarai kannadathil pesa solgiraar. Idhanbodhu iruvarukkum idaiye vaakkuvaadham erpattulladhu. Aanaal, aadiyovai maatri edit seythu, karnaadaga vangiyil panavarthanai seyya sendra islaamiya penmani kannadam pesiyadhai vangi adhigaari kandithadhaagak koori, vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Aduthappadiyaaga, indha sambavam nigazhndhadhu metro nilaiyathil; vangiyil nadakkavillai.
Melum, video-vil kaanappadum irandu pengalum metro payanigal. Vangi aluvalaro, vaadikkaiyaalaro illai.
Idhudhodarbaaga, palveru oodagangalilum erkanave seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
Hindustan Times l Deccan Herald l Financial Express
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video-vin audio edit seyyappattulladhu endrum, kurippitta islaamiya pendhaan indhiyil pesugiraar endrum, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Mumbaiyil vaaganangalil ‘I love Muhammad’ stikkar ottiya navargalai Police kaidhu seythanaraa?
text:
‘’mumbaiyil vaaganangalil ‘I love Muhammad’ stikkar ottiya islaamiyargalai Police kaidhu seythanar,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kurlaavil el.pi.es maarkkil valukkattaayamaaga pokkuvarathai niruthi, vaaganangalil “ai lav mugamadhu” endra stikkargalai ottiya muslim jihaadhigalukku mumbai kaavaldhurai *”sariyaana sigichai”* alikkiradhu 👌👏😃😂,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha veediyovukkum, ivargal koorum thagavalukkum endha thodarbum illai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, magaaraashdiraa maanilam, naasik nagaril kolaik kutravaali oruvar jaameenil velivandhullaar. Idhanai, avaradhu koottaaligal saalaiyil oorvalamaaga sendru kondaadiyullanar. Appodhu, kaiyil aayudhangaludan sendru, podhumakkalukku idaiyooru erpaduthiyullanar. Melum, idhudhodarbaana video kaatchigalai samooga oodagangal moolamaaga reels seythum ullanar.
Idhanberil, Nashik City Police kurippitta sambavathil thodarbudaiya 21 perai kaidhu seythu, avargalai podhu makkal paarkkum vagaiyil oorvalamaaga, adithu izhuthus sendranar.
Idhuvatri palveru oodagangalum erkanave seythi veliyittullana.
The Week l NDTV l Times of India
enave, veroru sambavam thodarbaana video ondrai eduthu, mumbaiyil vaaganangalil ‘I love Muhammad’ stikkar ottiya islaamiyargalai Police kaidhu seythadhaagak koori, vendumendre samooga valaidhalangalil vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Elaan mask matrum Trump udan sunidhaa villiyams sandhippu endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’elaan mask matrum Trump udan sunidhaa villiyams sandhippu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kuzhuvukku elaan mask paaraattu-adhivarukku nandri
vinveli veerargalai pathiramaaga azhaithuvandha Space X, naasaa kuzhuvukku elaan mask paaraattu
thittathukku munnurimai alitha America adhivar trambukku nandri,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. 
Pudhiya thalaimurai mattumindri munnani oodagangal palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu unmaiyaana pugaippadam kidaiyaadhu endrum, AI muraiyil thayaarikkappattadhu endru theriyavandhadhu.
Aam, kurippitta pugaippadathai utru kavanithaal, adhil nirkum elaan mask matrum tonaaldu Trump aagiyorin thotram avargaladhu unmaiyaana thotrathil irundhu mutrilum veruvatta ondraaga ulladhai, therindhugollalaam. Melum, idhil Grok endra vaattarmaark idambetrulladhu. Idhu elaan mask nadathum X samooga valaidhalathin saarbaaga, AI pugaippadangalai thayaarikka udhavum pudhiya seyali aagum.
Aduthappadiyaaga, elaan mask edhenum idhuvondra pugaippadathai thanadhu adhigaarappoorva X valaidhala pakkathil pagirndhullaaraa endru thediyavodhu, ivvaaru edhuvum pagiravillai, endru theriyavandhadhu. Idhu mattumindri sunidhaa villiyams, elaan mask, Trump ullittor neradiyaaga, sandhithuk kondadhaaga, indha aayvukkatturai veliyaagum indha nodi varaiyilum endha seythiyum kaana kidaikkavillai.
Idhu mattumindri, AI pugaippadangalai paguppaayvu seyyum Hive Moderation matrum sight engine ullittavatrin udhaviyudan kurippitta pugaippadam, unmaiyaanadhalla enbadhai urudhi seythullom.
Ivatrin adippadaiyil, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam, AI muraiyil thayaarikkappatta ondrudhaan, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kavalaiyalikkum velai vaayppinmai.. 9 kodi ilainjargal paadhippu - nidhi aayok adhirchith thagaval!!
text:
Mathiya arasingeezh ulla nidhi aayok amaippu veliyittulla aayvarikkaiyil, India-vil ulla sumaar 600 maavattangalil 15 mudhal 29 vayadhukkutbatta ilainjargalidam indha aayvu merkollappattadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu. Idhil, 250 maavattangalil 25 sadhaveedhathukkum adhigamaanor kalvi, velaivaayppu alladhu endhavidhamaana thiran payitsiyum peraamal avadhippattu varuvadhu theriyavandhulladhu. Naadu muzhuvadhum ottumothamaaga ettu kodiye 70 latcham ilainjargal idhanaal paadhikkappattulladhaaga nidhi aayok aayvarikkai suttikkaattiyulladhu.
Thenmaanilangalai vida vadamaanilangalil indha paadhippugal adhigarithu kaanappaduvadhu theriyavandhulladhu. Kurippaaga pigaar, uthara piradhesam, hariyaanaa, panjjaap, merku vangam aagiya maanilangalil adhiga ilainjargal avadhiyutru varuvadhaagavum, moondril irandu pangu ilainjargal, indha maanilangalil paadhippai sandhithu varuvadhaagavum therivikkappattulladhu. Satheesgaril ulla kavirdham , raajnanthgaavan, uthar pasdhar kangar aagiya maavattangal, himaachala piradhesathin sambaa maavattam, keralaavin ernaagulam, mathiya piradhesathin maantlaa aagiya maavattangalilum, kuraindha ennikkaiyilaana ilainjargale paadhikkappattulladhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Naattileye migak kuraivaana alavaaga 4.1 sadhaveedha ilainjargal mattume odishaavin navarangboor maavattathil paadhikkappattullanar. Kalvith thagudhikkum velaivaayppukkum idaiye ulla periya idaiveli matrum koodudhal payitsi pera ulla nidhi nerukkadi pondravaiye idharku mukkiya kaaranangalaaga paarkkappadugiradhu. Valarchiyadaindha indhiyaavai uruvaakkuvadharku indha manidhavalap patraakkuraiyaik kalaindhu, maanavargalukkum ilainjargalukkum maaniya vilaiyil thiran payitsigalaiyum, ulloor thevaigalukku erpa velaivaayppugalaiyum suyadhozhil vaayppugalaiyum uruvaakka vendum ena andha arikkai parindhuraikkiradhu.

headline: America-vukku arasu murai payanam; China adhivar jinbingai vimaana nilaiyathil varaverkiraar adhivar Trump
text:
Vaashingdan: America-vukku arasu murai payanam merkolla ulla China adhivar shee jinbingai neril varaverka America adhivar tonaaldu Trump vimaana nilaiyam sellavullaar.
Nam andai naadaana China-vin adhivar shee jinbing, adutha vaaram arasu murai payanamaaga America sella ullaar. China thalaivar oruvar, 10 aandugalukku pin merkollum mudhal arasu murai payanam idhuvaagum. Idharkaaga varum, 23l vaashingdan arugil ulla jaayint pes aantroos vimaana thalathil vandhirangum jinbingai neril varaverka Trump sella ulladhaaga mootha adhigaarigal therivithanar.
Vellai maaligaiyil nadakkum varaverpu nigazhchiyilum, Trump matrum avaradhu manaivi melaniyaa aagiyor jinbing matrum avaradhu manaivi peng liyuvaan aagiyorai varaverkindranar. Melum, iru tharappu uravu matrum varthagam kurithu irunaattu thalaivargalum vellai maaligaiyil kalandhuraiyaadugindranar.
Vazhakkamaaga vellai maaligaiyil vaithe, America adhivargal, velinaattu thalaivargalai sandhippadhu vazhakkam. Aanaal, vazhakkathirku maaraaga vimaana nilaiyam sendru China adhivarai varaverka Trump thittamittullaar.

headline: Etrivitta eni samuthirakkaniyai etti udhaitha sooryaa endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’etrivitta eni samuthiraganiyai etti udhaitha sithirakkullan sooryaa’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ indha koothaadi sooryaa paya vaangura adiya paathu ini evanum DMK sombu Stand edukkave payappadanum .
Etrivitta eni samuthiraganiyai etti udhaitha sithirakkullan sooryaa kudumbathirku thagundha paadam pugatta purakkanippom retro padathai!!
Sinimaavila niraiya per vayitrerichalai vaangi kattikkonda sel thatti sivagumaar kudumbam!!
#BoycottRetro
#retrodisaster,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan samuthirakkani pesuvadhu pondra video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Meendum orumurai kurippitta video-vai muzhumaiyaagap paarthom.
Adhil, ‘’appa nee sinimaavaiyum konnuttu, ellaathaiyum kaali pannittu, vera engayo pora. Haa haa haa… (thoguppaalini idaiye kurukkittu, neengale ivvalavu emoshanal aagureenga endru ketkiraar) aamaa. Romba vedhanaiyaa irundhuchu. Ennaa, naanga rendu perum idhuvaraikkum ennenna pesirukkom, eppadi pazhagirukkom, naan enna pannirukkan, avaru ennavellaam pannirukkaaru. Idhellaam naan pakkathula irundhu paathavan. (thoguppaalini meendum kurukkittu, adhenna saar vanmamaa, endru ketkiraar) adhenna endre theriyavillai. Adhu enakku ondrume puriyavillai. Enna solvadhendre theriyavillai. Andha manidhan vaazhndha aram irukkulla. Avar oru arathodu vaazhndhaar illa, avar vandhu samoogathirku ennallaam senjjirukkaar, ethana pera padikka vachirukkaar, adhellaam ennaaguradhu endra kelvi varudhu illaiyaa, avara ninaichuthaan naan romba varuthappatten. Vedhanaippatten. Varuvaaru peeniks maadhiri ezhundhirichi varuvaaru,’’ endru samuthirakkani pesiyullaar.
Idhanbadi, samuthirakkani pesuvadhil, mudhal sila nodigal mattum kettaal, sooryaa thannai emaatriyadhuvola, avar kurippiduvadhaaga, ninaikkath thondrugiradhu. Aanaal, muzhu veediyovaiyum kettaal, samuthirakkani, sooryaavai vimarsippavargalai patriye aadhangam therivippadhaaga, unara mudigiradhu. Idhanmoolamaaga, samuthirakkani engeyum sooryaa thannai emaatrivittadhaagak kooravillai enbadhu namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Muzhu video lingk keezhe inaikkappattulladhu.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, naam samuthirakkani tharappilum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, arasiyal ulnokkathudan vendumendre, samuthirakkani SS Music oodagathirku alitha pettiyai muzhumaiyaagak ketkaamal, oru pagudhiyai mattum edit seythu, samooga valaidhalangalil parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Salem: meen kadaiyil neer kaagam iraichi virpanai; athumeerum vettai kumbal... Adhirchi pinnani!
text:
Salem maavattathil neer kaagangalaiyum vittu vaikkaamal vettaiyaadi iraichiyai virpanai seythu varum vettai kumbalin athumeeral sambavam adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Salem maavattam, sangagiri arugil ulla konerippatti akrahaaram pagudhiyil ulla oru meen kadaiyil neer kaagam ( Cormorant) iraichi virpanai seyyappattu varuvadhaaga vanathuraikku ragasiya thagaval kidaithirukkiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil andha pagudhikkus sendra vanathuraiyinar, meen kadaigalil aayvu merkondadhil oru kadaiyil 24 neer kaagangalaik kondru iraichikkaaga vaithiruppadhaik kandarindhullanar. Paadhugaakkappada vendiya paravai inathai vettaiyaadiya sasigumaar endra ilainjanai kaidhu seythu visaaranai merkondu varugindranar. Sasigumaaridam irundha neer kaagangalin iraichiyai parimudhal seythu azhithullanar.
Idhu kurithu therivitha vanathuraiyinar, "konerippatti perej saalai matrum adhanai ottiya kaaviri aatrup pagudhigalil neer kaagangal adhiga alavil irukkindrana. Indha neer kaagangalai oru kumbal ragasiyamaaga valaivirithup pidippadhu, vishap porulgalai payanbaduthi vettaiyaaduvadhu pondra thodar athumeeral seyalgalil eeduvattu varugindranar. Vettaiyaadappadum neer kaagangalin tholai urithu iraichiyaaga virpanai seythu varugindranar. Neer kaagangal pondra kaattup paravaigalai vettaiyaaduvadhum, adhan iraichiyai virpanai seyvadhum kadumaiyaana kutramaagum. Podhumakkal thangalukkuth therindha idangalil idhu pondra neer paravaigal vettaiyaadappattaalo alladhu iraichi virkappattaalo udanadiyaaga arugil ulla vanathuraikko alladhu unavup paadhugaapputh thuraikko thagaval therivikkavum. Vettaiyil eeduvatta sasigumaar meedhu vanappaadhugaappu sattathin keezh vazhakkuvadhivu seyyappattulladhu " endranar.

headline: “en vetrikkuk kaaranam en kaadhalidhaan” endru M.K. Stalin koorinaaraa?
text:
En vetrikkuk kaaranam en kaadhalidhaan endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaagavum adhan adippadaiyil paathimaa paavu pugaippadathudan pudhiya thalaimurai news card veliyittadhaaga oru padhivu

pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittadhu pondru M.K. Stalin – paathimaa paavu ondraaga iruppadhu pondra pugaippadathudan news card ondru samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu. Adhil, “en vetrikku kaaranam en kaadhalidhaan – mudhalvar mu.ka.staalin” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Mudhalamaichar mu.ka.staalinudan TV seythi vaasippaalaraaga irundhu nadigaiyaaga maariya paathimaa paavuvai inaithu 35-40 aandugalukkum melaaga vadhandhi parappappattu varugiradhu. Idhu patri iruvarume vilakkam alithuvittanar. Ennaip patri naan solvadhudhaan unmai endru paathimaa paavu kaattamaagave padhil alithuvittaar. Aanaalum, adhai naangal nambamaattom endru vishamigal thodarndha vadhandhi parappi varugindranar. Idhu thodarbaaga nammudaiya fekt kirasandovil 2019m aande katturai veliyittirundhom.
Indha vadhandhi thodarbaaga paathimaa paavu alitha vilakkathai 2018m aandil thinamani veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil, “thoordharshanil seythi vaasippaalaraaga irundha samayathil orumurai naan sithirappaavai enum thodaril nadikka oppuk kondirundhen. Thoordharshan vazhakkappadi seeriyal mudiyum varai enakku seythi vaasikka vaayppu alikkappadavillai. Andha idaiveliyil ennais seythi vaasippaalaraagak kaana mudiyaadha kaaranathaal ippadi oru vadhandhiyai parappiyirukkiraargal. Sithirappaavai thodar 13 vaarangalil mudindhadhum naan meendum seythi vaasippaalaraagath thodarndhen.
Thirumanathirku munbe en kanavaraana paavu thaan ennai thoordharshan aluvalagathukku azhaithus selvadhum, veettukku thirumba azhaithus selvadhumaaga irundhaar. Appadiyirukkaiyil ippadi oru vadhandhi eppadi paraviyadhu, parappappattadhu endru enakkup puriyavillai. Naan appodhum, ippodhum ennai ivvishayamaaga visaarikkum enadhu nanbargalukku mele sonna kaaranathaith thaan vilakkamaaga alithu varugiren.
Adhai nambuvadhum, nambaadhadhum avaravar paadu. Aanaal, idhan kaaranamaaga oru katchiyin seyaldhalaivaraagap pattavarin kerakdaraik kolai seyvadhu thavaru. Naan vilakkam alitha piragum silar adhe vadhandhiyai unmai polak koori avaradhu narpeyarukkuk kalanga vilaivippaargalaanaal adhaip patri naan ondrum solvadharkillai. Ennaip patri naan solvadhu thaan unmai, adhaith thaan neengal namba vendum. Adhai vittu vittu veliyil palarum kadhai kattuvadhaip pola masaalaa thadaviya karpanaip poyyaithaan nambuveergal endraal, adhaip patri enakkuk kavalai illai. Adhu ungal ishdam. Idharku mel idhaip patri kelvi vandhaal naam padhil solvadhaaga illai” endru kooriyirundhaar.
Indha nilaiyil, en vetrikkuk kaaranam en kaadhali endru M.K. Stalin kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Ippadi padhividuvavargal yaar endru paarkkum podhu adhu oru pudhiya katchiyais saarndhavargal enbadhu therindhadhu. Paarkkum podhe indha news card poliyaanadhu endru therindhadhu. Aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyya aayvu seythom.
Ippadi oru news card-ai pudhiya thalaimurai veliyittirundhadhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu, 2025 tisambaril “en vetrikku kaaranam en manaividhaan – mudhalvar mu.ka.staalin” endru kurippittu news card-ai veliyittirundhadhu therindhadhu. Andha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraagap padhivittiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Idhai melum urudhiseyya pudhiya thalaimurai digital poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Melum, indha poliyaana news card migavum keezhtharamaaga ulladhu. Adhanaal engal samooga oodaga pakkangalil veliyittuvittu adhai agatrivittom. WhatsApp sandhaadhaarargalukku mattum idhai anuppiyullom” endru koori adhai namakkum anuppinaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pandrikku poonool podum poraattam sameevathil nadandhadhaa?
text:
Pandrikku poonool podum poraattathai thi.ka nadathiyadhu endru oru padhivu

pandriyudan oruvar irukkum pugaippadathai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilaith thagavalil, “pandrikku poonool pottu thiga poraattam… idhukku edhukkudaa pandriyai kodumaivaduthureenga,avanukke pottu vitrukkalaam.. Poruthamaa irundhirukkum” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thiraavidar kazhagam saarbil sameevathil pandrikku poonool aniyum poraattam nadathiyadhu pondru samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, appadi endha poraattamum nadandhadhu pondru seythi illai. Madha nambikkaiyai kochaippaduthivittadhaaga ivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Pira madhathinaraiyum idhai vaithu vimarsithu varugindranar. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, ettu aandugalukku munbu indha seythi veliyaagi iruppadhu therindhadhu. 2017m aandu aagast maadham 7m thedhi indha seythi matrum pugaippadathai on India thamizhil veliyittirundhadhu. Adhil thandhai poiyaar thiraavidar kazhagam saarbil pandrigalukku poonool anivithu poraattam nadathuvadhaaga irundhadhu. Mirugavadhaith thadais sattathin keezh thandhai periyaar thiraavidar kazhagathais saarndha 9 per meedhu vazhakkup padhivu seyyappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Poraattathil eeduvattavargal thiraavidar kazhagathais saarndhavargal illai. 2012m aandil thi.ka-vil irundhu silar pirindhu thodangiyadhudhaan periyaar thiraavidar kazhagam. Enave, thi.ka pandrigalukku poonool anivikkum poraattam nadathiyadhu endru kooruvadhe thavaraanadhu. Melum 2017m aandu nadandha sambavathai eduthu 2025l sameevathil nadandhadhu pondru thavaraaga padhivittullanar. Idhan moolam unmaiyai maraithu thavaraana thagavalai parappi iru tharappinaridaiye modhalai thoondum vagaiyil padhivittiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu.

headline: Vijay aatchiyil min kambiyil thongi vilaiyaadum ilainjargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Vijay aatchiyin uyar azhutha min kambiyil thongi vilaiyaadum ilainjargal endru oru video

neernilaikkul amaikkappatta uyar azhutha mingambiyil ilainjargal palarum thongi vilaiyaadum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “tey shaak adikka povudhudaa..⚡ podaa vennai…. Yaar aatchi nadakkudhu theriyumaa? Naam vijaynnaa aatchi…… karant ellaa varaadhu thairiyamaa vilaiyaadu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil TVK aatchi amaindha piragu pala idangalil minvettu erpattu varugiradhu. Indha minvettu kaaranamaaga min kambigalil thongi ilainjargal vilaiyaadugindranar endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha video Tamil Naattil engu, eppodhu edukkappattadhu endru endha oru thagavalum illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu pala maadhangalaagave indha video samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Palarum peegaaril indha video edukkappattadhaaga kurippittirundhanar. Sila seythi oodagangalilum kooda peegaaril mazhai vella paadhippu kaaranamaaga migapperiya alavil minvettu nilavi varugiradhu. Indha soozhalil min kambigalil thongi ilainjargal vilaiyaadinar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum 2025 sepdambar 22m thedhiyil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Indha video peegaarais saarndhadhu endru palarum kurippittirundhanar. Aanaal, engu edukkappattadhu endru yaarum padhividavillai. Enave, indha video peegaarais saarndhadhudhaan enbadhai nammaal urudhi seyya mudiyavillai. Aanaal, 2025 sepdambaril indha video veliyaagi iruppadhu urudhiyaagi ulladhu.
2026 me maadham thaan Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam aatchikku vandhadhu. 2025l ellaam DMK thaan aatchiyilirundhadhu. Enave, indha video TVK aatchiyil edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil Vijay aatchiyil min kambiyil thongi vilaiyaadum ilainjargal endru paravum video thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ini minsaara kattanathai inaiyavazhiyil seluthalaam endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Ini minsaara kattanathai inaiya vazhiyil seluthalaam endru Polimer TV veliyittadhu pondru oru news card

Polimer seythigal veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “ini minsaara kattanathai inaiya vazhiyil seluthalaam ena arivippu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil mundhaiya ADMK, DMK aatchikkaalangalil nadaimuraikku vandha thittangalai ellaam TVK aatchikku vandha piragu arimugam seythadhu pondru seythigal veliyaagi varugindrana. Idhai vaithu TVK arasai kindal seyyum vagaiyil pala padhivugal samooga oodagangalil padhividappattu varugindrana.
Andha vagaiyil minsaara kattanathai inaiyathil seluthalaam endru Tamil Nadu arasu arivithadhu pondru oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Andha news card-il Tamil Nadu arasu arivithadhu endru illai. Melum adhil me 18, 2026 endru irundhadhu. Enave, andha kurippitta thedhiyil Polimer tivi-yil ippadi seythi veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appadi endha oru news kaardum namakku kidaikkavillai. Adhe nerathil indha news card-ai naangal veliyidavillai endru Polimer seythigal veliyittirundha padhivu namakku kidaithadhu.
Indha seythiyin pinnani patri ariya thodarndhu aayvu seythom. Appodhu me 17, 2026 andru thinamalar veliyittirundha seythi ondru namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil idhuvarai aanlainil ovvoru muraiyum panam katti varugirom, ini thaaniyangi muraiyil pil thayaaraanadhilirundhu 10vadhu naalil nammudaiya vangik kanakku, kiredit card-il irundhu neradiyaaga panam minsaara vaariyathirku seluthum vagaiyil pudhiya vasadhi arimugam seyyappattulladhu endru adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nammudaiya kiredit kaart, indarnet, tholaivesi kattanam ullitta palavatril ippadi kurippitta naalil thaaniyangi muraiyil panam seluthum vasadhi ulladhu. Andha vasadhiyai tharpodhu min kattanathilum arimugam seyyappattulladhaaga veliyaana seythiyai vishamathamaaga maatri samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thiruppadhi koyilil mottai aditha nayandhaaraa endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘thiruppadhi koyilil mottai aditha nayandhaaraa,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ thiruppadhi koyilla mottai adithukkonda nayandhaaraa,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha epral 9, 2026 andru nayandhaaraa matrum viknesh sivan aagiyor thiruppadhi sendradhaaga, oodagangalil seythi veliyidappattirundhadhu. Adhudhodarbaana pugaippadam ondrai eduthu, ivvaaru edit seythu parappugiraargal.
Muzhu video-vai inge matrum inge kaanalaam.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
aduthappadiyaaga, wasitai, hive moderation pondra AI sarivaarppu inaiyadhalangal udhaviyudan merkanda pugaippadathai aayvu seythavodhu, idhu AI moolamaaga edit seyyappattulladhaaga, urudhiyaanadhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam edit seyyappatta ondru, ena sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: "edharkeduthaalum DMK engal meedhu kutramsumathugiradhu!" - amaichar ramesh vimarsanam
text:
"arasiyalil edharkeduthaalum DMK engalai kutram sumathugiradhu" endru amaichar ramesh therivithullaar.
Thamizhaga indhu samaya aranilaiyathurai amaichar ramesh, thiruchiyil seythiyaalargalai sandhithu pesinaar. Appodhu avar,
"Trichy maavattathil tharpodhaiya nilavarappadi motham 590 palligalil kaalai unavuth thittam migas sirandha muraiyil seyalbaduthappattu varugiradhu. Idhan moolam, 63,157 palli maanavargal thinasarip payan petru varugindranar. Ezhai, eliya maanavargalin nalanaik karuthil kondu indha arasu ithittathais sirappaaga seyalbaduthi varugiradhu. Thiruvarangathil nadaivetrulla roo.50 kodi madhippilaana koyil nila avagarippu mosadi vazhakkil arasu theevira nadavadikkai eduthu varugiradhu. Indha nila mosadip pinnaniyil oyvuvetra munnaal needhiyarasaro alladhu saar padhivaalaro, yaaraaga irundhaalum sari, sattam than kadamaiyais seyyum. Thavaru seythavargal ethagaiya uyar padhaviyil irundhaalum avargal meedhu kadum nadavadikkai edukkappadum enbadhil maatrukkaruthillai. Sameevathil nadaivetra Madurai meenaatchi amman koyil kumbaavishega vizhaavin podhu, latchakkanakkaana pakdhargal endhavidhap paaguvaadumindri podhu varisaiyil nindru migavum amaidhiyaana muraiyil suvaami tharisanam seythanar. Kumbaavishega nigazhchiyaith thuraiyin amaichar endra muraiyil naane munnindru nadathinen. Avvaaru irukkumbodhu, nirvaagathai vazhinadathum naangal evvaaru podhu vazhiyil sendru tharisikka mudiyum?. Idhanais silar thevaiyindri sarchaiyaakka muyalgindranar. Arasiyalil edharkeduthaalum kutram sumathum thi.mu.ka-vinarukku aappilukkum, aaranjjukkum ulla vithiyaasam koodath therivadhillai.
M.K. Stalin thanadhu kolathoor thogudhikku evvidha narpanigalaiyum seyyavillai. Thogudhi makkalin adhirupdhi matrum aruvaruppaana seyalbaadugalin kaaranamaagave, kolathoor thogudhi makkale kadandha therdhalil staalinaith thorkadithullanar. Sattamandrak koottathodaril Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathinar paadum paattaiye Udhayanidhi staalinum thirumbath thirumbak koori varugiraar. Sattamandrak koottathodar nadakkum podhu Udhayanidhi Stalin ozhungaagath thanadhu irukkaiyil amarndhu kavanithirundhaal, yaar yaar endhendhath thuraikku amaichargalaagap poruppu vagikkiraargal enbadhu avarukkuth therindhirukkum. Aanaal, avar kilaasai kat adithuvittu sendruvidugiraar. Appadi irukkumbodhu, avarukku endha amaichar endhath thurai endru eppadith theriyavarum?" endru koorinaar.

headline: Nevaalathukku vandha sodhanai.. Aduthaduthu kulungiya nilam.. Meendum ulukkiya iyarkai!
text:
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
imayamalaiyil ulla panippaarai urugiyadhaal, kadandha aagastu 26-aam thedhi andru nevaalathin koshi aatrilum, thirisooli aatrilum migapperiya vellam erpattadhu. 50 ekkar parappalavu konda panippaarai urugi, 300 km vegathil mini sunaami pol vandha indha vellathil sikki, 1300-kkum merpattor uyirizhandhiruppadhudan, 5 aayirathirkum merpattor maayamaagiyullanar.
Nevaalathil erpatta vellathaal, China-vin kattuppaattil ulla thiveth pagudhiyilum, indhiyaavilum paadhippugal erpattulladhu. Kurippaaga, India-vin peegaar, utharappiradhesam, utharagaant aagiya maanilangalilum, nevaala vellathin thaakkam edhirolithirundhadhu. Ippadi maaverum azhivai erpaduthiyulla indha peridar nadandhu 14 naatkal aagiyulla nilaiyilum, maayamaanavargalai meetkum pani thodarndhu nadaivetru varugiradhu.
Innilaiyil, erkenave iyarkaiyin korathaal paadhikkappattulla nevaalathil, meendum matror iyarkaip peridar erpattulladhu. Adhaavadhu, nevaalathin vadamerkup pagudhiyil amaindhulla musdhaang maavattathil, netru iravu 10 mani alavil, 5.3 rikdaril nilanadukkam erpattulladhu. Indha nilanadukkathin adhirvugal, andai maavattangal silavatrilum unarappattadhaagas sollappadugiradhu. Thesiya nilanadukka kangaanippu matrum aaraaychi maiyathin thagavalgalinbadi, kaathmaandil irundhu vadamerke 375 kilomeettar tholaivil ulla musdhaang maavattathin lomandhaang pagudhiye idhan maiyamaagum.
Indha nilanadukkathaal, uyirchedhamo alladhu porutchedhamo erpattadhaaga udanadiyaaga endhath thagavalum veliyaagavillai. Eninum, manaang, tolbaa matrum miyaakdi (Myagdi) aagiya maavattangalilum nilanadukkathin adhirvugal unarappattana. Nilanadukkangal, theevira vaanilai nigazhvugalaal elidhil paadhikkappadakkoodiya naadaana nevaalathil, indhas sameevathiya nilanadukkam makkalidaiye melum achathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Netru iravu erpatta indha nilanadukkathaith thodarndhu adhigaariga nilaimaiyai madhippittu varugindranar.

headline: Jananaayagan padam inaiyathil veliyaanadharku DMK aidi ving kaaranam endru paravum niyoosgaardu unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘jananaayagan padam inaiyathil veliyaanadharku DMK aidi ving kaaranam,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ veliyaana jananaayagan. Adhirchi thagaval. Jananaayagan padam netru iravu inaiyathil veliyaanadhukku pinnaal DMK aidi ving serndha navargaldhaan kaaranam endru theriya vandhulladhu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda niyoosgaardu unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta niyoosgaardu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, unmaiyaana niyoosgaardil, ‘’veliyaana jananaayagan. ‘jananaayagan’ muzhu padamum inaiyathil veliyaanadhaal padakkuzhuvinar adhirchi. Padathin 5 nimida kaatchigal netru inaiyathil veliyaagi irundha nilaiyil tharpodhu 3 mani nera muzhu padamum veliyaanadhaal paravarappu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, News Tamil 24X7 oodagam maruppu veliyittulladhaik kandom. Adhanaiyum inge inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda niyoosgaardu thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Raagul kaandhi kaidhu seyyappattadhai kandithu Congress rail mariyal endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Neet thervukku edhirppu therivithu maanavargal nadathum poraattathil pangetra raagul kaandhi kaidhu seyyappattadhai kandithu Tamil Nadu Congress saarbil rail mariyal poraattam nadathappattadhaaga oru pugaippadam

Tamil Nadu Congress kamitti munnaal thalaivar ke.es.azhagiri matrum silar rail thandavaalathin meedhu nindru rail mariyalil eeduvatta pugaippadam threads.com-l padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “raagulgaandhi kaidhukku irayil mariyal poraattam… thamizhnaade adhirndhadhu….. ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Telliyil ‘neet’ thervu muraigedu matrum ilainjargal meedhu thaakkudhal nadandha vivagaarathil, piradhamar Modi padhavi vilagakkori Congress thalaivar raagul kaandhi poraattam perani nadathinaar. Piradhamar illam nokki peraniyaaga sendravargalai kaaval thuraiyinar kaidhu seythanar. Raagul kaandhiyaip palavandhamaaga izhuthus sendru perundhil etriyavodhu erpatta thallumulluvil avaradhu mookkil kaayamum, kan matrum nenjjup pagudhiyil lesaana kaayangalum erpattadhaagavum mookkil irundhu ratham vandhadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu.
Raagul kaandhi kaidhu seyyappattadhai kandithu Tamil Naattil Congress katchiyinar thideer rail mariyalil eeduvattadhaaga naangu per mattum thandavaalathin meedhu nirkum pugaippadathai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Sila aandugalukku munbu edukkappatta indha pugaippadathai tharpodhaiya sambavathudan thodarbuppaduthi palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha pugaippadam 2023m aandu veliyaagi irundhadhu therindhadhu. Piradhamar narendhira Modi kurithu avamadhikkum vidhamaaga karuthukkalaith therivitha raagul kaandhikku kujaraath maanilam soorath Needhimandram 2 aandugal siraith thandanai vadhithadhu. Idhaik kandikkum vagaiyil appodhu Tamil Nadu Congress kamitti thalaivaraaga irundha ke.es.azhagiri matrum moondru per kumbagonam rail nilaiyathil thideerendru rail mariyalil eeduvattanar. Avargalidam Police pechu vaarthai nadathi kalaindhu poga seythanar. Avargal meedhu Police vazhakkup padhivu seythullanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Melum indha poraattathai appodhu Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivaraaga irundha annaamalaiyum vimarsithu thannudaiya samooga oodaga pakkangalil padhivittirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu. Moondru perudan rail mariyalil eeduvattadhu en endru ke.es.azhagiri alithirundha vilakkamum namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil, “kumbagonathirku thirumana nigazhvukku sellum podhu rail nilaiyathil kaathirundhen. Appodhu thagudhi neekkam kuritha thagaval vandha podhu 4 perudan rail mariyal poraattathil eeduvatten” endru kooriyirundhaar.
Idhan moolam 2023m aandil raagul kaandhikku sirai thandanai vazhangappattavodhu nadandha rail mariyal sambavathin pugaippadathai, 2026l neet edhirppu poraattathin raagul kaandhi kaidhu seyyappattadharku edhirppu therivithu Congress katchi saarbil rail mariyal nadathappattadhu endru thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ji.ti.pi., adutha 20 aandugalil roo.3,646 latcham kodiyaaga uyarum: thesiya paadhugaappu aalosagar thoval nambikkai
text:
Roorkki: “nam naattin, ji.ti.pi., enappadum motha ulnaattu urpathi, adutha 20 aandugalil, 3,646 latcham kodi roobaayaaga uyarum,” ena, thesiya paadhugaappu aalosagar ajith thoval therivithullaar.
Utharagant maanilathin roorkkiyil ulla ai.ai.ti.,yil pattamalippu vizhaa netru nadandhadhu. Idhil, sirappu virundhinaraaga nam naattin thesiya paadhugaappu aalosagar ajith thoval pangetru pesiyadhaavadhu:
nam naattil, migapperiya maatrangal nigazhndhu varugindrana. Oru sirappaana edhirgaalathai nokki naam nagarndhu kondirukkirom. Maanavargal, oru maatrathai uruvaakkum kaalakkattathil vaazhvadhu adhirshdam; avargalin edhirgaalam migundha nambikkaikkuriyadhaaga ulladhu. Tharpodhu, nam naattin motha ulnaattu urpathi, 385.18 latcham kodi roobaayaaga ulladhu. Idhu, adutha 20 aandugalil, 3,646 latcham kodi roobaayaaga uyarum.
Kadandha kaalap poraattangalaip pol indri, eraalamaana vaayppugalaik konda adhirshdasaaligalaaga tharpodhaiya thalaimurai thigazhgiradhu. Idhu thozhilnutbam, poriyiyal matrum puthaakkathin kaalam; idhu samooga valarchiyai munneduthus selgiradhu. Maanavargal, thangal vaazhkkaiyil thunichalaaga irukka vendum. Oru thalaivaraaga uruvedukka, mudivedukkum thiranum, oru kolgaiyaiyum uruvaakkik kolvadhu avasiyam.
Sikkimil, aarambagaalathil naan paniyaatriya podhu imayamalaiyil vaazhum pazhangudi inathais serndha oruvar enakku vaazhkkaikkaana moondru mandhirangalai katruth thandhaar. Adhu, ippodhu naam enge irukkirom; engu sella vendum; angu sendru thirumbuvadharkaana paadhaiyai arivadhu aagiyavai aagum.
Ivvaaru avar pesinaar.

Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu News 7 Tamil oodagathin peyaril pagirappadum poliyaana news card, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhuvatri News 7 Tamil oodagathin digital pirivu nirvaagiyai thodargondu vilakkam kettom. Avar,’’idhanai naangal veliyidavillai. Idhudhodarbaaga, engaladhu X samooga valaidhala pakkathil maruppu therivithullom,’’ endraar.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, TVK, podhus seyalaalar aananth, aluvalagathai thodarbu kondu pesinom. Avargalum, ‘’idhu thavaraana seythi, engal katchiyai keli seyvadharkaaga, edhirkkatchigal ivvaaru vadhandhi parappugiraargal. Idhanai TVK thondargalum unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share seyvadhu vedhanaiyaaga ulladhu,’’ endru therivithanar.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card, unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kambar pirandha ooril ulla avaradhu veettin indraiya nilai endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:

idhil, ‘’ #kamban veettu kattuthariyum kavi paadum’ enbaargal. Aanaal #mayilaadudhuraikku arugil ulla avar pirandha #therazhundhooril indru avaradhu veedum illai, kavivaada kattuthariyum illai.⚜️🚩
kambar pirandha idamaaga indhiyath tholliyal
thurai mulveliyittu adaiyaalappaduthi ulla idam” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval, ena theriyavandhadhu. Aam, ivargal parappum pugaippadam therazhundhooril ulla aamaruvip perumaal koyilukku sondhamaana vasandha mandavathin pazhaiya padam. Aanaal, andha idam erkanave seeramaikkappattuvittadhu.
Idhuvatri Tamil Nadu arasin adhigaarappoorva fektchek kuzhu (TN Factcheck) sambandhappatta aamaruvip perumaal koyil nirvaagathidam pesi urudhippaduthiyulladhu.
Idhu mattumindri, therazhundhooril ulla kambar medu (veedu irundha idam) matrum kambar kottam aagiya idangalin tharpodhaiya pugaippadangalaiyum TN Factcheck veliyittulladhu.
Irudhiyaaga, therazhundhooril vasikkum navar oruvar sambandhappatta idathirku neril sendru, video eduthu padhivittullaar. Adhanaiyum keezhe aadhaarathirkaaga, inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadathirkum, kambar veedu irundha idathirkum endha sambandhamum illai endru, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Russia nilanadukkam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Russia-vil erpatta nilanadukkam endru kurippittu selbon kadai ondru urukkulaindhu pogum sisidivi kaatchi

nilanadukkam kaaranamaaga selbon kadai ondru urukkulaindha video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “rashyaavin kizhakku kadarkarai pagudhiyil thideerena sakdhi vaayndha nilanadukkam erpattadhu. Idhanaiyaduthu Russia, jappaanai sunaami alaigal thaakkiyullana. Sunaamikku payandhu makkal uyirai kaiyil pidithukkondu paadhugaappaana idangalil thanjjamadaindhullanar.
Russia-vil erpatta nilanadukkam kurithu mudhalil Japan nilanadukka aayvu maiyamdhaan arivippai veliyittadhu. Nilanadukkam sakdhi vaayndhadhaaga iruppadhaal sunaami echarikkaiyum vidukkappattirundhadhu. Echarithadhai polave pala idangalai sunaami thaakkiyulladhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Russia-vin kizhakku kadarkaraiyil 8.8 rikdar alavilaana nilanadukkam erpattadhu. Adhaith thodarndhu, pasivik perungadal muzhuvadhum sunaami echarikkai vidukkappattulladhu. Indha nilaiyil Russia nilanadukkam endru samooga oodagangalil pala video-kkal pagirappattu varugindrana. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil, indha video Russia-vil edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Aanaal, Russia-vil nilanadukkam erpattadhu endru kurippittiruppadhan moolam idhu Russia-vil erpatta nilanadukkam endru makkal karudhum vagaiyil ulladhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video thelivillaamal ulladhu. Enave, adhil ulla thedhiyai sariyaaga kaana mudiyavillai. Enave, video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, samooga oodagangalil indru (joolai 30, 2025) Russia nilanadukkam endru kurippittu palarum indha video-vai padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Video-vil irukkum pennaip paarkkum podhu China pen polath therindhadhaal thodarndhu thedinom.
Appodhu, 2025 maars maadham irudhiyil idhe video-vai oruvar YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Adhil, miyaanmar – China ellaiyil erpatta nilanadukkathin kaatchi endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Kadandha 2025 maars maadham miyaanmar, thaaylaandhu, China-vin sila pagudhigalil nilanadukka paadhippu erpattirundhadhu. Appodhu miyaanmaril ulla oru kadaiyil irundha sisidivi kemaraavil padhivaana video endru indha video-vai appodhu veliyittirundhanar. Andha video-vai ippodhu Russia nilanadukkathudan thodarbuppaduthi, padhivittiruppadhu therindhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thediya podhu, 2025 maars maadham naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video kaatchiyudan veliyaana pala padhivugal, seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Thelivaaga irundha andha veediyokkalil maars 28, 2025 endru thelivaaga thedhi therindhadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovukkum Russia nilanadukkathirkum thodarbillai enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Poroor raamachandhiraa palgalai thina vizhaa oozhiyargalukku virudhu vazhangi kavuravam
text:
Poroor: poroor raamachandhiraa uyargalvi matrum aaraaychi niruvanathil netru nadandha palgalai thina vizhaavil, maanava -- maanaviyar matrum niruvana oozhiyargalukku, virudhugal vazhangappattana.
Porooril ulla sree raamachandhiraa uyargalvi matrum aaraaychi niruvanathin niruvanar pirandhanaal matrum palgalai thina vizhaa, maruthuvamanai valaaga arangil netru nadandhadhu.
Innigazhchiyil, padippil sirandhu vilangum 28 maanava -- maanaviyarukku 38 thangap padhakkangal vazhangappattana. Idhil, em.pi.pi.es., padippil sirappaana idam piditha avinayaa endra maanavikku, naangu thanga padhakkangal vazhangappattana.
Thavira, niruvanathil 10 mudhal 40 aandugal paniyaatriya 282 oozhiyargalukku, virudhugal matrum thanga padhakkangal vazhangappattana.
Raamachandhiraa maruthuvak kalloori thalaivarum, podhu aruvai sigichai thurai peraasiriyarumaana paalaaji sing matrum kadhiriyakkaviyal thurai peraasiriyar raay sandhosham aagiyorukku, 'vaazhnaal saadhanaiyaalar' virudhu vazhangappattadhu.
Mudaneekkiyal, mudhugelumbu aruvai sigichai thurai peraasiriyar kannan kaarthik kailaashukku, 'maanavar vazhigaatti' virudhu vazhangappattadhu.
Nigazhvin oru pagudhiyaaga, niruvana vendhar vengadaasalam, 'sahaayaa' enum noyaaligalin veettukke sendru sigichai alippadharkaana thuraiyai thodangi vaithaar.
Maruthuvamanaiyilirundhu veedu thirumbum noyaaligalukku thodar maruthuva aalosanai, iyanmurai sigichai, aayvaga parisodhanai ullitta pala sevaigalai orunginaithu vazhanguvadharkaaga, ippudhiya thurai thodangappattulladhu.

headline: Jaargant arasil BJP amaichar endru paravum padhivaal kuzhappam!
text:
Pahalgaam payangaravaadha thaakkudhalukkup poruppetru himaachala piradhesa mudhalamaichar padhavi vilagavendum endru jaargant maanila BJP amaichar petti alithadhaaga oru padhivu

oruvar petti alitha video-vai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilaith thagavalil, “pahaalgaam thaakkudhal – imaachal mudhalamaicharin thavaraal nadandhadhaam – jaargant pijevi amaichar,
(thaakkudhal nadandha maanilam theriyala) pijevi amaichar ivvalavu arivaaliyaa irundhaa – sangigal evvalavu arivaaliyaa iruppaanga??? 🤔🤦♀️🤦♀️🤦♀️😂😂😂 valarppu appadi ” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Jaargant maanila BJP amaichar oruvar pahalgaam thaakkudhalukku himaachala piradhesa Congress mudhalamaichardhaan porupperka vendum endru kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Jaargandil iruppadhu hemanth soran thalaimaiyilaana jaargant mukdhi motchaa (je.em.em) matrum Congress koottani arasu aagum. Congress koottani arasil BJP amaichar ullaar endra thagavale nagaippukkuriyadhaaga ulladhu. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil jaargant amaichar alitha petti thodarbaana seythiyaith thedi eduthom. Adhil pahalgaam thaakkudhalukku poruppetru himaachalaviradhesa Congress mudhalamaichar padhavi vilaga vendum endru jaargant amaichar sudhivya kumaar sonu (Sudivya Kumar Sonu) sarchai karuthu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Jaargant mukdhi motchaa – Congress koottani arasilirundhu kondu thaakkudhal sambavam endha maanilathil nadandhadhu endru kooda theriyaamal petti alithulla amaicharin karuthaal sarchai erpattulladhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Jaargandil 2024 sattamandra therdhalil hemanth soran thalaimaiyilaana koottani vetri petradhu. Hemanth soran amaicharavaiyil Congress katchiyais saarndhavargalum amaichargalaaga ullanar. Sudhivya kumaar sonu jaargant mukdhi motchaavais saarndhavar endrum nagarppura membaadu, uyar matrum thozhilnutba kalvi, sutrulaa ullitta thuraigalin amaicharaaga avar iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Avar jaargant mukdhi motchaavai saarndhavar enbadhai urudhi seyya kadandha therdhalil avar vetbumanu thaakkal seyyappatta vivarathai indhiyath therdhal aanaiya inaiyathalathil thedi eduthom. Adhil, sudhivya kumaar jaargant mukdhi motchaa saarbil pottiyittavar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam sudhivya kumaar BJP amaichar illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Ilambennukku thirumanam kanavar, paatti meedhu pokso
text:

headline: Taadaa kuzhumathil meendum veditha adhigaara modhal.. Sandhirasegaran padhavi neettippum noyal edhirppum!
text:
India-vin migap perum varthagakkuzhumamaana taadaavil meendum adhigaara modhal vedithulladhu.sandhirasegaranukku melum 5 aandugal padhavi neettippu vazhangappattadharku, taadaa tirast thalaivar noyal taadaa kadum edhirpputh therivithullaar. Taadaa kuzhumathil ennadhaan nadakkiradhu? Virivaagap paarkkalaam...
Taadaa tirast thalaivar noyal taadaavudanaana modhal kaaranamaaga, thalaivar padhaviyil needikkappovadhillai ena kadandha aagast maadham sandhirasegaran arivithirundhaar. Indhas soozhalil, avarukku meendum 5 aandugal padhavi neettippu vazhanga iyakkunar kuzhu oppudhal alithiruppadhu perum mukkiyathuvam petrulladhu. Aanaal, iyakkunar kuzhuvin indha mudivu sattavirodhamaanadhu ena noyal taadaa edhirpputh therivithullaar. Taadaa kuzhumathin mukkiya amaippugal taadaa tirast matrum taadaa sans aagum. Taadaa mottaars, tisies enath thodangi 26 niruvanangal taadaa sansin keezh pangus sandhaiyil pattiyalaagiyullana. Idhan thalaivaraaga 2017aam aandu en.sandhirasegaran niyamikkappattaar.
Taadaa kudumbathinar allaadhu veliye irundhu oruvar taadaa sans thalaivaraaga niyamikkappattadhu adhuve mudhanmurai. Aanaal, indha taadaa sansin 66 sadhaveedhap pangugal taadaa tirast vasame ullana. Indha amaippin thalaivardhaan noyal taadaa. En.sandhirasegaran, er India maruseeramaippu, elaktrik vaaganam matrum semigandakdar mudhaleedugal moolam kuzhumathaip pala thalangalil virivaakkiyadhudan, kuzhuma sandhai madhippai avaaramaaga uyarthinaar.
Iruppinum, avaradhu seyalbaadugal kurithu noyal taadaavukku vimarsanangal irundhana. Kurippaaga, taadaa sansaip pangus sandhaiyil pattiyaliduvadharkaana sandhirasegaranin thittathirku noyal taadaa thodarndhu edhirpputh therivithuvandhaar. Idhan neetchiyaagave, 2027 pipravarikkup piragu padhaviyil thodarappovadhillai ena sandhirasegaran munbu arivithirundhaar. Idhanidaiye, vidhimuraippadi taadaa sans panguchandhaiyil pattiyalidappada vendum ena risarv vangi utharavittadhaal, niruvanathaip panguchandhaiyil kattaayam pattiyalida vendiya soozhal uruvaanadhu.
Podhuppangu veliyeettinbodhu mudhaleettaalargalin nambikkaiyaip perath thodarchiyaana thalaimai avasiyam enbadhaal, sandhirasegaranaiye meendum thodarumaaru nirvaagak kuzhu kettukkondadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Aanaal, tirast parindhuraitha iyakkunargalin perumbaanmai aadharavindri edukkappatta indhath theermaanam sattappadi sellaadhu ena noyal taadaa therivithullaar. Idhanaal, sandhirasegaranin thalaimai matrum pangus sandhaip pattiyal kuritha sikkal taadaa kuzhumathil thodargiradhu.

headline: 92% arasu oozhiyargal adhimuga-vukku vaakkalithaargal endru paravum news kaardugal unmaiyaa?
text:
92 sadhavigidha arasu oozhiyargal adhimuga-vukku vaakkalithadhaaga san news matrum Polimer TV veliyittadhu pondru news kaardugal

san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “92% arasu oozhiyargal adhimugavirku vaakku! Arasu aasiriyargal, maruthuvargal, kaavaldhuraiyinar ena thamizhagathais serndha arasu paniyaalargal 92% adhimugavirkum adhan koottani katchigalukkum thavaal vaakku seluthiyulladhaaga thagaval paravi varugiradhu. Thamizhaga arasiyalil idhu oru megaa thiruppamaaga paarkkappadugiradhu ena arasiyal vimarsagargal therivithullanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhe thagavalai oru vaarthai kooda maatraamal Polimer tholaikkaatchi veliyittadhu polavum silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, indha irandu news kaardugal thodarbaagavum aayvu seythom.
investigation_details:
Therdhal paniyil eeduvadum arasu oozhiyargal, mudhiyavargalukku thavaal vaakku seluthum vasadhi ulladhu. Idhu vaakku ennikkai andru thaan ennappadum. Aanaal, arasu oozhiyargalil 92 sadhavigidham per adhimuga-vukku thavaal vaakku alithulladhaaga thagaval paraviyulladhu endru palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Yaar indha thagavalai sonnadhu endru illai.
Thimuga-vukku edhiraana, adhimuga-vukku saadhagamaana vadhandhi pondra padhivugalai san news veliyida vaayppum illai. Thavaal vaakkugalai ennum varaiyil indha vivarangal veliyaaga vaayppillai enbadhaalum, indha news card-il ulla thamizh faant vazhakkamaaga san news, Polimer news veliyidum news kaardugalil ulladhu pola illai enbadhaalum idhai aayvu seythom.
Ippadi oru news card-ai san news matrum Polimer seythigal oodagam veliyittadhaa endru ariya avatrin Facebook pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha news kaardum illai. Enave, indha news card-ai san news digital matrum Polimer TV digital pirivu poruppaalargalukku WhatsApp moolam anuppinom. Avargalum ivai poliyaana news card enbadhai urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Marital Rape kutramaa? ’neenga adhai mudivu seyya mudiyaadhu..’ uchaneedhimandrathirku mathiya arasu padhil!
