Thirumanam pennin sudhandhirathai azhikka mudiyaadhu ena needhivadhi jaaymaalyaa paaksi karuthu therivithaar.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
thirumana uravukkul nadaiverum paaliyal vangodumaiyai (Marital Rape) kutramaakkuvadhu thodarbaana vazhakkugalin irudhi visaaranaiyai 3 vaarangalukkup piragu thodanga Uchaneedhimandram mudivu seythulladhu.
Thirumana uravukkul manaiviyin viruppathirku maaraaga nadaiverum paaliyal uravai kutramaagak karudha vendum enak kori palveru manukkal uchaneedhimandrathil thaakkal seyyappattullana. Indha manukkal meedhaana visaaranai, thalaimai needhivadhi soorya kaanth, needhivadhigal jaaymaalyaa paaksi matrum vi. Moganaa aagiyor adangiya amarvu munbu nadaivetru varugiradhu.
Innilaiyil, pudhangizhamai (indru) nadaivetra visaaranaiyinbodhu mathiya arasu thanadhu nilaippaattai uchaneedhimandrathil therivithadhu. Thirumana vangodumaiyai kutramaakkuvadhu thodarbaana mudivu naadaalumandram matrum arasin kolgai saarndha adhigaara varambukkul varuvadhaagavum, idhanai Uchaneedhimandram theermaanippadhu poruthamaanadhalla endrum mathiya arasu tharappil therivikkappattadhu.
Adhaavadhu, tharpodhulla sattangalil maatram seythu thirumana vangodumaiyai thanik kutramaaga varaiyaruppadhu naadaalumandrathin paniyaagum ena mathiya arasu vaadhittadhu. Idhuvondra mukkiyamaana samooga matrum satta maatrathai needhimandrathin moolam merkolvadharkup padhilaaga, naadaalumandrathil virivaana vivaadham nadathi mudivu edukka vendum endrum therivikkappattadhu.
Idharkidaiye, needhivadhi jaaymaalyaa paaksi mukkiyamaana karuthai munvaithaar. Thirumanam enbadhu oru pennin sudhandhirathai mutrilum azhippadhaaga irukka mudiyaadhu ena avar kurippittaar.
Thirumanam seythu kondadhan kaaranamaaga oru pennin thanippatta viruppam, udal meedhaana urimai matrum mudivedukkum sudhandhiram mudivukku vandhuvidaadhu enbadhe indhak karuthin adippadai.
Indha vazhakkil thaninavar urimai, thirumana uravin thanmai, pengalin udal matrum paaliyal suyaatchi, kutraviyal sattathin varambu ullitta pala mukkiyamaana satta matrum samoogak kelvigal ezhuppappattullana.
Indha manukkal meedhaana irudhi visaaranai 3 vaarangalukkup piragu pudhan matrum viyaazhakkizhamaigalil nadaiverum ena Uchaneedhimandram therivithulladhu.

headline: Madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram idaitherdhal.. Vetbumanuth thaakkal indru thodakkam!!
text:
Kadandha sattamandrath therdhalil koottani amaithup pottiyitta ADMK, verum 47 idangalil mattume vetri petradhaal 3-aam idathirku thallappattadhu. Idhanaal, sila karuthu veruvaadugal erpattu, mukkiya nirvaagigal palar katchiyil irundhu veliyerinar.
Kurippaaga, madhuraandhagam thogudhiyil vetrivetra maragadham kumaravel, perundhurai thogudhiyil vetrivetra Jayakumar, thaaraavuram thogudhiyil vetri petra sathyavaamaa, ambaasamuthiram thogudhiyil vetri petra isakki suppaiyaa aagiyorum, munnaal amaichargalaana si.vijayavaasgar, em.aar.vijayavaasgar aagiyorum, ADMK-vil irundhu vilagi, thavegavil inaindhanar.
Melum, thangaladhu em.el.e padhavigalai raajinaamaa seythadhaal, Tamil Naattil kaaliyaaga ulla thogudhigalin ennikkai 7-aaga uyarndhadhu. Indha 7 thogudhigalil, 5-l therdhal vazhakkugal niluvaiyil iruppadhaal, idaitherdhalai nadatha mudiyaadha soozhal irundhadhu. Innilaiyil, meedhamulla 2 thogudhigalaana madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram aagiya irandu thogudhigalukkaana idaitherdhalai therdhal aanaiyam arivithulladhu.
Adhanbadi, adutha maadham (akdovar) 6-m thedhi nadaiveravirukkiradhu. Indhachoozhalil thaan, indha irandu thogudhi idaitherdhalukkaana vetbumanuth thaakkal indru thodangugiradhu. Sepdambar 16aam thedhi varai vetbu thaakkal seyyalaam.
Madhuraandhagam thogudhiyai poruthavaraiyil motham 285 vaakkuppadhivu maiyangal ullana. Mothamaaga indha thogudhiyil 2 latchathu 13 latchathu 689 vaakkaalargal ullanar. Idhil aan vaakkaalargal 104886 perum, pen vaakkaalargal 108738 perum moondraam paalina vaakkaalargal 65 perum ullanar.
Adhevola, thaaraavuram thani thogudhi idaith therdhalai poruthavarai, 2,23,243 vaakkaalargal ullanar. 320 vaakkusaavadigal ullana. Adhil 18 vaakkusaavadigal padhatramaanavai endru kandariyappadulladhaagavum, thaaraavuram thani thogudhiyai kangaanikka 9 parakkum padaigal amaippattulladhaagavum, avai 3 anigalaaga pirikkappattu suzhatsi muraiyil paniyaatruvargal endrum adhigaarigal tharappil therivikkappattulladhu.

headline: Karant pil adhigam ena makkal pugaar kooruvadhaal thavega-vinar tiraansfaarmarai thaakkinaargalaa?
text:
Min kattanam adhigarithu Vijay aatchikkuk ketta peyarai erpaduthuvadhaagak koori minmaatriyai (Transformer) thavega-vinar thaakkiyadhaaga oru video

tiraansfaarmarai silar kattaiyaal thaakkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “tharkuris: karant pil adhigamaa aakkivittu enga #visay_maamaa kku ketta peru vaangi kodukkura” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Mathiya piradhesathil minsaaram thaakki pasu ondru uyirizhandha aathirathil kiraama makkal minsaara tiraansbaarmar meedhu thaakkudhal nadathinar endru seythi ondru veliyaanadhu. Thideerendru paarthaal andha video-vai Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video-vai muzhumaiyaagap paarthaale adhil ullavargal indhiyil pesuvadhaik ketka mudigiradhu. Vada Indhiya pengal anivadhu pondru selai anindhu sila pengal iruppadhaiyum kaana mudigiradhu. Tiraansfaarmarukku arugile pasu maadu ondru irandhu kidappadhaiyum kaana mudigiradhu. Ivai ellaam indha video mathiya piradhesathil pasu uyirizhandhadhaal minmaatriyaith thaakkiya kiraama makkal endru paravum veediyodhaan enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Https://twitter.com/thetatvaindia/status/2087798809371775244
video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu samooga oodagangalil palarum mathiya piradhesathil maadu uyirizhandhadhaal minmaatriyaith thaakkiya makkal endru kurippittu indha video-vai padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Oruvar indha sambavam “mathiyap piradhesa maanilam, shaahdhol maavattam, jeysingnagar thaalukkaavil ulla pondi kaalaa kiraamathil (Pondi Kala village, Shahdol district, Madhya Pradesh) nadandhadhu” endru kurippittu padhivittirundhaar.
Https://twitter.com/ItzDeeba/status/2087468160006119725
mathiya piradhesathil appadi oru kiraamam ulladhaa, sambavam nadandha idathin koogul street viyoo kaatchi kidaikkumaa endru koogul mep-l thedinom. Andha kiraamathin ore oru theruvin koogul street viyoo namakku kidaithadhu. Andha theru vazhiyaagath thediya podhu, sambavam nadandha idathai kandarindhom. Tiraansfaarmar, neela nira pilaastik sheet koorai amaikkappatta veedu ellaam sariyaagap porundhiyadhu. Idhan moolam indha video mathiya piradhesathais saarndhadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Mathiya piradhesathil pasu maadu minsaaram thaakki irandhadhaal aathiram adaindha makkal, minsaara tiraansfaarmarai thaakkiya sambavathin video-vai eduthu, Tamil Naattil minsaara kattanam adhigamaaga varugiradhu endru makkal pugaar kooruvadhaal tiraansbaarmarai thaakkiya tha.ve.ka-vinar endru thavaraana thagaval serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Porukku edhiraaga aarppaattam seytha isreliyargal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Iran udanaana porukku edhiraaga Israel naattil aayirakkanakkaana makkal therukkalil irangi aarppaattathil eeduvattadhaaga oru video

makkal poraattathil eeduvattadhan video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video meedhu Israel makkal aarppaattam endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “isrel naattil aayirakkanakkaana makkal therukkalil irangi periya alavil aarppaattathil eeduvattullanar.
Tel Aviv matrum Jerusalem ullitta pala nagarangalil makkal arasin kolgaigal matrum por nilaimaiyai edhirthu koshamittu poraattam nadathugindranar. Sila idangalil poraattakkaarargal matrum paadhugaappup padaiyinarukku idaiye padhatra nilaiyum erpattulladhaaga thagavalgal veliyaagindrana. Nilaimai thodarndhu maarikkondirukkiradhu. Melum thagavalgal viraivil… ⚠️ echarikkai: nunukkamaana (Sensitive) ulladakkam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Eeraanukku edhiraaga por purindhuvarum isrelai, andha naattu makkale kandippadhaagath thodarndhu samooga oodagangalil thagavalgal pagirappattu varugindrana. Indha veediyovaavadhu unmaiyaaga irukkumaa alladhu idhuvum vadhandhiyaa enbadhai ariya aayvu seythu paarthom.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, indha video 2026 janavariyil samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kandom. Adhuvum indha sambavam Iran naattil janavari 8m thedhi nadandhadhaagak kurippidappattirundhadhu. Iran meedhu Israel thaakkudhal nadathath thodangiyadhu pipravari 28, 2026. Adharku ondrarai maadhangalukku munbaaga indha sambavam nadandhadhaaga andha padhivugalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Iran arasukku edhiraaga poraadiya makkalai paadhugaappup padaiyinar thadutha niruthiyullanar. Appodhu paadhugaappup padaiyinar nadathiya thaakkudhalil palarum kaayam adaindhadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu. Iran-in mashhath (Mashhad) endra idathil janavari 8m thedhi indha sambavam nadandhadhu endru adhil padhivu seythirundhanar.
Idhan adippadaiyil thediya podhu Iran arasukku edhiraaga mashhath pagudhiyil tisambar 26, 2025l irundhu janavari 14, 2026 varai poraattam nadandhadhaagas seythigal namakku kidaithana. Idhan moolam indha video Israel-il edukkappattadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Koronaa noyaaligal aasbidosbermaa marundhu saappittaal aaksijan alavu adhigarikkumaa?
text:
Koronaa noyaaligalukku suvaasathinaral pirasnai erpattaal aasbidosbermaa endra homiyovadhi marundhai saappittaal sariyaagividum endru oru padhivu

aasbidosbermaa (Aspidosperma) endra homiyovadhi marundhin pugaippadathudan Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “#koronaa thotru meendum thodarum indha kaalangalil aaksijan alavu kuraindhuvittaal peedhi adaiya vendaam, homiyovadhi marundhu kadaiyil #aasbidosbermaa endra sottu marundhu kidaikkum. Thaamadhamillaamal vaangi, oru tamlar thanneeril 20 drops marundhu kalandhu noyaalikku kodungal. Aaksijan alavu udane meendum Normal aagividum.
Corona samayathil aaksijan silindar kidaikkaadha podhu, indha sottu marundhudhaan palar uyirai kaappaatriyadhu. Eppodhum veettil vaithu irungal. Mudhiyavargalukku samaya sanjjeeviyaaga payanbadum. #padithen_pagirndhen” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittum, pagirndhum varugindranar.
investigation_details:
2021m aandu korona paraval theeviramaaga irundha podhu aaksijan patraakkurai kaaranamaaga pala uyirgalai izhandhom. Suvaasath thinaral erpattu moochuvida mudiyaamal patta avasdhaiyais solla vaarthaigal illai. Aanaal, appadippatta miga mosamaana soozhalil seyarkai suvaasam moolam aaksijan pera erpaadu seyyaamal, homiyovadhi marundhai saappittaal uyirizhappu kooda erpadalaam endru appodhe maruthuvargal echarithirundhanar.
Tharpodhu 2025l meendum pala naadugalil koronaa paravi varugiradhu. Indhiyaavilum kooda koronaa nolaayigal ennikkai adhigarikkath thodangiyulladhu. Iruppinum idhu miga mosamaana paadhippai erpaduthaadha omikraan vagai koronaa endru sugaadhaarath thurai vilakkam alithulladhu. Iruppinum kavanak kuraivaaga irundhuvida vendaam endrum echarithulladhu. Indha soozhalil moochuth thinaral, aaksijan patraakkurai erpattaal homiyovadhi marundhais saappidumbadi palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Idhu patri homiyovadhi maruthuvar sunidhaavaith thodarbugondu pesinom. “aasbidosbermaa marundhaanadhu suvaasa mandala pirasnaigalukkaaga parindhuraikkappadugiradhu. Suvaasath thinaral pirasnaigalukkaaga idhai parindhuraikkirom. Suvaasa mandalathaith thoondi rathathil aaksijan alavai adhigarikka indha marundhu udhavugiradhu. Aanaal idhai maruthuvar parindhuraithaal mattume eduthukkolla vendum. Indha thagaval koronaa uchathilirundha kaalathilirundhe paravi varugiradhu. Koronaa noyaaliyin nilai enna, avarukku asbidosbermaa kodukkalaamaa alladhu veru marundhu sariyaaga irukkumaa enbadhai maruthuvardhaan mudivu seyya mudiyum.
Indha thagaval thavaru endru koorivida mudiyaadhu… aanaal aaksijan alavu 90kku keezh kuraindhuvitta nilaiyil maruthuvarin aalosanai indri suyamaaga ippadi marundhu eduppadhu palan tharumaa enbadhudhaan kelvik kuri. Koronaa mattumalla thalaivali, mudi udhirvu, paaliyal saarndha pirasnai ena ellaa pirasnaigalukkum samooga oodagangalil, YouTube-il paravum pala thagavalai nambi palarum suya maruthuvam seythu kolgindranar. Idhu pondra vadhandhigalaith thavirthuvittu maruthuvarais sandhithu aalosanai peruvadhu nalladhu. Yaarukku enna maadhiriyaana sigichai alikka vendum, avarukku enna marundhu, evvalavu kodukka vendum enbadhu ellaam maruthuvar noyaaliyin nilaiyai aaraayndhu parindhuraippaar. Suya maruthuvathaith thavirthu vida vendum” endraar.
Indha marundhu thodarbaaga Tamil Nadu arasu alladhu Indhiya arasu tharappil parindhurai alikkappattulladhaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Appodhu, 2021m aandu koronaa uchathilirundha podhu Indhiya arasin aayush thurai veliyittirundha samooga oodaga padhivugal namakku kidaithana. Adhil, “aasbidosbermaa kyoo 20 marundhu eduppadhu aaksijan alavai adhigarikkas seyyum endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Melum, “oruvarukku aaksijan thevaiyaa matrum maathirai marundhu thevaiyaa enbadhai ellaam sigichai alikkum maruthuvardhaan mudivu seyvaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Aastidosbermaa marundhu mutrilum thavaraanadhu endru koorivida mudiyaadhu. Aanaal idhai mattum eduthukkondaal aaksijan patraakkurai sariyaagi, noyaali uyir pizhaithuviduvaar endru koorum thagaval mutrilum thavaraanadhu enbadhai thagundha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seythullom. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “roo.4000 kodi selavu seythum Chennai saalaigalil vellam” endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Roo.4000m kodi selavu seythum Chennai-yil mazhai vellam erpattulladhu. Roo.4000m kodi ennaachu endru kettu oru pugaippadam

saalaiyil vella neeril vaaganangal payanikkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhu indhoneshiyaa arugil irukkum pura maanagar pagudhi… idha yaarukkettaalum naan appudithaan solren.. 🖤❤️ #4000kodi_ennaachu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha pugaippadathai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Chennai-yil kadandha sila naatkalaaga mazhai peythu vandhaalum kadandha aandugalaip pola perumbaalaana pagudhigalil vella paadhippu edhum illai. Mazhai peyyum podhu saalaigalil thanneer odinaalum sila mani nerangalil nilaimai seeraagividugiradhu. Ellaa pagudhigalilum mazhai neer thengave illai endru kooravillai. Adhu patriya aayvukkum naam sellavillai. Mazhai neer thengiyadhu endru paravum padhivugalai mattum aayvu seythu varugirom.
Kolgathaavil edukkappatta video-vai Chennai endru kurippittu palarum vadhandhi parappiyirundhanar. Adhu pondru oru pugaippadathai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu idhu Chennai endru maraimugamaaga vairalaakki varugindranar. Sila maadhangalukku munbu Chennai pallikkaranaiyil saalai mosamaaga ulladhu endru samooga oodagangalil thagaval veliyaanadhu. Idharku DMK tharappinar idhu Chennai illai peegaar endru thavaraana thavalai alithirundhanar. Adhaik kindal seyyum vagaiyil yaar kettaalum idhu indhoneshiyaa endru thaan solvom endru kurippittullanar. Adhanudan roo.4000 kodi enna aanadhu endru kettiruppadhan moolam avargal sennaiyaik kurippiduvadhu thelivaagiradhu.
Comment pagudhiyil palarum idhu Chennai illai endru kurippittullanar. Aanaalum idhu sennaidhaan endru innum palar padhivittu, DMK arasai vimarsithu varugindranar. Enave, indha padhivu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai paarkkum podhu Chennai polath theriyavillai. Kurippaaga pachai nira auto Chennai-yil kidaiyaadhu. Enave indha pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu kujaraath maanilathais saarndhadhu endru oraandukku munbaaga seythigal veliyaagi irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil kujaraath maanilam raajgottil kana mazhai kaaranamaaga saalaigalil thengiya mazhai vellathil vaaganangal payanithana endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thi indhu veliyittirundha seythiyil indha pugaippadam raajgottil 2024m aandu aagast 25m thedhi edukkappattadhaagavum idhai PTI seythi niruvanam eduthadhaagavum kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Paaradhiya janadhaa katchi aadharavu oodagam endru ariyappadum sila thamizh oodagangalilum kooda indha pugaippadathai 2024m aandu aagast maadham veliyittirundhanar. Avatrilum kooda indha pugaippadam kujaraathil edukkappattadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indhu veliyittirundha seythiyil indha pugaippadam kujaraathil edukkappattadhu endru kurippittirundhaalum, aidharaavaath, pengalooru mazhai thodarbaana seythigalilum kooda indha pugaippadam payanbaduthappattirundhadhu. Enave, indha idam kujaraathaan enbadhai urudhi seythugolla aayvaith thodarndhom. Thi indhu veliyittirundha pugaippadam satru thelivaaga irundhadhu. Adhai peridhuvaduthi paartha podhu, bus nilaiyathil kujaraathi mozhiyil ezhudhappattirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Adhai koogul tiraanslettar aap moolam aayvu seythu paarthom. Madhapar endru vandhadhu. Appadi oru idam kujaraathin raajgottil ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appadi oru pagudhi raajgottil iruppadhu theriyavandhadhu. Andha oorin bus staant padam koogul street viyoovil ulladhaa endru paarthom. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petra bus nilaiyam Madhapar-l iruppadhai kandarindhom.
Koogul streettil andha bus nilaiyam thodarbaaga podhu makkal edutha pugaippadangal, veediyokkalum padhividappattirundhana. Adhil 2024m aandil erpatta mazhai vellathin podhu andha bus nilaiyathin nilai thodarbaaga oruvar eduthirundha video padhividappattirundhadhaiyum kandarindhom. Andha video-vil idam petra kaatchiyum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda pugaippadamum kittathatta ondraaga irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu.
Idhan moolam kujaraath maanila mazhai vella paadhippu pugaippadathai Chennai-yil mazhai vella paadhippu endru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Namakku kidaitha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Vimaanangal thaamadham alladhu rathaagiradhaa? Payanigalukku irukkum urimaigal enna?
text:
Sivil vimaanap pokkuvarathu iyakkunaragathin pudhiya pani nera varambu vidhigalaal indigo vimaanas sevai kadumaiyaana paadhippugalais sandhithullana. Thozhilnutbak kolaarugal, paadhagamaana kaalanilai matrum pudhiya pani vidhigal aagiya idaiyoorugalaal sevaigal paadhikkappattadhaaga indigo nirvaagam therivithirundhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, payanigalidam mannippu koriya indigo nirvaagam, viraivil sevaigal sari seyyappadum enavum urudhiyalithirundhadhu. Aanaal, netrum idhe pirasnai naadu muzhuvadhum thodarndhadhu. 150kkum merpatta vimaanangal rathu seyyappattirundhana. Podhiya alavil vimaanap paniyaalargal illaadhadhe idharku kaaranam enak koorappattadhu. Innilaiyil, indrum naadu muzhuvadhum 400kkum merpatta vimaanangal rathu seyyappattullana.
Perumbaalaana naduthara varkka indhiyargal mukkiyamaana alladhu ikkattaana soozhnilaigalil mattume, udanadiyaaga oru idathil irundhu matroru idathirku selvadharku vimaana pokkuvarathu sevaiyai thervu seythu payanikkiraargal. Appadiyirukkum podhu, vimaana attavanaigalil erpadum kularuvadi, vimaanangal rathu pondravai payanigalukku mana ulaichalai erpaduthum ondraagave irukkindrana. Aanaal, vimaana sevai niruvanangal elidhaaga payanigalidam mannippu kori kadandhu selgindrana.
Innilaiyil, oru vimaanam rathu alladhu thaamadham erpadum podhu payanigalukku irukkum urimaigal kurithup paarkkalaam. Sivil vimaanap pokkuvarathu iyakkunaragam (DGCA) 2019 aam veliyitta payanigalin urimaigal kurithaana saasanam, vimaanangal thaamadham alladhu rathaagum podhu, payanigalukkaana urimaigal kurithup pesiyirukkiradhu.
Melum, vimaanangal thaamadhamaavadhu enbadhu, ulnaattu vimaanap pokkuvarathai poruthavarai 2 mani nerathirku mel sendraale vimaanappayanigal thangaladhu urimaigalaip pera mudiyum. Aanaal, sarvadhesa vimaanangalaip poruthavarai 6 mani nerathirku thaamadhamaanaal mattume, urimaigalaip pera mudiyum. Avvaaru, naam engu payanikkirom, endha vimaana niruvanathai thervu seythu payanikkirom enbadhaip poruthu maaruvadum.
Sivil vimaanap pokkuvarathu iyakkunaragam (DGCA) payanigal urimai kolgaigalin padi, 2 mani nerathirku mel vimaanam thaamadhamaagum podhu payanigalukku vimaana niruvanam ilavasa unavu matrum sitrundiyai vazhanga vendum. Thodarndhu, 6 maninerathirku mel vimaanam thaamadhamaagum podhu, maatru vimaanathai payanigalukku erpaadu seythu koduthal vendum alladhu payanacheettirkaana muzhuthogaiyayum thiruppi alithal vendum. Melum, payanigalukku edhu viruppamo adhaiye, vimaana niruvanangal seythu koduthal vendum.
24 mani neram vimaanam thaamadhamaagum podhu, payanigalukku vimaana niruvanam thanguvadharkaana arai vasadhigalai erpaadu seythu koduthal vendum. Indha thaamadhangal iyarkai peridargalaal erpadum podhu payanigal indha urimaigalaip pera mudiyaadhu. Vimaana niruvanathin sondhak kaaranangalaal indha thaamadham alladhu rathu erpadum podhe vimaana payanigal indha urimaigalaip pera mudiyum.
Vimaana niruvanathaal oru vimaanam rathu seyyappadum patchathil, adhu purappadum nerathirku sumaar irandu vaarangalukku munbe payanigalukkuth therivikkappada vendum enbadhu oru mukkiya vidhi. Avvaaru, therivikkappadaadha patchathil 5,000 mudhal 2,10,000 varai vimaanak kattanathudan koodiya izhappeettuth thogaiyai naam petruk kolla mudiyum. Panathai thiruppiyalikka 7 naatkal vimaana niruvanathirku avagaasam alikkappattirukkiradhu.
Enge pugaaralippadhu alladhu urimaigalai koruvadhu?
Vimaanam thaamadhamaanaalo alladhu rathu seyyappattaalo kurippitta vimaana niruvanathidam naam korikkaigal vaikka iyalum. Anniruvanam korikkaigalai niraagarithaal uriya aadhaarangalaik (sgireen saat, payanas seettu) kondu ersevaa seyali alladhu www.airsewa.gov.in endra inaiyathalathil pugaaralikkalaam. Thodarndhu, ovvoru vimaana nilaiyathil irukkum sivil vimaanap pokkuvarathu iyakkunar aluvalagathin nodal adhigaariyai thodarbu kondu pugaaralikkalaam.

headline: America mudhal thurukki varai... Havudhiyin adhiradi warning !
text:
Emanin havudhi amaippu, savudhi areviyaavukku edhiraana thaakkudhalaith thodarum endrum, riyaathukku neradi raanuva udhavi vazhangum America, Israel, Pakistan, thurukki pondra naadugalaiyum poril izhukkum echarikkai viduthulladhu. Bab el-Mandeb neerinai aruge modhal theeviramaavadhaal sengadal–edan valaigudaa kadalvazhi, ulaga varthagam, erisakdhi viniyogam paadhikkappadum avaayam adhigarithulladhu.
Seythiyaalar - M. Meeraa
mathiya kizhakkil erkanave padhatram needithu varum nilaiyil, emanin havudhi amaippukkum savudhi areviyaavukkum idaiyeyaana modhal pudhiya kattathai ettiyulladhu.
Savudhi areviyaavukku edhiraana thangaladhu nadavadikkaigal thodarum ena havudhi tharappu echarikkai viduthulladhu. Havudhi arasiyal pirivu uruppinar mugamadhu al-pugaidhi, savudhiyudan inaindhu modhalil eeduvadum naadugalukku edhiraagavum porai virivuvaduthath thayaaraaga iruppadhaagak kooriyullaar.
Indha modhalil havudhigalin aakkiramippu Bab el-Mandeb neerinaikku arugil sendriruppadhu sarvadhesa varthagathirku kavalaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Sengadalaiyum edan valaigudaavaiyum inaikkum indha mukkiya kadalvazhi, ulaga varthagathukku mukkiyamaana paadhaiyaagum. Indhap pagudhiyil kappal pokkuvarathu paadhikkappattaal, enney ullitta erisakdhi viniyogam matrum sarvadhesa sarakku pokkuvarathilum thaakkam erpadakkoodum.
Sameevathiya thaakkudhalgalil savudhi thalainagar riyaathai nokkiyum havudhigal evuganai matrum trongalai payanbaduthiyadhaaga thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana. Idhaiyaduthu savudhi thanadhu vaan paadhugaappai melum valuppadutha udhaviyai naadiyulladhu.
Idhan thodarchiyaaga savudhikku aadharavaaga pirittan varaiyarukkappatta raanuva udhaviyai vazhanga mudivu seythulladhu. Savudhi areviyaa vidutha korikkaiyaith thodarndhu, savudhi vimaanappadaikku tharkaappu nadavadikkaigalukkaana vaanvazhi erivorul nirappum (air-to-air refuelling) aadharavai vazhanga pirittan oppukkondulladhu.
Idharkaaga oru RAF Voyager vimaanathai anuppa iruppadhaaga pirittish arasu therivithulladhu. Indha udhavi kurippitta kaalathirku mattume vazhangappadum endrum, pinnar nilaimaiyaip poruthu maruvariseelanai seyyappadum endrum kooriyulladhu pirittan.
Mukkiyamaaga, havudhi ilakkugal meedhu thaakkudhal nadathuvadharku pirittish vimaanangal neradiyaagap payanbaduthappadaadhu; savudhi vimaanangal evuganaigal matrum trongalil irundhu thangalaith tharkaathukkollum nadavadikkaigalukku indha aadharavu vazhangappaduvadhaaga therivikkappattulladhu.
Idhanaith thodarndhu savudhi areviyaavukku edhiraana modhalil matra naadugal kalamiranginaal, por melum virivadaiyum ena havudhi thalaimai echarithulladhu. Kurippaaga America, Israel, Pakistan matrum thurukki aagiya naadugal riyaathukku neradi raanuva aadharavu vazhanguvadhaith thavirkka vendum ena havudhi tharappu kooriyulladhu.
Indha echarikkai veliyaagum nerathil, savudhi areviyaa–paagisdhaan–thurukki idaiyeyaana pudhiya paadhugaappu oppandham mukkiyathuvam petrulladhu. Thurukki, savudhikku raanuva matrum thozhilnutba udhavi thevaippattaal vazhangath thayaaraaga iruppadhaagavum therivithulladhu.
Adhe nerathil, amerikkaavai poruthavarai havudhigalin nilaippaadu satru maaruvattadhaaga ulladhu. Oman vazhiyaaga amerikkaa–havudhi pechuvaarthaigal nadaivetradhaagavum, America kappalgalaith thaakkum nokkam tharpodhu illai ena havudhi tharappu urudhiyalithadhaagavum thagavalgal veliyaagiyullana. Adhevelai, America matrum Israel savudhi nadavadikkaiyil neradiyaaga inaindhaal, modhal melum virivadaiyum endra echarikkaiyum havudhi tharappil munvaikkappattulladhu.
Idhanaal, havudhiyin echarikkai tharpodhu savudhi–eman ellaiyaith thaandi, America, Israel, Pakistan matrum thurukki ullitta pala naadugalai ulladakkiya piraandhiya modhalaaga indhap pirachinai maarakkoodum endra kavanathai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: “modikku aadharavu kodungal” endru Pakistan muslim kooriyadhaagap paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Indhiya islaamiyargale thirundhungal, piradhamar Modi-kku aadharavu thaarungal endru paagisdhaanais saarndha muslim oruvar video veliyittadhaaga oru padhivu

islaamiyar oruvar thaan paagisdhaanilirundhu pesuvadhaaga video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “_aslaam alaikkum. Naan *paagisdhaanil* irundhu aasip sardhaari pesugiren. Enadhu iniya *indhiya islaamiyargale*…. Neengal India-vil nalla unavugal, pazhangal, inippugal saappidugireergal. ( ippozhudhu azhugaikku maarugiraar). *engal veettil unavillai. Engal vaaganangalukku petrolillai. Kaiyil selavukku panamillai… panjjamum pasip pattiniyum paakkisdhaanil thalai virithaadugiradhu.* paakkisdhaan seeradaiyum nilaiyil engal thesam illave illai. *indhiya islaamiyargale … thirundhungal…* ungal thesa soozhal arpudhamaaga ulladhu. Ungal *piradhamar modi* avargalin aatchikku aadharavu aliyungal. Modi arpudhamaanavar. Naangalellaam avar paakkisdhaan meedhu por thoduthu, engal naattai ungal naattudan inaithuk kondaal engal porulaadhaaram membadume…. Saappiduvadharkaavadhu edhaavadhu kidaikkume ena engugirom. Neengal indhiyaavirku *thurogam seyyaadheergal.* neengal ippozhudhu oru *paadhugaappaana nilavil valamaaga irukkireergal.* edhirgatchigal pechaik kettu paazhaagividaadheergal engiraar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
“paagisdhaanil islaamiyargal migavum mosamaana nilaiyil ullanar. Aanaal, India-vil muslimgalin nilai nandraaga ulladhu. Idharkaaga piradhamar narendhira Modi-kku Indhiya islaamiyargal aadharavu alikka vendum” endru paagisdhaanais saarndha islaamiyar oruvar pesuvadhu pondru video ulladhu. Indha video unmaidhaanaa endru arindhugolla aayvu seythom.
Indha video kaatchiyaip pugaippadamaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Indha video-vai oraandukkum melaagap palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, indha video thodarbaaga veru thagaval namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Adhe nerathil video-vil dhirendra_raghav_79 endra instaagiraam aidi-yai kaana mudindhadhu. Enave, instaagiraamil andha aidi-yai thedi eduthom.
Adhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil irukkum navarin instaagiraam pakkam enbadhu theriyavandhadhu. Indhu poosaari, islaamiyar, panjjaap sardhaarji, saaybaavaa ena pala veshangalil andha navar eraalamaana veediyokkalai veliyittirundhaar. Andha navarin suyavivarak kurippu pagudhiyaip paarthom. Adhil avar thannudaiya peyar theerendhira raagav (Dhirendra Raghav) endrum nadigar endrum kurippittirundhaar. Avarudaiya Facebook pakkathil avar utharappiradhesa maanilam aakraavais saarndhavar endru kurippittirundhaar.
Avarudaiya instaagiraam veediyokkalil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai thedip paarthom. Aanaal, andha video-vai kandariya mudiyavillai. Adhe nerathil andha video-vai vaithu vada Indhiya oodagam ondru veliyittirundha seythiyin video-vai avar padhivittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Adhe pol Facebook reels pagudhiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai avar padhivittirundhadhaiyum kandu eduthom.
Islaamiyar pola vedamittu eraalamaana veediyokkalai avar thannudaiya instaagiraam pakkathil padhivittirundhaar. Adhanudan Indhiya thesap patraalaraaga eraalamaana veediyokkalaiyum avar veliyittirundhaar. Ivaradhu veediyokkalai paarkkum podhu ivar BJP aadharavaalar polath therigiradhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil avar thannai indhiyar endrum utharappiradhesa maanilam aakraavil vasippavar endrum kurippittiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil Pakistan islaamiyar Indhiya islaamiyargalukku modiyai aadharikkumbadi kooriyadhaaga paravum video poliyaanadhu, nadigar oruvar veliyitta video idhu enbadhum urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: ``thalithugalukku edhiraaga poy vazhakkup punaivadhai kaavaldhurai kaivida vendum!’’ - thirumaavalavan
text:
``madhachaarbatra samooganeedhi vetrik koottaniyai madhuraandhagathilum, thaaraavurathilum makkal veguvaaga aadharikka ullanar. Indha 2 vetbaalargalaiyum vetrivera vaippaargal endra nambikkai engalukku ulladhu’’ engiraar thirumaavalavan.
Raanippettai maavattam, aarkaattil VCK thalaivar thirumaavalavan indru maalai seythiyaalargalais sandhithaar. Appodhu avar pesiyadhaavadhu, ``thalithugalukku edhiraaga poy vazhakkup punaivadhai kaavaldhurai kaivida vendum. Idhudhodarbaaga mudhalvarais sandhithu muraiyida irukkirom. Madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram aagiya iru thogudhigalilum nadaivera ulla idaitherdhalgalil vidudhalais siruthaigal katchiyin saarbil therdhal panikkuzhu niyamikkappadugiradhu.
Madhuraandhagathil merpaarvaiyaalargalaaga katchiyin podhucheyalaalarum naadaalumandra uruppinarumaana ravikkumaar matrum samooganeedhithurai amaichar vanniyarasu aagiyor niyamikkappadugindranar. Ivargalin merpaarvaiyingeezh menaal sattamandra uruppinar es.es.paalaaji thalaimaiyil 10 per konda orunginaippuk kuzhu amaikkappadugiradhu.
Thaaraavurathil merpaarvaiyaalargalaaga katchiyin podhucheyalaalar sindhanaichelvan, seythith thodarbaalar ku.kaa.paavalan aagiyor niyamikkappadugindranar. Angu orunginaippaalargalaaga katchiyin thunaip podhucheyalaalar ve.kaniyamudhan thalaimaiyil 10 per konda kuzhu niyamikkappadugiradhu. Madhuraandhagathilum, thaaraavurathilum madhachaarbatra samooganeedhi vetrik koottaniyin saarbil podhukkoottangal orunginaippada ulladhu.
Andha podhukkoottangalil koottani katchith thalaivargal naangal pangetru vaakku segarikka ullom. `vetri petravar padhavi vilagivittaar’ engira varutham silarukku undu; ulladhu. Avargal thangal adhirupdhiyai edhirppai velippaduthiyirukkiraargal.
Aanaalumgooda madhachaarbatra samooganeedhi vetrik koottaniyai madhuraandhagathilum, thaaraavurathilum makkal veguvaaga aadharikka ullanar. Indha 2 vetbaalargalaiyum vetrivera vaippaargal endra nambikkai engalukku ulladhu. Idaitherdhalukkup piragu TVK koottaniyil PMK inaivadhaagas solvadhe yoogamaana kelvi. Adharkellaam naangal eppadi padhil solla mudiyum?
Jem veeramaniyin vazhakkil Thamizhaga arasu migavum kavanamaaga pulanaayvu seythu uriya nadavadikkaigalai eduthu varugiradhu. Indha perum kodung kutrathil thodarbudaiya yaarum thappikkak koodaadhu engira vagaiyil Chennai maanagara kaaval aanaiyarukku mudhalamaichar aanaiyittirukkiraar endra thagavalum veliyaagiyirukkiradhu.
Idhuvondra kutrangal migundha adhirchiyalikkak koodiyavaiyaaga ullana. Enave, idhil thodarbudaiyavargal yaaraaga irundhaalum, athanai perum kaidhu seyyappada vendum. Avargalukku uriya thandanai petruth tharuvadharku arasu uriya nadavadikkaigalai merkolla vendum endru vidudhalais siruthaigal katchiyin saarbil meendum valiyuruthugirom’’ endraar.

headline: Thiruvannaamalaiyil aar.es.es anivaguppu endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Thiruvannaamalaiyil aar.es.es nadathiya anivaguppu endru oru video

aareses thondargalin perani video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “needhimandra utharavukkup piragu, thiruvannaamalaiyil aar.es.es. Paadhai anivaguppu migavum palatha Police paadhugaappil!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil thiruvannaamalaiyil aareses perani nadandhadhu endru video padhividappattulladhu. Aanaal, eppodhu nadandhadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Thiruvannaamalaiyil aareses perani munbu nadandhadhaaga seythi paditha ninaivu irundhadhaal sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha video thagaval unmaidhaanaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Sameevathil edhenum aareses perani nadandhadhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appadi endha oru thagavalum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. 2023, 24m aandugalil oorvalam nadandhadhaaga sila seythigal kidaithana. Aanaal, ellaam pagal nerathil nadandhadhaagave video-kkal kidaithana. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil iruppadhu pondru endha pazhaiya veediyovum kidaikkavillai.
Indha video-vai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai 2025 akdovaril palarum padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, mathiyaviradhesa maanilam rathlam (Ratlam) endra idathil aareses thondargalin perani nadandhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Oodagangalilum kooda indha perani thodarbaana seythi 2025 akdovar mudhal vaarathil veliyaagi irundhadhu. Rathlamil aindhu idangalil irundhu thodangiya perani bus nilaiyam aruge mudindhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Aar.es.es oodagamaana Organiser-n samooga oodaga pakkathilum kooda indha video veliyaagi irundhadhu. Akdovar 6, 2025 andru veliyaana andha padhivilum kooda indha perani rathlamil nadandhadhu endre kurippidappattirundhadhu. Ivaiye podhumaana aadhaarangalaaga irundhaalum, andha pagudhiyin idam kidaithaal koodudhal palamaaga irukkum enbadhaal aayvaith thodarndhom.
Rathlam bus nilaiyam aruge indha perani nadandhadhu endru kurippittirundhadhaal, andha pagudhiyai koogul street viyoovil paarvaiyittom. Video-vil saalai valaivaik kaana mudindhadhu. Appadi oru valaivu ulladhaa endru thediya podhu oru saalai namakkuk kidaithadhu. Andha idathil irundha kattidangalum, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda veediyovil idam petrirundha kattidangalum othuppoyina. Idhan moolam indha idam mathiyap piradhesa maanilam rathlamdhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Kaas kuzhaay padhikka roo.2 latcham kettu mirattal: TVK, nirvaagi thambi utbada 5 perukku valai
text:
Kolathoor: samaiyal erivaayu kuzhaay padhikkum paniyai thodara, 2 latcham roobai lanjjam kettu mirattiyadhaaga alitha pugaaril, TVK, maavatta seyalarin thambi ullitta aindhu perai Police thedi varugindranar.
Maadhavarathais serndhavar suvendhu samandhaa, 47; thaniyaar niruvana merpaarvaiyaalar. Kolathoor latchumi amman kovil, kangaa thiyettar aruge, kadandha 12m thedhi mudhal nadaiverum samaiyal erivaayu kuzhaay padhikkum panigalai, 'torant paiplain' niruvanathukkaaga ivar kavanithu varugiraar.
Pani thodangiya naal mudhal, thileepgumaar, mugamadhu saleem ullitta aindhu per, paniyidathukku vandhu, 'naangal indha eriyaa aatkal. Engalukku 2 latcham roobai koduthuvittu paniyai thodarungal' ena mirattiyadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Panam tharaavittaal adithu virattuvom enakkoori, velaiyai seyya vidaamal thaduthadhaagavum pugaar alikkappattulladhu.
Kadandha 17m thedhi, paniyidathukku vandha aivar kumbal, paniyai thaduthu, suvendhu samandhaavai thaakka muyandradhaaga therigiradhu. Idhuguritha pugaarinbadi, raajamangalam Police vazhakkuppadhindhu, thileepgumaar, 31, ullitta aindhu perai thedi varugindranar. Idhil thileepgumaar, TVK, maavatta seyalar thanigaavin thambi enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.
Vazhakkuppadhivai thodarndhu, TVK, vazhakkarinjar matrum 30 perudan raajamangalam kaaval nilaiyathukku sendru, visaaranai mudiyum varai panigalai nirutha vendum ena, valiyuruthinar. Idhaiyaduthu, netru madhiyam 1:30 mani mudhal kuzhaay padhikkum pani niruthappattadhu.

headline: Varalaatril illaadha sarivu : paridhaavathil vairathin vilai - thangathukkum idhe nilai varumaa?
text:
Ulaga vaira sandhaiyil varalaatrileye illaadha vilai sarivu erpattulladhu.
Ulagin madhippu mikka porulgalil ondraaga vairangal thigazhndhu varugiradhu. Ulaga alavil miga kuraindha alavil, sila idangalil mattume indha vairangal kidaithu vandhadhaal adhan vilai saamaaniyargalukku ettaadha vagaiyileye irundhu vandhadhu.
Aanaal 1950-kalil America-vil seyarkai vairangal uruvaakkappattadhu oru puratchiyaagave karudhappattadhu. Adhanaith thodarndhu ippadi seyarkaiyaaga uruvaakkappatta vairangal sandhaiyil virpanaikkum konduvarappattadhu.
Thodakkathil seyarkai vairangalum iyarkai vairangalukku inaiyaana vilaiyil virpanai seyyappattadhu. Aanaal thozhilnutbam valarndha pinnar seyarkai vairathai uruvaakkum selavu periya alavil kuraindhadhu. Saplai timaant adippadaiyileye vairathin vilai nirnayam seyyappadum nilaiyil, seyarkai vairangalin saplai adhigarithadhaal sarvadhesa sandhaiyil adhan vilaiyum kadumaiyaaga sarindhulladhu.
Kadandha 2021- 2022-l 1-kaarat vairathin saraasari vilai sumaar 6,819 America taalar endra uchathai ettiyadhu. Aanaal tharpodhu adhu 4,500 America taalar endra alavil kuraindhulladhu. Adhaavadhu vairathin vilai kurugiya kaalathil 27% veezhchiyai sandhithulladhu.
Idharku mukkiya kaaranamaaga China thigazhndhu varuvadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Seyarkai vairathin saplaiyil sumaar 60 sadhaveedha ulaga sandhaiyais China mattume aakkiramithulladhu. Adhodu 2026aam aandil mudhal 6 maadhathil China-vin seyarkai vairathin etrumadhi alavu 65.3 sadhaveedham adhigarithulladhu. Idhanaal varum kaalangalil vairathin vilai melum sariyum endre edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Vairathai pola thangathaiyum seyarkaiyaaga uruvaakka palveru muyatsigalum merkollappattu varugiradhu. Vairathai pola thangathai seyarkaiyaaga uruvaakkuvadhum saathiyamaanaal thangathin vilaiyum pala madangu veezhchiyai sandhikkum enbadhu kurippidathakkadhu.

headline: Putrunoy | “noyaaligalukku edhiraana appattamaana pagal kollai” - needhivadhigal adhirupdhi
text:
Putrunoy | “noyaaligalukku edhiraana appattamaana pagal kollai” - needhivadhigal adhirupdhi
marundhugalin vilai mosadigal kurithu thaakkal seyyappattirundha manukkalil, putrunoykkaana athiyaavasiya marundhugalin vilai nirnayam matrum sillarai virpanai nadaimuraigal kurithu adhirchiyalikkum aadhaarangal munvaikkappattana. Idhai visaaritha needhivadhigal, virpanaiyaalargalukku 2,700 roovaaykku viniyogikkappadum putrunoy marundhu, nugarvorukku adhigavatchamaaga 27 aayiram roobai varai virkappaduvadhai suttikkaattinar.
Putrunoyaal paadhikkappadum makkal, thangalin uyiraik kaappaatrikkolla veedugalaiyum nagaigalaiyum virkum nilaikkuth thallappadugindranar. Ithagaiya soozhalil, noyaaligalidam 10 madangu adhiga panam vasoolippadhu emaatru velai ena saadiya Needhimandram, idhaith thadukkavendiya adhigaarigal vedikkai paarppadhu en endrum kelvi ezhuppiyadhu. Ucha needhimandrathin karuthai urudhi seyyum vagaiyil, mathiya pulliyiyal matrum thitta amalaakkath thurai kadandha epral 20aam thedhi veliyittirundha pulli vivarathinbadi thamizhnaattai serndha putrunoyaali oruvar, parisodhanai matrum thodakka nilai sigichaigalukke oru latchathu 35 aayirathu 368 roobai selavazhippadhu theriyavandhulladhu. Innilaiyil Thamizhagathil ovvoru aandum putrunoyaal paadhikkappaduvorin ennikkai adhigarithuvarugiradhu.
Mathiya sugaadhaara amaichagam naadaalumandrathil kadandha pipravari maadham alitha padhilil Thamizhagathil 2020aam aandu 68 aayirathu 750 perukkum, 2021aam aandu 76 aayirathu 968 perukkum, 2022aam aandu 89 aayirathu 265 perukkum putrunoy paadhippu urudhi seyyappattadhaaga therivikkappattirundhadhu. 2023aam aandu 92 aayirathu 816 perukkum, 2024aam aandu 96 aayirathu 486 perukkum putrunoy paadhippu urudhi seyyappattadhu. Kadandha 2025aam aandil mattum pudhidhaaga oru latchathu 97 perukku putrunoy urudhi seyyappattulladhu.

headline: Minsaaram paayndhu thozhilaali pali
text:
Thiruchi:thiruchiyil, min kambathil, vilakku pazhudhu neekkiya podhu, thozhilaali oruvar minsaaram paayndhu uyirizhandhaar.
Trichy, aalandhoor ooraatchikku utbatta kullambattiyil, theru min vilakkugal sariyaaga eriyavillai.
Ooraatchi nirvaagap paniyaalar oruvar, viraalimalaiyai serndha karuppaiyaa, 42, enbavarai azhaithu vandhu, min vilakkugalai pazhudhu paarkkas solli ullaar. Avar, min kambathil eriyappodhu, minsaaram paayndhu uyirizhandhaar. Manigandam Police, vazhakku padhindhu visaarikkindranar.

headline: Teknikkal anaalisis: thisai theriyaadha nilai uruvaaga vaayppulladhu
text:
Netru 15 pulligal etrathudan aarambitha nipdi, 3 mani varai sirusiru etra irakkangalai sandhithu pinnar naalin irudhiyil 46 pulligal uyarndhu mudindhadhu. Parandha sandhai kuriyeedugal 17l 2 kuriyeedugal etrathudanum; 15 kuriyeedugal irakkathudanum niraivadaindhana.
Ivatril, 'nipdi100' kuriyeedu adhiga patchamaaga 0.08 sadhaveedha uyarvudanum, 'nipdimitkep150' kuriyeedu adhiga patchamaaga 0.38 sadhavigidha sarivudanum mudindhana. 21 thurai saarndha kuriyeedugalil 7 kuriyeedugal etrathudanum; 14 kuriyeedugal irakkathudanum kaanappattana.
Ivatril, 'nipdi meediyaa' kuriyeedu adhiga patchamaaga 0.55 sadhaveedha etrathudanum, 'nipdi mitsmaal ai.ti., & teligaam' kuriyeedu adhiga patchamaaga 0.77 sadhaveedha irakkathudanum niraivadaindhana. En.es.i.,-yil varthagam nadandha 3,666 niruvanangalin pangugalil 1,466 etrathudanum; 2,077 irakkathudanum; 123 maatram edhum illaamalum niraivadaindhirundhana.
Nipdi meendum anaithu mukkiya saraasarigal (i.em.e.,) matrum ichimogu kilavudukku keezhe niraivadandhulladhu. Aar.es.ai., matrum stokkaasttik adhiga alavil ovarsoldu endra teknikkal nilaiyil iruppadhai kaattugiradhu. 23,380 udanadi sapporttaaga irukkiradhu.
 Idharku keezhe sendraal irakkam thodaralaam. Udanadi resistens 23,700-23,770l irukkiradhu. Ivatrai thaandi etram kandaalume 23,960-24,030l valuvaana resistensai nipdi sandhikka vendiyirukkum. Teknikkalaaga ovarsoldu nilamai iruppadhaal siriyadhoru etram vara vaayppulladhu.
Appadi etram vandhaalume 23,700ai thaandaadhavarai teknikkalaaga etram nilaithirukkum enbadharkaana urudhi edhumillai. Enave, tharpodhaiya soozhalil thisaidheriyaa nilai uruvaaga vaayppulladhu.

headline: Nellai: kottith theertha kanamazhai; thirakkappadaadha kolmudhal nilaiyangal - sedhamaana nel moottaigal!
text:
Nellaiyil kolmudhal nilaiyangal thirakkappadaadhadhaal aruvadai seytha nel moottaigalai virpanai seyyamudiyaamal vivasaayigal thavithu vandhanar. Indha nilaiyil, thideerena peytha mazhaiyil nel moottaigal sedhamadaindhadhaal kavalaiyil aazhndhullanar.
Nellai maavattam, ambaasamuthiram matrum adhan sutruvattaarap pagudhigalil nel aruvadai panigal theeviramaaga nadaivetru varugindrana. Pala maadhangalaaga vayalil uzhaithu aruvadai seytha nelmanigalai virpanai seyvadharkaaga vivasaayigal kolmudhal nilaiyangalai edhirbaarthu kaathirundhanar. Aanaal, kurippitta pagudhigalil nel kolmudhal nilaiyangal innum thirakkappadavillai. Idhanaal, aruvadai seyyappatta nel moottaigalai paadhugaappaana idathil semithu vaikka mudiyaamal vivasaayigal siramappattu vandhanar.
Kurippaaga, ayan singambatti, jameen singambatti, vairaavigulam, therku paappaangulam ullitta pagudhigalil nel kolmudhal nilaiyangal idhuvarai thirakkappadaadhadhaal, vivasaayigal aruvadai seytha Nellai veedugalin munbaagavum, saalaiyorangalilum, thirandhaveliyilum kuvithu vaithirundhanar. Indha nilaiyil, yaarum edhirbaaraadha vagaiyil thideerena kanamazhai peythadhu. Mazhaineer pugundhadhudan, thirandhaveliyil kuvithu vaikkappattirundha nel moottaigal muzhuvadhumaaga nanaindhu sedhamadaindhana.
Idhugurithu vivasaayigalidam pesinom, “nellai maavattam, ambaasamuthiram sutruvattaarap pagudhigalil tharpodhu nel aruvadaik kaalam. Aruvadai mudindhu veedugalin munbu kuvithu vaikkappattirundha nel moottaigal mattumindri, erkanave virpanaikkaaga kondu varappattu kolmudhal nilaiyangalai edhirbaarthu vaikkappattirundha nel moottaigalum mazhaiyil nanaindhullana. Idhanaal nellin tharam paadhikkappaduvadhudan, eerappadham adhigarithu edai kuraiyum nilaiyum erpattulladhu.
Melum, nanaindha Nellai udanadiyaaga ulartha mudiyaadha nilaiyil, thodarndhu mazhai peythaal nel mulaithu, virpanaikku thagudhiyatradhaaga maarum. Erkanave vidhai, uram, poochikkolli marundhu, vivasaaya kooli ullitta palveru selavugalai seythu aruvadai seytha nel, kolmudhal nilaiyangal thirakkappadaadhadhaal thirandhaveliyil vaikkappattu, tharpodhu mazhaiyilum nanaindhu sedhamadaindhiruppadhu vivasaayigalidaiye kadum adhirupdhiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Indha sedhathaal vivasaayigalin porulaadhaara nerukkadiyai melum adhigarithulladhu. Sedhamadaindha nel moottaigalai adhigaarigal neril paarvaiyittu aayvu seythu, vivasaayigalukku uriya nivaaranam alladhu izhappeedu vazhanga nadavadikkai edukka vendum.” endranar. Idhugurithu ambaasamuthiram vattaara velaan adhigaarigal tharappil pesinom, “nel kolmudhal nilaiyangalai seyalbaduthuvadharkuth thevaiyaana iyandhirangal matrum uvagaranangal kondu varappattulladhu.
Innum oriru naatkalil kolmudhal nilaiyangal thirakkappattu nel kolmudhal thodangum.” endranar. Aanaal, adharkul meendum mazhai peythaal melum pala nel moottaigal sedhamadaiyum avaayam ulladhaal, kaaladhaamadhamindri kolmudhal nilaiyangalai thirandhu nel kolmudhalai thodanga vendum enbadhe vivasaayigalin mukkiya korikkaiyaaga ulladhu.

headline: Jananaayagan padathai leek seytha navar kaidhu endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘jananaayagan padathai leek seytha navar kaidhu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ jananaayagan padathai leek seytha thiruttu paiyan indru kaidhu seyyappattan
ini ivvaru kutram seythaal ini kadumaiyaana  thandanai vazhanga padavendum ✅,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan pugaippadam ondrum inaikkappattulladhu. 
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda seythi unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi kadandha 2019m aandu kovaiyil 7 vayadhu sirumiyai vangodumai seythu, kondra sandhoshgumaar enbavarukku, thookku thandanai vidhikkappattadhu. Adhanbodhu, sandhoshgumaarai Police azhaithus sendra pugaippadamdhaan idhu. Idhanai edit seythu, thavaraana mugam serthu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Idhudhodarbaaga, palveru oodagangalilum erkanave seythi veliyaagiyulladhu.
The News Minute l Timesofindia l NDTV l New Indian Express
adhesamayam, jananaayagan padam inaiyathil thiruttuthanamaaga veliyaana vivagaarathil, silar kaidhu seyyappattullanar. Aanaal, adharkum, naam aayvu seyyum pugaippadathirkum endha thodarbum illai.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thavaru nadappadhai yaaraalum thadukka mudiyaadhu endru kudumba nalathurai amaichar arun raaj koorinaaraa?
text:
‘‘thavaru nadappadhai yaaraalum thadukka mudiyaadhu’’, endru kudumba nalathurai amaichar arun raaj kooriyadhaaga,

idhil, ‘’10 vayadhu sirumiyin uyirukkaana padhil! Thavaru nadappadhai yaaraalum thadukka mudiyaadhu; nadavadikkai edukkavillaiyendraal mattum kelvi ezhuppungal. Sirumiyaik kondravargal kaidhu seyyappattullaargal, veru enna seyya vendum ungalukku?- kudumba nalathurai amaichar arunraaj.’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Polimer news logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda news card unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu Polimer News peyaril paravum vadhandhi, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, Polimer News aasiriyar kuzhu matrum TVK thalaimai aluvalagathilum idhuvatri pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda news card poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Sirumi paaliyal vangodumai vazhakkil oruvarukku thookku; iruvarukku sirai: pokso Court adhiradi
text:
Tirunelveli: thirunelveliyil sirumiyai paaliyal vangodumai seytha vazhakkil sinnagutti enbavarukku thookku thandanai, muneesvaranukku 13 aandugal sirai, murugesanukku 20 aandu sirai thandanai vidhithu pokso Needhimandram theerppalithadhu.
Tirunelveli kokkiragulathai serndha 16 vayadhu sirumi, uravinar veettil thangi pilas 2 padithaar.
2022l sirumi paditha palliyil peyint adikkum panikku vilaathigulathai serndha muneesvaran 26, vandhaar. Erkanave thirumanamaanadhai maraithu, sirumiyai thirumanam seyvadhaaga koori pazhaginaar. 2022 akdovaril sirumiyai melappaalaiyam pagudhikku azhaithus sendraar. Angu vandha keezhaveeraraagavavurathai serndha sinnagutti 28, murugesan 23, aagiyor sirumiyai muneesvaranidam irundhu pirithu paaliyal vangodumai seythanar.
Sambavam kurithu sirumi tharappil poleesil pugaar alikkappadavillai. Thagavalarindha Police, kuzhandhai paadhugaappu adhigaarigalidam pugaar petru visaaranai nadathi moovaraiyum kaidhu seythanar. Visaaranai Tirunelveli pokso sirappu needhimandrathil nadandhadhu. Ivvazhakkil kaidhaana moovarum kutravaaligal ena sila thinangalukku mun needhivadhi sureshgumaar theerppalithaar. Netru thandanai vivaram arivikkappattadhu.
Idhil sinnaguttikku thookku thandanai vidhikkappattadhu. Muneesvaranukku 13 aandugal, murugesanukku 20 aandugal sirai thandanai vidhikkappattadhu. Sinnaguttikku roo.12 aayiramum, matra iruvarukkum thalaa roo.10 aayiramum avaraadham vidhikkappattadhu. Paadhikkappatta sirumikku Thamizhaga arasu saarbil roo.10 latcham izhappeedu vazhangavum needhivadhi utharavittaar. Arasu tharappil vazhakkarinjar ushaa aajaraanaar. Vazhakku visaaranaiyil sirappaaga seyalbatta insbekdargal raamesvari, muthulatchumi, naagagumaari matrum Police renugaa aagiyorai maanagara Police kamishanar segar theshmuk paaraattinaar.
2025 mudhal 4 perukku thookku Tirunelveli maavattathil 2025 mudhal idhuvarai 28 pokso vazhakkugalil 29 kutravaaligalukku needhimandrangal thandanai vazhangiyullana.
Idhil 2025l sondha magalukku paaliyal thondharavu kodutha thandhai, 2026 maarchil kurichiyai serndha aanandhasegar, aaga.20l naangu sirumigalukku paaliyal thondharavu kodutha madhavodhagar aaviragaam aagiyorukku thookkuthandanai vidhikkappattadhu.
Tharpodhu sinnaguttikku thookku thandanai vidhikkappattulladhu. Enave 2025 mudhal idhuvarai 4 perukku thookku thandanai vidhikkappattulladhu. Tirunelveli pokso sirappu needhimandrathil paaliyal vazhakkugalil idhuvarai 10 perukku thookku thandanai vidhikkappattulladhu.

headline: Kanima valathurai amaichar ti.ke. Piravu VV minarals kudumbathai sandhithaaraa?
text:
‘‘VV minarals kudumbathai sandhitha kanima valathurai amaichar ti.ke. Piravu’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ Thamizhaga varalaatril kodooramaana kanimavala kollaiyan endraal adhu vaigundaraajan VV minarals… indha kanimavala kollaiyan kudumbathai kooppittu sandhikka vendiya avasiyam kanimavala thurai amaicharukku enna irukku? Kanimala kollaiyai thaduppen sollivittu adutha naale andha kollaikkumbalin thalaivan kudumbathai kooppittu sandhikkum andha manasu thaan saar… varisaiyaa vaanga vandhu enga aatchikku kamishan thandhuttu ponga momant maadhiri irukkulla ..
Aanaa kadandha DMK aatchiyila thimugagaaran thaan kollaiyadikkuradhaa narettiv set panni iruppaanunga!,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, ti.ke. Piravuvudan nirkum navar TVK thengaasi therku maavatta seyalaalar vivin sakkaravarthi aavaar. Ivar, VV Minerals vaigundaraajan magan alladhu neradi vaarisu kidaiyaadhu. Vivin TVK nirvaagi enbadhudan, TPV Multiplex urimaiyaalar. Avaradhu thandhai peyar T.P. Velsamy Nadar.
Melum, sameevathil nadaivetra Tamil Nadu sattamandra therdhalil, vivin aalangulam sattamandra thogudhiyil pottiyittaar.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, TVK thalaimai aluvalagam matrum vivin tharappilum idhuvatri pesi, urudhippaduthiyullom.
Idhanbadi, kadandha me 22, 2026 andru kanima valam kadathalai thadukka kori kanima valathurai amaichar thiru. T.K.piravuvidam vivin sakkaravarthi manu alithaar. Andha pugaippadathai eduthu, thavaraana thagaval pagirappaduvadhaaga, namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, vivin sakkaravarthi, VV Minerals vaigundaraajan magan alladhu neradi vaarisu kidaiyaadhu; naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Maanaviyarukku thollai kirisdhuva paadhiriyaar kaidhu
text:
Trichy maavattam, samayavuram, pallividai pagudhiyil punidha mariyannai arasu udhaviverum uyarnilaippalliyin thalaimai aasiriyaraaga, paadhiriyaar jeyaraaj, aaru maadhangalukku mun poruppetraar.
Netru mundhinam, ven kattanam kurithu ketka, jeyaraaj araikku sendra, ezhaam vaguppu maanavikku, jeyaraaj paaliyal thollai koduthullaar. Maanavi thappikka muyandravodhu, 'veliye son naal tholaithu viduven' ena, mirattiyullaar.
Thagavalil, maanaviyin petror, kiraama makkal, netru kaalai pallikku thirandu vandhanar. Jeyaraaj, pal liyin pinvaasal vazhiyaaga, thappiyodivittaar. Podhumakkal palliyai mutrugaiyittavodhu, jeyaraaj, idhevola, pala maanavi yarukkum thollai koduthadhu therindhadhu.
Samayavuram Police, podhumakkalidam pesi, amaidhippaduthinar. Maavatta mudhanmai kalvi aluvalar ushaa, pallikku vandhu visaaranai nadathinaar. Police, jeyaraajai poksovil, netru kaidhu seythanar.

headline:
NEET thervu muraigedu edhiroli..
Ini manidhargal illai? ‘AI’ moolam nadakkappogum adhiradi maatram!
text:
NEET thervu muraigedu edhiroli.. Ini manidhargal illai? ‘AI’ moolam nadakkappogum adhiradi maatram!
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
kalvi karpippadhu mudhal maruthuvam varai, anaithuth thuraigalilum ‘AI’ enappadum seyarkai nunnarivin payanbaadu vegamaaga adhigarithu varum nilaiyil, tharpodhu naattin mukkiyamaana nuzhaivuthervugalukkaana vinaathaal thayaarippu matrum mozhiveyarppup panigalilum AI mukkiyap pangu vagikka ulladhu. NEET pondra naadu muzhuvadhum nadaiverum mukkiyamaana nuzhaivuthervugalil vinaathaal paadhugaappu matrum thervu nadaimuraigal thodarbaaga thodarndhu palveru vivaadhangal ezhundhu varum nilaiyil, thesiya thervu mugamai enappadum NTA tharpodhu thervu muraigalil palveru maatrangalai merkondu varugiradhu. Andha vagaiyil, vinaathaalgalai mozhiveyarkkum nadaimuraiyilum seyarkai nunnarivu thozhilnutbathai adhiga alavil payanbaduthath thittamidappattulladhu.
Maruthuvap padippugalukkaana mukkiya nuzhaivuthervaana NEET, thamizh, indhi ullitta 13 mozhigalil nadathappadugiradhu. 2026-aam aandukkaana NEET thervilum 13 mozhigalil vinaathaalgal vazhangappattullana. Maanavargal thangalukku viruppamaana piraandhiya mozhiyaith thervuseyyum nilaiyil, andha mozhiyilum aangilathilum vinaathaal vazhangappadugiradhu. Mozhiveyarppil edhenum kuzhappam erpattaal, aangilap padhippe irudhiyaanadhaagak karudhappadum ena NTA thanadhu vidhimuraigalil therivithulladhu.
Indha nilaiyil, aangilathil irundhu pira mozhigalukku vinaathaalgalai mozhiveyarkkum paniyil AI thozhilnutbathai adhiga alavil payanbadutha NTA thittamittulladhu. Idhanmoolam mozhiveyarppu paniyai vegamaaga merkolvadhudan, mozhiveyarppil ore maadhiriyaana tharathai paraamarikka mudiyum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Aanaal, idhan kaaranamaaga inimel vinaathaalgalai manidhargale mozhiveyarkka maattaargal endru koora mudiyaadhu. AI moolam merkollappadum mozhiveyarppil erpadakkoodiya mozhi, ilakkanam matrum paadam saarndha pizhaigalai kandarindhu sarivaarppadharku manidha nivunargalin pangalippum thodarndhu irukkum vagaiyil nadaimuraigal uruvaakkappattu varugindrana. Idharkaagave NTA tharpodhu Subject Matter Experts enappadum paadappirivu nivunargalai pudhidhaaga empanel seythu varugiradhu. Vinaathaal thayaarippadhu mattumindri, kelvigalai madhippaayvu seythal, mozhiveyarppu, mozhiveyarppai sarivaarthal matrum moderation ullitta palveru panigalilum indha nivunargal eeduvada ulladhaaga NTA therivithulladhu.
Idhumattumindri, vinaathaal paadhugaappai adhigarikkum vagaiyilum NTA palveru maatrangalai merkondu varugiradhu. Mukkiyamaana ragasiya panigalukkaaga paadhugaappaana kanini amaippugal, thanimaippaduthappatta paniyidangal matrum paniyaalargalukkaana palveru paadhugaappu kattuppaadugal pondra nadaimuraigalum kondu varappattu varugindrana. Melum, vinaathaalil thagaval saarndha pizhaigal, mozhip pizhaigal, mozhiveyarppu matrum vadivamaippu thodarbaana thavarugalai kandarindhu sariseyvadharkaaga pala adukku sarivaarppu muraigalum merkollappada ullana. Idhanmoolam vinaathaal paadhugaappai melum adhigarikkavum, mozhiveyarppil erpadakkoodiya thavarugalai kuraikkavum, naadu muzhuvadhum ore maadhiriyaana thervu nadaimuraiyai uruvaakkavum mudiyum ena edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.

headline: Erivorul thattuppaadu : sikkana nadavadikkaigalai pinbatrum Pakistan
text:
Islaamaavaath: merkaasiyaavil nilavum padhatramaana soozhalai karudhi, erivorul sikkana nadavadikkaigalai Pakistan arivithulladhu.
Merkaasiya naadaana Iran - America idaiyeyaana modhalaal, haarmus jalasandhi mudakkam, Iran aadharavu petra havudhi payangaravaadhigal - savudhi areviyaa idaiyeyaana modhalaal, sengadal pagudhiyil ulla paap el - maandep jalasandhi mudakkam ullittavatraal, ulagalaaviya kachaa enney etrumadhi paadhikkappattulladhu.
Innilaiyil, nam andai naadaana paak., erivorulai semikka sikkana nadavadikkaigalai arivithulladhu. Idhanbadi, arasu vaaganangal vaanga muzhumaiyaaga thadai vidhikkappattulladhu. Melum, arasu vaaganangalukkaana erivorul odhukkeettil, 50 sadhaveedham kuraikkappattulladhu.
Thirumana nigazhchigalil, 'ore oru unavu vagai' mattume parimaarappada vendum; arasu adhigaarigal velinaadugalukku payanam seyya thadai pondra kattuppaadugal vidhikkappattullana. Vaniga valaagangalai, iravu 10:00 manikkullum, unavagangalai iravu, 11:00 manikkullum mooda utharavidappattu ulladhu. Athiyaavasiya sevaigalukku indha kattuppaattil irundhu vilakku alikkappattulladhu.

headline: ‘DMK-vai adikka neengal payanbaduthum seruppu sais enna’ endru vijayidam CBI kettadhaa?
text:
‘‘DMK-vai adikka neengal payanbaduthum seruppu sais enna’’, endru vijayidam CBI kettadhaagak koori,

idhil, ‘’saramaari kelvi. DMK-vai adikka neengal payanbaduthum seruppu sais enna?,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
San news logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha news card-il logo irukkum idathil irandu pan ulladhaik kandom.
Idhanai paarkkumbodhe edit seyyappattulladhaa endru sandhegam ezhugiradhu. Enave, Sun News aasiriyar kuzhuvil visaarithom. Appodhu, ‘’idhu edit seyyappatta news card naangal veliyitta seythi verondru,’’ endru therivithanar.
Unmaiyaana news card lingk idho…
idhil, ‘’ thanneer paattilai veesiyavodhu kootta nerisalai paarkkavillaiyaa?
Vaaganathin mel irundha ungalukku, keezhe nilaimai mosamaanadhu theriyavillaiyaa? Karooril 41 per uyirizhandha vazhakku – vijayidam CBI saramaari kelvi,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Amithshaavai miratti amara vaitha thirinaamul Congress em.pi endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Naadaalumandrathil mathiya uldhurai amaichar amithshaavai miratti amara vaitha thirinaamul Congress em.pi kaagoli kosh endru oru video

naadaalumandrathil em.pi oruvar pesa adharku piradhamar narendhira Modi, uldhurai amaichar amithshaa ullittor padhil solla mudiyaamal thinariyadhu pondru oru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Avar utkaar endru adhattalaaga pesa, amithshaa amaidhiyaaga amarvadhu pondru kaatchiyum ulladhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “thirumadhi kaagoli kosh MP amith shaa vai mirattugiraar 🔥
nee ukkaaru! Unakku enna theriyum? Ninnukkitte irukke… naan solrenla, pesaama ukkaaru! Unakku onnun theriyaadhu.
Petrol vilai ₹100 ai thaandiyiruchu. Vilaivaasi kannaa pinnaa nu eriduchu. Ezhaigal eppadi soru thimbaanga nu yosichiyaa? Edharkeduthaalum GST podure…
pesaama kammunu kundhikkinaaru amith shaa… 😂😂😂” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil viral-aaga pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Naadaalumandrathil alladhu sattamandrathil uruppinargal pesum podhu amaichargal kurukkittaal uruppinargal amaidhiyaaga irukka vendum. Amaichar pesa avaith thalaivar anumadhi alippaar. Piradhamar alladhu mudhalamaichar ezhundhaal avaiye amaidhiyaagividum. Aanaal, indha video-vil Modi thinaruvadhu pondru kaattappadugiradhu.
Naadaalumandra uruppinar kaagoli kosh makkalavaiyilirundhu pesugiraar. Avaradhu naarkaaliyin niram pachaiyaaga iruppadhai kaanalaam. Makkalavaiyil thaan irukkai methai pachai nirathil irukkum. Maanilangalavai irukkai methaigal adar sivappu nirathil irukkum. Amithshaa amarum kaatchiyil avaiyin irukkai niram adar sivappu nirathil ulladhaik kaanalaam. Enave, indha video edit seyyappattulladhu enbadhai arindhugolla mudigiradhu.
Unmaiyil thirinaamul Congress em.pi amithshaavai miratti amara vaithaaraa endru ariya unmai video-vai thedi eduthom. 2022m aandu aagast 1m thedhi Sansad TV andha video-vai YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhu. Adhil vilaivaasi, petroliya porutkal vilai uyarvu patri kaagoli kosh pesugiraar. 12:38 vadhu nimidathil andha kaatchi varugiradhu. Adhil avar yaarai amaras solgiraar endru thelivaagak kaattavillai. Aanaal andha nerathil avaiyil nidhiyamaichar nirmalaa seedhaaraaman mattum iruppadhu pondru kaattappadugiradhu.
Aduthadhaaga amithshaa thorbaana video-vai thedi eduthom. Andha video-vai Sansad TV 2022 pipravari 7m thedhi YouTube-il padhivittirundhadhu. Asadhutheen ovaisiyin vaaganam meedhu nadathappatta thaakkudhal thodarbaaga amithshaa padhil alitha video adhu. Adhil avar padhil alithuvittu kadaiyil amarndha kaatchiyai mattum eduthu kaagoli kosh video-vil serthu edit seythu padhivittulladhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Uppaaru odaiyin neervazhithadam maayam!: seemaigaruvela marangalaal avalam
text:
Udumalai: uppaaru anaikku, pi.e.pi., piradhaana kaalvaayil irundhu thanneer thirakkappadum odaiyil seemaigaruvela marangal aakkiramithulladhaal, anaiyai neer ettuvadhu kelvikkuriyaagiyulladhu. Thaaraavuram thaalugaa kethalrev pagudhiyil, amaindhulla uppaaru anai, 572 milliyan kanaadi kollalavu kondadhaagum; neradiyaaga, 6,060 ekkar nilangal paasana vasadhi perugiradhu.
Podhiya neerppidippu pagudhigal indha anaikku illai. Pi.e.pi., paasanam irandu mandalamaaga mattum irundha podhu, uppaaru odai vazhiyaaga, kasivu neerum, arasaanai adippadaiyil, pi.e.pi., piradhaana kaalvaayil irundhu arasoor shattar vazhiyaagavum, anaikku thanneer sendradhu.
Pi.e.pi., naangu mandalamaaga virivuvaduthappatta piragu, kasivu neer selvadhu thadaivattu, uppaaru padugai varatchippagudhiyaaga maariyadhu. Sila aandugalaaga, kudineer thevaikkaaga pi.e.pi., piradhaana kaalvaayil irundhu uppaaru anaikku thanneer vazhangappadugiradhu.
Mirattum varatchi indhaandu paruvamazhai peyyaamal pi.e.pi., thoguppu anaigal nirambavillai. Aaga., maadhathil, paasanathukkum, thirumoorthi anaiyilirundhu thanneer thirakkavillai.
Innilaiyil, kudineer thevaikkaaga uppaaru anaikku, pi.e.pi., kaalvaayil irundhu thanneer thirakka, thaaraavuram pagudhi makkal poraattathil eeduvattu varugindranar.
'mandala paasanathukke neer iruppu illaadha podhu, uppaaru anaikku thanneer thirakkagoodaadhu', ena pi.e.pi., vivasaayigal pollaachiyil poraadinar.
Iru tharappinarum poraadinaalum, anaikku thanneer sellum, odaiyin paridhaava nilaiyai kandugollavillai.
Meetbadhu avasiyam pi.e.pi., arasoor shattaril irundhu thuvangum uppaaru odai, 30 ki.mee.,kkum adhigamaana thooram payanithu uppaaru anaiyudan sergiradhu. Indha odai iruppadhe theriyaadha alavukku seemai karuvela marangal aakkiramithullana.
Neenda kaalamaaga thoorvaarappadaamal, pala idangalil manmedaagavum, paadhaiyaagavum maarivittadhu. Piradhaana kaalvaayil thirakkappadum thanneer, paadhikkum kuraivaagave anaiyai sendradaiyum nilaiyil odai ulladhu.
Indha odaikku mazhaikkaalangalilum neer varathu kidaikkaadha alavukku, neervazhithadangalum aakkiramikkappattullana. Vazhiyora thaduppanaigalum paraamarippindri ulladhu.
Uppaaru anaikku thanneer thirappadhu kuritha sarchaiyai thaandi, odaiyai meetka thittam edhuvum seyalbaduthappadavillai. Neervalathurai adhigaarigal, odaiyai muzhumaiyaaga alaveedu seythu, aakkiramippugalaiyum, seemaigaruvela marangalaiyum agatra vendum.
Illaavittaal, mazhaippozhivu adhigarithaalum, pi.e.pi., kaalvaayil thanneer thirandhaalum, uppaaru padugaiyil nilavum varatchikku mutruppulli vaikka mudiyaadhu.
Neervalathurai thirumoorthi uvagotta seyarporiyaalar piravaagaran koorugaiyil, '' uppaaru odaiyil seemaigaruvela marangal kurippitta idaiveliyil agatrappadugiradhu. Tharpodhu thaaraavuram pagudhiyil ippanigal nadakkiradhu. Odai muzhuvadhum ippanigalai merkolla thannaarva amaippugalin udhavi ketkappattulladhu. Neervazhithadam muzhuvadhum seemaigaruvela marangal viraivil agatrappadum,'' endraar.

headline: Vi.e.o.,vukku lanjjam kodukka pichaiyedutha tip taap aasaamiyaal paravarappu
text:
Vi.e.o.,vukku lanjjam kodukka pichaiyedutha 'tip taap' aasaamiyaal paravarappu
 ulundhoorbettai: ulundhoorbettaiyil vi.e.o., vukku lanjjam kodukka kooling kilaasudan tip taap aasaami kaiyil thattendhi pichaiyeduthadhaal paravarappu nilaviyadhu.
Kallakkurichi maavattam, elavanaasoorgottai adutha keezhappaalaiyam pagudhiyais serndhavar apdhulsaleem shek, 45; nonaiyavaadi kiraamathai serndha ivaradhu manaiviyaana thaahiron, 40; kudumbathil ulla nilathirku koottu pattaavil peyar serkkak kori kadandha maars maadham elavanaasoorgottai vi.e.o.,vidam manu alithullaar.
Innilaiyil, koottu pattaavil peyar serkka vi.e.o., 20 aayiram roobai lanjjam ketbadhaaga koori, apdhulsaleem shek, ulundhoorbettai bus nilaiyathil podhumakkalidam kaiyil thattu endhi pichai kettaar.
Melum avar, vaazhga thamizh, ozhiyattum oozhal, poorveega sothil koottu pattaavil peyar serkka vi.e.o., lanjjam kettaar. Ennidam panam illai, adhanaal makkal mathiyil pichai edukkiren ena padhaagai vaithirundhaar.
Vi.e.o., vukku lanjjam koduppadharkaaga jeens, pent sattai anindhu kooling kilaasudan tipdaappaaga valam vandhu pichai edutha sambavam appagudhiyil paravarappai erpaduthiyadhu.

headline: Kalappu kudiyiruppu enbadhaal anumadhi maruppu pirinding yoonit iyanguvadhil sikkal
text:
'kalappu kudiyiruppu' enbadhaal anumadhi maruppu pirinding yoonit iyanguvadhil sikkal
Tiruppur: thiruppooril, maasukkattuppaadu vaariya parakkum padaiyinar thodarndhu aayvu nadathi, suthigarippu kattamaippu illaadha pirinding niruvanangalai moodi varugindranar.
Vaariyathin arivuruthalinbadi, kazhivuneer suthigarippu kattamaippu amaithu, anumadhi kori kadidham alithaal, meendum iyakka anumadhi vazhangappadum ena therivikkappattadhu. Aanaal, naangu maadhangalaaga anumadhi vazhangappadaamal kaaladhaamadham erpattu varuvadhaaga thozhildhuraiyinar therivithullanar.
Idhu kurithu, pirinding yoonit urimaiyaalargal silar kooriyadhaavadhu:
kadandha 20 aandugalukkum melaaga pirinding thozhil seythu varugirom. Veedugal illaadha pagudhigalil yoonittugalai amaithirundhom. Pinnar andha pagudhigalil kudiyiruppugal uruvaagina. Tharpodhu iyakkathukku thayaaraaga ulla pirinding yoonittugal, kalappu kudiyiruppu pagudhiyil iruppadhaaga koori anumadhi marukkappadugiradhu. Idhanaal vaazhvaadhaaram paadhikkappattulladhu. Viraivil anumadhi vazhangaavittaal kudumbathudan arapporaattathil eeduvaduvom.
Ivvaaru, avargal koorinar.
Uyir kodungal! Tiruppur nitbirindars asosiyeshan (tekbaa) thalaivar sreegaanth kooriyadhaavadhu:
perumbaalaana pirinding aalaigal suthigarippu vasadhiyai amaithullana. Siriya yoonitkal suthigarippu vasadhi illaadhadhaal moodappattana.
Adhanbin, kazhivuneer suthigarippu kattamaippai amaithu, meendum iyakka anumadhi kori vinnappithullana. Kalappu kudiyiruppu pagudhi endra kaaranathaal anumadhi vazhanguvadhil kaaladhaamadham needikkiradhu. Erkanave pala aandugalaaga iyangi vandha yoonitkalai meendum iyakka anumadhikka vendum.
Ivvaaru, avar koorinaar.
Vi raivil theervu kidaikkum ippirasnai kurithu, maasukkattuppaadu vaariya maavatta poriyaalar paaradhi kooriyadhaavadhu:
kadandha moondru maadhamaaga, kalappu kudiyiruppu pagudhigalil iyangum pirinding aalaigalukku pudhuppippu urimam vazhanguvadhu merku mandalam muzhuvadhum niruthi vaikkappattulladhu.
Muraiyaaga suthigarippu kattamaippu amaithulla, erkanave kalappu kudiyiruppu pagudhigalil iyangi vandha yoonittugalukku pudhuppippu urimam vazhanga vendum ena thozhildhuraiyinar korikkai viduthullanar. Idhudhodarbaaga maasukkattuppaadu vaariyam uriya vazhigaattudhalai vazhangiyadhum, melnadavadikkai edukkappadum.
Ivvaaru, avar koorinaar.

headline: M.K. Stalin Delhi payanam endru paravum niyoosgaardu unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’M.K. Stalin Delhi payanam,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’mudhalamaichar indru Delhi payanam. 2 naal payanamaaga indru maalai Delhi purappadugiraar mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin naalai piradhamar modiyai sandhithu Tamil Naattin korikkaigal adangiya manuvai alikkiraar” endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhil, 16.08.2025 endru thedhiyum kurippidappattulladhu.
News 18 logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Idhanbadi, kadandha 16.08.2025 andru M.K. Stalin tellikkus sendradhaaga, oodagangalil edhenum seythi veliyaagiyulladhaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Avvaaru endha seythiyum kaanappadavillai.
Aduthappadiyaaga, M.K. Stalin X valaidhala pakkathirkus sendru paarthom. Adhilum idhuvondra endha oru padhivum idamberavillai. Maaraaga, 16.08.2025, 17.08.2025 aagiya naatkalil M.K. Stalin Chennai, Salem pondra idangalildhaan irundhullaar endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu, news 18 Tamil Nadu aasiriyar kuzhuvai thodarbugondu pesinom. Avargalum, idhu poliyaana seythi, enbadhai urudhi seythanar.
Irudhiyaaga, news 18 Tamil Nadu peyaril pagirappadum merkanda niyoosgaardu unmaiyalla, endru koori, Tamil Nadu arasukkus sondhamaana TN Factcheck tharappilum maruppu therivikkappattulladhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda niyoosgaardu poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.
