headline: Havaay theevil sunaami thaakkudhal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Havaay theevai sunaami thaakki azhithadhu endru oru video

theevu nagarai sunaami thaakki azhithadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Vimaananilaiyam, kudiyiruppu, saalaigal, kadarkarai ellaam sunaami thaakkudhalil azhindhu ponadhu pondru kaatchigal varugindrana.
Nilaith thagavalil, “rashyaavil erpatta sakdhivaayndha nilanadukkathaal havaay theevil sunaami thaakkudhal.!🌊🌊🌊
palveru naadugalukkum sunaami echarikkai…!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Russia-vil erpatta payangara sakdhi vaayndha nilanadukkathaith thodarndha samooga oodagangalil makkalai peedhi adaiya vaikkum vagaiyil pala padhivugal padhividappattu varugindrana. Podhuvaaga iyarkai peridar, por, payangaravaadha thaakkudhal nadakkum podhellaam pazhaiya veediyokkalai, pugaippadangalai padhivittu peedhiyai erpaduthuvadhu thodarndhu kondedhaan irukkindradhu.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai pala adukku maadi konda kattidathai moozhgadikkum alavukku alai ezhundhadhu pondru kaattappadugiradhu. Appadi payangara sunaami erpattirundhaal havaay theevugal mattumalla, pala naadugal azhindhu poyirukkum. Melum, video-vin pala kaatchigalum idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu.
Video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu idhe video-vai 2025 maars 29m thedhi Japan-il erpatta sunaami thaakkudhal endru kurippittu silar padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Russia nilanadukkathirkuk kittathatta 4 maadhangalukku munbaaga indha video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattulladhu. Idhan moolam idhu Russia nilanadukkathin podhu padhivaana kaatchi illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Aduthadhaaga indha video kaatchigalaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri hivemoderation.com endra eai video, pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum inaiyathalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Adhil indha video eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhudhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Thodarndhu indha video patrith thedik kondirundha podhu maars 10, 2025l veliyaana fekt sek katturai ondraik kandom. Adhil, piresilil sunaami endru kurippittu indha video 2025 maars thodakkathil samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhaagak kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Video-vil piresil thalainagar riyo ti jeniro vimaananilaiyam paadhikkappattiruppadhu pol kaattappattulladhu. Aanaal, piresilil kadandha irandu aandugalil sunaami thaakkudhal edhum erpadavillai endrum idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endrum kurippittirundhanar. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: ”siraiyil pootha pudhiya paadhai” - vazhi thavariya kuzhandhaigalukku vazhi kaattum thanjjai maavatta aatchiyar
text:
''kutravaaligalaagap paarkkaamal kuzhandhaiyaagap paarkka vendum, meendum avargalukku siraikkadhavu thirandhudakkoodaadhu. Moonu varusham padichittu veliye pogumbodhu nalla velaikkup poyittaa avanoda vaazhkkai vetrip payanamaa maaridum'' engiraar maavatta aatchiyar.
Palveru kutrachambavangalil eeduppattu koornokku illathil adaikkappatta 18 vayadhirkutbatta kuzhandhaigalukkup pudhiya paadhai amaithu tharum perum munneduppai Thanjavur maavatta aatchiyar revadhi sathamillaamal nigazhthiyirukkiraar.
Thadaippatta avargalin kalvikku uyir koduthu, thevaiyaana udhavigalais seythu oli etriyirukkiraar. Koornokku illathil irundhu veliye sendra kuzhandhaigalukku meendum oru siraivaasam erpadaamal paadhugaathu pudhiya paadhai thittathin moolam vetrippaadhaikku vazhigaattum maavatta aatchiyar revadhiyin seyalukkup paaraattugal kuvigindrana.
Idhugurithu vivaram arindhavargal tharappil pesinom, ''edho oru soozhalaal unarchivasappattu palli matrum kalloori maanavargal kutrachambavangalil eeduppattu vidugindranar. 18 vayadhukku utbatta avargal koornokku illathil adaikkappadugindranar.
Kutram seythu vittu koornokku illathirku varum ethanaiyo kuzhandhaigal adhan piragu seytha thavarai unarndhu varundhugindranar. Engaloda laippe pochu, ini padikka mudiyaadhu, appaa, ammaa moonjjila muzhikka mudiyaadhu endrellaam udaindhu kalanguvaargal.
Ippadiyaana soozhalil avargalukku peyil kidaichi veliye sendru viduvar. Pinnar avargal vaazhkkaiyil palaveru kashdangalais sandhikka neridum. Innilaiyil, adidhadi vazhakkil koornokku illathil irundha oru maanavar, peyil kidaichi veliye sendra piragu meendum padikka aasaippattullaar.
Kutrathil eeduppattavar enbadhai kaaranam kaatti avarukkaana kadhavugal adaikkappadugindrana. Idhu maavatta aatchiyar revadhi kavanathukkus sella udane andha maanavaridam pesi, idharku munbu paditha vivarangalaik kettullaar. Appodhu, andha maanavar aidiai padichen tisgandiniyoo seythu vittanar endrullaar.
Idhaiyaduthu maavatta aatchiyar andha maanavanai meendum avar paditha adhe aidiai-yil serthu vittadhudan padippukkaana udhavigalaiyum seythu koduthaar.
Idhuvol koornokku illathil irundhu veliye sendra anaivarukkum nalvazhi amaichi kodukka vendum endra ennathil aatchiyar seyalbaduthiyadhe pudhiya paadhai thittam. Maavatta kuzhandhaigal paadhugaappu alagu moolam adhigaarigalai orunginaithu idhanais seyalbaduthi varugiraar.
Idhan moolam koornokku illathil irundhu kadandha aaru maadhathirkul peyilil veliye sendravargal kuritha tettaa poleesaar udhaviyudan edukkappattadhu. Pinnar avargal eppadi irukkiraargal, kudumbap pinnani kurithellaam arindhu kondom. Motham 74 kuzhandhaigal kuritha vivaram perappattadhu. Idhil 41 kuzhandhaigalai avargaladhu petrorudan vara vachi pesinom.
Koornokku illathil irundhu sendravargal seytha thavaraal kalvi idai neekkam seyyappatta palarum meendum padippadharku aarvamaaga irundhanar. Enna padikkireergal endradharkup palarum aidiai padippadhaagas sonnaargal. Idhaiyaduthu maavatta aatchiyar muyatsiyil mudhal kattamaaga 20 per aidiai-yil serkkappattullanar.
Avargalukkaana thevaiyaana pees ullitta anaithu udhavigalum seythu tharappattulladhu. Vazhippariyil eeduppattu thandanaikkullaana oru maanavan, edho oru soozhalil kutrathais senjji ennoda vaazhkkaiyai naane kuzhi thondi pudhaichitten.
Ellaam mudinjji pochi, ini endha nalladhum nadakkaadhunu thenam kanneer vadichen. Meendum naan padikka poradhukku maavatta aatchiyar kaaranam ena urukkamaa sonnaan.
Innoru maanavanoda tisi ullitta saandridhazh ellaam erinjji pochi. Kalloori padikka aasaippatta avanukku adharkaana erpaadugalais seythu thandhaar. Avanoda, ammaa en pullaikku maruvaazhvu koduthutteengnu thazhu thazhuthaar.
Koornokkathil irundhu sendravargalukku meendum thavaru seyvadharkaana vaayppugal elidhaaga amaiyum. Andhak kuzhandhaiyaik kavanithu kaakkavillai endraal vaazhkkaiye kelvi kuriyaagidum. Appadi nadakkaamal thaduthu nalvazhippaduthave pudhiya paadhai thittam.
Moonu varusham padichittu veliye pogum podhu nalla velaikkup poyittaa avanoda vaazhkkai vetrippayanamaa maaridum ena koorum maavatta aatchiyar idharkaaga thurai adhigaarigal matrum aluvalargalaiyum mudukki vittullaar.
Kutravaaligalaagap paarkkaamal kuzhandhaiyaagap paarkka vendum, meendum avargalukku siraikkadhavu thirandhudakkoodaadhu, vazhi thavariya andhak kuzhandhaigalukku maatrathai undaakki pudhiya paadhai amaichi koduthu thaay idathil irundhu thalaiyezhuthai maathanum idhuve namakkaana perumidham engiraar maavatta aatchiyar.

headline: Manippooril siruvaanmaiyinar veedugalai azhitha Indhiya raanuvam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Manippooril siruvaanmaiyina makkalin veedugalai Indhiya raanuvam thaakki azhithadhaaga oru video

kattidangal meedhu vedigundu thaakkudhal nadathappatta video ondru Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video-vin meedhu aangilathil, “idhu Palestine alla… manippoor. Manippooril siruvaanmaiyina makkalin veedugalai Indhiya raanuvam azhithadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “idhu manippoor, Palestine alla. Manippooril siruvaanmaiyinarin veedugalai Indhiya raanuvam azhithu varugiradhu!
Manippoorin suraasanthbooril Indhiya aayudhap padaigalaal vedivorutkalaip payanbaduthith thanadhu veedu thagarkkappattadhaiyaduthu, oruvar thanadhu thuyarathaiyum aathirathaiyum velippaduthugiraar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiya makkalin veedugalai Indhiya raanuvame thaakki azhithadhaaga oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Manippooril pala varudangalaaga vanmurai sambavangal nadandhu varum soozhalil Indhiya raanuvam meedhu kutramsaatti palarum video-vai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varave idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu 2024m aandil indha video samooga oodagangalil veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhil, ‘’kukki payangaravaadhigal maithi ina veedugalai thaakki azhithadharkaana mudhal aadhaaram. 2023m aandu joon maadham indha sambavam nadandhadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha video samooga oodagangalil 2024m aandu viral-aaga pagirappadave, idhu thodarbaaga endidivi ullitta oodagangalilum kooda seythi veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Avatril paadhikkappatta maithi inathais saarndha ivomchaa (Ibomcha) enbavarin pettiyaiyum veliyittirundhanar.
Adhil avar, “idhu ennudaiya veedudhaan. Kadandha aandu (2023) sepdambar maadham nivaaranap paniyil eeduvatta nanbar oruvar engalin andha veettai kukki payangaravaadhigal thaakki azhithadhaaga ennidam therivithaar. Aanaal, andha thaakkudhal video-vai ippodhudhaan paarkkiren. 2023m aandu me maadham maithi – kukki ina makkalidaiye modhal thodangum varai angu vasithu vandhen. Ettu aandugalaaga uriya urimam petru thuppaakki virpanai seyyum kadaiyai nadathi vandhen. Vanmuraiyil ennudaiya kadai sooraiyaadappattadhu” endru kooriyadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Manippooril maithikkal perumbaanmaiyaagavum kukkigal siruvaanmai ina makkalaagavum vasikkindranar. Perumbaanmai inathais saarndhavarin veettai kukkigal thagarthadhaagas seythi veliyaagi ulladhu. Aanaal adhai maatri siruvaanmaiyina makkalin veedugalai Indhiya raanuvam thaakki azhithadhaagath thavaraagap padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil endidivi seythiyai adippadaiyaaga vaithu samooga oodagangalil paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru Indhiya arasin piaivi fekt sek pirivum padhivai veliyittirundhadhaik kandarindhom. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ji.es.ti.,yil enna pirasnai?(26)
text:
Kutrachaattugal matrum theervukkaana yosanaigal kurithu vanigargal ullitta vari seluthuvor evarum ezhudhalaam endra, 'thinamalar' arivippukku nalla varaverpu; nootrukkanakkaana kadidhangalai ezhudhi kuvithuvittanar. Adhanvivaram, 'thinamalar' idhazhil ippagudhiyil veliyaagum.
Marundhugalukku variyaik kuraikkalaame!
Marundhup porutkalukku 12 sadhaveedha ji.es. Ti., vidhikkappadugiradhu. Idhu migavum adhigam. Ezhai eliya makkalin porulaadhaara nilaikku ugandhadhalla.
Kurippitta sila marundhugal meedhaana vari neekkap pattulladhu varaverkathakkadhu. Eninum, marun thugal anaithume indriyamaiyaadhavaidhaan enbadhil iruveru karuthugal irukka mudi yaadhu. Unavu, udai, uraividam ivat rodu marundhugalum saamaaniya makkalin athi yaavasiya pattiyalil ulladhu.
Marundhup porutkal meedhaana vari enbadhu noyaaligal meedhaana vari enbadhe yadhaartha nilai. Nadunilaiyudan aaraayndhaal, marundhugal meedhaana vari evvagaiyilum niyaayamatradhu en padhu thelivaagum. Marundhugalin meedhaana variyai mutrilum neekkinaal makkal nal vaazhvil adhu oru mail kallaaga amaiyum.
Avvaaru, marundhugalin meedhaana variyai muzhu vadhum rathu seyvadhu saathiyam illai enil, tharpodhulla 12 sadhaveedha ji.es.ti., enbadhil irundhu, 6 sadhaveedha ji.es.ti.,yaaga kuraikka ji.es.ti., kavunsilum, mathiya, maanila arasu kalum orumitha karuthudan munvandhaal, ezhai eliya makkal payanberuvar. Adhevondru, 'maldivittamin' pondra marundhugalukku that podhu 18 sadhaveedha ji.es.ti., vidhikkappadugiradhu. Idhanaiyum 6 sadhaveedhamaagak kuraikka vendum. Oottas sathu patraakkuraiyaal, vittamin, minaralgal adangiya marundhugal adhigath thevai yullavargal ezhai eliya makkale enbadhai naam kavanathil kolla vendiyadhu avasi yam. Marundhugal meedhaana ji.es.ti., kuraippu korikkaiyai, mathiya, maanila arasugal kanivu tan pariseelikka vendum.

headline: ADMK koottaniyil BJP illai endru Jayakumar koorinaaraa?
text:
ADMK koottaniyil BJP illai endru munnaal amaichar Jayakumar kooriyadhaaga oru news card

san news veliyitta news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “adhimuga koottaniyil BJP illai. Arinjar annaa patriya Annamalai-yin pechaal ADMK – BJP idaiye modhal mutriya nilaiyil ADMK munnaal amaichar Jayakumar petti” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ADMK koottaniyil BJP illai endru munnaal amaichar Jayakumar kooriyadhaaga oru news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, sameevathil andha karuthai Jayakumar kooravillai. Padhivai paarkkum podhu, adhil thedhiyum kurippidappadavillai. Idhanaal, sameevathil Jayakumar indha pettiyai alithadhu pondra thotrathai indha padhivu erpaduthugiradhu.
Nilaith thagavalilum indha news card ippodhu veliyaanadhu illai endru kurippidappadavillai. Andha news card-ai kilik seythu paarkkum podhu, adhil thedhi irukkiradhu. 2023m aandu sepdambar maadham 18m thedhi andha news card veliyaagi iruppadhaaga kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil 2023m aandu sepdambar maadham san news veliyittirundha news card-ai thedi eduthom. 2023m aandu BJP – ADMK koottani murindhadhu. Irandu katchigalum thanithaniyaagak koottaniyai uruvaakki 2024 naadaalumandrath therdhalil pottiyittu tholviyadaindhana. Adhan piragu 2025m aandu indha irandu katchigalukku idaiyeyum koottani erpattadhu. Tharpodhu anbumaniyin PMK, tidivi thinagaran aniyum andha koottaniyil inaindhullana.
2023m aandu veliyaana news card-ai tharpodhu veliyittadhu pondru thavaraaga samooga oodagangalil padhivittiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card thedhiyai maraithu, kuzhappathai erpaduthum vagaiyil padhivittiruppadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: TVK natchathira pechaalar pattiyalil irundhu neekkappattadhaal vaigo azhudhaaraa?
text:
TVK natchathira pechaalar pattiyalilirundhu peyar neekkappattadhaal vaigo kadhari azhudhaar endru oru video

vaigo kadhari azhudha video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Video meedhu TVK natchathira pechaalar pattiyalilirundhu vaigo peyar neekkam! Kadhari azhum kaatchi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram idaith therdhalil Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagathin natchathira pechaalargal pattiyalil koottani katchith thalaivargalaana vaigo, thirumaavalavan ullittorin peyarum idam petrirundhadhu. Idharku edhirkkatchigal edhirppu therivithadhaith thodarndhu koottani katchith thalaivargalin peyar neekkappattulladhu. Thannudaiya peyar neekkappattadhaal vaigo kadhari azhudhaar endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Vaigo kadhari azhum video migavum pazhamaiyaanadhu. Idhai vaithu naame erkanave oru fekt sek seythirundhadhu ninaivilirundhadhu. Enave, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seyya aayvu seythom. Nammudaiya fekt kirasandovil veliyaana katturaiyai thedi eduthom. 2020m aandu joolai maadham indha katturaiyai veliyittirundhom. Adhil indha video 2018m aandu edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Vaigovin marumagan saravanan suresh virudhunagar aruge ulla soolakkaraiyil petrolai ootri theekkulithaar. Avarai maruthuvamanaiyil vandhu nalam visaaritha vaigo, seythiyaalargalais sandhithu kadhariyazhudhaar. Pinnar pesum podhu, “thannudaiya marumagan theekkulikka naam thamizhar katchiyinar samooga oodagangalil seythu varum avadhooru pirasaarangaldhaan kaaranam” endru kooriyadhaaga seythigalil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Vaigovin marumagan sigichai palanindri uyirizhandhavodhu, kaaviri vivagaarathirkaaga theekkulithaar endru vaigo arikkai veliyittadhaagavum seythigal namakku kidaithana. Idhan moolam indha video TVK natchathira pechaalar pattiyalilirundha peyar neekkappattadhaal vaigo azhudhadhu illai enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ulaga nalanukkaana aakkappoorvamaana pechu; piriks maanaattil nadakkum ena piradhamar Modi urudhi
text:
Pudhudilli: ulaga nalanukkaana aakkappoorvamaana pechu piriks uchimaanaattil nadaiverum ena piradhamar Modi therivithullaar.
Piresil, Russia, India, China, then aaprikkaa ullitta aagiya naadugal uruppinargalaaga ulla piriks amaippin maanaadu varum 12 matrum 13 thedhigalil tilliyil paarath mandavathil nadakkiradhu. Immaanaattirku 4vadhu muraiyaaga India thalaimai erkiradhu.
Russia adhivar pudin, China adhivar shi jinbing, then aappirikkaa adhivar siril ramavosaa, Iran adhivar masooth pejeshgiyaan, egipdhu adhivar apdhel pattaa el sisi, ethiyoppiyaa piradhamar avi ahamadhu, indhoneshiyaa adhivar piravaavo suviyaando, yuei saarbil, avudhaavi pattathu ilavarasar shek kaalith pin mugamadhu pin jayeeth alnahyaan, piresil veliyuravu amaichar mavuro viyiraa aagiyor pangerkindranar.
Innilaiyil indru (sep 11) piradhamar Modi veliyittulla padhivil kooriyiruppadhaavadhu: tilliyil piriks uchimaanaattirkaaga ulagam muzhuvadhilumirundhu thalaivargal ondrugooduvaargal. Ulaga nalanai munniruthi, palveru vivagaarangal kurithu immaanaattil aakkavoorvamaana vivaadhangal nadaiverum endru naan urudhiyaaga nambugiren'' ena kurippittullaar.

headline: Mudhalamaichar edukkum mudivukku kattuppaduvom endru thol thirumaavalavan koorinaaraa?
text:
Koottani thodarbaaga mudhalamaichar edukkum mudivukku kattuppaduvom endru thol thirumaavalavan kooriyadhaaga oru padhivu

Polimer tholaikkaatchi veliyitta news card-ai 2024l thandhi TV veliyittirundha news kaardudan inaithu Facebook-il padhividappattirundhadhu. Indru endru kurippidappattirundha news card-il, “mudhalamaichar edukkum mudivukku kattuppaduvom. DMK koottaniyil yaarai serthaalum vidudhalai siruthaigal katchi thalaiyidaadhu; mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin edukkum mudivukku kattuppaduvom. VCK thalaivar thirumaavalavan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Nilaith thagavalil,
“ada narambillaadha naakke” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Saadhi – madha reedhiyaana aniyudan koottaniyillai enbadhai 2011m aande mudiveduthuvittom. Andha mudivil maatram illai endru thodarndhu thirumaavalavan koori varugiraar. Idhan moolam PMK irukkum aniyudan koottani illai enbadhai maraimugamaaga avar katchi therivithu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, paamaga-vin doctor raamadhaas thalaimaiyilaana ani DMK-vil inaiyum endru samooga oodagangalil pesappattu varugiradhu.
Indha soozhalil, yaarai koottaniyil serthaalum thalaiyida maattom. Mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin edukkum mudivukku kattuppaduvom endru thirumaavalavan kooriyadhaaga palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha thagaval unmaidhaanaa endru ariya aayvu seythom. Polimer veliyitta news card, seythiyaith thavaraaga maatri vishamigal samooga oodagangalil pagirndhu varugiraargalaa endru ariya adhu veliyitta seythigalaip paarthom.
Appodhu, thirumaavalavan petti veediyovudan veliyittirundha seythi kidaithadhu. Adhil, “thi.mu.ka. Koottaniyil yaarai inaithaalum thalaiyida maattom.. Mudhalamaichar edukkum mudivukkuk kattuppaduvom.. Thirumaavalavan adhiradi arivippu” endru kurippidappattirundhanar. Andha video-vai paarthom. Video-vil endha idathilum mudhalamaichar edukkum mudivukkuk kattuppaduvom endru avar kooravillai. Engal mudivil urudhiyaaga irukkirom endru mattume koorinaar. Adhaavadhu, saadhi, madha adippadaiyilaana katchi irukkum koottaniyil naangal irukka maattom endra arthathil avar kooruvadhaik kettom. Adhe nerathil DMK koottaniyil yaarais serkka vendum enbadhai DMK thaan mudivu seyya vendum, avargalukku arivurai, aalosanai koorum nilaiyil naangal illai endru avar koorugiraar.
Polimer TV veliyitta video muzhumaiyaanadhaaga illai. Enave, thirumaavalavanin muzhu pettiyaiyum san news TV-yil irundhu eduthom. Adhil, “2011 podhuth therdhalukkup piragu naangal urudhippadath therivitha koottani nilaippaadu, saadhiya madhavaadha arasiyal katchigalodu oruvodhum naangal koottani vaithukkolla maattom. Andha katchigal koottaniyil idamberum koottaniyilum idambera maattom endru arivithom. Andha nilaippaattil indrum urudhiyaaga irukkirom.
DMK koottaniyil endha endha katchigal sera vendum enbadhu kurithu DMK thalaimaidhaan mudivedukka vendum. Vidudhalais siruthaigal indha katchiyai serkka vendum, indha katchiyai serkkak koodaadhu endru koora endha adhigaaramum illai, urimaiyum illai. Naangal engal nilaippaattil urudhiyaaga irukkirom enbadhaith thavira, thi.mu.ka-vukku aalosanai sollak koodiya idathil alladhu nerukkadi kodukkum idathil naangal illai.
Endha oru katchiyin meedhum thanippatta veruppu engalukku illai. Kolgai saarndhu naangal edutha mudivil urudhiyaaga irundhaaldhaan ennudaiya thalaimaiyai etrukkonda katchith thozhargalidam ennudaiya nambagathanmaiyaik kaappaatra mudiyum. Podhu makkalukku idaiyeyum vidudhalais siruthaigal katchikkulla nambathanmaiyaik kaappaatra mudiyum. DMK koottaniyai edhirkkum valimai endha koottanikkum Tamil Naattil illai” endru koorugiraar.
DMK koottaniyil yaarais serkka vendum enbadhai DMK thalaimaidhaan mudivu seyya vendum. Engal kolgaikku edhiraana katchigalaik koottaniyil inaithaal 14 aandugalukku munbu edutha mudivinbadi seyalbaduvom endru thirumaavalavan kooriyadhaith thirithu thavaraana artham vurum vagaiyil thavaraana seythiyai Polimer TV veliyittiruppadhu thelivaagiradhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Trichy maanagaraatchi aluvalagathil kaali kudangaludan pengal mutrugai
text:

Idhaiyaduthu oru mani neram poraattam nadathiya makkal, angirundhu kalaindhu sendranar.

investigation_details:

Aam, o.panneerselvam DMK-vil inaindhadhu patri M.K. Stalin avaradhu adhigaarappoorva X valaidhala pakkathil thagaval pagirndhullaar. Adhil idambetrulla pugaippadangalukkum, naam aayvu seyyum pugaippadathirkum endha thodarbum illai.
Melum, idhudhodarbaana video seythigalilum o.panneerselvam nirpadhu pondra kaatchigale idambetrullana.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
idhudhodarbaaga, naam o.panneerselvam tharappil kettom. ‘’naangal DMK-vil inaindhadhu patri vendumendre edhirigal vadhandhi parappugiraargal. Adhil ondrudhaan kaalil vizhuvadhu pondra pugaippadam,’’ endru maruppu therivithanar.
O.panneerselvam patri erkanave pala vadhandhigal paraviyullana. Naamum fektchek seythirukkirom. Avatrai padikka inge kilik seyyungal.
Irudhiyaaga, hivemoderation, wasitai pondra AI sarivaarppu inaiyadhalangal udhaviyudan aayvu seythavodhu, merkanda pugaippadam AI thozhilnutbam payanbaduthi, thayaarikkappattadhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Ungal semippai kollaiyadikkum aavaasa vilambarangal... Idhu pudhu raga digital kollai!
text:
Koogul ple storil illaadha endha oru seyaliyaiyum ponil niruvave koodaadhu. ‘ple storil illai endraal, adhu en ponukkul illai’ enbadhil urudhiyaaga irungal.
Nisapdhamaana iravil, instaagiraamil video-kkal paarppadhu palarukku aarudhalaagath thondralaam. Aanaal, andha veediyokkalukku idaiyil thondrum vilambarangal moolam ungal vaazhnaal semippaik kollaiyadikka oru kumbal kaathirukkiradhu enbadhu theriyumaa... Aam, samooga valaidhalangalil ulavum aavaasamaana vilambarangal moolam ungal smaartbonaik kaippatrum oru pudhiya raga digital kollai India-vil vegamaagap paravivarugiradhu.
Facebook alladhu instaagiraamil naam veediyokkalaip paarthuk kondirukkum podhu, thideerena sila vilambarangal thondrum. `iravil thanimaiyil irukkireergalaa?’, `ungalukkup poruthamaana thunaiyai udanadiyaagath therndhedukkalaam’, `ilavasamaagap pesungal’ ena kilugiluppaana aavaasak kaatchigaludan koodiya video-kkal thiraiyil midhakkum.
Aarvam thaangaamal adhaith thottaal adhu ungalai oru veli inaiyadhalathukku azhaithus sellum. Angu, `indha video-vai muzhumaiyaagap paarkka alladhu indha aappil pesa, indhas seyaliyai padhivirakkam seyyungal’ enak koorum. `ada ilavasamdhaane...’ ena naamum andha aappai movailil instaal seyvom.
Ingedhaan aavathu thodangugiradhu!
Podhuvaaga, naam seyaligalai koogul ple storilirundhu padhivirakkam seyvom. Aanaal, indha vilambarangal nammai `APK' enappadum velivagai koppugalaip padhivirakkam seyyavaikkum.
Indha aavathaana seyaligal ungal ponukkul vandhadhum enna seyyum theriyumaa?
Smaartbongalil paarvaiyatravargal alladhu udaliyakkak kuraivaadu ullavargal elidhaagath thiraiyaip payanbadutha koogul vazhangiyirukkum oru sirappu vasadhi `Accessibility Service'. Urai urakkap padikkappaduvadhu, thiraiyilulla pothaangalaith thaanaaga azhuthuvadhu pondra udhavigalai idhu seyyum.
Aanaal, indha aavathaana aavaasas seyaligal instaal aagumbodhu indha anumadhiyaip petrukkondu ponai muzhuvadhum than kattuppaattukkul kondu vandhuvidum.
Neengal ponaith thodaamaleye, pinnaniyil thiraiyaith thoduvadhu, aapgalaith thirappadhu, pudhiya anumadhigalaith thaane ‘OK’ seythugolvadhu ena ellaavatraiyum indhas seyali ungalin anumadhi illaamaleye seythu mudikkum.
Neengal vangiyin aappaiyo alladhu UPI aappaiyo thirakkumbodhu, neengal adikkum kadavuchol, paasvert engal, thiraiyil thondrum ragasiyak kuriyeedugal anaithaiyum idhu appadiye ‘sgireenshaat' alladhu ‘live veediyo'polap padhivuseythu kutravaaligalukku anuppividum.
Ungal ponukku varum es.em.es seythigalai neengal paarppadharku munbe idhu padithuvidum. Idhanaal, panap parivarthanaikkaana o.ti.pi-yai kutravaaligalaal miga elidhaagap payanbadutha mudiyum.
Vazhakkamaaga oru pudhiya seyalikku anumadhi tharumbodhu pon nammidam echarikkai ketkum. Aanaal, ‘Accessibility' anumadhi kaikku vandhuvittaal, indhas seyaliye ponin andha echarikkaip pettiyaiyum thaane ‘Allow’ seythuvittu, thanakkuth thevaiyaana anaithu adhigaarangalaiyum eduthukkollum.
Sila seyaligal ungal ponil oru poliyaana VPN-ai niruvividum. Idhan moolam ungal ponin inaiya inaippu muzhuvadhum kutravaaligalin sarvar vazhiyaagave sellum
indha aavathai unarndhu neengal andhas seyaliyai ponin ‘Settings' pagudhikkus sendru neekka muyandraal, ‘Accessibility' vasadhiyaip payanbaduthi udane andhap pakkathai moodividum alladhu thiraiyai appadiye uraiyas seythuvidum.
Surukkamaagas sonnaal, ungal smaartbon ungal kaigalil irukkume thavira, adhil irukkum vangis seyaligal, o.ti.pi ena mothak kattuppaadum indhas seyaligalidam vandhuvidum.
Ippadithaan ungal vangik kanakkilirundhu panam thirudappadugiradhu.
‘ilavasamaagak kidaikkiradhu’ endra aasaiyaiyum, edhu vandhaalum padikkaamal ‘Allow' enath thattum namadhu avasarap pazhakkathaiyumdhaan indhak kutravaaligal thangalukkus saadhagamaagap payanbaduthik kolgiraargal.
Indhiya inaiyak kutra orunginaippu maiyam (I4C), idhu pondru ulavum ‘Night Play’, ‘Reloop’, ‘Kyss’, ‘Vimo’, ‘Rivo’, ‘Nexo’, ‘Vixa’ pondra pala aavathaana aavaasas seyaligalaip pattiyalittu echarithirukkiradhu.
Sari, ungal pon paadhikkappattirukkiradhaa... Kandarivadhu eppadi?
Neengal thodaamaleye kaippesi thaanaagave iyanguvadhu alladhu thiraiyil edho thoduvadhuvol iruppadhu.
Ungalukkuth theriyaamaleye ponin merpagudhiyil `VPN' endra kuriyeedu thondruvadhu.
Neengal padhivirakkame seyyaadha pudhiya seyaligal ponil iruppadhu.
Oruvelai ithagaiya seyali ponil niruvappattu, saadhaarana muraiyil neekka mudiyavillai endraal, ponai ‘Safe Mode' enbadhil ‘Restart' seyya vendum. ‘Safe Mode’-l velippuras seyaligal iyangaadhu enbadhaal, ‘Settings > Apps' pagudhikkus sendru andhas seyaliyai elidhaaga ‘Uninstall' seythuvidalaam.
Ungalaip paadhugaathukkolla eliya vazhigal!
Koogul ple storil illaadha endha oru seyaliyaiyum ponil niruvave koodaadhu. ‘ple storil illai endraal, adhu en ponukkul illai’ enbadhil urudhiyaaga irungal.
Endhavoru theriyaadha seyalikkum ‘Accessibility' alladhu ‘SMS' paarkkum anumadhigalai vazhangaadheergal.
Soshiyal meediyaavil varum kilugiluppaana, kavarchi karamaana vilambarang kalai mutrilumaagap purak kaniyungal.
Koogul ple storilulla, `ple purodekt’ (Play Protect) enum paadhugaappu amsathai eppodhum ‘ON' seythu vaiyungal.
Panathai izhandhaal enna seyvadhu?
Oruvelai neengal indha valaiyil vizhundhu panathai izhakka nerittaal, siridhum thayangaamal udanadiyaaga 1930 endra thesiya inaiyak kutra udhavi ennukku azhaikkavum. Sambavam nadandha mudhal oru mani nerathukkul pugaaralithaal, parivona ungal panathai meetka adhiga vaayppirukkiradhu.

headline: Sunaami, nilanadukkam varumaa? Karai odhungiya kodoora meen? Pulambith thallum podhumakkal!
text:
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
indhonesiyaavil ulla mavunt ivu, mavunt semeru, anak kiragadaav, levodovi laagi-laagi, ili levodolok, sinaavung aagiya 6 erimalaigal, kadandha aagast 31-aam thedhi andru ore samayathil vedithus sidharina. Kurippaaga, mavunt sinaavung erimalai vedithavodhu, sumaar 3,500 meter uyaram varai, saambal thugal mele ezhumbiyadhaagavum sollappattadhu.
Idhanaal, vimaanas sevaiyum paadhikkappattu, 22 aayirathukkum merpatta payanigal avadhi adaindhanar. Singappoor, haangaang, sitni, aamstardaam, siyol pondra pagudhigalukkaana velinaattu vimaanas sevaiyum, paali, suraavaayaa pondra nagarangalukkaana ulnaattu vimaanas sevaiyum rathu seyyappattirundhadhu.
Idhan thaakkam kuraiyaamal irundha nilaiyil, sepdambar 4-aam thedhi andru, anak kiragadaav erimalai meendum vedithus sidhariyadhaal, podhumakkal perum adhirchikku aalaagiyirundhanar. Ivvaaru indhonesiyaa iyarkai kora karangalaal kadumaiyaagap paadhikkappattu vandha nilaiyil, andha naattil pudhiya thagaval ondru veliyaagi, vairalaagap paravi varugiradhu. Idhanaal, makkal kadum achathirku aalaagiyullanar. Adhaavadhu, indhonesiyaavin komodo pagudhiyil ulla pingk kadarkaraiyil, kadandha aagast 25-aam thedhi andru, 13 adi neelam konda, pirammaandamaana orbish endra vagai meen irandhu karai odhungiyirundhadhu.
Kadalin aazhathil vaazhakkoodiya indha meengal, aridhaagave karai odhunguvadhaagavum, ’kadavulin thoodhargal’ endru azhaikkappadum indha meengal karai odhunginaal, sunaami, nilanadukkam, erimalai vedippu pondra iyarkaip peridargal erpadum endrum, podhumakkal mathiyil nambikkai ulladhu. Enave, indha meen karai odhungiyavodhu aavathu erpadum ena makkal payathil irundha samayathil, sariyaaga 6 naatkalukkup piragu, periya erimalai vedippus sambavam nadandhadhu. Edhaarchaiyaaga nadandha indhas sambavathai, andha meenodu thodarbuvaduthik kondulla makkal, sunaami, nilanadukkam pondra innum veru edhaavadhu iyarkaip peridar varumaa endra achathil ullanar. Aanaal, ariviyal aadhaarangalinbadi, meen thondruvadharkum iyarkai idarbaadugalukkum endhavidhamaana aadhaaramum illai endru therivikkappattulladhu.

investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhe kuzhandhai video erkanave sila maadhangalukku munbaaga instaagiraam pakkam ondril pagirappattulladhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.

Naangal andha kuzhandhaiyin veediyokkalai pirandhadhu mudhale indruvarai avvappodhu padhivittu varugirom. Idhu kuppaithottiyil irundhu edukkappadavillai; naangalum avvaaru kuppaiyil veesavillai. Yaaro vendumendre engaladhu video-vai eduthu, vadhandhi parappugiraargal,’’ endru therivithanar.
