headline: Vegamaaga urugum imayamalai! India-vukku varum peraavathu? Porulaadhaaram thalaigeezhe vizhum?
text:
Imayamalaiyin migapperiya panippaaraigal vegamaaga urugi, nevaalathil koshi, thirisooli aarugalil peruvellam erpattu aayirakkanakkaana uyirizhappugal, maayangal padhivaagiyullana. Puvi veppamayamaadhalaal 2050kkul pani urugum alavu adhigarithu, kadalukku neer servadhaal nadhineer kuraindhu, kadumaiyaana neer patraakkurai, vivasaaya sarivu, unavu panjjam uruvaagum avaayam munvaikkappadugiradhu.
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
imayamalaiyil ulla migapperiya panippaarai urugiyadhaal, nevaalathin koshi aatrilum, thirisooli aatrilum kadandha aagastu 26-aam thedhi andru, peruvellam erpattadhu. 50 ekkar parappalavu konda panippaarai urugi, 300 kilo meter vegathil vandha vellathil sikki, idhuvarai aayirathu 400-kkum merpattor uyirizhandhiruppadhudan, 6 aayirathirkum merpattor maayamaagiyiruppadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Indha sambavathirku piragu, imayamalaiyil ulla matra panippaaraigalai, India, China, nevaalam aagiya naadugal thodarchiyaaga kangaanithu varugindrana.
Indha nilaiyil, imayamalaiyil ulla panippaaraigal thodarndhu urugi varuvadhaal, perum aavathu vara iruppadhaaga, sameevathiya aayvarikkaiyin moolam theriyavandhulladhu. Adhaavadhu, puvi veppam adaidhal kaaranamaaga, vazhakkathai vida vegamaaga panippaaraigal urugi varugindrana. Idhanaal, 2050-aam aandukkul, pani urugum alavu adhigappadiyaaga uyarndhu, andha neer kadalil kalandhuvidum. Enave, nadhigalil neervarathu kadumaiyaaga sarindhu, migakkadumaiyaana neer patraakkurai erpadum endru kanikkappattulladhu.
Melum, 2100-aam aandukkul, thanadhu motha panippaaraigalil 80 sadhaveedhathai imayamalai izhandhuvidum endrum sollappadugiradhu. Ivvaaru soozhaliyal maatrangal oruvuram nadandhaal, matroruvuram imayamalaiyai nambiyulla India-vin porulaadhaaram kadumaiyaaga paadhikkappadum endru koorappadugiradhu. 2024-aam aandil, motha ulnaattu urpathiyil 64.8 latcham kodi roobai imayamalaiyai neradiyaagavo alladhu maraimugamaagavo saarndhu irukkiradhu. Indha panippaaraigal uruguvadhum, adhanaal erpadum paruvanilai maatrangalum Indhiya porulaadhaarathai perum aavathil thallum endru aayvarikkaiyil koorappattulladhu.
Imayamalaip panippaaraigal iyarkaiyaana neer semippuk kidangugalaagas seyalbadugindrana. Angirundhu uruvaagum sindhu, kangai, pirammavuthiraa pondra nadhigalin neerai nambiye vada India-vin muzhumaiyaana vivasaayame saarndhu irukkiradhu. Enave, panippaaraigal uruguvadhaal, vivasaayam kadumaiyaaga paadhikkappattu, unavu panjjam erpadavum vaayppu ulladhu. Ivvalavu periya paadhippugal erpaduvadharku, puvi veppamayamaadhal thaan kaaranamaaga irukkiradhu. Idhanai sari seyvadharku, arasu thagundha nadavadikkai edukka vendum endru samooga aarvalargal korikkai vaithu varugindranar.

headline: Peegaar makkal therdhal kamishanar aluvalagathai mutrugaiyittaargalaa?
text:
Therdhal mudivukku edhirppu therivithu peegaar maanilath thalaimai therdhal aanaiyam aluvalagathai makkal mutrugaiyittadhaaga oru video

podhuk koottathirkuk koodiyadhu pondru makkal koottamaaga irukkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peehaar maanila thalaimai therdhal kamishan netru kaalai mudhal mutrugai idappattu irukkum kan kollaa kaatchi! Amaidhiyaaga muraiyil kaaro seyyappattu varuvadhaal padhatram needikkiradhu. Aanaal, podhu amaidhikku endha pangamum erpada villai!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhalil BJP koottani vetri petradhaakku podhu makkal mathiyil edhirppu iruppadhu pondru padhivugal samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu varugindrana. Andha vagaiyil peegaar maanila therdhal kamishanai makkal mutrugaiyittadhaaga video ondru samooga oodagangalil padhividappattu varugiradhu. Naadaalumandra, sattamandra therdhalgalai indhiyath therdhal aanaiyamdhaan nadathum. Idharkendru ovvoru maanilathilum thalaimai therdhal adhigaari iruppaar. Maanila therdhal aanaiyam endru maanila alavil irukkum. Ullaatchith therdhalgalai indha maanila therdhal aanaiyam nadathum. Indha irandu aanaiyangalukkum endha thodarbum irukkaadhu.
Aanaal, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil peegaar maanilath thalaimai therdhal aanaiyathai makkal mutrugai mutrugaiyittadhaagak koorappattirundhadhu. Idhu sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu. Melum, therdhal mudivukku edhirppu therivithu makkal poraattam nadathiyadhaaga seythigal edhuvum illai. Ivvalavu periya koottam maanilath thalaimai therdhal adhigaari aluvalagathai mutrugaiyittirundhaal adhu migapperiya seythiyaagi irukkum. Aanaal, endha oodagathilum ippadi oru seythi namakkuk kidaikkavillai.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Kadandha naangu – aindhu naatkalaagap palarum indha video matrum thagavalai samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Ivatrukkidaiye navambar 9m thedhi veliyaana padhivu ondrum namakku kidaithadhu. Peegaar maanila sattamandra therdhal mudivugal navambar 14m thedhi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Adharku aindhu naatkalukku munbaaga video samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhaal idhu therdhal mudivukku edhirppu therivithuk koodiya koottamaaga irukkaadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Namakku kidaitha padhivil aarjedi (raashdiriya janadhaa thalam) endru mattume kurippidappattirundhadhu. Enave, idhu aarjedi therdhal pirasaara koottamaaga irukkalaam endru therindhadhu. Aanaal, idhai urudhi seyvadharku endha seythiyum namakkuk kidaikkavillai. Namakkuk kidaitha video nandraaga thelivaaga irundhadhu. Adhilirundha kattidathil indhiyil ezhudhappattirundhadhai mozhimaatram seythu paarthom. Appodhu peegaar maanilathil ulla Chiraiya endra ooril ulla pallikkooda kattidam endru theriyavandhadhu. Adhan adippadaiyil andha ooril ulla pallikkoodathaik koogul street viyoo moolam thedinom. Appodhu naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil iruppadhu pondru vaasal konda pallikkooda kattidam kidaithadhu.
Idhan moolam indha koottam therdhal aanaiyathai mutrugaiyitta koottam illai enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Jammu kaashmeer kaattaatru vellam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Jammu kaashmeeril thideerendru erpatta kaattaatru vellam endru oru video

kaattaatru vellam ondru paayum video Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “kaashmeeril thideerena uruvaana kaattaatru vellam anaithaiyum surutti selgiradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Kaashmeer matrum vada India-vin pala pagudhigalil kana mazhai peythu varugiradhu. Indha nilaiyil, kaashmeeril erpatta thideer kaattaatru vellam endru oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Video-vil ullavargal kookkural ezhuppuvadhai ketkum podhu kaashmeeri, indhi pola illai. Aravi pondra mozhiyil kathuvadhu pola ulladhu. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu samooga oodagangalil palarum indha video-vai kaashmeer endre kurippittu padhivittirundhanar. Aanaal, endha oru oodagamum idhai veliyidavillai. Melum, kaashmeeril endha idathil indha video edukkappattadhu endrum kurippidappadavillai.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu moraakko naattil kadandha aagast maadham erpatta kana mazhai kaaranamaaga thideer kaattaatru vellam endru kurippittu indha video-vai moraakko naattu oodagangal veliyittirundhana. Andha seythigalil, Al Haouz endra pagudhiyil thideer mazhai kaaranamaaga kaattaatru vellam erpattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Matroru seythiyil Al Haouz pagudhiyil ulla Oued Azaden, Ouirgane endra idathil indha kaattaatru vellam erpattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Moraakkovil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil ulla idam ulladhaa endru ariya aayvaith thodarndhom. Koogul street mep-l andha idam ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Andha pagudhiyil koogul street mep illai. Aanaal, koogul mep-l naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil idam petradhu pondra paalam matrum saalai iruppadhaik kandarindhom. Enave, indha video moraakko naattais saarndhadhudhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Seyarkai karutharithal | kadanil sikkik kollum 90% thambadhigal., aayvil thagaval!
text:
Indhiya samoogam, thirumanathirku piragu kuzhandhai pirandhe aaga vendum endra azhuthathai kaalangalaamaaga ovvoruvar manadhilum uruvaakki vaithirukkiradhu. Thirumanamaagi oru varudathirku mel aagumbodhu andha thambadhigalin uravinargal utbada palarum kelvigalaal mana ulaichalukku ullaakkugiraargal. Melum, ichamoogamum varalaatril kuzhandhai illaadha pengalai pala nalla vishayangalil irundhu odhukkiye vaithirukkiradhu. Indha azhuthangal kaaranamaagave thambadhigal seyarkai karutharithal maiyangalai naada vendiya thevai irukkiradhu.
Innilaiyildhaan, India-vil seyarkaik karutharippu muraiyaana aiviep (IVF) sigichaiyai naadum 10 thambadhigalil 9 per perum kadan sumaiyil thallappaduvadhaaga or aayvu therivithulladhu. Oru aiviep suzhatsikkaana saraasari selavu, arasu maruthuvamanaigalil 1.1 latcham roobai enavum, thaniyaar maruthuvamanaigalil 2.30 latcham roobai enavum ulladhu. Indha sigichaiyai merkolbavargalil 5 vizhukkaattinar mattume maruthuvak kaappeedu petravargalaaga ullanar. Idhan vilaivaaga, paadhikkum merpatta thambadhigal sigichaikkaagap panam kadan vaanga vendiya kattaayathirku aalaagiraargal.
Sigichaiyin nidhis sumaiyaith thaanguvadhudan, indhath thambadhigal kavalai, mana azhutham matrum kuraindha vaazhkkaith tharam pondra udal matrum mananalap paadhippugalaiyum edhirgolvadhaaga aayvu kandarindhulladhu. Sigichaikkaana selavu matrum thambadhigalin sumaiyaik kuraikkum vagaiyil, piradhama mandhiri jan aarokkiya yojanaa thittathin keezh aiviep sigichaiyaiyum konduvara aayvaalargal parindhuraithullanar. Indhath thittathin keezh, oru aiviep suzhatsikkaana selavai 81 aayirathu 332 roobai ena nirnayithuth thiruppis seluthum vagaiyil maatrangalais seyya vendum endrum avargal valiyuruthiyullanar.

headline: Telliyil NIA kaidhu seytha navarin udal muzhukka vedigundugal endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Telliyil vedigundugalai udalil kattikkondu alaindha sadhigaara payangaravaadha amaippin thalaivan kaidhu endru oru pugaippadam

udalil vedigundugalai kattikkondu oruvar nirkum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “N.I.A vaal telliyil 16 per kaidhu seyyappattullanar.
Neengalum naanum nimmadhiyaaga thoongik kondirundhavodhu, thoval ji therukkalilum sutruppurangalilum ilakkindri sutrith thiriyavillai. Delhi matrum u.pi. Poleesaarin udhaviyudan thesiya pulanaayvu niruvanam (NIA) netru iravu telliyil ulla seelamboor matrum u.pi.yil ulla amrohaavil sodhanai nadathi 16 perai kaidhu seythadhu… keezhe pugaippadathil sadhigaara payangaravaadha amaippin kumbalin thalaivan” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Indhiya makkal naam ellaam nimmadhiyaaga thoonga, thesiya paadhugaappu aalosagar ajith thoval Delhi therukkalil sutrith thirindhu, payangaravaadhigalaik kaidhu seythullaar endrum, udalil vedigundai kattikkondu irundha payangaravaadha koottathin thalaivanaiyum kaidhu seythullaar endru samooga oodagangalil silar padhivittu varugindranar. Melum, oru kurippitta pirivinarai neradiyaaga payangaravaadhathudan thodarbuvaduthi padhivittullanar.
Tellikkulleye payangaravaadhigal vandhuvittaargal endraal endha alavukku nammudaiya naattin paadhugaappu kelvikkuriyaaga ulladhu enbadhu kooda puriyaamal oru tharappinarukku edhiraaga vanmurai, vishama karuthai pagirndhullanar.
Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla ellaa karuthukkal thodarbaagavum naam aayvu seyyavillai. Udalil vedimarundhu kattikkondu tharkolai thaakkudhal nadathum ennathil sutrith thirindha navarai ajith thoval kaidhu seythullaar endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru mattum aayvu seythom. Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu telliyil sikkiya payangaravaadhi endru endru sameeva kaalamaaga palarum padhivittu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Thedal mudivugalin pirpagudhiyaip paarkkum podhu 2010m aandilirundhu indha pugaippadam seythi matrum samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhuvum naiyaandip padhivaaga 2015m aandil indha pugaippadathaip palarum padhivittirundhanar. 2010m aandu pershiya mozhiyil veliyaana seythi ondril indha pugaippadam irundhadhu. Andha seythiyai mozhimaatram seythu paarthom.
Adhil, “faraa maagaanathil tharkolaith thaakkudhalaith thittamittirundha oruvaraik kaidhu seythadhaaga aapgaanisdhaan kaavaldhurai adhigaarigal arivithanar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Faraa enbadhu aapgaanisdhaanil merkup pagudhiyil ulla maagaanam aagum. 2010 kaalagattathil thaalivaangal andha pagudhiyil adhiga alavil tharkolaip padaith thaakkudhal nadathi vandhadhaaga andha seythiyil kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nammudaiya aayvil indha pugaippadam 2010m aandilirundhu seythi, samooga oodagangalil pagirappattu vandhiruppadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Indha navar thaalivaan tharkolaip padaiyais serndhavar endru 2010m aandu veliyaana seythi koorugiradhu. Idhan moolam telliyil ajith thovaal matrum NIA kaidhu seytha payangaravaadhigalin thalaivan ivan endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: Peegaaril idindhu vizhundha paalam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaaril ore vaarathil aindhu paalangal idindhu vizhundhadhu endru oru video

pirammaanda paalam ondru idindhu vizhum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “peegaaril indha vaarathil mattum jandhu paalangal idindhu vizhundhadhu BJP nidhish irattai enjjin aatchi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaaril ore vaarathil aindhu paalangal idindhu vizhundhadhu endru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Ippadi oru pirammaanda paalam peegaaril idindhu vizhundhadhaaga seythigal illai. Siriya paalam idindhu vizhundhaale adhu patri poiya alavil seythigal veliyaagum soozhalil, ivvalavu periya paalam idindhirundhaal adhu patri siriya pettis seythi kooda veliyaagaamal iruppadhu sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu.
Peegaar paalam idindhadhu thodarbaaga thediyavodhu pala video-kkal namakku kidaithana. Adhil edhuvum naam aayvukku eduthukkonda veediyovudan othuppogavillai. Melum, video-vai paarkkum podhu seyarkai nunnarivu (eai) moolam uruvaakkappattadhu pola ulladhu. Paalathin thoon aruge irandu per nirpadhu pondru ulladhu. Paalam idindhu vizhum podhu thoon arugilirundhu sidhari odugindranar.
Appadi oduvavargal thideerendru ore navaraaga maarividugindranar. Melum, saalaiyin maiyil ulla kemaraa konathilirundhu mattume paalam therigiradhu. Vizhundhirundhaal kemaraa pagudhiyil ulla paalamum idindhu vizhundhirukka vendum. Aanaal, andha idathil paalame illaadhadhu pola ulladhu. Ivai ellaam sandhegathai erpadutha aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens ullitta rivars imej thedal thalangalil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu joolai 15, 2025 andru veliyaana sila Facebook pakkangalil idhu eai moolam uruvaakkappatta video endru kurippittu padhividappattirundhadhu.
Indha video kaatchigalai eai veediyokkalaik kandariya udhavum hivemoderation.com endra inaiyathalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Adhu indha video 99.9 sadhavigidham eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu thaan endru urudhi seythadhu. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: ‘aasiriyai kaalukku masaaj seyyum palli maanavigal’ video Tamil Naattil edukkappattadhaa?
text:
‘’aasiriyai kaalukku masaaj seyyum palli maanavigal’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ Madam nallaa irukkaa??? Nallaa sugamaa irukkaa masaaj??,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Idhanudan, palli aasiriyai kaalukku maanavigal masaaj seyvadhu pondra kaatchigal konda video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video Tamil Naattil edukkappadavillai, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, aandhira maanilathin sreegaagulam maavattathil ulla pandappalli pazhangudi nalap palliyil merkanda sambavam nigazhndhulladhu. Indha video samooga valaidhalangal moolamaaga vairalaagap paraviya nilaiyil, sambandhappatta aasiriyai udane sasbent seyyappattaar.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
NDTV l India Today l Times of India l The News Minute·
idhanmoolamaaga, aandhiraavil edutha video-vai Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru thavaraana thagaval parappugiraargal, endru namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, thavaraanadhu endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyarai siraiyil adaikka vendum! - uthav thaakkare
text:
Thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaaneshgumaar thannichaiyaaga seyalbattu, SIR nadavadikkaiyaal vaakkaalar pattiyalil perum kularuvadigal erpattadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu.
Indhiyan eksbiras veliyitta thagavalinbadi, thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaaneshgumaar matra aanaiyargalukku thagaval tharaamal ragasiyamaaga seyalbattadhaaga kutrachaattu ezhundhulladhu. SIR nadavadikkaiyaal vaakkaalar pattiyalil perum kularuvadigal erpattadhaagavum, needhimandra utharavugalum purakkanikkappattadhaagavum koori, thesiya katchigal matrum maanila katchigal thalaimai therdhal aanaiyarai neekki, SIR nadavadikkaigalai nirutha vendum ena korugindrana.
Indhasoozhalil thalaimaith therdhal aanaiyar njaanesh kumaarai udanadiyaagap panineekkam seythu siraiyil adaikka vendum ena sivasenaa yuvidi pirivin thalaivar uthav thaakkare valiyuruthiyullaar. Therdhal aanaiya adhigaarigalidaiye karuthu veruvaadu ezhundhulla nilaiyil indha korikkaiyai avar munvaithullaar. Magaaraashdiraa, merku vangam matrum thamizhagam aagiyavatrin sattamandra therdhalgalai rathu seythu, vaakkucheettu muraiyil meendum therdhal nadatha vendum enavum avar korikkai viduthullaar. Jananaayagathaik kaappaatra anaithu edhirkkatchigalum inaiya vendum endrum uthav kettukkondullaar.

headline: Madurai: paraamarippindri kidakkum maanagaraatchip poongaa - seeramaikkak korum podhu makkal!
text:
Marma navargalaal vilaiyaattu uvagaranangalaana oonjjal, sarukku maram, irumbuk kambigal ena anaithum udaikkappattu irundhana. Madhuppiriyargal koodum idamaaga poongaa maariyadhu. Madhu paattilgal udaikkappattuk kidappadhaip paartha podhumakkal, poongaavukku varuvadhaiye thavirkka aarambithanar.
Madurai maavattam, therkuth thogudhi, vaardu en 71, mandalam 3 pagudhiyil serman muthuraamaiyar saalaiyil Madurai maanagaraatchiyin josap poongaa kadandha 2016 – 2017 aam aandu (AMRUT – Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation) puthunarchi matrum nagarppura maatrathirkaana adal mishan thittathin moolamaaga panigal thodangappattu, makkal payanbaattirku kondu varappattadhu.
Ithittam 2015 aam aandu Indhiya arasaal thodangappatta oru nagarppura membaattuth thittam. Nagarangalil vasikkum makkalukku paadhugaappaana kudineer vasadhi, muraiyaana kazhivuneer melaanmai, mazhaineer vadigaal amaippugal matrum poongaakkal pondra adippadai ulgattamaippugalai membaduthuvadhai ithittam nokkamaagak kondulladhu.
Madurai maavattathin therkuth thogudhikku utbatta sinnak kanmaay, keezhmadhurai, kaamaraasavuram, paalarengavuram, indhiraa nagarp pagudhigalil kittathatta aindhaayirathirkum merpatta kudumbangal vasithu varugindrana. Avargalukkuk kudineer aadhaaramaaga ippoongaavil ulla maanagaraatchiyin iru melnilai kudineer thottigal amaindhullana.
Ippoongaa thirakkappatta piragu, appagudhi vaazh siruvar-sirumiyar, palli maanavargal, petrorgal, mudhiyorgal ena eraalamaanor kaalaiyilum maalaiyilum vilaiyaattu, udarpayitsi, nadaippayitsi merkolvadharku poongaavaip payanbaduthi vandhanar.
Koronaa perundhotrin podhu erpatta ooradangu kaaranamaaga podhumakkal varathu thadaivattu, poongaa paraamarippindri kaividappattadhu. Marma navargalaal vilaiyaattu uvagaranangalaana oonjjal, sarukku maram, irumbuk kambigal ena anaithum udaikkappattu irundhana. Madhuppiriyargal koodum idamaaga poongaa maariyadhu. Madhu paattilgal udaikkappattuk kidappadhaip paartha podhumakkal, poongaavukku varuvadhaiye thavirkka aarambithanar.
Idhu kurithu ange silambakkalai payitsiyil eeduvattuk kondirundha ilainjaridam kettavodhu, “en veedu ippoongaavilirundhu aindhu theru thallidhaan irukkiradhu. Naan pathaam vaguppu padikkumbodhu indhap poongaadhaan engal maidhaanam. Palli mudindhu saayangaalam ezhu mani varaikkum ingudhaan iruppom. Vidumurai vittaal podhum ingu vandhuviduvom. Adharkup piragu koronaa ooradangu vandhadhu.
Appappo indhap pakkam vandhu povadhu undu. Aindhu varudangalaaga ippadiyethaan kidakkiradhu. Appodhu vilaiyaadiya pasanga yaarum ippodhu illai. Irundha vilakkugal ellaam udaindhu kidakkindrana. Naangal vilaiyaadiya oonjjal, sarukku maram edhaiyum ippodhu kaanavillai. Paadhiyaaga udaindhu, irundha idam theriyaamal indru irukkiradhu. Niraiya petrorgal, kuzhandhaigal, mudhiyavargal varuvaargal. Aanaal ippodhu yaarum peridhaaga ingu varuvadhillai.
Naanum engal silambakkalai payitsip pattarai maanavargal 60kkum merpattorum kadandha 2 maadhangalaaga indhap poongaavil payitsi seythu kondirukkirom. Indhap poongaavais seeramaippu seythu maanavargal vilaiyaaduvadharku edhuvaaga, paadhugaappaana idamaaga maatrik koduthaal migavum nandraaga irukkum" endraar.
Ippoongaavais sutri thirumana mandavangal, kovil, kudiyiruppugal matrum poongaavirkup pinburam palli, maruthuvamanai ena podhumakkalin andraada payanbaattu idangal niraindhirukkindrana.
Enave, sambandhappatta maanagaraatchi adhigaarigal uriya nadavadikkai eduthu ippoongaavinai maruseeramaippu seythu, uriya paraamarippodum paadhugaappaana sutruchoozhalodum makkal payanbaattirkuk konduvara vendumena appagudhivaazh podhumakkalum palli maanavargalum vendugol vidukkindranar.

headline: Yoodiyoovar jodhi malhothraavai raagul kaandhi thanippatta muraiyil sandhithaaraa?
text:
‘’yoodiyoovar jodhi malhothraavai raagul kaandhi thanippatta muraiyil sandhippu’’ endru koori,

idhe pugaippadangalai vaithu, Facebook, X valaidhalam palavatrilum padhivugal pagirappadugindrana.
Avatril, ‘’ paagisdhaanirku ulavu paartha yoodiyoovar jodhi malhothraavudan
raagulgaandhi thanippatta muraiyil sandhithiruppadhu migundha sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu
evan evan naattukku edhiraaga seyalbadugiraano avanudan ellaam pappu natbu paaraattugiraar🤬.’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha pugaippadangal unmaiyaanadhu kidaiyaadhu endrum, edit seyyappattavai endrum, theriyavandhadhu. Ivatrukkum, sarchaikkuriya yoodiyuvar Jyoti Malhotra-kkum endha thodarbum illai.
India Today l The New Indian Express l Free Press Journal
aam, mudhal pugaippadathil raagul kaandhiyudan iruppavar Congress katchi nirvaagi Aditi Singh aavaar. Kadandha 2018m aandu oodagangalil veliyaana pugaippadathai tharpodhu eduthu, adhidhi sing mugathai matrum edit seythu, jodhi malhothraa mugathai serthu, thavaraaga parappugindranar.
Idhevondru, irandaavadhu pugaippadam raagul kaandhi, Bharat Jodo Yatra sendravodhu, keralaavil avaradhu aadharavaalargalai sandhithavodhu edukkappattadhu. Idhanai kadandha 2022m aandu raagul kaandhiye avaradhu adhigaarappoorva Facebook pakkathil pagirndhullaar.
Unmaiyaana pugaippadathaiyum, edit seyyappatta pugaippadathaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadangal, edit seyyappattavai endru, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Idaitherdhal pirasaarathil DMK vetbaalarukku aarathi; panam viniyogathaal paravarappu
text:
Thaaraavuram: idaitherdhal nadakkum thaaraavurathil, pirasaarathukku sellum DMK vetbaalarukku aarathi edutha pengalukku, DMK nirvaagi thattil panam viniyogam seythadhaaga paravarappu ezhundhulladhu.
Thaaraavuram, DMK vetbaalar suganyaa, moolanoor ondriyathukku utbatta punjjai thalaiyoor, velaanboondi ullitta ooraatchigalil katchiyinarudan veeduveedaaga sendru ottu segarithaar. Avarai varavetru pengal aarathi eduthanar. Appodhu, vetbaalarudan vandha DMK nirvaagi oruvar, aarathi edutha pengalin thattil panam vaithaar.
Therdhal nadathai vidhimuraigal amalil ulla nilaiyil, aarathi edutha pengalukku katchiyinar panam viniyogam seythadhaaga koorappadum, video tharpodhu veliyaagiyulladhu. Idhu kurithu Police visaarithu varugindranar.

headline: Agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathukku mun payani oruvar veliyitta video idhuvaa?
text:
‘’agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathil paliyaana payani edutha kadaisi video’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ *idhayathai udaikkum:😭 er India vimaanam AI171 sambandhappatta kujaraathin agamadhaavaath aruge sogamaana vimaana vivathukku…
sila nimidangalukku munbu payani oruvarin Facebook live video veliyaagiyulladhu.*
evvalavu kanavugalodu irundhiruppaargal.kan imaikkum nerathil ellaame nadandhu mudindhu vittadhu..
Ivvalavudhaan vaazhkkai.😭
anaivarukkum piraarthanaigal.. Om saandhi 😭🙏 ” endru ezhudhappattulladhu. Idhanudan video ondrum inaikkappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa, endru thagaval thedinom. Appodhu, idhu thavaraana thagaval, ena theriyavandhadhu. Aam, ivargal parappum veediyovukkum, tharpodhu nigazhndha agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathirkum endha thodarbum illai.
Idhu kadandha 2023m aandu nevaalam naattil erpatta Yeti Airlines Flight Crash thodarbaana video
indhiyaavai serndha sonu jeysvaal endra navar, nevaalam naattil kadandha 2023m aandu janavari maadham thedhi erpatta vimaana vivathil uyirizhandhaar. Irappadharku munbaaga, thanadhu nanbargaludan serndhu avar, Facebook live muraiyil thanadhu vimaana payanathai video-vaaga pagirndhugondaar. Aanaal, Facebook live mudiyum munbaagave, andha vimaanam vivathil sikkiyadhu sogakkadhai.
India Today l Hindustan Times l Zee News
kurippitta video-vai eduthu, tharpodhaiya agamadhaavaath vimaana vivathudan thodarbuvaduthi, vadhandhi parappugiraargal, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: 10 America kappalgal meedhu thaakkudhal; jordaanil por vimaanangal sedham: Iran-in padhiladi
text:
Tehraan: haarmus jalasandhiyil, 10 America kappalgal utbada 20-kkum merpatta kappalgal meedhu thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga Iran-in islaamiya puratchigara kaavalbadai arivithulladhu.
Merkaasiya naadaana eeraanukkum, amerikkaavukkum idaiye meendum modhal mutriyulladhu. Haarmus jalasandhiyil America kadarpadai porkkappal meedhu sameevathil Iran-in islaamiya puratchigara kaavalbadai evuganaigalai veesi thaakkiyadhu.
Idharkup padhiladiyaaga, kadandha 8m thedhi America raanuvam, eeraanukkus sondhamaana 5 kachaa enney kappalgalai thaakki azhithadhu. Idhanaal aathiramadaindha Iran, andru irave merkaasiyaavil ulla jordaanin paprak, asrak nagarangalil iyangi varum America raanuvath thalangalai kurivaithu thaakkudhal nadathiyulladhu.
Thaakkudhalil, naveena por vimaanangalil migavum pugazhbetra ep-15 raga 8 vimaanangal sedhamadaindhadhadhaaga thagaval veliyaagi ulladhu. Idhevondru 'vaarhaak' endru azhaikkappadum e-10 raga thaakkudhal vimaanam ondru palatha sedhamadaindhu, adhan oru sakkaram, irakkai kaanaamal ponadhaagavum koorappadugiradhu. Indhath thaakkudhalil America tharappil yaarum uyirizhakkavillai ena America raanuvam therivithulladhu.
Innilaiyil thangaludaiya, 5 enney tengar kappalgalai America moozhgadithadharku padhiladiyaaga, America-vin, 2 pork kappalgal, 8 enney kappalgal meedhu Iran thaakkudhal nadathiyadhu. Melum, thadaiyai meeris sendradhaaga matra naadugalais serndha, 10 kappalgal meedhum thaakkudhal nadathiyadhaaga Iran therivithulladhu.
Haarmus jalasandhiyai thaandi, oman valaigudaa matrum aravik kadal pagudhigalilum Iran than kattuppaattu mandalathai virivuppaduthiyulladhu. Anumadhiyindri indhap pagudhikkul nuzhaiyum kappalgal meedhu kadumaiyaana nadavadikkai edukkappadum enavum Iran echarithulladhu. Idhanaal sarvadhesa sandhaiyil kachaa enney vilai kidugiduvena uyarndhu oru peral 100 taalaraith thaandi virpanaiyaagi varugiradhu.

headline: “sangeedhaavai manaivi endru Vijay sollavillai” endru es.e.sandhirasegar koorinaaraa?
text:
Sangeedhaavai thirumanam seythu kondaare thavira avarai than manaivi endru Vijay kooravillai endru es.e.sandhirasegar vilakkam alithadhaaga oru news card

thandhi TV veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “josap Vijay appaa vilakkam. Sangeedhaavai kalyaanam seythu kondaare thavira avarai than manaivi endru sollavillai! Adhevol thirishaavudan living togedhar vaazhgiraar avarai than manaivi illai endru sonnadhillai? – petti ondril iyakkunar es.e.sandhirasegar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sangeedhaavai than manaivi endru Vijay sollavillai endru es.e.sandhirasegar pudhu vilakkam alithadhu pondru news card ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha news card-il ulla thamizh faant vazhakkamaaga thandhi TV veliyidum news card-il ulladhu pola illai. Thagavalum vishamathanamaaga ulladhu. Enave, idhu poliyaanadhu endru therindhadhu. Enave, idhai aayvukku eduthukkondom.
Thandhi TV ippadi oru news card-ai veliyittadhaa endru ariya adhan Facebook pakkathai paarthom. Adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru idhe pugaippadangaludan news card ondrai thandhi TV veliyittirundhadhai kandom. Aanaal adhil, “enakku Vijay kadanaa tharalaye. Akkavunt pukkil en appaavukku ivvalavu koduthirukkiren endru ezhudhiyadhai therdhal piramaana pathirathil thaakkal seythullaar. Udane ellaarum adhanai kadan ena thavaraaga ezhudhi parappi varugindraargal. 200 kodi sambaadhikkum oru pillai appaavukku oru 5 kodi kodukka koodaadhaa.. Avar panam koduthen endrudhaan kurippittullaar. Engeyum kadanaagak koduthen ena kurippidavillai – petti ondril iyakkunar es.e.sandhirasegar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha news card-ai edit seythu thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam thelivaanadhu. Idhu poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythugolla indha news card-ai thandhi TV digital poruppaalarukku anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Needhimandrathil oozhiyarai mirattiyavar kaidhu
text:
Peraiyoor: peraiyoor urimaiyiyal matrum needhithurai naduvar needhimandrathil thalaimai ezhutharaaga sadheeshraajaa panivurindhu varugiraar.
Ivar netru madhiyam needhimandra araiyil velai seythu kondirundhavodhu, angu vandha mangalrevu murugan 39, enbavar 'naan tippar laari vaangiyullen. Adhanai vaanguvadharku mun vazhakkil irundhadhaal aar.si puthagam ingudhaan irukkiradhu. Adhu ippodhu enakku vendum 'ena sadheeshraajaavai mirattinaar.
Murugesanai kaidhu seytha Police visaarithu varugindranar.

headline: ‘metrovil kaadhaliyudan amarndhirundha maganukku angeye nichayam seytha thaay’ endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Metro rail nilaiyathil kaadhaliyudan amarndhu pesik kondirundha thannudaiya maganaip paartha thaay oruvar, kovappadaamal avargalukku angeye nichayam seythu vaithaar endru oru video

ilam jodi ondrukku penmani oruvar nichayam seythu vaippadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “kaadhal jodigale ushaar! Ini odip pidikka neramillai… neradiyaaga nichayadhaartham thaan. Adhiradi kaattiya thaay” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “metrovil kaadhal ; angeye nichayadhaartham! Adhiradi kaattiya thaay!
Metro rail nilaiyathil ragasiyamaagas sandhitha kaadhalargalukku, angeye nichayadhaartham seythu vaithu adhiradi kaattiyullaar oru thaay!
Thannudaiya magan kaadhaliyudan iruppadhaip paartha andhath thaay, kovappadaamal saadhuryamaagas seyalbattaar. “ini olindhu maraindhu pesa vendaam” enak koori, inippugal vazhangi angeye aasi vazhanginaar.
Kaadhalaith thadukkaamal kanniyamaaga angeegaritha indhath thaayin seyal inaiyathil viral-aagi varugiradhu. Kaadhalargale jaakkiradhai, ini ammaavidam sikkinaal neraagak kalyaanamdhaan!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Sgiripdat naadaaga video-kkal YouTube ullitta samooga oodagangalil thodarndhu veliyidappattu varugiradhu. Adhai unmai endru nambi palarum adhai samooga oodagangalil pagirndha varugindranar. Andha vagaiyil, metro station-il thannudaiya magan than kaadhaliyudan amarndhirundhadhaik kanda thaay oruvar, avargalukku angeye nichayadhaartham seythu vaithaar endru oru video tharpodhu viral-aaga pagirappattu varugiradhu.
Video-vai paarkka seyarkaiyaaga, naadagathanamaaga ulladhu. Thideerendru rail nilaiyathil thannudaiya maganai andha thaay paarthaar endru sollappadugiradhu. Aanaal, nichayam seyya pazhangal, inippugal ena ellaam eppadi sariyaaga vaangi vandhirukka mudiyum endra kelvi ezhugiradhu. Thideerendru than thaayaip paarkkum andha maganukkum sari, kaadhalikkum sari endha oru paravarappo, payamo illaamal iruppadhu ellaam idhu sgiripdat veediyodhaan enbadhai urudhi seygindrana.
Aanaal, aadhaarangal adippadaiyil urudhi seyyalaam endru thediya podhu endha aadhaaramum kidaikkaamal irundhadhu. Indha video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thediyavodhu, indha video-vai chalte_phirte endra instaagiraam aidi kondavar veliyittiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Andha video-vil avarum irukkiraar. Enave, ivardhaan indha video-vai veliyittirukka vendum endru therigiradhu. Aanaal, idhu sgiripdat video endru avar endha oru kurippaiyum veliyidavillai.
Avar veliyittirundha video-vai paarkkum podhu, nichayam seyyum mudivodu andha ilainjarin petror vandhiruppadhu pola therigiradhu. Andha pennin petror avargalin kaadhalukku oppudhal therivikkavillai enbadhu pola pesugiraargal. Ingu nadakkum nichayathai video eduthu andha pennin appaavukku anuppumbadi andha penmani koorugiraar. Indha video unmaiyaanadhu illai enbadharku neradi aadhaarangal illaamal irundhadhu.
Indha nilaiyil, nammudaiya fekt kirasando malaiyaalam kuzhuvinar indha video-vai veliyittirundha chalte_phirte098 endra instaagiraam aidi vaithulla navaraith thodarbugondu pesinar. Appodhu avar, “idhu unmai sambavam alla. Ennidam matravargal pagirndhugonda unmai sambavangalai adippadaiyaaga vaithu idhai uruvaakkinom. Idhuvum appadi oru unmaik kadhaiyai adippadaiyaagak kondu uruvaakkappatta sgiripdat naadagamdhaan” endru therivithullaar. Fekt kirasando malaiyaalam veliyittirundha katturaiyai kaana inge kilik seyyungal. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “sadalathai thookkippodu... Innoru kalyaanam pannikko!”
text:
Karppiniyin uyirukku mudhalaali vaitha vilai
“en manaivi en kanmunne pechu moochillaamal kidandhaal. Kuzhandhai paadhi veliye vandhirundhadhu. Maruthuvamanaikkuk kondu sella mudiyavillai. Udhavikku yaarum illai. Ippodhu manaiviyum illai... Kuzhandhaiyum illai...” endru koolithozhilaali aanandhan kanneermalgath therivithavodhu, kaavaldhuraiyinare kalangithaan ponaargal.
Kaanjjivurathai adutha singaadivaakkam irular kudiyiruppais serndhavar aanandhan. Maram vettum thozhil seythuvarugiraar. Ivarin manaivi thenmozhi. Niraimaadha karppiniyaana thenmozhikku sepdambar 8-m thedhi pirasava vali erpattirukkiradhu. Uriya nerathil maruthuva udhavi kidaikkaadha nilaiyil, thenmozhiyum, vayitrilirundha kuzhandhaiyum paridhaavamaaga uyirizhandhirukkiraargal. Idhu thodarbaaga ponnerikkarai poleesaar vazhakku padhivu seythu visaarithuvarugiraargal.
Enna nadandhadhu endru kaaval sithravadhaikku edhiraana koottamaippin maanila orunginaippaalar aaseervaadham, makkal mandrathin orunginaippaalar magesh iruvarum vivarikkiraargal...
Roo.20 aayirathukkaagath thadukkappatta maruthuva udhavi!
“kaanjjivurathukku arugeyulla vannaandhaangalais serndhavar aarumugam. Viragu viyaavaariyaana ivaridam aanandhan, thenmozhi, ivargalin uravinargal sila maadhangalaaga maram vettum velai seythu vandhirukkiraargal. Idharkaaga vellai ket pagudhiyilulla kaattuppagudhiyil kottagai amaithuth thangiyirukkiraargal.
Niraimaadha karppiniyaaga irundha thenmozhiyai maruthuvamanaikku azhaithus sendru parisodhanai seyya aarumugathidam aanandhan anumadhi kettirukkiraar. Aanaal, maram vettum velaikkaaga roo.20 aayiram atvaans vaangiyiruppadhaal, marangalai vetti muditha piragudhaan oorukkus sella mudiyum endru aarumugam karaaraagak kooriyirukkiraar. Idhanaal thenmozhiyai maruthuvamanaikku azhaithus sellavillai.
Indha nilaiyil, sepdambar 8-m thedhi thenmozhikku thideerena pirasava vali erpattirukkiradhu. Avargal thangiyirundha idam kaattuppagudhi enbadhaal, arugil yaarum illai. Padharippona aanandhan, thannudaiya onar aarumugathukku pon seythirukkiraar. Aanaal, avar ponai edukkavillai. Veru vazhiyindri, veettil irundha vilakkenneyaith thenmozhiyin vayitril thadaviyirukkiraar aanandhan. Siridhu nerathil vali kuraindhadhaagath therindhadhaal, maram vettuvadharkaaga kaattuppagudhikkus sendruvittaar. Veettil thenmozhi mattum thaniyaaga irundhirukkiraar.
Kadharith thuditha karppini... Ketka yaarumillai!
Appodhu, meendum thenmozhikkup pirasava vali erpattirukkiradhu. Valiyaal avar kadharith thuditha satham yaarukkum ketkavillai. Kuzhandhai, aanandhiyin vayitrilirundhu paadhi veliyil vandha nilaiyil, thenmozhi adhiga rathappokku kaaranamaagap pechu moochillaamal kidandhirukkiraar. Thanneer kudippadharkaaga aanandhan veettukku vandhavodhudhaan indhak kodoorak kaatchiyaip paarthirukkiraar. Adhirchiyil kadharith thuditha avar, udanadiyaaga aarumugathukku pon seythu nadandhadhaith therivithirukkiraar. Adhan piragu aambulansukkuth thagaval therivikkappattirukkiradhu.
Sambava idathukku vandha aambulans oozhiyargal thenmozhiyaip parisodhithavodhu, avar erkenave uyirizhandhuvittadhaagas solliyirukkiraargal. Idhaiyaduthu ponnerikkarai kaaval nilaiyathukkuth thagaval therivikkappattirukkiradhu. Sambava idathukku vandha poleesaar thenmozhi, kuzhandhaiyin sadalangalai meettu piredha parisodhanaikkaaga Chengalpattu arasu maruthuvamanaikku anuppivaithirukkiraargal.
Indhas sambavam kurithuth thagaval kidaithadhum naangal angu sendru visaarithom. Appodhu, thenmozhiyum kuzhandhaiyum uyirizhandha sambavathai aarumugam moodi maraikka muyandradhu theriyavandhadhu. Engalin poraattathukkup pirage, aarumugathin meedhu vazhakku padhivu seythaargal. Pazhangudiyina makkalin uzhaippais surandiyadhaal, pazhangudiyinar matrum pattiyal saadhiyinar (vangodumai thaduppu) sattathin keezh vazhakku padhivuseyyappattulladhu” endranar.
“sadalathaith thookkippodu... Innoru kalyaanam pannikko!”
ponnerikkarai poleesaaridam pesiyavodhu, “aanandhanidam visaarithavodhu, avar sonna thagavalgal adhirchiyaaga irundhana. ‘sariyaana kooliyai vazhangaamal saaraayathai vaangik koduthu, engal uzhaippai aarumugam surandivandhaar. Velai sariyaagas seyyavillai endraal, aarumugathin aatkal engalai adithu udhaippaargal. Adhanaaldhaan, manaivi pirasava valiyaal thudithavodhum adikku payandhu velaikkus sendruvitten. Manaivi irandha thagavalai aarumugathidam sonnavodhu 2,000 roovaayaik koduthu sadalathaith thookkippodas sonnadhodu, ‘innoru kalyaanam pannikko’ endru sarva saadhaaranamaagas sonnaar’ endru engalidam kadharinaar. Avarin vaakkumoolathin adippadaiyildhaan aarumugathin meedhu vazhakku padhivuseythu visaarithuvarugirom” endraargal.
Maruthuva vasadhigal evvalavo valarndhuvittadhaagas sollappadum indhak kaalathilum, thalainagar sennaikku miga arugileye oru thaayum, aval vayitril irundha kuzhandhaiyum maruthuva udhavikkaagak kaathirundhavadiye uyirizhandhiruppadhu, manasaatchiyai ulukkum vedhanai.

headline: Es1pi visaa kattana uyarvai oraandukku neettithaar Trump
text:
Vaashingdan: es1pi visaa kattuppaadugal matrum 96 latcham roobai kattana thittathai America adhivar tonaaldu Trump melum oraandukku needithu arivippu veliyittullaar.
America adhivaraaga tonaaldu Trump irandaavadhu muraiyaaga kadandhaandu janavariyil padhaviyetradhil irundhu kudiyetrak kolgaigalil kadum kattuppaadugalai kondu vandhaar.
America-vil ulla niruvanangal velinaattinarai panikku amarthuvadhai kattuppaduthum muyatsigalil eeduvattu varugiraar. Idhan oruvagudhiyaaga kadandhaandu sepdambaril es1pi visaavirku palveru kattuppaadugalai kondu vandhadhudan, vinnappa kattanathaiyum, 5 latchathil irundhu 96 latcham roobaayaaga uyarthinaar.
Indha kattana uyarvai edhirthu needhimandrangalil vazhakkugal niluvaiyil ullana. Innilaiyil, immaadhathudan mudivadaiya irundha es1pi visaa kattuppaadugal matrum vinnappak kattanam uyarvai, aduthaandu sep., varai oraandukku neettithu Trump nirvaagam utharavittulladhu.
Tharpodhaiya arivippu pazhaiya utharavin neettippu enbadhaal, needhimandrathin thadai utharavai meeri visaa kattuppaadugal matrum kattanangalai seyalbadutha mudiyaadhu. Iruppinum, Trump nirvaagam thodarndhu sattap poraattathai nadathi varugiradhu.

headline: Tharaiyil vizhundha silindar.. Aduthu nadandha payangaram.. Telliyil adhirchi!
text:
Seythiyaalar : aidaa arutchelvi
Delhi oklaa pes-1 (Phase-I) pagudhiyil indru kaalai vaniga payanbaattukkaana aaksijan silindar vedithu vivathu erpattadhu. Kaavaldhurai thagavalinbadi, kaalai sumaar 10.43 maniyalavil oklaa pes-1 pagudhiyil ulla D-23 endra idathil indha vivathu nadandhulladhu. SM Traders niruvanathukkus sondhamaana Tata 407 vaaganam, kaasiyaavaathil irundhu vanigap payanbaattukkaana aaksijan silindargalai etrikkondu angu vandhadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Vaaganathil irundha silindargalai thozhilaalargal irakki, arugil ulla kudonukkul eduthus sendrullanar. Appodhu oru silindar vaaganathil irundhu thavari saalaiyil vizhundhadhaagavum, adhaith thodarndhu andha silindar vedithadhaagavum kaavaldhurai therivithulladhu. Vedippukkaana sariyaana thozhilnutba kaaranam innum urudhi seyyappadavillai. Sambava idam, silindar, vaaganam ullittavatrai thozhilnutba matrum thadayaviyal nivunargal aayvu seytha pinnare kaaranam theriyavarum endru kaavaldhurai therivithulladhu. Indha vivathil, 35 vayadhaana thozhilaali oruvar uyirizhandhaar. Uyirizhandhavar mogith sing ena adaiyaalam kaanappattullaar. Raajasdhaan maanilam jeyppoorais serndha ivar, thozhildhurai aaksijan silindargalai ulloorp pagudhigalil viniyogam seyyum SM Traders niruvanathil udhaviyaalaraagap paniyaatri vandhaar. Kadandha 3 aandugalaaga andha niruvanathil velai seythu vandhadhaaga therivikkappadugiradhu. Melum indha vivathil, umesh, aravinth, manoj matrum pangaj aagiyor kaayamadaindhanar. Avargal sigichaikkaaga AIIMS maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattullanar.
SM Traders niruvanam andha idathai vaadagaikku eduthu kudonaaga payanbaduthi vandhadhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Kadandha 1 mudhal 2 aandugalaaga angu niruvanam seyalbattu vandhulladhu. Kaasiyaavaathil irundhu nirappappatta aaksijan silindargalai petru, oklaa ullitta pagudhigalil ulla viyaavaarigal matrum thozhil niruvanangalukku vazhangi vandhadhaaga mudharkatta visaaranaiyil theriyavandhulladhu.
Andha kudonil aaksijan nirappum aalai edhuvum illai endrum kaavaldhurai therivithulladhu. Thinamum sumaar 70 mudhal 80 silindargal varai inniruvanathukku vandhu selvadhaaga koorappadugiradhu.
Silindargal engirundhu perappattana, avatrai vazhangiya niruvanathin vivarangal enna, silindargalin urimaiyaalar yaar, avatrais semithu vaikkavum kaiyaalavum kondu sellavum thevaiyaana anumadhigal matrum urimangal ullanavaa enbadhaiyum kaavaldhurai visaarithu varugiradhu.
Vivathu nadandha kudon moodappattulla nilaiyil, visaaranai thodarndhu nadaivetru varugiradhu. Silindar vedithadharkaana sariyaana kaaranamum, vivathu nadandha soozhnilaiyum visaaranaiyin mudivil theriyavarum endru kaavaldhurai therivithulladhu.

headline: India-vil UPI payanbaadu! 10 aandugalil nigazhndha piramaanda valarchi #DataStory
text:
India-vil 2016l thodangiya UPI, 10 aandugalil digital panapparivarthanaiyin mudhugelumbaaga maariyulladhu. 1.78 kodi parivarthanaigal 24,162 kodiyaaga, ₹0.07 latcham kodi madhippu ₹314 latcham kodiyaaga uyarndhulladhu. 703 vangigal inaindhulla nilaiyil, thinasari 66 kodi parivarthanaigal nadaiverugindrana. 11 naadugalukku virindha idhu, India-vin digital porulaadhaarathaiyum nidhi ulladakkathaiyum maatriyamaithulladhu.
India-vin digital panapparivarthanaip puratchiyil migapperiya maatrathai erpaduthiya thozhilnutbangalil Unified Payments Interface (UPI) miga mukkiyamaana idathaip petrulladhu. 2016 aagast 25 andru Indhiya thesiya panapparivarthanaik kazhagam (NPCI), Indhiya risarv vangiyin (RBI) ozhungumurai merpaarvaiyin keezh UPI sevaiyai arimugappaduthiyadhu.
Aarambathil kuraindha ennikkaiyilaana vangigaludan thodangiya UPI, indru India-vin andraada panapparivarthanaiyin mukkiyamaana oru vazhiyaaga maariyulladhu. Panam anuppuvadhu, kadaigalil porutkal vaanguvadhu, online sevaigalukku panam seluthuvadhu ena palveru thevaigalukku UPI payanbaduthappadugiradhu.
UPI arimugamaana 2016-17 nidhiyaandil verum 1.78 kodi parivarthanaigal mattume nadaivetrana. Adutha aandileye adhan payanbaadu vegamaaga adhigarithu 2017-18-l 92 kodi parivarthanaigalaaga uyarndhadhu. 2018-19-l UPI parivarthanaigal 535 kodiyai ettina. 2019-20-l 1,252 kodiyaagavum, 2020-21-l 2,233 kodiyaagavum uyarndhadhu. Idhan moolam UPI payanbaadu Indhiya makkalidaiye vegamaagap paravi vandhulladhu.
2021-22l 4,597 kodi parivarthanaigal nadaivetra nilaiyil, 2022-23l 8,375 kodiyaaga uyarndhadhu. Adutha aandil melum vegamadaindhu 2023-24l 13,116 kodi parivarthanaigal nadandhullana. 2024-25l UPI parivarthanaigalin ennikkai 18,587 kodiyaaga uyarndhadhu. 2025-26 nidhiyaandil, 2026 joolai 31 varaiyilaana tharavugalinbadi, India-vil 24,162 kodi parivarthanaigal nadaivetrullana.
Adhaavadhu, 2016-17-l irundha 1.78 kodi parivarthanaigaludan oppidumbodhu, pathu aandugalukkul UPI parivarthanaigalin aandu alavu kittathatta 13,000 madangu uyarndhulladhu.
Oru naalil saraasariyaaga 66 kodi UPI parivarthanaigal nadaiverum alavukku indha digital kattana amaippu valarndhulladhu. Idhan moolam UPI enbadhu oru maatru kattana murai endra nilaiyaik kadandhu, makkalin andraada vaazhkkaiyin oru pagudhiyaaga maariyirukkiradhu.
UPI-yin valarchiyai parivarthanaigalin ennikkai mattum velippaduthavillai. Adhan moolam merkollappadum parivarthanaigalin motha pana madhippilum migapperiya uyarvu erpattulladhu.
2016-17 nidhiyaandil UPI moolam merkollappatta parivarthanaigalin motha madhippu verum ₹0.07 latcham kodi mattume. 2017-18-l idhu ₹1 latcham kodiyaaga uyarndhadhu. 2018-19-l ₹9 latcham kodiyaagavum, 2019-20-l ₹21 latcham kodiyaagavum adhigarithadhu. 2020-21-l UPI parivarthanaigalin madhippu ₹41 latcham kodiyai ettiyadhu. Adhan piragu valarchi melum vegamadaindhu, 2021-22-l ₹84 latcham kodiyaaga irundha madhippu, 2022-23-l ₹139 latcham kodiyaaga uyarndhadhu.
2023-24-l ₹200 latcham kodiyaiyum, 2024-25-l ₹261 latcham kodiyaiyum UPI parivarthanai madhippu kadandhadhu. 2025-26 nidhiyaandil, 2026 joolai 31 varaiyilaana tharavugalinbadi, UPI moolam merkollappatta parivarthanaigalin motha madhippu ₹314 latcham kodiyaaga uyarndhulladhu.
2016-17-l irundha ₹0.07 latcham kodiyudan oppidumbodhu, idhu 4,000 madangukkum adhigamaana uyarvu aagum.
Indha valarchi UPI moolam siriya alavilaana andraada panapparivarthanaigal mattumindri, migapperiya alavilaana digital parivarthanaigalum nadaiveruvadhaiyum velippaduthugiradhu.
UPI-yin valarchikku adhiga ennikkaiyilaana vangigal indha sevaiyil inaindhadhum mukkiya kaaranamaagum. 2017-m nidhiyaandil verum 44 vangigal mattume UPI sevaiyil inaindhirundhana. 2018-l 91 vangigalaagavum, 2019-l 142 vangigalaagavum ennikkai uyarndhadhu. 2020-l 148 vangigalum, 2021-l 216 vangigalum UPI sevaiyil inaindhana. 2022-l 314 vangigalaagavum, 2023-l 399 vangigalaagavum uyarndhadhu. 2024-l 572 vangigalum, 2025-l 661 vangigalum UPI sevaiyil inaindhirundha nilaiyil, 2026-l indha ennikkai 703 vangigalaaga uyarndhulladhu.
Vangigalin indha virivaakkam UPI sevaiyai naattin palveru pagudhigalil ulla makkalukkum, palveru vagaiyaana vangik kanakku vaithiruppavargalukkum elidhaagak kidaikkas seythulladhu.
UPI ivvalavu vegamaaga valarndhadharku palveru kaaranangal ullana. Smaartbon payanbaadu adhigarippu, malivaana inaiya vasadhi, vangik kanakkugalin ennikkai adhigarippu, digital sevaigal paravalaanadhu aagiyavai UPI valarchikku adithalamaaga amaindhana. Melum, QR Code moolam panam seluthum vasadhi UPI payanbaattai siru vanigargalidamum vegamaagap paraviyadhu. Periya vaniga niruvanangal mattumindri, siriya kadaigal, theruvora viyaavaarigal, sevai vazhangunargal ena palveru tharappinarum UPI kattanathai etrukkollath thodanginar.
Idhanaal, panam illaamaleye smaartbon moolam udanadiyaaga panam seluthum nadaimurai podhumakkalidaiye vazhakkamaana ondraaga maariyadhu.
UPI-yin mukkiyamaana thaakkam adhan vegathil ulladhu. Oruvarukku panam anuppuvadhilirundhu maligaik kadaiyil porutkal vaanguvadhu varai palveru thevaigalukku UPI payanbaduthappadugiradhu. Kurippaaga, siru thogai parivarthanaigalil UPI migapperiya maatrathai erpaduthiyulladhu. Munbu sillaraip panam thevaippatta pala parivarthanaigal indru QR Code-ai sgen seyvadhan moolam sila vinaadigalil mudivadaigindrana. Idhan moolam digital panapparivarthanai nagarppurangalaith thaandi siru nagarangal matrum kiraamappurangalilum virivadaiya vazhivaguthulladhu.
UPI-yin valarchi India-vin Financial Inclusion – nidhi ulladakkathukkum mukkiya pangalippai vazhangiyulladhu. Vangik kilaigalukku neradiyaagas sellaamal, smaartbon moolamaagave panathai anuppavum peravum mudivadhaal, digital nidhis sevaigalukkaana anugal elimaiyaagiyulladhu.
Siru vanigargal matrum suyadhozhil seybavargalukkum idhu payanulladhaaga amaindhulladhu. Panapparivarthanaiyai elidhaagap peruvadhudan, digital parivarthanaigalin padhivugalaiyum vaithirukka mudigiradhu. Idhanaal, UPI India-vin digital porulaadhaara valarchiyil mukkiya pangaatrum kattamaippaaga uruveduthulladhu.
UPI-yin thaakkam Indhiya ellaigalukkul mattum nindruvidavillai. India-vin indha digital panapparivarthanai muraikku sarvadhesa alavilum varaverpu kidaithulladhu. Tharpodhu aikkiya aravu ameeragam, piraans, poodaan, ilangai, nevaalam, singappoor, moreeshas, kathaar, kambodiyaa, kirees matrum maalatheevu ullitta 11 naadugalil UPI seyalbaattil ulladhu. Indha sarvadhesa virivaakkam, India uruvaakkiya digital panapparivarthanai kattamaippu ulagalavil kavanam petriruppadhai kaattugiradhu.
UPI enbadhu verum panam seluthum seyalmurai alla. Idhu India-vin Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) enappadum digital podhu ulgattamaippin mukkiya thoongalil ondraaga uruveduthulladhu. Vevveru vangigal matrum palveru UPI seyaligalaip payanbaduthum payanargal oruvarukkoruvar panathai anuppum vagaiyil uruvaakkappattulla adhan inakkathanmai, adhan migapperiya palamaagum.
Idhan moolam thaninavar mudhal vaniga niruvanangal varai palveru tharappinarukkum ore maadhiriyaana digital panapparivarthanai anuvavam kidaikkiradhu.
Sarvadhesa naanaya nidhiyamum (IMF), parivarthanai ennikkaiyin adippadaiyil UPI-yai ulagin migapperiya nigazhnera panapparivarthanai amaippu enak kurippittulladhu.
2016 aagast 25 andru thodangiya UPI sevai, 10 aandugalil India-vin digital porulaadhaarathin mukkiya adaiyaalamaaga maariyulladhu. Aarambathil migak kuraindha alavil irundha adhan payanbaadu, indru kodikkanakkaana parivarthanaigalai thinasari kaiyaalum alavukku valarndhulladhu.
Parivarthanaigalin ennikkaiyil erpatta migapperiya uyarvudan, avatrin motha madhippilum aayirakkanakkaana madangu valarchi erpattulladhu. Adhe nerathil, UPI sevaiyil inaindha vangigalin ennikkaiyum pala madangu adhigarithulladhu.
Makkalin andraada panapparivarthanaiyai elimaiyaakkiyadhu mattumindri, siru vanigargalukku digital kattana vasadhiyai erpaduthiyadhu, nidhi ulladakkathai membaduthiyadhu, India-vin digital podhu ulgattamaippai valuppaduthiyadhu ena UPI-yin thaakkam palveru thalangalil kaanappadugiradhu.
Indhiyaavaith thaandi palveru naadugalilum UPI payanbaadu virivadaindhu varuvadhu, adhan edhirgaala sarvadhesa vaayppugalaiyum velippaduthugiradhu. Oru kaalathil pudhiya thozhilnutbamaaga arimugamaana UPI, indru indhiyargalin andraada vaazhkkaiyil thavirkka mudiyaadha digital panapparivarthanai muraiyaaga maariyulladhu.
2016-l thodangiya UPI-yin mudhal 10 aandugal, India-vin digital maatrap payanathil oru mukkiyamaana athiyaayamaaga padhivaagiyulladhu.

headline: Nayinaar kes ejensiyai mutrugaiyitta makkal endru paravum news card unmaiyaa?
text:
Kes kidaikkaadhadhaal, nayinaar naagendhiranukku sondhamaana kes ejensiyai makkal mutrugaiyittadhaaga oru news kaarat

seythi oodagam ondru veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “nayinaar kes ejansiyai mutrugaiyitta makkal. Kes thattuppaadu illai ena BJP thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiran pesiya nilaiyil kes kidaikkaadhadhaal thirunelveliyil ulla avaradhu kes ejansiyai mutrugaiyitta makkal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran por edhiroliyaaga naadu muzhuvadhum kes silindar thattuppaadu erpattulladhu. Aanaal, indha thagaval unmaiyillai endru Tamil Nadu BJP thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiran petti alithirundhaar. Melum, “naane oru kes ejensi vaithirukkiren. Naane oru kes teelar thaan. Engu ungalukku silindar vendumo naan tharugiren” endrum avar kooriyirundhaar. Indha nilaiyil, avaradhu kes ejensiyai makkal mutrugaiyittadhaaga news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
Indha news card-ai paarkka andha kurippitta seythi oodagam veliyittadhu polave ulladhu. Vazhakkamaaga andha oodagam veliyidum news kaardukkum idharkum periya vithiyaasam illai. Iruppinum aayvukku eduthukkonda news card-il thedhi vazhakkathai vida peridhaaga irundhadhu. Melum, ejensi enbadhai ejansi endru kurippittirundhanar. Idhanaal, idhu poliyaanadhaaga irukkalaam endra sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Mudhalil indha news card-ai andha oodagam veliyittadhaa endru ariya andha oodagathin samooga oodaga pakkangalaip paarvaiyittom. Aanaal, adhil naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondru endha news kaardum illai. Enave, andha oodagathin WhatsApp ennukku indha news card-ai anuppi idhu unmaiyaa endru kettom. Avargal, indha news card poliyaanadhu endru kurippittu avargal samooga oodaga pakkangalil padhivaaga veliyittanar.
Indha seythiyaavadhu unmaiyaa endru thedip paarthom. Appadi endha oru seythiyum veliyaagavillai. Nellai nagara seythiyaalargalai thodarbugondu visaarithom. Avargalum appadi mutrugai poraattam nadandhadhaaga thagaval illai. Indha thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seythanar. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Siraar aavaasa padangalai pagirvorai pidikka keralaavil pudhiya menborul
text:
Siraar aavaasa padangalai pagirvorai pidikka keralaavil pudhiya menborul
thiruvanandhavuram: samooga valaidhalangalil siraar aavaasa padangalai pagirvorin inaiya mugavarigalai kandariya, kerala Police sirappu menborulai payanbaduthi varugindranar.
Siraargalukku edhiraana paaliyal surandal matrum kutrangalai thadukkum vagaiyil, kerala poleesaarin si.si.es.i., enappadum sirappu kuzhu seyalbattu varugiradhu. Indha kuzhu, inaiyavazhiyaaga kuzhandhaigal thodarbaana paaliyal kutrangalil eeduvaduvorai kandarindhu nadavadikkai eduthu varugiradhu.
Innilaiyil, si.si.es.i., kuzhuvinar segaritha thagavalgalin adippadaiyil, kadandha 21m thedhi maanilam muzhudhum ore nerathil sodhanai nadathinar. Adhil ettu per kaidhu seyyappattanar. 135 vazhakkugal padhivu seyyappattadhudan, movail pongal, modamgal, haardu tiskkugal, memari kaardugal ullitta 212 minnanu saadhanangal parimudhal seyyappattana.
Parimudhal seyyappatta saadhanangalin adippadaiyil, kuzhandhaigal thodarbaana paaliyal aavaasa veediyokkalai pagirndha melum palarai kandariyum visaaranai thodarndhu nadandhu varugiradhu. 
Siraargal thodarndhu paaliyal surandalukku ullaakkappadum soozhalin theevirathai karuthil kondu, si.si.es.i., maiyam uyar thozhilnutba nadavadikkaigalukku maariyulladhu. Sirappu menborutkalai payanbaduthi inaiya mugavarigalai segarippadhudan, samooga valaidhalangalil kuzhandhaigal sambandhappatta aavaasa video-kkal pagirndhavargalai kandariya naveena digital karuvigalaiyum payanbaduthiyullanar.
Kerala poleesin si.si.es.i., merkondu varum ‘aappareshan pi – -hant’ nadavadikkaiyin oru pagudhiyaaga idhu pondra sodhanaigal nadathappadugindrana.

headline: Nevaalathil petroraith thedum kuzhandhaigal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Nevaala vellap perukkil kaanaamal pona appaa, ammaavaith thedum kuzhandhaigal endru oru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu.

Siruvan oruvan kuzhandhaiyai than mudhugil sumandhavadi nirkum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Andha video-vil, “enge engaladhu ammaa, appaa? Nevaalap perazhivil veliyaana idhayam kanakkum kaatchi!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “nevaalathil nigazhndha thuyaramaana sambavathaith thodarndhu, petraaraith thedi alaindhu kondirukkum siruvan oruvan thanadhu thangaiyaip paraamarikkum nenjjaip pizhiyum pugaippadangal samooga valaithalangalil paravi adhirchiyai erpaduthiyullana.
Andhas siru kuzhandhaigal iruvarin mugangalilum kaanappadum kaayangalum, thazhumbugalum, avargal anuvavitha kodooramaana vedhanaiyaiyum valiyaiyum appattamaaga velippaduthugindrana.
Thangalin petraar engu irukkiraargal endru theriyaamal, thavithuk kondirukkum velaiyilum, andhas siruvan than thangai meedhu kaattum paasamum aravanaippum kaanborin kangalil kanneerai varavazhaikkindradhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Nevaalathil petrorai izhandha kuzhandhaigal endru oru video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, ivargalaip paarkka nevaala kuzhandhaigal pola illai. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchigalai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu, thienduyennet endra instaagiraam aidi kondavarin pakkathil indha video padhividappattirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Nevaala vella paadhippu sambavathirkup piragu padhividappattirundhadhu. Aanaal adhil idhu nevaalathil edukkappattadhu endru endha kurippum illai. “uchi veyilil siruvan than udanbirandha kuzhandhaiyai sumandhugondu alaivadhu en nenjjai urukkuvadhaaga ulladhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Avaradhu instaagiraam pakkathil avaradhu WhatsApp ennum irundhadhu. +84 endra sarvadhesa azhaippu kuriyeettudan (country code) andha en irundhadhu. +84 endha naattin kuriyeedu endru thediya podhu, viyatnaam naattais saarndhadhu endru theriyavandhadhu. Avaradhu instaagiraam pakkathil ippadi kuzhandhaigal velai seyvadhu thodarbaaga pala pugaippadangal, veediyokkalai padhivittirundhadhaiyum kaana mudindhadhu.
Avarai WhatsApp moolam thodarbugolla muyatsi seythom. Idharkidaiye nammudaiya fekt kirasando malaiyaalam kuzhuvinar WhatsApp moolam avarai thodarbugondu padhilai petranar. “indha video nevaalathil edukkappattadhu illai. Idhu viyatnaamil edukkappattadhu. Nevaala vella perazhivukkum indha veediyovukkum thodarbillai” endru fekt kirasando malaiyaalam kuzhuvinaridam andha navar urudhi seythirundhaar. Indha aadhaarathin adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Youtuber maaridhaas-kku sikkal.. TVK amaicharin adhiradi.. Nadandhadhu enna?
text:
Seythiyaalar - Karthikeyan
’maaridhaas Answers’ endra peyaril Youtube channel nadathi varuvavardhaan maaridhaas. Theevira valadhusaari aadharavaalaraana ivar, avvappodhu perum sarchaigalil sikkuvadhu vazhakkam. Kadandha 2021-aam aandil, muppadaith thalaimai thalavadhi pivin raavath heligaapdar vivathil uyirizhandhavodhu, ’adutha kaashmeeraaga thamizhagam maarugiradhaa’ endra thalaippil ivar veliyittirundha video-kkal perum paravarappai erpaduthiyirundhadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, appodhaiya DMK arasu, maaridhaasai kaidhu seythirundhanar.
Tharpodhulla, Thamizhaga vetrik kazhaga arasu meedhu avvappodhu palveru adhirchi alikkum vagaiyilaana, kutrachaattugalai thodarndhu ezhuppi varugiraar. Ippadiyaana soozhnilaiyil, Youtuber maaridhaas-kku adhirchi alikkum vagaiyilaana nadavadikkaiyai, amaichar piravu eduthullaar. Adhaavadhu, kaaraikkudi thogudhiyil irundhu Thamizhaga vetrik kazhagam saarbil em.el.e-vaaga therndhedukkappatta ti.ke.piravu, Thamizhaga amaicharavaiyil, kanimavalathurai amaicharaaga padhavi vagithu varugiraar.
Ivar, Youtuber maaridhaas-kku edhiraaga Chennai uyarneedhimandrathil manudhaakkal seythullaar. Thannai kurithu avadhooru parappu vagaiyilaana karuthugalaiyum, aadhaaramatra oozhal kutrachaattukkalaiyum, maaridhaas parappi varugiraar. Enave, avar 1 kodi roovaayai nashda eedaaga vazhanga vendum endru andha manuvil ti.ke.piravu kurippittullaar. Indha vazhakku needhivadhi kovindharaajan thilagavadhi mun indru visaaranaikku vandhadhu.
Indha manuvai visaaranaikku etra needhivadhi, manuvukku ennidum nadaimuraigalai mudithu, visaaranaikku pattiyalida padhivuthuraikku utharavittaar. Indha vazhakkil, maaridhaas mattumindri, amerikkaavais serndha X niruvanamum, koogul niruvanamum, Youtube niruvanamum, edhirmanudhaarargalaaga serkkappattulladhaaga koorappadugiradhu. Samooga valaidhalangalil veliyidappattadhaagak koorappadum padhivugal matrum avatrin moolam erpattadhaaga koorappadum paadhippugal thodarbaaga, indha niruvanangalum vazhakkil serkkappattulladhaagavum sollappadugiradhu.

headline: Aayiram sandhegangal: miyoochuval pandu enepo vil mudhaleedu seyyalaamaa?
text:
Miyoochuval pandu en.ep.o., varumbodhellaam, en purokkar aluvalagathil irundhu azhaithu, 'pathu roobai vilaiyil en.ep.o. Varudhu saar.. Vaangunga' endru solvar. Appadiyaanaal, en.e.vi. Adhigamaaga irundhaal, adhai vaanga koodaadhaa? 
Jaanagiraaman, pozhichaloor
avargal en.ep.o.,vai virpanai seyya vendum enbadharkaaga appadi solgiraargal. Miyoochuval pandu en.e.vi.,yaiyum, pangugalin vilaiyaiyum ondru pol karudha vaithu, kuraindha vilaiyil kidaikkiradhu endra maaya thotrathai uruvaakka muyalgiraargal.
Miyoochuval pandu thittangalum, pangugalin vilaigalum ondralla. Pangugalil thaan kuraindha vilaiyil vaangi adhiga vilaiyil virpanai seyya vendum endra paalavaadam sollitharappadum.
Aanaal, miyoochuval pandugal, en.e.vi., enbadhu andha thittathil ulla motha sothugalai, ethanai yoonittugal undo, adhanaal vagukkappattu, net aset velyoo vivaram thinamum veliyidappadum.
Inge 10 roobai en.e.vi.,yum, 1,000 roobai en.e.vi.,yum ondru thaan. Udhaaranamaaga, irandu thittangalum aandondrukku 12 sadhaveedha rittarn kodukkiradhu endru karudhuvom. 10 roobai 11.20 roobaayaaga uyarum. 1,000 roobai, 1,120 roobaayaaga uyarum. Irandilum, ore valarchi thaan.
En.e.vi., adhigamaaga iruppadharku kaaranam, andha pandu thittam pala aandugalaaga puzhakkathil irukkiradhu, thodarchiyaana ullaarndha sothugalin madhippu kanisamaaga uyarndhirukkiradhu enbadhe. Pudhiya thittangal thaan 10 roobai vilaiyil kidaikkum. Avatril inimel thaan sothukkalai vaangi serkka pogiraargal.
Mudhaleettaalaraaga neengal kavanikka vendiyadhu, oru kurippitta pirivil endha pandu, thodarchiyaaga adhan penjsmaarkkai vida koodudhal laavam eettiyirukkiradhu, adhan 'eksbens reshiyo' enappadum selavinangal kuraivaaga irukkiradhaa, adhan nirvaagam valuvaaga irukkiradhaa enbavatraiye.
 Naan palveru kaaranangalai otti pala idangalil kadan vaanga vendiya soozhal erpadugiradhu. Erkanave oru parsanal lonum, oru too veelar lonum irukkindrana. Innum koodudhal lon vaangalaamaa? 
Je. Loganaadhan, maayavaram
koodudhal ennikkaiyilaana kadangal endraal koodudhal thalaivali endru artham. Naangaindhu longal vaithirundhu ovvondrum ovvoru thedhiyil maadhaandhira thavanai varugiradhu endru vaithukkolvom. Ovvondrukkum panam thetruvadharkul ungalukku vizhi pidhungividaadhaa? Avatril edhenum ondru thaamadham aanaalo alladhu viduvattaalo, adhan pinvilaivugal mosamaanavai. Vattikku mel vatti pottu, kadan palgi peruguvadhu oruvuram endraal, innoru puram kadanai muraiyaaga thiruppis seluthaadhadhu ungal kiredit sgoraiyum paadhikkalaam.
Adhigavatcham irandu kadangalukku mel vaithukkollaadheergal. Irande adhigam endru solven. Kadane illaamal iruppadhu thaan saalachirandhadhu. Mudiyaadhavodhu, athiyaavasiyamaana oru thevaikkaaga edhenum oru kadan vaangalaam. Andha kadanai adaithuvittu, adutha kadanukku povadhu thaan nalladhu. Kanakku pottu selavazhippadharku adhu thaan ugandha vazhi.
 Enakku vayadhu 60. Sameevathil en manaiviyum thandhaiyum irandhuvittanar. Enakku vaarisu illai. Thandhai peyaril vaippu nidhi ulladhu. Adhu 'i aar es' aaga thaan ulladhu. Ippodhu adhai en peyarukku maatrumbodhu naamini poda vendum endru kattaayappaduthugindranar. Enakku sondhavandham yaarum illai. Indha soozhnilaiyil vaippu nidhi pottu, maadha vatti petru ennudaiya irudhikkaala vaazhkkaiyai thalla mudiyumaa, enna seyvadhu? 
Es.sivaraaman, madhurai-.
Vangigal naamini pottuthaan aagavendum endru valiyurutha mudiyaadhu. Vangi kanakku alladhu vaippu nidhi thuvangumbodhu, naamini vivaram padhivu seyvadhu enbadhu 'viruppath thervu' (aapshanal) endru thaan aar.pi.ai. Vidhigal solgindrana. Ungalukku naamini poda viruppamillai endraal, vangiyidam adharkaana 'aapt-avut' padivathai kettu vaangi, adhil kaiyezhuthittu koduthu vidalaam. Adhan pin vaippu nidhiyaaga pottukkollalaam. Ungalukku 60 vayadhu aagivittadhaal, mootha kudimakkal semippu thittathil panathai podalaam. Saadhaarana vaippu nidhi vattiyai vida, tharpodhu idharku 8.20 sadhaveedha vatti kidaikkum.
 Naan 'i.pi.es., 95' oyvu oodhiyam peruvavan. Mahaaraashdiraa min vaariyathil paniyaatrinen. 2005l 3 paagangal aaga tiraivargeshan nadandhadhu. Si.pi.ep. Tirast eksempdat stedasil irundhu vilakku aanadhu. Ippodhu 2026l i.pi.ep.o., tirasttai eduthu kondadhu. Aapshan kodukkavillai. 2012l oyvu petren. Ellorukkum kidaikkum uyarvu oyvoodhiyam pera ungal aalosanai thevai. Nugarvor Needhimandram vaayilaaga kidaikka vaayppu ulladhaa? 
Sundhar nadaraajan, minnanjjal
ungalukku koodudhal oyvoodhiyam kidaikka vaayppillai. Sepdambar 1, 2014kku munnadhaaga oyvu petravargalil, appodhu paniyil irundhavodhu, adhiga oyvoodhiyathukkaana 'jaayint aapshan' koduthirukka vendum. Neengal 2012leye oyvu petruvitteergal; melum andha aapshanaiyum kodukkavillai. Enave, ucha needhimandra theerppai thodarndhu vazhangappatta adhiga oyvoodhiyathukkaana vaayppu ungalukku porundhaadhu. Mahaaraashdiraa min vaariyathin pi.ep., tirast pinnar eksempdat nilaiyilirundhu veliyeri, ippodhu i.pi.ep.o., nirvaagathukku vandhiruppadhu mattum indha thagudhiyai maatraadhu.
Melum, indha vivagaaram nugarvor needhimandrathil theervu kaana vendiya pirasnai alla. Enave, nugarvor Needhimandram vaayilaaga adhiga oyvoodhiyam peralaam endru edhirbaarkka vendaam.
Vaasagargale, nidhi sambandhappatta ungal kelvigalai, 'i---meyil' matrum 'vaatsaap' vaayilaaga anuppalaam.

headline: Epsteenudan narendhira Modi endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
America needhithurai veliyittirundha Epstein koppugalil epsteenudan narendhira Modi iruppadhaaga oru pugaippadam

America needhithurai veliyittirundha Epstein fails aavanathil epsteenudan Indhiya piradhamar narendhira Modi iruppadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “innaikku idha sangi payaluga #AI sonnaalum aacharyappada onnumillai 😏 ennaa thappikka ore vazhi adhudhaane 😌
aanaa paarunga Abdul Jaleel namma annaathe audio indha AI musivathukku munnaadiye vandhadhaale 🤣 poradiyila adichi veliya pathivittaachi 🤭 illa innukkum mmmmm” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhai palarum pagirndhu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Epsteenudan narendhira Modi irukkum pugaippadathai paajaga-vinar thappippadharkaaga eai endru solvaargal endra arthathil Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhaavadhu, unmaiyaana pugaippadam enbadhu polavum eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru koori paajaga-vinar thappikka muyatsi seyvaargal enbadhu polavum kurippidappattirundhadhu. Enave, indha pugaippadam thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Pugaippadathil Modi-kku pinburam alamaari muzhukka puthagangal adukki vaikkappattiruppadhu polavum, Epstein pakkam marangal niraindha thirandha veliyil iruppadhu polavum ulladhu. Sariyaaga edit kooda seyyath theriyaadhavargal indha pugaippadathai edit seythu veliyittiruppadhu padathaip paarkkum podhe therigiradhu.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. America needhithurai veliyittirundha Epstein koppugalilirundhu indha pugaippadam edukkappattadhaaga endha oru oodagathilum seythi veliyaagi irukkavillai. Melum, Modi-yin pugaippadathirku padhil raagul kaandhiyin pugaippadathai vaithum samooga oodagangalil padhividappattu vandhiruppadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam Congress, BJP ena irandu katchiyinarum oruvar matroruvar pugaippadathai vaithu edit seythu vadhandhi parappiyiruppadhu theriya vandhadhu.
Idhaith thavira endha oru nambathagundha, sarvadhesa, Indhiya oodagangalilirundhu seythi, pugaippadam veliyaagi irukkavillai. Unmaiyaana pugaippadamaaga irundhirundhaal sarvadhesa oodagangalilaavadhu veliyaagi irundhirukkum. Ivai ellaam indha pugaippadam poliyaanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.
Epstein koppugalai veliyittulla America needhithuraiyin inaiyadhalathirku (https://www.justice.gov/epstein) sendru idhu thodarbaaga thedip paarthom. Narendhira Modi peyarai taip seythu thediya podhu 31 idangalil avaradhu peyar kurippidappattirundhadhu. Avatrai thirandhu paartha podhu avaraip patri veliyaagi irundha seythigal adhil irundhana. Teekkadaikkaarar eppadi piradhamar aanaar enbadhu pondra andha seythigalai paarkka mudindhadhu.
Raagul kaandhi endru taip seythu thediya podhu, naangu idangalil avaradhu peyar idam petrirundhadhu. Adhil moondru raagul kaandhi thodarbaana veliyaana seythigalaaga irundhadhu. Ondru veru oru raagul kaandhiyai patriya kurippaaga irundhadhu. Matravadi naam aayvukku eduthukkondadhu pondra pugaippadathai avatril kaana mudiyavillai.
Idhai melum urudhi seythugolla eai pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum inaiyadhalangalil idhai padhivetrith thedinom. Avaiyum indha pugaippadam unmaiyaanadhaaga irukka vaayppillai. 94 sadhavigidham varai digital muraiyil edit seythu uruvaakkappattadhaaga irukkalaam endru therivithana. Sila toolgalil indha sadhavigidham satru kuraivaaga irundhaalum perumbaalaana nambathagundha eai video, pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum thalangal idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadamdhaan endru urudhi seythana.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu nammudaiya Fact Crescendo Tamil ilangai thamizh inaiyadhalathilum indha pugaippadam thodarbaaga katturai veliyaagi irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Adhilum eai pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum thalangalin udhaviyudan indha pugaigappadam poliyaanadhu endru avargal urudhi seythirundhanar. Andha katturaiyai kaana inge kilik seyyungal.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu edit seyyappattadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Arasiyalil irundhu vilagiya Annamalai endru paravum thagaval unmaiyaa?
text:
‘‘arasiyalil irundhu vilagiya Annamalai,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ arivaalayathin sengalai pirippen endru sonnavar therdhal poruppugalil irundhe vilaginaar.’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, thanadhu thandhaikku udalnilai sariyillai enbadhaal, avarai kavanithukkolla vendiya kadamai ulladhaal, thogudhi poruppaalar padhaviyilirundhu maanilath thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiranidam koorivittu vilagi vitten endrudhaan Annamalai kooriyadhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
Polimer News l Dailythanthi l Vikatan l Puthiyathalaimurai
adhesamayam, nirandharamaaga arasiyalil irundhu vilaguvadhaaga, Annamalai koorave illai. Aanaal, avar vilaguvadhaagak kooriyadhaaga, samooga valaidhalangalil thagaval paravum soozhalil BJP maanilath thalaivar nayinaar naagendhiran tharpodhu vilakkam alithullaar. Annamalai patri pagirappadum thagaval poyyaanadhu, endru avar therivithullaar.
Koodudhal aadhaarathirkaaga, naam BJP aidi pirivilum pesi urudhippaduthiyullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, thavaraanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Thiruvannaamalai kovil peyar matrum arivippup palagaigalil thamizh agatrappattadhaa?
text:
Thiruvannaamalai kovilil ulla peyar matrum arivippup palagaigalil thamizh agatrappattuvittadhu endru oru pugaippadam

kovil ondril enna mozhi endre theriyaadha vagaiyil edho oru mozhiyil peyar matrum arivippup palagaigal vaikkappattirukkum pugaippadam Facebook-il pagirappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “thamizhargalidam irundhu parivogum nilaiyil thiruvannaamalai.! Aariyamum thiraavidamum koottukkalavaanigal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Thiruvannaamalai annaamalaiyaar thirukkovililirundha peyar matrum arivippup palagaigalil thamizhai agatrivittu thelungu mozhiyil arivippup palagaigalai vaithulladhaagap palarum pugaippadangalai samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Aanaal, andha pugaippadangalai paarkkum podhu unmaiyaanadhu polath theriyavillai. Eai (seyarkai nunnarivu thozhilnutbam) moolam uruvaakkappatta pugaippadangal pola ulladhu. Enna mozhi endre theriyaadha vagaiyil paarkka kannadam, singala mozhi ezhuthukkal pola irukkiradhu. Aanaal nichayam idhu endha mozhiyin ezhuthum illai.
Eai-l ezhuthukkal sariyaaga idam peraadhu. Aangila vaarthaigalil kooda thavarugalaik kaana mudiyum. Appadi irukka thelungu mozhiyil eai toolai payanbaduthiyullanar. Adhu veru thanakkuth therindha mozhigalai ellaam serthu pudhiya mozhiyil peyarppalagaiyaith thayaar seythu koduthulladhu. Indha pugaippadam eai-l uruvaakkappattadhaa endru eai pugaippadangalai kandariya udhavum inaiyathalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Adhuvum idhu eai pugaippadam enbadhai urudhi seythadhu.
Indha pugaippadathai thiruvannaamalaiyil ulla munnani oodagam ondrin seythiyaalarukku anuppi, thiruvannaamalai kovilil veru mozhiyil alladhu thelungu mozhiyil arivippu vaikkappattulladhaa endru kettom. Avarum indha thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Idhu thodarbaaga Tamil Nadu fekt sek tharappil edhenum padhivu veliyidappattulladhaa endru paarthom. Adhil, “idhu mutrilum poyyaana thagaval. Indhap pugaippadathil iruppadhu thiruvannaamalaiyil ulla koyil alla. Adhil ulla penaril iruppadhu mozhiye alla. Seyarkai nunnarivu (AI) moolam uruvaakkappatta poliyaana pugaippadathai thiruvannaamalaiyil ulla koyil endru kurippittu vadhandhi parappi varugindranar. Idhai thiruvannaamalai koyil udhavi aanaiyarum maruthullaar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Patraakkurai!
text:
Kaaviriyil thamizhagathirku 20 ti.em.si., neer... Oruvaarathil padhil thara karnaadagaavukku utharavu
–sirappu niruvar–
kaaviriyil thamizhagathirku erpattulla 20 ti.em.si., neer patraakkuraiyai eedugatta nadavadikkai edukkak kori Thamizhaga arasu thaakkal seythulla manu meedhu oru vaarathirkul padhil alikkumbadi karnaadaga arasukku ucha Needhimandram utharavittulladhu.
Thamizhagathirku uriya kaaviri neerai thirandhuvidak kori, ucha needhimandrathil Thamizhaga arasu pudhidhaaga manuth thaakkal seythadhu. Adhil, ‘mazhai kuraindha aandil, uriya neer thirakkappadaadhadhaal, paasanathirku neer patraakkurai erpattadhu. Idhanaal, Thamizhagathil kuruvai saaguvadi paadhikkappattulladhu’ ena, therivikkappattadhu.
Indha manu needhivadhigal vikram naath, akstin jaarj maasih matrum sandheep methaa amarvil netru visaaranaikku vandhadhu.
Appodhu Thamizhaga arasu tharappil aajaraana mootha vazhakkarinjar si.es.vaithiyanaadhan, ‘‘thamizhagathirku erpattulla neer patraakkurai kurithu kaaviri neer melaanmai aanaiyam uriya utharavu pirappikka vendum,’’ endraar.
Needhivadhigal, ‘evvalavu neer patraakkurai erpattulladhu’ ena vinavinar.
Idharku mootha vazhakkarinjar si.es.vaithiyanaadhan munvaitha vaadham:
engal kanakkuppadi thamizhagathirku 20 ti.em.si., neer patraakkurai erpattulladhu. Karnaadaga arasu uriya nerathil kaaviriyil neerai thirakkaadhadhaal, Thamizhagathil mungaar saaguvadi erkanave paadhikkappattuvittadhu. Vigidhaachaara adippadaiyil neer thirakkappattaal mattume thamizhagathirkaana pangu kidaikkum. Tharpodhu Thamizhagathil kadumaiyaana neer patraakkurai nilavugiradhu. Indhas soozhalil thaan kaaviriyil uriya neerai thirandhuvidumbadi korikkai vaikkirom.
Aanaal, indha niyaayamaana korikkaiyai kooda kaaviri neer melaanmai aanaiyam pariseelippadhe illai. Patraakkurai alavaana 20 ti.em.si., neerai petru tharuvadharku kooda, kaaviri neer melaanmai aanaiyam uriya utharavugalai pirappippadhu illai.
Kadandha joon maadham karnaadaga anaigalil podhiya neer iruppu thekkappattirundhadhu. Eninum, ammaanila arasu kulangal matrum thaduppanaigalukku 19 ti.em.si., alavukku neerai madaimaatram seythulladhu. Idhan moolam thamizhagathirku uriya pangeettai kuraikka paarkkiradhu.
Ivvaaru avar vaadhittaar.
Thamizhaga arasin indha vaadhathirku karnaadaga arasu tharappu mootha vazhakkarinjar shyaam thivaan kadumaiyaaga edhirppu therivithaar. Avar vaadhidugaiyil, ‘‘karnaadagaavil mazhai pozhivu kuraivaaga irundhadhaal, pala maavattangal varatchi pagudhigalaaga arivikkappattullana. Thavira, kadumaiyaana neer patraakkuraiyum erpattulladhu. Mazhai kuraiyum aandugalil vazhakkamaaga erpadum sikkale tharpodhu nilavugiradhu.
‘‘kaaviri neer melaanmai aanaiyam pirappikkum utharavugalai karnaadaga arasu thavaraamal amalbaduthi varugiradhu. Aanaal, thamizhagam tharpodhu korum koodudhal neerai thirandhuvida mudiyaadha soozhal nilavugiradhu,’’ endraar.
Iru tharappu vaadhangalaiyum ketta pin needhivadhigal pirappitha utharavu:
neer patraakkurai kurithu Thamizhaga arasu pugaar therivithulladhu. Adhu kurithu kaaviri neer melaanmai aanaiyam uriya mudivu edukka vendum. 20 ti.em.si., neer patraakkurai kurithu karnaadaga arasu virivaana padhil manuvai oru vaarathirkul thaakkal seyya vendum. Kaaviri neer pangeettu vivagaarathil endhavoru thaninavaro alladhu thaniyaar amaippo thaakkal seyyum idaiyeettu manukkalai Needhimandram visaaranaikku etruk kollaadhu.
Ivvaaru utharavittu vazhakku visaaranaiyai ak., 12m thedhikku othivaithanar.
Kadandha sep., 8l kaaviri neer ozhungaatruk kuzhuvin parindhuraiyai kaaviri neer melaanmai aanaiyam urudhi seythadhu. Adhanbadi, thamizhagathukku, 15 naatkalukku vinaadikku, 6,000 kanaadi neerai thirandhu vida karnaadagaavukku utharavidappattadhu. Andha utharavuppadi karnaadagaa neerai thirandhu varuvadhaaga ucha needhimandrathil therivikkappattadhu.
Melum, kaaviri neer ozhungaatruk kuzhu, 15 naatkalukku orumurai neer nilavarathai aayvu seythu varuvadhaagavum needhimandrathil therivikkappattadhu.
