headline: Kanniyaagumariyil saalaiyai kadandha raatchadha malaippaambu idhuvaa?
text:
‘’kanniyaagumariyil saalaiyai kadandha raatchadha malaippaambu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kumari maavatta saalaiyil kadandhu sendra raatchadha malaippaambu,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil, kumari maavattathil malaippaambu nadamaattam endru edhenum seythi veliyaagiyulladhaa, endru paarthom.
Appodhu, kadandha 2025, joolai maadham ‘’ naagargovil paarvadhivuram aruge saalaiyai kadandhu sendra raatchadha malaippaambu,’’ endra thalaippil veliyaana seythi aadhaarangal kidaithana. Aanaal, andha veediyovukkum, naam aayvu seyyum veediyovukkum niraiya veruvaadugal ulladhaiyum kandom.
Aduthappadiyaaga, naam aayvu seyyum video-vin oru firemai piritheduthu, koogul udhaviyudan rivars imej thedal seythom. Appodhu, indha video kadandha 2022m aandu mudhale inaiyadhalangalil share seyyappadum ondru, ena theriyavandhadhu.
Kadandha 2022m aandu maars maadham 06m thedhi ETV Bharat veliyitta seythiyil, karnaadagaa maanilam, Karwar pagudhiyil indha paambu kaanappattadhaagak koorappattulladhu.
Adhesamayam, maars 20, 2022 andru Times of India veliyitta seythiyil, kerala maanilam, Wayanad pagudhiyil indha paambu kaanappattadhaagak kurippidappattulladhu.
Idhanmoolamaaga, naam aayvu seyyum video kadandha 2022m aandu mudhalaaga, enge edukkappattadhu endru theriyaamal kuzhappamaana thagavaludan pagirappattu varuvadhu, thelivaagiradhu.
Thodarndhu, Tamil Nadu arasin adhigaarappoorva fektchek kuzhu TN Factcheck kurippitta video patri maruppu veliyittulladhaaga, vivaram kidaithadhu.
Enave, naam aayvu seyyum veediyovukkum, kanniyaagumarikkum endha thodarbum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Poombugaaril 10 sadhaveedha thalluvadiyil kolu pommaigal virpanai
text:
Salem: navaraathiri vizhaavai otti, Salem, pazhaiya bus staant, thiruvalluvar silai edhire ulla poombugaar kaivinai porutkal virpanai nilaiyathil, kolu pommaigal kan-kaatchi matrum virpanaiyai, maavatta varuvaay aluvalar ravikkumaar, netru thodangi vaithaar.
Idhugurithu virpanai nilaiya melaalar narendhira pos kooriya-thaavadhu:ingu pommaigal, 15 mudhal, 32,500 roobai varai virpa-naikku vaikkappattullana.
Pudhu varavaaga, 18 sithargal, kirivalam, solingar narasimmar, thiru-naavukkarasar, panjja sdhalam, magaavaaradham, nava thurkkai, sathya naaraa-yanan, maarkkandeyar, aruvadai veedu murugan, sapdha rishigal, sreedhevi poodhevi samedha perumaal ullittavai setkalaa-kavum, thaniye thirumangai yaazhvaar, poori jegannaadhar, paala aandaal, paala meenaatchi, meenaatchi jananam, paala pojanam, theechatti amman, vadivudai amman, kodiyidai amman, apdhul kalaam, thiruvalluvar, suvaami vivegaanandhar ena, eraa-lamaana pommaigal ullana. Ak., 30 varai, vidumurai indri kangaatchi nadakkiradhu. Kolu pommaigalukku, 10 sadha-veedha thalluvadi vazhangappadugiradhu.
Ivvaaaaru avar koorinaar.

headline: Edappadi pazhanisaamiyidam varutham therivithaaraa Vijay?
text:
‘’Edappadi pazhanisaamiyidam varutham therivitha Vijay,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ aadhav arjoonaa appadi pesi irukkak koodaadhu. ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi pazhanisaamiyidam, TVK thalaivar Vijay tholaivesiyil pesiyadhaagath thagaval. ‘’aadhav arjoonaa appadi pesi irukkak koodaadhu,’’ endru Edappadi pazhanisaamiyidam Vijay varutham therivithadhaagath thagaval ” endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
ADMK podhus seyalaalar Edappadi Palaniswami patri sameevathil TVK nirvaagi aadhav arjoonaa orumaiyil karuthu therivithadhaaga, samooga valaidhalangalil vimarsikkappadugiradhu. Idhaiyaduthu, aadhav arjoonaa vilakkam alithirundhaar.
Indha soozhalil, aadhav arjoonaa orumaiyil pesiyadharkaaga, Edappadi pazhanisaamiyai tholaivesiyil thodarbugondu, Vijay varutham therivithaar, endru samooga valaidhalangalil oru thagaval pagirappadugiradhu.
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Idhugurithu, Polimer news tharappil kettavodhu, ‘’unmaithanmai sarivaarkkaamal, mudhalil ivvaaru seythi veliyittirundha nilaiyil, piragu adhanai thangaladhu samooga valaidhala pakkangalil irundhu agatrivittom’’, endru therivithanar.
Idhudhodarbaaga, koogulil thedumbodhu, Polimer news veliyitta seythiyin lingk kidaithaalum, adhan ulle paarthavodhu, kandent telit seyyappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu.
Aduthappadiyaaga, kurippitta seythi oru adippadai aadhaaramatra vadhandhi endru TVK, tharappil erkanave adhigaarappoorva vilakkam alikkappattirundhadhaiyum kandom.
Irudhiyaaga, Edappadi pazhanisaamiyin aluvalagathai thodarbu kondu vilakkam kettom. ‘’ivvaaru Vijay edhuvum pesavillai. Idhuvatri erkanave engaladhu podhus seyalaalar oodagangalukku vilakkam alithullaar,’’ endru therivithanar.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…

enave, ‘Edappadi pazhanisaamiyidam varutham therivitha Vijay’ endru pagirappadum seythi oru adippadai aadhaaramatra vadhandhi, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Indru 11 maavattangalukku echarikkai.. Velukkappogum kanamazhai!
text:
Thamizhagathil indru 11 maavattangalukku kanamazhai echarikkai vidukkappattulladhu. Neelagiri, Kovai, Krishnagiri, tharumavuri, raanippettai, vizhuppuram, thiruvannaamalai aagiya maavattangalilum, thiruppathoor, veloor, kallakkurichi, Madurai maavattangal matrum pudhucheriyilum idi minnal matrum palatha kaatrudan koodiya kanamazhai peyyakkoodum ena vaanilai aayvu maiyam therivithulladhu. Idhevondru, varum 20, 21aam thedhigalil neelagiri, Kovai, thindukkal, tharumavuri, Krishnagiri, Trichy, ariyaloor, perambaloor, Madurai, vizhuppuram, kallakkurichi, thiruvannaamalai, thiruppathoor, veloor aagiya 14 maavattangalukku kanamazhai echarikkai vidukkappattulladhu.
22aam thedhi neelagiri, Kovai maavattangalil mattum kanamazhai peyyakkoodum endrum therivikkappattulladhu. Thamizhagathil 2 naatkalukku veppanilai adhigarikkakkoodum ena vaanilai aayvu maiyam therivithulladhu. Thamizhagam, pudhucheri matrum kaaraikkaal pagudhigalil orusila idangalil adhigavatcha veppanilai iyalbaivida 2 mudhal 3 tigiri selsiyas adhigamaaga irukkakkoodum ena kurippittulladhu. Varum 20aam thedhi mudhal 22aam thedhi varai adhigavatcha veppanilai iyalbai ottiye irukkakkoodum endrum kanithulladhu.

headline: Paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga vandha thurukki kadarpadai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga thurukki anuppiya kadarpadai kappalgal endru oru video

kappalgal anivaguthu varum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga #thurukki kapparpadai indhiyaavai nokki vandhu kondu iruppadhaaga samooga oodagangal vazhiye seythigal varugiradhu….
Varum seythi unmaiyaa poyyaannu theriyala…. Aanaa appadi namakku edhiraa vandhaa avanungalukku INS – VIKRANT paadai katta povadhu urudhi” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittullanar.
investigation_details:
India-vil payangaravaadha thaakkudhal nadathiya Pakistan payangaravaadhigalukku padhiladi alikkum vagaiyil aavareshan sindhoor endra thaakkudhalai India nadathiyadhu. Appodhu, paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga thurukki arasu thannudaiya kadarpadaiyai anuppiyadhu endru oru video-vai silar samooga oodagangalil padhivittirundhanar.
2024m aandu levanaan meedhu Israel thaakkudhal nadathiya podhu idhe video-vai levaanukku aadharavaaga kadarpadaiyai anuppiya thurukki endru silar padhivittirundhanar. Indha video-vai appodhu fekt sek seythirundha ninaivu irundhadhu. Enave, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil ulla video pazhaiyadhu thaanaa enbadhai meendum urudhi seythugolla aayvu seythom.
Pazhaiya katturaiyaith thedi eduthup paartha podhu, irandu padhivugalilum ore veediyovaith thaan padhivittullanar enbadhu thelivaanadhu. 2023m aandu thurukki arasu kudiyarasaaga maariyadhan 100m aandai kondaadum vidhathil thannudaiya kadarpadai matrum vimaanappadaiyin saagasa nigazhchiyai nadathiyadhu. Appodhu edukkappatta video-vai paagisdhaanukku aadharavaaga kadarpadaiyai anuppiya thurukki endru thavaraagap pagirndhiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu.

headline: Odai thoorvaarum pani mummuram
text:

headline: Ilainjargalaith thaakkum maaradaippu; thappippadhu eppadi?
text:
Indhiya ilainjargalil idhaya noy adhigarippukku vaazhkkai murai kaaranigal mukkiyam ena aayvugal echarikkindrana. Vaarathirku 150 nimidam nadai/udarpayitsi, kuraindha kozhuppu–uppu unavu, pugai–madhuvaith thavirthal, mana azhuthak kattuppaadu, 40 vayadhukku munbe idhaya parisodhanai seyvadhu pondra munnecharikkai nadavadikkaigal maaradaippu aavathai kuraikka udhavum.
Pugaiyilai payanbaadu, uyar ratha azhutham, adhiga kolastraal, sarkkarai noy, udalbaruman, theevira mana azhutham matrum podhaipporul payanbaadu pondravai maaradaippukkaana mudhanmai kaaranigalaaga amaigindrana. Maraviyalreedhiyaagavum, vayadhu adhigarikkumbodhum indha aavathu melum adhigarikkiradhu.
Melnaadugalodu oppidugaiyil, India-vil idhaya noy paadhippu miga ilamaiyileye thodangugiradhu. India-vil erpadum maaradaippu maranangalil sumaar 30 sadhaveedham 45 vayadhukku utbatta ilainjargalukke erpaduvadhaaga aayvugal adhirchith thagavalai therivikkindrana.
Maaradaippu endraal verum maarbu vali mattume endru alatchiyamaaga irundhuvidak koodaadhu. Maarbil kadumaiyaana vali alladhu azhutham erpaduvadhu, idadhu kai, thaadai, kazhuthu, mudhugu alladhu mel vayitril vali paravuvadhu, thideer mayakkam matrum moochuthinaral aagiyavai idhan mukkiya arigurigalaagum. Adheneram, aangalaivida pengalukku arigurigal satru maaruvadalaam.
Nenjjerichal, seeratra serimaanam, kaaranam illaadha theevira sorvu, vaandhi matrum thideerena kulirndha viyarvai veliyeruvadhu pondra maaruvatta arigurigalum maaradaippin ariguriyaaga irukkalaam. Pengalukku ithagaiya arigurigal mana azhutham enath thavaraagap purindhugollappaduvadhaal, sigichai peruvadhil thaamadham erpadugiradhu.
Maaradaippu varaamal thadukka aarokkiyamaana vaazhkkai muraiyaip pinbatruvadhu avasiyam. Vaarathukku 150 nimidangal nadaippayitsi alladhu udarpayitsi seyvadhu, kozhuppu matrum uppu kuraindha unavup pazhakkam, pugai matrum madhuppazhakkathaith thavirppadhu, mana azhuthathaik kuraippadhu aagiyavai idhaya aarokkiyathai urudhi seyyum. 40 vayadhukku utbatta ilainjargalukkum, idhaya noy aavathu adhigam ullavargalukkum muraiyaana maruthuvap parisodhanaigalaik kattaayamaakkuvadhu, maaradaippaal erpadum uyirizhappugalaith thadukka udhavum endru maruthuva vallunargal echarikkindranar.

headline: Maambazhangalai saappittuvittu kulirbaanam kudithaal irappu erpadumaa?
text: Maambazham saappittuvittu kulirbaanam kudithaal maranam
investigation_details:
Viral-aagum thagaval thavaraanadhu; aadhaaramatradhu aagum.
Maambazhangalai saappittuvittu kulirbaana kudithaal irappu erpadum endru thagaval ondru samooga valaithalangalil viral-aagi varugiradhu.
”oru sinna echarikkai maambazhangalais saappidungal, kulir paanangal kudikkaadheergal! Sila sutrulaap payanigal sandigarukkus sendranar. Maambazhathai saappitta udane kulirbaanathai kudithaar. Avargal anaivarukkum udalnilai sariyillaamal mayakkam erpattadhu. Maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappatta avargal anaivarum irandhuvittadhaaga arivikkappattadhu. Maambazham saappitta piragu kulirbaanamo, kulirbaanamo arundhak koodaadhu ena maruthuvargal therivithullanar. Maambazhathil ulla sitrik amilamum, kulirbaanathil ulla aargaanik amilamum serndhu vishamaagiradhu.” enbadhaaga seythi ondru samooga valaithalangalil paravi varugiradhu. Idhugurithu, nammudaiya vaasagargalum thodarchiyaaga kelvi ezhuppi varugindranar.
Samooga valaithalangalil paravi varum ithagavalin unmaithanmaik kurithu ariya ithagaval kurithu niyoossekkar thamizh saarbil aayvu seyya mudivu seythom.

Factcheck / Verification
maambazhangalai saappittuvittu kulirbaana kudithaal irappu erpadum endru samooga valaithalangalil seythi paraviyadhaith thodarndhu adhuguritha aayvil eeduvattom.
Mudhalaavadhaaga, sandigaril ippadi oru nigazhvu nadandhiruppadhaaga viral padhivil iruppadhaith thodarndhu appadi nigazhvu edhenum nigazhndhulladhaa endru kee-verdugalaal thedinom.
Aanaal, seythigalil appadi sandigar sutrulaappayanigal maambazham saappittuvittu kulirbaanam kudithadhaal irandhadhaaga thagaval edhuvum padhivaagiyirukkavillai. Melum, kadandha sila varudangalaagave indha viral padhivu samooga valaithalangalil paravi varuvadhum theriya vandhadhu.
Thodarndhu idhugurithu thediyavodhu, kadandha 2019 aam aandu, Frontiers veliyittirundha katturai ondru namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil, “Mango contains organic acids like malic and citric acid, which are the main reason for the sourness of mango fruit.” endru maambazhathil ulla rasaayana panbugal patri kurippidappattulladhu.
National Library of Medicine veliyittulla matroru katturaiyil maambazhathil ulla sathugal matrum udalukku thevaiyaana vaittamingal kurithu therivikkappattulladhu.
Kulirbaanangalil ulla kaarbonik amilam, kulirbaana paattilai thirandhavudaneye sidhaindhuvidum endru pirittaanigaavin katturaiyil therivikkappattulladhu.
Maambazham matrum kulirbaanathil ulla rasaayanangal edhirmaraiyaana vilaivugalai erpaduthumaa? Enbadhu kurithu aaraayndhom. Adharkumunbu, Thoughtco janavari 29, 2020l pagirndhirundha katturai ondril palaveenamaana amilangal kurithu kodukkappattulladhu. Adhil, “a weak acid is an acid that is partially soluble in water or ions in an aqueous solution. Citric and carbonic acid are two such weak acids. Generally, two weak acids with similar dissociation constants coexist in solution without much interaction. They have similar dissociation constants in water.” endru therivikkappattulladhu.
Idhudhodarbaaga, KLE maruthuvamanaiyin maruthuvar maadhav piravuvai thodarbu kondu pesiyavodhu, “idhuvondru nigazhndhadhaaga idhuvarai endha seythiyum vandhadhillai. Maambazham matrum kulirbaanam irandil irukkum porutkalum maranathai vilaivikkaadhu.” endru vilakkamalithaar.
Thodarndhu, idhugurithu kadandha 2022aam aande yasodhaa maruthuvamanai maruthuvar sruthigaa shingaaraa enbavaraith thodarbu kondu pesiyullom. Adhil avar, “sitrik amilam maambazhathil miga kuraindha alave irukkum. Kulirbaanathil irukkum kaarbonik amilam matrum sitrik amilam irandume udalil kavalaikkuriya maatrangalai erpaduthaadhu. Aanaal, thinasari kaarbonet paanangalai eduthuk kondaal avai ajeeranak kolaarugalai erpaduthalaam” endru vilakkamalithullaar.
Indha viral padhivu kurithu melum arindhugolla, raajesvari shilge ennum oottachathu nivunaraith thodarbu kondu pesinom. Appodhu avar, “sitrik amilam alladhu kaarbonik amilam ulla unavugalai eduthukkollumbodhu vaayuthollai matrum ajeeranam erpadalaam. Aanaal, avatraal udanadi maranam enbadhellaam vaayppillai” endru therivithaar.

Conclusion
maambazhangalai saappittuvittu kulirbaanam kudithaal irappu erpadum endru paravugindra thagaval thavaraanadhu; aadhaaramindri paravugiradhu enbadhu namakku kidaitha aadhaarangalin vaayilaaga thelivaagiyulladhu.

headline: Koottani katchi thalaivargaludan medaiyerum Vijay; podhukkoottangalil ondraaga pangerka mudivu
text:
- namadhu niruvar - 
idaitherdhal nadakkum thogudhigalil, mudhalvar Vijay matrum madhachaarbatra samooga needhi vetrik koottani katchith thalaivargal pangerkum podhukkoottam nadathappada ulladhaaga thagaval veliyaagi ulladhu.
TVK, thalaimaiyilaana madhachaarbatra samooga needhi vetrik koottaniyil, Congress - ma.thi.mu.ka., - VCK, - Indhiya yooniyan muslim leek aagiya katchigal idam petrullana.
Innilaiyil, kaaliyaaga ulla madhuraandhagam matrum thaaraavuram thogudhigalil, ak., 6l idaitherdhal nadakka ulladhu.
Koottani amaitha pin nadakkum, mudhal idaitherdhal enbadhaal, makkalidam TVK, arasin saadhanaiyai vilakki pesa vendum. Adharku madhuraandhagam, thaaraavuram thogudhigalil podhukkoottam nadatha vendum.
Adhil, koottani katchith thalaivargaludan mudhalvar Vijay pangerka vendum ena, ma.thi.mu.ka., podhucheyalar vaigo viruppam therivithullaar. Adhai, mudhalvar Vijay etruk kondullaar.
 TVK, nirvaagigal silar kooriyadhaavadhu: koottani katchigalin thalaivargal, ore medaiyil pirasaaram seyvadhu, andha aniyin otrumaiyai vaakkaalargalidam velippaduthum.
Indha podhukkoottangal, arasiyal reedhiyaagavum kavanam perum. Mudhalvar Vijay-in pirasaarathai makkal edhirbaarppar. Avar mudhalvaraanadhum nammai thedi varugiraaraa endra edhirbaarppu makkalidam irukkum.
Enave, mudhalvar Vijay, koottani katchigalin thalaivargalodu inaindhu pirasaaram seyvadhu, idaitherdhal vetriyai elidhaakkum. Ivvaaru avargal koorinar.

headline: DMK ilainjarani maanaattil kuvaattar paattil viniyogikkappattadhaa?
text:
‘‘DMK ilainjarani maanaattil kuvaattar paattil viniyogikkappattadhu,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ kuvaattar paattil.! DMK ilainjarani maanaattil ovvoru irukkaiyilum ”Quarter Bottle” vaithu ilainjargalai thavaraaga vazhinadathum DMK-vinar,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Mudhalil naam DMK aidi., pirivu tharappil vilakkam kettavodhu, ‘’idhu edit seyyappatta pugaippadam, unmaiyaanadhalla,’’ endru therivithanar.
Melum, unmaiyaana pugaippadathin lingk namakku kodukkappattadhu. Adhil vendumendre kuvaattar paattil padathai serthu, edit seythullanar, endru thelivaagiradhu.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadam edit seyyappattadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Karoor vivagaarathil DMK sadhi endru vigadan plas seythi veliyittadhaa?
text:
‘‘karoor vivagaarathil DMK sadhi’’, endru koori,

idhil ‘’ karoor 41, mudhalaam aandu ninaivu; sadhi seytha DMK, maattik konda TVK, vigadan plas,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Vigadan plas logo ulladhaal, palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, vigadan plas peyaril paravum poliyaana postar idhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Merkanda attaippadathil 4.10.2026 endru thedhi kurippidappattulladhu. Andha thedhiyinbadi thagaval thediyavodhu, namakku kidaitha padam verondraaga irundhadhu. Adhil, SIR matrum therdhal aanaiyam patriya kaarttoon idambetrulladhu.
Unmaiyaana padathaiyum, naam aayvu seyyum padathaiyum oppeedu seythu, keezhe inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda attaippadam poliyaanadhu, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Kaalai unavuth thittam virivaakkam.. Thodangi vaithaar mudhalvar Vijay!!
text:
5-m vaguppu varai arasup palliyil payilum maanavargalukku, oottachathulla unavalikkum vagaiyil, kaalai unavuth thittathai kadandha 2022-m aandu, appodhaiya mudhalvar mu.ka. Stalin konduvandhaar. Pinnar, ithittam arasu udhavi perum palli maanavargalukkum virivuvaduthappattirundhadhu. Indhath thittathirku mundhaiya DMK arasil ”mudhalamaichar kaalai unavuth thittam” ena peyar vaikkappattirundhadhu.
Innilaiyil, 2026 sattapperavaiyil vendru aatchikku vandhulla mudhalvar Vijay thalaimaiyilaana arasu, indhath thittathai 8 vaguppu varai virivuvaduthappadum ena therivithirundhadhu.
Adhanbadi, virivuvaduthappatta kaalai unavuth thittathai mudhalvar Vijay indru kaalai, Chennai thiruvaanmiyooril ulla oru arasu palliyil thodangi vaithullaar. Perundhalaivar kaamaraajar kaalai unavuth thittam enap peyar maatrappattulla ithittathin moolam, thamizhagam muzhuvadhu 15.30 latcham maanavargal payan peruvaargal ena arasu saarbil therivikkappattulladhu.
Munnadhaaga, maanavargalukku unavu parimaari thittathai thodangi vaitha mudhalvar Vijay, avargaludan amarndhu unavarundhinaar.

headline: Madurai: palli maanavan irappu vivagaarathil needhi kettu poraadiyavargal meedhu 7 pirivugalil vazhakku padhivu!
text:
Palli maanavan thamizhselvan irappirku needhi kettu Madurai aatchiyar aluvalagathai mutrugaiyitta poraadiyavargal meedhu 7 pirivugalin keezh kaavaldhuraiyinar vazhakku padhivu seythiruppadhu adhirchiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.
Madurai aanaiyoor koodalbudhoor vaanavil theru pagudhiyai serndhavar 11-m vaguppu palli maanavan thamizhchelvan. Ivar kadandha vaaram mutbudhar kuttai ondril irandha nilaiyil sadalamaaga meetkappattaar. Idhu thodarbaaga kaavaldhuraiyinar sandhega maranam endra pirivin keezh vazhakku padhivu seythu visaaranai nadathi varum nilaiyil palli maanavan thamizhchelvan maranathai kolai vazhakkaaga maatra vendum, visaaranai adhigaariyai udanadiyaaga maatra vendum, visaaranaiyai thuridhappaduthi kutravaaligalai kaidhu seyya vendum ena kori oru vaaramaaga avaradhu udalai vaanga maruthu avaradhu kudumbathinar poraattam nadathi varugindranar.
Innilaiyil netru palli maanavan thamizhselvanukku needhi kettu Madurai aatchiyar aluvalagathai mutrugaiyittu Indhiya maanavar sangathinar poraattam nadatha muyandradhaal kaavaldhuraiyinar avargalai thaduthu niruthi Madurai maavatta aatchiyar aluvalagam nuzhaivu vaayil kadhavinai poottiya nilaiyil
avvamaippai serndha ilainjargal poottappattirundha kadhavugal meedhu eri kudhithu aatchiyar aluvalagathukkul saramaariyaaga odi vandhadhaal paravarappaana soozhal erpattadhu.
Idhaiyaduthu thunai aanaiyar kaarthik thalaimaiyil kaavaldhuraiyinar pechuvaarthai nadathiyavodhum kalaindhu sellaadha nilaiyil poraattathil eeduvattavargalai kaavaldhuraiyinar valukkattaayamaaga kaidhu seythu izhuthus sendranar.
Idhanaal kaavaldhuraiyinarukkum ilainjargalukkum idaiye thallumullu erpattadhu.
Melum aatchiyar aluvalagam valaagathirkul amarndhu needhi vendum engira koshangalai ezhuppi poraattathil eeduvattavargalidaiye kaavaldhuraiyinar pechuvaarthai nadathiyum avargal kalaindhu sellaadhadhaal kaavaldhuraiyinar poraattathil eeduvattavargalin kai,kaalgalai pidithu thookki sendru perundhugalil etri kaidhu seythu azhaithu sendranar.
Kaidhu nadavadikkaiyin podhu kaavaldhuraiyinarukkum poraattakkaarargalukkum kadum thallumullum vaakkuvaadhamum erpattadhu.
Kaidhu seytha 52 peraiyum thaniyaar mandavathil adaitha vaitha Police avargal meedhu 7 pirivugalil vazhakku padhivu seytha thallaakkulam kaaval nilaiya Police moondru naatkal neril aajaraaga vendumena samman anuppiyulladhu sarchaiyai erpaduthiyulladhu.

headline: Tamil Naattil palligal thirakkum thedhi joon 9kku maatrappattadhaa?
text:
Tamil Naattil 1 mudhal 12m vaguppu varaiyilaana vaguppugal kodai vidumuraikkup piragu joon 9m thedhi thirakkum endru pallik kalvith thurai amaichar anbil magesh arivithadhaaga oru news card

san news veliyittadhu pondru news card Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Adhil, “joon 2 thedhi palligal thirappu kidaiyaadhu! 1 mudhal 12m vaguppu palligal thirappu joon-9 thedhi magizhchi thagaval. Anbil magesh adhiradi arivippu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha news card-ai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Naattil kodai vidumuraikkup piragu palligal joon 2m thedhi thirakkappadum endru arivikkappattirundhadhu. Kodai veppam migudhiyaaga irundhaal palligal thirakkappadum thedhi thalli vaikkappadum. Aanaal, Thamizhagathil paravalaaga megamoottathudanum, sila idangalil mazhaiyum peythu varuvadhaal 2025m aandigal palligal thirakkappaduvadhu thallippoga vaayppillai.
Indha nilaiyil palligal joon 9m thedhi thirakkappadum endru samooga oodagangalil silar padhivittu varugindranar. Paarkka indha news card san TV veliyittadhu pola illai. Tamil Nadu arasu tharappilirundhu arivippum veliyaagavillai. Aanaal, samooga oodagangalil mattum indha thagaval viral-aaga pagirappattu varave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha news card san TV veliyittadhu pola illai. Enave, idhu thodarbaaga san news digital pirivu poruppaalarukku indha news card-ai anuppinom. Avarum idhu poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seythaar.
Aduthadhaaga palli thirappu thodarbaaga pallik kalvith thurai tharappil arivippu veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu Tamil Nadu arasin unmai kandariyum pirivu veliyittirundha X thala padhivu namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil, “thamizhnaattil palligal joon 9m thedhi thirappadhaaga parappappadum vadhandhi” endru kurippittirundhanar.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu joon 2m thedhi palligalaith thirakka vazhigaattu nerimuraigalaip pallik kalvith thurai veliyittiruppadhaagas seythigal namakkuk kidaithana. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda news card matrum thagaval thavaraanadhu enbadhai urudhi seythana.

headline: Visaaranaikkaaga vandha navarai Police thaakkiyadhaaga pugaar
text:
Tirunelveli: thiruttu vazhakku visaaranaikkaaga azhaithus sendra andhoni, 28, enbavarai Police thaakkiyadhaaga pugaar ezhundhulladhu.
Tirunelveli maavattam, seranmagaadhevi aruge vallathu nambikkulathais serndha andhoniyai, sep., 8 nalliravu iru Police, visaaranaikkaaga avarai veettil irundhu azhaithus sendranar.
Angulla seyint maikkel sars valaagathukku andhoniyai azhaithuchendru thaakkiyullanar.
Veeravanalloor Police station pinburam ulla pazhaiya kattadathukku, andhoniyai azhaithus sendru pirambaal thaakkinar.
Adhanbin, adhigaalai, 3:30 manikku avarai veettil vittuchendra Police, oor naattaamai thuraiyudan kaalai, Police steshanukku varumaaru therivithu ullanar.
Kaayamadaindha andhoni, Tirunelveli arasu maruthuvamanaiyil anumadhikkappattaar.
Maavatta es.pi., vishvesh saasdhiri koorugaiyil, ''andhoni, visaaranaikkaaga steshanukku azhaithu varappadavillai.
''andhoni vaakkumoolam padhivu seyyappattu, Police meedhaana kutrachaattu, avarukku edhiraana vazhakkugal kurithu visaaranai nadathappadum,'' endraar.

headline: Indhu kovilil irundhu roo.445 kodi vasoolithu masoodhi, sarchugalukku vazhangiyadhaa DMK arasu?
text:
Indhu kovilgalilirundhu roo.445 kodi panathai vasoolithu adhil 330 kodiyai masoodhi, thevaalayam katta kodutha DMK arasu endru oru padhivu

thinamalar naalidhazh veliyitta seythiyai sgireenshaat eduthu yaaro oruvar veliyitta padhivai meendum sgireenshaat eduthu Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Andha seythiyil, “koyilgalil irundhu roo.445 kodi vari vasool roo.330 kodi masoodhi, sarchugalukku vaari vazhangal” endru thalaippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “445 kodi koyil undiyal panathai sarchu masoodhi kattuvadharku nidhi alithiyulladhu DMK arasu😡 pallaayiram kodi
koyil undil panam enge pogudhu…? Neengal undiyalil podum panamdhaan, Tamil Naattin vazhivaattaiyum, koyilgalaiyum azhithuk kondirukkiradhu enbadhu ungal ethanai perukku theriyum…?
Thayavu seythu koyil undiyalil panam poda vendaam ..🙏 enendraal neengal koyil undiyalil podum panam neradiyaaga thiruttu thiraavida kumbalukku pogiradhu, koyilil poojai seyyum arsagarin thattil panathai podunga thayavuseythu… oru poosaariyaal oru koyil azhindhadhaaga varalaaru illai, avar thattil podum panam andha koyilai sirappaaga paarthukkolla ookkuvikkum, poosaarikku varumaanam adhigarithaal, koyilai nandraaga paarthuk kolvaan, kovilin meedhaana akkarai koodum, kovilai endha soozhalilum vittuk kodukka maattaan, kovilai kattiyadhu nam thamizh munnorgal thaan, aanaal adhai poojai seythu paadhugaathu varuvadhu poosaarigal thaan, DMK aatchikku vandha piragu aranilai thurai meetta koyilgal ethanai …? Seeramaitha koyilgal ethanai, onnum illa, aanaal nam kan munne ethanai veediyokkalai naam kaangirom nam thamizh koyilgal idikkappaduvadhai… nam koyilai izhappadhu enbadhu, nam valadhu kaal kaiyai izhappadharku samam…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
investigation_details:
Thamizh naadu patjet maars 14, 2025 andru thaan thaakkal seyyappadave ulladhu. Adharkullaaga edhan adippadaiyil Tamil Nadu arasu kovilgalilirundhu variyaagap petra panathai masoodhi, sars katta odhukkiyadhu endru theriyavillaiye endru kuzhappam erpattadhu. Oruvelai 2024l ippadi edhenum arivippu veliyaagi ulladhaa endru therindhugolla aayvukku eduthuk kondom.
Andha sgireenshaattil ulla thalaippai appadiye taip seythu thediya podhu, adhu thodarbaaga endha seythiyum namakku kidaikkavillai. Andha seythiyai satru peridhu seythu paartha podhu, “karnaadagaavil mudhalvar sitharaamaiyaa thalaimaiyil Congress aatchi nadakkiradhu. Indha aatchi indhukkalukku edhiraaga seyalbaduvadhaaga paaja thodarndhu kutram saatti varugiradhu. Idhai urudhi seyvadhu pol, indhu koyilgalukku sitharaamaiyaa arasu pudhu vari vidhithulladhu” endru irundhadhu.
Idhan moolam indha seythi thamizhnaattais saarndhadhadhu illai enbadhu thelivaanadhu. Karnaadagaa thodarbaana seythiyai eduthu Tamil Naattil DMK arasu kovil panathai veru madhathinar membaattukkaaga selavazhithadhu endru thavaraana seythiyaip parappiyiruppadhu thelivaanadhu.
Thodarndhu andha paditha podhu “roo.25 latcham mudhal roo.1 kodi varai varumaanam ulla kovilgalukku 5 sadhavigidhamum, oru kodikku mel varumaanam varum kovilgalukku 10 sadhavigidhamum vari vidhikka masodho kondu varappattadhu. Aanaal, idharku kaiyezhuthida aalunar maruthuvittaar” endru kurippittanar.
Adharku adutha pathiye kuzhappum vagaiyil kadandha oraandil mattum koyilgalukku vidhikkappatta vari moolam roo.445 kodi kidaithulladhu. Idhilirundhu siruvaanmaiyinar niruvanangalukku roo.330 kodi selavu seyyappattadhu. Vakp sothu membaattukku roo.100 kodi, pengaloor haj payanukkaaga roo.10 kodi, yaathirigar thangum idathukkaaga roo.10 kodi kirisdhavar samoogathukkaaga roo.200 kodi vazhangappattadhu endru thagaval ariyum urimais sattathin keezh sienen news channel petru ambalappaduthiyulladhu” endru kurippittirundhanar.
Pudhidhaaga vari vidhikka masodhaa kondu vandhaargal endraal eppadi adharkullaaga vari vasoolithaargal endru kelvi ezhundhadhu. Masodhaavukku aalunar kaiyezhuthida maruthuvitta soozhalil eppadi oraandukku munbaaga irundhu vari vasoolithaargal endra kelviyum ezhundhadhu. Melum muzhukka muzhukka oru tharappinarai thoondi vidum vagaiyileye seythi ezhudhappattirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga thodarndhu aayvu seythom.
Appodhu idhu thodarbaaga karnaadaga indhu samaya aranilaiyath thurai amaichar thinesh kundu raav alitha padhil ondru namakkuk kidaithadhu. Adhil, “unmaiyil BJP thaan indhu virodha katchi. Idhu pudhidhaaga konduvarappadum vari masodhaa illai. Thirutham mattume. Tharpodhu 25 latcham roovaaykku adhigamaaga varumaanam perum kovilgalukku 10 sadhavigidha vari ulladhu. Kadandha BJP aatchiyilum indha vari vasoolikkappattadhu. Tharpodhu adhai oru kodi varai vari varuvaay ulla kovilgalukku 5 sadhavigidhamaaga kuraithullom. Unmaiyil siriya kovilgalukku naangal nanmaiye seythullom” endru koorinaar. Melum indha vari varuvaay moolam kidaikkum panathaik kondu si kiredu nilaiyil ulla eraalamaana siriya kovilgalukku udhavigal seyya ullom. Idhai BJP thadukkiradhu” endru kooriyirundhaar.
Tamil Naattil pazhamaiyaana koyil paraamarippukku endru kadandha patjettil Tamil Nadu arasu roo.100 kodi odhukkiyadhu. Adhe pol pazhamaiyaana masoodhi, thevaalayam punaramaippukku thalaa roo.10 kodi odhukkiyadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhil indhu kovilgalukku Tamil Nadu arasu ondrume seyyavillai endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Aanaal, 2024-25 patjettil DMK arasu poruppetra moondru aandugalil 1290 kovilgalukkuk kudamuzhukku seyyappattulladhu. Naal muzhuvadhum annadhaanam vazhangum thittam 11 kovilgalil nadaimuraippaduthappattu varugiradhu. 6071 ekkar nilam, 2534 latcham sadhura adi manaigalum, 504 latcham sadhura adi kattidangalum meetkappattulladhu. 143 kovil thirukkulangalais seeramaikka 84 kodi selavidappattadhu endrellaam kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Variyai kuraithaargalaa, koottinaargalaa enbadhu patriya aayvukkul naam sellavillai. Indha vari vidhippu varuvaay, pira madhathinarukku odhukkiyadhu ellaam Tamil Naattil, DMK aatchiyil nadandhadhaa endru mattum aayvu seythom. Nammudaiya aayvil indha seythi karnaadagathai serndhadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu. Idhan moolam naam aayvukku eduthuk konda padhivu vishamathanamaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil indhu kovilgalil irundhu roo.445 kodi panathai vasoolithu adhil 330 kodiyai masoodhi, thevaalayam katta kodutha DMK arasu endru paravum thagaval thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Padipparai: taattoo - saridhaa jo
text:
Verum kaatchigalaaga mattum vivarikkaamal, kanavin adippadai, taattoovin varalaaru enap pala mukkiya vishayangalaip pesugiradhu indha nool
nool: taattoo
aasiriyar: saridhaa jo
veliyeedu: aalaa padhippagam, 171/5, indhu nagar, pazhaiya paalaiyam, merinaa hottal edhiril, Erode – 638 012.
Tholaivesi: 99407 16606.
Vilai: roo.180
pakkangal: 144
manidhagulam andraadam edhirgollum, adhenerathil podhuveliyil pesath thayangum oru mukkiyamaana pirasnaidhaan indha naavalin maiyap porul. Andhath thadaiyai udaikkavendiya avasiyathai elimaiyaana, unarvuvoorvamaana kaatchigalaaga vivarikkiraar ezhuthaalar saridhaa jo. `ilaiyor naaval’ endra azhuthamaana uva thalaippu naavalai kavanamgolla vaikkiradhu.
`kaadu than kangalaik kasakkikkondirundhadhu’ engira mudhal variye nammaik kaiyaip pidithu izhuthu kadhaikkul utkaaravaithuvidugiradhu. Maayaa kalloori maanavi. Kanavu kaangiraal. Kaadu. Sutri eriyum thee. Naduvil maattikkondu thavikkiraal. Innoru kanavil kadalil thathalikkum maayaavaith thimingilangal soozhndhugolgindrana. Matroru kanavil paalaivanam. Kadum veppam. Thondaiyai varattum thaagam. Adhodu manalilirundhu ezhum poodhangal avalai virattugindrana. Neruppai umizhndhavadi avalai vizhungath thudikkum tiraagan, udalai irukkum paambu… ippadik kanavugal.
Maayaavin ammaavum appaavum avalai mananala maruthuvar paaminiyidam azhaithup pogiraargal. Paamini, thangai arshaa, than thozhigal aagiyorin udhaviyudan achamoottum kanavugalukkaana kaaranathai maayaa eppadik kanduvidikkiraal… avatrilirundhu eppadi meendezhugiraal enbadhudhaan kadhai. Paatti, thaathaa, taattoo kalainjar, arshaa, thozhi natchathiraa ena naavalil vandhu pogum athanai manidhargalum manadhil nirkiraargal.
Verum kaatchigalaaga mattum vivarikkaamal, kanavin adippadai, taattoovin varalaaru enap pala mukkiya vishayangalaip pesugiradhu indha nool. `ulaviyalin thandhai’ sikmant firaaydin `thi indarbiratteshan aap tireems’, indraikkum pala mananala maruthuvargalukku vazhigaattiyaaga vilangum puthagam. Andha noolilirundhu ezhuthaalar saridhaa jo kanavugalukkaana kaaranangalai adukkuvadhu aacharyamgolla vaikkiradhu. Adhevola, `aval kangalil irulum oliyum maari maarith therindhana. Adhu, kanavin vedhanaiyaagavum, unarvin velichamaagavum irundhadhu’ ena anaayaasamaaga vandhu vizhugira varigal eerthuvidugindrana. Taattoovaip patris sollumbodhu, `indhak kalai manidhagula varalaatril migap pazhaimaiyaana udal alangaarangalil ondru’ engiraar noolaasiriyar. Ulaga alavil valiyaith thaangikkondu eraalamaanavargal en taattoo pottukkolgiraargal enbadharkaana kaaranathaiyum solgiraar.
Mejikkal riyalisa paaniyil ezhudhappatta indha naaval or ulaviyal payanam. `kanavugal verum kaatchigal alla… nam aazhmanadhin mozhi’ engira sikmant firaaydin kootrukku muzhu niyaayam serkkiradhu indha naaval.

headline: Raajasdhaanil amaikkappattulla thesiya nedunjjaalai endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Raajasdhaan thaar paalaivanathil amaikkappattulla thesiya nedunjjaalai endru oru video

paalaivanathin naduve amaikkappattulla nedunjjaalai ondrin video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “raajasdhaan maanilam thaar paalaivanathil thesiya nedunjjaalai amaikkappattulladhu ..” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Raajasdhaan paalaivanathin naduve Indhiya thesiya nedunjjaalaigal aanaiyam saarbil adhinaveena vasadhigal konda thesiya nedunjjaalai amaikkappattulladhaaga video pagirappattulladhu. Indha thagaval unmaidhaanaa endru endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyai pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu seenaavil amaikkappattadhaaga sila padhivugal namakku kidaithana. Kovaa – mumbai nedunjjaalai endru silar padhivittirundhanar. Veru silar veru sila naadugalaik kurippittum padhivittirundhanar. Idhanaal kuzhappam erpattadhu.
Thodarndhu thediya podhu, jappaanin osaakkaavil ulla China-vin thoodharagathin adhigaarappoorva X thala pakkathil indha video kadandha aagast maadham padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhil, “sinjiyaang uygoor thannaatchi pagudhiyil amaikkappattulla maastarbees kattumaanam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Pala China oodagangalum idhai veliyittirundhana. Indhiya thesiya nedunjjaalaigal aanaiyam indha video-vai veliyidavillai. Ivai ellaam indha video raajasdhaanais saarndhadhu illai enbadhu urudhi seygindrana.

headline: Aapgaanisdhaanil paandavargal, kauravargal vazhivatta sivan koyil idhuvaa?
text:
‘’aapgaanisdhaanil paandavargal, kauravargal vazhivatta pazhamaiyaana sivan koyil’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ aapganil ulla sivan kovil’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seythu varugindranar.
Silar idhe pugaippadathai, koodudhal vivaram serthu, pagirvadhaiyum kandom. ‘’ *kaandhaara thesam”* endrazhaikkavadum aapgaanisdhaanil ulla “Asamai endra malaithodaril ulla sivan koyilin indraiya nilai…ith indrum ulladhu , aanaal inge vazhi paadu illai – kovil aruge ulla kulam indrum ulladhu musleem thesam aagi vittadhaal avargal idhai kandu kolvadhillai. Aanaal saguni , kaandhaari inge thaan pirandhanar. Oru kaalathil panjja paandavargal kauravargal saguni kaandhaari utbada anaivarum vazhivadappatta siva perumaan ivar. Kaandhaara naattu thalai nagar thaan tharpodhu kaandhahaar endra peyaril aapgaanil ulladhu ! Idhan aruge ulla muldhaan endra ooril thaan saguni pirandhaar. Nandri,’’ endra thalaippil kurippitta pugaippadathai parappugiraargal.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha pugaippadathil ulla sivan koyil magaaraashdiraa maanilathil ulladhaaga, theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, magaaraashdiraa maanilathil Harishchandragad Fort pagudhiyil amaindhulla Harishchandreshwar Temple endru theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, kadandha 2021m aandu instaagiraam pakkam ondril pagirappatta pugaippadathai eduthu, aapgaanisdhaanil kaandhahaar pagudhiyil ulla sivan koyil endru thavaraana thagaval parappugiraargal endru, thelivaagiradhu.
Indha koyil thodarbaana pugaippadangal, video niraiya samooga valaidhalangalil kaana kidaikkindrana. Avatril, silavatrai keezhe aadhaarathirkaaga, inaithullom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda pugaippadathil ulla koyil, magaaraashdiraavil amaindhulladhu endrum, idharkum, aapgaanisdhaanukkum endha thodarbum illai endrum, sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline:
“endha ellaikkum selvom..”
kalathil irangum Pakistan?
Thaakkudhalaal paravarakkum valaigudaa!
text:
“endha ellaikkum selvom..” kalathil irangum Pakistan? Thaakkudhalaal paravarakkum valaigudaa!
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar.ra
savoodhi areviyaa endraale islaamiyargalin punidhath thalangalaana makkaa, madheenaa, enney valam, valaigudaa naadugal enap pala vishayangal ninaivukku varum. Aanaal, tharpodhu savoodhi areviyaavais sutri adhigarithu varum paadhugaappu achuruthalgalukku mathiyil, “savoodhi areviyaavukkaaga... Endha ellaikkum selvom!” ena Pakistan raanuvam veliyittulla indha adhiradi arivippu, tharpodhu sarvadhesa alavil kavanam petrulladhu.
Savoodhi areviyaavukkum, yemanil seyalbattu varum havudhi amaippukkum idaiye por padhatram adhigarithu varugiradhu. Sameeva naatkalil savoodhiyai nokki evuganai matrum tron thaakkudhalgal nadathappattu varugiradhu. Islaamiyargalin punidha nagaramaana makkaavaiyum havudhigal tron moolam thaakka muyandradhaagavum, adhanai savoodhi vaan paadhugaappup padaigal idaimarithadhaagavum annaattu adhigaarigal therivithullanar.
Eninum, makkaa alladhu veru endha islaamiyap punidhath thalathaiyum kurivaithu thaakkudhal nadatha muyandradhaagak koorappadum thagavalgalai havudhigal maruthullanar. Innilaiyil, havudhigalukku edhiraana poril udhavumaaru savoodhi areviyaa korikkai viduthirundhadhaagak koorappadugiradhu. Mekkaa oppandhathil inaindhulla thurukkiyum, paagisdhaanum udhava munvaravillai endrum, amerikkaavum indhap poril neradiyaaga eeduvadaamal vilagi irundhadhaagavum thagavalgal veliyaagina.
Indhas soozhalil, savoodhi areviyaavaip paadhugaappadharkaagath thevaiyaana endha ellaikkum sellath thayaaraaga iruppadhaaga Pakistan raanuvam therivithulladhu. Pakistan raanuvathin seythith thodarbaalarum, ISPR thalaimai iyakkunarumaana lepdinant jenaral agamadhu shereep sauthri, annaattu oodagangalukku alitha pettiyil idhanaith therivithullaar.
“raajadhandhira reedhiyaaga mattumalla... Kala reedhiyaagavum savoodhi areviyaavukku Pakistan muzhumaiyaagath thunai nirkiradhu. Savoodhi sagodharargal ketkum matrum thevaippadum endha ellaikkum naangal selvom” ena avar therivithullaar.
Melum, savoodhi areviyaavin paadhugaappukkaana paagisdhaanin arppanippu nivandhanaiyatradhu endrum avar kurippittullaar. Idhanaal, havudhigalukku edhiraana nadavadikkaiyil savoodhi areviyaavukku Pakistan neradiyaaga raanuva udhavi seyyumaa endra kelvigalum ezhundhullana. Idhugurithu pesiya lepdinant jenaral agamadhu shereep sauthri, makkaa matrum madheenaavaik kurippittu, islaamiyargalin punidhath thalangalaiyum savoodhi areviyaavaiyum paadhugaappadharkaana paagisdhaanin urudhi thodarndhu irukkum ena therivithullaar. Savoodhi areviyaavin paadhugaappu thodarbaaga Pakistan ivvalavu valuvaana urudhiyai velippaduthiyiruppadhu, tharpodhu sarvadhesa alavil kavanathai eerthulladhu.

headline: Panjjaap vellathil adithus sellappadum erumai maadugal endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
‘’ panjjaap vellathil adithus sellappadum erumai maadugal,’’ endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ pasumaattai paadhugaakkirom endru muslimgalai adithe kolvaargal aariya paarppana aar es es kaavi indhuthuva theeviravaadha kumbal…
erumai maattaiyo matra pasu maattaiyo vellathil irundhu kaappaatra munvara maattaargal andha sangigal…
panjjaap vellam…,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.
Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, idhu unmaiyaana video kidaiyaadhu endrum, AI thozhilnutbam moolamaaga thayaarikkappatta video endrum, theriyavandhadhu.
Idhanbadi, koogul rivars udhaviyudan thagaval thediyavodhu, @theaiworldofpakistan endra yoodiyup channel indha video-vai mudhanmudhalaaga pagirndhulladhaik kandom. Idhuvondre vellathil maadugal thathalikkum kaatchigal konda eraalamaana video kurippitta yoodiyup senalil veliyidappattullana.
Idhanmoolamaaga, yadhaartha ulagirku saathiyam illaadha kaatchigal konda veediyokkalai AI udhaviyudan thayaarithu, merkanda yoodiyup senalil pagirvadhu vazhakkam, endru thelivaagiradhu. Idhil oru video-vai eduthe, vada India-vil vellathil sikkiya erumai maadugalai pasu paadhugaavalargal matrum aareses kandugollavillai, endru vadhandhi parappugiraargal.
Irudhiyaaga, Sightengine matrum Hive Moderation pondra AI sarivaarppu inaiyadhalangal moolamaaga naam aayvu seyyum video kaatchi unmaiyalla, enbadhai urudhi seythom.
Enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video, AI thozhilnutbam moolamaaga thayaarikkappatta ondru; unmaiyaanadhalla, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Neerizhivu noy| pengalukku mananalam, aangalukku idhaya noy.. Pakkavilaivu echarikkai!
text:
Ingilaandhu kuyin meri palgalaikkazhaga aayvil, taip 2 neerizhivu noyaal paadhikkappatta pengalukku mananalap pirachinaigal 8.1% alavil adhigam iruppadhu kandariyappattulladhu. Kurippaaga ilam pengalil mana azhutham vegamaaga velippaduvadhaal, neerizhivu sigichaiyudan mananala parisodhanaigalaiyum vazhakkamaagas seyya vendum ena aayvu valiyuruthugiradhu; paalinam, vayadhukku etra thanippatta sigichai avasiyam enavum koorugiradhu.
Taip 2 neerizhivu noyaal paadhikkappadum aangalukkum pengalukkum erpadum pakkavilaivugal veruvaduvadhaaga ingilaandhin kuyin meri palgalaikkazhaga aaraaychiyaalargalin pudhiya aayvu therivikkiradhu. 28,000kkum merpattorin maruthuvak kurippugalai aayvu seythadhil, neerizhivu noykkup piragu pengalukku mananalap paadhippugal adhigamaaga, adhaavadhu 8 pulli oru sadhaveedham erpaduvadhu kandariyappattulladhu. Kurippaaga ilam vayadhu pengalukku mana azhuthap paadhippugal viraivaaga velippaduvadhaal, neerizhivu noyaaligalukku vazhakkamaana mananala parisodhanaigal avasiyam ena aayvaalargal parindhuraikkindranar.
Adhevelaiyil, aangalukku idhaya noygal 8 pulli 4 sadhaveedham erpada vaayppulladhu kandariyappattulladhu. Melum, siruneeragak kolaarugal matrum uyar ratha azhutham pondra paadhippugal pengalukku munbaagave aangalukku erpadugindrana. Neerizhivu noyudan mananalap paadhippum serumbodhu, aan-pen iruvaalarukkum kuraindha vayadhileye uyirizhappu erpadum avaayam adhigarikkiradhu. Enave, paalinam matrum vayadhukku erpa thanithuvamaana sigichai muraigalai vazhanga vendiyadhu avasiyam ena indha aayvu valiyuruthugiradhu.

headline: Paatnaavil paajaga-vukku edhiraaga makkal poraattam endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Peegaaril muraigedu seythu vetri petra paajaga-vukku edhiraaga makkal poraattathil eeduvattulladhaaga oru video

saalaiyil aayirakkanakkaanor peraniyaaga sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil. “vaakkaalar pattiyalil peyar neekkam seythadhu. Uyirodu irukkum pozhudhe irandhu vittadhaaga pattiyalil serthadhu. 70,000 islaamiyargal peyarai 20 thogudhigalil irundhu neekkiyadhu. Peegaar maanilathirku sambandhamillaadha sumaar moondru latcham perai vaakku pattiyalil serthadhu. Vaakku selutha vandha thalith makkalaiyum islaamiya siruvaanmaiyinaraiyum thaakkiyadhu. Anaithirkum melaaga vaakkuppadhivu iyandhirathai maatriyadhu vaakku ennikkai maiyathirkul nuzhaindhu anaivaraiyum veliyetriyadhu. Pondra theeya seyalgalil eeduvattu aatchiyaip piditha BJP-virku edhiraaga peegaar maanilam thalainagar paatnaavil periya makkal poraattam vedithadhu” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Peegaar sattamandra therdhalil BJP muraigedu seythu vetri petradhaaga samooga oodagangalil palarum padhivittu varugindranar. Indha muraigettais seytha paajaga-vai edhirthu peegaar thalainagar paatnaavil makkal poraattam vedithadhu endru palarum video-vai padhivittu varugindranar. Andha video-vil isaik kuzhu ondru selvadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Kalavaram seybavargal isaikkuzhuvodu selvaargalaa endra kelvi ezhave, idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Kadandha sila naatkalaaga andha video-vai palarum padhivittirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Kujaraathi mozhiyil pala padhivugal veliyaagi irundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Oru silar peegaaril vaakkuth thiruttukku edhiraaga endrum kurippittu padhivittirundhanar. Idhanaal, kuzhappam adhigarithadhu.
Oru video padhivil “Jai Bajrang Band, At Netrang 15/11/2025. MLA Chaitar Vasva” idhu patrith thedinom. Netrang (nethraang) enbadhu kujaraathil irukkum oru oor enbadhumMLA Chaitar Vasava enbavar kujaraathin aamaathmi katchi em.el.e-endrum theriyavandhadhu. Thodarndhu thediya podhu saidhar vaasvaa sameevathil pirsaa mundaa endra aadhivaasi ina thalaivarin 150 aandu vizhaavaik kondaadinaar endrum idhil latchakkanakkaana makkal kalandhugondaargal endrum seythigal kidaithana.
Nethraang endra oorin koogul mep street viyoo kidaikkiradhaa endru paarthom. Andha oorin street viyoo namakku kidaithadhu. Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil ulla idangal othuppogiradhaa endru thedip paarthom. Appodhu irandu veediyovilum ulla kattidangal, migapperiya kodik kambam ena palarum othuppoyina. Idhan moolam indha video nethraang endra kujaraathin nagaril edukkappattadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
Namakku samooga oodagangalil pala nalla thelivaana veediyokkalum kidaithana. Avatraip paarkkum podhu pirsaa mundaavin pugaippadathudan penargal irundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Idhan moolam peegaar thalainagar paatnaavil paajaga-vukku edhiraaga peraattathil eeduvatta makkal endru paravum video thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Apple-n pudhiya thittam.. Malivu vilaiyil arimugamaagum aivon, mekbuk!
text:
Indha aandu aappil niruvanam 5 mukkiya thayaarippugalai arimugappaduthum endru edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Edhirbaarkkappadum veliyeedugalil aivon 17e, pudhuppikkappatta mekbuk pro matrum sameevathiya aappil silikkaan moolam iyakkappadum mekbuk er maadalgal adangum.
1.aivon 17e
kadandha aandu arimugappaduthappatta aivon 16e in thodarchiyaaga aivon 17e irukkum. Idhu aivon 17 thodaril migavum malivu vilaiyil kidaikkum aivonaaga irukkum endru edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Melum aivon 17e A19 sipset matrum meksep saarjing vasadhiyudan veliyaagum
2. Mekbuk pro
pudhiya mekbuk pro maadalgal pudhiya M5 pro matrum M5 meks sipgaludan pudhuppikkappatta mekbuk pro madikkaninigalai aappil veliyida irukkiradhu . Kadandha aandu M5 mekbuk provai arimugappaduthiyadhu. M5 pro matrum M5 meks saadhanangal adhe vadivamaippaith thakkavaithukkollum endru edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu.
Malivu vilaiyil mekbuk
ilainjargalai kavarum vagaiyil malivu vilaiyil mekbuk matrum M4 sip konda aivet er maadalgalum indha varisaiyil idamberalaam endru edhirbaarkkappadugiradhu. Aappil indelijens vasadhigalukku mukkiyathuvam alikkum vagaiyil vadivamaikkappattulla indhath thayaarippugal, thozhilnutba sandhaiyil perum edhirbaarppai erpaduthiyullana.

headline: “kalavarathai thoondiya ulavaaligalaik kaidhu seytha eeraan” endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Eeraanukkul ulavu paarthu kalavarathaith thoondivitta ulavaaligalai Iran kudiyarasup padai kaidhu seythu azhaithu sendradhu endru oru pugaippadam

thalaiyil saakkuppai pottu maraithu silaraik katti azhaithus sellum pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “ee+raa+ni+l aakkiramippu pagudhiyilirundhu vandhu thiruttu thanamaaga ulavu paarthu kalavarathai seytha kodiyavargalai ee+raa+ni+ya kudiyarasuppadai kaidhu seythu podhumakkal mathiyil oorvalamaaga azhaithu sendranar” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivaip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Iran-il tharpodhu nigazhndhu varum poraattangalaith thoondivittadhaaga ulavaaligal silarai Iran paadhugaappup padai kaidhu seythadhaaga pugaippadam ondraip palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar. Indha seythi matrum pugaippadam unmaiyaa endru ariya aayvu seythom.
Indha pugaippadathai koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. 2016m aandil indha pugaippadathai pala seythi oodagangalum veliyittirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Kittathatta 10 aandu pazhaiya pugaippadathai eduthu thavaraaga pagirndhiruppadhu theriyavandhadhu.
Indha pugaippadam thodarbaaga andha oodagangalil enna kurippittullaargal endru paarthom. 2016m aandu janavari maadham Iran-in islaamik revalyooshanari card kaarps (Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy) America kadarpadai maalumigalai siraividithanar. Andha aandu Iran thalainagar thehraanil nadandha Iran puratchiyin 37vadhu aandu vizhaa peraniyin podhu America maalumigalai siraividitha kaatchiyai paadhugaappup padai veerargal nadithuk kaattinar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha pugaippadathai evi sarvadhesa oodaga niruvanam veliyittirundhadhaaga adhil kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhan adippadaiyil evi inaiyadhala pakkathilirundhu indha pugaippadathaith thedi eduthom. Adhilum indha pugaippadam 2016m aandu pipravari maadham edukkappattadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhan moolam eeraanukkul ulavu paartha ulavaaligal kaidhu seyyappattu azhaithus sellappadugiraar endru paravum pugaippadam thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.

headline: TASMAC vivagaaram: aagaash paasgaranukku uchaneedhimandrathil pinnadaivu? Enna nadandhadhu?
text:
TASMAC muraigedu vazhakkil, amalaakkathurai sodhanaiyai sattavirodham ena challenging seytha aagaash paasgaranin manuvai Chennai Uyarneedhimandram niraagarithu, avar amalaakkathurai melmuraiyeettu theerppaayathai anugalaam ena utharavittadhu. Indha utharavukku edhiraaga avar thaakkal seytha melmuraiyeettai Uchaneedhimandram visaaranaikku erka maruthadhaal, aagaash paasgaranukku sattareedhiyaana pinnadaivu erpattulladhu.
TASMAC muraigedu vazhakkil amalaakkathurai melmuraiyeettu theerppaayathai anuga utharavittadhai edhirthu thiraippada thayaarippaalar aagaash paasgaran thaakkal seytha melmuraiyeettu manuvai visaaranaikku erka Uchaneedhimandram maruppu therivithulladhu. TASMAC muraigedu thodarbaaga, sinimaa thayaarippaalar aagaash paasgaran matrum thozhiladhivar vikram raveendhiran aagiyorukku sondhamaana idangalil kadandha 2025 me maadham sodhanai nadathiya amalaakkath thurai, aagaash paasgaranidam irundhu pala aavanangalai parimudhal seythadhu.
Amalaakkath thuraiyin indha sodhanaiyai sattavirodhamaanadhu ena arivikkak kori aagaash paasgaran saarbil Chennai uyar needhimandrathil manu thaakkal seyyappattadhu. Indha vazhakkai visaaritha Chennai uyar Needhimandram, aagaash paasgaranukku edhiraaga merkondu nadavadikkaigalai edukka amalaakkath thuraikku idaikkaala thadai vidhithirundhadhu. Innilaiyil, Chennai uyar needhimandra utharavai meeri aavanangalai samarppikkak kori amalaakkathurai nottees anuppiyadhaal adharkedhiraaga needhimandra avamadhippu vazhakku thaakkal seyyappattadhu
aanaal, amalaakkathurai saarbil, aavanangal thodarbaaga aagaash paasgaranukku anuppappatta nottees thirumba perappattadhaagavum, vendumaanaal uriya vidhimuraigalai pinbatri pudhidhaaga nottees anuppappadum enavum amalakkathurai Chennai uyarneedhimandrathil therivithadhu. Idhaiyaduthu, amalaakkath thurai nadavadikkaikku edhiraaga aagaash paasgaran thodarndha vazhakkai mudithu vaitha Uyarneedhimandram, aagaash paasgaran thanadhu tharappu vaadhangalai amalakkathurai melmuraiyeettu theerppaayathil munvaikkalaam ena utharavittadhodu indha vazhakkil pirappikkappatta idaikkaala thadaigalai neekkiyadhu.
Indha utharavukku edhiraaga aagaash paasgaran tharappil ucha needhimandrathil melmuraiyeedu seyyappattadhu, andha manu thalaimai needhivadhi soorya kaanth, needhivadhigal jaay maalyaa pak shi,vi.moganaa aagiya adangiya amarvil indru visaaranaikku vandhavodhu, andha manuvai visaaranaikku erka needhivadhigal maruppu therivithanar.

headline: Trichy: sirumiyaip paaliyal vangodumai seytha 4 siruvargal; siruvar seerdhiruthap palliyil serppu
text:
Mananala savaaludaiya sirumiyai naangu siruvargal paaliyal vangodumai seythulla sambavam, adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.
Trichy maanagaram, kaandhi maarkket kaaval nilaiya ellaikkutbatta pagudhiyais serndhavar 16 vayadhu sirumi. Petror iruvarum illaadha nilaiyil avarudaiya uravinar aravanaippil andhas sirumi valarndhu varugiraar.
Andhas sirumi satru mananala savaaludaiyavar enak koorappadugiradhu. Innilaiyil, andhap pagudhiyais serndha palliyil padikkum naangu siruvargal andhas sirumiyai emaatri appagudhiyil kattappattu varum oru kattadathil aatkal illaadha nerathil azhaithus sendru sirumikkup paaliyal thunburuthal seythullanar. Adikkadi avargal avvaaru seythulladhaagak koorappadugiradhu.
Indha nilaiyil netru andhas sirumi udal nalam sariyillaamal irundhadhaik kandu andhas sirumaiyil sithi, idhu kurithu visaarithullaar. Appozhudhu, andhas sirumi nadandhavatrai therivithullaar. Udanadiyaaga, andhas sirumiyai Trichy magaathmaa kaandhi ninaivu arasu maruthuvamanaiyil sigichaikkaaga anumadhithanar.
Thodarndhu, avargal kottai anaithu magalir kaaval nilaiyathil ichambavam kurithu pugaar alithanar. Pugaarin peril visaaranai seytha poleesaar naangu siruvargalaiyum kaidhu seythu siruvar seerdhiruthap palliyil adaithullanar.
Sirumiyaip paaliyal vangodumai seytha naangu siruvargal kaidhaagiyulla sambavam, adhirchiyai erpaduthiyirukkiradhu.

headline: Karuppu kaayin vaithu keram vilaiyaadiya Stalin endru paravum pugaippadam unmaiyaa?
text:
Keram vilaiyaattil stiraikkarukku padhil karuppu kaayinai vaithu Stalin vilaiyaadiyadhu pondru oru pugaippadam

Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin keram vilaiyaadiyadhu thodarbaaga veliyaana seythiyin sgireenshaattai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Nilaith thagavalil, “oru lakkanathil onbadhu kiragamum ucham petra oruvan staraikkarilum keram aadalaam black coin nilum aadalaam” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha padhivai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Tamil Nadu mudhalamaichar M.K. Stalin keram vilaiyaattil stiraikkaraip payanbaduthuvadharku padhil karuppu kaayinai vaithu matroru karuppu kaayinai adithadhu pondru pugaippadam Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Indha siriya vishayam kooda theriyaamal keram vilaiyaada vandhuvittaar enbadhu pondru staalinai naiyaandi seythu padhividappattulladhu. Aanaal, video-vai veliyidavillai. Enave, sandhegathin adippadaiyil indha pugaippadam thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Thiruchiyil anbu solai thirakkappatta podhu indha seythi veliyaagi irundhadhu. Enave, Polimer tivi-yil idhu thodarbaaga veliyaana video-vai thedi eduthom. Adhil karuppu kaayinai eduthu vilaiyaadiyadhu pola illai.
Polimer mattumindri matra oodagangalil veliyaana veediyokkalaiyum aadhaaramaaga vaithullom. Avar stiraikkarai vaithu vilaiyaaduvadhu video-vil thelivaagath therigiradhu. Indha video kaatchiyai eduthu, edit seythu karuppu kaayinai vaithu poliyaana pugaippadathai uruvaakkiyiruppadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Idhan adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Azhage un vilai enna! Thaninavar paraamarippu thuraiyil mudhaleettukkaana uthigal
text:
India-vil thaninavar varumaanam adhigarithu varuvadhaal, athiyaavasiya porutkalai thaandi, pireemiyam matrum thaninavar paraamarippu porutkalukkaana selavum adhigarithu varugiradhu. Kurippaaga, jensi thalaimuraiyin maarivarum nugarvu pazhakkam, pudhiya piraandugalukku valarchi vaayppaiyum, paarambariya ep.em.si.ji., niruvanangalukku pottiyaiyum uruvaakkiyulladhu.
Thaninavar paraamarippu porutkal thurais saarndha niruvana pangugalin edhirgaalam kurithu, 'eksis' niruvanathin risars analist aar.naresh therivithadhaavadhu:
tharpodhu tharam, piraandu matrum thanithuvamaana thayaarippugalukku nugarvor adhiga mukkiyathuvam alippadhaal, thaninavar paraamarippu thuraiyil niruvanangalin valarchi ore maadhiriyaaga illai.
Pudhiya thalaimuraiyai ilakkaaga konda piraandugal vegamaaga valarndhu varum nilaiyil, paarambariya niruvanangal valarchiyai thakkavaikka pudhiya thayaarippugal matrum sandhaippaduthal uthigalil kavanam seluthi varugindrana.
Indha thuraiyil mudhaleettaalargal virpanai valarchiyai mattumindri, piraandin valimai, vilai nirnaya sakdhi matrum pangin tharpodhaiya madhippeedu aagiyavatraiyum kavanikka vendum. Kurippaaga, moolapporutkalin vilai uyarumbodhum thayaarippu vilaiyai uyarthi vaadikkaiyaalargalai thakkavaikkum niruvanangal, laava varambai paadhugaakkum vaayppai perugindrana.
Udhaaranamaaga, 'aalmandu tiraaps' vilai uyarthappattavodhum virpanai alavu 10 sadhaveedham adhigarithiruppadhu, 'pajaaj kansyoomar ker' niruvanathin vilai nirnaya sakdhiyai eduthukkaattugiradhu. Adheneram, vegamaana valarchi konda niruvanangalin pangugal adhiga madhippeettil varthagamaagum soozhalil, edhirbaarkkappadum valarchi matrum pangu vilai aagiyavatrukku idaiyilaana samanilaiyaiyum mudhaleettaalargal kavanikka vendum.
Ivvaaru avar therivithullaar.

headline: CoBRA padaiyin mudhal pen thalavadhi.. Varalaaru padaitha sanjjudhaa paraashar.. Yaar indha irumbup penmani?
text:
Seythiyaalar - raajgumaar .ra
aangal mattume thalaimaip poruppu vagithu vazhinadathi vandha Indhiya paadhugaappup padaiyin mukkiyamaana adhiradip pirivaana CoBRA-vai, ippodhu mudhalmuraiyaaga oru pen adhigaari vazhinadatha irukkiraar. CoBRA padai endraal enna? Indha adhiradip padaiyin thalaimaip poruppai etrulla pen adhigaari yaar? Avaradhu pinnani enna? Idho paarkkalaam...
India-vin naksal edhirppu sirappup padaiyaana CoBRA-vin thalavadhiyaaga niyamikkappattu varalaaru padaithullaar IPS adhigaari sanjjudhaa paraashar. Indhiya risarv Police padaiyaana CRPF-n sirappup pirivaaga 2008-aam aandu uruvaakkappattadhudhaan CoBRA — Commando Battalion for Resolute Action. Adarndha kaadugalil padhungiyirundhu seyalbaduvadhu, kerillaa por muraigalai edhirgolvadhu, vedigundugalai kandarindhu seyalizhakkas seyvadhu, kadinamaana nilapparappugalil nadavadikkaigalai merkolvadhu ena palveru adhiradi nadavadikkaigalukkaaga CoBRA kamaandokkal sirappup payitsi petravargal. Kurippaaga, naksal matrum maavoyist paadhippu adhigam ulla pagudhigalil ulnaattup paadhugaappu nadavadikkaigalil indhap padai mukkiyap pangaatri varugiradhu.
CRPF-in 207-aavadhu CoBRA pattaaliyanin kamaandandaaga sanjjudhaa paraashar poruppetrullaar. Idhanmoolam CoBRA pattaaliyanai vazhinadathum mudhal pen adhigaari endra perumaiyai avar petrullaar. 2006-aam aandu IPS adhigaariyaaga thervaana sanjjudhaa paraashar, asaam–megaalayaa kedarais serndhavar. Kaaval thuraiyil thanadhu panikkaalathil theeviravaadham matrum naksal paadhippu pagudhigalil paniyaatriya anuvavam avarukku ulladhu.
Kadinamaana paadhugaappus soozhalgal niraindha pagudhigalil paniyaatriyadhudan, thesiya pulanaayvu mugamaiyaana NIA-vilum thunai insbekdar jenaral DIG padhaviyil paniyaatriya anuvavam sanjjudhaa paraasharukku ulladhu. Asaamil paniyaatriya kaalathil theeviravaadha edhirppu nadavadikkaigalil avar vagitha pangukkaaga, ’Iron Lady of Assam’ endra adaiyaalathaalum avar ariyappadugiraar. Pengal paadhugaappup padaigalil palveru mukkiyap poruppugalai etru varum nilaiyil, CoBRA pondra sirappup pirivin pattaaliyan kamaandandaaga oru pen adhigaari niyamikkappattiruppadhu, Indhiya paadhugaapputh thuraiyil pengalin adhigarithu varum thalaimaip pangalippai eduthukkaattum nigazhvaaga amaindhulladhu.

headline: Aaru pandhil 6 vikket veezhthiya merkindhiya veerar endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Merkindhiya kirikket veerar josappin thodarndhu veesiya aaru pandhil aaru vikket veezhthinaar endru oru video

aasdhireliyaa – merku Indhiya theevugal anigalukku idaiyeyaana kirikket pottiyil me.i theevugal aniyin shamar josap (Shamar Joseph) thodarndhu aaru pandhugal veesi aaru vikket veezhthiyadhu pondru video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “aasdhireliyaavin aaru vikkettugalai ore ovaril thookki merkindhiya veerar josappin saadhanai…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Ore ovaril aaru vikkettaiyum veezhthiya merku indhiyath theevugal ani veerar shamar josap saadhanai endru kurippittu video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vai paarkka eai moolam uruvaakkappattadhu pondru irundhadhu. Melum. 90 ovar potti endru kurippidappattirundhadhum sandhegathai erpaduthiyadhu. Enave, indha video thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Indha video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lensil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhiruppadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, andha video-kkal thelivaaga irundhana. Unmaiyaana video pol irundhadhaal kuzhappam erpattadhu.
Koogulil, shamar josap, aasdhireliyaa – me.i.theevugal, 6 vikket ena adippadai vaarthaigal silavatrai aangilathil taip seythu thedinom. Appodhu, aasdhireliyaavukku edhiraana pottiyil ezhu vikket veezhthiya josap endru kurippittu idhe video 2024m aandu thodakkathil samooga oodagangalil padhividappattirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Adhan muzhu video-vai staar sborts thannudaiya YouTube pakkathil 2024 janavari 28m thedhi padhivittirundhadhu.
Adhan adippadaiyil thodarndhu thedinom. Appodhu, aasdhireliyaavin pirisbenil 2024m aandu janavari maadham 25 mudhal 28m thedhi varai test potti nadandhadhu. Adhil irandaavadhu inningsin podhu josap ezhu vikket veezhthinaar. Adhai thodarndhu aaru pandhugalil illaamal, pala ovargalil veezhthinaar endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Thodarndhu aaru pandhugalil aaru vikkettai avar veezhthiyadhaaga endha seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaagiradhu.
2024m aandil shamar josap ezhu vikketkalai veezhthiya video-vai eduthu, ore ovaril aaru vikket veezhthiyadhu pondru thagavalai serthu samooga oodagangalil pagirndhiruppadhu idhan moolam urudhiyaagiradhu. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivu thavaraanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: “megavedippin kaatchi” endru paravum video unmaiyaa?
text:
Mega vedippu erpattavodhu padhivu seyyappatta video endru oru padhivu

theru ondril padhivaana sisidivi kaatchi pondru video ondrai Facebook-il padhivittullanar. Adhil, “megavedippu kelvippattiruppeergal. Ippodhu paarungal” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Nilaith thagavalil, “thulithuliyaaya parandhu pozhiyum mazhaineer ondrudhirandu ore idathil kuvindhu pozhindhaal….megavedippu…” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Mega vedippu erpattu aruvi pondru mazhai neer thideerendru kottuvadhu pondru video padhividappattulladhu. Ore idathil kurippitta nerathirkullaaga adhigappadiyaana mazhai pozhivadhai mega vedippu enbaargal. Adhaavadhu arai mani nerathil 5 alladhu 10 se.mee alladhu adharkum mel mazhai pozhivadhai mega vedippu enbaargal. Ippadi megathai kizhithukkondu aruvi pondru thanneer kottumaa endru theriyavillai.
Indha veediyovum paarkka unmaiyaanadhu pola illai. Avvalavu thanneer mele irundhu kottugiradhu. Aanaal, theruvil niruthi vaikkappattirundha irusakkara mottaar vaaganangalil siru asaivu kooda illai. Ivvalavu thanneer kottiyirundhaal mottaar saikkil ellaam adithukkondu sellappattirukkum. Enave, indha video unmaiyaaga irukka vaayppillai enbadhaal idhu thodarbaaga aayvu seythom.
Hivemoderation.com endra eai veediyokkalai kandariya udhavum thalathil indha video-vai padhivetri aayvu seythom. Theruve verichodi irukkum pagudhiyai unmaiyaanadhaaga irukkum endru kanitha andha inaiyathalam, thanneer kottum pagudhi 99.6 sadhavigidham seyarkai nunnarivu moolam uruvaakkappattadhu endru urudhi seythadhu.
Indha video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. 2025 aagast 6, 7 thedhigalukkup piragu idhai adhiga alavil palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, idhai yaar mudhalil veliyittaargal enbadhai kandariya mudiyavillai. Ellaa veediyokkalaiyum paarkkum podhu adhil, instaagiraam aidi ondrai vaattarmaark-aaga vaithirundhadhai kaana mudindhadhu. Kandha_odysseys_vines endru irundhadhu.
Video-vil kurippitta andha kandha_odysseys_vines endra instaagiraam aidi-yai thedi eduthom. Andha instaagiraam pakkathil indha video aagast 5, 2025 andru padhividappattirundhadhu. Adhil, “This is AI-generated + VFX touched fictional content for entertainment purposes only” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Adhaavadhu, eai moolam uruvaakkappattu viepeks moolam sari seyyappatta karpanai kaatchi, pozhudhuvokkukkaaga mattum” endru irundhadhu.
Andha instaagiraam pakkathil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video pondru pala eai moolam uruvaakkappatta kaanoligalum irundhana. Ivai ellaam naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video unmaiyaanadhu illai enbadhai urudhi seythana. Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil mega vedippin unmai kaatchi endru paravum video poliyaanadhu endru urudhi seyyappadugiradhu. Idhu thodarbaaga nammudaiya fekt kirasando malaiyaalathil veliyaana katturaiyai kaana inge kilik seyyungal.
Megavedippu endraal enna?
Oru mani nerathirkul 20 km – 30 km sutralavukkul 10 se.mee. Mazhai peyvadhai, ‘megavedippu‘ nigazhvaaga Indhiya vaanilai aayvu maiyam vagaippaduthugiradhu. Idhu mukkiyamaaga malaippagudhigalil nigazhgiradhu. Enave idhu utharagant, imaachalap piradhesam, ladaak, kaashmeer matrum nevaalathil adhigamaagak kaanappadugiradhu. Idhil, neerin ottam neerootru pola alla. Maaraaga vaanathilirundhu oru thotti vedithu, thanneer miga viraivaaga periya alavil nilathil kottuvadhu pola irukkum.

headline: Mudhiyavarai thaakkum Tamil Nadu arasup perundhu ottunar endru paravum video tharpodhu edukkappattadhaa?
text:

investigation_details:

Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda video 2022m aandu mudhale samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappattu varum ondru, idharkum tharpodhaiya TVK aatchikkum endha sambandhamum illai, endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Indhu kadaigalil porutkal vaangakkoodaadhu endru America muslimgal pirachaaram seythanaraa?
text:
‘’indhu kadaigalil porutkal vaangakkoodaadhu endru America muslimgal pirachaaram’’, endru koori,

idhil, ‘’ *amerikka muslimgal velainirutham seygiraargal…. Kaaygarigalin vilai uyarndhadhaal alla…. Avargal indhu kadaigalil irundhu muslimgal porutkal vaangakkoodaadhu endru rodu rodaaga pirachaaram seygindranar. Viyaavaara laavathil kujaraathi hindhukkal Indhiya indhukkalukku udhava anuppugindranar. Adhu thavirkkappada vendum endru solgiraargal.
Indhukkaludan viyaavaaram seyya vendaam endra vizhippunarvai erpadutha velainirutham seygiraargal…!!!*
*indhukkalaagiya naam nam sondha makkalidam viyaavaaram seygiromaa?*
oru kaalathil indhukkal vaazhum eriyaavil muslimgal vandhu kudiyirukka maattaargal. Adhuvol muslim vaazhum eriyaakkalil indhukkal poy kudi irukkave maattaargal.
Aanaal indru muslimgal indhukkal vaazhum eriyaavil sarvasaadhaaranamaaga veedu vaangugiraargal. Sarva saadhaaranamaaga kadaigal vaithu avargal indhukkalidam viyaavaaram seygindranar. Adharku avargal kovilgalil ulla madha kurukkal / madha sangangal ookkam alithu pana udhavi seygindranar.
Rombave sistamettikkaa avargal seyalbaduthappadugindranar.
Idhai unarungal.
*indhukkale vizhithirungal….*,’’ endru ezhudhappattulladhu.

Palarum idhanai unmai ena nambi, samooga valaidhalangalil share, comment seyvadhaik kaana mudigiradhu.
investigation_details:
Merkanda thagaval unmaiyaa endru naam aayvu merkondom. Appodhu, indha video kadandha 2022m aandu mudhal samooga valaidhalangalil pagirappattu varugiradhu, endru theriyavandhadhu.
Kadandha 2022m aandu paajaga.,vai serndha Nupur Sharma matrum Naveen Kumar Jindal aagiyor mugamadhu navigal patri vimarsanam ondrai mun vaithanar. Idharku sarvadhesa alavil kandanam ezhundhadhu. Idhaiyotti, America-vil ulla sigaago nagaril musleem amaippugal ondruserndhu, poraattam nadathinar. Appodhu, indhuthuvaa karuthukku edhirppu therivithu, padhaagaigalai silar endhivandhanar. Andha video-vai eduthudhaan, tharpodhu thavaraana thagaval serthu, parappugiraargal.
Idhanbadi, indhuthuvaa karuthugalai edhirthu nadaivetra poraatta kaatchiyai eduthu, America-vil ulla indhukkalukkus sondhamaana kadaigalil porul vaangakkoodaadhu endru kori musleemgal poraattam nadathiyadhaaga, vadhandhi parappuvadhu, namakku thelivaagiradhu.
Indha pugaippadathil ulla navardhaan Muslim Mirror oodagam veliyitta seythiyil ulla pugaippadathilum kaanappadugiraar.
Koodudhal seythi aadhaaram idho…
enave, naam aayvukku eduthuk konda thagaval, thavaraanadhu endru sandhegamindri urudhi seyyappadugiradhu.

headline: Pattappagalil sangili parippu endru paravum video Tamil Naattil nadandhadhaa?
text:
Pattappagalil sarva saadhaaranamaagas sangili parippu nadakkiradhu endru oru video

mottaar saikkilil vandha iruvar saalaiyil nadandhu sendru kondirundha pennin kazhuthilirundhu sangiliyai parithus sellum video Facebook-il padhividappattulladhu. Nilaith thagavalil, “pattappagalil sarva saadhaaranamaaga nadakkum sangili parippugal…🤭
pengal koodudhal kavanathudan iruppadhu nalladhu…!” endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Indha video-vai palarum samooga oodagangalil padhivittu varugindranar.
investigation_details:
Saalaiyil sarva saadhaaranamaaga sangili parippu sambavam nadaiveruvadhaal pengal vizhippunarvudan irukka vendum endru samooga poruppudan padhividappattulladhu. Aanaal, indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidappadavillai. Idhanaal, Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru comment pagudhiyil palarum vimarsithu varugindranar. Enave, indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru arindhugolla aayvu seythom.
Video kaatchiyaip pugaippadangalaaga maatri koogul lens thalathil padhivetrith thedinom. Appodhu indha video-vai palarum kadandha oru maadhathukkum melaaga samooga oodagangalil padhivittu vandhirundhadhaik kaana mudindhadhu. Aanaal, yaarum indha sambavam engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidaamale padhivittirundhanar. Ivatrukku idaiye chhatrapati_sambhajinagar_news endra instaagiraam pakkathil indha video thodarbaaga seythi veliyittirundhanar.
Indhiyil irundha padhivai koogul tiraanslettar moolam mozhimaatram seythu paarthom. Appodhu andha padhivu maraathi mozhiyil veliyaagi iruppadhu therindhadhu. Melum adhil ulladhai padithu paarkkum podhu, indha sambavam magaaraashdiraa maanilam avurangaavaath endru azhaikkappatta sathravadhi saambaajinagar maavattathil kaldaa kaarnar (Kalda Corner) endra idathil nadandhadhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu. Idhu thodarbaaga sathravadhi saambaajinagarin usmaanburaa kaavalnilaiyathil vazhakku padhivu seyyappattulladhu endru kurippidappattirundhadhu.
Indha thagaval adippadaiyil veru seythi veliyaagi ulladhaa endru thedip paarthom. Aanaal, namakku endha seythiyum kidaikkavillai. Idhanaal usmaanburaa kaaval nilaiyathirkutbatta kaldaa kaarnar endra pagudhi naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vil ulla pagudhi ulladhaa endru ariya koogul mep street veeyoovai paarthom.
Adhil, naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video-vin pagudhiyaik kandariya mudindhadhu. Oru veettin munbu maattappattirundha sisidivi kemaraa moolam indha video padhivaagiyirundhadhu. Indha veettin valaindha vadivamaippudan koodiya madhil suvar, veettukku edhire ulla madhil suvar matrum angirundha car ulbada palavum koogul street viyoovudan othupponadhu. Idhan moolam indha idam magaaraashdiraavil ulladhudhaan enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu.
Indha aadhaarangal adippadaiyil naam aayvukku eduthukkonda video magaaraashdiraa maanilam avurangaavaath endru azhaikkappatta sathravadhi saambaajinagaril padhivaanadhu enbadhu urudhiyaanadhu. Naam aayvukku eduthukkonda padhivil indha sambavam Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu endru kurippidavillai. Aanaal, engu nadandhadhu endru kurippidaadha kaaranathaal Tamil Naattil nadandhadhu pondru palarum comment seythu varugindranar. Aanaal nammudaiya thedalil indha sambavam magaaraashdiraavil nadandhadhu enbadhu urudhi seyyappattulladhu.
Idhan adippadaiyil muzhumaiyaana thagaval illaadhadhaal thavaraana puridhalai erpaduthum vagaiyil indha padhivu amaindhulladhu enbadhu thelivaagiradhu.
